reviews.author: Tomika28
reviews.title: Second time at Paradisus
reviews.text:
A very honest review. 

This was our second stay at Paradisus Cancun, with our first visit being in March 2023. We enjoyed our first stay enough to return, so I feel I can give a fair and honest comparison.

The first thing I have to say is that this resort is absolutely beautiful. The grounds are stunning and impeccably maintained. Throughout our entire stay, staff were constantly working to keep the landscaping pristine and the property spotless. The resort itself feels luxurious, clean, and very well cared for. Even though many of the common areas are open-air and not air-conditioned, there is usually a nice breeze that keeps things comfortable. I also appreciated the size of the resort—large enough to offer plenty of amenities, but not so large that you feel lost trying to get around.

The renovated rooms are beautiful, especially the bathrooms, which are modern, stylish, and very aesthetically pleasing. My only complaint is the lack of storage space. As a family of four, we found it difficult to unpack and organize our belongings. There are only a few hangers and a couple of drawers available. The previous TV stand with additional storage appears to have been removed, and the room would benefit greatly from having more space for clothing and personal items.

As for the food, I want to be honest. The resort was only about 30% occupied during our stay, so that may have affected the offerings. Unfortunately, the lunch and dinner buffet were disappointing. Variety was limited, and the children's section was especially lacking. Most days, the only options for kids were macaroni and cheese and chicken nuggets, often without even fries. Breakfast, however, was excellent. There was a great selection of fresh fruit, healthy options, and everything always tasted fresh and well prepared.

The restaurants were much better than the buffet. Blue Agave was one of our favorites for dinner—the food was fantastic. Lunch, however, was a different story. The tacos we ordered were not enjoyable, and we barely touched them. Cappella was another standout, with a beautiful atmosphere and very good food. Zesty was also excellent, and our children really enjoyed it.

The poolside grill was consistently one of the best places to eat during our stay. There was always a good variety of casual favorites such as burgers, hot dogs, fries, wings, chicken fingers, and nachos. The food was consistently good, and the gentleman working the grill deserves special recognition for his patience, friendliness, and hard work.

Antonio at the smoothie bar was also wonderful—always attentive, friendly, and pleasant.

My favorite place in the entire resort was the coffee shop. The ice cream was incredible, honestly some of the best we've had at an all-inclusive resort. The flavors were fantastic, and we visited at least twice a day. The coffee was exceptional every single time, which was a huge improvement from our previous visit. The coffee shop itself is adorable and quickly became our favorite spot. A huge thank you to Alejandro (Alex), Norma, Rosalinda, and Perla for their amazing service and for making the best iced cappuccinos every day.

The beach was unfortunately affected by a significant amount of seaweed during our stay. While the resort did clean it a couple of times during our 9-day vacation, the seaweed returned quickly. The smell made the beach less enjoyable, and we only spent time there once or twice. I understand this is largely nature-related and not entirely within the resort's control, but it did impact our experience, but again, of course this isn’t the hotels fault. 

One of the biggest surprises of our trip was the Kids Club. We have traveled throughout Mexico and the Caribbean many times, and I have never left my children at a kids club before. After visiting the Kids Dome, we decided to give it a try. When I returned to pick them up, my children were upset because they wanted to stay longer! That says everything. Maylin and Gipsy were absolutely phenomenal. They were patient, attentive, caring, and genuinely wonderful with the children. They kept the kids busy with activities and made them feel special. Both of these ladies deserve tremendous recognition for the incredible job they do.

Unfortunately, the biggest disappointment of our stay was the entertainment. Having visited many resorts throughout Mexico, I can honestly say this was some of the weakest entertainment we've experienced. The evening shows lacked energy and excitement, and many guests were leaving shortly after they began. We looked forward to the nightly entertainment but were unable to sit through most of the shows during our stay.

The pool entertainment was also very limited. During our 9-day vacation, there were only a couple of days (2) with organized activities around the pool, and even then they were fairly short and underwhelming, no DJ playing music either. If you're looking for a lively resort with music, activities, and engaging entertainment throughout the day and evening, this may not be the best fit for you.

That being said, the staff are truly the heart of this resort. Nearly every employee we encountered was exceptional. They paid attention to details, worked incredibly hard, and provided excellent service throughout the property. The only negative service experience we had was during lunch at Vibra, where the staff seemed uninterested and quite rude. Aside from that, everyone else was wonderful.

Would I return for a third stay? Personally, no.

While the resort is beautiful, luxurious, exceptionally clean, and staffed by some truly amazing people, the food and entertainment simply did not meet our expectations. Overall, I would rate the food around a 5/10. We've experienced much better dining at other resorts in Mexico, including Royalton and RIU properties. Likewise, the entertainment was a major letdown compared to what we've experienced elsewhere.

I would recommend this resort to travelers who value a beautiful property, a relaxing atmosphere, excellent service, and a fantastic Kids Club. However, if entertainment, lively pool activities, and strong food options are priorities for your family, I would encourage you to carefully read reviews and make sure this resort aligns with your vacation style and expectations.

Despite the areas where we felt improvements could be be made, we are grateful for the wonderful staff who helped make our stay enjoyable and for the many great memories we made as a family.

reviews.text:
I went with a group of 7. Initially it was supposed to be 8. I tried called before the trip to change the rooms and was told it would cost more to remove the person. When we arrived they had down a reservation for 9, that make checking in have a few bumps. We stayed in the reserves, which was well worth it. We received a butler Edwardo. He was amazing and we were able to use whatsapp to contact him making it very convenient. 
The staff were all very nice but being primarily English speaking there was a language barrier with many of them. 
Most of the food at many of the restaurants was just okay, but Sal's and Koa were by far the best food at the resort. Drinks were okay. Some bars made amazing drinks, but others were subpar at best. Food was intermittently cold and many of the dishes didn't have a lot of flavor. The mimosa were a bit disappointing. And the wine selection was limited unless you wanted to pay extra. Hours of restaurant were a bit confusing and the only place open past 11 pm was the icecream/ coffee shop (but they put away the icecream at 11, so you only really had espresso late at night). Make sure you arrive at any of the restaurants before 10pm (they close at 11). If you arrive after 10 they will turn you away (so you'll be stuck going to the buffet). 
Overall I would say the place was beautiful and the staff was kind but don't go for the food or drinks. 
Also if you have any issues and try to call it is difficult to get issues resolved over the phone due to the language barrier.

reviews.author: Elizabeth S
reviews.title: A mixed stay at the recently renovated Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Our stay was 8 days after they reopened from their massive year long renovation so we knew going in that there would be some re-opening issues. We also found out that they changed their entire staff over during the reno. My summary would be if you are looking for an adult-only/focused hotel with nightlife or evening entertainment....this is not the resort for you. It is very family friendly and while there is an adult only option which we did not stay in, it did not seem to offer any adult specific entertainment or later night activities which is why we didn't pay up for that option. 
- Check in - didn't get a King room when we asked to check for one, otherwise this was straightforward and we did get a welcome cocktail.
- Room - the room was nice, Junior Sunset Suite but it isn't a suite like the Paradisus in Playa Del Carmen - just a regular hotel room. The room is nice, clean and spacious but we were warm, I set the A/C at 64 and it rarely got below 70 (keep the curtains closed during the day to help!)
- Housekeeping - this was excellent, we texted daily for housekeeping service and extra water and each time it was done prior to us returning from our day at the pool/beach.
- Food/Reservations - this was a mess. No one knew what time the reservation desk was open, a random concierge assisted us with 3 reservations but by Sat (day 3 of our 6 day stay), they changed to a 'walk in only' policy. This was fine for us because by Sun-Mon, the resort was very quiet and were able to walk in to all the restaurants. Overall, the food was fine - the buffet had good options for breakfast, Blue Agave was the stand out for us but Capella and Kao were good as well. 
- Pool/beach - the main pool with the pool bar that connects to the kids area is 5 feet deep...the entire way around which is kind of wild. The pool bar was never very busy but service was good. Beach was nice but both areas it was hard to get a chair the first 4 days, only Monday/Tuesday were seats available (unless you got up at 7am)
- Events - the daytime event team was working really hard and did a good job. Some days missed events (bracelet making) but the guacamole event was great. The evening events were overrun with kids and there really was no adult-only themed entertainment. The Ginger bar was meant to be 18+ after 6 but several nights there were kids in there. Everything closed by 11pm which was disapointing to us. 
All in, this was just not the right property for us and will look to other options.

reviews.author: Mark G
reviews.title: Average Resort - Nothing Special
reviews.text: My family and I stayed at the Paradisus for a family vacation. As soon as we arrived, we weren’t off to a great start. We requested two beds, but they insisted the only had a king size  room available. Apparently they were doing this to a lot of guests when they arrived. After arguing for about 30 minutes, they accommodated us with a double bed room. As well as the other guests. I guess it’s common practice to argue with the guests when they arrive? I don’t see any other why they insisted they didn’t have any double bed rooms available when they clearly did. The pools were really nice, but some tiles were chipping off. Most disappointing about the resort was the food. It was average at best. The à la carte restaurants were not very good apart from the Blue Agave. One night we tried going to the Italian restaurant and were turned away saying they were overbooked, but the restaurant was about 70% empty. Not exaggerating. Also, you weren’t allowed to make reservations unless you were a member. Which meant the average guest would be stuck eating at the buffet every night. This is a terrible system in my opinion. Forces you to pay extra or settle for the bare minimum. The service overall was subpar. I believe they were understaffed for such a large resort. I know they just reopened in April but clearly they have not got down the routines yet as they were constant lineups everywhere. Nothing was labelled at the food stands or bathrooms. Looking for a bathroom is basically an Easter egg hunt, including which room is male or female. The resort itself was not air-conditioned, despite being enclosed, the elevators are basically small sweat boxes. To top off the resort, one of my family members found cockroaches in the shower on the last day. The resort did have a beautiful piano bar room and the bartenders were very nice as well. The resort needs to be better managed and better staffed and it could be a true 5 star resort. As it is right now, it is maybe  3.5–4 stars at best. I’ve been to about 7 different resorts in Cancun and the Paradisus ranks among the bottom 2. We will not be returning, but hopefully they can get their act together in the future.

reviews.author: Ethan H
reviews.title: Amazing Resort, Not so great food
reviews.text:
My wife and I went to Paradisus to celebrate our honeymoon immediately after getting married. My wife had visited every year up until COVID hit for 7 years, so she knew the ins and outs of the resort and her recommendation is why we went. We stayed in the adults-only "Reserve" and the experience was so peaceful and relaxing. 

The room was amazing. We had our own private balcony and there was a very large bath tub with a view out to the balcony. As with most hotels and resorts, the pillows were not the best and left my neck hurting in the morning.

The Reserve itself was very quiet and peaceful. We spent most mornings eating at the Atrium as it was the best option for breakfast (and honestly any food, more on that later) and very relaxing. The Reserve also includes an Adults only pool and this is where we spent most of our week. Two Bali-Bed reservations are included at the reserve, with a waitlist available afterwards, but it was so light when we went that we were able to secure one every day. The drinks were great and many of the servers were a delight to talk with.

We had the all inclusive package but we did spring for two upgrades. We got a couple's massage while we were there which ran us about $350 USD. It was very relaxing and absolutely worth it. We also did a 20-30min photo shoot with one of the onsite photographers. He was very professional and really knew how to pose us! I've attached a few of those photos to this review. The photo session itself was free but they charge per photo + have some bundles. They told us it was $20 per photo we liked but we ended up liking around 25-30, so we got a bundle that ended up around $400. We got the digital photos and a physical photo book that we took home with us. With how good the photos came out, it was absolutely worth it to us, especially to not have to worry about taking our own photos.

We had such a great time all around... except for the food. If the food had been better I'd rate it 5 stars. Unfortunately, while there were a few good eats here and there, we were left constantly disappointed with the quality of the food. This is especially upsetting considering my wife's favorite thing about this resort for the 7 years she'd come here was how good the food was. One day she even got either a stomach bug or food poisoning from drinking the coffee, which lasted about two days. We'd order off their menus and the items we received would be completely different. The best example of this was when we ordered a "Pretzel Dog" off the room service menu, which was listed as coming with a pretzel bun, caramelized onions, and a few other toppings. When it arrived it was just a plain old hot dog with no toppings and no special bun. Most of the food we ordered was either like that, or it was just not very tasty. If you're looking for the best spots to eat at, we enjoyed the pizza by the pool, the breakfast at the atrium in the reserve, and the sushi at Lemonfish.

My hope is that this was just an off week for them. We were told we were one of the last groups staying at the resort before it shuts down for a year for renovations. My hunch is that they were just trying to get through the last renovations before closing and either didn't care too much about the food quality or decided not to reorder ingredients as they ran out. 

We'd love to stay there again in a few years, but we'll be waiting to see reviews from others after the renovations to make sure the food gets better.

reviews.author: Milena D
reviews.title: Real evaluation
reviews.text:
My mother and I stayed for 14 days at Paradisus Cancun. I want to be fair in this assessment because I believe everyone here needs a true report!
The hotel is beautiful and huge, lots of pools, the beach in front is beautiful, lots of good food and drinks at will! 
I hosted through RCI, but what does that mean? Means that I paid monthly 1000,00 reais and more 150,00 of condominium to be entitled to RCI for nine years until I am exempt and only have to pay condominium. When I stay at a resort I pay a better value for accommodation but the all inclusive is at the normal value!
What I will report here is not a problem related to hosting but something that affects our dignity as people.
If you are American your treatment will be amazing, will take all kinds of foods and drinks at any time, you will be treated respectfully and priority after all 1 weight equals 0.05 dollars!!!! Yeah, very sad! American loves fun in Mexico after all is very cheap!!!!! 
If you are Mexican you will be treated well, of course not like the Americans, but the equals recognize and in a hotel like this has to be a Mexican with money!
Well, about us Brazilians, who spend our sweaty money, yes sweaty because $1,00 is equivalent to $6,00. We are treated with prejudice, yes, we will wait longer to enter one of the restaurants for dinner, will underestimate any lost objects our, even if it is related to health, you will not have the rewards of the Americans no, you can forget, they are priority after all their money is worth more! At dinner at the same time that an American ordered a plate, for us the kitchen is closing!
Mexicans would surely be treated respectfully in our country, now in the US are not very welcome...
As far as I know and despite moving to the economy, they are not welcome!
It's really a pity and I say more our money is worth more work, more effort and more sacrifice! 
Hotel with excellent structure but leaves to be desired in the dignity of Latin Americans! 
We should have more empathy after all we suffer the same evil!

reviews.author: Demeitrice C
reviews.title: "Overpriced, pushy sales tactics, poor service — not the honeymoon experience we dreamed of at Paradisus Cancun."
reviews.text:
My wife and I recently stayed at Paradisus Cancun for our honeymoon, and unfortunately, it was a very disappointing experience from start to finish.

Upon arriving in Cancun, we called the resort to ask about shuttle transportation. They told us it had to be arranged in advance and that we would need to take a taxi. However, there was a Paradisus companion shuttle parked right in front of us, which immediately made us feel misled.

When we finally arrived at the resort by taxi, guest services immediately tried to upsell us to a more expensive room with a better view. After we declined, the front desk agent’s attitude completely changed. She informed us that our original room wasn't ready due to a “service issue” and we would need to wait another hour. We asked if they could at least upgrade us for the inconvenience, but they refused. To make matters worse, we were required to pay the full balance of our stay upfront at check-in.

On the way to our room, we were stopped by another staff member trying to sell us a timeshare. He offered us a free massage in exchange for sitting through a "40-minute" sales pitch, which we declined. Unfortunately, he continued to harass us every time we crossed paths with him during our stay.

The dining experience was mediocre at best. Out of the five days we stayed, we only had one truly good dining experience. Everything else was subpar. When we asked about better food options, we were told that we would need to pay extra for "premium" meals, even though we had purchased the all-inclusive package.

The drinks were made with unfamiliar and lower-end alcohol brands. Again, we were told that to get name-brand alcohol, we would need to pay for a premium package.

Our room was poorly maintained. The light switches were wired awkwardly — to turn on the bathroom light, the bedroom light also had to be on, and the ceiling fan only worked if the shower light was on. The lamp on the desk didn’t work either, making it very uncomfortable for me to do any work.

At the beach, we were immediately pressured to rent cabanas for $250 if we wanted a comfortable place to relax — again, something you’d expect to be included in an all-inclusive package.

The prices at the gift shop were outrageous. A toothbrush and a small bar of soap cost us $30.

Whenever we had service issues or concerns, the default response we received was, "We don't speak English," which felt dismissive and unhelpful.

Another major disappointment was the lack of communication about the resort activities. It wasn’t until the third day that we realized we had to scan a QR code hidden at the bottom of a pamphlet to find the schedule. Even then, the adult activities were minimal — usually just one event per night from 8–9 PM. Meanwhile, there were plenty of daytime activities for kids.

This was my second stay at Paradisus Cancun, and sadly, it will be my last. A honeymoon is supposed to be a once-in-a-lifetime memory, but this experience left us feeling frustrated and extremely disappointed.

For a resort that markets itself as "luxury" and "all-inclusive," we felt nickel-and-dimed at every turn and treated as less important when we declined to spend additional money. We expected so much more — especially for such an important occasion.

reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text:
Stay from 09/03 to 16/03.
I'm doing this evaluation pq I tried contacting by email and haven't got a return until now.

I would like to explain that at all times they knew it was our honeymoon.

When we arrived we were very well received by Gisele who took us to the area of The Reserve. We made our check-in with Oscar and awaited the release of the room. Meanwhile, Isis - our concierge - introduced herself and gave us the schedule she had set up. 
During the entire stay at 0Isis was the only person who cared about pleasing us. She made a surprise in the room with decoration, gave me a gift on the day of leaving. She is very attentive and helpful, her care was great.

When we entered the room, it was nothing like the link they sent me when I upgraded. The bathtub was not closed with transparent glass walls, and the view was quite different from what appeared on the site. We were facing a cargo and discharge truck, outside the street full of cars. The lake was far behind and the view was not private. We went to talk to Oscar about the possibility of changing rooms and he did not show any willingness to help us, instead, he said that we could do a downgrade and go to the common area of the hotel. His comment was quite offensive and unnecessary, as we were on our honeymoon and upgraded to The Reserve to have more peace and privacy. So we asked to talk to Samuel who was his supervisor who gave us a great service. He told us that the hotel was overcrowded due to the spring break and that he would check availability for the next few days.

The next night when we were trying to sleep almost midnight, a mess began in the next bedroom where only a conjoined bedroom portava separated us. I called room service to complain and security came up to see what was going on. There were 19 people inside the room !!!! They were drunk and drugged teenagers and they could knock the door at any time and enter our room, so I sent a message and requested room change for ISIS because I felt insecure. The next day she managed to make the exchange and put us in a better room.

The gym is good, but there's nothing to do to clean the appliances, so they're all sweaty and dirty. This needs to be resolved.

Now I would like to point out some specific employee services.
First, I would like to praise the service of the Santé staff, always very careful and friendly and the responsible for breakfast at The Reserve, Lorena. 

At Lemon Fish, Hostess Yamaira (I think that's her name) served us very well, and when my husband explained that it was our honeymoon and we wanted a nice table, she promptly asked us to wait and so we did. So, waitress Iran called us to a table and she interrupted him explaining that he was waiting for our table to be released. 
When we sat at the table, my husband saw another nearby who was free and asked the hostess if we could change and she replied yes. When we changed table, Iran came to question us the change and said that it was to have warned pq he was bringing 2 people to sit at the table and had to change. When my husband explained that we wanted a nice place and reserved his answer was "we are in a restaurant" and was complaining about what we did, which was very unpleasant because we talked to the hostess. 

Speaking of restaurants, we made a reservation for dinner at Sal and had to change tables because there were 3 cockroaches walking near my husband's feet. A very embarrassing situation. Pass the image that is a super chic restaurant, but the cleanliness leaves to be desired.

Another unpleasant experience was when we won as a gift from Christian - who stayed in the Lobby to present the Circle to the guests - a bali bed on the beach with lagoon and sparkling. When we got there we talked to the hostess who directed us to our bali, and soon after that came Alberto to ask what we were doing there and that bali was reserved and paid. When we explained that the reservation was ours he didn't know what to say and didn't look at us anymore. The service at Bali was ok, the food took 3 hours to arrive and was not tasty.

Despite these unpleasant and disrespectful situations, I would like to praise the attention of Alejandro and Ricardo da Nespresso. It was the best service we had! They are friendly, well-humored, like the work and always received us with a lot of affection! They deserve a bonus because they made a difference in all the care we received. 

I know the hotel will be reformed, so I think that during this period it would be cool to give training to the staff, and the hotel should think about how to welcome guests who choose Meliá to spend special moments and occasions.

So, if you ask me how my honeymoon was at Paradisus Cancun?
My answer will be: It was ok, I do not recommend.
If we had gone on a honeymoon or not, it would have made no difference because we did not receive any different care because we are in such a special week for us.
Unfortunately, my honeymoon wasn't what I imagined.

reviews.author: Thiago O
reviews.title: March 2024, 3 adults and a baby
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Cancún for 7 nights, from 14 to 21 March 2025, I, my wife, our year-and-a-half-year-old son and my mother-in-law. We stayed on the 5* floor of the pyramid 2, bedroom/apartment with sea view, spacious, comfortable bed, air-conditioned in good operation, but decoration very old, nothing that bothered us. 
The hotel is very well decorated, very sophisticated, incredible interior landscape, huge structure. Nice pools and good beach space. 
The hotel staff is great, people are happy, polite and very requested, but the hotel has few chairs with hatches on the edge of the pool and the baili beds are for daily rental, you need to pay to use them. The outdoor area has two bars, a restaurant and a snack, being insufficient to serve everyone. The beach has no kiosk for drinks or snacks, there are only a few waiters who note our orders and go to the bars or the restaurant to pick up the drinks which makes the service very time-consuming as it is very distant. You can't eat or drink when you're on the beach. 
The restaurants need reservation for dinner and only the Italian Capella is worth it. Food is not there such things and there is virtually no steak available any day. 
Breakfast is quite varied, but it is necessary to arrive before 8am to not have to wait for more than 30 minutes. 
The Nesspresso coffee is very simple and tasteless. 
Night entertainment ends well early and is very graceless, looks very improvised. 
You need to expand the beach service with a closer bar for self-service and more waiters. 
Breakfast needs a bigger place to finish the queues. I think there are better hotels in the same price range. I don't know if we'll be back someday.

reviews.author: pablo a
reviews.title: paradisus cancun
reviews.text: I was with my partner 3 days in the hotel, the hotel is good, clean in all areas very clean, the sea view very incredible beautiful. in the pool area, all the very friendly staff attentive, in the KANA area. the very rude bartender. I ordered cocktail, it takes more than half an hour to give me the drinks. treats you unwillingly, I don't know if there is no manager or manager to check those details. or also does not care how they work your collaborators.

reviews.author: patelron50
reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.text: Hotel is very good services very poor. Family concierge is a joke. There is nothing like family concierge. Lalo was my family concierge and he did not contact me for 1 day and he was off another day and rest of 3 days he did not help a bit to make my stay enjoyable. Nothing. Waste of money. Better go with standard ocean view room and save some money.

reviews.author: Юля К
reviews.title: Not the best experience
reviews.text: The hotel itself was outdated. The shower was covered in limescale with very low water pressure, and there was a ceiling leak in the toilet. We called for a handyman, but he did nothing and promised to return, though he never did. For a hotel that accommodates over 500 guests, they only provided about 200 sunbeds. If you didn’t wake up around 6AM, you were left without a sunbed or umbrella for the rest of the day. There was a balcony with one sunbed (room was Junior suit, so theoretically can stay 3 people) and bath tub which never ever been cleaned. Under the table I found some nest (even don't wanna know who lives there)

reviews.author: kellycrespi
reviews.title: Paradise with Restrictions
reviews.text:
Positive points: Wonderful beach. Hotel with impressive infrastructure. Courteous attention. Delicious food. 
Negatives: hotel with old structure especially in the rooms. We were informed that the hotel will be closed soon for renovations. 
Use of Balinese beds, beach chairs and the like are complex. You never know exactly where you can sit. 
As partners of the hotel we find the interior care to other resorts of the Meliã network that we already know.

reviews.author: Julia D
reviews.title: Concierge
reviews.text: The hotel and experience was just okay. However, our concierge Enrique was WONDERFUL. He helped us through every single detail and was incredibly attentive. He is by far the best we have ever worked with and we were so grateful to him. If you’re going to stay at this hotel, definitely utilize the concierge service and request Enrique!

reviews.author: Dennis B
reviews.title: Beautiful  but needs updating - closing end of May for major renovation
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful and the staff is very friendly. Unfortunately, the grounds are not very accessible for individuals with mobility issues. Restrooms  near the beach require descending and ascending stairs with limited hand rails. We are Circle members so we had a concierge to handle dinner, Bali bed, and other reservations.  There are only about 3 Concirge for all members, so they are not always available. As Members we are not interested  in upgrading our benefits. Our Concierge kept pressuring us to attend one to find out new benefits. We finally conceded with the promise of a free massage. Presentation was only 40 minutes, but to get the new benefits, we would need to shell out $26k. No thanks. Once we attended, our Concirge became almost invisible.  Hopefully, after the renovation  they will be hiring more staff. Current  staff have no idea what will happen to them when the resort shuts down at the end of May

reviews.author: Catharine M
reviews.title: Pros and Cons
reviews.text:
The hotel resort and amenities are beautiful. The pools were clean and wonderful, as well as my room. I upgraded to The Reserve (adults only) and was assigned a concierge, Manuel, who was wonderful and helped me book dinner reservations, the spa, etc. The drinks were great and the service was overall good, but here are some complaints I had: 

1. I found the food to overall be terrible. I had some good meals - sea bass, tilapia, and other fish, but everything else was barely edible, and it upset my stomach (and I have a strong stomach!)   Lemon Fish and Aqua Marina were good, but I didn't like any of the other restaurants. Sal Steakhouse I found to be very overrated and the service was not good (maybe because I was just one person?) Malva, the buffet, had good salad and fruit, but that was about it. Everything else was not good, and also not very warm. 

2. I found it frustrating that dinner reservations had to be made, and they were not easy (thank goodness for Manuel!)  Several nights the restaurants were booked until 8:30 or 9pm and I don't like to eat that late, so I was irritated that I was at an all-inclusive and my dinner times and locations were very limited. 

3.  The pools were lovely, but it would have been nice to have a swim-up bar at the adults-only pool and not just the family pool. 

4. It would have been nice to have bars where you could actually sit at the bar - better for socializing. But this resort did not have that so you just ordered your drink and left. 

I have stayed at only two other all-inclusive resorts in my life (all in Mexico) so I am not an expert, but the food was the worst I've ever had. However, the drinks were good and the grounds were lovely - the hotel, facilities, pool, all very nice. So it just depends on what is important to you.

reviews.author: Ric S
reviews.title: Great lack of beach chairs and swimming pool!
reviews.text:
There is a great lack of chairs at the beach and pool to the point of creating conflicts between holidaymakers. There are only half the required chairs in place. Probably to force people to pay for beach beds way too expensive.
I'm not going back because of this.

Otherwise the restaurants are very good and the employees are attentive. 9-hole golf is good for getting your mind off things. There are shows in the evening but still a lack of chairs to watch them.

Conclusion everything is fine except the lack of chairs which is unacceptable for the price of the hotel.

reviews.author: Quest39710840341
reviews.title: Outdated Resort
reviews.text: Resort is closing in May 2025 for full renovations. You can tell the rooms are barely maintained in anticipation for the renovations.

reviews.author: Lucyale
reviews.title: Poor care in Club
reviews.text: I am part of Club Meliá, and unfortunately in December I was disappointed by the treatment received in the Club area, in Reception. Miss Arlette seems to be only dispatching guests without the slightest intention of providing good service (zero empathy). On the other hand, Club offices only serve you well if you decide to change the type of membership by paying more. Otherwise, the hotel lacks maintenance that we were told will be given this year and so will have fewer rooms available and fewer staff.

reviews.author: SummrGirl!
reviews.title: Affordable AI option with some downside
reviews.text: Great food options.  Beach is nice but cannot access after dark.  Pool also closes at dark which is a big deal.  Reason given was they didn't have enough lighting.  That's a pretty easy fix for a resort however.  No hot tubs and not enough seating at the pools.  Staff was wonderful.  Entertainment was average.  More family oriented entertainment and no adults only options.  The rock band entertainment was obnoxious.  It's inside the rotunda and you can hear it super loudly throughout the hotel and in your room.  It goes until almost midnight so if you or your children are trying to sleep the night this band is playing, forget it.  Really unacceptable.

reviews.author: Schesmila annie T
reviews.title: Not a good experience at all
reviews.text: I spent a week in the hotel with a group of 25 executives. Overall, our stay was disappointing. Many of my group had to request room changes due to problems with the AC, a leaking room size, etc. I came in with my family (3) and was assigned to a king-size bed. I had to switch rooms on my second day without being advised that it would be a noisy area. It was six nights of bad sleep. Even though my dedicated manager (Gerardo) was great at accommodating all my requests, the hotel could have better services. The AC and power in the meeting room went off twice. The F&B were very poor. The quality of pastries and desserts was terrible. Overall, the food was okay, but the all-inclusive package did not offer a good variety of dishes. For my group dinners, I had three main course choices. The only fish offered was sea bass. It was challenging to have avocados for breakfast or guacamole with meals. This shouldn't be an issue in Mexico. For breakfast, there was no freshly squeezed orange juice. That is the least any hotel can offer. The hotel was old, falling into pieces. Unfortunately, the weather wasn't good that week, so the hotel should come up with indoor activities and announce them. Loud music should not pass 10 pm. It disrespects the families and people working, even though it's a vacation resort.

reviews.author: Kprice75
reviews.title: Staff is wonderful,  but some experiences could be improved.
reviews.text: The staff at this place was the best part!  Kind,  caring,  funny,  efficient,  always making sure we are good. My biggest complaint is that the beach bars and activities close early at 5:30pm (in January).  And the nightly entertainment is loud and done inside the same building as the rooms.  Loud music until 11pm isn't family friendly.   Shows should have their own building.

reviews.author: Jorge S.
reviews.title: 2025 New Year Stay The Reserve Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Service and food were good.

Only thing that was very below expectation was the New Year party:
Party was in the convention center downstair instead of any open air space at the pool area or any other open area in a non cloud and non rain night (events team should have more then one scenario planned).
I tried to get a champagne glass before midnight for toast with my family and the waiter tried to give me it in a plastic cup instead a properly champagne glass (he mentioned that the champagne glass was only for the paid dinner guests. This was a very bad answer/training for an all inclusive resort, even that I had The Reserve bracelet).
To become even worst, there was no band, only DJ, and after midnight, from 12:15 am until 12:45 am, only local Spanish music was playing in a party that supposed to attend international guests. Very bad music selection! At this time, 12:45 am, the party had less than 30% of the guests, everybody left.
Also there wasn’t any fireworks to see at the hotel, some people got out side of the hotel to see some neighborhood fireworks, very bad!

I’ve been at The Reserve Paradisus Cancun 3 times before and this last time, was my first New Year stay try, but for New Year uroose, The Reserve Palma Real Punta Cana team event organization/party are much better!

Hope you guys can talk with each other to exchange ideas!

Regards.

reviews.title: Paradisus Hotel
reviews.text:
The Reserve. Adults only.
Thank you Enrique. You were excellent!!
Food was 3 star but paid for 5 star.

Receiving managers lack clarity on the information we are Circle members for

reviews.author: Pasang T
reviews.title: Cockroach on buffet section !
reviews.text:
We stayed here for a week and had a mixed experience. On the positive side, the food was fantastic, and the beach was beautiful—definitely the highlights of our stay.

However, there were significant issues with the room. When we checked in, we found a drill and several nails left on the sofa. On the balcony, we faced a more alarming situation: my two-year-old found a cigarette butt and put it in his mouth. reviews.title: Don't
reviews.text:
Don't let pic fool you! Let's start with rooms , oh boy , run down very old ,the pic you see are the diamond club ( even then not good ).took as 2 days to even get a room we paid for witch was ocean view.ended up in the basement barely seeing a view.

hotel is closing in 6 months for renovations would have been nice to know , well needed for the rooms.

Wouldn't come back sadly,  but the pic do look pretty definitely not a 5 star resort. !!

reviews.author: 737maxwellm
reviews.title: Luxury hotel but bad experience
reviews.text:
We booked a 7-night stay over Christmas at Paradisus Cancún, a Meliá hotel. It’s hard to describe how disappointed we were. We booked a “Premium Suite Lagoon View” room which was pricey – and we booked it more than 8 months early. What we got was a first-floor room in the timeshare section with a view of the hallway doors that lead to the pool area. It wasn’t even on the correct side of the building. The bedroom flooded when it rained, the kitchen fan made a noise so loud it couldn’t be used, and the bathroom sink drained slowly.

The reservation desk just said that room types aren’t guaranteed and that no other rooms were available. We even offered to have our room downgraded. We asked for a manager and were taken to guest services instead. They offered to give us access to the spa for a day – not spa services, just access to the spa (sauna, etc.).  

This was the beginning of a very discouraging stay at Paradisus Cancun. We had the all-inclusive package but found out that in order to have dinner at any of the included restaurants, you had to book them between 10AM and 4PM, a time when most people are on excursions. And the reservation desk usually had a very long line. So, we were forced to eat our first 2 dinners at the buffet, which is mediocre at best.

We finally were at the hotel 1 day between 10-4 & were able to make dinner reservations for the rest of the stay.  We found Sante, Aqua Marina, and Flora to be excellent restaurants.  However, the house white wine included in the price wasn’t drinkable and the red was very low-end. We had Christmas dinner at Capella, and this was worse than the buffet. The food looked like it had been warmed over from days before. Thankfully the live Christmas show that was blasting into the restaurant got rained out halfway through dinner and our group could finally talk.

The other 3 rooms booked for family members were better – the only complaint was lack of hot water. Several times it was tepid and one time it was cold.

We did enjoy the grounds, the pools and the beach and the staff was pleasant. The hotel has great potential. If you have a decent room with a view, you will likely have a better experience than we did.

One other note: for tipping, take lots of smaller bills in pesos with you as we couldn’t get change anywhere at the hotel.

reviews.author: ChaineBlais
reviews.title: Does not match a 4 1/2 at all
reviews.text: Really disappointed, we had paid more to have more, but had much less. The room was not clean and did not match the photos published, among others, the shower in the bath which is painted white, a single chair on the terrace, dirt on the switches and the table. Quieter pool accessible only in the morning and at the beginning of pm, we were expelled from this pool 5 days a week around 2 / 3 pm to prepare private evening parties. Towels lying around in piles on the floor for the first two days, it came back after but the first impression was ruined. Not enough chairs and umbrellas around the pools, people steal umbrellas from each other. Vomited in the pool, 3 employees came to see but did not do anything to pick up, same for supplies outages during the week, they see but do not repair. Main pool broke but although it reopened, the water level remained lower than the filter ducts. Several evenings with private party outside not giving access to the outdoor area and also to one of the restaurants. Beef braised served with a piece containing 100% fat. We wanted to attend the Transat meeting but the representative did not make the planned meeting, we knew it when we were paying attention to the place agreed with another couple, he contacted us only by text.

reviews.author: Joseph F
reviews.title: Cancun Paradisus So So
reviews.text: Tne resort was nice, the food was OK when they could get the reservation correct. Paraddisus and Melia overall arent a bad company, this resotrt is my least favorite of all. I will NOT be coming back. Daniel the concierge messed up all reservations for food and did not do much so i would say concierge at Cancun is terrible! Playa Del Carmen I would recommend 10/10 as they know what service is! Unfortunately my experence and purchasing 5 rooms was not a great time...

reviews.author: Shweta
reviews.title: Extremely cold water!!  Missing evening entertainment for young adults.
reviews.text: The resort is good and the beach is beautiful.  The pools have extremely cold freezing water which are not comfortable.   We took day pass to neighboring resort Hilton and loved it...all the pools are heated , lots of water activities and people enjoying the pools Disspointing.  Also the website brass about night life...other than few kids shows there's no entertainment for teenagers and young adults.

reviews.author: venkat933
reviews.title: Great beach. Hotel stay was just okay!
reviews.text: Access to the beach was amazing and the beach was well maintained. Hotel is at a great location. Rooms are below average.

reviews.author: José Luis L
reviews.title: visit 01/12 to 08/12
reviews.text: It is the second time I stayed at the hotel and there were some changes comparing last time, in general all well but unfortunately this time the concierge that touched us left a lot to be desired, the first negative point was that when we arrived (we arrived around 5 pm) we were not assigned to anyone, the next day we were assigned to Juan Carlos, but as the days passed we saw that nothing to do with Bernabé (the one who was assigned to us last time) left the reservations to the last, I had to be reminding him to make them and we had a bad time with our reservation in Kanna, but in the end it could be solved; analyzing everything in the end I do not see a great benefit to be at The Reserve so if I came back I do not think I would stay in this section again. Everything else is within acceptable, the only very negative point during my stay was the breakfast firm because the food is cold, there was not a day when I could say that I had hot food for breakfast, orange juice is artificial reduced with natural which makes it taste worse.

reviews.author: Manuel L
reviews.title: Rooms are NOT from a 5-star hotel. URGENT Maintenance
reviews.text:
This is a hotel that we have visited on 4 occasions and URGENT maintenance of the rooms, we were a family of 10 including children in 3 rooms (3200, 3205 and 3207). Rooms without any decoration , with obvious lack of maintenance on walls, furniture and curtains, far removed from a hotel that is listed as 5 stars, in terms of rooms can be a decent 3 stars. 
There are not enough beds, it is an odyssey to be able to get one when the hotel is medium full. Pool beds is a business of towel people, if you pay them what they call a "tip", which also they decide the amount , they can "loan" you one, to us for two days it costs 120 usd to be able to use those beds.

The common areas are fine and the restaurants too, both the law firm and the specialties comply well and the service and food are VERY GOOD

The Kind Club girls, good

The animation team well   

If anyone from the administration is interested, I can send several videos of the state of the rooms to some mail.

reviews.author: Mary Z.
reviews.title: Behemoth of Mediocrity.
reviews.text:
If you want the Instagram pictures and are willing to pay up the @55 for it, this could be your spot. Friends and I stayed for 4+ days for an event and would not willingly return. 

PROS: Beautiful views, in-person staff is very attentive, convenient, for relaxation

CONS: Broken rooms, unresponsive staff through the app/online, incredibly mediocre food and watered down drinks, not good for work

- Hot water was not available upon check in, had to speak to the front desk about it
- Toilet seat did not fit the porcelain throne (I really did try to make it fit, but this detail was missed) 
- Missing shower hooks so shower curtain was only half of what it could be, so water spilled everywhere. This was resolved through in-person complaining at the front desk. 
- Body wash was empty upon check in
- Cracks in the tub that moved upon placing weight on it 
- They recommended you utilise their app/online to request amenities and service but   all the requests went no where and stuff was never delivered/fixed. It was only fixed once I walked back to the front desk to discuss our requests
- The food. THE FOOD. :( Not worth it if your palette is any bit refined. For USA, if you're from either of the coasts, this is not up to your standards. If you're from middle America, you could think this is pretty good. Flavour for a lot of the restaurants was bland and they sometimes compensated for it by making other dishes incredibly salty. High school me would have been impressed because everything tasted like college me prepared it. Adult me was very disappointed and our group of friends also confirmed this. 
- Outlets are nowhere near the placement of desks/tables and the lighting did not light up desks/tables, quite useless for work purposes 
- Personal preference, why have spaces for decor but not have anything in them? Our room had an empty shelves so we brought in our own decoration to fill it. 

For a supposed 5 star hotel, I expected better. Now I know better.

reviews.author: Oscar O
reviews.title: Several nights practically without sleep
reviews.text: They have a bar next to the Sunset junior rooms that finishes the music until 4 am, the glass absorbs the vibration and it is difficult to sleep, in the hotel they know because I reported it and commented that they can not do anything about it! Room 4411

reviews.author: Nomad26913780069
reviews.title: REGULAR
reviews.text: It has a beautiful beach, a very entertaining kids club for the kids , the only detail is that we went to celebrate my sister's birthday arriving at reception I mentioned her birthday I expected some surprise as I have had in other hotel chains and nothing ... I had to mention it again in the restaurant of Heaven that by the way the waiters super attentive with my sister sang the mornings with a dessert ... I was disappointed the lack of interest in reception , the buffet is not entirely pleasant compared to the Paradisus Riviera Maya ...

reviews.author: Alebagu2
reviews.title: Generally regular
reviews.text:
In general the service is not very good, they always try to sell you something or they are just waiting for the tip. 
The buffet food is not the best. The Peruvian Japanese restaurant very good and good service. 
The hotel is very nice and I understand they will even remodel it even more. very clean and large

reviews.author: Odyssey698748
reviews.title: Experience at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: The only thing that was excellent is the attention of Renan and the waiters at Agua Marina restaurant, they miraculously saved experience here. The hotel has many areas of opportunity, such as the variety of food in the buffet, the number of beds always insufficient, 20 minutes for the reservation line for specialty restaurants.

reviews.author: sergio07adz
reviews.title: All good.
reviews.text: In general well lack a little remodeling and atmosphere for adults at least in the night area the very good food the best of the hotel.. but if they limit very much to guests who are not members

reviews.author: Sergio R
reviews.title: Not what it used to be.
reviews.text:
He have been to this resort at least 5 times over the last 9 years. This time around sad to say the quality and attention to detail
Is not the same as our past stays. 

You can tell they are not putting level of attention as they used to to staff, service and rooms. 

With a bit more of investment into the hotel it can hopefully get to where it used to be. 

Staff seem overwhelmed, there are delays everywhere we are at. Food is not was it used to be. The property still has that beautiful feel and the beach is still the same just sad we are leaving this type of review when it’s been our go to vacation destination for so many years. 

When we voiced our concerns you can tell mgmt notified the staff at the restaurant we ate and they were really attentive to us. 

When we ran into a staff member we recognized in years past he too admitted ownership hasn’t been investing the same as before. 

Apparently they will be remodeling the property in 2025. Months Hope it’s all for the better and don’t take away from the nautical beautify the entrance has. 

Wish mgmt would have really taken our concerns and at least comp’d us a night or at least can invite us back when the remodel is done to give this place a better review. 

This could be the last time we stay here :(

reviews.author: Viktor H
reviews.title: Nice beach, beautiful resort, but needs maintenance and better service
reviews.text: The good - nice beautiful lobby, big room, plenty of walking space for the Cancun hotel zone resort. Good Nespresso coffee is a hude plus!!! But service is below average - similar priced resorts have much better service - lack or workers. They are running out of towels several times a day - not appropriate for the hotel priced at $400+/night. Very hard to find beach chair or near the pool. The management trying to sell you a cabana for $250/day instead of providing a free beach/pool chair. The buffet also below average, but restaurants are good! The hotel is outdated, needs maintenance touch in many areas, rooms needs to be updated. Very limited entertainment for teenagers. Not the worst resort, but we will not come back - expected more for the price paid. Thank you for the proffesional live band on Thanksgiving day!

reviews.author: Romina G
reviews.title: Low quality but good working staff
reviews.text:
I came back for the 2nd time and the truth is there are several things to improve. It's not bad but I'm down to what it was before. 
In the snacks air the attention of Laura was excellent, super attentive and friendly. Pizzas are delicious and the variety of ice cream is AMAZING. Never seen before in any all inclusive.
The same thing I highlight to Jorge of the restaurant lemon fish. It made us feel incredibly good to indulge in dishes that we thought we wouldn’t find what we liked. Very but very attentive

reviews.author: Wander816590
reviews.title: Reasonable
reviews.text: When we arrived at the resort we went with my boyfriend's parents and put each couple in different pyramids. They had one or another friendly employee but many of them antipathetic at the restaurant Malva often ignored the customer, when he ordered something like a dessert cutter that was never disposable neither in the buffet nor in the tables were still badly disguised for asking as if it were a favor, the food always the same. Limited animation, restaurants and bars closed after 23:00 p.m. The staff of the ginger bar, the snacks from the pool area and the pool bar were very attentive. The shower in the room did not work properly.For a resort of 5 * needed to improve.The lack of loungers in the pool area, was a fortune to catch any because many of them are reserved so to pay off the amount that had already been paid.The Nespresso cafeteria staff very friendly and attentive, very good coffee always filled with cookies to accompany.Good and clean rooms and mini bar always loaded. Very nice resort and good beach.

reviews.author: Daniel Y
reviews.title: HIGH PRESSURE sales tactics within the resort
reviews.text:
The service, food and pool are absolutely fantastic but I will be spreading my words to all my colleagues in my airline because there’s something really unfortunate here. This is my third day here, and I am here only for 4 days. The first day when we arrived the moment we step into the hotel, we received a really warm welcome from a so-call concierge person, showing us around the hotel and explaining how everything works around here. We felt great, but things turn south after a while, I kept being pushes to listen to a 40 minutes hotel presentation with exchange of free tour or beach club entries. Even today, I am still getting texts from the concierge asking me to go to the presentation. 

I am really fed up with this situation happening in this resort. I am not sure how are they being treated as an employee but the way he insists on asking me to go to the presentation is telling me this resort is doing some really bad practice. How can you let your guest to stay in a resort that supposed to be relaxing but at the back of the mind keep thinking how to reject the presentation offer. 

Your company should be ashamed of doing practice like this. I am not blaming on the employee but the management. And I will definitely spread my words.

reviews.author: Brittnay F
reviews.title: MEH
reviews.text: Not the best....We didn't have one great meal the entire time we were there. The only "decent" meal was Lemon Fish. We were supposed to have our rooms adjoining (took our teenage kids) and they put us on different floors. Lack of amenities. I would have liked to see fitness classes throughout the AM- they only had early AM classes, which if you're on vacation I would prefer mid AM. The facilities are showing its age for sure- lots of roof leaks, peeling paint, etc. Customer Service was low level. No activities for teens at all aside from pool/beach. Definitely the worst all inclusive we have been to for sure. Will not be coming back.

reviews.author: psicnelly
reviews.title: It's not all inclusive as they say.
reviews.text:
Not all-inclusive, beds charge in pool and beach area ($250 USD)
The elevators stopped working.

reviews.author: Jessica P
reviews.title: Excitement turned into disappointment :(
reviews.text: We came to this resort for our honeymoon and wanted to come back for our 10 year anniversary. We booked what appeared to be a beautiful premium ocean view suite in the adults only Reserve.  Upon checking in we got to our room - went down under sea level and the room had no view, the top of the balcony wall was actually ground level. We requested a new room and were refused even though we were told that the hotel was not full.  So extremely disappointing. Otherwise everything was amazing but the was so incredibly disappointing and our hopes of returning for each anniversary will likely be a different resort now.

reviews.author: Paren S
reviews.title: Ok but that’s all
reviews.text: Staying at the hotel at the moment. Overall it is okay but not spectacular. Restaurant staff are attentive and food in the main restaurants (non buffet) has been nice even for vegetarians. Rooms are dated and items need repairing. Service can be slow in some places and there could be more outdoor facilities for children. I also found Family Concierge better value for money in other Meliá resorts such as in the Dominican Republic, where we even received gift packs. You might be told that you will receive a Welcome Pack but then you will need to attend 45 min “information session” about their Circle D package - not sure if it is worth it. I may choose another hotel if I come to Cancun again.

reviews.author: jacquimuniz93
reviews.title: Bad service from a waiter
reviews.text: The rude waiter, the hard octopus, the pasta of the raw dante restaurant, dirty beach, not so new rooms

reviews.author: Vladson1956
reviews.title: Old resort with no rain protection in the ocean view room
reviews.text: Food as average 3 star resort, servants trying to help. Payinzg extra for main building 50 US, per night- disappointments started right at night. Rain somehow get in has to removed everything from the floor to higher level.  Same every rainy night. We're 4 in a row, free advise: get more pool towels we are has 5 after first night, but was not enough. Conclusion, think twice before choose that 30 years old resort.

reviews.author: Bruna M
reviews.title: THERE IS NO GENERATOR
reviews.text: My experience was being excellent until the electricity was out. On my last night, the energy was running out and I could not sleep due to the extreme heat due to the lack of air conditioning and the whole hotel became dark, even in the common areas. There was no water to take a bath and even give a discharge.

reviews.author: Paul M
reviews.title: Cancun sun and rain
reviews.text: It's a big hotel. Long walks from room to reception. Two days of storm weather and the hotel was flooded and fallong apart. Restaurants were ok and the main buffet/breakfast was great. Pools are busy. Stayed in adults only part of hotel. In general clean and tidy. Front desk/concieege Staff are curt and polite. Entertainment and pool staff were great.  Biggest let down was the quality of the decor. Overpriced shops and additionals.

reviews.author: Sarah P
reviews.title: Not notable nfoParadisus Cancun
reviews.text:
The good stuff.
The Meliá chain is usually really pleasurable in terms of food, you are always going to have a surprise since all the foods have a special quality and especially the waiters of the main restaurants (dinners) will always make you have a good experience
Special congratulations to Atilano de Blue Agave, to Shade de Flora, the waiters of Blue Fish and Cielo. And the beach is very nice.

The bad.- the hotel is in really bad condition, it is a 5-star hotel that looks neglected: leaky, super dusty vents, starry floors and chipped door frames. The concierges who are really salespeople spent harassing me to sell me the Circle talk, to one you say no and 5 more come back to find you, you go downstairs and offer the same, they call you to your room and you have to avoid them all over the Hotel (honestly what need to be running away from people on your vacation). Just like entering the beach that in the towel service also want to sell you tours, I get a very bad Impression of Shera as she called us to the room, we went, she wanted to sell us the “experience” and told us I understand that they do not want the talk told us of an anniversary amenity which never arrived because we refused to go to the talk. Also another thing that is too noticeable is the preference for foreigners especially in breakfast and food, throughout my stay during the meal I had to be stopping to serve my drinks as the waiters only catered to foreigners and Mexicans forgot. Considering we always left tips.
In short, if you are foreign ahead, if you are Mexican opt to go to Paradisus la Perla!

reviews.author: ifierro007
reviews.title: Undated rooms
reviews.text: Old facility, the rooms are old, the snack location and sport bar were closed early, no night club, the food and service was good.

reviews.author: 720cynthiaj
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Restaurants really wasn’t good in my eye. After paying me all inclusive fee  it seems like there was always stuff not not covered want you to more. One thing I was really was disappointed was the steakhouse was totally not covered in the all inclusive fee if I wanted to go had to pay Al cart, even had to pay for my drinks if I went to that restaurant (didn’t make sense because every other place on the resort drinks was included & I didn’t have to pay to drink only in steakhouse ??) Also not much going on I know it is slow season but should have some activities especially around the pool only had music most of the time.

reviews.author: Suzete O
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel, but internally quite damaged. Restaurant staff very tired and without the sympathy that has the M
reviews.text: My third time in Cancun. Beautiful hotel, requiring a lot of repairs. Very weak employee care.Many were in bad mood, ugly face, reclamones. Been delighted with the staff of Guest Service Israel, treated me with great attention and solved everything I asked you. They just made me feel more welcomed and gave me the attention that every vacationer deserves.

reviews.author: LordEthan
reviews.title: UK Review - Important points for British travellers with ALLERGENS
reviews.text:
This review is primarily for British/UK travellers as we have different needs/wants when travelling abroad. 

To start you’re welcomed with tequila shot and asked if you’re celebrating anything. If you are they’ll offer a voucher book for massages and food options for things outside of the package you’ve already paid for. The catch is that the next morning before you’ve seen the hotel or experience the hotel in any depth you have to sit through a timeshare presentation. I won’t bore you with the details but it’s a 20 year commitment costing about 40k for a one week holiday once a year. Whether or not you think it’s worth your time to sit through this, the timing was horrible as not only are you jet lagged, they’re asking for a deposit of 3-5k immediately and then a monthly payment of about £200-500. That is insane. 

The hotel itself is fine, there’s an option to get the ‘reserve’ package which upgrades your room and allows you to another part of the pool area and one or two other restaurants. It costs about $50 USD per night extra and to be honest it’s absolutely not worth it unless the hotel is super busy which it wasn’t when we went. 

THE FOOD. 

The hotel has a good number of decent restaurants to choose from. It also has a buffet and this is where the experience really is disappointing. The breakfast and lunch food is either lukewarm or cold. It is never hot. It was always lukewarm or cold. Even the fried foods were cold. Like not even remotely warm to the touch. 

Also you’re asked if you have any allergies. One of us had a nut allergy and although we told the staff that we had a nut allergy, on SEVERAL occasions we were brought food with almonds or pistachios and had to send it back so I cannot recommend this place if you have a severe food allergy. It’s simply not safe. The food is not labeled correctly and the staff don’t understand that a nut allergy means all nuts can be dangerous. 

If you can get over the constant upselling (I respect the hustle) it’s a decent hotel but they make you feel a little bit ‘less than’ sometimes.

reviews.author: regaladomiguel
reviews.title: They can improve some shortcomings to make travelers have a wonderful stay.
reviews.text:
In our accommodation, there were several deficiencies that lowered the quality of the product obtained by this hotel.
Overall it is a very nice hotel, but there were leaks in the balcony window, there were leaks in the air conditioning, the bathroom door did not close, the closet door was a curtain.
The breakfast buffet was good, but it was not exactly a Mexican food experience. Chilaquiles were made with ingredients too packaged and were not exactly the chilaquiles that one imagines. PAN CAKES were also not exactly fresh, although they were acceptable.
The buffet if it was tremendously large, those were a few details, the rest of the option bars were very good and the waiters' attention always very good.
The spectacular pools!
Asking well for information and costs of Balinese beds... apparently there was no one who handled the data and/or prices well with the associated services available.

reviews.author: Andre M
reviews.title: A very clueless and abusive hotel in several respects.
reviews.text:
I just liked the hotel. Rooms well, bathroom clean, bed comfortable; facilities well. Special restaurants have good food and taste. I was in Family Concierge (FC) mode, the FC team very good, very attentive and helpful. 

However, there are details that are not right and that detract much from the experience.

1. They tell you how like family concierge, you have an a la carte breakfast restaurant, BUT, "a la carte" has 4 packages; it is NOT really a la carte. The best of those 4 packs are chilaquiles. Imagine the other 3 packages.

2. All special restaurants do not have air conditioning, so you will always be warm while dining, even perspiring.

3. To have a bedchamber, you have to get up at 6 am to set aside. At 6:30 am, there are literally no more beds, either in the pool area or on the beach.

4. Context: I got a lot of sand in my ear, so I would just wash myself. All I needed was a syringe. I went to the medical service, the doctor told me I had to pay $1. I thought, "okay, so I don't go outside." When the doctor asks me what size I needed; I answer the big one...if I remember 20 ml. After five minutes waiting, he told me that syringe was worth $15. I said no, I went out on the street, crossed the avenue, walked into the savings pharmacy and bought it for $1.

5. The kids area, for young children is fine and safe, however, your teenager....will have problems. The pool table, it's dirty, there are two cleats, one of them is broken and stuck with diurex. The football table, it's broken, it's missing "players" and handles. Really: No more.

reviews.author: Eduardo P
reviews.title: A hotel that deteriorated a lot
reviews.text: I was lucky enough to go to this hotel several times, most recently 7 or 8 years ago, the surprise was tremendous, although the building is maintained quite well (you can tell it lacks maintenance ) the beaches are half of a few years ago and the attention of the staff is a disaster, they do not want to attend you, when you go to lunch they take time to bring you water or a spoon , what you need seems to be quite a problem, the attention of the waiters is very bad, the people at the reception are friendly but are few, at peak times do not give enough. I rescue the poor cooks who send them to an island of pasta for example "alone" to serve several people at once, they are alone and no one helps them! I can't believe how low this hotel is being Melia, I recommend the owners of the chain review this, we will not consider them for future visits

reviews.author: Yasin R
reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.text:
Hotel is OK. The hotel is over 30 years old, they have done a fair job in keeping the condition of the hotel fairly well. The service is hit or miss. Mini bar took an hour and half to deliver water for me, when I ran out of water. Food and drink service at the pool area is sub par. The staff will come around and ask if you need any drinks or snacks but some staff never come back with your oder. 
I work in hotels, I am a former director of Front desk and current Director of housekeeping. Upon my check in i found dirty stains on the top bed sheet, I asked the front desk if they can have housekeepers to come back and change it. Front desk seems like didn’t care and were in different about my situation. The night prior upon my day of check out, I went to the front desk and was given a late check out till 1pm and would have to pay 50$ each additional hour. I wanted to pay that night, but was advised to come back in the morning, unsure why. I came the next morning and no notes were taken about my late checkout request and my desire to pay for a later checkout. I would say the front desk needs to be more attentive to guests and not seem so indifferent. Servers in the restaurant were way more hospitable than front desk staff

reviews.author: Jade D
reviews.title: Average hotel
reviews.text:
I went to the Paradisus for my honeymoon. First of all, it is a beautiful hotel. It has spacious rooms and delicious food. You could always get in the restaurants and the sea was on your door step. The spa was also amazing! 

However, there was a lot of ‘style over substance’ here. It was very difficult to get a sun bed, and staff were taking tips/bribes to reserve for guests. So we missed out on this multiple days (even one day going down at 7am we got the only 2 left). Everything good was extra money. And all the extras were soooo expensive. Hiring a Bali bed for a day by the pool was $260 US dollars. For an all inclusive hotel, you were still expected to tip so please aware, you will still need cash. Something we weren’t expecting so had to get some smaller notes. I had contacted the hotel prior to arriving to say it was our honeymoon. Nothing was done to make this more special, in fact our ‘lagoona view’ room had no view at all. Just a concrete post. We did speak to Josue and he gave us a pink band to give us some discounts which was nice. But that was just by chance. Also a couple of restaurants brought out special deserts for us. The entertainment was very average, and was on a weeks cycle so the same stuff on week two. Lastly, the cleanliness of the rooms was not five stars. We had dirty towels, bedding and surfaces. The house keeping was inconsistent sometimes leaving us with only one towel between us. Also the filling of the minibar and snacks was inconsistent sometimes not being filled at all (this is where we got the water).  Also in the hotel, as it looked lovely with all the plants, it was very hot and humid inside too - so there was little relief from the heat. We found ourselves going back to our room a few times just to cool down. 

On a positive note, Patricia who booked our trips was very helpful! She even moved one of our trips for us when I wasn’t well. The trips we did were also amazing and was worth visiting Mexico for! Although the free ‘Cancun’ tour was just two gift shops, not a tour of Cancun. 

Also special shout out to Marco in the traditional Mexican restaurant. He made our last night special and was super friendly!

reviews.author: Jason S
reviews.title: Good resort but needs upgrading
reviews.text: We stayed for 5 days 4 nights one adult two kids in family concierge. Overall , it was a great experience and we enjoyed our time there . The views everywhere were in the resort were breathtaking . The beach area with free lounge areas for hotel guests was very well done and kept up . Our family concierge , Rosanna, was the best !!!! She was extremely attentive , always on top of whatever I needed or asked and gave me true honest  feedback about any question I had . I HIGHLY recommend anyone request her for their concierge . The all inclusive was truly all inclusive and we wanted for not a single thing will there . Now the negatives . AC in the rooms is a bit lacking to say the least . While multiple attempts were made by staff to help make our room more comfortable there’s only so much they could do with a system that you can tell needs an upgrade . Their current AC feels like it’s on its last leg . Only 3 out of 4 elevators on our floor were working and all elevators were definitely small for a resort elevator and outdated . Definitely need an elevator upgrade . Food Service was meh . Even being sparsely crowded for the summer , it took a good while to get a servers attention and then another good while for said server to bring drinks/food. This is with tips being provided generously at every turn . Would I return ? Probably not until they made some necessary upgrades in both AC and customer service waitstaff ; that being said we still had a great time at Paradisus Cancun .

reviews.author: kelvin s
reviews.title: Air conditioning not working
reviews.text: Since I arrived I reported the air conditioning but they never went to check it I called 4 times for the same and they said they were going to send someone but it wasn't like that both days we had to sleep in heat

reviews.author: Ricardo S
reviews.title: The staff is the pillar of this place
reviews.text: This used to be an amazing property. I’m actually sad the way it has deteriorated and hasn’t been kept up with like it should. Fortunately there are people who  make the experience so much better. Notable people to mention, are Dalia and Diego from the reserve breakfast area. Those chilaquiles are what brought me back for a third time. Abraham the mixologist, what a great guy… he makes unbelievable drinks. My concierge Lalo also an amazing person that goes above and beyond. Ricardo and Ramiro from the buffet are super nice people as well, they go above and beyond.  I did notice some staff moral is not where it should be or has been in the past and it’s due to them being understaffed. They are being overworked and that’s reflecting on the customer service.

reviews.author: Becca0102
reviews.title: Good experience but wouldn’t return.
reviews.text:
Amazing at first glance but has improvements to make for the prices of their holiday. Booked via British Airways as a package; I have stayed at a Melia hotel and had BIG expectations. We stayed for 9 days. First time in Mexico. 

Amazing arrival when we got there, refreshments at check in and such an amazing hotel to look at inside the lobby is stunning! But the longer we stay realised that there is NO air conditioning in the lobby areas and it smelt like mould from the damp of the plants it had also been raining a few days while we were there which I’m sure didn’t help! One day the rain was so bad the whole hotel was leaking! Towels everywhere for the leaks it clearly needs some serious tlc on the inside structure and feel there’s a lot of mould hiding in this hotel!

We had a lovely lagoon view but did ask for a cheeky upgrade but was not provided as we wanted more content for my YouTube channel! However, we had a lovely size bed and it was clean with a full minibar.

We then got into a situation where we were told the bar was open until 11pm but unfortunately this was not the case! Last drinks for spirits are at 10.30pm and from 10.45pm it’s only beer! Very disappointing. When the bars shut and there’s no entertainment there isn’t much to do for adults wanting to drink longer it’s pretty much lights out unless you hit the bars or clubs which we did most nights but for all inclusive you’d think more! 

We then complained about this and then asked for more beer which should be in our mini bar it had not been restocked once out the first 4 days we were there we had to ask but we were told it was refilled everyday? Which was also false information. We then decided to write a review we were unsatisfied as we were told information which was wrong and also a reception staff was very rude when bringing this up.

However, the next day we received a letter explaining that guest services would like to help. They offered us apologies; an upgrade to the adults only which was lovely!! And also a sea view room. However, just as we moved room we got moved into a room that STUNK of mould after looking around I did in fact find mould. We then immediately asked to be moved as we refused to stay in a mouldy room! Then moved to another sea view from on the 7th floor, an amazing view and perfect stay however once the rain day came our room became FLOODED with water we used towel after towel cleaning it luckily it stopped raining the day after but it was honestly flooded! I know this can be out of control but as I said the hotel needs a lot of tlc so this damp and mould stops!!
