The Nespresso bars were amazing!!! I would love to give a massive shout out to Alejandro at  Nespresso bar he was amazing bubbly, funny and an overall amazing person who honestly made our mornings!

The pools were amazing, unfortunately at the general pool if you want Bali beds you must pay but there is a lack of sun beds and umbrellas these NEED to be updated and bought in! The hotel is massive and honestly there’s not enough beds or umbrellas you’ll struggle if you go peak time in the afternoon! Luckily we had the choice mid way through our holiday to use adults only where there was more beds and quieter.

The beach was AMAZING so clean!

Overall, I would not return to this hotel. It has a lot of updates to do the food was average too breakfast was the best as well but dinner wasn’t AMAZING!

reviews.author: Stephanie N
reviews.title: Certainly not 5 star!!
reviews.text:
This hotel is nowhere near 5 star.  We were traveling with a group of 20 and chose Nikte upgrade (now called family concierge) mainly because we were told over the phone by the reservationist that the upcharge (+ $120/nt) included "premium" liquor both in the minibar and at the various bars,restaurants etc.  That proved not to be the case and we were told that it would cost extra (per drink) for premium liquor.  Only the Reserve has premium liquor. However, if you're traveling with kids, you cannot stay at the reserve.  So why is the reservation dept giving out false information? I was told to speak to the supervisor in guest services - a total waste of my time and not worth the next watered down tequila! A wonderful concierge , Rocio, was also made available to us and she was a huge help with reservations, etc.  She informed us that premium alcohol was "never" included with Nikte.  Obviously the people booking reservations need better training.  
Our room was nothing special - the bathroom had been updated because the rest of the room looked like a motel.  The A/C hardly worked, sliding door to balcony was IMPOSSIBLE to open, there was garbage in one of the drawers and the beds were Double not Queen - really??? The minibar was only refilled 3 times for our 5 night stay and there was no liquor - just beer, water and juice.  Someone in our group didn't opt for the upgrade and aside from the bathroom the room, minibar, balcony etc were identical.  So, what did we pay for? - the privilege of eating at Sal Steakhouse which was included with the Nikte upgrade. However, after being shown a beautiful presentation of prime Tomahawk steaks, 2" rib-eyes, etc. we were then give the menu options available to us at no charge. We all opted for the included menu.  The food was good but I've definitely had better - again, definitely not worth the $120/nt upcharge. 
Overall, we had a good time but I would definitely pick a different resort next time.  I've stayed at many in Cancun over the years and this would have to be the most in need of a spruce up and inefficiently run.  The staff was great but it seemed management was non-existent.

reviews.author: pricci11
reviews.title: Staff is EXCELLENT!  The facility maintenance and operations were horrible.
reviews.text: Scheduled room 6 months in advance (ocean view master suite in the Reserve) asking for upper floor.  Upon arrival, get assigned basement floor with shrubs blocking the ocean view.  We threatened to go to another hotel, and the staff accommodated with a 7th floor master suite in the non-Reserve section which was much nicer.  We had to wait an additional 3 hours for it.  Raining when we got there, buckets everywhere collecting water from the leaking roof.  Our room had a significant leak as well.  Our shower hot water didn't work in the morning,  Our room refrigerator had to be replaced cause it didn't work.  The replacement didn't work well either.  The bathroom light went out and had to be fixed.  Only one of two elevators were working 9 of the 10 days causing delays moving around.  The restaurants were very good, not great....the food was kinda bland across the board.  It just seems to me that the excellent staff working day to day was doing their very best to cover up for the abysmal failures of leadership at the corporate level when it comes to the building maintenance area and the operations.  There are just some high-level problems you just can't hide no matter how well you treat guests.  A "good" experience overall because of this excellent service at the interaction level......but not 100% sure I would revisit this hotel chain again until they start running their business well....ensuring the building is the highest quality, and the operations/communication is in place.

reviews.author: Andre S
reviews.title: it had some disadvantages but the hotel is decent
reviews.text: Wonderful beach and nice people. It was our first experience at this hotel but unfortunately the buffet which was open air and the birds were diving in the buffet and we decided to transfer to the larger section which had extra costs and the buffet was in an air conditioned environment and when we returned to the room there was no phone and we asked again to have a new room and upon arrival in the new room we discovered that the safe was not fixed to the wall and the next day a hotel employee came to fix it to the wall.

reviews.author: Hamed M
reviews.title: Not Worth the 5-Star Hype
reviews.text:
My recent stay at Paradisus Cancún was unfortunately far from the 5-star experience I anticipated. Here are some key issues I encountered during my visit:

1. Delayed Check-In:
Despite the advertised check-in time of 3 PM, I didn't receive my room until 3:45 PM. This delay set the tone for a series of disappointments.

2. Room Quality:
Upon entering the room, I expected a luxurious, 5-star environment as advertised. However, I was greeted with a cracked sink, a mirror that was fading at the corners, and a shower that felt more akin to a budget motel than a premium resort.

3. Dining Challenges:
Getting food was a major hassle. There was a one-hour waiting list just to dine, making the buffet the only viable option. Even the buffet had a long line in the morning, taking about an hour to get in. Additionally, the service was subpar; it took 20 minutes for servers to return with coffee refills.

4. Pool and Beach Facilities:
The pool area was overcrowded with a limited number of lounge chairs. Unless you secured a spot very early in the morning, finding a chair was impossible. On a positive note, the beach was relatively clean with an adequate number of lounge chairs available.

5. Dinner Wait Times:
Dinner was another disappointment with a two-hour waiting list after 8 PM. This added unnecessary stress to what should have been a relaxing experience.

6. Not Kid-Friendly:
Additionally, this resort is not kid-friendly. There were not many activities for children, making it difficult to keep them entertained.

I visited Paradisus Cancún a few years ago and had an amazing experience, but sadly, the quality has significantly declined. If you are looking for a true 5-star quality hotel, I recommend considering other options. This experience was highly disappointing, and I will not be returning.

I hope this review helps others who are seeking a quality vacation and a resort where they can fully enjoy their time with their family.

reviews.author: Themeis
reviews.title: THE TRUTH  ! THE GOOD , BAD AND THE UGLY
reviews.text:
TThis is our 3rd trip to this part in Mexico , and first big 2 week trip without Kids . 
we chose after a lot of research to stay in the reserve Adult only part of the hotel . the room we chose was the top room , Master Suite ocen view . i would 100% recommend this , the views were amazing , had 4 balconies , 1 from the main bedroom and 3 different angles from the suite lounge part , 2 bathrooms , loads of hanging space in both rooms , bed was super comfy  .  i will add 1st room we had did not have 2 bathrooms , the are all slightly different configs . 
Room 5412 and 5610 are highly recommended 

with the reserve you get a concierge who checks in on you via whatsapp and meeting you , booking restaurants , and our one was excellent  

Restaurants were ion general good and very good , apart from the Buffet ! 

fav restaurants  Dinner  = Flora  , Lemon fish , Sals Steak ( 1 complimentary dinner with reserve booking ) 
the Buffet was disappointing , too small , both in seating and choice .
if you compare this to the finest , the Finest was different level .
we had to queue up few times to get in , and the line for the cooked  eggs was way too long . 

the pool area in the reserve was great , it wasn’t busy , great  pool / bar . amazing views and we were able to get a cabana nearly every day . 

ok the bad - we were unlucky, we had a week of tropical storms , mid june , if it was 2 weeks of super sunny weather maybe the rest wouldn’t of been see or mattered as much , as we would never of known . 

as above the Buffet not up to standard compared to others  

the hotel was built 40 Years ago and refurbed a few times , so for instance our room and hotel areas all good . But , the finish / fittings you can tell , so when we had a storm , with bad rain and worse wind , was terrible , water came in our patio doors really badly and we had a leak in the ceiling - to be fair the hotel did try and help out with cleaning up , repairs , but wasn’t what u expect from a 5* hotel . my point they are not cut out for any stormy weather imo  !  

i would say the Assistant manager was super helpful re this issue and we managed to sort things out 

also entertainment could be inproved , 1 show was fun , abba , the other things they had not great and some started too early if ur ating at 730 / 8 pm you will miss it  

very special mention to 

GALDINO - our concierge , did an amazing job , couldn’t do enough to help , and did his best with any issues we had - he was amazing  
LUIZ - barmen at pool bar in the reserve so helpful welcoming , friendly etc 
STEPHANIE   - FLORA restaurant  , so nice  

SUMMARY  - good value for what you pay , would i go again  ? no , maybe we were spoilt by the Finest but i think the Hotel rooms need to be sorted and modernized , and the buffet knocked down , made much bigger , better choices  !

reviews.author: Culture63012337554
reviews.title: Lovely Lobby...
reviews.text: Full of surprises...the hotel lobby and entry points are beyond impressive and aesthetically pleasing, but it all abruptly ends when you get to your room.  There was a total of four rooms booked in our party and EVERY one of us had to relocate to different rooms due to everything from water leaks, no a/c, and my personal experience...we entered a room that was occupied.  The rooms simply are falling apart and need a thorough cleaning.  The dining options were fine, and the vibe was chill, but I couldn't get over the air vents with inches of dust mites and gritty floors.  The front desk staff were also just ok, they did not even seem 'moved' by the fact that I entered a room that was still occupied.  Good Luck!

reviews.author: Alejandro Guarda
reviews.title: bad experience
reviews.text:
the room that touched us was in bad shape, the air conditioning very noisy, the bathroom in bad shape, the third day we changed rooms.
the beach of this hotel is very bad, the pools, beautiful but to touch an umbrella you must be at 8 in the morning, rent you some beds at 250 dollars, crazy, the food is varied but without red meats, very few proteins, have different restaurants and just the meat has to be paid, the Italian restaurant is bad, you order pasta and they bring you supermarket spaguettis, the service in general is bad, except for some waiters, inside the same hotel they try to put memberships at the point of deceit, the activities are also of a very basic level, I have been in hotels cheaper than this and the activities are better, in general I would never return to this hotel

reviews.author: Carlos G
reviews.title: Improving service is an area of opportunity
reviews.text: Insufficient staff for the number of guests, this means that the staff is not friendly or available for the most part, the umbrellas in the pools are scarce and if for some reason we were late we could no longer find anywhere to protect ourselves from the sun. The terrace of the room was flooded the days we stayed although it rained little. The facilities are nice but they smell musty.

reviews.author: Juan PabloJG
reviews.title: Beware hotel not prepared for POWER outages!!
reviews.text:
Let's go on the good side, I stayed in Paradisus 2 years ago and I left disappointed with the food in most of the restaurants, this time I was pleasantly surprised that they changed some restaurants and added another (organic food), which yes Well, the name didn't sell it to me but the food was very good, the salmon, the green pasta, and most of the dishes.  They even improved the quality and types of food at the buffet! Italian also improved. 
The part that is incompressible, 11 at night with the desire to continue drinking gin, there was no bar open, not even room service does they bring you alcohol at that time. TOTALLY INSANE! Then on the last day the hotel's power went out, around 10 PM, I suppose it was due to someone else's fault, the issue is that the rooms and common spaces are not prepared for the air conditioners to function, in my case at 6 AM the power did not come back on, I mean, I went to rest with my family and we didn't sleep that night, the heat was unbearable and the hotel never gave information on when the power could come back on.  A hotel of the category they boast of is not prepared for a power outage!!! nor the staff prepared to act with the guests in those cases.

reviews.author: linamarivera25
reviews.title: I would not stay in paradise again
reviews.text:
It is not a family hotel, there is absolutely nothing for children, the people who serve are NOT friendly, they are rude, the phone in the room was always damaged and I was never able to order room service, which is what you really pay for, there were more Damaged things in the room like the balcony door got all the water into the room and the coffee maker never worked  
I recommend that for the price you pay in Paradisus you look for another hotel that is better

reviews.author: David_balam
reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: The hotel is kind of old but they have a nice beach, the NICKTE concept comes in handy. In reality there is no difference in the service or any detail in the room. We are Melia customers and at Paradisus Playa del Carmen they offer you gifts for the children and they give you a better quality service and details that make a difference.

reviews.author: Erika G
reviews.title: I DO NOT RECOMMEND IT
reviews.text:
The hotel is very nice, it has a beautiful beach, although upon my arrival I had to see cockroaches in one of the bathrooms near the lobby, in addition to the toilets being quite dirty, the room with sea views is spacious and very clean, this is the 2nd time I have visited and I continue to complain. of the TERRIBLE attention, if you are a foreigner, I have no doubt that they will treat you with the tea and leaves as a national; it seems that you are going to ask them for free and that your money is not worth it.
I think it's excellent that they have a smoking area.
In my opinion, Malva's food was very bad except for Flora, the service was fast and delicious, Blue Agave was too slow and it really bothered me to go for 4 tacos and they kept me waiting for more than half an hour.

reviews.author: Robert A
reviews.title: MELIÁ Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: I so very much wanted to write a good review but my conscious dictated otherwise. The flight there and back was almost perfect, including customs. When we arrived at the hotel, we were greeted and escorted to registration.  That’s when the nightmare began, 2+ hours registering 3 couples in 3 different rooms. The registration person and her manager has zero customer service skills and have poor English skills. Once you get to your room, you can see the resort is old and needs updating/repairs.  The highlight of each was our server, Martine, in the Malva buffet. The buffet was okay but continuously ran out of different offerings. Onto the pool for a few hours, we stayed in the same area most days and our server was Didi, who was awesome. The only issue we had was they would run out of different alcohols and nothing was top shelf, unless you paid extra.  Once it was time for dinner, that was the disturbing part of the day. Each restaurant we visited, no matter what time, always had a 30 - 90 minute wait, unless of course you pulled out a $20 bill and then you had the next table, we did that twice. The food at the restaurants was typical buffet food, absolutely nothing special. The best 2 restaurants being Lemon Fish and Blue Agave. Capella was a close 3rd choice. We did go off property to eat 1 night at Harry’s Steakhouse, which was awesome, $1,185 plus a 20% tip for a family of 8, including drinks and dessert. Highly recommend Harry’s Steakhouse. The nightly entertainment was cute for the kids and we enjoyed the positivity of the entertainers. As fir cocktails, unless you gave the bartender a $50 tip to start out, you waited for drinks and couldn’t get top shelf alcohol, plus there is such inconsistency between the bars in how drinks were made. I can honestly say the best part of our stay at Paradisus is when we left. This is not a 5 star resort but charge as if they are a 5 star resort. They’re more like a 3 star resort. Will we ever go back to Paradisus, no we will not. All 3 couple felt the same way. Sorry MELIÁ Paradisus  Cancún, but you are losing customers for life. Instead will will stay at a hotel over on Isla Mujeres.

reviews.author: Battler V
reviews.title: Vacation fatigue
reviews.text: "Vacationing" in this hotel was an agony for us. The hotel itself and its view from inside is impressive at first, but its enormity completely destroys convenience. You must go down and up the floors to get to the restaurants. Only one floor has a through passageway. All others are confined to their "pyramid." The hotel looks powerful, but it is very outdated regarding equipment and technical support: ventilation is noisy, the refrigerator whistles, ventilation in the toilet is broken and does not work, ventilation is not adjusted and in one room is cold, in the other hot. As for service, everything is according to Mexican traditions, which is not a superclass. Restaurants are quite normal. Swimming in the sea was impossible: waves and loose sand. But the pool is really beautiful. The general impression is as follows: we "struggled" with the circumstances of the enormity of the hotel, and departure from the hotel was the most desirable event.

reviews.author: meshellatl
reviews.title: Good for a work conference but wouldn’t pay for a personal vacation
reviews.text:
Mixed feelings about this all-inclusive but glad I didn’t have to pay since it was a work trip. The good: nice private beach area, a couple of good restaurants (Lemon Fish was definitely the best… Flora and Blue Agave were decent… Malva, the buffet, was average) and the overall grounds were nice and well kept. The air conditioning in the conference area was great and they did a good job accommodating all of us (almost 500 people) during lunch.

The reason I wouldn’t pay…. 1) Made sense that the communal areas didn’t have a/c bc it’s a big lobby - would be a nightmare to keep cool. But the room a/c was minimal at best. Luckily, I requested a floor fan and they brought me one so that saved the trip… not sure how I would’ve been able to sleep without it as the room temp with a/c at the lowest setting felt like 75-80 the whole time. 2) Request to get more bottled water took 2 hours and 2 calls to get 3) it just didn’t have the 5 star feeling. The room was dated, there was duct tape holding one of the elevator panels on… for $450/night for their basic room (I extended my stay) it also seemed tacky to charge $5/usd for each room service delivery (and you had to call them to pick up the dishes after). 

Recommendation to the hotel: get Melia to update your app so customers can order through it and stop charging room service delivery. Invest in updating rooms so there isn’t rust around the faucets, better lighting and air conditioning

reviews.author: Nelson C
reviews.title: Nice hotel. Bad management decisions.
reviews.text: Bars close at 10:45pm. And when you want to watch the playoff hockey game the response is "we don't get that channel" or "we lost the remote" even though everyone was watching hockey a few nights ago. BTW, some rooms don't have air conditioning. Don't blame the staff, they do their best.

reviews.author: MaryAnn R
reviews.title: GREAT PEOPLE, beware of CLUB membership.  Research the reviews on it.
reviews.text: Couldn't get the little  things right... replenishing water,minibar, snacks or even a pen.  Everything shuts down at 11:00.   DON'T go to hear about the hotel unless you're looking for a different twist on a time share, BUT ALL STAFF WERE AWESOME PEOPLE.

reviews.author: Manosith
reviews.title: Big Meh
reviews.text:
Despite booking directly through their website it took 1-1.5hrs to check in (not counting queue time)
No concierge were assigned to us so we had to figure out everything on our own on our first day which is terrible after our long flight and being our first time in Cancun. Hotel does show its age and the hotel was mostly humid most of our stay. Buffet was decent but the surrounding was beautiful. Few workers went above and beyond that was what saved the stay.
Overall one of the worst 5 stars hotel we ever stayed felt like a 3.5-4 star hotel.

reviews.author: Devanshu S
reviews.title: Average experience - did not see any value.
reviews.text:
We visited in April and the issues started with check in. I was visiting with another family and we made requested for adjacent rooms when we booked five months in advance. However, no one considered request which was a bummer as our kids wanted to play together. Anyways, we were in oceanfront room and the view was spectacular. 
Saw some ants in the room, wash basin was clogged or very slow, room needed some TLC for sure. 
Food and drinks were very average, we are vegetarians was surprised finding an avocado for breakfast can be so daunting.
One thing which stood out was the services provided by our concierge MICHELLE. She made every effort to solve our issues and always carried a smile.
Overall, I will not recommend for vegetarian families, there are so few options.

reviews.author: Jc Val
reviews.title: There are things to improve
reviews.text:
It has good and bad things, among the most notable, the buffet food, despite being very repetitive, is rich and quality inputs are perceived, the human talent is also to be admired, especially the attention on the beach (Mr. Javier) and restaurants (Mr. Atilano, Mr. Raul). But there are many things that do not match the costs of the hotel and it is that there is a lot of deterioration inside the rooms. In addition to them for 4 days, they only refilled the mini bar in one of them, they did not change the towels and on another occasion they did not recover them, however the instructions for the process of changing them were followed.
In addition to this, the damage to the room, balcony door that does not close and therefore difficult to have air conditioning, clogged sink, leaks in the shower. The view of the room spectacular
It could be commented that it can be reported or made known to the reception, however one should not be looking for compliance with processes that the hotel has to cover without major obstacles.
Paradisus Cancun, despite being the same chain, falls quite short of Paradisus Playa del Carmen.

reviews.author: SuzanneA
reviews.title: Nikte NOT worth it
reviews.text:
This was my 5th time at this hotel and I will have to think long and hard about coming back. Hotel has become really run down, with the pool visibly dirty and some days water level was so low it was pretty gross. Room was in sad shape- lots of lights out, in need of a deep clean and entire wall outside my room was being worked on the entire time.

Nikte has replaced family conceirge and, while costing the same as the adult only reserve upgrade, really was worthless while the same cost of the reserve provides significant benefits and access. Sal access was useless for families since you had to be over 18 to access and on vacation people eat dinner with their families. 

I am disappointed as Paradisus Cancún used to be the go to place for my family and the level of service, food and hotel condition have really gone downhill while Paradisus prices and advertises as a 4/5 star resort- it’s sadly become a 3 star resort with significant room for improvement. 

Check in was a nightmare- Nikte no longer gets private check in while the same cost of Reserve gets a private check in. Mini bar was never refilled during my 6 nights, my Nikte excursion that was supposed to be included was never mentioned, no free bottle of wine either that was supposed to be included with Nikte. I called and asked for a hair dryer and at first was told no and that the hotel didn’t have any available all were in use. The a la carte restaurants were not that great and mostly all the same food from the buffet was seen again in the other restaurants.  Dinner at the buffet was just plain gross- we ended up going out most nights after a while. I was never contacted when my room became available despite being told I would be at check in. Coffee was never replaced after I used it the first morning. 

Advice to hotel: return to private Nikte check in similar to how Family conceirge check in used to be. Check in and how it was handled really started the vacation off wrong- after all that hassle then I had to wait to meet the person assigned to me- which was the last thing I wanted to do after a flight and dealing with the hassle of the existing check in process, it became an aggravation and another annoyance. My “concierge” didn’t really do anything either to make my stay more enjoyable- a text every morning isn’t the level of service I had received in the past and they didn’t do  really do anything to enhance my stay. 

Check out left a pretty bad taste with the bellhop harassing my son and I for our bags when we showed up 2 minutes before our pickup and didn’t need help- and had to say as much too many times. The bellhop wouldn’t leave us alone asking us about our ride and did we pay already and what company did we use and was just in general obviously trying to get a tip but when I said leave us alone we are all set- he persisted. So both check in and check out were bad experiences due to the staff. 

Those that were fantastic were Luis and pool waiter Hernandez (I hope I am remembering his name correct) at the pool as well as the man working at the coffee bar. All three should be recognized for their great customer service, not just to me but to all customers they interacted with.

reviews.author: Pioneer52026026509
reviews.title: A little disappointed. The food is not up to the standard of the hotel. Only Gabi and her boys are in tune with the people.e
reviews.text: The food, the cleanliness is not the best. The mariachi shows didn't let us have dinner and be able to talk to each other. The attention of the people was average to me with one EXCPETION: GINGER SPORT BAR: Gabi (super nice and attentive), Jorge, Alberto and Gladis... honestly this place was the only one where I felt cared for in a hotel of this size. style should represent. They should learn from them. Constructive criticism.

reviews.author: Sarah G
reviews.title: Not the best value for money
reviews.text: When we arrived we had really high hopes of spending new year at this hotel. I was left disappointed by the hotel not allowing bookings for evening meals. We stayed for 9 nights & got in to only 1 restaurant that we actually wanted to visit. We spent so much time being told they were fully booked come back in 90/120 minutes ect it just became a joke. I’ve spent much less on other holidays & got a far better service. The food also isn’t Amazing some of it was good but nothing to write home about. Most of the staff were lovely to be fair always happy to bring you drinks while we were chilling in the reserve area. (Adults only) our concierge was hopeless to be honest don’t know what he actually did. The information we asked for we never received. The manager walked round one morning to chat to the guests who all seemed to have the same complaints but not sure anything was done about it. Don’t think I would visit again as you’re paying 5* money but getting 3 star service @ best.

reviews.author: Inkpen73
reviews.title: Not 5 star quality
reviews.text: There were lots of good points but more negative points and sadly the hotel does live up to its 5 star claim. The view and food was good, beds were okay but the room was a bit shabby for me and my family.  The rooms were not cleaned till the evening and towels were often not replaced. Getting subbed impossible and the staff did not help as they want everyone to pay for the 250 dollar cabanas. While most of the staff were good some were very rude,  especially in all the bar areas and would serve drinks to their ‘preferred’ customers and miss some that had been standing for 20mins! Sadly we left my daughter’s watch in the room but the appropriate team had not even bothered to reply despite sending 2 emails.

reviews.author: Gabriel Malovays
reviews.title: Spectacular food, average service
reviews.text:
I tend to be very objective in my reviews because I think this platform is very useful for those of us who are frequent travelers.

The hotel has a privileged beach, the food is exquisite and of a very good culinary level, especially the Lemon Fish. I would like to make a special mention of the waiter Abraham, who offers an extraordinary service in addition to knowing magic tricks that he performs in case he sees small children. in your reservation.

Something that I definitely did not like was that the hotel does not have a reservation system in the restaurants as usually happens in hotels that have specialty restaurants, a situation that makes your stay not pleasant because it is very complicated that upon arrival at a specialty restaurant there is a table available to be able to enter your dinner, having to wait about an hour or ending up deciding to go to the buffet restaurant (where the food is also very delicious)

This situation of not being able to reserve your dinner time generates a lot of annoyance among guests, since unfortunately the table assignment staff is not trained to be able to handle it, creating a bad experience during your stay.

Another special mention that I think I should recognize is the service of the waiters, Martin from the Malva restaurant has a truly warm and extraordinary level of service, making your start to the day very enjoyable.

The staff is not fully trained to give you accurate information, the tennis court is open from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. and there is no one to give you the rackets and balls at 7:00 a.m. because the service staff guest arrives until 8:00 hrs. I asked at the reception and Rafael told me that the staff arrived until 9:00 with nothing that could be done, until I asked to speak with a supervisor, that was when they gave me the rackets and balls to use the tennis court.

Another situation that I observed where the staff was not trained, is that upon my arrival I asked the room concierge about a Teens Club where there were video games so that my children could play during my stay, they told me that there was no type of service. and that only with one type of membership could they provide us with a video game console in the room; Later my children discovered that there was an area where there were video games for guests.

Something that I loved about the hotel is that there is a cafeteria open 24 hours a day with Nespresso coffee and cakes and baguettes for guests. A highly valued service because the coffees and desserts are very delicious.

One point that, at least I didn't like, was that the people at the reception immediately look at your wrist to know what type of bracelet you have to answer any questions you have during your stay. That happened to me with Rafael, who gave me imprecise information. of the arrival time of the guest service area and who confirmed again that there was no video game area for children and that only guests with a Nicte membership could request a video game console in the room.

The level of maintenance of the hotel is not good, my room 3604 did not close the door properly and you had to pull it very hard to ensure that it did not stay open, in fact on one day of our stay after the cleaning service was done the room was left open.

In summary, I think that the hotel is a good resort but it has points that can be improved to make the guest's stay more pleasant.

reviews.author: Alfredo C
reviews.title: Nikte is not the Reserve for families
reviews.text:
We are a family that travels three or four times a year to Cancun, we had visited the Paradisus in Cancun three or four times in previous years, and the one in Playa del Carmen. likewise.

We have a bad impression now that we come as a family because before - at least in Playa del Carmen - we contracted the “Reserve” package, and now we could only contract the “Nikte” package, for coming as a family.

The big issue is that they sell the package as a “superior” package, and the truth is that it does not include anything additional, or superior that is worth it, being that the “reserve” does have premium liquor, for example, but that for Coming as a family, unfortunately, you have no scope, which is disappointing.

reviews.author: J S
reviews.title: Average Experience
reviews.text:
I’ve stayed at both Paradisus Cancun and Cabo.  I do not think I’ll return to either as there are far superior resorts in both locations.  Paradisus Cancun is a beautiful property/location, but the resort is run down. My party received an “updated” luxury ocean view room and it was still fairly basic.  Sink in bathroom did not drain properly.  No coffee in room.  Check in process is a nightmare. Expect to wait at least one hour.  This is the first resort I’ve been to that does not give you a room until the exact check in time (3pm).  Others in our party did not receive their room until almost 4 pm.
If you have a room in the main pyramid (#3), be aware that it will be loud until appx 11 pm due to shows and music. This was not an issue for my party, but may be for others.  
Restaurants do not accept reservations.  If you want to eat any at of the restaurants you need to line up at 6 pm to put your name on the list.  For Lemon Fish, you’ll need to line up even earlier.  If you have a larger party (9 or more), expect a 2 hour wait for a table (or be told they cannot accommodate your party). We were only able to eat at Cielo and Capella.  Buffet food was hit and miss.  Often cold.  
Pool has minimal shade and chairs.  My party rented a cabana near the pool bar for $255 PER DAY (x 4 days).  Includes a bottle of champagne and seafood platter each day.  Jorge, our cabana waiter, was excellent.  Service elsewhere in the resort was average.

reviews.author: Suzy I
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel, Service needs work.
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at the Paradisus Cancun Hotel and I have some thoughts. First off, the hotel itself is gorgeous. The grounds look amazing and the ocean view is really nice. But that's where most of the good stuff ends.

The main problem is that there aren't enough people working there for all the guests. It felt like they couldn't help us much because they were always busy or just not around.

For example, they say they have a pool concierge, but don't expect much. They won't set up your beach or pool chair. Finding a seat is all on you. This led to a lot of guests grabbing more chairs than they needed and no one from the hotel did anything about it. We even had to wake up super early to get chairs, but then other guests would just take them. And there weren't enough umbrellas, which was a big issue for some of us who needed shade. We tried talking to the staff about it, but didn't get much help. One staff member (Luis) even told us to just steal someone else's chair! Then, a manager Ignacio came and when the server was explaining to him what was going on - he rolled his eyes and told him to ignore us in Spanish and walked away. I was really surprised. This has never happened to me at any hotel before. 

Other guests had the same problem with chairs and not enough towels. Sometimes there was only one person taking orders by the pool, and they said they couldn't take our order.

Check-in was another headache. It took forever, and there were lots of people waiting behind us too.

Eating here was tough as well. You can't book tables at the restaurants, so we had to wait a long time to get a table for our group of 8. 

Some staff members were nice, but a lot of them didn't seem too happy to help or answer questions. It's a shame because the hotel is truly beautiful. But the service, or lack of it, really made our trip less enjoyable.

I don't like giving bad reviews, but I think if the hotel worked on these issues, staying here would be so much better.

reviews.author: arati d
reviews.title: Quick get away
reviews.text: Not what I expected.  The food was subpar and repetitive.  Long line up for the buffet.    Lemon Fish was the only good al carte. Amazing sushi. The rooms are clean but dated.  It was a beautiful resort with friendly people but that's all. Disappointed

reviews.author: Juan Jose G
reviews.title: Everyone is in a hurry. Id like to have more attention from staff. Except Fernanda Ortega and the buffet captain. Great
reviews.text: Everyone is in a hurry. Seems to be all are mad and just want to leave. Except Fernanda Ortega and the buffet restaurant captain who are great people who pursuit in helping us and engaged to give us a great experience and a great time. My congrats to them.

reviews.author: Kelly P
reviews.title: Great service, average thoughts on overall resort.
reviews.text: It’s a huge resort, took days to feel comfortable. Biggest disappointment was everything shutting down at 11pm every night. Room service was available but wait times were long. Activities were off time and just ok, if you weren’t there 15mins early you couldn’t get a spot. The Buffett was great, tons of options, Armando, Ignacio and Jonny made every visit incredible.

reviews.author: biki_ma
reviews.title: Take this cat to the vet!!!!!
reviews.text:
The resort cat Daisy is sick with upper respiratory infection and this was reported multiple times by me and different ppl to the front desk and supervisor Angelica but I doubt they will do anything about it. 
They use this cat as mascot of the resort but don’t care for her, they don’t feed her nor take her to the vet.
This morning she stopped eating completely, I hope she won’t die but she will if they don’t take her to the vet.
Heartless people, only running after $$$

reviews.author: dan270960
reviews.title: HALF FIG HALF GRAPE
reviews.text:
We went to Paradisus from February 18 to 27. Here are the negatives and positives
Negatives: When we arrived at our room, big disappointment...view of the lagoon and also of the parking lot...the balcony very small and no place to sit. And even sitting, view of the concrete from the balcony. No coffee available in the room.
-Positive: They worked hard to find us another room that was a little better with an ocean view but still with an unusable balcony.
-Chairs on the beach, impossible to lie down...mid-sitting position only...First time I've seen this in a resort...
-Positive: Very beautiful beach cleaned every day and very pleasant water for swimming.
-Negative: Not enough accessible restaurants and too long waiting time (up to 2 hours waiting some evenings). Why 2 Mexican restaurants?
-Positive: Very nice buffet in the morning and at lunchtime.
-Negative: Lobby bar, only one person serving drinks and not available every evening. The bartenders have a tough time but are long enough to be served.
Positive: The kindness of the people at the resort in general. The service at the Malva buffet: Alfredo, Martin and Gérardo were very nice and friendly. They made our stay very pleasant during our meals.
-Negative: Apart from the Malva (buffet) the only interesting "restaurant" for us is the Lemon Fish but the waiting time is too long.
-Positive: Congratulations to Angel for his patience and having to deal with people who were very irritated or intoxicated by the waiting time. A nice thought for Miguel too.
-Negative: Lighting too bright at the Capella
-Positive: The menu at Capella is very interesting and Jesus was very kind.
-Negative: Not being "preferred", no access to the healthy restaurant or the Steak for a fee.
In summary: The price paid is too high for this huge resort but the kindness of the people made our stay interesting.
Danny

reviews.author: Anonimus
reviews.title: If you are looking for a five star hotel, don't come here.
reviews.text:
If you are looking for a real 5 star hotel, this is not the place for you. It might have been 5 stars 15 years ago, but now it can be rated 3 stars.
The buildings, rooms, common areas, restaurants, pools are very out dated and the all property need a big renovation. They are trying to fix things and painting some surfaces but this only makes everything more out dated. The furnitures in the restaurants are worn out, the chairs are dirty, the kinderdome need a big cleaning, because the toys and tools are very dirty. We visited there two times, but never again..

Lot of guest complaning, that there are not enough sunbeds around the pools, and less umbrellas, only every 8-10th sunbesd comes with unbrella, so you can burn to red in the sun, or you are forced to rent a balinese bed for $250 a day if you need any shades.
It is unacceptable in a 5-star hotel where you pay USD 400-700 per night that you have to spread your towel on the concrete by the pool because there are not enough beds. Families have to sit on their towells by the pool or on the beach in the sand, because there are not enough palapas on the beach too, but there are lot of balinese beds for extra cost of course..
It is outrageous in a 5-star hotel, that you have to reserve a sunbed early morning, between 6-7am in the darkness, because if you arrive later, no chance to have any bed.
The staff and service are good, excep the staff at the check-in. They are very rude and dismissive.
We booked two Nikte rooms, and we got a Nikte room, while the other room was a  lower category older and smaller. When we complained, the manager was upset and wanted to convince us that both rooms were Nikte category. Even though we showed them their website, it was clear that based on the photos, the other room was not a Nikté. It took 2 days to change the room to a Nikté category, but they refuse to refund the difference for two nights between the Nikté and lower category room. Lot of people complain about the quality of the rooms, and the staff don't do nothing.

The hotel hosts a lot of weddings and conferences, so the only heated pool and the area around, are closed several times a week at 2 p.m., to pepare for the event, so the guests have to leave and and there is no chance to find other sunbed on the beach or by the other pool.

The food is average or below. They are not nicely presented and at the pool, the food is served on aluminum trays, usually cold

In conclusion, the beach is beautiful, with white sands, but if you are looking for a five star hotel, don't come here. If only the all inclusive plan and the lots of tequila is the most important, then this is your place, but if the 5 stars quality is, a good food, look for another hotel. If this hotel is a 5 stars, I think the JW  Marriott 8 stars next door. The Paradisus Cancun was a big disappointment for us

reviews.author: FellowTraveler178947
reviews.title: Good hotel with a great beach
reviews.text: The rooms were dated and could use some refresh. There were entertainments and activities to do throughout the day. Every worker there was very friendly, accommodating, and helpful. Special thanks to our concierge, Daniela, who listened to our concerns and went up and beyond to make things right. She also helps us made last minute reservations and check in on us daily to make sure we are doing good.

reviews.author: Phillip G
reviews.title: Beautiful grounds, but the chairs!
reviews.text:
Currently staying here so maybe my rating will change, but there are definitely pros and cons.

The grounds are beautiful. I’ll give them that. Everything is well maintained and the ambiance at the restaurants is top notch. The food at the restaurants is good. As far as the rooms go, the bed is comfortable and the layout of the room overall is nice.

There are definitely some negatives though. To start, the rooms do not have a coffee maker. This seems like it should be a standard amenity. We asked three different people to send one to the room and got three different answers. The chairs at the pool and beach are constantly taken. Seems like people get up at 630 am to reserve their spot. I wouldn’t mind if people were in the pools, but that’s not the case. The pools are empty. Where are the people??? You shouldn’t be able to throw your stuff on a chair and leave for hours. There should be a policy update. Either that or please add more chairs. 

Overall, I would rate this hotel 3 stars right now. It could be 5 stars, but there are some things that need to changed in order for that to happen.

reviews.author: Sergio A
reviews.title: THANKS FOR EVERYTHING CÉSAR (Mexican restaurant)
reviews.text: At the Mexican restaurant, César, the best, shined, it is the best thing that has happened to me since I arrived here, he has 10/10 hospitality, I of you will give him tips and not only that, but also a raise or better yet Let the manager do it, why? Because today's manager, the one with a white shirt, on February 17, 2024, behaved very badly, disastrous in my opinion, very poor customer service, the customer is always right and César made me understand it, but this lady He refused our pleasure and did nothing but harm to our entire group and worse, to my mental health and the rest of the group that accompanied us. On the other hand, Felipe, the Cuban, is not only one of the best chefs who has served me, but one of the people with the biggest hearts I have ever met, a great friend to remember.

reviews.author: ClauZ
reviews.title: NOT SUITABLE FOR FAMILIES WITH TEENS OR FOR DEMANDING GUESTS
reviews.text:
The GOOD: The facilities.
The food, in general, except Mexican food that is nothing like the native one. Restaurant Lemon Fish and Nespresso point
The BAD: Excessive restrictions for those under 18 years of age - they are not allowed to participate in many activities or stay in a beach bar or a bar with a pool, not even accompanied by their parents (I am referring to a 13-year-old teenager).
Almost zero entertainment - some live musical acts (with poor quality sound) and a few beach/pool/indoor activities with little attendance. No nightly shows or entertainment equipment like in other hotels.
The cocktail bar: with the exception of the drinks prepared by Orlando at the pool bar, the drinks are horrible and served in plastic glasses. They denied me a glass of tequila (national drink that is supposed to be included in the Nikte plan)
The attention: in general it is bad, and not because of the bad predisposition of the staff, but rather as a policy of the hotel: good manners are tip-dependent.
Bad management in restaurants: even if the restaurant is empty, they do not allow you to sit wherever you like. You no longer have to reserve dinner in restaurants in advance, but since they are always full, you inevitably end up on a waiting list that is arbitrarily managed.
the beach: although it is not the hotel's fault, it should be noted that the beach has sectors with significant unevenness and stones that make it very difficult to navigate
the Mexican restaurant: very small, not suitable for claustrophobics. The greasy and unpleasant food, very different from the native ones I have tried in CDMX.
In short, I do not recommend it to go as a family with teenagers or children or for demanding guests.

reviews.author: Siqueiros102
reviews.title: Bad mouth taste
reviews.text:
It's not the first time I've gone, it lost that exclusive touch, I highly recommended it to my partner and it was a great owe.
I feel that the hotel is a little neglected even though they have done renovations, it smelled a lot of fresh paint near my room and there is a lack of more personal details that make you feel at home.

reviews.author: chareleneserrano
reviews.title: Feedback
reviews.text: rooms in tower 1 need to be updated it looks outdated. Accessibility to restaurants & coffee are only in tower 3 which if you stay at any other tower you have to walk to the main tower to get food or coffee. Yes you can order room service but after the second one you pay 6 dollars.

reviews.author: Carolina G
reviews.title: Don't go with children
reviews.text:
Don't go with children. Although it is allowed, the hotel is not prepared and the staff not only does not facilitate the stay but is annoyed that they are there. While we were at breakfast, they took away the sugar packets that my daughter was playing with because it bothered them. They do not allow you to remove food from the buffet to take it to another place unless it is in your own food container.
The sofa bed is unpresentable for a hotel of this category.
Although the restaurants say they are open until 11 p.m., at 9:45 they no longer let us enter one of them and on another occasion they brought us appetizers, main course and dessert all together because the kitchen closes at 10 p.m.
Access is on a first-come, first-served basis and reservations are not accepted. So you have to decide at the moment if there is no place after waiting in line.
Every night there is a music show in a part of the hotel that is heard very loudly in the rooms, not even allowing you to hear the TV. Lasts until 11pm.
There is a heated pool but sometimes it is reserved for private events so you are not allowed access.
Little variety of food at the buffet and poor service at the stations that prepare food.
The beach is good, the room and the view are very good too.
We expected more from this hotel for the price of the stay. We prefer other chains.

reviews.author: dolcesollove
reviews.title: Not bad but not so great
reviews.text: If you are looking for a hotel with bang for the buck, this place might be the one. The location is great and the beach and hotel are beautiful. But there are too much option for extra cost and for all-inclusive, service and everything I don't know what exactly but something lacks little bit.

reviews.author: Ric J
reviews.title: Carders served it up big!
reviews.text: The pillows are the fluffiest I’ve ever felt! Caesar was great he suggested some great menu items. Unfortunately the didn’t have Caesar salad or Caesar to drink. The tacos were great and the drinks were flowing all night long. I worth paying for the meal at an all inclusive resort.

reviews.author: Sanda24
reviews.title: Wouldn't stay here again
reviews.text:
I'll start with a pros and cons list:

Pros:
Comfortable bed and pillow
Fairly good food and very good service at buffet and beach
Liked having the room key as part of our all-inclusive bracelet
Liked that we did not need towel cards
Good water pressure in shower and good hairdryer
Most of the drinks were made well (not diluted)
Plenty of outlets in room

Cons:
Narrow drop-off beach
Loungers on beach and in room were not adjustable. Could not lay down flat or sit in a  more upright position to read.
No coffee-maker or clock in the room
Steps everywhere, even in the room. A 4" step in to the bathroom, into the shower and
   into the toilet stall.  Constantly tripping
Air conditioner condensation constantly dripping on the floor in middle of room
Patio door ridiculously heavy and hard to open
No clothesline in shower area for hanging wet swimwear
Not enough shade by pool area

General Comments:
This was a lovely property but too many negatives for us to return.  We've stayed at other all-inclusives that cost less money that worked better for us.  
One of my favorite things is sitting out on the balcony with my morning coffee while still in my PJs.  It defeats the experience to have to get dressed and go and get a coffee to bring back to the room.  I don't want to have to get dressed for room service either plus I want my coffee now.  
The fact that the loungers on the balcony and on the beach did not change position was totally unacceptable.  We've been to many properties over the years and have never experienced that.
The food was fairly good but no better than many places we've stayed for less money.

reviews.author: 4fun42024
reviews.title: The Reserve - Changes to bad
reviews.text:
Was staying Here before, but now the Reserve has changed in 2 important Points. Bali beds Reservation only twice per stay and Restaurants are now First come First serve which lead to inappropriate waiting times for me.
Staff was very nice, friendly and helpful as Always. Special thanks to Nicole. Very Well and organized Handling of the Pool area.

reviews.author: Kathleen F
reviews.title: Beach Bar was a highlight!
reviews.text: Great service at Kanna beach bar. Abraham and Karina are the best! Also excellent service at the adults only pool. Victor hooked us up with chairs and cabanas every day. Food was mediocre and room didn’t have outlets by the bed which was not ideal.  Overall had a great time for a long weekend.

reviews.author: Luis A
reviews.title: Good hotel, needs to improve service
reviews.text:
Terrible service upon arrival (no bellboy attends, waiters are inflexible in accommodating large groups at tables together), however the kids club and the staff that takes care of the children is excellent, they really allow parents to have the peace of mind that their children are safe and having fun.

The quality of food and drinks is good, the beach is very good too, balconies unsafe for children.

reviews.author: KatieB76
reviews.title: Mostly “All Inclusive”
reviews.text: We booked through Chase using our points. We chose this place because it was advertised as “all inclusive”, but there were so many things that were not actually included. Certain drinks, restaurants, etc. Even room service had an upcharge. I am not sure if this is typical, but we were both surprised and a little miffed, having just left a different all-inclusive resort. That said, the staff was absolutely wonderful. Everyone made us feel welcome, and did their best to accommodate us. Special thanks to Otneil for his warmth and enthusiasm, and Gerardo in the international buffet for bringing kindness and coffee to the breakfast table!

reviews.author: Jose Avellaneda
reviews.title: Good hotel but not 5 stars
reviews.text:
An average hotel for the hotel zone that has all inclusive, but not to be considered 5 stars, which is how they sell it.

Bad things:

- The hotel is already old, it needs maintenance in many places. There are leaks in each of the pyramids, so it is normal to see flooding in the hallways.
The furniture in the rooms is old. In our case, the couch in our room was old, it smelled of cigarettes and dirt, and the TV had black lines on the screen, despite being relatively new. The bathroom had a leak from the toilet faucet and the only thing they did was put on a jargon throughout my stay, but it didn't cause any major problems. The air conditioning makes a lot of noise, as does the mini bar, which can be annoying for people who have trouble falling asleep.

- The hotel bathrooms are old, lousy, dirty, nothing like other types of bathrooms in 5-star hotels.

- The Lebanese beds that the hotel has in the beach and pool area are too many and take up most of the space that could exist for lounge chairs for common use. The use of the beds is 250usd per day (I think it includes a bottle of champagne and lobster), additional to the cost per night and all inclusive. During the 5 days I was there, if 2 or 3 beds were occupied it was a lot.

- The service in certain restaurants was terrible. Lemon Fish, my food took 1 hour and the restaurant had few tables. Waiters with no desire to work there. Also at the Blue Agave restaurant, very bad service and they practically want a tip for everything they bring you.

- I suppose this is general and not in the hotel, but if you are a foreigner the service is very good, if you are a local, try to wait unless you find polite staff who earn the extra tip.

Good things:

The bartenders Carlos and Eduardo from Alberca and Jorge from the second floor bar, incredible service, as well as the waiters at the Malva Food Bazaar restaurant and the Capella restaurant. But without a doubt, the best restaurant was Agua Marina, the salmon and the excellent stone broth! First class food and service.

Incredible attention from the people at the Nespresso bar.

The beach is clean and tidy unlike hotels attached to the hotel zone. Lifeguard attention at all times.

The food is generally good and the alcohol is of medium-high quality.

reviews.author: Musicjaime
reviews.title: Average facility. Good food, excellent breakfast servers.
reviews.text:
I was at the Paradisus last week for a work conference and decided to extend my visit by a day to relax end escape New England winter. I had stayed there last year for the same conference as well, and also extended. The hotel has good and average aspects to it in my opinion. I never wrote last year but meant to so I’ll make my one gripe from that now. I spent 2 nights in the “adults only” Reserve and there were kids running around and screaming constantly in the atrium area like it was their playground. I asked reception about it and they did nothing. At least if they made an exception to allow them with their parents they should have controlled the noise for the benefit of those of us who paid extra for a quieter experience. This year I did not bother with the reserve. The Sante restaurant was good, I thought Sel was average. 
This year I was very specific that I wanted a room with two beds when I made the reservation. I was told that that was noted in the reservation. When I arrived, the “gentleman” who checked me in was not friendly or helpful and when I was specific about the two beds he said the room that had been reserved for me had a king bed and if I wanted a second there was a pullout couch. I pulled up my reservation confirmation to show him the two beds and he didn’t care. The rooms are definitely outdated. Mine smelled musty, the floor was dirty (needed to be polished) and while there was a balcony (I only paid for lagoon view) there was no furniture on it. I wanted to dry my bathing suit a bit with the hair dryer before leaving and it didn’t work. In the gym, the equipment is sparse for a hotel of that size. There were free weights, maybe 5 treadmills and 3 elliptical machines. I tried one elliptical and it didn’t work. I tried another and it worked but only for 10 minute intervals, after which it needed to be reprogrammed. To me, all this combined equals average, not a 5 star “luxury” resort. I don’t need 5 stars personally, but when it is billed as 5 stars and priced as such, I expected more.
I ate in the Mexican, the taco (Blue Agave) and the breakfast restaurants, plus group lunches and dinners for the conference. The restaurants were good overall. The highlight for me was the two servers who took care of the outside space for the breakfast restaurant (definitely sit here and not inside…it is far more pleasant with good music and great views). Manuel and Anatola (I may have gotten this name slightly wrong) were both excellent, remembered me and my colleague every day as well as what we like for beverages and laughed and joked with us easily. We had fun with them and service was excellent, which made breakfast a great start to the day.
I’ll go back again next year if the conference is there again and will likely extend my stay by a day or two again, but have a realistic perspective of what to expect, and not. Maybe two beds next year…

reviews.author: matt willigman
reviews.title: Decent Cancun vacation
reviews.text:
Just got back from a 6 day stay.  Please be patient as I have a lot to share.

Check in for us was not smooth.  We made a few requests when we booked that were completely ignored.  We were told they could not accommodate what was asked for at this time.  After an hour and a half of going around and around, amazingly they were able to meet our requests.  Whole check in thing is kind of a joke.

That being said the room was nice.  Big enough for myself, my wife, and two teenagers.  The weather was beautiful so we weren't in it much but had a great ocean front view.  Maid service was great.  Room was well cleaned daily.  Fridge and snack bar always refilled.

We were in building three, which was very well maintained.  Almost all the restaurants are in this building, and it has a 24 hour coffee/snack bar.  The main pool and a smaller pool are also located at building three.  

The grounds are well groomed, and the beach is huge and beautiful.  The pools were not my favorite.  They were not heated.  The water was also below the skimmer line so water was not circulating in the main pool.  Also, pool chair saving starts very early, and unfortunately, many "reserved" chairs sat empty all day.  I just started moving people's things after a couple of hours.  Service at the pools was pretty good.

Food was hit or miss.  The taqueria and Mexican restaurant were great.  The buffet and Italian restaurant were ok.  The seafood restaurant was below average.  The service and food at the Asian restaurant were bad.

We booked through Costco, and arranged our transfers through their provider: BD Experience.  I do not recommend them.  They wanted to pick us up 3.5 hours before our return flight when were were 20 minutes from the airport.

Overall, it's not a 5 star resort, but it was a good escape in the winter.

reviews.author: Jillian M
reviews.title: SAL is the best experience
reviews.text: Leo and Daniel at SAL were amazing!!! Best service we got all weekend. Very happy to have come!!!! If you come here you must visit Leo and Daniel!! Extra plus they are very gluten free friendly and have amazing drinks. Great smiles too (: great job

reviews.author: TinLove
reviews.title: Christmas at Paradisus with young kids
reviews.text:
For anyone interested in staying here over the festive period in future, or going as a family with young kids, or if you want honest foodie recommendations - get ready to read on...

CHRISTMAS: they had a couple of events for guests including a nochebuena buffet dinner on Dec 24th with entertainment (singers, musician, DJ performances). For families on Christmas Day, Mexican Santa and the kid's club team arranged to give out locally-crafted gifts to children by age, which is a lovely touch. Santa made an appearance almost every evening leading up to Christmas. The Grinch was also going around the resort, scaring everyone. There was another evening event for families on Christmas Day, which didn't seem well promoted as we only found out about it while waiting for a table for a restaurant at dinner. As well as a buffet, there was an elote food stand, crepe stand, face painting, tote painting for grown-ups and lots of funfair games to win prizes. There were circus performers and dancers for entertainment, which was a special way to celebrate Christmas. 

Tip: ask at the guest concierge desks to find out what events are on.

YOUNG CHILDREN: They have the Kidsdom club which runs from 10am-1pm, 2-5pm and 7-10pm. The staff are all friendly and it was never busy for the toddler group, but for the 5 years and above group, there were more children. The space is clean and we were allowed to go in and explore with our youngest who spent some time in the softplay area (she refused to go back without us). The older group spent time by the pool in the afternoon slot followed by outdoor festive craft activities. Our eldest enjoyed pottery-making and moulded a little Christmas tree, she painted characters on canvases and more. 

Tip: ask all the questions, the Kidsdom staff are well informed and professional. 

FOOD: the food at Paradisus across all the restaurants was very hit and miss, as expected for an all-inclusive resort. The service and quality really varies depending on where you go. We tried most options...
Cielo (4/5) - great tasting Mexican food, colouring in sheets for kids and kids meal options, warm and welcoming staff, good service.
Malva Food Bar (2.5/5) -  average food but lots to choose from, one of three places serving breakfast, busy queues for omelette counter, friendly staff, I recommend the delicious green juice and mochaccino. As we were still jetlagged and on UK time, we got there after 7am so it wasn't busy. It gets busier after 8:30am. Desserts were terrible and lacked flavour, which was disappointing as someone with a sweet tooth.
Agua Marina (5/5) - best restaurant there in our opinion in terms of food quality and service. We recommend the ceviches and all their seafood dishes tasted fresh and great! We went for dinner on our second night and back again for our last dinner where they had a singer and band. We also had lunch there on our last day.
Blue Agave (1/5) - extremely slow service, the chef was running late for the breakfast opening so we were waiting for our food for 45+ mins, food was very salty but glad we got to try Mexican coffee.
Lemon Fish (3/5) - food was actually delicious when we eventually got it but the wait was ridiculous! We got there as soon as it opened at 6pm to put our room number down on the waiting list for 7pm. We didn't get seated till after 8pm as they seemed understaffed and there were lots of frustrated crowds/groups waiting around (not great when you have hungry and tired little ones!) Don't think most guests realise it's also open for breakfast at 8am and would just head to Malva Food bar by default. Smaller scale of the breakfast buffet, lots of fruit flies on the fresh fruit table because the restaurant is surrounded by plants. Great atmosphere and felt nice to be sat down look around the atrium in the daytime.
Cappella (4/5) - again, we got there as soon as it opened to avoid the long dinner queues. Pasta dishes were decent, but portions were quite tiny.

Tip: grab an easy lunch by the pool/beach and order from the waiters. Definitely get the burger and fries - that beef patty is so good! The pizza's from Mascalzone were delicious too, and we loved the ice cream/gelato counter (especially the orange and dulce de leche flavours). We drank mango margharitas everyday in the sun and also enjoyed coffees (with caramel/marshmallow syrup) from the Nespresso counter.

About the resort overall - everything felt quite outdated including our lagoon junior suite and the gym. Our sink was always clogged and had slow drainage, but they sent someone up to sort it out. Room service food was so so. The front desk always ring and do a courtesy call after any requests to check all is ok, which is a nice touch but not when you have a napping toddler (turn down phone ring volume). Half of the lifts were out of order for a couple of days which means waiting and skipping lift calls. The resort staff are lovely, hard-working, and cheeful, we had regular chats with Shera who made us feel so welcome during our stay! The kiddie pool doesn't have much to offer so bring your own pool toys, and reserve your sunbeds early in the morning before breakfast with provided towels/non valuables. If you buy essentials from the resort shops, expect to pay a lot more than the RRP. 

We had a really amazing stay as a family creating beautiful memories, and the flaws didn't matter in the end but we would probably stay elsewhere if we ever travel to Cancun again.

reviews.author: Freddie T
reviews.title: Paradisus Hotel
reviews.text:
Overall, what made our experience great was the staff and service. Specially, Hector Lagunas’s in the pool area. He was very accommodating and truly made our vacation great!

Now, the not so good, our rooms! Air conditioner was very noisy and didn’t work properly. We would constantly have to turn it off and on throughout the day and night. Refrigerator was so loud we just ended up turning it off after we called a couple of times to get it switched and no one ever came. Also, there was a strong odor coming from the bathroom.

reviews.author: Micaela A
reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Excellent service from Atilano Armando and Ariadna, waiters from Malva and very good food. And Axel's predisposition for animation is very good. Lemon fish's service is very bad, there is a lot of waiting. Very good service at Nescafé and very delicious cakes.

reviews.author: jgonzalez2024
reviews.title: The hotel has deteriorated, becoming a member of the Meliá company should make the difference noticeable because in my case it was not
reviews.text: The hotel a year ago was one thing and today it is another, you find a staff that is not very pleasant and helpful, to everything they say No it can be done! I feel that what was promised was not fulfilled when I became a Meliá member, there is total dissatisfaction on the part of the staff because the hotel is nice but it no longer has the type of disposition of the people who work there as we perceived on the previous trip

reviews.author: Stay02370132622
reviews.title: A luxury hotel that leaves much to be desired
reviews.text: Many people lying on the floor because there are not enough beds for the guests, if you want a Bali bed they charge you USD 265, crazy, very bad attention for guests who are not reserved. a shame

reviews.author: Sharonbee3
reviews.title: Resort of Contradictions, how a resort with an incredible beach can fail so bad.
reviews.text:
My family traveled to Paradisus Cancun December 28-January 2nd.   We experienced a contradiction of experiences.   We had two Nitke Oceanview rooms, the rooms were nice with large balconies.   Having a concierge didn't anything to the trip, since there is no ability to make reservations other than booking a spa appointment there was no benefit.    I would not return to this resort unless they fixed their restaurant issues.    Here are the highs and lows of our trip.

The Good…  
•	The Beach is beautiful, crystal-clear blue water, amazing white sand, extremely clean.   Only improvement I would make is to replace beach chairs with ones that could be adjusted to different angles.
•	Resort is beautiful and the plants and lights in the main pyramid is lovely.
•	Beach service for drinks and food was great.   
•	Rooms were nice, beds comfortable, nice bathrooms.
•	The Gingers Sports bar Gabrielle is amazing, she makes every night special.
•	Kanna Bar - loved having an evening cocktail overlooking the ocean.  Shout out to bartender, Anna.
•	Spa was great and treatments and water therapy was very good.
•	We had a late flight and was able to book hospitality suite for an hour to shower which was great.

The Bad….
•	Lines, lines and more lines.   Nothing spoils a vacation more than stressing about how and when to eat or get a seat.    The Nespresso Coffee Bar is the only place to grab a coffee.   There is ONE person working the counter and there was never a time there wasn’t a line.  For a resort with 650+ rooms having only one person working the coffee bar is ridiculous!  Getting a coffee or tea took 20+ mins and the hot water button for tea only filled the cup around 40% so teas were tiny.  We started ordering multiple teas to get one cup of tea.   There needs to be a self-serve station to grab a plain coffee or tea and leave the specialty coffees to the bar or it needs to be staffed for the demand.
•	We got up at 6:45AM to get a seat at the beach.  By 7:00 AM almost all chairs by pool and beach are gone.
•	Food is bad, nowhere near a 5 star resort.  We were expecting at a minimum Blue Agave to be great, it started nice with good Guacamole and Chips, but the Tacos were bland, lacked any toppings and were so mild.   We asked if they had a hot sauce as the hot sauce, they served tasted of tomato sauce and it was hard to tell the difference between the different meats.    We thought even if all other restaurants were average a Mexican resort should be able to make a taco!
•	Check In – we arrived excited and happy to arrive and the people checking us in were miserable.   There was no wait, and we were happy to be there and when we asked a question we were chastised and told to be quiet that they were working and to wait.   It was harsh.
•	Lunch - there are limited options and lines for everything.  Like the coffee station there is a pool pizza place that is opened in the afternoon, and it is staffed by ONE person, she does everything from taking orders to cooking, plating every individual pizza.   The lines get long and with lines so long I saw people ordering up to 10 pizzas in one order.    
•	Restaurants have empty tables, but you are told there is an hour wait because restaurants can’t cook for all the tables at the same time.  With limited hours for each meal it is confounding why they are not staffed for the number of guests.
•	Buffet - be prepared to get up early or wait in a huge line.  I have never seen a resort where the buffet has a huge line to get a table.   The buffet is so poorly organized, it is spread out over a number of areas and people are bumping into each other, the food is cold and at breakfast like the coffee and pizza example one person is making the omelets and when she runs out of items, she needs to stop to chop ham or veggies (why isn’t someone prepping for the cook?).   It is crazy how one person is assigned to the busiest tasks.
•	Table at Capella are constantly sticky and dirty, not sure if they are ever cleaned.
•	Resort is Loud - even at 6:30 AM there is music blaring and due to the pyramid shape and how sound travels it gets loud at all hours of the day and night.
•	Customer Service lacking - we had one person in the family get sick and was in bed for 36 hours.  We went to the buffet to get some bread and light items and were told we were not allowed to take anything out of the buffet (we ignored them).     I asked if they could get me a yogurt and I was told they were busy and to wait.   We never got it, they really didn’t care which unfortunately was a common occurrence.   

The beach is normally at the top of our list of items we seek when going on a sun vacation, but the negatives of this resort outweigh any benefits and I would not recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Lizeth R
reviews.title: I'm not coming back
reviews.text:
I'm here and I don't love it anymore, we came on the same dates last year and everything was much better, they removed the
Option to make reservations at restaurants and there is no way to find a place to dine, therefore room service is very late, and at 8/9 in the morning they decide to play loud music in the lobby and you can hear all the rooms if you want to sleep late the music wakes you up or if you want to watch tv there is no way, the staff is very nice but I have not been able to go to dinner at the restaurants the lines are 1:30 long you get desperate and opt for other options like the buffet, which is the only thing they offer you faster and it's not worth it, you pay a lot to have options and they don't give them to you

reviews.author: Gelacio J
reviews.title: Nice hotel, average-bad service
reviews.text:
Nice hotel, average-bad service

Since before arrival we were battling. Transportation to and from the airport was included in our reservation.
However, when we spoke before arrival to schedule it, they never recorded our data and agreed to send us a form by email. Which they sent until the last day.
Because they asked us for the information on the last day, the airport-hotel transfer was no longer confirmed and we were waiting for it at the airport, without success. We prefer to pay for private transportation.

Arriving at the hotel, they gave us our room until approximately 5 p.m.

Concierge service in Nikte area is very different from other hotels. Only one person writes to you on WhatsApp, but there is no desk with whom you can contact.

We did not notice any difference in Nikte service vs. regular one.

To schedule return transportation also an odyssey. Approximately 10 emails sent, since the reception couldn't schedule it for us there
Same.

I think there are better options in the area. Unless there are major changes to the service, I would not return

reviews.author: nelidaers
reviews.title: only good. not great
reviews.text:
Hotel facilities are nice, rooms need maintenance.
Food is good, 
Some staff needs to be more polite.
WIFI has excellent signal all over the hotel.
the beach was very clean and  beautiful.
drinks were delicious

reviews.author: garedot
reviews.title: A lot of things to get improved
reviews.text:
Not a great stay, price is not matching the whole experience at this hotel.  A lot of Areas of Opportunities for this Hotel to get work on.
I think this hotel will need to work on the Facilities to get imprvoved

reviews.author: Bo A
reviews.title: First day gave us doubts
reviews.text:
This was the first time staying at the Paradisus Cancun.  We up-graded to the "Reserve" ahead of the trip. Upon arrival we waited 4 hours to get into the room. this left us in doubt about the rest of the trip.
The next morning changed my point of view. Breakfast and lunch at the pool was wonderful. the pool staff was amazing making sure we had everything we wanted. Nicole and Victor took care of reservation for a pool bed and lounge chairs. the wait staff made frequent visits to make sure food and drinks were plentiful . The Reserve pool was adults only and refreshing. The crystal clear water of the Caribbean was gorgeous shades of blue however the beach was rather narrow and the water rough.
Dinners at Capella (Italian), Lemon Tree (Seafood}, Cielo (Mexican) did not need reservations. Sol (stake house) had limited access (1 time per week) with multiple up -charges Lobster and better cuts of meats, So much for "all inclusive "
The room was comfortable with a view of the ocean. the entire facility and grounds  were beautiful and immaculately clean.

reviews.author: briancronin07
reviews.title: Was an average stay
reviews.text: I felt as though the music festival that was coming was more important to the hotel over the guests already staying there. Felt as though my family needs were not met 100% and felt the value of your establishment was just average.

reviews.author: Global59259362361
reviews.title: Pool concierge make the trip
reviews.text:
The hotel leaves much to be desired. If it weren’t for Nicole and Victor, pool concierge, the trip would have been awful. Nicole and Victor were there with a smile and always looking to please. Kudos to them. The service at Sante and the pool  was excellent. Gabriella, Valeria, Oscar, Joel and Javier met our every need. 
Not a place we will return to 
It took us 4 and a half hours to get our room. Just kept getting the run around about it
Getting to the beach is impossible for anyone with mobility issues
