The staff works very hard to ensure guest satisfaction, and even worked very hard on Christmas Day away from their own families, and does so with a smile on their face. And we enjoyed some of the very best food we have ever enjoyed on any vacation, which was truly a positive surprise. We did not feel the need to pay any upcharge for specialty dining since the regular options were so good. 

This all said, there are a number of areas that detracted from the experience that would have truly made this a 5 star stay. Overall, the stay we had was more of a 4 star experience. Some of the areas I felt needed improvement: 

- Staff is very warm and friendly, but does not do a good job of thinking outside the box. We had a 4 and 1 year old in our party, and none of the specialty restaurants had food appropriate for young kids. When we asked the staff to make a simple dish of rice and beans, they could not or struggled heavily with this simple request, since it was not on the menu. The staff did very well for anything that is "on template" but struggled mightily with anything that required thinking "outside the box." 
- Property is very dated and in need of a renovation. Our room was generally OK and would have been superb had this been a Hampton Inn, but was not quite up to 5 star standards. The toilet did not flush properly, tiles in our bathroom and room were chipping away, there was mold in some areas, etc. Many rooms need modernization, and many of the bathrooms do not have a separate tub and shower or two sinks as would be expected at this star level and price point. The hotel glass roofed area was also leaking during heavy raining. 
- The room we received was missing basic items that were to be included and are even stated to be included on the room description when making the booking. We had to ask several times to get basic items such as a hair dryer, coffee machine, and iron, items which should have been included anyway especially for a hotel at this price point. We had also asked for a crib when we made the booking and staff confirmed the request was on the booking, but when we checked into the room, there was no baby crib. These were the kinds of small touches and supreme attention to details that were missing throughout the stay that would truly make this a 5 star experience. 
- It took a very long time for bags to come to the room, despite staff assurance that they would be there ASAP. Again, this is similar to the other comments that the level of service is not up to the standards of the 5 star hotel standard that the hotel bills itself as. 
- Hotel layout does not make sense: elevators are very small, and there is no service elevator, so staff uses the same elevators as guests, which coupled with very small elevators makes for extra long wait times during peak times. There are many spaces under construction in main, visible parts of the hotel.
- Hotel has poor lighting in the common areas- there is a lot the hotel could do to add better lighting with the hanging plants that are otherwise beautiful. 
- Some exterior areas seem to be made of cheaper construction: columns block prime oceanfront views in most outdoor dining terrace options.
- I did speak with staff about some of the service and other issues we experienced during our stay, but again, in their inability to think outside the box, were not able to address any of them except offer some pleasantries and condolences. They did send a cake and wine bottle to the room without any note or explanation as some sort of "consolation", so also missed the mark on that as well. 

Overall, despite the above, we had a great and relaxing time, which was our goal. My kids had a lot of fun in the kids center and we would go back, but just need to adjust expectations for some of the above.

reviews.author: BabaRizal
reviews.title: Overall an OK experience
reviews.text: We felt that the rooms need upgrading as there were times where we couldn't use the facility/amenity as they should. Otherwise the sleep quality i.e. bed, pillow, AC, noise level, was pretty good. We were quite impressed with the presentation and quality of food in some of the restaurants that we booked in. There wasn't clear information regarding the restaurants and how to reserve. We didn't get the tour of the facility when checking in, so had to kind of figure out on our own.

reviews.author: annov8
reviews.title: Christmas Weekend
reviews.text: An OK experience. But I wouldn't comeback anytime soon. There were baby roaches or pest that look like baby roaches around our mini fridge. We killed a few, but each day there is 1-2 always running around the fridge or bathroom wall. The food variety is very limited. We had a difficult time trying to make reservation for dinner. Luckily there are restaurants across the street outside of this resort. Our bathroom sink water is really strong and it keep splashing water at us/everywhere if we forget to open slowly. The people there are excellent, our questions were answered and whatever we needed they were able to help us with a smile. The location is beachfront on one side and across the street there is some 4-5 stars restaurants available. The ocean water at the front of this property is blue and clear. No seaweed seen as of Christmas weekend 2022.

reviews.author: shariqmansuri
reviews.title: Sol is definitely the weak link...
reviews.text: Mediocre experience. Would not repeat. Food is plentiful but quality is poor. Provide less food options and improve quality. Property has potential but we had the continuous feeling of having made a wrong decision.

reviews.author: Kevininhawaii
reviews.title: First timers review here 10k pyramid 1 2BR suite
reviews.text:
Came here for a music festival event.  Got the 10k package for the suites located in Pyramid 1.  It was too far from everything, and only allowed me to hold 6 people.  Food was meh from the main buffet as I felt like it was low quality and just a lot of egg dishes.

The service was great - 5/5 and all of the employees really took care of you.  

I lost my wristband on the last day and they wanted $120, unreal, after all I spent.

The place did look amazing though, and the room was nice for what I paid for. 

I would definitely try and come here again to give it another chance.

Pricing 3/5
Location 3/5
Food 3/5
Service 5/5

Overall 3.5

reviews.author: Jane I
reviews.title: We won't be back
reviews.text: The location was beautiful and the beach and pool were beautiful, but the beds were not comfortable. The shower got water on half the bathroom floor, and the food was average. When you pay that much for an all inclusive resort, the hope is that the food is fantastic, the rooms are stylish and comfortable, and the drinks are strong. That was NOT the case here.

reviews.author: Connector310862
reviews.title: Average place for the price you pay.
reviews.text: I will start with good things, , good service overall, view is nice, clean place. on the other hand they were not very accommodating, first day they told we cannot make reservation for dinner at any restaurent, the Concierge Service they provided was new and next day he was off with no backup the manage Fernando said we will provide you a new concierge but he never did which was very disappointed some room did not had bathroom doors, the view is not good from room for ocean view its blocked due to design and they have the chairs low and wall blocking view. over all it was ok, do not recommend to use their circle promotion it is waste of time and do not provide any coupon etc for your time.

reviews.author: ShyGurl888
reviews.title: Beautiful well kept resort, great wait staff, rooms are outdated
reviews.text: It’s a gorgeous resort, the staff is always cleaning and maintaining the main areas. The waiters at all the restaurants and beach are very nice. Please make sure to tip them. Everyone on here raves about Lemonfish. We didn’t find it that great, average at best. Loved Capella, Ciello and Agua Marina though. Rooms are ok. Standard room: nothing to write home about. We stayed on the 1st floor and it smelled musty. There were cockroaches in the room but chalked it to being a tropical destination. Made sure to zip up our luggage and shake it out when we got home. I had to call the Operator twice to get a hair dryer and called them again on a separate night to get toilet paper, which they did not bring to the room. So, don’t expect great service when you call the operator if you need anything.

reviews.author: talup30
reviews.title: Beautiful with amazing service
reviews.text:
The service is 5 stars!!! We stayed in The Reserve side.  Manuel was an awesome bartender.  The pool cabana service with Ruben and Moses 100% amazing.  We always had a drink. 
Levi our concierge was very nice and helpful.  Jenny was the girl who helped get our cabana everyday.  They were all amazing, nice, and treated us so well.
The resort is huge and took a day or two to figure out where our room was. The food wasn’t very good at all.  Breakfast was good, lunch was okay, and dinners were not good at all.

reviews.author: Anna W
reviews.title: Mrs Wong
reviews.text: The service was very good. miguel and jorge did a good job in providing a nice environment and helped us out to choose our food.  Food was just ok, not as good as I thought.  Atmosphere was good.  However, it was quiet hard to make reservations.

reviews.author: Happiness721881
reviews.title: 9 days stay
reviews.text: The  waiters in the restaurant are very good and helpful most of the them are extremely good . But food in the restaurants didn’t enjoy at all . Hope they rectify this . Hotel is overrated in my opinion as we have been to few hotels with all inclusive in different countries. But I can’t find fault with the hotel staff they were extremely helpful with the exception of  check in reception staff who were very official and not helpful in any way

reviews.author: I Gorman - London
reviews.title: A few Improvements could make this resort so much better
reviews.text:
We visited Paradisus Cancun for 13 nights from 22/08 (2 adults and one child).   This was our 5th trip to Cancun but first to Paradisus.  I have mixed feelings about this resort as there are so many positives but a few negatives that really let it down.

Starting with the positives - The service is EXCELLENT. The staff literally make this a 4/5 star resort and it would be a lot less without them.  They are friendly, polite and hard working, could not fault a single one of them.  We hired a sea view cabana bed every day and the serving staff were exceptional, nothing was too much to ask, drinks and ice buckets filled without even having to ask etc…. 

The view are stunning. Lots of sun beds and cabanas looking over the beach…. It was literally paradise.  There was lots of seaweed when we visited but the beach was still well maintained and beautiful. 

The main pool design is great, its in need of a bit of tlc but it’s huge, warm and a large shallow area for kids to play in. 

The one big negative about the pool is that it was not filled high enough and so the filter system was not fully in use so it was dirty….. which was ok to start but got considerable worse by the second week when the resort filled up a bit more. 

The food was average.  We tried all restaurants and whilst there was a good selection everything was just warm and not hot. Again after 2 weeks this starts to grate on you, so we ended up going out for dinner a few times just to get something hot.  

The room was ok. We were upgraded to an ocean view on arrival which was lovely.  Good size balcony and sufficient space in the room.  The rooms are a little tired but that wasn’t a problem for us.  A few small negatives were the air con wasn’t that cool and was soooo noisy (although after a few nights we got used to it) and whilst the maid service was excellent on a day to day basis the room was quite dirty underneath cupboards and on shelf’s etc. 

There was a leak in the ceiling in the corridor leading to our room and whilst there was a bucket there every day there were no wet floor signs etc and it was still leaking when we left so clearly not in a rush to fix it.

The main lobby and entertainment area was very nice to look at but my goodness it was HOT. This is not made clear to you when reading the hotel information  on line. There are lots of amazing plants so it’s clearly a good eco hotel but other than your room, the main buffet and the sports bar there is no aircon anywhere.  This made for some very sticky and uncomfortable evenings.  It was actually cooler outside then in after about 8pm but unfortunately there are no outside bars that allow children, so we had very limited choices. 

Another big negative about this hotel is the price of things…… I appreciate the world is a different place currently and everyone needs to make money again but the prices they wanted to charge for some things was criminal.  To withdraw cash from the ATM there was a $25 transaction fee!!!!!! If you literally went outside the hotel at the end of their driveway and used the public machine it was $6.99.   We also went to the 1st floor shop on the day of arrival as my son wanted a ball for the pool and they charged me $30, for a cheap basic beach ball.  We also had to get him a rash very at one point as the first few days were extremely hot and I had to pay $70….. after that we discovered there was a huge shop in aqua world across the road that was a fraction of the price so got everything we needed from there going forwards.  I dont mind paying a little over the odds for things in hotels but the prices they charged were ridiculous and insulting. 

Over all - I enjoyed my holiday here, I tried to overlook the negatives and just embrace the wonderful location and spectacular service, however would I recommend this hotel or visit here again? No I’m afraid I wouldn’t.

reviews.author: Traveller & Foodie
reviews.title: Back to this hotel after five years - third visit in fifteen years
reviews.text: I came here for business meetings again, not by choice. Five years later and I get an outdated room again. Maybe some rooms are renovated but don't be fooled by the website pictures. My friend's room ceiling collapsed while she was in the room because of water damage.   She was lucky not to get hurt.   The hotel changed her room and upgraded to the V.I.P section.   My room had two queen beds.  The balcony overlooking the lagoon was not very appealing; the chairs were dirty, and so was the balcony, but great views. I also called to complain I had no hot water; the receptionist told me to let the water run longer. I took cold showers during my whole stay.   The buffet restaurant had a good selection of food. The wine in the all-inclusive package was horrible. We could order wine; however, if it is all-inclusive, please have decent wine for the guests. The restaurants were ok, not fine cuisine but acceptable. The pools and the beach are lovely; come early to find good chairs. The lobby where you check in is charming, then the main area in the middle of the hotel is a central jungle of plants; that produces too much humidity. In fifteen years, I have been here three times. I think it's time they change this look. Although the hotel seemed short-staffed, most employees I ran into were always pleasant at the bar and restaurants. I have to add I appreciated the coffee shop at the exit to the main pool area with muffins and donuts. I tried to change my room, but because it's a group reservation, the staff told me it was impossible. The best part of this hotel is the ocean view rooms, pool area and beach views. Depending on which room you get once you check in can change your experience.

reviews.author: JosephFelton
reviews.title: Just OK
reviews.text: I would consider this place a mid tier vacation stop. If your lucky to find a good bartender stick with them. Drink was water down and oddly flavored. Had roaches in the elevator. Food had its highs low.

reviews.author: Alyssa Bowser
reviews.title: Good but not great
reviews.text:
Tripadvisor review of Paradisus Cancun:

Overall my husband and I had a good time. Nothing bad, but with paying for all inclusive we had hoped we would enjoy the food more than we did and the facilities to be a little nicer. We got a junior ocean suite room which had a nice partial view of the ocean. The patio was dirty with spilled coffee which never was cleaned up while we were there. We also slept kind of hot so we needed new sheets everyday in order to get rid of the sweaty ones. 🫡😒  The tub drained very slow and the lighting was very dim as well in our bathroom. Light switches didn't all work and one night we aren't sure if it was related to the switches, but our plug-ins where we charged our phones didn't work. The next day they did. 🤷 Room service food also was sub-par. The app is laggy and not very user friendly in my opinion. It came in handy a few times, but no one encouraged us to use the app to make dinner reservations so one of the restaurants we didn't even go to since we thought we had to go through the concierge to book dinner times. The property itself is quite beautiful, however, the walking areas inside are not air conditioned and we found ourselves sweaty all the time in the hotel. As far as extra experiences we tried, we got a couple spa massages with exfoliating treatments, etc. and my husband and I enjoyed them. I don't think in the US these services would cost as much, but I think you're paying for the convenience and experience at your hotel so it's going to cost more. My husband's massage therapist, Leo was very good. My therapist, Gemma, was amazing! She was so strong but didn't over do the pressure, and I fell asleep so you know it was good! She spent extra time on my neck and upper back which is so tight and it felt SO good! We also did a tequila tasting which I set up ahead of our arrival to the hotel. The tasting itself was nice, Iran Cervantes the somolier was very knowledgeable and enthusiastic about the tequila and David the head chef was very friendly. What I thought would have improved my own experience is if the staff's English was better. I personally had a little difficulty following and I could tell that Iran was making a solid effort but I felt I missed some things because of the language barrier. My husband did not feel this way, however.

I DO NOT RECOMMEND BOOKING anything through Premium moments. Flores and Guendoline were difficult to get in touch with via email and Guendoline accidently cancelled our massages due to a communication error so we wasted time going to the spa on Friday morning and had to rebook for Sat morning. It worked out, but it was annoying. When we went to check out, we also were told we needed to pay for the tequila tasting…which I had paid for before we even arrived at the hotel. When the hotel asked me to pay, they also asked me for $20 less than what I originally paid. I had to send the guest services associate an email with my payment screenshot I kept from my phone and forward the email thread which I showed Flores has accepted my payment and received it. The hotel didn't give me a hard time for it, but again, just something that shouldn't have come up. 

I realize I need to improve my Spanish if we come back to help us enjoy our experience more. Overall, the Paradisus Cancun was a nice hotel, but I probably would book a different one next time or go without the all inclusive plan at least since there were many other food options (including even Dominos lol), with many nice options down the hotel zone. I didn't think we got our money's worth.

The Bowsers room 2112

reviews.author: Cynthia
reviews.title: An honest review
reviews.text: We had booked a group of 14 in February and we all booked Reserve Level.  When we arrived we were disappointed we were in different towers and had to forgo certain things to be in the same tower.  Some were never able to be booked in the same tower and were seperate from the group. We were not offered a welcome drink and had to ask on our own which was disappointing.  Our concierge Galdino did work to make our stay amazing so we all did appreciate his attention to us and the staff in general went out of their way to make the birthday girl feel special.  Nicole and Jennifer at the reserve pool are wonderful and truly worked to accommodate us all week, they were amazing.  The team working at Sante and around the pool were so attentive, Moses, Ruben, Valeria, Joel, Julio, Yamil, Oscar and Diego took great care of us! The restaurants,  Cielo and Lemon Fish were the best and the staff at both were truly spectacular! The biggest disappointment was Capelli, not that the food wasn't delicious but that we were told we could only oder an appetizer and a salad but not both.  It was so bizarre that they were so adamant that we could basically not order what we wanted and that was such a turn off.  Blue Agave was also fantastic and the guys were amazing, great experience.   Aqua Marina was meh...and Lunch Box was probably the least favorite.  I personally never ate at the buffet so can not give any review.  Sante was were we ate breakfast everyday and had the lobster lunch twice (EXTRA CHARGE) but we knew that and it was not a disappointment.  Overall the rooms to me were mediocre.  The snacks offered in the room were geared I feel to kids, oreos, m&ms and chips, and not worthy to call a reserve mini bar in my opinion.  And I think I got turn down service once my entire trip which again for reserve level was actually a disappointment as well.  I felt there was no real sense of that "extra touch" .  And the snacks in the reserve level in tower 5 were also mediocre, just really nothing special.  The resort overall is hot, the restaurants that are not air conditioned are hot. Yes we went in July but it was so warm to eat dinner, Cappelli was the worst since it's the main atrium at the bottom with very little air flow.  So the resort is beautiful and green but it comes at a cost and that's comfort from the heat. Overall the entertainment was boring.  Activities team was pretty unengaging and honestly seemed very "cheap".  The swim up bar had kids sitting and climbing all over the place and that was a total turn off.  So we stayed in the reserve pool.  Sadly the only time it was super lively there was the time they had water aerobics and the one time during the week we had the DJ.  So it's very quiet and I felt  could be livelier.  Overall it's a beautiful resort with some amazing aspects.  But if I came to Cancun again I would not chose this resort unfortunately because it just seemed mediocre overall despite the entire team who work so very hard to make it special.

reviews.author: Josh
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Manuel and Balta were amazing servers and killed it. Always helping us out with anything we need, even offered to take pics multiple times and made sure we felt comfortable. Hotel was dated and food was not good at all on the other side

reviews.author: Lizelle P
reviews.title: Average Resort, Honest Opinion
reviews.text:
I've been so my fair share of all inclusive resorts and while definitely a beautiful resort, Paradisus was lacking in a lot of aspects. I really wanted to love this resort, but we ran into so many issues and inconveniences that it was just disappointing. 

We had booked this resort in March and was excited to come here with my boyfriend and his family. The week of our arrival we were offered an upgrade to The Reserve and we excitedly agreed. When we arrived at the resort, we walked to pyramid 5 to check in and were told there were only double beds available for us. I really didn't want to spend my vacation with my boyfriend cramped up in a tiny full sized bed or in separate bed, so i insisted on getting a King sized bed. The front desk employees were extremely accommodating and Heriberto helped us out the best he could. We ended up staying one night with the double bed, and were promptly moved up the next day to a room with a king bed. Not the best start to the vacation but the employees really tried to fix the problem. We appreciated their efforts and couldn't complain.

Pros - huge resort with lots of activities, restaurants, a beautiful view, and an amazing concept for its design. Great place for families with kids! There are 5 pyramids. The 1st 4 are family friendly. the 5th Pyramid is meant for the Reserve adults only section. The restaurants were all great and the music shows were a blast! I also loved the cabana booking system. I definitely recommend Cielo. It was my favorite restaurant by far!

I strongly believe the servers at this resort are what made the experience great. These people were obviously overworked but did their best to ensure their service did  not suffer. They were the best part of this whole vacation. They were attentive and super friendly.

Cons - While the indoor greenhouse design is stunning and has that beautiful eco friendly vibe, it is also very insect friendly. In the Reserve area of Pyramid 5 is a little food area with fruits, baked goods, salads, etc. All this food was in open area and constantly had flies swarming around it AND in it. Not very appetizing. I also saw my several cockroaches in the hallway - dead and alive. 

We were sold on the idea that Pyramid 5 was the most recently renovated pyramid and all the suites there were newer. From my experience, it seemed like that must have been a long time ago. The elevator was tiny and extremely slow. There was only one elevator for both patrons and service.  My family that was staying in pyramid 3 was move twice because the air conditioner did not work. not a great thing in the thick of the summer season.

In the Reserve, you are given a personal concierge that can assist you with your reservations and anything else you might need during your stay. Our concierge, Frida, seemed to be overloaded on how many people she was covering. I was there for 5 days and 4 nights and i probably only spoke to Frida twice as she was hard to get in touch with. She helped to book a cabana for us on our first day at the resort and answered a question about the Spa for me. She seemed to confuse me and my boyfriend for another room she was assisting and us booked for additional reservations at restaurants and the pool/beach cabanas that we did not request. We ultimately decided to not to utilize our concierge.

I absolutely do NOT recommend the room service food. Always make the effort to go to one of the restaurants for dinner. One night, my boyfriend and i decided to stay in and order room service and lord was it a mistake. The pizza seems microwaved snd barely cooked, the flank steak didn't taste like real meat (if that makes sense), the lettuce of my caesar salad seemed to go bad, and there was no sauces/dips available for the chicken tenders, fries, and hot dog. Everything was just so dry... We had this poor guy running around the whole resort just searching for some packets of ketchup. He eventually founds some almost an hour later. I gave him big tip and thanked him profusely.

Another point about the food. Wine is not included for your all inclusive package. At dinner, the waiters were pushing and recommending several bottles of wine. By boyfriends mom prefers wine to liquor and opted for a nice red wine. At the end of the meal we were asked how we were going to pay and were so confused. Had we known that wine wasn't included, we wouldn't have even bothered and no one cared to share with us that tidbit of information.

My last issue was the pool area. This was a kids friendly resort and the men in my group were laughing at the irony of how the mens room urinals were so high, they couldn't even imagine how a child could use the bathroom there. These were the ONLY bathrooms in the beach/pool area. You can imagine how many kids just didn't even bother walking to the bathroom to pee.  As a family predominately in healthcare, I was constantly thinking about how these pools must have riddled with urine, fecal matter, and other bacteria. The bottoms of the pools also had sand in them as well. It just didn't feel clean to me. Needless to say, I didn't spend a lot of time in the pool. Also only the main pool had a swim up bar. The adults only pool for the reserve patrons, which i would have preferred throughout my stay here,  only had a bar near the restaurant, so you'd wither have to walk there or order from one of the few servers walking around. It was not ideal. They definitely need to rethink some of the structural designs in their beach/pool area. The towels also had a lot of stains on them.

reviews.author: jasmine j
reviews.title: Family resort or no
reviews.text: This was a beautiful resort, but it was not a family resort . There was a shallow pool for kids but not water slides or activities for children , most things close at 6 making it hard to explore the resort with Children , There was no family night entertainment.  The resort was catered more to the reserve side of the resort . Food was okay for a resort 7 /10 . Customer service and staff 8/10 . Check in and check was great fast and helpful. The rooms need a little update . The fish tacos were the best meal at the entire resort .

reviews.author: Gin A
reviews.title: An ok hotel
reviews.text:
The hotel is beautiful and the staff that work for tips are amazing! Other staff members are kinda rude! The rooms are hot and in tower 3 it is loud at night. The reservations for food absolutely suck! We tried to make reservations ahead of the trip and got no response. We tried as soon as we got there too with no such luck! Not much entertainment at night either. Kind of a disappointing with being all inclusive and can’t eat in the best restaurants! A big shout out to Alejandro at the Lemon Fish! He was amazing! He was very pleasant and took care of us! Lemon Fish is a great restaurant! We had to beg to get us in for our anniversary! Diana the host helped make this happen! Thanks! 
The swim up bar and bartenders were amazing too! 
The rooms are clean but they never restocked our minibar, I had to call. 
Overall besides the reservations and hot room, we had an ok visit! We will definitely go to another resort if we ever go back to Cancun!

reviews.author: Tifany E
reviews.title: wouldn't stay again
reviews.text:
I just got back on 6/26/2022. We stayed for 5 days. Here's my review-
The staff is great. I enjoyed the decor. Our room was cleaned very well every day. We stayed in reserve & the extra perks were nice and worth the upgrade. The bad- it took a long time anytime we went to eat. It took while to get our food at every restaurant in the resort. The food was NOT good, i barely ate while i was there. The only thing i enjoyed was the hamburgers they serve by the pool and then when we paid extra to eat at Sal-Steakhouse. The website said there was plenty of entertainment/activities and shows to keep you entertained. We were bored most of the time, especially at night. There was never any shows. They had a couple of DJ's playing music if you wanted to dance and one night in the bar they had a 2 man band. The list of entertainment they sent me was bare and not pleasing. The only time we had any real fun on our trip was when we went and did excursions. While I did enjoy the staff i associated with, unfortunately I would NOT stay at that resort again.

Also- (and i know this may be a stupid complaint, with it being the beach/island) but 90% of the resort is hot. I spent most of my time all sweaty and couldn't sleep well at night because the room would only cool off so much.  I dont enjoy sweating while im at dinner-inside.

reviews.author: Rob
reviews.title: Vacation 2022
reviews.text: Beautiful resort. Friendly staff. Unfortunately unorganized. When we got to the resort we supposed to have a double bed room, but they didn't have one ready. The room they did have ready our keys didn't work so we had to keep going back down to customer service. So we had to wait until the following day in order to move into the double bed room. When we came back at Noon the next day as we were told to do the room still wasn't ready, so we had to come back 3 more hours later to see if it was ready. Kinda of ruined the day as we had to keep going back and forth between the front desk. Also one of the mornings the water in the room did not work, and had to wait until later in the day to have showers and what not  Concierge was very nice, however not very helpful. He told us the whale shark tour was being cancelled everyday, yet when I talked with the excursions guy he said they had been going out every day. So thankfully I checked, because we would not have been able to go. Very Expensive excursions. I would suggest going directly through the specific excursion companies. Also the all inclusive was good, just be aware there are limitations. Extra charges for upgraded foods are prevalent.  Overall it was an ok stay. May or may not stay there again, we'll see.

reviews.author: Daniel G
reviews.title: Third time visiting the Reserve at Paradisus Cancun and unfortunately it was by far the worst
reviews.text:
We really tried to make it work but couldn’t
The reserve is supposed to have a concierge service that we only needed to make dining reservations and to secure the pool cabin included on our stay but neither of those worked… definitely not worth the Reserve if you have kids… it was raining and the kids club was overly crowded but they didn’t have enough staff or options to make it work given the circumstances 
Our concierge Freddy disappeared for the first couple of days and even though we chatted via text after that we never saw him
We were a big party and 4 out of 5 rooms have leaking issues (see pictures) and they practically did nothing about it
Truly disappointing experience mainly given the fact we had great experiences before
The exclusive pool included with the Reserve it’s adult only so with kids half of the pool and beach area it’s of limits (We knew this beforehand but FYI for you guys)
Bottom line, if you read the reserve description and are thinking it might be worth having someone looking out for you while you are here think twice and save your money cause a good tip will get you 1000 time more than the concierge

reviews.author: Breanne
reviews.title: Not what it used to be that’s for sure
reviews.text: Do not book with MVC. The customer service was TERRIBLE! You will feel like a 3rd rate customer. They only cater to the resorts circle club members and have obvious preferential treatment. The resort gets quiet at 6pm, no outdoor bars remain open, there is one buffet with very average food and no variety throughout the week. Sergio at the hooka bar outside was the only fantastic aspect of this resort. Rooms need to be updated, we stayed in building 2, and maid service needs to step up their game. Sadly we would never book here again due to the average food, terrible MVC checkin service, and dirty beach. If you’re looking for entertainment on site and an upbeat vibe this resort isn’t for you.

reviews.author: Grande Gonzalez
reviews.title: Very sad. No more "Royal Service" no more "Adults Only"
reviews.text: My wife and I go to Melia Paradisus in Cancun twice a year normally in February & October. They use to offer what was called "Royal Service" which has since been replaced with "The Reserve" Removing "Royal Service" was a BIG MISTAKE for the Melia brand. There are five buildings. Building number five use to be for adults only. Now they allow children. Where you use to be able to relax in serenity there are now screaming children. When you have four other buildings for families and children WHY would you take away relaxation for adults? For the past ten years we always went in February but since they were booked we tried March. NEVER AGAIN! There were a bunch of rowdy drunk underage spring breakers. The pool side bathrooms were always dirty and out of paper. They were short on lounge chairs by the pool and when we asked why they said that a private school had a big party of which fights broke out and they destroyed a lot of the chairs. Our first day of five days we had to lay on a towel on the concrete by the pool. Kids in private school are wealthy. Their parents are wealthy. The kids should have been arrested and their parents should have paid to replace the new chairs! It is so sad to see what was once a 5 star luxury resort turn into a 2 star hotel. There use to be a manager by the name of Lazaro. He was an asset to Melia. He understood customer service and trained his staff with that same mentality. Now that I have voiced my concerns on the resort itself I must mention THE GOOD that is still present. It is the staff. Even with all the bad changes that have been made to the resort ALL of the staff always try their very best to accommodate the guests. If your name is not mentioned here it is because there are so many of you that do an amazing job and it would take pages to list. But I do need to mention a few. It is always a pleasure to see Moises and Valerie poolside. They are always smiling and happy and they always go above and beyond to please. It was also great to see my old friend Djordje (George) The three of them have been there many years and have always helped to make our stay special. Our past two visits October 2021 and March 2022 we met Janick a concierge and Diego a manager. Both of them also go above and beyond with all the guests providing top notch customer service. I am a business owner who understands and appreciates hard workers. Diego is a great manager. He is never standing around he's constantly moving. I watched him manage both staff and guests and his level of service is impeccable. In closing I hope that the corporate office of Melia reads this review and reconsiders their removal of "Royal Service" At the very least they should return building five to adults only. I have children but need a break every once and a while. Every adult needs a getaway to relax without hearing screaming kids.

reviews.author: Tim
reviews.title: Trip with friends, 2nd time here, will not be back~!
reviews.text:
The resort is beautiful. My 2nd time here, but unfortunately I will not be back. The rooms are dated and only 1 electrical outlet to use in the whole room for your devices. Trip hazard to the bathroom. Don't stay on the 3rd level facing the adult pool, the exhaust from the restaurant below came into the room even with the crappy sliders closed. The slider was beat up and in poor condition. So our room smelled like burned oil all the time. Housekeeping took our un opened bottle of bubbly after the 1st day! WHY? We were saving it. Why take away an unopened bottle? Not cool! 
Could not book the Italian Restaurant, no openings were available. The other food was descent. If you are thinking about the Reserve upgrade, it's not worth it at all. Total rip off to charge so much more and not get the added value you think you will get. Trust me, I have been to Cancun 6 times, did the VIP upgrades before at other resorts and this resort is terrible for the upgrade. Save your $. Will never return here unfortunately.

reviews.author: J7558AKstephaniec
reviews.title: Great property - not the best food
reviews.text:
This is such a Beautiful modern resort but unfortunately the food is not the best. We were not impressed during any meal and tried all the restaurants. The best meal we had was at capella. 

We loved the property and the reserve perks and activities. They cleaned the beach everyday and The service was great the whole week ( special shout out to our server at blue agave , Paola ). We didn’t love the reservation system - you basically had to book 2 days in advance for dinner anywhere that wasn’t the buffet. 
We did enjoy the nightly entertainment. Better than at other resorts we’ve stayed at.

reviews.author: Joshua N
reviews.title: Nice, but not that impressed for the price paid
reviews.text:
Overall, a 3/5 experience. Don't get me wrong - the resort is beautiful and the staff is generally great. What lacks though is the food quality, watered down drinks at restaurants, a lack of available reservations at their restaurants, wait staff attentiveness, inability to get ahold of the property and no welcome amenities as promised when I booked this reservation via Expedia.

Individually these are small things, but all-in-all left me with a very mediocre impression of a highly-rated (and expensive) all-inclusive resort. I will be looking elsewhere to stay the next time I'm in Cancún. 

Pro tip: if you decide to stay here, make all your dinner reservations for your entire stay the second you get to the resort. Unless you're happy eating at the buffet every dinner, that is.

reviews.author: Chris H
reviews.title: Beautiful Location, Consistently Friendly Staff, Nice Property
reviews.text:
Located in the hotel zone, the views of the Caribbean are incredible; blue water and white sand.

We spent a week at Paradisus Cancun with our 2 teenage children. While the hotel offers a "Reserve" experience that comes with some additional amenities, we did not upgrade.

The pools are immaculate and there are enough of them to find your own little corner in which to relax. There are plenty of servers to ensure you always have a drink in your hand. There are multiple food stands located around the pools that serve a variety of items including hamburgers, hot dogs, ice cream, shrimp tostadas, quesadillas and wings.

The hotel is clean and very well kept. The rooms are as advertised with nice furniture, decor and spacious patio. Each room contains a mini fridge that is stocked daily with water, soda and beer. Snacks like potato chips, peanuts, M & M's and breakfast bars are also included.

There are 9 restaurants* which each offer their own menu. Seafood is a predominant item at most of the venues but you will be able to find something unique at all of them. Our entire family really enjoyed Lemon Fish. Agua Marina was a favorite of my wife and I. Breakfast is served buffet style at the Malva Food Bazaar.

*As of writing this review, the restaurants on the Paradisus website are not up to date. Current restaurants are: The Malva Food Bazaar, Agua Marina, Cielo, Blue Agave, Lemon Fish, Capella, The Lunch Box, The Sal Steak Cave (upcharge), and La Palapa (Reserve guests only).

Multiple bars on the property provide drinks and nightly entertainment. The Yhi spa offers spa services and a nice gym.

PROS:

- The property is clean, well-maintained and really stands out among neighboring hotels

- Restaurant and Poolside service is amazing: JONI at Malva will welcome you with a smile everyday and makes you feel right at home; NURBY, at the pool, is kind and attentive; ORLANDO at the Nespresso bar will always remember your last order

- Food is good and relatively upscale for a family resort

- There are several gift shops that offer everything from daily needs to souvenirs

- Covid testing is offered on site for convenience - Despite a reservation system, this service is first come, first serve

- Room service is quick and courteous and will bring you anything from more water to full meals

- Housekeeping is thorough and flexible

- Beach lifeguards are attentive and proactive

CONS:

- There seems to be a lack of overall communication and organization with guest services** (see below)

- All restaurants, aside from the buffet at Malva, require reservations: We were advised of this requirement but never of the process

- This is a large property and it can be confusing to find and determine the details of each amenity: Where are all of the restaurants? Which are included with your stay? Do all restaurants server breakfast, lunch and dinner? Where do you get pool towels? How do I reserve a Covid test before returning home? What spaces are dedicated for Reserve guests? How are the rooms numbered? -- This could and should all be covered at check-in

- Depending on the wind, ocean-front rooms can be affected by exhaust from the grill vent below

- On-site activity schedules seem to be hit or miss

- Dress codes and a 30-minute limit on reserving pool chairs (as well as mask rules) are loosely enforced

- While always courteous and not pushy, you will be asked daily if you would like to sign up for activities with AquaWorld

- Motion sensors on the thermostat will cause the A/C to stop working in the night

TIPS:

- Be prepared to enjoy a meal while you wait for your room or pack a swimsuit in your backpack to hit the pool after checking in. Rooms are generally ready around 3 PM

- Find one of the concierges walking around the main pyramid. They will connect with you over WhatsApp to help with your stay -- We were never told the concierges existed and only happened upon one while waiting for our room to be ready

- Make dinner reservations early in the week. The restaurants fill quickly as the weekend nears

- Pool towels can be found at the cabana under the red and white SCUBA flag. This is run by AquaWorld and allows them to pitch their activities

- Cabanas are available for an upcharge but also INCLUDE upgraded food and drinks. We reserved a cabana on the beach for our last day. The added expense was well worth it in our experience

- As with most resorts, it can be hard to find a chair or umbrella by the pool: While not the best solution, it seems the only answer is to place your belongings by the pool early to reserve the spot -- Just be courteous and try to get back within 30 minutes

** We checked in Saturday and realized our shower would not drain on Sunday afternoon. Maintenance promptly came to our room and attempted to use a plunger to fix the issue. The employee left our room without notice or fixing the problem. We called again after dinner.

Maintenance, once more, brought a plunger and eventually called a supervisor. The supervisor kindly told us that he would have to speak with his boss in the morning and that they may need to get us a different room.

When we didn't hear from anyone the next morning, we stopped at the welcome desk to see if there were any updates. The employee asked us to speak with guest services. After sitting at the empty guest services desk for 45 minutes, we returned to the welcome desk. We were asked to come back after 1 PM for further details. Around 1:30 we were told there were no other rooms and that maintenance would be up with a 'special chemical'. Maintenance never came.

We returned to our room to shower before dinner and found that the drain was still clogged. We all showered in knee-deep water in order to make our reservation. After eating we again called maintenance and a nice employee finally told us that they would be unable to fix the problem and that we would be given a new room in the morning.

We received a call around 9:30 on Tuesday and were told that our new room would be ready in 20 minutes. After an hour, we went to the welcome desk to inquire about any updates. We were told our room would be available in about 30 minutes. We went to our room to re-pack our belongings. About an hour later we received a call that our new room was ready.

After changing our room key wrist bands at the welcome desk, we were told to move to a room in another building. We carried our luggage across the hotel to find that maintenance was working in the room. With our belongings in the hall, I went back down to the welcome desk. Staff told us we were supposed to be in a different room located 1 floor below our original room instead.

We carried our things back to the other building and got re-settled. We finally made it to the pool around 1 PM.

We understand that things happen but felt we needed to drive the urgency around this issue. There was a lack of general communication regarding the hotel's response. We asked if we could be compensated for all of the trouble and were told that something would be sent to our room. Nothing ever arrived. Unfortunately, this experience overshadowed a great deal of our stay.

While we wouldn't dissuade someone from staying at Paradisus, with so many other options in the area, we will likely not return.

reviews.author: Traveling family of 4
reviews.title: Wonderful staff / disappointed in room location
reviews.text:
Service from the staff absolutely top notch.  This is our second visit to the resort. Everyone from the start of your visit makes you feel welcome.  They all go above and beyond to accommodate you.  Buffet servers are all amazing Edier, Alfredo, Joni, Ramiro, Helen, Antonio, Orlando - thank you to all of you!!!    .  Victor and Yvonne at the pool were friendly and helpful every day!  These staff members are what made the trip.  Our last visit to the hotel was pre-Covid and some things have changed since then but overall a very nice time. 

Now for the reason I only rated 3 stars…. We booked a reserve ocean view one bedroom room.  At check in we were advised that we were on the 1st floor.  I wasn’t thrilled about that and asked if there was anything higher up but was immediately told no (even though the hotel was VERY quiet ). Walking into my room I saw that we had a RESORT VIEW from the balcony. In order to see the ocean you had to hang over the side of the balcony to peer out to the ocean.  Our windows from our side room did face the ocean but could not be appreciated as you could not access that balcony and the windows were cloudy from the salt air. We expressed our dissatisfaction again. To the credit of the hotel a day later we were offered a room in a different tower which we declined as we wanted to stay in the reserve section with the rest of our family.  No accommodation was offered to our bill for what was definitely NOT an ocean view with “unobstructed views of the Caribbean” as promised at booking. Our other family members had the same level room and an AMAZING view.  A simple rate reduction would have solved the case but instead we paid a premium to stare at another building.  Never got to speak to a manager despite several attempts. Luckily we didn’t spend much time in our room but this lack of  response has made us not want to return for our next trip in December. 

Highly recommend the bed rental at the beach with lobster and champagne. Such a great experience! 

The hotel is good for all ages / couples / families.

reviews.author: Rosanna & Jeff
reviews.title: Happy and Disappointed
reviews.text:
After a year of not being able to travel because of Covid, we were looking forward to returning to our home away from home, the Paradisus Cancun.
Upon arrival we immediately realized how many things had changed and not for the better.
Check-in at the Reserve:  Traditionally, the spoiling begins with a cool welcome beverage and room availability by 3:00 pm. However, no welcome beverage and no room, only excuses. We were told on numerous occasions that the hotel was fully booked with a shortage of staff. It was close to 5:00 pm when our room was finally available.
Restaurants: All restaurants have been renamed with new menus that we were looking forward to trying. Unfortunately, the old restaurants were better.  They presented a greater variety and a tastier fare. The new menus seem to be packaged differently yet repetitive from one restaurant to the other, indicating a cost cutting measure.
Reserve Lounge: The lounge always presented a different theme and variety for the late afternoon and early evening hors d'oeuvres. This time every day was the same fare. They did however maintain the level of premium alcohol but not complimentary mixes. Another cost cutting measure.
The Best of the Best: The saving grace of this hotel is their highly attentive and wonderful staff. 
Our concierge, Janick, was attentive and ensured that all our requests were fulfilled.
Diego, the manager, and Penelope at Sante were wonderful.  Julio, Oscar, Joel, Luis, Cesar and Reuban always made the breakfasts and lunches special.
Special mention to Max at the bali beds, always ensuring that everyone was well taken care of. 
Serving at the bali beds, Moise and Reuban always made sure that all were happy.
Omar and Jesus at Cappella, Ernesto and Alejandro at Lemon Fish, Antonio at Lunch box were all amazing.
In light of Covid we understand that everyone is trying to recoup their losses. However when prices have drastically increased and quality has significantly decreased, one cannot expect their guests to be content, especially for those guests that have been coming year after year.

reviews.author: rzolt
reviews.title: Our 14th Visit Was Disappointing
reviews.text:
This was our 14th stay at Paradisus Cancun and the only one we were disappointed with.  We come through their timeshare program and there were little annoyances throughout our stay.  First, there was no hair dryer in the room and not a full set of dishes or silverware.   It wasn’t until our concierge, Alejandra, intervened did we get what we needed and our room was cleaned better too.  Alejandra also helped us get our COVID test appointments and was definitely our MVP of the week.  Miguel also helped my wife navigate the technology and procedure for getting our COVID tests.

Alejandra also arranged for us to attend a presentation for their new timeshare program, The Circle.  I’ll be 71 years old in 2 months and a new timeshare just isn’t feasible.  But we agreed to listen and were treated respectfully by the timeshare saleswoman, Cynthia.  We were given a lobster lunch and a day bed just for attending the presentation and got great service from Balta while we enjoyed our lunch and a bottle of sparkling mind.  

So, no big problems occurred during our stay.  It just seemed that generally speaking people other than those I’ve named were “off their game”.  For example, I was told the day before we left that we can check out from the timeshare section as early 7:00 AM.  However, no one was there even by 8 and I had to check out at the main desk.  Again, not a big problem as much as an inconvenience but definitely part of a weeklong pattern.

I’m wondering if after the lockdown lifted and people returned in large numbers the Paradisus the staff may need to reorient themselves to business as usual again.  Those I’ve named, our concierge Alejandra, Miguel and Balta were totally 
professional.  If we hadn’t received such good treatment from them our grade might have been lower.  Fortunately, they stepped up when others didn’t.  

The only other thing I would like management to address is the condition of the greenery inside the hotel.  The greenery is beautiful inside.  Unfortunately, it is turning yellow and needs replacement.  I know it’s a huge undertaking to replace all the beautiful greenery.  It’s also a very visible sign that Paradisus may be off it’s game.  When you’re used to seeing such beauty it’s disappointing to see it neglected.

Finally, our Master one-bedroom left a lot to be desired.  The configuration was weird, there wasn’t a closet in the bedroom and the refrigerator was tiny.  We requested an ocean view but had to strain our necks to see the water.   Again, nothing tragic just not good.
We expect to return next year and I hope to have the great experience at Paradisus that  were were accustomed to.  As happy as we’ve been there we are happy to give it another chance.  I hope to see the necessary changes next year.

reviews.author: victorldleon
reviews.title: Good service, great reservation restaurants average rooms
reviews.text: The restaurants that have reservations are really good, the room that we got was not that good because the shower got clogged in general the employees were really kind and friendly the gym was cool, the time we came was low season so not all the restaurants were open an the ones opened were usually full

reviews.author: Julia W
reviews.title: Beautiful place but service lacking, reserve rooms isn’t reserved.
reviews.text:
This resort has Beautiful grounds and very nice entertainment, but the staff I am not sure as I read all the service is excellent but my friend and I are not being treated like how I remember Cancun as. As soon as we arrived, we were escorted to pyramid 5, to check in with Reserve reception. As soon as we met with the receptionist he acknowledged we were there but we did not feel welcomed and he did not offer even water, I asked him can we please have something to drink because we just waited one  hour for our transfer from the airport, then he acknowledge that we can go to the lobby bar and get a drink and some snacks. Once we get back another person took over as it seems to has which shift, he was much nicer more from there and check us in pyramid 3which wasn’t even in the reserve section, so beware if you book the reserve does not mean you will be staying at reserve towers. We ended up in pyramid three with the spring breakers, the room is a standard room with no tub, and it just is on top floor and gives you access to reserve section.
We We’re told our concierge will contact us, no one has done that and we went down ourselves to make reservation for restaurants. We were told we can only eat in the buffet or the taco place as everywhere else is booked, and they manage to book a reservation the next day. 
I have been to cancun numerous times, I even have stayed in this place before when it was me Cancun, which I got very bad food poisoning. I just don’t see this place with standard five star hotel service, even if we stay at hotels in the area has warmer staff and better service. 
The food in the taco place and buffet is nothing special, buffet doesn’t have much selections, we try to go to the Japanese restaurant since it’s booked up for the rest of the trip, the lady at the front desk was very rude saying you can  wait till 730 reservation cancellation and just left us on the side, never came back and check on us. 8 comes, I go over there and ask her if there’s any cancellation because I see so many empty tables, she tells me these are for 8 o’clock reservation and you can wait another 30 minutes to see if there’s any cancellations. I’ve never experienced this kind of rudeness in Cancun, usually everyone is very accommodating and if they cannot get you in a restaurant they were suggest somewhere for you to eat. I am unsure if everyone is just having a bad day or We are being treated differently because we are a small minority group of 2.
I hope they can adjust how they work with the reserve rooms and clarify. I asked the staff is the rooms are the same they claim they are but I overheard the fifth tower has tubs and Jacuzzis. 
If you are willing to spend more money for a high standard resort this may not meet your standards.
And we have not met our concierge or anyone reached out to help us with anything.
 Everywhere you go seems like you’re bothering them.
Today will be day 2, and I really hope We can get better service.

reviews.author: Brent S
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
My wife and I have traveled to 50+ all-inclusive throughout the Caribbean and as we get older (mid 50's) we become a little more selective in our choices. We had extremely high hopes after reading several reviews but were immediately disappointed upon arrival. We were rushed through our checkin process. No welcome drink, little explanation of the property and amenities, no map or schedule of activities, and no explanation of what was added to the upgrade we had purchased for a luxury Junior suite ocean view. We had a beautiful ocean view room but nothing else in the room appeared to be a  luxury upgrade. Even when making dinner reservations the employee assisting us questioned why we didn't have our concierge doing it for us. We were unaware that we might actually have one but would think with the upgrade we would.  Our first day by the pool resembled a spring break "Rave party" , drunken 20 yr olds doing shots screaming and yelling. I overheard a few of them state that a resort a couple properties away had several of their rooms condemned that they were put up here, and it was evident. I get that it is Spring Break, but I expected much higher standards from this resort. I went to guest services that evening to express my concerns and was assured that I would be contacted the following day by management. That was two day's ago and I've heard from no one. Disappointing.

Don't get me wrong, the property is beautiful, most employees are extremely friendly and hard working. However, we found the food mediocre at best, total lack of entertainment, and a total lack of an exciting beach vacation vibe. There was not much activity day or night.  The main bar and sports bar were consistently crowded with young teens and college age students.  We couldn't even get to play a game of pool because young kids were playing pool at 10 pm.  What a shame because the Ginger Bar 2 would have been a nice place to end the evening.  We love the Kanna bar but again after day one it was filled with young adults and by mid week the bar was not even open.  

I still have three days remaining here and hope it gets better. At this point however, I can't say
 that I will be recommending this resort to friends and family, especially during spring break.

reviews.author: Michelle M
reviews.title: Family vacation!
reviews.text:
My family of 4 (2 girls, both age 5) just came back from our vacation here in the end of February. We stayed in the one bedroom ocean view room. We were not in the reserve. We had a wonderful vacation, I would rate this resort around 3 1/2 stars. I’ll start with the positives, The resort itself is absolutely beautiful! The service and all the staff here were pleasant and kind. The activity staff who hosted activities in the pool  were all very good with the children. The breakfast buffet was very good, lunch was ok. The beach is beautiful. The pool staff will help you set up if you’re looking for a spot and the pool is crowded. COVID testing to return home was quick and easy!! The spa was amazing and they had a special at check in for $115 for a 50 minute massage!!! Also, on Sunday they had all these fun blowups in the main pool and an inflatable slip and slide in the pool. That was a lot of fun!!! We felt very safe at the resort and all the other places we visited while in Cancun!!

For negatives, the pool is not heated. I can see this not being an issue in the summer and warmer months, but when it’s an 85 degree day, it needs some heat, especially in the morning!!! It’s the only resort I’ve ever been to that you are completely alone in the pool at 9:30 am, because it’s freezing cold!! My kids were literally shivering in the pool!! 

One of the biggest negatives for me was the alcohol. It is without a doubt, watered down. I had like 900 bloody Mary’s and felt 100% sober. The only reason we were considering switching to reserve was for the better alcohol choices, I’d be pretty angry if we paid extra for this and got watered down alcohol. The only time I ever felt a buzz was for the dinners when we left the resort. 

The room was nice, however I was upset that we upgraded from lagoon view to ocean view because during the day we had to keep the shades closed because the AC was so weak and we were told to help keep the room somewhat cool, we’d need to keep the shades closed during the day. So there was literally no point in the upgrade. Luckily we weren’t in the room too much during the day, but most days we came back around 3 or 3:30, and the view we paid for would have been nice. I can’t imagine the temperature of this room in July. 

The food was ok. Nothing special. The first night we ate at Capella, the Italian restaurant. It was mediocre. We decided for the remaining nights to leave the resort for dinners. We went to Porfirio’s, Rosa Negra, Harry’s and Hacienda Sesal for the remaining nights, all were fantastic. So my recommendation is do not upgrade to reserve. Give yourself a real upgrade and leave the resort for dinners!!!

reviews.author: R.Craft
reviews.title: Disappointed In Paradise
reviews.text: I have stayed at this resort several times, and had reservations for June 22, 2022 which I canceled.  My husband and I stayed in October 2021 and I was very disappointed.  The main reason I stay in the reserve section is for the private beach for adults only. After the hurricane the private beach was destroyed.  The beach available for the entire resort was over crowded.  To get a cabana so we could be out of the sun I had to wait in line around one and half hours every day to get the best selection.  No on wants to pay for a service that is advertised but they don't receive.  And speaking to management is non existent.  I should  been informed of the condition of the private beach (which is advertised as part of the reserve amenities)  After this experience I canceled my June trip.

reviews.author: Juliana G
reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: For the most part the experience could have been better. If you speak spanish, they don’t treat you well. I do have to say that Eduardo, Martin and Ian were excellent. They made the whole experience a lot better. If we only had them taking care of us, I would have given the Hotel 5 stars.

reviews.author: Julia
reviews.title: Service broke all impression
reviews.text:
So, if u are thinking that after long flight, u can get a special treatment at that hotel, then u are wrong :) 
I will tell u our experience with booking one of the best room at reserve of Meliá Cancun paradisus.

For sure, u can forget about welcome drinks, about normal check in/check out. 

Girl who supposed to show us where is reception of reserve, left us at the middle of the way and said : okay so u should go there , after turned, after go down , after bla bla bla… hotel is quite big, so obviously we got lost very easy, and waste lots of time to find reception. 

When we got the room, we asked to change it,because it was noisy, and they change it very fast, but welcome fruits and vine they forget to give us back from 1st room 😅👍🏼

When I ask at reception of reserve to change money (only 100$) , they said to me that I can make it only at main reception. 

Main reception said to me, we don’t have local money, go to shop if u need it urgent. 
Very good answer for 5* hotel, because that’s really what I “wanted” to do after long flight 😅

( for your understanding  during 3 days, I could not change 100$ in local money) 

About pool, they have a special system of booking sunbeds :) It’s okay, but, be ready 😅 that u can book bed which u really want 3 or even 4 days before but never get it :) u will ask why? 
Because they will give it to people who pay them more tips, and after when u will freak out how that happened, they will say, oh oh don’t know. 

( as reality they just have 2 notebooks, one main and other kind of line, so control that they make reservation in main, or u will be waiting 3 days as us, and as result never get it and stay with very sad mood…)

Check out:
😂 that’s really amazing experience, will never forget it… 
Check out at reserve reception was fast and good, they give u a card, which u have to give to a bellboy guy to bring your luggage. 
So I came at entrance of hotel, and were not bellboys, so I came to reception in front, began to ask guy, to whom I should give that card, and if he can help me with taxi 
AND 😅 when I even didn’t finish my phrase , that guy , without any word/ apologize or what ever, just turned back and run away  from me to other couple at the street…
Other people at reception was staying and speaking between themselves, nobody really care about u, what u should do, where is bellboys, who can ask a taxi)) 

Service of that reception(of main building), without jokes is the worst ever in my live…. 
We left hotel with completely broken mood

Hotel by itself is really good, u go in with impression WOW, rooms at reserve are good, views amazing. Activities r funny, I never seen like that before. Restaurants r good too, they r really trying to make a hight lever service, and to be honest they r quite good in that. But all that good impression of hotel broken with completely not professional reception team… I don’t have even a word to describe their work. 
+ that situation at the pool was very sad too!

In general hotel is really cool,I love it and I would like to put a 5*, but all that bad experience I had with reception and pool team, don’t allow me to make it. 

Hotel I recommend but you need to be very patient to staying there  😁👌🏼

reviews.author: Julia S
reviews.title: Paradisus stay
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I stayed at Paradisus over winter break in the reserve. Our personal concierge Aaron was wonderful and very accommodating throughout the entire experience sending us the daily activities, booking our restaurants for us, and reserving a cabana for us at the pool every day. He was quick and professional to answer our questions if we needed help. Food was subpar, a lot of the restaurants had small portions and not a lot of food on the menus. The room we stayed in in the reserve was fantastic except for how dry the air was, some nights you couldn’t breathe properly. All of the staff was very friendly special shout-out to Hugo manager of the lemon fish restaraunt and some of the guys at the Malva restaraunt who treated us very well. As well, I happened to leave some personal belongings behind on our trip a few days ago that were pretty valuable because we were in a rush to leave. We have tried to reach out the the hotel by calling them messaging them on several different platforms and nobody seems to care or want to help me get my personal belongings back.

reviews.author: frederickbrn
reviews.title: Love The Resort but Groups Department is horrible.
reviews.text:
My wife and I love the Paradisus. So much so that we recently took over 50 people from our church travel club with us. After 30 years of organizing groups I have never seen a worse experience than working with the groups department here. My family and I initially had 34 rooms in 4 reservations. I asked to combine them and make one group. They said sure and that’s when the bottom fell out. From a lack of communication, canceling several of my rooms, wrong room assignments and several other issues it was horrible. This went on for months. After speaking to them, my wife and I actually flew there and stayed a week to get everything organized in person. We were 4 days into the week before anyone would meet with us. The meeting took place with me sitting on a couch near the reservations desk and lasted all of 20 mins. From there it got worse. I ended up communicating through email with 7 different people who obviously were not communicating with each other. The head of reservations actually called me at 10pm one night so rude and obnoxious that my wife was extremely upset with the way she was talking to me over their mistakes. It was their mistakes and I have the emails to prove it. 

The Good: Thanks to Jose Garcia who finally stepped in and got everything together. He was a pleasure to work with. Everyone loved the resort and had a blast. Check in was good and organized. Only 2 issues with 55 people so not bad. Staff was very attentive and excellent. Facilities and properties were very clean. Food and drinks were excellent. Nightly entertainment was just ok. I hate that we had this experience because we really love the property. Already planning to take 100 to Cancún next year. We will find a different property.

reviews.author: miafarah
reviews.title: Worst Management/ Good entertainment
reviews.text:
We had been planning this trip for almost two years so we were really excited to spend our anniversary for the first time in an all inclusive with our kids. We couldn’t wait to have good sleep and good fun!
The first thing we noticed when we entered the hotel was that you couldn’t feel the AC.
When they took us to our room we noticed that the AC had a noise and its wasn’t cool but we assumed the Ac had been off since it was an unoccupied room.
We were desperate to get unto the pool the kids were ecstatic. After an hour I went to the room only to find the AC had not cooled one single bit. I had to go to the front desk and complained. The manager Fabiola was such a sweet heart. She went to my room and surprisingly enough she was an HONEST person and told me the AC had been having some trouble that day.
and she at least acknowledged how hot the room really was!
I told them the least they could do was change me to another room that didnt have an AC with noise and that actually cooled.Fabiola changed us to another room. After a few hours my kids found out that some of their toys had been left in the first room and I called Fabiola and she found them and brought them to us! Fabiola you are amazing and deserve to be promoted. After months of my stay I still remember you!
After the whole day at the pool we went back to the room only to find the room had not cooled either!!! again the AC situation was not gonna be resolved. We called maintenance they gave us all sorts of explanations.
Our concierge Alan, was nice but not trained enough to really make our stay amazing. A couple reservations were not made properly that when we went to the restaurant they didn’t have us on the list. 
On the second day of sleeping in the worst bed with the worst pillows and all of us slept with underwear mainly because of the heat, Alan told us to speak with his supervisor. OMGoodness what a waste of time that was. Her name is Maricela also known as Malu. She convinced us of going on this meeting with some people that after a while I understood were trying to get us to become business partners with Melia and invest with them. What a joke!!! Two hours of them trying to sell me this, shoving me this idea down my throat when they cannot even provide me with a good nights sleep that I already paid for. An AC that should be working in any hotel and comfortable beds!! I was so aggravated!!! Two hours lost in this!!
I have to say that the only thing that would make us come again to this Hotel (which is highly unlikely) its their entertainment and their staff. If there is a reason I love Mexico is because of the people. Especially front of the house. 
Special mention to the Kids club staff: Axcel and Nicole! Our stay was romantic because they took care of our kids! They deserve a promotion!!! Also celeste and Jenny played with our kids!
Esteban from Fuego was super knowledgeable and very polite!
Alfredo de Capella went above and beyond saying to our requests (everything is possible) thank you for going above and beyond!
Victor from Mole simply super sweet and amazing!
 and the best of the best Atilano!!! what a server!!! simply made you feel so cared and important. Thank you Atilano for simply treating us like royalty!
A message for management especially Malu: You knew our complaints and did NOTHING then had the nerve to ask us if we had received a certain “amenity” left for us in our room. No amenity was ever given despite our continued discomfort  of our sleeping situation! If you wanted for us to receive an amenity you would have delivered it yourself. This is an all inclusive, bringing us a bottle of wine with some fruits from the buffet wouldnt have hurt the budget but wouldve gone a long way at least for us on your part.
Instead you saw in us a big money sign to maybe enroll us as partners? wow. May this be a learning experience for you. Seat with Atilano and let him teach you how to really connect with a guest, but trust me you could learn a lot from him.

Overall, I think that despite the old state that the hotel is in and the AC and sleeping situation, the entertainment in this hotel is TOP notch! Especially the kids club!! Thank you All!!!!

reviews.author: Vlamir G
reviews.title: For the price charged, the services and quality should be much better.
reviews.text: The resort has a reasonable area but during the period we were staying (07/12 to 21/12) many areas were full, especially at the Malva restaurant, where breakfast was served. As we stayed at the Reserve, we could opt for exclusive restaurants and services. In terms of food, nothing special. Little variety and quality is not always pleasant.

reviews.author: vbpod
reviews.title: Christmas at the Reserve
reviews.text:
We chose the Reserve at Paradisus Cancun for our extended family Christmas vacation. We have planned this for 6 months and reserved specific room types for the 5 families and dinner reservations for our party of 15. We had paid the full amount in advance with specifics on who was staying in each room and the specific bed configuration needed. All of this was verified and confirmed months in advance. 

After a long day of travel we were taken to the “reserve check in”. This turned out to be the worst experience ever.  We got absolutely no assistance from Alejandro. We were informed the specific rooms were not available. They only had kings even though we specifically asked for several double beds for our young adults. His solution was that one could sleep on the flimsy sofa bed. He also wanted to charge us extra for one teenager who we had already paid extra for. I tried to show him the email from Melia verifying all of this. At this point he started getting visibly angry with us.  He informed me that he cannot honor what Melia reservations had confirmed. It’s mind boggling to pay $20,000 in advance and be told that he cannot confirm this. 

The restaurants were hit or miss. Once again, reservations that we made through Melia months ago could not be verified and new ones had to be made through our concierge.  The buffet dinner at Malva was lousy. Avoid Sal (rude waiter and hidden charges). Lemon Fish and Enzo are nice. Sante was great for breakfast and lunch. 

The pools are warm and clean. The rooms in the reserve and clean and beds are comfortable. Most of the pool and housekeeping staff are helpful and work hard. The Covid testing was slow but luckily we were all negative. 

Read the other reviews, this check in service is either a sham to upcharge you or evidence that they are truly incompetent at customer service. It’s a shame because the rest of your stay is bitter after this check in service.

reviews.author: Departure598785
reviews.title: False Advertising on the FAMILY experience
reviews.text:
At the time of my visit, mid December 2021, this resort was focused on Adults. The kids entertainment (simply a small kiosk by the kids pool, which by the way is just a shallow pool with no fun, kid type stuff) was just crafts that were kind of hard for my 5 year old. No toys or games. No playground. No indoor space whatsoever. Apparently it was all being remodeled. The website mentioned and showed pics of treats for the kids that we were supposed to get in our room because we upgraded. We got nothing. They did not even provide beach toys. No cookies and milk turn down. Literally nothing for kids to do if they don't want to cram in to a single table in a tiny hot outdoor hut and make crafts. Which by the way even if you are right there to help, kids under 5 are not even allowed in so my 3 year old had NOTHING to do but play in the pool. 

For adults, it would have been lovely. The adults only pool at the Reserve looked nice. Our room was on the adults only side, which meant we had to drag my 3 and 5 year old across the resort to get to the kid pool. I stood on my beautiful balcony and longed for a moment of peace away from my kids, at a pool with quiet... but could not go there because my kids hated the kids club (aka hot hut with a table) and I could not get any answers on babysitting services. 

The food at the restaurants was very good.
