The quick access breakfast in the Reserve pyramid was very convenient since I am the only one in my family who likes breakfast, but by the end of the week as it got busy, the hot food ran out before I was able to get any, twice. The Reserve also had a bar with friendly help, but the wine selection was not great. The snacks available after noon were also disappointing. But, we ordered lunch by the pools every day and that was as to be expected from the little grills. Mediocre fries. Terrible nachos. But who cares it was dropped off directly at our chairs! The kids ate hot dogs and fries and we had rum and cokes and margaritas. 

It was also surprisingly difficult to get change for large bills. I expected from a 5 star resort that the front desk or guest services would load up on ones and fives in USD but they did not. We had to ask the servers to break all of our bills which is awkward. Also the USD ATM was not working. Not too big of a deal as we just withdrew Mexican Pesos.

I would return without kids for the price I paid but would choose somewhere else the next time I bring my family.

reviews.author: mvnova
reviews.title: Some good, some not so good
reviews.text:
Pros: The restaurant staff are amazing, especially at Malva. It was the only reason we enjoyed our stay.
Malva has a lot of options for kids and adults. 

Cons: Very outdated rooms in the main hotel. We paid a lot of money for a sub average room. Hardly any amenities, only one outlet in the room, poorly lit and musty smell. AC issues, we had to call someone to fix it at 4 am. Safe Deposit box didn't work, they eventually fixed it but I had to waste vacation time til they fixed it (it took more than one person to come out and look at it a couple of times).I would have rather spent that time at the beach not waiting for something to be fixed. 

Concierges and main greeter only nice to you until you reject the offer to go to the Melia Circle presentation. I did NOT come on vacation and pay a lot of money and take out time to listen to a sales pitch. That happened to us at the last Melia resort we stayed at too where we did waste an hour and a half of precious vacation time. We willl never stay at a Melia hotel again why would we want to join Circle. Once we said no we never heard from our greeter again.

reviews.author: Fabrizio
reviews.title: Can do better for a Reserve experience
reviews.text:
Having previously experienced the excellence of Paradisus, we were somewhat disappointed with this trip. Perhaps it's the challenge of returning to a busy season while still plagued by effects of the pandemic... we made allowances for that but unfortunately still did not meet overall expectations.
The staff are always so pleasant and helpful, friendly and hospitable. Our personal concierge, Rafael, was outstanding, assisting in every way possible (even on his days off). Most restaurant and service staff were at their best, including Valeria and Luis at Sante, Miguel at at Lemon Fish and Balta at Kannah among others who were delightful, although there were a few staff that are perhaps on long shifts or need more customer service skills training.
Sante and Lemon Fish were excellent restaurants and lived up to the Paradisus standard. Regretfully, the others were just not there with quality... at best mediocre, definitely not at the Paradisus-standard. 
If you've booked the Reserve services, we suggest you request accommodations in the Reserve tower (5) unless you have the higher floors in the main tower (3) although you will still feel the hustle-bustle of the activities throughout the day/night. If you want the full Reserve experience, stay in the Reserve tower. We decided to stay at tower 3 to get 2nd and 3rd floor sea-view rooms but we should have taken the 1st floor sea-view rooms initially proposed to us at tower 5, to enjoy the full immersion of the Reserve experience.
The beach, as most readers may already know, has succumbed to 3 hurricanes and is now much shorter but the location of Paradisus Cancun remains spectacular nonetheless... the water is as breathtaking as ever and the views are unforgettable! The resort had invested in bringing more sand to extend the beach but the last hurricane took it all away again. The outside venues' views and positioning are magnificent, from the pool areas to the beachside relaxation zones, it really is very good compared to other resorts.
Evening entertainment seemed fair and concentrated in mainly one area although we did not to attend each night. The opening of the Lemon Fish restaurant was very good with performances from various classical singers and a quartet.
Paradisus is making a good effort in their social and environmental role, with noticeable covid sanitization solutions and reducing their plastics use footprint. Paradisus includes a covid antigen testing location in the conference area. 
Happy holidays!

reviews.author: Jpfc524
reviews.title: Run down and badly managed
reviews.text:
This is not a 5 star hotel.  Every employee you talk to gives you different info about restaurants, covid testing and anything you ask as soon ask you get there.  They try to upsell you to the reserve rooms. 
The reservation system for dinners is frustrating and probably made that way so they can save money on the higher cost restaurants and make you go to the buffet which is cheaper.  But the food at the restaurants is decent if you can wait for it.  Service at restaurants is hit or miss. Sometimes they forget to put your order in.   Drinks at the pool and beach can take forever.  It doesn't serve them to be efficient because it's an all inclusive so the more they serve the more it costs them.  The rooms are getting old but ok.  The ocean view and balcony were nice to have.  The beach furniture and towels are not clean, a lot of them are stained.   The only good place here was the brand new restaurant lemon fish.  They had great service because they were new and wanted good reviews.  The buffet is not sanitary with covid going on.  Everyone shares tongs to pick up food so everyone is touching the same things,  some people didn't wear masks while getting food.  We were here over Christmas and for 2 nights they blasted  music inside the hotel until 1am.  For most rooms like ours in the atrium it was obnoxiously loud and you could feel the bass pounding in your room.  Doesn't matter if you have kids or are older or just wanted to get sleep earlier than 1am, they didn't care.  Lots of people complained about this to the front desk.  Also expect to tip or bribe for better service and to get into restaurants that they say are booked up but actually really empty.  Covid testing for return to the US is on site but unorganized.   On a positive the beach and pool are nice but not enough to make me come back to this resort.

reviews.author: TravelBug_YYZ
reviews.title: Impressive property but disappointing food experience
reviews.text:
Pros:
- Amazing location right on the beach
- Beautiful  pools, very clean, nice cabanas
- Clean rooms and all buildings are nice and clean
- Very helpful and friendly staff
- Nice breakfast, lunch and dinner buffet restaurant Lunch Box. This place was our saving grace during the trip
- Average seafood restaurant Enso
- Average taco place  Blue Agave

Cons:
- Food at all restaurants was bad bad bad taste wise. I really wonder who is approving this food in this nice resort 
- Extremely disappointed with food overall. And we were group of 5 who have travelled the world and experienced food around the world so we know what great food is like. Food at Paradisus is underwhelming.
- We had booked Jr Suite but given mediocre room upon checkin in main building 3 which is noisy and under renovation. We were asked to pay 700 USD for room upgrade and this was on top of expensive price we paid while booking. Not a pleasant experience to pay more to get decent room
- Evening/Night activities limited. Nothing impressive as such or even good enough to have fun evening. The entertainment room in building 3 is very small. Can barely host all the people
- Only 1 billiards table and 1 foosball table for such a big resort resulting in long wait times to play at the table in the evening

Overall quite disappointing experience. Very unlikely to repeat in future.

reviews.author: Francisco Brito
reviews.title: Paradisus is a nice property but avoid Sal Steakhouse.
reviews.text:
I am writing this review on my last night at Paradisus because I am fuming mad at my experience at Sal’s steakhouse.  

To give a little context I have been visiting paradisus  for many years and while the rooms are a bit dated everything around the property is well-maintained. One of my biggest disappointments is the poor quality of the food. Outside of breakfast all of the specialty restaurants we’re not very good.  I stayed on the Reserve side and the lunch at Sante was decent.  We would try to fill up during the day at Sante because the specialty restaurants for dinner we’re both difficult to reserve and the food quality was poor.  

One night we were hungry after an excursion and wanted a good meal. I decided to Spring for dinner at Sal.  We had a couple steaks & a couple drinks and my bill came out to $260 US.  I don’t spend that kind of money for the real deal at Fogo de Chão or Del Frisco’s.  But I was tipsy and feeling good and blew it off.

Fast forward to tonight my final night in Cancun, we’re sitting at Cipolla Italian restaurant and the food was just terrible my wife didn’t even eat anything. It was our last night and I wanted to end things on a good note so I bit the bullet and visited Sal but this time sober I paid close attention to my bill. My wife and I ordered the Australian ribeye which was $960 Pesos each. No appetizers or cocktails and was handed a bill for 200 bucks that did not match up with the price they had on the menus. When I disputed the bill they explained that what I ordered from the menu was not available so they gave me a different cut of Australian ribeye that was a double the price. I explained that was some thing that should’ve been stated when I first placed the order.  I feel like I got ripped off and it made me question why my bill was so high a couple nights before.  It really left a bad taste in my mouth and that’s unfortunate because the service was one of the shining points everyone works so hard to provide fantastic service and the dishonesty at Sal Is what I will remember most.

To add insult to injury while I’m sitting there enjoying my over priced steak a big roach just strolls through the dining area. I brought it to the managers attention and at first he seemed annoyed but later came back and profusely apologized (picture of roach attached).

I actually remember when Paradisus  had a really good Brazilian style steakhouse included with the all-inclusive package. I understand that Covid has affected businesses in  all sorts of ways but the food has really fallen off.  Im really kicking myself For being lazy because there is a Portofirios and Rosa Negra Right down the street with beautiful patio sunset views and ambience for less than what I paid at Sal. 

One last thing that disappointing me was the fact that I never saw my concierge for my entire stay.  That was one of the reasons I upgraded to reserve in the first place.  It was a pain in the butt to reserve dinner every night everything was booked and just getting information about Covid testing etc. that was supposed to be provided by your concierge we just had to figure it out on our own.  What was the point of offering a service that you don’t actually have in place?

Despite those two unfortunate experiences it truly is a beautiful place and the staff was very gracious.
Moral of the story stay clear of Sal steakhouse and don’t expect to see a concierge anytime soon and you’ll have a fantastic time.

Francisco

reviews.author: melanienweaver88
reviews.title: Family vaca
reviews.text: Needs more food variety. When you get there make your dinner reservation.  Dont eat at sal.  Super expensive for what its is.  Go across the street to rosa negra. Way cheaper and more variety and great atmosphere.

reviews.author: Victoria H
reviews.title: Paradisus November 2021
reviews.text:
We chose to go on vacation very last minute so we paid about 3800 for our Junior ocean view/7night stay at Paradisus. 

Over all we would come back but maybe if there was no Renovations and we knew the weather would be better. 

The Positive: we really enjoyed our Bartender Juan-Manuel at the Kanna Beach club. He was very friendly and we spent most afternoons at his bar. We enjoyed his drinks and even sat in the rain cuz we didn’t want to leave. 
I really enjoyed the Buffet and we went there often, our last server there, Joni, was very attentive and kind. The breakfast service was always the best but that’s probably because we woke up at 7-8, before crowds. 
The beach here is clean and beautiful even in the rain, we swam in the ocean and it was a lot of fun, although watch out for where there may be some exposed rocks near shore. 
There is a warmer and a cooler pool so it’s nice to have options. 
We watched a decent amount of the cable  TV because of the poor weather but there were some good movies to it wasn’t bad. 

The negative: The resort was under renovations (i knew ahead of time that there would be Just one restaurant unavailable because of this). However, being that our stay was pretty rainy and windy with minimal sun (no tan lines) we did spend some time inside the same building as the Renovations. The construction left a heavy layer of dust on all the plants in the sanctuary- the plants being a huge focus of the appeal of this resort- and the loud noises (later that 6pm) and smell of paint spray really makes the building unpleasant to be in. So I didn’t take any pictures of the plants since it looked so dirty. 

Another thing about the resort that Was not so great was the minimal activities to do. Only having been to one other resort ever, I thought it was normal to have things like lawn games out and stuff to do by the pool, but the activity schedule here seemed limited to weather dependent activities like outdoor yoga in the morning and volleyball on the pool. Can’t really do anything is it’s pouring rain. Other indoor activities probably would have been in the main 3rd pyramid/lobby, but again with the Reno’s it would be nauseating. 

We would have gotten a Bali bed but the weather was too unpredictable. Instead we did go Snorkeling but it was a bit of a bust, not much for cute fish. 

You have to make reservations for almost everything besides the Buffet +lunch, even need to book for the Gym which I didn’t go to because of the inconvenience. To make a reservation they originally tell you at check in to download this “Melia” APP but it doesn’t work-the reviews are so low on the APP. Instead you have to go each day to the guest services to book the reservation for the following night. Would be a lot easier to book everything for 7 days all at once. 
Also we were told we could Pay for our PCR test by Credit Card when we checked in but the nurse who did our swab insisted cash so thankfully I had cash on hand but it was meant for something else so that sucked.

reviews.author: Rds81
reviews.title: Ok but not again.
reviews.text:
We have been to Cancun 10-12 times over the past 10 years. My wife and I generally go once a year although we have had a few years where we have managed to go more. This is our second trip to Paradisus. The first time was a number of years back prior to Meliá purchasing.  

Our first stay was an incredible value for what we got. We stayed in what was then called Royal Service.  The service was great, the food was pretty good and the stay was all in all better. Not amazing but we felt we got an incredible value. 

This time was not as memorable. The resort is big and does show its age in many ways, however they do a pretty good job keeping it clean.  We stayed in a one bedroom ocean front suite in the “reserve”. Check in was fairly easy but our room was not ready when we got there at 1:30pm.  No big deal we also had friends there so we just hung out with them at the pool.  At this time we met our concierge which was probably the biggest let. down for the trip.  It is not that our concierge was rude, it was that he was basically non existent.  His name is Raffael. I would suggest another option if he is provided. 

When we checked he asked for our number and told me to download the Whats app app which is did.  He told us that he would let us know when the room was ready. After a few hours with no communication we had our friends contact him. He confirmed the room was ready.  Ok no big deal.  We met him in the hotel and he took us to the room. He never explained anything the resort had to offer, didn’t provide any type of notification of activities. He did not initially provide menus when asked he said my friend had them. (He did provide the next day when my wife contacted him. We had to get his number from our friends and use the app to find him even though he said he would contact us.)

Room was great. Always clean great bedding, great shower, stocked mini bar with snacks beer and sodas etc. Never an issue with the room.  Great job guys. 

Ok so dining. Food was ok everywhere. We weren’t overly impressed with anything.  However given the price point of this hotel I feel you need to have some sort of expectations based in reality. If you are a foodie and that will make or break your trip then I would go elsewhere. My wife and I are vegetarian however the couple we were with were not. The feeling was mutual. If you are vegetarian this hotel was probably the least accommodating we have been to. You can get something everywhere you go but many times it will be a special request of some sort of combination of items throughout the menu. There just were not many options with some restaurants only having a dessert item as an option. I believe two of the restaurants we went to had nothing.  In short you will be able to eat most anywhere but you will not have a comprehensive list of options. Especially if you like to eat somewhat healthy. It’s a shame as you know they have all the vegetarian options available just not thoughtful in that regard.   

The meat options looked ok. Don’t expect tomahawk ribeyes, fancy duck options or crab legs, at least not included in the price. They did have a few upsell menu items and a pay restaurant and upgraded beach service area if you want a more special experience. Having not paid for any of this as being vegetarian I can not speak to them. I did look at the steakhouse menu and you can expect to pay a few hundred bucks for a nice dinner with drinks etc.  I was told (not by our concierge) that the upgraded beach area was 220 usd per day. This included all you can drink champagne, lobster etc. it was very small but also some of the only beach area available. 

Ok about the beach. Non existent. If you love the beach this is not the hotel for you. I believe much of their beach was recently washed out. We are not beach people so this was not an issue. 

Pools were ok. We staid in the reserve pool area which is much quieter. The pool was good. Pretty warm and clean.  The other pools were overrun by kids and much louder. Great probably for families and those that want to do shots at the swim up bar. Plenty of pool areas. Not sure about seating outside of the reserve but imagine it goes the same as many places. Get up early to reserve your chairs. Without much beach area this will be exaggerated here.   With the reserve upgrade we got only 2 days out of five where you can get a cabana. Little seating out at the pools so you have to get up early or hope someone doesn’t show their cabana. We were able to do this a few days so it all worked out. However we did see plenty of pissed off people because of this. If you don’t want to wake up by 8-8:30 am to get your seat you will likely encounter limited options in the reserve area. 

With respect to the reserve I would say it is not worth much additional fee. First you will be the furthest away from restaurant. It is a hike. They have a nice area with small plates and a bar. It was nice but most of the options you could find throughout minus a few exceptions. The alcohol was ok. They had grey good, Hendricks and Bombay, jack Daniels, some decent rum, and Don Julio, 1800 etc. it was ok. Beer was basic fare. Heineken , Dos Equis, tecate etc. 

The only real advantage we saw was the more relaxed pool.  Again the concierge was essentially worthless which is ok. Many hotels do not have them but I would not put any value in this.   Feeling like more of a broken promise I would have said our stay would have been better without having one. Our dinner reservations always seemed to be an issue.  Luckily our friends did most of that part of communication with him. They asked for 6:30is timeframe for dinner which was only granted once. Our times were most often 8 or after. On the last night we didn’t get our table in the Italian place until 950. Our reservation was at 9:30.  Multiple requests to move the reservation were not replied to.  Our concierge never once checked on us and only would respond if we asked him a question. I think we only reached out 3 times our entire stay so not needy. Once to get menus which you would think would be provided. Twice to see if a reservation was needed for an activity.  Again he did not alert us to the activities nor provide any direction where to find out about these activities. He also did not let us know about the COVID testing. We knew about it luckily so we’re able to find out the ins and outs on our own.

Entertainment is also not a strongpoint if this hotel. It seems like this is becoming less and less of an option vs 10 years ago.  They don’t have a great areas to house this first of all. You have to crowd into the main bar.  Again nothing outstanding so don’t expect to be wowed here. The best was probably the silent party however it will not appeal to all. 

Hotel was clean with exception of where construction was occurring.  Pretty loud during the day but this should not be held against the hotel. They are building another restaurant which should help and is desperately needed.  Given the size of the hotel, reservations are a problem.  Only expect to be able to get into any of the high demand restaurants once during a stay. They have limited seating. Like 12 tables. And this resort is huge. You can always eat somewhere, but probably not where you want nor when you want. Reservations were the most frustrating part of the trip. We would have hoped our concierge could have helped with that but it was the bare minimum. He was actually the running joke of our stay. 

The gym looked nice. Good size. Tons of equipment. We did attempt to use the hydrotherapy during the stay. Huge disappointment. A little run down. Steam room not operational in men’s room. The jacuzzi in the area was not warm, actually cold. Actually there was not a hot tub anywhere in the resort. Major let down. 

In short this hotel was ok. Probably a great value for families wanting to take kids. I think they stay free.  No beach and limited seating by pool.  Food and drinks were ok. Service overall was good. You will have to get up and go get things and you may be told no in some situations, however again this is not an expensive stay. So don’t compare with something like Le Blanc.  We would not pick this resort for another stay. Even with the prices being lower we would be willing to pay more for better service, more open reservations and improved eating options. 

Two specific call out were Jose at “lunch box”. He was very welcoming and was quick to accommodate our vegetarian diet. There was not an option but he proactively offered. He was very funny and made everyone enjoy dinner. We wish we could have had him every time. 

Also Raoul at the door who took our bags upon arrivals and who met us at departure. He was great very welcoming and funny. He is an asset to the hotel.

reviews.author: Jade1234
reviews.title: Do not stay here
reviews.text: If you’re looking for a budget stay and do not consider yourself a “foodie,” I would say this is a good deal, as the views, pool, and beach are enjoyable. However, I probably stay at about 10 hotels a year and this is by far one of the worst experiences I’ve had. The food was hardly edible, the liquor was truly unrecognizable in flavor, and the rooms were a far cry from 5 star. Outside of motels, there are two hotel stays that stick in my mind as some of the worst experiences, and both include Melia Caribe resorts. It actually seems fraudulent to call this a 5 star hotel, but good spot if you’re looking for something budget and enjoyable.

reviews.author: abehache
reviews.title: Not a 5 stars at all
reviews.text: Hi everyone. Would like to start to say that hotel facility is clean but not a 5 stars resort as is promoted. Let’s keep in mind that the beginning of a vacation is crucial. We had 4 rooms and it took us more than 3 hours to get our rooms and that was we went back to from desk staff and complained our the issue. We ended up taken any room available and not what we had. As well information provided was very limited nor any literature at the rooms about hotel facilities and activities. 70% of the staff were friendly. Not refills in the rooms. Restaurants hard to get a reservation and once you there the first thing they promote the food and drinks that cost you extra. At the pool the cabanas was an extra charge of $250.00 as well the beach. They need to improve at large the entertainment. By midnight everything closes. Bars at the pool and beach close at 6:00pm. Enzo restaurant food was awful. We tried several dishes keep in mind that we have a group of ten. Italian was ok and Cielos the Mexican is the best option. Oscar, Atilano, David, Rafael, Pascual, Roque were great

reviews.author: Britany V
reviews.title:
Staff was good … food was not! 
Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
First off, I want to recognize Moises at the Reserve pool, Carlos at Cielo and Rafael Reserve concierge they all went above and beyond with their amazing customer service. Each of them did everything that they could to make our stay as special as possible. 

The initial reaction to the resort was beautiful. The live plants that lined the lobby were amazing. When we arrived we were escorted to the Reserve check in where we were walked partially through the resort and they pointed us the rest of the way to find the check in desk on our own. During the check in process the gentleman helping us was fairly new and unable to answer questions regarding some of the amenities. We did receive welcome cocktails which was a nice touch.

Our room was a deluxe ocean view suite, and the room hit all the buckets. Beautiful view, clean, very spacious, rain shower,   Comfortable King bed and a well stocked mini bar. 

In the Reserve area you are assigned a concierge/ butler to the room. Our initial concierge we met in our room, spoke to once and did not see again for 3 days. We requested a change and got to meet Rafael who came to meet us and once he found out we were celebrating our Honeymoon, he personally delivered balloons sparkling wine and chocolate dipped strawberries. It was a real treat. Rafael continued to be in contact with us the remainder of the trip to book our dinner reservations and attended to any other needs we had.

As a perk to our Reservation we were allowed use of the Bali beds. Moises was our server at the Reserve pool area, and he was so helpful. He has an awesome attitude and excellent customer service. You can really understand after speaking with him that he truly loves the work he does. He always recognized us wherever we were and asked how he could help us. We were also able to get to know him a bit on a personal level and it was so nice that he was comfortable opening up to us. He went above and beyond with everything he did for us. One day he even saw us by the main pool and said why aren’t you sitting with him? ( There hadn’t been any seats available) 15 minutes later he had loungers set up with water and our favorite drinks and came to tell us to come sit in his area. Amazing!

The biggest reason for our average review was because of the food. When you go to an all inclusive resort like this and you spend a decent amount of money, you expect a certain level of service and food selection. We felt as if we ate the same thing for 8 days…. Not ideal. The food was mediocre at best. There are many times throughout the day where the only option is Malva (buffet). The food at the buffet was terrible, mostly lukewarm mishmash of ingredients left little to be desired. The specialty restaurants seemed to have a bit more quality affair, however a reservation is required. Without a reservation you are left to room service or buffet which all come from the same kitchen. McDonald’s is luckily across the street if you need something to tie you over.

I highly recommend not booking this resort until the construction is over. The constant noise of grinding metal and dust in the air well into the evening make for a “relaxing” trip.

I wish I  could have come away with a better story to tell from our Honeymoon but this resort lack attention to detail, even when you pay for the extra perks.

Although we met a few great staff members we will likely not be returning to this resort.

Special Thank you to

Moises, Ruben, Oscar in the Reserve pool

reviews.author: AylinNazaryan
reviews.title: Construction I conviniance.
reviews.text: Property is very nice. But was under construction.  The middle part of the hotel was under construction and was not covered.  There was a coffee and ice cream desk under and next to the construction dust. The sofas and tables were covered in construction dust.  The Italian restaurant had no air conditioning.  Check in was very long. Only 3 people working and long line.

reviews.author: jruiz1174
reviews.title: Needs work
reviews.text:
The construction is a bit loud and dusty. The rooms need updating. My room specifically had a moldy smell and the ac unit did not work well. The air conditioning in the halls and lobby either does not work or was not put on. The staff in the restaurants were very friendly, but the food was just ok. 
Overall we had a good time, but just feel for the money spent was not up to standards.

reviews.author: Ceils
reviews.title: Reserve Upgrade not worth it for Family
reviews.text: I decided to purchase the RESERVE room, when I booked my Family trip, based on the description on the site.  Did not get any of the services offered. Only 2 dinner reservations, which in all honesty, I couldve made.  Not able to reserve an area at the Pool as told I would be, so we fended for ourselves. would call for services, and was bounced around. Our Butler was difficult to contact via whatsapp, took long. She offered us a meeting with one of the Sales people there, they upsell memberships i guess, but would require 1 hour in the morning, which we kindly declined. after that, unresponsive and she was on a day off one of the days we were there and did not offer an alternate contact.  Eddie in Capella restaurant and Enrique and Flora at the pool however, were amazing!  Nice looking hotel, but will skip the higher pricetag.

reviews.author: Emily448
reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text:
I booked this hotel after the most wonderful stay at the Paradisus La Perla in Playa Del Carmen in February 2020. I was under the impression that my family would be getting the same experience and unfortunately I shouldn’t assume things. 
I arrived at the hotel with my husband and 2 boys(6& 8). After about a 20 minute check in experience we found out our room wouldn’t be ready for an hour(3 pm). The bellman had already taken our luggage so all we could really do was sit around with 2 crazy kids. When we returned in an hour our room still wasn’t ready and ended up waiting another hour or so. 
They ended up giving us basically a ground floor/ basement room. I booked this trip back in March and I booked a 2 bedroom 2 bathroom suite. From the photos online it looked just like the Paradisus La Perla rooms but that couldn’t be farther from the truth. I booked through the Meliá website and when I did there was one price for the room I selected so I’m not sure why they acted like a better room was going to be an upgrade. 
After throwing a hissy fit which I never do they ended up giving us a room 2 floors up which was still nothing like the photos on the website. Oh well it’s just a room and I wasn’t going to ruin my vacation over it.
I thought when you checked in you were assigned a concierge  to help with dinner reservations, spa treatments and excursions which was what they do at the Paradisus La Perla. Again I was wrong. You have to call all the restaurants yourself and make reservations. When I asked the front desk about this they looked at me like I had 2 heads. My husband told me to lower my expectations so when I did that I was finally able to have fun.
Not sure about the kids club nobody told us anything about it and our boys were pretty bummed. Every time we walked by it was closed. My boys met a kid at the pool that said it opened at 2 but again we walked by it everyday at different times and it was dark. 
To us this place’s only saving grace was the food and beverage staff. While the food was mediocre the staff at the pool and in the restaurants were exceptional! It’s the only reason I’m giving a halfway decent review. I usually never write reviews especially bad ones but I just felt compelled to say something. Don’t get me wrong we still had a great time because we had fun with each other but this will be the last time I stay at a Meliá property.

reviews.author: Pamelalee1952
reviews.title: some great some not so great
reviews.text:
The first person we came in contact with at the resort was Olimpia during check in.  Through out our stay she was an outstanding contact, always courteous, friendly and very helpful.

The overall resort was very nice and we really enjoyed the beautiful pool and the friendly staff at the swim up bar. 

The food was acceptable but nothing great.  While many of the meals were not particularly bad there was not a single one that I would order again

reviews.author: WynR
reviews.title: Not quite what we were expecting....
reviews.text:
Traveling with a young family during COVID, we were well prepared to be understanding of the challenges and roll with the punches but Cancun Paradisus was still a pretty big disappointment.

Young families - this is not the hotel for you. The general pool is a full on party with tons of smoking, guests that bring their own boom boxes and loudly blare competing music and occasional pot smoking. We spent all of our time at the small kids pool which bored my 4 year old, but I didn't love the noise/smoke at the other pool.

Family concierge was also a huge disappointment. We had a few small requests upon arrival (i.e. to switch out the feather pillows for my husband who is allergic, a bottle opener for the water in the room that requires a bottle opener to open it) and each time it took several hours and several attempts to get a response. After our first day, we reached out a few additional times (i.e. to make dinner reservations which are required everywhere ) and were told we had to call ourselves from our hotel room between 9am - 5pm. However, with the kids, our preferred schedule was to go out early and be back midday for a nap. Sometimes by the time we were back, we were told the restaurants were "sold out" (for 6pm!) even though they always seemed empty.  The concierge service seems like a huge scam as all she did  was send us the days activities and request meetings to talk through joining the Club Melia  (though reading some of the reviews, other families appear to have more luck).

The food is fine. The hotel (as described elsewhere) is fine though showing quite a bit of wear and tear but for the price, there are several better options in Cancun, especially if you have young kids.

reviews.author: Kirsten M
reviews.title: Cancun Vacation
reviews.text:
We had an amazing time with the activities coordinator Augustin. My husband and I participated in the painting on the beach as well as volleyball during our stay.
The service and food were great during our stay, but the Air conditioning did not work very well in our room.

reviews.author: Candiago
reviews.title: It was Okay at best
reviews.text:
We visited Paradisus for a Birthday Getaway. We were a group of 7 (3 couples and 1 single traveler) Check in was not too bad but they do try to up sell everything and they make up prices as they go along.
One Couple opted for the reserve experience. The said it was great and the butler that was assigned to them was extremely attentive. They had a nice huge room for 2 nights but had to move due to a leak. They were moved to a room with twin beds and no ocean view. The resort said that was the only room available which I believe was B.S. We did not do reserve but upgraded our room to the "newer renovated" rooms for 150.00 the only difference was the furniture and bathroom style. The A.C. in all the rooms except for the reserve was HORRIBLE!!! this includes restaurants and lobby. The Ginger bar is where the shows and nightlife happens. it has a air conditioned area where you can drink and sit but the shows and DJ are in the open air area so no A.C. there. The shows were decent though. The drinks were okay as well some too sweet. Top shelf liquor is available with all inclusive. The Best thing about this resort for us was the food and "DIDI" the pool bar batender. For an all inclusive resort the food was very very good. Our least favorite restaurant would have to be the Italian restaurant. DIDI the Bartender/server was AMAZING! extremely attentive. He would bring drinks and food to us and would constantly come to see if we needed anything else. He was GREAT! In addition, the restaurant in the middle of the lobby is being renovated so there is construction going on throughout the day that can be loud. Covid testing was quick and easy as well. I personally would not be returning to the Paradisus Cancun because I feel there are better resorts for the money they are asking.

reviews.author: Kaitlyn C
reviews.title: Overall OK
reviews.text:
For the price we paid I am disappointed. Music blaring from 8:30-12am, impossible to sleep even with ear plugs and two pillows over my head. We were in pyramid 3. In the daytime there is roaring loud construction in the center of the hotel, we were not aware this would be happening. As many others say, be prepared to sweat like you've never sweat before. We talked to the front desk several times about the lack of air in our rooms and hand a handyman come in at least 4 times throughout our stay. The air kept going off and on because it's monitored through a switch on the back patio. We had a leak on the first day in our room and they came and fixed that also. Don't expect to be cool here it is very humid and rooms at best get to 72 or so, feels like 78 with the humidity. 

Food is good at the restaurants, buffet is subpar. Breakfast options are limited to the buffet- we got very bored of the same breakfast every day..

Service was great! Front desk really needs to improve but all over staff members or incredible!  This is the second time Ive been here and I would not return a third time.

reviews.author: JonathanDS7991
reviews.title: Cancun Paradisus Not Paradise
reviews.text:
My wife, myself, and our 9 year old daughter went for 10 days of vacation, and it was not even close to what we expected. We were in room 3356 in the center pyramid.
Day 1
We did not have the king size bed we requested and were told we would get. Thankfully the beds were not bolted in place and I was able to move the room around to fit our needs.
Day 2 
We were preparing for hurricane Grace to hit. We called maintenance as the slider was leaking and 4 men showed up. They adjusted the door as it wasn’t making a seal. They placed a 3” wide flexible adhesive strip to block the air flow. Nothing worked. That night the hurricane hit hard. The balcony had 4 inches of water on it because the drainage vents were all clogged and had not been cleaned so the water backed up into the room. I found the vents clogged the next day. The slider, as heavy as it was, was leaking water and the water was coming up from the bottom track. There were holes in it and the water was bubbling up through it and being forced up due to wind and water pressure from outside. The strip they installed for the wind started to vibrate and rattle all night. I travel with duct tape (and some tools) and I used it to hold the vibrating strip to the glass to quiet things down. We were up all night soaking up water with the towels and wringing them out in the wastebasket. We had 1” of water in the room everywhere. The beds were wet, everything was wet. 
Day 3
I went to the Front Desk and Guest Services starting at 4:00 am and the hotel was full of water everywhere. The room a few doors down from us literally had water pouring out from under the door into the hallway. I made 8 requests for maintenance and housekeeping. Maintenance NEVER showed up at all for the duration of our stay. Housekeeping did not show up either. My wife kept cleaning up the water with towels. I went looking for anything to clean the room with. I found a housekeeping cart nearby with a large floor squeegee in it. I borrowed it and went back to the room and started to clean the water off the floors. It seems the housekeeping person I borrowed the squeegee from wanted it back and she came knocking at the door. She saw what we were doing and stayed to clean the room for us. She dried he floor, plugged the holes in the door track with towels, and gave us clean and dry bedding and towels and made all the bad stuff go away. Her name was Makely and I wanted to keep her. She saved the day for us. She was an amazing, hard working woman. She deserves so much credit. Please recognize her. We were told that every room facing the ocean had water in it. This tells me as few things: The sliding doors do not make as good seal (and it doesn’t mean in high winds because the next day there was a slight shower and the water still came in), this most likely not the only hurricane to hit the hotel so this is a known problem that the hotel chooses to NOT FIX due to high cost for the occasional hurricane every 3 years or so (why spend the money when you can just blame it on a hurricane and let the guests suffer), if anyone goes there then need a hefty supply of Flex Seal products as they will not get any help from maintenance. On my 2nd request for maintenance, they NEVER showed up at the room again for the remainder of our 8 days there.

Other issues:
In the room they give you a stocked refrigerator, an ice bucket, but no glasses and no ice. I requested glasses for 4 days and finally I had to go downstairs to Guest Services to get 3 plastic cups. I also requested ice for 4 days and finally on the 4th day I got a bag of ice that would fill 5 ice buckets and I only had 1. I requested ice every day during our stay and got ice 4 times only out of 10 days. On the 6th day real glass glasses mysteriously showed up in the bathroom.
We had blood stained bed linen for 5 days. The shower controls would work one day and not the next. The tub was 2 & ½ feet high. It was impossible for me at 65 with arthritis and degenerative joint disease, and needing hip replacement surgery to get into and out of it without severe pain and help.
During the day time there were power tools and noise from construction work being done in the atrium area as it was demolished and being rebuilt which at the rate they were going will be finished sometime next year if they are lucky.
We were on the 3rd floor in pyramid 3 in room 3356. Directly below us was a sport bar which is where they had nightly entertainment. Seating was made possible for 30 people and the performing area was about 25 feet away from them. The speakers were at high volume. From 8:00 pm until midnight EVERY NIGHT we had to listed to whatever was going on. It was so loud, you could not sleep. It you were roomed in the atrium area in that building you would not be able to sleep until after midnight. Not good if you travel with a child and are older person who needs a little more sleep.
We needed toilet paper, so back to Guest Services to request toilet paper. The 2 rollers in the bathroom were empty. When we got to the room, there were 2 rolls of toilet paper on the counter in the bathroom. They wouldn’t even put them on the empty rollers. Not a huge deal as we all do it at home anyways, but when you spend thousands on a vacation, you expect a little pampering.
For 4 days we could not get the toiletries refilled in the bathroom. Back to Guest Services to get that done. Also, I had to go to Guest Services to get towels. When housekeeping made the room they left the towel bar in the bathroom empty. Now you would think that in doing your work routine you would see a long empty towel bar and say to yourself…hmmmmm, something needs to go there, and you fill it with towels. But, Noooooo.
Never in all my travels in whichever part of the world I have been in did I ever have to call EVERY day to request the beds made, toilet paper, soap, shampoo, towels, glasses, or ice. It seems here you have to do just that.
I had a blinking, red message waiting light on the room telephone that NOBODY in the hotel knew how to clear. Listening to the message (in Spanish) would not clear it. It blinked for 6 days until we left because no one knew how to clear it. I covered it with duct tape.

There was one day that my stomach wasn’t just right. We were out by the pool and there was a seafood restaurant close by so I figured I would find a toilet close by. There was 1 toilet in the bathroom and when I lifted the lid, well, not a pretty sight. Here’s the good part….I had to fix the toilet myself to get it to flush so I could then clean the seat and use the toilet as I was in desperation. My only other option was the ladies room which I figured would not have gone over well. As I was leaving, a maintenance man came in with a plunger. He looked in the toilet and saw it was empty and clean and he looked at me while I was washing my hands. I told him that “I fixed it”. He says “You fixed it”? “Yes” I told him. He flushed it twice and it worked fine. He looks back at me and says “Thank you”.
On our last day we saw a 2 year old boy who was not wearing swim diapers have a bowel movement in the pool. His family quickly tried to get the feces out of the water. The kid left a trail of feces out of the pool onto the walkway. His mother took him most likely to their room to clean and change him. We told the nearest resort worker about it and nothing was done for the next 3 hours we were there. On a cruise ship they drain the pool, clean it, and refill it. Here they ignore it and let the people swim in feces contaminated water. Ignorance is bliss.
That night in our room my daughter plugged in a table lamp and got a tingle. The lamp cord was in need of repair and had some black tape on it. 
That was pretty much the bad stuff. Now for the good.
I told you about the Makely from housekeeping. Awesome lady. 
Waiter Orlando Bello is phenomenal. This man remembered us by name, what we drank per person, and gave us the best possible service. This man was so good at what he did. He made us all feel like we were the most important people there.
There were 2 people by the pool area. Ivonne and Luis. Luis was always there if you needed something. He would literally run to get it for you so wouldn’t have to wait. Ivonne was so good to us. She gave us the best service outside, reserved a specific cabana for us which was a first come basis. She would block it off for us and reserved it for the entire day. She always stopped by the chat with us and we got to know her which was really nice. She was so attentive to not just us but everyone there. She cared about us and our timer there.
Two people in Guest Services I need to mention. Wen is a young lady who cared about the guests and helping them. She was a sweetheart for all that she did to help us. When we needed ice one day, she left her desk and brought it to us herself. She liked her job of helping people and it showed.
But the very best person if all, who actually deserves so much recognition is Christhian from Guest Services. This guy loves his job and takes great pride and enjoyment out of helping other. He upgraded us to gold standard which came with perks, he intervened with housekeeping to get us what we needed cleaned and done, and he literally bent over backwards to help us. Christhian literally is Paradisus Cancun. He should be on a sales brochure of the Paradisus with the hotel in the background and Christhian standing in the foreground with his arms crossed and his usually smiling face with the sparkle inn his eyes. This man loves his job and is proud of where he works and the service e performs. CHRISTHIAN IS THE PARADISUS RESORT ! He was the most important person there. He is also the first person I shook hands with in 2 years. That’s how well we got along. Funny story about him, I was looking for some umbrella sunblock for my wife. He said he was going into town that night and would look for me. The next day he texts me to come to Guest Services. I get there and he is beaming with pride as he hands me a 3 foot blue and white umbrella. I looked at him and showed him a picture of what I wanted and he hung his head in embarrassment. Wen, mentioned earlier, looked at him and said: “I told you his wife wanted sunscreen!” We all laughed so hard. I love this guy. If we ever go back there again, it will be because of him. He is by far the best Guest Services person I have ever known in all my years of traveling.
The people in the MALVA Restaurant were great. Alondra and Karen and Grace were always professional and attentive and friendly. Enrique, Arturo, Ignacio all are outstanding.
Henri, outside by the pool, a wonderfully attentive person who would do anything for you.
Daniella was the nicest and kindest young lady who was always there to help you out and listen to what you had to say to try to help.
Axel was probably the only person to repeatedly knock on my door and ask me what I wanted for my refrigerator in the room.
The people working there saved our vacation. It wasn’t a great vacation, but it was an okay one.   

There is a huge and serious disconnect from the people working in the hotel like maintenance and especially room service and housekeeping from the people waiting on you and Guest Services. This is the real problem there, They don’t work as a team there.

reviews.author: JD323
reviews.title: Just ok… will not return
reviews.text:
The hotel is UNDER CONSTRUCTION! This was nit well advertised so buyer beware. The noise was just horrific but the work is being done right in the lobby. The AC is horrific in pyramid three. You will wake up sweaty. We also had issues with pests in our room:roaches and ants. The hotel came and sprayed twice. However, I saw a roach in the buffet running around the beef station. That was truly disgusting. 

The food is mediocre in the buffet. Restaurants are pretty good. The highlight of this hotel is the STAFF! From the SPA, to the restaurants, to the vendors… the staff is AMAZING! Super accommodating, they remember your drinks, and will even find chicken tenders for your picky eater. My little ones also enjoyed the kids club activities but you must be 5 and older! 

Unfortunately, we did not have a five star experience and will not return. My recommendation is to fix the AC and the pest problem and be more open about the ongoing construction. 

Photo is of the roach running behind the curtain in the buffet. 

Buyer beware!

reviews.author: Jeanine D
reviews.title: Girls Trip
reviews.text: I planned a girls trip with 7 of my friends just needing a get away. Transportation was a mess. So no matter if you confirm and send the confirmation email with flights and arrival times. You’re not ok. And your friend is going to be left at the airport. Expect check in to be about an hour, even with the reserve which is suppose to be exclusive. You’re not going to be able to have a reservation at the restaurants for the first couple of nights because your concierge going to be reactive and not proactive. When it comes activities like tequila tasting and wine tasting you’ll be turned away. If you’re a black minority just don’t, but the waiters and waitresses staff are phenomenal.

reviews.author: Josiv K
reviews.title: Clean and Friendly but....
reviews.text: The resort is nice however the buffet is terrible. Food in general is ok.. not the best Ive had in Mexico. Night life is non existent. You need to go outside of the resort to have some fun. Air-conditioning in the room is terrible. They should tint the glass so that the sun is not beaming down and having to keep the blinds closed to get the room to be cooler. What's the point of a great view if the room is roasting? Pool is fun and the staff is very friendly. The best meal I had was at the pool side amenities. We went to the steak house for my friends birthday and it was very overpriced. Food was really good but for what I had I paid much less at a very high quality establishment in the USA. Construction is 6 days a week in the hotel which I understand but a little annoyed. Good resort but not 5 star... I'd say close to a 3.5 star. Food needs to be better, more entertainment, and better AC in the rooms. I hope to come back someday and have a better experience.

reviews.author: 258craig
reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text:
I booked 3 rooms in the reserved. Took hours upon arrival for my rooms to be ready. Then the rooms were in different towers. Then I didn’t get the room I paid for. Same day, hungry when to pool bar no chairs available to sit. Sat at bar ask to order food manager said you can’t get food with out chair. I explain there are no chairs. He said buy a cabana 250$. Haha 
No Ac in lobby area. The fragrance they have in the lobby was so bad I couldn’t breathe I had to personally unplug their machines. 
Room no hot water for 2 days. 
Ac in room so loud. 
Balcony no shade. 
Food quality bad. 
You had to buy water 6 dollars
Restaurant was always booked out. 
Pool area personally music playing so loud with bad language and I have kids. It felt like you were in rui cancun with teenagers 
Not enough chairs for the amount of guest 
Every time I ask concierge for a favor everything was no. 
The list goes on.

reviews.author: Jeanette R
reviews.title: 14th Anniversary Trip Turns Sour
reviews.text:
My husband and I just got back from our 14th anniversary trip to Cancun and we stayed in Paradisus Cancun - The Reserve. Overall our stay is good except for the check-in mishap and the last whole day of our stay which was supposed to be special because it was our 14th anniversary (the main reason of our trip) but dampen our mood because of a number of unfulfilled promises. 

First, we arrived around 9pm so famish since we only had a brunch in L.A. I thought that the "The Reserve" reception area is something VIPish, but definitely no. We walked quite a distance to get from the main lobby to the "The Reserve" reception area at building 5. The ambience of the area is so nice with dim lights and naturalistic interior design but the temperature was so hot. Sweat trickled down our haggard faces. We already checked-in through mobile app beforehand thinking the check-in process when we get there will be smooth and short coz' we knew we will arrive late and we wanted to be able to atleast eat in the buffet restaurant but opposite happens. It takes around 30 minutes for us to get our bracelet/key card because of some mishaps in room assignment according to the receptionist. She said we were assigned in a room that was not what we've booked for so she find us another The Reserve room (which was in the main pyramid-Building 3, far from The Reserve section in Building 5). We've waited for several minutes for our personal concierge, Rafael, to guide us to our room but we didn't expect that even that late at night Rafael tried to tour us around the resort. We were so desperate to eat because we were so hungry and it's 10pm already (restaurants closes at 11pm) so we talked to him that maybe we can proceed now to our room coz' we need to eat. Luckily, we were still able to eat in Malva and there was still ample amount of food even if its nearing closing time. 

We had booked a day tour and afternoon/night activity for the 2nd and 3rd day so most of our days in this trip were not in the resort. We only had the whole 4th day reserved to spend at the resort. We just requested to our personal concierge, Rafael, to do restaurants reservations, our Covid19 test appointment, and airport transfer and he all did it promptly. Rafael also answers our queries at WeChat. Sadly, on the 4th day (our last whole day in the resort), the most special day for this trip, our 14th anniversary it became disappointing. First, Rafael our concierge was in his scheduled day off at that day but the day before, he promised to us that everything for the next day will be prepared. He even promised that he will send a special gift to our room, have a Bali bed set up for us for the whole day and the Capella restaurant reservation for our anniversary dinner. We thought everything was prepared and we didn't even tried to contact him coz' he was in his day off except that night when we were so fed up with disappointments. First, the promised Bali bed was not prepared when we get there. Although we had the reservation, we still searched the attendant to ask our assigned Bali bed and was just set up when we get there. Just normal set up no 'special' things as promised. Second, for our reservation in Capella nothing was special. The receptionist ask the guests before us if they were celebrating something on that day, but us, she never asked. I was starting to get disappointed at that. When we were seated in a not so 'special' section of the restaurant my husband even asked a staff if something is prepared for us as per Rafael told us the day before and the staff even said yes there is, I think it was just wine or something. Only then that my husband replied to Rafael's message in WeChat asking us how our day goes by. He complained about the unfulfilled promises of him and Rafael said that he will check on it. He even told us that he had someone go to our room to fulfill his promise and we just gave him 30 minutes. We finished our dinner and nothing happens. We've waited for few minutes for the staff to gave us there 'special' token for our anniversary and nothing happened so we just decided to get up and went back to our room. And the third disappointment, nothing was in the room when we get there. It really sets our mood down. We planned to spend the night at Ginger Bar (the only open bar) to continue our supposed to be anniversary celebration but we didn't because of too much disappointments. We still waited up to 11pm in our room and still the promise 'gift' was nowhere until we just fall asleep with heavy heart. 

My husband and I really like this resort and even thought to stay here when we decided to visit Cancun again but because of that disappointing day we thought otherwise. Mind you, we were not demanding guests, we only contacted our personal concierge for few times just for the reservations. Every service given to us were paid in with ample tip from our personal concierge, room cleaner and restocking staff, we gave tip to them everyday. To pool attendants and servers in the restaurants and bars we gave tip in EVERY food or drink they served us even in Capella where service was really bad. That's why in every restaurants and in the bar that we went to in the resort except for the Capella, we were treated extra special. If they just assigned us another personal concierge to fulfill all that promises on that special day maybe our trip with this resort will be truly a HAPPY unforgettable one but was all ruined because of that day. 

P.S. For the restaurants review, my most favorite is Enso, food was really good, serving is just enough and the service was excellent. Second was Mole, food tasted good, serving was huge and the service was prompt and excellent. Third was Malva, we liked it here coz' only here that we got to eat beef. Most of the restaurants were more on seafoods but my husband is allergic to seafoods so he can not fully enjoy the menu. Food in Sante was good but the serving was just so little and it takes more than 30mins to serve the food. In Capella, food was just mediocre and service was really bad. We always dressed up during dinner but nothing is special on their set up. The server didn't even take out the appetizer plates before serving us the main course making our table look so inelegant and he even hand in to me in my bare hands my main course plate which was so hot I almost make it fall. We even can't find him to ask for another glass of drinks and no one even there to bother. Lastly, my husband didn't like the ambience in Ginger Bar coz' he said it was not like the bars he went to in the resort he previously stayed in Cancun that was really for adults only coz' it's in an open area.

reviews.author: Karen H
reviews.title: Lack of AC ruins what could be a great hotel!
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Paradisus in late July 2021.  The hotel is beautiful, but there is no air conditioning in most of the hotel! The rooms have it, but it is not very good. If you like a cool room, you will still be hot. Honestly, it really ruined the trip. A vacation should be relaxing, but we were sweating all the time! You couldn’t even shop in the gift shops without dying from the heat! Dinner at Cappella was so nice - lovely restaurant, good food, violinist was great - but we had to eat and go, no lingering for another glass of wine. Too hot’ I walked around with a battery operated fan, but i was still melting! This is just really unacceptable for a luxury hotel. I read the reviews complaining about the lack of AC about a week before I left, but it was too late then. I would never return to this hotel unless they had AC throughout the hotel. They also need to provide a map of the property and information on the restaurants and a schedule of the show. They just tell you to use the App which does not work and is not user friendly. We had no idea what shows were available. The sargassum was terrible. They do try to remove it from the beach, but it wasn’t really possible to go in the water. I saw very few people in the water. I imagined sitting on a beautiful beach during this vacation, but sadly, I wasn’t able to enjoy the beach and spent my time at the pool instead. The view is still gorgeous, but it was just very disappointing. 

On the positive side, the hotel is beautiful, the pool is nice, and most of the staff that we encountered were great! Francisco, who served us drinks at the pool, was very personable and remembered our names. Alfredo, who served us at Malvo a few times, was great as well. I feel for the staff who works so hard in the heat serving drinks outside, and there is no relief from the heat inside the hotel either! Tip them well, they so deserve it! We left a piece of luggage at the airport, and the concierge (I think her name was Wen) was incredibly helpful! She also helped us get reservations for dinner (the app does not work).  We met Augustin, who entertained us with magic tricks while we waited for one of the shows to start. Charming young man who spoke excellent English. I suspect he will be running the place one day!

reviews.author: Ana R
reviews.title: Please read this review from our recent stay
reviews.text:
Review

My husband and I got married at the Paradisus Cancun on 7/31. We stayed there from 7/28-8/3. Our guest count was about 58 people plus us makes 60. The resort itself is very beautiful. The staff was welcoming. We stayed on the reserve and were assigned Steff as our concierge. She was very sweet and attentive the entire time. She made herself available to meet in person whenever we needed to. The food in the resort was DELICIOUS! Blue Agave was our first place to eat since the buffet was closed for an hour. Please try it! Cappella is a great Italian restaurant and for an Italian restaurant in Mexico the food was really good I was impressed. 

Our wedding coordinator was Marlene. We loved her. She was very helpful and accommodated is throughout our stay and wedding. She was available through text when we needed her. I love that we were able to meet to go over the details for our wedding. We appreciated that she has our table set up ready to show us how our reception would look like. The wedding itself turned out to be very beautiful! Marlene was able to take everything we wanted and turn it into reality. 

Our welcome cocktail and wedding reception had amazing staff. They were very friendly which made the guest feel comfortable. One person who really stood out to us was Javier. He was the best!!! He took care of us at the wedding and kept bringing us cold towels (Cancun is unbearable in July) to keep us cool. Not only that he was doing it for the guests as well. He really went above and beyond for our party. 

Now that I’ve covered all of the good things, I do believe that there is room for improvement. I do want to let people know that the air conditioning sucked. It was pretty embarrassing because the guests complained the entire time. One of my guests was pregnant and was hot in her room! Stef helped us to make sure the room was cooler. This is not okay. I understand that the heat in July is insane however I had family that stayed in two different resorts after they stayed for the wedding and they had FULL BLAST A.C. For a luxury resort this is unacceptable. Not only is it horrible for the guests but these are horrible working conditions for the staff. I was taking pictures in my room with the bridesmaids as we got ready. I was drenched in sweat the entire time. I WAS IN DOORS. nope 👎🏼  They also need more staff. Sometimes I only saw 2 people working at the main pool area which is too little considering the amount of people that visit the resort.

reviews.author: Marcos R
reviews.title: Our First Covid Era Vacation.
reviews.text:
I had originally booked this vacation through Orbitz. I booked the Luxury Junior suite w/ ocean view for me and my girlfriend. Later I found out about the whole "reserve upgrade" So I called the resort and asked about it. I mentioned that me and my girlfriend were flying in August 4th and I spoke with Nadia. She told me for 2 people the reserve upgrade was going to be an extra $600 USD. We decided to go through with it. I find out a few days before our vacation that Orbitz only booked it for one person. I was panicking and called the resort and they also confirmed that the booking was for 1 person. They wanted to charge me an extra 1,000 USD too add my gf, but I instead went through Orbitz. I made it clear that I wanted the Reserve Junior Suite with ocean view for 2. I called Paradisus and again spoke with Nadia and she seen the update for 2, with the reserve junior suite with ocean view for $3,600 USD. It was WAY more than what I wanted to pay but I was not about to cancel my first vacation since this whole covid situation. 
We get to the resort I was told it was 3,660 for the room, I hand the girl my Credit Card, and the concierge that was assigned to us is putting on our reserve wristbands,  My phone goes off saying I just spent 4,301.17 USD. I get very upset and the girl informs me "that was for the reserve upgrade" We go back and forth arguing, I am very upset at this point because I am being told one thing and given another. It's a huge mess. We argue for a while, the manager ends up letting me keep the reserve upgrade wristbands (which gives us special pool access and other amenities) But they stick me in a cheaper room without everything I was guaranteed with the reserve upgrade room (Bath/jacuzzi style tub, bigger balcony, etc...) I appreciated the manager Carlos for allowing us to keep the wristbands but I shouldn't have to go there and fight to get what I was guaranteed. It made me feel very uncomfortable and upset.

We get to the room and for the first two nights the A/C is awful. We couldn't sleep at night. A gentleman came to fix it in the morning. It started working great. My girlfriend is finally comfortable with the temp and goes to take a shower and a cockroach (pictured below) is crawling on the shower curtain. We call down and the lady tells us that they will come fumigate the room and things will be okay. Not exactly what we wanted to hear, so again, we had to escalate things bc they were not in a rush to fix anything. They said they would move us to a different room and they did. The room was SIGNIFICANTLY smaller and the ocean view was cut big time. They didn't show much concern with the fact that I was bothered by that. I escalated the situation again and they moved me to a room on a higher floor, but the same size. The ocean view was a lot better so I just settled for it because this whole process killed my entire day. I wasted an entire daytime outing because of the mess. Wendolyn was very helpful in this situation and I was able to get a slight refund because of her. During my  last swim I ran into one more cockroach (literally) inside the reserve pool.

I don't want to drag the resort because it truly is a beautiful place. The staff inside of restaurants are amazing. Some of the nicest people. Two individuals stood out and honestly saved our vacation. Wendy who works inside the Ginger Bar was amazing. Very, very welcoming and just seemed genuinely happy to see you happy and enjoying your time there. And Carlos at the reserve pool. Carlos treated us like family and they are a big part as to why I am willing to give Paradisus another shot. 

I know sometimes things happen. This hotel is obviously not a bad place to stay, I would just like them to be a little more understanding and willing to go the extra mile to help out when someone is obviously having a rough time and things aren't going their way. I would love to give the Paradisus another shot to fix my rating to make my experience excellent.

reviews.author: Samantha D
reviews.text: They had good food options, but not many options for kids. Staff were great, but seemed to be understaffed in the most important areas, like poolside. Housekeepers were great! Always made up our room very nicely. The rooms were very warm, even with the fan and the air conditioning on all night and day.

reviews.author: nanoox2021
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text:
There was not enough information provided about the hotel amenities, entertainment, and restaurants. 

We specifically made reservations to use the Golf course.  The reservation desk said they did not have golf balls and send us on a scavenger hunt in town.  We were not able to find golf balls and never saw the course used by anyone.  What a waste of space.

For other amenities and entertainment we would ask staff around the hotel, but always got conflicting information.  We eventually were able to figure stuff out during trial and error, but information on the first day would have made it less frustrating.

For the restaurant details, we kept being told to use the melia app.  The app did not have reservation availability updated, so we still had to call the front desk to coordinate reservations.  The app has glitches and kept logging me out, so I gave up after 3 times.  We did not get an overview of the restaurants and food choices.  Some of the restaurant choices food was disappointing, but on the plus side the buffet food was good.

reviews.author: Keith R
reviews.title: Good food, nice resort, but not worth the cost
reviews.text: If you decide to visit, be sure to insist upon check-in: proper welcome befitting a tropical all-inclusive resort, contact with your personal concierge/butler (if booking in The Reserve wing), schedule of resort activities during your stay, a welcome tour of the property, and information on any specials (such as spa discounts) that are only available at check-in time. If you don't ask for those, you won't get them.

reviews.author: Sal R
reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text: Place is very nice can't denied that but had a bad experience at check in I got suckered into upgrade to so call reserved area where we was supposed to get high premium drinks,did I mention that cost me $475.00 more? well the room they gave me had a building for a view I had ocean deluxe suite. Well the drinks there where the same all over the resort.

reviews.author: Chamittleman
reviews.title: Just okay
reviews.text: We went from Paradisus Playa Del Carmen to Paradisus Cancun and had high expectations from spending five days in Playa Del Carmen, which is an exceptional property with exceptional service. The positives: this hotel is beautiful. The grounds are beautiful and the ocean views are stunning. The servers at the pool and in the restaurants are top notch. Especially Victor at the pool. We reserved a two bedroom suite and it is plenty spacious, a little dated, but nice. It has a view of the lagoon. The air conditioning struggled to work well and we finally called maintenance the second day and were told due to the location of the room, the AC just wasn’t going to work as well. Our major complaint with this hotel is we arrived at 1:30pm to check in. I had done an online check in and indicated we would be arriving around 1pm. When we arrived our room wasn’t ready, which wasn’t a big deal. We had lunch and walked around the property and were told our room would be ready by 2:30pm. We arrived back at 3 and told it wasn’t quite ready and to give them 20 minutes. We came back at 3:30pm and were told the room wouldn’t be ready for “at least” 90-120 minutes. When asked why the delay we were told we were in “a really big room” that took too long to clean (the room isn’t much bigger than the room we had at the other Paradisus, which was somehow cleaned efficiently each day.) When asked a second time about the delay we were told it was because the previous occupant didn’t check out on time and there was nothing they could do about it. We asked to speak to a manager to try to understand why they thought delaying a check in over two hours after their posted check in time was happening and were told the manager was “in a meeting”. We were assured the manager would reach out to us that day to follow up. Spoiler alert: we are still waiting for the manager to contact us and highly doubt they even care enough about this issue to follow up. The other downside of this hotel is it is a massive party site. We weren’t expecting that since the other Paradisus is so serene. We found a quiet pool to set up at, which wasn’t bad. But if you are expecting peace and quiet on this stay, go elsewhere. Overall, this place is just okay. I highly doubt we will be back, but am glad we visited. Next time we will just spend our whole trip at Paradisus Playa Del Carmen or try another resort.

reviews.author: Veronica M
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful but I will be be going back.  First, when checking in we were told our room was not ready and would be a room on the he Reserve side on the second floor ocean view which was perfect but seems they gave our room to someone else and we ended up on the ground floor which did not have a great view.  Second, the food was not good at all.  Third, the butler service was not good.   The pool workers, waiters and housekeepers were great but that's not enough to get me back or encourage other people to go there.  I travel a lot and was only impressed with the beauty of the resort.  Management needs to do something about the food.

reviews.author: Passport68147
reviews.title: The good and the bad
reviews.text: First, be aware that not everything is as advertised due to Covid restrictions which would have been good to know ahead of planning the trip and paying for the Reserve upgrade.  The good was that our concierge, Wendolyn, was absolutely amazing and really went above and beyond to ensure our stay was exceptional.  Also, my aesthetician, Itzel, at the Spa was wonderful and I highly recommend her!

reviews.author: Vic N
reviews.title: Not the best
reviews.text: For me, what makes a hotel/resort a 5 star is not only on the condition of the resort, but also the amenities and the service.  Our group of 29 traveled to Cancun to stay at Paradisus for a week.  Most of our rooms are Reserves so we did pay a little extra but got none of the benefits.  We never got the butler service, had to literally beg for dinner reservations, the room size is not impressive, and the check in/check out process was a nightmare, long and tedious.   Mid-way through our stay, we coincidentally bumped into a concierge, Juan Carlos, who volunteered to help with the group dinner reservations; otherwise, we would have to hit the buffet every night  :(.  One restaurant there, fuego, was horrible in terms of service.  The manager there, Guillerm, was a complete jerk and really soured our experience at Paradisus.  Not likely to come back here again.

reviews.author: Concetta A
reviews.title: Nice visit
reviews.text: This hotel was very nice and had many nice qualities. Our favorite restaurant was mole and we couldn’t get enough of the gelato bar. The rooms were kept very nice and clean and the area of the hotel is on the strip next to many restaurants and activities. We actually walked across the street to do a speed boat excursion :)

reviews.author: Seekingpace
reviews.title: Not a great experience
reviews.text: This was a check in nightmare with high humidity and heat and no air conditioning in the lobby and an intro by a woman trying to sell a frequent stay subscription to the new “circle” concept. It was such a turn off and so lacking in concern of our time and the heat that quite honestly we will not stay here again. In addition the room we booked with Delta Vacations was not given. Instead of an ocean front room with a balcony we looked over the rooftop of an on site restaurant and had to go outside to catch even a glimpse of the ocean. We did change rooms and then I had to “fix” the dribbling hot water tap by pulling on the plumbing connection and we also did without a hair dryer as it was inoperable. To sum it up I’d say this property has definitely had some issues of aging and lack of maintenance but the food is decent if somewhat lacking in fresh fish options. The lobby and interior public rooms desperately need to be air conditioned as even watching a performance inside was uncomfortable. In addition, the venue inside can’t accommodate more than 50 people at a time. I was never able to secure dining reservations at the phone number provided so I had to approach the restaurants directly.  Long needed floor renovations in the main lobby caused loudness all day long for every room since the floors are open to the lobby. Add in the fact that the beach is playing loud bass music from 11 am until 7pm and many are finding objection with it.

reviews.author: Reso R
reviews.title: It was pretty good but mean staff that might scam you so be careful because we got scammed stay away from Carlos
reviews.text:
