This resort was pretty amazing besides the first day.

We got scammed by getting advertised a section of the hotel called reserved. Carlos the manager of reserved was very rude, he was not the one who scammed us but he was lying to our face when we told him that we got scammed. We had a girl named Stephanie welcome us in and she advertised us reserved. She said reserved was a better experience with a butler and more. Turns out everyone that was in the hotel got a butler besides us.

The food was  amazing though

reviews.author: Andwick M
reviews.title: Pretty good
reviews.text: This place has very little air conditioning and Carlos the manager was terrible and yelled at my fam and changed our reservations on purpose🙄Food was good and pool was nice and Luis was the best.Carlos said we don’t get a butler when staying in the reserve even though we payed for it!

reviews.author: muditonline
reviews.title: Clean property but dissatisfied with room and restaurant availability.
reviews.text: Property has multiple outdoor pools and all are maintained well with good service staff. Rooms leave a lot to be desired and the restaurants are just unavailable. There was no communication from hotel to book in advance.

reviews.author: Ayisha D
reviews.title: Too hot In the public areas and some of the restaurants!
reviews.text:
Paradisus Review

If you are traveling in warmer months. I suggest you bring a portable fan with you. You will swelter under the immense amount of heat from the outside that carries to the inside. The lobbies, the hallways and all the public spaces with the exception of a few restaurants, have no air-conditioning.  

Imagine getting out the shower, doing your hair and walking out in the hallway and the temp is an average of 88-95 degrees at all times.  You are not looking cute for long. 

This is absolutely no exaggeration in July 2021. It was a hot topic amongst all the patrons of the hotel.  We all wondered if there was a problem with the A/C. Even the waiters brows were sweating as they served us. It was quite bothersome. Everyone was sweating!!!  

In the middle of July, you simply get no chance to have relief. The same temp is in the inside as it is the outside.
It’s a shame because what that means is, if you decide to travel in the warmer months the only time you will actually feel cool is in your room with your small travel fan (purchased from Amazon).  Don’t leave home with out it. Trust me! At least 100 people asked me where I got mine from during my 7 day stay.  

Again let me reiterate, there is no air conditioning in the lobby, the hallways, or the public areas in the hotel. Even some of the restaurants have no A/C. Every night at dinner I had my fan on the table providing the much needed relief. 

Food-par for the course. You must make reservations for dinner. Capella’s, the Italian restaurant in my opinion was the best. The buffet isn’t bad actually. 

We upgraded to the reserve rooms just because it was only $150.00 more at the time of booking.  With that you get a butler to help you navigate the amenities.  However I’m not sure if it’s totally worth it. The cabana’s were already booked by the time we arrived. With only a guarantee for 2 out of the 7 days we stayed. My daughter never got any children amenities as promised nor did we ever get a gaming console.

I wanted to really love this hotel, but the lack of A/C in the lobby, the will never bring me back here from April-November! I just can’t do it and I wouldn’t recommend it , if you enjoy getting relief from the outside. The inside is so beautiful, but you simply cannot enjoy your self though the haze and the humidity inside.

reviews.author: MsTracy1
reviews.title: Real honest Review - June 26 - July 3
reviews.text:
I’ve visited many all inclusive resorts in different places.  I have higher standards, especially when I have to spend more than normal to stay there.  Because of Covid, I did.  I read the reviews for this hotel before I picked it, and decided I would give it a try because I visited the Paradisus in Playa del Carmen and it was great!  Nobody seemed to give an honest review, but I will.  
PROS-
Check in was easy, I got there around 3pm, and my room was ready! Yay!  I was actually upgraded to a 1 br. suite, so I had lots of room to stretch, with 2 bathrooms and 2 balconies.   The bed was comfortable and the room was clean.
The hotel employees are the best, they are responsive and very accommodating.  If I needed anything, room service, towels, something fixed in the room, they were on the spot.  Everyone was mandated to wear masks, I dont think I ever saw any of them without one.
On the surface, the hotel is beautiful, the inside is lush with its greenery and ponds.  It’s like walking in an atrium.  Very appealing to the eyes.
All the restaurants and entertainment are in one building, building 3, so no walking far unless your room is located far from there.  The entertainment was nice, although there really is no assigned space for it.  It’s held in open spaces within building 3 or by one of the pools.  
Visit the spa, the hot stone massage was awesome! I got a 25 min reflexology and 25 minute hot stone massage for $100 USD.  Made a deal with the spa rep by the pool.  

CONS:
Where do I start:
When we arrived, it was raining. So hard that rain came in my sisters room thru the balcony doors, puddles and puddles.  Had to get a room change.  The next day.  I didn’t understand why, as the hotel is supposed to be 50% full right?  So they had to put towels under the door for that night.
No liquor in the rooms/minibar, didn’t matter though, it was all watered down, I didn’t get a buzz AT ALL during my 7 day stay.  
One of the things vacationers look forward to is the food.  Well, the food was awful.  Even the buffet food wasn’t good.  There are 4 dinner restaurants (besides) the buffet.  They weren’t good either. I couldn’t get reservations for them at first, so I had to sit thru a vacation club presentation with Club Melia to get a personal concierge that could get us reservations.  Seemed to me that all the restaurants served the same things but just cooked them differently.  But it didn’t matter, we didn’t enjoy our dinners.
I know this resort isn’t a newer resort, didn’t expect it to be perfect.  However, there is so much that needs to be redone/refurbished/fixed there.  There were sloppy patchy fixes all over the place.  Stains on almost all of the seating everywhere.  Oh and because of the lush main areas, I saw a few bugs running around as well.  I wouldn’t rate this place a 4 star.  One day it once was, but now, no way.  
I am a pretty easy going gal, of course I enjoyed my vacation anyway!  The weather for the most part was good, the outside activities I did were cool.  However, I would not visit this resort again.

reviews.author: Irwin L
reviews.title: Do Not Eat Here
reviews.text: Do not ever get all inclusive at this resort. The resort is nice, clean and big. That’s the only reason I’m giving them 3 stars. But the food at their restaurants suck. If you gave to stay here, just have your meals from elsewhere outside the resort. Also, they pester you with timeshare/membership sales. Hard selling, very persistent and persuasive! Wont take no for an answer.

reviews.author: Paulette
reviews.title: Birthday Vacay
reviews.text: Checked in on June 15th and given an accessible room.  I immediately went back to desk and asked for another room since (1) I didn't request this type and (2) I foresaw a problem with my teenage grandson taking a bath in shower with no door.  Potential for a flooded room and YES, that did happen 1st night.  They promised to move me on June 17th. Hotel did and I was sent to a room way on the other side from tower 3 to tower 1, dimly lit corridors and away from everything (felt like being punished).  Problem here, room was already occupied.  Together with Bellhop toted luggage back to desk and after about an hour, given another room in tower 3.  Not once did one member of staff apologize  for me being embarrassed and Carlos who spoke to me via phone stayed holed up in office behind desk while I waited for new assignment.  Otherwise Property is nice and so is beach area. Cabanas at $200 US daily..wow!! Dinner choices OK not all and free Covid test seamless and a plus. 3 stars for the room situation.

reviews.author: apulfer70
reviews.title: Let buyer beware
reviews.text: We were disappointed on the excessive rebooking fee they charged since we had to rebook from 2020 to 2021 due to Covid travel restrictions the almost 30% is a bit ridiculous and the amount was not disclosed to us until checkout

reviews.author: Rich R
reviews.title: Great staff but food not so much!
reviews.text:
The hotel is really nice and rooms are clean. Expect our room leaked at the patio doors when it rained. Had to constantly have towels by doors due to leak. 
Hotel is really nice and family friendly but a little boring. 
The food was not great at all but not horrible. We went to this resort because other reviews said it was amazing and food was stellar but maybe it’s because we went after Covid and they’re having some fissure now, don’t know? 
The staff is amazing and definitely working for your tips but I probably won’t be going back because the food quality and lack of things to do at the resort. 
Liquor at the bars is all top shelf and they’re very generous ton their pours so you’ll get  your moneys worth there.

reviews.author: angie
reviews.title: Cancun
reviews.text: Vacation. Augustine was great. He made the whole trip fun.   We had some issues early on but our travel agent got us free massages and the staff payed a lot of attention to us to make up for our issued and

reviews.author: babijol
reviews.title: Big let down
reviews.text: I was very disappointed with this hotel. To start, the check in process is a nightmare. It is extremely slow and took over an hour to check in. After a long flight the last thing I want to do is stand in line for over an hour just to check in. I checked in after 3pm and my room was not ready. Another thing I did not like is that all of the restaurants with the exception of the buffet required dinner reservations. All of the restaurants were already booked during my stay so we had no choice but to eat at the buffet every night. The reserve side is not worth the extra money in all honesty. I was not impressed with my reserve room at all. I’ve been to Mexico several times and stayed in standard rooms that were more modern than the reserve rooms. The only perked I liked from being on the reserve side was the use of the cabanas. The beach was closed the entire trip due to an influx of seaweed. This was not the hotels fault so I can’t blame them for that. You could go on the sand but not in the water. Due to this the pools were packed everyday. You cannot find a free pool chair after 9:30am. I did have a good experience with room service which was very quick whenever I called. The hotel also had a lot of great protocols in place when it came to sanitation which was good. They provided gloves in the buffet when you go to get food. Sanitizers could be found all over the property.

reviews.author: koriosullivan687
reviews.title: Senior trip
reviews.text: Great memories were made!  The resort and our rooms were very clean.  Not impressed with the reserve part of the hotel, it was not worth the money.  The views from the room are impaired by concrete walls, I don’t understand that.  I also did not like all the added cost to an all inclusive resort.

reviews.author: StashM17
reviews.title: Unfortunately will not be coming back
reviews.text:
I wanted to write this review while it was still fresh in my mind. Thus said, we left Cancun today and it’s truly a bittersweet moment. This is our 4th time in Mexico and our first time in Paradisus. From the moment we checked in to the moment we checked out we felt welcomed. The atmosphere was great. The staff are some of the most hardworking people we met. I haven’t encountered a single rude person. Everyone tried their best and went above and beyond to assist you. We arrived early and our room was not ready. We were given a different room in the mean time to simply change and get ready for the beach since we had little kids with us. We upgraded to ocean view and it was totally worth it!! The beach and pool area was very clean. The beach had seaweed which is a problem in most of Mexico but the resort tried their best to clean it every morning. My daughter loved KIDS CLUB. The staff was super friendly and very interactive with the children. There was a special area for kids pool. I have to mention... the staff by the kids pool was SO attentive and constantly brought us drinks and food. 
Now...I do have to say one negative thing about the resort and that is the FOOD. We have been to many many resorts and this is the first resort to give us an upset stomach. It’s unfortunate that we had to watch very carefully what we ate for the rest of our trip in fear we might get sick again. In this case alone, I do not see us returning back to this resort. 
Entertainment was great!! Every night they had a show. Kids loved it! 
We took a day trip to swim with the dolphins in Aquaworld and it’s definitely worth it if you have kids!! There is a little shopping center, and it was fun to walk around and be outside the resort for a change. 
We didn’t have the Reserve. But we heard  from many many families while we were there that it’s not worth it. 
The app was a hit or miss. All reservations and spa bookings were made through there. I found it very easy to navigate but the app itself did have some glitches. The staff was willing to help make reservations for us.

reviews.author: Sondi H
reviews.title: Not for us, and we won't be back - read my review for details so you can decide for yourself
reviews.text:
We stayed at this hotel from 5/11 – 5/19 and we purchased the “Reserve”.  We had a mixed experience, but I will detail everything out to you so you can make your own decision.  Bottom line for us, I would not stay here again.  
Here are some reasons you might not like this establishment:
•	If you expect management to be responsive and provide you with what you requested (type of room or special request), a fast check-in, a fast checkout?
•	If you are a foodie
•	If you like wine
•	If you don’t want to be around a bunch of drunk 20 somethings
•	If you are a family with young children
We have been to all-inclusives with butlers before and also all-adult all-inclusives.  The biggest thing we got out of our butler was dinner reservations.  We have had a much more personal experience from butlers in the past.  But, they are handling 30+ families per butler.  That’s really impossible to give anything but the basics to each one.  I blame this on the company not the butler. He was trying hard, but handcuffed by the amount of families he had to help.
I think something this resort is struggling with an identity crisis.  Do you want to be a party resort for 18 - 20 somethings, or a family resort, or a resort for couples.  You cannot do all three well.  For example, the 20 somethings partying at the main pool bar will drive off most couples and families with children.  Imagine a bunch of young women with butt implants standing up on the seats at the pool swim up bar and letting every man in the pool slap their butts. This is the environment at the main pool.  We normally love a swim up bar but this is not the kind of behavior we want to be around.  We are older and we like it fun, but not out of control.  We spent our whole vacation at the beach under a palapa.  We love it there, so it’s not torture, but options were limited based on the environment.  The resort also looks a bit old fashioned in how it is designed.  Lots of ivy hanging everywhere, pyramid type design, and zen type design around the spa area (think raked sand).  It seems cobbled together… For example, if you start out in floor 2 in the reserve and walk to the main building you are on floor 1. 
Rooms - The room situation is not being handled well at all.  The check-in process was horrible, the check-out process was horrible.  They pay no attention to things customers have requested before they arrive.  They put us in a room outside the Reserve area and tried to call it reserve. It was right over the main pool when I had requested a quiet room.  I saw so many people checking in and not getting the type of room they requested.  It seemed like this was being done on purpose.  Check-in took about 45 minutes to an hour and then longer to switch to a room in the reserve. I am very un-impressed with how they are running this facility. They are using paper forms to check you in and out. We had to go 4 places to check out and it took over 30 minutes.  We went to reserve and were sent to the main desk, then back to reserve, then into the other desk beside reserve where we finally got checked out.  Overall, there was just a lack of concern for what they putting the customer through.  We got an apology from some manager, but that is not enough to make up for the terrible experience they put us through.
Reserve experience – Here I have a mixed opinion.  If you are going to stay here, I suggest you get the reserve.  Otherwise, I fear you would have a very difficult time.  Don’t expect any kind of super personalized service.  You are not going to get that.  But, you will get your dinner reservations made and some help with other things like covid testing.  You will get a specific appointment time and it’s very quick.  If you are not in reserve you have to wait in a cattle line to get a test. You will get a shuttle appointment to go to the airport (we took a cab because they wanted us to go one hour earlier than we wanted to go). Make the shuttle appointment for the airport right when you get there so you get the time you want. Cabs are only $28 to go to the airport. 
The Reserve is actually in Building 5. There is a sign right above the entry to the building that says Reserve.  They are putting people in other buildings and calling it Reserve.  I insisted we be moved to the Reserve section and it was very quiet there (which we love).  But, there is a down-side to this. This is a bit far from the main building and the restaurants.  It is very close to the Reserve pool, beach, Reserve restaurant at the beach.  If you are in Reserve you will have a bit of a hike to the main building.  We didn’t mind it at all, but I guess you need to think about where you are going to spend most of your time. They also have a buffet/bar area in the Reserve building.  They serve a small breakfast there and they have the bar and a small buffet from 12 – 7 every day.  We utilized this Reserve bar every day and really liked going down before dinner for drinks and appetizers.  They have premium alcohol and on the food buffet they have several kinds of cured meats, cheeses, breads and just a few sweets. There were very few people using this bar/buffet.  We would see maybe 2 or 3 groups come through and they didn’t stay long.  You did get some conflicting rules here. Our butler told us 11 – 7 and I went over at 11:45 one day.  They refused to give me a drink even though the bar was all setup and ready to go. So, somewhere along the way they changed the time to eliminate an hour of service without telling the butlers. Some servers wanted you to wear a mask near the food and bar and others didn’t care.  They refused to give a young lady a peach because she only had a bikini top on.  I got her a peach, but still this shouldn’t have happened. They are just making up their own rules.  I’ve never been told “NO” so much at any all- inclusive where we have stayed.  
Reserve Restaurant and Beach/Pool – The Reserve restaurant is outside by the beach.  It’s very nice, but a limited menu. They have eggs benedict for breakfast and I enjoyed that.  Most mornings we ate at the main buffet but we did eat here, more for lunch than breakfast.  They also have a menu they serve on the beach but it’s more limited than the Reserve menu.  They had nice fish and chips, but it was a bit greasy.  I still had it a few times.  You can get a salad and one day I just asked for grilled shrimp.  Yes, there is one restaurant that can cook grilled shrimp perfectly.  I had the carbonara pasta one day and it was not that great.  The sauce was more like an alfredo but not even that good. The camembert cheese was a little odd to me, but others loved it.  Hamburger was just okay.  The service is very good and they bring you drinks from the Reserve bar (outside one by the beach) so you get good drinks.  It is a bit windy because it’s right by the beach.  But, it’s also okay to come up to eat in your bathing suit and bare feet.  The service at the beach is very good as well.  We tipped every day and I think that gets around but they were being good with everyone, not just us.  They bring you buckets of water which you will need.  They bring you drinks and if you are there regularly they will learn your drink and bring it automatically.  I have only compliments for the service we received from the staff at the restaurant and beach.  They also have a Reserve pool, but there is no where to get out of the sun unless you want to reserve a palapa.  You have to pay for this, and I wasn’t willing to do that.  It’s really a bed with a canopy on it.  I don’t want to lay down, I want to sit up and see.  Many people were sitting cross-legged, but if you have kids and want to be at the pool you will need one of these.  If you are people without kids and you want to be by the pool, you will need one of these if you want any shade at all. But, these were booked every day.  I think it was $40 or $50/day, but we never reserved one so I’m not 100% on that. The pool is very nice and big.  Service is very good there as well. 
They are not cleaning rooms unless you call every day or demand it be done.  I finally got it in our record somewhere that they were to clean our room every day.  They are using Covid as the excuse, but it’s just them trying to save money by not cleaning rooms.  
The only liquor in the room is some beer and hard seltzer.  No wine, no prosecco, no liquor.  I asked for wine and prosecco in the room.  It took 2 days but I finally got a bottle of each. They were so bad I had to tell them I did not want it any more.  All the house wine is bad.  The prosecco in the clear bottle was okay, but not the one in the black bottle.  They are trying to up-sell you all the time on the wine, but here's my take on this.  If you cannot pick a decent house wine, then I’m not trusting that if I buy your wine offering it will be any better.  I’ve never been to an all-inclusive that had such bad wine.  Boxed wine is MUCH better.  There is a Costco and we heard from another couple that they went there and bought wine to bring to the hotel.  I really don’t think I should have to do that, but if wine’s important to you (it is to me), and you really want to stay here… go to Costco.  
Drinks - When we first arrived, they were watering down drinks in the club.  I asked them for a shot of the Grey Goose I was supposedly getting in my Martini, and it was at least 50% water.  I could never drink a whole shot of Vodka and I was able to just drink the whole thing.  I told them I was going to report them to the Mexican Tourisim board and any other regulatory bodies I could find. The next time we went back the drinks were not watered down, but believe me it’s not Grey Goose.  The drinks at the Reserve Bar and the Reserve beach were good.  All the frozen type drinks are super sweet and they don’t really taste like they have alcohol in them.  The service in the Reserve area is much better than elsewhere.  
The show all these different restaurants on the web page for the hotel and there are basically four where you can get reservations.  Vento (Italian), Bana (Japanese), Mole (Mexican), and Enzo (International).  And, they all have small menus.  I saw a menu on trip advisor for some of these.  They are offering maybe a third of the items. The restaurants were just okay… nothing to write home about.  This is why I say if you are a foodie you will be disappointed in this resort. You are just not going to get anything that is really exceptional.
Buffet – We only ate here for breakfast, but we ate here most days.  The service is exceptional and you will be doted on from the minute you arrive to the minute you leave.  Try the iced coffee with cream it’s so delicious.  They will bring you anything you ask for that they can get.  Some of the hardest working people in the resort. I only have compliments for the staff and the food.  But, you cannot get eggs benedict here. 
Vento (Italian) - We ate at there the first night we were there.  The sauces were so bad.  There wasn’t any depth of flavor to any of it and they were drowning the food in the sauce.  I sent back the shrimp pasta because the sauce was bad and the shrimp were completely overcooked (this is a theme you will experience over and over).  I ordered the fish after and it was cooked very well.  It was again drowning in a bland green sauce, but at least I could eat the fish.  My husband had the shells and meatballs and he liked that one.  I was not a fan, but at least one of us had a meal we liked.  The arancini appetizer was just a bit odd to me.  It was a huge ball and it was described as Osso Bucco which I love.  But, it just came off as super heavy and nothing like arancini I’ve had before.  It has a brown gravy in the bottom… just odd.  Also I saw menus on trip advisor and they are really pared down.  It was not even half the items the picture showed.  The best thing they brought us was the bread, cheese, and meat at the beginning of the meal. 
Mole (Mexican) – We ate here a few times.  The pork leg is really good but you need to have them cut it off the bone for you.  It’s very hard to cut off yourself without making a mess.  They tried to tell us they wouldn’t cut it off the bone because of Covid, but I insisted and they got it done.  They try to use Covid as an excuse for anything they don’t want to do.  Tortillas were really good.  Nachos and guacamole were good.  I got the shrimp dish one night and the shrimp were as tough as the rubber on a tire.  It wasn’t even busy.  We eat very early and there may have been 2 other tables in the restaurant.  
Bana (Japanese) – This was a really good meal, but we were only able to get in once.  Have the fried rice, it’s amazing.  We had the beef but someone else said the chicken was exceptional too.  They fully season the rice and it’s just delicious.  We only ordered cooked sushi, and it was all really good.  Not too authentic, but good.  For example, one of our kinds of sushi had slices of cheese on top.  It was still good, but I know that any good sushi restaurant would probably freak out if they saw it.  We liked it, but I heard someone else say they hated it.  If you are looking for really authentic Japanese food you will probably be disappointed. I was really irritated on only being able to get in once.  None of these restaurants is busy early when we want to eat.  They really limit the number of reservations too much.   
Enzo (International) – This one is a mixed bag too.  We ate here for dinner and it was just okay.  Hit and miss on the dishes.  And, I got sick after eating here.  The wife of another couple we sat by on the beach got sick as well after eating there for dinner.  At lunch they turn in to a seafood shack.  No reservations are required.  The coconut shrimp was my favorite thing.  Not too sweet and they have a chipotle sauce to go with them that’s amazing.  I had the whole fried fish and it was super greasy and didn’t have very much meat.  I would not recommend it.  We got the salmon appetizer and it was a salmon salad that was very fishy.  We sent it back but he brought us some shrimp tacos that were delicious.  There is also beach food shack by the main pool right next to Enzo where you can get food.  There are shrimp tacos, hamburgers… smelled good but we never ate there. 
Sal (Very expensive paid steak house) – We ate here our last night and ended up walking out.  Filets were so tough we were having to saw on them. Our mashed potatoes had big chunks of un-mashed potatoes.  I agreed to pay for the crab legs and shrimp appetizer and it was $119 just for those 2 things.  The manager never should have even let me agree to this based on the experience we had.  Again, another example of bad management. This is a huge waste of money and you can do much better at a steak restaurant back home.  If you want to see more, I’ll leave a detailed review directly for this restaurant in trip advisor.  Just give it a pass. 

I'll add pictures later.

reviews.author: Elayna Myers
reviews.title: Beautiful property, reserve overhyped
reviews.text:
We traveled last week to this property after reading so many reviews and comparing endlessly to other resorts. We had 4 rooms in total, all in the Reserve area.

Upon arrival, we were shown to the "Reserve Check-in" area. There was a couple of larger groups. Someone was walking in to offer drinks. I had done the online check in and paid before arriving, yet when she went to check me in she said that I needed to pay. After a quite note, this was corrected. We arrived at 12:30pm, and our room was available which was fantastic, we we were ready to hit the pool. Our other friends were told to wait for their butler and they would be escorted upstairs. We were told ours was not yet available, but to download the WhatsApp and she would text us. Our friends butler, Adrian, escorted us and gave us some information as we walked to our room.

We were in room 5409 and had a partial view of the lagoon. Mostly we were looking at another building, but we didn't mind, we we did not plan to utilize the balcony. The room was clean, and the shower was really neat. The floors felt unclean, though. We were at the very end, opposite of the elevator, so noise was never an issue.

We were not able to find our butler at all our first day. I had to reach out multiple times. I was consistently told it had "been reported" to the reserve. Adrian let our other friends know that we needed reservations for bali beds and dinner.  There were no beds available until our last day, and dinner was 10pm or later. We were totally bummed. We took what we could and hit up the pool.

The second day, we were able to get a bali bed (and each day after) by getting some help from Victor and their team! There are daily cancelations, so just go check and see if there is anything. They were fantastic. We stayed over at the balid beds at the swim up bar area. The reserve, adults only wasnt our speed. It was much more quiet, and that was not what we wanted. Pedro and Luis at the swim up were our favorite bartenders our entire trip. They made sure to remember our names and our drinks.

We finally found our butler after my husband walked up to her, after seeing her name tag - Stef. She let us know she had made us reservations and would switch them from 2 people to 7, no problem. However, that was a huge problem. We had an issue EVERY NIGHT. Either no reservation, wrong time or wrong name. It became a hassle even going to dinner. She was totally MIA. When seeing Adrian, we definitely expected some type of the same service. 

Outside of the bali bed location, the reserve did nothing for us. I felt it was a total waste of money. 

The property itself is stunning. The beach had a lot of seaweed, but we knew to expect that, so it didnt bother us. We stayed at the pool, mostly. The service, outside of our "butler" was fantastic. The food was also amazing. A perk of the bali beds is that a server comes to bring your food. Ours was Jesus and he was a joy! 

Our COVID test took over a hour to get. Get a morning apt if possible!!! Our friends went at 915am and were out by 930. Ours was at 130 and we did not get back to the pool until 215pm.

Overall - the experience was ok. I likely would not stay here again, and if I did it would not be the reserve. The level of service we got from bartenders and the restaurant staff is what made our week good!

Try the baja tacos - they were our absolute favorite. We enjoyed Bana, Enso, the buffet and Mole for dinners. The buffet tacos were out of this world!

reviews.author: Samuel A
reviews.title: Skip the reserve “experience”
reviews.text:
First off, very nice resort and well maintained for its age. However, I feel the reserve experience is hyped up. Sure, the rooms are nicer, but the service wasn’t anything to brag about. 

I traveled with my family and we totaled seven. We had two rooms. I called the hotel from the US the day before after paying for my rooms I reserved a couple Months in advance. I even put on the additional notes my flight information because the reserve provides included transpiration to and from the airport. I called the resort the day before I left to make sure my flight information was given to someone to forward to the transport company. Well, it was not. Otium travel didn’t have myself or my family on their list and would not take us, even though I showed printed invoices of my rooms!  I had five swearing kids laying around on a Cancun airport floor trying to find shade with 100 eager taxi operators annoying us and wanting $150 to take us to the resort. After a good 20 minutes on the phone, I convinced the resort to handle this, which they did. Their initial reply was I had to pay the money and they would “see what they could do”.  This did not start the trip off well at all. 

However, the resort was very well cared for and I was impressed with the food. I didn’t have hot water for 2 nights around 6:30pm. Assuming because everyone was getting ready for dinner or going out. That wasn’t pleasant. 

Our butler left all the beer in our kids fridges even after we told him to get it out and replace with juices, chocolate milks and sodas. 

I just wouldn’t spend the money on reserve again. The resort I’d stay at though, but save some money and frustration. Check in took at least an hour because there were only two people working in the reserve check in lounge.

reviews.author: Andrew Angliss
reviews.title: RESERVE Complaint
reviews.text:
Who do I speak to to complain? I just checked out today I dont even want to deal with the people. I paid an extra $400 for reserve and i did not get any priority reservations! What am i paying for if everyone else can book the same restaurant reservations?? Butler service couldnt help, VIP check in took 40 minutes?? Only one person to check you in?? How does check in take so long?? And i couldnt even get my room a little bit earlier?? The hotel was empty on the day I checked in. 
Suites with luxury services??? There was no door to bathroom? Looked worse than the regular rooms. Had to even have someone fix the motor on the safe because it broke in the middle of my stay. It was my wife and I 9 year anniversary and I thought reserve would make it special. It did not!

I expect some sort of refund? I did not get what was expected for paying the extra $400. 

Andrew Angliss room 5703 may 12-16 

I already emailed havent gotten response yet

reviews.author: Kimberly D
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun May 2021
reviews.text:
I visited this property May 11-15 with my adult daughter and husband for some rest and relaxation and to mourn the passing of my mother and father-in-law who both passed from Covid in February.  This is a beautiful property and in all fairness, if there was an above-average rating, say 3.5, I would give it to them.  I hope this review will help others make a decision and I will try to break it down into categories.

Check-in-Junior Oceansuite Reserve Section
This was not a smooth process, but not too bad.  The room was not ready when we arrived.  Our luggage was taken and we were shown where we could eat and that our butler would contact us when the room was ready.  We were never contacted and we returned to the check-in desk and after a few minutes, we were told the room was ready and that our butler would contact us.  We were never shown around the hotel so it took us a day or so to navigate and figure out what we were doing and when.  I am extremely disappointed about this because the extra money was paid for this reason.  Our butler showed up to room 3307 around 8 pm.  You will be told to use Whatsapp to access all activities but it doesn't work until you are given a code which the butler has to give you.  We didn't have any dinner reservations the first night for this reason and were stuck eating room service.   The room was lovely with the rain shower in the bathroom, two queen beds and spectacular view from the balcony..  We requested a rollaway bed for our daughter, and they did one better and brought her a comfy twin bed.  I have a slipped disc in my back and the chairs on the balcony did not adjust to sit up so we requested different chairs.  More on this later.

Food
The second night, our butler, Diego, made reservations at Sal.  This is the only restaurant that was not included in the pricing and is a steakhouse.  Our food was $240 USD.  The service was fantastic, but the food was just average and I've had better food.  The grilled veggies were delicious, but the rice was similar to oatmeal..  We ordered two steaks and my daughter and I shared and my husband ordered a bone in ribeye.  Huge steaks, see pic.

La Palalpa
This is an outdoor restaurant with a limited menu but very good.  We ate there every day for lunch.  Honorable mention goes to Yamil and we tipped him accordingly for making us feel special.  The camabert cheese and fish tacos are to die for.   The fish finngers and fries are also very good.  The employee work hard.  Unlike any all inclusive we've visited in the Caribbean where tips are forbidden, tipping was done all over this result.  We took $400 just for tipping for four days and we wanted to spend it all, but did not.  The waiters at La Palapa got a good bit of it just for going above and beyond with a smile.

Malva
This is the buffet restaurant and we ate there each day for breakfast.  Huge spread of food.  Fresh omelets are delicious as well as fresh fruit, fresh fruit smoothies, french toast, etc.

Bana
This is a Japanese restaurant and was our favorite.  The service was great and the food is good.  The potsticker appetizers are so good, but you only get two so order 6 of them right off the top so you don't have to wait.  We made up dishes that were not on the menu and they came through.

Unfortunately, we didn't eat at Mole because we were told it was closed only to find out later they were open.  : -  <

Things to know: If you are in the reserve section, the Bali beds with the palapas are included in the price.  There are only 5.  We managed to get with the pool concierge and snag one for an entire day.  There are also Bali beds at the adult pool that need to be reserved.  I never found out how to reserve and our butler was unsuccessful at this.  Each time I tried to snag one, they were all reserved.  I was told to come back at 11 am and if there were no shows, we could have one.  This worked out each day, but it would have been nice to get help with the process of reserving.  Apparently, other people figured it out as those purple towels were out there indicating already reserved.

We were in building 3 and never heard any noise as mentioned in other reviews.  The rooms showed dating, but acceptable and comfortable with the exception of the air conditioning being a hit or miss.  We enjoyed our stay and this resort would have received 5 stars if I did not pay the extra money for the reserve section.  We just didn't get what we expected; however, we loved our butler and he brought a topical cream to ease some pain in my knee that was so appreciated.  He definitely has the personality, but maybe needs more experience or he was stretched too thin.

I've worked in customer service for years that includes hotel experience.  My tip is just make everyone feel important.  I felt other families were more important than us and was told daily that he was very busy with other families.  Big no no in my book.  I never received the adjustable chairs so I was unable to enjoy the large balcony over the ocean.  If this hotel smooths out their processes, I would return.

I hope this was helpful in making a decision.

reviews.author: Denise Reis
reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.text: The service on the entrance is SUPER SLOW. It can get you up to a hour to be attended. Frustrating and stressful! If you ask for a taxi at the entrance, they will tell you one price and charge you a higher amount. Take care if you think you can trust on what they tell you !

reviews.author: Troy S
reviews.title: Beautiful resort but not with the extra for the reserve
reviews.text: We had a good time and loved the resort but we upgraded and paid the extra for reserve and never even got a butler! We got ZERO help with reservations or anything! We didn’t even get shown around the property and spent the first 2 days lost. I wish I had saved the money as the people we traveled with had better service without the reserve. I also mentioned this to several people and even called the desk to get help scheduling our covid tests but it fell on deaf ears! Nobody reached out to help us out! We did have great service from Juan Carlos and Abel who are in marketing but god bless them they helped us get a couple of reservations! And Enrique gave us fantastic service pool side! I am just disappointed I wasted the money on reserve!

reviews.author: aliscan0
reviews.title: Mix feelings about this property!
reviews.text: The property is magnificent and by all means far better than most of the all inclusive in the Cancun hotel zone. It's just my experience on the check in (supposedly VIP/THE RESERVE), lack of attentiveness, personalization on that area only and the problem that we had on the bathroom- it's flooding and they are not doing anything about it...

reviews.author: Warima M
reviews.title: Not the same
reviews.text:
We just came back from Paradisus a week ago and that was our 3rd time.  My first time review was 5 stars review back in 2020 (actual visit was Dec, 2019)

We were thinking that this might be our go to place when we wanted to get away. 

However this trip was disappointed, they have changed and removed Royal service to The Reserve. Tower 5 is no longer for adults only. Even though you booked The Reserve, they can put you in a room in a families area. That was we ended up, we booked " The Reserve deluxe ocean view" it was supposed to be in Tower 5 ( the newer one) but the resort offered us an upgrade to " One bedroom deluxe lagoon view" we said " No, we want to remain with what we booked but somehow the miss-communication with the lady when we check-in, so we ended up at Tower 4 which the room is really old , outdated. Need some remodel badly. Refrigerator wasn't even cold. That was the first thing we were unhappy.

The nightlife is changed, La Palapa bar ( Adults access only)  close at 7pm. Kana bar by the beach closes at 7pm.. No alcohol delivery to your room either. 

This resort has been changed their view and focus on being families resort more than Adults only. We loved the way it was that if you want adults only then you have your area which the whole tower 5, included breakfast , snack bar  area and pool.
Now 95% of the resort is for families,  If you want Adults only resort, you might want to look somewhere else.

The service from pool area still remain great. Thanks for Max and Lucas at poolside service. These guys work hard , very attentive and try to make things happed for you whatever/ where ever balibed you want. 

We are hoping that somehow the resort is considering and have service for Adults only more than what it is now. At least bring back the services just like when it was " The Royal service" 

We felt comfortable here and hate to start looking for a go to place elsewhere.

reviews.author: sanelaporobic
reviews.title: Not great not bad
reviews.text: Our stay was a average. At the arrival I was expecting a warm welcome with refreshments and warm towels glass of Champaign or water.... received completely the opposite. No warm welcome no refreshments. Restaurants are a huge down fall. Steak House you have to pay for you entire meal out of your pocket (avg of 4 people $300 +). Italian was a huge negative, nothing Italian about that restaurant/ basically they serve you the pizza and pasta out of the buffet area, and you sit in the buffet area while you are supposed to be in a Italian restaurant. After those two tries we decided to eat at the Buffet which was ok nothing great about it same food every day lack in variety of options. I know they have an Asian and Japanese restaurant but no hibachi grill.  Rooms are ok clean but definitely need upgrades starting to look very old. Resort by its self is very huge and beautiful. Staff was ok not so much friendly as I expected.

reviews.author: Pravin H
reviews.title: Great Staff but Reserve experience could be better
reviews.text:
We were a family of 3 that visited Paradisus Cancun right at the end of Spring break. 

Pros:

Safety - Hotel maintained very good COVID safety protocols from santiization to ensuring food near buffets are served by staff, sanitizers everywhere, temperature check at restaurants & other places
Staff - I specifically want to call out Antony, Giovani & Augustus at Toji bar for hosting a private cocktail class for me! such friendly & honest guys, loved it. Antalya. Ignacio & Pascual made sure we got everything we need & felt comfortable during our daily breakfast at Malva restaurant. Rafael, Antonio & Jorge the chef at Bana made our dinner one of the best dinners, they really went out of their way to make it special. Sandra & Sarah at reserve check in did their best although they were busy
Restaurants - Plenty of food options, restaurants are all part of all inclusive plan, variety of food & themes & views. Bana was our favorite because of its ambiance & service!
Views - Our room had a great view of the blue ocean & we used the day beds to stare at the awesome Blue ocean couple of days

Area of Improvment:

- Check in - we were welcomed in & then the person takes us all the way to reserve section & leaves us there. We then asked someone where to check in & he says we need to go back to the main building & there is seperate reserve check in desk. We go back only to realize that teh place is very busy. We complete lunch & come back and had a key card ready & then we had to go back to the check in desk again to get our bracelets programmed.
Reserve - i wish i knew what was included in the reserve package. Nowhere in the property i felt exclusive so i didnt see the value add of reserve package. I was not given a brochure or any details on what reservce includes. We were under the impression that we would have a seperate pool section but realized it was only for adults, so with the la palapa restaurant & wondering if we have a kid is Reserve valuable?
Activities - Was dissapointed that kids section (Under 5 ) was closed because of COVID protocols, wish we were informed before
Food options - As a vegetarian we didnt have a lot of options as much as i would have loved.

reviews.author: Alban F
reviews.title: Not so bad
reviews.text:
I was not disappointed but I was not impressed. For the price, the standard of the room was average, clean and comfortable but need renovation (at leat for the paid price). The food is good but not amazing. It is true there is a lot of variety and it is of quality, but not gourmet at all as I can see in other reviews.
The very plus is the staff, very service focused, especially in restaurant and customer service. Except the staff at the beach, very sales agressive (selling you scuba diving or motor bike) and even not polite.

reviews.author: P20210320
reviews.title: Not a 5 ⭐️ experience
reviews.text: If this was a 4 star hotel then it would be decent experience, the property is very run down. Their best room is far below the standard. Duck taped walls, scratches everywhere, noisy hallway... Very positive experience was with all the staff around the hotel. Great people service - friendly, attentive, fast. Only issue is the building itself which is outdated.

reviews.author: Judith31555
reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.text:
Here we go again with one of these hotels who have removed all room daily housekeeping coffee maker, hair drier from rooms . Just left a 5* hotel20 miles south on Riviera Maya who can’t do enough to make their guests feel welcome , all services plus room make up and towel change at least every day, and this place who are using the excuse of COVID to save themselves effort and money. Feels very “Motel6”....
Have to say service is excellent. Nothing changed since we were here 3yrs ago. Other than the eye rolling by the waiter when told his Chardonnay was somewhat lacking , ( an understatement )Things are going well ! The 4 kids , as usual are enjoying everything. No decaf at coffee shop this morning ( not the waiter fault). Wel see what  last 2 days bring .

reviews.author: Emma
reviews.title: Honest review READ ! Roldolfo as an amazing butler/host. He made the experience more pleasant at the resort .
reviews.text:
Rodolfo is the only reason I would ever go back to the hotel. He was amazing . For the price the resort was good . Food was decent . The lamb chops at fuego very good. Tacos at the taco bar were good . The resort was renovated but it is an older property.  Roldolfo went above and behind texted us multiple times a day to make sure we had everything we needed done . We used the “reserve”‘part of  the hotel which gives you premium access to all with your personal butler. Roldolfo, the shows (entertainment )  and the beach were the best things at the resort. The beach is obviously nice and clean since it’s in hotel zone . The beach was warmer the the pools. The pools are very very cold . I did read this before I went and I decided to see for myself , and YES they are very  cold . If you have kids this is unpleasant , and an adult won’t want to swim in it. The service at the hotel was not typical “Cancun “ service . No one goes above and beyond and if you are dissatisfied they ultimately won’t care . The waiters are extremely slow and the food takes forever to come out even if you are the only table at the place . We booked through Meliá . They promised us a certain room type which was not what we were given , we couldn’t even upgrade
 ( and pay) because they had no rooms . They booked us in a room that had a see through shower , and a thin white curtain. Having teenage boys this was hard for me to take a shower , they had to leave the room for me to do so . House keeping always left sand on the floors which constantly stuck to our feet and eventually came home with us in our suitcases. The “suites” at the reserve that are for family’s , used to be couples only. Which is why they are more romantic. ( see through shower in middle or room).  They refused to change the room because they had no rooms , yet the hotel was at 30 percent capacity. Our  flight was  cancelled due to a winter storm so we booked another at it as the latest flight in Cancun . This time we booked and demanded the correct suite , needless to say we were given the Correct one this time we actually booked the first time . 80 dollars a night (which is fine ). Most the dining needs reservations which is where rodolfo came in and did that for us ! It was a big help!  The pools are not only cold but too deep for kids , you won’t be able to enjoy the sun since your constantly looking and watching the kids , with the cold and deep water . There is a kids area but it’s segregated from the hotel ,and a Boring area. No one wants to be there. The dj was great at the main pool and the belly dancing shows and Mexican shows were great ! They had an amazing band all the time. (Other resorts have zero entertainment ) . 

Would I stay there again? Maybe in July when the pool is natural warm since they have no heaters . Other then that no. They were oftenly “out “ of guacamole which I find hard for believe . The waiters are very  lazy and barley give you what you want , they leave and never return to the table. You will die waiting for a refill. Dinner would take  4 hours sometime due to the snow service . Last but not least the airport transfers with “otium” that are free or cme  with the  reservation are ok, but with the changes we had they were so cold to us at the otium desk and threatened not to take us back to the airport because of the flight change . In fact the man at the desk was so so rude and blamed the “resort” for him not making changes to the new pick up time and date due To the snow storms !! 

Hotel is located in a nice area, beach is good , entertainment is good and Rodolfo is great . He should be offered a manager position . He did everything he can do fix the weird
 problems we had .  Hotel was ok with being  clean lots of nice places to take photos . Other then that , find somwhere else to stay.

reviews.author: Jenny Eberle
reviews.title: Just meh.
reviews.text:
Our travel agent booked us a week long trip in The Reserve Junior Suite, Ocean View. 

Our experience here wasn't awful, but we weren't overly impressed for the money we spent on our trip. 

For the pros: 
•Hotel did a wonderful job with sanitation due to Covid regulations. There were hand sanitizer stations everywhere and mats to clean your shoes. Also, they always used tongs to place your wrapped silverware on the table and no one was allowed to touch the buffet to serve the food except for the staff. Each room also had a sealed packet with gloves, face masks, and sanitizer. 

•Staff is extremely friendly. 99% of them will greet you or stop to talk with you. They would do anything for you if you asked them to, which was awesome! And they were sincere about it! Excellent service!!

•The resort itself is very pretty. We loved all the plants throughout the buildings, along with the decorations. Also, the reserve pyramid is very quiet, which we loved. No loud music or screaming kids. 

•The grounds were very pretty and well kept. The beach is beautiful and clean. 

Cons:
•As soon as we stepped into our room after checking in, Fernanda was immediately calling us on the room phone to set up a meeting with her. She led us to think it would be her showing us the resort, when in reality, she tricked us into a 3 hour timeshare meeting. Because of this, we don't even want to return to this resort. That was 3 hours we could have been on the beach relaxing! So rude to trick your paying guests into these meetings!! 

•The smell! If you have a high sensitivity to smell, I do not recommend this resort. They have boxes all over the buildings blowing out horrible scents. I don't know if they were air fresheners or oils or what, but they gave me migraines the first half of the week until I got used to them. 

•We weren't impressed with any of the food and we ate at every restaurant, including Sal's. It didn't taste awful, there just wasn't anything special about any of it. 

•One of the things that irritated us the most was all the construction around us. We get that you have to fix things in the hotel and that's fine, but don't start early in the morning! We were trying to sleep in one morning and they were in the room next to us hammering and drilling and painting and it was SO LOUD. We wanted to relax and instead had to be woken up by power tools.

•The last thing that bothered us was that this was a honeymoon and it didn't seem like it. Other resorts go all out to make a special occasion special and all Paradisus did was send a plate of chocolate covered strawberries and truffles to our room. 

Now that I'm finished being negative, I do have to compliment our concierge, Aaron. He was always so friendly and just a text away if we had any questions or needed anything. I love Mountain Dew, which the resort doesn't serve, and he offered to stop at Walmart before he came into work to find some for me. Aaron was seriously so nice...he seemed like our friend, rather than concierge! Thank you Aaron! 

Overall, the trip was just okay. Not my favorite place that I have ever been to, so I don't know that I would come back. If I did, it would be because of how nice the staff is.

reviews.author: sabrina12092021
reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: I had a great time here. The rooms were really nice. I feel like their should be more activities to do at night. The drinks are very water down. The food was just okay. The best restaurant was Enzo and that was only opened one night. Breakfast was great and that’s about it. I am not sure if Reserve was worth it because the butler wasn’t that helpful. The nightlife could be better. The bars and clubs should close later and the room service should include alcoholic drinks. This property is too big to not have golf carts. Especially when it rains and you have to go to your dinner reservations. The hotel should have golf carts for the butlers and staff to take guests to their rooms or to restaurants. It’s a very beautiful resort.

reviews.author: Wanderer04278322889
reviews.title: Mixed experience
reviews.text: Our room had black mold when we checked in, but they did allow us to change rooms after we mentioned this to the front desk. We were here celebrating our 5 year anniversary and they did nothing to make this special/memorable even though we made a note in the reservation prior to arriving. They advertise how there are multiple bars in the resort, but due to covid/construction, in the evening there is only one bar open until 11pm. After 11pm there is no alcohol service. Room service food IS NOT worth it, otherwise the different restaurants were all very good. The concierge is very pushy with the sales pitch in the beginning and will continue to ask you to sign up for an information session throughout your stay every time they see you which is annoying. The activities they had were fun but I wish there was a wider variety instead of repeating the same thing every day.

reviews.author: Ella
reviews.title: Honest Review
reviews.text:
This is a straight up honest review of what I think of this place. And I’m going to make this short and sweet. 

Service and hospitality: 8/10 
The desk area when you check in is brutal, takes way too long to check in or if you have to change your room keys or something. Mar in the front is super sweet she’s amazing. Loved her. But check in It’s honestly really annoying. The servers and waiters are AMAZING!!! 

Rooms: 9/10
we were upgraded to the luxury ocean room view and it was nice, very clean and well kept. The beds are so so regarding comfort. But not so bad. There’s a safe box, washrooms are nice and spacious and clean. 

Beach and pool: 10/10
spectacular!!! The beach is amazing, very well kept. People are always cleaning the beach and pools so it’s nice. No seaweed in the water. Water is clear and beautiful. 

Food: 2/10 
I hate to say it but the food garbage. It honestly ruins the whole experience.

reviews.author: Cole
reviews.title: Mehhhh - Wouldn’t recommend or go back
reviews.text:
Resort overall is beautiful with amazing ocean views and clean beaches. We stayed at the grand reserve ocean view, the best part of the room being the ocean view & huge porcelain bathtub. The beds were VERY VERY uncomfortable and we got bit by some kind of bugs. The room’s mini bar was not automatically stocked daily and we had to call. Room service food was gross & barely edible. 

The overall resort food was mediocre at best, the highlight being the breakfast buffets. The dinners were not very good at all. Bana did however have good sushi. The house alcohol was watered down, the wines were not good, I recommend sticking to beer as your safest bet.

Rodolfo our butler was amazing & provided us with above & beyond service!!! Service on the beach under the Palapa’s was fantastic as well! 

The YHI spa was also great! I recommend Gemma, as she gave the most relaxing message! Take into consideration that no place on the property has a hot tub, not even the spa which is supposed to.... The water is Luke warm at best. 

Overall for the price of this all inclusive I would recommend just staying at a regular resort and venturing out to other restaurants to eat. We ate at Crabhouse and Fred’s seafood both were fantastic and across the street. We stayed at a Meliá in Dominican Republic and felt that the rooms were cleaner and comfier and that the food there overall was MUCH better than the Paradisus. This was a bit of a let down for us. Would not go back.

reviews.author: Rachel
reviews.title: 10 year wedding anniversary
reviews.text:
We booked the Reserve as we were there without the kiddos to celebrate our 10 year wedding anniversary. We didn't ask much of our concierge other than to make dinner reservations and help us with gym times...and he didn't do anything more than that. We were a little surprised he didn't make a notation with any of our reservations about our anniversary to the staff to at least have them say something upon check in. Shout out to the staff at Enso, when we told them they brought us a bottle of bubbly to the table. Vento was our least favorite, appetizers were good but the main dishes were subpar. They put us in Malva seating with very bright lights, we asked if we could wait for a table in the more intimate main area and it seemed like we personally offended our waiter. I wasn't impressed and would recommend just about any other restaurant for dinner. Best lunch award went to Fuego (market grill on their website...I'll get to that). Overall, other than our Vento experience we really enjoyed the food.
The Excellent: Daniel the manager(?) for the Reserve area. La Palapa was closed 2 out of 4 days for hurricane repair. He was gracious, kind, checked in on us multiple times throughout the day and definitely runs a tight ship. Aaron at the Reserve pool was just as wonderful. He made sure we had the same Bali bed daily, stored floats for us. These two individuals alone made our stay. The room was great, being in a more quiet area was perfect for us.
The Good: We probably should have been more forceful in our request for top shelf. We took the opportunity to try things new or different. There is NO drink menu to speak of. I asked if there were specialty drinks at each location. Passion fruit margarita and tamarind margarita stood out as some of our favorites. No timeshare pressure at all, was prepared for a polite no but never needed it.
The Covid: Gym is limited to about 4 or 5 people, I'm a workout nut,  I don't miss a day the gym closed early in my opinion and it was difficult to get a good workout time. I booked Reserve to have spa access for the hydrotherapy area...no hydrotherapy due to covid restrictions (understandable). Maybe our concierge would have left us a dessert in our room if not for covid restrictions...
The Bad: The app is horrible. It is awful. DO NOT expect it to work correctly. It had wrong times for restaurants (closed when open, open for al a cart when not open at all), wrong menus (2 lunch menus at 1 location), not clear how to get food descriptions (tap on the item you will get a description, it doesn't look clickable). The most frustrating thing about the app was actually our room service. I ordered coffee to have while getting ready, 1st day it showed accepted, coffee was late, I called they said their was an issue, they brought it immediately, day 2 worked fine. Day 3 they claimed they never received the order. Just call, save yourself the frustration. I wouldn't trust it to  make my dinner reservations if you are not reserve. La Palapa was closed for repairs for 2 days. They set up a little breakfast and lunch area in tower 5 but it wasn't made to order and wasn't near the quality of what we did have at la Palapa. I would have opened another space for al a cart for Reserve guests personally. The really bad though was when our concierge said he set up our bellman service on our last day. We waited as late as we could to still make our shuttle and no bellman arrived. A guest services rep came to ask about our stay as we were walking out the door with our luggage in hand. She seemed apologetic is the most I could say about that experience she carried one bag, while my husband and I carried the rest. We were livid, it was our last impression and I don't think we will try a Melia brand again.
#rayraythegatherer

reviews.author: Jenessa Rodriguez
reviews.title: Ok
reviews.text: Check in was very slow, and unorganized. No clear direction on facility, restaurants, and available services. I don’t think the team was attentive, pool closed early, jacuzzi was cold. Restaurant was ok but food was poor quality.

reviews.author: steveg12xTurqoise
reviews.title: Parisus Cancun - Reserve, Nov 2020
reviews.text:
nice property,  The Reserve was very good as was the Butler service
could not get king size bed despite advance request
was not given credit for 2 nights my girlfriend left early due to work despite reservations saying it would be handled at Reception/check out

reviews.author: KIM
reviews.title: Okay but not great
reviews.text: This resort is beautiful hands down. That's pretty much where it ends. The food is average at best. Breakfast is the same everyday. You will wait 15 minutes after getting your food for condiments to arrive to your table. By then your food is cold. The mixes they have for drinks are way to sweet and they have no natural fruit to make daiquiris with. It's all nasty concentrated overly sweet juice. There are no straws at the resort. We went to the Mole restaurant and there was no one in there but were told we needed to have made a reservation 3 hours prior. Meanwhile the staff was standing around talking to each other. Enso is absolutely horrible food and staff. I find the people with good reviews have paid extra to stay in the Reserve but you shouldn't have to upgrade and pay more when you arrive to have decent service and food. Also, the music by the pool is terrible except for when the dj plays only a couple times a week. If he's not there it's the same boring beat day in and day out. I wanted to love this resort. It was on my bucket list. It missed the mark.

reviews.author: Guestess
reviews.title: Beautiful but Major Problems.
reviews.text:
We stayed in the Royal Service area, and my friend and I each had our own rooms. When my friend arrived, they left her waiting in the Royal Service reception area for a half an hour before taking her to the area she had her room.  Not a good way to start off. 
The pool attendants and waiters, especially Joel, were fabulous!  However, the food throughout the rest of the property was hardly befitting a place where they purport to being 5 star. The Asian restaurant had the smallest dim sum I had ever seen, which was ok because they weren’t worth eating anyway. 
The worst part of the trip was when my friend was startled by a man verbally and physically abusing his female companion outside her room. When that was reported, I asked if the abusive man was escorted off the property and our concierge’s response was that he’d stay because he paid for the room. There was another fight earlier in the day by the pool. Not exactly the well heeled clientele.

reviews.author: World traveler 1947
reviews.title: 2nd Visit
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying I've been traveling to Cancun for 12 years now. I try to stay at most of the resorts and write honest reviews. Looking for that perfect place I'll always come back to. I stayed at Paradisus playa del Carmen last year for a week, and even though service there was great, I missed the beaches in Cancun.  So I extended my stayed with 2 nights at Paradisus Cancun.  I felt like I needed to try the resort again for a longer time to officially give it a proper review.
So I stayed the week of March 10-16 2020. Spring break was very busy. check in was delayed and when We finally got a room, it overlooked the parking lot,and smelled of a very strong chemical. I tried to bypass the smell, until I started feeling faint and wanted to vomit. I called the front desk to complain, and they told me if I wanted a new room I would have to pay $160 a night for a royal service room that was smaller than the JR suite that I already paid for. I fought with them saying I didn't need royal service,  just the same room that didn't have this chemical smell. They said nothing was available. Need less to say I was upset and went downstairs to speak with the manager and request my money back.  I even called the credit card company up to see what my rights were. After 30 minutes, the manager said he had an equivalent room to offer me. This room did not smell,  and was clean. It also had a better view. (I do want to clarify we wanted to investigate what the smell was) My husband found that the headboard, chairs,and coffee table were varnished. They stained all the wood furniture in a closed non ventilated room, and tried to put guests in there, while it still was wet! I included the picture of the wet varnish. management didn't even want to acknowledge the smell or the wet varnish. 
We tried to make the best of this trip, and were thankful they switched rooms. Pros: Service was good in the restaurant's. Beach side service was amazing, though drinks were so watered down. It was like drinking koolaid. Food in the restaurants 8/10. The cleaning crew for our room gets an A+, turn down service was great,we appreciated her very much. Thank you Cynthia!!! The beach was clean, and walkable.
Cons: The plastic cups they serve poolside are being reused! I didn't realize this until I got my own drink at the bar by the pool. All this time I thought they were disposable.  This is during CORONA!!! WE stopped drinking after that day. I purchased my own cup for outside. The only coffee poolside in the morning was by the bar,it was always empty. The royal service side was empty only 2 beds were in use, the other side was 100% full, we were kicked out of an empty palapa, and laid out on a towel on the beach.  Like I said when your on vacation u make the best of things,we didn't dwell. Nor did I feel like upgrading to Royal service, the first time I stayed at this resort I stayed in Royal service and didn't feel like it was worth the extra money. There was a Brazilian steakhouse when I stayed a year ago. They eliminated the steakhouse and replaced it with an ala cart steakhouse. Very pricey, food was just ok. Definitely not worth the money. You can go to a restaurant on the strip and pay half the money, for better food.

reviews.author: Compass236881
reviews.title: not great according to the web site
reviews.text: I stayed there for 7 days and could not wait untill this vacation would be over. The food in the buffet was excellent. There was poor entertaiment in the evening, In the evening was very boring and not fun  that at 9 pm we were in our room. There is nothing to do if your age is between 40 and 60. They have a night club which is very small and crowded and mainly designated to the young people. In the swimming pool was boring also. Water was super cold  Not too many activities were there either. I previously was staying in the different resorts and this one was the worse and not cheap. This is  my first time when I regret being there.

reviews.author: MesmerisedNot
reviews.title: Lovely resort, shame about the food
reviews.text:
What a lovely resort; beautifully clean with plenty of staff  to attend to your every need.  We spent a very relaxing 10 days at The Paradisus Cancun, lovely spacious room, great pool space and adjacent to a lovely sandy beach.  Plenty of sun-loungers available, although you will find holidaymakers wandering around at 06:00 to secure their favourite spot!  In addition to the main Buffet which serves breakfast / lunch / dinner, there are a few specialist restaurants which you need to book in advance; Japanese, Mexican, Asian, South American ...... special mention to all the wonderful staff who make this resort so special and, in particular;
 KARINA at the Coco Beach Bar, 
MARTIN and CARLOS at the buffet in the Fuego area 
DANIELA  at the YHI Spa

But, the downside for us which made this a standard 3/4* as opposed to a 5* is:

1. Terrible food!  The Buffet area is crowded but the food, whether it be breakfast/lunch/ dinner, is simply average and cold - not even warm.  
2. The food in the ‘specialist’ restaurants was also cold ... Japanese and Asian food was good but cold, but the Mexican and South American food  was awful!
3. The sun loungers are (where you spend the vast majority of your day) dated and uncomfortable. The majority are fixed in a semi upright position which means you cannot lie flat and are not conducive to a position for reading.  If you upgrade to the Bali Beds (for a fee) you will get fully flexible sun loungers!  My gripe is that after having paid a 5*star fee for your accommodation, you then have to pay extra for a better sun lounger.  Never experienced this before having stayed in Cancun resorts previously.

reviews.author: Ves
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Disappointed with the resort. We had a cockroach in our room. No one bothered to check in to see how our stay was, bathroom by the beach was closed for 2 days due to plumbing issues.  They had a steak house there that was extra$$$, including alcoholic drinks and lounge beds on the beach were also extra.  Food was nothing spectacular and staff could have been friendlier.  I would definitely not come back.

reviews.author: Natalie H
reviews.title: Definitely Not 5 Star
reviews.text:
This was my first trip to Mexico and first time at Meliá. In the past I’ve been to Riu, Bahia, and Sandals. This is my review in hopes that it helps someone make their decision to book or not to book.

Rooms
Some of the rooms are outdated and look nothing like the images posted...our first room had an smell in the bathroom and a view of the employee parking lot. I originally requested a room close to the ground level but we complained due to the smell and eventually were moved to a better room.

Food
The food at the buffet was almost never hot, either lukewarm or room temperature. The grill was the only source for a hot meal. There was a lack of variety even though they did rotate from day to day it seemed to repeat every 2 or 3 days. The poolside buffet offers burgers and fries, hotdogs and chips which wasn’t bad.

Service
The service at this hotel is impeccable! I rarely had to go to the bar for myself and the servers constantly check in; possibly the only downside to this was feeling obligated to tip all the time.

After visiting this hotel I don’t think I would return. I heard Paradisus has another location and was told it’s much better than the Cancún location. The common areas are beautiful but the outdated room and the food were a disappointment.

reviews.author: PMOM
reviews.title: Amazing staff
reviews.text:
The staff at this hotel are amazing. The lady who was our guide, Marina, was very helpful and always available. We were particularly served for lunch and dinner by Edier and Alejandro who were very nice, polite and helpful too.
One thing we were not happy about though was our room and its location. They placed us on a floor where there were some ongoing renovation and painting. It disrupted our two kids naps and we could also smell the paint from time to time. 
The thermostat was not functioning the first two nights till we asked them to come and fix it. 
The fridge was making a lot of noise which we again asked to be replaced. I am sure they could have offered us a better room specially since it is a huge hotel with many many rooms.

reviews.author: Curious526886
reviews.title: Get ready for time share pitches!
reviews.text:
The hotel is nice. The location is nice. Unfortunately they tried over and over to sell us a time share package and it got frustrating. We were scooped up quickly by the well dressed concierge staff acting like we were VIP's only to find out they were just trying to sell us something we don't want. We never got told about the hotel and how everything works because of this. 

Overall this hotel could be 5 star, but the concierge people ruin it for everyone else if you don't want a time share. 

Hotel was spotless and the food was fantastic. All the staff was super friendly once your away from the check-in area. They do not respond to emails so don't try.

reviews.author: Darrell W
reviews.title: 5 Star Goods & Services Not Offered Automatically / Timeshare Greeting
reviews.text:
I just returned from a 10 nights vacation at the Paradisus Cancun. The facilities were clean and well maintained. 
The staff were great and the buffet meals were ok. The specialty restaurants were a plus and I enjoyed the meals they served. I have vacationed at many 5 star hotels from Hawaii to Jamaica. I was disappointed at having to request goods and services automatically offered at other 5 star resorts. 
I had to request bathrobe and slippers as there were none in the room upon arrival. 
I was lead to believe by the snack guy replenishing the fridge that the only snacks available were chips. I had that corrected quickly by calling the front desk staff. 
I spent the first 2 nights with no turndown service and cleaning in the evening and had to call the front desk again to request the service. At other 5 star hotels the service is automatic. 
Upon arriving at the Paradisus Cancun I was greeted by a rep who introduced me to the facilities at the Paradisus lookand later attempted to give me a timeshare pitch. I wasn't impressed. 
Pool towels were not properly checked out and in by staff by taking room numbers from hotel guests. 
As a result rather than guests returning towels to the staff in the towel shack the towels were left on lounge chairs making other guests believe that the lounges were being occupied and not available. Quite a nuisance. I understand many towels were stolen by hotel guests too.

reviews.author: Ioanna N
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, but limited space.
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed here for a quick 3 day getaway last week.  The hotel is beautiful! The lobby is stunning and lush.  The service at check-in was..ok. There was a mixup with our room, we wanted a king junior ocean view suite.  They put us in a double room.  After waiting on the phone for half-hour, hubby finally just went to lobby to complain.  After some arguing, they provided us with the room we originally booked.  First off, whoever had the idea to place tall planters on the balcony was crazy. They COMPLETELY obstruct your view.  Oceanview means standing unconfortably at cement planters to see it.  Bad idea.  It wasn't just ours, this is every room.  

The hotel has several options for dining, however if you want to make reservations, you must do so before you ever arrive at the hotel because they are full...constantly. the restaurants are so small, seating is very limited so you are unable to make reservations at any of them even with 3 days as we had.  

The hotel is huge.  There ARE five pools, however only one has a swim-up bar and the others are fairly small.  Also, beach chairs are also very limited.  I'd go down at 7am to watch the sunrise and they were all reserved then!  It's a shame to have such a large hotel, and such limited space!  With the number of families, young children, it's difficult to find anywhere to sit in the afternoons.
