With so many other options, larger pools, more swim-up bars, better service, and activities, we won't be coming back here.

reviews.author: Lynn H G
reviews.title: February staff at Paradisus Cancun Royal Service
reviews.text: We travel each winter and Mexico has become our destination of choice, based on reviews we looked fwd to the Royal Svc at Paradisus but it did not live up to our expectations.  Smooth and quick checkin process although there was a little pressure to attend a time share presentation; our firm no addressed this.  When introduced to our butler we learned we needed to download an app to communicate with him. Potential to be efficient and effective but responses were inconsistent - some delays were by several hours (up to 24). We mainly used this for dinner reservations.  Service was also slow at the restaurants and food quality was not as good as we hoped. We also booked an ocean view but the view was limited. A bit disappointing.  If you are sensitive to scents be aware there is a lot of incense used everywhere and was quite strong.  We had great service at the pool and really appreciate Aaron’s efforts.  The water in pool was so warm; the beach was lovely too however every day was a red flag day. If you are looking for evening entertainment or daytime activities this resort had little to offer. We did appreciate how attentive staff was really attentive to the cleanliness of the resort and this was evident everywhere we went.  Housekeeping did a good job on our room but on last two nights we were left short on towels even when we asked for more.  When we checked out the process again was very quick. Surprised that we did not get assistance with our luggage as there were lots of stairs and quite a distance to main lobby.  Would we go back? Not to this resort unfortunately but definitely toMexico.

reviews.author: 997shaun
reviews.title: Nice resort but lacking in entertainment activies and terrible food.
reviews.text: I stayed here with my family 2 kids under 4. Nice resort but lacking in entertainment activies and terrible food. There was no yoga for example on the beach no volleyball nothing. The place was focused on house music and drinking not ideal for a young family. We got lucky the weather was perfect staff friendly but they create a division of people of class when you are in the resort to pay extra for different beach chairs etc.. I would not come back becuase the food was terrible specfically a restaruant called Mole. This was terrible food. It was overpriced place I should of went to super clubs for this price sandals. I'm going back to cruises in future.

reviews.author: Kiki
reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text:
With all the other choices in the area, this resort needs some improvements to be competitive.  Good points:  families with small children love it (good news for families with small children);  beach is one of the best we've stayed in the area; food pretty good; friendly staff; close to airport.

Not so good:   Reservations needed TWO days ahead for most restaurants other than buffett; Needs a facelift around resort; Air conditioning in our room totally didn't work and we complained twice;  no "big" shows like other resorts which are kinda fun; bathrooms way too far from pool....hmmm...I've had intestinal issues for 5 days and counting now🤢.

Bottom line:  to each their own.  This resort is not for us.

reviews.author: write_to_me___
reviews.title: Golf at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
I noticed not much said about the golf course, so will tell you about my experience. 
Cost is $25.US for your clubs which include pw,sw, putter 7 & 8 iron in a small golf bag. All holes are par 3.
This can be picked up at a place called "the store" lower level building 3. Balls are extra charge so we had our own.
Most holes are marked once you find hole number one, which  is beside practice putting area. 
Grass is not cut short so you are playing in the rough the whole time. Which means if you try to bounce it onto the green, it would just stop dead. Greens are just ok and are not fast. 
You have to sign a form before you play that says you are responsible for any damage. 
I can see why as a few holes are close to traffic and hole #9 is beside a parking lot with a lot of nice cars. 
We just played it once and took about an hour for 9 holes, we were losing the ball even when we were on the fairway as it sinks down in the grass. 
The course is only open till 1 pm, not sure why maybe because it's too hot after that. 
Hope this helps as I could not find much information about this before my trip.

reviews.author: Lola O
reviews.title: Needs improvement
reviews.text:
The hotel was beautiful and the location/beaches were breath taking!!
The waitstaff was attentive and kind.

However, for the amount of money that is paid to stay at this hotel, they need to be more accommodating and honor what guests paid for.

Neither my friends or I (2 rooms reserved between the 3 of us) were what we paid for. When we went to the front desk to ask to switch to the correct rooms, they originally refused and referred to a ridiculous disclaimer on the website. This is unacceptable. They eventually moved us, but they made it very difficult.

They also fumigated my room in the middle of my stay. This is absolutely not okay. If a room needs maintenance, do not book it until complete.

reviews.author: Daniel G
reviews.title: Can't give a 4, sorry Paradisus, needs to improve
reviews.text:
My family and I just returned home from Paradisus Cancun. Stayed there 5 nights and six days.
It's our third time in Cancun. Also been in cruises,  Dominican Republic, Spain, france, Italy, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Estonia, Canada, Bahamas,  Chile, Peru, Colombia, Brazil, Panama,  among others. So I'm not a rookie traveler.

Yes thos Hotel is outdated but that's not the problem. There are several major issues with this potential great place:

1. Infrastructure 
It's a mess having to go up stairs and down stairs all the time cause pyramid 1 ONLY communicates with pyramid 2 in 1 floor. And same between 2 and 3. So from our room to go to lower level and the major restaurant we needed to go down to then go up.

This hotel has little real estate. Yes, we were while hotel was  85-90% full but there was a line to get breakfast at 8am. The place is designed not considered people flow, so accumulates people in certain areas and makes it over crowded. 

There are also 1 unique breakfast place, in a buffet restaurant, where you need to make a line. No other options and people are forced to crowd some areas.

There is also a need to grab a place in the beach or at the pool before 8AM. There are several hits left, but no resting "reclaiming chairs". How can you explain that?

There are two lounges, one is never used, red lounge, and the other and open space with sort of Bali beads with very loud music, electronic music, not appealing to the non millenial guests. This place needs some serious musical consultant,  musical selection at the pool and beach is deeply needed. Were in a tropical place, relaxing and all music is for electronic partying. 

The restaurant, newley renovated is uninviting and poorly designed. People come and go, again no flow, so always crowded and you have to bump to everyone, and different to ikea, again, there is not a smart flow of traffic.

Did I mention wait in line? Possibly understaffed also. Too many co charges all over the hotel trying to upsell Melia Club CIRCLE but not so many servers. And some empty staples that can be rotated faster.

Finally. Very important,  this place needs a pastry chef. Not even ice cream is good desserts are really, really, really way below average. Everyday, incredibly, in all restaurants, especially in the main, awful, desert is a treat, on vacation is important. Really poor selection, not fun, not tasty.

Finally, lack of Mexican experience. We really wanted a real mexican experience. The night we set aside for the non reservation was closed when hotel busy. Not even a quesadilla,  fajita, kind of disappointing.

Finally, the "Hispanic manana syndrome" . 10AM can be 10 or 10:30AM. This means checknin and check out are a nightmare. Specially checkin. They have credit card, all info, taking a copy of a passport and keys should be simple, but takes for ever. Even more disgusting, you are bombarded by these converges trying to trick you to give them 90 minutes (it's really way more than that) to listen to a sales speech to get you to purchase circle membership. You are tired from a long day, flights, airport drop off and pick up. You want to get vacation started ASAP and you are in a check in process that takes 20 min wait and then 30 min for them wanting your attention at the worse possible time....

reviews.author: Emily
reviews.title: Of all the all-inclusive resorts...Paradisus leaves something to be desired.
reviews.text:
We've done a February trip to an all-inclusive resort in Cancun the past 5 years.  We "upgraded" this year and paid a little more to go to Paradisus (last year we did Panama Jacks and I have to say - it was nicer...AND $500+ less!!).  However, even though we thought we upgraded, we left with just an "okay" rating.  It was fine - the rooms were clean and nothing terrible happened.  However, there was really nothing to brag about.  

My biggest complaint - the buffet was quite terrible.  NO variety...day-to-day the only fresh order options was the pasta station and with one slow employee working, it was at LEAST a 10 minute wait.  There were also no "kid friendly" options which EVERY other hotel we've stayed at offered.  Also, 2 out of 7 people in our party did get VERY sick from the food (one of which was my kiddo) which we've never had happen in our previous Mexico stays.

Service was fine - staff were all very friendly but SO SLOW.  I know things are more laid back and slow in Mexico.  However, things were SO SLOW.  Check-in took 25 minutes and we were the ONLY ONES THERE.  I already mentioned the pasta station...

We paid for the family concierge - the two gals we had helping us were very nice and responsive but the other benefits were minimal.  The "family lounge" that was supposed to have snacks and beverages available was never stocked - couldn't get a beer, diet coke, or bottled water half the time because it was never stocked.  They had a bunch of booze out but no mixers because the other beverages were empty.  Totally worthless benefit.

I don't normally leave reviews but I was really looking forward to an upgraded experience this year and was very disappointed.  Hopefully I can stop someone else from making the same mistake!

reviews.author: rockglenlmjohn
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
This particular hotel is located in a very appealing and attractive spot. The White sand beaches were incredible and it’s location for shopping and restaurants was ideal. The employees were very friendly and helpful. Room service was impeccable. 
This hotel is very pricey. I am not sure what employees are paid but they depend heavily on tips. I am not sure if the stay was worth the money spent. The rooms are starting to show their age. Pin holes in the blackout shades, taps backwards, and food at Buffet is not up to prices charged. Hot food warm at best and foods that are cold are under lights so questionable. Hair salon changed $80.00 US for a wash and blow dry.  That was totally a rip off. If you are a member of one of their time share plans it might be worth the money they charge but if you are planning a stay st the Paradisus without a time share plan. Definitely not worth the money

reviews.author: Jaison98
reviews.title: Don’t expect good service
reviews.text:
What a bizarre stay. The Paradisus Royal Service does so many things right but always finds a way to make you say “huh?” 

The Good: 
- Some of the best liquor selections I’ve ever seen at an all-inclusive resort (Grey Goose and more in Royal Service). Note: I said liquor - the free wines were below average and the mixed drinks were hit and miss. 
- The food at most restaurants was above average quality for resorts and the buffet had a number of great options 
- The entire establishment was clean (except all the flies on the food in Royal Service) and housekeeping did a very thorough job each time they came 

However the contact problem for us was often aloof and generally disorganized service

Here’s an example from our first moments there. Getting out of the cab, we were warmly greeted and provided a face towel. A gentleman took our luggage and we were guided to go through the door to the left. Inside someone said they’ll be with us in a minute so we sat with our towels... and continued to sit longer. Around a corner I found welcome snacks and quality Moet champagne available. I proceeded to open a new bottle (as the previous one was closed) and enjoyed a wonderful first drink. Still clutching my dirty face towel and sipping champagne, I found a table where several other guests had tossed their used towels and proceeded to add mine to the collection. After about 10 mins, my name was called and I was asked to follow an associate to Royal Service. He spoke a little but was mostly glued to his phone, laughing at what apparently was a funny situation with coworkers. Finally (I mean it really was over a 5 min walk) we reached the checkin desk. A new associate asked for our passports and spent the next 15 minutes getting us checked in. This process should have taken about 3 minutes given we checked in online but we sat though it.

Soon after, our butler arrived and guided us to our beautiful room. Things were looking up but he then informed us there were no reservations available at any of the restaurants during our stay but if we text him ahead of time next time we visit he can help. Wow... not helpful and honestly confusing as the hotel appeared very empty on our mid-week stay. 

Throughout our trip, a series of the butler telling us he could get us into restaurant X at a certain time, us showing up and not being able to get in, a series of chaotic events and then suddenly we have a table occurred on multiple evenings. I could go on but TA says we’re done!

reviews.author: Shergril-La
reviews.title: Disappointing for a Paradisus
reviews.text:
We have been to both the Paradisus Playa Del Carmen and Cabo San Lucas in the last 2 years and loved them. This one is more of a 3 star because of services and condition of rooms - Tub is cracked and mirror is all spotted. 
Rooms are very rundown and need renovations although common areas are stunning. 
The other Paradisus' we had gourmet coffee shops but none here. They put out a coffee station that ran out of coffee. They didn’t have pool towel cards available until second day and pool chairs don't recline flat which is a bit annoying. Good wifi though.
Way better sister hotels in playa del Carmen and Cabo where I'd choose again.

reviews.author: Jingo99
reviews.title: Better places. Do your research
reviews.text:
Room was a good standard for a standard room however they put you above the night time disco so you have to pay to upgrade to a better location. Sea View from 2nd floor was good though. 

The buffet food was very good for a buffet and the drink service by the pool was good. 

Check out is interesting and I recommend do not charge anything to the room as they conveniently do not have change.... their little hands are twitching expecting it to be a tip.... this is stuff I’m paying for that I have been overcharged for at the hotel shop!!! 

Vanessa on the reception of the restaurant felt like the only genuine staff member who was interested in you as a person not sizing you up for a tip.... probably the only person worthy of a tip! 

Coffee station was a good touch and the man in the nesspresso coffee shop tried hard but never listened to what you ordered. Coffee was good though. 

Clean surroundings and a busy hotel who favour the guests who are here on business or royal service. 

Irregular daytime entertainment at the pool..... shame as this could be so good everyday. 

Air con on room is hit and miss and WiFi too. Seemed dependant on number of ‘business’ guests in the hotel. 

Great location for bus into town. If not use Uber very cheap. 

I recommend doing the research as I feel for the money spent you could do better.

reviews.author: Adrian
reviews.title: High and Lows throughout the Trip
reviews.text:
I don't normally leave reviews, however this was a very interesting stay that I had at the Paradisus. We'll start with what we loved about the hotel.

Staff: A large majority of the staff was incredibly welcoming and helpful throughout our stay. Most of the staff work multiple zones throughout the day so they get to know you.

For breakfast: Hosts Vanessa and Noemi, and waiters Martin and Pascal were incredibly nice and welcoming.
Our bartenders at Avenue bar Luis & Luis were fantastic. We would come and grab a few drinks to take to our room and by the second night they already knew what we wanted.
Orlando from the Blue Agave restaurant was fantastic as well.

The hotel itself is absolutely gorgeous. You can tell they take pride in keeping the common areas clean and well maintained.

Overall the food in the hotel was great. You can't go wrong at the buffet and we went there almost everyday for some meal. Blue Agave, Bana the sushi restaurant, and Enzo were our favorites.

Now for some things we didn't love about it.

Restaurants: Making reservations for the restaurants is rather difficult. If you decide that day what restaurant you want to eat at you have to book before 5 PM. You can walk over but they make it seem like there is going to be a ridiculously long wait even though the hotel was largely unoccupied. Every restaurant we went to was pretty empty and we dined at various times between 7 and 10 PM throughout our stay. We came back from an excursion at 10PM exactly, I ran down to let the host know we were going to take ten minutes to change and she said she couldn't hold the reservation. There were four occupied tables in a restaurant of 40 tables.

The room left a lot to be desired. The bedside outlet was ripped out of the wall, and a few lights didn't work alongside the poorly laid out lights throughout. There were no hooks in the bathroom and the bathtub spout didn't work. The balcony had a great view of the ocean but they plant shrubs on the balcony to act as privacy. They directly block your ocean view when you're sitting down. The mini fridge was fully restocked every day which is awesome, but the water bottles are glass and they don't provide you with a bottle opener. I get that these are small things, but they should be thought about from a guest convenience aspect.

The pool bar is only open 11 to 6. So if you want to grab seats early because they filled up quick you'd only be able to drink brunch drinks within the breakfast area. Instead of making the pool a dry area until 11, confine it to brunch drinks until then. 

Finally, upon checkin they offer you time the next morning to plan out excursions and get a discount on other facilities in the hotel like the spa. In reality they sit you down for a Timeshare pitch that took up 2 hours of our day.

reviews.author: ikhawaja
reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.text:
For the 1st time in 23 years I was disappointed in the service I received at Paradisus. We are Melia Club members who bought twice (Upgraded) because we love this resort. This time thou we felt unwelcome at times. Ate at Bana the 1st night the food was not as good as usual. we tried to eat at Fuego. After being seated we were given Menus that were without prices. We were then told we would have to pay the Buffet price to eat even if we only ordered one item or everything on the Menu. we walked out. Tried to eat twice at blue Agave. Once it was closed for a private party and another time we were told it will be available only after 8. The Marriott next door was happy to take our money and serve us an excellent meal Ala cart.
 Everything else was wonderful as usual. The workers were Friendly and as accommodating as possible. Paradisus has changed Managers and they need to take care of this disorganization quick.

reviews.author: Dustinius
reviews.title: The Good, bad and ugly
reviews.text:
Just returned from an 8 night trip with my wife and another couple (without kids!!). 

The Good:
The grounds and beach are truly spectacular. Without this, I don’t think that the Paradisus Cancun would get away with calling their resort 5 star. 
The addition of a few hammocks throughout the resort would be welcomed, and please replace the lounge chairs!!! The majority do not lay flat and are very uncomfortable. The Bali beds are nice, but are only for those who wish to suffer through the timeshare/vacation club presentation or for those who upgraded to the “royal service”, or those who want to pay out of pocket. 
As for restaurants that are currently opened, the only ones that fit in the good category would be Vento and Fuego. If you are a foodie, then you will most likely agree that none should be considered 5 star dining, however, Vento and Fuego did satisfy. 
The service is very good. They are attentive and hard working. Please tip them appropriately... it was disgusting to see how many people I saw get up in the restaurants and leave nothing. Special shout-out to the boxer/waiter in the buffet and Fuego, Andres. He worked his butt off. 

The Bad: 
Blue Agave tacos were really bad. This is not something you can get wrong in Mexico, especially at a 5 star resort! The theme in most restaurants is that the food is prepared en-masse well before hand and kept out for long periods of time. This results in dry and cold food. This was evident in every single restaurant. Bana served me rock hard rice noodles in a stir fry! I understand that there are plenty of people to feed at once, but they need to sort out a system that allows them to at least reheat/flash-fry the food prior to serving it. 
The rooms on the Lagoon side could use some upgrading. They weren’t horrible, just a little dated. I don’t spend much time in my room, so it didn’t completely turn me off. Also, there are no hard alcohol dispensers in the room. I’ve stayed at several resorts, and this was a first. Not everybody wants beer. Granted, you could go to a bar to get a drink, sometimes it’s nice to make your own in the comfort of your room. 
The buffet food was hit-and-miss, which is to be expected. The lunch was pretty good, with many options, including sushi. However, they cheap out on the good stuff, like sashimi. They will put out one plate, and once it’s gone, they won’t replenish it. The amount of times I was told “sorry senior, no more left” was bothersome to say the least. Until they sort this out, I suggest arriving to the buffet at 1pm when it opens. 

The Ugly:
So many things are “extra”. If you don’t upgrade to the Royal Service, room service comes with a $5 fee. Speaking of room service, it was the worst I’ve ever had in my life. I tried almost everything on the “24 hour menu” and the only thing that was edible was the Caesar salad. 
Little things like coconut water and Perrier are “extra”. My wife and friend were told that the quesadillas that they were preparing at the pool-side snack bar were extra. Seriously? Tortillas and cheese? It’s not a “Most Inclusive”, it’s an “ALL Inclusive”. They really cheap out on many things! We were there for Super Bowl. If you wanted to sit down with a view of the screen, you had to pay $220 usd (for a group of 6), this came with perks, but not enough to make it worth it. If you wanted a difference tier of seating, you had to pay for an expensive bottle of wine. If you declined either, you were allowed in the “nose-bleed” section with the rest of the peasants. We all paid a lot of money to be at the resort, stop the penny pinching! 
The activities are non-existent and if you’re looking to come with kids, there is little to nothing for them to do. Moon Palace has a Wave simulator, and a full arcade, wave pool, lazy river, play centre for kids. Paradisus Cancun has nothing. We were without kids, but should we take our kids back to Cancun, it won’t be at the Paradisus. 
Their Gelato station was only opened sometimes. You’re a sunny, hot destination. Keep it open all day!! Also, not all restaurants were open everyday, and trying to get reservations is comical. You get the run-around daily. “Sorry senior, our system is down, please come back later” only to come back later to “sorry everything is booked, come back tomorrow”. They cater to the royal service people first, where reservations are completed via their personal concierge, and if there are any  tables left, you can maybe get in. They want you to eat in the buffet for every meal. My advice, don’t take no for an answer. Speak with the manager if need be. 
Is Royal Service worth it? They want you to think so as you pay top dollar for it. Do the math yourself. About $800 usd extra for a lame section of the hotel (everyone I spoke to said it was extremely boring there). In addition, you will have to tip your concierge another couple hundred. This gives you access to Bali beds for a couple days and allows you to eat at Palapa restaurant and you don’t pay the $5 room service charge. IMO, I’ll keep my $1000 and go to one of the several fabulous restaurants in close proximity of the hotel. 
Another thing worth noting; they water down their alcohol. If was extremely obvious, especially if you like things neat like me. 
All-in-all, I enjoyed myself! I definitely didn’t leave disappointed, however they need to make changes or stop claiming they are a 5 star resort.

reviews.author: BIll S
reviews.title: Getting a little tired
reviews.text: Throughout the week pretty-much every staff person that we interacted with were pleasant and helpful. The room:  Bed was very comfortable, but the air conditioning was a bit of a challenge to get right.  the room had its own wifi antenna, so the signal was great anywhere in the building (and throughout the grounds). Housekeeping were on their game and things were cleaned and tidied-up quite well.  It took a day-or-so to get the hot water working properly, but it worked-out.  Food: Just OK, but a la cartes seem to rotate opening and it was not possible for us to get what we wanted, either because there was no availability (which seemed odd as there were very few guests there), or it was closed on the days we wanted to go there.  The buffets are quite small in size and selection is limited.  Pools/Beach:  Both the general pool and the Reserve pool are very well maintained and there were lots of lounge chairs available, and I didn't notice any early morning "reservations" on chairs (which is a good thing).  Service around the pools was very sparse and I can't say that I saw someone gathering drink orders more than a couple of times per day.  The property backs onto a beautiful beach that is very deep and long enough to provide for a good long walk in either direction.  The waves were quite large the week that we were there but we did go out a ways and were impressed that the bottom is all sane; no weeds, mud, or rocks. Overall, it's a nice place but it can use some work on the meal side.

reviews.author: Gnarcia
reviews.title: Amazing establishment/service w/ Poor Food Quality
reviews.text:
Paradisus is an absolutely beautiful establishment. The appearance and cleanliness is great. The staff is very friendly and eager to serve well above anything you would experience in the US. 

KENIA was our butler and helped us with all of our reservations and also surprise set up a bubble bath with champagne and chocolate covered strawberries for my wife and I which made for an unforgettable moment for us. 

We stayed 4 nights. The first 2 mornings we woke up before 8am because of a man pressure washing outside our room. Not happy with that. Our butler said if it happens again (so 3/4 of our stay) that they will move us. We thought that they’d offer to move us anyway and maybe feel bad that we were woken up by maintenance personnel but they didn’t. 

The bathroom in our royal service junior lagoon view room is absolutely amazing. Best part of the room. Our lagoon view was actually a view of the tennis court with mcDonalds in the background. Not even a hint of water or a lagoon. Whatever. 

I would only return here if the food was not substandard. The only food that’s fresh is fruit and salad stuff. Everything else is most likely frozen and tastes like cafeteria food. There’s better food at airports. 

The beach and Bali beds are great and the service out there is excellent. Very genuinely friendly and thoughtful. 

We would give this place 2.5 stars because of the poor food quality. I read lots of reviews and I don’t see how any could possibly say anything amazing about the food unless those people are accustomed to low food quality. 
We tried a wide variety of foods at the restaurants and room service and were mostly dissatisfied. 

The spa area is nice. The pool, that looks like a giant hot tub should be warmer to be more appealing. The sauna is nice. The steam room is loaded with essential oil that is very irritating to lungs and skin. The pool area is relaxing. 

We chose royal service to be away from kids and that was successful. When we at at the buffet, there were typical vacation families with kids playing around their tables and riding scooters IN THE RESTAURANT. Whatever. 

Overall we had a great time and will most likely go to a different resort in the future, hoping to spend less and have a better experience that we hear about from others we talk to.

reviews.author: Joey Batchelor
reviews.title: Couples 4 Day Weekend- sewage leak at Royal Service Pool area awful smell
reviews.text: Booked Royal Service with 3 couples.  Concierge and Butler service was very good (Alex).  Rooms were nice and clean.  Food in onsite restaurants was ok, buffet food was high quality and very good. We paid extra for Royal Service which have us access to private pool and beach area.  Last 2 days of trip couldn’t even go to our private pool because of major sewage leak and horrible smell.  Kind of ruined our trip since the private pool area was our reason for paying extra.  Very disappointed with this matter.

reviews.author: JustynaB27
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text:
Great service ! Big thank you to Gloria and Brenda our butlers , all the servers that work at the hotel, beach and pool.
When it comes to the hotel I was not thrilled. Very limited choice of food, all restaurants are either spanish or asian, nothing to do for kids beside kids club, entertainment very poor.

reviews.author: Sungbin K
reviews.title: Excellent overall services and hotel conditions - ruined by a single instance of Circle by Melia Timeshare
reviews.text:
Some warning and/or advice: Do not be fooled into sitting to hear more about their hotel. Act like you've been there before and you're not at all interested in their Circle by Melia timeshare. No matter what they say, that's what they are trying to sell you. They won't once mention the word "Timeshare" as that must be part of their way to get people to sit and sign up. Instead, they'll sneakily offer a free 'perk' with no commitment, in exchange for some time to reserve and sit and listen to them. Again, it seems obvious, but even after multiple attempts at saying I'm not interested or that I even know what they're trying to do, they won't just stop. There must be a lot of pressure or incentive to get that first signature. Don't sign anything, don't take up their time, and I'm sure it will be fine. But I cannot recommend this hotel until they change this tactic in their management. It completely ruins the experience and I couldn't trust the rest of the staff for the remainder of the trip. I found that it's not true for the overall staff and experience as the rest of the staff was incredible. So it's only the front desk/first visit people they try to target.

I chose an ocean view family concierge experience and I don't regret it. Compared to the price difference of the lowest option to book this hotel and the concierge that comes with butler service, it really changed the whole experience for us. Each night they left a nice toy/trinket for our son and were in constant communication with us through Whatsapp. They automatically booked us reservations (we forgot about the 2nd night) to ensure us a spot. While they couldn't get us booked to a dinner that was already sold out, it did feel like they did their best to find another booking. Also, the family concierge room where you check in was a great place to get a free adult beverage, coffee, bottled water while running around the hotel.

When checking out, our flight was delayed so the front desk helped us get a taxi and it cost $27 US. This price actually beats the shuttle and as long as you have exact change (bring plenty of ones, fives, tens in US - they'll accept it), you're fine. I suggest converting a few dollars to pesos, but if you're staying at the resort, you don't need pesos at all. 

Again, this was an incredible hotel, but they're also responsible for the timeshare pitch and that's a ridiculous thing to pressure on us at the price we're paying to stay at this hotel.

reviews.author: rf999999
reviews.title: Mixed Feelings
reviews.text:
This is our second time at this location. First, it's a beautiful property. We did Royal Service both times and found it more than worth it.  The staff is amazing. The beach is perfect. The pool and cabanas are great.  The only negative, and it's a big one, is the food.  It's been about 5 years since we had been here but felt the food has gone so far downhill it's almost inedible.  With the exception of breakfast at La Palapa.  We ate at Vento, Bana, and the buffet for our short 4 day stay.  They were all terrible. Very basic, bland food. I'm really not sure how to describe it other than they found out how to maximize profit by cutting food down to the bare minimum. 
  The drinks were good, property is perfect but the food was so bad that we will be searching for new vacation spots.

reviews.author: swellsy2020
reviews.title: Wonderful people. Good food. Bad rooms.
reviews.text: The hotel has so much potential and offered better food and service than expected, however, the room and the lack of seating in the pool/ beach areas left much to be desired. We ended up having a great time by renting a Bali bed each day to guarantee a place to sit by the pool and spending as little time as possible in the room. The room needed to be renovated 10 years ago - we had 3 leaks, an uncomfortable bed and bathroom lighting so bad makeup application was impossible. It’s truly unfortunate that Melia has only focused on the common areas and restaurants because it would be a place I would want to return but for the room.

reviews.author: toi b
reviews.title: NEW YEARS
reviews.text: Beautiful property, amazing beach. Royal service was not worth it. The buttler only took reservations for us and did nothing else. We were not able to get a reservation for new years at the restaurant that is crazy why book people in a resort for new years if you don't have the space. The hostess was very rude to us when we got to the restaurant and we saw 5 tables open and she said she has nothing available. The only restaurant that we really enjoyed was mole. I would not recommend this resort the paradisus in playa de carmen is better food and service.

reviews.author: EDWARD G
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Review
reviews.text: Let's start off by saying this place was amazing! Very good service especially when they know you are carrying US dollars. One thing that I did not like was that they called us at about 9am to tell us they had a gift for us. Scheme!! I should have seen that coming. It was a scheme to try and get us to sign into a Timeshare sort of deal. The guy was very persistent on trying to have us watch the presentation but I kept saying no. He kept throwing in offers but since I've been schemed before, I sworn to never believe this stuff any longer. Sure enough now I'm looking at their club melia reviews and I can see I did  the right thing. Another complaint I had was we had the all inclusive package but I did not know what it included and what restaurants it included. So prior to making a reservation I called the operator to ask if ENSO restaurant was included in the all inclusive package. They said Yes! Upon arrival I gave my reservation room number and they sat us down. As the waiter approaches us and are ready to order on one of  the plates he says that'll cost you $40USD per plate is that ok? I was like I made sure this dinner was covered with the all inclusive package, what the heck. He responded sorry sir it's not. So I ended up paying for it. I was not going to have my wife and daughter go through the humiliation of having to leave. Because of this minor experience I will never stay here again. I figured it cost me about $120 to never have to stay here again. There are many options to choose from anyways. They should just be honest with their customers. They would have had a loyal one with me.

reviews.author: Yuanfang J
reviews.title: Good service but bad food
reviews.text: The family concierge service is pretty good. But the food here is really bad except Tempo which needs to pay more than $100 per person ( I love Tempo though) Also, we don’t like those salesperson trying to push you buy their circle membership.

reviews.author: John Z
reviews.title: good  hotel rooms but lack of resort feel
reviews.text:
the hotel has great beach, good location. The restaurants have good food and services, except the buffet area, which is very small and crowded, with poor food choices. No sausages for breakfast in one of the mornings at 8:30am! Waiters frequently forgot the drinks you ordered. To be fair, the stuff in other areas are very helpful and warm, especially the services in regular restaurants are excellent.
We have been to a few resorts in Cancun. I think this one has cleaner hotel rooms but feels more like a hotel rather than an all inclusive resort. The beach is great but they don’t have resort operated (free) water sports like some other resorts in Cancun have.

reviews.author: Wendy D
reviews.title: OK
reviews.text: Not a place to go if you are not all inclusive.  Can't upgrade to Royal Service unless you buy the all inclusive package.  No place to buy just an egg sandwich, had to go to buffet for breakfast.   For lunch on the beach, no menu, and can't order until after noon.   Bartenders aggravated to process payment for drinks, many times they just gave us the beer and told us to go.   Majority of guests are all inclusive and many were just too drunk and sloppy.   We watched one girl pee in her dress during dinner.   Prior trips they had a deli downstairs where we could get a croissant, fruit and sandwiches.  That is no longer there.  Really missed it.   Best part was the gym and Boot Camp and HITT classes by Alan.  He was amazing.  Definitely take a class.   Spa is getting old and needs renovations.  Spa bed was not warm.   Don't think we will be back again.

reviews.author: lilg0811
reviews.title: Our honeymoon experience
reviews.text: We were treated great until we turned down the club Meliá (time share) offer and then we were ignored. Our tours to Chichen Itza and Isla Mujeres were amazing. The food choices within the hotel were lacking variety. No matter which restaurant we went to they all offered the same thing. We walked across the street and had dinner at a local restaurant (we paid a lot for the meal but it was worth it completely) and had really good food. Next Anniversary vacation we go on will be to an all adult resort, there were a lot of children there. We did witness some of the staff speaking in Spanish and making fun of a couple customers who didn’t speak Spanish.

reviews.author: Judy1363
reviews.title: Graet resort, but pretty noisy at night in the main tower. We had difficulty sleeping. Also room could be larger.
reviews.text:
Loved the beach, food was decent, resort is extremely clean, restaurants are great. The huge downside is exterior room noise at main lobby at night, very loud music till late.
If they can fix the noise issue, I think it would be the best experience.

reviews.author: Parth S
reviews.title: Pete’s
reviews.text:
Overall good in terms of locations and beach. The things they need to improve-
Some Staff in reception and buffet area need basic customer service training 
Definitely have more veg food options 
Provide entertainment that’s not by the pool so we can sit properly instead of the on the floor

reviews.author: indirar2017
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel - food is so so
reviews.text: My second time there. Fist time everything was amazing that’s why we went back. This time around it was all different. No seafood options (at all) which is super sad because you went from having all kinds of ceviche, tuna, octopus, etc to not having anything. Seafood paella had only one shrimp. Most of the restaurants were booked way in advance so they had space only after our departure day (lame). Buffet desserts used to be so good but now all the same everyday. Room was dirty at checkin and wasn’t cleaned properly the next day

reviews.author: NB0624
reviews.title: False Advertising and disappointed
reviews.text:
When we first arrived, we were positively welcomed by the friendly staff. The property is spacious and beautiful. The resort advertises a large selection of restaurants, but almost 2 days into the trip we realized this was not the case. Realistically, we only had 4 restaurants for dinner. The first night we tried to go to Market Grill, but it was closed for renovations. Two of the restaurants were not included (Coco's and Tempo- we knew about Tempo ahead of time). Vento restaurant (advertised on website) did not exist. That left us with 4 out of the 9 advertised. We called to make reservations, but were upset to hear everything was booked up. 

Aside from our issues with dining, the rooms are dated. We didn't feel well one night and decided to head to bed after dinner and watch a movie. Our TV was against the wall which clearly were not soundproof because shortly into our movie we got a noise complaint. We lowered the volume and received another complaint 15 minutes later. It was NOT at an excessive volume.

reviews.author: Seaside28693389663
reviews.title: Paradise for Non-Vegetarians, Vegetarians beware
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed here during thanksgiving and I should say I really enjoyed all the services and amenities on the resort. The staff and everyone was very courteous and had a nice smiling demeanor. The facilities are very well kept and no issues with cleanliness in the room or outside.

Being a vegetarian, my biggest problem was good unique vegetarian food. Not that there were no options, but the vast majority were non-veggie options and what was left was just the usual pizza, burgers and pasta and bread which i could have anywhere else in the world. I would have liked to see more local vegetarian dishes prepared or atleast make it vegetarian on the customer's request.
Not just local maybe more global like thai, indian etc. After a day or two  this menu wares you down. 

Other than the lack of vegetarian options in this resort, I would say I really enjoyed my stay. Was totally relaxed and recharged to go back to work!

reviews.author: kajm1967
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel but some poor service
reviews.text:
Be sure to read the fine print, we booked a higher end room then our first visit with an Ocean View, but basically received the wrong room with a basic view of the pool. Really poor experience with the room.
Apart from this the hotel and staff is beautiful.

reviews.author: alfredocX4700HU
reviews.title: In average
reviews.text: The staff at the check-in area and at restaurants generally unwilling to serve us. Asking for 16 people was impossible in all restaurants. Asking to move a table was impossible. Grudgingness in most waiters.

reviews.author: Becca
reviews.title: Nice staff but loud amplified music at night
reviews.text:
At first we thought the hotel would be great for our trip; however, a couple of nights in loud amplified music was being performed in the hotel central area. It was VERY loud in our room and this wasn’t something the hotel staff had warned us about. This was really obnoxious when we wanted to get enough rest before getting an early start. When we called the front desk to inquire about turning the volume down, they said the music was scheduled to go until 11PM (on a Monday night!) and that we could move rooms. Not sure why that was the best option - to inconvenience paying guests who had already unpacked to move and settled in the room to move? 

Besides the loud music, the hotel was okay but not great, especially considering the expense. The pool and beach are really nice, but be aware that the nice looking Bali beds in the advertising are an extra charge. 

Additionally, the food is hit or miss. La Palapa was quite nice and the grilled food by the pool was great. We liked the sushi restaurant in the middle of the hotel. The burger place by the pool was mediocre at best. The food at Mole and Blue Agave missed the mark. 

Drinks throughout the resort were good and again the staff was very nice. The swim up bar was great! 

Our room was very clean and well kept. Linens and towels were okay quality, but not great. The pillows were also kind of odd. The furniture and decor were pretty outdated. We didn’t have a bad experience, but I wouldn’t recommend this place or come back to it. I think there are probably better resorts in the area for comparable prices.

reviews.author: J S
reviews.title: Not Up to Par
reviews.text:
Just completed my 3rd visit to the Paradisus Cancun. 

The restaurants are not what they used to be. The buffet was very limited compared to past visits. Mole and Enso were less than ok. Overall, the food selections were pretty poor. 

Stayed in the Royal Service section. Our butler, Galdi was excellent and always checking to see if everything was ok. The resort needs more Bali beds. For what we were paying, we should have been able to have a Bali bed without any problem. The only service issue that we had was the rude pool attendant who could have cared less that he couldn’t accommodate us. Our one bedroom suite was nice and had an awesome view. 

The pool food and beverage servers were awesome. 

We do love Cancun. The beach and the water were beautiful! Just might try a different resort next time which offers better restaurants and better poolside amenities.

reviews.author: desiree k
reviews.title: Remodeling, & being there in the in between was not so good.
reviews.text: This was our 3 and last trip to Paradisus.  Love the views and most of the staff, however we paid for a Butler that we saw only on day ONE! Never saw him again.  Javiar did have an intern with him, she was delightful, however we barely heard from her as well.  Check in was a hot mess, we paid extra for the Royal Service as usually it's very accommodating.  Disappointed with the food options - Mole was mediocre at best,  We chose to eat at the buffet  twice - blah.  For the price paid and the lack of service and the watered down drinks by the pool.... I'm fairly confident we could have stayed somewhere better for less.

reviews.author: J K
reviews.title: Worse than expectation.
reviews.text: Too noisy. Scent of room is terrible. Food in Japanese restaurant is worse than local cheap one. The alarming light on your head is blinking all the time in bed. Kids zone is the only satisfactory part in this hotel.

reviews.author: Paul M
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Review
reviews.text:
Vacation October 26th-November 2nd at Paradisus, Cancun.
Pros
- pool staff very attentive. Laura and Flor excellent service at poolside. Kept area clean and guest happy.
- Rooms on fifth floor, main building were newly remodeled and very nice. Booked this hotel six months in advance and requested to be on the same floor as travel companions. We had to tip the person at check in to get us in the same building. This should not occur and is not very professional or accommodating. 
- Bartender (Edgar) outstanding!
- Bellmen very attentive and helpful on checkin and checkout. Professional and efficient. 
- Beach area was very nice and well maintained. 

Cons-
- Hotel showing it's age and in need of general maintainance. Peeling paint in many areas. Paster coming off the ceiling and walls in many areas and tiles missing in pool area. Staff was working on several updates during our stay but many more needed. 
- Restaurants - three closed for remodel, food was the worst of any all-inclusive we have ever stayed. Buffet sub par with very limited options. We would not return to this hotel based on food alone. 
- Checkin  - not informative or very helpful. Did not guide us to our room or give us towel cards for the pool area. 
- Checkout - same as ckeckin, just took our room keys. 

Summary 
- there are many better hotel options in Cancun hotel district. I would not recommend and will not return in future visits. I would rate this hotel avaerage at best.

reviews.author: RonnM
reviews.title: Beach was beautiful though...
reviews.text:
Our 3rd time in Mexico but first time in Cancun and we picked Paradisus expecting to get 5 star service. Me and my family were a bit disappointed as we have stayed in better resorts. Our trip was for my girlfriend's birthday and in our purchased online ticket it specifically said it's for her celebration. On her birthday, I was expecting they'd do something in the room to make her feel special, (mind you, other resorts in the past have done this for us). No cute decorations, no "happy birthdays". We had to call them to ask them for something and waste one hour just talking to the manager on the phone. So finally my girl just asked if we can at least have a cabana for free, which they did but only for a day ($100/daily).

We upgraded to oceanview luxury suite on the 7th floor in pyramid 3 and we kinda regret it. Yes the ocean view was amazing but not worth the extra $350. The 'suite' was small and AC was loud. Also, our door card stopped working and we had to wait and go back to the reception for someone to come up and "replace the battery". We are a bit concerned because these cards are the same cards you will have to use on the safety box. We had to make sure everything is working fine and our room and box isn't compromised. 

There aren't many buffet and ala cartes to choose from. Enzo was ok but it was dark during dinner time. They need to add more lighting, it's hard to eat when you can't see the food. Entertainment was ok, not great.

Overall we didn't like the hotel because as a 5 star, they didn't deliver. Having said that, the staff was amazing! Their service was top notch especially Alfredo and Gaudencio in the Blue Agave buffet. Every time we come to eat they treated us like family and we really appreciate their effort. Thanks Amigos! Also, Manuel in the pool area who treated us like royalty while relaxing. The bartender in the swim up bar, I'm sorry I forgot your name buddy but you serve the best mix of drinks! (Mexican holy water) And the lifeguard Moses for going out there to try and retrieve my drone. I appreciate it, brother!

reviews.author: Sarah Y
reviews.title: Very Humid, Disappointing Food, Not Worth It
reviews.text:
When we checked in, we did not get a room with two beds as per our initial booking - which was fine but then we asked for a room with a better view to make up for this, which they also did not provide. When we were getting our tour of the facility, it was very clear that the hotel was undergoing construction... the tour guide even mentioned "I hope you were made aware of the fact that we are undergoing construction ahead of time" - we were not. The construction was noisy and the elevators did not work. We were on the third floor which is not so bad but I would hate to know what someone who is elderly or disabled would have done.

The staff was very nice and the bed was comfortable but the hotel was SUPER hot and humid... to the point that we were sweating while we were walking through and even while we were sitting at the restaurants. 

Unfortunately the food at the pool/beach (which was the same restaurant they used for room service) was NOT good... it seemed like everything was frozen. Food always came cold... at the pool/beach and in the room.

The food at the Japanese restaurant inside the hotel was also not good... the sushi did not taste fresh and the rice was hard. The ceviche had a strange consistency.

On a positive note, the traditional Mexican restaurant (Mole) was very good so at least we had one positive food experience.

Overall, I would not recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Aryene A
reviews.title: Wallet stolen from room, no towel card received at check in
reviews.text: At check in we did not receive our towel cards and when we asked for it, not even 1 hr after check in we were treated like criminals. My husbands wallet was taken from our room on our  last day at the resort, when we weren’t expecting any room service due to the fact that we would be leaving at 3am the next day, but be a robe magically appeared in that room (why give that to a customer on their last day?) and his wallet was gone.

reviews.author: Shaya S
reviews.title: not 5 star
reviews.text:
I stayed here for a week in September. I was pleased with how clean the hotel was and how nice and courteous the staff, especially servers at all restaurants, were. But this is by no means a luxury hotel! Buffet restaurant's food was low quality and offered limited options. They had theme nights, except for Mexican nights that were amazing, this place was easy to pass. Blue agave offered great breakfast and was open pretty much all day, they offer really good tacos but because menu was very limited you couldn't keep going back to this place. Mole' was meh, Japanese was 5/10, portions at the market grill were extremely small! All other restaurants were closed for construction at the time we were there. 
Another thing I'd like to mention is that this is not a particularly lively place. pool bar closed at 6...which is super early. Maybe 20% of guests were English speaking, the rest were Spanish or Portuguese speaking. (which was pretty cool). A lot of people come into the pool with clothes on which I wasn't fond of. If you are looking to meet people, I recommend you choose a different resort. 
Water is rather rough by this side of the strip so keep that in mind if you're looking to swim in the ocean everyday/ have kids. We took the bus which was only $1 to the public beach area a couple of times, water was much calmer and nicer!
A tip if you're going to Isla Mujeres. We opted to take the ferry there and rented a gold cart in the island and explored the island for hours , went to couple of different beaches, went snorkelling at Garrifon de Castillo  for like $5 if I remember correctly, did some shopping etc. This was a great experience, you get the local experience, spend less money and more time on this beautiful island. I'd recommend exploring Isla mujeres on your own vs going on a tour!
all in all, I probably wouldn't stay here again. Pool was old, quality of food was low which is pretty important if you're staying at a place for an entire week, just didn't live up to a 5 start hotel standards. I'd give it a 3.5. Oh and also, we din't get the "Royal" service! there was a weird divide in the middle of one of the 2 pools and you can't go past a certain line because its for loyal service. 
We were really worried about the weather going there is September, it was hot,humid  and rained maybe once for like 15 minutes the entire time we were there. travelled sep 12-19. Perfect weather!

reviews.author: Katie
reviews.title: Will not book my wedding here
reviews.text:
My fiancé and I came here to potentially book our wedding. I’ll start off by saying I filled out several requests to speak with a wedding coordinator before the visit and received no response. 

Pros:
1. Most of the staff was amazing. Martin at the buffet was great and generally all the wait staff was fast and accommodating. 
2. Beach and location. It’s close to the airport and the beach and water is fantastic. 
3. Coffee shop was cute and staff there were nice 
 
Cons:

1. Hotel is under construction and 3 of the restaurants are closed. The employees don’t know that apparently because twice I asked where 2 different restaurants were, they gave me directions and sent me to a closed place. 
2. Check in was long and they try to sell you a timeshare
3. Rooms are dated, lighting is terrible and outlets are hard to come by
4. Pool is outdated and it’s impossible to find a chair if you are not there at 8am. The hotel wasn’t even that busy, so I cant imagine what it’s like when it is.
5. You need a towel card for the pool. I figured for the level hotel they advertise, you wouldn’t need something like that. It’s a pain to go get your towels and when you do they relentlessly try to sell you an adventure like jet skiing or parasailing. It was soooo annoying that it was the main reason I didnt want to host a wedding there. No one needs a high pressure sales environment when they’re trying to relax at the pool. 
6. The timeshare pitch doesn’t stop at check in, they call you and let you know someone has a gift for you at the front desk and just ask for Carlos to pick it up. Sure be right there.....
7. You need reservations at most of the restaurants 

Overall great location and if you pay for the royal service I’m sure it is better. Was surprised at how high the rating was for this location. Didn’t waste my time meeting with the coordinator because I knew it wasn’t the place for me. Was decent for a quick getaway but definitely not my favorite.

reviews.author: AustinHall0508
reviews.title: Lack of personalization and maintenance
reviews.text: It was our engagement trip, we felt like 2 sheep in a hotel of 2000. Our host ditched us as soon as she read off the hotel info and restaurants and never saw her again although she promised us engagement surprises and told us one of them would be champagne to our room which never came, the room had many flaws; small, granite falling off walls, everything was very “used”. Lighting for my fiancé’s make up was a joke. The outlets only worked half the time. Pool was falling apart. Beach and Bali beds were nice. The spa was obnoxiously loud due to the layout of the YHI spa, you’re getting a message that was expensive feet from where people are in the pool screaming and yelling and getting a message in that environment was a disgrace, this is a short list, prepare to be forgot about. We booked this trip last minute and decided on this hotel because we had stayed at Melia Playa before and in hopes it was close to the same. They complete opposites.

reviews.author: JoshyPenguin
reviews.title: Not delivering to potential
reviews.text:
The hotel is in a fabulous location on the Cancun strip with a glorious white sand beach and clear sea. The interior of the hotel also looks impressive with greenery and water features. 

In addition the service we received was efficient and very friendly.

However there were a number of areas where the hotel didn't deliver:
- our check in experience was remarkably similar to a previous poster below. We were staying in a suite for 5 but the room only had bedding available for 2. We had to chase twice to get this rectified. When you have children and recognising the material time difference for us this wasn't a great start. In addition I would have hoped that previous feedback would have been heeded.
- two out of the five of us had food poisoning
- the a la carte restaurants were good but difficult to get a reservation. The quality of food at buffets was poor and became quite repetitive.
- for one a la carte restaurant they were apparently overbooked so we were moved to a nearby restaurant but with the same menu. Felt like second class citizens.

Overall it was an ok holiday but felt like it should have been better still...

reviews.author: Bob S
reviews.title: Beautiful place , but.....
reviews.text: My wife and I visited last week along with my 23 year old daughter. We did Royal Service which comes with an assigned “butler” and is in the adults only section of the hotel. Butler is really a service professional who is assigned to you but also services several other guests. More of like a personal concierge. Norma our butler was fantastic. She comes up to your room with you, shows you the amenities, naked restaurant and cabana reservations for you. Basically attends to all your needs. The hotel and grounds are beautiful. Really nice pools and beach. Cabanas are really nice too. Service on grounds was wonderful. Big shout outs to Daniel ( service supervisor) , Orlando, Eddie, Javier, and Oscar. They always made sure we had a drink of a bite to eat. Where the hotel faltered and the reason it didn’t get 5 stars from me was the food. It just wasn’t good. We first went to Bana , their sushi restaurant and it was awful . Sushi just didn’t taste fresh . It seemed it was frozen and the defrosted. We walked out. Their taco restaurant , Blue Agave, wasn’t much better. My daughter referred to it as dog food. Market Grill was ok, as was breakfast buffet which was a bit disappointing. My wife was sick with diarrhea for 2 days and I got a 24 hour bug. Food was so bad we went off property in 2 evenings. Not what you expect to do at an all inclusive. Best restaurant was La Playaba on Royal Service side. Even Mole , their Mexican restaurant had bad appetizers but decent mains. This should be a five star destination, but the food has to improve immensely.

reviews.author: AustinFelich
reviews.title: NOT AS GOOD AS FIRST TIME
reviews.text:
My wife and I got engaged at the Paradisus in 2016. We had been to other resorts in Cancun and the Paradisus was at the top. We made sure we went back. 

I read a lot of reviews before booking the second time, I should have taken them more seriously. Inside the hotel is very hot, you may not notice it the minute you walk in, but it won’t take long. It’s frustrating after a while. The inside of the resort is absolutely beautiful. The service is great, everyone is very nice. There were a couple workers who kept pushing the 90 minute breakfast to promote their Meliá time share deal. They wouldn’t take no for answer. I acted like I was on my phone multiple times to avoid these couple workers. The food was not as good this time around either. There were a couple restaurants under construction so that made the selection smaller. The breakfast at the two buffets is average at best. The snack bar by the pool had decent food. The wings there were really good and the pizza wasn’t bad. The market grill Brazilian steakhouse was good. The Asian restaurant Bana in the middle and the Mexican restaurant Blue agave were also good. My wife’s and her friends stomach were upset for multiple days. Not sure what it was from. 

The bartenders and waiters/waitresses at the pool were all awesome. Great service. One thing about the pool...the most shallow part is where the bar is, and there are kids all over and around the bar area. I don’t mind kids at all but there were way to many around the pool bar. 

Beach area is great, water and sand were amazing. The waiters/waitresses on the beach were all awesome also. 

The rooms were ok, nothing great or anything to really complain about them. I did feel like the AC worked less and less or got a little warmer as the week progressed. 

If it weren’t for the service I wouldn’t have given the resort three stars. We will always remember the Paradisus from getting engaged there. But we will be staying at another resort next time in Cancun.

reviews.author: Paul R
reviews.title: So much potential but lacking in many areas
reviews.text:
Visited late September for one week as a couple. The hotel location, grounds and pool/beach areas are really impressive. Food choice is poor, first night there we both had stomach upset. Service in general was very good, had no issues.
There is an issue with the temperature in the common areas, there is no AC working or even ventilation. Try to sit near a window that opens and hope the wind is blowing through.
Getting a sunbed by the pool is difficult but there are plenty on the beach. There are many Bali beds that were always empty. The management seem to have a ridiculous policy where you have to pay around US$170 per day for one of these, come on get real, if these were reduced to a realistic reasonable price they would be utilised much better.
Overall enjoyed the stay but would not recommend.

reviews.author: JKK123
reviews.title: Nice place but the food...just not good!
reviews.text:
I was at this resort for nine days so got to experience most of it A-Z.

First five days was work meetings at hotel w/ colleagues & last four days was vacation.  Wife was with me the entire time so was only vacation for her.

PROS:
1 SERVICE:  everyone working at resort was extremely nice & courteous...never had to wait on a refill or service request or anything...if every hotel/resort had this kind of service would be great
2 BEACH:  beautiful waterfront beach area...large & nobody really on this section of beach except for those at resort...we very much enjoyed beach time & plenty of covered areas for when you need a tanning break
3 LINENS:  good quality bedding & towels
4 ROOM:  big TV & plenty of ENGLISH channels as well as Spanish speaking channels
5 POOL:  HUGE pools winding all along beach...very nice!
6 LOCATION:  Only 15 minute drive from airport...easily accessible.

CONS:
1 POOL:  closed at 7 PM...what????   makes little sense to close a pool this early...most beach resorts are beach during day & pool time in evening...this made no sense?
2  CONDITION OF RESORT:  appears to be an older property...well maintained but certainly due for some new furniture in rooms, tidying of paint, etc
3  CONFUSION OF OFFERING:  at check-in no real instruction on resort activities, restaurants, etc; some restaurants closed & others open at times that did not match their website description; there was some evening entertainment but we did not know when/where/what...after some days we figured it all out but certainly at check-in a simple information packet would have made it much more enjoyable
4 WEBSITE:  poor website & does little to detail all the offerings resort has
5 ROOM SERVICE:  menu was fine but the $5 delivery charge was not welcome considering the $$ paid for an all-inclusive resort
6 FOOD:  OK...THIS WAS BY FAR THE BIGGEST ISSUE.  Although there were multiple restaurants the food was cheap cafeteria quality at best.  The presentation was very nice, dishes all looked attractive, variety was there, BUT in general it all tasted the same after a few days & food quality just not great.  Even the steaks were quite poor quality.  The BLUE AGAVE restaurant was only one that tasted like something I would pay for willingly at a restaurant BUT you can only eat tacos so many times in a week!  We ate (multiple times) at every restaurant there (except TEMPO which was not part of all-inclusive food) so it was just not good.  Pretty sad leaving a resort after a week craving decent food.  And odd but no easy place during day just to grab a simple sandwich/chips.  Every meal was very heavy.  In the outdoor dining (Enso) we did enjoy the salad/veg/fruit offerings BUT they really need to figure a way to keep things cooler in this warm climate.  Warm salad dressing is a recipe for disaster for sure!  Overall food was just NOT good...almost to point of "bad".

We did not use spa at all so no comments to make there.

OVERALL this resort was decent & for just a few days if price is right & someone just enjoys the drinking aspect of vacation (we are not drinkers) maybe this is okay choice.  But for a long stay I think w/ all the resorts in Cancun/Cozumel/Playa we will not return to this one sorry!

reviews.author: Jane
reviews.title: Paradisus Overview
reviews.text:
Overall, this was a very relaxing vacay. The staff is so nice and accommodating. When I got to the resort, they put me in a room in the oldest tower, that looked nothing like the room shown in the pictures, lagoon view junior suite. We marched right back to the front desk and were then placed in the right room. 

The food is subpar, make sure to book your dinner reservations ASAP. We were told upon check-in to book by 5 pm each day. On the last two nights, they had booked up and we were sick of buffet food, so we went to a nearby restaurant. (Side note: Lavo is a MUST VISIT, ask for Luis as your waiter, and get the rock shrimp. We had it 2 nights in a row, it was divine and not too pricey.)

The drinks and bars were awesome at Paradisus. The bartenders were even better, very nice and helpful with recommendations when you've had 40 too many margaritas that week.

The room itself was OK. The AC doesn't go lower than 65. The bed is fine up until night 4-5 (hard as a rock.) The maid didn't come at first, so on day 3 I had to call and request cleaning service. Room service is only $5 USD and the hotdogs (w/o chili) are great.

Other: The gelato shop is amazing, try the vanilla and coconut. Bring your own sunscreen, because its $40 USD for a spray bottle. 

Pro tip: Tip big on the first few days. The staff will know you by name within a day or two, and you are basically treated like royalty. We tipped the bartenders always.

reviews.author: Vlad G
reviews.title: When your expectations are higher than reality
reviews.text:
At Royal services we expected a bit upgrade,such as extended wine selection,a room comfort,as we used to have it elsewhere. Unfortunately we've been offered only 3 types of wines: white,red and sparkling. During our stay we changed our room 3 times,as AC was awfully noisy and we couldn't sleep well. We noticed the resort tries to be eco friendly and saves energy consumption,as the result overall temperature inside the building was quite high and uncomfortable.
Food was just mediocre,probably because 2 major eateries were under construction,which wasn't announced while we were shopping for this resort. Minor thing,but left some taste of unpleasantness.
The only really bright side of our stay (besides the Sea,of course) are people working there. They are genuinely friendly and really do whatever they can to make your stay comfortable.Thank you STAFF!

reviews.author: Estephany L
reviews.title: Should informed 3 if the restaurant are closed for renovations
reviews.text: We arrived 21st September, looking forward for the five stars service, but when we arrived the t was so confused, the front desk did not give out enough information about three restaurants been closed for renovations, and the website should stated they are under construction because we were looking forward for the international buffet and other restaurant like Vento, unfortunately they are closed. The hotel barely have sign have the room number, activities and restaurant hours , on top of that, there are no coffee and desserts available 24 hrs, their coffee are very average and this is Mexico right. Would I come back? No! Make sure states in website the restaurants are closed for renovations,

reviews.author: 362hugoh
reviews.title: Beautiful beach - average hotel
reviews.text: This hotel has to sections; normal and royal service. We were in royal service. This comes with a butler service. The hotel has a beautiful beach and the amenities are in okay condition. The food and drinks offered are sub par. The butler service is nice, however our butler had a day off during our 4 night stay and no substitute was appointed. We booked with an offer that gave us 500 USD in hotel credit. They forgot to mention that this credit was in the form of worthless coupons where most were for services already included. SPA and other offers on property is prices far over market price. There are lots of other hotels to choose from. We are Melia gold members, however this made no difference at property. Super slow service in all restaurants and by the pool. Beautiful beach.

reviews.author: Michelle B
reviews.title: Wish I could give it a better rating..
reviews.text:
Forewarning, unless you are booked in Royal Service, you will really feel the difference. 
Several restaurants were closed so choices were limited, Enso, Blue Agave, Mole and finally Market Grill, 
There is virtually no daytime entertainment or activities going on, which can make for a boring day, and there is no lounge with pool or ping pong tables, which would make a nice break if you wanted out of the sun.  There are no signs or notices as to what the nightly show will be or where, which was odd, but I found unless you wandered around on your own, there were no signs for the concierge desk or anything really.
The beach was beautiful, and we lucked out that we always found chairs, 
We only went to the pool once, and it was ok.. 
my biggest gripe.. The room, we were in 1414 in the Club Melia tower
It was old, and in need of renovating, desperately. We want down to the check in desk, and asked if we could change rooms, and although the resort was apparently at  60% capacity, this could not be accommodated if we wanted to keep our king bed ?!?!   We were given the option of 2 beds or spent the $480.00 USD to upgrade to Royal Service, NOT COOL    
We were told others would love our King bed,this left a bad taste in my mouth
We asked to be put on a list if a room came up, and other than a phone call the same day asking if the room was ok (I said not really) no one ever followed up.
Overall I'm not one to complain, but would I consider this a 5 star vacation ? NO, would I come back here ? NO

reviews.author: Annie T
reviews.title: Pluses and minuses
reviews.text:
Dated but still beautiful. Grand entrance brings outdoors in. They are renovating so it will be even nicer. Some restaurants were closed so that was a bit disappointing, but overall pleased with food options. Don’t like the initial timeshare pressure sale, but just tactfully and firmly decline. Rooms are dated as well but nice sized (at least one bedroom) though divider was heavy, glass, and very hard to use. Liked that there was a full kitchenette if you wanted to use including a nice sized mini fridge. Perfect for families. Balcony was nice with tub (nice thought... although super dirty so would never use). 

Spa was nice. Again dated but facilities included pool with multiple jets, vitality soaking area, sauna, steam room, etc.  Expected more of a spread for snacks instead it was literally a jar of peanuts and a jar of slivered almonds. Nice staff and attendants. Massage was pretty good. Expensive of course, but still nice and worth the relaxing time. Beach has a lot of seaweed but still nice area and not busy. 

Worst part was getting sick... either heat or food... but miserable for part of trip. Then baby got sick as well but different. Caused by kiddie pool according to the pediatrician when we got back stateside. So, very unfortunate ending to the trip...

reviews.author: Cathy D
reviews.title: Embarrassing encounter at pool
reviews.text: We were so impressed by the Melia Paradisus Cancun resort that on our first day  we decided to sit through the sales presentation about their rewards program, and were even seriously considering purchasing the package for both of our families. We were having this discussion by the pool under an umbrella, when an hour and a half later, another guest and her family came “back” to these chairs and hovered over us for over 30 minutes, causing a scene and even speaking to the waitstaff and pool staff about us. (We had done nothing; it was embarrassing.) When we spoke to pool management all they said is they accommodated the other family so we should be okay now. While I can appreciate this, nothing was done to help us. It certainly left an impression... accommodate the load screaming lady by giving her an upgrade or cabana... tell the innocent guests they are “ok” now. That said, we have found a super sweet pool server in Asunción.

reviews.author: ninad
reviews.title: No wow feeling this time
reviews.text: We are presently at the resort 3 days in and I’m must say that the experience I  had 3 yrs ago was not the same ! Resort is showing it’s age and presently 3 restaurants are closed for  renovations ! I was given a side partial ocean view in pyramid 4 (last time was given ocean view higher floor in main pyramide without asking for any upgrades) I was surprised  to know that rooms have tubs/shower with over 2ft climb can be tricky is you are not  careful I asked if any rooms have walk-in showers and was suggested the first floor handicap room which I declined since we are not handicap and that room would kill any vacation vibe !!! The staff are all amazing they work hard and will accommodate  any requests !  The buffet is just okay I’ve had better and the à la carte restaurants like Mole mexicain and Bano Japanese are pretty good .  The other downside for me is trying to get a good night rest as the air conditioning runs very loud once in the middle of the night it sounded like a jet engine ! The pool and beach are great we find the cost of the Bali beds too expensive as I’ve stayed in other resorts and if you get one early enough ... are free! I am a Meliá reward customer and always chose this chain and I’ve been acknowledged at other resorts with upgrades in Punta  Cana, Cuba but not in Cancun so this resort will not be on my return list as there are so many more option along  the Cancun coast !

reviews.author: Anna Z
reviews.title: Aug 29-Sept 5
reviews.text:
Me and my boyfriend came here for 7 days and we have mixed feelings about this resort. 
Pros: Big Resort, Close to the airport and mall, amazing service, and nice view of both ocean and lagoon. Royal service (adults only) is absolutely necessary and worth the upgrade!! With out it this resort feels more like a 3 star. 

Cons: Food is TERRIBLE unless you're apart of the Royal Service. Royal Service has an exclusive restaurant called La Palapa which is pretty good for breakfast, lunch & dinner. Market Grill is also good for dinner (Brazilian steak house) but during the day its a tiny buffet with nothing other than salad and pasta. 
Entertainment is pretty lame unless you're into listening to opera and watching dancing performances. 
Room service is hit and miss, somedays they wont clean your room until 4/5pm and some days its done by 1. Fridge also isn't stocked every day.  
Condition of the room is pretty good, i felt like the shower needed some updating but no big deal. It seems like most of the hotel is going through renovation, 2-3 restaurants were closed so our options were very limited. 

Over all i dont think we would ever come back to this resort.

reviews.author: Simone W
reviews.title: Paradisus, but not the same as I’ve known it...
reviews.text:
Having stayed at two previous FC Paradisus properties ( Esmeralda in Playa Del Carmen & The Reserve In Punta Cana) I was really looking forward to my stay on the white sand beaches of Cancun.  I must say that I left disappointed.  Not due to the staff, our concierge Alexa was always keeping in touch and kept my two kids in all the chocolate milk and nighttime gifts and most of the wait staff, spa staff and Kids/baby club staff were great.  It was just overall the experience was not the same.

Pro’s
