Really close to the airport - maximum 25 minutes transfer
Lovely beach and sea not too rough, so you could swim, but no young kids as waves quite strong.
FC lounge - great snacks all day, staff knowledgeable although kids play area in lounge requires updating.
Great room service - in fact the food was better by room service than in the restaurants ( which should not be the case!).

Con’s
FC service amenities no way as good as previous. Towel cards, lack of FC beach space - poor in comparison.
Food - not great at all - three restaurants closed whilst we were there. Vegetarian options really bad.
Bali-beds should be unlimited in FC having it for only one day is silly especially as they sit there unused as no one wants to pay for them. 
FC is in Tower three and nightly entertainment is in the atrium of this tower. So loud music after 8pm is not great for young familiies. 
Property is very old and is showing its age, despite the upgrades to rooms.

Yes to FC, but not in Cancun again.

reviews.author: Max N
reviews.title: Average Resort
reviews.text:
I spent 7 days, 6 nights here. I primarily chose the hotel because it was rated highly by many of the users on Expedia & TripAdvisor plus I had some acquaintances tell me it was good. To start, the check in process was a little frustrating. We had requested two rooms with 2 double beds but were told they were no longer available and rooms with king beds were only available. After some negotiation, we managed to get the rooms as requested. The rooms are mediocre at best - with outlets that don’t work & a gazillion light switches. The shower controls were confusing as you have to play around with it to get the desired water temperature. Beds were comfy.
Pools were clean and very well maintained. The bars and all the staff members were courteous and friendly throughout our stay. Particularly, Ignatcio at Enso was helpful. 
Food wise, many of the dishes were similar with not that much variety. Outside of the market grill which serves primarily an assortment of meats, most of the other restaurants had similar foods and minimal variety. In the Japanese restaurant, sushi was 90% rice with very little fish / veggies in it. The desserts were awful. I had “fried banana with rice pudding” and it was horrendous. Most of the restaurants offer a buffet-styled design. My favorite restaurant was the sunset grill - the chicken burgers are good there. Overall, the food was just average. 
For entertainment, there was very few options. There is a lounge called the red lounge open from 10 PM - 2 AM which is small and mostly people with family / significant others. By the market grill, they have shows occasionally. 
At the beaches & poolside, they have Bali beds but they have to be paid for (pretty expensive) just to use. I’ve noticed that most of the time they’re empty meanwhile other people can’t find tanning beds to occupy. It’s a ridiculous policy. Room service costs a $5 delivery fee. Massages are $150 per person. And one of the restaurants is not included in the all inclusive package deal. The Mediterranean restaurant was also closed for renovations. 
I highly recommend activities to be done here (jet ski, scuba diving, paragliding, etc either through Expedia / TripAdvisor or you can book on the resort itself, they have agents there). The resort itself is relatively bland in the evening.
Overall, it was just a decent stay. I wouldn’t necessarily say it was a 5 star experience though. More like a 3/5.

reviews.author: V M
reviews.title: Redemption of ENZO'S Restaurant
reviews.text: The food at the resort was just ok during our stay. More than 4 resort restaurants were closed for reconstruction. It would have been nice to be informed of this. Even some employees seemed ill-informed as to where guest could eat depending upon their purchased room package. The last night we ate at Enzo's and it was the most thoughtful customer service and delicious food we had during our entire stay. Rafael was our waiter and he did a magnificent job of going above and beyond. EAT THERE AND ASK FOR RAFAEL. This isolated experience gets a 5/5 from us. Customer service overall is 4.5/5. YHI Spa was 5/5. The general organization 3.5/5 for a lot of little issues.

reviews.author: Pete
reviews.title: The A team
reviews.text: My family and I just stayed at Paradisus Cancun for the first time, and we were not that impressed. I will say that the rooms were clean and AC was good, but as for the lobby and the rest of the building, there is no AC at all. I will say that the staff was excellent, especially the A team that took care of us (Alfredo, Abraham, and Alejandro).  The food was good, especially at Vento, Blue Agave, and Mole.

reviews.author: JRM426
reviews.title: If you like AC don’t stay here
reviews.text: It seems that there’s a lack of AC in the entire hotel, including common areas. The rooms don’t go below a certain temperature so if you’re like me and need cooler temperatures to sleep, stay away.  Vacation week turned into miserable week of poor sleep and crankiness. You should be in better conditions on vacation than at home. It’s the least you can hope for. Instead, I couldn’t wait to board the plane back. What a waste.

reviews.author: Anushk G
reviews.title: Too Hot, Buffet was mediocre
reviews.text:
The hotel has no air conditioning in the lobbies, most of the restaurants and they set a limit for AC in the rooms as well making it very unenjoyable to eat in the buffet, restaurants and even in the rooms. It was in the 90s in Cancun for most of my stay, and it was that same heat in the hotel as well which is very unexpected of a 5 star resort. It is very bad when you start sweating the second you start walking anywhere, or while eating at every restaurant and buffet. 
We are a vegetarian family, and the buffet lacked any variety for vegetarians. They also had no live cooking stations.
The resort also charges for many of the extras such as cabanas and they say that they are going to give you $550 in resort credits but then they just give you a useless coupon book with $10 off a insanely priced amenity which is totally unexpected.

Some positives were the staff who were absolutely brilliant. The restaurants, although not air conditioned did have delicious food. The infrastructure of the hotel is beautiful with stuff going on nonstop throughout the day. 

The hotel looks like a rainforest inside which was amazing, however, it also feels like a rainforest which is awful.

reviews.author: Naa Adzeley B
reviews.title: very boring hotel-would not recommend for young ones
reviews.text:
Extremely boring hotel-would not recommend if you are under 30 because of lack of entertainment. 
The food is very average but not as bad as I expected
I will say however that the staff goes above and beyond to please its guest

reviews.author: dbaird2019
reviews.title: Make sure the A/C in your room works.
reviews.text: Our overall experience was positive, with the exception of the service for the a/c in our room, and the inability of front staff to make decisions on their own to provide a “problem fixed” experience.

reviews.author: ATNG01
reviews.title: Many thing changed since 2017
reviews.text: Wonderful 2 yeas ago but not now. Need improvement or bring back your service including night activities, kid's activities and especially .the food and kitchen such like before. We like your resource but don't be back if we don't have a quality service. Thanks

reviews.author: Morgan M
reviews.title: Issues with hotel room
reviews.text:
I want to start off on a positive note. The property itself is beautiful. The pool is excellent, the beach is clean and the staff was pleasant. 
However, upon arrival be prepared to stand for about an hour just to check-in. This is the slowest process. Also, be aware that your room request you booked is not guaranteed. We had a group of 15 arriving and 4 of the rooms we booked were supposed to be doubles according to what we booked online. Upon arrival, we were told those rooms were not guaranteed and were not available and they had to bring rollaway cots to our rooms. Because the rooms are smaller, these cots made it impossible to move around the room. The rooms are extremely outdated and do not match the rest of the property. The air conditioning units went out in 2 of our rooms. This happened to multiple people at the resort per our conversations with them at the pool. This was an open thing that many guests were complaining about. Our family (multiple rooms) had to move to other rooms throughout our stay just to have air conditioning. 
As I mentioned the property is beautiful and the food and drinks were great, but the rooms side, from check-in to check-out, was a nightmare.

reviews.author: Edward
reviews.title: Okay Service
reviews.text: I didn't like how they separate their members vs their guess. They do not provide a full Cancun experience. The sales personal are everywhere, and they try to sale their product at all the time. The staff wasn't as courdious as I expected to be

reviews.author: David L
reviews.title: All good execept registration
reviews.text:
We just got back from a week stay at Paradisus Cancun.  Lets get the bad stuff out of the way first.  The registration process was horrible!!!  After traveling all day to get there, it took 1 hour and 5 minutes to wait in line and get registered!  There were only about 5 groups in front of us but there were only two employees doing registration.  There was a third employee that handled only 1 guest.  It took about 25 minutes to check-in each group.  There were many employees standing around but apparently they were not trained to check-in guests.  

We had requested a king bed on a high floor.  They said the only king available was on floor #2.  Since that was our only choice we took it.  When we got to the room it had 2 double beds and it was immediately above the buffet.  Really?  We went back down to registration and they said that was the only room available and to come back the next morning because rooms would be available.  The next morning we were told there were not any king beds available.  I asked how that could be possible with so many people checking out.  He said that was the way it was.  So we ended up this two double beds on the 4th floor.

This was our second trip to Paradisus Cancun so we knew what to expect.  The food was good.  The waiters and waitresses were great, especially the beach crew including Ascension, Faviola, Gabriella, and Flor.  Alejandro in the Market Grill was great too.  

The beach towels were threadbare and could use replacement.  Also, my wife used the Royal Service beach bathroom which had cloth towels which she really liked until she saw the employee folding the used towels and putting them back for reuse!  Gross.  

All in all a good trip but next time we might give another resort a try.

reviews.author: ariel408
reviews.title: Resort experience was average
reviews.text:
Their website doesn’t give you a lot of information.

When you check in, you are initially bugged by sales calls for airport transportation, excursions, etc. 

Restaurants: Even though there are 9, some are only open for dinner, one is royal service section (upgraded cost for adults only), some are reservation only. Hard to get seated together when traveling with a large group. Most with no AC. Restaurants aren’t easy to find/get to since at least three (Fuego, Vento, and Market Grill) are just sectioned off areas of their main dining area, Naos. Enso was supposed to be Asian fusion but it just did not taste right.  Blue Agave had good tacos and quesadillas and they’re open for late night snacking. Most of our group wound up with stomach issues during the trip. The Paradisus may have high AAA ratings but they are not for the restaurants. 

Coffee stand is only open for a few hours in the morning and in the afternoon. Gelato stand is only open two hours a day.

Room: AC worked really well, beds nice and firm. They don’t restock the mini fridge every night. You have to request it and even then sometimes they don’t come.

Beach: At the time we went, there was a lot of seaweed in water and on sand. Water choppy and red flagged so swimming wasn’t allowed. Many stairs/steps to get down to beach. Not great for those with knee or back problems.

Pools: Didn’t have enough chairs, umbrellas or towels. Some were fairly deep, even though they didn’t fill the pools up to the capacity line. One of the ladders in the pools only had two steps for getting in and out - the bottom ones must be missing because it’s practically at your chest level so it made it almost impossible to use it to get out of the pool. One pool only had beverage service and no food service. One pool is Royal Service only. Towel cards must all be returned at check out or else they will charge you.

They have activities for kids but it is limited to 15 max. In the evenings they have a show with dancers or singers, sometimes inside the hotel, sometimes out by the pool. The Avenue Bar has some entertainment in the evening with a small area for dancing. Seats are tough to get.

There are a few boutiquey stores on the first level (beach wear, jewelry, Quiksilver, souvenirs). There is another large store on floor zero with clothing, souvenirs, snacks, drinks. They also do currency exchange at a better rate than the Cancun airport.
It feels like there is no AC in the center of hotel but they burn incense on a regular basis and it makes the already heavy, humid air feel even heavier.

Some staff were super friendly and attentive, some were rude. The buses to take you up and down the hotel zone are only 12 pesos but they can get crowded. The buses are fast and bumpy.

reviews.author: xguest2019
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: Average Hotel, nothing fancy on the rooms, very nice entrance and main building but rooms not according to hotel shape, need to improve service, so far so good but nothing that can tell about they are beyond other brands.

reviews.author: Juan T
reviews.title: June/July Trip
reviews.text:
Very nice hotel. You can tell it's in need of some renovations. We were there for 6 nights, I got sick on my second night there (stomach bug). The hotel burns incense that over powers the entire hotel, having the stomach bug plus this smell was not good for me at all, even thinking of the smell now makes me sick.

Hotel staff is super awesome.
The food sucks ( I mean how can you mess up tacos in Mexico?!?) 
We paid over 6k for a six night stay and it was not worth the money. I could have spent half that and would of had a better experience in Florida or any other US beach.

reviews.author: Cindy L
reviews.title: 3.5 Rating - Services leaves much to be desired
reviews.text:
My actual rating is 3.5, not quite a 4, but a little better than a 3.
Here are my observations:

Facilities: Great
The place is beautiful.  The color, the décor, the design is all worthy of a 5 star resort.  I don't believe they have air conditioning in the main areas or the hallways.  It's very humid and hot at all times.  I found the fragrances they use a little overwhelming.  They have a baby room and a kids room.  I only have experience with the baby room.  You're allowed to leave your infant there if they are over a year old and can stand by themselves. There's a room there with a TV and toys.  Mostly they just play tv for the kids there.  There's limited arts and crafts and the girls there will do face painting.  There's also a little climbing gym for young children.  There's also washrooms and a change table in the womens/girls washroom.  There's no shoes or food or drinks allowed, but even then, because of the humidity the room seems a little grimy and gritty.  Not sure how often they actually clean the room or the toys but my daughter picked up Hand, Foot, Mouth from there.  She had a fever the day after we came back, based on an incubation period of 3-6 days she 100% picked it up from the resort.  Not impressed but also it couldn't be helped as my daughter has a tendency to put everything in her mouth or put her mouth on everything.
They have decently fast wifi everywhere in the resort.
It seems like they have a lot of activities, none of which we used.
They have bars everywhere.
They had quite a few huts for shade by the pool.  You can also rent one of the bali beds for $.  Didn't do it so not sure how much it is.  But they do have electrical outlets built into each bali bed too so you can charge your devices.  

Room:  Junior Suite Ocean View - Good
View was beautiful.  Balcony was private.  It's nice that in the afternoon, thanks to their architecture, you always get shade on your balcony if you're facing the ocean.
The room itself was nice.  It looked clean.  There's no coffee maker, so having to warm my baby's bottle required several soakings in hot tap water.  Eventually we called them and asked for a coffee maker and they graciously delivered one.  Their mini fridge has canned beer, pop, juice boxes and bottles of water.  We pushed our double beds together to create one big bed since we never got our request for a king-sized bed.  After we moved the bed we noticed stains on the floor that look like they've been there for awhile.  The sheets are nice and soft but they have just an uncovered comforter sandwiched between 2 flat sheets...I'd rather they encase their comforter and give me a flat sheet instead because it was a pain to peel the flat sheet off when I only wanted to use the flat sheet.  
The a/c is strong but a little on the loud side.  Although the noise does help drown out the noise you hear from the hallways because you can hear everybody passing by.
Our room was situated on top Vento.  So we were very close to the nightly performances which were SUPER loud.  Luckily my infant didn't have any trouble sleeping to it but I can see it bothering others.
The bathroom has a tub with a rain shower and a handheld shower head.  There's a toilet and a bidet.  They give you just basic toiletries: shower gel/shampoo, conditioner, and lotion.  All were decent.  
There's a hair dryer, iron and room safe.  Our room safe was out of batteries when we got there and had to wait for security to come and change our batteries for us.
Apparently a/c gathers condensation so we had a bit of a dripping issue in our bathroom.

Food: Pretty Good
We tried every restaurant but the paid one.  They were all ok.  Not the greatest but better than passable.  There's two omelette stations in the morning at the buffet.  The line up for the omelette station is always long.  There's also a juice bar.  Typical fare.  Sometimes there's a wait to be seated for breakfast.  If you don't want to wait you can go to ENSO.  The A/C is extremely weak if maybe not even on in the buffet and the glass panes block the strong breeze from the ocean so sitting there for breakfast is quite hot.  We gave up trying to eat breakfast there after the 3/4th day and instead just ordered room service.  
Bana one was ok.  I did enjoy their octopus and sea bass sashimi.  Everything else was only so-so.
The restaurants book up quickly, you pretty much have to book two days in advance.  There's an app of theirs you can download to request bookings but then you end up having this back and forth because you can only request a booking without seeing actual availabilities.  
Blue agave was a disappointment.  
At Vento we ordered about 7/8 dishes, and 2 of them were good, can't remember which ones they were anymore.
Didn't try Enso at night.  Checked out their menu.  Looks like it would be a disappointment.  Weird choice of dishes.
Market Grill was ok.  I remember two of the steak dishes were good.  The chicken was alright.  The pork was too dry.
Fuego had the best service out of all the restaurants.  Food was good too, just portions are little smaller than we expected.
Mole's food was so-so.  Maybe it was my mistake ordering duck confit from a restaurant that's service contemporary Mexican.  I remember one of the appetizers was extremely salty.  

Service:  Poor
We got attitude from the guy who checked us in.  He forgot to give us towel keys.  Not sure who dropped the ball, whether it was the resort or our travel agents but we got neither the king size bed we requested nor the baby crib.  We had to request twice for a baby crib with their concierge.  They gave us a Graco pack n play, which is fine.  Another couple we met said they first delivered a tiny crib and they had to ask for another.  On the second day, our daughter's sleep schedule kept conflicting with when the cleaning service would try and come to our room so we skipped it the first day.  I find it annoying that they would call the room to ask if we wanted our room cleaned as their phone call would almost always interrupt my infant's nap.  The second day the cleaning staff came in they took all our dirty towels and didn't leave us any new ones.  We had to call the concierge to ask them to bring us towels.  I wouldn't trust their cleaning if I were you.  They didn't change our bedsheets once while we were there, just made our beds.  
Their waitstaff in general are pretty slow and need to be asked several times to do something.  We asked about 3x for a high chair and was brought one with a broken strap.  We gave up on asking for high chairs and just brought our own booster.
The concierge doesn't break bills for you, so either bring a lot of ones and fives or be prepared to awkwardly ask the waitstaff to break bills for you.
There's a towel hut near the kids pools and it seems like they're always out of towels towards the end of the day.

reviews.author: Basat K
reviews.title: Was an Okay stay.
reviews.text: Went here as a company trip, resort looked amazing, room was nice and clean. The pool was really nice. There were some major drawbacks, there were only two restaurants with good food and service, I would recommend everyone go check out Mole and enso. The food at the other locations were just bad. Service at the resort was horrible, you asked question and no one knew the answer or they would direct you to someone else who did not know the answer. We were given a coupon book to use at the resort, the whole book was useless. We followed strict guidelines of how and where we can use them, the places where we would go they would either reject it or said it is not attached to my reservation even though I got the book the day I checked in. Elevators were super slow, and they only had one working on our side, but we used the stairs. The pool was super hot, and I wish they had some shade. I could keep going, but overall the resort was nice and clean, the room was good, but everything else was okay....

reviews.author: Brimal13
reviews.title: “Obnoxious guests”
reviews.text: We went there through timeshare. Resort is huge, staff is friendly and helpful. For a large resort like this they need more restaurants and some updates especially on the side for their timeshare guests. Not a resort to go to if you don’t speak spanish. My daughter was bullied by some kids but she knows some Spanish and knew exactly what they were saying.  One day we rented a cabana and when we got to it after breakfast it was occupied with some guests. The pool concierge told them to move but we had the feeling they wanted to pick a fight because they kept carrying on about it and give us dirty looks. I would not go back to Cancun in the future.

reviews.author: yan e
reviews.title: Mixed Bag
reviews.text:
Still at the hotel 2 more days but wanted to write a bit about my stay

Paradisus Cancun. What I find is that it’s a mixed bag. You have families, couples and all walks of life. Not a 5 star resort by any means. limited shade by pool. They want to sell cabanas. Not 5 star quality food. Very light on fresh fish,lobster, and even grilled shrimp. Actually food is hit or miss. Very inconsistent. If your a beach person be prepared there is seaweed everywhere. The employees do go out of their way with friendly attentive customer service. 

Limited activities after 6:00. Would I come back probably not. Does meet expectations.

reviews.author: Hubert L
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: Last week, we personally found this resort substantially less appealing than other Paradisus properties that we have visited. We had concierge service that was of minimal help to our group. We were told that the pyramid were stayed in had just been updated within the past year. It had. As a retired construction tradesman of four decades, I would describe the repairs as Workman-like definitely not of Craftsman quality. The buffet food is typical of what one would expect. They insisted on serving food in the sit down restaurants, “family style”. We had to finally insist on ordering a meal that we wanted directly from the menu. The staff was cordial, two of whom were exceptional. The sixteen of us, in consensus, have decided not to return there in the future. The value we received for our dollar was definitely less than we had expected.

reviews.author: Chris H
reviews.title: Resort is showing its age. Highly attentive staff attempt to offset somewhat disappointing Royal Service and Hotel
reviews.text:
My wife and I opted for the Royal Service for the adult-only atmosphere. The Royal Service is basically a separated wing of the hotel with it's own pool, restaurant and beach area. We would have been tortured by the amount of children chaos happening in the general public pool. Hard working wait-staff constantly tended to the Royal Service areas. So in this regard the RS was the only way we could have enjoyed this hotel (more of a necessity than a perk).

My issue is that, for the price we paid, I wasn't impressed with the food or upkeep of the facility. The pool was dated, crusty and people were complaining about the green algae in the water. It did not appear that the pool-side bed linens were washed day-to-day. I noticed some bird droppings where a water-fall feature flowed into the pool. Overall a turn-off. 

Problem #2: The RS can't protect you from the inevitability of the common areas: The buffet food was mediocre. All of the restaurants we visited looked outdated and tired. The menus were falling apart or disgustingly worn/soiled with stains, etc. The 
 5-day stay I had 2 or 3 meals that I would have paid for if it weren't included. Everything else was simply not enjoyable/disappointing. Your adult-only RS atmosphere doesn't apply in the restaurants where you will be seated next to families with kids for better or worse. The night-shows were basically for kids. We attended a few nights but left after a few minutes. However there was nowhere for us to go since the RS pool area, bar and restaurant all close down about 7pm. So we basically retreated to our room

A few other tidbits:
-The $500 resort credit is basically a coupon book you can use to get $10 off a massage or some other extra purchase you make. We used none of this and I felt it was deceivingly advertised on the website. We thought this would offset the premium hotel price a little bit but you'd have to spend thousands of dollars extra to receive your $500 benefit.
-The butler service helped coordinate restaurant bookings and pool-side beds. Helpful but I don't think we needed it.
-The ocean in this area of Mexico was very rough and full of seaweed. You could not swim, snorkel or do anything recreational on site unlike other resorts we've stayed at.

Overall I'm a bit surprised by how good the reviews are for this resort. My wife and I have stayed at a few other all-inclusive resorts in Mexico with exponentially better value.

reviews.author: Journey767483
reviews.title: Beautiful property but beware
reviews.text:
The hotel is beautiful, well maintained and clean. The staff was fantastic, friendly and hard working. Food was fine. Our favorites were Vento, ibana and Blue agave. 
We had to switch our room 3 times because air conditioning was not working.They were accommodating and fixed the problem quickly. Our teens room had a leak from the ceiling AC vent. They did come pretty fast to fix it. 
Our biggest complaint was there is basically NO AC in the resort. Except for the room and maybe 2 restaurants ..... it’s unbearable. The check in area no AC, vaos buffet no ac, market grill no AC, the avenue bar , the red lounge nightclub no ac. The list goes on and on. We would rush through dinner just to run back to our rooms to find relief. Not happy to spend thousands of dollars on a vacation and be uncomfortable for most of the trip. 
I did ask an employee and she said the AC is broken. Not what u would expect from a 5 star hotel. If there was air conditioning in the resort it would have been a great trip!

reviews.author: Sportsfam5
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: The Paradisus is a beautiful resort, well maintained and very clean.  We also chose ocean front... but you can not see the ocean when you are sitting in the chairs... for us, I wish we had chosen a lagoon view.  We chose the family concierge and have to tell you it was not worth the extra money at all.  Out concierge really did nothing for us but book our reservations for dinner.  The food is only ok for the most part.  Vento was the only restaurant that was really good.  Stay away from Fuego... worst meal I have ever eaten. David was our water in the beach (the beach that all guests can use) and he was AMAZING!  The weather was fantastic.  While I am glad we came to Cancun, we won’t be coming back.

reviews.author: Mark H
reviews.title: 25th anniversary
reviews.text: Stayed at the Paradisus two years ago and used the family concierge service. The concierge was very attentive and worked to make sure we had an enjoyable trip. This year the hotel overall was more concerned about selling the timeshare aspect of the property than your overall experience. You cannot get a bottle of alcohol sent to the room which is very different than two years ago. You cannot take any food out of the buffet restaurant or get chased down and made to go back into restaurant to eat it. We experienced this first hand when after getting such poor service at fruegos restaurant we decide to stop in the buffet and get a ice cream and cake for dessert upon leaving the host chased us down the hall in front of everyone and demanded that we return to the restaurant to eat it. The concierge could nothing about it, how embarrassing.

reviews.author: Inaj
reviews.title: Nice place but very crowded
reviews.text: I went during December 2018 for a 5 day vacation. I arrived at 2pm and waited over 2 hours to check in. Once checked in, I went to my room and there was water gushing down the walls. I didn't know where it was coming from so I slipped and fell and fractured my ankle bone. No one answered when I called the front desk or concierge and my husband had to run to the front desk and retrieve someone. They upgraded us to Royal Service and a better room since I fell and fractured my ankle. The food is okay but the royal service restaurant was the best! I say upgrade to the Royal Service since it's not worth going there if you don't have it.

reviews.author: breezy2011
reviews.title: Average stay at Paradissus Cancun
reviews.text:
Our family was here for 7 days with the family concierge.  The stay was okay over all but the concierge service is a bit misleading.  The butlers are great at coordinating and scheduling dinners for you but that was all that they did.  The name "butler" is misleading and it should be "coordinator" instead. I  believe that in the family concierge description, they should change butler to coordinator instead.  When you hear "butler" you think someone will be with you to assist your needs and requests.  But this was not the case, and everything was via "whatssapp"  Granted they were very quick in responding to your question but you didnt feel pampered.  One of my questions was "are we able to order foods from the pool" which was standard at these types of resorts.  The reply was "no, drinks only, you could go get food from the pool restaurant yourself"  What type of butlers service was that? 
Overall, foods were average, nothing to write home about.
Beach: lots of seaweed
Pool: great pools 
Facility: clean
Kids center: great staff and they did an awesome job
Room: very small but clean

reviews.author: RLY59
reviews.title: Better than 3 1/2 stars but not quite 4 stars
reviews.text:
These are just our observations while staying here from June1-8. 
 The resort is a 4 diamond resort based on AAA. And as such certain criterias have to be met and adhere to. For the most part, Paradisus Cancun achieve that rating. However, there are some inconsistancies that need to be address in order for this resort to be considered above average. 
 Upon arrival, we upgraded to Royal Service, but kept our lagoon view room.  The upgrade allowed us to access everything except the royal service rooms. With royal service, we were guaranteed 2 Bali bed reservations for our entire stay at the Adluts only pool and royal service beach front. You could use the Bali beds if no one claimed them or had reservations on that day. This was important as we found that we could not find one spot around the other pools that affords us shade. 
The rooms were satisfactory but dated. Maid service was consistantly good and mini bar was stocked to our requests. 
 Food is so very subjective, so I will only say that ingredients were fresh and you should be able to find something to eat. They did make a point of asking about allegies at each of the restaruants we visited. Like others have noted, the buffet area does need AC. Also note, they will benefit from having a hawk and it's handler at the resort to keep the other birds away. 
 Entertainment was surprisingly abundant and varied. There was always one show around 8 then had  some musical guest at the Avenue bar at around 9-9:30. We did enjoy the live music there on many occasions.
 Now comes the real reason why I rated this resort as noted. 
 Service on the whole was very good . There were some exceptions in the Adults only pool and royal service beach area that drag their ratings down. First, there was one pool concierge who literally looked like he was doing you a favor by acknowledging you. Never crack a smile, and seemed really put off by any interactions with us. Second, while at the royal service beach area one day( 4 hours in the afternoon) not once did we receive any service for drinks. We did see them many times servicing the beach side Bali beds but they just didn't bother to go down to the beach. Now since we upgraded to royal service, we definitely did not expect such bad service. 
 Having upgraded to royal service, you would think service would be better than non royal parts of the resort, sadly that was not the case. 
 No resort is perfect, and for the most part,we enjoyed our stay. However, I just can't reconcile these major gaffs in service. Would we come back? Probably not. 
 Ultimately, I would rate this as a lower end 4 diamond resort

reviews.author: Climber33210103638
reviews.title: Read if you have kids
reviews.text:
No A/C very hot inside resort 
Needs to be kid proof for families with kids. 
Food is great
Margaritas are great
Service at market grill is great 
Photo services are way to expensive the cheapest package is 350 dls I means come on. Rich people are rich for a reason

reviews.author: FlashLosAngeles
reviews.title: Great room and beach, forget the front desk
reviews.text: I was in Cancun on business.  When trying to check out the night before departure -- I had a 4 AM pick up for the airport -- I realized that there were errors on the bill and they could not run the final bill since the last night would not post until later that evening.  While I believed that we resolved some, but not all of the errors, and was not completely pleased before going to bed late, I did expect that I would receive a copy of the bill when leaving the hotel at 4 AM.  At 4 AM they could not give me a copy, I was told to leave my email, which I did and that they would email me later that day.  Well, now more that 2 weeks later no copy of the bill, which is critical for travel reimbursement.  Not only that, but in calling the hotel they could not provide me with a bill.  Perhaps it is ok for a vacation but not for a conference in Cancun. In addition, I came back ill, which I believe was from the ice.

reviews.author: ploaco
reviews.title: Stay away from high pressure sales people.
reviews.text:
Hotel is fine, food is fine and service is fine. “Time share” people ... not good. They are very pushy until you go to a meeting and push you to want to spend 60K on 50 years of vacations. 🤣Yeah right! Do the math and you will see how much a loss this could be. Stay away! We went to the 90 minute meeting to get our half price excursion tickets. The salespeople were annoyed we never flinched and WE asked a million questions. We literally had to be rude to get out of our situation. This didn’t ruin our vacation at all... in fact, it was so comical,it was entertaining dinner conversation with friends we were traveling with. I’d never stay here again but I’d say hotel is a tad over average. Just so HOT is my biggest complaint. Some friendly staff members and okayfood- it all tastes a bit off.
The pool closes at 7 which is not fun and there is a ton of seaweed. (Currently June 2019)

reviews.author: Climber42464279896
reviews.title: Dissatisfied
reviews.text: This hotel was amazing two years ago. I don't know what happened this year. The food was terrible and extremely salty. The service was poor and the waiters were inattentive in the taco restaurant. The evening shows were not that entertaining. The only good part would be the bars and the beach. Honestly, would not recommend to a friend.

reviews.author: Wander67123093167
reviews.title: Paradisus May 2019
reviews.text: Very hot humid in lobby no ac, hotel feels old outdated , not many food selections and the restaurant that requires reservations are generally booked . The lighting in the room is dark. The shower water is weak with no pressure

reviews.author: Ro T
reviews.title: Mixed Feelings
reviews.text:
This resort wants to be great but it failed in two key areas for me: customer service (guest reception lounge) and food options.

The check-in process has got to be the worst I have ever experienced. While the employees are nice and have the best of intentions, I feel like they are at the mercy of the company’s paper-intensive, complicated, outdated processes and systems. It takes 15-20 minutes to check two people in. Add another 5 minutes for every additional person and you could be waiting in line for quite awhile. Employees stare at their computer screens with these confused looks, like they’re trying to make sense of the universe. The line to check in or check out is usually long and people are obviously frustrated.  And you could even have 3 people at the counter and the line is still long. Either employees need better training or new more efficient processes are needed.

The food selection is okay. For such a large resort, I would expect a little more variety. The servers in all of the restaurants and buffet area are wonderful. These people are so hard working, quick, efficient, and proactive. Most go above and beyond to give outstanding service. But service alone cannot make up for the dining experience.

The facilities and grounds are beautiful. They do put a lot of effort into maintaining the public areas.

My biggest issue with them is more personal in nature. I accidentally booked a room for “2” when it was just myself. Of course, this resulted in a higher rate (prices are usually based on double occupancy). When I emailed customer service, they told me to go ahead and book another reservation with the correct number of people for the room, which is 1, and they would refund me the first reservation. They did say that they would make this exception for me because these prices are non-refundable.  It has been 5 weeks and I still have not received a refund. I was told that it would take about 2 weeks.  I was left with no choice but to call my credit card company and ask for assistance. I’m left to wonder if they are slow in refunding me because they’re dishonest or just very very VERY slow in getting things done.

This was my second visit to Paradisus and unfortunately will be my last. I gave them a second chance and realized that this resort is just not for me.

reviews.author: Eludium-Q36
reviews.title: Decent, but expected so much better
reviews.text: I was told there that the Paradisus is 35yo and is about to close for a 1 yr (or more) renovation. I would've liked to have known that ahead of time. I'm going to make what could be a LONG review into one as short as possible. The resort hotel is huge consisting of five pyramid sections though you'll only be in the main one and the one with your room. A/C throughout is lacking and can be uncomfortable even in the restaurants. We used the royal service which permitted almost all food and drink and private pool and beach area so that was a good thing for the most part. However, the pool area was marked non-smoking but the same daily set of a-holes thought they were above it and were not stopped by pool staff. Sodas were mostly zero-calorie and served barely cool - we ALWAYS had to ask for ice. Even regular canned Coke didn't taste quite right though. In-house restaurants disappointed, the morning juices seemed watered, and the food throughout was flavorless. Restaurants in Cancun were much better but were no bargain. Our royal service jr suite was passable but not memorable. The 42-in LCD tv had 40+ channels but only 3 were English speaking, so I was thrilled that my Fire TV stick with Dish Network app worked there - though I did accidentally leave the remote there which no one contacted me about, so that's a $30 unforced error. There were popular water sports available right there on the beach but at stupid, greedy pricing (parasail $65ea, jetski $75ea for 1/2 hr). People, they'll only drop the pricing to reasonable levels if you refuse to support those ridic prices. Tips: the later you book, the better the pricing. Change about $75 to Pesos if you plan to do light shopping in the area. Also, anything of any value to you must be stored in the room's safe or your locked luggage. We had something of minor value go missing after our first maid service so that was another disappointment. It was a decent trip overall but I wouldn't return there, though it may be better after renovations and they are building a new Paradisus on the north end so maybe that'll be better, too.

reviews.author: Josue S
reviews.title: Good Hotel - Noisy Room
reviews.text: The hotel was very nice and clean. The only issue I had was a constant bad "electrical" buzzing sound in my room that would not allow my family to sleep. I called the office several times to get this checked and fixed, but they would just tell me it was fixed when it was not. I eventually requested to be moved to a different room and even then they sent someone to double check that there was still this sound in my room. Finally I was moved to another room in which I was actually able to sleep properly. The rest of the hotel and restaurant were good, but this issue left a bad taste in our vacations.

reviews.author: Nic
reviews.title: Montezuma's Revenge
reviews.text: Had a great time here on a short trip with the wife and friends until I could literally stomach no more. Royal service and a nice aesthetic saved this place from 2 stars, owing to the intestinal nightmare that ensued from the wee hours of our first night until now, 6 days later, as I type this at work after finally being able to consume solid food again. The food is poison here and you will remain sick for as long as you consume it. You will not believe the horrors that will come out of your system. I've traveled the developing world far and wide, and Paradisus was up there with the worst of them...only the food is better in most developing countries, so at least it's kind of worth it. I suppose their cuisine here rates as passable to excellent if you spend 340 days a year eating Hamburger Helper and the rest of your days going on all inclusive vacations. Then it's understandable why you'd have no frame of reference of what edible food actually is. But hey, it's Cancun and it's all inclusive, so what can one expect?

reviews.author: CathyGilman
reviews.title: Lovely people mediocre hotel
reviews.text:
The hotel has a lovely beach location but the Cancun strip has very little to recommend it, just hotel after hotel.
The check in after a long flight simply takes too long and the rooms are a bit faded for the price. Communal areas are largely not air conditioned and so the humidity is a bit uncomfortable throughout.
The people are lovely but this would not be a place high on my list to return to.

reviews.author: LalaAtl
reviews.title: BUGS & Basic Service
reviews.text:
Upon check in, expect to wait in a long line.  They do provide many people to greet you and offer drinks during this time though.  Arriving at our room, we saw bugs in the bathroom and asked the bellman to take care of them, hoping it would be an isolated incident.  Upon returning to our room that evening, roaches greeted us on our dresser and we had enough.  Not wanting to room with roaches, we called down to request a new room and proceed to repack all of our luggage.  What a huge surprise when "guest services" Paulina came to our room and demanded we show her the dead bug or a photo of the live bug!!  Because they ran behind the dresser when we entered, we could not find them and did not look, we were ready to get out of there.  After over an hour of them debating on how to handle this, finally we were offered a new room.  It was very frustrating to have gone through all this at 11pm after a long day of travel and just wanting to go to bed.  

We did encounter some great customer service throughout our stay from certain staff.  The "Guests Service" staff was the least helpful and least friendly of them all, ironically.  The servers on the beach are EXTREMELY attentive and never let your drink run dry.  The servers at most restaurants treated us well and were very friendly.

The food was nothing to brag about in our opinion.  The cantonese restaurant Enso was our favourite and the taco restaurant Blue Agave was awful.  How hard is it to make decent tacos!?

Housekeeping did not leave washcloths and when we called to request some they never brought us any so we were forced to attempt to wash the sand off our bodies with no washcloths which was super annoying.

The ocean view from the balcony was amazing and very private.  The room stayed nice and cool, but it was basically the ONLY place in the entire hotel with air conditioning!  It was cooler out on the beach than in the hotel the entire time!

The pool was nice and very big.  The beach was nice and mostly quiet, but the water was full of seaweed and you could´t swim without getting tangled up in it.  Not many people in the water, presumably because of this.

Regarding our SECOND room, I liked the shower, the hairdryer, and the beds were comfortable.  Only 1 channel on the TV was in English.  The first room they put us in was pretty bad and had old furniture, only one power outlet, and BUGS of course. The light switches in both rooms were confusing.  They are everywhere, most of them don´t do anything, and each switch is not even near what it controls.  They are not logical at all and need to be labeled.

My very expensive sunglasses disappeared on our last day and we only made 3 stops in the hotel.  We checked with the workers at all 3 places we had been and no one admitted to seeing them.  Not sure if it was housekeeping or someone else but they are gone, not returned to lost and found and SOMEONE has them.  I am very upset about this.

Basically, we enjoyed a decent stay here, but had some less than stellar experiences with BUGS and the customer service.  It was not worth a return visit in our opinion.

reviews.author: Tavares J
reviews.title: Needs improvement.
reviews.text: The staff is great. That is the best part of the hotel. The first floor seems to have a plumbing problem as it smelled of bathroom. They had tonput incence to hide it but it didn't work. The buffet was good. The a la carte restaurants were very good. The beach was great except for the seaweed.

reviews.author: izi na
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text:
Nice hotel, but old. You feel it with the slow stream at the shower, and in other infrastructure. 
The staff is nice and friendly. Be sure to set with the bill boys the price for the taxi, because you might be surprised. The sheets and pillows weren't clean.

reviews.author: Shannon
reviews.title: Nice property
reviews.text: I was unimpressed with the food and the cleanliness of this resort. Great location... drinks were ok and the service was decent however I doubt I would stay here again. The food was subpar and seemed to be the same thing over and over everyday as there wasn’t much variety on the menu at the buffet and other restaurants on the property.

reviews.author: Olga Z
reviews.title: Terrible check-in
reviews.text:
We arrived 02/05/2019 at 01:00 am to the hotel. Thanks god, I printed confirmation. It took more then hour to check in. First room was different that I 100% prepayed on Booking.com. I spent a lot of money for international phone call to improve our payment and room and service categories;(( also a lot of nerves;(( and lost good mood in the beginning of my vacation;(
But ocean view is amazing!

reviews.author: Peter C
reviews.title: Amazing Kids Club, so so rooms
reviews.text:
We picked the resort because it advertised it's "children friendly" facilities.  We were not disappointed.  The facilities were not exceptional but the staff was amazing.  Violeta and the rest of the staff at the kids club were amazing. 

In terms of the resort, it's the "Wal-Mart" of all inclusive resorts.  It has everything you would want. Quality was good but not luxurious.  Be mindful of the room choices.  Don't get fooled when they tell you it's a Junior Suite...nothing more than a room with a balcony.  Rooms are clean but AC system was old and our "junior suite" was what I would call a standard hotel room.  Two queen size beds were a little rough for a family of four (two adults and two small children).

reviews.author: artmarcelino
reviews.title: Not a five star experience
reviews.text: I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun from March 18 to 25. It was a buddies golf trip & were assigned Rooms 3618 & 3620. Unfortunately the bad experiences trump the good in this case. It started off bad as check in took almost an hour, they truly need to revisit a more efficient way of checking guests in. When a bus full of people come to the resort to start their vacation the last thing they want to do is wait almost an hour to get their rooms. Waiting that long is a new experience for me as I have never had that in any all inclusive (AI) resort I've ever been to. Just unacceptable. But I have other firsts to share with the Tripadvisor community. They ran out of towels daily at the beach & pool area. That's daily folks. I'm not making that up. Towels, at a resort, on the beach. I'm trying to figure out how that occurs? Good luck if you're lucky enough to score a beach lounge chair before 10 am. As a matter of fact, early in my stay I observed a rather irate guest ask for management to do something about the shortage of beach chairs & was dully ignored. Ridiculous. NEVER have I been on the beach at an AI & not had beach chairs accessible to everyone. The food was average at best. In fact 3 of the 4 of us got some bug which I can't truly attribute to the food at the resort but I was sick on Wednesday (Day 3) & Friday (Day 5). So I can only deduce it might have came from the food. The best meal I had was on our last day the Sunday where we tried the Japanese restaurant in the main atrium. It was delicious, flavourful & fresh. I'm sorry to not have ate there more during the stay but sushi in the Caribbean is hit or miss sometimes & being sick two days I had to be careful. But I'm truly shocked some members gave this place five stars which I believe should be reserved for exceptional resorts with extraordinary customer service. Take for example their Nespresso stand which opens at 8:00 am to 10:00 am in the morning & 3:00 pm to 5:00 pm in the afternoon. My buddy was 2nd in line in a 2 person lineup at 5:01 pm & the barista shut him down citing they were closed. That is not going out of their way for guests to provide truly great customer service. Like the extra 4 minutes he would have taken to make my friend's cappuccino would have impacted his workday so negatively? We also experienced this puzzling practice of not getting enough water from the beverage replenishment staff. My friends would leave notes on the counter above the fridge requesting, no begging for more bottled water & usually what they would call "stocking" your fridge was three mini water bottles. Finally we had to practically confront a beverage cart attendant & give him 10 US dollars/room & we were able to get all the large bottles we wanted for the week. Just so frustrating why they would hoard their bottled water like that. Just unexplainable. But it wasn't all negative as the rooms were quite clean & the beds were comfortable & most of the staff were very engaging & friendly. The resort sits on a pristine stretch of beach & the main atrium is beautiful. I would call the Paradisus all style & no substance. I believe all of my reviews have been an honest assessment of my experiences & unfortunately because of all the issues I've experienced during this stay sadly, I can not recommend this property.

reviews.author: Molson_12
reviews.title: All inclusive paradisus cancun - has been better in the past
reviews.text:
This resort is still very nice but in my opinion has slipped since I was there 2 years ago.  The food is ok - probably still better than most but definitely not as good as it was. Every morning they ran out of bacon.  The entertainment is generally well done.  There are a few very annoying things that although not earth shattering does cause frustration 
1) if you like to tip - make sure you bring enough small USD bills. We were sent on an incredible wild goose chase trying to get small bills for tipping and to take the bus into town
2) the cafe used to be open longer - now it is just a couple of time slots in the day.  Staff at this station were not friendly. Should have a 24 hour self serve station that is stocked properly. I need tea like many need coffee and trying  to get regular black tea was a challenge if not impossible at times. Luckily I found a waiter who gave me several to get me through the remaining days.
3)room service is supposed to be free with all inclusive package but now they charge a delivery fee
4)they simply do not have enough lounge chairs - yet they take up a lot of space with the cabanas that are available for rent. People reserve chairs even though they are not supposed to but you can understand why they do due to limited availability.
5) stocking of the fridge and coffee supplies in the room was not done everyday - we had to call on a regular basis 
6)spa prices are crazy expensive - you can go into town for a fraction of the price 

These are not huge issues but enough to make me want to try somewhere else for my next trip.

reviews.author: Navigate40221045210
reviews.title: Been better in the past
reviews.text: 4th year here. There has been some obvious cost cutting to maid service, Mini bar service, and guacamole which was disappointing as the first three years were amazing...now just average. Have to really think long and hard as to if we’ll go back again next year.

reviews.author: Tayla Park
reviews.title: Average at best
reviews.text:
Started off the trip a little rocky. Alejandro did our check in for us and it appared he had no idea what he was talking about. He gave us the option to upgrade to Royal Service for $70/day/person which we decided to do based on the perks. Although, he gave us info that wasn’t even correct, regarding location of La Palapa or the hours that they served. After upgrading we were then told that there were no king beds available for us and wouldn’t be until the next day (found this totally ridiculous, who doesn’t have any king beds?!) No compensation/ room upgrade was given after complaining but we were moved the next day, although this process wasn’t easy either, we personally had to move our bags from room to room. 

Room- Ocean view was beautiful nonetheless, I would not recommend staying in building 3. This building has the main bar/ restaurants in it which creates extreme noise at all hours of the night. The music at the bar was heard until 11pm some nights, not ideal if you’re wanting an early night! The room was also extremely small and there were ants in our room. 

Restaurants- Food overall was very poor. First night we ate at Bana, the sushi was nothing special and a little flavorless, second night we ate at Blue Agave, tacos were good but more of a lunch spot, third night we ate at Maket Grill which was by far the best meal we ate there, lastly we ate at Fuego, food was extremely average and service was the worst we have had yet. No asking how our food was, no refilling of drinks etc. 

Bar- The main bar is Avenue Bar, this bar was very dissapointing compared to other resorts we have stayed at. Service was not very good, they were not attentive when you needed a drink. The overall ambience was not very beach vacation like. I would suggest having more tables and chairs rather than lounging beds in a bar. 

Royal service- Worth the money but not $70/day. The service was definitely above average at the adults only pool, beach, and at La Palapa. The best food we experienced was there, everything was extremely tasty. It is a nice plus that you get to have the day beds included. 

Other cons- 
Charged $5 delivery fee for room service (ordered a sandwich and pasta included on the 24 hour room service menu, should not be a fee for this).

reviews.author: dnlmom
reviews.title: Disappointed in our return trip
reviews.text:
One of the things we were really looking forward to on our return trip to the Paradisus was early evening cocktails at the lobby bar.  Well, the bar never opened until 6:00 and they had removed all but 4 seats at the bar!  We like to go for drinks around 4:30 or 5:00, before dinner.  When we spoke to the bar manager, he gave us a long winded excuse about how it worked better for the hotel to open at 6:00 (but not for the customers).  He assured us that the bar would open the next evening at 5:30 and noted that the Avenue Bar was always open anyway (again with only 4 seats).  The next evening, the lobby bar did not open until 6:00, nor did the Avenue Bar!  So much for assurances by management.
Furthermore, when we arrived, we had been assigned rooms facing the lagoon, even though we very specifically asked for ocean front.  After 1 1/2 hours at registration, they arranged for ocean front rooms for us beginning the next day.  Registration lines were ridiculously long.
Rooms were made up late (not done by 3:30 PM), refrigerator was not regularly restocked.  There always seemed to be some kind of little problem.
Pool was way too loud in the afternoon!
We have stayed at many Melia hotels and at the Paradisus more than twice.  I will check around next time we come to Cancun to see what the other options are.

reviews.author: Amarjeet M
reviews.title: They Say Great employees and Staff Can hide your all deficiencies .
reviews.text: Great staff ,hard workers But management thumbsdown Small reception desk could not hold even office supply.Basement Ground floor rooms Noisy Couldn't sleep kept getting noise from adjoining restaurant

reviews.author: Jen
reviews.title: Go to Paradisus in Playa Del Carmen Instead.
reviews.text:
We (husband and I)  travelled with our baby 2 years old here. Had a great trip but here's our summary: 

ROOM: Decent, outdated but clean and spacious. Tub kept leaking but upon calling they did respond quickly to fix the problem. We had the family concierge room and it was great for families. No mini bar in room though.  Highly recommend ocean view rooms here...beautiful view. No tub on porch or jacuzzi..but you get that at Playa Del Carmen. The beds are the best at Playa Del Carmen....beds in Paradisus Cancun are ok. Pillows weren't great in Cancun either but in Playa we loved it. Microwave provided if requested for heating up baby bottle in Cancun. In Playa Del Carmen, it comes in room with a full kitchen for you in your suite. 

FOOD: Average- not great but not bad. Ice cream was great though!

SERVICE: Good, respond quickly to all your needs but you have to ask for everything...including for your in room snacks and drinks and coffee and water to be refilled. Could use more poolside servers as service wasn't great there. It didn't appear as if there was enough staff poolside. 

BEACH: Beautiful, no complaints here. 
 
POOL: Getting a pool chair seemed to be an issue around the kids side. More guests than available seats. Pool is shallow for kids but really deep on the adults side at around 5ft deep of water. 

Summary: We have travelled to many 5 star resorts in Cancun. For a 4.5 star facility, it seems to be lacking the service and amenities of the Playa Del Carmen sister resort. Our advice is to pay extra and go to Paradisus La Esmeralda in Playa Del Carmen- food, service, rooms, pool, amenities for children are way way better. We travelled to Playa Del Carmen Paradisus Las Esmeralda three months ago and we are at Paradisus Cancun right now and see a dramatic difference all aspects.

reviews.author: roman s
reviews.title: So so experience for the money
reviews.text:
Context: this is compared to a couple of RIUs and iberostar and we did NON pay the extra fee for the “club membership”. Restaurant and pool service is very slow, and food selection is mediocre compared to the other places and the most annoying thing was sneaky pitches about the club membership masked as a family consierge. 

I feel like the hotel is really optimized for the folks who have the membership, as there is way more cabanas (only for members) than regular shaded lounge chairs. If you want to pay for a cabana it’s $150 a day... or get the membership. I also suspect many of the 5 star reviews came from members, so I want to make sure I explained the difference.

reviews.author: Jarrod D
reviews.title: 4th time @ Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Timeshare vendors need to lay off us guests when we express we are not interested in timeshare purchasing.. Check in wait times need improvement. Other than that had an okay stay here. Just certain staff members made it less enjoyable this trip.

reviews.author: Johnny G
reviews.title: A Great Vacation, with a few Caveats
reviews.text:
Summary - Great pool, beautiful beach, helpful waiters, very nice hotel rooms. Poor quality food, aggressive and annoying sales people: be prepared for a stay in a comfortable and well appointed room and for a relaxing time at the pool and beach, but also be firm at managing and walking away from the sales pitches people will constantly be giving you and brace yourself for bland and poorly cooked food that should be considered unacceptable for a resort of this quality.

We stayed at the Paradisus for 5 nights, overall we had a good stay. We upgraded to an ocean view room for $50 extra per night and thought it was totally worth it. We declined an upgrade to Royal Service since we didn't think we would use it and didn't want to spend time in the quiet adults-only section of the pool. There are many pros and cons to our experience, here are the most important ones:

Pros:

- Hotel aesthetics and decor: the hotel is designed nicely for a massive resort hotel and the decor is pleasing. The garden and koi ponds in the atrium are a plus as are the amounts of natural sunlight in the hotel.

- Room comfort and quality: the room was updated, clean, had a great A/C, excellent bathroom, and an amazing view with a very private balcony. The bed was comfortable and the drinks/waters we took from the refrigerator were replaced daily. 

- Pool and Beach: the pool(s) are great. They were never too crowded, have a swim up bar that we can easily access, and are clean. There is a shortage of pool chairs, so get to the pool early if you can OR reserve a Bali bed. We chose to reserve a Bali bed each day and it's worth it to have some private space, waiter service, and guaranteed shade. Beware that they will try to get you to pay for bottle service, a seafood platter, and snacks for $175 for the day. You can opt for just the Bali bed and a bottle of Prosecco for $60. The beach in front of the resort was kept very clean and was raked daily. There were usually plenty of beach chairs available. 

- Hotel Staff: the wait staff were friendly, eager to help, and very attentive to our needs. Their responsiveness to our needs and requests made a big difference in our stay. The front desk staff was friendly but was slow during check in and wouldn't give us answers to question we had and continuously decided to defer us to "guest services" (aka, pushy sales people who did at times provide helpful information).  

Cons:

- Food: this is by far our biggest complaint. This resort is a culinary mess! The food was absolutely terrible and the blandest stuff on earth. It's like it was made for a person whose palate requires zero flavor, zero seasoning, and no spice. The Naos Restaurant buffet had a lot of poor quality selections that were obviously not fresh, had obviously been sitting out all day, and were from reused pieces of leftovers from prior meals or the prior day(s). It was a challenge to make a reservation at any of the specialty restaurants and it could only be done prior to 5pm on the same day by calling from your hotel room. While they claimed that they were nearly booked solid and they had only limited availability at many of the restaurants, we noticed that they were only about half full. A few that I'm going to call out:
- Restaurant Blue Agave: tacos were very average and somewhat flavorless, I've had better at countless places in the United States. 
-Restaurant Fuego: they claim to be a restaurant that has spicy Latin American cuisine, but each of our dishes was mild with no heat and little to no seasoning. 
- Restaurant Enso: almost none of their main dishes on the menu were what they claimed to be (for instance, spicy Pad Thai does not consist of Italian linguine noodles mixed with a few vegetables and peanuts in a flavorless brown broth). That wait staff was great here and picked out a super bottle of wine for us, so that made up for the horribly misleading/false menu.

- Aggressive and Annoying Sales People: everyone from the people handing out beach towels and info on extra activities, to the guest services concierge rep, to the front desk staff is focused on a hard upsell. They are persistent to the point where they are annoying and offensive. Be politely blunt and do not let the "guest services" rep badger you, walk away. Unless you are in the market for a timeshare/club membership, do not agree to sit through one of their presentations. We initially agreed to attend a breakfast to learn about a new property and then we found out it was a 2 hour long sales pitch so we backed out. We were persistently contacted and bothered and had to eventually feel like we were being rude for repeatedly saying no. It was definitely a negative part of our visit. 

Overall it was a pleasurable and worthwhile trip and we had a great time. I simply warn future Paradisus visitors to be blunt with the sales/service folks and not to engage in conversation with them.  Also, don't expect a culinary adventure. It's a place that's great for those who looking for a comfortable and relaxing beach visit.

reviews.author: Ann M S
reviews.title: Royal service nice but not always best
reviews.text: We enjoyed our own pool area but disappointed there wasn't a pool bar at our end. We only had drink/food service when we had a bali bed reserved otherwise they ignored us and we were ready to tip big!  Enso was good- skip Mole- market grille like a knock of Fago de chao -large buffet ok- smoothies were good.

reviews.author: GarryP
reviews.title: March 6th - 10th 2019
reviews.text:
Overall OK but very slow check in and check out
Buffet average not very imaginative  but did enjoy the lunches at poolside
Great staff - very helpful and friendly
Clean rooms and clean pool areas
Cheap poolside chairs without ability to adjust
Loved Vento and Baha restaurants
Don't get sucked into the upgrade for Royal service - not really worth it
Lots of stairs to get to and from buildings and the beach
Not much daily information on daily events or activities

reviews.author: Camino_Jim
reviews.title: Just average
reviews.text: While I have been to Playa del Carmen three times this was my first time going to Cancun.  I am not a typical all-inconclusive type of traveler. I expected gorgeous beach and 5-star dining.  The beach is gorgeous, but too few cabanas on the beach unless you pay extra.  Very average food all the way around.  The service is great.  I am not much of a drinker, so if your idea of a great vacation is free drinks once you get there, my review does not apply to you.  I was not impressed and would not do this place again.

reviews.author: Amy D
reviews.title: So Much Potential.
reviews.text:
Alex and I just got back from the beautiful and sunny Cancun. Getting away from the snowy D.C. was sensational. We stayed at the Paradisus all inclusive. We chose this hotel because it was gorgeous online and had plenty of restaurant options. Being foodies we also chose it for Tempo, a restaurant operated by a chef holding eight Michelin stars. Here are the pros and cons of our trip:

Pros: 
1. Aesthetically: gorgeous hotel. The greenery, flowers and koi in the ponds all around the resort are exquisite. The layout is beautiful and it’s right on the water. Looks just like the pictures online. 
2. Staff is so attentive and nice. While being there we learned about countless servers/bartenders/staffs families, where they are from and their way of life. There are plenty of people to help you out or just get you a drink! Every meal we had we had a friendly server who spoke English very well and was outstanding! Daniel was an incredible manager who really cared about his staff and cared about the guests. One morning I even asked for some citrus for my gin and tonic and he brought ALL the citrus LOL. Also, Edgar was very good as well. He was very attentive and kind, always going the extra mile. These two made the entire trip awesome!
3. Expansive pool options.
4. Alcohol: free flowing. If you would like a bottle for the room you can just ask downstairs and they will give it to you with cups to enjoy on your balcony. Tried a lot of new drinks. Like all all-inclusive resorts that go light on the pours so we always asked for doubles. My favorite was the Hendricks G&T (double) with a lime and an orange.
5. Restaurants: Fuego delicious (see pictures). Enso meh. Mole ok too good. Will have more individual reviews on their Yelp pages.

Cons:
1. While there are a lot of pools, there aren’t a lot of pool chairs. We are not morning people, but forced waking up around 8:30 just to get a spot around the pool. It was always packed. One morning we waited until 9:15 to go down and we were screwed. Oh and pools FREEZING!
2. The Clientele: Rudest people I have ever encountered. EVERYONE staying at this hotel was a jerk. Most self indulged and insufferable people I’ve ever encountered, all in one place. I have been to Mexico several times, including another all-inclusive and never seen such ugly hearted people. I don’t know if this is due to the cultures the brand attracts or because it was high season so the amount of people attracted to Cancun was higher, I can’t pinpoint it. Was here for 4 days and met only one nice older group from Canada and that was it. We are a very friendly couple and love meeting new people but guests at this resort made it impossible. We even had an incident at dinner one night with a 40-something year old dad who was sitting at the table in front of ours. His table was in our line of sight of the beach and when he got up to leave confronted Alex saying “you have a staring problem”. We were floored. After some back and forth and him not quitting the staff had to get involved. Don’t need this while on vacation. You are on vacation people, this is supposed to be the most relaxing time!!   
3. BIGGEST CON: Restaurants. As I said it was high season and every night 2 to 3 of the restaurants are closed. Sunday - Blue Agave, Bana and Fuego all closed. You have thousands of people and the only offerings at 4/7 restaurants are available. Not to mention, as all other mentioned, it is IMPOSSIBLE to get a reservation. We had read this so emailed the hotel the week before but no answer to several emails. When we checked in we mentioned it and was told you can only reserve from your hotel phone. We called as soon as reaching the room Saturday afternoon and all reservations were full until after our departure on Tuesday. This seems non-sensical. I have never seen reservations nor a business run so poorly. Either have a way to make reservations ahead of time and set aside tables for walk-in’s or don’t have reservations at all. Seriously. Somehow later we snagged a 9pm at Mole on Monday night and half of the tables in the restaurant are empty. We also noticed this when walking by Vento. Thank God we did the Royal Service upgrade when arriving because we ate at  La Palapa for nearly every lunch and thoroughly enjoyed the La Palapa lounge for snacks and drinks in the evenings. Tip: The hotel should give our a brochure of restaurants operating hours, what meals you can get at which and which you have to pay extra for.
4. Speaking of paying extra: This place is terrible with the upsell’s, every corner we turned, upsell, upsell, upsell. Sat thru their timeshare presentation and the rates were awful; 50 vacations for 30K at 16.9%. As money savvy people no one in their right mind would take this. As soon as they realized we weren’t going to buy they were done with us. Everyone was upsell and tip greedy (minus Daniel, Edgar, Javier and Hugo - they were just genuinely customer driven). Beware of anything you do here: any photo opportunities, any different wines at the restaurants or food specials of the night - all uncharges. Even room service was a fee, at an all-inclusive!!! Oh and the food you get at Naos (the buffet) don’t even think about bringing that up to your room, not allowed! So much for enjoying a nice cake or snack from the balcony.
5. Lastly, Maid Service: minibar not stocked, no water available in the rooms and no robes or slippers. Saturday, Sunday and Monday morning none of this existed. Maid came once a day and on Sunday, I even laid out a tip and a note about all of these things and when we arrived back from the pool nothing was there and the money was not taken… maybe the maid didn’t read/speak English… not sure. Then miraculously, Monday we walked into our room and there were robes/towels and lots of water; money and note gone. Then while we were relaxing on the balcony we get a knock on the balcony door and its the maid ready to do turn down service (whaaaaa? turn down service is now a thing?! last night and now it happens…). She turns down and leaves we walk in and there are now more items and chocolates on our pillows, where the F has this been the whole time?! Service is so spotty, but heck we chalked it up to being in Mexico!

Last tip before I leave you: They don’t tell you but I realized the last day, when I was full out itchy, that the toilet paper is scented. May be a nice perk for some folks but unfortunately for a girl with a scent sensitivity would have been a great heads up! 

All and all was a nice time, but had we been given the level of service that was shown on Monday after 3pm and restaurants weren’t such a disaster to make a reservation at we would likely be back. We love traveling and love relaxing and after this will likely try a different resort next time. To put it in perspective we even received a free 4 day/3 night stay for listening to the sales presentation and are debating even using it because we would rather go somewhere else.

reviews.author: Guide62350921511
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel with salty food.
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel but restaurants need more staff especiallly when it rains. Coffee service should be improved. The hotel offers Nepresso service only in a certain time. Regular coffee is ready on the hallways but milk bottle was empty whenever I needed it. Food is very salty. They need more staff at the restaurants especially when it rains because most people stay inside the hotel when it rains. My room window was leaking water from outside when it was rainy. I didn't report it since it was minimal leakage. I just put towel on the window side. My other family's rooms were ok though... staff are kind and attentive. Easy check in and out. Oh!! The spa is wonderful!! Amazing deep tissue massage!! My mother's back pain is so much better after getting massage from David! Amazing!! Overall, hotel is nice except food.

reviews.author: Weimiao L
reviews.title: Average experience
reviews.text: Rooms are very outdated. Online pictures are deceiving. Buffet dinner and lunch is disappointing, and it is difficult to get a spot at the reservation only restaurants at the hotel. Room cleaning always run late and maids don’t restock the fridge. The plus is beautiful beach. Overall definitely not a five star standard and would not return.

reviews.author: joseM2111OP
reviews.title: Destination wedding
reviews.text: Paradiscus Cancun was not a great experience for me and fiance.  The food was not good and the service was very poor.  Entertainment at this resort was terrible and there was no information put out indicating what kind of entertainment they were having each day.  The hotel workers were not friendly like they are at other resorts. I will not be going back to this resort for sure.

reviews.author: Paula C
reviews.title: Gorgeous views but the food was never hot
reviews.text:
Beautiful grounds and views.  The beach is gorgeous and I've never seen such clear beautiful water.  There is an open-air dining room for breakfast, lunch and dinner.  I thought the staff was always helpful and considerate. Overall, I really enjoyed the quiet and relaxing atmosphere. Grounds get an A

Hotel check-in was slow.  We checked in before 3 and had to go back at 3 to get our keys.  Our junior suite with an ocean view was roomy enough, but the sliding glass door leaked during very heavy rain - housekeeping had to put towels down on the floor. There was a ceiling light that wouldn't work and they couldn't fix it so maintenance put a lamp on the table.  The room and bathroom were very clean and my bed was very comfortable. The bathroom does not have an exhaust fan. There is no additional way to lock the door from the inside - none of those swing arms that prevent the door from being pushed open. Check-in and Room get a C (that lack of security took it down from a B

The food wasn't bad but it was not hot.
