There are multiple restaurants but theyr'e more like dining rooms than restaurants - you can take your buffet lunch from Naos and sit in Naos or Market Grill or Fuego or one of the others. You need dinner reservations at Fuego, which is a la carte for dinner; Vento, a tapas restaurant; Market Grill which is Argentinian / Brazilian Steakhouse where meat is carved onto your plate but you get your own sides.  There's a sushi restaurant but it wasn't always open. Any hot dish I took from the buffet was never more than warm-ish. My favorite place to eat was Market Grill because it's open air and even in the rainy weather it was a delightful place to sit and relax.  Warning, though. The wood tables need to be scrubbed, sanded and refinished.  They always felt sticky; I had to open my napkin and spread it out like a large placemat. The wait staff was all very nice but also very obvious about looking for tips -  Food gets a C

What? No bingo! No! There weren't a lot of activities to do - unless they were all at the family pool.  I didn't mind that too much - I was more interested in just relaxing and decompressing after a stressful year.  Each evening there was a show at the Avenue Bar but it seemed to be about 30 or 45 minutes and it was family friendly.  Activities get a C

It's not a dump but it's not spectacular (in my opinion). Overall, I'd give the resort a C+ (2 1/2 stars).

Hey TripAdvisor - you need to add 1/2 stars (circles?) to your rating system.

reviews.author: janw48
reviews.title: A fair hotel
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun is a beautiful hotel and well maintained. The service was excellent and the rooms were spacious and clean.

There are lots of palapas on the beach and near the pool which provide shade. Waiters even come to the beach and the poolside to take orders and bring you drinks. 

The biggest downside to this hotel is the food in the buffet. EVERYTHING was cold so food that should have been hot was not even warm.  I never had any food that was remotely warm.  The selection was the same every day with not many cooked vegetables.  Most of the food was very bland and salt and pepper were not on the table.  You had to ask the waiter and he put it on your food for you.  Never had that experience before.  I talked with several guests who had the same complaints about the food and said that it was definitely not up to the standard of a 4+ hotel.

For this reason I wouldn't go back to this hotel or recommend it to any of my friends.

reviews.author: Liz M
reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: This resort is very clean and the staff are top notch.  Always willing to serve and have a smile on their face.  A huge disappointment was the fact that not all of the restaurants were open and the others had to have reservations.  Every time I would call they would say that they were all full,  but it was very obvious that there were tons of seats open.  We had to eat at the same place every night which was a disappointment.  The food and drinks were good.  If it rains you are out of luck unless you go out to the swim up bar.  All of the other bars are closed until 5:00.

reviews.author: Danielle N
reviews.title: Great bartenders, event staff, and pool area, bad rooms
reviews.text:
The wait staff and bartenders were AMAZING. Always so willing to help and make the experience fun and relaxing. Antonio and Alan were the best bartenders there. They made us feel so at home. And Angel who coordinated the daily hotel events was very helpful and friendly. We loved the margarita class! The restaurants, lobby area, and pool area and beach were beautiful and very clean. The only thing I didn’t understand was how the hotel was basically and we could never get a towel. 

The rooms however were disgusting at best. Our smoke alarm was leaking “water” (we hoped), our door to the outside leaked and flooded our room during a storm, and the walls were leaking and had black spots everywhere....oh and the shower head was falling off. A few times we flushed the toilet and the entire room smelled like waste. We left the room gagging. We went to complain and didn’t even receive an apology or get an offer to switch rooms. The cleaning staff basically sprayed fabreeze in called it a day. Oh and they were terrible. No matter how much we complained we never got fresh towels, anything in our fridge...they basically just made the bed everyday. 

Basically...great waitstaff and events staff (5 stars) Front desk was fine the first night but then was pretty terrible and the rooms were gross. That’s what brought the rating down.

reviews.author: Junnie
reviews.title: Celebration birthday !
reviews.text: Friends recommend this hotel they say the service everything is so good but  was 2yrs to go we coming to Celebration birthday 5day 4ninght  ! Last time my friend get free upgrade but not for us 😂😂. So we pay extra to upgrade the room if you ask me any  special  For the birthday they only will  decorate little thing in the room !  food service is ok not bad! Service some  are good same are so so next time not coming back this hotel !

reviews.author: Brett
reviews.title: The Good, The Bad, and The Ugly
reviews.text: Just got back from a 6 night stay at this resort. I’ll start with the good. I think the staff and Hotel cleanliness are good. The restaurants are better than other all inclusive’s I’ve gone to. I was in an updated room and that was nice as well. The Bad was the buffet and the lack of a coffee type place available all day. For the Buffet, it’s was eh. Not impressed. I’ve been to multiple RIU resorts that have a far larger buffet selection. There is a Nespresso station for a handful of drink options. However, they were out of ingredients when I asked for one of the items. I went to that Nespresso bar at various times during a day and it was closed. The hours aren’t posted from what I could tell. I think the hotel needs something along the lines of a Starbucks (definitely doesn’t need to be Starbucks) that is available all day for the guests. Something like this would provide a variety. I think the guests would like it because, the times the Nespresso was open, there was a line. The ugly consists of 3 items. First, our room was on the 6th floor in the main pyramid (bldg 3). However, we were not told there is a disco that opens at 10pm every night in that bldg. That disco is on 1st floor yet sounded like it was in our room! If you plan to go to bed prior to 1am then I suggest being in a different building. The staff should notify guests being placed in that building about the disco and give an option to be moved. Second, I went to get lounge chairs outside at beach and pool during day and almost all were taken. Yet, there are countless cabana’s surrounding the perimeter with all but one being empty. I was told the cost to rent one was over $100. Didn’t seem right to have so many of these open yet almost all lounges taken. The last item was the lack of alcohol in room. In most other all inclusive’s that I’ve been in there is stocked alcohol in the room. Here, there were 3 different Mexican beers and that was it. No rum, tequila, wine, etc. In short, I paid more for this resort and had higher expectations as such. I think I’ll try another resort next time.

reviews.author: Journey27813006360
reviews.title: Hire new chefs and focus on taste, quality, authenticity, and delight
reviews.text: There are excellent ingredients in Mexico so please use it to your advantage.  Hire people who can teach rest of your cook team how to make tasteful meals.  The Asian restaurants seriously lacking flavors and authenticity.  It's really a waste of ingredients.

reviews.author: Miguel B
reviews.title: expected more for the price
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel before several times. We like the property design , amenities. However customer service has declined over the years. We changed rooms 3 times. We travel with our son , and my husband requested a queen bed with a sofa. We were given a two bed room. Then the third room had the handle of shower room broken , we left and no-one show up to fix it. Many of the furniture through the hotel was broken. Employees did not pay attention to our request. My room was sent to the laundry by mistake , called reception to find out about it and they did not get back to me until the day I was leaving and because I went personally to the front desk. several times we asked for something and the waitress said they did not have it. If you tip them they will go find it!!! It should be the other way around. If they provide a good service then you tip. It was OK , but we expected more for the price and 5 diamond category that this hotel has. Really disappointed this time.

reviews.author: Laura S
reviews.title: Not bad for 2 days at Christmas
reviews.text:
Grateful there was rooms available so close to Christmas. The main lobby and all the inside of the hotel was beautifully decorated for Christmas Check in was easy for us. Color coded wristlets for those who could drink and those under age is smart. Not to thrilled with the sales ppl who talked with us about joining thier clubs. We were their for 2 days and didn't want to spend 90 minutes in a presentation to get a day cabana and food. Plus who know how long Tilley were ready. They were a little pushy with it which we were not a fan of. Wifi in the buildings was great but once you stepped outside at the pool or 10 steps outside at the beach, it's not the greatest. There are a couple restaurants that require dinner reservations and with Christmas Eve and Christmas Day, they filled up very fast but were able to get an early dinner res at the Market Grill. Very limited buffet menu for a place that required reservations but went back and forth to the non res buffet next door and made the best of it. The breakfast morning views around 8am ish were beautiful while eating. They were just so breathtaking <3 taco place was my favorite! No horchata but that's ok lol housekeeping doesn't do a great job keeping the mini bar/fridges restocked. 
Not a bad experience since we were at the beach most of the time. Not sure if we will be back though...

reviews.author: TravellerJ80
reviews.title: A great hotel, but an upgrade to royal service is needed. Re-consider this resort if you have a child friendly holiday.
reviews.text:
A very mixed review of the Paradisus Cancun. The resort is beautiful with stunning architecture, a lovely beach & very clean. The food is generally good with a variety of contemporary choices. It is in an excellent location, making it easy to venture into downtown Cancun & enjoy local attractions. 

However, if you are travelling without children or looking for a relaxing break, the regular service at this hotel is disappointing. The buffet restaurants are busy & pretty standard for a hotel and the ordinary pool & beach areas noisy, with ridiculous charges for the bali daybeds.

Therefore, we upgraded to royal service on our 1st morning. Whilst this was a great experience & I have given it 5 stars, it was disappointing to spend additional money to enjoy basic things such as breakfast near the beach & an adults only pool area. 

We were unimpressed to find out half way through our stay that reservations were required for the restaurants each night & ended up eating at 9pm to avoid the masses & have a more relaxing meal, with better service. 

The resorts credits are a joke. I was given a book worth $550, yet didn't use any. Be prepared to spend $100 to get $10 off, it works out very expensive! The golf course is also a joke with a charge of $25 per club & $12 for a set of 4 balls, it was empty for the majority of our stay. 

The bar areas are a missed opportunity, with 1 limited bar situated on the beach & the main bar being more of a family lounging area. The nicest bar in the centre of pyramid 3 usually had 4 bar stools & would benefit from an extension. 

The food was generally good with our favourite restaurants being Lapa lapa, Fuego & the Japanese. The Blue Agave was a bit disappointing. 

The staff are generally attentive & work hard to provide an excellent service. However, there were a number of staff who were slightly rude & particularly arrogant which was not a pleasant experience. 

The room was spacious, clean & well maintained throughout our stay. We had a lagoon view which was pleasant and the room was very quiet for a good nights sleep. 

Aquaworld is a great facility, across the road this removes a lot of the motorised sports from the beach. Was great to use the non-motorised sports for free. 

Overall, we had a great holiday and did enjoy the hotel. However, I'm not convinced about the value for money & feel it needs to be more focused for adults.

reviews.author: Shelby D
reviews.title: Fun trip minus the staff completely scamming us
reviews.text: Just traveled to Cancun for an earned work trip and stayed at Paradisus. Everything was really great up until checkout where the hotel made me and multiple people pay RIDICULOUS amounts for wine that we never purchased. The same situation happened to multiple people from my company and it is a disgrace. Paradisus is an all inclusive, obviously minus alcohol that is not included. At dinner the first night, we asked for house wine and the waiter kept only shoving the wine list in front of our faces and kept telling us it was included and paid for by our company and that all we needed to do was sign. We knew better but he kept insisting it was included. Little did we know we'd be paying $500 out of pocket for wine that was not even good nor included in the "all inclusive" deals. The women at checkout would do absolutely nothing about it. All the staff did was threaten to call the police and that we could not leave the hotel if the wine was not paid for. This was appalling and we were 100% taken advantage of. It was really unfortunate that our trip had to end on a bad note and I would not recommend anyone staying here because of their staff.

reviews.author: ac_traveler
reviews.title: Average all-inclusive experience - maybe look into other newer resorts
reviews.text:
We traveled in a large group as we celebrated several family members birthdays on this trip. We enjoyed, but some things fell short:

- We reserved 2 rooms with king beds, but we did not get any rooms with king beds. All of our rooms were two full beds. Even though they accommodated us as best they could, it's hard to understand how our reservation so far in advance came up to no king beds when we finally arrived
- We called in advance to try and make reservations at the hotel restaurants because of our large group size and we were told no reservations could be made. Then we arrived on Dec 1 and all of a sudden, our concierge Judy was able to help us make reservations for each night. I don't understand why we couldn't do it ahead of time, but we were able to do it later on. That's confusing for customers. 
- When my family checked in, we were given schedules for the Adult activities and Children activities so that we could keep track of everything going on at the resort. But a few days later (when our trip was ready to end), we found out that the schedules were not up to date. We found out the Kidzone staff had a totally different schedule to follow. Another miscommunication that could have been avoided
- The crib (pack and play) we had sent to our room was very very old and dilapidated. We had to use pillows at the bottom to give our son extra cushioning while he slept. Maybe consider updating to newer ones, especially since you market yourselves as a family resort 
- The hotel itself is very old and it’s obvious that it’s in need of renovations. During our stay of 8 days, 6 of those days there was always some kind of chemical smells in the main hallways (like paint thinner, or paint, or cleaning solutions) - it was unpleasant for us and i’m sure for other guests. And don’t let the photos fool you, the resort is actually pretty small. The areas where you would eat at a restaurant are all crowded together (except for 1 or 2 that are near the pool) and the space within each restaurant is extremely limited. There is no theater to watch shows, they try to fit that in right next to the pool and there’s no real areas to just sit and hang out indoors (it’s taken up by restaurants or bars or spa areas). 
- Golf course was fun to hit around on and nice scenery, but the golf clubs were so old and in bad shape. For such beat up equipment, why charge rental fee? Just let your guests use them for free and leave a deposit or a drivers license?
- There is one coffee shop in the entire hotel (at least on the family side, i do not know about the adults-only side) and it is only open for a small window at some point in the mornings. There is no way to know when, because there is no sign that says when they open and when they close. Why is this so limited for your guests? In that same token, they had one gelato shop, open 2 hours each day. I was never able to enjoy it but again, i’m wondering why the limited hours. Is it a matter of being under-staffed? 

There are a few positive notes though:
- Eduardo, the restaurant manager was fantastic. He tried so hard to make sure that our huge group was taken care of, that we were all happy with the food and service and that our seating arrangements and accommodations were all top notch
- There were a few food servers that really gave exceptional service: Martin (Naos buffet) and Leo (Vento). Thank you very much for going out of your way to take care of us and for being so warm and friendly
- All of the drink service staff around the pool/beach areas - always so friendly and attentive 
- The food at Vento, Naos and Market Grill were delicious 
- The pool and pool areas were always kept incredibly clean - thank you to that staff!

Conclusion: For the amount of money we paid, I would probably not stay at this hotel again. I'd look for a newer or renovated resort, probably one with better amenities that are available throughout the day (not just for 1 or 2 hours through the day) and with staff members that inform guests of the fun activities to be aware of for the day.

reviews.author: Randy H
reviews.title: Fall Family trip to the All Inclusive resort of "Paradisus Cancun", Mexico
reviews.text:
Our family of four had a very enjoyable time visiting Cancun and staying in the Melia Resorts of "Paradisus Cancun".  This was an All Inclusive resort, right on the beach.  

We booked a "Family Concierge Ocean View Suite" that was actually very disappointing.  It was not set up like their website showed.  Instead of having two double beds in the main room and a lot of sitting areas/TV/tables in the second room, there was just one bed in the main room and a fold out couch and no chairs in the second room.  The couch was very uncomfortable when folded out to a bed.  A cot type bed was brought in for the forth sleeping bed and it was also very uncomfortable.

In talking with the Manager she told me out of the 7 Suites normally available 4 were being worked on so there was nothing she could do to make things better.

We got a second cot brought in.  We moved the couch to the main room so the four of us could sit and talk and play games.  Other things that were found were:  half the electrical outlets did not work; the main bathroom sink would not drain; the patio door lock was broken and the door would hardly move; the ceiling fan was wobbly and very noisy; there were only two chairs on the balcony.  Our "Butler",named Alex, was very helpful in getting most of these thing fixed and even brought a third chair for the balcony.  It took about two days to get all these little thing fixed.  The service provided to us was excellent but, the basic room was, again, very disappointing and not worth the money we had to pay.  The room was on the first floor, with bushes along the balcony edge, so we didn't even get the so called "Ocean View" until they were finally trimmed on day 6 and we jumped up on a patio bench.

As for the rest of the resort I must say that the staff was very friendly and helpful, especially Alex and Lilly, our two 'Butlers'.  All the employees in the numerous Restaurants were great also, along with the maintenance people that worked on our room.

Again, our two Butlers did a fantastic job.  They made restaurant reservations each night, gave us two free "Bali Bed" reservations, helped with all room problems, as much as they could, etc...

The pools were very nice and so was the beach.  The 9 hole golf Course looked very nice but, we didn't get a chance to play.  A great excursion was booked for us by a company located right in the resort.

I should have quizzed the check in lady a lot more before heading off to the room.

All in all, we still a nice vacation thanks to the employees that actually helped us.

reviews.author: Stremma
reviews.title: Could Be So Much Better
reviews.text: Breathtaking lobby, spectacular facility.  On first glance, this is a great place until you start to stay there and experience the frustration.Starting with the bedroom, don't try and sit on the hide a bed couch for any length of time.  Your back will thank you.  We actually stuffed some pillows under the couch cushions to try and get a comfortable seat while watching TV.  It helped.  We didn't have anybody sleeping on the hide a bed, but I'm sure they would hate it.The food selection is spectacular.  Just don't expect the food to be hot, and don't expect to eat it on a stable table.  Seriously ... 9 out of 10 tables at the resort wobble like a weeble.  If I ever go back to this hotel, I'm bringing a few wedges for the tables and the lounge chairs.Call the front desk when you're leaving the room for a while and ask them to clean your room or your room won't get cleaned that day.  Turndown service was hit and miss.  Sometimes we got it, other times we didn't.  Bring your own face towels.  We never got any.The practice is that people reserve choice pool locations and palapas around 7:00 am.  One day, we put out our towels at 7:00 am only to return an hour later to find that our towels had been removed as the entire pool area was reserved for a private function later in the day.  The hotel management removed from service about 20% of the pool chairs affecting all those in the resort that were not part of the private event.Pool service was spectacular.  Shout outs to Flo, David, Sergio, Luiz, Elliott and Michael.  They kept us comfortable and hydrated.

reviews.author: Bcardonne
reviews.title: There are better hotels in Cancun for this price
reviews.text: Stay in a newer hotel, no friendly staff at pool bar, the check in personnel not friendly, show at night not good, boring hotel, water leak at the room, we had to call twice and go to the reception to get it fixed.

reviews.author: gary g
reviews.title: Based purely on value it's a great place
reviews.text: Mixed review, super attentive friendly staff, based on price well worth the cost, amazing architecture, really huge sprawling resort, terrific beach, food is reasonable but far from great, rooms reasonably clean, nicely appointed, very poor housekeeping (always short towels, water, soap, had to keep asking, the same spilled fruit stains outside the door were there when we checked in and still there when we left).  "Butler" concierge was very helpful in reserving restaurants.  Market grill very good, Rafael was fantastic, Fuego was very good, Vento only fair, Tempo very strange, reasonable upcharge for the experience but wine costs are insane, much higher than any restaurant I've ever been,  "resort credits" are a joke, you get a ticket book that you try to apply to services, but if the spa has a special, you can't use the ticket and the $100 bottle of french wine qualified for the $10 coupon discount,  but the front desk wouldn't honor it at check out.  $550 in resort credits, we attempted to use 4 coupons all were rejected for one lame reason or another.  Go for the bargain price off season and it can be a great vacation however Live Aqua is much better as are several other options like Le Blanc.  Paradisus Cancun is nowhere near as nice as other Melia locations and the "credits" are very misleading.  Royal section is worth it for peace and quiet, avoiding children and most of the crowded areas.

reviews.author: CanadianSuzyQ
reviews.title: VERY DISAPPOINTING
reviews.text:
1)     This hotel has a "Club" (time share), and you are directed to them when you check in.  Too aggressive for my liking. 
2)      No one seemed to know what the entertainment was and where it was and even what time it started.  This is the first all inclusive hotel I have ever stayed at that didn't have nightly entertainment - at a set time and in a set place.
3)      Food was OK.  Staff was great.  
4)      Spa - massage was amazing but the experience before (1 hour before was boring and the water was cool to cold in the pool area and the shower
5)       One day they put up a blow up slide by the pool for the kids, but that was it.  No one doing water aerobics, playing volley ball or anything else to keep the guests entertained.

reviews.author: Shaman
reviews.title: Starting to show its age
reviews.text: We really liked our experience at the restaurants here, but the hotel it self is really starting to show its age. The pools were not adequately heated during our time there, but the staff and service were really kind and amazing. We paid extra for the Royal Service but I would not do so in the future, we barely saw our "butler" and he was no where to be found after maybe one or two days. The best part about Royal Service was the royal service only restaurant, which had an amazing view. We have been to four the the Paradisus brand resorts and this one by far had the best food.

reviews.author: Pev1982
reviews.title: Thank you Rodolfo & Alexander
reviews.text:
If you do decide to stay here, make sure you opt for the concierge service, request for Rodolfo & Alexander to be your butlers as they are brilliant. 

Food wasn’t that great, we had dominos 4 times and went out of the resort for dinner most nights. 

Thank you Rodolfo & Alexander for making our stay so lovely. 

Lots of love 

Patel family - room 1601

reviews.author: Pathfinder234683
reviews.title: Relaxation
reviews.text: N Joy our stay somewhat, was better when we stayed there before and was not as expensive on the other side. It has its pros and cons, should be able to use other Cabanas when others are in use on adult side.

reviews.author: Tomas W
reviews.title: An Ok ....huge Resort
reviews.text: I give this resort 3.5 starsI would consider it a 4 stars if the food was better.The staff is really attentive and ready to help.The Royal Service adults only was a good option for us, great quality premium beverages and the size of this section is a bit cozier than the rest of the ptoperty.The resort is HUGE and difficult to see it all in a 4 days stay, the Disco is awesome for after dinner fun...without children running around.Our only bad experience was outside Vento while having dinner...we saw roaches crawling from a lobby fish pond...to underneath our table....our appetite was gone for the remainder of the trip.

reviews.author: Tourist46534803668
reviews.title: Paradises Cancun
reviews.text:
Hello all!

This was my very first time staying at the Paradisus resort and I was for the most part pleased.

My critiques would be the wait for seating at a restaurant if you were to arrive anytime later then 7pm the wait could exceed an hour. Also, not a wide variety of food, restaurants very small in comparison to the size of the hotel. Fuego was good, we enjoyed the sirloin and seafood dishes. The largest buffet on site was closed for reservations until our last day. The outside grill was satisfactory, definitely could have been better. 

Our room was SUPER small, we had a junior suite ocean view which is the typical room we book elsewhere, but this was exceptionally small compared to other resorts. Bathroom & room decor was dated. Long walks to restaurant areas.

The bar sizes are super small. THERE IS NOT ONE BAR WITH A TV, sports lovers beware! We were forced to leave the resort to watch a football game. Unlike other resorts aside from the pool bar there were only two more bars, one in the center which could only fit 6 people and then a large entertainment area that in my opinion was a waste of space, only opened late at night. 

The cabanas on beach look dirty.

Now to the good stuff!...

My boyfriend and I were celebrating our anniversary so when we arrived there were rose petals on floor, also champagne was delivered that night. 

Cabana service (at the pool) was worth the money, we had a blast. Our servers David and Didier were AMAZING!! I can not compliment them enough, very personable, great attitudes, attentive to all of your needs. The lobster and champagne served were great. 

The pool bar was nice, the bartenders were good and again attentive. (Closes at 6pm, which was the worst part). 

We did a fishing excursion through Aqua world and it was amazing. We caught in total 17 HUGE fish, the staff was great and super helpful. Conveniently Aqua world is located directly across the street from the resort.

The center bar was good (with the exception of size) but bartender Jamie made it that much better, he was great, again super personable, pleasant! 

Clean resort. 
Food mediocre.
Great service - Jamie (center bar), David and Didier (cabana & pool service)

reviews.author: Journey59531
reviews.title: Confused by all the positive reviews
reviews.text:
- There is only one restaurant that accepts dinner reservations (the most expensive one); aside from that, it is a 1.5 HOUR wait for dinner each night. I have no idea why people are saying that their butler got them dinner reservations -- ours told us that dinner reservations are not possible and that we either need to show up at 6 pm to hope to get in within 10-15 minutes.... otherwise, it's easily a 1-1.5 hr wait for dinner. And you are not allowed to leave the area, because if they call your name and you are not there, you lose your reservation, so you literally need to stand outside of the restaurant for an hour just to get in!   

- Assuming you can get in to one of the nice restaurants, they are only open for dinner...

-... therefore, the rest of the day, you're stuck mostly with buffet food: soggy fries, over-cooked hot-dogs, room-temperature ceviche...leather-tough waffles at breakfast.  Yes, the omelettes at breakfast are lovely... too bad there is a 30-minute long line to get them!!!!

What is the point of going to an "all you can eat" place if the waits are so long, you can't actually eat anything?  (and the stuff that IS available at the buffet is unappetizing?)

And the free alcohol -- sure, it's "free", as in "might as well we alcohol free" -- we ended up ordering beer and wine in the hopes of getting alcohol in the drinks; otherwise, they were very weak. 

Enjoy your relaxing time by the pool.... as the tour operators try to sell you on a tour package for the umpteenth time, or relax on the beach as hawkers walk by, trying to get you to buy their stuff  / get your hair braided. 

My lesson has been learned -- if this is what all "all-inclusive" resort is (it was my first time staying in one), then I will never do it again.  There are so many tricks for them to save money (cheap buffet food; lines so long at the restaurants that you can't eat at them; watered down cocktails...), that it is not even close to being worth the cost. 

Oh! My favorite part!  The "all-inclusive" latte / capuccino service... that was only open for like 2 hours per day!   I was SO excited when our butler told us that the Nespresso latte / capuccino / espresso bar was included in the all you can eat.... well the joke was on me, because the place was never open.  Even better, they don't even post a list of times that it will be open!  Ditto for the free gelato place next to it. Free gelato, wow!  Except... except it was almost never open? 

From now on, I'd rather spend twice as much money but go to a hotel where I can get what I want, when I want it. 

Sorry if this is harsh but the fact that there are SO many 5-star reviews here had given me sky-high expectations... expectations that were not met by the sad buffet food, the room service with only a handful of options, and the 'six pm or nothing' option for the nice dinner restaurants.  I only get a little bit of vacation each year, and I want to relax and Id rather pay for my latte, but at least get one when I want one.

reviews.author: Rafik G
reviews.title: Cancun Vacation
reviews.text: Not good value for money, pools need maintenance and upgrades, so loud too. Few restaurants were closed for renovations, air condition is loud in the rooms. Tenjo and Vento are the best restaurants, and night shows are really nice.

reviews.author: eb0nyg0d
reviews.title: Nice trip
reviews.text: There was a few of us that came together, we took up 5 Ocean view rooms, we called up prior to us arriving and requested the rooms be on the same floor. We were given the rooms as requested. On arrival the Concierge told us to check in and that he would be along shortly to assist us with our suitcases. After check in, he and his colleagues were nowhere to be found. So we lugged our suitcases upstairs. 2 of the rooms had initial problems with their showers and maintenance was called, unfortunately the issue was resolved with us tinkering about with the controls and maintenance still had not shown up. The rooms were adequate sized, with private balcony. The balconies themselves could do with a deep clean but they were nice to use. The rooms were nice and cosy but could do with a fair amount of maintenance, cleaning of the rooms was sporadic and to ensure that they were done, it is an idea to call housekeeping as you are going out. Room service was quick but unfortunately the food kept arriving lukewarm, even after I specifically told them this and requested hot food. In the restaurant for breakfast, Gaudcino took care of us and he was different types of amazing, we were there for my daughters birthday and he made it extremely special for her. I would like to say a special thank you to him. The beach area for us commoners quickly filled up, and the service was definitely of the quality that made the Royal service section very enviable. I can understand there being a 2 tier service but some decent service for the ordinary guests would have been good.The beach however was well maintained and the dead seaweed cleared away from the the hotels section of the beach was nice to relax.  I have to confess I have previously stayed in Cancun at the Ritz Carlton and the difference in service is pretty obvious. The hotel needs refurbishing and a tightening of their services, the staff are amazing and do what they can, but to be classed as a 4 * hotel, I do not think they are there yet. For instance, I was informed that the gym was 24/7 but on going down there early one day I was told that it did not open until 6AM, All in all a brilliant stay, the staff made it so that I would stay again, but certainly not before a full hotel refurbishment.

reviews.author: CFM
reviews.title: 6 Day Family Reunion
reviews.text:
Here is an honest on-balance review of the Paradisus by Melia – Cancun, from soup to nuts. 

 I planned the trip as family reunion, with olks flying in from NY, CA and GA. 
Shuttle from airport to hotel (SuperShuttle) - went very smoothly in both directions -- although I did contact Expedia a day or two before arrival in Cancun requesting that they contact the carrier in Cancun to confirm and verify the reservation.  I Did this based on the mixed reviews I saw on-line.  Expedia happily obliged, and the supervisor of the shuttle service contacted me by e-mail from Cancun to confirm.  Suggest you do the same -- to avoid any of the horror stories you read about from some previous customers of the service.  Service was on-time, courteous, direct to hotel, polite driver - both ways, and affordable.

Hotel:  This place is massive.  Has 5 separate blgs. (all connected).  Has a golf course (was planning to play a round – but it was too hot.  Also expect to pay $25.00 each for a few clubs, and 12 dollars for three hotel inscribed balls.  Course is 9 hole – real short – almost like pitch and put.  Get out by 8 AM or you’ll fry!!  We went in October.  Based on course size, condition, price and weather conditions, we didn’t feel it was worth it.  There was no one playing anytime we looked!!  We did the all-inclusive pckg. For everyone, and arrived a day earlier than others to iron out any kinks.  Room (gulf facing) was nice – but small (it was deluxe ocean view Jr. ).  Mini-bar poorly stocked – no liquor, beer soda, water and a few candy bars.  A/C was good.  Rain shower a plus.  View excellent.

Went to pool and got a real surprise.  Pretty crowded and LOUD.  Better get there early or you won’t find two chaises together, despite size of pool. A lot of loud activity in pool – especially around the swim up bar.  20-30 somethings (yo) very loud, boisterous and drinking heavily.  Music being played around the pool was at top volume, and most of it was hip-hop/rap.  No matter where you went along the pool you couldn’t escape it.  At 3PM – three entertainers (female) scantily dressed located themselves atop a knoll overlooking the pool, and continued the hip-hop live – the volume was so loud that I saw people fleeing the area.  I won’t comment critically on their ability because I’m not a fan of that music.

We thought about the several days we would be there, the situation we encountered, and decided to upgrade everyone in our party to what they call “Royal Service” .  Had to change rooms – different section of hotel – lost the gulf view – but had an “adults only” area to enjoy and a variety of other upgrades – which we paid handsomely to get.  The quieter atmosphere itself was worth it.  You are given a private valet/butler who will make reservations, run interference as needed, and pay some special attention to you.  The fellow we had was “off” 2 of the 5 days we were in “Royal Service” – but he was helpful and nice when around, and when we needed him.  You get his cell # to call for anything, and he touches base with you a few times a day.  .  Name was Alex – spoke excellent English which helped us. (This place is a real Int’l destination with people from all over the world represented).  Royal service upgrade quite expensive.  Allows you to use a restaurant by their pool which serves breakfast and lunch – and it was a joy to get away from the craziness and crowds at the buffet. 
 
Don’t plan on losing anything while there (eg – in my case a pair of glasses, and sandals).  The lost and found is a joke.  When the hotel rep in charge of (L&F) essentially told me I thought she was lying because I expressed surprise that only 1 pair of pink glasses and a pair of flip-flops were all that was in the lost and found (as far as items I was looking for), I felt offended.  She was a female named Neyeea.  I checked back with her later in the rip – same attitude!!  The sandals (a real good pair) were left under the cabana bed reserved for our private use for the time we were there – I’m sure no occupant picked them up.  The glasses were lost on the beach – so that I guess would have been tougher.  

The Restaurants were generally pretty good – BUT you need reservations TWO days in advance to get into anything other than the buffet.  So be prepared to make Reservations on arrival.  Despite this, there were usually plenty of open seats at the specialty restaurants we got reservations for.  Our private butler was helpful on this.  The food at the buffet was below-par.  The specialty restaurants (6) were fine.
The evening shows were pitiful!!  I’ve been to many resorts over the years – Cancun amd otherwise, and these were the weakest shows I’ve ever encountered.  They usually started around 8 and went 90 min.  I won’t even bother to describe them --- just take my word!!  Seemed like most people stayed away.

No American TV at all – no sports – all news was Int’l or local.  Very few Eng speaking channels.  Wanted to watch a particular college football game on Sat, and had to leave the grounds and go to a neighboring hotel that had a sports bar.  If you need TV coverage, plan ahead.

Ocean was beautiful – Beach well maintained.  Royal service pool was well maintained – can’t say the same of the other pool.  I’ll just leave it at that.

The main bldgs of the resorts (5) were huge wide open spaces with atrium's – and these are where the different restaurants are located.  Either they interiors were too exposed to the elements or they weren’t  Air Conditioned – because it was Really Hot anywhere in them – which made eating unpleasurable at times.  Fans were blowing hot humid air around in many of the restaurants.  Walking around in the shops was also uncomfortable.  May have been that the place is just too big to keep cool.  

All in all, I would rate our vacation a 5 out of 10.  I am generally not a complainer at all – and I don’t consider this to be a bad review – just an average one.  Nothing special.  I would have expected Royal Service would have been more special than it was.

The ladies enjoyed the spa services – they got some discounted treatments being on the Royal Service tier. 

Probably wouldn’t return.

reviews.author: Angela Peoples
reviews.title: Nice hotel but needs an upgrade
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradiusus in Cancun for 4 nights/5 days in October. Our arrival experience was excellent, very efficient and complimentary drinks offered at check in. However we did not appreciate the ‘hard sell’ on activities from the ladies who greeted us, we found it difficult to stop them and go to our room. Food isn’t great, in fact we only had one nice meal in the Mexican restaurant. Be careful as everything is not included in the all inclusive. The location and pool area are beautiful and the entertainment during the day was great, we thoroughly enjoyed everything the staff put on. Our last night stay was marred by the very noisy nightclub below us. The music was soo loud we didn’t get much sleep until around 2am when it closed. One afternoon we were sat on our balancing and a steel ‘girder’ dropped from a height above us. We reported to staff who came and removed it but no apology was received, nor at check out when we again reported it. I have attached a photograph of this.

reviews.author: Fyodor K
reviews.title: Was a really great resort, but degrading during the last two years
reviews.text:
We were coming to Paradisus Cancun five years in a row and were really happy during our visits. The resort was really the best we've seen in Cancun and we were looking around for different resorts and every time were convinced that Paradisus is the best. Few great points are for: fantastic interior that looks like a tropical garden under the roof, great location right in the middle of hotel zone, and great quality food with nice selection of fresh juices, smoked salmon and french cheese for breakfast; few sorts of fish and seafood for dinner and nice la-carte restaurants when you want to try something new.
The amenities are OK with special kudos to the Kids Club stuff that is organizing nice activities for the kids.
Speaking other words we were super happy and would continue to come back. Things started to degrade a year ago (2017) when the fresh juice disappeared and seafood dinner with lobsters and crabs started to happen only once a week. But this year (2018) things became really bad - the quality of food severely degraded: no more french and swiss cheeses (only local cheese), no more smoked salmon, barely one kind of grilled fish every other day. I wasn't able to find even grilled veggies for dinner... They closed three restaurants for renovation and looks like they are unable to keep up the good service and good variety of food. So, essentially, you are getting less for your money (price remained approximately the same).
With all this combined, unfortunately, Paradisus has likely lost us as customers and this is quite sad, because the interior and the location are great.

reviews.author: Glowee
reviews.title: The Paradisus Cancun was just okay
reviews.text:
Went to Paradisus with my girlfriends for a long getaway weekend.  The food wasn't good, the best meal we received was when we rented the Bali bed for the day.  The drinks were good with top shelf alcohol.  The hotel itself is beautiful and for the most part clean.  Wish there were more activities during the day but the nightclub was definitely the place to be at night for drinking and dancing.  

We encounter some great staff at the hotel, Didie and Rene in the Bali bed area, Julio with entertainment, Atilano in Fuego, and Jorge in the Market Grill.  These staff members made our stay at the Paradisus unforgettable, if the food was good I would've given the hotel five starts.

reviews.author: S C
reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text: Booked through westjet vacations we wanted a five star all inclusive. This is not 5 star we have been coming to  Cancun and riviera mya for 10 years this is worst experience. Three restaurants closed indefinitely. There is drywall dust in elevator and on the floors . There are power cords  across the elevators .Room service only came after complaining after an hour.  15 french fries cold burger .....pass on this establishment.  There are many higher rated

reviews.author: Rumrush
reviews.title: Upgrade to “Royal Services”
reviews.text:
Food: all restaurants were average. The best one (great food) was “Fuego” 

Rooms: definitely upgrade to “Royal services”, their rooms are renovated and their pool is for adults only and very nice. 

Beach: very nice, waiters attentive and friendly.

reviews.author: Brittany P
reviews.title: Our honeymoon
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed here for 7 days recently, my first impression of this resort is wow, gorgeous!! I love plants so absolutely loved the way the did this resort up. 
The food was ok, the only restaurant we ate at was enso ( it was good ) because that’s the only one we could get a reservation for! Every other restaurant was booked or closed, what they don’t tell you at check in was that you can reserve 2-3 days in advance not the day of up until 4 pm like they told us! 

The activities were poor compared to other resorts I’ve stayed at, they had different activities listed throughout the day but they never actually played them which was disappointing. 

We really enjoyed the play Coco, Mexican dancers and the circus! 

Our room wasn’t anything special, we were lagoon view, out bed was so soft and sagging that I ended up in the middle of the bed every night, the bathroom was gross, the bathtub was stained and the ceiling looked as if it was a 2 star resort, ( pictures below ) we also had a few bugs in our room ( ewww )

The coffee bar was often out of coffee or cream and gelato was often closed early. 

The beach and pool area is amazing however I wasn’t super impressed when they brought out 3 dancers on the bar while the kids club was in the pool as well as other kids and families, I know I wouldn’t be impressed if my kids were with me, they were playing some really derogatory music too! 

We love Mexico and are looking forward to a new adventure there in the new year!

reviews.author: Fara S
reviews.title: Man I wish I could give this resort a 5 star.
reviews.text: Hey everyone! I'm back with a detailed review of the Paradisus Cancun. First let me begin by saying how much fun I had during my 7 days! What a blast! I went parasailing, jet skiing, boat touring and Flo riding. Alright, the two cons about the hotel is the very long check in procedure. I can't tell you how long we had to wait on the line just to get checked into our room :-( I guess it's expected on a Tuesday/Wednesday. The second and major con were the two small roaches we found in our room during our stay. Oh my goodness I can't begin to tell you how I despise insects in my living quarters. Anyhow, after all the grimace and running back and forth we killed the insects. I can honestly say that this hotel would've definitely been a 5 star if it weren't for one of the two cons (the insects). Other than that the hotel is beautiful, the beach is beautiful, the pool is fun, the reception/conference center for weddings was beautiful! The food was simply ok nothing major and the entertainment was nice too. The rooms and restrooms were spacious, but the hallway leading to our room was a bit dim...I'm guessing it's because they wanted to keep the jungle theme going from the main lobby. One big piece of advice I would give to the wedding coordinators; if the ceremony has to be held indoors because of weather I would advise that the ceremony take place in the hallway outside the reception hall. I cannot begin to tell you how large, bright and beautiful that area was. The wedding that I attended was so dim because of the jungle themed lobby area. Not a good place for a ceremony. Overall, I had a blast, but the only thing that would have made this top notch is if I didn't have to play bug inspector. Oh and I almost forgot, outside my room were towels because the ceiling was leaking.Hotel is handicap accessible, smoking outdoors and is a family resort.  :-( That's all for now. Pictures to follow.

reviews.author: JTomaaque
reviews.title: Relaxing, but not up to par.. (food and drinks get 1 star)
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful, relaxing time at Paradisus, but we would likely never come back. The service is nice, the main tower is gorgeous and the smells are wonderful. We stayed in Royal Service and our room was very nice. One of the drawers to our dresser was broken and there were some odd, out-dated parts to the hotel, but nothing too bad or uncomfortable. 

The private Royal Service pool was quiet and peaceful. Our first day in a Bali Bed, we barely saw our server which was frustrating. Our second day though, our server was very attentive. Even on the beach one day we had great service. 

The food was TERRIBLE. We read so many reviews and did a lot of research before settling on Paradisus. We saw the reviews where some said the food was bad and thought "well, ya, but its big buffets.." Frankly, I have a guilty pleasure for mid-quality buffet food- typically! Unfortunately, very few things were enjoyable, or even edible, during our stay. Cold, runny, or straight-up weird stuff. The best, in my opinion, were the tacos at Blue Agave and the food at La Palapa (private royal service restaurant). Vento was like the buffet food but in small portions and Enso was cold and mass-produced dishes. The Naos buffet had a few winners (surprisingly enough, the ceviche was decent) but mostly just cold, stale and bad. You get a lot of the same ingredients/tastes across all the restaurants which gets slightly annoying!

Something I didn't read about at all, but killed my vibe personally, was that all the sweet drinks used artificial sweetener! The sour mix and all the frozen drinks had a bad taste/aftertaste that I couldn't stomach after a couple days. Ended up just ordering vodka/tequila with soda water after that. These were fine but I REALLY wanted to kick back with a piña colada on most days and just couldn't put up with the taste any longer. 

I don't regret the vacation but would've traded some of the better parts of Paradisus for better food and drinks and would seek a better all-inclusive experience in the future. 

The weather was fantastic in October. We had rain forecasted every day but only got 1 brief shower in the morning.

reviews.author: hollymasterson
reviews.title: Good Hotel - needs updating. Just missed out on 4 stars.
reviews.text:
A lovely hotel but needs updating, think website and travel agency’s are a bit misleading on this. To begin with we had a nice bedroom located in the 4th tower. Room was nice, bit dated. A couple of days into the trip the aircon unit started to leak – it got considerably worse as the day went on until there was a mini swimming pool by the door. We also had a lot of water coming in through the balcony doors due to the rain. We complained and asked to move rooms. This was sorted and we were moved to a room in the 3rd tower. This room was better and was more modern! However after a couple more days in this hotel they started doing building work above us – which started really early in morning and went on until the early evening. Once again we complained but nothing was really done about this issue and in the end just decided to get on and enjoy our holiday. We found it really strange that they moved us to a room which they knew would be disrupted by the building work – not very good customer service. Tip – if you are planning on staying here the rooms in 2nd and 3rd tower are not very quiet as they are above all the bars! 

Food. Overall the food is good and does well for mass catering. Couple of places to stay clear off
Blue Algarve – food had absolutely no flavour! 
Vento – again really really bland food 
Enso – hit and miss – some dishes are ok and some again need flavour! 

The rest of the restaurants are great, including the buffet. Tip – on arrival they say you can book restaurants 1 day in advance, this is a lie you can book up to 2/3 days in advance so don’t get caught out. Reservations go quickly as not every restaurant is open every night. 

Swimming pools are excellent. There is an adults only/ royal service one, a quieter pool, the main pool ( which includes a swim up bar and music) and the kids pool which connects to the main pool. There are a lot of beds round the pools – the beds round the main pool are usually all gone by mid-morning but people come and go throughout the day. There is a serious lack of umbrellas! Cabanas are available to hire ( they are part of COCOs beach club) The beach is lovely and there are staff on hand to serve drinks.

Entertainment – hardly any of the activities that they advertised on the daily board actually happen… Evening entertainment is what you expect from a hotel. There were a couple of nights where the entertainment is exceeded expectations. 

Vibe – there is a real mix of dynamics at this hotel, couples, families, stag and hen groups, wedding groups. 
Staff – really friendly and mainly very helpful. 

Overall this was a good hotel. I believe they should have done more to compensate for the room problems but we could not be bothered to spend our holiday in reception complaining. There are better Cancun resorts but you will need to pay more so depends on what your budget is.

reviews.author: kristiamalone
reviews.title: Paradisus Melia Cancun
reviews.text: The hotel was built in 1999 and while our rooms were wonderful the outside pool chairs, outside of the building, and some minor leaking in our bathroom indicate repairs are needed. There were buckets in the hallway collecting rain and towels on the ground. If you like buffets vs sit down restaurants for lunch it is a great place. Most restaurants that are not buffets are only open for dinner or there is one for adults only. There are three pool options. One for little children, one for adults with loud club music and another quiet pool but there is no swim up pool bar in this one. If you book family concierge you will be provided with one VIP pool couch but only by the shallow pool and our children are too old for the shallow pool. Despite the rain with many of these couches available at the second large pool they would not move this as part of our experience.

reviews.author: Fer_MdelC
reviews.title: Not as good as before
reviews.text:
We were here two years ago and it was an invaluable experience. Service was great, food excellent and the premises were beautiful. 

This time we found an average hotel, the food was nothing exciting, it lacked the sea food and room treats we had on our last visit, the pool facilities lacked maintenance and the room jacuzzi didn't invite us to use it.

It's a shame to see that maybe because by trying to reduce costs they sacrificed quality.

reviews.author: Mark H
reviews.title: Mr
reviews.text:
This was our 17 th time to Cancun area. The reviews you read about this hotel are pretty accurate. The people are friendly that work there. The place is elegant, views are awesome. Food is confusing, pay here$ , not here, all inclusive means all inclusive. They will charge $ at certain restaurants. To confusing. The reviews , like I said earlier , are pretty accurate. However, no one addresses the “FUN” factor , this is not a “fun” place. They worry about elegance. It’s more for the 1 % ters of the world, not the common person, middle class. Of all the places, 36 throughout the Caribbean, we have been to , we have never been in a pool like theirs. 5’2” deep!!! Your kids can not play volleyball, basketball, etc....my wife is short , 5’4” tall. It was a struggle walking to the pool bar. Every pool we have been to is 4 ‘ (48”) deep. Kids playing everywhere. Absolutely no entertainment at the pool during the day, what? I’m not kidding. Everybody has entertainment at the pool, just not here. The music is European electronic dance music, and very loud. This is Mexico!!! 
This hotel is Beautiful, elegant, amazing, just not “ FUN”.  

Make sure you see the Whale Sharks.

reviews.author: marie e
reviews.title: Decent for the price
reviews.text: We returned to paradisus because we were here 2 years ago and really enjoyed our stay as well as the quality of everything for the price of the deal that we got. This visit was not as great. The quality of both the food and drinks has gone down. It's still a decent hotel if you can get a good deal on your room but it's just not great anymore. All of the drinks (even the ones that aren't supposed to be) were very sugary and very weak. I ended up having to buy a bottle of wine just to get a drink that wasn't loaded with sugar....then again, maybe that was the plan on the part of the hotel? The restaurants are not bad but we were not blown away. The red lounge was fun...until you wanted to go to sleep and couldn't because all you could hear is the noise coming from the red lounge if your room is close to it. The gym was pretty good for a hotel gym and the excercise classes were not too bad. The "entertainment staff" was not good. They often had events posted such as beach volleyball and pool Zumba that never happened which left a lack of things to do during the day if you weren't out on an excursion. Overall, not terrible but I don't think that we'll be returning.

reviews.author: washingtonsammy88
reviews.title: Check reviews b4 booking
reviews.text: Great location nice front hotel features nice lobby nice decore great food in resturants rooms need upgrading slow service when checking with staff members more staff needed at front desk slow service when checking out room service with towels and cleaning is slow.

reviews.author: JOSE M
reviews.title: 50/50 experience
reviews.text: During my stay I wasn't able to try every restaurant so wasn't completely satisfied and we had encountered elevator problems and restrooms through the hotel didn't have paper towels so I had to dry myself with my own shirt ...

reviews.author: Extraordinary581618
reviews.title: Great Staff - Mediocre Resort
reviews.text: The staff are there to help and do a fantastic job.  They were absolutely wonderful.  The grounds are lovely, although there was a ton of seaweed that was not removed until about our 4th day there; perhaps there's a good reason for that, but it smells and does not make the beach very inviting.  The pools were not crowded at all when we were there the first week of September.  We found it odd that the largest pool (with the only swim-up bar) was so deep.  It's huge and yet the entire thing is about 5 feet deep with the only shallow area leading up to the bar.  It could be because we're mature travelers (late 50s/early 60s) that we didn't appreciate the odd lounges/bars which had beds and low seating in one and just an odd decor in the other.  Maybe it's more suitable for a younger crowd; just didn't appeal to us.  The food was just OK - wasn't really our cup of tea.  We prefer Italian, French, American and I didn't pay any attention to the evening restaurant options before I booked so that's my fault and not theirs.    The buffet had nice options and I would say it was better than many other all-inclusives we've been to.  We were thankful we had gotten the Royal Service because it was the only place we felt we could go and be comfortable visiting with friends at regular tables and chairs.  Every morning and evening they had a (slight) variety of food options if you preferred to eat there and not at the buffet or elsewhere.  They also had a nice open-air restaurant and a bar out by the pool/beach that was exclusively for Royal Service guests.  Coors light was the only option as far as American beers go and they were only available in the Royal Service area. The Mexican light beers were tasty so that was fine. They had nice top-shelf liquors in the Royal Service area as well.Our room was comfortable and we were able to keep it nice and cool with temps outside in the 80s.  The rest of the resort was HOT.  HOT as in sweat your butt off hot.  There were a couple of restaurants with A/C and that's it.  The common areas, shops, majority of restaurants - basically the entire resort was without air.  That would be fine if there were any sort of attempt to bring the nice breezes in off the gulf, but that's not the case.  It's almost like the design KEPT the cool breezes out by putting up doors and glass and walls, etc.  This is the primary reason we will not be back.  We don't like to eat and drink and socialize while sweating.

reviews.author: SasaMil
reviews.title: Great service everywhere except reception
reviews.text:
Came to Paradisus Cancun on Friday , couple , requested one bed got 2 double, room was not clean, if you got out in balcony you can’t get back, no handle, night stand  drovers are falling out....when I when to reception with my concerns they told me, no other rooms are available ( even hotel is half empty) and well what can we do. ........
Very disappointed in room 3624 and reception staff service ( can’t even change money).,. Everybody else is happy to do it.
When I asked to upgrade to royal service I got 2 different answers on cost..$400 and then 15 min later $500

Otherwise food is great, service everywhere else is great.

This is my 3rd visit to Meliá and by far moist disappointing .

reviews.author: 24K60763
reviews.title: End of summer vacation
reviews.text:
Nice place. We stayed at tower 1. The area seems always clean. They fixed our room twice in a day. 
The staff are always helpful on everything you need. 
You can always expect courteous and friendly staff and people around here in Mexico. 
We opted out on all inclusive however, we had few meals in this resort. We had dinner at Mole and Naos. Personally, I think they need a new chef.

reviews.author: Andy
reviews.title: Cancun one day
reviews.text: This resort need update very nice staff. The pool need to be update the beach is not clean the food is really good this hotel is for adult not for a family a lot people drinking in the pool there is no place to seat very busy. If you have kids you have to go Paradisus Playa del Carmen.

reviews.author: Cmarch310
reviews.title: DO NOT recommend for Club Melia Members
reviews.text:
I greatly enjoy the Melia hotel chain and have stayed at multiple Melia resorts (Paradisus Playa del Carmen, Paradisus Punta Cana, Melia Orlando, The Level at Melia Tropical, spent a day at Melia Cozumel) and in my opinion this hotel does not live up to the rest. This was my second stay at this hotel (last stay was in 2016) and I would say the service has declined over the years. I traveled with a Club Melia member and we were NEVER contacted by anyone on the Club Melia staff to see how our stay was going. We were a bit surprised by this as every other time (8+ times) we have stayed in a Melia resort the service is always the outstanding part– here the service is what was extremely lacking! Cancun is one of our top travel destinations but unfortunately I will return to this resort again. 
Some notes from our stay:
-	The hotel accommodations are good - hotel is extremely walkable, everything in a short distance. Nice large pool area, Jacuzzi on balcony is a great touch. 
-	One of the “rules” is to not reserve chairs by the pool, however, during busy season if you do not get your spot picked before 8am you will not have much luck finding a spot later in the day. 
-	The food is not bad for an all inclusive. We enjoyed the Grill, the Brazilian steakhouse style restaurant as well as Fusion for dinner. Blue Agave has great authentic tacos. Red lounge is a fun nighttime option after 10pm. 
-	We had a wheelchair accessible room and if you do not need it I would try to steer away from it. Limited counter space in the bathroom as well as a bit of an awkward room layout due to ramps. It is not a deal breaker by any means but if you can avoid it I would try to. 

All in all, the hotel is not bad. However, in comparison to the other Melia properties and service we have received in the past, it definitely falls short from the others. We will not return.

reviews.author: Daria A
reviews.title: No life after 9 pm
reviews.text:
We love this resort . We r staying here for the second time. And the only thing that we dislike about it is lack of entertainment. They have a little ( mostly boring) show at night from 8 to 9 and that’s it. Once they had life music in the main bar after “main show” and it was awesome. However we stayed here for 5 days and it happens only once!!and please, stop doing this Michael Jackson show - it is getting worse with every year.... and it’s really lame. 
Otherwise great service, good food, pretty design.

reviews.author: BubblesVacations
reviews.title: Nice resort
reviews.text:
This is a long post so please read.  Hope it provides useful information. 

The resort is older and shoes it's age specifically when you walk the hallways to the rooms. 

Check in for us went smooth.
However, the room (Room 3327) we were given had AC issues and the shower leaked.  The maintenance guys were able to correct the issue a few days later but not the water leak.  So during our stay we used towels to clean up the water leak.

The restaurants are very nice but book a reservation to them at least 2 days in advance otherwise you will not be able to get in until late or just not at all.

NAOS, the buffet style restaurant was good.  However, there was not alot of variety and there seemed to be one station that offered left overs such as rice, beans,  meat etc.  Aside from that, there was a great waiter,   older gentleman that worked at this restaurant who made you feel so welcomed which, we really appreciated.  Blue Agave was another restaurant which serves breakfast and late lunch/dinner.  The other restaurants, Bana which serves Sushi, Vento which serves Tapas and The Market Grill which serves Rodizio and Mole which serves Mexican were all great.  These were a la carte  restaurants and the food was simply delicious. There were a few restaurants we did not visit because of time constraints. 

The host and chef at the Market Grill were great.  We let them know we were celebrating our daughter's birthday and they went ahead and prepared a cake for her.

There was not much entertainment during the day. At the main pool they kept playing the same songs repeatedly. In the evenings the shows were just okay. 

The Yhi spa was small but the staff was great.  Justina and Laura were fantastic!!!

Overall, we liked the restaurants and our massage.  Everything else was just okay.

reviews.author: happynómada
reviews.title: Drinks sucks
reviews.text:
all Drinks are made with a fake non natural sugar endulcorant that taste just bad and is risky for people with severe allergies because they never alert that everything that they prepare alchohol or non alchohol drinks are made with the same product.

Not because is all inclusive that means that drinks and food are free we all pay for that and is not cheap.

Pools are extremely dangerous even for adult people because are so deep that you cannot relax or play as a family.

Showers at the rooms have the same issues .... they have a bathtub super high for normal people and you can fall trying to get into.

Blue Agave restaurant is the worst they take several time to have your order ready and when you are finally ready to eat  have your tacos just taste bad.

Be careful because between the sargassum, insecurity and all Cancun problems you should take care of your guests.

reviews.author: Sandra O
reviews.title: Resort is okay
reviews.text: Not much day activities but i guess for older couples this is a go to since its a very quiet resort compared to what im used to. Staff is very friendly our friend fransisco who is the bartender at red lounge club which you should definitly visit if your planning on coming to this resort, showed us an amazing time he and the rest of the bartenders were very nice and entertaining. Our room was a regular lagoon view room which had a wonderful view. I woke up every morning looking foward to that view, the food i genuwinly hated, i only enjoyed the a la cartes im not a picky eater but that food i just couldnt deal with also we had some technical issues with our room shower and some appliances but nothing serious. Staff was always willing to help.

reviews.author: Rachel I
reviews.title: Meh.
reviews.text:
Pros:  Rooms are nice.  Buffet and bar staff went above and beyond and were fabulous!

Cons: Both during check in, check out, and several times when we had questions, there were anywhere from 3-5 people standing around with iPads.  Not one of them was able to answer any of our questions or help out in any way.  

I joined the "Melia Club" and checked in online several days in advance.  When we arrived at the check-in, there was a special line for club members. We sat in that line for several moments until someone told us we had to go to the other line.  There were additional people who had joined the line since we were there that were now in front of us.  The wait to check in was over 25 minutes.  I booked the resort with  my husband's credit card, but he was not on the trip.  It is the same account, but they made us rebook with my card and then refund his.  Bringing the card used to book the room was NOT listed on my confirmation email.  The room we reserved "wasn't available" and we were told it's not something the resort even offers.  I don't know how that's possible when I clicked the button for a two bed, ocean view room.  We were given a King size.  The room was nice, but we looked at a wall.  When we went to discuss this the next day as we were paying an additional $30/night for an ocean view, we were told that "nowhere on the website does it guarantee you a view" and that you are "either on the lagoon side or the ocean side".  (This is incorrect; see my attached photos.)  We were then given a different room that faced the ocean but had a poor view due to shrubbery.  Neither room had a stocked fridge when we arrived, however, when we went to take our stuff from the first room (we stayed one night there), the fridge was then stocked.  Lastly, there was a big difference in the height of the bathroom floor vs. the rest of the room.  I stubbed my toe in the middle of the night, and anyone with poor vision may end up doing it multiple times!

Dining: The buffet is great- good choices and variety, and they move relatively quickly to get you seated for meals.  Staff here went above and beyond!

We were not told at check-in that reservations were required for dinner.  I have been to several other all-inclusive Cancun resorts, some of which require reservations and others do not.  I have been informed at check in IF I need reservations at every other resort I've stayed at.  We went to get sushi, not realizing we needed reservations.  We were told we could not be seated because we didn't have a reservation, but there were *at least* 15 open tables.  After we pointed that out, they told us we could be seated in 15 minutes.  

Pools: We took a tour with a staff member of the hotel for an event.  She took us to the "adults only" side and showed us what the facilities in that area looked like.  The next day, we walked through the glass stores stating only "Adults Only" and attempted to settle in lounge chairs only to be told we didn't have the right color bracelet and the "adults only" side was only for patrons in Pyramid 5.  This was not previously explained to us nor is it posted at the entrance.

Pools were overall beautiful and were clean.  Service at the "regular" pools was slow.  Our server was very friendly but obviously had a big area to cover as she only came by once in about 2 hours.

All in all, we were very disappointed in such a highly rated resort.  While there was nothing earth-shattering like food poisoning, there were SO many little things that were not indicative of such a "nice" resort.  We will not be returning.

Pics are of our original room, the view from the Asian restaurant, or food, the room we switched to with a supposed “view, the empty fridge, doorway height discrepancy

reviews.author: InKleined2Blue
reviews.title: Somewhat Disappointed
reviews.text:
Located in the hotel zone, it is easy to get to the shopping district or to other resorts. Almost all employees were polite, friendly, and helpful. These are the two saving graces.

Now for the room. We were in an ocean view junior suite. The suite had ample room, although much of it was wasted space (bedroom area, kitchen/dining area, two bathrooms). One of the bathrooms, while spacious, had issues: hairdryer didn't work (actually smelled of burnt electrical) and no hot water. This suite needed repairs and updating. The wall had a hole near the base boards, the entry area had deep holes in the tiles, the fan was rusty, the bed lumpy, and the furniture worn. Food was ample (not always stellar) and servers were excellent. We ate at Bana one evening and found the food substandard (except for the salad). The daily buffet is usually the best bet, but it is repetitious. Upon leaving, we noticed enroute to the airport that one of us had left a hat on the bed in the room. We immediately called the resort to secure the hat. Of course, the hat was not located and we were given the runaround about retrieving it. If the hotel manager contacts us with information about returning the hat, I will update this review to be more favorable. Would we return again? Let's see how the hotel manager responds.

reviews.author: derek r
reviews.title: Okay
reviews.text:
I'll try to be short, simple and to the point.

Check in is not organized. Told to walk to the back to a place you can't find. Had to ask a few different people where to go. Decided to pass on the Family Concierge upgrade. $540. Don't think i would have used it much anyway. It was too hot to ever need a Bali bed. Dinner reservations were easy. 
Right after checking in a lady sits you down to offer you all these crazy discounts on tours if we go to breakfast for a couple hours in the morning. Thankfully i found a couple at the pool bar that day that warned me about it. It's $1400 once a year plus $250 a month. Then you still have to pay extra for air $$$ and All Inclusive which is $100 a day. Why would anybody ever do that? Just say you will show up and don't answer your phone the rest of the week. lol. I spend way less than that with Orbitz or any travel agent anywhere. 

Food was the worst I have ever had in a dozen years in Cancun. Seriously. My kids wouldn't eat anything but pancakes or hot dogs and hamburgers if they were available. Honestly I couldn't even tell what I was eating half the time.
Only ate at the Asian fusion and the sushi fine dining. Sushi was like Safeway. Asian was like frozen food. Gave up after that. Just ate out elsewhere. 
At least offer a taco or burrito for a day. nothing normal. You will understand when you get there.

Our room was amazing. room 3005. They gave me a king bed for 3 of us by mistake. They sent me down an extra single bed. I didn't complain cause the room, view and location was incredible. one of the new upgraded remodeled rooms. even with the extra bed there was still plenty of room. Ac would have this annoying knocking sound. would wake up almost every other hour because of it.

Bartenders were awesome at the swim up bar and the purple bar late in the evenings. I tip extremely well so i got poured nice nice drinks with premium alcohol. Tipping extra is always a good thing.

Hotel in general was beautiful. But no AC though. Always hot and muggy. sweating just going from your room to the restaurants. 

All and all it was okay. Just a little too big for my liking. I like a little smaller place where employees get to know you. Paradisus was okay just not my style. I will never like a time share pushy place. I should have done a little more research.
any questions feel free to ask.

reviews.author: Christee21
reviews.title: Same name totally different resort!
reviews.text: I wish I could give this resort 4 stars but I can’t. Reason being, during our stay we had 2 days of rain. Be warned, there is absolutely nothing to do at the resort if the weather is bad but eat. I was on a family vacation with about 15 people, 7 kids total. The kids ages ranged from 10-17. They were confined to their rooms playing games and on their phones because of boredom. I had an ocean view room which was modern and beautiful, I can’t say the same for my sister. Her room was a bit dated, refrigerator did not work and air conditioner did not cool the room. Also many places in the hotel was extremely hot, a few restaurants had air conditioning. Overall the food was decent, a bit repetitive at the buffet and we had to make separate reservations at the restaurants because many of them could not accommodate our Party size. Asian inspired restaurant was delicious. For the most part hotel was clean, staff friendly. Hotel entertainment was lacking. We all expected more because of the wonderful punta Cana location that we stayed at for my sisters wedding this is why we all came back together to help celebrate their fifth year anniversary. We all said we should have went back to the punta Cana location. P.S. no real party life atmosphere, total relaxation. The grounds was totally beautiful and well maintained.

reviews.author: perezrichard92
reviews.title: Save yourself and go to the Playa Del Carmen Paradisus
reviews.text: Came here with my girlfriend to celebrate our / year dating anniversary. Now, I know it isn’t a huge deal considering wedding anniversaries take priority, but still, I shelled out good, hard earned money and even upgraded to their “Royal Service”. My checkin was a disaster, having to wait nearly 2-3 hours before being given a room due to various miscommunication issues within their team. Then, they give us a room with a non functioning toilet, our housekeeping the following day did not have our room clean until 3-4PM despite waking us up at 930AM to clean it. Our welcome amenity was a day late, mind you I had to ask again where it was. Overall, the hotel itself was enjoyable due to us just trying to make the most of it, but if you are considering here or Playa del Carmen, I wholeheartedly recommend Playa. They know how to really take care of guests.

reviews.author: Cheetapita
reviews.title: Very nice hotel and worth the trip
