reviews.text: Overall a good resort with beautiful views. Unfortunately the interior is not air conditioned and you will feel it at the Japanese restaurant and other restaurants during dinner. I hate that feeling when having dinner so be warned in advance. Additionally the rooms are not renovated they are just painted all over same furniture in white. Looks pretty tacky to me and not elegant or modern. Just plain old tacky to see the dark brown furniture painted white.

reviews.author: tatiana_romao
reviews.title: Just an OK Hotel
reviews.text:
DEFINITELY not as amazing as people say. Cancun is magical, the beach is stunning and I would go back in a heart beat but we had a few issues at the hotel and it is NOT a 4 and a half stars hotel. The hotel has not been renovated they just built a separated new area called "Royal" in which you have to pay extra to be a part of. $60/ night more specifically. The breakfast is super super simple and DO NOT get drinks by the pool as they DEFINITELY add water to them. You think you would be drunk with 2 or 3, on the 8th you are just very fool and feeling sick from all the extra juices and water in it.

Also I called a week before getting there and aske them for a bday cake or something as it was my boyfriends bday the day that we arrived, not only the room was not ready before 5pm (we got there at 7am), but there was no decoration, nothing. After that was sorted, the day after we decided to hear a sales person talk about Club Melia as they would give us discounts in tours if we do and there were "no hard fillings" if we didn't want to join. Towards a somewhat of an ok presentation Viko or Niko, the sales manager pushed us to buy the package, was EXTREMELLY agressive and rude towards us! That was awful and DEFINITELY not worth the few bucks we saved on the tours. 

Also the pool is warm and the beach in front of it has so so many seaweeds that is hard to go in

reviews.author: Phuong Jenna T
reviews.title: Only good for Adults only, not family
reviews.text: We went as a group of 8 families with kids and teens. For those with Family concierge the experience is slightly better, but for non-family concierge, it's not a great experience. The hotel did not have enough staffs and not enough restaurant tables so if you don't have Family concierge, be prepared to wake up at 7am on your vacation to call in the restaurants to reserve. Even with Family concierge, which our family had, it's not a guarantee to get in a restaurant, so mostly you are stuck with a buffet that does not have enough variety or quality even in comparison of the cheapest cruise ship. The hotel is beautiful, and when we drop off our kids and head to the Adults only area, it's wonderful. Staffs there are attentive and the food/beverages are better quality. The beach is not great for swimming, it's filled with seaweeds, and the pool on family side are so packed that if you want a chair, you need to wake up at 7am on vacation and bring some personal things to put on them to reserve. The staffs tried, but there isn't enough of them comparing to the amount of guests, think waiting 1 hour for a drink by the pool, even when you tip them generously they are so overwhelmed. Our room was nice, but one of the bathroom leaks, and the furniture is pretty outdated. We won't be going back since it's not a relaxing vacation as we expected, even with Family Concierge/Ocean View Suite package, it's just okay.

reviews.author: LEL
reviews.title: Hotel - rate 9 - wedding coordinator - rate Marlene 0
reviews.text:
My fiancé and I recently stayed at this hotel 4th of July week and we opted to do Royal Service as it is adult only side and we did not want to deal with kids on this trip. When we arrived we got pulled into their registration area and were asked to wait until someone from Royal Service came and got us. The waiting area was dark and very humid after a long trip the last thing you want is to be seated in an even hotter area and we were not offered water or anything. We sat here for some time until someone got us. At least have fans going to cool the area down.

We opted to do the Royal Service and I strongly recommend to pay for the added luxury service as it is adult only side and you also get a butler. Our Butler was Daniel he was great as he took care of all of our needs. To making reservations at the different restaurants for different days and reserving the Bali beds during our stay. Daniel also saw our dislike of the location of the room and next day offered to upgrade us to a room higher up with a better view which was great and really appreciated. He also stayed in contact with us the entire stay and made sure things were okay with us, I also asked him to do something special in the room for our anniversary one day. When we came back from the pool and beach he had filled the room with rose pedals filled the tub with water, bubbles and rose pedals with a bottle of champagne. Which was great and my Fiancé loved it.  

The adult only side of the pool was great as the servers by the pool were always there to take care of you. Caesar, Victor, Joel, Edgar were great as they always made sure your cup was full and had food in your stomachs to get you thru the day.  

The adult side of the hotel is okay as it does pull you away from the crowds of people that gather in the main hotel. They do serve a continental style type of breakfast and will provide appetizer type items for lunch and desert during dinner hours. The Palapa restaurant is adult only and serve food all day. What is missing is some sort of entertainment on the adult side by the pool and indoor it will be nice to have. They do have a separate small pool area on the side that does have a nice view of the beach but it is covered by bushes so no one really sits there. It is very unfortunate as that is one thing that side is missing is a view of the beach from the pool

We stayed at this hotel because it was our top choice for our destination wedding. We had an appointment to meet MARLENE which we did not meet until the day of the appointment. When we arrived on a Tues we made the people who checked us in that we were there to meet MARLENE the wedding coordinator. Which I would of thought there would have been some notes in the system showing that we are there for that reason as well. Knowing that we are looking to spend money there for our wedding we would of received a nicer room to just give us the feeling of what a Bride & Groom will get and the view. I was not asking for the presidential suite but something to give me the Aww factor which we did not get. From Tues to Fri MARLENE did not once bother to show up to our room or even ask our butler to introduce us so that she can at least give us the feeling that she was very interested and excited as we are to maybe have our wedding there. On that Friday we did not hear from her as well and we did not even know where to go meet her. We finally met MARLENE she seemed confused as to why we were there which did not give me a good feeling. I did ask her if she knew when we were coming and she did not seem to know and her response was “well I told the front desk to let me know when you arrived” I am sorry that us not there job it is your job to know and to at least do pre meet and greet so we can have that Warm and Fuzzy feeling from her. From then on I was very disappointed and I did not get the feeling that she really did care about our wedding she was just cold the entire time. It is not a language barrier because we did speak to her in Spanish the entire time and she was not welcoming. She showed us around the property of possible location and brought us back to the office to show us the Bridal suite. Another bride came by to make a payment and she asked if she can take care of her and we said okay as we thought that it will be quick and left us with another Wedding Coordinator. We waited made small talk with the other WC and 30mins later MARLENE still did not come back and we just ended up finishing our questions with the other coordinator. She was very helpful and I am sorry as I forgot her name young lady she just started working there. After the meeting with MARLENE we did pass her up twice in the hotel and she did not even acknowledge us which was very rude. We had also asked MARLENE if she can show us a room in the hotel where the guest will be staying and she said yes. We were there from Tues to Tues and not once did MARLENE come by to apologize for having us waiting for so long or for not showing us a room. 

It is very unfortunate that we did not get the service from MARLENE that we would have liked since the main reason of staying in that hotel is to see what the service was like and how it would be for our wedding. I cannot trust MARLENE to provide us with the wedding that we would have liked. To me it seemed like she was more interested in the business side of things rather than actually being a wedding coordinator. Anyone can be an Even Coordinator but if you do not have the enthusiasm to show that you enjoy doing weddings than it rubs off on your personality. It does not give the couple that Warm and Fuzzy feeling that you are going to be taken care of. I can see why so many people have left MARLENE so many bad reviews on here.

Other than weddings I do recommend this hotel as it is a fun hotel for families and 1st timers as well. It’s on the main strip not far from the shopping, entertainment, and the airport.

reviews.author: Ethan N
reviews.title: Very disappointed the room
reviews.text: My family stayed 6 days at this resort on the 1st week of July. Everything is okay except the room and the cleaning room service was disappointed me. This is the ocean view room. You don’t want to pay much money for this type of room. The head light on the right side is almost fall off and the other light is keep turn on and off at night. The toilet seat is look old and disgusting. On my second day at the hotel, I requested the room cleaning service. Whoever clean my room did a good job but the third day was so bad. The mess still the same except they did change the new bed skirt ( I always put the room tips and thank you note on the table). The foods is okay! There are just few restaurants to eat because some of the restaurants only for reservations and it’s not easy to reserve it.

reviews.author: AmyKaye9
reviews.title: Okay visit, will never return
reviews.text:
Me, my boyfriend and our 7 month old baby stayed for a 5 days. We also were joined by our friends and their two young children who are loyal Melia customers. Here’s my thoughts on our trip. 

Check-in: Service was A-1 the moment we stepped on property. They made check-in a breeze. Only negative was the time share sales pitch. After traveling 10 hours with a 7 month old I didn’t want to be haggled for 15min. Also the check in area has the strongest and I mean STRONG odor of incents or oils not sure but it’s intense. 

Room: Here is where it went BAD. We stayed in a lagoon view junior suite room 3429, the view was beautiful BUT that was he only positive. The room was SO unbelievably musty and damp that it was clear the moment we walked in that it was infested with mold. I immediately called the front desk after 30min of trying to get over the odor. They stated that they couldn’t move us and i’d have to try my luck the next day. We said fine and showered and got ready to meet our friends for dinner. The room was seriously dated, mirror cracked, mold on the pictures in the room, mold all along the ceiling, old AC unit blowing hot air, furniture chipped. After dinner I went to the front desk to beg for another room. He said no again and told me we could move the next day. We didn’t even sleep under the covers we were so disgusted. I luckily brought a sheet from home for the baby crib and his own covers. Also the bed was broken, my boyfriend had to prop one side up with one of our pillows. Included are pics of the black mold. They never offered to refund us the one night we were forced to stay in a mold infested room. The new room 3 doors down 3433 was much better you could feel the difference in the air quality OK

Service: Wait staff at the restaurants are great! So polite and always on top of things. Staff at the pool bars, servers, pool attendants were amazing. Even on the beach they are right on top of things. They even had staff playing soccer with my friends son. Francisco and Victor at the bar The Stadium ( I think that’s what it’s called) were amazing!! My boyfriend even went down alone sometimes to visit and have drinks there while they worked. They remembered all our names and what we drank for the entire trip. 

Food: Naos buffet wasn’t terrible but wasn’t great. The best dinner was the Brazilian restaurant the last night. We had not one good Mexican dish while we were there. The pool buffets were convenient and did the trick while out with the kids. Wish we walked to a local restaurant one of the nights for better quality meal atleast once. 

Activities: we rented the jetskiis and that was fun. Wear sunscreen I got so burned out on it for even 30min. It’s a little walk but me and my boyfriend took turns going and it was a good time even alone.

Pool/beach: pool was amazing, clean and nice and deep for adults. They have a children side also and a swim up bar too in the main part. Service at the pool and beach did not lack. The beach had a ton of seaweed but was still nice and a beautiful view. Lots of shower areas to rinse off.

Tips: bring lots of sunscreen, I barely wore any because I wanted to tan and I am covered in a heat rash now. Also I did use the tap water to brush my teeth (didn’t drink only rinced my brush) and I had diarrhea one night and bad stomach pain. Not sure if it was the water, food or heat but  probably a combination. My friends husband got up at 5-6am every morning and reserved pool chairs and beach chairs. I recommend getting up early and doing so, it was so nice having a shady spot.

reviews.author: Ryan A
reviews.title: Royal service, cockroaches, great service, Butler.
reviews.text:
Cons: I stayed for 4 days and initially paid for the lagoon view but upgraded to ocean view when I got the hotel. Be aware if you get first floor ocean view. My room had cockroaches on half of the room and we weren't changed rooms for two of the 4 days. Apparently when a complaint goes in about cockroaches, a fumigation of the room is equal to a guy with a can of raid. They also failed to tell me about any of the Royal services for the two days, which included the fact that I had a Butler and free bottle of alcohol with my new room upgrade or any benefits besides the room view.

One more thing about the cockroaches. Once I found out I had a Butler I told him about my cockroaches and he fixed it immediately which makes me wonder what would've happened if I didn't have a Butler upgrade. Would they have just sent the guy with the raid can offer until I left? 

I probably would've left, but I know Mexico. Me leaving to another place means that the new hotel will know they have an advantage and get worse so I dealt with it.

Room service might as well just be frozen hot pockets and chimichangas. The food in room service was terrible but that's not a big deal to me. The restaurants more than make up for it.

Once you give them your money it's theirs. Even if you can't use half your room for 2 of 4 days because of cockroaches. Being denied a refund of $280 upgrade fee because I didn't get Royal services I thought was fair. They did not and refused my request for refund. 

Pros: minus the negatives, my ocean view was gorgeous. Fuego and mole were delicious restaurants. The yhi spa massage was the best massage I've ever had.  The staff is incredibly nice and seemed to always say hi even just in passing by which I like. My bed was awesome. 

The pool was great. The beach is great. Regardless of my cockroaches I loved the hotel. But I probably won't go back. The refund for cockroaches really bothered me.

reviews.author: KAZI
reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: Nothing special about his hotel. Food is average, not anything that I miss. We were there for 3 nights, but if we were there longer, I could see that we would get sick of the food. Activities were average. Nothing about this hotel and experience stood out above average. Not that we had any bad experience here, but I’ve stayed at better all inclusive resorts that I would not return to this hotel. It was just two girls and we had a very relaxing trip. Bar/club they have were lame. They did leave us a bottle of tequila in our room on arrival, but also we have upgraded to adults only area of the hotel. I’m not sure if that was worth it.

reviews.author: Eric W
reviews.title: First visit to an All-inclusive....lots of lessons learned.
reviews.text:
Mixed experiences here. Was under impression from Travelocity ad for it that it is 18+ (the "Royal Service" aspect), but that is only 1/4th of the property. The rest is family, so I felt somewhat misled. The bulk of the restaurants on-site were in the family section of the resort, and every meal I had in one of those spots, regardless of the quality of the food, there were screaming/yelling children everywhere where the parents just let them do it. 
I was not greeted when I got to the hotel, I was mis-directed to the general check-in (not the "Royal Service" I should have been sent to), and stood 45 minutes waiting to get to the counter. When I got up to the staff, he immediately saw that I should have been taken to the Royal Service portion of the hotel at which I was redirected. 
      The site is beautiful, and I was MOSTLY treated extremely well by staff. But the energy of the place does not seem to lend itself to "socializing" (couples and small groups basically stuck to themselves), so I was left to myself for virtually the entire trip (and I am a pretty social guy).
Note that the rooms have a LOT of ambient light that gets brighter the darker the room gets (at night) that can only be turned off by killing the master light switch- however that kills ALL the electricity in the room, so the alarm clock won't work, you cannot charge phones/ipads during the night, etc..Also, I was never made aware that the cabanas by the pool and beach need to be reserved in advance (which makes sense), so when I arrived on a Monday afternoon, nothing was available on paper until THURSDAY (and I was leaving Friday). In fairness, Tuesday and Wednesday I was on a waiting list and was able to get one, but it is not a guarantee. The food was hit and miss. Some things were delicious, others were very basic.(They had a seemingly difficult time with "medium rare" meat. It was either VERY medium well, or almost raw).  One of the perks is you get a free bottle of booze when you arrive, so I was set with Rum and Cokes in my room for the week. Like I said its a beautiful site, but if you are looking for a vacation that is truly 18+, this isn't likely the best place for you.

reviews.author: friscorealtor
reviews.title: Will be choosing another resort for future Cancun trips
reviews.text: I'll start by saying that we are frequent and loyal Melia members. This was our first stay at the Cancun Paradisus.  Upon our arrival, we were pleasantly greeted and our luggage was tagged. We were accompanied to the check in desk. The pleasantries stopped there. The gentleman checking us in was in a generally bitter mood. We were assigned an ocean front suite with a balcony jacuzzi and given the room number to set up the app.  He gruffly stated that it would be a 3 hour wait. Ok…off to lunch we go.  After the 3 hour wait, we return to get our keys. They attempt to give us a lagoon view with no jacuzzi. When I objected, he rolls his eyes and gives us the correct room. We get checked in and begin to explore. On the surface the resort is beautiful, but is in need of renovation. Most of the tile in the pool has fallen off. The pool is not a relaxing experience. One end is 2ft (great for small children), the middle is 6 feet and is quite surprising when you step off the last step, and the area by the bar is 5 feet.  I will say that the bar staff is incredibly friendly and accommodating.  My only negative is that they hand wash and reuse the disposable cups. REALLY GROSS!  The food at the buffet is average, but the restaurants are exceptional. We enjoyed our stay because Cancun is a stunning destination, but our overall experience at the Paradisus will lead us to stay at another resort.

reviews.author: dbillysmalls
reviews.title: Paradisus, not impressed
reviews.text: The hotel was poorly maintained.  There were buckets and towels all around to catch water leaks.  Guest room floors collapsed from water leaks, restaurant ceiling collapsed from water leaks.  Mold/Mildew present from water leaks.  Restaurant air conditioning broken for the entire week.  Night club was closed due leaks.  Some food was very good, some was terrible.  Kid's food was pretty bad, especially the burgers.  Booked this with a large group (14), none of us will return.  Beds were uncomfortable, both beds dipped 6-8 inches from one side to another.  Butlers Gloria and Maria were very good and friendly. Overall, average to below experience for the money paid.  They pushed us out of the large pool/pool bar at 5pm to set up for the nightly outdoor shows.  The other pool was under repair so there was no swimming after 5-6pm.

reviews.author: vfair2018
reviews.title: Had an amazing time!
reviews.text: The atmosphere of Royal Service was so peaceful and relaxing. The only problem I incurred were the lack of vegan options in the restaurants. However, one chef did make me a vegan dish since there wasn't anything that I could eat on the menu. There were also cockroaches in the YHI Spa that ruined my spa experience. My concierge went above and beyond for our stay. He truly made my birthday so memorable!

reviews.author: Leskind
reviews.title: Room 3006 sewage issue
reviews.text: Don’t stay in room 3006. The drains in room 3006 were stopped up and sewage bubbled up in the floor.  Management was slow to respond. I had to demand a new room.  The problem was a health hazard and definitely should be fixed. I’m sure this had happened before by looking closely at the baseboards in the bathroom.  Nothing was even offered as a compensation for the inconvenience.  I was moved to 1406 which was adequate.  Hallway was way to dark for my comfort.  The beds were comfortable and the view was amazing.  The room needed updating. The fan mad noise and the lamp had a short in it.

reviews.author: Wrldtrvlr
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: This hotel is about a 20 min ride from the airport and right across the street from aquaworld which offers great excursions. Bus stop for transportation to shopping is right in front of hotel as well. Great location. Middle of hotel is a beautiful atrium, but not air conditioned. Most restaurants were somewhat warm as well and fans were the only means of A/C. Staff was very friendly and tried to accommodate in every way. Hotel doesn’t pay attention to room requests. When making reservations, both parties requested double beds. Both parties received king beds. The people traveling with us had a horrible experience. Their shower backed up and flooded the bathroom floor, then the toilet backed up and flooded the floor. After several calls to the front desk, maintenance supposedly fixed the problem only to have it happen again the next day. This resulted in them having to move their things into our room to wait until after 4pm to get another room. Beautiful pool and beach area. There was a lot of renovations going on the hotel. Must say much needed! IMO... better options!

reviews.author: StreathamVoyager
reviews.title: Sub-par business trip
reviews.text:
Stayed here for 10 days for a conference in June 2018. It all went wrong as we tried to check in, as staff were giving contradictory advice about where to check in. You’d think it would be at the main “check-in” desks by the big front door. But oh no - we had to go down stairs, along a corridor, round a corner and then down an escalator to find another check-in desk for conferences. I was checked in efficiently and given a room number but no guidance on how to find it, so spent 15 mins walking round the hotel, dragging my suitcase, looking for the room. Suddenly no staff could be found for directions... Anyway, my room was tucked away in a basement level and if I leaned out far enough from its terrace, I could just about glimpse the parking lot. The room was large and perfectly clean, with a separate seating area down a small step. It’s what they called a “Junior Suite”. The light switches were a constant source of entertainment for the full ten days I stayed ... I still didn’t really work out which switch did what. They were like one of those logic puzzles where you have to align them all, in the right order, to get a light to switch on. In the bathroom, the towel rail and shower curtain rail were barely clinging to the wall thanks to a few loose screws. 

The hotel communal areas had a constant strange smell of rancid swamp. Some guessed it was the insecticide they use to keep the mosquitos down. If that was the intention, it was only partly successful. But at least being in the basement was good for my health - it meant using lots of stairs to get anywhere else in the hotel. As others have mentioned, the doors and windows (and on a few occasions, ceilings) leaked profusely whenever it rained, and apparently, it rains a lot in Cancun in June. Most of the bars and restaurants had their windows lined with towels most of the time. One lunchtime, a large part of a ceiling collapsed into the lunch buffet and water sprayed liberally over food and guests. 

A positive word for the staff, who were very helpful and friendly,and mostly spoke good English. Samuel at Coco’s bar by the beach was very helpful. 

This was my first experience of staying in an all-inclusive resort hotel, so I’m not sure what I was expecting from the restaurants. Having to book a table the day before you wanted to eat was strange (unless you want dinner at 6.30 or 10pm, that is). I’ll review some of the restaurants separately. 

Summary: I was travelling on business.  I wouldn’t spend my own money on coming back here.

reviews.author: Kristin S
reviews.title: Some good some bad
reviews.text: Family of 5, 3 kids ages 12, 16, 19.  The pros are the food service staff is very attentive in the restaurants, pool and beach areas.  The hotel in neat and clean throughout.  Hector was very nice and personable from the activities group.  It was fun to have music play at the pool and beach all day. The cons for our trip where that actual food is subpar compared to most all inclusives.  The buffet was very small and dinner variety was poor.  Our bed linens never got changed despite us leaving the cards on the beds daily.  We complained and they got changed only that day.  We had 2 rooms and the door was broken between the rooms which never got fixed.  There was nothing but beach volleyball for my kids to play during the day.  The activities are not for teenagers.  I was looking for aquaerobics, bingo, ping pong, etc... The pool and beach chairs are poor quality, have to get there early to reserve to get any.  The pool is 5 foot deep throughout entire pool except right at the bar, Im 5'2

reviews.author: susanxxe
reviews.title: Great property! Royal Service not worth it if you get a bad butler.
reviews.text: I booked 2 rooms at the Paradisus Cancun with a few girlfriends to celebrate a birthday. The property was absolutely beautiful, the amenities were great, and the food at La Palapa kept us wanting more. The only issue is that we had a terrible butler. We paid extra for the Royal Service based on high recommendations from another friend. Unfortunately, the service was not as described, which really impacted our overall experience.

reviews.author: Chrisboricua
reviews.title: Average hotel - not that good
reviews.text: My husband and I ended up in Cancun for the weekend. We choose this hotel because of the prices. The hotel is nice, but it’s in desperate need of renovation. Paint is pilling off the walls. When you step l in to check in there is a representative trying to sell you a timeshare. Restaurants are reservations only ( and they are always full ). Buffet and taco place are not good. Another thing we didn’t liked is that the pool bars close at 6PM. I don’t see myself coming back to this particular hotel.

reviews.author: Style K
reviews.title: Just another average Cancun resort
reviews.text: The rooms are decent and they do have decent food but nothing here is outstanding.  Especially if you are looking for any cool night life as that is non existent.  If staying at a resort then you want to stay somewhere that has more to do so you don't have to leave.  Spend the extra $100 and stay somewhere nicer.

reviews.author: aabga
reviews.title: average
reviews.text:
so so
good place to feel the beach
but time is not good to us
Sarragas is prominent 
Beach was so dirty
But see itself was clean and has beautiful color
I miss cancun sea
this hotel is good looking
but good food is difficult to access.

reviews.author: Kimboree
reviews.title: Great service at a dated facility
reviews.text:
The Room: The room we reserved was on the lagoon side, 2nd pyramid on the 2nd floor (Room 2204). Great sunset view!  We had parking lot view with lagoon in the background.  If it had been a higher floor, you probably would not see the parking lot.  The room was dated.  Bathroom was dated with signs of repair (caulking, etc).  We had a king bed with a pull out sofa.  Bed was comfy, sofa was a tad hard.  There was a fridge with 2 types of beer, Spirit, Coke, orange and apple juice and water.  There was also a coffee maker with coffee and tea (coffee did not have much flavor.  Towels were great.  Toiletries were Mulger Cologne shampoo/body wash and soap, shower cap, Q-tips, sewing kit, and make up cotton wipes. 

Junior Suite Lagoon view room 3012.  This room is in the connection area of the pyramids and had view of the parking lot and terraces.  We originally had room 2201, but the shower did not work and bidet did not work, they had tried to fix it with no avail and gave the room to us anyways.  They were quick to give us another room, but when we checked room 3012 with no lagoon view, I went back to reception to get a room with a lagoon view but they said the resort was full and cannot move.  I would expect some sort of discount since they did not give us what I originally paid for.  

The Check In: Reception was friendly.  The check in was very slow.  The room was not ready at 3:00 p.m.  After we checked in, Victor took us on a brief tour of the main pyramid and tried to talk us in a brief meeting the next morning (probably on a timeshare of some sort) to get a discount on some excursion. 

The House Cleaner: We really did not see the housekeeper, but they did a good job on getting us clean towels a toiletries.  They could have cleaned the floors a little bit more, but I understand in a beach environment, it is hard to get all the sand out of a room.  Turn down service was nice.  They did a good job on straightening the room.

The Beach: The beach was nice.  Although during the time we stayed there was a lot of seaweed that washed ashore. Still the beach service was good.

The Pool: Did not swim in the pool.  Pool looks like it needs re-plastering. 

The Restaurants:  Some restaurants did not have AIR CONDITIONING (must be broken)! They had fans to cool the area but not enough.  DO NOT go to the Asian restaurants there (Bana and Enso)  They will disappoint.  We had a miscommunication and could not try Mole, which they could've checked to see if they could see us even if it was disconnect on the RSVP. The Market Grill, Brazilian style with meat cut in front of you, is good.  The buffet which we ate often is average, nothing to rave about.  BlueAgave only has tacos and quesadillas, which is a bit salty, but favor is good.  For a Mexican style restaurant, it should have better salsa, but again, we might just be used to salsa in the states.   Room service was good, we had them bring some omelets and they brought it in about 30 minutes. 

The Ice Cream station: The Ice cream parlor was okay.  Most of the flavors are lime, coconut, vanilla, chocolate, and cheesecake.  It was just okay and opens only during a certain hours. 

The Nespresso station: The drinks here are good.  But the guy making it is inconsistent on how he makes the drinks.  I ordered an almond coffee the first day and it was yummy.  The next day I ordered it, it was not made the same as the first day.  This station has limited hours, mainly in the morning.  

The facility: The facility is really neat like a big giant greenhouse.  But with all the plants, and water features, there will the "smell" and there was a lot of incense that they burned at night to mask the smell and probably as bug repellent (which is good!)  The facility was very clean and well maintained.  They had activities but we were to darn tired to enjoy them. 

Overall, the facility was good.  I would probably choose another resort on the next trip to Cancun due to the plant smell.  They need to either up the Asian restaurant or take those two restaurants out of the resort and add better ones.

reviews.author: R&A Escobar Beach Couple
reviews.title: Its ok. Not 5 star
reviews.text:
Family vacation and anniversary vacation. 7 nights

Arrival:  Arrival was accommodating. They direct you to the desk and offer to make you a drink. Then they send you to a desk to have someone explain what’s included and the layout of the resort.

Exterior: Very nice green plants and trees all along the inside of the resort that is shaped in pyramids. The interior smells fresh and clean

Service:  Service was great, the coffee shop was Nespresso, Andres was extremely nice and makes coffees to perfection. Turn down service was great, they always cleaned the room and if there was an issue it was taken care of.

Room:  Clean, huge and they decorated the bed with rose petals. Mini fridge was cold and fully stocked with beverages and a few snacks.

Beach: The beach was nice to look at, the current is extremely strong, and very difficult to get in. There were life guards constantly walking around which was reassuring to see. This is not a swimmable beach area. Not the hotels fault, but take note of this if your looking for a beach to sit in, this is not it. The towel game is in full force. If you do not reserve your beach chairs before 7 am, you will not have seating at the beach.

Bars: Not enough bars. There are 2 outdoor bars the main swim up and one off to the right. In my opinion this hotel is too large to only have 2, they get extremely busy, so if your in the beach area the beach bartenders will bring you drinks, but they do get busy.

Restaurants: The restaurants do require reservations, but it is not too much of an inconvenience. You can reserve over the phone the day of and there is always one available. Agave did not require reservations and in our opinion was the best. The tacos are excellent.

Food: Buffet was ok, gets extremely busy all the time. There is always a line for omelets. Food is sometimes the same. Nothing to brag about. 

Check out:  Check out was fine.

Best part: The service at restaurants, the coffee shop, Agave restaurant. Volleyball at the beach

Worst part: The pools are not really inviting, The depths of the pools go from waist deep to 6 feet. So you cant really walk around with your drink.  The swim up bar get very rowdy for party guests that get out of control. Not ok, when this is a family resort.   The sales pitch at check in to become one the the Royal service guest is unnecessary. They also try to get you to attend a breakfast convention to sell you products, but tell you its free. We were not interested from the beginning, But it was hard to constantly have to explain to them no, as they continued every day they saw us to bring it up.

Would I return or recommend:  No. Nice hotel, clean, but I would recommend to guests that are ok with a 3 star hotel. I think that they need kids clubs for somewhere for kids to hang out. More bars, and improvement of rowdy guests.

reviews.author: hwapper
reviews.title: Large resort with great food and some service and maintenance issues to address
reviews.text:
We stayed here a for 4 days with 2 rooms and for the most part it was okay. It excelled in certain areas and completely lacking in other.

The property itself is somewhat older and in desperate need of updating and repair.  There were many areas where the paint was fading and or chipping off or just dangling. There was rust everywhere.  A thunder storm came through while we were there and they had many buckets and towels out to catch the dripping water.

The rooms were for the most part spacious, and came equipped with a fully stocked mini-bar and bath accessories. Room service is available, though we did not try it.  There were no electrical outlets by the beds in the rooms we had.  Air conditioning worked fine.  There was mold on the ceiling of one of the bathrooms. In our bathroom the bidet did not drain correctly.

When checking in nobody explained how the room numbering scheme worked and nobody directed us as to where our rooms were so we ended up wandering for a bit until we figured it out.  Numbering scheme is PFRR (Pyramid number, Floor, Room).  Our kids rooms were ready but my wife and I had to wait a few hours for our room.  We were given keys and told it would be ready in 2 hours.  When I tried to go to the room after 2 hours, someone was already assigned the room.  We had to be assigned another room.  We were sufficiently disappointed in our new room, we paid for ocean view and the room barely had an ocean view, that we decided to upgrade to royal service.

The Royal Service rooms have been renovated.  There were no issues in our room like we saw in the non-royal service rooms.  Multiple electrical outlets by the bed.  Bathrooms were clean and everything worked. You are assigned a butler but we really only asked ours for help with reservations for dinner.

Being such a large resort, they seem to try and limit what you can do by making you get reservations for EVERYTHING.  With Royal Service you can reserve a cabana at no extra charge but there are not enough cabanas for every room so you have to reserve them as soon as possible for all the days that you will be wanting them.  We tried to reserve three days and managed to get one.  The other is restaurants, we manged to get 4 reservations, 2 of them was before 7pm.  The other two was at 830 and 9PM.  We could never get reservations at one of the restaurants we wanted to try the entire time we were there.

I don't want to make it seem like everything was bad.  Far from it, this resort had probably the best food we've ever had at an all inclusive.  Even the buffet was excellent and we usually try to avoid the buffets.  There were lots of options and there was lots of variety as they seem to change the menu from night to night. Of the restaurants we enjoyed Mole the most, the tres leches was so good.  The burgers at La Palapa were amazing.  And the Asian fare at Enso was surprisingly good. The portions are small which means you should be able to order 4 courses if you wanted to without being stuffed.  With Royal Service you also have access to the lounge where they have finger foods and breakfast.  The snacks here were usually different than what was being served in the buffet.

The drinks were similarly well crafted.  All the drinks tasted great and did not seem watered down at all.  The pool side and beach side service was excellent.  Everyone was extremely hospitable and friendly. Jose and Victor you guys made our stay great.

reviews.author: Margaret L
reviews.title: Moises is a gem!
reviews.text: This was a last minute 4night stay that was a good deal - had we paid more we would have been disappointed. Check in was horrible even after agreeing to a Royal Service upgrade. Rode our butler secured our choice of 4 dinner reservations (vento, Market Grill, Enso & Mole) as well as our Bali beds. We did not like the menu at Mole and went to Bana instead last minute and enjoyed the sushi. Food in general was horrible - the only hot meal we had was from the RS grill near the pool/beach. Food was consistently cold at the buffet, room service x 2 was cold, even the steak selections at the Brazilian restaurant were served cold. The resort is pretty to walk through although the ventilation is poor and subsequently very warm. We had the pleasure of meeting Moises (Go Real Madrid!!) several times in the RS lounge and him & Jorge were our Bali bed servers - they were fantastic. Service overall was outstanding 5/5 - servers and maids were always friendly and made efforts to exceed our expectations. We enjoyed our stay because of these incredible servers! Beautiful resort, great pools & beach and definitely worth the upgrade to Royal Service.

reviews.author: The Howards
reviews.title: Could have been better
reviews.text: Upon check in, we had to meet with Bianca who told us all about the hotel but also tried to sell us packages, which took 30 minutes. With 2 small kids after a long flight, would have liked to skip this. We asked if we could upgrade because we had the money to do so but were told the hotel was absolutely booked and no upgrades were available (they have 5 connecting hotels). Later on the beach we met a couple who asked if we had Family Concierge and we said no. Well apparently they upgraded upon check in to Family Concierge in Tower 3 where there is a special block of rooms only for families. The hotel staff make reservations for you, book your excursions, and you get a free bottle of champagne every night. We got a plain room in Tower 1. Really confused why we were not offered this even after we asked for an upgrade?? So we complained to our hostess Bianca about the roll away bed my husband had to sleep on-literally a very thin mattress on chunky coils. Bianca said she would get a new bed right away for us. She never did and we had to call the front desk and do it ourselves. Disappointing. FYI the hotel charges $400 for a trip to Excaret Park for 1 day. The photo people walk around and take pics of you with parrots etc; however, they charge $50 for 3 printed pics. The waiters expect to be tipped. Housekeeping was amazing. Food was okay, except all steaks were amazing. All the on site restaurants had NO air conditioning. They used fans to cool us off. The hotel did not have air on except the front desk check in and your room. It was hot. We did not feel taken care of here while everyone else were raving about Family Concierge. First time for my kids in Cancun, with a not so great experience. And yes we've been to Cancun many times before kids.

reviews.author: Anna R
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful, most staff very friendly and helpful. the view from the room is spectacular. Buffet food is good, other restaurants weren't all good. We didn't like the check in, very slow, was told that the club and royal members get priority. The cabanas on the beach are reserved for club and royal members but most of them empty. Found most of the beach was reserved for club and royal members. Got the impression that they prefer Royal and club members only which is unfortunate as we really liked the resort.

reviews.author: SummerLoverNJ
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, not for foodies
reviews.text: Arriving to this resort was visually impressive. The decor and architecture is beautiful. The resort is clean and well kept. The pool area has cabanas and the ocean has tiki huts with beach chairs. We had the royal service package which was a great choice for our adult group. Our butler Daniel was attentive without being pushy, and was able to accommodate our reservation requests and book us a pool cabana. The gym facility was nice and clean. We took a class with Erick who was a good instructor who focused on form and was passionate about his job. The service at the resort was excellent. If you are not a drink and relax person, this isn’t the resort for you. The daily activities are limited unless you book an excursion. The nightly entertainment was far from entertaining, but the night dance location called the Red Lounge was a lot of fun and it was nice to have a place to dance right on the resort. The biggest downfall of this resort was the food. For lack of a better term, it was basically terrible. Good food is an important part of our vacations , but the food here was a let down. The Brazilian steakhouse could not even compare to a low end steak house at home. We booked dinner for sushi one night but after we tried the other food on the resort we decided to cancel the sushi dinner. The desserts were terrible with the exception of the gelato which was only served during the day. The gelato was def the best food on the resort. If you are a foodie this is not the place for you. There is no drink menu and the drinks are inconsistent between bars and bartenders. I asked for a rum runner and they said they ran out of banana, but a rum runner does not have banana. If you looking for a beautiful resort to just lay by the pool with a drink and a view of the beautiful aqua and teal colored ocean then this is a good resort for you, but if you are looking for some activities and good food this is not the place.

reviews.author: shyamdua
reviews.title: SSD Reviw
reviews.text: Front desk very poor service and needs improvement. A major turn off! It should not take 3+ hours to check in. In addition, it took forever to get any issues resolved because of their incompetence. In restaurants, they required 24 hour reservation while most of the times it was half empty.

reviews.author: Laura H
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, but the beach had tons of seaweed that would not be removed at night so it just kept building up. Check in and check out procedures are far too long and complicated (checking in took an hour, checking out took 40 minutes while our taxi waited impatiently outside).  The bars are good, food as well, but limited nightlife.  So many children too - more of a family resort than a place for couples to go to get away from work.

reviews.author: Travelholic0711
reviews.title: Great hotel, great service, ok food
reviews.text:
This was our 2nd time at the Paradisus. We were there a year and a half ago and had a really great time! First the pros - the hotel is great, smells really good everywhere you go, the staff is very helpful with whatever it is that you need. Our waiter Armando at the Naos Restaurant was AWESOME! He’s pretty much the only reason we kept eating the buffet everyday. He made us feel so welcome and at home. He’s the reason I’m rating a 3 instead of a 1. The thing is, the staff is awesome, the management has to make changes to the way they run things. There are resorts in cancun that have a nice theatre, plenty of restaurant choices, and very similar service, and most resorts don’t even need reservations at the restaurants. Paradisus need to step it up and make it a reasonable deal. It almost seems like if you don’t have the Royal Service, you pretty much get the leftovers!
Cons: food was bland this time around and the buffet didn’t have too many options. The steak at the market grill smelled like kerosene 3 days in a row. I was upset with the fact that the nespresso coffee station closes during the day - not all of us like to be swimming in alcohol all day long, we want our caffeine! And it is almost impossible to get a reservation at the restaurants if you haven’t purchased their “Royal Service” deal. Unless you want to eat at 6:30pm or after 9:30pm, you’re going to have to eat the buffet. The nightly shows used to be a lot better too.. there is never enough space to sit - can’t believe a hotel this size doesn’t have it’s own theater. This hotel isn’t cheap, it’s on the more expensive side actually, so even if you don’t purchase the Royal Service, you should feel Royal! I’m going to try a different resort next time.

reviews.author: Coni812
reviews.title: Gorgeous View! Mediocure Food
reviews.text:
Was here in April for a work conference.  The resort location was beautiful!  Pool and beach well maintained,   Lots of chairs and palapa's.  Our room was on the first floor overlooking the pool and ocean. The room itself was disappointing.  We were missing a bathroom door.. which is a little awkward when rooming with someone you work with and don't know well. But the view was so wonderful we decided not to request another room.  Our lighted mirror and coffee maker didn't work though the front desk was quick to have someone come and fix them.   

We were with a large conference and on the all inclusive.   Food was very disappointing.  I survived the week on dinner rolls and chips and guacamole (the guac was fantastic though) and some fruit.  Most of the meals were barely warm. (that scares me)  The night we had Mexican was good.  Other nights there was Thai and Italian etc.  The pool food was much better - pizza, chicken wings, chicken sandwiches.  Also many in our group raved about the Sushi restaurant.  (I don't care for Sushi so didn't go).  There were also a few other restaurants that I didn't try because of time restrictions and wanting to spend time at the pool or beach.  Feedback from coworkers were mixed, some good some bad.   The drinks are weak, I'm not much of a drinker so that really wasn't an issue for me.  The meeting venues were really nice and the resort itself seemed clean though needing some maintenance (like our bathroom door, some paint touch up etc)  All the employees were very friendly and helpful. 

We have stayed at another resort twice that was much nicer but didn't have a view.   It wasn't an all inclusive and food and drinks were much better.   I didn't pay for this stay so I've given it an average score but probably wouldn't stay here if I were paying for a vacation.  I like to eat.   But the view and ocean was unbelievably beautiful!!!

reviews.author: Carla
reviews.title: Nice resort but rooms are old
reviews.text: The resort was nice a big but the rooms where outdated.  I stayed in paradisus playa del carmen so I expected this resor to be top of the line too but it wasn't. Pool, kidszone and rooms are old and out dated.  Restaurants buffet, market grill and fuego were really good but enso was not good.   Bali beds were a joke.  150 dollars a day but paradisus playa del carmen were free.  Just. Disappointment.

reviews.author: ooch92
reviews.title: All inclusive????
reviews.text: Although the place itself was beautiful, there wasn't enough night time entertainment for adults. The lighting in the bathrooms was poor. Definitely not enough seating at pool and beach. On the bright side, the spa was fabulous.

reviews.author: pepinlauren
reviews.title: Deceptive Descriptions & All those Stairs?!
reviews.text:
The room reservations are tricky. We came with a large group of varying ages of 2-65 using 6 suites. We were cheated. 

We reserved, based on their website and multiple phone calls to their lackluster "English" service, 
Premium One Bedroom Master Suites and 
Premium One Bedroom Suites. 

Not sure what makes them Premium as they are similar to other configurations but without ocean views. In fact we ALL had fabulous views of the parking lot. So much so we couldn't even keep our drapes open bc we were eye level with garden employees. Floorplans online are useless, room descriptions are useless and the front desk is unconcerned you've reserved 6 high end rooms in their resort. We called and specifically asked if our room type would have an ocean view and were assured "yes". Unless the room description specifically states "Ocean view" in the actual title of the room you won't have a view. 

Restaurants: Reservations games like all other resorts: can’t book more than a day in advance; have to call by dialing zero between the hours of 8a-5p; bring a jacket and nice pants other than jeans if you want to eat in the fancy restaurant. 

Hotel is set and built way up high so you’re not on the beach. It feels like you’re looking at the water from a cruise ship bc it’s so high they have glass barrier walls. 

A large group shouldn't be punished due to its size but at least appreciated for bringing so much business. Management please spare me the typical email of "we're sorry to hear your vacation was interrupted due to our staff not giving a whip of concern...." because we'll never stay in any Melia property again.

reviews.author: ChungBrowne
reviews.title: Great food, beautiful beach but small rooms and average service
reviews.text:
My family (four adults and three children aged 8, 4 and 2) stayed at Paradisus Cancun for one week. We had vacationed at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana, which we loved, and were looking for a nice, easy holiday again. We signed up for the family concierge service because our experience at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana was amazing. 

Overall, I would give an average rating. There were some good parts but they were offset by bad parts. The resort itself seemed to be run down and needed renovations. The staff tried but didn't quite meet our expectations. We had to make the same requests multiple times before they were done (like asking for additional towels 4x before getting them) and towards the end I was just sick of keep asking for the same things that I gave up. Most likely, we will not return to this resort. 

The first impression - The check in and the front desk staff were pleasant. We had a reservations for two junior suites. When I made the reservation I double checked that the rooms were connected. However, our rooms were not connected (not even noted in the reservation) and the front desk staff put us on the wait list.

The rooms - Although they were described as junior suites, they were normal rooms. I think the room size is listed as around 600 square feet and it was definitely smaller than that (I don't know if their size includes the balcony and the bathroom. It probably does.). Once the sofa bed was opened, there was no room for anything else and I even had to ask to remove some furniture from the room so we have some floor space. The king size bed was very comfortable. On the other hand, the sofa bed was just atrocious and way too uncomfortable. The double beds were too small for two small kids to sleep together. I didn't expect them to be closer to twin size beds. Also, there was no sofa bed in the double bed room.

Once they moved us to the connected rooms, there were no sofa beds at all, and the rooms seemed much smaller. We had to request for two extra beds which barely fit and got in the door connecting two rooms.

Family concierge service - We had high hopes because of our previous experience. Alas, we left a bit disappointed and I'm not sure if our experience there was THAT much better because we had the service. Two butlers assigned to us were Sandra and Alexander. I give Sandra higher marks than Alexander. She was very pleasant and made sure we were well taken care of. When she was on duty, all of my questions were answered right away and she met our requests promptly. However, Alexander did not respond to any of my messages/questions for 24 hours until I went to find him (he also had not introduced himself although I was literally in front of him asking his colleague about his whereabouts). There were other specific issues related to assigning us a Bali bed and rather than owning up to his mistake, he blamed it on Sandra. Very unprofessional. I did speak with their manager Leslie and I hope they do better team training to avoid this kind of unpleasantness. However, things improved after my conversation with Leslie. 

The food was delicious and everyone enjoyed it. Market Grill and Blue Agave restaurants were really nice. I would not recommend either of the Asian restaurants (Enso and Bana). The buffet served its purpose and given the busy season the wait was long.

The pool - It was deeper than I expected. On average it was 5' 7'' in the main pool.  The kids' pool was nice but the pool meant for toddlers was too deep as well (think it was about 2 1/2 feet, def too deep for little babies.)

The beach - This was the best part. As long as you secure some shade, it was nice to walk right on to the beach.

reviews.author: F B
reviews.title: Not happy with overall service
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful. The food is a 3, you are overwhelmed with sales pitches for timeshares and it's almost impossible to get dinner reservations because they say they are booked. I wouldn't stay again

reviews.author: Barry D
reviews.title: likely seen better days
reviews.text: I spent 6 nights here for a work conference. The grounds, hotel reception areas and beach are all very nice. The room, however, looked pretty dated and seemed musty. Buffet food at lunchtimes was of average quality (nondescript flavours, sauces), whereas the evening choices were generally better, eg TexMex and Asian. Although I'm not a seasoned resort visitor, I'd like to think I've travelled extensively and so I'd conclude that the resort didn't have a wow factor, for me at least

reviews.author: FamilyTravels
reviews.title: Overpriced - Service was good
reviews.text:
So just the facts.

Stayed at the Paradisus with the family (7 people total) for 7 days.  This was our first time staying there (and the last).  We travel to Cancun fairly often.  Check in was fairly quick - they assign you to a check-in clerk/host which you soon will realize is mainly there to help sell you their hotel packages, excursions, upgrades etc.  Do not feel obligated to sign up or put a deposit down for anything.  

Rooms were as expected based on previous Tripadvisor photos - clean, fridges always stocked, bathroom was very clean, towels were plenty, safe was functional.  **Note** our 2 children became ill on this trip (nothing to do with the hotel and this room became quite the haven to nest in -  we had 24 hour room service and we visited the doctor twice - one for each child as their colds progressed differently.  Both times, doctors were fully knowledgeable and took their time - we felt that we were in good hands and my husband and I are super picky.

Food was just ok - given the reviews of other guests we expected something pretty decent however food was just mediocre - if you have been to other hotels in Cancun you could say that the buffet was quite repetitive and lacking in variety.  Also there was not much taste to the food other than salt.

Note to parents with young children -  you will have to carry your stroller down to the beach as there are only stairs leading down to the beach and in the centre court/courtyard where the sushi restaurant and bar is, it is NOT stroller friendly.  Also another really annoying thing is that during the day, you can only get alcohol outside of the building by the pools and such.  All bars inside are closed.

Service and people are amazing, definitely there to help.  We would have to give it a 5/5 star rating.

Ultimately, we will not be staying here again, we had high hopes based on reviews and rating of this hotel.   However, it just didn't do it for us.  With what we paid there are other options that we could of went with - hope it works out better for you.

reviews.author: Cara P
reviews.title: Mehh.
reviews.text: It was ok.. I guess I was expecting more for the price. I had high expectations and then when I got there they were crumbled (maybe not that harsh).  The food was ok.  I guess that's what I should expect from an all inclusive resort... Sub par.  Rooms were clean, staff mostly nice. Next time I'm going to do an air bnb or home away...done with the all inclusion life.

reviews.author: Adam
reviews.title: Royal Service made our stay, otherwise our experience was mediorce
reviews.text: Royal Service was worth every penny.  Without it, the trip would not have been worth the time.  Rode was an excellent butler, and was responsive to every need.  Additionally, Eddie took excellent care of us while we were enjoying the bali beds by the pool.  The food was only okay in many instances.  Each restaurant has a limited number of dishes that are above average, and figuring them out is key to having a good time.  Tipping the staff is greatly appreciated and will drastically improve the level of service during your stay.  Make sure to take full advantage of the Bali beds, they are one of the most enjoyable aspects of this hotel.  To reiterate, Eddie was incredible.  We wished there were more activities included with the hotel.

reviews.author: Bridget D
reviews.title: Did not meet our expectations
reviews.text:
The first thing you notice when you walk in is the overwhelming scent of incense being burnt. If you are sensitive to scent or migraines are triggered my scent do not stay here. In parts of the building (older buildings) you can actually smell the mold and mildew they are trying to cover up. 

Were were initially put in the wrong room but had to walk about 15 minutes to the furthest building and up 5 flights of stairs before we figured it out. The room was DISGUSTING. I feel like everyone rejects that room or they put the drunk 18/19 y/o college kids in it. The couch was stained and so worn out, the air was filled with bleach and the balcony was over the parking lot which had construction and we couldn’t hear a thing. The mirror also had a red burn stain all over it so you couldn’t even see in it. They had 1 tiny elevator for this building and it wasn’t working, so we hiked it up 5 flights of stairs before realizing they put us in the wrong type of room. 

We were relocated to building #3, night and day!! The room looked like the pictures online, it was clean, didn’t smell, balcony was larger, and the bathroom mirror was clear. The staff did not heckel us for this so I give them credit for that, BUT I give them 1 Star for putting me in a room like the first one to begin with after spending $360/night. 

Our shower was never cleaned during the 2 night/ 3 day stay. I set up the shower head, etc., to test it and it was never touched. Pretty gross. Waters in fridge were never refilled and safe only worked on room key. The room also didn’t have an extra latch lock, this made my friend and I a little uneasy. 

FOOD: we did room service, pool side service, buffet and the taco restaurant. I would give it all 2 stars, not good at all. But they are feeding the masses. 

POOL/BEACH: The pools are huge and they have a lot of cabanas to rent. The lounge chairs are first come first serve. I watched the pool servers give away people’s chairs (mine included) when they stepped away for less then 10 minutes and left personal belongings on them. So unless you’ve parked your behind on the chair, it’s not safe. Beach views and beach front is a major plus for this hotel. If you’re a beach goer, this is a prime spot. 

SPA- ALERT!! We had a spa employee offer a private 20 minute massage out of the spa and asked us to keep it a secret. He was so creepy and made my friend and I so uncomfortable we immediately ended the conversation and did not schedule any spa services. He begged us many times not to tell anyone at the hotel, which we didn’t but we are writing it on here. 

Paradisus is a very large resort but it’s old and not well maintained all around. If you are paying for Royal or family concierge they may focus on you otherwise I would spend the extra $$$ and stay at the Marriott next time.

reviews.author: Josh M
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort with Terrible Service
reviews.text:
I recently went with my family of 4 to the Paradisus Cancun. We stayed in a Family Concierge 1 Bedroom Suite for 6 days. For the last 3 years, we stayed at The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real in the DR (I'll refer to it as DR throughout). In the DR, we had such wonderful service, beautiful large clean bedrooms, amazing fresh fruit tropical drinks, the best butlers, and, well average food. We wanted to see if the Paradisus Cancun could give us some variety and still be as wonderful as the DR. 

We thought this hotel and facilities were absolutely beautiful with few exceptions. The lobby in building 3 is spectacular. Everything is clean and well maintained. I'll walk you through my overall experience and why the service was terrible.

**Check-In**
Upon arrival we had a very nice welcome and private check-in in the family concierge lounge.  The lounge is not as easily accessible from the pool as it was in the DR and also did not have any windows or a bartender making amazing drinks. This was nice benefit in the DR. In Cancun it was a nice facility with a self service bar (that we never used), and had some food throughout the day. It also had a nice area for children under 5. That area was too childish in design for my 7 and 10 year old. Check-In was quick and painless, they offered a bottle of vodka, rum, or tequila to take to our room and introduced us to our butler.

**The Room**
We had an ocean front one bedroom suite with one balcony off the living room and one very large balcony off the bedroom. The room was very clean. The one bedroom suite in the DR was more than TWICE the size. I asked that they bring in beds for my children and they converted the living room to a bedroom. The convertible couch was tiny and would never accommodate 2 children comfortably. With the beds in the living room there was no room for anything else. In the DR, with the beds in the living room, we still had a couch, large coffee table, small dining room table and wet bar. The DR had a massive walk-in closet, huge bathroom with 2 sinks, and a large walk in shower and separate soaking tub. The toilet in the DR was in a separate small room (WC) which was very convenient. In Cancun, there was a much smaller bathroom with only a tub and a single sink. The tub had a rain shower head which was very nice. This is a huge difference in living space when the price was very similar.  So over all, i'd say we were disappointed in comparison to the DR. I also wonder if we were not given the room type we should have had.

**Food**
The food in the Naos which is the buffet style service was good. Breakfast service was much better than the DR. In the DR the buffet style area was so huge and had so many options it did not have a cozy feel. If felt more like they were feeding the herd. In Cancun, it had a better feel, but it had fewer, but higher quality options. The rest of the restaurants were underwhelming with the exception of the peking duck at Enso which does not compare to NYC peking duck but was really good. The mexican food at Mole and Blue Agave was really good too. Bana was good as long as you don't expect NYC sushi. The pool food at Sunset Grill does not qualify as food. Remember the hockey puck hamburger from high school lunch and the cardboard pizza.  The pizza was better in the high school cafeteria. The only edible pool food was the amazing guacamole and probably the best chicken nuggets ever. Tempo which is an additional charge restaurant with Michelin stars was good. We had a few outstanding dishes at Tempo, but some were below average. They served us seared tuna that we ended up sending back because the texture and flavor was way off. The person playing the piano at Tempo was so incredibly talented and it made the whole night better.

**Drinks**
The drinks were a major disappointment in Cancun. In the DR, everything was made with fresh fruit and not the artificial corn syrup mixes as used in Cancun.  When they made a pina colada in the DR they put fresh pineapple in the blender. In the DR they also had the high quality blenders that did not leave big chunks of ice in the drinks. I love a good daiquiri or dirty banana and the bar tenders were not as skilled as in the DR. Also, in the DR, some of the bars and bar tenders were very kid friendly. My kids love ordering all of the same drinks without alcohol. In the DR they could easily get service at the bar. The bar tenders in Cancun paid more attention to the drunk people ordering tequila shots then my children (okay i was that drunk person a few times). I needed to help my kids order drinks a few times when they get such a kick out of doing it themselves.

**The Service**
This is where Paradisus Cancun fell very short. This may sound snobby to some, but the extra money I paid to have a butler was a total waste of money. I think they actually made my stay more stressful. The first day we arrived, we asked them to reserve dinner between 7 and 8 at every restaurant for our stay. Every day was a mistake or issue that I needed to spend time working out. They always had one excuse or another as to why mistakes were made. I needed to be very persistent on my vacation. This is an additional service that the hotel offers so you can relax. In the DR, they got the reservations right, they learned the food and drinks you liked and surprised you with things at the pool or beach like a plate of sushi or shrimp cocktail. 

In the DR, our butler had a cabana reserved for us each day with towels. In Cancun they charge you $130 USD for a cabana by the pool which included pool food service which was terrible. They don't let you take food from Naos back to your seat. There was no place to go for anything fresh unless you go inside. The cabana is a way to extort more money from people who are already paying a lot. I asked my butler if I can get tacos from Blue Agave to the pool and they said NO. It is a strange rule to have when the pool food is so bad.

Some of the waiters were very good, but a majority would give you a warm welcome, ask if there is anything at all they can get you, and then completely forget or never return.

This service was very disappointing. No one cared at the hotel to improve it. 

We still really enjoyed our vacation and spending time with family, but I will not be returning to Paradisus Cancun. Next year it will either be back in the DR or looking for a new experience.

reviews.author: Wyatt M
reviews.title: Beautiful but subpar
reviews.text: The Paradisus is beautiful but has some glaring problems. The service was fantastic, especially Francisco in the red lounge. He took care of our every need and was extremely friendly and funny. However our experience at the front desk was painfully difficult. The beach and pool were great and relaxing and the room was very nice but dirty and smelled like mildew. The food was mediocre and we had to skip multiple meals because the food looked so unappetizing.  Overall it was a good experience but for Melia/Paradisus this resort did not live up to our expectations.

reviews.author: fransvan0
reviews.title: Are you under 14 ?
reviews.text:
Location, infrastructure, architecture, design, room comfort = 10/10.
ICT (pre-check in, registration, customer monitoring, invoicing, check out) = complete chaos. How does this hard working amiable front office desk staff (there are 10 of them) manage to cope with this situation, day after day ?
Must be paradise for the children, but for those over 14 you should pay 10 % extra and book Royal Service Exclusive in order to avoid the beehive.

reviews.author: DMS79
reviews.title: Mixed feelings
reviews.text:
We decided to go to Paradisus based on the many good ratings and unfortunately we did not have the greatest experience and we did purchase Royal service. 

Positives:

* Great views from ocean front rooms.
* Room was modern, clean and very comfortable.
* Beach was fantastic and the beach service was outstanding.
* Lots of restaurant options.
* Location is great and convent to stores and shopping.
* Hotel was very clean and appeared to be well staffed.
* Royal service pool was nice and quiet. 

Negatives:

* Found hard plastic/ceramic in our food at Enso which caused a cut. No one appeared to really care when we brought it to our servers attention.
* Two mornings the Royal service lounge did not have food in the hot breakfast area, and after waiting 30 min it was not refilled even though it was prior to 8 am.
* While in our Bali bed we were repeatedly asked if we were using our bed or chairs even though we were in them. When we got up to go to the bathroom the concierge would ask if we were leaving. They didn't ask those around us so we feel someone wanted our bed specifically. But as it was assigned to us we didn't appreciate feeling like we couldn't use it. It took me yelling at the concierge that I just got up to get my phone and to leave us alone as yes we were using our chairs to get him to stop. 
* Our butler was the worst part. He told us to contact him for certain things and when we did, he acted like it was a hassle and that in order to do things like get us a bottle or make a reservation was a "special" treat. We know that this is standard services that they're are supposed to do. He would also leave us gifts which were nice, but then message us to remind us how nice it was of him to leave us the treats. We paid for Royal service and it is included with the extra $$ so it was frustrating that we had to continually thank our butler for providing services that we paid for. 

Overall the trip was okay which is too bad as it was costly and we were not satisfied guests. 

I am glad we went and tried the resort out, though we will choose a different one next time due to the Bali bed and Butler issues.

reviews.author: Shah K
reviews.title: So so
reviews.text: First trip to Cancun. Disappointed. Good service. Food not good at all. Bad choice for buffet. Speciality restaurants not good either. Night time shows were so bad and arranged in a poor manner. I had a concierge room but she would come up with excuses all the time. I’m never going back to Mexico.

reviews.author: Rogelio14
reviews.title: Just starting and it has been way below expectations!
reviews.text:
Room: 5312

We just arrived on Feb, 25...it has been only one day and we have been dissapointed several times. This review is not done in a vaccum as we have been in sister properties who has been much better and also lots of other hotel chains on the same price range. Here are a couple of issues we have had in less than 24hrs:

1) We arrive at the hotel around 2:30pm, after being escorted to Royal Servicd we actually started checkin at 3:10pm...and only one of two rooms were ready...after pointing out that check-in is at 3pm the person responde that hotel was near capacity..THAT IS NOT MY PROBLEM. After they saw I would not just take that argument they "found" us a ready room.

2) First day at the pool, we booked the Balinese beds...they are cool! But pool service is really slow...they need more waiters or a better system.

3) Tried to go into the big jacuzzi and to our surprise it was not even close to warm...there is absolutely no heating on it...a cold jacuzzi is not what you expect on a hotel on this price range....the pool temperature could be hotter but it was close to acceptable.

4) On out first full day we left our room at 10am...came back at 4:30pm and the room
was still not done.

5) We have not seen the night shows but their so called "show venue" are the bottom of the main steps...people actually have to seat on the floor and the space is very reduced which means shows are probably not good

We have gone to a lot of different all incluse chains including Paradisus Playa del Carmen and the comparison ends in the name...they are not on the same level, pricing showed that a little but expected a lot more from the brand....

Nothing in this post is extremely bad...its mostly that the expectations where a lot higher on this brand and property.

Regards
Rogelio

reviews.author: TravelerForLifeNow
reviews.title: The food is HORRIBLE
reviews.text: Stayed at this all inclusive resort for a business conference.  The property is run down and dated.  The food is absolutely horrible, especially the buffet restaurants.  The remaining restaurants all require reservations.  I would NEVER stay here again

reviews.author: Ebony M
reviews.title: Beautiful Property/Front Desk Staff...not so much
reviews.text:
This is an absolutely beautiful resort. It is very clean, the staff members are excellent (with the exception of some of the front desk staff).
My husband and I just wanted a quick getaway, so we decided to take a trip to Cancun. We initially booked a different hotel (3-star) but left within an hour because it was just unacceptable & nothing like the pics on the website. So we quickly jumped on trip advisor and found Paradisus. Upon arrival, we had some issues with the room given to us. Karen checked us in. She wasn't very friendly to begin with, and was even less friendly when we told her that she was giving us a room different than what we had booked (she gave us one on the 4th floor but not the bed we requested). After asking to speak with a manager (Guadeloupe), she offered us a different room, only to find out that the room she gave us was a bit of a downgrade from the 1st room as it was on the very bottom level (Level 0), and the bellhop let us know before we even got there that there wasn't really a view (which we had paid for). The truth is, they didn't have the room I requested and instead of upgrading us, they put us downstairs because that was the only one similar to what we had booked with a king bed....like I said, it was a downgrade without the view we paid extra for.
Nonetheless, Guadaloupe refused to upgrade us so we took the initial room. 
Thankfully I was able to speak with a different manager, (Reuben) and he was very accommodating to the point that he upgraded us to a room better than we ever expected! We were more than satisfied with that he offered, but I had to wonder why I had to make such a fuss about the room before something was done.
Overall, I would't stay here again because I felt unappreciated as a guest, initially. But I wouldn't discourage someone else from staying here because it really is a nice resort.

reviews.author: Michael Y
reviews.title: Servers are good - management as some issues to work out
reviews.text:
Overall Paradisus Cancun is showing its age and as other reviews have shared, there are better All Inclusives for the price within Cancun. The servers we had at the restaurant and the pool were very friendly and helpful, the fault lies with the management.

The main building is stunning, and the pyramids are something else. My infant daughter loved walking through and looking up at the vines. The downside is that being on the 2nd floor of the main pyramid means that everything is really loud, especially at night. The rooms on the other hand while pleasant have some renovations that are needed. The paint is chipping at places, the toilet seat needed to be replaced. We had to ask to have our patio door fixed twice and the lamps don't turn on at the side of the bed.

My main issue has to do with management, here are a few examples:
1) On the first night, we were locked out of our room twice. With my daughter screaming, we went to front desk and they told us to go our room to wait at the door while a repairman came up to fix the batteries on the door. We waited 20 minutes and no one showed up. Only when I went down and forcefully asserted myself did someone come up to help. No apologies, from management or acknowledgement of the trouble on our first day of vacation.
