I explained to the manager and she would not let us eat when the restaurant was empty. The kids club is a big no no. The staff told me that she cannot keep the kids if they cried. The staff is very incompetent and are not well trained. The baby  room for 1-4 years old is lacking, especially if your kids are more developed. We ate at Blue Agave most of the time, the food is amazing. Leah in Blue agave is such a good waitress. Few staff such as Rosa at concierge is helpful. The pool service waiters were nice and helpful.Alejandra in the buffet is such a sweetheart. When i told her about my incident, she went and get a happy birthday ballon for my son. Such a kind gesture. What i realize is if you tip the staff before service they treat you well. If you don't tip the service is horrible. Even though the property is nice, i will not return. The timeshare people are like vultures. Even when you say no they continue to push relentlessly. It is such a turn off. Also bring enough singles to tip. We tip on average $US10 daily.

reviews.author: Don M
reviews.title: No night life
reviews.text: Horrible layout for night show . The chairs around the pool are not enough no activtes around the pool .First day there waited for water aerobics at noon no one showed up not the way to start a vacation no communication at all.

reviews.author: Bobby T
reviews.title: Service and Nightlife were amazing...however the food and rooms had serious room for improvement...
reviews.text:
Okay First lets talk about what was great.

The Service- We did the all inclusive package and they made sure to take care of each and every one of us! Their service staff and bartenders did an exceptional job at making sure everything we needed was taken care of and in a timely manner. Cindy, Asuncion and Eden are the three names that especially stood out to us. Daily they made sure our needs we met and did so with a smile! All three of those employees are a great asset to that resort. 

Nightlife-  If you're looking for a resort with things to do a night, this is a great place to go! The have a beach bar that is a great atmosphere and offers an amazing view of the beach. The bar is open until 12 pm and has a great selection of drinks, as well as offering hookah and cigars if that's your cup of tea. Great place to hang out with friends or go to meet new people.   

The red lounge is another great place to go at night. It's a club atmosphere that is open until 2 am. Late night , this is the place to be! Fun for all ages 18 and up. The bar staff are terrific and will defintely ensure you have a great time. The DJ is great and places many types of music while also taking requests. Ask for Alexandro and ask him to make his famous JellyFish Shots! 

Now for the bad.....

Food- The food is no where near what I was hoping for or expecting. For the price that we paid for our vacation, I was seriously disappointed with what we were presented with. The buffet was okay...most of the time food was cold and bland. Enso, the asian fusion, was not worth the trip. The menu is very small and doesn't cater to many pallets. 

The best two restaurants hands down were Market Grill and Bana. I would recommend going to those during your stay but I honestly can't recommend any of the other dining options. I was not impressed by them at all. 

Rooms-  The rooms were okay, they are your average hotel room. We did have a great view of the ocean which was something that we were very thankful for. The room wasn't very important to us as we really only slept in there. They major problem was.... I spent a lot of the week being sick and sick to my stomach. We figured the food had something to do with it... but the second to last night we were there we finally got sick of our AC grate on the ceiling leaking and decided to look into it.... 

Not only had this grate leaked all week and soaked my clothes the first night we were there , also ruining medications that I brought with me... but there was mold on the top of the door in the bathroom. We wiped it with a towel MULTIPLE times and the black mold just kept coming.... the people who were with us didn't have this problem and their room was fine but it did happen to us and is part of why I am giving the rating that I am. 

When asked if I would stay there again, it's something that I would really have to think about...

reviews.author: Seth A
reviews.title: Consider looking elsewhere
reviews.text:
If you are not a seasoned traveler or are an occasionally vacationer, you may not be bothered by this place.  It’s typical of very large hotels…rules for the sake of rules, and very bureaucratic.  Tremendous difficulty getting resolution to problems. And little attention paid to detail.  Main problems were:
The check in process is a guest’s first exposure….and it’s an abomination!  Perhaps Ricardo Gerente (who will likely provide a useless response to this review) can spend some time aiding front desk staff to speed up the check in process.  It took over 40 minutes, and my room wasn’t ready. Come back for you key when it is, and wait in line another 30 minutes.  Oh, you requested a quiet room…and we have you directly above the pool where the music is playing? Come to the desk, wait in line another 30 minutes, and we will tell you we don’t have another room.  But, you could come back tomorrow, wait in line, and maybe we will have a quiet room.  OK, I’ll play along.  Wait in line, get a key for a new room, and it literally abuts a building that is currently under construction, complete with jack hammers and drilling.  You get the picture.
The music on the beach is a bit much.  Think…thumping bass, techno …or, as the DJ referred to it when we asked him to tone it down, “deep house”.  So, with “deep house” blaring every day, it’s difficult to relax on the beach.  And, of course, everyone is just flocking here to listen to “deep house”.  After all, isn’t that what every guest here is just dying to hear?  One word for you Mr. DJ…”variety”.
As for food, I felt as though I was back in college trying to sneak food out of the cafeteria for a visiting friend.  I’m an adult, and I paid to stay here. If I want to bring a salad down to the beach, please let me do that.  NO Senhor!!!!! You must eat in the dining area!  Food cannot be removed from the buffet area!!!  Seriously…this is just dumb.
OK, I’ll sit at the bar at the taco place and have a beer and a quick taco.  Oh no Senhor, you cannot get food at the bar.  You must move 8 feet away to a table and there you can get all the food you want.  Aahhh…my favorite…. A rule for the sake of having rules.
Restaurant food was just OK.  We travelled with a large group, and dined as a group. Making dinner reservations in advance of our arrival was a project involving dozens of emails and phone calls, a boat load of excuses as to why they can’t do advance reservations, and finally the hotel making reservations in advance.  It was all very unnecessary.
I will say that the bar service and beach service were very good.
I am mystified by all the fabulous reviews of this place.  If you value quality over quantity, this place is probably not for you.  I now know it’s not for me.

reviews.author: MissK7012
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
Went on family vacation with husband and children including a 2 1/2 year old. Resort is beautiful,clean  and  well kept. Buffet food is  not great, not that much variety
We ate at  Tempo (not part of all inclusive) food was great ,very tasty  but overall pricy especially the wine. We also ate at Market grill ,another non inclusive restaurant. Our waiter Carlos went above and beyond with the service he provided us . Food was good . Do not go to Enzo,food is horrible. Spoke to some other people we met at the resort and everyone hated it. The food at Vento,no extra charge was very good as well as the tacos at blue agave. The 12 hours day care 9am to 9pm is very attractive ,kids seem to love it. My daughter enjoyed it. The service seemed to be good. The one thing that really annoyed us was that you couldn't find any spot at the beach or by the pool. You could   rent a canopy for 50 dollars a day which I think is very expensive.  They just don't have enough "free" or should I say all inclusive spots to accommodate guests and that to me is a big minus and brought their rating low for me

reviews.author: markpK7696XB
reviews.title: Paradisus Stay
reviews.text:
We stayed Royal Service for 6 days/5 nights.

The GOOD...Facilities are well kept and clean, Rooms in Royal Service were very nice and adequate for the amount of time spent in them. We really enjoyed the YHI Spa as well as the Royal Service pool and Beach Area..We enjoyed the food in all the restaurants we tried and found the food and beverage staff to be the ones that made the Paradisus enjoyable for us.
The NOT SO GOOD.. Club Melia vacation club. They WILL contact you and offer to show you all the benefits your entitled to as part of your stay. We found the offers to be less than honest and not worth the time to even spend listening to any of it. I would prefer a resort that didn't try so hard to sell me a vacation for the next 50 years of my life! We also had a billing problem in the one restaurant that is an extra cost to dine at. Our experience eating at Tempo was outstanding with the exception that they presented a bill that wasn't close to what we ordered. Back at home, now still trying to work it out, and of course not holding my breath about it!! 
Our stay would have been 4 stars but for the above mentioned.
We were really impressed with how hard the Staff works for the guests. Management might learn a bit from the staff!

reviews.author: Cherie D
reviews.title: New widow
reviews.text:
I was widowed after booking this trip with friends and my husband and the place was not very compassionate about the circumstances, didn't even address my questions about any sort of refund and sending a death certificate unlike the airline which quickly refunded the whole cost and sent a letter expressing their sympathy. After making phone calls was told the refund for an all inclusive with one person not going was 50.00 dollars a day, I personally don't think that that is fair  and it was difficult to even get them to do that. Pretty sad, what is there biggest concern? Money?
And there check-in and check-out service was horrible. They really need to re-evaluate how they do it.

reviews.author: Nicole S
reviews.title: Poor quality hotel
reviews.text:
Mediocre hotel with great service,
ok food, great beach location. But will not go back as the quality of the hotel rooms were old and small.  We traveled through the Melia club, through RCI and it was very clear we were secondary guests and were not offered the same amenities or well cared for rooms as their club members. They were mainly interested in getting you to buy their timeshare and once you went to their breakfast, didn't bother helping you with anything.

reviews.author: videodude_Fremont
reviews.title: The Good, The Bad, The Ugly
reviews.text:
Before I begin, let me state that we are Melia Vacation Club members, and our 
experiences are slightly different than regular hotel guests.  That said, I will 
concentrate most of my comments on areas of common interest.

Appearance

The physical property is lovely.  The view from the drive is very impressive, with all 5 pyramids visible.  A woman in our shuttle said "Oh My God, you're staying HERE? This place is incredible!".  And it is. The lobby is open, very airy, tall, and inviting.  

Reception is to the left as you enter the lobby located in pyramid 3, in a separate check in area.  Never once did we see long lines, or people with typical front desk issues.  That seems to be a good sign.  MVC members check in in pyramid 1, which isn't immediately clear but a staff member escorted us to the check in area.  Check-in was fast and efficient.  The entire lobby area is clean and appears to be well maintained.  

Rooms

As I was never in a regular hotel room, I won't make any assumptions.  The room we 
reserved was a Studio, which had a king bed a bathroom.  There is no kitchenette in the studio units, despite what the website shows.  The bath was all granite, and included a tub/shower, and a bidet.  We always had sufficient hot water and pressure.  Our room was always kept clean by housekeeping, and the refrigerator was always stocked with water, soda, and beer.

Pool

There is one very large pool.  There is also a small children's area of the main pool, which we noticed a number of families were using.  There is also a "private pool" for Royal Service customers.  More on them later.  Bali beds surround the pool, but they are all reservation only, and are extra charge for everyone, including MVC members.  Other Melia properties offer Bali beds at no charge for MVC members. There is no whirlpool or hot tub.  At one end of the pool is a pool bar, which closes at 6pm.  Drinks of any kind are NOT allowed in the pool.  This rule doesn't seem to be enforced.  We never had a problem getting pool chairs, despite the resort being full.  No diving is allowed, the pool isn't deep enough for that.  There is no "artificial beach", for easy access, you have to use the steps.

Beach

Cancun sand is like no other; it's like flour.  The sand is soft and very white, and is never hot.  Very different from Pacific sand.  There are palm trees, palapas, and beach chairs.  We saw very few beach vendors, which is nice.

Food and Beverage

There is a beach bar.  It is open until 12 or 1am.  There is no actual lobby bar, at least not one that is quiet.  The beach bar is often windy, and there isn't really a view.  Everything is very dark at night.  Drink taste is pretty consistent from bar to bar, leaving me to believe that the bartenders use the same formulas for mixing.  The "so-called" lobby bar is used for entertainment, so it is impossible to find a quiet corner to have a drink and have a conversation.

Breakfast is always at the buffet, located on the ground floor of the main building.  
Although never disappointing, it's always the same.  The only way to get something hot for breakfast is to have an omelette or have eggs made to order. For reasons unknown, the Paridisus Cancun has NO steam tables in their buffet.  Hot food brought from the kitchen quickly gets cold sitting on the bricks that have been placed in the steam table openings. Sometimes, even food from the kitchen that should be hot, is cold before it is even placed on the bricks.  I watched kitchen help bring a tray of tater tots out from the kitchen, and place them on the bricks. Hoping to get them "fresh out of the kitchen", I got some to go with my eggs.  Surprise!  All were cold as a stone.  Whomever had the lame idea to disable the steam tables and fill them with bricks ought to be shot at sunrise.  FAIL. 

Lunch is either at the buffet (same issues as at breakfast) or the pool snack bar.  The problems with the main buffet speak for themselves, and the pool snack bar isn't much better.  Burgers and hot dogs are placed in stainless steel trays and allowed to get cold.  Another FAIL.  There is a Mexican "taco place" inside that will actually make you "tapas style" tacos and other items.  It is pretty good, especially considering how bad everything else is.    

Dinner was either at the buffet (different themes every night) or one of the specialty 
restaurants.  Our MVP concierge had made reservations for us at all of them, so we had something different every night. All I'm going to say is that the menu for each 
of the specialty restaurants NEVER changed for the week we were there, that should 
tell you everything  you need to know.  Now, if the menus were extensive, that might 
be fine, but the offerings were very limited, and not main stream at all.  The best of them all was a Spanish Tapas restaurant, which was reasonable.  For that reason 
alone, most of these restaurants get a FAIL from me.  We never went back after the first time.  The nightly buffet was marginally adequate, at least there was an attempt to change things up every night, but there was nothing exciting, and nothing that was served hot.  Not memorable.

Entertainment

What entertainment? There is no showroom, so the "shows" are put on in the lobby bar, which is inadequate at best.  The room is too small, any "show" is difficult to see, and the acoustics of the space make everything impossible to hear.  For a property of this caliber, it was the second major disappointment, next to the food.

Staff

The staff is attentive and helpful.  We never met anyone who didn't have a positive attitude.  There is, however, an emphasis on the "caste" system.  There is this "thing" at the Parisisus called "Royal Service", which is an extra charge for hotel guest who want (or need) a personal concierge, and a private pool, and a private dining area.  This seems like an East Coast thing, as we have noticed similar types of service levels at properties catering to East Coast folks.  Different strokes, I guess.  Maybe you have to have "Royal Service" to get hot food.

In Cancun, eating out isn't necessarily an easy option.  One would need to take the bus or a taxi to town, nothing is within walking distance.

Conclusion

It probably sounds like I am trashing the Paridisus, I'm not.  I just see room for major improvement.  First off, we will likely come back.  However, I won't expect much from Food and Beverage.  The all-inclusive is very expensive and I don't feel that I received value for what it cost.  I would plan on eating out, and would get a larger room with a kitchenette, so we could at least prepare our own HOT breakfast.

I would challenge the Food and Beverage manager to eat in his own restaurants, just like a guest, not sampling food in the kitchen.  There IS a problem that needs to be addressed.  Fix the food and I will be in love with the place.  Otherwise, there are other properties in the Hotel Zone that do a better overall job.

reviews.author: swright_utd
reviews.title: More like 3.5 star.....
reviews.text: The Paradisus is a beautiful hotel inside and out and is positioned on an amazing beach. That is where the positives end.  Long check in and out process.  Tons of beach beds left empty ( literally like 90%open) because they charge $120usd while there are no open beach chairs because everyone takes them by 9am.  There is no nightlife.  The food is not on par with other resorts.  We were here during the Super Bowl and they charged $90 per person to get to watch the game. At an all inclusive. Rediculous. I just booked another Mexico trip for May to the Hyatt.

reviews.author: Erin C
reviews.title: Rooms were nice, beach is great, drinks were terrible, and food was ok.
reviews.text: The staff and the rooms were very nice.  The beach was absolutely wonderful.  The all inclusive drinks were absolutely horrible.  We ended up paying for bottles of wine (which were so over priced) in order to have something to drink.  The buffet food was ok, and the reservation restaurants were nothing special.  There were also way too many children there for our liking.  With this said, it is great for families with children, but terrible if you are looking for an adult only vacation.

reviews.author: megan kelly t
reviews.title: Service is great , food is terrible
reviews.text:
We had the royal service and we upgraded our room , to the renovated oceanview royal service room . The renovated room is amazing! 

Royal service is great and the premium alcohol makes a big difference, but the food is really bad ! Chicken undercooked, cold food at the buffet and restaurant very poor selection 

Hotel needs some improvement ( ripped cushion,chairs) no evening show and uncomfortable beach chairs

They need more bali beds in the royal service,

reviews.author: Lilianabv
reviews.title: i had high expectations..
reviews.text:
building, decoration is nice but little old. room with ocean view has a bathtub and nice view but again decoration is old fashioned... the most important thing here was the food.. I did not like it at all.. and if you want to pay all included is not only for quantity ... we tried 3 restaurants and were simply tasteless. 

I wont recommended it because for that price you can get much better.

reviews.author: Allie T
reviews.title: Great waitstaff, item was stolen out of our bag while hotel was in possession of them.
reviews.text: The hotel was clean and the wait staff in the restaurants were amazing. The individuals at the from desk were very rude and not helpful. Our flight got cancelled and we had to spend an extra night, the hotel was not at all helpful in helping up book another room. They made us go online to book it and then check in again. While we were doing this, our bags were with the bellmen because we were expecting a shuttle. When we the bags were brought up to our room we were missing our Nintendo DS, it had been replaced with a little girls hair clip. The front desk was not helpful in this matter and when I contact the hotel once we got home I was told there was nothing they could do. I was shocked that something like this would happen at a resort of this size. I would not go back.

reviews.author: cloverChapelHill
reviews.title: Did not convert us to "resort people"
reviews.text:
Disclaimer: We are not resort people, but now that we have a kid, we decided to give it a try. This experience did not convert us. But I have tried to write this review to be useful to resort goers. 

Service: High variance. The folks at the Family Concierge were amazing. Friendly and always ready to help. They did a bunch of cool stuff for our three-year old. The wait staff was a hit and miss. Some were cheerful and helpful (Martin in the buffet area, our waiter at Mole and Bana restaurants), others behaved as if we were an inconvenience to them and were quite resistant to our (reasonable) requests (remarkably bad service at Vento restaurant).

Food: Mediocre at best. Admittedly we are foodies and while we did not expect to be blown away, we expected something better. We tried all of the restaurants except for the Market Grill and Blue Agave. Mole was good. Fuego was ok. Enso and Vento were not good. It is remarkable that at a resort where we were paying $700/night for three adults, there were only TWO kinds of wine (yes, you guessed it: red or white) and they were both BAD. 

Rooms: We stayed at a Family Concierge Suite Lagoon View. The room was spacious (separate bedroom with a door, a living area and two full bathrooms) and clean. There were a few signs of age (the blinds in the bathroom), but it did not bother us. Overall, great value.

Pool, Beach, etc.: The pool area is quite nice, but it was a tad cool during our visit and we did not go in the pool. The beach area is beautiful too, but the ocean was extremely rocky. The gym was absolutely great.

Guests: Perhaps because we have typically stated at boutique hotels or bed & breakfast type of places, we are used to our fellow travelers displaying some minimal level of friendliness and respect. Not here. Most of the guests were rude. Put food in abundance in front of people and observe how our primitive side comes out. 

Overall: We are unlikely to do another resort trip in the near future. If we do, we may choose another Meliora location, and, if we do that, we will make sure to get Family Concierge. That was totally worth it.

reviews.author: Magnús O
reviews.title: Reservation hell in paradise
reviews.text: I was at this resort for a conference and as a conference center this was a good location.  I had one day off at the end of the conference and was looking forward to experiencing something else than the buffet.  There are several restaurants where a reservation is needed.  For some strange reason though those restaurants are half empty all the time and they are not willing to let anyone in without a reservation.  A total turnoff since the restaurants are booked out two days in advance.  Another disappointment was that I reserved a beach hut.  The morning was cloudy so I decided to clean up some work before noon and when I showed up at 1 pm by reserved hut had been assigned to someone else.  Apparently the fine print says that one has to arrive before 11.  There like with the restaurants the occupancy was about 30% on average.  So all in all keep your expectations low, unless your are extremely organised and strategic "booker" this resort is not for your.

reviews.author: JANET R
reviews.title: Used to be The Melia Grand
reviews.text:
Arrived the week of Jan,08,2017
Huge property! Beautiful gardens and indoor decor. Excellent beach, you can walk for miles, fairly rough ocean, always a surf.
If you have any mobility issues this is NOT the hotel for you!,stairs everywhere! If you smoke, this is not the hotel for you! 
We stayed Royal Service,upgraded to waterfront but I think the Lagoon side would have been just fine and $350.00 U.S. Cheaper. Susanne our butler was excellent! 
The buffet had an amazing selection and our server Fernando was outstanding!
Carlos the pool consiger was very quick to assist in anything we could possibly need!
I gave the Resort a 3 due to varying service! , consistency of food and difficulty for me getting from one place to another. The Royal Service restaurant Lapalapa was more like a pool side bar, and we never got anyone to help us take our order or even say Welcome. I did hear other people say the staff was all over them!
Love the Paradisus Properties this will be our 9 visit, however I probably will not return to this particular property.

reviews.author: Stremma
reviews.title: Better than Some ... But Certainly Not the Best
reviews.text:
Arrived in the late afternoon.  Check in was quick and easy.  Got a junior suite.  The room was clean and comfortable.  The only really bad thing about the room was the living room sofa.  The cushion that you sit upon was so worn that we had to stuff other cushions under it so that our butts wouldn't sink down to the floor.  Other than that problem, the room was pretty good.  The mini bar fridge didn't keep things very cold, but ice was delivered promptly once we called for it.

I rec'd frequent calls from staff trying to sell me activities or offer me welcome gifts followed by attempts to arrange time share presentations.  That was annoying.  I wish I could have figured out a way to prevent that.

FOOD:

Breakfast dining options are limited to room service or buffet (unless you select the Royal Service - I didn't).  The buffet has plenty of food, and it all looks great.  Unfortunately, all the food is the same temperature.  The cold food isn't cold and the hot food isn't hot.  It's all just luke warm.  The only exception is the made to order omelet.  That comes out hot.

We ate lunch at the buffet one day.  We were one of the first people there (starts at 12:30 pm) and even though the food was just freshly prepared (at least in theory), it was still just warm.  Disappointing.

Dinner was a different story.  We tried five or six different restaurants and quite enjoyed the food and the service.  Bana is exceptional.  It was our favorite.  Skip Market Grille for dinner.  Enso and Vento were good too though the portions are small so be prepared to order two or even three times as much food as you would normally expect to order.

POOLS:

Inconsiderate guests race out early and place towels and other items under palapas and on lounge chairs to reserve them for the day.  There are resort signs limiting absences to less than 30 minutes, but the staff refuses to enforce the rule.  We frequently saw chairs without guests for periods in excess of 90 minutes.  I'm an early bird, so it didn't affect me much, but it was sad to see guests looking for a place to sit when many of the chairs were occupied by nothing more than a towel and a paperback well beyond noon.

The service was pretty good.  Just a skeleton crew between 10:00 am and 11:00 am.  They had their "regulars" (timeshare people that come year after year) and spent an inordinate amount of time visiting with them before offering service to others.  Once 11:00 am rolls around, there seems to be more service staff and food and beverages flow.

I could have done without the loud music around the pool, and maybe a little better service, but on the whole, I'd give them a 7 out of 10.

reviews.author: jenn4dex
reviews.title: Should have been better for the price and rating.
reviews.text: Pool was horrible, way too deep and the chairs were old and didn't work.  You could only sit in one position.  Small children hanging around the bar. For the price I would have thought you could wade in the pool as it was too hot to sit on your one way chair.   Food was average.  Breakfast buffet was cold, but it did have a lot of options.  My room was not very clean and had to ask to have the sheets changed after 4 days.    Entertainment was excellent and beach was nice and clean.

reviews.author: Shelley G
reviews.title: Last minute decision to spend Christmas here
reviews.text:
After cancelling our reservation a week before departure at another hotel due to bad reviews, we spent our Christmas week here at Paradisus Cancun.  I will qualify this review by saying that we have stayed twice at Paradisus La Esmeralda (as recently as this Thanksgiving) and loved it both times.  We felt confident of a good vacation knowing the Paradisus brand is of high quality.  
We arrived Dec 23rd in the morning and were met with a long line for check in.  We joined the line for the Melia rewards club line as we are members and hoped this would make the wait shorter - it didn't!  The staff were doing their best but they really were overwhelmed.  My request for two rooms connecting or adjacent could not be met.  We were travelling with our teenage kids and the nearest they could get us was a few rooms apart.  I wasn't thrilled but there was nothing to be done.  In the end that wasn't a problem whatsoever and gave the kids a sense of freedom away from my watching eye, it has taught me not to be so protective, they're teens not babies. 
The hotel is an older Melia property that has converted into the Paradisus brand.  In our opinion the design was outdated and the rooms and common areas needed attention.  But the beach was the best we saw along the Cancun strip, so much wider than any other property.  the hotel is wide and low rather than the Cancun typical high rise, which is so much nicer.  
The food in the restaurants was just ok and usually cold.  We were so surprised because the highlight of the Playa del Carmen Paradisus is the food, the best we've experienced in any all inclusive.  That said the staff here were more friendly and really did seem to want you to have the best vacation.  Our waiter on our first lunch visit remembered all of our names and drinks orders and was the best guy ever.  Thank you Antonio in Market Grill, it was a pleasure to meet you.  
The entertainment team around the pool were great too.  They knew my daughter and husband by name and were such good fun to spend time with.  Not at all cheesy or fake as some of these teams can be.  Special mention to Antonio Sanchez Ramon, for making it fun and always having a smile on your face.  
We did a few trips arranged with the water sports team on site, you have to go just over the main road to the lagoon to actually do these sports and all were fun.  We also went to Xplor for the day, recomended.  
Thank you to the team at Paradisus for a good stay.  We did enjoy the valuable family time over Christmas but really do feel there are a number of improvements needed to make this hotel as good as the one in Playa del Carmen.

reviews.author: Lillianne G
reviews.title: Ups and Downs during our stay
reviews.text:
We arrived late at night and although I had requested late check in, were told that our room had been "given away" and we ended up in the lobby overlooking plants and listening to the employee's conversations while trying to sleep. The room's tub was so high from the floor that I had issues getting into it. 

We upgraded our room and were offered the Royal Service Wing. It took half the morning to do so and we ended up canceling our plans for the day and booked mani/pedi's instead. The ladies at the spa were very nice but by the second day of our stay my gel manicure peeled off. 

At the Royal wing, our butler Rossana was amazing and the details throughout our stay impeccable. However, we had a bad experience with one of the Royal Service employees who processed a currency change from dollars to pesos. We brought $140 and he told us that for $148 we would get 2400 pesos, so we owed him an extra $8. he told us not to worry about the $8 and gave us the 2400. Two mornings later we brought him $10 because we had no change. He took it. 

When at checkout we disputed the peeled manicure charges they pulled out an itemized charge sheet and we noticed that we were supposed to get 2600 pesos for $140 without the extra $10 we had given him to complete the $148 he said would complete 2400 pesos. To add to the lie, he had given us a form to sign that had my husband's name and no other information of the transaction and he said it was for the hotel to know who they did a transaction with. My husband signed it. When we requested to know why he gave us wrong information he pulled the form out and he had added that he had given us 2600 pesos, which was not true. 

So, be very careful when you make your currency changes. This employee ended up with 200 pesos and $10 dollars that belonged to us. Ask to see transaction details in writing before signing. The only contact from the hotel was his supervisor saying they would take measurements and apologizing and asking us to stay again, not to offer a refund of the amounts that were taken for us. 

A lots of positives but also lot of negatives.

reviews.author: Amit S
reviews.title: An overpriced hotel with a great beach, good buffet, average service.
reviews.text:
We just got back (dec 31/2016) after 7 days at this hotel. We were a party of 10 5 adults and 5 kids.

The Good
Beach is tremendous. The water is warm and the waves are a lot of fun. The beach staff does a great job keeping people safe. It water was rough much of the time, so limited water sports, but that was ok by us. We bought some boogie boards and spent a lot of time in the water. The beach was very clean and the sand was beautiful - reminds me of Negril in Jamaica.
The buffet was above average - good variety, a bit overcooked. The fish was always fresh. Good salads and desserts and nice wait staff, always smiling. Breakfast was always busy, lines long for the fresh eggs.

The average - even though there were a lot of options for dining, they were not great. The best was Market Grill at night where they have a Brazilian steakhouse (they bring the meat to you). The others were a disappointment - service was slow and the food was so-so. 

Not so good - check in was obnoxiously long and delayed. Had to change rooms even though we were guaranteed ocean room. The keys to the doors kept getting deactivated. The front desk was not responsive. Also the room servicing was not done well. There were a couple of spots where water was coming down and they had buckets to catch it. The night shows were poor and the nightclub was cheesy. 

Price - for what we paid for it we were expecting more. It was much too crowded and you felt it at the buffet.

Overall I could give it a half point more if pushed. We made the best of it - spent the money to get the cabanas - highly recommended (they come with champagne). Also went one night to porofiro's that is a walk down the street - great ambience and highly recommended.

reviews.author: Shawafel
reviews.title: Our Stay At Paradisus Cancu
reviews.text:
Overall a great experience. 

Pros:
- Clean
- Multiple Nice Pools
- Staff very friendly
- Great experience with the professional photographer Parvi from outdoors photo, she did an outstanding job organizing our large family (23 family members celebrating parents 50th anniversary). She was very professional with a huge smile all the time. We had many children with us, and she was great with them as well.
- Another great guy was the Coffee Bar attendant Andres, very friendly and great at his job.
- I also had great experience with Norma from the front desk, she is very nice and super professional

Cons:
- Buffet was good, but other restaurants were not that great, the Asian fusion one was not good at all. Japanese restaurant and Tapas one were ok.
- Rooms are small, we had the ocean view junior sweet.
- They clean the rooms once a day and they do it very late, I noticed they don't clean the floors as sand from the beach will stay on the floors for days
- Before check in I sent an email to the front desk supervisor and to try and prep for the trip but she never replied back, I sent her two emails but no response. I met her at check in, she tried to help but there was a lot of confusion that I wanted to avoid by reaching out early since we were such a large group.
- I saw some insects in the room, showed a picture to the same supervisor she apologized and sent someone to fix the problem but did not offer me an upgrade when I asked for one, and I know that there were plenty of available rooms at the time.
- The air conditioning filter was very dirty, I asked for it to be changed but they never did change it.
- Only one show in one place inside the resort and not many activities or shows outside
- only one cafe/coffee place with good coffee

Overall not a bad place, will look at other places next time before deciding if I want to come back to Paradisus next year.

reviews.author: BeachTraveler6780
reviews.title: Overall pleasant experience
reviews.text:
Just returned from a 4 night stay.  After reading all recent tripadvisor reviews, I have to say that I thought  TAAJ_2013's review was spot on.  Overall my family (traveling with a 3 year old) had a pleasant stay and I felt that for what we paid, it was worth it- but there were some shortcomings.

I've stayed in many all inclusives in the Caribbean & Mexico.  Paradisus is a great brand.  Compared to some of the chains, I've stayed at like Riu, Iberostar, and Fiesta Americana- Paradisus definitely provides superior quality and service. In comparison to a place like Live Aqua- it's similar, but not quite as good in service, location, and amenities.  Part of my slight disappointment may be due to a comparison to the Paradisus Palma Real which I stayed in Punta Cana.  The service/room/food there was excellent (although to be fair, it was also a much higher price).

PROS:  friendly staff, clean beach, many areas for smaller kids (big kiddie pool, kids club), decent food

CONS:  Electricity set up in room was very odd/ and plumbing seemed a bit spotty, not enough attention to detail, from far away everything looks modern- but when you get closer you notice some imperfections  (not a deal breaker, but prevents them from getting a 5 star in my book); cleanliness could be improved (for example., placemats at the table were nice to see, but not when most of them are filthy),  very loud music at night

Perhaps the most disappointing thing was that for the majority of my trip, all of the beach palapas were knocked down in preparation for a huge private event.  Almost all of the beach front was taken up to prep for this event leaving essentially no space at all for hotel (non-royal service guests).  In addition, on my last night there- over half of the specialty restaurants were closed- again- to accommodate the private event.  I feel that this should have been made clear at time of booking, for my understanding practically the entire hotel was booked by this one group of people.  

It pissed me off to go to cancun for the beach only to see two huge stages set up and areas roped off with caution tape.  If I were a guest as part of that private party, I would have been thrilled as the way they transformed the place was truly stunning.  However, as a regular hotel guest- no one seemed to care that the preparations were inconveniencing others.  Loud music was playing outside until 3AM.  In Pyramind 3 you could hear everything.  At least if you are going to close parts of the hotel for a private party let people know prior to booking or give a deep discount.  

Not to mention I got pressured into sitting in a vacation club presentation the minute I walked in the door....

reviews.author: mwhiterun
reviews.title: Two reviews in one
reviews.text:
I am not sure how to write this review for Paradisus at Cancun Mexico since the hotel itself fell far below standards of an all inclusive resort. However four individual staff members stood out and need to be commended. 

The quality of service and degree they went exceeded our expectations and made us feel at home. I have Celiac Disease and was worried about what I would eat once I got here. Once I meet Cristian Lovera & Carlos at Nanos Restaurant, any worries I had were removed. Cristian made arrangements with chief and every morning Cristian had my breakfast ready for me. For dinner Leonardo Canul at Mole & Ligia Balun  at Blue Agave went out of their way to have dishes made to order. 

Their enthusiasm to help assist with making our stay an enjoyable one will never be forgotten and was priceless. Unfortunately, the same cannot be said of other department and hotel as a whole. 

One day our keys did not work and we had to call front desk to have someone let us in. After waiting over 15 minutes, we asked a staff member who was walking by and had no clue about our lock out. The staff member was kind in opening the door but never checked who we were and if in fact we did stay in this room. Not sure about anyone else but that is a big security concern. Even after we were let into our room no one ever checked to see if we got in. Also, no one seem to be able to assist with reward points and having them used for a message. Spa said ask the Front desk. Front desk said ask concierge. Concierge said ask Front Desk. Endless loops of insanity so we said what's the point. Not something you want guest of your hotel saying or is it just me. 

Now if all the hotel staff followed Cristian, Carlos, Leonardo, and Ligia examples this would be place to go in Cancun and get five stars all day long. However, that was not the case and management needs to work on improving that. It's the staff that makes or brakes a hotel and it would be ashamed to wast the outstanding efforts of Cristian, Carlos, Leonardo, and Ligia. 
They were the reason our stay enjoyable. Four is not enough.

reviews.author: rays757
reviews.title: Paradius
reviews.text: The hotel food was bland and hotel is showing signs of wear. The staff were friendly,helpful efficient. The resort is showing its age but clean. The bell men are very helpful. The Kids Zone had activities geared to younger children so anyone over 10 years would be bored. The small coffee shop in restaurant area is a must stop and donuts come out at 3 pm

reviews.author: maren315
reviews.title: Updating needed
reviews.text:
We visited this resort 12-4-16 thru 12-11-16. We were disappointed by the rooms. They are in serious need of updating. The lighting is awful and we had a few issues with electrical and toilets. Our 13 year old daughter was served alcohol and was completely drunk one evening due to the color on her wristband. We booked a room under the impression it was a two room suite, but when we arrived, we were told otherwise and had to spend an additional $950 to upgrade. Also, a BIG thing is all staff expect tipping. We spent a fortune on tipping. Everyone has their hand out. 
The beach was beautiful, but a lot of vagrants. Pool areas are very nice. The waitstaff were fabulous. As for food, it's the same as any typical all inclusive. Bland, but edible.

reviews.author: thearamadan
reviews.title: Decent place.
reviews.text:
2 of the restaurants were good. Most of the service people were nice and friendly. The service at Cocos beach club was great. The beach beds made our stay a lot more enjoyable. (We were not aware the beach club was not part of the all inclusive package). 
The room was awful. Old, musty-smelling and small. Bed was horrible. The bathroom was ok and updated. 
Guest services people were useless and rude. Victor especially. 
The host of Mole was fantastic and so was the chef. The food was great as well. 
Blue agave was also great. Every item on the menu was delicious.

reviews.author: Stanley G
reviews.title: Cancun 2016
reviews.text: 1. Reward upgrade was not honored. 2. Food choices at buffet have diminished 3. Premium liquor was more limited than in years past 4. Beach activities were sparse compared to other resorts 5. Access to spa facility was $35, unlike other 5 star resorts 6. Tennis clinic was offered only twice during the week

reviews.author: Alan G
reviews.title: Bad management!! There was noise from construction. Gave another room-air conditioner was leaking from the ceiling!!
reviews.text: Bad!! Bad!! Bad!!!!   Poor management!!!!! Should refund money and apologize. I was surprise by the behavior of management. They should have refunded my money and/or offer to bring us back next year at minimum cits.

reviews.author: epidermnurse
reviews.title: Great facility if you don't mind young children everywhere
reviews.text: This was a large and beautiful facility with many amenities. The staff was professional and very friendly. I would've rated 5 stars except the facility allows young children everywhere,  including pool bar, bars and all restaurants. It was nearly impossible to relax. Would recommned adults only bars and adults only areas.

reviews.author: Shelley T
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun,  a nice vacation But needs some work.
reviews.text:
My Husband and I and a group of friends traveled to Paradisus the 1st week of Nov.
When we arrived it was Dark out. Walked into the Hotel, the smell was overwhelming(too much essential oils and the incense have to go!) Check in was fast,but then we sat down with this lady telling us about the hotel, which was great. Then it happened, she offered us a deal on an excursion if we would have a special breakfast with her in the morning, RED FLAG!  My husband and I said no, and after that we were treated very cold. She wanted us to waste our beautiful morning listening to her try selling us a timeshare with Melia. I was really turned off by our 1st half hour or so of our arrival. So we make our way to our room,the resort is very dark and I wasn't impressed with that, Kinda dangerous I think. Our room was very spacious and clean also had a very nice plate of fruit and a Mayan mask as a welcome gift, along with balloons on the bed as I was celebrating my retirement. Thank you!!

The service from the staff at the Buffet,Ala Carts and Bars was very good. I preferred eating at the Ala carts rather than the Buffet.Which is weird because it's usually the other way around when we travel. Believe me, I'm not a picky eater, the buffet was not that Great!
THE CHICKEN WINGS AT THE POOL WERE AWESOME!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
One of our friends that we were traveling with needed wheel chair access. This resort needs more of that. We wanted to go sit in the Red light lounge,I think that's what it was called, we couldn't  because of the stairs. Couldn't sit at outside lounge, No wheel chair access.Very frustrating for him!
Also I think this resort needs a Theater you have to stand and watch the show in the Lounge, Really!! And get rid of those darn bed loungers in the Lounge.What a waste of space and kinda dirty! 
We've been to many resorts and there's always places to sit in the lobby to visit and have a few drinks where its quiet,this resort has nothing like that. Oh sure there's place to sit as walking down the hall way etc. But there is no type of beverage service if you were to do that.                              MORE WHEEL CHAIR ACCESS!!

The pool area and beach was wonderful. Always a place to sit and plenty of towels. I love the fact that there's no towel cards. Always had friendly service around the pool area. The staff was always cleaning and keeping the guests happy.

We always had a good night sleep. The beds were very comfortable and our area was very quiet. We were in room 3211 with a gorgeous Lagoon view. Our maid was wonderful and the turn down service was awesome too! Fridge was always stocked daily with lots of water,pop and goodies.

Would we return here? No (there are way too many better resorts out there that I would return to.)
Would I recommend it to my friends? Maybe,but they would know about all the issues we all had as a group.

Aside from all the things I felt needs to be looked at by administration, we did have a very fun and relaxing vacation at the Paradisus Cancun.  Thank you!

reviews.author: mjbernatz
reviews.title: Not quite up to standard
reviews.text:
Okay, here is the good, the bad and the ugly...

First, the good. We chose the Family Concierge package and really liked it. Our concierge, Gloria, was amazing. When we were brought to our ocean view room from which the ocean could barely be seen, she immediately located another room us. Gloria made our restaurant reservations and each evening had a surprise snack waiting for us (wine, cheese, etc). The pool area was very nice, and I didn't see any difference between the main pool and the Royal Service pool area. All of the restaurants were very nice, and our room was cleaned and fridge restocked daily. Having the bus stop in front of the hotel was convenient for shopping trips into the city. The Yhi Spa was nice, really enjoyed the massage provided by Jenny. Finally, the fitness center had plenty of equipment and wasn't crowded. 

The bad. The buffet, Naos, was a disappointment. Some of the food was at room temperature and food quality and presentation reminded us of the buffet on National Lampoons Vegas Vacation. The nightly entertainment, held in the Avenue Bar, had inadequate seating and viewing so patrons were stepping in front of each other to get a glimpse of the shows. 

The ugly. When we arrived we immediately noticed a huge tent erected on the beach with dozens of tables and more than 200 chairs. This structure (see photo) took up more than 100 feet of the beach in front of the hotel, and remained there, unused, for the entire week. Many guests were complaining about it. It is inexcusable that hotel management would permit such an eyesore to remain on this wonderful stretch of beach. Shame on them. 

While we had a good time, we will not return.  If we vacation in Mexico again we will return to the Barcelo Maya Palace Deluxe where we visited last year.

reviews.author: RICKDallas
reviews.title: Not Luxury, just ok.
reviews.text:
Well this resort is listed as a luxury resort and I really don't agree. If you are American and used to staying at luxury resorts I would move on. 
There were some good things about our stay, but also bad.
The main problem we experienced is the lack of air conditioning. IT IS SUPER HOT!
Our room would get to about 77 at night and then 80 degrees in the day. We asked to move rooms , but were told NO. The maintenance man came and tried to work on the air, but it really could not keep up. They did bring us a fan to try and keep us happy, but it was pretty miserable. 
Common areas , like restaurants and night club get really hot. Be prepared to sweat. 
Was almost unbearable. 
The food was actually good for a Mexico resort and many choices of restaurants. 
The one thing I found really strange is the lunch situation. 
The have a pool snack bar that is soooo BAD!!
They have other options for lunch, a buffet and Mexican food restaurant. BUT!! You can't go in in those if you are in the pool. You have to go change clothes and then eat and then go back and change clothes again if you are swimming at the beach or pool. Really was irritating. 
They have nice out door restaurant, Enzo's , but they don't open that for lunch. WHY??
I was starving one afternoon when going back up to the room from the pool. Put on my shorts and shoes with my board shorts,. Dried off and all. Was totally presentable. 
I attempted to get a plate of food from the buffet to take to the room.
Was rudely told NO and thrown out. Told you can't bring food up to your room. 
How can this be you have room service. How can you not bring food up to your room?
We were told NO! a lot. 
Am I the guest or a pest?
Another big point! Yes, they have room service, but do not serve any alcohol with room service. No champagne in the morning on vacation? WHAT?
Was told NO again. 
Wanted a taxi one night to go out to dinner. They acted like the did not know what a taxi was. Told to walk to the bus stop. NO!
I did not want to take a bus. 
Over all we still had fun, but it was strange and would never go back. 
The entertainment was fairly good. They just surprise you from time to time with a performance. 
Kind of cool. Opera singing pool guy one afternoon. 
Dance numbers by the pool.
Belly dancing in the lobby by the bar. 
Mayan show by the pool one afternoon.
Liked that part. I give the entertainers props. 
One ting I do want o mention. If you want to go out to dinner one nightt out of the hotel there is a place called Crab House right down the street you can walk to. It is tremendous. Definitely recommend it for a nice dinner over looking the bay.
To sum it up. I think there are many nicer hotels than this in Cancun.
I travel quite a bit so I have experience in this. 
Did meet lots of nice people from all around the world and enjoyed that.
Was also my 53rd birthday while there.  They knew about it, but did nothing. 
Shop around. 
Paradisus, just so you know. Americans need air conditioning!
You need to do something about it and get rid of the horrible snack bar!
STOP TELLING YOUR GUESTS NO!
WE PAID FOR A VACATION.
One more thing to make known. If you have any walking problems do not go here. It is thousands of steps. You get a leg work out for sure. Tons of places you can have serious wipe out. By the towel are there is 4 foot drop off with no railing. Not good for people having cocktails. 
Rick and Lisa from Dallas, Texas.

reviews.author: HollywoodCouple
reviews.title: Mixed Emotions
reviews.text:
Stayed in April 2016, took me so long to review because how upset i was from my departure experience i wanted to cool down before i reviewed so it would be fair.  Unfortunately did not get the name but the young looking short stocky Spanish guy at the front desk with dark hair with a DA type haircut, short on the sides and combed back with gel on the top. So rude and really left a bad taste in my mouth and for that i gave a 3 even after my cool down.  Took long to write but he was very rude and unhelpful upon check out even going as far as being combative with me not a great experience.  
Pros: Nice property stayed in the Punta Cana one and similar features which i really love. Great beach, good food which is important to me. Rooms decent favorite features were big balcony with great ocean views, bade, and big soaking tub.  Disco on site which was nice with live DJ. Nice spa with hydro therapy pool.

Cons: Service is hit or miss with the staff.

Overall had a nice time i will be honest what really impacted my 3 star instead of 1 was Kauil he was an amazing experience.  He was a waiter at the buffet and he is truly amazing, energetic, professional, i can go on.  I would have give 5 star just because of him had it not been for the front desk agent upon check out.  I cannot say it enough KAUIL is the best at what he does.  Thank you!!

reviews.author: xeimex
reviews.title: Know before you go..
reviews.text:
We booked Paradusis for a luxury getaway before travelling through Mexico on a much tighter budget. As a pair of girls we wanted a safe and luxurious all inclusive option where we didn't have to think about anything. We booked an all inclusive stay for 4 nights in a twin room. 

We checked in late at night with no hassle. The concierge told us we were in Pyramid 1, and that we could have a Lagoon Room with twin beds or be upgraded to an ocean view room and share a king bed. We went for the upgrade. 

Rooms were nice, aircon worked but was extremely loud. We later realised this was probably a good thing because the noise from the clubs and beach was so loud in the beach view rooms in Pyramid 1 and the doors were definitely not soundproof. 

Bathrooms are a little run down, but clean and stocked with essentials. Bed was comfy and the turn down service at night was a nice touch. 

The beachfront is beautiful, if you manage to get a good day bed, you're set. But be aware that the nicer beach beds are reserved for members or you have to pay extra to use them. 

There are a few different restaurants in the resort, all average unfortunately. If you're after western style food and buffets, you will like it. If you want some gourmet.. forget it. Or, pay extra to eat at the expensive option. 
We had a manicure in the spa while we were there, prices were extremely expensive. I wouldn't pay these prices at home, but we were on vacay. Had the manicure in a kids room because apparently there was something wrong with the usual room. Sitting in a kids chair for over an hour hunching over a small table for an average manicure was not ideal. 

Otherwise the pools and service was great. Good wifi. Tacky entertainment, but lots of people love that sort of thing. Minibar and water in room was only restocked once, had to keep asking for water to use. Beachfront was definitely the best part of the hotel. 

If your not a club member, or paying extra to use the beach club, make sure your room isn't internal to Pyramid 1 so you can get some sleep.

reviews.author: Angelique C
reviews.title: Looked Better from the Outside
reviews.text:
ROOM:
My husband and I made reservations here to celebrate our first anniversary. The outside and common area was very nice; however, our room was not very impressive. We were on the 3rd floor in the center of the complex.  The drain on the bathroom floor reeked of raw sewer and the odor would fill the room.  Housekeeping's solution was to spray the room with air freshener to mask the smell. No bottles of liquor in the room.

CHECK IN:
Check in was fairly easy.  They served you drinks while we waited which was nice.  Since we arrived at the property before normal check in time, we were given a short tour and allowed to eat lunch while we waited for our rooms. Betty was the one who gave us a tour and made our dinner reservations.  She also convinced us to do the membership tour so that we could take advantage of the gifts for our anniversary.

MEMBERSHIP TOUR:
Rafael was really great and knowledgeable of the resorts. When it came down to decide whether or not we wanted to buy, my husband and I decided that it was not a good time to buy. He asked if anything would change our minds, and I said no money down and $100 a month.  He said, that would be a really good deal but didn't think they would have anything.  We were okay with that, but I guess he was still required to bring in the "second" person. Her name was Carolina.  Carolina was the rudest person we have ever met.  She asked why we took the presentation if we knew we weren't going to buy. We told her that we liked the gifts and were undecided about becoming members when we took the tour.  She then said, "Next time do me a favor and don't come again. Don't waste everybody's time." This is obviously not the job for her.  If you can't handle rejection without being rude, then you're in the wrong business.

FOOD:
The restaurant selections were just okay.  You needed to make dinner reservations unless you wanted to have buffet all the time. Some of the seats worn especially in Vento.

POOL/BEACH:
Both areas were very nice. We got to enjoy a Bali bed by the pool as part of our free gifts which was very nice.

FREE GIFTS:
One of the gifts we received was for 4 days and 3 nights stay at Paradisus.  However, when we got to our room and read the fine print, we noticed that it was for the room only.  It was not an all inclusive trip. That was very disappointing.

reviews.author: Christian P
reviews.title: Not a Paradisus like the others we visited
reviews.text:
We have been to other Paradisus in Punta Cana and Playa del Carmen. This one cannot compare to the others by any means. Other than the Beach, the rest is just below average compared to our previous Paradisus Experience. We are not going again to this Hotel.
If you compare it with Paradisus La Perla, this one onlye has a better beach only.

reviews.author: Cathy A
reviews.title: Great service- not much for kids- food poor
reviews.text:
September 19, 2016
Hotel is great if you are traveling with out kids. 1st night the a/c was not working had 2 fans so around 11pm we finally was able to get a room change which the new room was much better. if your traveling with kids and longer than 3 night consider family concierge. 

Food horrible the restaurants were blah,  the buffet for dinner seems to serve the same thing every night. Breakfast and lunch ok....
ENSO - WAS THE BEST I AM NOT A SEAFOOD PERSON AND THEY MADE ME A FRIED RICE WITH NO SEAFOOD.

the market was ok id suggest arriving early we arrive at 9 and most of the meat was really rare.

didnt try blue agave and mole just seemed they were serving the same thing a nao, tacos, alot of seafood and weird tasting pastas.....room service is good hamburger & fries... 

desserts we good, ice cream vanilla and coconut yummy.

Service in every aspect of the resort was excellent aside from check in/ check out crew

The waitstaff/bartenders/room service all we super great!!

The restaurants are all about the same.. Tacos, Asian, sushi and buffet which serves about the same thing....
 
WHAT I DIDNT LIKE

Nothing to do for the kids, play area but not entertaining enough they pool area nothing fun to keep the kids entertained. I took him to the kids corner and both times the girls were sitting up front and letting the kids run free (indoor playground) not entertaining for them...pool side for kids very boring nothing to do.

 only 1 swim up bar. so bring lots of singles to tip that way you dont have to worry about fighting the swim up bar....take care of your waitstaff and they will take care of you.

Evening night show was not so great either.

This is a great place for older adults who are not looking to do much but relax and dont care about the food......

Beach was always cleaned and service was on point. jet ski you have to walk about 3 hotels down.

i dont think I would visit Paradisus Cancun again...For my family we need much for entertainment and stuff to do for kids.

They said ZUMBA at 10 am by the pool i waited from 9:45-10:30 and nobody appeared.

Spa - they rushed us around we werent allot to try the pool out.

reviews.author: foxymifflin
reviews.title: Average hotel not average price
reviews.text: Hotel is dated, poor staff work hard but very understaffed great spa. I won't recommend Royal service it's not worth the money . Average hotel for an expense price. Sushi restaurant was great and room service food was good!

reviews.author: Jim H
reviews.title: Restaurant Service
reviews.text: Our server, Gaudencio, during our stay was fabulous at the Market Grill was fabulous.  He did an exceptional job and entertained our 1 year old grandson beyond belief.  Kudos to him.  You should be proud of him.

reviews.author: jordanm782
reviews.title: They don't wash plastic cups
reviews.text:
The worst part of the hotel and most disturbing is their lack of washing for all of their plastic cups that they use for the pool and beach area. 

At multiple bars on the property I watched bartenders simply take dirty cups and rinse them off in a hand sink with no soap or bleach solution and promptly put them back on the counter for use. It makes sense now why so many glasses had lipstick on them

I even had a shot glasses given to our party that still had creamy Bailey Irish cream type liquid all over the glass

I loved the property but when I am drinking out of a community cup everyday that makes me sick to my stomach

reviews.author: 429nanm
reviews.title: All Inclusive?
reviews.text: Although the drinks and food were at no extra charge, they were not readily available.  Restaurants, other than the buffet, required advance, not same-day, reservations.  Available bars during the day were few and far between - unless you were a high-ranked loyalty member.  The coffee shop wasn't even open until 10 AM!

reviews.author: Nestor Carlos
reviews.title: Did not feel the Paradisus Experience
reviews.text: I was not offered water at check in, check in experience took 30 minutes.  I pre paid my reservation and I was told it wasn't and wanted a credit card so I can get a band.  I was located on Tower 5 Royal service.  The elevator floor was cracked, the same as the 4th floor. In addition to this, someone hang the Do not disturb outside my door and we did not get cleaning towels, shower caps, soap and shampoo on 2 nights.

reviews.author: neverhomebrooklyn
reviews.title: Would choose another next time.
reviews.text:
I came with 2 young kids, ages 7 and 9 and had at best an average vacation.

Pros: 
Food is excellent. Plenty of variety and very friendly waiters. Con: You will need to reserve an evening restaurant each day and can reserve for next day as well. But good luck getting a time slot that you want. 

Pools are in good condition. Beach areas are very clean and lifeguards are available as the waves get very rough most days. Enough showers and beds/chairs to find one easily.

Gym is good size and enough equipment including treadmills and ellipticals to have a productive workout and is open 24/hr a day.

Cons: 
Weak kids program - geared for younger kds up to age 7. Kids are not separated by group. Some activities require sign up ahead of time and if the sign up didn't happen, then the child will be turned away.

Entertainment sucks -  Just not enough entertainment options throughout the day. The programs that are there are pretty weak and not of an interesting variety and can best be described as amateurish. Several times I came over and found out that the program was cancelled with no prior notice or explanation.
 Normally I like a nice 1 hour production show for the evening program, but what you get a 45 min at best of a fairly weak caliber. The location of the program is a bit unreal. As they happen in the middle of a bar, and maybe a dozen lounge sofa / beds that fill up instantly. Most people just stand around or sit on a floor to get a good view. 

Map / signs around the resort are just terrible. The layout is very confusing and spread out (ex must go up, to go down)  and there is absolutely no signs, arrows, etc to know which way you are going. If they just put up some simple signs on the walls, that would have saved me so much wasted time.

Room has just 1 dresser, with a maximum capacity of 4 people. I had to get pretty creative to spread everyone's stuff out. Big turn off to use the tables to host my socks.

Overall, for the amount of money I paid in off season, I would expect a way better experience, and would choose a different hotel if I could do it again.

Whatever hotel you choose, make sure you go to the local theme park call XCaret, it's pricey but the experience is very unique.

reviews.author: monicaandfamily
reviews.title: It could be excellent, but it's not
reviews.text: I arrived Sept 6 and I'm still here now. Check in was easy for us. Hotel is beautiful. Rooms have mold or mildew though. I wake h every morning with swollen eyes. I am taking allergy pills and using a rolled up towel for pillow. Restaurants are meh. Been to most, market grill was our favorite, we would not go back to the others. The buffet is a normal all inclusive one so that's ok. Yesterday I stepped on glass in the pool, they offered to call a doctor but politely refused to help me. I needed tweezers to pull it out. So we grabbed our 1 yr old and packed our stuff and I hopped to the room to get my tweezers. That was pretty annoying. I didn't see them using a pool vacuum to make sure everything was cleaned up. Chicken wings at the snack bar were raw one day. They did grab my plate and run back to the snack bar to make sure  the rest were cooked. Thank goodness I bit it and not my toddler. This is my 5 Th trip to Mexico and we will not be back here. They are so close to being excellent and could be, but aren't. In one of their gourmet restaurants they bread a lamb chop, deep fry it and call that a tapa. Smh...............

reviews.author: Worldtrekker7777777
reviews.title: Did not meet expectations
reviews.text:
This was our 6th trip to Mexico and we chose to stay at this resort after having stayed at the Paradisus La Perla in Playa del Carmen a few years ago. No complaints with that resort. We expected a similar experience but we're quite disappointed. We were celebrating an anniversary and took our 2 year old son and my wife's parents for their 1st Mexican vacation. We booked 2 ocean view Jr. Suites for an 7 night stay.
Check-in: arrived around 11:30am, waited in a long line, and ultimately were told that we could return by 2pm to have our rooms ready. Also there was an error with one of the bookings with double beds vs a king bed. Upon return, were told that the rooms would be ready in approximately a half hour. Returned within the half hour and were told the rooms would be ready within 10 minutes. No drinks were offered during this time (as they were during our Paradisus La Perla check in).
   Upon arrival to the rooms my wife's parents' room was decorated with balloons and our room was not. They did not decorate the correct room for our anniversary even though we had this listed in our booking (this continued for a few days). Our mini fridge was not working properly and we also requested additional pillows. We tipped the bellman and he said that he would have the fridge repaired and he would send pillows. No pillows and no repair. After going out to the balcony, I couldn't get back into the room because there was no handle on the outside of the sliding door, only 2 small drilled holes with jagged edges. Called maintenance regarding this and the fridge. They repaired the fridge but stated that there were no handles on the outside of the balcony doors. Upon asking how to get back into the room, the maintenance person pressed his hands against the glass and struggled to open the door.
   After a few days of this disappointment, went to the concierge and expressed all of our concerns and even showed him a picture of the balcony door with the drilled holes. We asked if we could be upgraded to Family Concierge in light of these circumstances. He apologized, agreed that the door needed to be repaired, and said that he would speak with his supervisor. When we followed up with this same person, he said that maintenance said that the door was okay as they don't have handles. Even concierge expressed confusion regarding this. As for the upgrade, we were upgraded to Family Concierge services EXCEPT, no butler and no room upgrade (these were the primary highlights of Family Concierege). This individual was polite and friendly but he could only offer what his supervisor granted.
   Had a leak in our bathroom ceiling one evening around 9:30pm. Called maintenance and someone came in approximately 25 minutes. He repaired the leak and put a dirty towel down to soak up the remaining drips that he said would stop in a few minutes. He left debris on the floor and in the bathtub. My wife called and had a cleaning person come to clean it up.
   Lots of disappointments. Still can't believe the balcony door issue and no repair. The positives... Jared in Concierge was very friendly. Fuego food, staff, and service was great. When we discussed our previous positive experiences from Paradisus La Perla with one of the staff of Paradisus Cancun, he informed us that even though these were both Melia resorts, they were quite different in what they offered. Chose this resort because of the previous Melia/Paradisus experience, but this resort did not live up to expectations.

reviews.author: Gen G
reviews.title: Pros and Cons of Paradisus
reviews.text:
Pros & Cons to Paradisus Cancun Resort
Pros:
•	The resort is beautifully constructed and decorated 
•	The staff are friendly and super polite
•	The staff definitely try to get you to drink as much alcohol as possible
•	There was an Amstar desk in the resort to schedule excursions through
•	The sand is white and the ocean is clear turquoise blue
•	There was a “Family Concierge” person upon check in that explained how the resorts work
•	Room service was free
•	Top shelf liquor selection included 
Cons:
•	It is extremely humid inside the resort. There are a ton of plants and fountains with a glass pyramid ceiling, which, with the lack of air conditioning, creates a greenhouse effect. Bad hair day every day.
•	The bars or lounges were sooooo humid, we could not stand being in them to drink. We spent most of our nights in our room where there was air conditioning. 
•	We paid for a Junior Suite with Lagoon View room. All that could be seen from the window was a building. When we complained, they said if we go out on the porch and peek around the corner, we can see the lagoon.
•	Don’t go expecting not to bring additional money. Everywhere you try to sit outside costs additional money. We finally gave in one day and paid for the cabana. It normally cost $140 USD for the day, but they cut us a deal for $80 and threw in a free bottle of tequila as a present.  The waiter brought us drinks and food all day which was pleasant. I don’t usually drink alcohol, so my tolerance is low. I had 7 double shot pina coladas and was not even buzzed at all.
•	We were on floor 0 of pyramid 4. The corridor right outside our room was set up for breakfast and cocktails for people with special gold bands. We were not allowed to partake. The annoying part was that it woke me up at 6:30 every morning when they were setting up breakfast and then there were constantly people congregating outside our room door.
•	All of the restaurants, except two, within the resort require reservations that have to be made a day in advance. So upon arrival, you have the choice between sweating in a taco restaurant called Blue Agave that is super humid, but yummy, or a buffet restaurant called Naos, which wasn’t that great. Actually, I wasn’t overly impressed with the food at any of the restaurants.
•	The bed was hard
•	Being on floor 0, you cannot simply walk across all 5 pyramids in the resort across floor 0. We had to constantly walk up to floor one to cross over the restaurants and then back down to floor 0 again. 
•	We did a snorkeling excursion through Cancun Sailing to Isla Mujeres. It was fun, but all of the coral looked dead. The Amstar guy said we shouldn’t have booked it through Cheapcarribean.com when we booked our resort stay because it wasn’t the greatest snorkeling. What can I say, he was definitely right. Unfortunately, the excursions are non-refundable. I recommend waiting to book excursions until you get to the resort and can talk to the Amstar guys who are local rather than a customer service representative at cheapcarribean.com who doesn’t really know.

reviews.author: MDtravel23
reviews.title: Okay, but not 5 stars
reviews.text:
We stayed for at Paradisus Cancun for wedding for one of our friends. Overall, the resort is nice with beautiful interiors and helpful people. Some of these are editorial comments, and might not apply to you:

1. I have celiac disease and ability to find gluten free food is of utmost importance. Most of the staff/servers were familiar with what we were talking about. At check-in, I was given a 'gluten allergy' card which every server recognized. They have gluten free pasta and pizza for room service for lunch and dinner, which tastes okay. Buffet is okay, with limited options. My husband who is not gluten free, was not impressed with food at the buffet - except for the desserts. Food was cold. I got corn tortilla quesadillas that were made on request during lunch or dinner and were good. The dine-in restaurants are only for dinner and have gluten free options, they were very good. The menu has some items marked as gluten free and vegetarian, however, the list, by no means, is inclusive. I talked to my server who was able to check with chef. Overall, happy that there were a few safe options, sad that dessert options were non-existent. 

2. Rooms were clean. But everything is old. You can see that most of the plumbing is super old and rusted. The first room we were given, had a non-working shower and a hole in the ceiling where there should be light. We requested to change the room and which they happily did for us. The next room was okay, but still with rusted shower. For some reason, there were instructions in both bathrooms about how to turn on the shower, which doesn't apply to that bathroom at all - weird. There is a bidet, if you want.

3. Housekeeping is nice. Employees are kind and professional. You need to know a few words of Spanish to get by. Restaurant/check-in/concierge people will speak English. 

4. Shows are okay. Seating is limited. 

5. Pools are kid friendly and have either a depth of 2.2 ft or 5.1-6 ft, from what I could notice. 

6. They are trying to make you signup for Melia rewards and want you to attend an early morning breakfast to tell you more about it. We don't travel much and were not very interested, but the concierge were persistent. Called us many times to remind us which was a turn off. I don't want to get up at 730 while on vacation for marketing breakfast!

Overall, nice hotel with not-the-best rooms or food (brownie points for being allergen friendly)

reviews.author: Joel B
reviews.title: Not the greatest...OK resort with inadequate customer service
reviews.text:
Check in was frustrating...we booked a room for 3 people and requested 2 double beds. When we arrived, they said they don't have any double beds available, only 1 king and a pull out sofa bed. After 45min talking with a manager, they suddenly found a room with 2 double beds. The staff was extremely rude and only when the manager witnessed that not having the requested room was not an option did they say there was an appropriate room avaliable. 

When we entered the room, the fridge was not stocked nor were there any towels, robes, slippers or the usual items that are found in Paradisus resorts.

Then they lost the dress bag for my friends wedding dress. They did not offer any solutions just excuses that the person they need is at dinner or a friend of theirs says they delivered the bag when clearly it wasn't there. 

I like the chain of Paradisus but NOT this one in Cancun...very disappointing.

reviews.author: jax A
reviews.title: Feeling cheated
reviews.text: We had booked a lagoon view suite and were told of we wanted a king size bed we would have to be on the ground floor (my view is a parking lot).  I'm also a Melia rewards member and received a promotion for a free 1 level room upgrade for a birthday promotion. This was denied and we were told we would have to book another stay to use it.  Disappointed with the experience because they are trying to sell overpriced extra services and things I cannot use (like my 3 year old son wants to get a manicure-- really?) The check in was horrible, as someone who worked in 5 star hospitality they should learn how to make a first impression

reviews.author: Steven L
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text:
