Just came back from our second visit of Paradisus Cancun. I have to say the place still is beautiful with a great beach and pool. For an all inclusive the food is very good and the restaurants are great. Sadly a few mis- steps left us wondering if we will be back. We stayed for 4 days on the tail end of a long  Mexican trip, and for almost 3 of those days we had no air conditioner. I understand things happen beyond you control but nothing was done on managements behalf to make us happy. We called several times a day and were told it was being worked on it will be fixed very soon. Luckily with the ocean breeze it was only about 85 degrees in our room but still-  also our jacuzzi never worked and then our patio flooded. Not a big deal, but having to stand in 3 inches of water to watch the ocean and enjoy a glass of wine wasn't what we paid for. I was wondering if Paradisus was just too big a place for management to maintain! The day after it rained there were dozens of beach towels all around the property floors to catch the water leaking from the roof and windows. 
I can say the employees are exceptional. Every single person we encountered was super friendly and made sure they said hello. I almost hate to give a 3 star review, but last time we were here in late 2014 we were blown away by every last detail.  This time when we left my wife & I looked at each other and said "think I've had enough of Paradisus". That was sad for us to say because there are things we will miss, but for the money we spent we might look at other properties

reviews.author: finedrew
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text:
Our stay started off poorly, but slowing got better throughout the week.  After a slow check-in process, it took 2 hours for the bellman to bring our bags to the room - which we had to call down and request.  The housekeepers were using the guest elevators, so we ended up having to use the stairs after about 9am through around 5pm each day to get up to the 5th floor.  Not a huge deal since we are both in good shape, not the best service when we saw guests and housekeepers with carts waiting on every floor for the 1 elevator to come.

Other than that, the food is really good at all of the restaurants and the pool was really fun.  At night they had different shows in the Avenue Bar.

reviews.author: donovansimon87
reviews.title: Seen better days...
reviews.text:
This hotel has seen better days, the air conditioning seems to be an issue in most rooms as it leaks onto the floor, after two days we had a room upgrade following two complaints, this hotel just seems to be too big and it needs all the restaurants on offer to cater for all the guests and it constantly fails.
The food is ok, but my advice is to get up early for breakfast, it's like a cattle market after 9pm and ques to be seated, for food etc can be long...
Be very cautious when booking trips, time share rip offs are common place especially out of the complex offering too good to be true deals on excursions that usually are just that! TGTBT... You'll be enticed with offers of free breakfast that your getting anyway in exchange for a 3-4 hour seminar sold too you as a 90 minute 'chat' .... Be warned!!!
On the plus side the beach is awesome, plenty to do on your doorstep, the pools are large enough not to be cramped and the drink is readily available with brand shots generously poured, food is available all day but again, pretty standard stuff...
The entertainment at night is rickety at best, and nothing for children, although there is a kids club, you have to leave your kids in the care of others which wasn't for us... But each to there own...
Hotel is situated in a good location, with most excursions no more than  twenty minute cab ride away, you can get the local bus for cheaper, but it's hot with no air con...
Senior Frogs is a must in my opinion, the foods good and it's good fun, especially with children...

reviews.author: leba0210
reviews.title: Mrs! González
reviews.text: Close to airport! Nice beach! Very Good pools!! Good food!!!But in general guest attention was very limited!! No warm approach!! Poor coordination between concierge and tour schedule , activities, and expedia representative apears to be not working there!! Lack of information!! We had some incident with pick Up and drop of with amigostours travel guide!! The information was not clear!! Múltiple cultural issues !! We have been taking some actions for The unpleasant events that We  live!!!

reviews.author: 147alfredr
reviews.title: Do not get lodge in Building 1
reviews.text: Building appears to be the oldest building in the complex.  The rooms show the sign of time.  The mattress are only good for the dumpsters.  The AC did not work well and the room only had one small chair for us to sit on.

reviews.author: 336p
reviews.title: Mixed bag
reviews.text:
A large 1980s-era hotel on the beach. 
The pool is quite cramped for the number of guests.
Rooms are spacious and clean, with large balconies.
Restaurants vary from the excellent (Naos, Ibana) to the hopeless (Market Grill.)
Service varies from polite but slow (poolside) to the seriously eccentric (restaurant waiters.)
Checking out is a bizarre process that involves going to different desks and paying off different parts of the bill to different offices. Only when this is complete do you receive a 'check out voucher' without which you can't put your luggage in a taxi.  
Someone at Melia should try staying here as a guest.

reviews.author: 381Rosie
reviews.title: Food is average at best
reviews.text: We were disappointed by the food at several of the restaurants on site. The room is adequate but nothing special. The hotel staff are friendly and helpful. Probably not the place to choose if you prefer quiet and absence of crowds.

reviews.author: Jacob Q
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Check in process was horrible. Very slow. Almost like the attendants didn't have any incentive to be timely. They just didn't care. They did offer beer and drinks in the check in area but only if you asked. 
We arrived at 5 PM as a party of 4. Then they tried to give us a room with one King bed. Who does that? I kind of have a feeling they lowered there expectations when they saw us, same skin color and race, and thought we could all spend 8 days in the same king bed together. After 2 more hours of complaining, they finally moved us to a room with 2 full beds. 
Funny thing is, my brother in law who looks white was able to move us to an ocean view room next to his the next day at noon. With no upgrade fees. Go figure. 
Now most if not all the staff were very nice and well groomed. Especially pool side. 
The pool was great with the cabanas. The ocean location was excellent. The restaurant food was great as well as the buffets. Always fresh. Thy were very accommodating with reservations as well. 
I hope my review was fair.

reviews.author: Farnoosh M
reviews.title: Beautiful, long check in lines
reviews.text:
Resort is beautiful! Great access to the beach. Long check in lines. Rooms are nice most with a beautiful view. Not all the guests are all inclusive so you may not take any food or snack out of the restaurants. Friendly staff. They try to sell you time share, so if you don't want it don't fall for 3 free nights (those free nights will not be all inclusive). 

Water was pretty wavy but fun for us. Beach was sandy and not many rocks.

reviews.author: Pam A
reviews.title: Mostly good but needs improvement
reviews.text:
The Paradisus started off in the wrong foot, but redeemed itself with all it had to offer. 
THE GOOD: The staff. They work tirelessly to keep the hotel clean and everyone served. The rooms-spacious and comfortable, cleaned two to three times a day and my room had turn down service with chocolates placed on my pillows. Room service and requests were fast and efficient. Kudos to the housekeeping department here. They deserve an award!!! The fourth tower is nice and quiet. The bathrooms had huge bath sheets (think restoration hardware) and plenty of terry mugler toiletries. The shower had an ample deep tub with an over head rain shower and a side hand held one, good water pressure too. The toilet had both a urinal and a commode and a privacy door. The grounds-are beautifully kept and service at the restaurants is excellent. 
The food-Good in the market argentinian meats, the sushi (try the black tea ice cream) and fuego (try the salmon ceviche). 

THE BAD: check in is a long and tedious chore that leaves a bad aftertaste for the rest of your stay. My room wasn't ready and I was told to come back two hours later at 3. I went back at 3:10 and waited for 20 minutes in line and no one could give me a key to my rooms. Sandy in the front desk rudely sent me back to the check in desk and didn't apologize for making me run back and forth asking for my room key. Why can't they have one desk for everything? I booked two rooms but only got one and was told the other room was dirty so someone would go to my room and give me the key. No one ever went. I finally had to go and complain at the check in desk and they gave me two clean rooms immediately. Check out was annoying too. I was charged $85 pesos for a local 3 minute call to my shuttle company. 
The food- the buffet at naos was only good at breakfast. The rest was hit and miss. 
The pools- huge and clean. Towel service doesn't require a card or have strict return policies which is great. 
The bars- I only went to the Michael Jackson show and the huge crowds constricted their performance. They don't have enough sitting for everyone and the dance floor/stage is small. 
The pool- all chairs were taken even in early morning. I was told by the waiter to just rent a Bali bed but when i tried to I was sent to the ugly ones on the back and was told the ocean view ones were reserved for club members. Then they sent me down to the beach and was told the same thing and to come back tomorrow because club members have priority. So, if you're not a melia club member get used to placing ur towel on the grass as I did. 
The service was not as good as other cancun hotels I've stayed in. There was just way to many patrons and the staff couldn't keep up. I always tipped well but wasn't too impressed. I rarely was offered anything at the pool and never got offered anything at the beach. 
TIPS:  carry a multi port charger for all your devices. There's hardly any outlets in the room. 
Protect your cell phone with a water proof case. 
Check in after 4 p.m. and avoid the annoying lines. Be patient. Their check in process is unlike any other hotel. Horrible system. They send you to one desk for checking in and to another desk on the opposite side of the lobby for your key...if it's ready. 
TIP your waiter. Take some tip dollars. Even though tips are included I noticed some people were treated better than others. 
Take comfortable non slip shoes. The floors get slippery with water. I had croc sandals that worked wonders. 
Use the kids club. The children love it. 
DO NOT USE their phone! Or be aware you'll incur charges upon check out and further delay the check out process. 
Be aware that they make carbon copies of your credit card as in the old days. They also make copies of your passport. 

Hope this review helps anyone visiting this hotel. Enjoy and have fun!

reviews.author: Kathy B
reviews.title: Won't come back
reviews.text:
Started out just ok.  Check in ok for family plan. Made it sound like a fab upgrade with 550$ in hotel credit.  It was a coupn book. It was one fiasco aft another. I had no electric the first night during the night.  The safe was broken.  No hot water. They did fix electric and safe (which they told me I didn't know how to use it).  Safe was broken. The best is the hot water. They basically told me I was crazy. There was hot water. Ok. I took another shower, cold again, etc etc.  kept making  excuses.  Finally sent someone again and there was a broken valve.  My room was dirty, never supplied with proper amenities. 
I didn't expect to be waited on hand foot but we did have a family butler.  The room never had enough towels, etc., had to keep calling.  Just an FYI:  they give day passes to locals.  Not a good situation.  Tabititha was fabulous from the pool and food manager.  Family concierge mgr did try her best.  
Probably will not go back.

reviews.author: Rakesh P
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, Great Employees
reviews.text: This resort is stunning- however the rooms need work/update and the food is served cold even in the buffet style, certain things were delicious but our food was not enjoyable cold. Our family owns restaurants and know that if food is served room temperature during buffet it allows food longevity- however it's not enjoyable. Perhaps a new method for feeding the masses and maintaining food quality would be best.

reviews.author: Stephane G
reviews.title: No AC on July lobby.. it so hot..
reviews.text: I stay with some friends over 3 nights. Place is amazing when you arrive you don't notes there is not AC inside just on in close areas like the main waiting check in, and then some restaurants not all have Ac running so if you are the persons that needs AC all times don't Stay here they have fans stands around for air flow on the sushi restaurant is amazing because the plants hanging in the middle.. Ac on rooms can't be ajust is set. Also we have a problem with a guy that works there, he ask me what room I was staying the First night we arrive and he have other rooms numbers  on a notebook he asked what we like and what we didn't, I just wake up in the middle of the night and saw him standing there.. I wake up the next morning and check the door the door wasn't locked we forgot to looked, I asked my friends is they saw someone here last night, next night we make sure was lock, when I leave i make sure they knew about it at the front desk... so lock you door also if you stay here.. specially if you come with  young kids. I won't stay here again. Sorry.. also they have a bar where you have to buy a shisha or buy a bottle to sit there.. so we were thinking we can enjoy the place we already paid all inclusive. :(. Good things beds are very clean and comfortable, sushi resturant with reservation excellent food and service and music at night. That's what most enjoyable thing about the place. The pool is ok but not the best. The beach is clean but you can sit outside with out paying.. so ...

reviews.author: MLi2015
reviews.title: Beautiful beach, mediocre food, skip market grill
reviews.text:
This is our sixth resort in the cancun/riviera maya area, and our third Melia property.
We have previously been to Paradisus La Esmerelda, and Melia Punta Cana. Other hotels we have compared this to include Marina El cid, the Royalton, and El Dorado Royale.

Pros: The beach is a bit rough, but is absolutely spectacular! Perfect temperature,perfect color! Minimal seaweed which were big problems at Emerelda and Royaltom.
-Most amazing kids club! Wonderful staff! They built a new indoor playspace that my kids could not get enough of.
-Beautiful decor in the main spaces
-We had Pamela as our butler for family concierge. I can not emphasize how wonderful she was! She was professional, kind, and so very helpful. She was one of the highlights of our trip. The kids loved the little presents especially the marionette puppets.
-As in all of Mexico- the people here work so hard.  It is not necessary to tip, but its nice to recognize their hard work.
-First time that we were barely bitten by mosquitos. Probably because this resort was nowhere near mangroves. 

Cons: the food was mediocre and underwhelming.  Its hard to get breakfast wrong at a buffet and somehow, it was still bad here.  The pancakes and waffles and crepes were made in large batches and by the time it got to you, it was either rock hard or super soggy.  None of the restaurants impressed us.  please take my advice and stay away from the market grill where they serve the mexican version of rodizio-  all four adults in our party got food poisoning resulting in atleast one lost vacation day for recovery.  We spoke to two other couples who also got food poisoning from the same place.  Don't say I didn't warn you;-)
- The inside of the hotel, including all the restaurants are not enclosed, which is to say, there was no air conditioning. I understand that we are in Mexico, but it is truly uncomfortable to eat while you are sweating. Thank you to Miguel in Bana restaurant for bringing an extra fan when he realized I was going to pass out in the heat.
-While our room had an amazing view (we stayed in a one-bedroom ocean view suite), it was still pretty small.  The two bathrooms were totally worth the upgrade, though.
- in La Esmeralda, family concierge had its own pool and own restaurant (amazing food), and a large lounge. Here, there are no such amenities and the FC lounge is quite small.
Not sure if FC was worth it in cancun, but again, out butler was so amazing.
-Also not sure why Bali beds needed to be paid for- many were left empty- this was really annoying in an all-inclusive especially when it was included at la esmerelda.

Overall we actually had a wonderful and relaxing time.  If they can work on the food quality, we would consider coming back for the beach.

reviews.author: amehrazar
reviews.title: Wonderful staff but lacks any culture and average dinning experience!!!
reviews.text:
Overall good experience. Very good service. Staff work very hard to please you. If you appreciate good, tasty and quality food this is not a place for you. Lack of any taste or safisticated dinning. Hotel policy somewhat difficult to make reservation but if you insist they'll try their best to accommodate you! Boring nights,  there are many resorts with lively programs in their lobby during the night time. 
Hooka freindly resort. 
Beach is great and you are able to swim in the ocean!
Pools are clean but can get crowded.
Decent selections of alcoholic drinks. 
Horrible selection of natural juices and cocktails. 
Very poor and mediocre snack selection around the pool area. If you are a buffet person they do have a restaurant inside with very average quality food!
Go very early in the morning so you can reserve a chair by leaving a towel on it!!! Otherwise they want you to pay $100 a day for reserving a bed!!!!
I personally like the experience of the privately owned smaller resorts. 
This hotel is too comercialized!
By all mean you will not regret your stay at this resort but I did not experience a wow factor!

reviews.author: Jason T
reviews.title: Beautiful "Looking".  Average "Actually"
reviews.text:
There is NEVER any AC on in the public areas, which is where ALL of the restaurants for the most part are located.   You will be greeted with a stunning visual, a lobby that begs to be enjoyed, but you will be angry that you can't dine in comfort because it is like a sauna.  Considering most of the travelers that visit are American, it is confusing why anyone would think a "Melia" experience should be broiling hot in July.....

The restaurants also "look" beautiful but are HOT as hell with food that is average.  Exception was Mole and Fuego.   The rooms are severely outdated.

As for enjoying the pool or beach..  GOOD LUCK getting a lounge chair with any type of shade unless you are down there throwing towels on it at 7AM.  I for one don't go on vacation to be up at 7AM, nor do I expect to have to sit on sand or grass in the sun.  

This resort LOOKS like a 4.5 star resort, but once you are there and get past the immediate visual, it is more like 3 stars.

reviews.author: 585reddy
reviews.title: Cancun Frequent Traveler
reviews.text:
It is a very nice hotel but can improve on couple things:
- At the check in we were given a room on Floor 1 and it was very loud. We had to pay extra to get on a higher floor and had to upgrade. The Staff is nice but can be more helpful. 
- Not many good dinning options. We love Pasta and Italian food but there wasn't any good restaurant where we could order good. 
- Do not go to the Fusion restaurant. The food really sucks there. Not tasty at all 
- Breakfast options were good. 
- Good kids friendly hotel

reviews.author: Karuna J
reviews.title: Not sure I'll go back, possible :)
reviews.text:
Traveled with my family to Cancun, this was our very first visit to Mexico. Here is how I would summarize this resort experience:
Check in experience
Awful! We had to line up in a slow line to check in, we ordered drinks while waiting as we were parched and they never came, upon check in we were told by Eduardo that our room would be ready in 15 Minutes so we decided to go get food and enjoy the ambiance while we waited, I arrived 1 hour and 40 minutes after to collect the keys and was made to line up all over again to obtain - Norma was super rude at the counter and so was Veronica, neither of them seemed to care about my inconvenience or even bothered to apologize.
Restaurants
I thought the food was quite good at Fuego and Vento, the Buffet had great variety and lovely fresh fruit. The Market Grill bbq was my husbands favorite lunch order.
Service
Our waiters at all the restaurants were amazing. Antonio and Jesus at the buffet were always attentive and helpful. Jose at dinner on the beach was superb!
Cleanliness
Resort was clean and our rooms also quite clean.
Pool
We spent most of our time at the kids pool which was awesome, our 2 year old son had a great time. Alejandro at the kids pool was great at getting us drinks promptly.
Beach
Clear waters but a tad bit on the rough side

A point to note - the hotel is more Asian themed with decor and restaurants in line with this. 
ps. good tacos at blueagave too.
All in all not a bad experience if we put the first impression at check in aside :)

reviews.author: Jillian S
reviews.title: A dime a dozen
reviews.text: This hotel is a dime a dozen and doesn't really stand out compared to any other Mexican or Caribbean resort.  First, they were always short on towels.  In order to get a towel, you needed to go to the towel stand very early in the morning.  There were also not enough lounge chairs.  You need to get up early, get a towel and leave it on a lounge chair to guarantee yourself a towel and a chair.  The food was just ok, nothing special.  The rooms were very nice and very clean.  I will say that the ocean was beautiful.  We stayed at the ocean most of time since the pool was too hot.  We did do a zip lining tour with Selvatica and that was awesome.  I highly recommend that.  When returning to Cancun, I will more than likely explore other hotel options

reviews.author: JKMouse
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Regarding our 4 night stay at the Paradisus Cancun.
PROS:
-Resort is decorated beautifully
-Beach and view are gorgeous
-Very hard working staff and extremely friendly. Very appreciative when offered a tip. Never saw one worker "just standing around."
-Market Grill and Blue Agave Restaurants are delicious
-Gift shop workers very helpful
-Michael Jackson show very entertaining
-Snack bar by pool very convenient
-Pool outside Market Grill was very nice
-Fitness Center

CONS:
-Arrived at 11am, unable to get room right away. Was handed off to a young gentleman who was supposed to help us with a tour of the resort, instead was a ploy to get us to a timeshare presentation
-No washcloths for 2 days, even after calling twice to get them
-Resort is extremely warm, only certain areas air conditioned. Made it very uncomfortable to watch a show in the Avenue Bar
-Room was very hot also even at coolest setting
-Not much for kids to do. After 7pm we just stayed in our room and watched TV
-Mini fridge didn't get stocked day before checkout
-Resort is too dark at night. Would be nice to have some light when getting around
-Naos doesn't offer much in regards to "kid food." My daughter pretty much ate the same thing at every meal
-Some parts of resort look dated and could use upgrading
-Not sure if turn down service is supposed to be nightly, but it only happened twice. Not a big deal really
-Nothing explained to us, for instance, how to order a cabana, etc. 

Overall, I guess I expected more. Maybe I should have splurged for the Family Concierge. The area is gorgeous, I just would not stay here again.

reviews.author: Laura S
reviews.title: Great location, beautiful hotel, nice beach.
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel. My second stay here. First stay was great but I stayed in the premium adult only side. This time was with kids. The beach is beautiful sand but water on this side a little rough for kids. The first time out A/C went out on the first night I was understanding. These things happen. But when it happened every night and finally the 5th time maintenance admits it cannot keep it running I was really peeved that they were apparently satisfied to just let us swear every night until we called. We were never offered a room change I finally insisted on it. No offer of any compensation for our problem even though we were certainly asked to pay extra to get that room because it had the ocean view. If you charge extra for a room and that room turns out to be substandard then I think abating the surcharge is only reasonable.

reviews.author: KandB53
reviews.title: Not that great!
reviews.text:
Room was very average. Hallways and area that you watched the entertainment was very very hot. Food was also average. Pools were nice and hotel staff was very good. 
I did enjoy the stay but I will choose a different hotel the next time I go to cancun.

reviews.author: Cristina C
reviews.title: Neutral
reviews.text: Tell your employees to come up with solutions. By the way i forgot to mention  the room got flood. Water was coming out of the wall but your personal was trying to make it like it was our fault. But i have a feeling that it happenes regular when you use the plug in the tub.  We didn't use the plug anymore and it didn't  happen again.

reviews.author: captainpegleg12221
reviews.title: Hotel Paradicius Cancun
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort. However, we had our honeymoon here 14 years ago.  It was intimate, QUIET, had great services and amenities at no extra charge. Not anymore. It's all inclusive bragging 9 restaurants--or actually 9 dining rooms with a central kitchen. Food is OK.  Now instead of relaxing at the pool under an umbrella, you have noisy DJ's pumping loud music. No shade from the sun because most were removed. You now have to pay $75 for a lounging bed to rent all day. Can't swim in July on beach because surf is too violent. Swimming is not recommended. I was turned away from restaurants because we didn't have any reservations. Restaurant was half empty. Would not seat me. My quiet room I asked for has a door to another suite-adjoining rooms.  Not in use. Neighbors are loud. Club Melis extras for $100 per day use to be standard. Huts on beach are now off limits. Other hotels offer them free. This place is nice but you have to pay for extras that should not be. 
Service is outstanding-employees
However. Will not come back. Disappointment

reviews.author: Andrew
reviews.title: Great Hotel + Jewelry stolen out of room..
reviews.text:
I want to first get the negative part out so I can focus on what we enjoyed. Throughout the trip there was roughly 3 times in the day where different parties entered your room, such as the maids, towel people and food and beverage stockers for the mini fridge. I found this very concerning knowing that multiple people would be coming in and out of my room throughout the trip and had a bad feeling about it. Sure enough, my girlfriend leaves her pouch with her 4 pairs of earnings and a bracelet on the bathroom counter with her makeup. We return to find the bathroom had been neatly cleaned, the towels change out and no jewelry to be found. I sent an email asking for assistance and was never heard from again...go figure. LOCK UP VALUABLES IN SAFE! 

...The hotel staff overall was friendly and the beach was beautiful. We didn't let a couple of thieves ruin our trip. The Mexican restaurant next to the taco shop was very good. The other restaurants were hit or miss to be honest. The buffet however always provided options if the restaurant food was lacking. I found most of the bars on the property to be inconsistent. The bar in the taco shop however made the best margaritas. The nightly entertainment was pretty pathetic to be honest but I wasn't expecting a Las Vegas quality show. The property was extremely well manicured and clean. The rooms were decent and the service was fine. We will most likely not return.

reviews.author: Timothy
reviews.title: Wish we stayed at Moon Palace!
reviews.text:
So we are on day 5 of an 8 day, well earned vacation.  We are a family of 4 with the kids being 12 and 8. I'd like to start this review on a positive note by saying that of the 10 or so "all inclusive resorts" I have stayed at, the Paradisus has the best food I can remember (though I certainly can't remember all the restaurants in all the resorts I have stayed at).  The waitstaff has been fantastic and have really made my family and I feel welcomed and pampered.  The housekeeping has done a nice job as well and the lobby looks cool. 

The 3 stars is because of the above but here is why they lose 2 stars in my book.  For the same price we were torn between this hotel and Moon Palace. We knew Moon Palace was going to be fantastic, not just based on reviews, but also based on advice of friends who stayed there.  The Paradisus had a special that continues today where those staying seven nights or more get a "$1500 resort credit." Im no fool, and was certain that I would not get $1500 to blow but I thought a room upgrade and a spa treatment for my wife would probably be what was offered. I called the hotel and was assured that the $1500 was for a room with ocean view, spa treatments or some "family concierge" they offer. We were very surprised when we arrived to check in and found that what is provided is a coupon book. For instance, $15 off a $100 Bali bed rental on the beach or $10 off a $200 gift shop purchase. To obtain the $1500 resort credit you would probably have to spend about $40,000 in and around the lobby! 

Though I did not want to complain, especially since Im with my family and I didn't want to dampen the mood, I would also note that our room could probably not be in a worse location as it is on the lobby level and faces the employee parking lot. We booked this reservation on "book it.com" that touted this hotel as five-star and four diamonds but our room is not much better than the Holiday Inn in most places. 

Bottom line- the kids are having a great time, we are happy to be resting but certainly feel tricked by the resort credit nonsense, room location and room condition. I would certainly recommend those of you shopping to choose another hotel.

reviews.author: Kathy S
reviews.title: Hard working people
reviews.text: Hubby and I went there from 6/29/2016-7/3/2016....we noticed how hard working everyone we came in contact with worked....but the hotel need work....in Naos (buffet for every meal)there was plenty of choices but when we looked around there was mold all around the ceiling and vents...not too good to breathe that all in....the best place in our opinion was the Blue Agave....we ate in there alot and the waiters were fantastic....miss them.....over all a nice place but needs work...we had a leak outside our door every evening and almost fell a couple of times...and boy is it hot as soon as you step out of your room, wish they could do something about that....

reviews.author: V4288OTclaudiac
reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: The resort and staff are great , the process of making a reservation for the restaurants is difficult and confusing. It's always booked even if you call a couple of days in advance. The rooms have very dim and minimal lighting and the only mirror is in the bathroom. We were never advised on how to call room service and the directions were not on the phone.

reviews.author: susankara26
reviews.title: Family Vacation- not what I expected.  Food was terrible
reviews.text: I am not a big foodie... but the food was pretty bad.  Went with my husband, 9 year old daughter and mom and mother-in-law.  The beach was beautiful, pool was nice but I have seen better.  It was all-inclusive but there were extras they wanted to sell you.  $80 for a cabana, bottles of wine etc... There was a distinct odor in and around our room when we left our room.  Perhaps it is the smell of the food from the various restaurants that was rising up to tower 3 mixed with the smell of the greenery in the rain forest like decor and then the spray of tropical air freshener air that was hard to deal with but honestly, the food was below par.  The rooms were dated with stains on wall photos and lamp shades.  just not what I expected.  The people were wonderful and hospitable but I definitely stayed at better all-inclusive resorts.

reviews.author: KARIS S
reviews.title: Beautiful but not worth it!!!
reviews.text: I had the opportunity to stay at another Melia resort in D.R. in the VIP section ( The Level), and unfortunately was very disappointed in the Royal Service at Paridisus Cancun. We did not receive any extra royal treatment besides the self service bar and La Palapa restaurant. The staff was unfriendly and unable to answer simple questions. The hotel and beach itself were absolutely beautiful. I think that this was a more family oriented low key resort. I would not recommend this resort to a younger crowd.

reviews.author: sobdude
reviews.title: Fair to good resort that needs some grooming
reviews.text: A decent place. Decent food. Beach is average. Rooms were good. Nothing to write home about. Need to curb the crazy kids or give them an their own area.  Relaxing but nothing to do if you decide to get active on the resort. Need more activities in the pool areas, other than drinking during the day.  Also they say its all inclusive, but they wanted us to buy a bottle of wine, a cigar, or hookah just to sit on a couch at one bar...and we were the only ones at the bar !!!  No thanks. Comfortable seating extra? Nahh.  We're not cheap by any means and we tip well. But I'm not gonna be forced to pay for wine or cigar just so I can have a beer. Send your bar managers to Hyatt Ziva and learn what good service is all about.  Shows were kinda bogus at night.  Overall a relaxing place but nothing to get excited about. Felt like the workers just wanted tips all the time. The Brazilian steak house was pretty good.

reviews.author: selina s
reviews.title: Here now and so far- less than thrilled
reviews.text:
This is our 2nd time at a Paradisus resort. We usually stay at La Esmerelda- and I am kicking myself that we didn't go back to that location. While this resort is nice- it's outdated. The rooms are not as luxurious and the beds not very comfortable- I'm awake at 5am bc the pillows are super flat.  We usually love the family aspect of Paradisus so we are doing the family concierge and our butler is nice- so that's a plus. But the kids club here isn't as fun as the other location- it's located in a basement and the activities don't seem very organized. They also didn't turn down the bed for the kids and we upgraded to a one bedroom- with a pullout so the kids can have their own spot - took them a while to get it done. 
It's only been day one so I am hoping it will get better- I'll update my review if it does.

reviews.author: CR
reviews.title: Did Not Meet Expectations.
reviews.text: went without sleep for over 24 hours because of the noise level of the hotel--was moved to a room on the 2nd day that was under construction and in front of the pool bar-music started playing there at 7:00 AM!!!! I could hear every word to every song through out my suite--intolerable! A terrible way to celebrate a 50th birthday.

reviews.author: 422sharifh
reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.text: First time staying in Cancun.  I've visited other parts of Mexico and experienced more value for the money.  This hotel was rated highly however I'm assuming it's based on comparisons to other hotels in the area.  It seems like most the hotels are older so based on that I can see why this resort would get higher raining.  Food quality and selection was mediocre.  Hotel had several severe leaks when it rained our bedroom flooded causing me to almost slip and break my neck.  We didn't complain or say anything because it was late at night so we just threw all the towels on the floor to soak up all the water.  What bothered me is hotel staff had been there prior to me entering the room to turn the beds and did nothing about the water on the floor.  I know this because there were wet foot prints in the bathroom which was elevated from the bedroom!   We had the royal service however our butler was NEVER available.   What made this hotel decent was the wait staff.  They were so pleasant.

reviews.author: O6631IWsamanthac
reviews.title: Okay stay
reviews.text: I wish there was more to do. The hotel was kind of boring and the food made me sick. The hotel was very pretty and clean but the pool was boring and i felt like there was nothing going on. Wont be going back

reviews.author: Hai L
reviews.title: Not impressed.
reviews.text:
Pros: Location, Beach, Pricing, Food

Cons: Room, Staff, Cleanliness, Consistency, Noise

Buildings:
We arrived 2hrs before their 3pm check-in policy and they accommodated us.  Our other family members arrived at 10am and didn't get a room for hours; keep in mind this is a 500+ room hotel and they were no where near capacity.  We stayed in building #3 (main building) on the 7th floor (8 floors total), another family member stayed in the same building but on the 3rd floor, and another family member stayed in building #1.  Building 3 has all the restaurants, clubs, shows, etc.  We were on the 7th floor; so the noise level was tolerable; unfortunately, our other family members were on the 3rd floor of the same building and it sounded like there was a nightclub in their room.  Building #1 is super quiet; because they are further from the main building, as a result, you would have to walk through 2 buildings to get to any food, shows, etc.

Room Cleanliness:
During our stay, there were some scattered showers, and since the balconies are sloped in towards the rooms, one of the rooms our family stayed in FLOODED.  They also did not have sufficient towels (1 towel for a family of 4) and a shower curtain; it took 2 phone calls and 2 hours for hotel staff to respond.  Sink backed up even after having it snaked by room service. Plumbing leaked, and whatever was removed and/or supposed to be replaced by room service (i.e. towels, snacks) was inconsistent. For example they took away floor mats and hand towels and replaced them every other time; but easy items to stock like bars of soap, we had 6 by the end of the trip! Slippers and bath robes were not supplied in each room but had to be requested. The hotel was recently renovated so paint and wood stain drips were everywhere.  Iron malfunction burned a hole into one of our family member's blouses.  Otherwise, room decor was acceptable, beds were comfortable, and ocean view was nice.

Hotel Staff:
Because english is not their first language, there are language barriers, and that is something to be expected when visiting other countries.  But certain staff members who are in positions of customer service (i.e. front desk) do not even try to understand or get help from another person to understand your request, but instead, just brush you off and/or say "no".  For example, we wanted golf cart service to the front of the resort (they have a very long drive way in) so that we can go to our excursion across the street; one front desk employee said she didn't know where the driver was or when he'll be back and brushed us off. So we asked another person who went around the corner and found him. Another example of this is when making restaurant reservations. They will not hear you out, but instead say "no". Just keep repeating yourself and they will eventually listen.

Food: 
If traveling with a group of 6 or more people, they will almost always book you at 9pm or later (not good for small children). Also, reservations for some restaurants must be made the day before. Some restaurants do not require reservations; but is very difficult for them to accommodate large groups and they do not have a waitlist system, instead they tell you to check back later. Which, I don't understand how this would work since they have to keep tables clear to push together for a large group.  
1) Vento: Very good Tapas menu and fast service.
2) Fuego: Very slow service (dinner took 2+ hours for 3 course meal).  Mediocre Latin Food.
3) Naos: Buffet, food changes from meal to meal and day to day.  Lots of variety.  
4) Blue Agave: VERY GOOD tacos, fast service
5) Enso: Disgusting

Pool: Mostly 6ft deep pools, not suitable for small children.

Landscape: Lots of stairs with no rails and poor lighting in main areas; not safe if traveling with disabilities or elderlies. Otherwise clean.

Conclusion: Will not come back; cons outweigh pros. Should be a 3 star hotel.

reviews.author: Jeremy Liu
reviews.title: Facilities are old
reviews.text: We stayed a week in this hotel with family. The hotel facilities were kind of old. My room bathroom had water leaks from day two. A/C was too loud. The A/C in the main lobby (pyramid 3) was almost zero. Loud music kept playing until late night. There was no 7/24 hours restaurant like cruise. NAOS, the buffet restaurant, took 1.5 hours between breakfast and lunch. No snack bars were available.

reviews.author: francophileonthemove
reviews.title: Good conference center, average hotel
reviews.text:
I spent 10 nights at Paradisus for a conference. I need to preface my review by saying that this hotel has an unusual Tripadvisor presence because most of the reviews are from new reviewers with only 1 or 2 reviews and arguably little to compare their experience to. Unusually, they also mention lots of staff by name. Typically, I only consider reviews written by more experienced travelers. However: 

1. Check in was time consuming and laborious but when we eventually got to our Royal Service room we were happy with it. The hotel is older and could really do with refurbishment but it's fairly clean. The bed was great and toiletries plentiful. The coffee machine and free mineral water were great too. 

2. We liked the Royal Service lounge and food plus the private pool and bar. Definitely worth the upgrade and thankfully, kid free. The cabanas are lovely and the waiter service good, especially with lunch snacks. However, the promised butler service is non-existent, housekeeping can be very variable and the staff at the desk in the Royal lounge the most unhelpful I've ever met. The wifi is intermittent. 

3. We used most of the restaurants at the resort but they are VERY variable. For example, Fuego is excellent but Vento is beyond dreadful. My suggestion would be to check out the Tripadvisor reviews. Also, under no circumstances allow the waiters to con you into accepting the 'chefs recommended menu for tonight'. It's easier for the staff if you accept this but it's a disaster and just results in wasted food as how can a chef know what one wants to eat?! Some of the food is absolutely dreadful. The Avenue bar is a shambles. The furniture only fit for garbage as its so damaged and every night they run out of glassware. 

4. The tipping policy at this hotel needs to be made transparent. We were told not to tip and even that the 'problem with Americans tipping is that the staff now expect it'. However, we quickly worked out that unless we tipped we got at worst no service and at best surly and off hand service. It is within the gift of the hotel to sort this out. 

5. The conference facilities are excellent but the catering staff disorganized. 

Overall, I would cautiously recommend this hotel for a conference but it wouldn't be my choice for a vacation where service and food quality is more of a focus for me.

reviews.author: Aldo0526
reviews.title: Not what I was expecting
reviews.text: I have stayed at the Paradisus Punta Cana and I was expecting the same level of service and atmosphere and it just wasn't there.  I guess my expectations were too high and the hotel just didn't do it for me.  The hotel is a bit dated and it is in need of a good facelift.

reviews.author: Wendell S
reviews.title: It was OK
reviews.text: The food was tasty however the restaurant reservation system is horrible. Make sure you get up at 7a to make a reservation and have them confirm the restaurant before you get off the phone. We had a mix up. Don't stay on the ground floor even if it is ocean view...it is dark and no view. The grounds are beautiful. Lock up all your belongings in a safe. Things may "walk" away. The kids enjoyed the pool and the beach.

reviews.author: JZ55
reviews.title: Good To Place to Go
reviews.text:
Stayed there for 4 nights .
Place is very well kept , The common areas are spotless . 
Smell through the hotel is great 
Service is great and the staff is very friendly . 
I did an upgrade for a beach front room.  The view is beautiful , and the balconies 
are big .  
Beds are soft as well as the pillow 
Pool is huge  , with a great view of the Ocean .. 

areas that need to be improved 
Restaurants at the hotel, kind surprise me, Even when they were almost full 
they kept saying to arriving guest that didn't have a reservation , to wait 30min to 1Hr
even when the restaurants
I made reservations for 4 nights , at 4 different restaurants. On all  I had a previous reservations, however when I arrived at the restaurants, it was about 1/3 occupied ,
but kept saying to arriving guests that didn't have a reservation the wait was 30 to 60 minutes.. I wonder why this done.. I asked, but couldn't get a good answer. 

I had dinner at Bana , the last night of my stay . Service was great , and Sushi Rolls were  plenty to pick from .. However, I had some  mild food poisoning  , as well as my wife , my Nephew and My Brother wife ,, This highly unusual for this kind of place, but better method should be put in place in food handling.

reviews.author: jenandike
reviews.title: Definitely not above a three star hotel!
reviews.text:
My husband and I arrived at the Paradisus on a Friday morning.  We were greeted at check-in by a very nice girl who was accommodating and said our room would be ready by noon.  Since we arrived very early, 6am, that was welcome news.  I had planned spa appointments for 10am so it worked out great.  I will do another review of the spa on it's own.  The room was very small and we were right over the air-conditioning main units.  My husband thought we were in the wrong room as the description on Expedia did not match what we were in. (Expedia's fault). I have to warn you that there is a tricky step out and in of the bathroom.  My husband and I both fell three times, I hurt my foot pretty bad.  The tub/shower combination was not what we thought it would be.  The button to make the water go into the tub was stuck so we couldn't use it.  The air conditioner in our room leaked all over the floor making it very slippery.  The safe in our room was so old that the instructions could not be read.  I also had been calling for weeks to try and get an upgrade to Royal Service but it never happened.  We stayed for one night in that room and then asked for a different room.  The first room was 3344.  The view was nice but if there are any weddings going on it is very noisy until late at night.  

The next room we got was 3605. It was the same set up as the other room.  If there were 4 adults it would be too small.  In this room we encountered small black bugs all over the bathroom.  They were on our toothbrushes, hairbrushes, the sink, mirror, everywhere!  I showed them to housekeeping who said they would check into it.  I hope we didn't bring anything home with us!  We never got a single person to come try and spray or anything.  

The food was okay.  The buffet was good, food was good, but nothing great.  The last night we were there my foot was swollen and my stomach was hurting ( i have a rare disease) so I sent my husband down to the buffet to get the few pieces of fruit I could eat and that would help my situation.  My husband was told he was not allowed to bring food to me, that if I was sick I needed to see a DR.  He tried to explain my situation to the manager but they kept telling him no!.  Finally they got the General Manager who conceded to letting him take me a few pieces of fruit, a plastic fork and that was it.  They told my husband it was against policy, that I should have called room service.  Room service is a very limited menu and did not have what I needed. 

While I was there I lost two items.  One was a children's neck pillow.  I went to the Concierge three times until someone finally called lost and found.  They had had it all along!.  The next item that was lost was by someone else.  It was a heart shaped custom button.  I actually found the item by the pool and turned it into housekeeping right away.  When the person came looking for the item I told them I gave it to housekeeping and to check lost and found.  They came back and told me he concierge told them no one turned in the item.  I know that I turned it in so I went to the Concierge.  I asked him again if someone had turned in a gold heart shaped button.  He looked me straight in the eye and said "no miss, I PROMISE you , no one has turned in an item like that".  When I told him I had turned it in to housekeeping myself he said I must have been mistaken.  So, be very careful with your items as they will not be returned very easily.

There are no lifeguards so swim at your own risk in the ocean and the pool.  

People start saving spots by the pool around 9:30, even though there are signs that say it's not allowed.  It happens and by 11 there are no more spots unless you pay for a cabana or Bali bed.

The setting is beautiful, the beach very clean.

The only place to get iced coffee is at the little store inside the hotel and you have to pay for it.

Everything is included, alcoholic drinks, room service and the mini bar

I would not stay here again. Too many other choices in Cancun

reviews.author: mikegross50
reviews.title: OK, Not Great
reviews.text:
The hotel was nice and the people very polite but the rooms need work.  The food wasn't very good.  In fact we found ourselves going to the buffet almost every night after being so disappointed with the other restaurants.

The butler service was amazing and our butler was the best.

reviews.author: Y6708IObrendas
reviews.title: April 23-30 2016
reviews.text:
This was a beautiful resort, although it was too hot for my liking in most areas, at times it felt like the only air conditioned place was my room.  

We had too many maintenance issues during our week stay.  The safe box door had to be replaced because the lock didn't work.  Our key cards needed to be inserted several times before the door would open, and we had to go to the front desk to exchange keys that eventually didn't work at all multiple times.  We were told it was due to being near cell phones, but even after making sure the key card was not near a cell phone the issues persisted.  We also saw people from a room a few doors down sitting in the hallway one day because they couldn't get into their room because their key cards were not working and they were waiting for maintenance, which makes me think it was not a isolated incident.  They had to come more than once to fix a ceiling air conditioner that was dripping large amounts of water onto the floor.  Our alarm clock never worked after trying to plug it into many different outlets, I asked to exchange it but that never happened so we asked for wake up calls.  Maintenance staff were kind, timely and they did fix every issue except the alarm clock.

The evening  shows were at The Red Lounge which was an extremely small venue for the amount of guests staying at the resort.  After standing out in the hallway trying to see the shows because there was not enough seating,  I gave up trying to go at all.  The show dancers I did see were great, they deserve a more appropriate venue location.

There was a Nexpresso coffee shop but it was never open in the morning when most people would want a coffee specialty drink.  The drinks were good and the staff there were extremely friendly.
The food was good at the resort, I seemed to really like all the different chicken dishes, which sounds odd, but it made me think that I need to learn more ways to cook chicken at home.  The drinks were good, they used good quality alcohol.

The beach was beautiful, but the main beach area directly out of the central building only had cabana beds and not chairs.  There was a DJ booth playing music, but if you sat on the beach chairs to the side you could not hear the music, so it seemed like the music was catering to a small area that could not accommodate very many people.  Both beach & pool areas did not have enough spaces with shade or umbrellas.  

5 star staff, extremely and genuinely friendly.

reviews.author: Karla C
reviews.text:
The hotel is beautiful and the service is great overall, however, there were a few incidents that left a bad taste in our mouth. One where our room was not cleaned during the entire morning/afternoon and we had to request someone to clean it (we did not leave a 'Do not disturb' sign or anything). We were in the room while it was being cleaned and that was not very comfortable. Also, we left a card requesting breakfast in our room before the specified time for requests. The next morning when we saw that breakfast hadn't arrived by the time we requested we opened the door and saw that the card was still there! No one checked the rooms to pick up the requests. My fiance had to call room service to request the breakfast that we had already requested the night before and the person who answered the phone was very rude! He didn't feel comfortable making the request at all. After we got the food we noticed that we hadn't gotten the juice he asked for, but he didn't want to say anything because the lady who took the order was rude and not welcoming. 
We made some comments when we left the hotel but are not sure if anything happened with that. We stayed in room 1605 (we paid for the upgrade) from May 9 to 11 (2016). 
I have also tried MULTIPLE times to contact their event management people and no one has answered my calls nor returned them. When checking out they said they would send me an email with information about weddings in their hotel and I never received it. I left a voicemail recently and no one has returned it :/. Not very good follow up there. Hopefully that will improve. In the meantime we have already received information for other hotels' wedding departments.

reviews.author: Maribel F
reviews.title: Unhappy
reviews.text: Food was horrible Royal Service was not worth it there was no royal treatment we were not pamper at all. An the butler did nothing for us and didn't know anything her name was Rosanna. Fuego restaurant was not good I recommend the Brazilian Restaurant.

reviews.author: Charles J
reviews.title: Not likely to return
reviews.text: The air conditioning was set at 65 the whole week and could not cool the room on 6th floor. The Building 1 only had a single stairwell and the only elevator in building 1 was broke for the first 30 hours we were there. Not good for six floor building.

reviews.author: Marina P
reviews.title: Paradisus...not so much
reviews.text: our family came along for the weeklong seminar; the hotel is falling apart, from the rooms to the spa things look like they are disintegrating and fast; the most expensive ocean view family concierge room that we had barely had enough seats to accommodate a comfortable meal;  the paint was peeling, the curtains had stains,  the beds were uncomfortable, the air conditioning worked when you turned it off and barely and quite unpredictably;  however, the staff is great, especially the Kids' club staff - they are the only reason this place is getting any stars from us.  The food is ok, with the exception of  Mole and Tempo, which were great.  The layout of the hotel is such that if you have a stroller or wheelchair and you need to move about  quite a bit you will be met with a few obstacles. The pyramids are not all alighted - you have to go up the stairs and then down the stairs to get from one pyramid to another.  There are elevators but many were often broken or just took too long when we visited.  If you choose you can walk outside but there are lots of up/down ramps which again can make stroller operation challenging.  Again, the staff were great for the most part, except if you call 0, you might have to call for a long time - no one would really pick up or call back.    So we are definitely not coming back to this location.

reviews.author: Barbara A
reviews.title: Loved everything but the food
reviews.text: The property is gorgeous, the beach incredible, but the food was terrible.  We stayed in Royal service and I loved that part.  Unfortunately many people at the hotel got sick,   My husband included and it was my understanding that the doctors ran out of IV for people. I hardly wanted to eat because of the food quality and taste.  Because it's all-inclusive I think  there were too many shortcuts on food quality. We stayed at a different Paradiso's in Playa Del Carmen and the food there was outstanding two years ago.

reviews.author: Leticia M
reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: Facility is ok nothing fancy.  Food very limited in the selection.  Hotel is dark not enough lighting. The set up in the hotel is very confusing. Got lost several times getting to my room. I couldn't find anyone to help me out, had to go to reception for help.

reviews.author: Xiaoyang G
reviews.title: Good hotel, but poor service
reviews.text:
It is a very nice hotel, clean and beautiful with a lot of famous restaurants inside. I was very happy when I first got to the hotel. But then the bad service turn me down.
I arrived the hotel about 7pm at night. The staff told me I can not make reservation for any restaurant after 4pm, I must go to buffet. That is ok. I told him I want to make a reservation for tomorrow's dinner. Then he told me he can only find a table for me after 9:30pm. I asked him how about the day after tomorrow? He finally book a restaurant for me at 8:30pm. So I went to buffet for 2 days, finally the good restaurant on the third day. I was so hungry when I got to the restaurant at 8:30pm, but I told myself, it is worth waiting. Then the receptionist told me that THEY CAN NOT FIND MY RESERVATION!!!!! I tried to argue with them, but it is useless. They treat me like liar or trouble maker. So, I went to buffet again. I know those people don't really care about the tourists, but they should at least pretend they feel sorry for their mistake.

reviews.author: Sharon P
reviews.title: A little disappointed
reviews.text: Bathroom lighting was so dark it was hard to see.  No one spoke enough english to be helpful.  Staff not very knowledgeable.  Spa was chaotic. Massage was nice but staff not helpful about signing us in and giving us guidance.

reviews.author: Christina K
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Skip Family Concierge
reviews.text:
My family (with two kids, 8 and 10) stayed at the Paradisus Cancun over spring break April 2-9. I'll preface this review by saying that we stayed in the Family Concierge area of The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real last year and had impeccable service from our concierge. We came to Cancun expecting same or similar service.

First, don't waste your money on the Family Concierge service. It is not worth the extra money here. We were checked in at the FC lounge and introduced to our concierce, Ramon. He showed us to our room and told us that he would make reservations to restaurants for us. Then we didn't see him for three days. I passed him by the pool and tried to flag him down and he had no idea who I was and didn't stop. Luckily he'd told us that first day where we would be eating for the first few nights, so we knew where to go. It wasn't until I went to the FC lounge and complained and asked the person at the desk where the rest of our reservations were that we got some attention from Ramon. From then on we found little toys and treats for the kids in our room, but we still never saw Ramon unless I went looking for him. We are low maintenance guests, so perhaps that was our problem. Maybe needier people get good service. I don't feel like the toys and reservations were worth the extra money, so I would skip it next time. From what I heard, though, reservations can be a pain on your own, so good luck!

My thoughts on certain aspects of the hotel:

POOLS
The main pool is very large and there are lots of fun things happening all day long. There is music playing, and the swim up bar is always hopping. The drinks were hit or miss. Sometimes they were really strong and other times I'm not sure there was any alcohol in them at all. I got up early (about 7am) to reserve chairs with an umbrella, but there were usually chairs to be found later, until 9am or so. We were there toward the end of the spring break time, so this could have been different weeks earlier when more schools were on spring break. I cannot say enough about the poolside servers and how hard they work. David is one we remember well, but they ALL hustled all day long. We did tip our server each day, but it appeared that those who didn't also received great service. The other pool is smaller and much quieter. Chairs were usually more available there, but service was a little slower and there isn't any entertainment. One thing to note…a few days while we were there the "pool chair police" were removing things from chairs that were not occupied for more than an hour or so. The same happened on the beach. So while the pool chair struggle is real, it appears they are trying to find a solution. The same can be said for towels. I read several reviews that mentioned the lack of towels. We had to check towels out at the activity palapa every day and were only allowed one per person. Clearly they are trying to work out some of their issues.

BEACH
The beach is beautiful and was always clean.  They drag it daily to help with the debris and we never saw it looking anything but perfect. Chairs and palapas go fast. I think all of the good spots were gone by 7am most days. The servers are great here as well and always kept the cool drinks coming. The water is very rough, so we never felt safe letting out kids swim alone, but we loved body surfing in the waves. We walked past several of the neighboring resorts and the beach in front of Paradisus was definitely the cleanest and most maintained portion of the beach.

ROOM
The room was ok. We had a one bedroom ocean front room and the views were wonderful. We had two large balconies which were very nice. The pullout sofa is worn down and flimsy. Our kids slept fine on it, but it is not suitable for anyone older than that. The king bed was very comfortable and the bathroom was fine. Overall, the main room seemed kind of cramped, but hey, first world problems. A big thing to note is that we were in pyramid three and that would NOT be ideal for those with small children. Pyramid three is VERY LOUD and it continues quite late into the evening. We didn't have a problem as our kids are good sleepers and we brought sound machines with us. If you are light sleepers or have younger children, do NOT stay in pyramid three.

KIDS CLUB
We were hoping that our kids would enjoy the kids club here as much as they did at Palma Real, but the week we were there it was dead. The club itself is located in a dark area off the main pyramid. There wasn't really anything happening that drew my kids in, so they didn't spend any time there.

FOOD/RESTAURANTS
Let me say first that the servers and staff at this hotel work SO HARD (noticing a theme here?) We were impressed every day by how kind and helpful the folks were in the buffets and in the restaurants. They really do make your stay so pleasant. The food in the buffet is good, not exceptional. There is something for everyone at every meal. My family liked the offerings, but it is not five star food.  This is an all-inclusive after all. We ate at some of the reservation restaurants. We loved Fuego (seriously delicious) and Mole. Bana and Vento were just ok. 

OTHER
A few other things to note: The hotel overall is bombarded with scents. The toilet paper is scented, the doorways areas have scents shooting out, the whole of pyramid three reeks on incense constantly. I'm sure they are trying to mask any mold and mildew smells that come with a beachside hotel, but it is a bit much. Also, I don't know if it was the chlorine in the pool or the detergent on the sheets and towels, but our some broke out in a horrible rash all over his body. We also had decent wifi service while we were there.  It was spotty by the pool, but fine in our room.

Overall, we enjoyed our stay. We probably would choose a different hotel next time we come to Cancun. The Paradisus was nice, but I think we can find better for our money elsewhere.

reviews.author: Douglas C
reviews.title: Ok stay
reviews.text: Nice hotel. Everyone employed by the Hotel was courteous, friendly and helpful. The Restaurants were all very good. Take the time to book your meals. I need to tell you to stay away from the Best Day travel store at the Hotel because they are rip offs. They subcontract out and you never know whats going to happen. I booked a trip to Tulum and the wife got sick beforehand but I still wanted to go. Of course I expected that they were going to charge for my wife but then they refused to take just me and refused a refund. I had to make a scene and get the management involved. This was all very uncomfortable. Not what you want to do on your vacation. Anyway next time I'll take the 1.5 hour ride south and stay away from the Cancun Hotel zone as it will be quieter. We did leave before the spring breakers so we stayed when it was "about the norm" in terms of noise and traveler volume. I suggest not going to the flea market unless you want to punish yourself. Nasty area. Good luck.

reviews.author: labamba8
reviews.title: Mildly disappointing- challenging for anyone with walking or balance problems.
reviews.text:
First of all, this hotel is pretty much what one would expect. Beautiful beaches nice pool and lots of restaurants. It is not convenient to get into town, either Cancun or Playa Del Carmen. The latter is a 45 minute taxi ride. 

One of my big gripes is the number of unexpected steps and toe catchers. In my room there was a step down in the middle and then another step 1 foot from the sliding door. There are also places where there are raised bits that will catch her foot.

The rooms are spacious and generally satisfactory. However, the light switches, many of which are three way, are in comprehensible. The shower and tub controls are a challenge.

What can I say about the restaurants? They are pretty much what you would expect in an all-inclusive resort. There was one restaurant that was not all-inclusive and I never saw anyone in it.  This is not to say that there weren't some high points, but I expected more from a relatively upscale resort.

We were here during a big convention and when it let out, 1400 people were competing for restaurants. One day we gave up trying to eat lunch because of the lines and went into town.

In my opinion you can do better for your money in this area, possibly in a smaller resort. This is the first time I've gone to an all-inclusive resort and it will be my last. I completely understand why this appeals to some people, but it's not for me.

reviews.author: Tammy K
reviews.title: Third time was NOT the Charm!  Will be looking for a new resort.
reviews.text:
This was my 3rd trip to the Paradisus in 14 months.  We upgraded again for the Royal Service.  There was a large group in the All Adult Royal Service.  They were very loud and came in very early in the morning, 3 a.m. and woke us up every night.  
The Royal Service Housekeeping was the worst I have ever experienced.  They left dirty plates in my room for THREE days.  I had to say something to our Butler to get them removed.  We also made FOUR calls to get wash cloths.  After just getting totally frustrated, we yelled in the Atrium, "what do you have to do to get a washcloth".  Finally we got washcloths for one day only!  
The air conditioning does not work well, if at all.  We called many times to get our room adjusted, it was still hot all week. 
The food service was the only great thing about our visit this time.

reviews.author: glennd738
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, friendly staff, clean beautiful resort. Food portions at Vento's and Blueagave restaurant very tiny, they should be embarrassed to serve it. Sewage smell outside room when on the terrace facing the lagoon. Air conditioning not working properly, safe did not work, these problems were fixed.

reviews.author: criss994
reviews.title: Not my top choice
reviews.text: The resort is ok.  The food is par for the course and there are only a very few workers that are top notch.  We stayed in the Royal Service area which was nice but they burn incense every night and day so your clothes will come back with this smell.  One night was ok but every night was a bit much.  The elevators are extremely slow and the concierge service needs a lot of improvement for the price you pay for this service.  If you go to the spa make sure and bring cash or CC because they WON'T charge to your room.  They forget to tell you this if you book this at the pool and then you have to go back and get cash or cc and will lose out on your massage.  We ended up canceling our massages since it took 30 minutes of our hour massage to get the paper work filled out etc.  Had to get the late charge taken off due to horrible service.  We also were to receive a butler and we only saw him 1 time in 8 days.  A waste of money.  Pool are is great and the service in the Royal area is the best on the resort.  As for Moses of you want the most amazing service EVER.  He will take care of you.  We had a romantic dinner on the beach and he was our server.  The food was amazing.  We didn't go to the other area for the swim up bar so can't review this.  Plan on a long time to check in as well.  They could get better in this area.

reviews.author: George M
reviews.title: Quantum of Solace
reviews.text: Honeymoon. Second time to the Cancun-Tulum area within a year, engaged at Catalonia Royal Tulum last Summer, just recently married this time. As expected the service was top notch, the lobby and ambiance fantastic. If you need to get away, melt into the sand, sunburn your anxiety away, and then revive with an frozen alcohol elixir, this might be your place. The white sandy beaches and crystal clear blue waters work wonders. The ivy draped rain forest cavernous lobby is a scene from another place. The massages, a least, were worth the spa trip, but the better experience is outside, a smorgasbord of the senses. This place is big, a bit impersonal, at least compared to some of the smaller resorts down the highway towards Tulum. Be careful around Spring Break, as the party continues all night, and we were drunkenly serenaded each morning around 4. There is some kitschy entertainment at night -- mariachis, belly dancers and a "circus" of trampoline artists. At one of the daily pool parties, the wife had me enter the stand-on-the-surfboard-while-we-shake-it contest, but the place was spinning before I even stepped aboard (maybe next time). But I'll leave it here: go for the sunrise (beach side), the surf (always red-flagged and rough), and that feeling that, just for a moment or two, before you have to return to reality, nothing else really matters -- except her hand in yours, her head on your chest, hearts now pledged together, and every last worry blown away by the ocean breeze . . .

reviews.author: Kinleigh Z
reviews.title: Good stay but the WORST food!!
reviews.text: The room, staff, pool and beach was good. Very clean! But man... Did I starve for the first day! The food is so horrible I thought for a second it might be fake! Wow, never have I had such bad tasting food. And not just the Buffett, all the restaurants you have to make reservations for are no good.

reviews.author: bethanybeach2016
reviews.title: Overpriced
reviews.text: Overall, the staff was nice. Be sure when you are booking if you think you may be able to use the resort credits advertised online that you ready all fine print. The staff would not let us use the credits we thought we had. The main pool was very dated. The food was good. However, the family concierge amenities that were advertised were not provided. If you plan to play golf, bring your clubs, balls and water. There is no one on the golf course to direct you or to give you water or a beer! The spa was surprisingly nice.

reviews.author: markwJ99PH
reviews.title: No Concierge service in the "Family Concierge".
reviews.text: We stayed in a Melia resort in the Dominican and had a great experience, so we booked Melia Cancun. BIG MISTAKE. The concierge never came to meet us, never met our son, and never provided us any service. I called management twice and received no reply. The hotel is visually appealing, however there is no where in the hotel to sit and have a drink and a snack outside of a restaurant - there are no lounge areas that serve snacks indoors. The beds are miserable and the towel service is horrible. Towels on the floor in most place means we desire new towels - here they just pick them up and refold them.

reviews.author: clinicoid
reviews.title: Started strong then faded
reviews.text:
A few things to note for prospective guests:
1.  The royal service isn't so royal.  They promise a " butler ".  Ours spoke to us on day one.  After that we didn't see her.
2.  Upon checking in they had no king beds.  Travelers should note that bed size cannot be guaranteed 
3.  Some of the staff try to sell you time shares.   
4.  They only guarantee a Bali bed for 2 days.  The website says they guarantee the Bali bed.  This was our main concern.  Really felt like this was bait and switch 
5.  Overall the food was very good.  The one bright spot is the restaurant service.  The servers were really good at mealtime. 
6.  The room was nice.   Enjoyed the patio

Overall they could have done better.  This was the classic case of over promise and under deliver.

reviews.author: Tracey K
reviews.title: Nice resort but to big....
reviews.text:
My first time to Cancun and the Paradisus had incredible reviews, that is why we chose it. I have to say it was less than incredible. We booked a Jr. Suite with an ocean view, when we arrived to our room our view was of a building across from us, you could only see a small corner of the ocean. We went to the front desk and asked for what we had purchased. The manager wasn't very nice and seemed like it was an inconvince to move our room. She moved us to bldg 1 which is their time share bldg. The room was nothing like in any of the pictures on the website. It was very old looking, not updated like what we were expecting, but...we're in Cancun and the view of the Sea was incredible! The hotel itself is absolutely beautiful! Much to big for us, a lot of walking from your room to the pool, a restaurant or even to find a restroom. 
There is also no air conditioning in any part of the hotel except for your room, so when going to a nice dinner, it is extremely warm and sticky! 
The food was so,so and a buffet is a buffet, the restaurants were good but difficult to get a reservation for the next evening. Market grill was the best! 
The staff was a delight! The pool service was incredible and everyone was extremely friendly, always greeting you with hola or buenos dias, etc. 
We would defiantly not stay here again. For the price we paid, we did not see the value compared to other hotels. 
We did have a fabulous time! Cancun is incredibly beautiful and we will be back!

reviews.author: Chelsea W
reviews.title: Nice resort but lots of rude kids
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun for a week in July. I have been to many all inclusives and although this resort was very beautiful, our trip was nearly ruined by all of the unruly, rude children... With parents that didn't care. It was hard to enjoy any part of the trip. Kids were rude in the pool... Kids were rude in the restaurants. Running around screaming... Knocking over drinks... Splashing in your drink without a thought for someone else. I am a teacher so I understand children... What I didn't understand was the parents lack of thought for anyone around them. I read reviews prior to us going that this was a problem for others... I figured that since I'm around kids all day it would be fine! This was def not the case. If you are going to relax and unwind, I would not recommend. 

Food and rooms were nice. Staff was great and friendly!!! Def the spot light of this resort.

reviews.author: Cherie B
reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: Outdated rooms and very small! Buffet was great and beach! Service just ok. Safe didn't work and wifi on and off! Had to exchange American money for pesos to buy things in hotel stores. Not enough beach chairs. View from room was great. Balcony was nice.

reviews.author: dinopsych
reviews.title: Mexico with my daughter when she was 10
reviews.text:
This hotel was very nice. We had a good time. 
Food was good, Never had a problem getting a lounger by the pool. 
Rooms were nice. 
Entertainment was eh - my daughter was 10 and there were NO other children around. 
This was my daughters 3rd time in Mexico and every other time she was able to meet other children with no problem. Even with that we still had a blast and made memories for a lifetime!

reviews.author: Hdm12345
reviews.title: DATED.
reviews.text:
Traveled with 2 other couples....requested queen beds, received doubles.  It took a bit of convincing, but they did manage to find available rooms. In each of our rooms, there were a few flaws concerning the facilities....bidet, shower, tv.
 Food was nothing to brag about at the main eatery, but we were impressed with the Sushi right beneath the lobby.  Service was great.
Keep in mind that it IS family oriented, so if you don't mind children all about, you will be fine.   This hotel, along with many others, continues to sell memberships. So if you don't belong, you will notice a difference in services.

reviews.author: Erin P
reviews.title: Misleading!!
reviews.text:
The service was excellent in the restaurants, poolside bars and beach. They worked very hard to make their guests comfortable!! If only the concierge desk and personal concierge we had were half that good we would've enjoyed our stay.
Please tell me what sets your hotels apart from other hotels. I'd really like to know your opinion as to why you feel it's better.
I've stayed in much nicer hotels than this for less $

reviews.author: imh829
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun is an average resort
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun is a 3 star resort -- it's nice but needs improvement in a few areas.  Concierge staff is very pushy -- they try to get you to sign up for time share meetings!
