reviews.title: Nothing special; very average resort.
reviews.text:
We rate this hotel as very average, nothing spectacular stood out. We came here as part of a group and Cancun/this particular location was chosen by the people who coordinated the trip. 
We stayed in the Royal Services side and appreciate that with this option we did have a quiet pool area, a butler to help us with reservations/etc, and a private beach area. Our butler was Galdino and he was very nice and helped us with reservations. He also gave us great advice on navigating Market 28 in downtown Cancun. At the Royal Services pool/Bali bed we had Cesar as a waiter one day and he was great! We never had to wonder when he was going to come back by or get us what we wanted...as we did with some of the other waiters. The bathroom at the Royal Serviced pool did get dirty quickly and ran out of TP, soap, and towels often. The Bali bed reservations fill up FAST so if you want one book ASAP! There are plenty of towels always available at the pool area. 
The food at the resort was not great, except for Tempo (which costs extra, but was amazing! Our waiter was Samuel and he was fantastic!). The buffet is subpar at best and your only option for lunch is the buffet or the Royal Services restaurant (which is only open to RS guests). The restaurants were also just OK and left us desiring better. In fact, we left the resort to eat somewhere else after getting tired of the limited options. The RS area has a continental breakfast and snacks throughout the day which we found to be fine, but nothing special.
The rooms were clean and comfortable. They provide you with all bathroom amenities you may need (soap, shampoo, hairdryer, etc). The maid service came daily and also our fridge was restocked with water, etc. The resort overall was clean. 
We visited the gym a couple of times. Most of the equipment was not working...2/4 treadmills and 2/4 elliptical were out of order during our entire week long stay. They also offer a couple of stationary bikes and free weights. 
The spa was very nice and prices were on par with what I would expect at a resort. I had a facial and it was relaxing. The amenities at the spa were very nice. 
Nancy at Olympus tours was the best! She helped us get a transfer back to the airport and also booked a snorkeling trip for our group. Her suggestions were very honest and appreciated. She also gave good advice on navigating the city when we left the resort area. 
Overall, all staff was courteous...but a few (Galdino, Cesar, and Nancy) stood out. We tipped these individuals, but none of the others went out of their way to provide service that we deemed to be worthy of an extra tip. In our future trips to Mexico, We would not come back to Cancun...we've been to other parts of Mexico and found them to be more our style and a little nicer. We came to this particular place as part of a large group of friends/family and we, personally, would choose to go somewhere else rather than return to this resort. 
We did have a relaxing and enjoyable time with our friends/family while here.

reviews.author: TravelersChoiceGirl
reviews.title: Very friendly staff
reviews.text: Check in by a very nice staff. Common areas are well kept and seem nice but not luxurious. Rooms are dated, small and need an overhaul. I have stayed at much nicer hotels. Very poorly lighting in the rooms and the resort in general. Good enough but not top of the line. Staff is extremely helpful.

reviews.author: bernardl228
reviews.title: Building too old, but staff excellent, excellent service, food too be improved
reviews.text:
I enjoy because of the staff, the beach  the service, the pool service.
But  the food was not so good and cold.
Need more info about the service offered in the royal service 
Please spend money too improve the permeabilty of the roof and windows 

Again BRAVO for the staff and service

reviews.author: peirick18
reviews.title: Great hotel nice beach great value
reviews.text: I've stayed here 3 times . Very pretty resort for the money . Large footprint , big rooms with great terrace. Food is incredible , service is great . Don't get a room above the dance club 3355-3356 gangham style till 230 am with no one in the club but music pounding into my room. Royal service is the way to go at this resort . I didn't do it this past time and I regret it. I waited30 minutes to check out to pay $2 for a phone call . Like it was 1985 or something . Ok enough complaining the staff was awesome , the food was incredible , there are a lot of inferior hotels you can pay a lot more for . I'd recommend any Paradisus this is my 8th different one . They are a good brand for sure

reviews.author: djroze
reviews.title: Nice Resort, But Beware False Advertising in Room Categories
reviews.text:
I stayed here solo for ten nights around Thanksgiving. Overall I had a good time but I had an issue with my room which was never addressed to my satisfaction even though I raised it through three different channels. Unless it gets resolved at some point I would not return to this hotel or any other Melia property.

Ambiance: The hotel is absolutely beautiful inside and out. It has an extremely pleasant and relaxing atmosphere, with live music often happening a couple different places for about 45-60 minutes in the evenings. I stayed in the Royal Service section which I would definitely recommend; for the most part I really did feel like it granted a higher level of service. The building does show its age in number of respects but they do a pretty good job of combatting that.

Food: I liked the buffet, I *loved* the Market Grill (Brazilian), and I visited a new restaurant called Enso during their soft opening which was very good. I enjoyed Vento as well, which is a tapas restaurant. The taqueria is also enjoyable and open late night with a limited menu. I didn't care for the food at the sushi restaurant, Ibana, but it has a very nice atmosphere in the middle of the hotel.

Pools: Brr. Cold, and the hot tub in the Royal Service area wasn't even heated (no idea why). I thought they said the spa had a jacuzzi available but I never found one there, just another pool that is also cold as part of their "water ritual." The Bali beds are definitely worth doing for comfort, though you won't get any sun when you're in them. Service was very good around the Royal Service pool, where they will keep a bucket full of ice and your favorite drinks throughout the day.

Bars & Nightlife: This hotel has a good amount of nightlife, which is important because it's not so close to the club zone. I didn't end up going to the club zone at all throughout my stay, which I guess is a compliment to the amount you can do at the hotel (or proof of my laziness :-P). They have a nightclub which gets fairly busy later in the week, a beachfront bar, a pool bar and an indoor bar where they have a nightly show. There isn't much seating for the show so that's not very well thought out, but you can at least sit nearby in the bar / lounge area and listen to it if you don't want to stand.

Room: Here was my major complaint that never got resolved. So I had booked a "lagoon view" room, and when I checked in I was brought to a room on the third floor with a lagoon view and two twin beds. I told them my preference was a king bed and asked if they had any available, and they said there was only one room available starting the following day and that it was on the first floor. I decided to switch (without getting a chance to see it first) and so I mostly lived out of my suitcase for the first night. After having to pack back up the next day and waiting through delays past their estimates, I eventually got moved into my new room (it probably took 1.5-2 hours out of that day in total). When changing rooms I asked explicitly and they confirmed that it was the same category ("in fact, it's a little bit bigger") and on the first floor.

Well, once I finally moved in to the new room I discovered that it had zero view of the lagoon whatsoever, and simply faced one of the neighboring hotel buildings and the side of the walkway between them. Given that there were no other rooms available and I'd already spent too much time changing rooms and not being able to unpack, I wasn't about to try changing again. The room was pleasant enough otherwise, but clearly did not match the advertised description and what I had paid for. I was OK with staying there under the circumstances but it seems to me that the hotel should certainly have credited me to match what they would charge for a "garden view" or the like. They also should have warned me from the beginning about the lack of a view.

I later asked at the front desk about a billing adjustment and the receptionist said that that's just how they categorize the two sides of the building, ocean and lagoon view, and didn't seem to understand why this was problematic. I guess you can call it whatever you want but if you charge someone for a given service and don't deliver it, that's called false advertising. I had also emailed two separate endpoints (Paradisus and Melia Rewards) and never received a response from either. Really terrible handling all around, and now I guess I'll have to deal with my credit company to see if they can do a partial chargeback. For the most part the Royal Service was great but they seriously dropped the ball on this one. They very much made it seem that once they swiped my card upon arrival, they didn't want to hear about any complaints I had. While some might say the view isn't a big deal, it's obviously enough of a big deal that they charge more for better views, and it's a core part of the pricing model, so I have no idea why this hotel doesn't seem to think they're responsible for false advertising in the room descriptions.

Overall: I enjoyed myself here but I would not return to a hotel or chain that ignores customers like this. If you happen to not be asking for anything out of the ordinary, and don't mind the risk that you may not get the room category you paid for (and no remediation), then you'll probably have a great time at this resort. Also as a heads-up, wifi can be very spotty here; I usually got very slow and then disconnected service every 15 or 20 minutes.

reviews.author: D T
reviews.title: Top notch resort, wish the food was better
reviews.text: This resort had the MOST beautiful beach we have been too! It was awesome! The drinks were delicious, and the staff was excellent. The food could have definitely been better....We thought it was pretty bad.... we are not buffet people though, so that could make a difference. The best place to eat at the resort is blue agave! Just an FYI. As far as the staff: we loved Asuncion by the beach! She was the best, so sweet, and caring! Also, shout out to Christian and Jacien at the pool bar, they work so hard! They were great. PS. The Michael Jackson show is fantastic! Check it out!

reviews.author: StephanieM1976
reviews.title: Just OK
reviews.text:
We stayed at this resort from Aug 30-Sept 6. We come to Cancun twice a year.  We were celebrating our anniversary.  

We paid to be upgraded to the "Royal Service." It was 530 extra.  Not so sure it was worth the extra money.  Then to find out they were upgrading others for free.  

The food was good, resort clean and nice beaches. Daniel at the pool was awesome!  And the best waiter at the pool was Jorge!! He wasn't even our waiter but he was the only one that acknowledged our anniversary.  There were a few other waiters at the pool that were good too. 

That being said I would have to get one heck of a deal to come back to this resort.

reviews.author: TXAmanda
reviews.title: Great relaxing vacation, disappointed in Kids Club
reviews.text:
My husband,  4 year old son,  and myself stayed here for 5 nights Thanksgiving week.  We have previously stayed at Paradisus in Punta Cana and were looking to try a new location.  
We also like to visit Paradisus because of the great service we had at the kids club in Punta Cana.

Well, the kids club here is a joke!  They have a "baby club" for infants to four years old.   It was a room full of cribs and baby toys.  On the first day,  and subsequent days after,  there was no more than one kid in the baby room.  There were no scheduled activities for this room.   My son is very active, attends preschool and I found it an insult that he be in a room for babies. We questioned the staff and they seemed annoyed with our questions.  One male staff member was sitting on a bench reading a book. While this room had nothing going on,  all the action was in the room next door.   Our son saw that and wanted to go play in the kids club room. I voiced my concern for this and asked if he could go to the room next door, the kids club,  and was given the run-around from the staff.   "I have to ask my supervisor..."  Eventually I checked back and was told my son could attend the kids club if I was with him.  Ok, no problem,  at least he can do some activities and play with some kids.  On Wednesday of our trip, I escorted him to the kids club for wax art.  The supervisor told me that he is not allowed even if I was with him!   I was livid,  I went off!   I questioned her to what activities he is able to do??  She quickly escorted my son and I to the baby club and they let him make a visor.
The next day while at the pool the kids club staff walked through the kids pool area displaying a play doh scence he could make and telling us that it would be at 4:00 in the kids club.   We walked there and once again were turned away because he is 4.  Well, wth did you invite him????? 
Also, when we would walk by the kids club, the kids-especially boys, were running around,  throwing a ball against a wall, kids getting hurt (saw it with my own eyes when I escorted son), staff members not really leading any games.
I would rate the kids club as terrible!

Pool:
Very good service, rented a Bali bed,($50 a day) which is nice.  On our last day, there was a piece of feces floating in the kids pool, which is connected to the adult pool.  We told the staff and they said they "would take care of it"  We didn't see anything done.  And I know that whenever there is feces in the pool, it has to be shut down for 24 hours.  Kids and adults were still playing in the pool as we were leaving.
Pool rating is average bc of the feces situation.

Restaurants:
Breakfast buffet is average.
Bana is delicious.
Vento is delicious.
Mole is delicious.
Blue Agave is nasty.
Market Grill is delicious.
Service was great in all restaurants!
Restaurant rating is above average.

Family Concierge:
Loved the private check in and games, toys, and snacks available.  There were more activities here for our son than at the kids club.
Staff was very friendly and accommodating.
Our Butler was ok.  The service in Punta Cana was excellent and she did not live up to our expectations.

Room:
Ocean view was gorgeous!
We had the junior suite.  
Room was very clean and appointed.

We all enjoyed the Michael Jackson show!

We would choose Punta Cana any day over this resort.

reviews.author: Bruce N
reviews.title: How much can you drink
reviews.text: First all inclusive trip. Loved the Royal Service at pool and beach, especially the Bali Beds. Our Lagoon view room was a few of the main road and McDonalds. There was water somewhere behind that. We wanted to have a quiet vacation and booked last minute. The Royal Service and no kids actually was perfect. All Inclusive was not a good value for us. How much can you drink?  Also if staying more than four nights you may tire of the restaurants in the hotel. Most of the food included in the inclusive had limited selections and wasn't great. We ended up going off property for dinner last three nights. Finally if you are traveling w dollars make sure you bring small bills, we had trouble getting change for $20s. Gratuities are appreciated by the staff

reviews.author: Debbie G
reviews.title: Recent stay at Paradisus
reviews.text:
This hotel was very nice but it is showing its age.  There were a lot leakage problems, water pouring through the ceiling in buffet seating area.  Towels always on the floors in the hallways to the rooms.  The hallways were VERY dark so it was hard to see the water on the floors.  The smell of the incense burning to hide the smell from all of the plants was very overwhelming and actually sickening.  

The wait staff is extraordinary.  Extra thanks goes out to Antonio in the buffet.  We asked for him every day for breakfast and sometimes lunch.  He went above and beyond to meets our needs before we even asked.  Also, kudos to Gerardo at the swim up bar.  He was lots of fun and knew how to make lots of fun, different and good drinks.

reviews.author: MaureenB2013
reviews.title: Royal Service is not worth it!
reviews.text:
I have stayed at other Melia resorts and found the Royal Service to be superb.
That was not the case recently.  Our butler Rode was not attentive at all and there were many things not in order:  beds not made, air conditioning not working, no turn down service, refridgerator not stocked, etc. etc.
The resort is beautiful, but the level of Royal Service needs to be upgrade.  It is not worth the premium price.
Also, there needs to be more entertainment available at various venues within the hotel.

reviews.author: Martin N
reviews.title: There is lots of good here but some things need work.
reviews.text: Just got back from the Paradisus Cancun after a week in paradise. This resort is in a great location. The staff was awesome, very friendly and attentive. The resort is clean and the food was pretty consistent quality but limited in selection. Tapas resturant is well done with some good food. Blue Agave was a favorite of mine, love some authentic tacos. The drinks are good not watered down at all. They make a good magarita. They do need a better selection of wine. Our room was small but did the job with a nice view of the ocean. What I did not like was how dark this property is. I would prefer less plants and trees with more light getting into property. It reminds my wife of being on a Cruise. .. the decor is just to heavy. Also there is no bar open during the day in the actual building. You have to go poolside with I'm my opinion has too many people drinking all day. One other issue was how they allow people to put towels on chairs near pool and beach even though they are not there. They should police that better. We did like our vacation just not sure we would return to this property.

reviews.author: Jojoeles
reviews.title: Not loving it!!!!
reviews.text: Currently staying at the Paradisus in Cancun and are really disappointed! We arrived on Saturday and today is Monday and had to go to the front desk both days to request that our room be cleaned( at 4pm) . Since it was late in the day we also did not receive towels. While trying to view Mail on my iPad noticed a swarm of little gnat type bugs sashaying across the glass table .  After staying at 4 other Paradisus resorts this is a big disappointment. Hope the remainder of the week gets better!

reviews.author: Simplyidi
reviews.title: Not what i expected!
reviews.text: Pics look way better than reality. Was not welcomed at the door with a beverage or cool towel as i read in reviews. Check in was a mess.took 30 min. Could not find my name. Then said no room available. Not even offered a drink in the mean time. And i was doing royal service. Did not feel royal at all. Food at buffet was the same everyday. Activities at the avenue bar were somewhat boring. Was called to my room to ask me if i was with another family.. (Which i wasnt) they were so confused.. Royal service pool menu was bland. Requested a bali bed with ovean view and it was given to another couple because nonone ever told us we had to be down the pool by 11am. Nonone ever informed us. We arrived at 11:30 and it was given to another couple already. Walked in to the hotel few times after comming in from outside activitys no one at the door.. Anyone could just walk in. Cleaning lady threw out my personal soap i took. Did not replenish facial towels i had to ask for them daily. At check out they could not find my paper work. Then asked if i had switched rooms which i didnt.! Total mess again. Sorry. But would not return.

reviews.author: ladyfish574
reviews.title: gorgeous view average hotel
reviews.text:
Although this Hotel has a great view and the staff is superb, this Hotel is starting to show its age. Because of a high Atrium and long hanging vines the humidity in the central area is high and this creates a mold smell which the Hotel tries to cover up with strong flower scents. In the evening it gets really warm in that area and in the morning the couch cushions are wet.
Food is average except for the Friday night buffet which is not advertised well but is awesome. Unlimited lobster, stone crabs, snow crabs mussels shrimp and octopus. Don't miss Friday night buffet.
The shows are in a small area in the atrium and you have to stand mostly to see it if it is crowded. I would take out the desk in the center that holds the light and sound controls and open the entire area up so it is fully visible from the bar.
The pools are nice. If you are short watch out because they are 5' 5 all around with no shallow end. The cabanas are a nice touch but it is a shame after paying for all inclusive you have to pay for Royal service and cabanas to enjoy the amenities. 
Our room was clean and well attended, however, we could hear the beat of the Disco on the 3rd floor. I would rate this Hotel average.

reviews.author: Heeva A
reviews.title: Average hotel overall
reviews.text:
Stayed here for 5 nights in late October and enjoyed our stay. I've stayed at better all-inclusives in Cancun (Excellence Playa Mujeres), but this hotel did a good job. The pool is nothing special, but it's very clean. The staff was very nice (for the most part), but the most disappointing aspect of this hotel was the food. The food was pretty awful actually. I only truly enjoyed one meal and that was at the Market Grill for dinner (Brazilian BBQ). The staff and food were amazing. Our server (Efratin) was super helpful and accommodating. 

Now let me tell you about our rooms. At first, we were given rooms in building 4 (which is quite a far walk to the main building where all the food and activities are). We were there for a couple days until my wife (she's 7 months pregnant) noticed they were applying paint thinner and other chemicals to all the floors in our building. I immediately asked to be moved due to the tremendous health hazard (esp for someone pregnant) and I was moved 3 hrs later. They apparently only had 1 room available, which I highly doubt since they were only at 40% capacity. That was annoying (not having more options) and we lost our ocean view since there were no other rooms available (or so they said).

I wouldn't come back, but wouldn't also say it was so terrible that I would deter people from going. I would simply suggest a different all-inclusive.

reviews.author: SoCa1l26
reviews.title: A Zen experience, but pools limiting and beach lacking
reviews.text:
My wife and I have stayed many times in the Mayan Riviera, but this was our first time in Cancun. We wanted to compare the experience to other resorts down the coast.

THE RESORT: The resort is a set of nice pyramid shaped buildings and the main building is a large enclosed space with a beautiful atrium and hanging green plants that remind me of some of the cenotes in the area. It is quite beautiful. To add to that, the "theme" of this resort seems to be a spa-Zen type relaxation motif. 

There is a spa-like smell in the main atrium area, there is zen music playing (starts promptly at 7am every morning), and all of the staff are wearing uniforms that are like white martial arts robes with colored belts. It is certainly different and kind of pleasant althoug if I worked there I could imagine it would drive me crazy after a few weeks.

CHECK-IN: Check-in was fast and efficient. A nice lady met us to tell us about the hotel; she also wanted us to come back after checkin to go over what can be done and what services are at the resort. She was very nice and friendly, but in the back of my head I suspected timeshare sales. We did meet with her the next day and she spent a good 20 minutes with us going over area sights, transportation, etc. with no hint of any sales. I was just about to think that I had been too cynical about the timeshare sales thought in the back of my head when the mention of a "vacation club" came up - so I had to cut her off at that point and tell her we were not interested.

I guess some people fall for this or like timeshares, but personally I like to have complete flexibility to travel without monthly payments or annual maintenance fees that you can't get out of or weeks that you must take your vacation. I suppose that it works for some, but I find it kind of offensive that I'm on a limited vacation where I'm spending a lot of money to enjoy myself and then the resorts have sales people trying to comandeer your time for 1-3 hours of a sales presentation. No thanks. We've found this at a variety of resorts but I must say the one place that has never done this to us is Iberostar, fyi. We really like the Iberostar resorts for service and value.

THE ROOM: We had an ocean facing room in the main pyramid and it was quite nice. The AC worked well. The view was a bit limited as there are large side dividers that stick way out due to the architecture of the building, so you can't see sideways very much, only straight ahead. Also, even though the atrium has gorgeous well maintained hanging plants, each room has a large planter on the balcony where the rail would be (there is like 18 inches of planter between your balcony and the drop off) and the planter was just dirt, devoid of plants. So from the outside of the building you see just the building but  in days of yore it probably had hanging or other plants on the outside, too. This seemed kind of cheap to us and is a downside - either maintain the planters or get rid of them!

FOOD: We don't drink and ate only in the buffet, so we can't comment on those aspects of the resort. The buffet was consistently excellent for food and noticeably better than other AI resorts where we have stayed.

BEACH/POOLS: The beach is kind of curious as compared to say, the resorts near Playa del Carmen. I understand that the color of the water is gorgeous in Cancun, and it was that way on some days, but on other days it was kind of ugly brown near shore due to the seaweed/sargassum problems that have been well publicized recently. Certainly not the resort's fault. 

What is weird is that while in PDC you see huge numbers of people on the beach, in Cancun it seems that many more people are at the pools and the beach is relatively deserted. At the Paradisus, there are relatively few loungers and Palapas and they were not even crowded. The water was kind of rough and there was a significant slope along the water which made it hard to walk down the beach.

Now let's talk about the pools. It was hot in September and we wanted shade. So first of all the smaller pool is off limits unless you paid a lot more for the upscale package. So that's 1/3 of the pool space off limits to you. Second, at the larger pool that you can go to, there are huge numbers of Bali Beds that cost like $50/day or some such to reserve. 

The proportion of shaded space with umbrellas that is open to anybody is pretty small. So perhaps 25% of the large pool has publicly accessible shaded space; 25% is public, unshaded, and the other 50% or so is Bali Beds! So if you want shaded space and *didn't* pay even more for the exclusive club, then you have 25% of 2/3 of the pool space (the large pool) to choose from. That is about 16% of the total pool space for anybody who wants shade, didn't pay for the high end club, and doesn't pay for a Bali Bed. 

This is not one of the cheaper resorts but it is an "All Inclusive" that doesn't include most of the pool space that most of the cheaper AI resorts provide to you with shade!

We liked the resort but based upon these issues, probably won't be back.

In summary, the good:
- clean, zen atmosphere, beautiful atrium, comfortable room, good food and service
The bad:
- timeshare sales, limited pool shade, not the best place if you want a good beach

reviews.author: Thefourbatemans
reviews.title: Problems Left and Right
reviews.text:
For how expensive this place was, I was expecting a lot more. The problems started right when we arrived, they didn't have our reservations. The first clerk was extremely rude. We purchased the family concierge package, they were much nicer but nothing was fixed, we arrived late Saturday when they were supposed to go home (sorry), so we were put into a small hotel room the first night, nothing given to us or explained. We spent the first two days just trying to get things fixed and figured out, I was extremely frustrated.

They were very-very accommodating on switching our room, the first room was tiny and most of the electrical fixtures didn't work, it was in the main pyramid, very noisy. They put us in a very nice, first floor room, close to the kids zone, big enough for our family of four, they even showed us three rooms to choose from, we chose the king size bed with two roll away beds, I was very impressed with that service but that's were it ends. Not sure if the concierge was worth the money or not, they definitely seemed to try and help, felt too little too late, and we heard a lot of complaints from other vacationers.

The restaurants were good, and accommodating for younger kids, The wait staff is either great or horrible depending on who you get, sometimes we felt ignored.

The staff around the kids pool is amazing, they were very friendly and always ready to help, drinks and food every time you turn around. 

The room service is convenient but they NEVER get your order right, have to wait 30 minutes to get the rest of your food, two or three times.

The hotel is very nice and kept clean, the rooms can be wonderful or horrible.

Resort credit was misleading, they were coupons, such as $10 off $100 purchase. Many were for wine selection discounts, and little girl spa discounts.

reviews.author: MGIson
reviews.title: Huge hotel with staff that could care less about the guests
reviews.text: Overall, this is a huge hotel with lots of options and a beautiful beach.  The staff is the weakest I've ever experienced at a hotel.  From check in, to solving details, to care at the restaurants the only consistent thing is that not a single staff member cared about the guests.  They have lots of staff but no one ever seems to do anything help the customer.  I had a problem with my room key and after 4 visits to the front desk and a "security officer" nothing worked.  I demanded a manager come solve the problem and new keys magically worked.  It should not have taken so much to solve such a simple problem.  Even though the staff saw me back in the welcome lounge, I had to wait until they finished with all the customers.  Every simple problem that was raised by me or any member of the large group here for a meeting, nothing was solved simply.  You have to wait for towels to be told they have run out.  You are told you can't be seated in one of the restaurants without a reservation - but after throwing a fit magically we were seated in a near empty restaurant that always had a free table during our visit.  You have lots of choices in Cancun - my only advice is to pick another hotel!

reviews.author: MsLyn901
reviews.title: Lacking Attention to Detail
reviews.text:
Overall, the trip was great. The beach is beautiful, there were several great food options, the housekeeping staff did a great job, the Royal Service pool area is beautiful, and the Royal Service outdoor staff is extremely attentive. 

However, there were several issues that I didn't expect to have with Royal Service. I had to call to have the minibar restocked, as it had not been restocked for more than 2 days. The power went out several times - not sure if this is generally an issue in Cancun or just this hotel. Whenever the butler was not at work, the lady answering the request line would say she would call back but never called back. Thus, I ended up having to call multiple times to get simple things done, and some tasks, like reserving a Bali bed, were never done! 

I hate to complain about such little things, but these issues made the trip much less relaxing as I was counting on things to be done that were never done. Plus, I felt like I never received the amenities and extras that were promised to me upon checkin. I definitely question whether Royal Service was worth the extra cost.

reviews.author: corazonespinado_b
reviews.title: It was cool
reviews.text: the free room service was cool. I think I spent the whole day with a yard stick margarita in my hand. They will kick you out if you drink to much so be careful. Make sure to make reservations as soon as you can or all you'll be eating is tacos

reviews.author: Vera B
reviews.title: Nice hotel, but would try another hotel
reviews.text: The hotel is nice. I would have preferred for them to have entertainment at night for adults. Also, the food gets a little boring, I would have night themes for dinner. I was there 6 days, same food ah

reviews.author: A_G_Pennypacker
reviews.title: Our honest experience at Paradisus
reviews.text:
My family (myself, wife, daughter 3.5, son 1.5) stayed at the Paradisus cancun for 2 weeks in September.  Staying for such a long period of time gave us an opportunity to try all the food outlets and get to know the staff quite well, and gave us a true feel for this resort.  
I will mention that we have been to Mexico several times, staying in all inclusives in Cabo, PV, and all over Riviera Nayarit.  
I'll start with the bad. Both of our children got sick on separate occasions during our stay. We can't say for sure what it was- food/ virus etc but they were throwing up and had diarrhea for a significant chunk of time.  As a parent, this is the kind of thing that I look for on Trip Advisor reviews, and it alters my decision on where to stay.  My wife and I understand that this is a part of staying in a foreign country for a significant amount of time, but it definitely put a bit of a dampener on part of the vacation.  I won't let that dominate my review of Paradisus, so on to the rest.
Food was very good.  We found ourselves eating at the buffet most of the time and it was impressive!  We loved eating dinner at the buffet, they change the theme every night so it never got repetitive for us, and the quality and assortment of food was outstanding.  We went to all the restaurants on the property (except Tempo & Mole) and found them to be very good.  Bana was probably our favourite restaurant, the setting is amazing and the sushi was quite good for an AI resort in Mexico.
Room service was not good.  We ordered several times and were amazed at how much worse the food was than the rest of the resort.  We ordered nachos and were presented with a soup bowl of chips with carrots, beans and a massive amount of liquid cheese.  These were the worst nachos that my wife and I have ever seen (I included a picture).  Also of note was the processed cheese found in our omelette.  I'm not trying to be a pain in the a#@ but at a higher end 5 star resort this was not impressive.    
Our room was average.  We booked a jr suite ocean view, and were placed on the 5th floor between tower 2 and 3 (very good location, not loud at night and high enough to have a great view of the pools and Caribbean). Our room was long and narrow, which we expected due to the architecture, there were 2 chairs with a round table, and a larger sofa chair with a coffee table.  The balcony had 2 lounge chairs and a small metal table which we used plenty.  One side note about the balcony which was a disappointment, is that the light is on an automatic timer and went off at 10pm every night.  This was disappointing because we like to sit outside and play cards while having a cocktail at night, but had to move inside at 10 due to lack of light.  Compared to rooms at Dreams resorts or Riu Palace, our room at the Paradisus was small and outdated.  We had requested a crib and pull out couch twice before we got there, but neither were in our room when we arrived.  They sent a crib up within 90 minutes and a cot followed not long after that. 
The staff were amazing!  Thank you to all the staff that worked while we were visiting, you were all incredible.  Special thanks to Flor, Sergio and Laura on the beach, you went above and beyond and really provided exceptional service to our family, it was so greatly appreciated.  We are very generous when it comes to tipping, and the staff here deserve it.  Our chamber maid was incredible, our room was always cleaned and stocked without us needing to request for it to be done.  We donated some childrens items to our chambermaid the day that we were leaving to show our appreciation for the service she provided us.  Remember these employees work 6 days a week and long hours for very little pay, show your appreciation!  Also worth mentioning is the entertainment staff.  This was without a doubt the most impressive resort entertainment we have ever seen.  These employees were so talented and worked so hard every night to entertain the guests, they should have had a tipping option for the entertainment crew.  I will try to post a video of one of the shows, they truly were incredible.  
The beach was great, seaweed wasn't much of an issue, it was only really bad 2 or 3 days out of 14.  
I hope this helps other families who may be shopping around for the right resort.

reviews.author: Sara V
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
The hotel staff was top notch.  Watch out for the Club Melia people who will try to get you to sign up for a time share presentation.  The will get you right at check-in by asking if you have been to the resort before.  If your reservation states that transportation is provided...do not believe it.

The room we reserved was not ready at 1500 as promised and we were put in a room with two double beds our first night.  No one offered this information and no one offered a pro-rate for the difference of the room.  
The entire hotel leaked like crazy when it rained literally water running down the walls.  The poor staff were constantly mopping, etc.  Our room flooded under the balcony door one night and created a puddle that took four very large beach towels to soak up.
Food was hit or miss.  The best was Market Street and Mole.  Cell phone was stolen at buffet NAOS.
Beach and pools were awesome.  Staff was the best.  I'm not sure if I would stay here again.

reviews.author: sandsurf15
reviews.title: My experience
reviews.text: No ice machine available due to it being broke. Had to call front desk when we wanted ice. Hard time receiving washcloths and extra towels. Finding drinks after pool area and restraurant closed was very hard. Was only available in a elegant dress lounge or one in the center of hotel area but that one was limited as to what they could make.

reviews.author: MC9856
reviews.title: Not good for those with disabilities
reviews.text: Friendly staff but the hotel is showing its age - needs updating but there is not much that can be done to the uniques architecture that is really unattractive in this day and age.  Restaurants were okay to good but a few people in our group developed stomach issues. Horrible for people using wheelchairs, walkers or canes.  Too many levels.  Too choppy in general.  Very nice staff.

reviews.author: Ioana T
reviews.title: Good service, but quite expensive, feel somewhat captive within the hotel property
reviews.text: I stayed at this hotel for a week (Sept 5-11, 2015)---so off-season, while attending an industry conference that took place at the hotel.  While the quality of the room, service, food were OK I don't see how they delivered the value for money, at a room rate of USD315/night, and I stayed in their executive/special reserve area.  While there is a diversity of restaurants on site, it is quite difficult to make a reservation (they seemed booked all the time), so I expect during the season is almost impossible.  The food at the buffet is OK but nothing special.  The entertainment throughout the hotel was average quality (lots of loud singing) and could have done without.  Prices at the boutique at the hotel are ridiculous (a regular sun lotion Banana Boat was 24 USD).  Concierge staff was very helpful and friendly.   The beach/ocean water had lots of algae so in some days was quite difficult and unpleasant to swim (despite excellent water temperature).  The conference room facilities could have been a lot better (no windows in any of the conference rooms, air conditioning was either freezing cold or not working at all and logistics support was mediocre at best).

reviews.author: Koyarzabal
reviews.title: It was nice but I would consider another hotel next time
reviews.text:
Pros: Good location, nice hotel, good atmosphere & good food
Cons: Restaurant reservation open only until 4 pm. Pool bar closes at 6pm (early) When turning off lights at night, the switches to charge cell phones and cameras turns off too. Hotels does not offer shuttle service from/to hotel/airport. 

For tours: Do not book anything at the hotel as the price for tours doubles.

reviews.author: Maricela L
reviews.title: Hot hotel (Literally)
reviews.text: This hotel is eye candy...beautiful interior and exterior...that said..the hotel is hot...once you leave your room prepare to sweat...everywhere else in the hotel is an inferno...workers are not friendly...every time we would ask for something there was an excuse as to why they couldn't comply with us...One waitress flat out told us she would not return to attend us because our group was too big...I could make a list of all the times we were mistreated...but instead I'll suggest you pay the extra money and stay at The Hard Rock Hotel...now that is bang for you buck!

reviews.author: voicemai
reviews.title: Our visit to Paradisus
reviews.text: My family and I visited Paradisus in July 2015.  We expected a lot as this was supposed to be a 5 star hotel. First, our room was more like a 3 star room. Then we discovered that the AC unit was not working and the room was hot and never could get it to cool down.  The room was not very clean but acceptable.  We asked to be moved to another room and asked for a king bed as the double beds were very uncomfortable.  They moved us to another room and this one also had a broken AC unit.  I complained again and the front desk girl seemed to annoyed. I thought this was a 5 star hotel???  They moved us to a third room. This one, the AC worked but it was just above their restaurant and we could smell all the food and smoke whenever we opened the window.  By now I had given up trying to change rooms.  The food was very very bland. We kept trying food and desserts looking for something that tasted good but no luck.  The food was like 3 to 4 star quality but I would say more like 3 star.  The service was so so, but this place was very very crowded.  My little boy asked for a cheeseburger and fries. I asked for a seedless bun as he is allergic to the seeds.  It took them three (3) hours, yes that is correct 3 hours to get us the cheeseburger.  The beach was full of sea-weed but this was only the cause of nature and not the hotel's problem. The pool side drink service was non-existent, I mean NO ONE every came by an asked if I wanted a drink.  This was supposed to be a 5 star hotel.  This is the first and last time we stay here. We stayed at Excellence in 2008 and it was way way better.

reviews.author: Brandi S
reviews.title: Lock your stuff up!!!!
reviews.text: I stayed here on a girls trip In September 2013.  We upgraded to Royal service but did not feel this was worth the extra cost. We reserved a room with two beds and at check in they tried give us a King... The had overbooked our room and were forced to upgrade us. Nothing special though just a little bigger room.  The food they serve in the Royal service lounge was awful!!  The restaurants were all very good and the drinks were just ok...  FYI  always be sure to lock everything up in your room safe!!  My friend accidentally left her drivers license and earrings out on the counter and they were stolen!!  The staff just said.  we're sorry!?  This ruined the rest of our trip until it came to check out.     At check out they had charged me $65.00 for sheets they said had blood on them??? What?  From who?  Wasn't us!!!  I asked for proof and they said they had been washed.  I was very upset and they said  they would not charge me but when I got home and checked my bank account they had not only charged my card but also overcharged me by 25.00 for a pair of flip flops I purchased in the hotel store.  I was so sick about this.  I do have to say thought that the people that work here at the restaurants and around the pool are wonderful and they really do try to make your stay nice.  Just be careful about leaving your belongings out in your room.   Because of the theft and the bogus charges though I would never return here.

reviews.author: Luis N
reviews.title: Paradisus just Average
reviews.text:
Be prepared to wake up at 7am to get a beach or pool chair otherwise you will be left to stand around. Hotel music be played outside your room at 7am.Pools are not children friendly. The staff was very friendly and the food was average.
Hotel just average

reviews.author: I8054YHalexa
reviews.title: Nice resort but needs attention to details.
reviews.text:
it was our first visit to this resort. It was highly rated on travel websites. So we had high expectations.
And this is indeed a nice looking resort inside and out. We loved it from the first minute and we still like our vacation there.
There were few areas for improvement. Bed were very uncomfortable with sagging mattresses and stone-hard and smelly pillows. Water wasn't draining properly in the bath tub and hand sink. TV remote was broken and some lights didn't work either.
Food was good overall, although in vary from restaurant to restaurant. From highly rated Fuego restaurant ( I will give it 4 stars), to La Perla ( 1 star will be too much for this one). Buffet restaurant Naos provided tasty food all day long.

reviews.author: Joey W
reviews.title: Service hit and miss.
reviews.text:
We stayed here August 1-10 in the Royal section.  A little about us.  We are a gay couple and this is our second year in Cancun and our 5th overall in the area.  Previous 3 visits were near Akumal.  I only mention our sexual orientation because som elf ten ask about the gay friendliness of the area and resorts and this resort is the first where being gay may have affected service.
Check In & Room
Check in is a bit unorganized if you booked Royal.  We arrived at the main reception and were to wait. After no further explanation and 10 minutes later we spoke to reception and someone finally escorted us to the Royal pyramid for check in.  Uneventful but this has been the first resort we have been to where they held appx $200 US for incidentals.
Our room was on the 6th floor oceanview.  Good size, nicely appointed.  Huge balcony with 2 chairs.  There were also 3 small bottles of liquor.  Should have been 4 but we were told they were out of rum.  A Nespresso machine and well stocked fridge with beers, soda and juices as well as M&Ms.  Bathroom was also well stocked.  Probably best of any hotel or resort I've ever stayed is as the had razors and shaving lotion.
Airconditioning worked very well.
Common Areas
This is a beautiful and unique resort.  Well kept and generally clean. (There was a can of beer that we passed by 3 days in a row on our way to the gym).
The gym is somewhat hidden and not labeled well.  It's across from the spa and the entry looks like you are entering another part of the spa.  Small but well equipped with several treadmills, bikes, weight machines and small stack of free weights.  Good a/c.
While on the topic of a/c, it is severely lacking in the common areas and just bearable in many restaurants. Somewhat understandable due the the pyramid design tho.  
There is also a gift shop but at $39 for a small wooden box and $15 for a pack of cigarettes I would skip it.  (Go across the street to the OXXO if you need anything)
Restaurants
Buffet, ate breakfast there all but one morning.  Omelette station is. Good and there is a smoothie bar as well.  Precooked food is pretty much cold.  Bacon is thin, overcooked and greasy. Not very appetizing.  Lots of meat leftovers.  Same holds true for the few lunches and dinners we ate there.  A lot of fish, some actually good.
Service is hit and miss.  Some staff seem more concerned about socializing.  The good staff are over the top great.
Ate at Bana twice.  Pretty good.  Good service.  There was a singer there both nights.  She was pretty amazing.  Ate once at Mole.  Very small portions. Had the best fish ever there.  Believe it was grilled red snapper with a red sauce.  We had reservations at Fuego but after looking at the menu, skipped it.  Wish we had also skipped Blue Agave.  It's basically a taco joint.  Touted as authentic Mexican complete with stale tasting chips from a bag.  The tacos themselves were edible although not even close to the tacos I get at home from the taco truck.  The quesadillas were actually nauseating.  Not sure about the filling.  It was described as beef stew!  Disgusting.  The Brazillian restaurant was our favorite.  Great meat and sides and the most attentive staff of any of the restaurants we visited. 
Other meals we ate poolside.  Some great wings over on the non Royal section.  Even better wings at Royal section which at first we did not realize as it is not on the menu. Just ask.
Pool and beach
This is where Paradisus really left us with a bad taste.  During our orientation we were told there is a pool concierge who will greet you upon arrival at the pool.  They will find you a lounger and give you your towels.  There are usually 3 people in the towel hut but they do not greet you and barely reciprocate a hello when you ask for a towel.  You can have your butler reserve a Bali Bed at least two times during your stay.  If you do not get a bed you are stuck with 4 loungers in front of the towel hut with no shade.  TIP, if you don't have a reserved Bali Bed ask to be put on the waiting list with the towel hut guys.  If someone does not claim their bed by 11am they will put you in one. We were always able to get one when we did this.  Also there are plenty of loungers and palapas at the beach.
Service. We were at the pool the afternoon of our first day and pretty much the entire time our second day.  While in the pool and sitting poolside, we were never once approached and asked if we wanted something to drink.  However we did observe other couples who were offered buckets of water bottles and drinks. Initially I think we just wrote it off as poor service and the fact we had arrived that afternoon and weren't there very long.  When we continued to be ignored all of day two we began to wonder if it was because we were two males travelling together.  We've never been treated differently in our previous travels to the area or any other area including back home so it was rather strange.  I can't say with 100% certainty this was the reason and have never before felt like this.  We are not demanding and extremely thankful for any service.  We also are very liberal tippers so to this day don't know what it was those two day except maybe...
The second day we spent the morning on a lounger at the beach and again noticed a server asking others what they wanted and ignored us.  
Day 3 we had a Bali bed and everything turned around.  We finally had an amazing server who would even bring another drink to the bed if we were in the pool without us asking.  The remainder of our stay service was hit and miss but we were no longer completely ignored.  On the bright side, the bartender benefited from all of this since most of our tips went to him.  Great service at the bar and he always had our shots and drink choices ready as we walked up.  Kudos as well to one of the bar managers who became a bit angry as my partner was struggling to carry two drinks and two bottle of water down to the beach.  He actually got one of the servers standing around the bar to take the drinks and bring them down along with a bucket of ice and additional waters.
One other negative is the pool water temperature.  It is borderline hot.  I believe I've read that the pool is heated in the winter but it seems the heater is running during summer as well.  The temp was ok in the morning but too warm in the afternoon.  The pool is rather deep so hard to believe it would warm up that much.  There is a small shallow pool hidden to the side and it was much cooler despite only being about two feet deep.  We walked over to the family pools a couple times and it was kinda a madhouse.  I could not imagine staying in that section unless it was during off season.

Overall this is not a bad resort.  It is clean, well maintained and for the most part staff are friendly and accommodating. We were on vacation and enjoyed ourselves. However the situation we experienced our first two days at the pool and one other time after that, soured our impression.  For the right price this would be a great property for many but regardless of price we would not return.

reviews.author: Patrice A
reviews.title: Don't go if you do not pay extra for Royal Service!
reviews.text:
Me and mi fiancé wanted to try Cancun for the first time and we picked this place based on the beautiful photos. We were not disappointed by the resort itself. The resort was grandiose, and very meticulous. We upgraded our room and we had a jacuzzi on our balcony. 
Our vacation started great until we got kicked off the bali beds which are in every picture on their website, and they cost $100 a day to rent….By the way, very few people ever rented them, majority of the time they were empty, which was a disappointment because I just wanted to use them for maybe 20 minutes in a day. 
And it got worse when we found out that the adult only pool were for "the royal service" so we had to spend our whole time in the main pool with little kids splashing water in our drinks and screaming. Also, half the beach was for the "royal service" which no one was ever sitting in. On the half of the beach we were allowed to sit in, there were never any empty chairs, and people would go before breakfast and leave a towel there to save their seat.
If i knew that the resort was going to be segregated I wouldn't have gone here. We paid for all inclusive, but the "royal service" "club melia" "family concierge" "non- all inclusive"
were all treated better and served first before us. The waiters on the beach and around the pool would serve the non-all inclusive people first because they though they would tip since that wasn't included in their package. SInce the tips were included in our all inclusive package they would serve us last thinking we weren't going to tip.

Our disappointment continued when we went to get lunch right after we got there. We asked to sit outside and we kept waiting for a waiter to come over but no one ever did. There were two waiters walking around ignoring us. This kept happening every time we would go to Naos which was the resorts buffet, Finally on our last couple of days there we finally got to meet two waiters named Luis and Leonardo. We ended up siting in his section the rest of the time, and he treated us very nicely. I would defiantly recommend sitting inside at this buffet if not you will get ignored. The waiters at the restaurants that required a reservation were all great and we would tip them $5 each. 
The pool bar was again slow service, it took forever to get a drink. The problem with this resort is that they seemed understaffed. Most of the time only 2 bartenders were at the pool bar and at one point the other went on break and there was only 1 pool bartender serving 40+ people. 
My last few days there I met a waiter named Erik who was at a side bar. I was happy to get out of the pool and walk to the bar under the palapa restaurant just to have him make my drinks. Having him as a bartender honestly made my miserable vacation so much better.
Don't use the iron they provide!!!!! It burnt directly through my brand new dress!!!!!!
I will surely not return to this resort despite the beautiful property and the delicious gourmet food.

reviews.author: Trevor O
reviews.title: Good and Bad
reviews.text: Happy to help others and share some information about my recent family vacation to the Paradisus Cancun Aug. 13th through 19, 2015.  My kids are 13 and 12 and they are active kids.  We were very disappointment with the amount of seaweed on the beach.  It appears this is a Cancun thing and not isolated to this resort, however everyone is telling me this problem has been going on for some time.  The water temp was excellent, but you really need to swim out about 40 yards to avoid the seaweed.   There is not a lot of activities for the kids.  The resort is safe and we were comfortable letting our kids explore.  Our kids played soccer a lot on the beach with other children.  We rented a beach bed at Cocos Beach Club - Sam our waiter was excellent and very attentive. I highly recommend renting the beach bed - they make the whole experience better - they will work with you on price.  The food - the best meals we had were on the beach bed at Cocos - shrimp and chicken skewers were very good.  We ate at all the restaurants and none of them gave us the WOW factor - however we are not foodies.  All require a reservation, except Blue Agave which was nice if you just wanted quick food with a waiter.  Breakfast was good at the large buffet at Naos.  The hotel itself was very clean and the staff were friendly.  Except for the pool swim up bar - those guys had no personality and never engaged in conversation.  I was very disappointed with our package and the coupons you receive.  They are basically worthless - spend $100 in the gift shop to save $20, etc.  Rooms - There are 5 towers.  the main tower is #3 and I would reommend staying in #2 or #4.  We upgraded to a two bedroom suite and were first placed in tower #1 - just to far of a walk.  we moved halfway to tower #4 and we liked the room and the location - much easier to run up from the beach to your room if you forgot something.  Overall I would give this resort a 4 out of 5 stars.  I enjoy vacationing in the Caribbean more then Mexico.

reviews.author: Vanessa d
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel but needs improvements in diff. areas
reviews.text:
The hotel is beautiful with green plants eveyrwhere.  Great location, beautiful beach and pool area. However, there are a few major issues:
1. Location of the shows is terrible. When we go on vacation, we really enjoy the evening shows. Our kids enjoy the shows and entertainment. The Paradissus hotel has great show but it does not have an appropriate location for shows.  The hotel should consider building an appropriate location with a stage or moving one of the restaurants.
2. Pool - not enough chairs/shade. When we go on vacation, we don't want to worry about finding a place to sit around the pool. Many guests would leave towels for 2+ hours. The staff should monitor the chairs/guests around the pool.  
3. Service around the pool - the guests that rented a bali bed would have great service. We know because we rented for 2 days due the fact we could not find chairs. The bali bed is $50 a day.  Service around the pool needs to improve
4. Restaurants - the market grill and the Asian restaurants are the best restaturants at the Paradissus. All others, needs major improvement on quality of food.  
5. Reservations for restaurants - resevation was required the day before. It was very difficult to get reservations. However, when you walk to the restaurants, there was always many empty tables.

reviews.author: lmchiaca
reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text:
We were in Paradisus Cancun in March 2015. The resort and view was beautiful. The servers and food are very good. Especially Javier and Jorge, their service were top notch. 
Our room bed had badbug and  my husband got bttten all over his arm and leg. We requested changing bed but was ignored. They didn't do anything about it. 
We will not go back to this resort again

reviews.author: drnudy
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: Hotel rooms are not great quality, look old. All inclusive restaurants are booked and can't accommodate large groups. Our group booked 3 months in advance and we couldn't get hotel rooms in the same building. We requested double beds, none available, were given king size single bed room. Took forever to check in to hotel, over an hour.

reviews.author: Tina T
reviews.title: Anniversary trip
reviews.text: 5 Star for Butlers, and waiters, view, service.  3 star for the buildings.  The room was great, but the middle of buildings were horrible.  We traveled in the middle of July for a trip to paradise adults only. We paid for the Royal Service when we made the reservation because we wanted to have an enjoyable time with out kids to relax.  We arrived around 2 and was immediately taken over to the Royal Service side.  Check in was not bad.  Our room had a sea view and was awesome!  It overlooked the pool area and able to see the sea and all it's beauty.  We were assigned a Butler Giroldo(sp) who was awesome.  He got us reservations at all the restaurants, booked the Bali Beds, and made sure all was going okay.  We tipped him good the first day.  Then once again before we left.  Our first nights dinner was at LA PALAPA RESTAURANT by the pool on the Royal Service side.  We had a table right next to the glass railing overlooking the beach.  A wedding had taken place and the reception was going on on the beach with music and dancing.  We could not have made plans any better than that!.  Saturday morning our toilet overflowed and it took more than 3 hours to get it fixed.  Our waiters at the pool Caesar(sp) and one other gentleman were fantastic!  We tipped them good so they were always making sure we were good.  We were lucky (or not) to have had a Bali Bed everyday.  Normally you only have it reserved 2 days.  If you wait until 11:00 who ever did not claim their beds will loose them so that was how we got lucky on two days.  Monday morning we were going to stay in and watch the British Open, but the Cable Box broke.  So another 3 hours to get that fixed.  Needless to say, they were very happy to just get us a reservation for a Bali Bed on Tuesday for all we had to deal with.  It is so close to a top notch place but just does not reach it!  The atriums (all the rooms are on the sides leaving an atrium in the middle) in every building does not have air conditioning or fans.  This makes the breakfast area in the Royal Service building too hot to eat in.  The building which housed the restaurant Vento did not have air conditioning where you ate.  They did have an area that seats people with fans overhead.  We had to be moved to one of those.  The food was top notch in the restaurants!  Beautifully arranged and flavorful.  We only ate breakfast in the Buffet area once.  After the first day of sweating to death in the Royal Service food area we opted to get room service the next day.  Be prepared for an hour or more to get room service delivered.  It was delicious, just took a long time.  We got lost one night trying to get back to our building and was soaking wet when we finally got back to the room.  Too hot in the corridors!  We only travelled from building to building outside after that.  Cooler outside than in.  To make it to a 5 star they only need to put in air conditioning or fans to have air circulation.    My husband has no desire to return because of the air condition problem.  Oh the room air only goes down to 68, but it never gets that cold since when the cleaning people come and the turn down service comes they leave the door open and all the cool air leaves the room while they work  They did put rose pedals on the bed in the shape of a heart and gave us a bottle of Champagne the first night.  The night of the cable box issue, they drew a hot bath and put rose pedals in the bath.  All in all I enjoyed my stay.  Hey it's Cancun, but, I paid a whole lot to stay here and would have liked to have  been comfortable the entire time.  If air conditioning is not a problem for you, then this is a 5 star place!  Also there was a wedding every night we were there.

reviews.author: jkbarryatl
reviews.title: Amazing Staff, Not a 5 star resort
reviews.text:
First let me start with the good, and I should say great because the staff at the Paradisus is absolutely incredible top to bottom. Whether its the bartenders, room cleaners, butlers .. .Everyone goes above and beyond. We had Royal Service and our Butler Galdino did a GREAT job in making sure we had everything we needed. 

Now that the good is out of the way lets talk about the bad. 

AIR CONDITIONING.... I'd say it was bad but i'm pretty sure it didn't exist. I understand that much of the resort is outside and its impossible to cool but I can't think of one place in the resort that is well air conditioned. The lobby, The indoor restaurants, even our room. Our sister had to change rooms it was so bad but when she switched the new one was good. We had 4 rooms at the resort and 3 of them were nice and cold. Ours was cool at best. We could have moved but we were so moved in we didn't want to have to re-pack. 

The food was average at best. La Perla, the steak and pasta restaurant was definitely the best. Mole and the Asian place were close seconds. Everything else was poor. The food at the buffet for lunch and dinner was really poor. 

Note to management. Don't put a tennis court next to a sewage pipe. Yes, I'm serious. Every 10 minutes you get a treat that you DONT want. Also, Upgrade your WIFI, its really bad in most of the hotel. 

As a whole I can't recommend the Paradisus unless they make a lot of changes.

reviews.author: Shelley W
reviews.title: Average Hotel/Service
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying that My husband and I have been to Cancun/Playa Del Carmen about 7 times over the past 10 years. We have always stayed in AI resorts....I rate Paradisus average....this resort is NOT a 5 star resort I am sorry to say. 
We booked a OV suite as we were traveling with our 17 month old. The room was a nice size and enabled us to keep our daughter in a separate sleeping area which was great. The OV while beautiful is limited to standing because of the design of the balcony you cannot sit down and see the ocean. If I was to ever stay here again I would NOT waste my money on OV because of this. When I booked OV I want to be able to sit on my balcony and enjoy the view.
We also booked Family Concierge. While Ramon was very helpful and nice....I would not waste my money on this either. Unless you plan on calling your butler constantly and asking for stuff...you really don’t need this. The backpack and bucket with sand toys was nice but honestly not worth very much...certainly not the cost of the upgrade. The cookies and milk at night was a joke...first two nights we didn’t even get it and its milk that you already have in your fridge and one pathetic looking cookie that didn't taste like much. I called several times (3-4) to get my husband a different pillow and as per the benefits of family con. you get a "pillow menu" which we were never given or offered....anyway we never did receive a new pillow after asking 3-4 times for a new one. 
Since we had to travel around with a stroller...the elevator situation was annoying...long wait times due to the staff using the elevator. Probably because its an older hotel and they don’t have service elevators but just a note...if you will be using a stroller...this can be frustrating at times.
We didn’t have a problem with getting a Palapa at the pool every day because my husband was down there at 5:30-6 am putting out our things....but the pool/beach is very busy so get up early and reserve your spot or you will not have one.
Food was average...not bad but nothing spectacular either...the specialty restaurants were OK...my favorites were Mole (Luis our waiter there twice was GREAT) and Market Grill for Brazilian Steak experience. all others were just average for us.
Lunch pretty much option was buffet...or Taco place (which was pretty good too). First day we were there Market Grill had a menu and it was very good but after that they never had a menu there again and only served hamburgers and pizza?
Seaweed is bad for sure and kind of ruined the beach but hey its mother nature. Resorts were all seemed to do a good job at keeping it under control. 
Pool temp was pretty warm for my taste not very refreshing. Service at pool area was ok...not fastest but not terrible either.
We like our coffee…as I am sure most people do...aside from coffee being out at Naos in the morning before bfast....it is VERY difficult to get coffee at lunch/dinner time...you will get it...it just takes a while and it seems hard to get cream instead of milk as well. Mainly what I mean is you can’t get a coffee on the run...unless you are sitting down in the restaurant you can’t get a coffee? All of the other places we have stayed had coffee house type place where you could always get a coffee no matter time of day.

Overall this was a nice trip...just average not 5 star in our opinion. Was a decent quality for price paid. Staff was friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Sylvia R
reviews.title: Disappointed in  Paradisus
reviews.text: Travelled with grown daughter on July 5-12  .Upon registering was given Pyramid 3 which I said I didn NOT  want because of noise.Clerk at reception said that we had a quiet room on floor 6.It was very  noisy with music-- .so next morning my daughter went to reception & we were given a room in Pyramid 2 facing parking lot.We kept that room as it was quiet & easy to get to pool.     Waiters in Naos were excellent -as was food  So we ate all our meals in Naos--Orlando ,excellent waiter .We   could not   swim in ocean--red flags up every day & beach was covered in seaweed.  No one cleaned away the weeds as they did in the hotel next door.. Therefore pools were crowded & there were many children there.Pool water was very warm.

reviews.author: LuxWorldTraveler
reviews.title: A place to stay and have fun not luxurious
reviews.text:
This is an hotel about 30-40 years old which I am sure was very luxurious then but not any more. The maintenance is not well done and the place plus rooms is very tired and old. All inclusive Hotel food buffet with a lot of variety of dishes
Really good attentive service from all the employees, Most of the employees are of the older generation. The drink service is top notch as they serve premium drinks also. 

Here is the not so good.....went for a weekend and could not rent a cabana claiming they are all booked already. It seems you must book a cabana months in advance before you are even planning in going to Cancun which is pretty ridiculous.  After making a big fuss they finally where able to scrap one. There are not enough cabanas and lounge chairs at the pool. The food is not of high quality dining. The place is old and needs a major renovation from the lobby to the pool and back. Wifi very slow and remember their are 800 rooms. If they were to invest in renovating the whole place it can be something good but you will feel like in the 80s as of now.

reviews.author: Rias10
reviews.title: Just a mediocre resort
reviews.text: Ok let's start with I travel a lot .. I have been staying at all inclusive resorts for the past tens years now. This was not my favorite. Where should we start I got here on July 19 and leave on the 24th . We upgraded to royal service to get better service better pool etc. the first day the pool was. Disgusting empty ketchup packets and sweet and low all throughout the pool. I never complain about anything but I complained to the towel guys and after a hour the pool guy came and cleaned it a little bit. Today was actually the first day since being here I would say the pool was actually clean. Ok let's move on to the buffet / dinner on the verge of horrible . The buffet breakfast lunch and dinner selection was probably the worse I have seen in ten plus years I have been traveling. Dinner restaurants just mediocre bans and agauva was very good. Just not the four star hotel I thought it was going to be. Definetly makes me think if I would ever go to paradisus again. This is not the first paradisus I have been to I went to la perla in riviera maya and Palma real in dr . This hotel should be a three star hotel.

reviews.author: seattle_maslow
reviews.title: Overcrowding spoils the experience
reviews.text:
My family of four just returned from a 7 night stay July 9-16, 2015. 

Overall, this is a nice property, with generally friendly and helpful staff, but the overcrowding, coupled with some rough edges in service and facility,  diminished the experience for us on a number of fronts. 

What we liked
	• The food. The food is the best we've had among many trips to AI resorts.
	• Room service. We used it several times for breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks. Very nice to escape the crowds at the resort. 
	• The staff. Most of the people we encountered were very friendly
	• Checkout was efficient and painless

What we didn't like
Beach chair game: There simply aren't enough beach chairs for all the guests. After getting shut out the first day, I asked an attendant to help us find a spot. He moved someone's hat that was reserving two chairs. Sure enough, the couple came to the spot and were incensed at us, leading to an awkward confrontation--absolutely the last thing I want on vacation. The attendant later told me to reserve a spot with some personal belongings. OK, so I learned to play the game. However, we saw reserved chairs go unoccupied until 4 p.m. Selfish and ridiculous behavior and the hotel encourages it. It wouldn't be so bad if 95% of the chairs weren't reserved by 8 a.m. 

Uneven service: Upon checkin we didn't receive towel cards, so lo and behold we have to trek to the lobby on our first morning at the pool. Housekeeping covered our bathroom drain with the wastebasket causing it to flood. Twice we only received 1-2 towels  (for three people) from housekeeping. We got turndown service two out of seven nights, hard to understand what's the norm? Three days the towel cabana ran out of towels so we were stuck using damp dirty towels. The wait for fresh cooked eggs in the cafeteria ranged from 15-20 minutes. In-room coffee was restocked only twice in seven days. 

The seaweed. Not the hotel's fault, but they essentially stopped trying to address the situation and the seaweed literally piled up most of the days we were there.  

Packed gym: While the gym is reasonably well-equipped, between 7-9 a.m. it's impossible to use a machine without a significant wait. Further, the ceiling leaks directly down onto several of the machines. 

The golf course. The hotel advertises a free 9 hole golf course. It's only a golf course using the most liberal interpretation of the term. It's essentially 9 nicely mowed greens amidst the front lawn. The hotel also lacks any kind of reciprocal arrangement or discounted rate with a real golf course.

reviews.author: J W
reviews.title: Great Resort but only gave it 3 out of 5
reviews.text: My wife and I just got back from this resort.  It was awesome.  Only gave it a 3 out of 5 and here is the reason.  When we arrived at the resort, we were greeted by staff who took us to the check in line.  There was 3 lines and very busy.  The line we were in was very slow.  We waited in line for 1 hour to get checked in.  When it was finally our turn, the lady behind the desk, picked up her purse, said something & left for the day.  We stood there about another 5 min with no one wanting to help us.  We asked for a manager from staff who was standing behind the lines.  She went and advised the manager that we requested him.  He sent another staff member over to us.  This person was great.  He had us checked in, in less than 10 minutes and upgraded us to Royal Service.  We enjoyed the location of the building and the private pool & beach (no kids).  We were never assigned a butler.  Every time we made reservations for the cabana's at the pool or at a restaurant, the staff would say your butler needs to do this.  When we advised we were never assigned a butler, no one ever tried to help us get one assigned to us.  This was my only main complaint.  If you are going to upgrade someone, make sure they get the FULL upgrade.  Other than this, the food was great & the staff was very easy to work with.  They will try to sell you a membership to the Media Club.  It is a 90 minute presentation with NO pressure.  My wife and I did it just to get a $200 Catamaran adventure for free.  You do not have to go to presentation if you do not want.  The only other complaint I have is they need a theatre/stage for their shows.  They have their shows in the entry way of the Avenue Bar and everyone pulls chairs around this to watch. If there was a theatre, it would have been a better experience with the shows.

reviews.author: John Martin B
reviews.title: Mediocre experience at Paradisus
reviews.text: Pool doesn't have enough chairs.  Buffet has variety but food was not hot.  Disappointing to have to make reservations a day in advance for meals. Entertainment was excellent but the venue where it was located was far too small.  Jesus and Victor made the dining expereinces fabulous!  Jesus goes out of his way to make your dining experience the best -- he made our trip!

reviews.author: Amy R
reviews.title: Not exactly what we were expecting
reviews.text:
We are members of the Melia Vacation Club and this year we decided to go to Cancun.  Other reviews are right, unless you are a member expect to spend half a day with a salesman.  Remember if you tell them you not interested in a timeshare they will say no problem just meet us, it's not a timeshare.  That way they get you there and sell you on the fact that it is a club not a timeshare.

We were not able to get in the ocean due to large amounts of seaweed on the beach and in the water.  They did clean the seaweed off the beach but only every other day, so you truly could not enjoy it.  

The pool could have been amazing but the water was as hot as the air.  I do understand that kids go on vacation, but it was like being at Disney.  It did not bother me to much until I was ready to use the swim up bar, but could not sit nor hardly get close to it because of all the kids.  Yes, you can get the Royal Service so it is basically adults only but you looking at about an extra $100 a day per person.  By the way Salvador the bartender was amazing!

The buffet was ok, yes they do have tons of choices but it was not the best food to us.  Now the restaurants were amazing, but portions are small, but when I say amazing they truly are.  Make sure to book your restaurant 24 horse in advance or you may be stuck at the buffet.

Now the resort itself and the staff were amazing.  They did try to accommodate everything and the atmosphere was great in the resort.
