The beach was beautiful, one of the best we’ve been to.  I loved that they didn’t use towel cards but depending on who is manning the towels, you may be restricted to how many you can have.  There is drink service on the beach and waiters come through at regular intervals.  

Overall, we had a good vacation.  Everyone we met was kind and provided great service.  However, the amenities that we like in a resort were lacking so we probably will not stay at the Paradisus on our next trip to Cancun.

reviews.author: EV1970294478
reviews.title: A bit dissapointed
reviews.text:
I would have given this resort more stars but...  We were supposed to get a room upgrade for being an EXPEDIA VIP member. At check in they said they didnt have any, etc. Then they said they were going to "Upgrade" me to an ocean view room (which is what I originally paid for).
Tired of arguing, plus a long flight we decided to take the room. Bathroom lights didnt work, one of the hot water faucets didnt work, and mini-firdge not working. So I go back and tell them I dont care about where they move us just give another room. 2 days later they inform me that the general manager was looking for me. He apologizes and says he's got me a Junior suite and will take care of moving all our stuff (This is the upgrade I should have gotten on day one..!)  From here on everything is looking great. Enjoyed the food, the restaurants were nice, the drinks were well made and strong (not watered down), and the staff service great (I must say the staff in general were excellent). So, everything great and would have forgotten the "hiccup at checking".   I checked out the day we left and paid all extra charges we had.  Well..... when I got back home and check my credit card statement there was a $300 dollar charge that I never made. After 2 months of disputing and calling CITIBANK the resort finally acknowledge they "accidentally" ran and charged my card erroneously at one of their restaurants (There is one restaurant that is not ALL Inclusive as well as any bottles of wine you consume at any restaurants).
To this day I m still waiting The whole charge settled with the credit card company.
Dont think I will return.  Too bad because it is a nice resort.

reviews.author: Joseph R
reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: We were very disappointed with the room we were given at check in. It looked like a garage and the view from the balcony was a wall. We received better accommodations after we expressed our displeasure with the reception desk. It was not the best way to start a relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: Wendy M
reviews.title: Less than "Royal Service"upon arrival......
reviews.text:
Let me start off by saying we previously stayed at Paradisus Punta Cana in Royal Service Suite and it was one of our best vacations ever which led us to choose this resort.  After a two and a two and a half hour flight delay and a hectic one and a half hour adventure getting thru customs and waiting 1/2 hour to get on our airport transfer we arrived at the resort to check in around 5:30
pm. We were greeted by a sorry your room isn't ready yet - no real excuse but why don't you have a cocktail and we will try to get it ready- went back hour later still not ready - by this time I
just wanted a shower and to relax and have dinner - they offered us another room we could just
shower in and then they would move us after - I said no wanted our room and wanted to shower
and not be moved. we went to dinner - still with no room  - on our way back we stopped in to 
main resort check in and asked to speak with manager - I was exhausted and very upset - he made a call got us our room in royal service gave us our keys and had our luggage sent there - he apologized and told us he would email the Royal Service Manager and have him contact us
regarding the problem - we were there til Wednesday morning - NEVER heard from him!!!!!!

reviews.author: Harry__Hood95
reviews.title: Beautiful beach, average food
reviews.text:
Just got back from a week-long stay at the Paradisus Cancun.  We were booked at the Paradisus Playa del Carmen, but after the hour-long bus ride to Playa, we were told that they had over-booked and would have to send us to Cancun.  We weren't happy, but made the most of it because this is a very nice resort.  Nowhere near as nice as the resort in Playa that we paid for, but still more than adequate for our needs.

To start, we had an ocean view room on the 5th floor, and the view was stunning.  The room itself was nice but not special,  The fridge was stocked with beer and soda, but no liquor for cocktails which was disappointing as most resorts I've stayed at in the past provided whatever you wanted in your room.  Our TV went out one day and it took longer than it should have to get someone up to take a look at it.  And we only had one chair on our balcony, even though we could see plenty of other rooms that had two.  

The food was good...not great but I didn't have any complaints.  We ate at most of the restaurants and nothing stood out for being especially great or poor.  Only real problem was that it was almost impossible to get reservations at a decent hour.  Seriously, book your reservations EARLY if you don't want to be eating dinner at 9:30 or later.      

The pool was nice & big, very good swim-up bar and it allowed you to enjoy the sun almost all day.  Not even close to enough chairs, and no floats or anything to lounge around in the water.  Also, it's not a big deal but the pool was really deep (I think 5+ feet) with no shallow areas besides the kids area.  Not enough chairs is a pretty big negative.

Beach was very well maintained, which is a big plus for me. Again, not even close to enough chairs, but I don't mind laying down a towel in the sand so it didn't bother me.  I did a fair amount of walking up and down the beach, and it seemed the Paradisus's beach was as-well or better-maintained than almost any other resorts on that strip of beach.  

Service was very friendly, although things seemed disorganized.  We waited 2-3 hours to get our room, with very little input as to what to do in the interim.  There wasn't much of a map, or list of restaurants or spa services or pricing for excursions that I saw.  I was interested in either taking a day-trip excursion or getting a massage at some point; however it was near impossible to tell what desks were for what, who worked for the resort or who was a "tour-guide pitchman", or how much things cost.  

I would definitely stay at this resort again for the right price, and would recommend it to a friend as the resort was clean, the staff was friendly and the beach was gorgeous.  It's not a 5-star place, but you're not paying 5-star prices so as long as you have the right expectations you should have a great time.

reviews.author: Brent B
reviews.title: Hit and Miss
reviews.text: This hotel had some good points and also some bad points on our trip.  The facilities are mostly very nice.  They have 3 nice pools, one of which is no kids, if you upgrade to the "Royal Service".  The staff was nice and seemed to be very customer minded.  The rooms seemed a bit dated and in my opinion, need updated.  Every morning when we went to the beach and pool, it seemed there was not enough beach chairs with umbrellas and the chairs around the pool seemed to be in short supply.  We actually did not sit on the beach any because of not having enough chairs and umbrellas.  The spa was so-so.  Not the worst message but a far cry from the best I have had.  The food was ok for an all inclusive.  I did think the breakfast was not very good.  I would go back, but also would have my eyes out for something better.

reviews.author: jjorow
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel, Terrible Food
reviews.text:
My wife and I booked this hotel for a quick getaway for four nights over Valentine's weekend. The lobby, pool area, and beach at this hotel are beautiful, but the hotel is very large and can be difficult to get around. We kept running into dead ends and had to go up and down flights of stairs to get to where we wanted to go. Check in was a disaster with long waits in line and then an even longer check in process once you got to the counter.

The pools were beautiful, but they were unheated (it wasn't working), and all of the Jacuzzis were ice cold. There was also construction of a cinder block wall going on in the pool area. There are a lot more people than there are chairs, so you have to get there early to get a spot.

The biggest issue we had was with the food, none of which was what we expected after reading descriptions on the website. Market Square is a Brazilian style restaurant and was good, Mole was described as Mexican but had a menu that looked so bad we cancelled our reservation, and at Vento my wife and I ordered 3 entrees to split and there was barely enough food for one of us. On top of that the filet was inedible. We left there and went to the buffet. The buffet is nothing special and the food was always cold. At breakfast, rather than have eggs in a chafing dish, you have to wait in line and order them to be cooked for you. We also had to wait a long time for them to refill anything that runs out. At lunch and dinner, most of the food had a Mexican flair to it. They do not have standard fare like hamburgers or chicken strips there. There was never silverware or condiments on the tables, and you had to ask and then wait for everything. As far as drinks, it was all standard. I read a review that said the drinks were top shelf, but I never saw anything better than average, i.e. Absolut Vodka, Cuervo Tequila.

On the plus side, the room was very nice and the people were very friendly. Overall we had a great time and made the best of it, but by the end of the trip we had pretty much given up on the food and were eating bread for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

reviews.author: Sunshine525593
reviews.title: Hotel Paradisus, Cancun
reviews.text: Have just returned from a two week stay at the Paradisus with my wife.On arrival we were impressed with the service until we had the hard sell of upgrading to royal service ,we declined ,the price dropped and we declined again. Our room [1514] had a lagoon view which was not a problem other than the room was set back and so we had very limited view to the right hand side.We only had one sun lounger on the balcony but decided not to complain as there wasn't room on the balcony anyway. The first week seemed quite quiet with no problems having to queue for restaurants etc or sunloungers on the beach.                 The breakfast was first class as was the lunch.The evening buffet was disappointing with most of the food only luke warm.There appeared to be a problem with a lack of spoons on the tables as we had to ask every day, also no condiments on the table.We also had the problem of going to select food and finding somebody else sitting at your table, this happened on more than one occassion. During the second week it appeared to be much busier and people were entering the restaurant, selecting food and then realising there were no tables available. We were told that the large round restaurant by the pool would not be open during the two weeks we were staying.We also noticed another bar near the main walkway to the beach was closed during our stay.                                                         The only bar that appeared to be open during the evening was the Avenue which hosted the caberat which was of a very good standard, the only problem was if you didn't get there early there were no seats.We found that there were very few areas that we could sit and have a drink and a chat.                                       My thoughts on the hotel are that it couldn't cope when busy and that it could really do with a upgrade as it was not much more than a four star standard hotel although the staff really worked hard.

reviews.author: rubentko
reviews.title: An average hotel, with friendly staff
reviews.text:
This hotel's best days may be past and it's age is showing, but the staff are incredibly friendly. My family and I (daughter, aged 10) visited during the New Year's week. First, the food is better than average. Most meals are at the Nao's, a buffet style restaurant. Food's hit or miss and frankly not really that bad, if you know what to look for and how to ask for certain things (like omelets). In the evening, I'd recommend the Blue Agave, a really good restaurant. No kids allowed, however, but the cuisine is worthy springing for a sitter.  There's also a restaurant called La Perla, which is all sea food but a good choice if Nao's is crowded. I agree with other comments about the long waits to enter Nao's.

Our room, tho with an ocean view, was smallish and again, needed a little TLC. The bed was relatively comfortable but the fridge was scantily stocked with local beers and water. 

The pools are standard, with the typical swim-up bar and a kid's pool. It's true that seating around is limited and you have to be an early bird to get pool-side lounges. But perhaps what bothered me most with the outside of the hotel (and probably overall) is that the beach, which as has been noted is public, is accessible by two sets of stairs from the pool/hotel area down to the beach. So the hotel doesn't have that "integrated" ocean/pool/hotel feeling like others I've been at. There's a physical barrier and again, it's not a big thing but this bothered me and it may you too if you have kids and want to easily go from pool to ocean / ocean to pool….The beach itself is nice and clean however. 

This is the second year in a row that I've been to Cancun area and like before I recommend taking single dollar bills to leave as tips to the staff. A buck here and there really means a lot to these folks who work very hard. 

The interior of the hotel is pretty nice, I must say. The center "pyramid" is where all the action takes place in the evening. Again, here, this central area is feels apart from the beach and ocean because there are these large (somewhat dirty) windows. 

The hotel is about 10-15 minutes from downtown Cancun by cab and the airport, too. You can probably do better in the central Cancun zone but such hotels probably also charge more. In my view, the setting and food is important, so I would look for a newer hotel. But if you get a really good deal then go for it. You can't really have a bad time in Cancun when you have a gorgeous ocean, friendly people, food at the beck and call and an unlimited supply of libations!

reviews.author: Gutierre_Blanco
reviews.title: Underwhelming family concierge experience
reviews.text:
If you are Looking for a vacation filled with disappointment then this is it. We were very disappointed with the entire experience and are surprised with all the positive reviews which just can't be true, or maybe we were just unlucky. We paid a premium for family concierge and the one bedroom suite but felt that we were constantly haggling for every single thing every single day.  

We are a family with two kids aged 4 and 2 and felt that the resort did not cater to this demographic. 

1.  Our butler was terrible. We got nothing from her and none of the perks that some of the other members mention in their reviews. Not worth the premium to get two free backpacks with some trivial items included. 

2. Getting a spot on the pool was hard. Not enough beds to accommodate the demand and if you wanted a Bali bed then you had to reserve in advance and hope they can accommodate you.  Again they offered us a bed in the adult area which was not appropriate. We haggled and finally got a bed by the kids pool. 

3.  Wifi is spotty and not reliable. I know this is supposed to be a vacation but these days connectivity is more for the kids than the adults. 

4.  Food is resort food (ie to be expected) but service is average and wait times for food and drink is much longer than anywhere else. They don't let you take food out to be consumed elsewhere like around the pool or in the room. 

5. If you have young kids and put them to bed early and have to hang around the room then forget about in room dining. The food is pool bar type food and they cannot bring wine or alcoholic drinks. You have a daily quota of 4 cans of beer which was their response to our request for some wine. Finally after much haggling we got a bottle of white wine which they did as a favour to us. But we had to haggle and I hate haggling on vacation. 

6. Spa is overpriced and overrated. No wonder it was empty. Our 50 min massage was 20 mins long. After we complained they offered to give us another massage for the full 50mins. Again. More haggling required. 

7. The beach was very nice. But then again it is a public beach. Still hard to find a spot to sit or free beds. 

8. Grounds are above average and staff is very friendly. They always say hello and were quick to respond to requests such as extra shampoo or forgetting to give the milk and cookies they promised the kids (4 of 7 days). However I did not feel like I was getting any premium service given that we paid a huge premium to stay here. 

9. Resort did not cater to younger kids and to be honest I did not see many families with our kids ages (4 and 2). Bathrooms not convenient to the restaurant area and you always had to go up and down stairs, ie all the amenities were spread across 2 floors which isn't an issue for older kids and adults of course but gets trickier when they are younger or if you have to lug a stroller around. 

I normally don't go out of my way to complain and we are a low maintenance family. However I was sold on this place being a premiere family oriented resort and frankly I felt ripped off. I tried to be specific so that others can get a better sense of the negative feedback I am giving this resort.

reviews.author: Valeri W
reviews.title: They have made changes not for the better
reviews.text:
My husband and I were at the Paradisus for the 1st week of February. This is our 5th trip to this hotel-we always came back because of the good food and spectacular service. I am very disappointed in the resort this year in that they have made changes that are not for the better. I do not know that we will be back again. They have eliminated the the pool menu and delivery of meals on the beach or at the pool. This is very disappointing as we enjoyed that and would tell others to stay at this resort because they would serve you food and drinks on the beach. A lot of other resorts do not do that. If you want a noon meal your options are the buffet or the Market-with a limited menu. We could not get a pizza unless we went to our room and ordered room service. This is a very big disappointment and if you were a family with kids you would really be limited. There was a small area where they had hamburgers and hotdogs and you could get a bag of chips with it but that was it.  Very disappointing! Our bright spots on this trip were the staff.  Arturo-our concierge was absolutely amazing and went above and beyond to help us with issues we may have. We had issues with our Air Conditioner which was supposed to have been fixed and the next day it still was not working. Arturo made some calls and said if it did not get fixed they would get us a new room. We also had the absolute best service from Miguel Gabriel Quinones at the Pool Bar. He would always start our day with a bottle of water and make sure we had everything we needed.  He was the best!!! 
We have been Melia Timeshare owners for several years and this is the 1st year we have been disappointed.  We have always thought that there should be more upgrades done to the facility, but realize that it is very expensive to upgrade a property of this size. Some of the changes they have made have been really good but eliminating the pool menu and food delivery are not good changes. They now do not require you to have towel cards. Not a big deal but just one more thing you had to keep track of while at the resort in the past that you no longer have to do. 
The Vento and Market Grill restaurants were very good and we really enjoy these. The buffet is average but most buffets are. The Blue Aquave tequila bar is VERY good.  The staff there is very accomodating and helpful.  We also enjoy going to the Avenue bar in the evening before our meal. The staff is excellent! We would come back to the Avenue bar after our meal for the entertainment. It was always very good. 
We were very disappointed in the Super Bowl party this year. If you wanted a table you had to reserve it for a cost of $160. Not worth that kind of money. You did get a bottle of alcohol and a tray of snacks for that $160. The tray of snacks that you could order was $23.50 and consisted of 4 chicken wings, 4 onion rings, 4 hotdog snacks and that was it. You could not order your snack tray until 7 pm and by the time we got ours 50 minutes later it was cold. Last year they set up La Perla for the Super Bowl and had buffets of food available for you. When you pay for the all inclusive and you are planning on this being your meal since the game is right over the supper hour, you would like a little more than cold snacks that are supposed to be hot. VERY DISAPPOINTING!!!!!
As others have posted we always bring money for tips. They claim with your all inclusive fees tips are included but how do you know what your servers are receiving. They work very hard and very long days for probably not much money. We feel they deserve the extra. 
With the changes that have been made at the resort we do not know that we will be back. They have not been good changes. We were very disappointed in the resort this year.

reviews.author: Kateenelson
reviews.title: Beautiful, but disappointing food
reviews.text: My husband and I have been to several resorts and this one was up there in how beautiful it was and the service was good, but the food was not great. The buffet was not very good, the mole a la carte was not good either. The sushi a la carte was very good though, as well as the market grill and fuego were pretty good. The entertainment shows were good, but the location is terrible. They don't have a stage, it's just in a bar and it's hard to get seats where you can see the whole show. The service was great, staff is very friendly and the snack bars were awesome!

reviews.author: USCThersa
reviews.title: Nice hotel, poor service
reviews.text:
This is the 2nd all-inclusive hotel I stayed at in cancun.  The hotel itself is pretty nice.  But the service is not at the 4 or 5 star level, nor was the food (except Mole, which was very tough to get reservation at).  Here are some of the reasons why I only gave it 3 stars.
-  They up sell you the "royal service" but didn't really get any of the special services.  The exclusive "restaurant" was just a poolside cafe, that was open for a few hours a day.  The food available in the atrium was terrible.  Basically, you get an adult only pool with chance to reserve a cabana. 
-  House keeping did not refill all the amenities everyday
-  They don't really respond to your requests, we had to call a few times to ask for things
-  Restaurants were only open at night by reservation.  And the food was not very good
Overall, their service was very restrictive and not accommodating, very frustrating. 

There  were some positives though
-  Food and service at Mole restaurant was good.  Our server Roberto was very professional.
-  Pool was very clean
-  Hotel was very big, and had a huge beach front

With all the options in Cancun, I would not be going to Paradisus again.

reviews.author: Bernardo S
reviews.title: Fairly good experience, but with reservations
reviews.text: The general quality of the Hotel was very good. The restaurants were generally good except the steak house, the Pearl Restaurant where the steak was so tough that I had to return it. The room needs some structural repairs because the rain semi flooded the room through the sliding door to the terrace. And I really regreted that the pool and the whirlpool were not heated, and, at least for us, unusable because the water was really cold. The attention from the staff was excelent

reviews.author: Betty L
reviews.title: Horrendous HORRENDOUS Service
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun and had absolutely horrendous service.  The Paradisus facilities were fine, the customer service was atrocious.  We checked in and our room wasn't ready, but it was before 3pm so we went to the beach.  Upon looking around there were several bars/restaurants closed.  When we asked why the beach bar was closed, we were told there were not enough customers to keep them all open.  We had just listened to a 5 minute speech on all the beautiful facilities.  So,  we had been lied to upon check in about the availability and times of all the facilities.  We were also bounced around three times when we asked where we could best change.  We were first sent from the check in desk to a concierge.  There was no sign for a concierge, so we asked again and were told to wait.  Once no one came we began to wander the hotel.  Once on the beach there were no beach chairs.  We asked if two could be brought since the hotel was at such low capacity, we were told to wait 10 minutes, so we waited again.  The waiter got a staff member and 15 minutes later he came with no chairs but we were told we could pay to upgrade for chairs.  This is a hotel that is not full enough to open 2 or 3 bars and restaurants a day but I need to pay for a beach chair?  Then we waited for our email telling us our room was ready.  We went to the desk after receiving our email and were told our room wasn't ready because it was not yet 3pm.  My husband told the staff we packed up and left a sandy beach because we had received an email saying our room was ready.  We were told to wait again and I thought my husband was going to walk out and book a new hotel room at a different hotel right then.  No one apologied to us, no one offered an explanation.  We were told to wait 10 minutes.  The front desk staff didn't tell us which tower, or where to go, just a room key with no words.  After wandering the hotel AGAIN we found the tower we needed and out room.  The fridge in the room was turned off, all the beverages were warm and smelled of stank unplugged refrigerator.  The TV was lopsided about 20 degrees off of center.  We decided to shake it off and get ready for the Super Bowl, which was shown on large screen tv's at the top of the lobby of the hotel.  We arrived to be told, once again, that there were no open seats, but if we wanted to upgrade and pay 80 dollars we could have one of the 25 open reserved BEDS/CHAISE in the bar.  We paid for an all inclusive resort only to be asked over and over again to wait and that if we wanted basic services like a beach chair or a seat in a bar before a Super Bowl we had to PAY MORE money.  The screens were horrid, there was options for 100 more seats if they brought it chairs and could have left their cheesy beds for those who wanted beds in a lobby bar.  The spots we found we on the back side of a projection screen so we saw the reverse image.  It was a joke.  My husband ordered room service after the game and was asked twice how he wanted his burger, medium please.  It arrived as a hocked puck, over done and not freshly prepared.  It was inedible.  It was a joke.  The service was a joke.  It was a waste of emotions and our time and money.

reviews.author: Rogier B
reviews.title: Good Price/Quality Hotel.... Rooms are little bit dated and leaky
reviews.text:
Location: 5
Cleanliness: 4
Bathroom: 3
Amenities: 4
Room Space: 4
Bed and Matrass : 4
Staff: 4

TIP: Book directly at the hotel website: much cheaper than any other hotel website.

We stayed here at the one bedroom suite with familiy concierge. The extra familiy concierge is really worth the extra bucks: personalized check in, bali bed, beach chairs and the extra service and attention. We loved the beach area which is very broad, clean (staff cleans out all the seaweed in the morning) and the beach umbrellas and chairs are excellent. There is drink service at the beach (more attention at the Familiy Concierge and Royal Service areas). PArt of the Familiy Concierge is some beach accesiories for the kids which our 18 month old used all day long. We liked the restaurants and bars of this hotel and also the overall layout. 

Minor points: When it rains it really leaks everywhere in the room and hotel. Our bathroom had a unpleasant smell the whole week; we asked for cleaning staff to do something about it but was only partly succesfull. When staying in Building 3; you can really hear the noise from the night entertainment in your room and there were construction noises from midnight till 2 am on one of th nights we stayed there even though we complained at the reception about it.

All in all; loved this hotel but did not love the room itself. Because we booked through the hotel website we got a very good deal so price quality was OK. Do not know if I would stay in the same hotel again; would probably look for something different next time.

reviews.author: Guatemala32139
reviews.title: Mixed emotions on our 47th anniversary. suite 3318
reviews.text: First day was bad the check in not good at all it was a total disappointmen the person that was to take care of us ( Alfonso ) had us about one hour trying to sell us anything and everything that came to his mind it was absurd, we were tired and wanted to rest the next day he came to ask us again if we wanted to do as he wanted and finally i had to tell him to get lost.                  The hotel is nice and the rest of the people were ok especially a lady at the restaurant Nao her name is Sandra she was great we really liked all her attentions she manifested towars us.         Warning to the traveler be aware of this individuals who want to take you and sell you everything they can.      Riley's

reviews.author: s1rscub
reviews.title: Good and Bad
reviews.text: Nice location, nice beach, nice hotel overall. Fortunately the buffet restaurant offers a great variety of options and good food because in order to dine in one of the other restaurants (6), you need to make a reservation a few days in advance apparently - that was an area of disappointment since we stayed only a couple of nights and managed to dine in one restaurant only, which was an average experience (good food but lengthy service). Beach and swimming pool are great but we had a hard time finding some beach chairs and umbrella - which we needed because we have a 2 year old. There is wifi in common areas but not in all rooms - another area of frustration.

reviews.author: Tom A
reviews.title: Paradisus Vacation
reviews.text: The facility is one of most beautiful that I have visited, rooms are very nice, clean and well kept, most of time. All service people we dealt with below management level were some of the best and friendliest help you ask for. Guest services and management level personnel was a different story.  We were misled from check-in to leaving by guest services management level people. Example, not enough chairs at pool side and no one there to assist guests, many conflicts between guests over chairs.Second example, we were told at check-in that only one restaurant required advance reservations, wrong, all but one did. We did not misunderstand, had the lady repeat it several times. We will not return to this resort until they get it together on a management level. They also have a real nice par three golf course, but we were told no loaner clubs we could rent. We were not the only ones feeling this way about the management.

reviews.author: Daph B
reviews.title: Ok, but never again!
reviews.text: We had a family of 8 stay here over the holidays. I will start with the fact that I travel to the Cancun area at least twice a year, so I have a clear understanding of almost every all-inclusive resort there. For starters, the check in/out process is absolute chaos! There is not near enough staff to accommodate the number of people coming in or out of this resort. It took an hour just to get room keys, & even longer to check out. This was during the week days, not even the weekend.The double rooms have tiny beds, & no sofa at all for seating. Nowhere did I ever read this place requires 24 hr advance reservations at ALL of the al-a-carte restaurants, none of which are great. Even when I made reservations, our large party was given a "limited" menu. It is nearly impossible to get a chair anywhere on the beach or at the pool if you are not out there before 10am claiming your spot. There is only one buffet that is a feeding frenzy with kids hands in everything, & people running all over the place grabbing food or waiting in a line to get food. Considering we spent (over $16k), I expected a little better treatment & service. Even the "nightly" shows are impossible to get a seat at since they are in a very small bar area with virtually no seating. The  excursion planning was a disaster as well when our ride arriving 2+ hours before the scheduled time, dragging us out of bed with no food or anything prior to leaving. No credits or consolation offered, just "sorry about the misunderstanding". I will not be returning to this property again based on the lack of service, accommodations & impersonal treatment.

reviews.author: Duncan G
reviews.title: Mixed bag at Cancun All Inclusive
reviews.text:
First the good news. The Mexican people at this resort and in all of Cancun were uniformly nice. All of the hotel staff were fantastic and made our stay all the more enjoyable. The location is great, less than 20 minutes from the airport. The beach is beautiful with great sand and clean warm water. The hotel pools are nice although the water was cold when we were there. There were no hot tubs that we saw but we had a hot tub on our deck outside of our room.

 The food was ok. One restaurant, La Perla, was very good. The buffet was just average, with limited selections and so-so quality. The pool grill was not good. Pre-cooked burgers, undercooked hot dogs, and nachos with melted cheese were the choices. 

The nightly entertainment was very good. 4 of our 6 nights we really enjoyed the music and dancing shows in the Avenue Bar. 

The hotel itself was very large and in need of a toal renovation. Chipping paint was every where. Broken fixtures in the room. When we were there it rained and there were so many leaks it felt like we were on a cruise ship. The check in staff ,while friendly, were incredibly slow. The housekeeping was spotty. We asked multiple times for more towels or the mini-bar to be replenished. They always resoponede quickly but we had to call. 

The gym is old and small and very difficult to find. The spa was good and a well deserved shout out should go to my massage therapist Yarelli who gave a fantastic deep tissue massage. 

Overall I would give the entire experience a C+/B-. Its hard to critize the freindly people and the beautiful beach but the other issues dragged down our rating.

reviews.author: jetsetter82_11
reviews.title: DECENT for the price but never again
reviews.text:
- same ol' food, majority buffet
- minimal selection
- watered down liquor
- amazing beach front
- decent pool 
- no music
- very lame energy
- nice wait staff but no service at the pool unless we stood @ bar
- great scenery in hotel but we were 22 ppl and they had us spread out between the entire hotel
- def recommend coco bongo nightclub
- they also have cabana section w hookah to the left of the pool, def worth checking out

reviews.author: darjosh
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun- Poor beach service and customer service
reviews.text: First thing - Bad Beach service - ran out of towels by 9 am on more than one day. Restaurants, - La perla has a good steak but the Mexican food at Mole was not good. I have been to mexico before and have had a great authentic mexican meal and this was by far no comparison. I am of the belief if you say something, honour it. We asked for an upgraded room to have an ocean view and were willing to pay for it, however, it was not available for the day that we arrived. We said that was okay, however, they called us to come get our key for the new room the next, it was not what we requested. They wasted our time for more than 1.5 hours when we could have been outside enjoying the great weather. The employee we dealt with (Adrian) who also worked with us the day before about getting the upgrade now was saying the original one was not available and was trying to tell us to switch to another room (and this room he told us the day before was not good because there was no view). I wouldn't feel comfortable recommending this resort to my family or friends, so, I would say there are probably better options for the price in Cancun.

reviews.author: Ivan F.
reviews.title: Hotel Facilities + / Room and Beach Services -
reviews.text:
Your first impression on Paradisus Cancun will be amazing: it looks beautiful, fancy and huge. And it is.
The hotel facilities are amazing and the staff very helpful and friendly.
The rooms are nice, with comfortable beds, nice shower and an amazing ocean view. By the way, the beach in front of the hotel is great!

The restaurants are good and I was able make reservations to all of them. Don't expect a menu with a lot of options though - in general there aren't many options in the menu.

Despite these great qualities I probably wouldn't return to this hotel for two special reasons:

- The room service was slow and weak: in one of  my days at the hotel I had to ask 3 times to have my room made -  and it just happened in the end of the day. In another day there were only 2 towels in our bathroom, and we were 3 people there (!!!)

- The beach service was AWFUL! You have to ask 3 times for a drink and wait around half hour to have it. There was only ONE waitress/waiter for an entire session of the beach. If you are at Club Meliá building or in another "premium" building (they call them pyramids 5 and 1) you will have special attention, otherwise you will wait a lot. Another negative point: there are 2 main pools for "regular" customers and one of them (in front of Grill restaurante) doesn't have a single bar, which makes the other overcrowded. Premium users also have their own pools and bars.

Paradisus Cancun overall is a great hotel, but I think it is possible to find better options in Cancun if you look for better room and beach services. I will do it next time.

***

Sua primeira impressão no Paradisus Cancun será incrível: o hotel parece bonito, luxuoso e bem grande. E realmente é.
A estrutura do hotel é ótima e a equipe muito cordial, atenciosa e pronta para ajudar.
Os quartos são ótimos, com camas confortáveis, bom chuveiro e uma linda vista para o oceano. Aliás, a praia em frente ao hotel é ótima!

Os restaurantes são bons e consegui fazer reservas para todos eles. No entanto, não espere  menus com muitas opções.

Apesar dessas ótimas qualidades, eu provavelmente não retornaria a esse hotel por duas razões especiais:

- O serviço de quarto foi fraco e lento: em um dos dias da minha estadia eu tive que pedir 3 vezes para que arrumassem meu quarto - e isso só aconteceu no final do dia. Em outro dia haviam apenas 2 toalhas no nosso banheiro, e estávamos em 3 pessoas no quarto (!!!).

-  O serviço de praia foi PÉSSIMO! Você tem que pedir 3 vezes por uma bebida e esperar por volta de meia hora até que ela chegue. Havia apenas UM garçom/garçonete para uma sessão inteira da praia. Se você está no Club Meliá ou em outra sessão "premium" do hotel (eles chamam de pirâmides 5 e 1), você terá uma atenção especial, caso contrário terá que esperar muito. Outro ponto negativo: existem duas piscinas principais para "hóspedes comuns" e uma delas (em frente ao restaurante Grill) não tem nenhum bar, o que faz com que a outra esteja lotada e tumultuada o tempo todo. Hóspedes "premium" também tem suas próprias piscinas e bares.

Paradisus Cancun no geral é um ótimo hotel, mas acho que é possível encontrar melhores opções em Cancun caso você busque bons serviços de quarto e praia. É o que farei da próxima vez.

reviews.author: Mimi_Renee
reviews.title: Hotel feel
reviews.text: When we arrived on December 28, we were very impressed with the inside design and look of the space and restaurants.  One negative is they have this strong scent everywhere, it actually makes us feel nauseous.  The restaurant service is amazing, 5 star for sure.  The restaurant buffet is always the same.  We liked most of the restaurants but nothing great. The beach in front of the hotel is amazing, there is a sandbar and it's safe.  Our daughter did not like the kids club.  We can't even leave our child there and go for a walk on the beach, we can't leave the premises, we have to check on her every 45 minutes, so we decided to not put her in the kids club.  The pool is alright, too deep for fun play.  We can never find chairs at the beach or pool.  The rooms are not 5 stars, typical Mexican décor, orange, dark wood furniture.  We are content but we will not return.

reviews.author: pppman2013
reviews.title: Staff is great, management has to stop upselling...
reviews.text:
I am currently staying here, and have another week+ to go.  I am enjoying the restaurants, and service.  The hotel is great with lots of amenities.

I am perturbed by the lack of lounge chairs available, in comparison to the (rentable) bali-beds around the pool.  These beds take up space, so the net amount of 'seating' by the pool is somewhat reduced.  As a non-upgraded (they try to sell you Family Concierge and Royal Service packages), you have to seek out the relatively few lounge chairs, while the bali-beds are booked and unavailable.  I see people laying towels on the grass, and any available space.

So, I broke down and ask about paying for a day use of the bali-beds.  It is not available.  The cost would be $50/day.  So, I am faced with the realization that management has geared this hotel towards making an disproportionate amount of upgraded amenities to guests, but at a somewhat maxed out level (week 51 & 52), the non-upgraded guests are left with little space to hang around.  It may seem like a sound strategy to enhance upwell, but when the aviallablility is too low, it becomes pretty transparent that this needs a correction.

I am a marketer (Product Manager), and can recognize the upwell approach to harvest revenue/profits through extra packages on an older property.  I can comment on the rain leakiness of the the hotel, but thats a different issue.  What I am raising here is that the ratio of premium/commoner reserved amenities seems too disproportionate, and the transparency of this problem is rather annoying to me.

I can go shopping at Walmart ad buy a bunch of cheap chairs and sit around, what can I do, can't find a lounge chair unless forced to upgrade, and even then, the space available (if I pay for the upgrade) is none.

I am still here this week - management, you can find me to discuss.

reviews.author: brooks11
reviews.title: Family-moon
reviews.text:
My husband and I went on our honeymoon from 12/16-12/21 and we brought our 20 month old toddler with us (hence family moon).  We chose Cancun because it was off season and chose Paridisus because of the boasting reviews for their family concierge.  I rate this hotel as a three star and not lower because the family concierge saved this review from not being lower.

As I stated above we chose this hotel due to how they treat their families and the Family Concierge treats families wonderfully.  They brought our daughter wonderful treats and were always willing to aid us.  The Housekeeping always left our room organized and clean.  

The food was average but the hotel gives numerous choices of restaurants;  Fuego and Tempo were my favorite.  Tempo is a Tapas menu so the portions are small.  The staff was immaculate; so friendly and always has a smile on their faces.

The hotel in general however was a major disappointment with how they treated us due to 400 employees there for a "convention."  We booked our reservation far in advance and never once were informed of anything going on until after we were almost done being checked-in.  The week quickly felt more like spring break.  The hotel only seemed to accommodate the 400 employees from a Company called, Power.  They bumped our room to the first floor parking lot view (only to change our room the following day), had a concert on the beach until 12:30 in the morning with blaring music and cursing DJs.  They had blasting music on the beach with a pool full of Jello.  Very disappointing, when as I stated above we planned this trip far in advance and had done our research.

Overall, we had a great time and now have memories to last us forever.  However, not sure I'd stay at this Paradisus hotel again, I may choose Paradisus Playa DEl Carmen instead.

reviews.author: Trevor M
reviews.title: Great hotel " Beware of Conventions "
reviews.text: Just returned with my family from the Paradisus Cancun, we stayed from Dec 11 to 18 in family concierge. Well my overall impression of the resort is great their were some short comings, I'll start with the good. The resort is in a great location in hotel zone with a beautiful beach and well cared for grounds with large pools. The building itself is grand and impressive although a bit dated, rooms were small on high floors and larger on lower floors with all the amenities one would expect. Don't rely on resort credits to be enough to upgrade from lagoon view to ocean view, I made that mistake thinking that the resort credit would cover the upgrade, they still wanted US $300 more. It would be cheaper and more convenient to just book ocean view in your vacation package. Don't expect any thing from the resort credits, their more like coupons. The service is great they try very hard, we had Nancy assigned as are butler and Juan was are pool concierge. Juan was great he made all are reservations and took care of us with what ever we needed. Nancy on the other hand we barely seen, her shift started at 3 PM and it was her day off when we arrived. Which is probably why we didn't know about all of the inclusions with are package till a few days later ( like family concierge adults are allowed to access royal service amenities), my advice make sure to ask. Food was very good in buffet but cold on many occasions, a la carte restaurants were confusing at best, nothing stood out to us and we tried fuego, market grill, vento ,mole. And lastly conventions, we had the privilege to see how this hotel runs during one. All guests other than convention members prepare to be inconvenienced, low key is not how this resort runs with conventions, they change their name" POWERdisus "they change their appearance they take away your space on the beach by the pools and inside at lounges and close restaurants.  Inconvenience you with construction of stages and displays and exhibits. Block access to the beach and bali beds, showers. Then they bring in the conventioneer's 1000 obnoxious kids on a company paid trip.  The best part of are trip at that point was leaving, and the hotel was in a hurry for that as well, they started putting guests luggage in are room before we even checked out.  My advise to anyone going to the Paradisus Cancun.  Call to see if they have conventions going on, they truly impacted are trip to Paradise...

reviews.author: raspberry1837
reviews.title: Overall a good vacation, not as great as i thought it would be
reviews.text:
Just got back from 6 days here & overall it was a good trip. Going into it, this was my second time in Cancun. First time I stayed at the Sun Palace, so from the beginning I knew it wouldn't be as good, but was still happy, considering we got a great deal-def. made it worth it!
When we arrived we checked in(did not get resort credits at first like we were supposed to, but got resolved second day) & got to our room, which was in the 3rd pyramid. Room was great, minus the power going off in our room 1 night & the sink getting clogged. Room was lagoon view & updated, very nice, would rate it a 9 out of 10!

Actual resort was great also, was big, modern, very nice! Didn't think i'd like the atrium, but loved it!

The ocean was great too, although would be perfect if it was a little more groomed. Never had an issue getting a chair on the beach.

Service was also great, everyone 
was so helpful & pleasant!

The food is where part of the issue was. The buffet was ok, not very good for a picky eater, but was still tolerable! One night we ate at Bana, and did not care for it. Last night we ate at Vento & loved it! loved the beef & mashed potatoes! Wish we found it from day 1! The market grill(i believe was the name) is closed...& the menu had everything imaginable! Def. think I would have enjoyed the food more if it was open! (they're in the process of remodeling)  Also got room service twice(no charge) & it was also ok..

loved the free wifi! I've read mixed statements about it, but it is free!

Now to the guests.. most were ignorant & rude! Everyone seemed so stuck up & full of themselves..not sure why, since it isn't one of the top rated resorts--people at the sun palace were much nicer & friendly! Most of the old women & well most girls were wearing thongs & it was quite disturbing, especially with children around--i can see if you were at an adult only, but none-the-less, was pretty gross! 

Also liked that there was a papa johns, mc donalds, oxox(or xoxo) & 7 eleven across the street..def worth walking & saving money as the resort shops are always expensive!

Overall it was a good trip, like i said compared to the sun palace, i liked there better, but for half the price, I was happy with what I got! Would I do it again? For the right price, yes, & prob more likely to if the other restaurant was open!

reviews.author: Barry M
reviews.title: It's good...but when you ask constantly to be reviewed on Tripadvisor...you ought to be (much) better
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed for 6 days in the Royal section, where it's promised pampering and individual attention and an excellent experience.  It was good...but certainly not stellar, and with all of the glowing reviews, I expected alot better.

You walk in and are greeted and given an overview of the property and the 'experience'. And the closing is all about tripadvisor and how a great rating is so important to their job.

The room.... very nice. Clean, plenty of room, the balcony was clean. I'd give it a 4.5 / 5.
The food... the small buffet that was part of the extra service was always very nice, fresh and filled. (as was the bar). The open environment there was very nice and calming. (think a wooded area with koi swimming underneath the elevated pathways. 5 / 5
               ...food at the Palapa (private area)... small menu, and boring after a couple of days.
The guacamole was generally good, the shrimp pizza was very good, the steak was good, the hamburger not good. 3.5 / 5
               ...Sushi at Bana.... terrible sake...just bad. Not a very good sushi.  Bland overall. 
3 / 5.  (I was hoping for super sushi...this wasn't it)
              ... Mexican at Mole... excellent waiter...who should have given me his card for tripadvisor...he was very good.  The food was very good also.  5 / 5
              ...Tapas at Vento... better than ok, but not memorable.  3.5 / 5
              ...Carne' at the Market Grill.... Service was slow...suddenly at 7:30 there was noone on the floor with skewers of meat...NOONE! they were all setting up tables in the back.  I thought I had put my red card (the stop feeding me card) on my forehead.  My waiter came to the rescue when he realized I was PO'd and brought skewers.  Everything ON the skewer was good.  4 / 5.  (if they had not stopped, and as I said, it was obvious they stopped, it would have been a 5 / 5)  (this was closed when we left to replace the flooring)
             ...Buffet at Naos... Really good most of the time.  Very varied selection, everything was fresh and tasty. Breakfast / lunch / dinner were all good. Service was very good. 5 / 5

Things to do.... this has been mentioned alot... there is not much activity, and nothing noteworthy in the evening.  We attended a tequila tasting / lesson given by their on site expert.
Tripadvisor mentioned, and at the same time told about how we are supposed to be 'listening', and many people don't, and blah blah blah. Only 10 people can attend this, and if I had waited for this and been excluded, I would be PO'd. They should add something to the calendar of events....limited to 10 people.  I'll give this guy a 3.5 / 5. I did learn something, but don't tell me more than 1x how I am supposed to behave and interact.

Front desk...I didn't have much interaction, acouple of questions, and they were precise, not warm and enthusiastic.  (I never saw the 'greeter' again after the initial information session...the one where Tripadvisor is so important...if cutomer experience is important... extend yourself...make a follow up call and see how I am, otherwise... who  were you? and why would I say something positive about you in Tripadvisor?

The exclusive area.... my butler...Juan...didn't see him much (we didn't take the cell phone to summon him, not our style). He was supposed to reserve a palapa (or whatever the covered beds are called) on day 2. Didn't happen... went down there...never heard of us.
One note of excellence was Francisco, one of the waiters at the pool. SUPER EXCELLENT!  bud...sadly...his area moves, so we had him 1x, the next day saw him, and found out where he would be for the following day, and when we went to reserve the palapa for the next day was told at the towel / palapa reservation hut  that her was somewhere else, we went THERE, and he was where he said he would be, so he could not be our waiter. Sadly, for me, the waiter I did have on day 2 was missing in action alot, I got my own drink a couple of times (I know..gasp!), and the next day, I never saw the guy , and I made a complaint at that point to the keeper of the Exclusive area, who was very solicitous, and of course since I was leaving the next day, there was nothing to be done. She did make notes and did have another manager speak with us, but for me the damage was done.

---the pool...all of them, the private and the public, are very nice.
---the ocean...beautiful...rough surf, nad beautiful beach.

Overall...I see even more glowing reviews, so it must just be me.  I just think if you are setting the expectation for excellence, and then keep pushing for positive praise (the bag porter at the end of our stay gave me a card with Tripadvisor emblazioned on it), you should be excellent.
Paradisus was good, maybe better than good, but the extra cost (not that much extra) private experience did not live up to expectations.  I might go back if a deal came by (and I got a deal to come down) but I wouldn't bring a group of friends there.

reviews.author: David F
reviews.title: Nice resort
reviews.text:
We had a nice week at the Paradisus Resort Club Melia. The staff in the restaurants and buffet where excellent. The food was very good at most eatery's with the 'Vento' being the least favorite and the 'Market Grill' for dinner was the favorite. The buffet was very good for breakfast and lunch. It would be nice if the resort offered a taco or small burrito by the pool area's. Hotdogs and hamburgers where good for the kids near the pool and the service around the pool was excellent. 
The resort offers non motorized water sports across the street, paddle boats and kayaks, not very convenient. It would have been nice if the resort offered a 'boogie board' to play in the surf. 
We had a large one bedroom two bath suite with nice amenities. We had to call twice for the mini bar to be restocked during our stay but they did respond quickly to correct the problem. 
We did have a problem receiving service from our concierge, she didn't respond to our requests for transportation information after stating she would "get back to us before noon". We didn't see her for the rest of our stay.
It would be nice if the hotel had a stage/theater for the shows they performed as they used a small open area in the Avenue bar and is not conducive to viewing.
This is a nice resort but needs to improve on their cleanliness of rooms and concierge service.

reviews.author: Marlayna J
reviews.title: Celebrating 50th
reviews.text:
We are return customers that will not be returning. I have stayed at this same location 5 times, 3 of which were prior to it becoming an all inclusive hotel. This is the first time that I had a bad experience, but it was enough so that I will not return.

We just returned from Paradisus Cancun where we went to celebrate a friends 50th birthday. I hesitated to give service an average. While  our service in the restaurant, poolside, and room service was exceptional, the service at the front desk for check-out, check-in and room key issues was horrible. We arrived Thursday early afternoon and had to wait in the check-in line for 45 minutes to only be told that we had to come back at 3:00 because our room was not ready. We were told that we could go right to the front when we returned to just grab our room keys, but ended up having to wait another 45 minutes. Everyday after our room was serviced (EXCEPTIONALLY), we had to go back down to the front desk - WAIT again, for them to re-program our room keys. Check-out rain similarly. 

The bartenders, servers in the pool area and restaurant staff were as ALWAYS incredibly helpful, always attentive and deserving of tips. The front desk area needs MAJOR renovations in terms of efficiency.

reviews.author: Gregory L
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun is "hit and miss"
reviews.text: Although the resort is beautiful and the service is friendly, this all-inclusive did not live up to the expectations everyone seems to be giving for this resort. Over 40 members of a wedding party stayed there and we had several mishaps. Appoximately 1/3 of us got stomach sickness and we believe it was related to the buffet, possibly the fruit and lettuce that was washed. Bottles of water are in the room for your coffee and brushing your teeth, but if you are not made aware on DAY ONE that the sink water is not purified, you could end up using this water for drinking purposes-especially if you automatically put your toothbrush under the faucet every morning! Also, be aware that you may have a wait time of up to 15 minutes between 11:00am and 2:00pm at the Registration desk when people are checking in. I experienced this 4 times - once when I was locked out of my room as my key no longer worked and I had to go to Guest Services (and request immediate service since they told me to go to Registration) to prevent waiting in line again. I tried to order champagne and strawberries to be delivered to the bride and groom and it was an extreme effort to get this accomplished as I was sent to various departments and individuals. I was incorrectly informed about the use of a discount coupon and had to wait 15 minutes in line one morning to correct this, only to find out at checkout I had to go through the entire process again. Luckily, I had a printout from the day before and a voice mail on my room phone supporting my position. The spa is not recommended. The bride went for a makeup appointment for one of our dinners and the stylist did not even have eyeliner! One of us tried to show the stylist how the look should be and after the bride was almost in tears, the stylist walked OUT of the salon. We reported this to management. The service at the pool side bar and in some of the restaurants was very good, but I recommend staying away from the buffet and anything that may be washed and not cooked. This was our first all-inclusive resort for some of us and we said we would NOT do it again. I guess every experience is different so I recommend you read all the reviews to get a good idea about this resort. Maybe we just had the "unlucky" experience.

reviews.author: DrEthan725
reviews.title: It's nice enough, but there are better places for better prices
reviews.text: Overall we were very happy we stayed here. There was one BIG NEGATIVE: There is a big push when you first arrive to attend a 90 min screening for Club Melia- which isnt' a timeshare, but sort of is- and they'll give you a heavily discounted spa service for listening to the pitch. The pitch went over the 90 minutes- 2 hrs 10 minutes. When they told us it was 138K to joint the "Club" and we could finance it over 60 months at 16.9% interest we said, "no, thanks." That's when the hard push came in. It was offensive, actually.  We left annoyed but were looking forward to the massages & hydrotherapy we booked for having lost 2+ hours of vacation. Sadly, the hydrotherapy was COLD water and the massages were some of the worst we'd ever had. Not a good spa. The food was decent, though never spectacular. The facilities really need attention. It rained our first 2 days there and there were leaks ALL OVER THE HOTEL. Our room, which faced the ocean, took on water through the sliding door. I don't think it should rain indoors in a "Luxury all-inclusive resort". I also found it very 1980's to have unpotable water in the bathrooms. All of the good modern resorts have full water filtration systems. That said, the service was excellent. People were friendly and solicitous. Truly, some of the best Mexican hospitality. Would I go back?  Sure-- if I were under the gun, again.  The beach is lovely as is the pool.  But if I had time to plan it?  I'd probably go elsewhere.

reviews.author: Antonio S
reviews.title: Cancun disappointment
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel, facilities not so good.
Poor restaurants, poor reservation system for the restaurants.
Several pools, but only one with access to a bar.
There were children at the bar area in the lobby running around until late hours.

reviews.author: S510
reviews.title: Needs upgrading!
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus Cancun in pyramid 1 from July 8th-July 17th. As Melia timeshare owner we pay good money every year for resort maintenance and that's why they have separate section for timeshare owners in most resorts. This resort has gone through a transition from Gran Melia to Paradisus but the quality has not improved at all. Upon arrival we had to give a long list of things to our concierge to have fixed. our fridge wasn't working and had to be replaced. Picture frame above my kids sofa bed was covered in mold and we asked them to remove it from the room. Dinning chairs had mold and had to be replaced. On more than one occasion our sheets and towels had stains all over them and one night we had to ask for new sheets at 11 pm and we ended up with sheets to small for our bed. On our third day which happened to be our wedding anniversary we noticed a bug infestation in the bathroom.  We called to ask someone to come and take a look to see what was gong on since they were taking over our whole bathroom sink and toilet. After 15 min they send someone to our room with a can of bug spray in hand. Since we had 2 small kids with us and my husband has allergy to the spray we didn't let them spray the bathroom. After 2 hours of people coming and going in our room to figure out what was happening they suggested that we should switch rooms. our only room option was in another pyramid which we had to take since there was nothing else available. New room didn't have a kitchen (which we needed because of our 2 young boys) had dirty and old dining table and chairs, very old and uncomfortable sofa bed for our kids and again flickering lights with no WiFi in the room so still not 5 star for sure. To top everything off my 6 year old son slipped in the bathtub few days after and had to be taken to the hospital to get stitches in his chin. very stressful for all of us. After speaking with the manager she told us there should have been a insert for the bathtub to prevented from being slippery and yes our room didn't have one. Over all I'm very disappointed with the whole resort. Managers and staff for club melia really tried to help but they can't really do much because in my opinion all the rooms need upgrading specially the members side since we pay for maintenance. Thanks to Club Melia staff Betsy and club melia manager Ivette Sanchez Ponce for all their help.  I would to go back but NOT till the rooms are renovated.

reviews.author: blvd30
reviews.title: Nice place but some points I wish I knew prior
reviews.text:
The hotel is a short cab ride from the airport which makes it very convenient and the beach that fronts it is beautiful.  The hotel is very well maintained and clean.

Now a few things I didnt like:
1. The pool is very deep.  I was on my tip toes at all times (I'm 5'3" tall) and it was very difficult to bring my baby in the pool since i would have to hold her over my head.  I wish it had been noted somewhere that the pool was that deep because that definitely would have changed my mind about booking this hotel.  We have been to Cancun several times and the pools are usually about waist deep, which is what you want when you want to just relax and enjoy a nice cocktail!
We did find out more than halfway thru our stay that there was a seperate family area with a shallow pool that you could pay extra for to stay in with kids.  Had we known that we may have stayed in that part... 

2. The food was ok at best.  There weren't many options and what was there was usually cold and not very appetizing.  Also, at the buffets, it was difficult to find a meat option that wasnt pork, bacon, etc.  If you do not eat pig you are pretty much out of luck since everything seemed to be wrapped in the stuff.
There were also some restaurants not included in the "all inclusive" that remained empty most nights which was frustrating since we didnt have to many dining options to begin with.  The a la carte restaurants were ok.  Market Grill was the best one and it was "ok".

3.  Oh, small note, check-in took forever.

Other than that, it was all good.  Beach was beautiful, grounds were well maintained and the people were very nice.

reviews.author: jrdavisjr
reviews.title: Average, could be much better, will not return.
reviews.text:
We just returned from our 6-day stay at the Paradisus Cancun yesterday.  Actually happy to be home after this resort stay.  We are not sure how this hotel scored a #20 in Cancun.

PROS: Good 'reservation only' restaurants with excellent food (Vento was the best), good selection of alcohol and beer, decent gym (about the size of a medium cruise ship), friendly bar/wait staff, linens in room were clean and fresh, nice beach (however water is always rough with large waves, not good for most any type of water activity), free WIFI.

CONS: Check-in was an hour long process, room had a dirty toilet with broken door, the buffet had strange tasting, poor quality food (cold items were never cold, and hot items never hot), building was a in severe disrepair - we had a day and a half of rain and it leaked in several areas (window, doors, ceilings) including rooms, no air condition in main hotel (the place was a hot and humid green house in the main pyramid), elevator fire occurred one afternoon during our stay (always unsettling).

Overall we were not impressed with this resort, we would not recommend this place to friends and family, and would not return. You get what you pay for.

reviews.author: Lyka74
reviews.title: OK, but could be better.
reviews.text:
We stayed here 1 wk this August under RCI and as an experienced traveller here's my take:
PROS: Beautiful location, great stretch of white sandy beach, near everything (located at Hotel zone), great Reception area, waiters are nice /ok, KIDS club till 8pm ( great for  families/ couples) without a fee, OK night show, reasonable All Inclusive meal plan.
CONS: Upon check in we ask to change room because bath tub is filthy ( even maintainance man cant take off bath stain/dirt), we got a room change nxt day but here and there some stuff in our new room breaks ( old building needs renovation) ,  when it rains the hallways floor are filled with towels to absorb roof water leaks ( not expected for a highly rated resort), breakfast and lunch All Inclusive is just one restaurant ( buffet) w/c mostly 60% same each day, only dinner varies amongs the 4-5 rest. but u need to reserve ahead cos always full but whenever we eat there, half are not filled.
Miscommunication among staff, they offer you a family concierge which u dont even able to use nor help you at all , @ times makes it more confusing.Night shows is OK ( hit or miss) but is in this just small part of a lounge where people are packed up and you cant even get a good view. The restaurant food are OK but can be better, for the amount they charge ( more than in US) you would expect better.Pool  cabanas are like dinner reservations, always full but never really occupied, there must be a new policy to cancel reservations and let people USE it if no one shows up. SPA charges a lot ( more than in the U.S.) but mediocre service and spa facility needs cleaning and renovation ( looks good online the jacuzzi but not so really) . All tips are included and automatic in your services ( rest., spa etc) . My kid got stomach ache after eating the room service food that took 2+ hrs to come so we used the hotel MD ( private and charges more than $100 USD for consultation and + $100 USD more for Rx).
OVERALL OK especially for kids & families esp. if you want to spend $$ every turn you make , every package you get ,  but its not the luxury , high rated hotel  that it looks like it boast of.
After u spend 3+ days you kinda want to get moving out lol .

reviews.author: IdealistRealist
reviews.title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
reviews.text:
This is my seventh time in Cancun and I have always selected this hotel (previously the Gran Melia) due to their attention to detail.  I have used their Royal Service each and every time (worth it).

Melia Hotels International still owns this hotel which recently changed names from the previous Gran Melia to the Paradisus.  The big difference is that now they are all-inclusive.

Unfortunately, I did not have the usual excellent experience during my stay from July 14th to July 19th.  Let me explain:

THE GOOD
The new butler service at the Royal Service Tower was quite good.  My assigned butler, Hector, was attentive and professional.  The best change was the all inclusive package.  The food from Vento, Fuego and Mole were delicious!  This was not always the case when it was the Gran Melia.  As usual, the Royal Service desk personnel were courteous and highly professional.

THE BAD
As I mentioned before, I have been a guest at this hotel several times, always choosing the Royal Service Tower.  I previously requested via email (never received a reply) and made a follow up phone call to Reservations get a room either in the 4th or 5th floor.  During the phone call, I was assured by the reservations representative, Victor,  that all was OK.  Upon arrival, I found out I was assigned to the basement level.  Personnel was unable to accommodate me and did not offer a complimentary upgrade.   Mind you, I am a loyal client and paid top money for the Royal Service.  Oh well, the room was OK but, did not have the views that I was accustomed to.

THE UGLY
In the past (when it was the Gran Melia), it was customary for Royal Service clients to request late check out (up to 4:00 p.m.).  This time I was told that I had to pay (an additional $90) to do so.  Interesting, in various traveling websites, the Paradisus offers late check out up to 4:00 p.m. as part of the Royal Service package.  I was still charged the additional $90.00.  I later contacted via email the hotel's General Manager Conrad [--](conrad[--]@melia.com) and the Royal Service Manager Lazaro [--] (lazaro[--]@melia.com) on July 21st requesting they look into this matter.  As of today (8/3/13) neither has responded. I intend to contact Corporate offices in Spain.

In sum, I am very disappointed with the new Management of this Hotel.  The previous General Manager, Rolf [--], would respond to my emails in a timely manner. This hotel has been a home away from home and I was hoping to come back soon.  I am not sure anymore.

reviews.author: HelloKitty0619
reviews.title: Beautiful resort but some horrible staff
reviews.text: Was there from 7/23-7/28/13 and I'm usually not picky however when we booked through Orbitz over the phone about 2 months in advance (party of 7) 2 rooms, we clearly requested that our rooms be close to one another, we also called the resort 2 times after booking to ensure that everything was in place and they promised that we would have our 2 rooms next to each other.  Well when we got to the hotel to our surprise our rooms were supposedly taken as our flight got delayed, we arrived at the resort at about 3am on the following day.  the rooms that were assigned to us were in completely different pyramids, supposedly they upgraded us to a family concierge room in pyramid 2 and a royal service room in pyramid 5 (which by the way is so secluded and extremely far to everything)  .  The family concierge room was very dated nothing like what you see in the pictures it smelled like rotten sewer as well.  The receptionist told us that she guaranteed for us to have close rooms on that same day after 12pm when other guests had checked out.  Well we returned at 12pm like she advised and were told that they weren't any rooms available that we had to return on the following day, at that point I became really upset.  This is the first time that I've ever had to set foot in the reception area more that once after checking in to a resort.  I asked to speak to a manager but they weren't; available.  We returned the following day and were accommodated thanks to Guadalupe Rodriguez one of the nicest people who works at this resort.  A lot of the employees are obnoxious like this lady named Luz who gave one of my aunts an attitude when my aunt asked how to get to the royal service pyramid.  She responded by saying that's a private area for guests who's rooms are there, clearly my aunt asked because that was where her room was so my aunt went off on her.  Luz was very unprofessional assuming that hispanics can't book a royal service suite!  The waiters and the housekeeping staff were wonderful as was the food at this resort.  I just regret all of the arguing that we had to do the first 3 days there.  We were also upset that the restaurant La Perla was closed throughout the weekend, this is one of their best restaurants during the afternoon anyway love the shrimp and fish tacos!  Also tried to book a massage at the spa and they gave me such a hassle that I just walked out, they tell you a price and then when you actually go they want to jack up the price!  If you don't mind not getting what you paid for then this is the resort for you.  I also thought they would have more cultural events but this didn't happen.  The red lounge sucks, the music sucks.  The drinks all over were very sugary as well, the servers at the Avenue Bar were very lazy and rude, if they want a tip you would think they would be a bit friendly, right?!  Not the case!   Beach was beautiful and clean, the pools were good also except for the one right off of the Market Grill could use some music and a swim up bar, it would get so boring there.

reviews.author: Allison T
reviews.title: Average with many flaws
reviews.text:
We were moved 3 times in 5 days. I am a firm believer in judging a place on how they handle "challenges". He in lies the problem with this resort. After waiting two hours after check-in to get into our room and are reading to take showers.  No hot water.  Maintenance comes about 45 minutes later and he says that it is fixed  now it is 6 o'clock and we have a 4 and 6 year old who are starving.  we run get something to eat and come back around 8 to find there is still no hot water. They told us we could switch rooms tomorrow and take a shower in a vacant room tonight. Engineering came again in the morning and tried again to fix it.  they did not. when i go to talk about the new room, they said they are going to send the concierge with me to check the water again.  it was like they didn't believe me.  when he confirmed that it was indeed broken, they said they could move me to a lagoon view one bedroom or an ocean view that would be available later that afternoon.  we paid for an ocean view, but she told me multiple times that a one bedroom was an upgrade.  we wanted an ocean view, so we said we would wait.  See the attached picture of the room they moved us to around 2p.m. that day.  it was old, rundown, musty smelling and had about 8 bedside tables lined up along the wall.  Not at all the lovely suite they show in the pictures on the website.  When i emailed the Family concierge manager a picture of the suite we were in vs. the one shown on the website, she said that we could move to a one bedroom ocean view the next day when it was available. i again was made aware that the one bedroom was an upgrade.  All we wanted was what we paid for with hot water. i resented the fact that they were acting like i was lucky i was getting an upgrade. OMG, i was exhausted.  We moved the next day and got a beautiful room and were so happy.  i received a complimentary massage for my troubles.  that night when we opened the pullout sofa for the children, it was completely broken.  there were about 15 zip ties where they had tried to fix the part that the mattress sits on, but it was completely ripped to shreds.  Once again at 8 o'clock at night, we had to call and get a new sofa sent to our room. Anjelica, the Family concierge manager was very sweet and i believe tried to do all she could to help, but i feel that she must have had her hands tied at some level.  i have never had a resort take so long to remedy a situation.  the only thing i could figure is that she has to get clearance before making any decisions to help us.  the hotel did not seem very full, yet they couldn't find another oceanview room available?  i just returned from another visit to cancun and now see how a luxury resort should handle problems.  promptly and without hesitation.  the customer is always right attitude.  i felt at every turn at Paradisus that i was a "complainer" when in actuality, i should have gotten the room i paid for with hot water and not made to feel that i was getting some kind of bonus.

the overall feel at the resort was not quite what i am used to in Mexico. at times i felt that workers avoided contact as if they did not want you to ask for anything.  of course there were many nice people, but i just noticed an overwhelming amount of people who looked too busy to help.

the resort has many beautiful aspects and i understand that there can be hiccups at any resort.  what sets this resort apart from other "luxury" resorts, is the unfortunately slow response and the attitude towards the customer when handling them.

reviews.author: Sa11yMc
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: The hotel itself is beautiful. The main entrance area is gorgeous with green vines hanging from the top floor to the bottom floor. The pool area is great - pool bar - and right on the beach. The room on the other hand, was a bit disappointing. The air-conditioner which was under the front door leaked.
