reviews.title: Very large and a beautiful setting
reviews.text:
We were invited to stay at this resort by our son and daughter - in - law.
The beach and pools were beautiful !!!
The a la cartes were quite good too.
The rooms however were a little tired. Now we were in the "members" building.
You'd think they would treat their members better, but I don't think this is the case.
The price they charge for all inclusive is way too high. But you have no choice as
the prices they charge at the resort are astronomial !!
Plus the charging of the pool beds for the days is just not right.
Not sure if we would go back again or not

reviews.author: Olga K
reviews.title: Terrible reception, average service and food, plenty faults, night repairs
reviews.text:
On the 2nd of February we, together with our friends, came to Cancun, Mexico on vacation and were met by an Apple rep.
Usually it takes about 10-15 minutes to fill the bus with passengers and move to the hotels.
We know that it’s a dispatcher’s job to distribute different customers to different minibuses, however we don’t understand why we had to wait for over 40 minutes until the bus started moving.
We entered the beautifully designed hotel and were so much surprised to find out that we were not welcome, as it seemed that nobody expected our visit. And mind, we were over an hour late for check-in, way after 4 pm. Our rooms were not ready, the receptionist couldn’t find available rooms, then with the help of her supervisor Ramon tried to offer us rooms on different floors – 0, 1 or 8. To get rooms at least on the same floor we had to wait for another hour or two. Meanwhile we decided to have something to eat – it turned out to be a problem in a 6-stars all-inclusive resort: the buffet was closed at 5 pm, you could get no food till 6pm. We were asked out of the buffet and offered a room service. Tell me, please, how you can get room service without any room. Amazing logic! The only open option was a bar with drinks, thanks God, we at least could quench our thirst with some soda and juice. No complains here, there was some waitress who brought us some nuts and dried fruit.
When we finally got to our rooms, it was too late to go down to the Sea to take the first swim as our tradition.
Anyway, we got to a restaurant and had nice food. Good people, good staff, good quality. We thought – finally we can have a well deserved rest. No way, people! I was startled around midnight by the noise of drilling and somebody talking loud on a walkie-talkie in the hallway, somebody was running on the roof and doing something. The receptionist when I called stated that the manager is there to take care of the noise. Nothing of the kind. In  the flyer we got the next day it said that they were upgrading conditioning system. Wonderful! We are all for it! But should it be done in the middle of the night when everybody is sleeping? It wasn’t an emergency, it could be done during the day. And three nights on the row it’s too much. The call to the receptionist didn’t solve the problem, only the conversation with the supervisor in the morning did. The only thing we wanted to know is how long it was going to continue – should we stay or request another hotel.
In spite of human errors and some lack of organization we liked the place. And Mother Nature did her best, thanks to Her - the sand, the sea, the sun - our vacation wasn’t completely ruined.
As for the food, not much variety. Besides, for 3 days they were fixing something in the buffet, so everybody was served in the open air – picnic style from morning till evening.
Yes, and conditioning system in the building leaves much to be desired. 
So 3 stars at most. They need to fix the drawbacks first, then claim 5 or 6 star level.

reviews.author: Todd P
reviews.title: Great Beach - Average Hotel and Service
reviews.text:
Just spent 5 days at the Paridisus, formely Gran Melia.
Check in, concierge staff very slow and not responsive, booked a King bed in a Junior suite, we got two doubles, no attempt or apology was ever made to remedy.  Hotel room (3553),had delaminating mirrors and plumbing fixtures held in place by lots of white caulk. Dining was ok, quality was good, portion size extremely small, i.e. scallops were the size of a quarter, and only 1 per entree. Best meal in all 5 restaurants was the made to order breakfast on the deck/buffet.
Spend 20-30 nights per year on business per year.  Hotel nice, but expensive and lower quality service/food than I have experienced at the Westin or Marriotts.

reviews.author: Canadian99999
reviews.title: Housekeeping...not great
reviews.text:
We are writing this from our room in this resort.
The resort is well located and the grounds well maintained. Staff are fantastic.  We have been here 6 nights.
The rooms are very average size and well appointed.
Our ongoing problem has been with housekeeping.  The first time our room was cleaned was 54 hours after we checked in, and after 6 calls requesting service. Examples of what has not been cleaned .... We doubt if the table tops and glass door and windows have been cleaned within a month. The deck has had a beer can in the flower box and French fries on the floor since we arrived.  The coffee pot is never emptied or cleaned ... We do it ourselves. 
Aside from that, with the exception that there are probably 5 hotel guests for every poolside or beach lounge chair, not too bad of a stay.

reviews.author: Larry
reviews.title: Nice, reasonable prices and large buffets
reviews.text: We stayed a week here and the place was very nice and clean - but didn't have the attention to details like the Marriott Casa Magna in Cancun.  The food was good and they had buffets daily.  The beach was incredible with crystal clear water and the walking distance to the center of Cancun was about 40 minutes - but they had a bus that you could take that runs up and down the strip 24 hours.  The service was good - we had a problem with the safe and they rectified the issue.  The hotel was booked solid and we did the tourist time share deal - where you spend an hour and get a free meal while they try to sell your a timeshare.   For 90 minutes of time we got 2 bottles of tequila, a  blanket, hat and 50 dollars.   All in all it was OK, but nothing real fancy as compared with other hotels.

reviews.author: Randy A
reviews.title: Missed Opportunity
reviews.text:
This is simply one of the most beautiful hotels in cancun with one of the best
beaches I've ever seen.  Even the rooms are nice and the hotel atrium is almost
breathtaking.  But it seems everything is so complicated at this hotel that if you
want anything out of the norm, you better dedicate an hour or two to trying to 
work it out.  For instance, I had to make three phone calls and wait three hours
to get a rollaway bed for my son, we had to make three maitenance calls for 
things not working in our room.  And trying to reserve a cabana out by the pool
took walking to three different locations in the hotel, only to be told there were none to reserve, when the one we sat by all day went unused.  I realize it is a 
big hotel but there is a little dysfunctionality going on in management.

reviews.author: CL0111
reviews.title: Nice beach side hotel
reviews.text:
Stayed here back in November 2012 when it was the Gran Melia Cancun.  Was here for a conference so I didn't get to enjoy all the amenities.  
Ride from airport to hotel took about 20 minutes.
Check in was reasonably quick, make sure they give you the bracelet thing so you can enjoy the all inclusive stuff.  When eating at the fancier restaurants in the basement, make sure to ask if it's included or if you have to pay extra.
Room was facing the road, but I could see the beach and ocean from the balcony.  The rooms on the other side of the hall were facing the beach and ocean as well, just closer.
Went to the buffet in the basement and it had a decent variety of food.  There's a carving station with a soft taco made to order station in the back corner.
The air conditioning in the room was great, but in the public areas like the lobby and hallways, it was humid.  Be sure to go outside (to the back) and enjoy the beach - I only got to walk it since there was no free time with the conference though.

reviews.author: MotorCityDude
reviews.title: Enjoyed my stay pretty decent hotel
reviews.text: My wife and I decided at the last minute to take an Xmas break vacation so our options were limited. From the airport we were told by the taxi driver that it was no longer called the Melia anymore but on the website it still goes by that name so it's kinda Deceptive. Once we arrived our room wasn't ready which is really the norm these days unless u get lucky so that was no biggie.. We were all-inclusive so we went to eat at the buffet and it was pretty good, the variety of meats and cheeses were decent along with the sides but the desserts weren't really were they should be but overall it's was ok.. We ate there a lot because we could walk right in and be seated. We also ate at the Mexican restaurant my wife didnt care for it but I thought it was ok on the outside its a restaurant called the grill where most of the food was cooked right on the spot, burgers,dogs and pasta with a nice salad bar . We didnt managed to eat at the higher end restaurant because that's not 100% inclusive which is strange but whatever our Excursions kept us busy.. The pool and beach were great we laid on the beach for hours and never hit the pool. The nightlife is pretty cool if your into it if not get a room farther away from the center.. The rooms were so-so the 1st thing I notice entering the rooms were the doors there kinda flimsy and they don't seem Sturdy at all. Once inside it was pretty cool, nice little couch for seating and cocktail table even though there was a chipped Glass on top so potential to cut yourself the bed was cool and the view was a garden view. Headed to the bathroom you have to step up to enter it so if u forget it leaving out you might twist your ankle especially at night with the lights off.. I couldnt understand how the knobs worked on the shower kinda confusing but its a waterfall faucet so it's pretty cool but the plaster around it needs to be sanded and repainted. Overall I had a pretty good experience at the Melia oops I mean Paradius Cancun I've never had all inclusive so being my 1st time I wasnt sure what to expect... But you always remember your 1st!!!!

reviews.title: Won't go back
reviews.text:
We had admired this hotel from afar when it was the Gran Melia and had always hoped to stay here one day.  So, when I saw it available for an inexpensive week thru RCI, we gave it a try.  Upon checking in we were offered all inclusive for an additional $190 a night which we declined.  The idea being we would try outside restaurants for the week.  We were also offered Royal service for $98 a day which we tried for one night.  
We were checked in easily with no wait at 1:00 and shown to an ocean front room with a large balcony in building two.  I had previously stopped by and requested oceanfront be written in as a request.  So I was initially happy with the room.
By day three, I had a persistent cough all night and occasionally thru the day.  After two days of this I realized it was tied to the air conditioning in the room.  So after that we slept with the air cond. off and the sliding door open and my breathing improved.  My guess is that the air conditioning filter has never been cleaned.  Other than that the room was fine, clean, hot water, good amenities a TV that also got NBC and ABC, a cushy pillow top mattress, a free bottles of water to start.  But, the pillows were terrible.  my husband said his ear hurt at night because the pillow would become hard.  However, mid- stay for no apparent reason, our TV was traded out and now we only had Spanish channels Fox News.  When we questioned this, we were told it hadn't happened!  Also, it's worth mentioning that there are a lot of stairs. Literally 2 flights to get to the beach.  Some of the few  elevators were out of commission.  Many of the bathrooms were downstairs.  If you use a walker or wheelchair, you cannot get around.
When we arrived, the hotel seemed to be at 30% capacity.  This was mid December and the signs of change over to Paradisus were most notable in that the two largest restaurants by the pool areas were being remodeled.  We were ok for breakfast and indeed the buffet was excellent for the first few days.  The waiter would bring us bottles of water, there was many different cheese, bacon, cream cheese and salmon, made to order omeletes etc.  but each day we noticed an increase in guests and a decrease in what was offered at the buffet.  First to go was the bottled water.  And we were told we could only have tap water, then one day cream cheese with no lox, and the next day lox with no cream cheese.  Then the bacon disappeared and the fancy pineapple marmalade.  By the last two days, we had a solution.  We made friends with one of the waiters, tipped him heavily and he went into the kitchen and brought us, bacon, cream cheese and lox, and made me capachinos.  Problem solved.  Incidentally as Melia members breakfast was only $20 if you showed your MAS card (half price).
Lunch was a whole bunch of problems.  We wanted to eat poolside or at the beach.  There was no restaurant open!  So we had to order from staff who would gladly bring you a $12 hamburger, hot dog, or nachos or wings.  That was the whole menu!  So we had a lousy $40 lunch (with soda) every day.
Incidentally the towel game is played big time as there aren't enough chairs.  If you wait until 11, you're out of luck and mind y ou we're at low capacity.  There are about 15 Bali beds which rent for $25. Or $15 for RCI.  Which we were doing every day.  Do not go at 7:00am to rent like they say.  Book thru your concierge or you will be out of luck.
So, as I said we did Royal Service for one day.  We didn't do the week as we felt it wasn't worth it.  The drinks in the evening were very nice. Top shelf.  Also the appetizers were pretty good, and if you weren't too hungry that could do it for dinner.  The breakfast was only a pale imitation of the regular buffet.  In fact we saw RoyalService people over at the regular buffet as it was so much better.  The Bali bed is included in Royal Service, but NO service is included in Royal Service.  This is why we quit.  While water and soda is free for Royal Service. You have to inside to help yourself.  If the waiter brings it to you, he has to charge you!  They did explain that if we were all inclusive that wouldn't have happened and that we could have called our butler to bring us a water.  But that seemed ridiculous.  So, Royal Service is no good unless your already all inclusive.
Now, as I said we wanted to eat out every night and check out the lively restaurant scene.  Well that was a disaster.  We're from NY.  We're used to paying a lot and getting great food.  Well in Cancun, they've figures out that they can charge NY prices and give you Mexican food.  We had one bad meal after another.  The only good meal we had, in fact it was a GREAT meal was at La Madonna restaurant in La Isla.  The service was discreet, the atmosphere was five star and the food and drinks were perfect.  Unfortunately it was our last night or we could have repeated it.
As our vacation was winding down, Christmas was approaching and we noticed lines everywhere.  We felt sorry for these people who will get a scaled down buffet. And poor service.

reviews.author: goldenboy1947
reviews.title: New Management working on much need improvements
reviews.text: My partner and I stayed at the Gran Mila now the Paadisus the second week of Dec.  Checking in was a problem as they could not figure out where to send me to check in.  Turns out I was a Timeshare Owner and I had to go the Club to register.  Not impressed, but once there they took good care of us.  We were offered an all inclusive option which we decided to try for three days.  At $89 a day per person we were not sure that it would a good deal for us.  However I think it worked out well because we did not have to worry about the any costs because they were prepaid. This option allowed us to order a drink when we wanted and to go to the restaurants that we wanted.  We went to the Tempo restaurant twice and really had a excellent meal with excellent service.  The only problem was some items on the menu were an extra 220 pesos per person.  What bothers me is that most of the help desk people did not know this option.  I understand the restaurant is completely changing their menu and they now will be charging $40 extra per person even if you are all inclusive.  However, like i say nobody but the restaurant manager knows what is going on.  The one complaint have I with this resort is that restaurants are half full but when you phone for a reservation they are full and not taking any.  Not good for business if you ask me.  On the last night we had to dine outside the resort.  And the other complaint that I have is the buffet is your only option for breakfast and lunch, except for the pool BBQ.  Our room had a partial view of the ocean if you peaked over the wall, not bad. as it could have been the parking lot or another the face of another building.  Our room was very dated  and would be like a $60 a night motel room in the USA.  Room Service was excellent.  The beach area was amazing and what you would expect in Cancun, beautiful blue of the Caribbean Sea.  The bar service was a nice touch, so you sit and relax and they would bring your drinks or food to you.  The resort had little or no entertainment.  One night they a Michael Jackson dance group on for 5 minutes.  Other times they  hired people to play in the lounge when the lounge was not open.  Great drinks in the lounge when it opened at 5:00 with a great view of the ocean.  Lots of construction going on and they are planning on opening two or three new restaurants before the end of the year. If I went back to Cancun I would choose a different resort.

reviews.author: amgad s
reviews.title: Mido’s Review- Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Not really impressed at all. 

1- Beach drop to 4-5 ft deep in the first 3 meters. 
2- It is hard to find chairs after 9am. 
3- Beach chairs can be set in only one position
4- Buffet verity is very low. 
5- huge disappointment, No night life, although there suppose to be DJ, but didn’t show up. There is a musician that comes from 8-9 and that is it. 
6- No shower to wash your feet from the sand
7- No volleyball
Boulders on some parts of the beach that hit you as soon as you walk in. 
8- Songs playing at 5-6 in the morning. Don’t know where it’s coming from. 
9- Can’t use the facilities after 6pm although our bus pickup is at 8pm.

reviews.author: Mark T
reviews.title: Bar Kanna is awesome!
reviews.text:
Bar Kanna is lush, relaxing by the sea with a rum n’ coke, chilled out tunes from the beach DJ… stunning!

Resort as a whole is great, yes it’s  a few years old, but the staff work really hard to keep it looking good..

Only issue was with older style rooms we were allocated, but these were changed after complaint to our tour operator

reviews.author: Kimberly M
reviews.title: Fabulous for ladies trip or family trip
reviews.text:
We were on a Ladies trip and stayed in the All-Inclusive Reserve Adults Only area.  It was so fun and relaxing.  There are 5 pyramids and we were in pyramid 5.  Most of the restaurants are in pyramid 3.  As a Reserve client, you have access to the entire resort. You also have a concierge.  Our concierge was Rocio and she was fantastic!  She booked our massages, specific restaurants, any reservation that we needed.  I wanted ice and it arrived 10 minutes after contacting Rocio. I would definitely request her when we go again.

We had a bali bed everyday we were there.  Out best attendant was Valeria.  She was kind, funny and very attentive.

There were many activities during our stay.  You could join the activities or just enjoy the ocean breeze and top shelf cocktails.  They do have classic American sodas,  excellent tequila, Jameson whiskey, Ketel One, Grey Goose, etc.   

There were having issues with the A/C in certain parts of the resort but our room was fine.  The room was nice and the bathroom was large and came with all the amenities needed for a stay.  There was a refrigerator stocked and a snack tray in the room.

We definitely will go back and I want to take my family for a long weekend trip.

reviews.author: Carmen R
reviews.title: EXCELLENT HOTEL IN ATTENTION ONE HUNDRED PERCENT RECOMMEND
reviews.text: The stay at Paradisus Cancun bellisimo Hotel I recommend, we were 4 couples all friends and had a spectacular time, the attention of the staff from reception concierge them, Jose always worried, we were in the adult part, in the pool part all extremely attentive, it was a unique experience, Greetings to all.

reviews.author: Betty C
reviews.title: Come and enjoy the best of Mexico
reviews.text:
The service at the ginger 2 bar was an excellent service, always with a happy face, thank you Gaby for making  us feel part of the melia family
 The staff Karina Salvador Johnathan.  Thank all  for your time for all the attention  you gave us. We will be keep you in mind for our next vacation

reviews.author: Nick M
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Food at Cielo was great. Our server, Moises, was amazing. We will be back tomorrow for more. Thank you again, Moises! 🙌👋👍🤘our over all we have been loving our stay in Paradisus Cancun! Everyone has been amazing! Excited to explore the hotel more

reviews.author: Sarah S
reviews.title: Dinner at Cielo
reviews.text:
It has only been 5 hours since we checked in but everything has been exceptional! We were first greeted by Andrey in the lobby who was very very nice. All the restaurants we went to were great and had great service. 
Moises who we met at Cielo was exceptional too!

reviews.author: Jessica H
reviews.title: Perfect! Heartfelt recommendation!
reviews.text:
Indescribably beautiful!
What should we write now, it's perfect.
Since sea beautiful the staff very friendly, the rooms clean and nice, the name of this hotel says it all, we were greeted with the words “welcome to the best hotel in the world” and yes it is. We stayed here 10 days and would recommend it to anyone. That's eating madness! 
Staff top!
Atmosphere top!
We have never experienced such a perfect experience.
Appearance of the hotel unique!
Unfortunately we forgot to write down all the names but everyone we had to deal with was very accommodating and friendly we are wishfully happy. 
We have booked the reserve area, we would recommend this to anyone who does not travel with children. Is the price so expensive worth it? We definitely say yes! We would pay exactly the same again for this incredible experience we were offered.
The food is like a 5 star restaurant and in every single one, this can not keep up with any previous hotel 1 A. All drinks and all food fresh and of very good quality. There's nothing here that doesn't exist. And if so, a solution is sought. Ice Tea ? Freshly brewed with and without sugar Juices freshly squeezed on request, both in Bali and in all restaurants. Your wish will be read from your lips.

reviews.author: Johnzags
reviews.title: Birthday trip
reviews.text: We spent my wifes birthday @ our favorite place in the world, Paradisus Cancun. Our butler Galdy went out of his way to make my wifes birthday a memorable experience.  The room was decorated perfectly and the small gifts were really amazing. Galdy has been our butler and now our friend for several years now and he reslly goes above and beyond for his guests. Cheers to Galdy and the entire crew @ Paradisus cancun for always making our visits so amazing!

reviews.author: Sandra Padilla
reviews.title: Dream vacation!
reviews.text:
Spectacular hotel! It exceeded all our expectations! 
The Adults Only area of The Reserve is a luxury and worthwhile. 
Very clean and well kept facilities, spacious rooms with terrace (those with sea views are the best). 
The hotel has several restaurants, the taqueria we loved, as well as Flora, it is worth trying its super original dishes, in addition, the Nesspreso corner available all day, is a joy.  
Activities every day from 7:30 am (yoga, mindfulness, etc.) and theme nights with show.  
Funny thing is that there is a turtle technician who takes care of them, protects them and explains to customers how important they are for the beaches of Cancun! If you are lucky, at night you may see a giant turtle on the shore (it is important not to disturb them by approaching them or lighting them up). 
But definitely the best of the hotel its staff. Our Concierge Rosana, Super Friendly and Pro. He kept an eye on us throughout the stay and helped us with bookings and resolving all questions related to the area. Also noteworthy was Limberth of the GEX team, very attentive and great person, Alex of Flora restaurant, very nice, made us feel at home on our first dinner and Victor, the guy in charge of the Balinese beds, always pending and with a big smile. Overall it has been a pleasant experience to visit Mexico and spend a week at this wonderful hotel!

reviews.author: olivia f
reviews.title: My Best Vacation,,, Rocio and Didier Top-rated,
reviews.text: Thank you very much for the excellent service you provided us in our stay at the hotel Rocio Concierge and Didier Pool Waiter, You made our holidays something amazing Attentive to us at all times, and exceeding our expectations,,,the restaurants, the Pools ,the room, the bars, the cafeteria, everything very well, quality of service, 100% recommended

reviews.author: Brandon M
reviews.title: Anniversary trip
reviews.text:
Today is our last day at Paradisus and we had an amazing experience. The restaurants offered a great variety of food, the service was top notch, and our needs were catered to for the entire duration of our trip. 

Our vacation was made extra special by Alejandro at the Nespresso Bar, and Alberto at the Malva Buffet. They always greeted us with a smile and went out of their way to give us all we needed. 

Thank you very much for the amazing service - we will be back.

reviews.author: Mo K
reviews.title: Great place thanks to Oscar and Victor.
reviews.text: We have been to Cancun so many times . We absolutely loved the Reserve section at the hotel . Oscar from Santee restaurant and pool area made our trip so worth while he and Victor at the cabana towel area they are the reason we will come back again and will recommend the hotel . The blue agave and santee were our favorite places to eat .

reviews.author: Alejandro M

Excellent music and service

reviews.author: Chris Z
reviews.title: Service at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Excellent service from our server. Made my vacation unforgettable! Thank you to Jorge our server for the wonderful dinner that my family enjoyed on our first night at the resort. Definitely coming back in the near future for another vacation.

reviews.author: Vanessa Harmir B
reviews.title: Family!
reviews.text:
Excellent activities, services!
We really liked the hotel has activities for large and small and its location is great!

The varied food, has different Areas of Attraction and is different even in its activities is excellent to come as a family!

reviews.author: Edmund L
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: Gold Star service from Samuel. He is nothing short of amazing. I highly recommend anyone to visit the cielo Mexican restaurant. Gave good recommendations for food and drink. I recommend the braised lamb and the corn cake. And don't forgot the mojito.

reviews.author: Elva B
reviews.title: Peruvian Japanese Dinner
reviews.text: Ernesto and Marco made the unforgettable dinner experience excellent service and delicious food we ordered 3-stroke food, delicious entrees the salmon and beef of excellent quality 100 recommended we ended up with dessert chocolate cake and delicious stain too

reviews.author: svo725
reviews.title: 2nd time here
reviews.text: This is our second trip to Cancun Paradisus and also went to Los Cabos Paradisus. The service is superb. Rosanna is our concierge and she has been so welcoming and accommodating. Daniel from Lemon Fish and Samuel from Cielo were great, amazing servers. Yami from Kidsdom was just awesome and so patient with our kids. They all deserve a big raise!! We always come back to Mexico because the people here are always so kind and we thank you so much for your service.

reviews.author: raq
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: Magnificent place and professionals, thank the treatment received as wonderful as ever by Diego, Galdino, and all the professionals of Sante (Martin, Caesar, Oscar, Luis, Valeria, Sofia, and a long etc). Thank you so much for making us feel at home.

reviews.author: Ivan L
reviews.title: I went to dinner with my partner at the Blue agave restaurant in Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Food and service can only say good things. We ordered a combination of tacos and it was spectacular, as well as being quite food. On the other hand, Ahmed's treatment was super polite and friendly. Restaurant highly recommended.

reviews.author: IslandHopper
reviews.title: Adults only section for peace and tranquility.
reviews.text: We enjoyed our relaxing stay at Paradisus in June.  We have been to many all-inclusives in the Caribbean and look for 5 star resorts.  The room was great - very comfortable - we got a high floor ocean view - adults only section -Building 5.  The view from our balcony was wonderful.  We enjoyed Sante and the food and snacks in the Atrium.  Our butler, Galdino, was helpful and gracious.

reviews.author: melissaerikson81
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: My family stayed at Paradisus Cancun for a week and can't wait to go back! The hotel and grounds are breathtaking, the staff is over-the-top friendly and helpful, the food and beverage selection and quality were perfect. We were mostly adults with one 6-year-old and were able to find something for everyone. I would highly recommend a stay here for either an individual, a couple or a family.

reviews.author: Dreamer51527477212

The best restaurant the staff of the best service very friendly attentive speed very good menu they support you to choose the dishes the truth we are delighted is something amazing x that we were attended 10 out of 10 Jorge and Miguel

reviews.author: Mobile700372

reviews.text: Jorge and Miguel made our last night at Cancun very memorable. Food was great and the waitresses were extremely helpful with great attitudes with positive vibes. Chef Karen and Marcos cooked amazing food. Tasted perfect! Don’t miss out Lemon Fish! Great customer service!

reviews.author: Global00060137409
reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.text:
Service outstanding. Can’t do enough for you. 
Jesus at lemon fish was a gent, as were all staff. 
Few issues with our room which was quickly rectified and switched for another upgraded room. 
Entertainment was great, live music and acrobatic shows. Pool games during the day etc. Top notch

reviews.author: lauris25ldjr
reviews.title: Very nice hotel
reviews.text: The hotel is amazing and the service too: Javier, Julio, cesar , Lorena, Gaby and Miguel... all the reserve in general always very friendly and attentive.

reviews.author: Cerissa H
reviews.title: The Swim Up is a Must!
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful atmosphere and amazing Staff. The Swim up suite has spoiled me. The stocked mini bar and daily treats for the kiddos are highly appreciated. Dining was excellent and so many pools we missed a few. This place is a MUST to stay. Waterpark and Beaches, who could ask for more.

reviews.author: Jaime C
reviews.title: Customer service
reviews.text: Good and dedicated attention in the hotel, especially in the restaurant Lemon&Fish. Special mention to the service provided by Maple. Good organization and good Japanese and Peruvian food. Maple in particular has been very helpful all night attentive to how we felt and how we were looking at the food

reviews.author: lorenzo m
reviews.title: The best waiter
reviews.text:
Maple service was the best in the hotel. Very attentive friendly and very good person. The restaurant very nice and spectacular.
The least fair thing about the triple room. Very old and a little spoiled.
And the shower with very little water flow and the premises close very soon.

reviews.author: LAURA P
reviews.title: Excellent food and service
reviews.text: Highly recommended food, spectacular pumpkin soup, delicious picaña and Paulova for dessert, without words, plus very good service. Bartender Santos, he kept an eye on us all dinner. We'll repeat for sure!

reviews.author: Migdalia R
reviews.title: Excellent experience!
reviews.text: Excellent! Aurelio was such a great server, he was attentive and very pleasant. The food was incredible, I’d recommend the short rib & the lichee ice cream - it was a delight. My family really enjoyed it. We also got to meet the chef, he came out to bring us our dinner - such a special experience. If you visit Paradisus, Lemon Fish is a must!!

reviews.author: Belly Treviño
reviews.title: Everything is perfect!
reviews.text: Everything is perfect at this hotel. Beautiful, from the moment you walk in it smells great, everything flawless. The service is unique. All restaurants have delicious food, drinks too. The view is beautiful from any room. The quiet beach.

reviews.author: Katherine V
reviews.title: Best year in Paradisus Hotel
reviews.text:
Wow I don't even know where to start. I'm not going to lie when my wife and I went 2 years ago, we didn't have as much fun or weren't informed of a lot of things. Even though 2 years ago, we also had our personal concierge. This year 2 years later for our anniversary we decided to come back and give it a second chance. Scared because two years ago we didn't have the best service. But this year the food was fenomenal, the service was exceptional and the entertainment was awesome. But all of this wouldn't have been possible if it wasn't for our personal concierge ROCIO this year. She was outstanding. She made our stay extraordinary. Rocio was constantly making sure we had our daily activities when and where and made sure we had our restaurant reservations. reviews.author: Tom
reviews.title: Fun overall. Probably better if you are a Circle member.
reviews.text:
We had fun. Service was very friendly. Food was good. Rooms were clean. AC worked great. There was ample everything. But there are some things to know that could improve your experience.

* Small beds: We had a Junior ocean suit with two double beds. These are *not* queen beds. They are double beds. Reception said it’s the only types of beds they have.

* Warm pool: the water in the pool did not cool down. One drawback of this is that if you want to jump into some cool refreshing water, there isn’t any. On the other hand, you get a warm pool even at 7am.  

* Restaurants: seating in the buffet isn’t very efficient. For example, 3 people will sit at a 10 person table, leaving your bigger group out of luck. On one occasion, the hostess gave our table—that she gave us—to another group while we were getting the food. 

* Excursions: for anything water related, check with the operator next to the pool (forgot the name) first. There’s a travel agency in the hotel called Otium, but for any water activities they just resell what the operator offers at a premium. 

* The Melia circle might be worth it if you plan to go to a Melia hotel for 14 days every year in the first five years, and the 50% discount on the reservation ends up covering the down payment.

reviews.author: Andre M
reviews.title: A very clueless and abusive hotel in several respects.
reviews.text:
I just liked the hotel. Rooms well, bathroom clean, bed comfortable; facilities well. Special restaurants have good food and taste. I was in Family Concierge (FC) mode, the FC team very good, very attentive and helpful. 

However, there are details that are not right and that detract much from the experience.

1. They tell you how like family concierge, you have an a la carte breakfast restaurant, BUT, "a la carte" has 4 packages; it is NOT really a la carte. The best of those 4 packs are chilaquiles. Imagine the other 3 packages.

2. All special restaurants do not have air conditioning, so you will always be warm while dining, even perspiring.

3. To have a bedchamber, you have to get up at 6 am to set aside. At 6:30 am, there are literally no more beds, either in the pool area or on the beach.

4. Context: I got a lot of sand in my ear, so I would just wash myself. All I needed was a syringe. I went to the medical service, the doctor told me I had to pay $1. I thought, "okay, so I don't go outside." When the doctor asks me what size I needed; I answer the big one...if I remember 20 ml. After five minutes waiting, he told me that syringe was worth $15. I said no, I went out on the street, crossed the avenue, walked into the savings pharmacy and bought it for $1.

5. The kids area, for young children is fine and safe, however, your teenager....will have problems. The pool table, it's dirty, there are two cleats, one of them is broken and stuck with diurex. The football table, it's broken, it's missing "players" and handles. Really: No more.

reviews.author: Rainy S
reviews.title: Disappointing Stay with Poor Maintenance and Service
reviews.text:
Stay from Aug10 - 16, 2024.

My recent stay at this hotel was marred by inadequate facilities and extremely disappointing service. We booked a premium suite with a sunset view for 6 nights, but our experience was far from satisfactory. The room we were given was unfinished, with numerous issues including a blocked stove, missing kitchen appliances, a non-working outlet, a hole in the bathroom, and ineffective air conditioning. Despite requesting a room change, the staff was unhelpful and unresponsive, only moving us to a slightly better room after much delay.

The service at the hotel's Melva restaurant was equally frustrating. During a busy breakfast period between 9-11am, we encountered poor service from a staff member named Brenanda. After waiting in line, we initially seated at a table of 2.  We informed her that although our room had only 2 occupants, we needed a table for 10. So we were taken back to the front desk and left waiting. Brenanda ignored us for another 30 minutes.

When we pointed out an empty table for 10, she told us to wait. After 45 minutes, another server, Edwardo, informed us that we had only 10 minutes to eat because they closed at 11am. Despite our told him that we hadn’t been seated, they refused to prepare the table until we complained about the poor service and Brenanda's disregard. Only then did they say it would take 2 minutes to clean the table, though they could not explain their previous inaction.

The facility’s maintenance was also lacking, with poor upkeep evident throughout. I was particularly surprised that the hotel offers wedding services despite such poorly trained staff. The disparity in service quality was evident, with some staff offering decent service if tipped well, while others were indifferent regardless of tipping.

One important note for future guests: if you encounter issues or poor treatment, go directly to guest services. The regular staff seemed unresponsive to complaints and requests, but guest services were more effective in addressing problems.

Overall, this stay did not meet the standards expected from a premium booking and left much to be desired in terms of both accommodation and hospitality.

reviews.author: Belenalv09
reviews.title: Excellent Experience

reviews.author: Carol z
reviews.title: Significant service disparities between towers; disappointing treatment of families and poor group seating in restaurant
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed in the adults-only tower (Tower 5), while our friends and their family stayed in Towers 1-4. This gave me a broader perspective on the services provided to guests in different towers. My husband and I were given different wristbands than our friends. Although the service we received was average—daily check-ins from the concierge and responses to our requests (we are very low maintenance and only requested towels and water, with no need for room cleaning)—I noticed a significant difference in how our friends staying in the other towers were treated.

First, they didn’t receive what they paid for. One of the so-called "premium" suites had no microwave, sofabed, stove, or working fridge, while the other premium suites they booked had all of these amenities. They reported the issue immediately, but the staff didn’t respond with an immediate room change. The room change wasn’t completed until we went to the lobby and repeated our request to the fourth person we spoke to (thank you, Janet and Adrian), who seemed to be the only staff members who cared about our stay. I’ve traveled enough to understand that issues can arise during a stay, but it’s the attitude with which guests are treated that matters. It was a big disappointment that our request (which was not a favor but simply an expectation to receive what we paid for) wasn’t addressed until the fourth time we raised it. This cost us almost 12 hours of our vacation due to the resort’s inefficiency.

Second, when my husband and I walked in the adults-only area of the resort, the staff who passed by would smile and nod. However, when walking in Towers 1-4, there was no such treatment. It made me feel bad for the families with kids who had to stay in Towers 1-4. The price difference between the towers isn’t significant, but the difference in service is drastic. Families with kids don’t deserve this disparity.

Lastly, the restaurant staff were not trained to properly seat large groups or prioritize resort guests. We understand that we can’t all sit at the same table, but they should at least seat us in the same area. It was clear that they were just trying to place us randomly. When we asked to be seated together, the default answer to any request was “no.” Another instance was at Aqua Marina (another restaurant), where they couldn’t seat us because the kitchen was at capacity. However, our request was just to sit at the table while waiting, but again, the answer was “no” with no explanation.

In summary, my suggestion is that if you have kids, don’t choose this resort because the disparity in treatment will ruin your stay. If you don’t have kids and are interested in staying in the adults-only tower, I would also advise against it, as the staff outside of your tower won’t prioritize your requests—unless you’re determined to stay inside your tower the entire time. I hope this helps.

reviews.author: AnsonS
reviews.title: Adult Only vs. Non-Adult Only: A Tale of Disparate Experiences at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Review of Paradisus Cancun Part 1 (August 10-16, 2024)
We recently stayed at Paradisus Cancun with a large group of 24 people. Our group was divided between two room types: 2 of us in the Adult Only Junior Suite Ocean View and the remaining 22 in Premium Suite Sunset View, across a total of 9 rooms. Despite the minimal price difference of $40 between these room categories, the service we received varied significantly.
From the outset, the differences were noticeable. Adult Only guests had a distinct check-in experience, with a more efficient and expedited process, and were granted early access to the hotel—2 to 3 hours before non-Adult Only guests. They also received a higher level of concierge service, with daily check-ins and more personalized attention, in stark contrast to the limited and often unresponsive concierge service provided to the rest of our group.
Another major discrepancy was in the amenities. Adult Only guests enjoyed complimentary access to private cabanas, while non-Adult Only guests were required to pay an additional $200 daily for the same privilege. Additionally, the Adult Only pool area, which had superior menu options and service, was off-limits to those staying in the Premium Suites.

Adult Only guests had access to three additional restaurants, including one complimentary meal at Sal Steakhouse. In contrast, non-Adult Only guests were required to pay extra to dine at Sal Steakhouse. This disparity was particularly notable given the minimal price difference between the room categories.

In terms of room amenities, there was a clear difference in the quality of bottled water provided. Adult Only guests received sanitized bottled water, whereas non-Adult Only guests were provided with tap water, which led to concerns about hygiene and safety.

The room conditions also differed noticeably. The Adult Only rooms were newer, with updated shower facilities, better air conditioning, and more pleasant hallways.
Given that the price difference between the room categories is relatively minor, the disparity in service and amenities was surprising and disappointing. We suggest that Paradisus Cancun consider offering a more equitable experience for all guests, regardless of their room type, to enhance overall satisfaction.

Part2
During our stay at Paradisus Cancun from August 10-16, 2024, we encountered significant issues with the restaurant services, particularly with accommodating our large group.
On our second day, we went to the Malva buffet for breakfast with a group of 9. Fernanda, who was responsible for seating arrangements, initially told us to wait while she served others who arrived after us. Despite observing several empty tables that could have accommodated our group, we were made to wait for 45 minutes without any effort to clean or prepare a table for us.
When we escalated the issue to Manager Eduardo, he suggested seating us outside, despite the availability of an empty large table inside. Only after insisting on speaking to higher management did Eduardo finally arrange a suitable table for us. Additionally, our attempts to address these issues with Guest Services were met with indifference, as our concerns were ignored and no apologies were offered.
Overall, the restaurant’s lack of preparedness for handling larger groups and the poor service from certain staff members significantly impacted our dining experience. For future improvements, we recommend better training and support for handling larger groups to ensure that all guests receive fair and efficient service.

Part3
During our stay at Paradisus Cancun from August 10-16, 2024, we experienced several issues with the service and accommodations that impacted our overall experience.
At various restaurants throughout the hotel, we noticed a distinct change in attitude from the servers whenever we requested seating for a large group. This inconsistency in service was frustrating and contributed to a sense of being unwelcome.
Service at the beach chairs was also problematic. Since beach chairs were available to all guests free of charge, we faced unprofessional behavior from the staff, including being reprimanded when ordering more than two drinks.
Additionally, the coffee stations had a similar issue. The servers’ attitude shifted negatively when we ordered more than two coffees, which was surprising and disappointing.
In terms of accommodations, the Premium Suite Sunset View was advertised to include an outdoor tub, but not all rooms were equipped with one. We also encountered maintenance issues; in one room, the fridge was broken and rusted, and the provided water was stale. The glass bottles used for water were filled with tap water and seemed unsanitized. After drinking this water, several of us felt unwell. Despite requesting plastic bottled water, the staff was uncooperative and refused to provide it.
These service and maintenance issues need addressing to improve the guest experience. Better training and consistent standards are essential for ensuring that all guests feel valued and receive the quality of service expected at a resort of this caliber.

reviews.author: Fahd Khan
reviews.title: Good facility but bad management, would not recommend
reviews.text:
I have been going to beach resorts in Mexico with my family since 12 years, and this year we decided to go Paradisus in Cancun managed by Melia. After this experience I will prefer never to stay at a Melia property. 
First let me cover the positives and then explain why I would not recommend this hotel and never go there again myself. 
It is a good size hotel, gives a good impression upon arrival and has a massive swimming pool. The lobby area and restaurants look nice and overall the hotel has a nice vibe. There were shows every night we were there and they were fun. The waiters in the restaurants were friendly and accommodating offering special dishes for the kids.
Now to the negatives. Two main reasons.
1. Condition and Maintenance: Upon arrival we were assigned a room which was not in best shape, the shower was damaged and dirty, the couch was broken and walls were damaged (pictures attached). When I complained about it to the reception, they first shoved it off saying it’s a renovated room. Then I went and took the pictures and showed the staff, their response was that we will send house keeping. At this point I pushed stating this is not just a house keeping issue, I want to change room, which they did but clearly the lady at reception was not happy about it and did not provide any apology for assigning us a damaged and dirty room. In addition to this, the swimming pool is not very clean, there are dead insects floating around, we even saw a dead cockroach in the pool!
2. Too Commercial: The deal breaker for us is how commercial this place is, they are trying to upsell you things at every point. Upon our arrival a concierge member approached us stating that given that we are visiting from Europe (most visitors were American and Mexican) we are entitled to a free massage in return they request us to promote the hotel to our friends and family in Europe. When we requested the coupons for the massage he pushed us for attending a 40 minute description about their loyalty program. I clearly told this person, if this is about a time share or any kind of investment, I am not interested, to which he responded saying no nothing like that it’s about our Melia loyalty program and its benefits. So we went for it, it took more than an hour and it was a pitch for investing into a time share, exactly what I told them that I was not interested in. When I was clearly stating that I am not interested and will not make any investment decision during my holiday, the salesman (Mathew) even tried mocking me hinting that I am lying that I don’t discuss investment and work during holidays. Really unpleasant experience. But it doesn’t end there, the concept of all-inclusive is that you don’t carry around your money, in the all-inclusive hotels I have been to in Mexico before this one, the servers don’t expect any tips either as you are supposed to be cash free. At Paradisus Cancun this was not the case, every bar counter had a big tip jar in front of you and the kind of service you received from them and servers at pool area differed if you were tipping or not tipping. Then you have all these tour operators and water sports activities people walking around the hotel trying to grab you at every corner to try to sell to you. In the restaurants for several dishes you have to pay additional. Even during a massage, they tried to upsell using a better quality oil for the massage! Absolutely absurd.
The room experience gave it a bad start, the lie about timeshare left a bad taste overall and the constant dodging of people trying to sell you stuff did not make us feel relaxed. This is why I would never go back to this hotel and overall avoid Melia.
On top of all of this, Cancun is absurdly over priced. My last resort break was in Puerto Vallarta, I would rather recommend to go there instead of Cancun.

reviews.author: agustina m
reviews.title: All excellent. Especially the bar of Santé and Gingger!
reviews.text:
I came with my partner and family. We stayed 15 days in the hotel and there is nothing to complain about! We appreciate and recommend the attention of Luis in Sante and Gladis in Gingger! Super attentive and friendly 👏🏼 
The overall staff is very good. Thank you!

reviews.author: Dennis P
reviews.title: Service on the beach
reviews.text: The experience we were at the beach was excellent, excellent work from Jhandi and Gaudencio. Good luck Jhandi I know you will do well in your new job on the beach Meliá Cancún following the Guide of the Master Gaudencio also working on the beach

reviews.author: ddpmp
reviews.title: Horrible service
reviews.text:
Customer service issues at Paradisus Cancun from Aug 10, 2024 - Aug 13, 2024
I am a Melia Vacation Club Member (timeshare owner). I arrived at Paradisus Cancun at
approximately 2:00 PM on Saturday August 10, 2024.
My room was not ready as checkin time is 4:00 PM. I was also told by the front desk that my
concierge would be Jenny. Then they proceeded to look around the Atrium for Jenny who
wasn’t there and said she would contact me which she never did. I have never waited for my
room to be ready before. I went to the pool bar and sat in the heat until 4:30 PM waiting for my
room. No one ever contacted me. Since my room wasn’t ready I waited an extra half hour to
give them some leeway. Still no one contacted me not even to apologize that the room still
wasn’t ready and give a new estimate as to when the room would be ready. Proper customer
service dictates that since I am an owner and my room was not ready was to move me to
another room that was ready when I arrived. At the very least communicate with me to keep
me updated on when my room would be ready. However it was nothing but crickets. I had to
go back to the checkin desk and demand they get me into a room. They put me on the 2nd
floor which was unacceptable after my long wait and nearly every other stay I have been in
room 2508. I went to the front desk and asked to speak to the hotel manager. I asked to be
moved to either The Reserve (Adults only area of the resort) or to room 2508. They moved me
to rooms 2509 and 2510. At this time I was told once again that my concierge would be Jenny
and she was off today (contradicting what I was told by the checkin desk). I was told Jenny
would contact me first thing in the morning when she got to work. I was also told they were
having the mini bar stocked for me right away.
Several hours later the mini bar was not stocked. I called the operator to get someone to
restock the minibar. Again I waited and waited and no one showed. I had to call the operator
every 15 minutes until someone finally showed up at my room to restock the mini bar.
Next I discovered the bathroom in room 2509 had no running water except the toilet, Both
rooms 2509 and 2510 had issues with the drapes working properly. One drape would not move
at all. The wand on one of the drapes came off in my hand while tracking to open them. One
drop was not even attached to the wand mechanism that opens it. I again had to call the
operator to send maintenance up to fix the water and drapes. I told them that they could come
into the room any time the next day to fix the issues.
The next morning when I showered I discovered that the shower in room 2510 (because the
shower in room 2509 wouldn’t work) that I could not get any shampoo out of the resort
provided shampoo bottle. I had brought a travel size of bottle of shampoo that I used that
morning. I expected that when housekeeping came that they would refill the shampoo bottle. I
left my room for the day. Upon returning to my room I found that I could still not get anything
out of the shampoo bottle. Once again I had to call the operator and was told that someone
would be there immediately. Again I waited over an hour before I had to start calling the
operator every 15 minutes to get housekeeping to replace the shampoo bottle with one that
worked. I also checked the bathroom in room 2509. The handwashing sinks now had water.
However the shower was still dry as a bone, no water to be had. Next I checked the drapes.
The non moving drape was fixed. The drape that was not connected was still not connected.
I never heard anything from Jenny until 5:00 PM AFTER I had to constantly complain to get
things taken care. This by the was supposed to be Jenny’s job since the only thing the
concierges have done was book restaurant reservations and on this trip the restaurants no
longer take reservations.
After 24 hours of non stop customer service issues which Noe (hotel manager) and Emayel
(vacation club supervisor) and Jenny (non existent concierge) were supposed to take care of
but I had to deal with myself, I booked the first flight home I could get as there was no
indication that anyone at the hotel was not going to do anything to improve customer service.
Customer service on this visit was non existent. I have never had this poor of customer service
at the hotel. However, I have had the same or worse level of poor customer service at 2 other
Melia properties I stayed at in the past.
I paid $100 dollars per person per night for 7 days all inclusive fee plus taxes which came to
$1,472.00. I only stayed 3 nights so I am owed the return of the all inclusive fee plus taxes for
the remaining 4 days, $841.12. Since I left early due to the poor customer service I received,
the hotel is also responsible for refunding me the cost to change my flights home in the amount
of $1,091.80. Finally, I had an excursion to Xcaret booked for the day that I left that I cancelled
on Sunday which cost $455.98 that Xcaret refused to refund therefore the hotel is responsible
for compensating me for the cost of the lost excursion.
In total the resort owes me $2,388.90. If I would have received proper customer service I would
have stayed for my original planned 7 nights and would not have incurred all of these financial
losses therefore the resort is directly responsible for all of these fees due to lack of customer
service.

reviews.author: rvizconde86
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: For a wedding with our friends and family. Great before and after experience would definitely come back for a 2nd or 3rd time. Felt very spoiled at this resort. Would recommend it to anyone coming to Cancun for the first time!

reviews.author: Leidy M
reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL HOTEL, VERY FRIENDLY STAFF
reviews.text:
This hotel is beautiful and welcoming, the temperature inside the hotel perfect, always very clean. We did very well at check in, we arrived very early (and since it was not checkin time we waited for the room until the indicated time), we were attended immediately, put the armbands, and we were given a physical map with all the information of the hotel, restaurants, and with QR codes to be attentive to the activities. We could enjoy the hotel while the rooms were delivered (we were 6 people, 2 rooms) which was also very punctual. 
- The beautiful rooms with a beautiful sea view, the beach is beautiful, and the service staff close to the beach is very formal and attentive. 
Very good food, there were many options, especially salads, and healthy food like quinoa, salmon, etc. I loved the Ramen of the restaurant Malva (although the soups vary daily)
Please note: 1. Some of the bathroom lighting comes on outside the bathroom, 2. if they leave the air on and the balcony door open starts to generate moisture, better to avoid and leave the balcony door closed. 
--- EYE RECOMMENDATIONS FOR IMPROVEMENT BY THE HOTEL: 

1. There are more activities for children, I really felt they lack spaces and activities for children, although there are some on the kidsdom side, it is insufficient.  Also for adults there are not many options. 
2. They should put a space for people to play their feet when climbing the beach, although there are showers, they are on the beach and when they go out the feet and shoes take a lot of sand and spread everywhere.  
3. Be more attentive in keeping with provisions the minibar of the rooms because only on the first day we found the water and snack in the minibar, then we were not put anything, you had to be asking for the water.

reviews.author: Luis  R
reviews.title: Lemon fish

reviews.author: Wen T

reviews.author: CC_Johnson

reviews.author: Aurelio M
