reviews.author: Road608666
reviews.title: Family vacay
reviews.text:
We just came back from a family vacation at paradisus hotel in cancun. Firstly, our server Didi was incredible. He was personable and truly enjoys his job. He let us know everything we can order and consistently checked in to see if we were okay.
The band Mougel that played the last night was great. The lead singer was amazing and very entertaining. The beach was beautiful and kept clean but unfortunately the water was very rough and we couldn't stay in too long. Overall it was a great experience.

reviews.author: manolopocholo
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun the best option
reviews.text:
A spectacular place to enjoy as a family, a spectacular view of the lagoon and the sea, installation of first class rooms, service and attention from the hosts of the best, we were fortunate to be attended by Lalo a person who was always attentive to our stay providing the best...
Thank you Paradisus Cancun

reviews.author: Lisa R
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text:
The resort is truly breathtaking, starting with the impressive atrium lobby that greets you upon arrival. Although check-in took a bit longer than expected, it was because the staff member was diligently explaining all the wonderful amenities and features of the resort.

We decided to upgrade to the Reserve package, and we’re so glad we did. The Reserve gave us access to:

* Sal Steak Cave (though we didn’t visit)
* Sante (where we dined several times; the food and views were exceptional)
* The Reserve pool
* A dedicated concierge (who expertly handled our dinner reservations and reserved a Bali bed for us)

I had read some reviews before our trip and was a bit apprehensive, but I was pleasantly surprised. The service was outstanding, the room was pleasantly cool, and room service was prompt.

Our highlight dining experience was at Lemon Fish, where the salmon tacos were a standout. Malva Food Bazar was perfect for satisfying our post-cocktail cravings after enjoying drinks at The Ginger Bar.

On the other hand, Taqueria Blue Agave was underwhelming; the food was quite bland. Initially seated near the entrance, I requested a table with an ocean view, and the staff kindly accommodated us. Their attentiveness was commendable throughout the meal.

Overall, four days wasn’t enough to fully explore and appreciate everything this resort has to offer. I would definitely return to experience it all again.

reviews.author: Vaishali F
reviews.title: This hotel is more 4* than 5*
reviews.text:
Hotel is relatively clean but dated. Rooms need a complete makeover and modernisation but are liveable. The AC in our room worked fine and kept the cool room in the heat. 
Beach is stunning with a tractor clearing the seaweed daily. Pools are nice but could be cleaned to a better standard, especially the baby pool. 
Activities are good in the main pool but there is no information about how you can join. Every time we asked to join we were told the list was closed. 
There was no information provided on the beach or by the pool about the nightly entertainment. 
One thing we were a bit confused about was there was a 2 drink maximum when ordering directly at the beach bar and yet when we ordered via the butler on the beach there was no limit. 
Our son had to be seen at the medical clinic and the hotel was great at getting the prescription from a local pharmacy rather than paying $80 per medicine. 
Food at the non buffet restaurants was average, as was the service. 
The buffet restaurant was decent with different freshly prepared grilled food, tacos, quesadillas etc. It was nice they had an extensive salad section and kids corner. Waiters were prompt with taking drinks orders and everyone in there was super helpful. It was our sons 5th birthday and they surprised him with a chocolate cake with a candle with some waiters singing him happy birthday which really made his day. 
Housekeeping was great replenishing towels and our mini bar daily. If we needed more bottled water or towels this would be delivered promptly. 
Room service was mediocre but in an emergency was ok. You were only permitted 2 room service orders a day which was fine for us as we only ordered once or twice throughout our entire stay. 

All in all, I would say this hotel is a solid 4* as it misses the 5* luxury aspect. The rooms need modernising and are too basic but are clean and this is a non negotiable for me. There were no slippers or robes provided which was slightly frustrating but we made do without.

reviews.author: Slickstep18
reviews.title: What was once a great place to visit fell short in expectation.
reviews.text:
I would like to start that my family and I had stayed at Melia Paradisus two years ago for my birthday and had an great time. We decided to return and this time bring 38 people including family and friends to share in our experience.

What was once a great stay, Melia had fell short in their high standard of hospitality and quality of their property ( as a Melia club member).

Upon check-in on the 1st night the AC in our suite was not working, the lever in the bathroom was broken, jacuzzi jets were not operational, and at night found a cockroach in the kitchen unit.

I informed front desk at 845am the following morning regarding all my concerns. At 445pm I followed up with alternatives to our stay, and the front desk replied "still looking into it". They had the whole day to take action and find a resolution and nothing was  done. We then had to escalate to management and it wasn't until 7pm where we had to move our items. They seem to drag their feet in everything.

Throughout our stay you can see that the structure around the pool and inside the pool itself is falling apart. The walls has chunks of material missing, the ceiling under the bridge in the pool had panels gone. 

Even having informed front desk that I was celebrating my 40th Birthday bringing in 9 rooms 50+ room nights, the hotel fell short in taking care of their guests on a momentous occasion. 

The only saving grace is that the F&B staff was all exceptional, the food was great, and attentiveness to our needs in this department was met. 

This will probably be the last time we visit the property.

reviews.author: Jacqui O
reviews.title: Best of the Best🫶💗😜
reviews.text: We visited Paradisus Cancun and met Jhonatan the best bartender in the resort. I still want to thank Gaby and Karina from the same bar. Top-rated. What makes a great vacation is meeting people like these guys. Thanks for everything

reviews.author: lucena s
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text:
Had an AMAZING dinner here at Lenon Fish at the Paradisus!
The food is top notch gourmet.
Kudos to chefs Karen and Marcos, and especially our most gracious waiter,  Jorge. He made our dinner unforgettable! Thank you for a wonderful experience!

reviews.author: Gabriel Ezer
reviews.title: Hotel Fantastic
reviews.text: Excellent service from the waiters at the beach, the entertainment people made my children have an unforgettable time with the wrestling activity that we loved seeing in a hotel, we thank the engineer who helped us with the air of our room.  Highly recommended we hope to return soon

reviews.author: Quest533147
reviews.title: Relaxing family get away
reviews.text:
We traveled from the US as a family of four x 5 days. Kids are 19 and 16 years old. We booked 2 rooms in pyramid 1. Spent our days exclusively at the beach. Had no trouble getting beach loungers each day, but I am an early riser. I think securing a spot in a lounger is probably more difficult past 8:30am. 

Our final day at the beach was, by far, the best experience due to the beach waiter Jhandi. He was so attentive! He had great suggestions for drinks and snacks and we left so impressed with his service.

The restaurants were fine for an AI. We enjoyed Blue Agave tacos the most. One night the ramen at Lemon Fish was terrific, the next night (because the kids enjoyed it so much) we returned and found it inedible. We just found something else to eat later.

Overall we were pleased with our stay. Rooms clean and comfortable. Food average. Service terrific.

reviews.author: Jodi J
reviews.title: Adult Family Birthday Vacation
reviews.text: Our Butler Falcon could not have been more helpful and pleasant! He was able to make all our requests and dinner reservations and since we were traveling with other family members in another room and he helped all of us! Cesar, Victor, and Oscar out by the reserve pool were all just absolutely amazing and made our vacation memorable. We could not have asked for better service and attention, they all went above and beyond.

reviews.author: Sergiu O
reviews.title: Good service and beautiful beach
reviews.text: The hotel is a little old but is clean and the service is very good, nobody is waiting for tips, everybody are nice and friendly. The beach is gorgeous, no algaes and the beach is wide, yes there are waives, one day smaller, other day bigger waives, but the water is clean, turquoise.

reviews.author: Rosie S
reviews.title: I love Lemon Fish!!
reviews.text: Jorge is amazing! His service is top of the the line and the food was spectacular. Marcos is the best chef and Jorge was very attentive! Love this place!! Not to mention the great mariachi band. Overall great service and amazing delicious food I would recommend this place to everyone! Thank you, Jorge for an amazing dinner!I love lemon fish!!

reviews.author: Bella S
reviews.title: I love Lemon Fish
reviews.text: This place is the best! Jorge from Lemon Fish was very attentive and very charismatic. As soon as my drink went finished I had a new one right away.  Marcos makes the most delicious food. I had an amazing experience!!!! The amazing mariachi was the cherry on top! I highly recommend eating at this amazing restaurant.

reviews.author: Robin N
reviews.title: Exceptional!!!
reviews.text: It was AMAZING! Falcon was our concierge and provided us with exceptional service! We truly felt like royalty! Cannot wait to go back to visit! The food, the atmosphere and the service far exceeded our expectations! It was such an amazing vacation!

reviews.author: Edy H
reviews.title: All friendly and attentive staff Rocio
reviews.text:
No negative comments 
All excellent 
From a friendly reception to the ease of check in and check out, this is a pleasant experience for guests. 
The all-inclusive plan is ideal for the family and with the support of the staff you have a better experience thanks to its recommendations and help at all times to answer questions.

reviews.author: Daydream14131043458
reviews.title: Friendly Staff
reviews.text:
We stayed for 5 nights and had a great time. 

Stayed in a Sunset View Room - Pyramid 2(Non-Reserve), and was nervous due to the negative reviews I was reading prior to coming. However, we didn’t face any big issues during our stay.

Our rooms did have minor issues like one of the light bulbs going out, but nothing that ruins our experience. 

Housekeeping made sure our room was clean and tidy everyday. 

The coffee corner was convenient with very pleasant staff. The line does get long but we opted to come in earlier to avoid the rush of guests. The same goes for the morning buffet. We avoided the wait by waking up a little earlier. 

Shoutout to the employees at the ginger bar Gabriela, Abby, Jonathan, Corina, and Everisto. They showed great hospitality and made sure that we were served despite how busy it got. If you want to have a good time, Gabriela, Abby and Jonathan works so well together and makes sure you’re smiling. 

Overall, we would come back again. 
The staff were very friendly. Especially Gabriela, who made my group of friends feel extra special.

reviews.author: Cristian R
reviews.title: Excellent service from Chef Marco
reviews.text: Excellent hotel with a beautiful and very clean beach. The culinary experience at Blueagave restaurant was perfect; the tacos were amazing. The Italian restaurant was also exceptional, although the waiting time can be long due to everyone coming in at the same time. The buffet is the highlight of the meal, offering a variety of dishes, excellent taste and a spectacular ceviche bar. However, I missed the buffet pizza, which I enjoyed on a previous visit. Fortunately, the poolside pizzeria offers delicious pizza throughout the day. Ice cream is also very good.

reviews.author: Bernabe
reviews.title: Reaction in time to enjoy Cancun
reviews.text:
After a disastrous start, due to the allocation of regrettable rooms, the hotel reacted superbly, allocating excellent rooms and providing unbeatable treatment. 
The experience of the holidays after the reaction of the hotel was quite successful. 
To thank our family concierge, Ricardo, and the guest experience Astrid.

reviews.author: Leonardo Ruiz
reviews.title: FRAUD on online reservations
reviews.text: I booked online via an Instagram link. The link said Melia.com and my reservation if made. The problem is that the app gave me the option of children up to 17 years old. I have a son of 14 I put the necessary data and when I arrive at the hotel they tell me that the children are maximum of 12 years and since mine was bigger they had to charge me the extra person at front desk price what is the most expensive of all. I paid 28 thousand pesos for the reservation and they wanted to charge me 31 THOUSAND PESOS MORE JUST FOR MY SON!!!! A total fraud by deception since being there is nothing else to pay.  Plus they're gonna close that hotel and give it zero maintenance. I recommend avoiding staying at the Paradisus Cancun hotel especially if you are with teenagers.

reviews.author: Travel25428060683
reviews.title: Good food.
reviews.text: My husband and I loved everything. The breakfast is very good, well varied, and the quantity good, with a great taste. The lunch buffet is great and wonderful from tasty. Chef Marco is very attentive, creative and makes great dishes. Everything was fine.

reviews.author: Márcio S
reviews.title: Regomendo
reviews.text: A perfect stay, wonderful beach, much heat at that time, amazing food, Chef Marco Lopes for twice in cooked some rice dishes that were divine. Very attentive to me and my wife. Aguamarina fish restaurant is very good. Restaurant Sal de carnes deserves another touch from the chef because it is different when he made the entrecotte for us. Let's go back.

reviews.author: Nicole C
reviews.title: Amazing Time at Paradisus Reserve
reviews.text: AMAZING vacation!!!! We upgraded the family to the Reserve and couldn't have been happier!!!!! Our concierge Roseanna was top notch!!! She helped us with everything during our stay including a birthday celebration for my sister, making sure we had dinner reservations every night, sunset cruise, bali beds at the pool daily, spa day etc. It made the trip so carefree and enjoyable and we really appreciated it!!!!!!!!!!! Victor at the cabana made sure we were taken care of each day with a beautiful bali bed and Oscar was the best server that was there for everything that our family needed the entire week!!! They all went above and beyond for our family!! It was nice nice to meet Nicole from the cabana area as well as Ceasar from serving who took care of us nicely!! Every dinner was wonderful and the decor inside the Reserve is breathtaking with the best ice lattes at the lobby bar!! All the workers were kind and friendly and made us feel like family. The ocean views from our rooms were to die for and the grounds at the reserve pool area were designed like a spa. My husband and I did stretching every morning at the gazebo and the family enjoyed the activities during the day including golf, the foam party, crafts, volleyball on the beach etc. There was a club for the kids to enjoy late night after dinner and tons of private beautiful areas to relax and talk for all of us. We also really enjoyed casino night as a family. We couldn't have asked for a more beautiful place to stay with the best staff with amazing views, beach, restaurants, activities, and spa. Was best mix of relaxation and fun!! We can't wait to go back!!!

reviews.author: carpio2017
reviews.title: AN EXTRAORDINARY HOTEL
reviews.text:
It is an excellent hotel with extraordinary food and service options

It is worth enjoying the Santé restaurant, like the Agave.   Overall, a very good experience, with excellent service in most cases.

reviews.author: Roberto N
reviews.title: Thank you very much Paradisus Cancun and Erich! Cheers!
reviews.text: Erich Andrade is a great host. There was a drawback with the Reservation as two double beds were requested and we were given a room with a king. However, Erich took care of changing rooms and everything in order. Everything else was spectacular. Thank you!

reviews.author: Keri M
reviews.title: Wonderful resort ….book your trip now!
reviews.text: We just returned from Paradisus Cancun, and we miss it already!  I highly recommend this resort.   We stayed on the Reserve side, and took our young adult kids (ages 20 & 22), and all had the best time!   This was a first experience for my kids and while they are younger adults, they too were treated with so much respect and made many friends with the staff!  The resort is so clean, beaches kept beautiful, food and drinks were amazing!  I can’t say enough about the staff….everyone was so nice and polite.  Our concierge was George, and his suggestions, attentiveness and willingness to help with any request we had was top notch!  Special shout outs to Luis for the drinks (Whoop! Whoop!), Itsamary for the fun day events, and Oscar for always keeping our drinks full and food in our belly’s!   We hope to return again!!

reviews.author: elizabeth85202024
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
Highly recommended, the attention of the concierge in the adult area is quite good and in itself that of the whole hotel.
Our concierge George Topalović was very attentive always, helped us to make our vacation better

reviews.author: nceline11
reviews.title: Flora restaurant review
reviews.text: Incredible food, great service, and lovely atmosphere! We chose a variety of different appetizers and main courses to share. We especially loved the duck, prawns, and octopus salad. Our server, Santos, was also wonderful! Overall a 5 star experience. We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Mackenzie M
reviews.title: We had the best time!!!
reviews.text: We booked the adult only reserve side of the resort and it was incredible. Completely different vibe than the other side of the hotel. Food & staff were amazing! We especially loved Alejandro & Christian! Will definitely recommend this place to friends!

reviews.author: MariaLuisa M
reviews.title: A luxurious experience
reviews.text: The staff who attended helped make the experience excellent.  The restaurant Sante provided us with good food and a beautiful view of the sea.Martín and Lorena were luxurious hosts, very concerned to give the improvement. . At the Atrio bar, where breakfast and lunch are also served, we were greeted by Julio, a very friendly gentleman and always with a smile.  We were assigned as concierge Limberth, very attentive with us. We recommend the experience.

reviews.author: Querube M
reviews.title: Poor Service Quality, not a great Family resort for those with small children
reviews.text:
My family and I stayed at Paradisus for a couple of nights and we were very disappointed. My husbands family is actually from the Dominican and we go to an all-inclusive resort every year, we are sad to say that the service was not great. Consider booking at another resort, they are some amazing ones out there. Here is my list of items that we experiences that were not great: 

Service Quality: Throughout our stay, we experienced consistently poor service. The staff did not appear enthusiastic or attentive, which impacted our overall experience negatively.

Check-In Process: The automatic online check-in service was non-functional, leading us to wait in line to speak to someone and get our room assigned. This inefficiency added unnecessary frustration to our arrival.

Delay in Room Requests: Despite requesting a bed and crib upon arrival, it took multiple follow-ups before these items were finally provided. This delay was inconvenient and did not meet our expectations for prompt service.

Family Activities: the resort is marketed as a family destination, but we found the kids' activities to be lacking. The kids' room and available activities were subpar compared to other resorts we’ve visited in Punta Cana, making it less appealing for families with children.

Dining Reservations: Securing reservations at your restaurants was challenging. We attempted to book a table at 9:30 am, but the only available option was the Dominican restaurant, which was not suitable for children.

reviews.author: ramirezjc410
reviews.title: Family vacation at Paradisus Cancun resort
reviews.text: If you want a 5-star experience go to Paradisus Cancun resort. The customer service was excellent and the food was delicious. The beach was amazing the water was great and weather too.

reviews.author: Norma N
reviews.title: Lovely experience!!
reviews.text: Beautiful building and pleasant atmosphere. You have the best beach and most spectacular views of Cancun. You have an extensive variety of food and drinks in 4 days and 3 nights we could not go to all available restaurants. The spectacular service from the moment of our arrival with the reception of Oscar giving us instructions of our room and the amenities that we have. one of the most important people that made our stay very pleasant was Rocio. Rocio one of the Concierge she was very friendly, very professional, and with one of the best attitudes, from the first day we aged for two of our Gala dinners with an expectacula service, not only agendo our dinner but also our spa. Thanks to Rocio we had an unforgettable experience. Like not naming the service provided in the Reserve area, Miguel and Cesar Top-rated in the area. So beautiful was our experience that right now we are planning the return to PARADISUS !!!!

reviews.author: Orlando C
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancún the best hotel in Cancún
reviews.text:
Don’t let the negative reviews about Paradisus Cancun sway you; they often come from those who fail to appreciate the resort’s beauty, luxury, and stunning scenery.

We’ve visited this wonderful hotel five times now, and the level of service is consistently top-notch. The beach is one of the best in the world—absolutely no seaweed!

I must mention Astrid Sarria, the guest experience manager, who is exceptional. She truly embodies the high standards of this hotel, going above and beyond to ensure a fantastic stay. She’s the best I’ve encountered in the business.
The food is delicious with a good variety.
Great shows, especially the African show was spectacular. The live band was also good. 
Ramiro from Malva restaurant is exceptional

You will not regret to choose Paradisus Cancun, the Best of the Best!

reviews.author: Papi Chulo
reviews.title: Paradisus, Kana beach club
reviews.text: David blanco was amazing. Best service in Cancun period! Highly recommend this perfect beach location. This was my first time to Cancun, and because of David and his team , my family and I had an absolutely fantastic experience, thank you David blanco and team, we will be back soon 👍

reviews.author: Stephanie C
reviews.title: Food experience
reviews.text: best tacos by far!! good flavor with each tacos. Amazing atmosphere with excellent music. Staff is very friendly and tentative. As well as giving the best recommendations for food. One of my favorite restaurants in the hotel. Will definitely be going back!!

reviews.author: GrandTour248827
reviews.title: Worst service ever
reviews.text:
I am rating this 2, thinking I should rate it a 1. A lot of things were horrible since day one of our arrival. I, along with my family, booked five rooms in total. I asked for at least two rooms to be together or close by to be with my kids, and they told me they couldn’t do that day until the following day. They gave me a room with one bed, although I had my babies. When I asked for two beds, they said my kids could sleep on the sofa bed, which was very thin, old, and uncomfortable. My kids had to sleep with us in bed; I couldn’t sleep. The following day, they sent me to a smaller room with one bed, so we had to go back to the old room, and the whole week, we had to sleep with my young kids, which was very uncomfortable although I was on vacation.

The worst of all was the service. I gave it a 0. They had no people to help, neither in the pool area, restaurants, or buffet. We couldn’t try the restaurants because every time we went to get a table, they would say 1 1/2 to 2 wait times, and by the time they had a table, the kitchen was going to be closed, so they didn't allow us even to put our name down. We had to eat at the buffet every night, and they usually had the same food and, again, no one to help us get our drinks or anything. We had to wait in line every morning for at least half an hour to have breakfast at the buffet. We go to different resorts yearly, and we have never experienced this. The reservation at the restaurant is a lot better.

Lastly, the hotel's entertainment was very short and very small. We even experienced no face painting for the kids because it was only for the kids at the kids' club. There was no entertainment past about 10. There was only one bar at night, and they closed early.

This has been the worst experience we had in many years. The only good thing was the beach in the hotel.

reviews.author: rachigna
reviews.title: Wonderful do not hesitate to visit everything is perfect
reviews.text: An amazing holiday! Super satisfied for the whole family would return one and a thousand times more! The staff is amazing

reviews.author: Juliana M
reviews.title: Wonderful holidays!!
reviews.text: Nice hotel, good location, good restaurants within the hotel. Spacious and clean room, good food and drinks... I would definitely come back!

reviews.author: Atak
reviews.title: The Reserve at Paradisus.
reviews.text:
What a lovely place to visit. My husband and I stayed for 8 days at the adults only Reserve part of the hotel. A big thank you to our concierge, Violeta,  and Nicole who looked after the bed allocation at the Reserve pool. We experienced the best of service from these ladies as well as the entertainment team at the pool and the staff around the Sante restaurant and bar area. There was fun activities to do each day. 

The private dining area in pyramid 5 was lovely and peaceful. The fact that the staff remembered our preferred drinks orders each day was a nice touch from our coffee preference to wines and cocktails.

The location is excellent for travelling around, the people friendly and helpful. Would highly recommend visiting Paradisus.

reviews.author: Guillermo
reviews.title: Quite a paradise!
reviews.text:
Hey, everybody! I just came back from an amazing vacation at the Paradisus Cancun (Melia) and I have a lot to tell you. Overall I give it a 4.5:)

The good:

The location of this hotel is privileged. The sea has an amazing color and the waves are spectacular. The interior of the hotel is great with a jungle decoration with many plants. It has 7 very rich restaurants, especially Italian. The staff was wonderful. I highly recommend dealing with Rocio (Family Concierge) and Malú as they were stars during our stay; their attention and warmth really made a difference. Thanks to them, every moment was special and we felt at home. The service here is definitely top notch.

The not so good:

On the other hand, although the hotel is a spectacular place, our room left a little to be desired. The facilities feel a bit old and definitely need an upgrade to keep up with the rest of the hotel. It's a shame because everything else was perfect. The walls, windows, glass and mirrors of the bathrooms are noticeable with antique damage.

In short, despite the details of the room, the experience was very positive, we will definitely return. I hope to return and find the renovated rooms for next time!

reviews.author: Vanessa Burgueño
reviews.title: Excelent!
reviews.text: We were at Paradisus Cancun, we thought the hotel was luxurious since it is an iconic place in Cancun where you see photos of the property everywhere, however the hotel is very deteriorated, and needs a lot of maintenance since there are leaks everywhere the buildings, the staff is friendly and the food is of good quality, we were assisted by a very friendly lady in the Family Concierge area who gave us information about the facilities and attractions of the area. A special greeting to Alondra who made the difference.

reviews.author: Faezeh T
reviews.title: AMAZING FOOD AND THE NICEST WORKERS!!
reviews.text: The waitress was so nice the whole experience was very good, he recommended great food, come here like NOW!! My first time in Mexico and I really enjoyed there traditional food! Again the waitresses AMAZING! 100% RECOMMEND!!

reviews.author: Babak K
reviews.title: Thankfully
reviews.text: I got a fantastic and wonderful service by the Moises Morales, he was so respectful and professional waiter and thanks for Moises friendly service . Also the restaurant was so traditionalist food and table and chairs. We were enjoyed this experience and recommend to anybody for this kind of traditionalist Mexican food.

reviews.author: Melissa C
reviews.title: Cielito lindo restaurant
reviews.text: I came to stay at paradisus and I would say for the food being free it is soooo good! Even the food that’s from my homeland ( yucatan) is soooo good too! Love the service I had with my waiter his name was Melvin and he was very nice and very attentive 10/10 service !

reviews.author: Brayan C
reviews.title: The best place to have a great time on vacation
reviews.text:
Everything is excellent, everyone is super attentive, friendly, helpful from the moment we arrive, the truth is we never want to leave here.
The rooms are very nice, the bed and pillows are very comfortable.
The hotel is incredible, along with its restaurants.

reviews.author: sapan m
reviews.title: Aug 2023 family reunion
reviews.text: The experience is one of the best we have had at an all inclusive. Atilano at the Bfast buffet was excellent and attended to our needs with our 3 children ages 6, 4 and 8. The resort had everything for everyone and very good with accommodating all 40 that traveled with us.

reviews.author: Shawn
reviews.title: Great trip!  Will be back.
reviews.text: The staff were amazing.   Food was great, especially at Lemon Fish!  Beautiful beach, no seaweed.  Beautiful resort that is well taken care of. Armando, Alfredo and Ramiro every morning at the breakfast buffet ready with a smile. Louis and Orlando at the pool bar made excellent drinks and were so much fun. Even Juan who handled our baggage remembered our names from when we checked in to when we left!  We did not write down the name od the beach server but he was there with a refill of our water or drinks all day.  I really appreciate that they do not give out water bottles anymore! Must save 100's or 1000's of plastic bottles a day.

reviews.author: A M
reviews.title: Malva Food Bazar
reviews.text: This review is for the Malva Food Bazar staff members Ivonn and Diego.  They  were our severs on multiple occasions and where always very friendly and attentive to our needs while we had our breakfast.  The restaurant is always very busy but they always took more than good care of us.  They were so sweet they even had a sign for us on our last day. we felt that was a sweet personal touch.

reviews.author: Ravi26v
reviews.title: Wonderful ambience with great pools and beach access, major disappointment was food
reviews.text:
Hotel looks extraordinary, feels like a Paradise, beach access is great, pools are awesome, kids rooms is great, spa is good. 

Drawbacks: 
1. Restaurants are not great expect for Malva 
2. Rooms doesn’t feel like 5 starts 
3. Being in tropical climate Air conditioning needs to be powerful 
4. All the included entertainment options are not disclosed ahead (kayaking, photography, etc) 
5. Coupons are useless

reviews.author: dksper
reviews.title: We were very well taken care of
reviews.text: Melvin made sure me and my wife's experience at Cielo was an amazing honeymoon welcome!  Highly recommend the food, the resort, the staff to everyone, definitely telling my friends and family!  It truly felt like a very special night.

reviews.author: Cindy M
reviews.title: Quiet getaway at the Paradesius
reviews.text: We planned a 7 day relaxation get away to Cancun, husband and I. We have been to Cancun 5 times.  This was the 3rd time at Paradisus. The service was amazing and actually why we returned. (It wasn't for the room accomodations) Oscar and Miguel for pool and dining experience (and a whole staff of people) took great care of us, the entire trip.  The Capella,  Santi for breakfast daily, Sal steak cave, Lemon Fish and icing on the cake "Aqua Marina",  we couldn't of been happier with the food and service from the pool to the restaurants. Our concierge (Alavetta) was very busy and helpful to address issues with 2 rooms, the a/c,  faucets etc, she did it with grace and professionalism.   We will be back to Cancun. I'm not sure if we can duplicate the great service the Reserve upgrade has to offer, adults only is the best. We would request a better room also a better ocean view but in the end, it was more about the service, which was what we came for. Thanks Miguel Gabñel Quiñones and our friend Oscar and everyone that took care of us. too. We will remember you for the experience!

reviews.author: Elsa F
reviews.title: Malva Restaurant
reviews.text: The Malva restaurant has excellent food and variety and the service is 5 stars thanks to Edier, Joni, Atilano and Alfredo, they treated us wonderfully at all times and were super kind to the family

reviews.author: MoisesAndreu
reviews.title: EXCELLENT SERVICE
reviews.text:
On a general level, the hotel is fantastic, but we consider things to improve as well.
In comparison to the magnificent service provided by all employees, from the gardener to the person who serves you a soft drink, the reception service leaves a lot to be desired, both due to the lack of information at check-in about all areas and restaurants of the hotel, as well as other information regarding Melia rewards discounts and benefits, which we requested on several occasions and it took us several confirmations and bad gestures to confirm what we requested, we understand that due to lack of information from the staff about them. SPECIAL MENTION to the room service, although the furniture needs renovation, it is the best service we have had in any hotel in the chain. We also want to make special mention of the service of all the people who make up the F&B department, highlighting the personalized service of JONI, ATILANO and EDIER at the Malva restaurant. And congratulations also to the girl whose name I don't remember who serves in the beach area, a true professional.

reviews.author: Vidyia R
reviews.title: Sweet holiday
reviews.text:
Sweetest smelling lobby ever and bars everywhere.  Beach was amazing although waves were a little rough for me, I still enjoyed the ocean water.  The pool was lovely and we would get a day bed and set up near the beach, pool and restaurant for the day.  We enjoyed the food and the silent disco and the lounge with the couches and beds.  The staff were all amazingly attentive.  Highly recommend early to breakfast as the lines can get long closer to 9.  

Had an ocean view room and the view was more than worth the price.  Couldn't be happier with the experience.

reviews.author: omar s
reviews.title: Good coffee
reviews.text: Alejandro at the Nespresso coffee station is the best employee at Paradisus. He makes delicious coffees apart from having a very good mood. He likes to joke and make people smile, Recommended!

reviews.author: arefinwadud
reviews.title: Paradisus review
reviews.text: The resort was very good except the check in procedure was such a hassle. We told the hotel prior that we are getting 2 rooms and that we need them next to each other given they don’t have connecting. They told me the day I got there after my 6 hour flight that they can’t do it until the next day.  The balcony doors were broken in both the rooms we got as well as the door for the bathroom was broken as well.

reviews.author: Wei W
reviews.title: Cielo🙌🙌💯
reviews.text: Exellent  new food for foreigners. An exceptional waiter named Moises was our waiter and  gave us excellent service. The restaurant was an intimate place with a good atmosphere. The food we ate was very good authentic Mexican food, really recommend visitors to try this place💯💯🇲🇽🇲🇽

reviews.author: Alex Fabricio Jaramillo
reviews.title: Blue agave restaurant
reviews.text:
Separate note, the hotel… is good, beautiful but at times its staff is careless. If you don't have the "all-inclusive" bracelet, they don't pay attention to you or make problems with each order. I found an empty water bottle on the 0th floor on Monday, by Thursday, it was still in the same place.

Its restaurants are very good but those that take the medal are Cielito Lindo and Blue Agave, in the latter, Very good tacos. Especially the chistorra one. The gringa de pastor and the cochinita are recommended.

Normal portions for a hotel and reasonable price

Exceptional attention from Daniel and his manager Barbara.

reviews.author: María Elena G
reviews.title: Total happiness
reviews.text: Excellent hotel, very nice facilities and very friendly staff. The best restaurants for dinner are Agua Marina, Cristel and Alex served us wonderfully. At Capella the cheese on their pizzas is delicious which gives it a special touch, Fernando's service was wonderful

reviews.author: xxx
reviews.title: Rafael from lemon fish, excellent service
reviews.text:
Very good recommendations and high level and very friendly service….
The suchis and tacos very good flavor

The atmosphere of the restaurant
Very nice and pleasant

One of the best of the different alternatives offered

reviews.author: Gianti F
reviews.title: 100/100! Recommend!!!
reviews.text: We LOVE, encanta, Ginger 2!! Karina was the absolute best cocktail server we could EVER ask for. Please tell karina her hard work and great personality made a great impact on our trip to Paradisus! Gaby y Valentine were so great too. Highly recommend Ginger bar 2, that are so amazing, personable, and SO friendly. WE LOVE THEM. especially Karina. I could giver her the world.

reviews.author: Capuccini E
reviews.title: 2 people from the Hotel Staff made my stay somewhat uncomfortable
reviews.text:
A very beautiful hotel, very nice facilities, they even take care of the smell of the hotel at all times.
The food, part of the breakfast, was not our favorite, but we liked the lunch and dinner a lot. In particular, we had the opportunity to go to dinner at Lemmon Fish and I must admit that it was quite an experience guided by Mr. Meserl Carlos, who was the one who attended us but more than that, he guided us to be able to taste everything. This guy's attitude is the best. The guys at Pool bar are always attentive and very friendly. I only had one detail, when we went to dinner at Blue Agave, when they handed us over everything was good except for one detail that did bother me, when the waiter arrived to take my drink order he had told him that the Hostess at the entrance had already I had taken my order. Apparently the girl heard and he went to my table and with a somewhat harsh tone he mentioned "I'm not the Hostess, I'm the one in charge of this restaurant..." I repeat this made me quite uncomfortable since I also work in a restaurant and customer service , and this is something you can't do... I didn't want to know if she was in charge of Blue Agave or the entire Hotel. If I said that it was the moment that the Hostess offered me, it was because I thought she had that position because she was the one who passed us on.
Another thing that was also very annoying is the Concierge staff “Marifer” who was super pushy for us to have a talk about the timeshares, so much so that he was even waiting for us outside The Luch Box when we were having breakfast. I understand that it is her job, but at no time did I see myself interested in the same thing, it was just that she wanted us to go.
Isaac the guy at the reception, super super friendly, explained all our questions at all times and even guided me to my room.
Delicious drinks, friendly staff and a very well-kept beach, very clean at all times.

reviews.author: B R
reviews.title: Thank you Manain
reviews.text: Manain Perez Alvarado, the lifeguard at Paradisus was wonderful. He helped us find something we lost and was concerned until we found it. He was kind everyday we were there and was very respectful. Wonderful person! Thank you Manain!

reviews.author: Mike S
reviews.title: Rapist/Abducter inside Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
********TRAVELERS BE AWARE*********
By far the worst hotel experience I've ever had. We had a party of 20 people that stayed here at Paradisus Cancun by Melia. On our night of the stay my wife was followed to our room as she was walking alone by a unknown individual. This predator waited until my wife went into the room and he starts forcing himself in through the door. He kept knocking and slamming on the door. My wife was screaming at him from the other side that this is not your room and you need to leave. He didn't care and this kept going for another 5 minutes as she was on the phone with me. I told her to call the front desk to tell them to send security to the room immediately. As she was on her cell phone with me as well as the front desk from the room phone I could hear the suspect banging on the door and speaking in Spanish. I took off running at this point towards the room from the gazebo location with my brother as well. 

We get to the forth floor several minutes after and the predator is still outside the door room 4410 I start yelling at him and he was not worried at all. My brother does the same and at this point he takes out his long key that looked like a knife and is flexing it towards my brother's face. At this point I put the suspect in a choke hold and slammed him to the ground. No security was there no manager was there no one to help my wife besides myself my brother and my sister in-law who ran for several minutes from outside the hotel to the 4th floor. The manager that arrived 15 minutes later his name is Jose Maday Molina who approached us as with a nasty attitude asking us with an authority why is this guy on the ground raising his voice towards me. As I was beyond furious with anger and beyond belief disappointed with the entire hotel staff after what we had gone through. No police were called by the hotel security or the manager. I'm fact my brother had to call the police on his own. The hotel failed us the Entire staff failed us the security failed us and were completely useless. I will report this place to the American Embassy in Mexico since none of the managers have even apologized to any of us. This place needs to be shut down. Do not take your family here. Please please stay away from Paradisus Cancun, don't be fooled by the name.

reviews.author: claudia t
reviews.title: Raphael from Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Excellent service from Mr. Rafael, very friendly and knows the complete menu, he suggested short rib taco, it was delicious done to perfection. Rafael is also very cool best service. Thank you very much!

reviews.author: roger l
reviews.title: Raffael at Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Food was delicious, service was great. Raffael was a attentative and provided everything we needed. Great choice of sushi and Peruvian food, seafood was fresh, desserts were excellent as well. Definitely recommend it

reviews.author: Alan M
reviews.title: Very good service
reviews.text: Excellent sea view to enjoy with family. Excellent service, they serve you very kindly and very attentive, especially the attention of the young Santos Pacheco, excellent food and drinks, 100% recommended.

reviews.author: Ricardo Arizpe
reviews.title: Paradissus Cancun Excellent
reviews.text:
The Hotel Paradissus Cancún gave us excellent treatment, from the moment we arrived the staff was very friendly, the check-in was super fast, the hotel in general was very clean and fresh with very nice facilities, the activities for the family were very good, contests for the whole family in the pool and beach, they even gave their guests activities that regularly have a cost in the independent Aquaword park, kids club, excellent attention always with a positive attitude and a smile for the children and their parents,
The waiters at the pools and restaurants were very attentive and helpful. The waiter Ricardo at the buffet restaurant even gave us a good talk about the catering.
Top-notch food quality. Very attentive staff at Circle by Melia
 The beach is clean with strong waves in the area
Without a doubt, we will visit the Melia hotel chain again, my family and I left with a great taste in our mouths, highly recommended.

reviews.author: Ciara D
reviews.title: Rafeal - lemon fish
reviews.text:
Rafeal was amazing , he was very attentive and catered to my request.
He always made sure the food was perfect and never let my glass go empty. 
The food was amazing and the atmosphere was very relaxing and calm.
Thank you Rafeal for making my dinner so amazing :)

reviews.author: Adrian V
reviews.title: Raphael
reviews.text: Excellent atmosphere, family atmosphere, excellent treatment from staff and waiters, very tasty food. Spacious places, excellent for photographs and moments of relaxation, excellent decoration and cleanliness.

reviews.author: Gary M
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text:
First time visiting Cancun and the Paradisus. This resort is awesome! The staff, restaurants, food, cleanliness, pool and beach location and overall experience was absolutely wonderful, with special thanks to some of the staff who really looked after us.
Ginger Bar 2, Gaby, Karina, Valentin.  Main Pool Bar, Alessio.  All the staff at Malva.

reviews.author: Mohamad M
reviews.title: Another amazing experience at melia paradisus resorts
reviews.text: Went to paradisus Cancun and and it is my second time here and it was an excellent experience both times, only down fall is no a/c in the lobby and it can get a little hot in the lobby and restaurants especially in the summer, but all the staff were amazing and friendly, and our butler Andres and Violeta helped us with a couple occasions and made our stay fantastic, the hostess Irania and the waiters in lunch box made us feel special, Elder in the buffet and many more names that we can’t remember

reviews.author: Alaa H
reviews.title: Lunch Box experience
reviews.text: The food was top-notch. We were a big party and the servers took good care of us. We loved their brisket entree and all their appetizers. All the servers are exceptional. We loved the company of Iran, she really goes beyond to make sure everyone is happy with the service.

reviews.author: jacky s
reviews.title: cute little sky
reviews.text: Cielito cute Mexican restaurant, excellent service, especially from Melvin Jimenez, as well as good food, highly recommended, a good idea to order different dishes to share and top it off with some churros for dessert

reviews.author: Alejandra F
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text:
Delighted with the hotel, the delicious food and the KidsDom the best, thank you for all the care towards the children, thank you so much Tessa, Rubí, Bruno, Ivana and Ivón, the best at taking care of and hacking the activities like the children, when we arrived we had an inconvenience with the weather it wasn't that cold and immediately
They changed our room, excellent service 10 out of 10

reviews.author: Maria Isabel G
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: A very good experience. The facilities are very good, the only drawback is the bathtub in the bathroom; Delicious food and above all I would highlight the treatment of the staff: kindness, friendliness, always willing to help and make the experience pleasant. I highlight the staff of the international buffet. Excellent nature conservation policy.

reviews.author: Kavitha B
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Very good food. Awesome service by Jorge, Juan Carlos, and Chef Mario. They went out of their way to make sure that all our dietary needs were taken care of (vegetarian dishes) , and made some special surprise dishes that were out of this world, including wonderful deserts.  Highly recommended, don’t miss the experience!

reviews.author: shoney
reviews.title: So conflicted…
reviews.text:
My husband I were vacationing at majestic elegance costa mujeres and decided to extend the trip 2 nights.  Back in 1997 we stayed here so we decided to go back to where our first trip occurred… enjoy some nostalgia 

Check in:  awful.  Long line. Slow.  

Lobby: stunning.  Incredibly hot.  This is a theme throughout.  

Service: impeccable. We sat in the upper tier beach section after check in.  I thought it might be so when the server approached I asked. He said since no one was here could he please get us lunch and drinks.  Why not?? He brought us out more than we ordered and it was lovely. 

The service everywhere was great. I don’t have names but everyone was wonderful. 

The room:  it was ok. Bed and linens were fine. No snacks or mini bar stocked on check in but replenished the next day    The tub was cracked the drain was scary. Not the nice walk in shower we have been accustomed to in the years since our visit 

The food:  this is where they shine. Fantastic meals.  Food quality and presentation on point.  The whole fried fish and coconut shrimp at the restaurant by the pool was absolutely fantastic.   The lack of a/c is an issue.  The first night we went tot the outside Mexican buffet. It was fine but the homemade to order marquesita was unforgettable.  Perfect.  Entertainment was great.  
Italian;  my husband didn’t wan to go because of the lack of a/c but we went early and got a table next to fountain.  Food and service fantastic. So glad went 

Bathrooms: the bathroom by the pool downstairs from the lunch restitution was gross. Like really gross. Lobby bathroom
 Was a little better but not much 

Pools.   Way too deep.  Too hot in august to enjoy. Didn’t feel clean. Left quickly

Beach: perfect. Had a ball in the water and drink service was great 

Overall: beautiful property.  Older facilities. Fantastic food    Way too hot !!!  Lack of air conditioning during. A Mexican heat wave was unbearable!!!

reviews.author: victorbotello01
reviews.title: Fumigate
reviews.text: The trip made them lose the cockroaches in the room, they have to take great care of that aspect, not suggesting a room change was also very discouraging, it costs nothing to the hotel, they were not full anyway.

reviews.author: Felix L
reviews.title: The best bar in Paradisus Resort, Cancun
reviews.text: Excellent service. Very good drinks Gaby, Karina and Valentín were amazing with their hospitality and charisma. I recommend that you visit the Ginger Bar when you come to Paradisus Cancún. …………It is our third time, and always the same service and quality.

reviews.author: Romina Gerardin... C
reviews.title: Juan Carlos and Rafael from lemon fish
reviews.text: A very nice hotel with a very good experience, it has very good staff and especially in the gastronomy in lemon fish (oriental food) super delicious with very friendly and attentive waiters….. a very relaxing and quiet hotel

reviews.author: Dalila M
reviews.title: Excellent attention and service from the employees Rubi, Bruno, Ivana, Ivon, from the kidsdom children's club, they are very friendly, paci
reviews.text:
Excellent attention and service from the employees Rubi, Bruno, Ivana, Ivon, from the kidsdom children's club, they are very kind, patient, aptitude, positive energy and optimistic.

This is the fourth time we have stayed at the Paradisus hotel and we love the hotel as well as its service.
 
Thank you

reviews.author: Samira
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text:
They treated us very well!!!!!!!!
The waiter Santos from blue agave had very good attention and everyone was very friendly.
Highly recommended to enjoy with the family and forget about the daily routine……. The view is beautiful. The Aladdin show was very cool, the Genie was very good

reviews.author: Gen A
reviews.title: Great hotel! Amazing service!
reviews.text:
My friends and I had a great time at Paradisus Cancun. The food was great at the buffet, restaurants, and room service. They drinks were good as well and there was a great selection of premium alcohol in the reserve side which I would highly recommend upgrading too. 

I want to give a huge shout out to Luis, Miguel, and Javier who provided amazing service throughout our 4 day stay. They went above and beyond for us. I cant recommend this hotel more and they are a main reason why. You will have a great time here I can guarantee it!

reviews.author: Magda Karina R
reviews.title: Service
reviews.text: Family hotel, very good service in the pool and beach area from Guaudencio, Eliseo and Baltazar. Helpful and attentive to the requirements of guests in the areas. Good attention from the staff.

reviews.author: Alejandro C
reviews.title: Paradisus August 2023
reviews.text:
It is the third time I have visited the hotel and we love the attention of the very friendly staff, they made us feel at home. Many thanks to Juan Carlos (Lemon Fish), Victor and Baltazar (Piscina)!!!

We will be back !!!

reviews.author: GabzTravelz
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: Excellent service, a lot of attention. Top food👌✨️ damn I had about 5, starter, food and dessert. We felt spoiled with everything included in our package. Apart from how attentive they were to us.

reviews.author: Kellie Á
reviews.title: Excellent food and staff service, I would definitely return to eat here
reviews.text: Excellent service from the waiter Moisés Morales, very friendly and attentive, excellent service also from the chef, delicious food, I give a 10 to all the staff and the food, I would definitely return to eat here

reviews.author: Jesus V
reviews.title: Excellent!!. I will be back!!
reviews.text:
Excellent service. Highlight the service of all the waiters: from the international restaurant: Francisco, Captain Guillermo, Libertad, from the bar next to the pool: Didier, from the restaurant by the sea: Rafael, Vanesa in the gym, in short everyone, thank you a thousand and a thousand , it feels like family!!
The food and the beach were phenomenal.
The cleanliness of the rooms, without buts.

reviews.author: Hilary R
reviews.title: First time here. Actively planning our next trip.
reviews.text: 10’s across the board. The service? Impeccable. The food? Divine. Drinks? Absolutely fantastic. We came for a bachelorette party and are actively planning our next trip. Ask for Gabby at the pool every. single. time. We stayed at The Reserve and it’s worth every penny for the upgrade. I cannot say enough good things about this place and the people and I will absolutely be back.

reviews.author: Linda Aitken
reviews.title: DO NOT GO HERE! 2 x couples we have been in 8 rooms in 11 days! Building work ongoing. Drainage in room 1 and 2 stinking
reviews.text: £11,000 for a holiday from hell. No working shower, 3 nights of water coming thru ceiling, we changed rooms 4 times, only got decent room by paying $600. And now the hotel is lying about it disgusted. Building work on top floor of atrium, just covered with tarpaulin,  dust and bits of plaster falling everywhere. We witnessed, men in the full main swimming pool, underwater chiselling out the grout, then sweeping the bottom of the pool. Pool was never emptied and children were back playing in it the next day, with large sharp pieces of cement still on floor of pool. Sat in main sports bar and a piece of plaster fell from the ceiling and hit me. It Was immediately filled with plaster and painted over. I have travelled the world and never seen such lack of care, service or safety from a hotel.

reviews.author: raq
reviews.title: Authentic Paradise
reviews.text: Incredible place and above all congratulate the great The Reserve team that assisted us for their professionalism, humanity and friendly treatment that makes you feel at home. Congratulations Mr Ignacio, to Diego, to Galdino, to Moisés, Valeria, Cesar, Julio and many more. Also congratulations to Sofonia and the luggage reception service. Thank you so much !!

reviews.author: Kami M
reviews.title: Eat at Lemon Fish!!!
reviews.text: The hotel is a paradise on earth!! Everyone very very friendly, and my partner and I had dinner at the Lemon Fish restaurant, we had literally the best food from Chef Gabriel. He left us with our mouths watering with each dish, it was excellent!! Ernesto was very kind and took great care of us, they gave us an unforgettable experience for our first night :) Thank you all!!

reviews.author: Samantha Guerrero
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: Since we arrived we were welcomed with complimentary drinks! We checked in but they didn't assign us a room until 3 in the afternoon, while we can use the other facilities, the delicious Malva buffet and great variety! The service is also very friendly. The spectacular pools, the only detail is that they are very deep and there are only certain areas that have a wading pool, the gym is very complete and super organized and clean areas, the room services have a first class service, the products in the refrigerator are free and they refilled them every time. day, the event organizer if I remember correctly Axel, super friendly, we had a mezcal tasting and several activities at the pool and the beach. At the ginger bar I want to thank Diana Juan and Carlos, they served us very well and not to mention Lemon Fish, the best Peruvian food and the waiters and the phenomenal bar! The Italian restaurant is a delight and very good service, as is the Agua Marina, excellent food but very bad service, I understand that they are high seasons but that should not affect the attitude of the waiters! Apart from that, my experience at the Paradisus was unforgettable and I did not hesitate to return very soon.

reviews.author: Laura M
reviews.title: Staff. 10
reviews.text:
The staff excellent attention. Better than feeling at home. Experience in consenting care.
At the pool Diego, César and Moises, host waiters treated us with excellence and we left good friends with them in Cancun
There are installation details that need to be improved

reviews.author: Ariana L
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
Everything was excellent, the attention from Cristy and the rest of the colleagues was super good, and the hotel and food were incredible, highly recommended.
Everyone was very attentive and supported us at all times!!!

reviews.author: Pía M
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: The food is delicious and the service is luxurious! Everyone is very attentive and friendly, but above all the kindness of the waiter Noé Méndez surprised us. We will definitely repeat the experience again...

reviews.author: Ricardo B
reviews.title: Thank you Rodrigo for everything...😊😊
reviews.text: I consider that the service at the main pool was the best because we were well served by the waiter Rodrigo Gorocica... I think he was the best of the best, great charisma and an excellent attitude, very good service, thank you for everything and I will definitely return

reviews.author: Nath S
reviews.title: Cielito linda at Hotel Paradisus
reviews.text:
Excellent hotel, the sky restaurant is delicious and Moisés the best waiter!
100% recommended
If you come or are a foreigner, that restaurant is pure magic, you should try it.
The hotel is huge and has many amenities.

reviews.author: Kathy B
reviews.title: Awesome Food at Lemon Fish
reviews.text: The food is good! very good, great service always had a positive attitude. Especially at Lemon Fish! Jeorge was a great server! love him 🙏 definitely made my vacation experience even better. Good food means good vacation

reviews.author: Gurvinder J
reviews.title: Excellent food and service
reviews.text: Fantastic service. 5* Service by Noe! We are vegetarian and were well catered for, including the kids! Would highly recommend this. Food was exceptionally prepared with great presentation and high quality ingredients!

reviews.author: dawn g
reviews.title: Horrible stay away far away!!!
reviews.text: The worst experience from the moment we checked in.  I’ve been at this hotel when it was the gran Meliá and they should’ve stayed that way because this hotel isn’t worth $100. We stayed in the reserve section, it was a ghost town away from civilization! No swim up bar the bar by the pool closed at 4 while all the other ones are open smh.  We booked two rooms next to each other. We got one room on one floor and the other room on another level. They said they couldn’t give us rooms together because they were booked and there was literally nobody there. We had no air conditioning and our refrigerator didn’t work so we had to move the next day to another room and what a coincidence The room was next to our friends room, where we wanted to be the night before when we checked in. The elevators wasn’t  working. we requested The room to be decorated for my friend’s birthday it never happened. We were supposed to have bottles of champagne in our rooms. Nothing we requested double beds we got a king size bed  The breakfast was horrible. Everything was soggy and cold.  Alcohol drinks were watered down. We had to walk, literally half mile to get to any restaurants in the hotel, or to see a human being. The only good thing about our stay, was our concierge Jose.  I talked with upper management Aaron and told him all of our concerns. I never heard from him after the first night of our stay I’m sure it went in one ear and out the other the hotel looks like it’s going under. The staff is overworked they don’t clean the beach anymore so you can’t see white sand it’s covered with seaweed. The entertainment is a joke! Save your money and go someplace else! Horrible experience and waste of money!!!

reviews.author: mcvelez2023
reviews.title: everything good except check in
reviews.text: Check in is at 3 pm because of our flight we arrived at 1 pm and they gave us room 4 at 30 pm and the person at reception only said that it was not their fault that it was the housekeeper's fault for not having the rooms ready I really don't believe That is an appropriate response and also if check-in is at 3 pm it is at that time no later than we were really very tired and they gave us the room very late

reviews.author: Steven F
reviews.title: JORGE AT LEMON FISH

reviews.author: Daniel D
reviews.title: Lemonfish

Everything more than perfect.
Jorge was a spectacle

The rooms are comfortable and clean, and the staff was very friendly and helpful. 24-hour Room Service, 24-hour coffee station, infinite minibar, very good SPA, in short: you won't get bored. I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a relaxing beach vacation.

reviews.author: MARTINEZ VEGA J

reviews.text: Excellent service from Daniel Dainzú, exquisite food and a very pleasant atmosphere, the ceviches and the picaña are highly recommended. If you are looking for good service, look for Daniel Dainzú, he has good recommendations.

reviews.author: Vanessa
