reviews.text: First night here. Exhausted and hot  after a long day travling here and was so happy to come to the blue Agave for dinner.  Food and Service was outstanding! Moises was so attentive! Also special thanks to Alfonzo and Adriana!

reviews.author: thea l
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Gaudencio was very friendly, the experience was incredible, the beach and the hotel are beautiful. The view, activities and food at Paradisus were excellent, I had never been but I would return anyway on my next vacation.

reviews.author: joannicprat
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text:
We stayed 7 days. We paid for the nikte room. We traveled with a girl and a baby.
I do not recommend nor would I choose the nikte option again, it feels like a scam.
The truth is that the hotel is very good but it seems that it is going downhill....you can see it in the details, in the old facilities, in the food, in the drinks, in the pools and in the restaurants.
I don't think I will return to this hotel again.

reviews.author: maluga54
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: Very accurate costs versus experience. The only thing that would improve would be to clean the room earlier. They always did it around 3 or 4 in the afternoon. Excellent service from the people on the beach

reviews.author: GoPlaces146562
reviews.title: I wouldn't go back
reviews.text:
There were several situations that caused my expectations to be frustrated. I'll just point out so as not to be extensive.
Firstly, all the attendants from the Malva restaurant, Lemon Fish, pool service, beach service, Italian, etc...
There is no smile given by the attendants, the impression it gives us is that I am being inconvenient in ordering anything. When you call them, they pretend they don't listen, there is a huge burden on them, they work at a discount and unfortunately, they take it out on their guests.
Very bad service at the beach service, I ordered more than 5 times a fries, it took more than 1 hour and a half, apart from the humor of the attendants.
I ordered water 3 times in my minibar, because they didn't refill it in room service. One at 8 am at the reception, another at 11 am by phone and another at 12 pm by phone, it arrived at 12:30 pm. There were days when it was replenished and days when it wasn't replenished.
Queues to get a table for breakfast, due to the number of guests there would have to be support from another restaurant serving, in this case the Mexican restaurant, so there would be no queues.
I asked to fix the water flow in the bathroom sink, as it wasn't working, they didn't fix it, if I left it on for 1 minute it would overflow.
Among many other things.
In other words, my expectations were very high because this hotel is among the 10 best hotels in the RCI, I wanted to stay at the Hard Rock and ended up being convinced to stay at the Paradisus, my expectations were highly frustrated and I certainly wouldn't recommend it to anyone, and I will stay pay more attention to Melia networks.
The bad mood of the attendants is simply general, the only one who was more cooperative was the pool service attendant Didie, at least one was friendly at this hotel.

reviews.author: denisediaz02
reviews.title: Cancun
reviews.text: Amazing trip. All workers were super welcoming, caring and attentive to be at service. Not only were they good at their jobs but also enhanced the experience and made the trip so fun overall. They were super nice and friendly, and good to have conversations with. The ginger bar 2 was out favourite and we had a blast every night with Gaby, Karina, Valentin, and Pedro, and were sad to say our goodbyes from them. Addtionally, nothing beats waking up in the morning to go collect your morning coffee and having a warm good morning from the baristas at the nespersso bar. Food wise the food was nothing crazy and at times lacked flavour. Rooms were nice too.

reviews.author: mark t
reviews.title: Good setup, poor execution
reviews.text:
Good setup, poor execution 
I think if you’re booking this resort without the adults only reserve upgrade option you should look elsewhere. We came here with kids and like the title says good idea horrible execution. From the start the main lobby and building has no AC. I’ve been to resorts that have no AC in the semi outdoor hallways but this is beyond since most of the restaurants and activities are in the lobby, main big building. Then we got to our room, the rooms haven’t been updated since they build the resort, provably from the 90s(except the adults only reserve section so we told by concierge). Everything falling apart, we had to switch rooms because like other reviews said AC was barely working. I had to go back and talk to the supervisor 3 times before I got a new room 4 hours later. 

Outside there is no system for towels or keycards, so everyone picks up a towel leaves them on the chairs and leaves, and you’re stuck wondering if they are taken or the person just left. If you’re not there at 6am you will have no place sit or lay for the rest of the day and there is no incentive for people to grab their towels when they done with the pool so you have no idea if the chairs are still take or not even at 4 pm. Other resorts manage this better either having enough chairs to accommodate their guests or towel cards so when you leave you have to return them.  

 The pool water wasn’t filtered well either. The second biggest weird issue is buffet, there are 5 large buildings and the hotel was packed and they have only 1 guy cooking pasta station and 1 guy cooking hibachi, 1. So I was stuck in line to get a plate for 30 mins, other open buffet choices weren’t that great either, 1 or 2 hot stations. Buffet also had a line to get seated, I’ve never waited this long for a buffet meal in an all inclusive. Especially with kids you don’t have patients or time to be waiting to get seated, also they don’t have a reservation system for restaurants so you end up getting a 40-90 min wait to come back to try one of the other places. Completely mismanaged, when they tell you it’s an hour and half wait they tell you you have to stay here with your full party! You cannot put your name down and come back. We came back to the Italian rest at 9:30 and saw a bunch of tables available the host told us it’s too late even though they close at 10 pm. We went up to guest services they gave some bs excuse and weren’t helpful at all. 

Also constantly harassed by their sales people always trying to “give you a free coupon” or some bs, even calling our room at 8 am! 

 Overall I would not recommend, especially if you’re going with kids. There are much better resorts which are more updated and more organized and have better service for the same price!

reviews.author: ana gloria g
reviews.title: Days to remember and want to return
reviews.text:
The bar is very nice and the facilities are very comfortable to have a good time and the staff who provide you with the service are very friendly.
Axel of activities
Karina and Gaby the waitresses
Salvador the bartender
They are very friendly and charismatic, you have a great time at the gingerbar (sports bar)

reviews.author: Gloria Elena M
reviews.title: Unforgettable days
reviews.text:
Excellent service from the moment you enter the hotel and in all its areas. Thank you very much for all your attention at El Ginger Bar, great service and attention from your staff:
Axel (activities)
Waitresses
Gaby and Karina
Barman
savior
And again thank you very much.

reviews.author: Felipe P
reviews.title: Stay at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Our stay at the hotel was very nice. The best is the KIDSDOM, a place where our children were treated with love, respect and dedication. Many thanks to the staff (Itzel, Ivón, Ivana, Rubí, Bruno and Tessa). My daughter will always carry them in her heart. 🇲🇽

reviews.author: Diego P
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
Excellent customer service at Agua Marina y Malva restaurant at all times.
Waiters Antonio and Jesús very friendly.
At reception, excellent service, especially from Miss Jenny.
Each of the hotel staff, with a good attitude, guides you in any situation in which you need support.

reviews.author: Viviana C
reviews.title: A wonderful dinner
reviews.text: Be sure to visit the Lemon Fish restaurant!! It's excellent!! The super friendly staff and especially Daniel Dacnzu who recommended the menu to us!! A genius!! Safety pin! Let yourself be tempted by the flavors that he himself recommends, a delight. They won't regret it

reviews.author: Adrian I
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Restaurant
reviews.text: At the Peruvian-Japanese fusion restaurant Lemon Fish, very good service. The atmosphere is pleasant and the scorching heat is not felt much. The food was very good. The waiter Daniel Dainzú made our experience much better. 10/10 I highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Mafer C
reviews.title: Dinner
reviews.text: Incredible at the lemon fish restaurant, the waiter Daniel Dainzú gives incredible service, a thousand points, the food is also super delicious, all the food is good, the desserts are delicious, there is no orchata: (but everything is delicious :)

reviews.author: Adventure38445006973
reviews.title: Didier was the best!
reviews.text: Liked the hotel, however, we must praise Didier from the main pool area who made our vacation better than expected. He was attentive, courteous, polite observant and made sure all of our needs were met. Thanks Didi!  If we ever come back, it would be great to see you!

reviews.author: Ali G
reviews.title: Avoid this scam! Terrible food
reviews.text:
We booked this trip for our honeymoon and it was the most disappointing experience. We booked a junior suite and it was a mediocre hotel room that wasn’t that nice and smelled of mildew. The staff was hit and miss. Some were pleasant and others looked miserable to be there. 

The food was absolutely terrible and the wait times were incredibly long with no way to make a reservation. We were told this was adults only but it was only the building we were staying in. If we wanted to go to food or any activities, it was mostly families. 

There wasn’t very many chairs to sit in around the pool unless you made a reservation for a cabana. But you could only reserve a cabana two of the days that you were there. 

They tried to sell us a timeshare which was infuriating. We booked a excursion through Odium, and they never showed up to take us on our excursion. It has been over a month, and despite the ongoing communication with the hotel, we have still not received our $300 back. 

It would have been cheaper for us to book a regular hotel and drink and eat all we wanted. And the food would have been better. 

Never coming back to a Melia resort again.

reviews.author: David S
reviews.title: Trip to Cancun Melia Paradisus
reviews.text: Very good service, very friendly and collaborative staff, especially Gaby and Salvador at the ginger, Orlando and Melin at the Pool bar, excellent food, the rooms are very good, the only thing is that there is a little disorganization for the chairs and awnings

reviews.author: carlos h
reviews.title: VERY BAD
reviews.text:
They say there is fun but it is not like that, it is quite boring, after 9 pm if you go as a family there is nothing to do, I arrived with two teenagers of almost 17 years old and they took us out of the only place where there is a foosball and a table pool (for a hotel of this size it's ridiculous), so what's the fun if you go as a family?
Be careful if you arrive earlier, they first tell you that the room will be given to you at 3 pm, when you arrive at the counter at that time they tell you that it is from 3 pm and that you must continue waiting…
They charge you almost 300 USD for the beach beds… Since you must consume wine, lobster and shrimp to use them…
Two of the restaurants are not included…
In some restaurants there are dishes that if you order them you must pay extra…
The AC in the room hardly cools and makes a lot of noise, you don't rest well…
The ice machines are useless… you have an ice container in the room, but it is of no use to you since the machines do not work… incredible…
Very unfortunate… I only arrived today and I already want to leave, unfortunately I have to stay the entire stay because I already paid for it… to never return to this hotel again…
Be careful and don't be fooled, it is an all-inclusive that doesn't even include the basics... VERY BAD...

reviews.author: Aaron S
reviews.title: Fantastic service and great poolside food
reviews.text: We had a great time at the resort and Sante had great poolside food. The wings, ceviche, and tacos were all outstanding. We were lucky to have Gaby as our server on our first day and she absolutely made the whole trip. She anticipated all our needs, and would check in on us even on days when we weren't in her section.

reviews.author: Hannah W
reviews.title: Excelente servicio !!! Hotel is amazing but the staff make it!
reviews.text: Josue at the ginger bar will make you a stellar cocktail and make you feel super special!! We also absolutely adored Dania, she switched between a couple bars but we would follow her everywhere lol! Everyone at the reserve pool bar was also very friendly and always a joy to see!

reviews.author: Katrina M
reviews.title: Be forewarned! $$$
reviews.text:
1. Lemon Grass restaurant did not serve me Wagyu, it was prime rib due to the amount of fat on the super thin piece I had, which was half of the cut. 
2. The hotel never forewarned us that the shop inside does the US exchange at a much lower value than government decrees. Example: at the time we were there the exchange for $1 us equaled $16.89 pesos. The item I purchased should have been $220US, but they charged me $250US. When I went back to question the value, the store explained that they charge $14pesos per US dollar. 
3. There are NOT enough chairs at the pool to accommodate everyone and to enjoy being outdoors we had to purchase a cabana to have a place to sit!! Ridiculous! 
4. Our “concierge” hunted us every day at the pool to get us to listen to a sales pitch for one hour in exchange for having a massage, cabana, or something else for free. We told them repeatedly NO but came back every.single.day!
5. There was a booming disco/club every night that you can hear over the loud a/c. I am a light sleeper and had to use my noise cancelling headphones every night in order to sleep!!
6. The air conditioner in our room was always set at 65 but when you looked at the display, it would say 69.

reviews.author: michaelwilliams0n
reviews.title: Paradisius was Paradise!
reviews.text: Flat awesome facility! It was so good we wanted more! I never write reviews but the place is great. We travelled from England and were not dissapointed. Great energy amongst the clients who stayed there as well. Not very pretentious etc. Awesome resort overall.

reviews.author: Luis A
reviews.title: Family holidays
reviews.text:
We are delighted with the service received, excellent food and drinks.
My son and we are grateful and pleased with the treatment received in the Kidsdom children's area.

The treatment and attention of Tessa, Ivana, Ivon, Itzel, Rubí and Bruno is so warm, special and fabulous, that they make the children feel at home and the treatment they receive is extraordinary.

reviews.author: Adventurer776604
reviews.title: Thank you Valentin Gaby Karina
reviews.text:
It is the best service of the entire Melia hotel in Cancun.
Thanks to Valentin Gaby and Karina. They totally break it, we pass it 100 points. The drinks are spectacular, we will return as soon as possible.

reviews.author: Maria Lourdes N
reviews.title: The value for money is not good
reviews.text:
We are regular Melia customers and this is the first one that disappoints us. We have been both in Spain and abroad, enjoying this hotel chain and I do not understand how they allow this level of service.
The rooms are very old, the air conditioning does not cool enough and it makes a lot of noise. The bathroom has curtains instead of a screen, so the entire bathroom floor gets waterlogged. In general, the condition of the rooms does not meet the minimum expectations. We have requested a room change several times and unfortunately it was not fixed.
There are only three restaurants in the entire hotel available without additional charges with air conditioning, taking into account the temperatures and the degree of humidity, it seems like little option to me, especially if you are staying for more than a week.
The ratio of hammocks and number of guests is very poor.
The Cielito restaurant was the one we enjoyed the most, the service and the food seemed excellent.
I wouldn't repeat. It's a shame, but it's been really disappointing.

reviews.author: Viridiana R
reviews.title: Excellent experience!!
reviews.text:
Excellent experience, we booked to celebrate our 8th wedding anniversary, my 5-year-old daughter enjoyed the kids club activities, the staff was very kind to her, the beach is beautiful, the food is delicious in all the restaurants, as well as the desserts from the coffee station, our favorite restaurant was the Lemon fish fusion of Peruvian and Japanese food, we thank Daniel Dainzu our waiter during dinner, for all his recommendations on the dishes, his attention and service was remarkable. Our room had a view of the lagoon, very spacious and comfortable, they welcomed us with amenities and many nice details! Only when we wanted to sleep and move the sheet, we realized that it was wet on one side 🥹, as well as all the sheets below, we called guest service and had no answer, my husband had to go to the reception to notify, in a few After 10 minutes they changed the sheets, but they did not change the mattress cover and that was making the bed wet again, we had to remove it to sleep, when we woke up we realized that one of the sheets was stained with drops of blood, a detail that made us uncomfortable. After a while, we left the room and told some very friendly maids who helped us change all the sheets on the bed.
One detail to consider is the waiting time in restaurants, go early and be patient or go to dinner at 6 or 9 p.m. that there are fewer people. I think they could work more on cordiality with guests to say that there are no tables available or that there is a waiting list in the restaurants, sometimes they forget to express it in a cordial way. We relaxed and had a drink while we waited.
Another point to improve is the care of the turtles (spawning season) on the beach at night, it was impressive to be able to see the turtles on the beach, we kept our distance observing, however there are guests who did not, they took photos with flash very close of the turtles, no one tells them what can or cannot be done at that moment, we reported it at reception, it was explained to us that there is staff in charge taking care of the eggs and turtles, a few minutes passed, a security person came a few minutes and he left, I understand that the beach is very long, but there should be staff in the area where you go to the beach and guide the guests with instructions to keep their distance, not to use the flash or lights so as not to bother the turtles.
 In general we enjoyed our stay, the details that are there for guests from the moment they arrive at the hotel make a memorable and different experience, it was a great hotel choice, thank you for all your service, facilities and attention.

reviews.author: liliyanikka
reviews.title: Great hotel.
reviews.text: Very Satisfied. Nice place to stay with kids. So much fun for all family. All week internment schedule poster for your convenience. Delicious food in buffet, bars and restaurant. Beautiful hotel. Great customer service all over the place. Just come and enjoy your stay.

reviews.author: carmenzabernalr
reviews.title: Excellent everything
reviews.text: Excellent everything seems to me that they have everything covered I loved even the air freshener they use in the hotel and the bathroom implements smell delicious the only thing I couldn't enjoy was a chair at the pool most of the people take ownership and not all of us can use them

reviews.author: Dominique L
reviews.title: Cancun is beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel. Great for relaxing. Found the child free spaces great. Cancun is expensive though. Conference facilities were good and meal options varied and tasty. Staff were friendly albeit a bit reserved. Would travel back for a holiday.

reviews.author: Daniela L
reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text: Since we arrived, they mixed up the reservation and left me waiting an hour or more to resolve it. When they finally gave me the rooms, my children's room, which should have been double, they gave me a king size room and it took another two or three hours to reassign me. to new ones, in the end they put me in different towers and floors which represented a big problem for my stay in general. To make matters worse, my room smells of humidity and the air conditioning sounds like a tractor. Today they did not clean my room or my children's room because they still had incorrect information and they left us check-out letters when we left for two days. The reception never has anyone. No one is available from the staff, no one knows how to reserve the tennis court, and one of the Playa waiters told me that “first dog” to be from the country where I come from (it should be noted that the man thought I was Mexican and His personal opinion “came out” but he said it 😵) I hope I can finish my stay without any further setbacks… yes, I will never return. The rest of the good things they may have, I am no longer interested in knowing about.

reviews.author: Alejandro S
reviews.title: horrible hotel
reviews.text:
The food is bad, at the buffet apart from a few options, the ones there taste very bad or are cold, the same in the pools, you pay for an all-inclusive and you still have to pay for beds in the pools (there are very few lounge chairs and they get very full fast) slow and bad service.

The worst of all is at night with their private parties that don't let you sleep AT ALL.

reviews.author: Adilson F
reviews.title: Salt Restaurant
reviews.text:
The experience at Sal restaurant was sensational. The service from waiter Roger was exceptional. Great professional and very kind. A good man.
The food is very good, well presented and in a very sophisticated environment.

reviews.author: Richonn C
reviews.title: Great fun
reviews.text:
Amazing trip filled with new friends, great service. 

First we checked in with Karen a sweetheart the reserve section. She was amazing.

Then Diego was our concierge/go to main man. Incredibly attentive and gave us info on anything we needed.

We had great service from Miguel at Sante bar he was our Bali bed waiter for 2 days and took care of us and make sure we always had Heinekens and ice and waters at all times. Luis at the reserve pool bar was amazing!!!! Oscar as well.

Nicole is the reserve pool Bali bed coordinator. She’s so Awesome, always made sure we had just the bed we wanted and even let us reserve an ocean view Bali bed special.  

Overall this was an amazing trip, I’m so glad my sister recommended it. Room service good wasn’t the greatest but everything else was 10/10.  Can’t wait to come back next year!!

reviews.author: yalin78
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Overall it’s a good experience. Bar tender Leo at lunch box was very friendly and excellent. He was one of the best server ever I have encountered with. I would give 12 out of 10. He even gifted us with coffee mug on our way out.

reviews.author: ginahernandez26
reviews.title: Very nice stay!
reviews.text: Had a very nice stay. This was our second time visiting the Paradisus Cancun There were some changes made to the names and menus at some of the restaurants. Also you don't make reservations for any of the restaurants except for the steak house, which isn't part of the all inclusive. The staff was outstanding as usual and went out of their way to accomodate you. We loved seeing Eddie, Pasqual and Manuel at the buffet breakfast every morning. They were wonderful and even made my husband's birthday more special by presenting him with a cake and singing happy birthday to him!!! Overall it was a wonderful vacation! We will be back!

reviews.author: Dale R Markowski
reviews.title: paradisus cancun excellente
reviews.text: everything was awesome from the upgraded room we got bc of renovations to the very tasty restaurants the lemon fish which is sushi was awesome went 3 times. the buffet was very good lots to choose from. italian was another great treat. hell it was good. get up early to mark your chairs at the pool and beach. no one messes with them. leave the towels and an item like hat or shirt.

reviews.author: Lorena L
reviews.title: Two weeks at Melia Cancun
reviews.text: We stayed at the club for two weeks and we had a very happy time. The rooms are spacious and functional. We had a mishap and it was resolved quickly, as the club's reception staff are very friendly and efficient. The food is very good, as well as the Service, I remember Berlin, Atilano, Teresa, Randy and Johnny, but everyone is very friendly. In addition, the nighttime entertainment is very good with different shows.

reviews.author: Jenny L
reviews.title: Best restaurant in Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: The food was amazing.  Our waiter Juan provided exceptional service and was very attentive to our needs. Food was delicious.  Make sure to get the basque salted caramel cheesecake.  The atmosphere was nice and sheek . Definitely recommend coming here. Wish we were able to come more than once in our vacation stay at the Paradisus.

reviews.author: Raul Mota
reviews.title: Bad restaurants, only Malva is an option
reviews.text: Restaurants in general need to improve service, Malva is the only one to recommend as they offer buffet with variety, Cielito Lindo and rest long waiting time, hotel service if you are US citizen it is guarantee you will be well served, rest or mexican will not be good served

reviews.author: natala772023
reviews.title: Awesome Ressort
reviews.text:
I love this Ressort, this is my second time staying there and I would come back as many times as possible.
The views inside and outside of the hotel are beautiful, the ambience, the food, the service, everything was great!

reviews.author: lisselotgeronimo
reviews.title: Hotel not recommended
reviews.text: Hotel with a pleasant atmosphere and many spots for photos but the staff service and gastronomic options are very poor, we were in the reservation area and they assign you a person to help you with whatever you need and we never saw that person until the last day Likewise, the cleaning staff was checking my bag that I left outside the safe because it was too big and they took the only money I had in cash at the time (100us). My husband didn't like the food and I feel like the area In the buffet lounge there are many pigeons around you that make you nervous when eating and you cannot leave your table alone for a moment

reviews.author: SpringMissy
reviews.title: Good, (not so) Bad and the (not so) Ugly
reviews.text:
As Melia Vacation Club members, we have been to this location multiple times.  But this was our first visit in about 10 years.  We tend to travel in May as the weather is warm and the (US) kids are still in school, so smaller crowds.
Our check in was smooth and we were given a full ocean view room in Building 1.  The One bedroom was perfect for the two of us.  Our concierge, Alejandra, was very good.  We were able to communicate with her through WhatsApp: she made dinner reservations and took care of anything we needed in our rooms.  
Sadly, food left a lot to be desired. The morning buffet was always good; lots of choices including an omelet bar.  We ate lunch one day at Aguas Marina – although the appetizer was delicious, it was entirely too heavy.  Our best bet for lunch was the nachos from the outside service area.  I ordered a hamburger one day from the pool side server and it took over an hour.  I think that came all the way from the Lunchbox.  I HATE having to view the menu on my phone!!!
Dinners were definitely so-so.  Menu choices were very limited and left much to be desired.  At the Italian restaurant, we had a pizza and a pasta dish.  The crust was nothing more than flour and water and the pasta was merely noodles with Ragu.  We went to the Mexican restaurant and couldn’t even figure out what was being offered; so we ate a little and left.
After that we just went to the buffet.  I could always get a salad there.  The last night, we ordered room service.  Again, a VERY limited menu; it didn’t even include a hamburger.  The sandwiches we did have were very good.
Around the pool area, things were busy.  By 8 am, 95% of the chairs were “occupied”.  We were early enough to secure chairs; but anyone who slept in was pretty much out of luck. Many thanks to our pool concierges:  Josue and Eliot as well as our pool-side server:  Yesenia (sp?)
There was evening entertainment.  We happened to be in the lobby the evening that Jerzy boys (sp?) played.  We thoroughly enjoyed their performance.
Room cleaning was thorough and done in a timely manner.  We were very pleased with that service.  Also, we requested more coffee pods and those were promptly brought to our room.
This hotel does not offer some of the niceties of the other Melia / Paradisus hotels.  The most glaring was the lack of an adults only pool (other than if you upgrade to the Reserve and that wasn’t an option through the club).  We sat near the kiddie area, which was fine as we had a club Bali bed.  In my opinion, the hotel ought to consider converting the pool near the Lunchbox to an adults only pool.
For anyone concerned about security, I felt totally safe.  We did not go down to the beach much as the seaweed was a bit heavy and it was obvious the surf was rough.  I did see La Policia patrolling the beach and next door as well as security on the Paradisus’ premises.  We did not see the vendors this time.  On a couple occasions, we walked out front to the street.  There were fewer people walking the sidewalks than I recall in the past.  We did not go into the convention area.
If you have smaller children, there were activities in the kiddie area every afternoon around 3 or 4.  The kids really enjoyed them and so did the adult onlookers.
The YHI spa offered a massage package for $230/couple.  A couple of days a week, they offer specials so check with them.  We enjoyed a couple’s massage; the young lady that did my deep massage was brutal!  Great experience.
We tip everyone.  Don’t assume that “tips included” is sufficient for these hard workers.  Also, the USD had been devalued against the Peso, so tip a little more if you are using USD.  We do not bother with converting to Pesos; just bring crisp, clean, unmarked bills in smaller denominations.
As for the club, 2 things:  Members’ event and The Circle.  There is a members’ event one night a week.  Ours was held in the sports bar area.  While the event was really nothing special, I do want to give a shout out to the entertainment:  Bianca & Giancarlo.  Excellent duo that should be added to the Ginger bar in the evenings. The Circle is the newest Melia concept for “membership”.  Despite our concierge asking, we did not attend the presentation in Cancun.  We did attend it in the DR a few years ago.  As members, we declined because the sole purpose of the presentation is to get us to spend more money!

reviews.author: torresvista55
reviews.title: EXCELLENT EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: All the staff is very friendly, attentive in all the restaurants, the pool area, a special recognition to: Jessica and Alicia, for their attention and affection towards us, to Juan from the POOL BAR also for his kindness and excellent attention as well as to Moisés Morales from Cielito Lindo, thank you all

reviews.author: Steve S
reviews.title: Lemon Fish @ Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Jorge gave us his opinion on what to choose at Lemon Fish, and everything was perfect! He did a fantastic job being our server and giving suggestions. The atmosphere was wonderful, very peaceful, and relaxing. I highly recommend if you love sushi

reviews.author: Manuel R
reviews.title: Great resort!
reviews.text: This resort is awesome!  The staff, restaurants, food, cleanliness, pool, location, entertainment, activities and overall experience was absolutely wonderful.  We will definitely return and would highly recommend it!

reviews.author: Ife
reviews.title: Wedding at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Tania, our wedding organizer was amazing. She paid attention to details and was very happy to provide us with all we needed for the wedding. The process took about 7 months to plan and she was very attentive when we called her and was organized as well. She liased with our own event planner seamlessly. I would recommend the hotel and Tania for future weddings.

reviews.author: Jesus canche
reviews.title: Food is great
reviews.text: Jesus is such a friendly waiter, and the food was very awesome. They have a wide selection of appetizers, pizzas, and pastas. They did a great job with the desserts, and the customer service was five star!⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.author: Mandy L
reviews.title: Excellent services
reviews.text: My whole family came to Paradisus Cancun for a week, Lemon Fish was our last dinner of our trip. Server who named Miguel Jorge Emmuel had provided us the exceptional services, foods were amazing, were the best foods we had for the whole trip. I will definitely recommend this hotel and restaurant.

reviews.author: Zee
reviews.title: Rafael at Lemon Fish
reviews.text: We had the best experience at lemon fish with Raphael the waiter you must go to him if you visit this resort the food and service were both amazing and we are coming back tomorrow thank you for a lovely meal!

reviews.author: Robert T
reviews.title: Service at the Paradisus Mexico
reviews.text: We were served by Armaando, Ignacio,Gerardo and Raul on different days. They were so pleasant and helpful. Everyday it was a pleasure to be served by the waiting staff. Also the cleaning and pool staff were always quick and helpful with our order.

reviews.author: tracy n
reviews.title: Service
reviews.text: The highlight of our trip was our dinner at Lemon Fish.   Our servers at Lemon Fish were amazing!!   Great atmosphere but the service was above and beyond.  Ask for Miguel, Ernesto or Jorge.  So grateful for the recommendations on what to order.

reviews.author: Aly D
reviews.title: Great service!
reviews.text: My family and I visited the Paradisis resort in Cancun for two weeks. We had an incredible experience, and really enjoyed the Capella restaurant, especially the service by our server Jesus, his captain, Carlos and hostess, Libni. They we all incredible and made our time there very special! Our daughter enjoyed the kids club as well!

reviews.author: vl60622
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: Excellent service from the time we got there Raul at the front was awesome and so friendly, at Restaurant Malva - Rafael, Candelario, Pascual, Gaudencio always on point always made sure I had my coffee so nice and welcoming so helpful the whole time.  The Nespresso Bar was so cute and tasteful.  If you have any questions on where to go and what to do just anything they are def very helpful.

reviews.author: Natalia B
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Had a great experience at Malva with Atilano, Janet, Arturo, Manuel at the buffet. They were very nice and attentive and always offering more mimosas at any time of the day. It was great to be served by them

reviews.author: Jennifer B
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Amazing service & people!
We will definitely come back!
Make sure to visit Josue at Ginger’s mixology bar!  
Ask for Augustin, he will take good care of all your requests while here!
Go see Manuel at the pool bar, he’s the best!
We went through the Circle presentation, they were very patient, not pushy at all!

reviews.author: Jessica S
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text: Lemon fish was great! Our server, Rafael, was great as well. He made numerous recommendations for us to try at dinner and we enjoyed all of them very much. He also made dessert recommendations for us, which was delicious as well. We had a great time and will be back !!

reviews.author: FabiTravell
reviews.title: Great family vacations 🌴🌵🌴
reviews.text:
Great experience.

We are still in this beautiful hotel. In total we’ll stay 9 days. We have choosen Melia Paradisus because it was recommended for families. I would like to thank Brenda, Ruben, Karel and the whole Kidsclub team for taking care of our two little boys. They are enjoying every second in the kidsclub (great activities every day).

Now let‘s talk about the hotel itself.

What we really enjoy is that you‘ll always find a quite place at the pool to relax 🌴. Working as a manager in a global acting company for me it‘s very important to escape the stress.

Moreover the food in most Restaurants is great. We prefer the Lemon Fish, The Mexican and the Italian Restaurant.

The hotel itself is huge and inside it looks like a beautiful tropical Garden (no mosquitos 😅).

We have a standard room with Lagoon view which is absolutely ok. Of course as already mentioned by other travellers the rooms are old but clean and comfortable. In the future they have to do some renovation work

I have to give 5 additional Stars for Gaby, which is doing an amazing job serving Cocktails 🍹 the whole day long. I hope the management team will read this review and give her an additional bonus!

Thx Gaby!!!

The beach is nice too. Unfortunately this year there are massive probleme with seaweed.

The whole Yucatan coast is suffering this issue.

Most clients here are from the US, Mexico or China. Mostly friendy. Not to many Party tourists, which is great.

We have been in many many hotels here in Yucatan (Riu, Catalonia, La Amada). This hotel is definitely a good choice for families and some good days to recover.

We‘ll be back soon.

reviews.author: Suzanne B
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: What a restaurant! Rafael, Nicolas, and Hugo made our last night in Cancun one to remember!! Lemon Fish is a welcoming and private experience with amazing service and beyond excellent food / sushi (& of course the pineapple margaritas!). It is a MUST visit when you stay at the Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: Yuka S.
reviews.title: Guacamole workshop
reviews.text:
Mr. Axcel and Mr. Saul are both greatly helpful and thoughtful! This workshop was very informative and lots of fun! It was a great cultural experience.
Moreover, handmade guacamole was so tasty!!

Highly recommend!

reviews.author: aszk
reviews.title: Work shop
reviews.text: Axcel and Saul arranged Guacamole workshop at Paradisus Cancun.  The work shop starts the story of Guacamole.  It was really good for my sons. The main part how to make guacamole is fun. We will make guacamole at home!

reviews.author: Tonii M
reviews.title: Amazing experience !
reviews.text: 5/5. Axcel and Saul were amazing hosts for all the activities! Make sure you find them and do all the activities they have to offer. They teach you all about Mexican culture. The service at the resort has been a 5 star experience and I highly recommend to anyone looking to come to Cancun!

reviews.author: Naïm I
reviews.title: Axel and Sal are amazing
reviews.text:
Had an amazing time at the resort… Sal and Axel were exceptional hosts during all our activities! 
The resort food was also the best of any resorts I’ve been to. The entire staff is friendly and helpful

reviews.author: Cole S
reviews.title: Dominican and Mexican night
reviews.text: I love the theme nights they have, axle one of the people who does the activitys made one of our last nights at the Paradisus rememberable & fun he taught me, my wife & a couple other people  how to dance ! The resort is absolutely beautiful everywhere, the food’s amazing & the all inclusive tops it off ! if you treat & take care of the workers good they will make sure you have everything you need like your their friend ! We had A little bit of trouble with our reservation at first but Diego helped us all the way & got everything figured out.  I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Nelcy F
reviews.title: Rest. Malva Ivonn Atilaro
reviews.text: Excellent Service at Malva at Paradisus.  Very attentive! Whatever we needed they were right there to provide us with anything we needed. Very friendly service to me and my family. My family enjoyed coming to Malva during our stay.

reviews.author: Mitchell Randulich
reviews.title: PARADISUS CANCÚN!!
reviews.text: Paradisus possibly best place in the game. Get yourself to Aqua Marina and get served by jesus and henry, dynamic duo right there! Place is amazing, and a fantastic experience from top to bottom! Drinks are great, food is better, weather is warm!! Love it here!

reviews.author: Ariana T
reviews.title: Lemon Fish - Paradisus
reviews.text: Amazing service from Miguel! Very nice and very sweet. Listened to our requests, brought out food in a timely matter. Beautiful ambiance of the hotel and restaurant  as well. Loved my experience. Food was great too.

reviews.author: Toya C
reviews.title: Lovely Vacation 2022
reviews.text:
We had a great time at this resort. Thanks to all the lovely staff who all work so hard to ensure we have a great stay. Thank you Diana, Joel, Ruben, Jose and Frita from the spa. Thank you to Axcel for always getting me involved in the lovely activities.

The staff here remembered our names, and are so attentive to details. The hotel managers walked around and checked on everyone which Is just going the extra mile. 

We did the parasailing with the watersport hut, that was lovely!

We stayed at The Reserve. It is amazing if you prefer a more quiet or one on one experience. You get access to the bali beds, with daily servers. There is an adult pool and a quiet pool as well. I loved so much our room and also enjoyed the Catch of the day and those pancakes and green juice served at the Santa restaurant (exclusive to the reserve guests).

Overall an amazing experience and the little issues are not even worth mentioning. Thank You all!

reviews.author: Marisa G
reviews.title: Incredible family vacation!
reviews.text:
I wanted to share my amazing experience. We just returned from a 1 week family vacation Aug 16 - 23rd and it was one of the best places we have stayed at.
The food, property, beach and especially the staff were all incredible. Just an FYI we were not part of the reserve.

The variety of food was very good and very fresh. The only complaint i have is their gluten free section compared to other resorts I've stayed at is extremely limited and there is no designated toaster. Most resorts today have a designated toaster, and a nice selection of GF options from breads, deserts, separate meals etc.. Although the staff always inquires about your allergies and if you ask them to prepare something for you they are always so willing to help you but it becomes a pain to always ask them. It would be nice to have everything labeled as GF or Vegan etc.. 
Some of the liquor options  like aperol were not available unless you were part of the reserve which we weren't happy about.

The main pool was spacious with plenty of chairs. there are 3 pools, the reserve and 2 others. It seemed as though everyone was at the main pool and the others were pretty empty. The activity staff was fantastic, they did an amazing job! we loved the obsticle and thank-you to Axcel who made it super fun for everyone. 

the grounds are not huge which is great so everything is easily accessible. 

they have something going on every night, whether its latin night, silent party, cuban night. It is not the traditional shows you may see at some of the other resorts which was actually a good thing because everyone got to interact with one another rather than sitting for 2 hours watching a show. 

The beach for the first few days was beautiful then the seaweed started to collect in patches, there were still some sections you could swim in and the water was so warm.

Restaurants were very nice too. If part of the reserve you have access to the steak house so i cannot comment. The lemon fish was sushi which was very good, we loved the aqua marina Latin American. The restaurants are gorgeous too!

They have a coffee bar open 24hrs, that was amazing! and the coffee was delicious. 

They have a gym which was small and could use some renos. 

There are stunning fireworks every night at the front of the resort - exactly 10:20pm

Last but not least i want to say that the staff at Paradisus was wonderful, some of the nicest people i have met and such hard workers! 
thank-you to Gerardo, Eddie, Edier and Melvin for making us feel so welcome! but a very special thank you to Martin who went above and beyond to make us feel special. We will miss them all especially Martin!

reviews.author: Cfdibia
reviews.title: Samuel Sosa was amazing
reviews.text:
He remembered us, was very attentive and always took care of us. He remembered what we liked and always brought it even before we ordered it. He is also very funny and entertaining. 

Not sure what else to write lol

reviews.author: Bayo D
reviews.title: Excellent Service
reviews.text: Went to Paradisis Hotel for a destination wedding and had the pleasure of having Samuel Sosa be our lunch and dinner server he was excellent throughout the week. He kept tabs on us and made sure we were looked after. He gave us good advice on what activities and places we should visit based on our tastes. He was lively, energetic and respectful. He was definitely one of the highlights of the trip and when I come back to Mexico, I look forward to seeing him again.

reviews.author: G D
reviews.title: Rafael Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Very nice, great service, always there if you need anything, the food was great, a wide variety of delicious dishes to choose from and the waiter was very talkative and nice, always checking if there was anything we needed.

reviews.author: Rodrigo V
reviews.title: An Unforgettable Experience

reviews.author: Alyssa Bowser
reviews.title: Good but not great
reviews.text:
Tripadvisor review of Paradisus Cancun:

Overall my husband and I had a good time. Nothing bad, but with paying for all inclusive we had hoped we would enjoy the food more than we did and the facilities to be a little nicer. We got a junior ocean suite room which had a nice partial view of the ocean. The patio was dirty with spilled coffee which never was cleaned up while we were there. We also slept kind of hot so we needed new sheets everyday in order to get rid of the sweaty ones. 🫡😒  The tub drained very slow and the lighting was very dim as well in our bathroom. Light switches didn't all work and one night we aren't sure if it was related to the switches, but our plug-ins where we charged our phones didn't work. The next day they did. 🤷 Room service food also was sub-par. The app is laggy and not very user friendly in my opinion. It came in handy a few times, but no one encouraged us to use the app to make dinner reservations so one of the restaurants we didn't even go to since we thought we had to go through the concierge to book dinner times. The property itself is quite beautiful, however, the walking areas inside are not air conditioned and we found ourselves sweaty all the time in the hotel. As far as extra experiences we tried, we got a couple spa massages with exfoliating treatments, etc. and my husband and I enjoyed them. I don't think in the US these services would cost as much, but I think you're paying for the convenience and experience at your hotel so it's going to cost more. My husband's massage therapist, Leo was very good. My therapist, Gemma, was amazing! She was so strong but didn't over do the pressure, and I fell asleep so you know it was good! She spent extra time on my neck and upper back which is so tight and it felt SO good! We also did a tequila tasting which I set up ahead of our arrival to the hotel. The tasting itself was nice, Iran Cervantes the somolier was very knowledgeable and enthusiastic about the tequila and David the head chef was very friendly. What I thought would have improved my own experience is if the staff's English was better. I personally had a little difficulty following and I could tell that Iran was making a solid effort but I felt I missed some things because of the language barrier. My husband did not feel this way, however.

I DO NOT RECOMMEND BOOKING anything through Premium moments. Flores and Guendoline were difficult to get in touch with via email and Guendoline accidently cancelled our massages due to a communication error so we wasted time going to the spa on Friday morning and had to rebook for Sat morning. It worked out, but it was annoying. When we went to check out, we also were told we needed to pay for the tequila tasting…which I had paid for before we even arrived at the hotel. When the hotel asked me to pay, they also asked me for $20 less than what I originally paid. I had to send the guest services associate an email with my payment screenshot I kept from my phone and forward the email thread which I showed Flores has accepted my payment and received it. The hotel didn't give me a hard time for it, but again, just something that shouldn't have come up. 

I realize I need to improve my Spanish if we come back to help us enjoy our experience more. Overall, the Paradisus Cancun was a nice hotel, but I probably would book a different one next time or go without the all inclusive plan at least since there were many other food options (including even Dominos lol), with many nice options down the hotel zone. I didn't think we got our money's worth.

The Bowsers room 2112

reviews.author: coco_chanel_081
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text:
I booked the junior deluxe ocean view suite and was in building 3 on the 4th floor for a week with my husband. It has been a while since we have travelled to Mexico due to COVID so we were really looking forward to this trip.
I read tons of reviews and was concerned with the vastly differing viewpoints and disparity between " best ever " and " would never return " Most of the negative feedback is unfounded and does not truly refelct how amazing this resort is.
Accomodation:
Our room was bright, modern , very clean with no issues with room temperature or humidity. Housekeepi8ng was prompt daily and thorough. View of the ocean was fantastic.  Mini bar and sancks were replenished daily.
Pools:
There are many pools to choose from. I am an early riser so I was able to get chairs at 7am and we remained at our chairs and did not leave them unattended for hours as many do.
Gabby and Flor provided excellent and attentive service for drinks and snacks.
The hotel grounds and common areas are immaculate with staff tirelessly cleaning and maintaining such a beautiful environment.
Entertainment was provided by Axcel and Pablo and I enjoyed making a homemade face mask, crafts and I painted a wooden rabbit.
Food:
The breakfast buffet was huge and had so much variety of fresh food. Luisa made custom eggs and omelettes. Everything is presented beautifully and cleanliness is a priority.
Alfredo made our trip especially wonderful with his attentive and excellent service and great personality. He greeted us each morning and knew our preferences for beverages in advance. He is truly one of a kind and is amazing.
You can make reservations for the a la carte restaurants up to 3 days in advance starting at 10 am. Many of the restaurants are fully booked already ( ?) and it is difficult to choose where and when you want to go unless prepared to dine at 6pm when they open or 9pm.
Our favorite two restaurants were Lemon Fish and Cappella. Miguel, Diana and Jorge were so helpful at Lemon Fish with suggestions and answering any questions as well as exemplary service.
At the Italian restaurant the food was amazing ( best mussels ever!! )  but the heat and humidity was intolerable due to the location in the main area with the tropical plants which need that environment to live and thrive.
The staff in each and every part of the resort are friendly and provide top notch service. The appearance of each and every area is shining, clean and well maintained.

The drawback and reason we will not be returning and it hurts me to say this as it has absolutely nothing to do with the resort itself or the staff. It is the number of children in all areas at all hours. Even the adults only Reserve section is not truly so with the buffet and most of the a la carte restaurants are all ages.
There were more children seated at the swim up BAR at all times.
The restaurants open at 6pm for dinner and your meal is guaranteed to include some tired, hungry and upset children.
I was most disappointed and shocked ( nothing to do with the resort or its staff ) at the lack of parental supervision at the pools. Every day we saw parents drop off a number of very young children at the pool " for the day " and then completely vacate the area popping by once in a while so we were privy to the meltdowns and crying.  I am not exaggerating. The safety concerns with unsupervised children wwere completely mind blowing to me.
This whole resort should be adults only and I would be willing to pay more as thsi was not a restful vacationb as it was intended to be.

reviews.author: Captain Ash
reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun from August 8-16-2022, it was our third visit to the hotel with the most recent one just before Covid. I gave the hotel 2 stars only because the hotel needs a major remodeling and cleaning. It’s way overpriced for what the hotel offers or it is in reality. They sell you Luxury Suite and it’s not even a one star small crowded room.
We planned the trip and book 3 rooms in March 22 to celebrate a family member’s birthday. We booked the Luxury suite Ocean view all inclusive. My only request to the reservation team is to keep the rooms close to each other since we have a lot of excited children, so they added my request to the notes and we expected that.
When we got to the hotel all the troubles started, we weren’t given rooms close to each other and not even at the same floor, they said if we upgrade the room for 90$ a night per room they will find us something close to each other. So basically they could’ve done it but they didn’t want to. I mean they wanted me to pay almost extra 2000$ on to of the 10,000$ we already paid, that was ridiculous.
When we got into our room the room was crowded with furniture, the ceiling paint falling off, the doors won’t close properly, the shampoo holder broken and the biggest thing for me was mold in the shower. After talking to a manager we were promised a better room on day 2 and we switched rooms, the new room was in the reserve section which is slightly higher end of the Luxury but we found the same issues we had in the previous room on top of that the shower/restroom has no door, I didn’t accept their offer to install a curtain and we switched to Room number 3. The only thing different was the air conditioning worked fine but we encountered the same issues of the previous rooms plus broken mirror in the bathroom.
I decided to talk to a manager and Marisol was aware of all our fiasco and disappointment so she offered us a one bedroom suite at the reserve in tower 5 which supposedly it’s the signature tower of the hotel. We did switch but honestly it was just the same issues of broken items and mold of the previous rooms but we got tired of moving so we settled in that room until the last day.
I did express all my concerns to the manager and how disappointed we all are from the quality of the hotel and it’s rooms.
Not only the rooms though needs a major cleaning and remodeling but the gym the restaurants, the hallways the pool etc…
The food was ok nothing fancy to justify the all inclusive price. No vegan options, also they use a lot of syrup and paste in their cooking, nothing fresh or exceptional.
The only reason I gave the hotel 2 stars and not 1 star it’s because of the employees, they are really polite and nice.
Bottom line it was a huge disappointment and I won’t recommend this hotel to anyone. At least not for the published price. I personally won’t go back there again.

reviews.title: Fantastic Experience
reviews.text:
My family is lucky enough to be able to do an annual trip to Cancun (we are a group of nine.) This was our first year at the Paradisus, and we were very impressed. We have stayed at many other resorts in Cancun as we have been coming yearly for some fifteen years at this point. 

Particularly excellent was the food; the breakfast and lunch buffets are far better than those at what comparable luxury all-inclusives like the Barcelo and the Iberostar. The 24/7 coffee bar is a fantastic amenity that we made frequent use of. 

The interior of the hotel is gorgeous - the dark hardwood combined with voluminous greenery and subtle touches of glass is visually astounding. Really, really lovely. 

The service was also fantastic. At the breakfast and lunch buffets, we were lucky to be regularly attended to by Alfredo. On the beach, Yesenia and Ana were attentive and prompt at all hours.  

I must mention one particular instance of excellent service at the Lunch Box with Guillermo. He went above and beyond to accommodate us and elevate our experience. Thank you Guillermo and thank you to all the excellent staff at the Paradisus!

reviews.author: E4908LVdavidb
reviews.title: Very disappointing. The worse Melia out of the 4 I've been.
reviews.text:
I have been to the hotels in Punta Cana, Playa del Carmen, Tenerife, and Cancun. This is by far the worst of them. 
Room: The room was OK, with a comfortable kind bed, and an extremely uncomfortable sofa bed. We asked for an additional twin bed, which came a day later and was good. The big issue with the room, is that the temperature (of all 3 rooms that we had) is extremely uneven. So the kids were freezing in the twin bed and sofa bed, and we were almost sweating in the king bed. 
Restaurants: Most of the restaurants were OK. The "Cielo" Restaurant had a great lamb dish, and the Italian restaurant was very good. The seafood restaurant by the pool has a pretty good dinner, but forgettable lunches. But in conclusion, the a la carte restaurants were good, and the buffet is sub par. 
Pool: The pool was very outdated and pretty disgusting. There were little to no attempts by the staff to get people from eating in the pool, and the water just looks murky. 
Activities: Very few activities for adults. Also, no organizers that get people involved and going. It is like they don't want to really have any activities, but they feel like they have to. A big different from resorts that create a community between guests. And the kids club which is for ages 5-10, is really for kids 4-7.
Aquaworld: So the hotel has outsourced all their responsibilities to have outdoor activities to a third party called aquaworld. Of course, this third party has only one interest, which is to sell you as much additional stuff as possible. Only midway through our trip did we learn that they had some included water activities like sailing, as these guys just want to rent jet skis or trip to Isla Mujeres. 
Concierge: Literally saw her once. She was fairly good about providing some assistance (and booking dinner reservations) through WhatsApp, but not very proactive or informative. In Paradisus Playa del Carmen, you come back to your room top find a bottle of champagne, a bubble bath with balloon animals for the kids, and little things like this. But in Cancun, you are lucky to have simply requests (like an extra bed) fulfilled in a timely manner. 
Value: You would think that subpar service and facilities would command a lower price... well, that's not the case. 

Overall, I am extremely disappointed with this hotel, and with the entire Melia Organization. They discontinued the Club Melia offering, and now are trying to sell you a new one, while doing the bare minimum to keep their existing commitments.

As a word of advice - If you are not between 18-30, stay out of Cancun. The beaches are full of seaweed, and the place is basically a party place. If you want to go and drink all day by the pool, and party all night, this is the place for you. But if you have a family, or you simply want to do more stuff, go to Playa del Carmen or other locations outside the Yucatan peninsula.  Also, go to the Xcaret parks, which to me is the only reason to ever go back to that general location. Also, skip Isla Mujeres. Not worth the trip.

reviews.author: Lucia L
reviews.title: Lunch Box
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel. Beautiful beach. Food is very good and Guillermo at Lunch Box with his outstanding service made the difference. He was on top of every detail and he would anticipate any thing we needed. We will come back next year to the same hotel

reviews.author: MP III
reviews.title: Wonderful Trip
reviews.text:
First I never write reviews however, I felt one was necessary in this case.  We spent 5 nights at Paradisus with a 13yo. Upgrade to the Reserve.  We were in Tower 3 in a Deluxe Junior Oceanfront Room. Floors 7 and 8 are reserve rooms and Tower 3 is the hub of most activities.  Noise from the nightly activities at the Ginger Bar was not an issue for us as our room was quiet.  The Reserve gives you access to Tower 5, or floors 7/8 Tower 3, nightly turndown service and towel refresh, and the Adults Only restaurant Sante and pool.  Most importantly you have a family concierge, ours was Mauricio.  He went above and beyond to communicate with us daily via whatsapp (even on his day off), make reservations for us, provide tour recommendations, and found us daily to speak and make sure we were satisfied everyday.  We witnessed folks trying to make dinner and cabana reservations daily which looked like a hassle during a vacation.  The concierge Mauricio took care of that for us.  

The food while not 5 star it was good with Lemonfish being the best followed by Cappela and Aquamarina while, the Lunchbox was just edible.  The buffet was satisfying.  The carnitas at Blue Agave were delicious and the poolside burgers were filling.  We did not try Cielo.  Of you are looking for the wild party hotel in Cancun this is not it.  Paradisus is definitely a family friendly relaxing hotel with family oriented entertainment and activities. 

The staff is very attentive and a small $5 or $10 tip will go a long way.  The grounds and rooms were well maintained and again the Reserve just for the concierge is the way to go.

We visited during seaweed season and only had 2 good beach days.  The other days there was an abundance if seaweed in the surf and along the beach. It is also sea turtle nesting season and we witnessed a sea turtle digging a nest for her eggs a highlight for my family.  

I would recommend this property and look forward to staying again in the future.

reviews.author: Kayla B
reviews.title: Amazing Service
reviews.text: Samuel Sosa at Restarante Melva was AMAZING!!! He was super nice and provided superb service👌🏾 I was on a birthday trip and he made sure myself and friends had a fun time. He makes me want to book the same service when I come back 🥰

reviews.author: Julio V
reviews.title: Good Dinner
reviews.text: Good waiter and have a great chef that was provided to us was great. Enjoy the experience with the waiter Cristian who made it better with the chef Ricardo who made the amazing food. We love the stay here.

reviews.author: MTomac
reviews.title: Absolutely Gorgeous Space and Relaxing week
reviews.text:
We just returned from a 6 day stay at Paradius with the Upgraded Reserve room in Pyramid 5 and it was a truly wonderful family stay .  We traveled with a 6 yo, 10yo, and two adults and thought the vibe was perfect mix of kid fun and adult sophistication. It was also a perfect fit for my 6 year old who has  FOOD ALLERGIES- the chef's and restaurant mangers were amazing and accommodated  his needs at each meal ( see below for more details.  I would read the reviews carefully , as I we LOVED our stay, I don't know if this a fit for everyone.
 
First- the grounds and lobby and common areas are beyond beautiful. More so than even the photos show. The resort has a late 80's vibe that has been creatively updated and modernized with unique landscaping and design elements. The five pyramids and the stunning indoor gardens make the hotel feel like a total escape and not at all like the cookie cutter mega towers on the strip. The pools and cabanas alll have wonderful views and the beach is beautiful. Upgrade to the reserve purely to access the magical private lobby and koi pond, bar and snack from 7-7. It is really a beautiful place to sit and relax and unwind. 

Kids - Kids had a great time in pools and cabanas. I would make reservations on day 1 with pool concierge for cabanas at each pool  to try each one. Reserve upgrade gets you two guaranteed reservations - VICTOR and NICOLE are amazing and made sure we were set up each day. Adult pool is truly stunning and quiet, main pool is alot of fun for kids and adults and get rowdy but not raunchy , and the kids pool, while a little underwhelming, is great for toddlers. Our only complaint is the kids pool was really for a younger 5 and under set and the main pool lacked some fun features for older kids like fountains or sprayers. The beach is beautful and lifeguards were attentive. For us this was the perfect mix of kid and adult friendly. If you are looking for big water slides or crazy bar scene - this isn't it- but it was perfect mix for both. Last but not least, KidDome the kids club was ALOT of fun for my kids. We only went 1 day but they had a blast and it was a nice break from the sun and pool. They had tons of organized activities and were very responsible. Shout out to Nicy and Esmeralda who took such excellent care of my boys.

Dinning- the resort is clearly trying to offer more than ust standard buffet fare and create dining experiences. Having said that our favorite restaurant was Marva the buffet/ bazar. The food was better than average and they had alot of options - the green juice cerviches, and breakfast pastries were the best. The waiters remember all your favorites and take excellent care of you . Martin was amazing and remembered all my kids favorites each morning. If you upgrade to reserve your concierge will make all your reservations for dinner- but you can also stop by the reservations desk and make your own. Lemonfish, Aquamarina, and Cielo were our favorites.  The food was great- but not AMAZING or out of this world- and were a little limited on vegetarian options. 
The cerviche's at lemonfish are the best thing on the menu and the empandana at Cielo were exceptional

Lunchbox is also very kid friendly and a standby for lunch. 

Kids menu's are available at all restaurants and have basics like quesdilLA, chicken fingers and fries

FOOD ALLERGIES - my son has serious allergies to peanuts, tree nuts, eggs, and sunflower and with some work - we were safe all week. I would recommend traveling with printed and translated allergy cards to inform all staff. If you have a family concierge let them know right away.  We also asked to speak to the restaurant mangers on day 1 and they posted my son's allergies to all the chef's across the resort so they were prepared for us wherever we went. The only place my son couldn't safely eat was MArva - the buffet because of cross contamination ( egg and peanut butter very present )  but that was just my preference.  They made all his food with separate gloves and in separate fryers. Last but not least, but sure to tell house keeping on day 1 your allergies so the do not keep stocking peanuts in your room. Very special shout outs to the following wonderful staff who took such excellent care of us. The entire team is great and everyone really takes their jobs seriously . No one was pushy or intrusive and everyone went above and beyond to ensure we had a great experience. Especially the following people:

Rafael- our family conceirge- AMAZING. texted me the whole time- even on days off. Ensured we had everything we needed

Andrea- restaurant manager and chef and took my child's allergies very seriously and made sure the all staff knew
 
William and Daniel at Cielo- made our last meal so special and safe for my boys

Julien- at Capelli- went above and beyond to accommodate us

Ana- 10/10 balinese massage

Martin- waiter extrandoniare!

Ivette- at the excursion desk who booked us a wonderful adventure. 

AND THE WHOLE AQUAMARINA STAFF  who's names i didn't write down- especially our chef who worked around sunflower oil

reviews.author: Bobby B
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text:
Giving 5 stars only for the service. We stayed for 5 days at Paradisus and the service was amazing! Janeth, Ivonne and Alfredo Alvaro went above and beyond for us every single day when we came downstairs to have breakfast. The rest of the staff was very friendly too. 
The facility needs major upgrades asap!! The rooms are outdated and are not sound proof and the nightly show literally happened underneath us so none of us could go to sleep until they were done.

reviews.author: MrSinghUK2022
reviews.title: World class service from Aaron Ruiz and colleagues
reviews.text:
I woud like to share an emai that i have sent this morning to the staff at the Paradisus. Fantastic service, the best i have seen. 

Hi Aaron and Andres 

I hope my email finds you both well 

Please can you kindly forward this email to the directors of Melia/Paradisus as high up as possible as you deserve recognition on a very senior level. Feel free to use my email as a testimonial for any type of literature or marketing you wish to use in the future, you have my full authority. 

Myself, my wife and children would like to thank you for the most exceptional service we have ever had in any hotel.  I have travelled 39 countries, seen many places around the world and stayed in many Hotels over many years.  What stands out is the world class service that we received. 
Aaron was simply outstanding and even this email cannot do justice and explain how comfortable he made our family feel and went out of his way to attend to every need throughout our entire stay.  Even on his day off he was checking to see if we needed anything and was still orchestrating things for us which we cannot thank him for enough. 
We had certain dietary requirements, every single restaurant we went to knew our situation exactly and provided bespoke menu options to cater for us.  A BIG thank you to Rodrigo Fraga and the amazing chef Apolinar Gomez. These guys are terrific and made the most delicious food.... even my kids liked it! :  )
Andres was very kind, we had a long 10 hour flight back to the UK and he knew that we did not like aeroplane food so he surprised us with sandwiches that we could take with us.  These types of gestures go a very long way and made our stay extra special.  Even when we arrived, Aaron had dishes of pasta waiting for us in our room as we were extremely tired and very hungry. 
This service is what sets you apart from the competition. Honestly, world class elite customer service which we will not forget. 
Also i cannot forget Victor and Elliot at the pools! The service was outstanding and consistent throughout all of your staff. 

I hope these staff are rewarded in some type of way as they made this recent stay so special for us. 

Thank you so much and we hope to see you soon 

All the very best. God bless  

Mr Singh & Family  (vatos locas)

reviews.author: snlrn2010
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text:
We stayed in "The Reserve" and it was a nice upgraded option. Our concierge Frida made sure we had dinner reservations every night and was very attentive to any needs that arose. 

There is a beautiful ocean front restaurant called Sante that my son and I had breakfast at almost every morning and it was excellent! Our server most days was Oscar and he was always polite and smiling! We were also able to reserve the Cabana's near Sante and Miguel was the best server out there! He made sure guests in the Cabana's were well taken care of! I also enjoyed the pool bar very much and Esteban was a great bartender! 

We had massages while there by Anna and Liliana. It was the Balinese massage and was one of the best massages I have ever had! I was so relaxed that I forgot all of my jewelry in the robe pocket in the spa. I didn't realize it until about 3 hrs later and the spa was closed at that time. I was frantic! The jewelry was VERY special to me. I immediately contacted the front desk and security and they went above and beyond to locate my items...special thanks to Ceci and Raul who were part of the management team and Leonel and Jonathan who were the securtity professionals. My beautiful trip would have been ruined if I had lost my jewelry! 

I would definitely return to Paradisus! Beautiful Beach and they cleaned the seaweed up as much as possible almost every morning. 

There is some construction/renovations going on around the property but they did not disturb my vacation. 

One of the only cons was that it was really hot inside most of the pyramids. Pyramid 5 which is where "The Reserve" is was nice and cool most of the time but the other Pyramids were uncomfortable to be in for long periods of time.

reviews.author: GILBERTO G
reviews.title: Great Experience at Lunch Box
reviews.text: Cristian Sánchez was an amazing server at Lunch Box and gave a great memorable experience! He helped celebrate Panchitas birthday. We had a large party and was very accommodating to our needs. I wish we had a server like him everywhere!

reviews.author: Lộc P
reviews.title: Great atmosphere
reviews.text: Great atmosphere. Very good service. Food decoration is very pretty. This restaurant located in a prime location of Paradisus Cancun resort. You have to reserve ahead of time to get a spot as they limit the number of customers served each night.

reviews.author: Sparkys P

Carlos Chay ,Jesus Canche, Libni Rodriguez were very professional and did an amazing job on getting us a place to sit ! Definitely coming back !

reviews.author: Frank A
reviews.title: Breakfast/lunch

reviews.author: Miranda A

reviews.text: Miguel, Diana, and Jorge provided the best dinner we had at Lemon Fish in Paradisus Cancun! They ga e us a slecetion if the entire menu to share together, a perfect way to experience the restaurant. Gracias por todos!

reviews.author: kaylen garcia
reviews.title: food service
reviews.text: The Malva waiters are very good! everyone was very nice and attentive. we were serviced by Ivom, Atilano, and Fernando, all are excellent!! They’re quick, observant, friendly and helpful. They all deserve +5 stars!

reviews.author: Sherry L
reviews.title: Amazing food and service!
reviews.text: We dined at the Italian restaurant capella. Javier is an amazing waiter, great service and super friendly. He made our experience wonderful and pleasant. If you have him as a server, you’re in for amazing service!

reviews.author: ALEX A
reviews.title: Great place and great food
reviews.text: Miguel  was amazing so nice and 6 stars service, and all the food was so great best restaurant on the resort  and also Diana and Jorge were great best service I've seen in Mexico so far everything we tried was so delicious

reviews.author: Abdul
reviews.title: Spend your money elsewhere!
reviews.text:
This was my second and it will be my last visit to Paradisus.very poor Customer’s service and the quality of everything went down and nobody cares.My son is vegetarian and I simply asked Julian (the chef) for some melted cheese for his nachos,he looked at me in the eyes and said he doesn’t have any,I found it very odd; a kitchen that big doesn’t have any cheese in it.I was still curious after sitting back at my table,so I asked my waiter which he was amazing ,his name is Alfred,I explained him my son’s condition,the first thing he told me that he has a daughter also and he totally understands and he will try to help me.10 min later he showed up with a bowl of melted cheese and he was able to put a smile on my son’s face,I was very disappointed of JULIAN as a leader and he couldn’t accommodate me for the smallest thing.I saw him afterwards around the buffet and I let him know that I was able to get some help,he had no answer for me.I asked to speak to his Boss and of course no follow up call .
My background is sales at a vacation club affiliated with RCI and I will never refer any guest to Paradisus!

reviews.author: Danny P
reviews.title: Paradisus resort’s Aguamarine restaurant
reviews.text: The restaurant was awesome. The view by the sea was beautiful, food was tasty, menu selections were well thought through and the service topped it off. Fernando and Daniel were great and took great care of us. Fernando even had a cake for our kids as it was their birthday.

reviews.author: April L
reviews.title: Embroidery magic
reviews.text: Fun and relaxing crafting activity! Lizzie and Mariana were such helpful and patient teachers. Enjoyed very much and was a nice afternoon activity to take a break from the sun. The view was beautiful too.

reviews.author: Sara O.
reviews.title: Paradisus Trip

All of the staff are well-mannered and so nice. Saul, Seney and Martin at the Reserve were great! We will definitely recommend this resort to everyone we know.

reviews.author: Mikayla R

reviews.text: paradisus cancun was amazing! S/o to mauro, angel, orlando, rafael, freddy, and more!!! Everyone was so amazing and nice and we can not wait to come back! The hotel is beautiful. The drinks are tastey snd strong. And the food is bomb! Also, s/o to the cleaning ladies they are the best!!!!

RAPHEL,
