reviews.text: Dreamy place and super friendly!   Staff is awesome and make you feel welcomed at all time.  I can’t wait to come back again.  One of my favorite was the 24hr Nespresso Bar and friendly barista.  The food and service at restaurants is outstanding.

reviews.author: Shakina
reviews.title: Great food friendly family atmosphere
reviews.text: Es muy fantastico. Servicio excelente will definitely come back again. MALVA has the best food on the resort be sure to eat here breakfast lunch and dinner.  Many different selections all really good. Great trip

reviews.author: BettinaCancunQuenn
reviews.title: 60th Birthday Celebration week!
reviews.text:
Just spent 7 days at the Paradisus in Cancun.
I decided to upgrade to the Reserve when we arrived. That was the best decision I could have made.
We had our own private Butler Freddy that took care of everything for us, even personally decorated our room and brought us champagne and strawberries. He was texting me everyday asking what he could do for us.
He reserved us Bali beds that faced the ocean. The service at the pool was amazing.
The Reserve side is much quieter and adults only. It was just what I needed. 
The Fiesta night was the best night with authentic food and entertainment you don’t want to miss. I have been staying at the Paradisus for the past 30 years.
The only disappointment I had was the buffet food was not as good as in past years,
Service throughout the resort is amazing and staff is all so kind and helpful. I highly recommend to upgrade to the Reserve side of the hotel and request Freddy.
I can’t wait to come back.

Bettina OBrien
Kansas City, Mo

reviews.author: Laura P
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Great Hotel with an amazing service! Everything was excellent, our servers Rafael, Nicolas were extremely helpful, I don't remember the names of the other guys but everyone here is great! Thank you so much for make our vacations so pleasant 😊

This resort is the best in hotel strip! We will continue to come and stay here!

reviews.author: Lourdes C
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Really great experience! The place was very nice. Rafael was very helpful. We requested a special order for our baby, who is 10 month old and he loved it! The sushi and the meat was really good. I would definitely recommend it!

reviews.author: Abby P
reviews.title: Axcel!
reviews.text: Axcel was great! He remembered all our names and made the effort to include us in all the activities that he put on! He was very fun but professional. He helped make our trip very enjoyable and made this resort every kid friendly but also fun for adults

reviews.author: Gennette F
reviews.title: Lemon Fish good
reviews.text: Lemon Fish was very very tasty! The restaurant gave small portions of ramen which allowed for more room for the yummy sushi. My personal favorite was the salmon nigiri yup! Rafael was our server and made our experience much more enjoyable!

reviews.author: Jessica C
reviews.title: Wonderful Family Vacation!
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful time at the Paradisus Cancun! My husband and I traveled with our two daughters, 9 and 5. The vacation was a perfect balance of relaxation and fun!!
I'll begin with our concierge Galdino. He was beyond helpful. He took care of all of our needs (dinner reservations, spa reservations, in room needs, etc.). He responded within minutes to every request! Thank you for making our stay so wonderful!
The food and restaurants met all of our expectations! The buffet had plenty of options for breakfast and lunch. We passed through the buffet almost every evening for the dessert bar!  Aqua Marina and Lemon Fish were our favorite for dinner! The staff at every restaurant were all exceptional! Jorge from Lemon Fish and Francisco at Aqua Marina made our time at each restaurant memorable! Room service for breakfast was fabulous! 
I drank my share of lattes and cappuccinos from the coffee bar! I cannot compliment the quality and variety in food options enough!
We were able to reserve a cabana near the family pool each day of our stay. It was absolute paradise! Leticia was there each day to greet use, taking care of all of our poolside drink and lunch needs. She was so sweet and such a pleasure to see each day! 
In addition to the amazing pool and beautiful beach, there were activities throughout the day that my girls enjoyed (painting crafts, piñata making, friendship bracelets, guacamole making)! The activities team was so kind and amazing with the kids. We had interactions with Karen, Maribel, and Axcel. The resort also brought in outside entertainment. The magic show and hand art wax were incredible! All part of your stay!
I also made time to visit the spa while there. Anna did my massage and it was heavenly!! 
The entertainment each night was spectacular. We enjoyed a little bit each evening after dinner. We especially enjoyed the Fiesta Friday! The resort provided themed foods and snack, while entertainment of singing and dancing, and local shopping vendors lined the resort! 
Our only request would be to not require staff to wear face masks. Not only does this make communication more challenging, we feel the interactions are less personable not being able to see their smiling faces! 
Thank you to the entire Paradisus Cancun for such a memorable family vacation! We will most certainly recommend this resort and look forward to visiting again!

reviews.author: Leticia P
reviews.title: Excellent vacation in paradius hotel!
reviews.text: Customer service was exceptional our waiters Pascual & Atilano provided the best attentive service @ Malva restaurant. All other waiters were also very attentive and made our stay here much more enjoying.

reviews.author: Jackie G
reviews.title: Great customer service! Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: All waiters were very attentive and helpful. Pascual and Atilano made sure we were well taken care of. The Lunch Box was pretty good, I ordered the grilled chicken nachos and deep fried Oreos. No complaints at all.

reviews.author: Gspan415
reviews.title: Nice looking property, disappointing experience
reviews.text:
I stayed at Paradisus over the 4th of July Weekend with my wife and our infant daughter (she was 8 months old at the time).  There were some upsides but the downsides just overwhelmed us.  As the old saying goes "Other than that, how was the play, Mrs. Lincoln?"

Pros
There were some.  The property itself is beautiful and located close to the airport and right in the hotel zone.  Because we had a baby, we didn't leave the property to go to Downtown Cancun or anything but it's pretty close if you decide to.  The staff was incredibly friendly and always willing to help out.  The pool was well designed.  It was incredibly long (probably about a quarter mile total) so it could cater to everyone.  There was a family side, a party side, and a quiet but deep side.  Whatever you were looking for at the pool you would find, which was nice.  It was also easy to get a drink, which isn't always the case at all-inclusives.

Cons
IT'S HOT.  And I don't mean hot as in great, I mean hot as in mercury rising.  The property has plant life (vines, trees) throughout the interior.  We arrived at night so didn't notice this at first but the following day, as we walked around, it was noticeably muggy and sticky inside the property in the common areas.  We asked someone on staff why the air conditioning wasn't on (it's July in Mexico) and his response was "because of the plants."  I don't know who made the decision to choose indoor plants over air conditioning at a resort in Cancun but it was the absolute, 100% wrong decision.  The air conditioning in our room worked but very poorly and it never got a reasonable temperature in our room.  We complained about this when we arrived but nothing was ever done about it.  The only place in the hotel that was comfortable was inside the restaurants and bars, where the AC was on full blast.  Anything else doesn't really matter since nobody can enjoy a vacation when they're uncomfortable but there was more.

We opted for the "Reserve" package.  This gives you access to a different part of the hotel and comes with your own "personal" concierge.  We didn't utilize the other part of the hotel because children were not allowed there.  That's not a big deal and obviously we made the choice to travel with a baby.  However, the "personal" concierge was an absolute waste of time and money.  First, ours did not tell us when we arrived that we should book cabanas by the pool right away because those book 2 days in advance. Instead, we were left scrambling to find a comfortable place to sit for the first few days of our trip when we could have dealt with that at check-in.  On the 2nd day there, we were looking for someone who could blow up our baby's floaties for the pool.  My wife and I walked almost the length of the resort before we found someone, but not before we contacted our concierge to ask how we could handle this.  No response.  Several hours later (and long after we found someone to handle this) we got a text saying that he "lost his phone" and that's why there was no response.  On  our second to last day, I asked our concierge if they could just confirm our transfer back to the airport.  When I didn't get a response by the morning we were supposed to leave, I did this myself as well.

I have no problem doing these things myself on vacation but I do take issue with selling people on a package where someone takes care of this and doesn't do the things that matter.  Essentially, the Reserve package gets you someone that will book you restaurant reservations, which I'd rather do myself if that's all I'm getting.

Those are the two major issues but there were some minor ones as well.  Despite being an all-inclusive resort, they didn't restock the fridge daily and I had to call several times to ask they restock us with water, which we needed for the baby's formula.  The fans weren't on during the daytime for the first few days that we were there (despite no air conditioning in the common areas) and I have no idea why.  By the last day they were running 24/7 so I'm guessing they got enough complaints about the heat and humidity.  When we arrived, the sheets were filthy and we had to ask someone to have them come and change the sheets out.  

Overall
The worst part is that the two biggest problems with this place are both easily fixable.  Turn on the air conditioning and don't waste time with the reserve package.  I would have honestly given this place 4/5 if those two weren't at issue.  My advice to anyone thinking about coming here is to come in the winter months and don't bother with the Reserve package.

reviews.author: Diandrea
reviews.title: Beautiful vacation
reviews.text: Highly recommend.  Must go to visit. The service, the location and the food was a perfect 10. I genuinely didn't want to leave. Every day felt like a fairy tale. Honestly one of the best resorts I ever stayed at.

reviews.author: Blanka
reviews.title: Best service😍😍😍😍😍
reviews.text: Armando, Pascual, Atilano, Edier, Orlando are the best service in restaurante malva!! You must ask for them. They are really helpful and kind with all of the guests! Also this is the best hotel i have ever stayed!

reviews.author: NICK FERNANDEZ
reviews.title: Lemon Fish restaurant at Paradisus Hotel Cancun
reviews.text: What a great experience we had server Jorge Ramos was excellent and it’s employees like him that make business successful great customer service that will keep us coming back. The chef Karen Y Mario is a top notch chef that know how to prepare Japanese cuisine like no others can.

reviews.author: Mike K
reviews.title: Wonderful staff despite some obvious shortcomings in the property
reviews.text: Alejandro at Lemon Fish, Gaby at the poolside, and Anna at Yhispa made this a trip of a lifetime. Could the resort use some updates in the rooms and pool? Absolutely. Are the people working at the resort largely amazing? Absolutely! Our trip has been incredibly fun and one we will always remember. The three people I’ve mentioned above have gone above and beyond to make it even more memorable.

reviews.author: william j
reviews.title: Lemon fish restaurant
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience at the lemon fish restaurant.  The food was excellent.  The atmosphere was outstanding.  Our waiter, Rafael, was the best.  He attended to all our needs and was entertaining as well!

reviews.author: Olivia M
reviews.title: AMAZING
reviews.text: This restaurant has been our favorite so far at the Paradisus. Our servers name was Jorge Ramos, and he was excellent. He gave 5 start service and the best recommendations for food and drinks. The chefs, Mario and Karen did an amazing job. Everything we had was delicious. We had the ceviche, sushi, and some of their skewers. Everything was nice and light and flavorful. Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Keyla S
reviews.title: Cristel at Spoons restaurant
reviews.text: Cristel is the hostess at Spoons Restaurant. She sat us down quickly and greeted us warmly. Every time we went to eat she was always so friendly. All the staff members gave us excellent service. We came back to this restaurant many times during our stay. The food is excellent.

reviews.author: Ingrid
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancún Buffet Service
reviews.text: Our server, Armando was excellent! He was always very courteous and went the extra mile to please our special requests!!! He pampered my grandparents and was always very sweet! Thank you for serving us!!

reviews.author: Jennifer B
reviews.title: Cappella
reviews.text: This place had such wonderful ambiance! The atmosphere is a beautiful place to have your dinner. Jesus was such a nice server, ask for him!  I highly recommend the pizzas. I had a truffle pizza, but they had a great variety. The desserts are out of this world too! I had a cream cheese like dessert with a raspberry topping. Fantastic atmosphere!

reviews.author: Britney P
reviews.title: Lemon Fish servers at Paradisus Cancun are amazing!
reviews.text: Cesar was a very attentive server, always asking if we needed anything and he was really quick to help and make sure we had everything we could ever need or want. He also had wonderful attention to detail. Daniel was also great! And Antonio and Salma in the kitchen were spectacular. The food was amazing! Everything tasted wonderful, and they all made sure my father-in-law had a special birthday complete with a fun birthday dessert and candle. All the staff even came out to sing to him! It’s a special place, but what makes it even better are all those spectacular people!

reviews.author: Piruza M
reviews.title: Thanks
reviews.text: I want to say thank you Karina fron Kanna beach for best costumer service for patient! She is a very kind and nice person! I want ro see next time her here !Ivon and  Victor manager from pool concierge I want to tell them bog thank you

reviews.author: JD323
reviews.title: Just ok… will not return
reviews.text:
The hotel is UNDER CONSTRUCTION! This was nit well advertised so buyer beware. The noise was just horrific but the work is being done right in the lobby. The AC is horrific in pyramid three. You will wake up sweaty. We also had issues with pests in our room:roaches and ants. The hotel came and sprayed twice. However, I saw a roach in the buffet running around the beef station. That was truly disgusting. 

The food is mediocre in the buffet. Restaurants are pretty good. The highlight of this hotel is the STAFF! From the SPA, to the restaurants, to the vendors… the staff is AMAZING! Super accommodating, they remember your drinks, and will even find chicken tenders for your picky eater. My little ones also enjoyed the kids club activities but you must be 5 and older! 

Unfortunately, we did not have a five star experience and will not return. My recommendation is to fix the AC and the pest problem and be more open about the ongoing construction. 

Photo is of the roach running behind the curtain in the buffet. 

Buyer beware!

reviews.author: Aisha B
reviews.title: Ms. Aisha Bilal
reviews.text: The Paridisus Cancun was an AWESOME resort!!! The rooms were clean the staff was outstanding!! Their customer service was second to none!!! All the restaurants were great but our favorite was Malva!!!! The food was so delicious & the staff provided excellent service!!! Alejandro Cob, David Contreras & Carlos Chay were wonderful!!! They made our dining experience so special!!! We loved it!! We will miss them!!!

reviews.author: Jeanine D
reviews.title: Girls Trip
reviews.text: I planned a girls trip with 7 of my friends just needing a get away. Transportation was a mess. So no matter if you confirm and send the confirmation email with flights and arrival times. You’re not ok. And your friend is going to be left at the airport. Expect check in to be about an hour, even with the reserve which is suppose to be exclusive. You’re not going to be able to have a reservation at the restaurants for the first couple of nights because your concierge going to be reactive and not proactive. When it comes activities like tequila tasting and wine tasting you’ll be turned away. If you’re a black minority just don’t, but the waiters and waitresses staff are phenomenal.

reviews.author: Josiv K
reviews.title: Clean and Friendly but....
reviews.text: The resort is nice however the buffet is terrible. Food in general is ok.. not the best Ive had in Mexico. Night life is non existent. You need to go outside of the resort to have some fun. Air-conditioning in the room is terrible. They should tint the glass so that the sun is not beaming down and having to keep the blinds closed to get the room to be cooler. What's the point of a great view if the room is roasting? Pool is fun and the staff is very friendly. The best meal I had was at the pool side amenities. We went to the steak house for my friends birthday and it was very overpriced. Food was really good but for what I had I paid much less at a very high quality establishment in the USA. Construction is 6 days a week in the hotel which I understand but a little annoyed. Good resort but not 5 star... I'd say close to a 3.5 star. Food needs to be better, more entertainment, and better AC in the rooms. I hope to come back someday and have a better experience.

reviews.author: hwassim
reviews.title: Many disappointments
reviews.text: Bad service, no apologies for anything, bad food except buffet, dirty pool, not enough employees, low quality alcohol, overpriced resort, bad beach access, loud construction, front desk takes too long to speak to someone

reviews.author: Raquel G
reviews.title: Amazing staff
reviews.text: I was very pleased with our stay. We were in Paradisus Cancun to celebrate our 40 birthday. The staff made us feel at home and safe. They were extremely attentive. Rafael, our butler had excellent recommendations and took care of reservations for dinner and Covid test. Diego, Max and the rest of pool staff were very pleasant and professional as well. 5/5 ⭐️

reviews.author: Tammy S
reviews.title: Paradise indeed
reviews.text:
I was looking for a relaxing first trip to Mexico and found it in the quiet serenity of Paradisus Cancun. I upgraded my room to a junior suite and received the benefit of "The Reserve" amenities, including all the perks of an all-inclusive, an upgraded room, cabana rental, adults-only pool area, AND a personal concierge (Rafael). My room had a beautiful ocean view, comfy bed, walk in shower with rain showerhead, and a gorgeous soaker tub. 

Rafael took care of my reservations: dinner, spa, and antigen testing. He ensured my minibar was stocked with my favorite beverages and provided gracious and helpful service throughout my stay. He also stayed connected to check on me in case there were anything additional I needed. 

Dinner each day was a treat but my favorite dinner spot was Mole, where the entree of roasted pork leg was only upstaged by the dessert (coconut cream with chocolate crumble). A close second would be Capella which served a tiramisu that was beyond delicious. Yes, I ate dessert at every meal. :)

Now for the negatives: 
I did not enjoy the breakfast buffet. Thankfully there were so many other options for food throughout the day and night that it did not dampen my overall enjoyment of the resort. 

Check-in took quite a bit longer than I expected. It was a little confusing not knowing where to stand (or sit) while waiting for someone to assist me, but someone eventually came over and let me know that there were two other groups ahead of me. Also, one of the staff came and offered me a beverage while I waited to check in (now THAT is what I like to see - lol).  

Just a word of advice: be sure to bring plenty of smaller bills for gratuities. The staff are super attentive and you want to be sure to reward them for that premium service.

reviews.author: Missnicky007
reviews.title: Amazing Employees!
reviews.text:
We were just here for my 40th birthday! The very first day, the very first people we met outside were Saul and Axcel, the activities directors. KILLING it with poolside Zumba! We weren’t at the pool for 10 mins before they were both IN THE POOL and playing volleyball with my group & I. Our 9 year old was never a second thought to them. They included her in everything like: doing magic card tricks & making her bracelets, they even did the obstacle course/went down the slide with her about 1,000 times. Then on our last night they met up with us to give her a special gift. These guys worked so hard each day not just for my family/group, but for everyone. They made us feel incredibly important and I feel like our whole trip was exponentially better because they were so fantastic. Thank you, from the bottom of my newly 40 year old heart 🥰

Also, the sommelier Hugo at Cappella was fantastic! He gave my husband a private lesson on red wine that was so professional, everyone at the table was impressed at his extensive knowledge. He even brought out a bottle to show that was from an original vine from the 1500’s!

reviews.author: Kelly M
reviews.title: Great wait staff
reviews.text: Guadencio was an incredible waiter, we specifically requested to sit in his section every morning for breakfast. The food was decent, and drinks were good. The room was good, although we were on the lagoon side, which was not as nice as the beach side. We thought pool side service was not as impressive as years past.

reviews.author: Travelingmami2
reviews.title: Overall good but some bad
reviews.text: My family and I stood for 6nights to celebrate my friend’s 40th birthday. The check-in was very slow and was waiting for like 2hrs. Our room view was not pretty we faced a parking lot/ ocean and was not lit up. Now on to the good part they had different options for restaurants to eat that that you needed reservations. They had an adult side (reserved) we didn’t stay on that side since I travelled with my daughter. I was able to go there for a bit and that side was more relaxing and had better food and liquor section but absolutely no kids. The regular pool side was big and pool waiters were great especially Didier he was awesome. The pool had an inflatable corse and slide. The restaurant at Mole was small and intimate our waiter was Carlos Gonzales he was also very good. The Enzo restaurant had pretty good sushi. Overall I would give the trip and a solid 7 out of 10. The check in and check out process was Terrible, supposedly they were understaffed. The COVID test process was simple and fast.

reviews.author: Bre O
reviews.text: Absolutely loved it here all of the staff were amazing. I will have to give my props to the pool bartenders Manuel and Osvaldo. They were absolutely amazing so kind, fast, and efficient. Everything was very clean the property is beautiful sooo nice. Enjoyed my stay the whole time the food was great and so was the lounge. Gaby and Leticia the lounge bartenders were amazing as well!!!! Took care of my friends and i every time we went to the lounge will for sure refer all my friends to this place!!!!!!!! Will definitely come back!!!

reviews.title: My wedding
reviews.text:
Everything Perfect Ana! Thank you

Thank you Orlando bar tender ginger!

Everything perfect!
All foods, drinks, patty’s.
I appreciate all you guys. 

I will be back soon.

reviews.author: Myra R
reviews.title: Mesero
reviews.text: Alfredo Alvaro at Malva Desayuno in Paradisus Cancun is one of the best waiters I’ve had in any vacation I’ve taken.  He was always very catering, always had a smile on his face, very attentive, and very kind. I’m glad I got to meet this sweet soul and he gave me one of the best breakfast experiences. Thank you Alfredo Alvaro!!!!

reviews.author: Thu D
reviews.title: Great vacation spot
reviews.text: Great food,  Great service.  Beautiful scenery.    What more can you ask for.   We got the reverse ocean view.    The view of the full moon at night shining on the ocean through our balcony was worth any price.    The reverse services was kinda odd though, cause we had to make reservations for dinner every night.   Would of be nice if we can just walk in and eat.   But our concierge  was great.   Would recommend this place for everyone.

reviews.author: Nabil C
reviews.title: Waste
reviews.text:
We booked 'The reserve' junior suite and  stayed at Paradisus Cancún for a week in August 2021.
If you are someone who likes under 15$ 'all you can eat' kind of restaurants in the US and don't mind waiting in lines and mediocre service you are going to absolutely love this place like other reviewers.
 I felt that instead of relieving stress with vacation we came back with more stress from the vacation. The resort has huge capacity (not sure if they limit it due to covid,  it was always super packed), the amenities are under designed per the number of rooms and they are understaffed,  so all the workers look overworked and stressed. If given a choice to go back in time I would probably book a better experience for my family.  
'The reserve' experience has misleading description on the website, since their own staff isn't aware of what is included in the reserve package and what has been promised to the customers . We had to show their staff screenshots from their website again and again which was very frustrating.
We were met by a 3rd party airport transfer service representative at the airport who was not even holding up the sign and was busy on his phone. We approached him, he didn't even look up or say 'hi' and asked us to wait. After 5-10 mins a driver came and took us to the resort.  At the hotel entrance a personal gave us directions to 'the reserve' reception which had no sign or stroller access. There was a long wait and just one person working at the desk who looked tense. We waited a good 20-30 mins cluelessly if this is the right place only to get a wrong room that they changed later after we disputed it,
The room itself is nice and clean. If you are not careful, be ready to get your fingers smashed by the washroom's sliding door handle which has no stopper until your fingers are crushed between the handle and the wall. Our toddler got hurt a couple of times.
Despite their website claims 'concierge' is not a personal butler but a customer relation officer who checks on you on whatsapp once a day (we got replies for our  queries after hours of waiting). Even for dinner reservations you are better off doing them yourself thru app or at the restaurant's check in counter.
The room service is included in the reserve package which is super frustrating. They will either forget the orders, bring them after an hour of waiting or just bring it wrong.  We provided the concierge the schedule for our baby's milk time, still no use. Same frustration to get room service everyday during our stay. The website says ironing 1 piece of clothing per guest plus shoe wiping is included for reserve customers during the stay but  every time we ordered we had to explain that to them or else they would try to charge us.
If you are a family with kids you can't access the "the reserve" pool area (which is a nice one) so you waste money for upgrades that you never got.  The "Bali beds" in non reserve areas by the beach or facing beach are 'extra charge'. The resort doesn't have a private beach of their own and it has huge rocks in the water (see attached pictures) and seaweed some days. On the resort side paradisus has their beach beds, but food and drinks services are not included and Bali beds are again extra charge. Following hurricane day they blocked access to the beach citing "safety concerns" by their floor manager. However, the guests at resorts left and right of our resorts were able to get to the beach no issue.
Overall Food and drinks service at the kids pool area is good, but still there was an instance where the server forgot our order, we waited for an hour and when asked instead of apologizing he argued he brought the food but 'someone' took it.
Our dinner reservations done by our concierge never coincided with any of the live events. Neither did she recommend shifting our dinner time for the same.
The breakfast and tea time food area has a very limited same selection of food every day. The main buffet food restaurant has decent selections but it's very crowded and no social distancing.

reviews.author: Angela
reviews.title: Family Vacations
reviews.text: We loved our visit to Cancun. The hotel property is beautiful, great drinks, and wonderful service. Armando and Adriana took care of us the entire time. The pool had lots of activities and kept us entertained.

reviews.author: llsmr777
reviews.title: Not coming back better options for sure.
reviews.text:
Check in- there was only 3 people and it was a small area. Took awhile but had two rooms. The thing that I wish they would have done is explained a little more where to get towels, room safe needed a key I had to come back for, how to make dinner reservations, just a simple overview.  You get a bracelet for room key.  Purple for non reserve and red for reserve. 
No one told me when I checked in how to get my appt for covid test. I had to go down the next day to find out. They were supposed to scheduled at check in but u have to scan a QR code and fill out online then they email you appt. appt was fine and was smooth. I went to guest services once I got the results to have them print. 
I met a couple who never was told. The day they left they forgot. Couldn’t get an appt. had to leave really early to get at airport. Yes they should have known but since no one told them they thought the day they leave they could just get. And they were not accommodated and could not get at hotel since they had no appt. 

Rooms - I got the luxury non reserve ocean view. One with king and one with two twins. The rooms are ok. It’s cute but it’s old. They had just painted or something so there was kinda a weird smell. The room itself is pretty small. The view was nice. Two chairs outside. 
Bathroom has big hand soap, body lotion, body wash, shampoo and conditioner. 
there was a leak by toilet. 
There is a fridge with beer, pop, water and chips and cookies. Better and more variety snacks would have been nice. 
My iron was broken the cord wouldn’t stay unwound. 

Hotel itself - it’s pretty run down. I was disappointed that the main forum was under construction and of course didn’t know that was gonna be the case when I booked. So the Japanese place in atrium is closed for a few months. I added pics. Construction started at 7am and was loud. 

The app - so hard to navigate. Would work sometimes. And to make dinner reservations it’s under Gastronomy? I could never make dinner reservations. When reporting was just told no one else reported issues and to just call. Why have the app if I can’t even use it. You can make dinner reservations 2 days in advance btw which no one told me. 

Restaurants - no one told me that I had to make dinner reservations. I knew from reading reviews before I came. So you can through the app which I could not. Or call right at 9am like everyone else. 

Blue agave - only was tacos, chips and salsa and some shrimp soup.  Took long to get just basically street tacos. The chips were corn and seemed stale. Came with some yummy guacamole though. But I wasn’t at all impressed and think the taco trucks at home (Seattle) are way better. 

Buffet - I love buffets. And this one well it sucks. Went for lunch and dinner. Same selections pretty much and nothing was at all amazing or even like really yummy. I don’t even want to go back there the rest of the trip if I can help it. Breakfast tho was totally acceptable. Very busy. 

Enso - loved this place. Sushi and other seafood dishes. Place is outside so it was hot. But food was delicious. This is one of the only places open for lunch besides buffet and there was another only for reserve guests. 

Mole - it was good but not my favorite. 

Fuego - was really good. Lots of seafood options but when we went the second time they didn’t have many of the options available. 

Capella - very good. Nice ambiance. Pizza and pastas. Ran out of short ribs. 
Room service is $5 fee if you are non reserve. Breakfast and late night selection is small. The food isn’t good. 

Room service - food is not good. If you are not reserve it’s a $5 charge each time. 

Entertainment - caught the Mexican dance show which was entertaining the staff did a good job. They do it in small area one of the bars so not too much seating. 
Led show was great. 
Elvis and the acrobat show was good too. 
If you are in main tower expect loud music until at least midnight or longer. I mean VERY loud music. I was okay with it but I would assume there are people who would wanna know this. 

Bali beds. $220 US to rent like what? Comes with champagne and some seafood platter. 
I got one with nothing for $50 but had to wait until no one reserved to see if one avail. And it’s cash only for the $50 option. Beds have a plug. I brought my multi outlet cord so that none of us had to fight on who could plug in. One plug and two usbs. 

People put their towels out early. Came down at 8. No one at pool but towels everywhere. They should really enforce this rule. 
No close bathrooms I’m sure everyone was peeing in the pool! 

Staff - waiters and pool folks were great! Front desk and concierge sucked. I was told I could check out early but still had my room. Because the same place you check in Is where you check out it takes forever! But when I went down they said I was misinformed. And wouldn’t allow me to. Said I had to wait in line when I was ready and so I had to go down 45min early to make sure I could check out in time In order to ensure I was done before my shuttle came. 
Guest services said that because my app wasn’t working they would txt reservations to let me know and allow me to make reservations ahead like the app does. No one said they got a txt. 

All in all. This is not a 4.5 hotel. It’s more a 3. Maybe if you were reserve? No idea. I felt when I asked anything no one knew and I was given wrong info all the time. I wouldn’t come back. And I suggest if you want really great service from everyone not just the hard folks working for tips, then go elsewhere. And again rooms were not amazing. Shouldn’t take 45min to check in and check out period. They should allow calling or through the app or tv for check out.

I have been to Cancun 3 times now. And this hotel isn’t worth coming back to. 
Rooms 3361 and 3363

reviews.author: Alise R
reviews.title: G Bar was the best
reviews.text: Gaby is the best bartender at Paradisus period!!!! Come see her at the G bar every night! She had the Hennessy shots on deck and kept us dancing all night long. Her service was awesome and we’ll definitely back!

reviews.author: Brock T
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: Axcel and Saul were great and amazing magic. This place is a place you need to visit.  Very clean and friendly! The amenities here make it relaxing, entertaining and one of my favorite vacation destinations! I will definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Nicole T
reviews.title: Entertainment
reviews.text: Had a great first night! Axcel and saul had awesome card tricks and entertaining vibes! Interested in coming back to see what else they have in store! The resort is amazing with all the amenities it has to offer!

reviews.author: Cody H
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: Staff in fantastic! Axcel and Saul entertained us with card tricks while we were having drinks. The food is amazing, the rooms are clean and you can’t beat the views! I stayed with friends for 5 nights and I am definitely coming back!

reviews.author: Ruthe S
reviews.title: The Best in Cancun
reviews.text:
Excellent hotel, services of high quality, but what enchanted us most was the treatment we received from the work team. Our special thanks to: Diego and his team, Ruben, Max, Lucas. Moises, Yamil, Joel Josue, Javier, Maria, Oscar, Miguel, Giovani, Alfredo Alvaro, Efrain, Pascual, The Best of Mexico, are the Mexicans!!!!
 Gracias Friends!

reviews.author: Nguyen T
reviews.title: great food great service
reviews.text: Excelence service of Alejandro Cob, Carlos Chay the manager of Malva restaurant, Javier Jimenez, food was very good, we loved the seafood was served en that restaurant, we're come back definitly very soon

reviews.author: Lynn Y
reviews.title: Awesome Vacation
reviews.text: We just returned from our vacation in Cancun! We stayed at the Reserve side of the Paradisus Cancun. The hotel was gorgeous and the service was excellent! The rooms were very clean and the minibar was restocked daily. The servers were very friendly and couldn’t do enough for us! Shout out to Ruth, Joel, Lucas and Moises for making our stay a very memorable and relaxing one.  The food  and drinks never stopped. Covid precautions were observed. Hand sanitizer was strategically placed throughout the hotel. The staff wore masks all the time. It truly was an amazing experience. I will definitely go back there again (hopefully someday very soon).

reviews.author: Korrie H
reviews.title: Muy Caliente!
reviews.text:
The resort was beautiful...a storm had hit a few days before we arrived so the beach was almost unusable sadly, however the pools were awesome (and needed due to the heat). The cabanas were perfect and a nice place for an afternoon nap!

Some favorite folks that made our stay nice at the Reserve pool was Diego, Oscar, Cesar, Maria, and Max. At Ginger Bar was Wendy and Sofiano..they made sure our before and after drinks were delicious (and it was the coolest spot AC-wise in the whole complex and very much appreciated).

For food: Enzo had some of the best sushi ever, Capella was delicious as well (Italian). The only downside was the heat as most of the restaurants are open air.
Our concierge Janick was very helpful in obtaining dinner reservations for us.
We were definitely glad to be in the adults only section called The Reserve...we had a small bar and snacks in our building lobby area daily so we didn't have far to go. 
The few downsides of our trip were in no way the resorts fault (the excessive heat, beach being closed, some construction in main building)  The employees were very attentive and wanted to make sure they got you what you needed. 
We would definitely recommend the resort and hope the next time we visit the items we missed out on are open once again.

reviews.author: Kcastillo414
reviews.title: Outstanding Staff/ Excellent Stay
reviews.text: This is my husband’s and I second time at this Resort and the second time is just as good as the first. The resort staff is exceptional and provide the best service! On this visit we stayed as Club Melia members and had the opportunity to have Jorge as our concierge! Jorge was Great! He greeted us every morning and made sure our dinner and pool Bali bed reservations were made. He also surprised us with a couples massage that was amazing with Gema and Daniella! The pool staff member Elliot always greeted us by the pool and made sure our Bali bed was reserved daily! The pool servers Flor and Manuel were very attentive to our needs! We would also like to acknowledge Karina at the Ginger Bar! She was Outstanding!!!!!!  She always made sure our favorite drinks were in our hand and always followed up with water for us. She was very attentive and her customer service skills is beyond measure! She would be the reason for our return to the resort! Thank you Karina for making our trip memorable!! As for the food, thought it was just ok.  My husband and I would order a few appetizers and entrees to share and try out. We did find things to eat in each restaurant (not picky eaters) but I do think they could improve on the food.  Also, the drinks need improvement. They were watered down and were way too sugary. I love fruity sweet drinks but thought the drinks were unbearable. Even the margaritas were sweet and watered down. Other than that we had an amazing time! I would also like to applaud All the resort staff for working together and working so hard to prepare us for Hurricane Grace that came through Cancun. They worked day and night to make sure the grounds were safe and cleaned up after the hurricane.

reviews.author: Marlon D
reviews.title: Marlon And Miranda’s great experience !
reviews.text: Omg Filiberto is absolutely amazing, service was so good you would think he’s the top guy there. I told a lot of people at the hotel too go to the restaurant just for his service and obviously the great tacos, absolutely great service he didn’t miss a beat! Thank you FILIBERTO we will remember you forever !!!

reviews.author: Julia D
reviews.title: Best Vacation
reviews.text: We had an amazing time, beautiful hotel, exceptional service. Especially 2 servers, Alfredo Alvaro and Alejandro Diaz, were the absolute best and went above and beyond to make sure we were taken care of. Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Christine M
reviews.title: WEEK OF PAMPERING AND PERFECTION
reviews.text:
There is a reason this is our favorite resort and it's the employees. We did Reserve after getting a great deal with airfare even though we did have kids. Check in was smooth since we did it onine before arrival. Manuel changed our room to the 8th floor in building 3 after consulting with Soni, our incredible conciege from a first floor room. We stayed in the Ocean view junior suite and it was fine for us since we spent little time in the room. A little tight for 4 people, 2 adults and 12 and 14 year old, though so next time we will get two rooms. Soni was simply amazing as our conciege. From checkin to leaving with lots of hugs and tears, she made our trip. We had bali beds for every day we were there at the kids and main pool (highly recommend the kids pool if you like peace and quiet, it was so nice on that side). She made all our reservations, booked our photographer(you get 3 free photos with the reserve package), got us a deal on our excursion to the jungle tour, and checked in every day with a list of the activities. She was there for anything i needed. We also loved the staff at the pool. Luis at the main pool for organizating everyone's bali beds and chairs. If you can't find one, he will get you one. He was always running. The main pool bartenders were fun. The kids pool side you got spoiled rotten. Enrique was simply the best- huge smile and constantly refiling our drinks or bringing us food. Elliot and Victor made sure our bali beds were saved for us and ready to go. They were just so sweet to talk with too. 
I definitely think the food at the restaurants has gotten way better since our last trip in 2017. We loved Capella, the Italian place and Enso's the best. Something even for picky eaters like my son. 
I don't get the poor reviews of this resort. It's our second stay and we loved every minute of it. The only issue we had was our photograhper not showing up for our 7pm reservation and we got some poor guy dragged in at the last mintue and he were super rushed due to the light disappearing. I do think what he captured was beautiful but many of the pics had us not smiling or making strange faces. I think 15 more minutes would have given him time to actually check the photos rather than just rushing through to grab us some shots since we were didn't have time to reschedule. But that is pretty minor in my book. Everything else was perfection. Our room was cleaned well, we always had what we needed in the minibar, our room was a perfect 70 degrees and I did notice the heat and humidity but it's an open air resort in August. It was way cooler than many described. Even a hurricane, didn't slow them down! They made extra sure to have the resort party hard on the Friday after it happened with a slide for the kids and a DJ all day. They quickly cleaned up the pool areas and made it seem like it never happend. Yes, we got water in our rooms but I get that at home with my sliding glass door in a pounding rain storm. They quickly tried to fix all the rooms that did have flooding. Covid protocols were followed too and I felt very safe. We all tested negative to come home.
All in all, a great stay and I will be back again.

reviews.author: Lucia C
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text:
My husband and i stayed here with our 2 adult children 8/16/21-8/21/21. Thanks to a review that suggested the reserve, we all stayed in the reserve in 2 rooms.  As a result, we'll choose the reserve every time.  Everything was so nice, including the adult only reserve pool area.  The workers were so great and the service was fantastic. 

Starting with Stef and Aaron who were our personal concierges. They were great at booking reservations for us and answering all our ques. They were always avail.

Lucas and Max worked the beds/cabanas at the reserve pool. They were great with anything we needed. Even on mornings that nothing was available (i swear there were over 30 cabanas), they said check back by 11am as there were many no shows. We got a cabana everytime. Both guys were very personable and friendly. 

Diego, the manager at the restaurant at the reserve pool would come and check on us regularly. He was always there to help with any potential issues or ques we had about food with great recommendations. 

Jennifer was part of the activities team. She made sure we knew the schedule and would come and get us for the activities we were interested in. 

Melvin at Mole was very helpful with the menu and extremely attentive to our needs. He was excellent in surprising my husband with a birthday dessert. He even sang with us and brought out so many treats for us all to share. 

Moses with room service was so polite, accommodating and always got my order right. 

Last but not least, my 2 fav ppl were Oscar and Cesar. They were servers/ bartender for us almost the entire time. They were funny and fantastic. Cesar never allowed our hands to be empty. He knew exactly what we liked and kept our cups full. 

Thank you to all of them and the countless other workers i didn't get a chance to learn names for. Even during and after the hurricane (yes, a literal HURRICANE), the workers never stopped being attentive. They never showed fear of the impending storm. They kept all the guests calm and entertained including some of the rude and entitled guests who felt the staff wasn't doing enough. They worked so hard to clean up after the storm. I was so surprised how fast they got the pools clean as we were poolside the next day as if nothing happened.

We will definitely return.

reviews.author: Violetsiva
reviews.title: You'll be taken care of at this all-inclusive.
reviews.text:
We went here for five days just after Hurricane Grace passed over. We were surprised to see that the hotel was completely clean the next day despite the storm. Staff was out in force cleaning the pool in the morning and everything. 

We forgot our passports in our check in bags when we got out of the shuttle. Just be prepared for them to whisk your stuff away right away in an attempt to check you in quickly. Soni, our concierge, offered to get them. She was reported for it and we wrote a written statement saying she did that for us. So security is pretty top notch here! 

Pools are wonderful and just warm/cool enough to still be refreshing in the heat but not cold enough that you won't wanna stay in there all day. 

Restaurants were really, really bland. We were offered habanero sauce at Blue Agave. It was the best thing we had because we'd been dying of lack of spice. We were even warned about it but it was like a 5/10 if those Asian 2x spicy hot chicken fire noodles are a 10. 

We were in tower 3. They are doing construction and there is a gross smell. If you want silence and no smell, ask for a different tower. 3305 was our room and was far enough away for things to be quiet though. 

We did the Reserve. I don't know if it's necessary. You get hit with sales pitches. We had better service at the cabana in the regular pool, but I did notice they were down a person that day in the Reserve pool. The free cabana might be a good reason to go Reserve if you're going to be poolside and at the beach all day like we were. Check-in is weird. Navigation is difficult in this hotel and Reserve check-in is in a weird place. Checkout is also weird since you have to go to the Reserve check-in area and then all the way back to the lobby to get to your shuttle. The best part of the Reserve is the concierge, which is worth it, especially when there are unspoken rules about things, like where to get towels or where to go to reserve the cabanas. 

We got stuck with a double queen room, despite having a king room reserved. The beds are not a normal queen size, but a little smaller. Just something to think about if you have two people to a bed. They offered to move us to a king the next day, but when you unpack, do you really wanna move? 

They serve glasses of water in the restaurants and not bottled. I heard someone complaining about that, but just know that it is still bottled water, just poured into a glass. I didn't use the tap to brush my teeth but my husband brushed his teeth in the shower. None of us got sick. 

Cleanliness was good. Housekeeping deserves a lot of kudos for that in these pandemic times. Hand sanitizer was everywhere and some people weren't wearing masks, but I can understand why if you're going to the pool/beach. There is even shoe sanitizer mats. 

I got buzzed once here. I switched from those frozen drinks to tequila shots, but yeah. I probably should've sat at a bar, it might've been a different experience. 

I don't know why this is, but we couldn't figure out how to turn the balcony light off or on. One day it was on all night, the next day it was off. No clue how or why. Just know it's bright and may shine through the crack in the curtain when you're sleeping.

I noticed some people complaining on here about the shower not being hot. I think these people aren't waiting long enough or are turning the faucet to the right instead of the left. 

We had an ocean view junior suite. The view was AMAZING. We had a good time here. Even the COVID test was easily set up and done right at the hotel. Our concierge, Soni, was great about getting back to us and answering questions. I can't remember the names of the people in the restaurants, but all of the waiters were excellent, particularly at Blue Agave and Fuego.

The rooms are kinda dated in some ways that you won't notice right away. Like the patio doors are drafty. The air conditioning is more like a swamp cooler. Some outlets and charge ports wouldn't work. Our room stayed at 76 degrees, which was comfortable for us. 

Activities are well organized and fun to do, and it's a great way to meet other travelers if you want. 

You'll be taken care of here. The staff is what makes this place pleasant and memorable. Jesus and Luis I think were some of them. We can't remember everyone's names but they were all amazing. You'll find everyone named in these reviews because they do get acknowledged for being in the reviews and it's a shame I can't remember the names of the waiters, particularly the ones who recommended a tequila at Fuego and the habanero sauce at Blue Agave, also one who recommended the chef's special dish at Mole. Fantastic people. 

I suffer from social anxiety. I had none of that here despite having to interact with people all the time, every day. They're just that friendly.

reviews.author: Erwin
reviews.title: Paradisus cancun
reviews.text: Check in was horrible, Esmeralda was completely unprofessional I waited over 30mins to check in, and when it was finally my turn, she was also taking care of three other guests. Aaron R and Violetta are amazing. I would go back just for them, they made my birthday special and were always available when needed. The staff at lapalapa always went above and beyond  thank you to Diego and his staffs Joel, Moises, Valeria, Yamil. Fernando at enso was an excellent server and had some great recommendations. Ana our housekeeper was also great always replenish everything everyday.

reviews.author: artika337
reviews.title: Survival Tips For The Wary Traveler
reviews.text:
Tip 1: My sisters and I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun from 8/19/21 to 8/23/21, so we arrived during the aftermath of Hurricane Grace. Upon my arrival at the airport, my pre-arranged transportation with the Cancun Airport Transportation company was cancelled without a warning (no text messages or even a voicemail)! I called every telephone number listed on the confirmation email, but the calls were never returned or answered; but, I degress, it’s recommended that you just wait until you arrive at the airport to arrange your transportation to the resort.

Now on to the subject of the Paradisus Cancun resort:

Tip 2: The Reserve is a SCAM!!! I repeat the RESERVE is a scam!! The Reserve option only grants you access to an adults only pool area, a butler/personal assistant for the stay, and access to several restaurants. However, your room could be assigned next to a family with some bad kids and their parents. The families with children remain the primary focus for this resort. For example, the adult only pool didn’t have a DJ or fun floats for the guests to use; but, the families side had the great music and water slides for the guests. The top tier/Reserve guests were forced to play music on their personal Bluetooth speakers for others to enjoy {FOR SHAME}!!! Take note Paradisus Cancun get with the times! The new resorts have foam parties and neon pool parties with great DJ(s) for their adult guests. If you fail to heed my warning your adult guests may stay elsewhere.

Tip 3: FOR ALL THAT IS HOLY, DO NOT USE THE RESORTS WEBSITE TO PAY FOR YOUR ROOM!!! OR YOU AND YOUR TRAVEL COMPANION COULD BE LEFT OUT IN THE COLD ON MEXICO. While I was awaiting 3 hours for my room
to be cleaned, I witnessed the sad sight of a couple who paid for their room in full on the resort’s website, but they were being told that no one at the resort could confirm the payment; so, they were offered the opportunity to pay for one night (a night that they had already paid for, I might add) until they can confirm the payment the next day; OR, they would have to stay elsewhere for the day until the next morning!! 

I encountered the same issue with I asked the staff to check my room balance before check out. I was told that I had to “pay for my stay,” when I had the confirmation of payment email. After I challenged the staff member’s claim, she confirmed that my balance was zero! So, TIP #1, pay for the room at the resort, not beforehand.

Oh, and the staff likes to speak with each in Spanish when they are discussing issues with you. My sister fall and injured herself, and while she was writing the report, the guest services staff starting conversing with each other in Spanish about her in front of us like we weren’t there! So rude….if we are having a conversation in English about an important matter let’s keep the lines of communication open.

Tip 4: the Bali Beds for Reserve guests. Make sure you claim your bed by 9am, or someone else will grab your spot. Once you’ve claimed your bed, you have until 12 pm to report to the spot. If the Bali Bed has been left unattended after 12 pm, it will be given away to another guest.

Tip #5: Shout-out to my personal assistant, Janick, he was great. Also, the Cuncrawl/Rockstar Club Crawl was simply wonderful!! The tour guide made sure that everyone was having a great time, while we all remained safe!! I would definitely recommend this tour.

reviews.author: Carrington D
reviews.title: Ridiculous to say the least
reviews.text: I have stayed in Meliá in Spain, Paris, and dominican Repúblic to say the least but this by far has been the worst. The reserve isn’t worst the money trust me. You pay to wait in line to have your questions answered. I waited in  line because my rooms was leaking form the AC and it wasn’t a good room to begin with and I made a big deal because the regular desk won’t deal with the reserve guest you have to go to a separate wing in the hotel. When you get there there is only 1 person working on checking people in or dealing with the reserve customer problems. I asked to get my room changed keep in mind I’m a Meliá member, I brought my family on vacation, I paid more than my group for each room, my room was leaking from the AC and it was also not a ocean view. It ways it is but from the first flow I have no idea what type of view that it. For the money I was disappointed. From the Meliá standards my wife and I were disappointed. This hotel made all the other Meliá properties we stayed at amazing. Please don’t stay here is if you don’t want to deal with a headache. Or if you do don’t get the reserve program it is not worth it please trust me i travel all the time it’s trash to say the least. I will never stay here again

reviews.author: savagepoetry23
reviews.title: Will not come back
reviews.text: This was a vacation with my family. Upon arrival there seemed to be a lot of confusion at the front desk we were approached by 4 different staff members who had 4 different responses and answers to our questions. I didn’t like the overall service I felt like at times I needed assistance and staff would turn away from me. I tried to engage in conversations with staff about Mexico and tequila and they didn’t really want to talk much.

reviews.author: Antonio E
reviews.title: Cancun vacation
reviews.text:
The best PR. 
Rafa Juarez thanks for everything, keeping up with us. Keep doing that. Amazing family vacation thanks to you and your service. Stay safe 
Gracias por todo Rafa. Desde q arríbanos hasta nuestra partida siempre atento cn todos nosotros muchas gracias por todas las atenciones. Gracias

reviews.author: CMAG
reviews.title: Drawing a line in the sand
reviews.text: Upon arrival I was greeted by Raul, a man that my own father knows well, as our family frequents the Paradisus. I, personally had not been for 15 years, but was immediately comfortable and felt attended to with familiarity. In Tower 5, Manuel checked my siblings and their families in when were were introduced to Pavel who assisted them for the entire stay. It's safe to say that I am high maintenance  and my 2 preteen and 1 teen kids needs, are my first priority, so when I  asked about accommodations for my special needs son even though my reservation hadn't indicated it was necessary, Rafael oversaw the changes I requested with chivalry and compassion. Of several special requests that I made, the most appreciated was a private tour of Chichen Itza for my kids, an aspiration I've had since I was a child myself; Rafael exceeded expectations in simplifying and specializing my entire vacation with my kids. My first trip back to Cancun in so many years was unforgettable and without hesitation, we will be staying again, as soon as we can

reviews.author: Marisela M
reviews.title: NOT A 5*** RESORT
reviews.text: I’m currently staying at Paradisus Cancun and am regretting it.  I’ve been here one day and the A/C in my room does not work and my room is very humid.  Out of the 6 rooms that our family currently occupy, one room has a good working air conditioner.  I’ve contacted the lobby numerous times and all I get is the run around and promises of sending maintenance.  DO NOT BOOK HERE, unless you want to gamble on possibly getting a room with a good working A/C.

reviews.author: Noemie D
reviews.title: Aweful buffet and stinky old rooms
reviews.text:
Paying $330 per night, everyday the buffet is the same, eggs not cooked, one time meat we saw, fried chicken is aweful, there is not good food in the buffet, mcdonalds egg is better than in your buffet, coffee is not good, only one red wine available for not reserve, our room smells old had another but changed it still stink, hot in common areas in the hotel - when we told receptionist we don’t want to upgrade no explanation or anything what or where is in the hotel - we went find out on our own. Oh and the sushi n food at enso is aweful…definitely its a one- time in this resort not coming back and not recommended- u cant even go to the beach its not cleaned everyday like what is being said in the tweet….chicken tenders by the pool is hard n not good wings but we don’t have choice but eat whats available…. Tsk tsk tsk…the drinks they cheat on how much alcohol they put basically drinking lots of sugary drinks!!!
The only good is Ceazar salad and the fuego…unfortunately its not worth it.

reviews.author: Kenia Lindda
reviews.title: Birthday trip
reviews.text: Rafael Juarez and the rest of the team who works for Paradius Melia in Cancun are the best people! Rafael did everything to make our stay the best time of our lives! Thanks Rafael for your attention with me and my crew! I hope to see you soon!!’

reviews.author: Maggie E
reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.text: The hotel was the best experience I have ever had in Mexico. The service was magnificent and the food was amazing. Super safe at this critical time during the pandemic. I will definitely be going again.

reviews.author: Farrell R
reviews.title: “Fuego” service!!!!
reviews.text: Where do I start?! Every waiter in this place it’s beyond amazing, they welcome you with open arms and are very hard workers! Gaudencio waited on us for breakfast and lunch, this guy is awesome he treats you like you are his own family. With genuine respect and dedication to his job, his passion is to do whatever it takes to satisfy his customers even if it means carrying their plates to the table for them!! If you are add the paradises in Cancun and you find yourself at Fuego make sure that you ask for Gaudencio, he is surely to satisfy and won’t disappoint!!! He made our trip very memorable and we will definitely be back!

reviews.author: 258craig
reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text:
I booked 3 rooms in the reserved. Took hours upon arrival for my rooms to be ready. Then the rooms were in different towers. Then I didn’t get the room I paid for. Same day, hungry when to pool bar no chairs available to sit. Sat at bar ask to order food manager said you can’t get food with out chair. I explain there are no chairs. He said buy a cabana 250$. Haha 
No Ac in lobby area. The fragrance they have in the lobby was so bad I couldn’t breathe I had to personally unplug their machines. 
Room no hot water for 2 days. 
Ac in room so loud. 
Balcony no shade. 
Food quality bad. 
You had to buy water 6 dollars
Restaurant was always booked out. 
Pool area personally music playing so loud with bad language and I have kids. It felt like you were in rui cancun with teenagers 
Not enough chairs for the amount of guest 
Every time I ask concierge for a favor everything was no. 
The list goes on.

reviews.author: Anum Zaheer
reviews.title: An honest review from an American in Aug 2021 - Please Ignore All the Fake “Positive” Reviews that are scams
reviews.text:
We have visited Cancun many times and stayed at multiple resorts (The Royal, Fiesta Contessa, etc.). I have never felt compelled to write a review because the service was usually decent (or even great!) and met minimum standards.  I am very easy going but I am very traumatized from my experience here, as well as all the other families we are traveling with and/or have spoken to. This is my personal experience in a recent stay:

1.  Do not stay at the Reserve on the hopes of ever getting a cabana or for “personal concierge” service.  There are only less than 10 cabanas for the entire Reserve at the main pool - when you arrive, you will be “waitlisted” for the cabanas.  We are on day 4, and like us, your turn will never come for the cabanas.  There are less than 10 available for the hundreds of families that stay at the Reserve.  All cabanas are always “waitlisted” and locals are more able to “luck” into a cabana.  We have spoke to 6 families, all still waitlisted on their 5th day here (some traveling with us and some we have gotten to know here).  Your personal concierge has 50+ people assigned to them (our concierge is managing 3 groups of 20). You can imagine how much service you are getting (spoiler alert: it is zero.) This is not the “personal concierge”’s fault - it is obviously a scam by the hotel management to have you pay extra to “upgrade” for a service they never intend on providing.

2.  This is not a customer-oriented hotel, this is a VOLUME business. I have traveled to 20+ countries, and this is my fourth time in Cancun - not once have I left a review. I want everyone to be aware what they are getting - there are paid reviews by local friends and family to get the hotel good reviews.  I really dont want anyone to pay good money for a terrible property and terrible service.  They depend on a HUGE volume of guests that are one-time
visitors only - their goal really is to get as many people as they can to pay and book the stay, then you will show up and see that 1) for most rooms, the AC is fixed so you can not go below 78 deg F, 2) cockroaches in the rooms and roaming the properties, 3) no guaranty of ever getting any chairs or cabanas (given to locals early in the process), and 4) all dinner reservations are booked and you will be stuck each night with the terrible Blue Agave restaurant or the buffet.  The worst is honestly the AC never cooling the rooms (we have 5 on different floors throughout the hotel - all have same issue).

3.  We have booked 5 rooms and each are completely flooded.  The hotel blames the hurricane, but how does this explain the leaking in the bathroom before any sort of hurricane? The puddles in the bathroom, under the beds next to the balcony.  Bizarre explanation.

4.  Power and AC are going off all day long.  There is no hot water at random times through out the day. If you are coming with kids, please be prepared to give them cold showers. Again, hotel staff says this is hurricane-related, but these issue precede any bad weather.  Very bizarre explanation.

In short, this hotel is extremely understaffed.  They promise big expectations to get a huge number of guests, then they understaff the hotel so they can make a good profit.  Many reviews are paid.  I am 34 years old, have spent about half my life travelling extensively for work and family vacations and have never felt compelled to leave a review until today. I dont want you all to get scammed - this hotel is not for americans and other foreigners - this is really a terrible scam.  We have been looking for early flights out of here because the bars, restaurants, cabanas, beach chairs, ALL REQUIRE HOURS OF STANDING IN LINE AND NO GUARANy YOU WILL GET FOOD, DRINK, or ANY RELAXATION BY POOL OR BEACH.

Terrible service, no AC in the rooms, no reliable power in the rooms, no dinner availability, no pool chairs or cabanas - it really is not a vacation. Last time we were in Cancun, we stayed in Fiesta Contessa next door and it was as advertised. That has been the same at Cancun, Aruba, Paris, Amsterdam, Columbia, Turkey, Pennsylvania, etc. and any other state/country we have traveled to.  We have stayed at cheap hotels (literally $60 a night in Thailand) and expensive hotels, and we know you get what you pay for.  Here, they are definitely over-selling to fill the hotel up after a dip in revenue during Covid and understaffing - if you stay here, you are basically here to fund the revenue lost during covid.

TL;Dr:  speaking from personal experience, and atleast a dozen other families here - this is a scam for american tourists.

reviews.author: JC230505
reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.text: It’s a wonderful experience from the time you check in to the time you check out. The whole resort staff is AMAZING. The really do make you feel at paradise the way they cater to your every want and need.

reviews.author: Raqui C
reviews.title: Best night ever
reviews.text: Had the best time ever when we got dance classes and got to use our dance lessons to the test with Axcel :) such a fun time. he got kids involved and all. i will be back tonight for a latin dance party.

reviews.author: Elvin
reviews.title: Paradise our home in Cancun
reviews.text:
Paraidsus Cacnun has always been our home when ever we travel to Cancun. This past visit was our 7th time to Paradisus Cancun. The resort has been  the background of many of our romantic vacations. We enjoyed our stay during this past visit. As always we were granted amazing service by most of the staff. Oscar our pool side waiter at the the reserve section of the resort went out of his way to make us feel special. W.E. love different type of hot sauces and we shared this information with Oscar. The next day Oscar brought us three different local  hot sauces. One example of going the extra mile to make his guest feel special. Diego one of the hospitality managers went out of his way to create a special lunch for my birthday. His staff cooked a fresh caught fish with muscles, shrimps, octopus, and a fresh salad to companion the dish. His staff of five catered to our every need during the lunch and our stay. Javier at Mole should have his own wine class on YouTube. He was extremely knowledgeable when it come to wines and the dishes the resturant served. Mesero and Noe went the extra mile at blue agave extremely intentive to any request we wish. And the singer at blue agave set the perfect vibe for a chill and romantic dinner. 

The only complaint we have when it came to our service was our butter for the reserve section of the resort. Armando, was not up to par. Last time we stood at the reserve section our butler would check up on us everyday to make sure we were good. We were the ones checking up on Armando to make sure he was good. He is a courtesis  and respectful gentleman but, maybe he is better suited at a different role at the resort.

Now, my advice to Paradisus Cancun Management. During our stay the hotel rented part of the Bali beds of the resort to a private promo event. The guest that attended this event really did not leave a good impression to my wife and I. We were told that one guest even urinated in one of the hall ways. I understand Covid really slowed business down, but do not sacrifice your reputation for a quick buck. W.E. love this hotel and it was sad to see this. Leave these type of events for the hotel down the street Oasis not Paradisus. Also, last time we visited the hotel there was a bar by the beach called Coco bar which was a lounge style bar. During our stay the bar was closed. I suggest opening the bar and for adults only or maybe constructing a bar near the patch of grass located in front of tower 5 for the Reserve guest and Adults only. During Covid we were not comfortable traveling outside the hotel and all of the night options were filled with young kids. W.E. love this hotel and  will back again in the future. W.E. hope you address these concerns so, Paradisus can remain amazing for years to come.

reviews.author: James H
reviews.title: Great Trip at the Paradisius Reserve
reviews.text:
We just returned from 5 nights at the Paradisius Cancun and we had a great time. 

First things first, we did the reserve and stayed in a 1 bedroom ocean view suite in tower 5 (reserve tower). If you don’t take anything else away from my review, remember this as you go through the reviews; the adult only reserve pool area provides a much different experience than the main/family pool area, at least when we were there. The personal concierge that comes with the reserve also helps with dinner reservations at the restaurants, which can be tougher to get without a concierge from what I’ve heard.   

When we stayed, there was a large group of about 300 that hung out by the main/family pool. Over there it was very crowded, loud with music blasting, pot smoke, people doing shots, etc. It was definitely a party atmosphere. If that’s your thing, there is nothing wrong with that, but we were looking for peace and quiet. If I didn’t do the reserve, this would probably be a much different review. 

On the reserve side in the adult’s only area, it was a much different story. It was very peaceful. The large pool was impeccably clean and at its peak didn’t have more than a dozen people in it. There were times where we were the only ones. We were able to reserve a covered bali bed every day and there was no fighting for chairs.  

However, the highlight of the Paradisius is really the people who work there. Everyone was extremely attentive and friendly. Our personal concierge Ismael always made sure we had what we needed. He made reservations for us at the restaurants each night and we never had a problem dining where we wanted. Moises, Diego & Lucus by the pool and Salante restaurant were all extremely attentive. We always had a drink when we wanted one by the pool without having to ask. I wish I remembered more names, especially the restaurant servers because they all deserve to be recognized.

The restaurants were all very good for an all-inclusive. Keep in mind that no all-inclusive is going to be Michelin 5 star dining, but we were satisfied. We liked Mole and Cappella for dinner the best. For lunch we really enjoyed the adult only Salante (formerly La Palapa …note to Paradisius, you need to update your website). I do wish some of the restaurants like Salante had a few simpler options like a grilled chicken sandwich or a burger. After a lot of heat, alcohol and rich food, sometimes you just want something simple. 

We did the buffet once for breakfast. The food was fine, but it was very crowded and chaotic and people were on top of each other (the big group of 300 was there). I don’t consider myself to be COVID paranoid, but I really didn’t want a positive test which means you can’t return to the US. This was the only time I felt a little nervous. Aside from this, the employees were fully masked and they were constantly cleaning. We also saw a health inspector onsite, so they do take it seriously.    

The beach was hit or miss. It was a lot smaller than last time we were there due to erosion. The seaweed was really bad 3 days (unswimmable), kind of bad 1 day, but at least swimmable and 2 days the water was beautiful; calm like a lake and very little seaweed. If you are all about the beach, you might want to take this into consideration.

reviews.author: Jeanette R
reviews.title: 14th Anniversary Trip Turns Sour
reviews.text:
My husband and I just got back from our 14th anniversary trip to Cancun and we stayed in Paradisus Cancun - The Reserve. Overall our stay is good except for the check-in mishap and the last whole day of our stay which was supposed to be special because it was our 14th anniversary (the main reason of our trip) but dampen our mood because of a number of unfulfilled promises. 

First, we arrived around 9pm so famish since we only had a brunch in L.A. I thought that the "The Reserve" reception area is something VIPish, but definitely no. We walked quite a distance to get from the main lobby to the "The Reserve" reception area at building 5. The ambience of the area is so nice with dim lights and naturalistic interior design but the temperature was so hot. Sweat trickled down our haggard faces. We already checked-in through mobile app beforehand thinking the check-in process when we get there will be smooth and short coz' we knew we will arrive late and we wanted to be able to atleast eat in the buffet restaurant but opposite happens. It takes around 30 minutes for us to get our bracelet/key card because of some mishaps in room assignment according to the receptionist. She said we were assigned in a room that was not what we've booked for so she find us another The Reserve room (which was in the main pyramid-Building 3, far from The Reserve section in Building 5). We've waited for several minutes for our personal concierge, Rafael, to guide us to our room but we didn't expect that even that late at night Rafael tried to tour us around the resort. We were so desperate to eat because we were so hungry and it's 10pm already (restaurants closes at 11pm) so we talked to him that maybe we can proceed now to our room coz' we need to eat. Luckily, we were still able to eat in Malva and there was still ample amount of food even if its nearing closing time. 

We had booked a day tour and afternoon/night activity for the 2nd and 3rd day so most of our days in this trip were not in the resort. We only had the whole 4th day reserved to spend at the resort. We just requested to our personal concierge, Rafael, to do restaurants reservations, our Covid19 test appointment, and airport transfer and he all did it promptly. Rafael also answers our queries at WeChat. Sadly, on the 4th day (our last whole day in the resort), the most special day for this trip, our 14th anniversary it became disappointing. First, Rafael our concierge was in his scheduled day off at that day but the day before, he promised to us that everything for the next day will be prepared. He even promised that he will send a special gift to our room, have a Bali bed set up for us for the whole day and the Capella restaurant reservation for our anniversary dinner. We thought everything was prepared and we didn't even tried to contact him coz' he was in his day off except that night when we were so fed up with disappointments. First, the promised Bali bed was not prepared when we get there. Although we had the reservation, we still searched the attendant to ask our assigned Bali bed and was just set up when we get there. Just normal set up no 'special' things as promised. Second, for our reservation in Capella nothing was special. The receptionist ask the guests before us if they were celebrating something on that day, but us, she never asked. I was starting to get disappointed at that. When we were seated in a not so 'special' section of the restaurant my husband even asked a staff if something is prepared for us as per Rafael told us the day before and the staff even said yes there is, I think it was just wine or something. Only then that my husband replied to Rafael's message in WeChat asking us how our day goes by. He complained about the unfulfilled promises of him and Rafael said that he will check on it. He even told us that he had someone go to our room to fulfill his promise and we just gave him 30 minutes. We finished our dinner and nothing happens. We've waited for few minutes for the staff to gave us there 'special' token for our anniversary and nothing happened so we just decided to get up and went back to our room. And the third disappointment, nothing was in the room when we get there. It really sets our mood down.
