We planned to spend the night at Ginger Bar (the only open bar) to continue our supposed to be anniversary celebration but we didn't because of too much disappointments. We still waited up to 11pm in our room and still the promise 'gift' was nowhere until we just fall asleep with heavy heart. 

My husband and I really like this resort and even thought to stay here when we decided to visit Cancun again but because of that disappointing day we thought otherwise. Mind you, we were not demanding guests, we only contacted our personal concierge for few times just for the reservations. Every service given to us were paid in with ample tip from our personal concierge, room cleaner and restocking staff, we gave tip to them everyday. To pool attendants and servers in the restaurants and bars we gave tip in EVERY food or drink they served us even in Capella where service was really bad. That's why in every restaurants and in the bar that we went to in the resort except for the Capella, we were treated extra special. If they just assigned us another personal concierge to fulfill all that promises on that special day maybe our trip with this resort will be truly a HAPPY unforgettable one but was all ruined because of that day. 

P.S. For the restaurants review, my most favorite is Enso, food was really good, serving is just enough and the service was excellent. Second was Mole, food tasted good, serving was huge and the service was prompt and excellent. Third was Malva, we liked it here coz' only here that we got to eat beef. Most of the restaurants were more on seafoods but my husband is allergic to seafoods so he can not fully enjoy the menu. Food in Sante was good but the serving was just so little and it takes more than 30mins to serve the food. In Capella, food was just mediocre and service was really bad. We always dressed up during dinner but nothing is special on their set up. The server didn't even take out the appetizer plates before serving us the main course making our table look so inelegant and he even hand in to me in my bare hands my main course plate which was so hot I almost make it fall. We even can't find him to ask for another glass of drinks and no one even there to bother. Lastly, my husband didn't like the ambience in Ginger Bar coz' he said it was not like the bars he went to in the resort he previously stayed in Cancun that was really for adults only coz' it's in an open area.

reviews.author: Karen H
reviews.title: Lack of AC ruins what could be a great hotel!
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Paradisus in late July 2021.  The hotel is beautiful, but there is no air conditioning in most of the hotel! The rooms have it, but it is not very good. If you like a cool room, you will still be hot. Honestly, it really ruined the trip. A vacation should be relaxing, but we were sweating all the time! You couldn’t even shop in the gift shops without dying from the heat! Dinner at Cappella was so nice - lovely restaurant, good food, violinist was great - but we had to eat and go, no lingering for another glass of wine. Too hot’ I walked around with a battery operated fan, but i was still melting! This is just really unacceptable for a luxury hotel. I read the reviews complaining about the lack of AC about a week before I left, but it was too late then. I would never return to this hotel unless they had AC throughout the hotel. They also need to provide a map of the property and information on the restaurants and a schedule of the show. They just tell you to use the App which does not work and is not user friendly. We had no idea what shows were available. The sargassum was terrible. They do try to remove it from the beach, but it wasn’t really possible to go in the water. I saw very few people in the water. I imagined sitting on a beautiful beach during this vacation, but sadly, I wasn’t able to enjoy the beach and spent my time at the pool instead. The view is still gorgeous, but it was just very disappointing. 

On the positive side, the hotel is beautiful, the pool is nice, and most of the staff that we encountered were great! Francisco, who served us drinks at the pool, was very personable and remembered our names. Alfredo, who served us at Malvo a few times, was great as well. I feel for the staff who works so hard in the heat serving drinks outside, and there is no relief from the heat inside the hotel either! Tip them well, they so deserve it! We left a piece of luggage at the airport, and the concierge (I think her name was Wen) was incredibly helpful! She also helped us get reservations for dinner (the app does not work).  We met Augustin, who entertained us with magic tricks while we waited for one of the shows to start. Charming young man who spoke excellent English. I suspect he will be running the place one day!

reviews.author: N G
reviews.title: Still A Family FAVOURITE!!!
reviews.text: We have been enjoying Paradisus Cancun since it was called Melia Cancun.  And what makes us return, is the wonderful and amazing staff.  Even wearing surgical masks, we still can feel their smiles.  We pray the staff and guests stay safe and healthy so everyone continues to enjoy their experiences!!!

reviews.author: Ana R
reviews.title: Please read this review from our recent stay
reviews.text:
Review

My husband and I got married at the Paradisus Cancun on 7/31. We stayed there from 7/28-8/3. Our guest count was about 58 people plus us makes 60. The resort itself is very beautiful. The staff was welcoming. We stayed on the reserve and were assigned Steff as our concierge. She was very sweet and attentive the entire time. She made herself available to meet in person whenever we needed to. The food in the resort was DELICIOUS! Blue Agave was our first place to eat since the buffet was closed for an hour. Please try it! Cappella is a great Italian restaurant and for an Italian restaurant in Mexico the food was really good I was impressed. 

Our wedding coordinator was Marlene. We loved her. She was very helpful and accommodated is throughout our stay and wedding. She was available through text when we needed her. I love that we were able to meet to go over the details for our wedding. We appreciated that she has our table set up ready to show us how our reception would look like. The wedding itself turned out to be very beautiful! Marlene was able to take everything we wanted and turn it into reality. 

Our welcome cocktail and wedding reception had amazing staff. They were very friendly which made the guest feel comfortable. One person who really stood out to us was Javier. He was the best!!! He took care of us at the wedding and kept bringing us cold towels (Cancun is unbearable in July) to keep us cool. Not only that he was doing it for the guests as well. He really went above and beyond for our party. 

Now that I’ve covered all of the good things, I do believe that there is room for improvement. I do want to let people know that the air conditioning sucked. It was pretty embarrassing because the guests complained the entire time. One of my guests was pregnant and was hot in her room! Stef helped us to make sure the room was cooler. This is not okay. I understand that the heat in July is insane however I had family that stayed in two different resorts after they stayed for the wedding and they had FULL BLAST A.C. For a luxury resort this is unacceptable. Not only is it horrible for the guests but these are horrible working conditions for the staff. I was taking pictures in my room with the bridesmaids as we got ready. I was drenched in sweat the entire time. I WAS IN DOORS. nope 👎🏼  They also need more staff. Sometimes I only saw 2 people working at the main pool area which is too little considering the amount of people that visit the resort.

reviews.author: Yaffe-Lee
reviews.title: Great People
reviews.text:
We booked 3 rooms at the Reserve.  5 adults and 1 teenager.  

When we first arrived, we received warm welcome and were brought to the Reserve check-in area.  Once we got there, no one was helping us for about 15-20mins.  We just sat there and had to ask to check in.  So, that's not so great.

There were some confusion about the hotel services during the check in.  The restaurants part of the websites specifically mentioned it's opened to all Reserve guest except the steak house.  However, we were told the Reserve is only for adult and our teenager cannot go to any of the Reserve restaurants.  We were not happy at all, but the guy who worked there was very patient and tried to help.  We essentially paid for the Reserve but couldn't use any of the restaurant.  I think they need to update the website or maybe change the policy to allow teenager traveled along with parents.  

Our butler, Juan,  was great.  He was helpful, friendly and respectful.  He texted me everyday to see whether we were ok and whether we needed anything.  He helped us to reserve a few restaurants for dinner.  He also sent us a bottle of champagne when we dined at the Peruvian restaurant.  He also sent us a couple gifts when we checked out.  Juan also arranged a meeting for my husband and the manager.  However, the manager was 45mins late.

The buffet at Malva was decent, but it didn't do well with my stomach.  The waiters/waitresses were amazing.  They were cheerful, warm, friendly and helpful.  

We had dinner at Fuego (Peruvian) restaurant.  The foods were outstanding.  It was plated nicely and the dishes were delicious.

We also went to Enso for dinner.  We ordered bunch of sushi, some fish, chicken and steak dishes.  The ambient was very nice and the foods were delicious.  The servers were outstanding.

My kids went to Mole restaurant and they said the Mexican dishes were outstanding.

My husband and I went to La Palapa restaurant for breakfast one day as it's only for adult.  Since my stomach wasn't sitting very well, the server was very accomodating and made up some drinks that sat well with my stomach.  Again, the wait staffs were amazing.

We tried to make reservation for the Italian restaurant but nothing was available except late at night.  This is something they seriously need to resolve.

Some of the restaurants are closed due to renovation.

Our room was at building 3, which is above the general pool area.  The access to the general pool was easy.  However, it was noisy all day and at night as well.  People were partying late and it was not relaxing at all.  I wish we were able to stay at Building 5 area as it seems more quiet there.

The pool at the Reserve was great.  You have to book the cabanna in advance.  After you booked it, you need to claim it everyday between 9am and 11am.  If you weren't there at that time, your cabanna will be given to people on waitlist.  The Reserve pool is more chill, we met a few people there and wish all of us were allowed to swim there.

A few things about Covid-19.  The resort set up our PCR test during check-in.  It was set the day before we went back to the US.  The testing site was clean and professional.  We found out that many staffs aren't fully vaccinated yet, which was a shock for us.  But they all wore masks.  I wish they all were vaccinated as it's a tourists hotspot.

Overall I think the resort is trying to balance between people who like to party and those who like some quiet time.  So far, it's not working well.  All the Reserve guests should be put in Building 5, not 3.  The restaurants at the Reserve should be opened to all Reserve guests especially teenager who are accompanied by their parents.  I have to say my teenager was more well behaved than many of the adults at the general area.  The general area was loud, people were smoking even though they aren't supposed to.  Lot of bad languages among the guests there.

I would say Paradisus Cancun is trying to be a 5 stars resort but it's probably a 4 stars resort.  What made this resort memorable is the people who works there.  From our butler to the waiter/waitresses, they were amazing.  I gave many people who have helped us (butler, waiters/waitresses/chefs/bartenders) during our stay some tips before I left.  They deserved it.

We probably will come back but it will be just two of us or until my younger kid turns 18 since we did enjoy the Reserve area as well as the people who work there.

reviews.author: Susan S
reviews.title: Fun with Jennifer
reviews.text: Jennifer was our activity girl. She was kind courteous and patient. We had so much fun making bracelets.  They really take the time to make sure you have fun doing things at your cabana. I am truly pleased with everything they do to make your stay a memorable one.

reviews.author: eliteBeacher
reviews.title: Great Vacation Overall!
reviews.text:
It's medium sized resort with good amenities - it has everything an All-Inclusive resort should have.  Overall, we (2 adults & 2 kids) enjoyed our time @ the resort except one.

Positive Experience: 
1) Pool area nearby Kids Club - all folks including Josue, Elliot and Francisco were friendly & helpful.  They often stopped by to say hello and asked what else they could help.  Amazing!
2) Adrianna, Celeste, and Paulo @ Kids Club were very kind and offered many activities for the kids.
3) Restaurants - Roberto (lunch time @ Enso), Roberto (dinner time @ Enso) and Dennis / manager @ Enso (spelling?!) were very friendly, helpful, and always went above & beyond to help.
4) Yhi Spa - we didn't enjoy our services - body massage and a facial; but David (concierge gentleman who walked around pool area) offered a free service to make up which we didn’t take.  It's good gesture.
5) Stef @ Concierge – she’s helpful when asked.

Area for Improvement:
Front Desk - we didn't have a good experience with the front desk.  It seems like they have a different DNA vs. the rest of the folks @ the resort.  We stopped by 3 times and had 2 bad experiences: 
1)	We came by to exchange for smaller bills - the front desk lady said they could only exchange to Mexican Pesos and offered $1 US for 18 Mexican Pesos while the official exchange rate was $1 US for 20 Mexican Pesos.  When asked why there’s a difference, the response was “that’s our resort rate.”
2)	When checked out, we were informed that the Spa charge was $390.00 US - higher than what we had agreed to pay at the spa.  When asked, it took a little while for the front desk lady to respond with an agreed payment of $350.  We asked why, she responded that “if it’s paid by credit card”.  We handed our credit to her, she made the charge and threw the card on the counter.

I’m confident that the experience would be perfect at the resort if the front-desk folks could be more polite and reasonable.

reviews.author: Endri R
reviews.title: The Best Resort
reviews.text:
Paradisus Resort is Heaven Resort. I mean the "Best" seafood, service, restaurant, tacos, shows and accommodation. The stuff that they have are excellent, especially Diego and his team in the Reserve area.
Thank you all of you guys and your service.

reviews.author: Clifford R
reviews.title: What an amazing way to spend my Birthday with my Fiancé! 😍😍
reviews.text: We loved the breakfast at Malva, we had to end the trip with the best breakfast! Arnufo, Antonio and Eddier (Fast Eddie) made us feel at home and started our day off right! I really can’t recommend this place enough, some of the nicest people I’ve come across in a long time.

reviews.author: Janet418
reviews.title: Very nice property
reviews.text: The property is very nice.  The restaurants could use more choices for people that don’t eat fish.  The buffet food was good, although when it was busy they hard a hard time keeping things replenished.  We had 2 rooms connecting, which made it a “suite”.  2 queen beds, 2 pull out couches.  The mattresses and pull outs were very hard, did not get great sleep.  There were no hair dryers in the rooms, but when I called the desk, they brought one right up.   The overall service was good, cleaned the room thoroughly each day, the staff always addressed you with a hello and good morning.   They are very Covid aware.   They require masks at all restaurants and shops everywhere in Cancun.  They take temps and make you use sanitizer when entering places.  All employees in all places we went, had on masks.  The speed and organization for getting tested to return to the US was great.  I would stay here again…there’s a few things that could be improved upon, but overall we were happy with this resort.

reviews.author: Daniel Vivieca Shephard
reviews.title: Vacation 2021
reviews.text: Pool people excellent, and pool bartender, Osvaldo and Manuel,  concierge Armando Rodriguez beyond helpful. The food was ok, place is very clean, and so are the rooms, elevators hallways restaurants, friendly employees everywhere, the entertainment in the evening was good. Overall would definitely come back. Great experience.

reviews.author: Cesar O
reviews.title: Vacationed 2021
reviews.text: Pool  people excellent, Victor,Ivone, Luis, and pool bartender, Osvaldo and Manuel, Buffet Ramiro, concierge Wendelyn. VICTOR WAS THE BEST. So was Julian. The food was ok, place is very clean, and so are the rooms, elevators hallways restaurants, friendly employees everywhere,  the entertainment in the evening was good, specifically Silent Disco was great. Oh and Elvis, as well as 2 girls and guy at Fuego Restaurant.

reviews.author: Connector820632
reviews.title: Best bar and restaurant on site
reviews.text: Wonderful experience at the Ginger Bar at the Paradisus Cancun. The staff was always friendly and welcoming. Our servers Sofonia and Wendy were amazing with the random, yet tasty selection of drinks. The bartenders and other staff including Pedro, Salvador and Randy were also great. Most definitely the best drinks served in the resort can be found here. Malva restaurant was not only delicious, with a great variety but the servers Pascual and Armando provided such a personalized service to our family throughout our 7 days.

reviews.author: Leonard M
reviews.title: Amazing Service, Amazing Food, Amazing People! The resort is amazing!
reviews.text:
The service in this place is Amazing I go on vacations for great service and food and this resort marks all the of it! Highly recommend The Reserve package! 

The restaurant by the pool (on the reserve side) has this amazing manager his name is DIEGO DIAZ! He accommodated our group of five with a fresh fish and tons of additional seafood and veggies it was slightly extra cost but the experience was amazing! And extremely worth it! They show you images of the fish when it’s caught and then prep it how ever you want it! 

Also had an amazing bar tender by the pool his name was OSCAR! This guy was the best! You can totally see how much he loves his job!! Along with his other coworkers very charismatic! All restaurants had great options buffet was also amazing all restaurants and buffet had healthy options as well for all diets! 

Drinks are great! Everything was great! The Reserve rooms include a butler service that personally takes care of all your needs during your stay it’s an awesome experience! My only con is I didn’t stay long enough lol!

Also in these new covid times they are extremely on top of cleanliness and disinfecting so that is the lease of your worries here hence why I almost forgot to mention it!

reviews.author: Tony Vilaysack
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: This was a great family oriented hotel. We upgraded to the reserve and it was definitely worth it! Violeta, our personal concierge made our stay enjoyable and we didn’t have to worry about anything. The coffee bar in the mornings was a great way to start off our day. There are plenty of restaurants to choose from but Cappella was the best, ask for Fernando. They had plenty of daily activities for all ages and the kids desert cart was a hit.

reviews.author: OG
reviews.title: 5 Star resort & Service!
reviews.text: Excellent service all around, from our “The Reserve” stay liason/manager Janiek,  Soni, Johny at the Reserve Cafe, Luis at the Cabana/Pool management, Filiberto and Chef Anibal at Blue Agave Restaurant,  Omar at Capella Restaurant to the rest of the team—5 Star service.  All inclusive is definitely worth the price, facilities are extremely clean, restaurant and mini bar selection is excellent.  This resort is also very kid friendly with  a  very organized schedule of actividades coordinated by some very friendly and patient and professional young ladies in a designated kids pool/activity resort area.   Will definitely be back, Thank you Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: Maria F
reviews.title: From Horrible to Amazing
reviews.text:
Recently visited this beautiful resort for 6 days, when we arrived there was a terrible mishap with the reservation, but we were able to get it some what situated. The A/C was horrible the first 2 nights and we finally were able get it fixed upon getting it fixed I hopped in the shower and my bf comes in yelling to not move; a roach was on the shower curtain!! We call front desk and they tell us to go eat while they fumigated, to leave our stuff and come back later. I said HELL NO! I’m not staying here we went back and forth and finally they moved us.  What made me mad was that even the maintenance guy said we couldn’t and shouldn’t stay in the room that we should call the front and ask to be moved. Obviously front desk has no idea what fumigating means. 
Well besides that horrible first 2 days we finally began to enjoy our stay. I highly recommend you get the reserve as well, the bartender Carlos made us feel so welcomed and his drinks were the best! 
Make sure you check out Wendy at the ginger bar, she was always in a good mood and always seemed happy to see us. Her drink recommendations were the best (photos below) 
If the beginning of this travel had been better I would have given it a 5, also Wendy and Carlos made the rating go up. If it wasn’t for them I would have given this place a 3.
In Honesty I would go back and hope for a better experience.

reviews.author: Marcos R
reviews.title: Our First Covid Era Vacation.
reviews.text:
I had originally booked this vacation through Orbitz. I booked the Luxury Junior suite w/ ocean view for me and my girlfriend. Later I found out about the whole "reserve upgrade" So I called the resort and asked about it. I mentioned that me and my girlfriend were flying in August 4th and I spoke with Nadia. She told me for 2 people the reserve upgrade was going to be an extra $600 USD. We decided to go through with it. I find out a few days before our vacation that Orbitz only booked it for one person. I was panicking and called the resort and they also confirmed that the booking was for 1 person. They wanted to charge me an extra 1,000 USD too add my gf, but I instead went through Orbitz. I made it clear that I wanted the Reserve Junior Suite with ocean view for 2. I called Paradisus and again spoke with Nadia and she seen the update for 2, with the reserve junior suite with ocean view for $3,600 USD. It was WAY more than what I wanted to pay but I was not about to cancel my first vacation since this whole covid situation. 
We get to the resort I was told it was 3,660 for the room, I hand the girl my Credit Card, and the concierge that was assigned to us is putting on our reserve wristbands,  My phone goes off saying I just spent 4,301.17 USD. I get very upset and the girl informs me "that was for the reserve upgrade" We go back and forth arguing, I am very upset at this point because I am being told one thing and given another. It's a huge mess. We argue for a while, the manager ends up letting me keep the reserve upgrade wristbands (which gives us special pool access and other amenities) But they stick me in a cheaper room without everything I was guaranteed with the reserve upgrade room (Bath/jacuzzi style tub, bigger balcony, etc...) I appreciated the manager Carlos for allowing us to keep the wristbands but I shouldn't have to go there and fight to get what I was guaranteed. It made me feel very uncomfortable and upset.

We get to the room and for the first two nights the A/C is awful. We couldn't sleep at night. A gentleman came to fix it in the morning. It started working great. My girlfriend is finally comfortable with the temp and goes to take a shower and a cockroach (pictured below) is crawling on the shower curtain. We call down and the lady tells us that they will come fumigate the room and things will be okay. Not exactly what we wanted to hear, so again, we had to escalate things bc they were not in a rush to fix anything. They said they would move us to a different room and they did. The room was SIGNIFICANTLY smaller and the ocean view was cut big time. They didn't show much concern with the fact that I was bothered by that. I escalated the situation again and they moved me to a room on a higher floor, but the same size. The ocean view was a lot better so I just settled for it because this whole process killed my entire day. I wasted an entire daytime outing because of the mess. Wendolyn was very helpful in this situation and I was able to get a slight refund because of her. During my  last swim I ran into one more cockroach (literally) inside the reserve pool.

I don't want to drag the resort because it truly is a beautiful place. The staff inside of restaurants are amazing. Some of the nicest people. Two individuals stood out and honestly saved our vacation. Wendy who works inside the Ginger Bar was amazing. Very, very welcoming and just seemed genuinely happy to see you happy and enjoying your time there. And Carlos at the reserve pool. Carlos treated us like family and they are a big part as to why I am willing to give Paradisus another shot. 

I know sometimes things happen. This hotel is obviously not a bad place to stay, I would just like them to be a little more understanding and willing to go the extra mile to help out when someone is obviously having a rough time and things aren't going their way. I would love to give the Paradisus another shot to fix my rating to make my experience excellent.

reviews.author: Nacaine
reviews.title: Romance package at Paradisus
reviews.text: I had a wedding renewal at Paradisus Cancun, and my wedding representative Ana was wonderful. Ana help me with everything including restaurant reservations for 31 guests. Ana answered all my calls and my questions. I would definitely recommend Weddings at Paradisus Cancun. And Please ask for Ana, she is great.

reviews.author: Pperie18
reviews.title: Great Vacation, Great Hotel with Great Service
reviews.text: Hotel provided great service, the food was great and the bar tenders at the pool bar (Osvaldo, Angel and Manuel) where above the expected level of service. Luis who takes care of the cabanas reservation at the pool area was great too and Juan at Fuego restaurant didn't missed a beat with his recommendations for dinner.

reviews.author: Dazymay28
reviews.title: Great Service!
reviews.text:
We recently visited Paradisus Cancun and had a great stay. It was our third time back the hotel, but this time the service was better than ever! Specifically we enjoyed our nights at the newly renovated sports bar. The drinks were delicious and the servers were beyond incredible. Sofonia, Wendy, and Pedro all went above an beyond and provided the best service and cocktails. They really did everything they could to guarantee we had a great time. Additionally, we visited the Ginger bar several times and Karina and Geovani also were amazing! They made sure we had drinks and service whenever we needed. 

Since we stayed in the Reserve section, we were assigned a butler. We were so lucky to have Violeta. Out of all our trips to different places with butlers, she was absolutely the best we have ever had! She made sure we always had dinner reservations, spa reservations, and everything we needed. She even surprises us with delicious treats and drinks in the room. 

Overall we had a great trip to Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: Lisa W
reviews.title: Janick, my concierge was awesome and HE GETS 10 STARS!
reviews.text:
They want an over all review for the hotel it's self, I cannot give 5 stars.  However, for the service I received through out the hotel it would be 10 STARS!!!!

If you stay at this hotel and do the Reserve Option and Get Janick for your concierge you are a lucky person.  Janick is a pleasure to know and he went above and way beyond to make sure everything I needed was met!

The hotel is lacking in air conditioning, therefor I gave 4 stars because of that.

reviews.author: christian_tirado
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Beautiful resort. Great environment and great service all around. Francisco was energetic and his service was unmatched! We were really able to hunker down and enjoy the beach to its full extent with him keeping us hydrated and full!  The food in all of the restaurants that we tried was phenomenal. The YHI spa was a bit pricey but worth every penny. Will definitely return soon.

reviews.author: jiffryi
reviews.title: Fantastic Resort
reviews.text:
We were extended family of 16 in 7 different rooms/units. Four of them were booked via RCI exchange and the other 3 directly with hotel. We just got back and loved our stay. We had a fun and enjoyable week at the Paradisus Cancun. Prior to the visit, communicating with Club Melia representatives was a bit challenging and time consuming. But Betsabe and her Manager Pasqual came through honoring my pre-pay All Inclusive fees. One of the 1 bedroom units were not available but they made up by giving me a high floor Oceanview studio and an extra compensation. Alex (Alejandro) at check in was very professional and nice. I was happy with their efforts to help in any way possible to make our stay comfortable. Our check-in process was smooth and easy on the Club Melia side. The sun was shining all week. The water was a bit rough at this time of year, and lots of seaweed, but the white sand and aqua blue waters were...aaahhh!!. Pavel, our Concierge, was attentive and when we needed him, just a text away. Very helpful guy and a for a job well done especially with restaurant reservations. Our view of the ocean was gorgeous in the morning with the sun rise. But the lagoon side also have beautiful sunset views. You will not be disappointed if you get a Lagoon view room. I wouldn't pay extra to upgrade to Oceanview. The Activities team put up fun games all day (pool parties, water volleyball, beach volleyball etc) and entertaining shows at night (Lion King, Aladdin, Elvis Show, Silent Disco, Salsa Dancing etc). Food at the Buffet was good but try all the restaurants too. We loved the seafood Asian fusion Enzo the best. Had many meals at Enzo. Make reservations for restaurants on the first day you arrive.
The hotel was spotless (except for a few areas under construction). I like the fact face mask were required everywhere. I felt very safe all over the resort. The extra precaution were satisfying to see.  Also Covid testing on the property. Aqua World, one of the largest water sports operations in Cancun is across the street from the Resort. We did Jet Ski's and parasailing. We also took a snorkeling trip as well as a day trip to Chichen Itza and Ceynote swimming.
Considering we are in the midst of a pandemic, and with a lot of green new staff, while there were a few shortcomings, I would like to acknowledge and celebrate the fact that Melia is doing a splendid job making us feel welcome and cared for.Tough times we live in, but our stay in Paradisus Cancun was memorable!

reviews.author: sang_maika
reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.text: I booked this trip to go with my family, maybe we didn’t get lucky but the overall experience was not what we expected. Pool was over crowded, so no chairs. Cabana was for special guests and with extra pay. Even if you want to pay it’s full. Beach was full of seaweed. Everyday the same food for breakfast and lunch. Dinner is hard to make reservations.

reviews.author: Francesco L
reviews.title: Amazing Wedding at Paradisus
reviews.text: We got married at Paradisus in a small ceremony with about 20 guests. The wedding was very nice, everything was organised by the wedding department  of the hotel who also advised on external providers (photographer, DJ). We feel like this was the perfect set up for an intimate wedding given the great location and the amazing service offered.

reviews.author: apetrus
reviews.title: Absolutely Great Experience!!!!
reviews.text:
We booked a five night stay at the Reserve at the Paradisus Cancun Resort and had an absolutely fantastic experience!!! The service by the staff was the best we have ever experienced and we have traveled the world visiting more than 37 countries. Every one of the staff were friendly and worked to make our visit feel special. 

Hotel Paradisus made us feel safe and comfortable in having strict Covid 19 protocols in place in having all staff and guests wear masks indoors and outdoors except when eating and drinking. Hotel Paradisus had a convenient Covid-19 testing center on grounds so that we could get the necessary documentation of a negative test in order to return home to the United States. 

Upon arrival our personal concierage, Soni, greeted us and offered to help make arrangements for dinner reservations, excursions, the spa, birthday celebration, Covid-19 testing, and much more. Soni was truly awesome and made our experience feel truly first class. We would also like to single out staff that provided us above and beyond service like, Soni.  We would like to recognize Oskar, Moises, Ruben and Louis for their gold standard customer service in 90 degree heat with a heat index of 100 degrees. 

We will plan to visit the Paradisus Cancun again soon and other resorts run by the parent company Melia, who has resorts throughout the world.

Keep up the outstanding work Paradisus Cancun, Muchos Gracias!!!!!

reviews.author: Miosoti M
reviews.title: 10/10 will recommend!!
reviews.text: My partner and I got to celebrate our 3 year anniversary at Paradisus! The ambiance, staff and over all location were far past our expectations. We even had an opportunity to have a lovely romantic dinner on the beach! The staff was very attentive, the hotel was very good at making sure we all were Covid safe with sanitizer/disinfectant stations throughout the property and made sure we all wore our mask in close proximities.The food was amazing.. 10/10 would recommend Fuego, Enso and the Buffet! The property was full of entertainment  allowing us to experience both live music and a DJ who catered to all genres of music in the lobby/lounge area nightly! We even got to end our last night with silent disco which was a hit! Lastly, if you are looking to do more than just relax by the pool whether on a cabana or sipping away at the swim up Bar, we’d definitely recommend the Xplor park where we experienced ziplining, ATV’s,a lovely adventure filled cave tour and an all you can eat buffet Plus More!  Disclaimer: A LOT of walking/stairs! All and all be prepared for a vacation to remember! We’ll definitely be back! Thank you Paradisus for allowing us to experience the culture without leaving the property!

reviews.author: JAMIE N
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: Our family of 19 people stayed here 8-1-21 to 8-5-21. We had a wonderful time. The resort is very clean, beautiful and food is excellent. A special thanks to Stef (concierge) for making our trip went very smooth. All the great staffs from all the restaurants and pool bar. We received wonderful services and couldn't be happier! We will be back for sure.

reviews.author: Joe Y
reviews.title: Fun in the sun!
reviews.text:
My family and I truly had a fantastic stay at Paradisus Cancun.  Although the beach, resort itself, the views on BOTH sides of the resort,  the pools, and of course the food and drinks were absolutely great... It was the staff that really shined!  From the bell boys to the concierge to the bartenders and the servers everyone was the epitome of the warmth and hospitality of the Mexican culture! 

We stayed 8 days and 7 nights in a Reserve Oceanfront room.  I definitely RECOMMEND going reserve!!! For what I think was a great value We were able to upgrade to a Reserve room, enjoy premium drinks, reserve poolside Bali beds, have an adult only pool and restaurant, and even included concierge service (set dinner reservations so we could enjoy most of the restaurants, helped keeped the snacks and beverages stocked in our fridge, and last but not least decorated our room for our 9 year old daughter for her birthday!) Thank you Stef your the best! 

Each pool had it's own merit. The adult pool was laid back and very intimate and quiet.  The pool in the middle of the resort had medium activity and we were able to enjoy a family atmosphere.  The large pool has the action.  Lined with Bali beds lounge chairs,  swim up bar and activities! This was my favorite because even though there was plenty to do it was spacious enough to not ever be crowded.  (Special thanks to servers Didi and Jesus! They went above and beyond taking care of the Family and their needs for lunch and drinks!)  

Thank you Paradisus Cancun for a great vacation! This is our second stay at a Melia hotel and I was not disappointed.  

If I had to list any negatives it would be the lack of ac in the common areas.  It was warm in the restaurants but wasn't unmanageable. Also, the beach had lots of seaweed.  I understand that can't be controlled and the resort worked as hard as they could to clear it and maintain the beach.  There were however several days with little to no seaweed and the beach was very enjoyable and fun to play in the waves and bodysurf!

reviews.author: Nomad750695
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: Excellent!! Elliot by the pool was AMAZING!!!!!! Mauricio felt like our personal guide!!! He was quick, efficient and was PHENOMENAL at solving a glitch we had with pictures during an excursion. He was available to us 24/7 when we had a question or wanted to book something!!!

reviews.author: ashroufa
reviews.title: Blue agave
reviews.text:
Great service ,Filiberto and chif Anibal are very friendly and taking a good care of guests here and even more I got a small gift for my daughter she got so happy never forget the place here thanks to everyone here 👍
I love the service and how deal

reviews.author: Natali S
reviews.title: Beach vacation
reviews.text: After not travelling for 2 years, it was much needed beach vacation. The hotels don't work with full capacity, so it was good for us, I wouldn't like to be there when it's full. The rooms are outdated, with a beautiful view though. We were in tower 1, second time. Quiet and I don't mind the walk. Food was good to very good. Difficult to get chairs by the pool, need to put towel early. I was interested in the beach, so had to reserve every morning.  Not happy with activities team. In 8 days my son got to play wallyball only once. I was looking forward to yoga on the beach and only saw them the day we were leaving. I saw activities with the kids few time, I think they are better organized. One can go to the gym only with reservation, so we didn't do that. Mini bar is not restocked, need to call if you need water, or anything.

reviews.author: kungpow928
reviews.title: Pretty good but needed improvement
reviews.text: All inclusive is well worth the price.  I wished air conditioning, ventilation, fans availability, was more present.  I hoped to try every restaurant at least once for normal guest.  The room noise was loud for rooms along the main hall.  I would like more outlets in the rooms.

reviews.author: Sivia
reviews.title: Excellent Service and Seafood
reviews.text:
I have stayed at this all-inclusive several times as a club melia member.  This recent trip involved excellent service from most of the staff and amazingly fresh sashimi, sushi, and ceviche at Enso.  Firstly, Asuncion is our favorite beach service worker.  They all work their tails off, but my friend and I just love her.  We look for her each time we go and situate ourselves in whatever section she is working in (beach/pool). 

Also, we love the bali beds there.  The two gentlemen that were taking care of the bali beds and pool area were Josue and Eliot.  They were wonderful.  We felt taken care of and enjoyed talking with them both.  

Our concierge was Jose and he was probably the best one we have had.   Very friendly and helpful.  

We had some strange issues: no bottle opener in one room and never got one after telling reception. You need one for your water bottles.  Also, my hot and cold water was switched around and it wasn’t obvious.  My friend got locked out of his kitchen area (?).  The most frustrating thing was trying to get fridge restocked.  Due to covid, you had to request what used to be done daily, then wait in your room.  You never knew how long it would take, so it was a pain.  One time it took me 45 min to get it done.   The second time, the employee (Alfonso?) loaded us up with drinks and chips so we wouldn’t have to call and wait every time we needed something.  That helped a lot.  

Although it looks like some travelers loved Mole, we did not like this new menu they have.  I loved the old one.  I actually did not like me food.  This is a first.  I love Mexican food, but when they try to make it gourmet, the dishes taste strange to me.  The pineapple and goat cheese combo was not tasty.  I went for mole.  I got mole salad.  It had no taste of mole, whatsoever.   I have spent a fair amount of time in Mexico over the last 30 years and I did not like the dishes at Mole this time around.  But Enso’s was out of this world.  We ended up choosing Enso’s for most of our meals.  

Something else new was that, as a club member you already pay a lot, and yet they had it set up where you felt obliged to tip everyone you came in contact with, and you had to come into contact with more people for everything!   That makes it even more expensive.  It seemed set up to be this way.  It made me wonder how well the staff is/is not being paid.  There was literally competition in the buffet to get people to sit in a particular server’s section.  You had to request drinks, but could go up to buffet for food.  You used to be able to get your own juice.  

Everyone that worked there wore masks ALL THE TIME.   Most visitors also followed the rules, and they provided the antigen test for free at the resort.  It was easy.  

Again, the staff was EXCELLENT and the Seafood at Enso’s was fresh.

reviews.author: Megan S
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with Excellent service
reviews.text:
We loved our week here. We had a room on first floor of building 1 and loved that because we could pop in and out from the Enso side of the pool rather easily. We were with a 12 and 14 yo so didn’t see the adult only side of the resort. Room AC was fine. As noted by others, rest of place is warm. Fine with me - it is bathing suit and shorts/Tshirt temp. I hate being cold from too much AC!
In case you don’t read it all, I’ll call out the service because it was excellent. Stand out was Leo at the swim up bar! Also, Oswaldo, Manuel and Esteban at the swim up. They made everyone feel remembered and welcome and also took great care of the kids. Tip them big in the morning so you don’t have to carry around lots of small bills in the water all day.  they are awesome. 
Also Armando at Malvo was great!
And the staff running activities were wonderful. My youngest discovered a love of volleyball and was on their organized games twice a day. Gracias Axcle and Saúl and Dael. 
I read many reviews before we arrived so was prepared to put down any hard sell on Reserve or timeshare tours but there was no hard sell. It was mentioned briefly at checking and by text but that is all. In fact, we got a little tour and it was just that - an introduction to the place that was very helpful. 
And I had read of issues with butlers/concierge but our experience was that concierge helped us a lot (and I don’t think we had Reserve upgrade. We booked via RCI). WhatsApp worked great with concierge Juan Carlos, who booked us dinner everywhere we asked and arranged our Covid testing (which was a breeze - remember that you need your passport at testing).  David also shot over the spa listing via WhatsApp . 
I was prepared to avoid Fuego after reviews too, but I would say that things must have changed since then becomes we had wonderful service and food there. 
We loved the Chile beef skewers. We also went to Mole, Enso, and Capella (formerly Vento) then asked to go back to Mole and Enso because those were the favs. Marlin tacos at Enso were great as was mole sea bass at Mole. There was great entertainment at Capbella and the Italian food was quite good. Try the calamari. 
The service at Mole is a step up - they walk you through each dish. We bought the upsell wine at Mole and Capella but you don’t have to. 
The water is a gorgeous blue.  tractors rake the beach each morning. Nothing they can do about algae at the breakers, some days have more than others. 
Get out for sunrise each day - it is beautiful and required if you want to get a chair, especially one with a little table. Keep towels from day before to hold a chair as you go to breakfast. But don’t be those people that hold more than you need like a set for sun and set for shade. or who leave towels there from sunrise to noon for no reason. There are too many people looking for a place to sit to justify that. It’s easy to get spots after 4pm. And pool is empty after 8. Which is great for us because it’s open to 10 and I like the peaceful time early and late. 
We parasailed with the outfit on the beach, which I will also review and recommend. 
The gift store prices are reasonable, except masks, so remember yours. Also remember $ for tips. Exchange before you get to Hotel or withdraw pesos. there is a US dollar ATM here too but it only gave $50s. Front desk and gift shop was able to make change.
Gelato and coffee station in main building near Malvo was a daily event. 
I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Gabrielle R
reviews.title: Blue Agave
reviews.text: This was our first and last stop of the trip. Blue Agave makes DELICIOUS tacos accompanied by perfect chips, guacamole, and pico. The staff is so friendly. Angel is the best! He is so nice, helpful and made us feel so welcomed. Also, thank you to Anibal for cooking us up amazing Mexican food that I am going to miss! Don’t forget to stop in Blue Agave during your trip!!! Thank you staff!!

reviews.author: John M
reviews.title: Blue Agave in Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Angel our waiter was super friendly, truly showed he cared about our experience. We made small talk with him for a minute and it’s nice to just talk to employees at the resort. He took care of us, always made sure our food and drinks were great. The chef Anibal was also great. The pork quesadilla made me keep coming back to blue agave!

reviews.author: Grysielle S
reviews.title: Post pandemic vacation.
reviews.text:
This is the second time we stayed at Paradisus . We love the food specially Mole the authentic Mexican experience! The staff is amazing Moses and all the waiters were exceptional!!!! The breakfast buffet was delicious and Edier took really good care of us!!! The staff is without a doubt the special feature of this hotel, otherwise the building and the pool are outdated and make sure they are not under renovation before you come so you don’t have the unpleasant sewage odor in  the elevators and lobby , I had  to use the stairs up and down the 6th floor because of the horrible odor … also they need more security cameras ,someone stole my kids glasses worth $500 … what a shame 😞 also heard a couple of complaints from guests missing phones and other items they need to improve on security. 
Not sure I will come back.

reviews.author: 561Traveler
reviews.title: Great Hotel Stay with Reserve Upgrade and Wonderful Customer Service
reviews.text:
Our family visited the Paradisus Cancun this past July and upgraded to the Reserve (a must) prior to arriving at the hotel. So very glad we did. This hotel prides itself in offering the best experience and customer service to their guests. We stayed at building 5 in a beautiful room with ocean view. The pictures of the greenery in the lobby and surrounding areas do not do it justice. It’s very beautiful in person. 

HOTEL ARRIVAL WITH RESERVE UPGRADE 

Acknowledgements: Soni Martinez (Personal Concierge) and Carlos Villa (Reserve Reception Manager)
    
From the moment we arrived, we were taken to a private check-in in building 5 where we were introduced to Soni Martinez, our personal concierge. Soni was absolutely amazing— professional, friendly, accessible and so accommodating. She greeted us daily sending us updates about activities and events of the day. She gave us recommendations of restaurants and made reservations for the entire week to ensure we were able to eat at all of the restaurants we wanted. She checked in on us frequently to ensure we were having a great time during our stay. She also booked our massages and helped us schedule the free covid test prior to our departure. Her assistance really elevated our experience. 

Carlos Villa, the manager in reception, was also very professional, welcoming and accommodating. 

RESERVE AREA POOLS

Acknowledgements: Diego Diaz (Manager),  Joel de Jesus (Waiter), Valeria (Waitress), Lucas (Pool area), Max (Pool area)

We spent most of the time by the pool area of the Reserve. *Important to acknowledge that the Reserve pool area has two sides. One side is adult only and has Bali beds that can be reserved daily. The other side, which is right next to the adults only area is for the Reserve guests with children.) This side does not have Bali beds but does have lounge chairs with umbrellas. The Reserve area (pool and Palapa Restaurant) is managed by Diego Diaz and we want to acknowledge him and his entire team for doing such an amazing job. Diego was very attentive and accommodating— checking in on us daily to ensure we were enjoying our stay. You can tell that the guests are his top priority and you feel that with the service provided by all the members of his entire team. The poolside servers rotate daily and were all great, especially Joel de Jesus and Valeria (the ones we interacted with the most) were both friendly, accommodating and very attentive. It’s impressive that they can be under the sun all day tending to all the needs of the guests with smiles (under their masks) just making sure we are relaxing and having a good time. 

Also by the pool area were Lucas and Max, who were also great, very attentive and accommodating when reserving our Bali beds and lounge chairs by the Reserve pools. They too checked in on us asking if we were enjoying our stay and letting us know they were there for anything we needed.  

We have visited Cancun many times. However, this was the first time at the Paradisus Cancun resort. We truly enjoyed our vacation so much that were sad to leave and cannot wait to go back.

reviews.author: Cassandra B
reviews.title: 1st vacation out of the USA!
reviews.text: Agustin from activities, Oswaldo at the pool bar, Giovanni at the ginger made our stay at the Paradisus Cancun one of the most rememberable trips for a lifetime. Thank you to these three for making sure we taken care of and being the most friendliest servers in Mexico. We will definitely be coming back next year! THANK YOU THANK YOU

reviews.author: ivanahdominguez
reviews.title: Mixed Feeling
reviews.text:
All employees work their tails off to make you feel at home with the exception of the Circle employees! Not everyone wants to buy a membership, we are ware that we need to cut the middle man. 

Sometimes we just want to splurge and upgrade, but yet that was impossible. According to the check-in manager we couldn’t upgrade to the Reserve area due to having children yet when we toured the area we saw tons of kids. Mind you all it was also way cooler in that area then in the building were most people stay. If you enjoy technology be aware there are only two areas were you can charge it in your room. Also, make reservations to dinner if not you will get stuck waiting to get into the buffet. During shows arrive extra early to the outdoor ones because sitting is limited! We had to stand, so we only enjoyed a couple of minutes. Silent party at the Ginger Bar was great, but the air does not circulate so it feels like a sauna. Same for Chappella! Management should not allow guest or employees to be uncomfortable due to the environment. The poor waiter was pouring in sweat. In the rooms are tiny with bulky furniture, bugs crawling in the sink area, and air conditioning was horrible until it was fixed by an employee. We were lucky it was working because many still complained about that exact problem at the pool.
I may have sounded like a negative Nancy, but I want you to know that the concierges, photographs, Otium, laundry and restaurant staff will not disappoint you.

I would recommend you to schedule your COVID exam as soon as you arrive that way you can work your tours around that the examen. Them have the Otium staff book your adventures! Always grab extra towels from the pool for your tours. If your wanting a photo session at the beach do the same day as your COVID exam.

reviews.author: Gisele K
reviews.title: come here for the people
reviews.text:
Paradisus is a beautiful hotel, but the true beauty of this place lies with the staff. Diego Diaz, the manager, Soni, the concierge, and the whole team working in The Reserve restaurant by the pool (Moises, Oscar, Yamil, and more) were absolutely fantastic. They did whatever possible to ensure our stay was perfect; we don't think our trip would've been as amazing if we didn't have them.
If you're looking to go away in Mexico, come here, not just because it is beautiful but because the people at The Reserve (especially the ones named) will make sure that your stay is dream-like.

reviews.author: GatorDan
reviews.title: Paradise at the Paradisus
reviews.text:
Our family had a amazing week at Paradisus at the end of July. We went with a reserve room and we were located in the central building on the 8th floor. The view of the ocean was awesome and we were centrally located. I will compare this with our stay at the Paradisus Esmeralda because we stayed there 4 years ago. 

Check- in and Check-out- it was quick and easy. 

Room- It was your standard room with two full size beds but our view was amazing. We were in building three so we were centrally located. 

Food- We tried all of the restaurants with the exception Of the adult reserve because we had our kids with us. All of the food was very good to excellent. I believe had our best meals at La Capella and Fuego. The buffet for lunch and breakfast had a large selection and food quality was very good.  We enjoyed lunch most days by the pool. They had burgers, dogs, tacos, nachos, etc.   

Entertainment- The entertainment was good not great. We enjoyed the shows most nights however the day time entertainment was lacking. I’m not sure if this due to COVID but really non-existent. 

COVID-  The test was an easy process. Upon arrival we were given QR to scan. I registered the family and within a few minutes we’re were given a date and time. 

Excursions- We booked a whale shark excursion about a month before and it was well with the money. The kids had a blast. Eco World Tours was excellent and highly recommend them for this and any excursion.  We also booked a Jungle Tour with Aqua World across the street. They have plenty of reps on-site so it was convenient. Another excursion that I would highly recommend. We tried to book parasailing with right in the ocean outside the resort for our last day however they said the couldn’t get a boat out there for to the seaweed. No big deal, they refunded me in full.  We took the ferry to Isla Muejeres which I would highly recommend. The bus to get to puerto Juárez was 12 pesos per person and the ferry was $65 for a family of four. We rented a golf cart for $45 for the day. Go to Punta Sur one the Southside then head back to playa Norte for some beach and shopping time. 

Activities-  This was the only thing lacking at the resort. They had the pool and the beach. Unfortunately with a 9 and and 11 year old I wish they had something for them to do. The Bali Beds were a plus for the two days we stayed at the resort. There was no entertainment staff with activities at the pool. 

Reserve -  Our concierge Stef was great but it didn’t compare the additional things they did at the Esmeralda. We were given beach bags for the kids with some toys and stuff for the kids to do at the beach or pool. At Cancun they were given a backpack at the end with some toys and a A cool Paradisus cup. Our concierge at Esmeralda had bubble baths ready for the kids each afternoon with balloons and what not. Not a big deal because they are much older now. Stef took care of our reservations for the Bali beds and restaurants while we were there and that was great. The reserve section had a pool and beach area but was only for adults. The Esmeralda had a pool for the entire family. We were in building 3 so didn’t we didn’t go in the lounge in 5 very often.  If you go without kids do the reserve. If you have kids I wouldn’t do it again until they were adults so we could use the amenities. 

Staff-  The staff was great.  Our concierge Stef was great. The service Josue and Seyney at the Kanna Beach bar was amazing. Luis was on top of it when it came to Bali Bed reservations. We had fabulous service from Didi and Jesus by the pool each day.  I believe they was a different lady was h day at the ice cream stand, but the kids loved it. 

Overall -  Would I go to this resort again?  Yes absolutely if the kids were older or if it was just me and the wife. Don’t get me wrong they are very family friendly but lacking in the activities for the kids. I believe they could easily add some activities for the kids at the front of the resort. There were a lot of unused grassy areas in the front  where the could add a miniature golf area or a trampoline with bungee (like the Esmeralda)  for the kids. If we stayed at a Meliá property in Mexico with the kids we would opt to stay at the Esmeralda. But this property for adults is excellent.

reviews.author: Samantha D
reviews.text: They had good food options, but not many options for kids. Staff were great, but seemed to be understaffed in the most important areas, like poolside. Housekeepers were great! Always made up our room very nicely. The rooms were very warm, even with the fan and the air conditioning on all night and day.

reviews.author: Sherly F
reviews.title: Great Stay Because of The People!!
reviews.text:
First of all, I'm late for my review. I stayed at this hotel in June with my wife and friends. Once you enter the hotel they greet you and take you to check-in. Before I start, yes they do push you to become a member, I don't find it worth it at all.

 We arrived at 12pm - so we knew our room were not ready. When it got stressful was when they told us that we were assigned to a room level we did not reserve and paid for. They said don't worry we will take care of it, well they didn't we got back and still assigned us the same room - My wife and I decided to take a look and it was the worst room I ever saw in my entire existence , corner, facing the parking lot and basement level! We paid for Lagoon view. 

We went back to front desk (mind you, third time) and thats where our angel appeared, Andres - Hope that's the correct name but we know hes in charged of front desk and is from Argentina. He listened to our concern and provided a solution. The rest of the team didn't bother to check, didn't bother to listen, and it was just the worst customer services - The only reason I share this bad experience is because I'm not the only one who complained about it and something should be done- Front desk is the first experience a customer get.

Moving on, the people there work very hard! Very attentive, dedicated and hard-workers! Please bring cash! and tip them nicely.  The only reason I give  5 star is because of them!

reviews.author: David J
reviews.title: Fun and original staff
reviews.text: They have good service and are always out to have a good time. The amenities are a little dated, but the people and activities make up for it. Drink lots of water and have fun. I need 200 characters to make this review lol

reviews.author: Aspen B
reviews.title: Wedding June 2021
reviews.text:
My husband and I chose to have our wedding at the Paradisus resort in Cancun, Mexico. We loved the resort from our first visit in August of 2019. To say that our day was everything we could have imagined and then some is an understatement. I was very nervous with planning and coordinating a destination wedding and was unsure of what that would entail. Our wedding coordinator Marlene Perez was absolutely amazing- She was our primary form of communication from October 2020 to the day of our wedding. Marlene greeted us right when we arrived at the hotel and ensured that our room was perfect and that we had everything we needed. Marlene truly made me feel like I was the only bride she was working with and she was on top of everything. Our wedding day would not have been as perfect as it was without her endless help and recommendations. Marlene attended every event we had that led up to our wedding to ensure that everything was in place and that we were happy with the event. I cannot say enough good things about Marlene to be honest, we were truly blessed to have such a great wedding coordinator. 

We had a welcome dinner (rehearsal dinner), cocktail dinner (day of wedding), and meal during our wedding with all of our guests (53) and the food was SO good. Our guests talked about it even after we got home! The amount of staff working the event matched the amount of people we had perfectly. We never felt like we were competing with other guests during this time, the events are very private. Every time we have visited Paradisus, the staff were amazing and very professional. 

We had Arturo from Novia Mia Photography capture our big day and again, we were amazed at how great he was! Our pictures are beautiful!! Our family commented on how great Arturo did with young kids. Arturo had a great eye for capturing my husband and I with a variety of backgrounds. 

Lastly, Marlene was able to upgrade us to the reserve side due to open rooms and our butler Djordje. Djordje went above and beyond to make our stay even better than it was before. He was very easy to get ahold and was quick to reply to our messages, even on the day that he was not working! 

For anybody considering having their wedding at the Paradisus resort in Cancun-- DO IT. They will make sure that all of your needs are met and it will surprise you with how beautiful and EASY the planning process is for the wedding couple.

reviews.author: Journey775482
reviews.title: Wonderful Stay but Outrageous Wine Prices
reviews.text: My family and I enjoyed enormously our 6 day stay at Paradisus Cancun with my best friend and his family. This is the third time we visit this resort and we highly recommend it.  The installations and the service from the staff were superb.  The only disappointment is that we found the house wine to be quite bad. My wife and I enjoy having a good wine with a nice meal so we asked to look at the wine carte, the prices were exorbitant in my opinion.  Very average wines that I can buy for $20 or less at my local supermarket were priced north of $100.  I am Ok with paying $100 or more for a good bottle of wine on a special occasion especially at a nice place but I found a significant mismatch between the quality of the selection and the prices.  Higher end wines that I can by for $40-50 at my local supermarket were priced north of $200.  In my opinion the mark ups are totally out of line even with international 5 star standards.  We have stayed at other comparable resorts in the Cancun area and found the wine prices to be much more reasonable.  Other than that, we loved the place and highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Bonnie V
reviews.title: CANCEL IF YOU CAN!
reviews.text:
I often turn to the reviews posted here on Trip Advisor when considering our family vacations.  I am sorry that I didn't rely on the previous reviews more heavily when booking my trip.
We arrived at the resort excited to celebrate our daughter's 16th birthday.  Almost immediately things began to go sour......
Upon check in (which took about 50 mins) two of our daughters were placed on an entirely different floor.  This seemed crazy to me how they would split a family up but being that we booked three rooms with one room on a different reservation I will let that part slide.  Everything else that happened after that still astounds me.
Lets start with the poor system of making dinner reservations and the lack of availability in most restaurants.  There is absolutely no reservations available on day of arrival.  The customer service desk is very helpful but it's still a poor system.  You are asked to call a number that never picks up and its extremely frustrating.  Furthermore...when you go to customer service and they call...miraculously reservations picks right up!  
NEXT...lets discuss the rooms.    The place needs a major renovation including the Air Conditioning which is next to NON-EXISTENT.  Our room thermostat never went below 78 degrees and when i checked our daughter's room it was 88 degrees despite the AC trying to cool the room to our set 65 degrees.  I had maintenance come twice but it never got better.  Sleeping in the heat was so unpleasant and dinners were just as unbearable.  It was only after we arrived at the airport did we feel any relief.  This was the MOST disturbing part of the resort.  How can they not provide adequate air conditioning?????  My heart goes out to the wonderful employees to work in that condition. 
Next lets discuss the pool situation.  The pool is gorgeous...very well kept.  You can enjoy it if you like getting up at 6am to get a chair.  The system is extremely poor.  Our first day we arrived at the pool at 7:50 am.  We were delighted to see nice neatly folded towels on each chair around the main pool area.  We put our belongings on 6 chairs with an umbrella between and took a dip in the pool.  About an hour later a gentleman approached us accompanied by a pool employee saying we "stole their Chairs".  He asked us to remove our things which we said we gladly would so long as they can find us 6 chairs with an umbrella somewhere else.  When an hour went by with no response...we figured they found the gentlman another spot.  There were no belongings on the chairs when we arrived and it looked like every other chair around the  pool.  There is no way we could have known the chairs were taken and there is no personnel around the pools until later in the morning.  We went to grab breakfast leaving our personal belongings on the chairs.  Upon our return some 40 mins later our belongings had been moved to a small table and onto one chair close by.  I was livid!    This is apparently how this place is run....
Luis at the pool tried to accommodate us and did find us another spot but it was so unpleasant.   Set the mood for the day.....
I will say the housekeeping staff was excellent and our rooms were cleaned daily, however, the in room refrigerator was never restocked with water...and trust me you need it with the heat in the room with no air....so that was a huge dissapointment.  Of course you can order room service for a charge (so much for all inclusive) and get water everytime you need it.  What a rip off!
The beaches are nice but the seaweed situation still exists so if you want clearer water you have to walk a bit off property.  Not such a great job of cleaning it for the guests....
The food was just okay....but the waiters were amazing.  They never disappointed us...always trying to tend to our needs.
My only complaint with the restaurants was the issue we had the last night of our trip.  We secured a reservation at the italian restaurant Cappella which is really part of the buffet that they cordone off at night to turn into an italian restaurant.  Its very nice...ambiance is nice.  However.....we arrive at our 7pm reservation ready to celebrate our daughter's 16th birthday and upon arrival they ask our names....we tell them.  They ask if we are celebrating anything...we tell them.  They say....we dont' have a table for 6...but we can put you in two tables near each other!  What the hell????  we are celebrating an occassion!  We made a reservation.  Furthermore.....as I am standing there trying to understand  how this even happens....i watch as the manager escorts a family of 7 to a large table in the back.  So there was a table..just not for us.  After much complaining.....15 minutes later we were escorted to two small round tables pushed together to accommodate us all.  Not the most comfortable but at least we got to eat.  No birthday celebration for our daughter....so asking when you check in is useless....if the message doesn't get to the servers.  The place needs new management if you ask me.
After traveling to this resort.....I am very disheartened with the Melia name......I am not quite sure if anyone is overseeing how things are being done here.  I intend to send a similar letter to the brand of hotel so they can possibly work on fixing the many deficiencies we experiences.  You pay a lot of money to vacation not to mention the time you take from work to spend with family and the last thing you want is to sweat your ass off in a room with no air.    I will say....Paradisus in Playa Del Carman is completely opposite of this.  We stayed there on our honeymoon in 2015 and it was the nicest place I have ever stayed.  So........take this review and reconsider if you have booked already and can cancel...i would say to do it and find a different resort.  I hate to give so many negatives but i really had wish i paid more attention to the reviews that mentioned some of the same issues.  I would have changed my plans....even if i had to lose a little money. 
Regardless, we made the best of it....our girls had fun they went parasailing (across the street...its NOT ON SITE)....and they enjoyed the silent disco and the water aerobics and finger painting at the pool deck.  The staff tries but they are limited to what they can do.  
I hope they can improve the accommodations and take the criticisms and fix the wrongs.

reviews.author: Fe Marie L
reviews.title: Great staff
reviews.text:
Staff was great!! Very attentive and easy going. Wonderful crew at the pool at the reserve side, who included Josoe, Ruben, Moises, Tamil, Diego who was the head waiter, Valeria, Oscar, Javier, & Eligio. The lobster and trio ceviche was bomb. The other food in the restaurant was not the best though. No variety and wasn't that tasty.  
But every staff in that hotel was super friendly and worked hard.

reviews.author: Genesis F
reviews.title: Loved this place
reviews.text: Axcel and Saul made our night we were bored on a Monday night and they made it came and played games with us and had a good time. We definitely recommend coming to this hotel their service here is amazing.

reviews.author: Fausto C
reviews.title: Friendship Vacations.
reviews.text:
Our group (15) just came back from Paradisus Cancun. Everyone made their own reservation at the website. A week before the trip, tried to call the reservation and start talking to Jorge, that's we found out that we booked through expedia and we were not entitled with free transportation to and from the hotel. When we were booking the expedia logo didn't came up so everyone thought we were booking directly. Jorge was nice enough to point that out to everyone and some in the grp didn't realize that there we a reserve section. Once everyone got to change to reserve section with the help of Jorge. Nadia and Jorge finally able to help us with our transportations. I was directed to Diana from group/convention reservations and she was very helpful in making our reservations to all the restaurants for our sit down dinner. 
When we arrived at the hotel, We checked and Diana was there to meet us and made sure our needs were met. I met Javier - supposedly our butler. We were not given tour or orientations like some other hotel guests which we all notice during our stay. 
The staff at the buffet were all nice and very professionals during our first meal, sorry can't remember much their names coz we barely eat at the buffet. We ate lunch at the La Palapa Restaurant every day and we all met Valeria, who is out waitress all the time. She demonstrate professional  expertise with what she does, she displays professional pride and tolerated all of us and excels in cutting through confusion, LOL.  Jhonny  who is our beverage person was very attentive to our needs and our drinks always filled and refilled.  He is exceptionally well informed. We met Diego on our last day and kudos for him that he has professional and displays pride in work. We enjoyed our last dinner at Mole which we celebrated birthday one of our friend. Javier and Christian were impeccable, I don't remember the server in the other table. 

The butler we had was useless coz we never heard from him at all. Some of my friends didn't even heard from their butler since no one met them when they arrived and registered. 

Lucas, Max and Yamil at the pool were very attentive and professional when everyone at the pool. 

The air conditioning in our room is not up to par, it can't maintain the temperature in our room, there are times it is miserable coz off the humidity. There are other buildings of the hotel were hot or warm too.

I checked out early on the 25th of July, and i was told to go to the other side to check out.  I met the worst person of the hotel name Diana (not from grp/conveciones), she was very short and tactless when I was asking about including my Melia rewards. She does not belong to the front desk/check out counter because she does NOT displays a pleasant, cheerful disposition or demeanor at all. She did NOT possesses many valued personal traits in my opinion. 

Please extend my sincerest gratitude and appreciation to all the staff at Paradisus Cancun except from Diana from front desk.

reviews.author: Sandra S
reviews.title: AMAZING ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
reviews.text:
My family and I had the pleasure of staying at Paradisus Cancun last month and let me just say we all had an amazing time. Everyone was so friendly and helpful. The food was delicious 😋. They had daily activities for the guest. The staff always went above and beyond to make sure you were taken care of. 
A special thank you to Aaron our personal butler during our stay. Ivonne and Jesus the pool area staff thank you. To the hotel sommelier Iran thank you so much for taking such good care of us especially our last night at Molé. Chef Diego and Rigoberto thank and you.

reviews.author: Ed S
reviews.title: Great vacation at the Reserve in Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun in Tower 5 of the Reserve section from July 7-18. The hotel, restaurants and entertainment were all excellent but in my opinion what sets this hotel apart from others I have stayed at are the staff. I travel for leisure several times a year and this was by far the best service I have received at any resort I have been to. 

Upon arrival we were introduced to our Butler Aaron.  He was amazing and made our vacation special and relaxing. Aaron handled everything that we could have possibly wanted or needed. He made all of our reservations, handled our covid tests and checked in on us several times daily.  He even kept in touch with us on our days off even though we told him to enjoy his time away with his family. Aaron is a very valuable asset to the resort 

We enjoyed the adults only pool and visited it each day of our stay. Lucas is another employee that went above and beyond daily to make sure we enjoyed our time at the resort. I can not thank him enough for always making sure we were enjoying our time there. Each day we had a Bali bed made up for us and he checked in several times a day to make sure that we were happy and content.  He truly went above and beyond and is a great employee. 

For lunch each day we ate at the La Palapa restaurant. On our first day we met Diego who is the Manager for the reserve area food and beverage. He is a nice and dedicated employee who worked just as hard as the people he managed. Diego visited with us every day and  I really enjoyed talking with him. The staff at La Palapa were all tremendous. They handled not only the lunch but made sure you had beverages at the pool. We never were in need of a fresh beverage and they constantly kept a bucket of ice with fresh bottled  water or any beverage we wanted at the Bali bed. Everyone was fantastic but some of the names that I remember are Yamil, Helena, Jhonny, Luis , Moises, Joel, Miguel and Oscar.  Each one of them and others served us during our stay and they always greeted us by name and by the second day had memorized our orders. They were all pleasant, funny, great employees and I enjoyed their company very much.  Several times during our stay Ricardo who is the food and beverage manager of the entire resort visited with us and checked in to see how our stay was. Please pass on my sincere thanks to all of these employees. We have never felt more valued at a resort as we did and that is a direct result of these employees. 

For Dinner we visited all of the restaurants and enjoyed them all. Our favorites were La Capella where Fernando gave us fabulous service. Mole was another favorite and Lamida the manager gave us wonderful service as well as the entire staff and Fuento was our third favorite where we had great food and tremendous service.

The only complaint that I would have is that the Air Conditioning in both the hotel and the room was not up to par. Our room never got cooler than 72 degrees and  the  main tower where most of the restaurants were was very hot. I feel that this is something that needs to be addressed by the resort as it appears to be a constant complaint on many of the previous reviews. For us this is an important issue as I dont like to be warm in the evenings in my room and if not rectified  I am not sure I would return as it really affects my ability to sleep and wind down in the evening. This is an issue that may not effect others and I totally understand that. For us having good A/C is a very important part of our vacation at any resort we chose.  I am hopeful that if enough people comment on this than management will see this as an issue and overhaul the HVAC.  

As I said before please pass on my sincere thanks and gratitude to all of the staff I mentioned.  They are a tremendous asset to the resort and to the Melia corporation.

reviews.author: Carol S
reviews.title: The Good, the bad, the covid
reviews.text:
We just returned from Paradisus Cancun.  We had a great trip!
THE GOOD
We paid extra for the Reserve service - worth every penny. The reserve pool is beautiful, there are beach beds, and the service is outstanding.  They will bring you whatever you want to eat or drink. The resort is clean, the people are helpful, and the food is good.  We were lucky that Djordje was assigned to us - his help was invaluable.  We travelled with our "kids" - they are 18 and 20 and said this was one of the best trips ever. Plenty for them to do.
