THE BAD
We were in Building 3. There is some construction during the day that is very loud. Jackhammers, saws, etc. If you are at the pool or beach, you won't hear it.
THE COVID
My daughter tested positive at the end of our week.  They were quick to respond, and had her in a separate hotel room immediately. We ended up staying a second week waiting for a negative test result. She had no symptoms and luckily felt fine. Again, Djordje was invaluable in helping us navigate the COVID procedures.

reviews.author: nanoox2021
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text:
There was not enough information provided about the hotel amenities, entertainment, and restaurants. 

We specifically made reservations to use the Golf course.  The reservation desk said they did not have golf balls and send us on a scavenger hunt in town.  We were not able to find golf balls and never saw the course used by anyone.  What a waste of space.

For other amenities and entertainment we would ask staff around the hotel, but always got conflicting information.  We eventually were able to figure stuff out during trial and error, but information on the first day would have made it less frustrating.

For the restaurant details, we kept being told to use the melia app.  The app did not have reservation availability updated, so we still had to call the front desk to coordinate reservations.  The app has glitches and kept logging me out, so I gave up after 3 times.  We did not get an overview of the restaurants and food choices.  Some of the restaurant choices food was disappointing, but on the plus side the buffet food was good.

reviews.author: frmsilloway
reviews.title: Great, but…
reviews.text: Great place, mostly amazing service.  Restaurants are amazing, poolside is amazing. Great room.  Fun design.  Lots of miscommunication and confusion, especially around check-in and out.  Lots of seaweed in water and on beach, not their fault.

reviews.author: Guestess
reviews.title: Beautiful but Major Problems.
reviews.text:
We stayed in the Royal Service area, and my friend and I each had our own rooms. When my friend arrived, they left her waiting in the Royal Service reception area for a half an hour before taking her to the area she had her room.  Not a good way to start off. 
The pool attendants and waiters, especially Joel, were fabulous!  However, the food throughout the rest of the property was hardly befitting a place where they purport to being 5 star. The Asian restaurant had the smallest dim sum I had ever seen, which was ok because they weren’t worth eating anyway. 
The worst part of the trip was when my friend was startled by a man verbally and physically abusing his female companion outside her room. When that was reported, I asked if the abusive man was escorted off the property and our concierge’s response was that he’d stay because he paid for the room. There was another fight earlier in the day by the pool. Not exactly the well heeled clientele.

reviews.author: Sara R
reviews.title: the best hotel in cancun
reviews.text:
It is a beautiful hotel, excellent service, the spaces are magical when entering the hotel and you are relaxed, because there is a lot of tranquility. The beach is very clean, in the restaurants the food is very delicious and the service at the beach, pool, restaurants and the bar are very agile.

excellent space for children perform many activitiesv that entertain them.

reviews.author: Tatiana T
reviews.title: Love love love this hotel!
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful and have tropical vibes everywhere. Blue and clean ocean , so warm and beautiful . Great food and best service ! Entertainment was good at the evening , but not so much during the day. Overall we enjoys this place.

reviews.author: RI
reviews.title: This was our first visit to Mexico
reviews.text: We stayed in an oceanfront room in the royal service adults only tower... it was great.  Very good service, great food, nice pools.  The room was nice & spacious... it was a wonderful stay, it was so nice that we ended up extending our stay by a few nights cuz we didn’t want to leave!

reviews.author: Jaclyn
reviews.title: Wedding at Paradisus Cancun; Novia Mia Photography
reviews.text: Although we absolutely love EVERYTHING about the Paradisus we are here to brag about something else; This review is for videographers at our wedding, Novia Mia Photography. My husband and I got married at the Paradisus Cancun July 22, 2017. Novia Mia were the videographers for our wedding. Our video was absolutely stunning and they truly captured the best moments of our special day. Not only were they so kind and fun to spend the day with, but even three years later they are still holding their amazing standards and love for their profession. Story time: Planning a destination wedding has many perks. On the flip-side, it can also be a lot of information that you can't quite remember everything that is said to you or what is on every contract you sign. My husband and I did not realize that our wedding Link would eventually be taken down and unfortunately we did not save the video correctly. We were absolutely devastated that our most incredible day was going to be lost forever. We decided to reach out to Novia Mia to see if there was any way they could retrieve the video for us. Although it seemed very grim, Camilo Alvarez, from Novia Mia, said he would work his very hardest to try and retrieve our video. He had spent three days searching every hard drive and file on hand. He even reached out to the video service that had our original link to our video. This was truly a long shot and we were praying for a miracle. That is exactly what we got. He found our video!!! This whole process was heartbreaking for us and not one time did Camilo make it seem like we were a burden. He was just as concerned and sad about the loss of our video. He even said he was so happy a couple got to relive their wedding again. When we originally chose Novia Mia for our videographers we had no idea how much passion and love they have for each couple they work with. They clearly go above and beyond for each couple. I HIGHLY recommend them! Thank you Novia Mia for everything. We are forever grateful!

reviews.author: David Santana
reviews.title: AMAZING HOTEL !
reviews.text: Staff is very friendly and involving with the guests.  They let us play our music out on the speakers during the afternoon.  Alan, Rodrigo & Julio they were very accommodating with everything, big shout out to them and the entertainment staff!   Jamie the bartender at the pool is unreal as well, great hotel overall!

reviews.author: DVJ
reviews.title: Awesome !
reviews.text: Awesome hotel and service ! The food at blueagave was great, especially the tacos. Everything was super clean and neat, as well as everyone was very friendly! The entertainment by Alan and rodrigo was definitely worth it and super fun! Nurby and Manuel by the poolside were also amazing ! Would definitely come back again!

reviews.author: Nafisa A
reviews.title: Amazing Experience
reviews.text:
This hotel was amazing from the moment my boyfriend and I walked in. We had a long flight but upon our early arrival, we were presented with damp towels and someone to collect our bags before we could even step foot inside. Carlos Gonzalez from their Enso restaurant made our trip ten times more incredible. He went above and beyond to make sure my birthday dinner and subsequent dinners were a dream come true. My boyfriend wasn’t sure what to order and he took time to listen to what he liked and created a combination from the menu items. He was so kind and really made us feel special. Edier from the Naos restaurant also stood out to us. He was kind, efficient, and went beyond his job to make sure our visit was pleasant. I can’t put into words how beautiful this hotel was. From the design, kind staff, spa, restaurants, etc., this hotel could not have oozed more luxury. I couldn’t have had a better 25th birthday/couples trip. 

P.S. Avoid the 1hr promotional discussion by “Circles.” You do get discounts on certain activities after (regardless of buying a package or not), but they are very pushy and the packages they sell are not worth it in my option.

reviews.author: emkelly7
reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful and the pool area is great. Had a great time at water aerobics with Alan!! He has a great energy and is very friendly. Ibana was good and the buffet had a wide variety of options. Would recommend for an all inclusive.

reviews.author: Omer Kurtoglu
reviews.title: Please do not be naive with their advertisement! Be prepared for any shocking suprrise!
reviews.text:
Please be prepared if you stay at this hotel:
They only clean swimming pools in exclusive area. I stayed 7 nights and I had not seen them cleaning the swimming pools at any time! My sun cut his finger in the swimming pool, even after that, (they made a report) they did not clean it. After we checked in, we were told there were a couple restaurants, but 3 out of 7 were closed without any notice. They were supposed to let us know in advance. Also, there are not enough shades for guests. If you have kids, you may be shocked because they will be burned or they will have to stay inside! Even if you asked for it, they will not provide you a shade or place instead, they will try to sell you a bungalow for usd 170!  Interestingly, The water was out in the entire hotel more than an hour and believe me you would not want to see the restrooms. We could not find any restroom to use including our rooms or anywhere in the hotel. The worst part (including the reception or front desk) nobody paid any attention to it! They just said go find another clean restroom you can clean your hands after we have water!.. If you complain about anything, believe you will not be listened, you will be very angry with their carelessness. If you like to swim in the ocean, there are a lot of sea weeds which disables you to swim, No body cleans. Ocean is bad, swimming pools are dirty + no enough shade!

reviews.author: Manaujla
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Had an amazing time at Paradisus Cancun. The entertainment guys were awesome. Alan and Rodrigo were amazing, very social and fun to be around, they kept the whole family entertained. We had an amazing time.

reviews.author: Rima
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: It’s my last day of a one-week stay at the Paradisus Cancun and my experience has been great. Great service, location, pool, And beach. Food is good. Hotel is very nice. Awesome pool area, service is very good. Asuncion’s service at the pool area has been impeccable - she always checked up on us, brought us drinks often, and paid close attention to detail. The days when she wasn’t here, the service was not the same. Special shoutout to Alan at the pool, who was very friendly and kept us up to date on all the activities happening around.

reviews.author: Thatsme12312
reviews.title: Paradisus cancun
reviews.text: spent couple of days at the paradisus cancun. Best hotel on the strip very big hotel and a very long beach! The food is not the greatest. Lunch menu is very limited (hot dogs held in the sun for hours and thick hamburgers) the coffee shop is only open for a very short period ( its not long enough). Mole restaurant is terrible. The two excellent restaurants palapa and market grill. Special shout out to alan the entertainment

reviews.author: jcamac631988
reviews.title: Food was terrible.
reviews.text: wouldn't recommend this hotel. I have stayed in Melias resorts in the past and I have no complaints but this one in particular most improve on the food and service in general also rooms are outdated and dirty. our cover sheets had bunch of stains on it.  for the price I would've expected a better experience .

reviews.author: SheriseClancy
reviews.title: Amazing Family Concierge Service
reviews.text: Just spent 6 wonderful days at the Paradisus resort, from the moment we checked in and were introduced to our concierge team Rodolpho and Gloria we knew we were in superb hands, they handled everything from dinner reservations to booking our Bali bed by the pool, nothing was a problem for them.. we particularly enjoyed the little surprises that they left for both us and our kids in the room daily! I fell ill for a short period of time and they both showed genuine concern even calling to doctor for me to speak with him. They even arranged the private Cava room in Tempo ( it’s the only restaurant which you have to pay in the resort) so that we could dine with our kids, special mention to Ignacio at Tempo for his impeccable service! Throughout our stay everyone from bar to restaurant staff were amazing! The only thing that has prevented me from giving a full 5 star rating is that our room was a bit outdated and small for a family room, and the double beds seemed smaller and were not very comfortable. That being said their service was top notch and friendly!

reviews.author: Mia
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text:
This hotel has been an amazing experience - pool is fantastic, good music, lovely drinks.
The entertainers were so good - we did some Zumba, danced and had good snacks by the poolside. The staff was very helpful - especially Rodrigo, Alan and Ricardo Torres.

reviews.author: Pia D
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel
reviews.text: Our experience here was 5 star. It was amazing food, amazing hotel and excellent service and entertainment. the shows have been really good, zumba and BBQ and dancing. We especially loved the warmth the staff had to offer. Rodrigo and Alan really helped us throughout our week.

reviews.author: cr1704
reviews.title: Vacation with daughter
reviews.text: Royal service is a must and the ocean views are beautiful. The views made up for any deficiencies. Depending on the day and restaurant the quality and selection of food varies. Rooms are clean but we had to contact maintenance three times due to issues with vent leak, toilet and air conditioner was not working. When we decided not to attend a timeshare presentation the rep seemed to get upset and shortly thereafter our room key deactivated.

reviews.author: Stang354
reviews.title: Really absolutely incredible!!
reviews.text:
We just got back from our unforgettable stay at Paradisus Cancun.  We have never been to Mexico before but we can't wait to come back!  We had family concierge with Alexa and Violeta as our Concierge servers all week.  I can't say enough about them.  Any questions we had were answered as they responded right away through WhatsApp, they sent us all the daily activites and booked all our dinner reservations for us!  
The restaurants are all amazing! We particularly loved Enso for breakfast and had the pleasure of having Pablo as our waiter each morning.  He is the best, and my daughter actually cried after we had our last breakfast. Dinner at Mole is nothing short of spectacular..I mean whatever you want they will do for you! This goes for every restaurant!  You can change the menu to whatever you want..or if you want one of everything..you got it!  But all in all, I didn't have anything in any restaurant that I wouldn't eat again.
The one thing that really stood out to us was that no matter who you encountered at this resort, everyone had pride in what they did and did it with a smile.
Every part of this resort is extremely clean! I just can't believe how many people they have taking care of every little aspect of this place.  The smells that come from all the incense burning and food cooking is relaxing in and of itself!  If you really want a vacation..like really a restful and amazing vacation this is the place!

reviews.author: Alan T
reviews.title: Solo
reviews.text: Enjoyable solo experience at Paradisus.  Had some rime to explore areas outside the hotel along with amenities of the resort.  I visit Cancun often and always go back to Paradisus.  Recommend this resort to others!

reviews.author: Irka143
reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text:
When you first walk in, it Looks amazing.  The lobby and the reception was very pretty with amazing decor. Very modern n relaxed feeling. Waited 3 hours for my room,  finally we got to our room and issues began, the Ac was not working, the safe was not working, the tv was not working, the mini fridge was dead. I spent 3 hours in my room while different workers came to fix each thing.  3 hours later they were not able to fix ac or the safe.  Poor customer service with all these problems I had to call n argue about getting moved to a new room. Finally they agreed to move us to the only available room,  originally had a room with a king size bed had to move to a room with 2 twin beds, that was day one. 

This is not the service you expect at all inclusive Meliá hotel. The rooms are very dated and need major improvements. There is no ac inside the hotel or several restaurants. When you dress up and go out for dinner be ready to sweat. I must the say the only meal me and my family enjoyed was breakfast at the only restaurant that has descent air conditioning. 

I don’t find the hotel kid friendly at all, they don’t even serve kid friendly food at a buffet, and the buffet hardly has any choices of food, very limited options. No kids entertainment. The shoes are very dull and boring. My kids ages 14 and 6 were so bored. 

The pools are great in the hotel and the pool staff is amazing. I would not come back to this hotel.

reviews.author: ladys712
reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: This hotel was absolutely amazing! I was so worried as I reading some of the reviews within the past few weeks were very skeptical. Upon my arrival, I booked with Otium Shuttle from the airport to the hotel (Otium is part of Paradisus). I was so worried because they base your pick up time from the time you land and although I landed on time. It took me over 2 hours to get through customs. Horrible. Once I got through, I met the Otium worker and he was absolutely amazing! He saw that I arrived earlier and knew I was in a 2 hour line at customs and gave me an upgraded private shuttle straight to the hotel free of charge! Without the upgrade, I would’ve had to wait for others and make multiple stops to other hotels. Once I arrived I was greeted by the door man, he took me inside and held my bags for me while I checked in. The front desk was amazing! So nice and friendly! Now, to remind everyone the inside hotel area does not have AC. This is where people might feel the discomfort as I did at some point while eating at the buffet inside, it can be a little uncomfortable. But my room was very nice! Updated, AC was great! Balcony to a gorgeous view of the water! Cleaning lady came every day. We had fresh towels every single day. Overall I was very happy and would definitely come again!! :)

reviews.author: Paul G
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text:
My girlfriend and I spent 5 days here and selected the Royal Service option. We were a little unsure of what that meant until we arrived, and it was nothing short of an incredible experience. Every staff member is professional and goes above and beyond what we expected, especially Cesar and Oscar who were our waiters by the pool. Whether they served us for that day or not, they made a point to say hello and ask if we needed anything.

We had an oceanview room, the view was amazing. We saw the sunrise every morning right from the balcony. This resort is huge, with guests, families, and kids all enjoying themselves. The adults only Royal Service feels like a completely different place, it is paradise. Lastly and certainly not least, with Royal Service you get a butler. Our butler's name was Rode and the service he provided was outstanding! From making reservations, and explaining different options available to us, he did everything. Most importantly, he left us to enjoy our time together and popped up at the perfect times. I highly recommend this resort, the royal service option, and of course Rode. Our week was unbelievable, and we would defnitely come back. We didn't want to leave.

reviews.author: Alan T
reviews.title: Gorgeous Resort!!
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun was by far one of the nicest resorts I’ve been too. The views from anywhere in the resort is breathtaking. From the lobby to our room you can feel the scenery and vibe the resort gives with the nature surrounding every corner. The resort felt like it’s own private getaway w/ all the different restaurants and things to do inside. I never find myself in a routine there with the many activities provided on site. 11/10 in my books!

reviews.author: Mark Pabian
reviews.title: ok but needs updates
reviews.text:
hotel facility very nice, nice and decent size of pools. Food was delicious , restaurants la carte five stars. Room service ok . Don't pick high floor rooms in pyramid 1!!! Rooms decor needs big improvements , very old fashions look , missing coffeemaker and kettle, unacceptable !!! Highly recommend the bar Avenue , the best bartender Alan ,
always nice and smiling , he's truly the bartender with heart and passion !!!!!!

reviews.author: Teja P
reviews.title: Quality has tanked definitely stay away
reviews.text:
I booked 25 room nights at the Melia over this past weekend.

I was really happy and excited as the quality of service, cleanliness and experience last year was spectacular, one of the best resorts I've stayed at overall. We were welcomed with a welcome drink, hotel rooms were in pristine condition, everything was clean and we were well taken care of.

This year, it was completely different. The hotel is deteriorating on the inside with half the rooms going under renovation. Even the majority of restaurants were closed leaving us with limited options for food throughout the day. 

Additionally, check in took several hours (also due to the added complexity of having multiple guests), but it looks like their systems were down so they were recording everything by hand this time around.

In addition to check in the room conditions this time around were attrocious. They were unclean with pieces of marble being broken off, the beds not being made/dirty linens, and the views not being as advertised. We booked lagoon rooms but had 2 rooms with a view of a truck. 

My personal room did not have access to air conditioning throughout the entire duration of the trip even though I called the concierge 5 times to come fix it. Given the average temperature was above 88F during the day, this was completely unreasonable and was not a safe place to sleep at even at night.

reviews.author: V M
reviews.title: Redemption of ENZO'S Restaurant
reviews.text: The food at the resort was just ok during our stay. More than 4 resort restaurants were closed for reconstruction. It would have been nice to be informed of this. Even some employees seemed ill-informed as to where guest could eat depending upon their purchased room package. The last night we ate at Enzo's and it was the most thoughtful customer service and delicious food we had during our entire stay. Rafael was our waiter and he did a magnificent job of going above and beyond. EAT THERE AND ASK FOR RAFAEL. This isolated experience gets a 5/5 from us. Customer service overall is 4.5/5. YHI Spa was 5/5. The general organization 3.5/5 for a lot of little issues.

reviews.author: Krisbreezy09
reviews.title: Love this resort! Royal Service is the way to go!
reviews.text:
We traveled with friends & family and opted for the Royal Service and all I can say is that we were catered to NON-STOP! We were so impressed with the service... the hotel is beautiful, fresh flowers EVERYWHERE so it smells amazing. Plenty of restaurants and Bars to choose from...
My son and I took a fishing excursion and he caught a huge Anahi- the captain filleted in-board and we took it back to the hotel where the chef at La Palapa made fish tacos for our group. Beautifully presented and so delicious! Plus, my son got thanked profusely for catching dinner! Great trip, awesome memories!

reviews.author: J Black
reviews.title: 1st all inclusive
reviews.text: This was my first time ever staying at an all inclusive resort and they really do spoil you. The staff was polite the food was good the drinks were good. Only issue we had was a broken iron and a leak

reviews.author: Glenn D
reviews.title: Paradisus employees Rock!!!!
reviews.text: Lapalapa restaurant by the pool is a hidden gem! The emoyees here are amazing and are like family to us! If you want to experience Cancun with your family and not drunk teenagers this is your place. Pedro across the street at the Jungle tour is the best guide. He's funny and experienced. Can't recommend itbenough!

reviews.author: gzayden
reviews.title: The best experience!
reviews.text: Rosana was amazing helping us to navigate this beautiful place. We will come back soon! We stayed at the Royal service and I couldn’t say enough good things about it. There was a some seaweed the first day and it cleared up on the second day.

reviews.author: Amelia S
reviews.title: Amazing trip!
reviews.text: This was our first time at Paradisus Cancun.  We typically go to the Paradisus in Playa del Carmen, which we love.  We wanted to try Cancun though for the beach and we were not disappointed.  While there was some sea weed, we got quite a few nice beach days during the week with not much sea weed and clear water.  The resort is beautiful...the views of the beach are just gorgeous.  Service was amazing.  Gloria and Rodolfo from Family Concierge took amazing care of us.  They always left treats for our girls in the room, brought them cute souvenir dolls and were prompt in meeting any requests or answering questions.  Waiters by the pool were awesome as well...I feel horrible but their names have escaped me (Jonathan and Roberto were two of them I think).  They took great care of us.  The hotel location is great too if you want to do any activities or excursions.  Aqua World is right across the street and you can book activities with the guys that work in the beach towel hut on the resort.  We did the jungle tour snorkeling which was such a fun family activity.  We did parasailing as well which I thought was scary but my daughter loved it.  The only negative I would add is that the restaurants can get really hot...many are open air and super hot even with the ocean breeze and fans.  The food was good for an all inclusive.  We really enjoyed Enso for breakfast also...a tip that Rodolfo gave us...the buffet gets really crowded, but if you walk over to Enso you can get a great breakfast and it was never crowded!  We will definitely be back to this resort.  One of our fav vacations yet.

reviews.author: Sara G
reviews.title: Beautiful resort - but that's about it
reviews.text:
Our overall stay was horrendous. 

Pros:
-beautiful landscape
-rooms were clean 
-bartenders at the pool were outgoing, friendly, and quick. Best staff at the resort hands down. 

Cons:
Everything else
-AC didn't work in main building or in our room. When we called down they said it hadn't been working for days, if we knew that we would have asked for a room that did have working AC
-food was terrible. Room service can sustain you for a day, but other than that - the McDonald's across the street is worth the trip
-as an all inclusive guest, the mini fridge was not stocked daily. We had to constantly call down to the front desk asking for bottled water (which should be a given - no matter where you are). 
-room service will say "30 min" no matter what, but usually takes close to 2 hours
-impossible to make reservations at the restaurants (but the food isn't worth it)
-the staff is not helpful at all. They would stare at us and then walk away with out answering a simple question ("what time does the restaurant open?")
-front desk calls every morning (early for vacationers) to claim your welcome gift -- which is a breakfast while they sales pitch for a timeshare. EVERY.SINGLE.DAY. 

I would recommend any other hotel, or go in with the above expectations

reviews.author: Alyson F
reviews.title: Great stay at the Paradisus!
reviews.text:
The paradisus saved my vacation!!

This vacation started out poorly- was booked at a nearby hotel and it just wasn’t up to my expectations :(

I stayed at the paradisus a little over a year ago and just knew I had to get back there! I went online, booked a room and the rest of my week was heavenly in the royal service area! Because I checked out if the original hotel at 8 am,  I arrived at the paradisus super early and the amazing royal svc staff accommodated us- they let us check in, have access to our room and our vacation finally began! Our awesome butler, Rode, did a great job of making sure we had all of the things we needed (Bali beds, restaurant reservations, spa day and excursions)! I can not recommend this hotel enough. The staff takes such great care of the clients and really cares that you enjoy your time in paradise! 
I will definitely be back!! 🏝🏖☀️

reviews.author: matac76
reviews.title: Amazing time, excellent service, Royal Service a MUST!
reviews.text: Had an excellent time visiting Paradisus Cancun! We upgraded to the Royal Service and ocean view! Well worth it! Alex was our "Butler" but he was more of a VIP host/concierge.  From the moment we arrived we were treated with excellent service and catered to with shots of what is now my favorite tequila (Herradura).  We dined at one of the properties every night of the week, or at the royal tower lounge, the palapa restaurant, or by the pool in our Bali Bed. We built rapport with the different servers who would rotate through the property.  It was relaxing, entertaining, and you'd never have to leave the property if you didn't want to.  The Royal service was adult only, it never got wild or loud, there were often groups of bachelorette parties, or couples, and it was easy to make friends with others who visiting. Everyone was so friendly.

reviews.author: Eileen M
reviews.title: Royal Service @ Paradisus
reviews.text:
We thoroughly enjoyed our week long stay! The resort exceeded expectations but Royal Service was outstanding. 
     We enjoyed our time so much we’ve already booked for a return visit over the holidays! 
    Our thanks and compliments to the finest butler, Galdino! Thank you so very much for all you contributed to make our special birthday trip so memorable! 
      We must also send our deepest thanks to Valeria at La Palapa, Two Cesar’s, Oscar and MOISES!!! Aaron, you made our time at the royal service pool so special. We look forward to seeing all of you at año Nuevo!

reviews.author: Hessam M
reviews.title: Melia Group has abandoned this resort
reviews.text:
No AC, money scamming, and filthy. Visited the resort August 19th with Family for a family retreat. Lobby was inhumanly hot. Concierge family is a total tourist trap ordered by Melia to defraud guests. They purposely lure you to chose concierge and confuse you by different wrist band colors. You ultimately pay for nothing extra as all the amenities are outdated, broken, and filthy. They tell you there are classes none of them either happen or gets cancelled. Food is below average. Most restaurants are under renovation and the Sushi bar is worse than middle of the road gas stations. 

But if you think this is the end of my complaint, you are all wrong. Listen to this:

1- We signed up with another resort to participate in a 90 minute timesharing in return of a boat tour to Isla Mujeres Island with transportation to and from our Hotel. When we tried to leave the resort when the individual from the other hotel was picking us up. The hotel staff didn’t let us leave. They said we will accommodate what you have  and match it with better. We listen cancelled the other guy and participated in their “90” (5 hours instead) time sharing scan. Melia group is actively pursuing guests in this resort. They did all sort of gimmicks to lure you into buying a membership in Melia Club, for $25k to $110k in return for a joke of a hotel chain. Anyways, when we finished the 5 hr long session, they sent gave us a ticket for a ferry instead of the boat from a place 40 minutes far from where we stayed and no transportation. It was so far that we even decided not to participate and let the ticket expire. 

I keep the best for the last though,

2- At time of check in, you see a beautiful lady with open smile, making sure they get every dime in your pocket from you. They get all the charges at first and run your credit card. At check out, however, you see Pablo: who is Pablo? Pablo is a tall Mexican man making sure you will not leave the resort unless he gets what he wants. How? I tell you:

We booked Family Concierge for 4. At check in I asked if any ocean view room is available. They said yes for the day after. So, we moved to our main room the day after. At check out they put a $400 charge in front of me and I complained that this charge is illegitimate. Pablo in return says: 
A. Managers not at resort at 8:00 Am and he wont call for the manager. 
B- He wont let me leave the property unless I pay in full. 
C- He will call security if I I ask for manager. 
D- He says that the charges are for family concierge upgrade, which we already got included in our package. 
 
A manager anyways arrives out of no where and after 45 minutes internal discussion in spanish, lady comes and say that Pablo was wrong and charges are not accurate. 

So, my question is this: who asked Pablo to add those charges and under what reason they decided to remove those charges. Again in my humble opinion Melia has abandoned Paradisus and Mexican runs the place Mexican way. A guy like Pablo should not work at Family Concierge and instead must work as a bouncer for a strip club downtown. 

And to Melia Group, while you are very busy luring people to invest in your club, it would be beneficial to have the AC run and the rest of the resort also and not only your timeshare office. We know you want our money to build more hotel for the father and son, but at least let the water be steady in the rooms and not shut off every other hour. 

By the way, if you need to contact me to see the proof of my statements, I will be ready to send them to you. 

Extremely disappointed customer. Instead of building new Hotels Melia, fix the ones you are already own.

reviews.author: Jennifer K
reviews.title: Royal Service is the way to go!
reviews.text: My husband and I recently stayed at the Royal Service Paradisus Cancún. (After staying at their Royal Service sister property in Playa del Carmen last year, we booked it again.) We were brought to the Royal Service concierge where Daphne checked us in and told us all about our amenities. She introduced us to Javier, our butler for the week. He brought us to our ocean front room and gave me his WhatsApp contact information. If we needed anything, just text him. Javier was AMAZING! Each day he would text me and ask where we wanted dinner reservations. He brought us aromatherapy pillows upon request. And for 3 days straight, he arranged a Bali bed on the beach for us! We did not want for anything. We went off property one day so I could go shopping. Warning... The bus drivers drive crazier than NYC cab drivers! We enjoyed our stay immensely and if anyone is thinking of going, I highly recommend that you request JAVIER as your butler!

reviews.author: Pete
reviews.title: The A team
reviews.text: My family and I just stayed at Paradisus Cancun for the first time, and we were not that impressed. I will say that the rooms were clean and AC was good, but as for the lobby and the rest of the building, there is no AC at all. I will say that the staff was excellent, especially the A team that took care of us (Alfredo, Abraham, and Alejandro).  The food was good, especially at Vento, Blue Agave, and Mole.

reviews.author: christineN4644XW
reviews.title: Best service!
reviews.text: The service sets this resort apart. We have been to many, and this by far is the best. We were recently at the new Royalton Suites further up the strip, but if you want a less crowded feel, come here. This resort has a lot of beach front property. Highly recommend Royal Service. Butler (Leyner was our wonderful Butler) will make dinner reservations and reserve Bali beds for you. The exclusive adult only pool, beach area, restaurant (La Palapa - great food - should be open for dinner and evening drinks) and beautiful lobby/bar/snack area are amazing and worth the upgrade. Staff can’t do enough (thank you Julio, Orlando, Cesar and Valeria). Beach is much better than Mayan Riviera area. Turquoise waters, no rocks in water, less seaweed. Food is decent. They just closed the buffet and one other restaurant for renovations. Hopefully food will improve. The common lounge area where most restaurants and bars are located (building 3) is large and open, therefore not air conditioned. Some restaurants are enclosed and have AC. Need an Italian restaurant. Overall a great stay. We never return to the same resort but will most likely return here.

reviews.author: Tiffany G
reviews.title: Best Family Vacation Ever!!
reviews.text: This was my second time here with my family and we had a blast! The first day was a little rough. My mom recently had spinal cord surgery and we had to convince her to come on this trip. After a long day of traveling walking into our room with no AC was tough for her. We called the operator and they ended up bringing my mom a fan and they got the AC up and running that night. After that it was smooth sailing! My family and I have never had so much fun or laughed so hard during this vacation. Amazing food, wonderful environment, beautiful pools and beach.. I could go on!!! Our favorite spot this year which we didn’t know about the last time was Coco’s bar! We went there almost every night and it was fantastic! We had the best service ever with the lovely Karina!!! She was super attentive and friendly! Definitely our favorite of the whole resort! We got to celebrate her birthday and had a great time with her as our server! Thank you so much Karina for everything! We also had a very pleasant experience with Yvonne who helped rent the pool cabanas and Jesus who served us! We rented the cabana on our last two days and they gave us two bottles of champagne! Not to mention the one they brought to our room on the last night! This resort is very close to the city life and had a great time going out! The only thing I would change is adding more AC to the resort. Other than that I would definitely come back again with my family or maybe some friends regardless! For anyone looking to have an amazing getaway in Cancun, do not pass up the opportunity to stay here because you won’t regret it! Paradisus Meliá thank you for everything we all had the memories of a lifetime and hope to return soon!!!!

reviews.author: Sherri
reviews.title: HOT & FILTHY
reviews.text:
Arroved Tuesday August 12th....  The lobby was an inferno.  Not a little hot, but Mayan  Aztec "you aint made for this heat" HOT!  Its the hottest Ive ever been INSIDE a building I literally sweated all my make up and eyelashes off while I waited to be checked in... LITERALLY! ( the lobby wasnt hot like that everyday but Friday morning at 8 am in the morning is was back to blazing HEAT hot in the lobby.  I came in sweating and they sent me off in a sweaty mess as well.  

So lets talk about my 5 star resort room.  My first room was FILTHY!  Walked in the door and the odor of mildew and the sweet scent of past quest sweat wafted into my nostrils.  I looked around the room which had obviously outlived its youth and tried to mentally move past the dread that was now seeping through me.  I went into denial.  Hey I was in Cancun, like how bad can it be.  Just unpack I said and go to the pool!  So I threw my suit case down opened it up and thats when I got a good look at the couch.  Not only was the frame OBVIOUSLY broken and you couldnt sit on it,  it was stained in a way that only people with small children or drunken relatives would understand.  Looking at the couch mad me start to scratch and itch like I had become allergic to it.  I thought it was my imagination and then my roomate started slapping herself and screaming....  the room had gnats, lots of them!  Oh by the way the outlets in the room didnt work as well.

FInally I accepted I was not going to make it to the pool to cool off after I had literally melted in the lobby the first time and went back to request another room....  hours later we got another room after the manager tried to convince me to sleep in the filthy stankin gnat infested room and he would upgrade me the next day.  I told him to get me transport back to the airport and explain to my company who was paying for this trip why I wouldnt be able to attend the functions.  By the way the pictures of hanging frabric is actually from the box spring in the 1st room, so its fair to say the bedding was less than desirable.

So the second room was clean and defintely more updated...  I still wouldnt call it luxurious but I didnt feel like I was sleeping in a cest pool.  However,  workers from the hotel begin to use the room directly next door from mine as a staging area for their spray painting projects  LITERALLY.  There were all out on the patio  and had the door to the room open because apparently they were chocking as well from the industrial spray paint machine they were using.  Unfortunately they didnt give us mask as well so we started to choke. So back to the inferno, im sorry I mean Lobby I go so we wait for another room....  rooms they initally said THEY DID NOT HAVE!

Its past 10 pm when we get a decent room...  we are still in the clothes we flew in and having been sweating profusely in from the moment we walked into this Hot Box of a resort.  No pool...  no nothing but back in forth to the lobby.  We never had a chance to fix ourselves up for the company dinner and arrived over an hour late.  Did I mention I was suppose to give a speech?  Anywho I was happy to at least sleep in a clean room that night.  I expectactions had been drastically lowered.

Oh by the way.... they owe me a new IPHONE.  My phone would charge sporatically on and off and sometime not at all.  Then the second day I took the cord out of the ipone and literally found soot around the connection like it had been burnt. Now my phone wont charge at ALL!  I checked with other people in my group who experienced the same thing.  Then the last day I overheard the people at the front desk say that its not an AC problem its and electrical problem  that they are working on that is affecting the AC.  Which makes sense im sure my phone took a power surge and was fried.  

 There are multiple people from my group with their own individual horror story.  I will let them share that independently.  Believe me whoever at corporate who booke the hotel is about to catch some heat from some VERY UNHAPPY top producers!

Please puruse the attached pictures at your leisure!

reviews.author: Bud V.
reviews.title: Awsome Stay--Royal Service
reviews.text:
(Cross posted to Royal Service Paradisus Cancun)

We had the great experience of staying at Paradisus Cancun (Royal Service) the last week of July and had a FANTASTIC time!  We are planning on returning again in January!

Every team member we interacted with was pleasant and eager to help. A special shout out to our Concierge Leynar! Leynar checked in with us every day, set up our dinner reservations at the places and times we requested, got us set up in a bali bed every day of our visit, and made sure our mini-fridge was full of snacks like M&M’s and Oreos!

Arrival:
We arrived at the resort around 1:00 PM, were escorted over to Pyramid 5 and after check-in/orientation (a disguised sales pitch) were informed that our room was not ready yet.  We were parked at the La Palapa restaurant for about 90 minutes in the hot weather still in our travel clothes.  In the meantime, Leynar informed us our room had been upgraded to a suite!  Excited, we went to check it out and it was a suite, but on the ground level with absolutely no view of the ocean. We did not want that room and it seemed like it was a bother to get them to change our rooms, first we were told there was not another room, then maybe a room would be available in a  few hours and finally a room opened up on the 2nd floor which was the category of room we originally booked.

Rooms:
Once settled into the room, it was spectacular—the bed was comfortable, the bathroom spacious, the shower was awesome. The room was serviced every day—there was even a knock at the door every night at about 6 asking if we needed extra towels!  The AC struggled to keep the room as cold as we wanted but it was still cool and comfortable.  

Pool Service/Beach:
We were lucky enough to get a bali bed every day for our entire stay.  Your concierge will make sure you are on the list at least 2 days and you can always check after 12:00 noon for any empty /unclaimed beds. Pool drink service was spotty, but that wasn’t a big deal for us, we can get our own drinks and snacks—sure the staff doesn’t get a big tip at the end of the day, but we don’t end up getting hammered either.  The adult pool is heated and very quiet—no music.

Beach was very nice—quite sandy and a good distance to the water.  The water was ROUGH that week, so we only spent limited time getting tossed around by the surf. There was only a day or 2 that the Sargassum made the water gross but Melia does a great job of cleaning the beach compared to the resorts on either side.

Food/Drink
All the restaurants and food options were generally on the OK to good side.  We utilized the buffet for breakfast (omelet bar), LaPalapa and Blue Agave for lunches, and Market Grill, Fuego, Mole and Vento for dinners.  Fuego and Mole are inside with AC, while Market Grill and Vento are outside and very warm.  The servers at Market Grill were great and would bring around whatever meats you wanted. Make sure you try the grilled pineapple for dessert! We did not need to venture off the resort for dinners. Tip—there’s a gelato bar in Pyramid 3 open from 4-6 every day—but you can get the same gelato off the buffet all day! 

If you are staying in Royal Service in Pyramid 5, there is a small buffet set up that serves continental breakfast and snacks through the day up until about 10 PM.  There is also a top shelf bar where the attendant can make you a great drink!  

Shows:
Shows were hit or miss.  They moved some out to the pool area outside Pyramid 4, but a lack of seating made the shows tough to watch/sit through.  Some shows were moved to the Avenue Bar inside Pyramid 3, but the venue was sweltering and not a great place to watch a show—again no chairs and literally sweat dripping down your back. We don’t go to a resort to watch shows but we find them fun to catch and often enjoy them.  These could be better or be in a place that has AC and more space. 
One night the pool area was shut down for a private party which was awkward as resort guest walked through looking for the show or a drink from the pool bar. Signs could have been used to point guests in the right direction.

Overall:
A great time was had. There were some things we thought could changed to make more sense, but they were small things.

We did not venture over to the family side/pool. We did not use the Spa. We did become Circle members as we have stayed at Melia resorts a lot over the past few years.

Remember to tip the staff—a few bucks here and there make a difference and you will get better service. 

Don’t be that obnoxious person that brings a big speaker to the pool to blast your music.  Nobody wants to hear it and nobody will tell you to turn it down.  If you want to crank it up, head over to the other pool, they have a DJ and a swim up bar!

If you are able to swing it—go Royal Service.  I think our experience would have been wholly different if we stayed on the regular side.

reviews.author: Stefan B
reviews.title: Stefan Bailey
reviews.text: This was a great place to stay for 6 days.  The room was comfortable, service was great, food was excellent.  The only thing we experienced was the battle with the time share presentation.  We had to say "no" to many times before they left us alone.  The only bad costumer service experience I had was with the gentleman at the coffee shop - he clearly had an attitude every time I went to get some coffee.  He wouldn't look at you at all and he mumbled with his back towards you.  Totally unprofessional.  Maybe he doesn't like Americans.  Now sure but he was the only one that was unprofessional.  Everyone else was above board and did an excellent job.  My wife and I loved this experience and we will return!

reviews.author: Adys G
reviews.title: Great Experience!!!
reviews.text: Really nice Experience in my 6 day in Paradisus Cancun, Especially Thanks for Alexa and Violet both were wonderful and always available for anything that we need. My girls were enchanted with the gifts and chocolate cookies and milk. Really Appreciated all the time and effort that you and your team put in on us for the best vacation ever!!!

reviews.author: Sjenn
reviews.title: Not happy unfortunately
reviews.text: I’m currently staying at the Paradisus Meliá Cancun All Inclusive. My family and I were super excited for our vacation at this resort but was quickly disappointed when we got here. The AC is non existent throughout the resort, only in 1 or 2 restaurants and the check in area.  NO AC in the club smh.  In addition, my first night here my bath tub water did not go down and I was taking a shower in a pool of wAter smh. The AC in my room barely worked. I expected so much more based on reviews and got the complete opposite. I really hope my lastnight here is enjoyable with my family. Disappointed client. I wish Paradisus Cancun would do something for my family and I to make our lastnight here better.

reviews.author: Angie L
reviews.title: Wedding and Vacation in Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
We went to Paradisus Cancun last year and we loved it so much that we decided to get married this June. I worked with Marlene as the wedding coordinator and everything came out great. Our wedding consisted of 25 people and we were put in the royal service building. Prior to arriving to Paradisus Cancun we picked flowers, wedding package, audio & lights and photograph package. The responses via email took about  24-48 hours and I got worried at times but I understand they are coordinating future weddings and having a daily wedding in the resort and everyone is busy. A few days before the wedding Marlene, Katia (decorator), Nina (Audio & lights)  and Camilo (sales photographer) had a meeting with us to go over the wedding itinerary. My makeup, hair and nails were done in the Paradisus Spa and I truly loved it. The decorations from Alquimia Events were truly amazing and everything that I dreamed of.  The photographer Juan from Novia Mia Photography knows the hotel very well on where to take great pictures. The DJ from JSAV was really good and everyone danced all night and I liked the lighting that they provided. Baltazar, Carlos and the rest of the banquet staff were very attentive and everyone talked how great their service was during the wedding. 

The only issues that I had that involved my guests was that only 1 restaurant could hold 25 head count. Most of the restaurants are small and couldn’t hold the head count we had. 
Also, some of my guests called around noon to make dinner reservations and the operator advised it was too early and to call back later. I thought it was a bit rude specially because they were at the beach and they only went to their rooms to make the dinner reservation. 

We went to Paradisus Cancun last year and I did notice some things had changed. 
We went to Naos for breakfast and dinner with our friends and family and we noticed the variety of food options had decreased and I think they don’t serve alcohol until after 11AM.
Mexican night last year was really nice but this time it seemed smaller and not as much variety of food. 
Room service was included last year but this year there was a $5 fee every time something was ordered. 
Now they provide cards to get beach towels which wasn’t done last year. 
It seemed that Paradisus is trying to cut cost.

We saw our waiters from last year Nurbi and Ignacio Vasquez and they gave us great service. 
I mentioned to Ignacio I needed a table for 7 people for the next day at 7AM and when we got there the next morning Ignacio was waiting for us with our table ready (that is great customer service).

Overall my wedding experience was really good. 
The service at Paradisus is great but I feel that things have changed.

reviews.author: Barbara C
reviews.title: good for the price and all inclusive
reviews.text:
If you were to ask me if a recommend it, it would probably be a yes. What I would mention is food is ok for all inclusive, some nighttime restaurants stand out like Fuego and it's incredible server Christian and Market Grill Rodizio. Tacos at Blue agave are great. Drinks are not watered down. 
It seems like the hotel was very luxurious when opening, but now it is starting to show need of refurbishment. Pool is worn out, tiles were sharp. seats in restaurants had the leather slashed. 
Beach and view is beautiful, they do a good job clearing the Sargassum. They to a great job with entertainment at night, great shows and live performers.

reviews.author: JRM426
reviews.title: If you like AC don’t stay here
reviews.text: It seems that there’s a lack of AC in the entire hotel, including common areas. The rooms don’t go below a certain temperature so if you’re like me and need cooler temperatures to sleep, stay away.  Vacation week turned into miserable week of poor sleep and crankiness. You should be in better conditions on vacation than at home. It’s the least you can hope for. Instead, I couldn’t wait to board the plane back. What a waste.

reviews.author: Guadalupe Zepeda
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation
reviews.text: We booked with Paradisus for the beginning of august for a week, we were very excited. As soon as we arrived there was an employee waiting for us with cold towels, they walked us over to the Royal Service building and all of the employees were super nice! They introduced us to our butler Leyner and he took care of everything for us, he was amazing! He booked our cabanas for the whole week, all of our restaurant reservations and everything we needed.The girls in the spa were so nice and helpful and explained everything. The staff at the Palapa restaurant was great and so was the food, Valeria was great. We didn't like the buffet food or the restaurants there, they smell like grease and the food was very bland, cold and very very basic, but the staff was nice. But we started to eat at the Palapa restaurant every day and it was so much better, they make the food basically next to you while your seeing the ocean, it was fresh and way better than all the other restaurants. The hotel didnt feel like it had air conditioning other than in the royal service building, it was extremely hot! The night time "show" wasn't very great, I RECOMMEND STAYING AT THIS HOTEL, IF YOU BOOK WITH ROYAL SERVICE.

reviews.author: Anushk G
reviews.title: Too Hot, Buffet was mediocre
reviews.text:
The hotel has no air conditioning in the lobbies, most of the restaurants and they set a limit for AC in the rooms as well making it very unenjoyable to eat in the buffet, restaurants and even in the rooms. It was in the 90s in Cancun for most of my stay, and it was that same heat in the hotel as well which is very unexpected of a 5 star resort. It is very bad when you start sweating the second you start walking anywhere, or while eating at every restaurant and buffet. 
We are a vegetarian family, and the buffet lacked any variety for vegetarians. They also had no live cooking stations.
The resort also charges for many of the extras such as cabanas and they say that they are going to give you $550 in resort credits but then they just give you a useless coupon book with $10 off a insanely priced amenity which is totally unexpected.

Some positives were the staff who were absolutely brilliant. The restaurants, although not air conditioned did have delicious food. The infrastructure of the hotel is beautiful with stuff going on nonstop throughout the day. 

The hotel looks like a rainforest inside which was amazing, however, it also feels like a rainforest which is awful.

reviews.author: Anonymous
reviews.title: DANGER! DO NOT STAY HERE!!!
reviews.text:
First off let me tell you we've stayed at numerous Paradisus and Melia resorts in different countries. They have all been fantastic. This trip was VERY different. It was to be a special family trip having brought my 9 month old daughter. It ended up being more of a nightmare. For any new mothers and fathers, let me give you the inside scoop. 

First, for nearly 3 days we had to ask them to come fix our door. You didnt even need a key to access our room You could simply walk in. ALL FATHERS!!! - How would you feel knowing anyone could access your room with your wife and baby sleeping inside???!!!. 

At one point when we really tried making it an issue, they told us we had to wait by the door for security. Of course, after we told them we have MILK inside the room and our child needs to EAT! They made us wait 45 MINUTES!

Next, for all of you mothers still feeding via breast milk, I'm sure you understand that you need to drink lots of water to keep this going. We asked for nearly 3 days to refill our water in the room. From guest services, receptionist, the maid, the maids in the hallway and even the FRONT DESK MANAGERS - ALMA AND JUAN!!!

Next, the AC goes out in the entire hotel. Our 9 month old cant even sleep in such heat! Of course, After the numerous occasions of trying to address the issues with the "Front Desk Manager, JUAN... I never hear back from him so I have to chase down someone new. This time is was ALMA. Didn't get very far with her either.

"ABSOLUTELY PATHETIC!"

Countless hours later, nothing has been resolved, no phone calls to check on us, not even a knock on the door. 

TO HELL WITH THIS RESORT! 

If you have a family, small children and especially an infant or baby, let this be your warning. This hotel is not a place you want to be.

p.s. We also found BLACK MOLD on our balcony.

reviews.author: Gabriela R
reviews.title: Family concierge worth the price
reviews.text:
The kids club was a wonderful option for my son, he had a great time although I felt they could be a bit more organized. 

The nighttime shows where amazing, there was always something to do and was always greeted by wonderful staff, great drinks and food at each show location! 

The spa is amazing and very relaxing to get away for a bit.
 
Our butlers were super nice as well as the staff, although I did notice a better treatment to Americans than Latinos. 

Will return!

reviews.author: Ernesto Moreno
reviews.title: Melia or Motel 6?
reviews.text: Was that a Melia or a Motel 6? We just came back from the hotel in a more than dissapointing vacation. The hotel is old and needs a renovation, A/C units don't work, we could'n sleep in 3 nights, changed rooms and didn't make the difference since A/C didn't go south of 74F. Food was tasteless and lacking variety. The staff was the only thing that raised to the occasion, Orlando Bello at Naos restaurant and Saul, Keren and Carolyn ant the Kids Club were superb and made the difference. Very far from Melia standards.

reviews.author: rhonday
reviews.title: Worst welcome on vacation
reviews.text:
We just checked in and immediately regret our decision. I wish Hyatt Ziva was available for a quick book but it’s too late to change. (We stayed there last year and doesn’t compare) Strongly advise going elsewhere with the money you spend. Juan (front desk “manager”) and Rosi at the front office didn’t even greet us with  a smile or look at us. We had booked a king room with ocean view and they first said it wasn’t available for another hour when our Check in time was suppose to be 3 and we got there at 5. Then she goes somewhere and comes back and says it’s actually not available at all... Then they’re like it’s not going to be available til tomorrow. I don’t understand this if we’ve made reservationsssssss- can someone explain????!!! 
Then we get to our room without assistance whereas Hyatt ziva or anywhere else usually has a bellboy and even offer you drinks. Our room is a flashback to the 80’s (minibar isn’t even stocked) with a corner view of the ocean. 

Oh we have “towel cards” for every time we need towels and if we lose these cards we have to pay for a replacement. I mean I could literally go on and on about how awful it is and how much we wish we booked elsewhere. 

Shower head was broken, Bathroom had leaks everywhere. They never replaced our hotel room towels for some reason? I had to call every single day to get new ones which was bizarre. 

Im gonna keep it short. My main issue is people like my family work hard everyday- we plan these vacations to look forward to something. These are suppose to be precious vacation time that we work hard for and rightfully deserve. We’re not rude, snobby or inconsiderate people and I expect the same in return when I’m on vacation. It’s a big letdown and I hope you other vacationers have better luck! Cheers-

reviews.author: Mary R
reviews.title: Generally Beautiful Hotel & Helpful Staff, But Pushy Marketing Strategies & Lackluster in Other Areas
reviews.text:
My husband, two children and mother-in-law stay here in August 2019. For y'all's ease of reading, I'll break it down into pros and cons. 

Pros: 
-Stunning decor and ambiance in main areas
-Excellent wait staff service (friendly, helpful, ABOVE AND BEYOND. If one restaurant didn't have what we needed, they'd go and FIND it from another one. They even learned our preferences down to which of us wanted coffee with milk, etc.)
-Great beach location; lots of options for seating. Close to activities (parasailing, jet skis, etc.) 
-Several pool options, including a kids wading pool that my son and daughter adored!
-Variety of included food options, including a five diamond restaurant. 
-Nightly show, from Cirque du Soleil-style water acrobatics to Disney themed programs
-BEAUTIFUL views (if you can get them; see below) 

Cons
-SUPER pushy marketing. The minute we got there, we were introduced to our personal "concierge" who was there to give us the rundown of the hotel (what restaurants needed a reservation, where the kids activities were, etc.). However, as we're sitting there exhausted from our very long trip and sweating in the tropical heat (with two kids who haven't eaten in hours), she starts pushing a complimentary "breakfast" and additional "bonus gift" (i.e. a tour, a cabana rental, etc.) that we need to schedule to attend. She called it a marketing talk, but it's a timeshare. Like, come on. Just to get her out of our hair, we scheduled it for one of the mornings we'd be there. We intended to call and cancel, but forgot. The morning of, she called our room three times and then literally stalked us to where we had chosen to eat that morning to nag us for not attending. She wanted us to take the kids and leave right then to go to this "talk"-- which we promptly refused. After that, we didn't see nor hear from her the entire trip. 
-The rooms are outdated. Unless you book one of the very upscale rooms, it seems it hasn't had a face lift in 10-15 years. Our bathroom's tile had mold on it and a crack in the tub. Our toilet sit was broken (someone had bent it to the side) and just looked like it hadn't had a good clean in a while. 
-DOUBLE CHECK when you get your room that you actually got ocean view. We purchased ocean view rooms-- and they took us to two on the first floor with machinery almost completely blocking the view. They finally conceded, but not without a fight. 
-Bathrooms are far walk from the beach; very inconvenient. 
-Poor selection of food/snacks by the pool.
-Drinks could be either really good, or really bad. There was no consistency. 
-This hotel is NOT handicap-accessible. There are a few ramps here and there, but virtually all paths to the beach required stairs--which was very hard for my handicapped mother in law who had to try and walk down stairs with crutches. 
-As noted above, there are shows every night, but no way to find out ahead of time what they were so we could plan. 
-The buffet was delicious for breakfast, but awful for dinner. In particular, the desserts tasted like nothing. Room service was equally poor. Tasteless food, watery spaghetti sauce.

reviews.author: Phi N
reviews.title: Paradisus cancun
reviews.text: Excellent resort to stay while in cancun. Got our own butler, Rosanna, one of the best there is. She is very attentive to our needs. Overall, the resort is very clean, staffs are very nice and the foods are good for a tourists area.

reviews.author: sslatifah7
reviews.title: Amazing vacation!
reviews.text: The food was amazing great quality & selection of food ! Christian in the Market grill was very attentive great service José at the Asian restaurant was also amazing! Nightlife at this resort exceeded me & my family expectations.. pool area was clean beach had a lot of seaweed but other than that clean.. Overall this resort had everything we wanted good staff , clean , fun night life , & good food would recommend to my friends & family

reviews.author: reneg342
reviews.title: Great hotel, great people
reviews.text: We stayed at the hotel this summer, the staff is very friendly, the hotel is very clean and all the amenities are great, all inclusive makes it a lot better, the restaurants are very diverse and food is overall very good, breakfast buffet is phenomenal.

reviews.author: 33SAMMIT
reviews.title: Royal Service all the way!
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun was a wonderful resort. We stayed on the Royal Service (adults only) side and we loved it! We loved the pool side restaurant that was exclusive for Royal Service guests. The restaurant served both breakfast and lunch and had excellent food. The Royal Service side of the resort felt truly exclusive and all of the staff members were wonderful. We also loved the pool side and beach side cabanas.  The only negative I would have about the resort would be the mattress in our room - it was not very comfortable. However, this did not lessen our experience here. We stayed in an oceanfront king room and it was lovely. We also enjoyed the different restaurants the resort had to offer. The food was very good! We never had any issues getting a reservation at the reservation only restaurants. We were able to try most of the restaurants onsite. Overall, the experience at Paradisus Cancun was a great one!

reviews.author: Naa Adzeley B
reviews.title: very boring hotel-would not recommend for young ones
reviews.text:
Extremely boring hotel-would not recommend if you are under 30 because of lack of entertainment. 
The food is very average but not as bad as I expected
I will say however that the staff goes above and beyond to please its guest

reviews.author: angelicazambran0
reviews.title: The best
reviews.text: This was our second time at paradises and I cannot picture coming back to Cancun and staying anywhere else because every time we try a new place it’s a major dissapointment only because we have something great and luxury to compare it to . This hotel is over all the most beautiful and clean we have stayed at in Mexico ! Thank you paradises ! We hope to see you again!

reviews.author: Traveler728037
reviews.title: Great staff!
reviews.text:
Great hotel! Staff is amazing especially Christian at Bana. He was so caring, accommodating, attentive. He was the best! Other excellent staff included Orlando Bello at Naos, Martin at Naos, Veronica at Bana. 
Thank you! We had a blast!

reviews.author: Hanna604
reviews.title: Good location, good service but food and room can use some improvement!
reviews.text:
Good location: not to far from the busy part of the Hotel Zone in Cancun ( 10 minute bus ride) but not too close so you can still enjoy the green space surrounded the compound. We really like that. 

Good service: Staff are friendly, well-trained and helpful. They made our stay! 

Room: when we arrived, we were told that we would be getting a twin room ( 2 beds) while in our booking we had requested a room with King bed. It took the receptionist a while to find us a room with one King bed but then it is located in Pyramid 1,which is quite far from where we were originally placed. No apology from her but we were too tired after a long day of flying that we took it anyway. Turned out, pyramid 1 is the older part of the hotel that has not been renovated. Our room is minimal to say the least, there is no couch( which we found odd because if you want to sit down the only place to do so is the bed), just a small coffee table (odd!) and furniture is outdated. Bathroom is spacious but again, outdated.  The only good thing was that AC in the room was working great. Our room was always nice and cool. Our friend who got a room in Pyramid 1 (main building, newly renovated room with nicer furniture), their AC was barely blowing out cool air. It felt so stuffy and unpleasant. 

Food: We tried all of the restaurants except for Enzo because we didnt find the menu to be appealing or authentic ( we have great Asian food in Vancouver that's why). If we were to choose, Vento and Market Grill are probably our most favourite. Though I have to be honest that we got pretty tired of all the food by day 3. We went back to Naos- the all day buffet quite often because of the salad bar and they at least change it up a little everyday (for lunch and dinner).
We found the Sunset Grill by the pool horrible. Service was slow. You can tell they are always understaffed. They could use at least 2 more people there.  Food is either left dry and cold or not refilled at all.  It is just conveniently located so quite a few people go there. After eating there for 2 days we decided to go to the buffet for lunch instead. 
Other than that the Nespresso Bar and Gelato Counter were great. I just wish they stayed open all day instead of just a few hours a day.

reviews.author: dsmile
reviews.title: Party of 10 Review
reviews.text: We had a great time at this resort. Our "butler" forgot to schedule our dinners and was not very helpful in terms of giving us information about what amenities were available to us. On the other hand, Carlos Gonzalez and Chef Ventura Jose Palesti at the Restaurant Enzo were absolutely amazing! We went back specifically because we had such a great experience. A group of 10 is hard enough to keep up with, but he took care of us like we were the only ones there. It is truly the hard working people at these types of resorts that make the vacation memorable. Thanks again Carlos!

reviews.author: Trent  A
reviews.title: Carlos at Enzo makes the trip worth it
reviews.text: Recently took a trip to Paradisus Cancun and the biggest disappoint was that we did not come across Carlos at Enso sooner. The food was amazing there, but Carlos made the experience worth the trip. He went above and beyond to make sure our experience was the best it could be. We were so impressed with his service, we decided to go back a second night. Somehow, Carlos was even more impressive the second visit. He remembered all of our drink orders and food allergies from the prior visit. He did an excellent job of recommending food and explaining what each item was. The experience was top notch, from the moment we walked in to the moment we left, Carlos was the simply the best. I would recommend this place to anyone, and if possible, request Carlos.

reviews.author: Smart Traveler
reviews.title: Needs Improvement
reviews.text:
Firstly, let me say we've have stayed at the Paradisus Cancun several times and many other resorts along the strip. We continue to come back to Paradisus because of the hotel's beauty, natural tropical/jungle appearance and the staff. The majority of the people here work tirelessly around the clock. I can't say enough about how hard they work. It's really amazing to watch. You won't get service like this in the states unless you're staying at the Ritz or some other high end hotel. I also enjoy that there isn't A/C in the hotel lobby. Adds to the tropical feel and yes, we actually like the smells/incense. Nostalgic feeling for our family as we travel here a lot. 

Okay, here are my dislikes, the rooms need renovations. I know they have been  working on but its taking years to get this completed. The restaurants are good, we always found something enjoyable to eat. Food does tend to taste the same by 3rd or 4th day. Can't quite pinpoint what it is that causes that as they do have quite a variety. Must be the seasonings. Hint: There are no salt/pepper shakers on the table. If you ask for salt, the waiter has to take it from someone else's table to yours. Once you take a shake, he immediately passes it to another table. So odd. They also only serve unsalted butter for breakfast. Why no salt or pepper Paradisus? Nobody could answer this question for me when I asked. It's a natural element that we have an abundance of and its cheap. The line to order eggs is terribly long. You could easily spend a 1/2 hour standing in line for an egg. It's also kind of grose to watch them cook as they're constantly scraping the spatula on plastic line garbage cans or anything else they can find to scrape off food and then use the same spatula to grill with. It just looks unsanitary to watch and then the cooks are terribly sweating and using their bare hands to refill veggies for the omlettes. Suggestion: Give these cooks some fans next to them and enforce gloves for food preparation. It would visually be more pleasing for guests. However, I will add to everyone reading this review, I have never once gotten sick from the food or tap water in Paradisus or any Cancun hotel. Where I've had food illnesses in the states countless times.

Entertainment is good and seems to be almost daily, however, I do miss it being inside the hotel. Didn't care for all the weddings taking over the hotel pool area at night thought. 

Pool area closes too early. They almost start pushing you out by 4:00 as the staff starts setting up for nightly entertainment around the pools at this time. Be aware of this when you rent palapa's. The staff will set up right in front of your bed forcing you to move out.  

Okay, those were small issues above which are a nuisance but tolerable. Now my major ones, the 2nd day I ordered a margarita from a pool waitress who retrieved from a hidden bar inside a palapa tent. Within about 15 minutes of having this 1 drink (which tasted unusually odd), I felt extremely dizzy and fatigued. I needed to ask my family to escort me to my room because I could barely walk. They said I was breathing very slow and heavy breaths. I slept for 5 hours that afternoon. When I woke up, I still felt strange, very tired and couldn't think clearly. I wasn't in the sun that morning, ate a good breakfast and only had 1 drink around noon. Unfortunately, as sad as it makes me to say, I think I was poisoned. Why, I don't know. Maybe one of my bracelets, which I removed that day (I'll explain that later). Anyhow, the next days, I reserved my alcohol to champagne, wine or canned beer. I did hear other guests, healthy looking men/women complain at the pool bar that they felt unusually drunk for such little amounts of alcohol. So one day, I sat at the bar and watched them make drinks. They don't use a jigger or shot glass for measuring. They heavily poor and mix various liquors into drinks (more than half the cup is liquor). Suggestion to future guests: Watch your drinks being made at all times and tell them exactly what you want. Especially to the females, smaller and younger drinkers. Suggestion to hotel manager: Please have more oversight with the bartenders and rules with alcohol. This could be a very dangerous situation for your hotel and the safety of the guests. 

Another issue for us was the various levels of service guests received based on how much money you spend, which is easily identified by your bracelet color. Each color has a different meaning. Trust me, you come here enough, and you will quickly notice the difference of how you're treated. You'll especially see with the room quality, amenities, and service provided at the restaurants and pools. Suggestion: This doesn't make for a good feel to guests who purchased a standard room, yet spent thousands of dollars to stay at your resort. Maybe you should put these high end guests in a different area of the resort so the rest of your guests don't feel like underprivileged, low statused people. No one should be made to feel like that, especially at a 4 star resort where every guest has paid a great deal of money to stay at your property. And it's those people who continue to travel and come back to your resort, myself and family as a great example. I for one can tell you we've spent far greater amounts of money at your resort than your Melia/Royal Service members. That's just ignorant and uncalled-for. Manage smarter.

Finally, another disappointing thing for me to relay (very sad about but have to mention).... if the staff here you speak English, you will be treated less than sufficiently, often ignored at the pool area, chairs, palapas and restaurants. Good luck trying to get a bartender's attention. Tip: Learn some spanish before you go! It's quite obvious that they purposely won't make eye contact with you when trying to order at swim-up bar. We constantly saw this occur, unless of course you flash CASH (why they expect you to hold money for tips while swimming and on vacation in an all-inclusive hotel, no less, is ridiculouss). Then you have the fat dudes who just look loaded with money by never removing their body from the bar chair - they sit with a pile of cash on hand - you know who they are.... And don't try and pass something small like a $5 or $10 bill. It will only make the bartenders ignore you more. I heard this same complaint numerous times from English speaking guests. 

And based on that I will say this: There is nothing like being an American. We treat all nationalities as equal. I'm so proud of my country. Yes, we have some bad seeds like every other country. And yes, our media exaggerates and lies but we the people, everyday working class citizens share a comradery and respect for one another of all differences like no other country. There is no other place in the world where you can see all nationalities come together and respect each other as one. While I love the beauty of MX and so many other countries, when I step off the airplane and hear the US customs agent say "Welcome Home", there is no better feeling than to watch to  see in line all different colors, different languages, all being welcomed home by the US. Proud, proud.

reviews.author: Fernando A
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
We visited “Paradisus”, in the hotel zone of Cancun! The Paradisus has several towers and corridors that connect everything, however most of the restaurants are located in the main tower where the hotel lobby is located. There is a Japanese restaurant “Bana” in the center with a lot of vegetation, it is beautiful and the food is very good. There they also offer live music, every night to accompany the dinner!
