To be able to take advantage of all the restaurants, you must make your reservations as soon as you arrive as they usually do not have space for several days and you have to plan ahead. There is a restaurant “Tempo” where there is an extra charge, we did not try it since there are enough restaurants in the hotel to have to pay more.

The food is varied, very good in some of the restaurants but not so good in others. In some the service quite slow. The taco restaurant “Blue Agave” leaves much to be desired however the Mexican “Mole” is good! Many offer you a special drink that you only find in that restaurant. The best was the Peruvian-Japanese restaurant “Fuego” and it was one of our favorite restaurants!

Every day there is a show that by the way is very good, around 8:00 PM. The show is in the “Avenue Bar” where there are not many places to sit, so if it does not arrive before 7 PM to move its places, there is no place to sit, maybe there is a place on the floor but it is also full. 

It is difficult to see it because it has several columns and the bar is not made for this, it is seen that the show was added later but it is not very well planned. Nor do they have an MC that would help give more recognition and support to artists who work so hard to present a good show. Perhaps for the future they can move the show to another place in the hotel so that all those who wish can go and see it.

The “Paradisus” has a section “Royal Service VIP” exclusive, is in the last tower and has its own pool where they guarantee a cabin for two days during their stay. The cabin is reserved with your name without any extra charge, although you can get the cabins for more days without problems, it all depends on how full the hotel is. This section of the hotel has two exclusive restaurants for guests of this section “Royal Service” one is called “La Palapa” next to the pool. 

They also have a restaurant in the center of the tower where you can have breakfast and have a snack for the rest of the day. It is a mini buffet with a variety of dishes, fruit and pastries. It has a bar and “Nespresso” coffee.

The best thing about the hotel is this section “Royal Service” mainly for the cabins, if you can find a good offer, it’s worth the expense!

reviews.author: nsmailis
reviews.title: Carlos is the real MVP of Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
I've been to a number of all-inclusive resorts, have had hundreds of different restaurant waiters in my lifetime, but none have come close to the experience from Carlos Gonzalez and Chef Ventura Jose Palesti at the Restaurant Enzo at Paradisus Cancun. They went above and beyond to make sure our vacation was a memorable one. 

Let's get into details - Our third night, our group of 10 went to Enzo for dinner. Carlos was our waiter and had such great attention to detail, filled up water without asking, was running around getting anything and everything we needed with a smile on his face. Normally a group of 10 has more than 1 waiter, but he took this job on himself and was amazing. We left and hugged him and told him we would be back.

We saw him in passing on our way to the pool the next day and we told him we were going to come back on our last night and he said "sounds great! Can't wait to have you. We will have something special for you."

Our last dinner at Paradisus and, as promised, we went to Enzo. Upon arrival, Carlos had our table set up with the words spelled out in coffee beans "We hope you enjoy your vacation Smailis Family!" That alone was enough! But Carlos went on from there- he really took care of us and we felt like VIPs. After we left, we all hugged him and even snagged a selfie with him and our group the night we were celebrating a Retirement.

Thanks for the fabulous time! I hope I come across more waiters and service like we received at Enzo!

reviews.author: Rajni L
reviews.title: 2nd Trip - VERY UPSET/SAD - Management went down the drain
reviews.text:
This was my 2nd trip to Paradisus. We stayed 3 years ago with our 4/2 year old daughters and had the best time ever. The hotel, food, kids club, pools & service were so great!  After 3 years we wanted to take our 3 month old son with us alone. A hotel so kid friendly - we absolutely had to choose Paradisus.

We paid for an Ocean Front King Size. When we got there - the checkout at 3pm (theirs shifts change at 3pm) there was only 1 person working and the line took us 45 minutes to get our turn. The room they gave us was a lagoon room - we went back to the reception where another couple was yelling at JUAN (manager).  We were next to speak to him and knew he wasnt going to do anything to help us - since he seemed less forgiving to the couple before us.  

We spoke to him and he said the hotel has nothing for us - and the only other option is a OCEAN FRONT on the 5th floor but its double beds.  This is our 10 year anniversary we are celebrating. We had no choice but to take this room - dissapointed with the service provided by the manager. 

The pools were dirty this time - people had thrown up in it and there was too much food in the pools. They werent cleaned everyday you could tell.

The entertainment has now moved to the pools. It used to be at the AVENUE BAR inside. Yes, its a smaller section for shows so they decided to move this to the pool.  The negative to this is that the pool they choose that night closes early and you cannot swim in that pool. 

One day they had MEXICAN NIGHT and they decided to build "stores" for shopping by the pool and in front of our bali bed they put these large wall paper stands.  Literally 2 feet from our bali bed; our view became the back of these wall papers. We could not believe it. The staff said all other beds are taken and at 4pm we had to leave our bali bed and just go inside. With our 3 month old we couldnt sit in regular lounge chairs (no shade).

The MARKET GRILL restaurant at lunch time used to serve yummy Italian food. It now is part of the buffet but just extended outside.  So this was a bummer.

The only options at lunch is the buffet (NAOS), the market grill (just another buffet) or  this taco place they have inside (REALLY NICE) but you cant eat lunch there 5 days in a row. It's beyond annoying.

Dinner options were good. MOLE was the best for us. It sucked because the reservations only avail every night were 6pm or 10pm. Really you either leave the pool at 4pm to shower/get ready for dinner at 6. Or you wait until 10pm. With a 3 month old we only ate dinners at the hotel 2 nights. We left the hotel to go to other restaurants more accomodating to our 3 month old's schedule.

We asked the room be changed twice - no one offered us an alternative solution.

The SPA - I made an appt at 9am. They asked me to come in at 8am for 1 hour before relaxation. Spa opens at 8. DO NOT BOOK A 9am and get there 1 hour before. NO ONE WAS THERE. The door was open. I had to get a manager and they called the staff.  Then I finally got to go into the relaxation room (which wasnt set up) the water was from the day before and not changed. HOT WATER wasnt ready for the tea. And a lady came to clean the wood floors at 8:30am.  I sat there to relax and a lady brought a bucket and a bowl. And she threw soapy water on the floor with the bowl and then scrubbed and wiped each section in front of me. The entire place smelled like BLEACH.  I was beyond annoyed.

The massage was alright.  For $130 it wasn't worth the experience at all. They have beautiful selection of teas.  I took 20 packets for myself to take home. Again, I was annoyed i Couldnt enjoy a cup there.

THe service overall LACKED in the hotel. 

The pool servers were too slow; they definitely need more staff at the pool. Getting ice regularly was annoying. I had to go multiple times with my bucket and just get it from the bar myself (which was no problem) but the bali beds came with service.

HEADS UP - if you want a bali bed (just the bed and no champage/shrimp/lobster combo, its only $30/day US dollars. Thats dirt cheap for you being in the shade. It's sooo worth it. There isnt much shade elsewhere.  And for $30 a day it was SOOO worth it.  

They have 10 beds by the wall for $30/day. The other beds closer to the ocean by the pool are $150/day and the difference is that you get MOET CHAMPAGNE/lobster/shrimp with it.  

You can get your own bottle of champagne from your room. Ask them for a bucket with ice and help yourself. We did that all 3 days. 

The bottle of champage was complimentary for our 10 year anniversary and they just kept bringing one everyday to our room - so cheers to that!!!  And we didnt have to pay $150/day for it.

When we left they asked us how our experience was and we told them we will NEVER stay at this hotel again. The service and experience were horrible. THe manager, ANGEL, said he agreed as they are having administrative problems right now and many people are complaining. 

We felt at peace a bit hearing that towards the end of our trip. I thought we were just struck with horrible bad luck every single day in different locations; but the management has gone down the drain.

They now have water bottles in GLASS BOTTLES. THey did this on purpose so people dont take their plastic water bottles outside of the hotel when they leave for their day trips. A great way for them to save costs; but its horrible. You cant even take a bottle water outside of your room. Who is going to carry a tall glass bottle.

You can ask for plastic bottles of water but they keep them at the concierge hidden and they give you only 1 unless you tell them 3 please. It's annoying.

The SUNSET GRILL (the burger/nachos place) outside by the pool - they will only give you 1 serving per person. Especially on the wings. 5 wings per person. I couldnt get 2 plates (one of me and one for my husband).  They had me put my plate away (i walked 5 feet away and set it down on the table - walked back and asked for another plate). Seriously at an all inclusive for 10 wings. It was insulting to say the least.

I wont stay here with kids ever again.  I'll try another place.

This place used to be so good; its horrible now.  And the management agreed when we checked out.

If you want service - dont stay here. If you want a manager to bend over backwards just to accomodate something - dont stay here.

Cancun rocks and is inexpensive - but these hotels are getting horrible.

reviews.author: NIQQIB
reviews.title: Paridisus - The best resort experience EVER!!!
reviews.text: Where do I start! I was on a trip with a group from July 10 - 16th. We checked in a day early and stayed a day later.  The event was actually July 11-15th.  When we checked into our new room on the Royal side we were met  and escorted  by our butler Rossana.  She was awesome and we have missed her since we left and would request her when we return next year!  The spa staff and service was amazing and so relaxing! Fernanda checked me and was so pleasant! Diane gave me the tour and was so informative on how I can relax and enjoy the spa before ad after my treatment. Liliana was my therapist and she was AMAZING.  The last day I was at the resort i was able to squeeze in the spa and was greeted by Diana again.  It was great to see a familiar face. The overall staff of the Paridisus was amazing overall.  One staff member dropped everything he was doing to make sure I found m way to my location!  Fernanda was amazing as our Buter and she was INSTRUMENTAL in my roommate and I having a great time. There was nothing we wanted for during our trip! I really hope she is availalbe next year.  If you can do the Royal Service and can get Fernando, you won't be disappointed!  The food and the restaurants where very good!

reviews.author: dbaird2019
reviews.title: Make sure the A/C in your room works.
reviews.text: Our overall experience was positive, with the exception of the service for the a/c in our room, and the inability of front staff to make decisions on their own to provide a “problem fixed” experience.

reviews.author: Wayne H
reviews.title: Rock Party
reviews.text: The Rock Party was so much fun. Dancing and music was awesome. Entertainment - Saul, Rodrigo, Julio, Nicole, Rachel, Karen, and Ivone were so much fun and involved with the people. They are also super fun to play volleyball with.

reviews.author: Jack H
reviews.title: This place is great!!
reviews.text: The staff is amazing and they regularly keep activities rolling. We loved playing volleyball with Saul, Julio and Rodrigo! The restaurant staff is also extremely kind and make sparkling conversation in the morning, and Pablo shines the brightest at this! We will continue to come back for years to come!

reviews.author: aavalle
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: While me and my wife stayed at Melia Paradisus in Cancun, Mexico it was one of the best experience I had ever had. The employees who work there make you feel welcome every day and they treat you like family in a nice and warm atmosphere. The only con to this hotel was the food because most restaurant served different food, but all the food we tried tasted just like the food inside the buffet, which is called Naos. If you are looking to enjoy food, I would recommend Naos buffet not just because its a buffet, but because every food in every other restaurant tastes the same as the food served in Naos. Another Con with this hotel is the music quailty and the type of music they play. Since it's Cancun, Mexico we were expected Mexican music and different types of Mexicans style, but in reality it was American type of music and it didn't make me feel like I was getting the Mexican music culture. Overall, this hotel was wonderful for an all inclusive resort and will definitely recommend it to anyone who is looking for a resort to stay in Cancun, Mexico.

reviews.author: Lauren
reviews.title: Paradisus Girls Trip
reviews.text:
I highly recommend Paradisus Cancún Resort to families, friends, couples, etc. I never once felt unsafe, the facilities are beautiful, the staff is phenomenal and not once did I see an employee just standing around. The food was excellent and the drinks were generous! Whenever we needed water to the room they were there within 15 minutes to drop it off. Our bartender Randy at ibana was FANTASTIC! My friend and I had drinks with him every evening before dinner, he was very attentive, always brought us water bottles, great conversation, and kept the drinks coming. Huge shout out to my boy Randy, thank you for taking such great care of us every night! 
I would definitely return to this resort again! It never felt too crowded at the pools until our very last day as a conference had just arrived. 
A few tips, bring several singles and fives for tips, the employees definitely deserve to be tipped for their services. The convenient store only offers pesos or card, but you can charge things to the room as well. Get outside early in the morning to reserve chairs/umbrellas. The resort could use several more umbrellas by the pool. 
Overall, great experience at Paradisus Cancún and a very affordable trip!

reviews.author: Andy
reviews.title: Cancun one day
reviews.text: This resort need update very nice staff. The pool need to be update the beach is not clean the food is really good this hotel is for adult not for a family a lot people drinking in the pool there is no place to seat very busy. If you have kids you have to go Paradisus Playa del Carmen.

reviews.author: thomahawkes
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel and excellent service in general, except the beach area that were not the same as in the photos, a lot of seaweed. We don't mind at all because my kids stays in the pool most of the time.

reviews.author: Natyra Kazagiqi
reviews.title: Great staff
reviews.text: We arrived yesterday and until now all we see is a great staff very very professional and they make you feel very special. Everyone is greeting  you with a warm smile. Every time i dial 0 to ask for something they call me after 15 min to check if we have received what we asked for ( very nice) Food is always delicious and fresh at buffet. Last night we were at Japanese restaurant and everything was so delicious . Im surprised not to much activity for my boys 12 and 16 years old 😐 they love ping pong or tennis nothing until now or beach volleyball. Mini bar is restock and free every day, room is clean and nice. We canceled other hotel because of a bad reviews and came here at Paradisus I hope we will continue to have a great time. One thing surprises me i wrote an email that i will come and we are celebrating our anniversary I didn’t expected rose pedal or vine ( we dont drink alcohol anyway) but at least cart to show that they care.  My friends went other places to celebrate and everyone were sending me pictures with room decorated  I told them they dont do that at Paradisus. Other then that great hotel with a wonderful staff and delicious food

reviews.author: FarAway161679
reviews.title: Great time!
reviews.text: Had a wonderful stay here for 3 x nights. The food and drinks were at a very high standard. Special mention to Jaimie who helped us get tickets for coco bongo, andreas and Moises from the buffet and the wonderful Elliot at the pool. These staff really made our stay. Look forward to visiting Mexico again !

reviews.author: Michelle M
reviews.title: Great Vacation at a Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: We loved this resort! The customer service is exceptional first and foremost. We stayed in pyramid 3 with a lagoon view and it was beautiful. The resort was very clean and well maintained. We tried most of the restaurants, food was good. You can download an app to make reservations at the restaurants during your stay, which made it very easy. We really enjoyed the food that is part of the Royal Service section called La Palapa as well as spending time at the swimming pool in this area as well, which is adults only. There was entertainment happening every night. Overall, we had an amazing time an would recommend Paradisus Cancun to everyone. Once again, best part about this resort is the customer service.

reviews.author: Katherine B
reviews.title: Love this resort
reviews.text: Beautiful property and friendly staff. Great buffet for breakfast and lunch, AMAZING Japanese restaurant in atrium of main building (all restaurants we tried were good as well), accommodating chef/staff for food allergies, on-site desk with booking agents for excursions through different companies (i.e. Expedia, etc.). If you tip a few bucks everywhere, the staff will give you a little more attention on your stay!

reviews.author: wrandall78
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text:
I would like to thank the Paradisus for an amazing vacation experience. The staff is second to none . The staff was always courteous and informative . The pool areas
were always clean as well as the rooms . If you needed anything all you had to do was ask  and the staff would have it to you in a few minutes. The dining experience was always pleasant . I would like to thank Armando, Gaudencio and Vincente at the Naos Restaurant . Their service was excellent and made for a great dining experience. 
Thank You All.

reviews.author: Azemina K
reviews.title: Beautiful resort!
reviews.text: Hotel could use some upgrading but overall we truly enjoyed our stay and service was great! Beautiful beach view!Lots of seaweed but we were able to find sections to swim. We would definitely go back there.

reviews.author: Nadine F
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
The hotel is absolutely lovely but for the money we spent, I expect just a touch more. We booked a Family Suite Junior Concierge Ocean View. The view is absolutely beautiful but the room is way too small. If traveling with kids, I suggest getting a bigger room. Also, you cannot get reservations the first two days of your travel for the restaurants so are you stuck eating at the buffet. The food is pretty much the same day in and day out so you will get tired of it. This was my main complaint. The food is not up to the quality for the brand you are paying for. The service is good all around other wise but if you think room service will deliver your food, this is hit or miss. My daughter ordered key lime pie 2 nights in a row and never received it. I finally had to ask our butlers to make she got it on day 3. That was just crazy to me. Probably will not stay here again due to the fact that one day all I wanted was food outside the hotel. I have never experienced that before when traveling. I tend to try local food everywhere I go but when all I want is McDonalds instead of eating at the buffet, it is sad.

The highlight of my entire stay was Gaudencio, a server in Naos Restaurant. He would go out of his way to get me fresh food from the kitchen just so I would eat. If he was not working, I avoided the buffet. His service& attention to detail is what you want on all vacations!

reviews.author: Ganusia
reviews.title: Great vacation with kids!!!
reviews.text:
Thank you very much for the great time we had at Paradisus. 
We had Family concierge suite with our personal butler Violeta. 
Thank you Violeta very much for your attention, professionalism and for being always there for us. The whole staff at the hotel was very nice and service was amazing. 
The only minus side for us was seaweed, but unfortunately, that's overall problem for the whole coast. 
Thanks again and we will be back!!!!!

reviews.author: johnciora1
reviews.title: 7th time here since 2016!!!
reviews.text:
Where to start???  The heart of the workers, the beautiful grounds, the cleanliness of the facility, the food, the ambiance and the most beautiful beach on the strip is what makes this the only place we will come to in Cancun.  We were here Aug. 24th to the 29th and we cant wait to book to come back for the 8th time since 2016.  Our new favorite restaurant is Fuego.  Not only because of the food, but Guillermo is one of the hardest working managers I have seen in this entire industry here and in the US.  That man runs around and leads his team to be such a professional staff that words cant explain.  There are leaders and there are managers....  he is a leader who knows how to inspire others to work hard.  Naos is the best for breakfast/lunch with Gaudencio and Tonii being the most upbeat and professional waiters in the place.  They remember everything you need from the day before and have such happy personalities all day long.  Being on vacation not only puts you in a good mood but having the workers enjoy their jobs is even better.  The entire breakfast crew is top notch with everyone being happy and smiling.  Chef Eduardo Mukul is awesome!!  He definitely made us feel special with a special meat dish he personally prepared for us.  
Our room was newly renovated and is beautiful but we miss the Bidet!!!  Our room service was alil behind the 2nd day but after we called and asked for the room to be completed earlier, we had no issues.  The food and beverage manager Sonnya, who started the position a few months ago always has a smile on her face and seems to be doing great.  The dim ambiance at night sets such a relaxing mood with the "smell" of Yhi spa all thru the resort.  I actually bought a few bottles of the oil last trip for a diffuser at work and people love it!!!  We love this hotel... we love the people... it is definitely our 2nd home.  The only bad thing I can say is the seaweed was very bad but that's out of control of everyone's hand and all mother nature.  Thank you to all at Paradisus!!!!!  We love you!!!!  See you in May!!!

reviews.author: MsAmyFK
reviews.title: Great all inclusive hotel
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus in early August. We moved to this hotel after checking out of an awful hotel in Tulum. We were very happy when we arrived - the hotel is very impressive. It has a great selection of restaurants, the pools are big and clean, the rooms are a good size and clean and the service is excellent. 

We had a 9 month old baby with us - the hotel is very baby friendly; it has a baby club and offers a babysitting service. My only criticisms of the hotel are that the main atrium of the hotel is quite hot and humid (the rest of the hotel is air conditioned well) and the food in some of the restaurants isn't as good quality as in some of the other restaurants. Overall, I would recommend this hotel - particularly for a family holiday or a holiday for a big group.

reviews.author: Andro1109
reviews.title: Excellent resort
reviews.text: I stayed there for a week in August of 2017. Originally I booked the regular room but when I got there I was upgraded to the royal service side of the resort.  I travel 2-3 times a year and I have to say this was my favorite place. The room was really nice,  food was good, beach was nice and blue, the staff was great especially the people working the royal service pool section(alex). I'm really impressed with the design of the resort as a whole it's really cool.  I'm exploring other corners of the Caribbean now, but I'm hoping to go back sometime soon.

reviews.author: Jane A
reviews.title: Go Elsewhere
reviews.text:
We just checked in today, and we are desperately trying to transfer hotels. From first impressions, the interior is lovely. The hanging vines are a nice accent, and the beachfront is beautiful. 

The check-in process itself was fine. We waited online for a bit, and then went up to the rooms. The arrangement of the rooms is very spread out, but if your room is closer to the elevator, it's not bad. The two rooms we have both smell of chemicals. One room only slightly, the other is unbearable. I can't tell if it is paint, or insecticide, but it's impossible to occupy the room. 

The hotel staff has tried to be accommodating, but it seems futile. Edgar was very understanding, and took us to several rooms, but we still haven't been able to find two adequate rooms on the same floor. While we were spending over an hour at the check-in we overheard another guest complaining about the bathroom in his room. Our friends recommended this place, but we wish we had stayed at the Hyatt Ziva instead of Paradisus. 

After looking into the other disappointed reviews on here, and I'm so upset that it's exactly the same experience for us. From what I can tell, I think that it really depends on where you are put in the hotel. Maybe if you call ahead, and book a room that does not smell, is not by loud construction, or super far from the lobby/concierge/restaurants/pool, then it can be fine.

reviews.author: mab521
reviews.title: Great Family Vacation
reviews.text:
Just returned from a week and really had a fantastic time.  Pool was great for kids of all ages (especially toddlers)- Bally beds were wonderful and clean.  Definitely recommend getting them for shade and ocean breeze in August.  Unfortunately seaweed was rampant in the ocean which was a deterrent- nothing the resort could really do although they did their best efforts to clean it up as much as possible.  9 people in our party and amazingly not one mosquito bite on anyone!  Yahoo!
Room seemed newly remodeled (pyramid 1) and spacious.  Food was good- Brazilian Steakhouse and outdoor special Pineapple Festival and Mexican Fiesta were a nice addition.
I have to recognize our AMAZING hard working server- Miguel Quinones at the pool.  Best server we've had at any resort! 
All in all a wonderful place and a wonderful week, Thank you!

reviews.author: MAO
reviews.title: Sunny Paradise
reviews.text: There is a reason why this was our fourth visit to the Paradisus Cancun and there are many reasons why we yearn to go back again. The Paradisus offers something for everyone, from a serene tranquil indoor atmosphere to daily shows and activities, the Fiesta Mexicana is one example this year, a night of traditional Mexican food, culture and activities and is highly recommended. There is food and drink to satisfy all taste buds. For us, it is the sensation “switching off” and of being looked after and pampered the minute you step in is priceless. Again whilst there is an army of people looking after you, all of whom were polite and helpful, a special thanks goes to Rodolfo who has been outstanding in preparing for our vacation and looking after our needs from the moment we arrive to the moment we leave, also a special thanks to Liliana in family concierge, who is outstandingly supportive and helpful, also special thanks to Maria and Gloria who contact us several times a day to ensure all our needs and desires are met, and finally a thank you to Sofansa (I hope I spelt his name right) by the pool who was there every day delivering our drinks.

reviews.author: Amina B
reviews.title: 1 week all inclusive
reviews.text:
Excellent setting and service. Really clean would definitely visit again.  Our bedroom was facing the lagoon, a large room with balcony and bathtub, only thing was the bed was a bit squeeky. Staff very friendly and very keen to help. 
A wide variety of food at several of the restaurants.

reviews.author: volgirl2015
reviews.title: Great place for Families as well as Adults Only
reviews.text: We stayed in a Family Concierge Suite and from the moment we checked in until our departure everything at the resort was excellent.  They pampered not only us but our kids as well (13 and 7) and made this one of the most relaxing vacations that we have experienced.  The food, beaches and pool(s) were all fabulous as well as the grounds were very clean.  My only complaint is the size of the room and the beds - I was a little disappointed as we are used to suites and our room was just that, a room.  The beds were double and should be considered to be upgraded to at least Queen.  However, the room served its purpose, it was just cozy.  Our butler, Sandra, was top notch and was very accommodating.  I highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Cmarch310
reviews.title: DO NOT recommend for Club Melia Members
reviews.text:
I greatly enjoy the Melia hotel chain and have stayed at multiple Melia resorts (Paradisus Playa del Carmen, Paradisus Punta Cana, Melia Orlando, The Level at Melia Tropical, spent a day at Melia Cozumel) and in my opinion this hotel does not live up to the rest. This was my second stay at this hotel (last stay was in 2016) and I would say the service has declined over the years. I traveled with a Club Melia member and we were NEVER contacted by anyone on the Club Melia staff to see how our stay was going. We were a bit surprised by this as every other time (8+ times) we have stayed in a Melia resort the service is always the outstanding part– here the service is what was extremely lacking! Cancun is one of our top travel destinations but unfortunately I will return to this resort again. 
Some notes from our stay:
-	The hotel accommodations are good - hotel is extremely walkable, everything in a short distance. Nice large pool area, Jacuzzi on balcony is a great touch. 
-	One of the “rules” is to not reserve chairs by the pool, however, during busy season if you do not get your spot picked before 8am you will not have much luck finding a spot later in the day. 
-	The food is not bad for an all inclusive. We enjoyed the Grill, the Brazilian steakhouse style restaurant as well as Fusion for dinner. Blue Agave has great authentic tacos. Red lounge is a fun nighttime option after 10pm. 
-	We had a wheelchair accessible room and if you do not need it I would try to steer away from it. Limited counter space in the bathroom as well as a bit of an awkward room layout due to ramps. It is not a deal breaker by any means but if you can avoid it I would try to. 

All in all, the hotel is not bad. However, in comparison to the other Melia properties and service we have received in the past, it definitely falls short from the others. We will not return.

reviews.author: Vivian M
reviews.title: The best vacation in long time
reviews.text: This hotel offering for family the best condition and atención. Pamela was amazing all time pending ours wishes. I advice every one to visit this place the beach the food the transportation was exactly in time and gorgeous.  The buffet simply awesome every thing do you want and do you think was there

reviews.author: Mohsen B
reviews.title: The best holiday ever!!
reviews.text:
The resort was beautiful and the service excellent! 
I’d like to thank Arturo Be from restaurent Naos Aim for providing me and my wife with an exceptionnal service and Ms. Mariza Amairany for her hard work. We would also like to thank Chef Eduardo Mukul and Captain Guillermo Lopez, they were very friendly and professionnal with us. Finally, a special thanks to Elisander for his precious help and knowledge. Looking forward to our next trip to this nice resort! 
Mohsen from Canada.

reviews.author: Bailey J
reviews.title: Great service and great trip
reviews.text: Our stay at paradises was spectacular, we enjoyed every aspect of our trip like the food (lots of options), the rooms were cleaned twice a day, clean pools and beaches (sadly when we were there the ocean was closed because of seaweed) but lots of chairs along side the pool and beach. The best part of this resort was the service and staff. I’d really like to mention one staff member in particular Carlos Gonsalez, who was our waiter at Enso restaurant, he really made the night for us, he was funny, polite and took very good care of us. Overall this is an amazing beautiful place to stay and would recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Mark B
reviews.title: Best Waiter Service, Ever
reviews.text:
Our trip was generally very good until we met Carlos Gonzalez at one of the restaurants called Enso and then it became amazing. Carlos is a phenomenal  waiter. We will certainly be coming back because of him. 

The hotel and service itself is highly recommended by this family.

reviews.author: jessup1411
reviews.title: Great Vacation at a Beautiful resort.
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful. The pool area was large and inviting. Didn't discover the Grill at then pool until the end of our stay. Wish we discovered sooner. One of the best dining options. The food was good and offered a good variety of items and healthy choices.

reviews.author: Daria A
reviews.title: No life after 9 pm
reviews.text:
We love this resort . We r staying here for the second time. And the only thing that we dislike about it is lack of entertainment. They have a little ( mostly boring) show at night from 8 to 9 and that’s it. Once they had life music in the main bar after “main show” and it was awesome. However we stayed here for 5 days and it happens only once!!and please, stop doing this Michael Jackson show - it is getting worse with every year.... and it’s really lame. 
Otherwise great service, good food, pretty design.

reviews.author: Hayley @ Travel Coordinates
reviews.title: Great Family Stay!
reviews.text: We travelled in April 2018, family of 4 (kids 4 and 2) and stayed in a Family Concierge Suite (1 bedroom).  The room was the perfect size, the family concierge was a great add-on with access to own check-in, and personal concierge to assist with reservations, cabana bookings and other daily queries.  We spent the week at the resort only leaving twice to go to local restaurants.  Plenty of variety with dining options in the hotel, great pool - plenty of space for families, couples and groups. Reserve your dining bookings in advance, and make the most of hiring a poolside cabana for at least a day. Well worth it! We found the location on the hotel zone better as we were not up the 'busy' end so avoided any crowds. We didn't swim in the ocean, due to the time of the year there was a lot of seaweed - clearly nothing the hotel has any control of but just be aware if you are booking around April/May.

reviews.author: Melissa B
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Paid for an ocean view (most expensive hotel we booked) and got the view of a brick wall....after we complained we got a better room with 2 double beds which isn’t ideal for a newly engaged couple (which also wasn’t celebrated). Couldn’t get a dinner booking on our first night and our room key continually didn’t work. Rooms weren’t cleaned daily until 4pm and staff were unapologetic. Drink service at the pool was the best part.

reviews.author: BubblesVacations
reviews.title: Nice resort
reviews.text:
This is a long post so please read.  Hope it provides useful information. 

The resort is older and shoes it's age specifically when you walk the hallways to the rooms. 

Check in for us went smooth.
However, the room (Room 3327) we were given had AC issues and the shower leaked.  The maintenance guys were able to correct the issue a few days later but not the water leak.  So during our stay we used towels to clean up the water leak.

The restaurants are very nice but book a reservation to them at least 2 days in advance otherwise you will not be able to get in until late or just not at all.

NAOS, the buffet style restaurant was good.  However, there was not alot of variety and there seemed to be one station that offered left overs such as rice, beans,  meat etc.  Aside from that, there was a great waiter,   older gentleman that worked at this restaurant who made you feel so welcomed which, we really appreciated.  Blue Agave was another restaurant which serves breakfast and late lunch/dinner.  The other restaurants, Bana which serves Sushi, Vento which serves Tapas and The Market Grill which serves Rodizio and Mole which serves Mexican were all great.  These were a la carte  restaurants and the food was simply delicious. There were a few restaurants we did not visit because of time constraints. 

The host and chef at the Market Grill were great.  We let them know we were celebrating our daughter's birthday and they went ahead and prepared a cake for her.

There was not much entertainment during the day. At the main pool they kept playing the same songs repeatedly. In the evenings the shows were just okay. 

The Yhi spa was small but the staff was great.  Justina and Laura were fantastic!!!

Overall, we liked the restaurants and our massage.  Everything else was just okay.

reviews.author: Turtlegirl
reviews.title: Very nice resort
reviews.text: Spent a week there this month. Food was great, beach was combed every day.  There was nightly entertainment by the pool. Sometimes it was good, and sometimes you had to open your mind a bit (think Mayan Elvis.). But everyone was friendly and the buffet gave you everything you’d want for a meal. I stayed on the family part of a resort with my 18 year old nephew in a separate room. It was a bit older, but our housekeeping staff made sure to always check in and ask if we needed anything. Plenty of bars, and if you asked for something made with a certain liquor, you always got it. You just have to be specific. Well worth the price we paid for the all inclusive.

reviews.author: Rainbow S
reviews.title: Excellent Service in NAOS restaurant
reviews.text: Andres and Juan provided super great service at the NAOS restaurant.  The Concierge was also extremely helpful with booking a trip.   The nightly entertainment was varied and very good.  The inside entertainment was especially nice.

reviews.author: Sheila W
reviews.title: AWSOME AWSOME HOTEL !!!
reviews.text:
Great hotel, beautiful outside and inside. Hotel staff friendly. 8 restaurants food was good and drinks even better. Great rooms with a view and good wifi to use. You never even have to leave the resort if you don't want too. I did jet ski and parasaile from hotel and the jungle tour literally across the street, just walk no bus needed !! This hotel is my choice for next vacation again to Cancun !!
Don't miss out on a wonderful Cancun experience.

reviews.author: happynómada
reviews.title: Drinks sucks
reviews.text:
all Drinks are made with a fake non natural sugar endulcorant that taste just bad and is risky for people with severe allergies because they never alert that everything that they prepare alchohol or non alchohol drinks are made with the same product.

Not because is all inclusive that means that drinks and food are free we all pay for that and is not cheap.

Pools are extremely dangerous even for adult people because are so deep that you cannot relax or play as a family.

Showers at the rooms have the same issues .... they have a bathtub super high for normal people and you can fall trying to get into.

Blue Agave restaurant is the worst they take several time to have your order ready and when you are finally ready to eat  have your tacos just taste bad.

Be careful because between the sargassum, insecurity and all Cancun problems you should take care of your guests.

reviews.author: Lizary More
reviews.title: Great Stay, Great Service
reviews.text:
I went with my family for over a week. I booked a room on Family concierge, at arrival someone was waiting for us at the door, which then escorted us to the family concierge private check in. The process was flawless and effortless. The made sure everything was covered and explained. They assign you butlers that will do anything to accommodate your needs. In my particular case Fernanda Garcia went above and beyond to fulfill our needs, from the simple things as restaurant reservations to the other end which was find specific grocery needs.
This resort is highly recommended, it has great amenities, great views, great pools, great all. And they dont seize from pampering you.

reviews.author: Courtneylea94
reviews.title: If it wasnt so far from Australia we would be back every year!!
reviews.text:
This was our first time in Mexico & first time at an all inclusive hotel. Unfortunately we picked the worst time to visit Cancun as for 5/7 days we were there it poured rain the whole time!!! The hotel had great food (burgers, chips, fish, pizzas) and the alcohol drinks were not watered down. The bartender in the pool was amazing, he made special shots or cocktails for us. There is people from Aqua world near the pools so you are able to organise jet ski, or jungle tours through them.. The rooms were amazing, and cleaned twice per day. (we did not stay in Royal service, and I am happy we didn't!).. We were super lucky to have a Jacuzzi on our balcony. we will defiantly visit again, just not in hurricane season!!  

Only negative, was because there SO much rain and how heavy it was, our room began to let water in.. we had to put lots of towels down as the floor was wet. But this was nothing to complain about..

reviews.author: Beth C
reviews.title: Service - impeccable
reviews.text: Rafael and Reuben at the Market Grill have to be the best!!! IMPECCABLE service and we are hard to please. Very attentive. Knew our names after one day and our food preferences and drinks. They were great with our kids! Went back to back nights because of them. Amazing men who are great at their jobs!!!!! Thank you gentlemen for two wonderful dinners.

reviews.author: ukgirl48
reviews.title: Great Place For A Family Holiday
reviews.text: Stayed at this hotel after checking out of Dreams in Tulum (where we stayed for less than 24 hours). Great hotel in a good location. The food lovely and there is plenty of choice. Only problem is you have to ensure you book by 7am the day before you want to dine in a particular restaurant to make you get a reservation for that night. If you forget you have to eat in the buffet. The buffet is nice but the other restaurants  are a lot nicer. The service and staff are fantastic - they couldn’t do enough for you. A really amazing all inclusive with lovely pool areas. Highly recommend

reviews.author: spirzada
reviews.title: SP, Houston
reviews.text: Great Property. Family Concierge service is great and is a worthwhile upgrade for families with young kids. Beach is great, only issue being that it fills up quickly. YHI spa services were good. The night activities were great. Nice mix of restaurants at the property and overall good quality. Overall great stay and would probably come back to this property again.

reviews.author: Trey D
reviews.title: Fun time!
reviews.text:
My husband and our two year old and eight month old visited the resort and we had a great time! A few glitches but the positives outweigh the cons. 

-Check in process wasn’t fun. The lobby was really humid after a long ways travel. The front desk staff were not the most friendly either. Once we got our room, it wasn’t the room we booked initially. Plus, it was an outdated room for sure. Old looking furniture, and chipped up paint. However they upgraded us, and apologized. Our upgraded room was AMAZING. it was a beautiful one bedroom suit with a beautiful view of Cancun. We were really happy with that. 

After waiting for about an hour we were confronted by the melia rewards agent (who is basically a times share rep) and she offered us a gift if we went to this breakfast. Anyway, the next morning we went to a two hour presentation where they tried to sell us a $40K timeshare. We kindly refused and got our massages, they didn’t harass us after that. It was annoying tho. 

The food was good for an all inclusive. Not great but good. 

The cabanas on the beach/pool were the best for our babies! 

The hookah was great! 
 
Seaweed is crazy we got about two days of light seaweed which was nice. but I think it’s a Cancun thing and nothing the hotel can do. 

The staff was wonderful, and the spa was lovely. 

Overall the hotel was nice. Definitely 4 stars and great value for an all inclusive!

reviews.author: Sandra O
reviews.title: Resort is okay
reviews.text: Not much day activities but i guess for older couples this is a go to since its a very quiet resort compared to what im used to. Staff is very friendly our friend fransisco who is the bartender at red lounge club which you should definitly visit if your planning on coming to this resort, showed us an amazing time he and the rest of the bartenders were very nice and entertaining. Our room was a regular lagoon view room which had a wonderful view. I woke up every morning looking foward to that view, the food i genuwinly hated, i only enjoyed the a la cartes im not a picky eater but that food i just couldnt deal with also we had some technical issues with our room shower and some appliances but nothing serious. Staff was always willing to help.

reviews.author: Are_we_there_yet652
reviews.title: Luxury holiday!
reviews.text: Just returned from this fantastic luxury resort on Thursday 16th August. It was amazing, the beach was out of this world, staff were fantastic, we couldn't fault this holiday and have already decided to return next year. If you want high end quality then go here!

reviews.author: Rachel I
reviews.title: Meh.
reviews.text:
Pros:  Rooms are nice.  Buffet and bar staff went above and beyond and were fabulous!

Cons: Both during check in, check out, and several times when we had questions, there were anywhere from 3-5 people standing around with iPads.  Not one of them was able to answer any of our questions or help out in any way.  

I joined the "Melia Club" and checked in online several days in advance.  When we arrived at the check-in, there was a special line for club members. We sat in that line for several moments until someone told us we had to go to the other line.  There were additional people who had joined the line since we were there that were now in front of us.  The wait to check in was over 25 minutes.  I booked the resort with  my husband's credit card, but he was not on the trip.  It is the same account, but they made us rebook with my card and then refund his.  Bringing the card used to book the room was NOT listed on my confirmation email.  The room we reserved "wasn't available" and we were told it's not something the resort even offers.  I don't know how that's possible when I clicked the button for a two bed, ocean view room.  We were given a King size.  The room was nice, but we looked at a wall.  When we went to discuss this the next day as we were paying an additional $30/night for an ocean view, we were told that "nowhere on the website does it guarantee you a view" and that you are "either on the lagoon side or the ocean side".  (This is incorrect; see my attached photos.)  We were then given a different room that faced the ocean but had a poor view due to shrubbery.  Neither room had a stocked fridge when we arrived, however, when we went to take our stuff from the first room (we stayed one night there), the fridge was then stocked.  Lastly, there was a big difference in the height of the bathroom floor vs. the rest of the room.  I stubbed my toe in the middle of the night, and anyone with poor vision may end up doing it multiple times!

Dining: The buffet is great- good choices and variety, and they move relatively quickly to get you seated for meals.  Staff here went above and beyond!

We were not told at check-in that reservations were required for dinner.  I have been to several other all-inclusive Cancun resorts, some of which require reservations and others do not.  I have been informed at check in IF I need reservations at every other resort I've stayed at.  We went to get sushi, not realizing we needed reservations.  We were told we could not be seated because we didn't have a reservation, but there were *at least* 15 open tables.  After we pointed that out, they told us we could be seated in 15 minutes.  

Pools: We took a tour with a staff member of the hotel for an event.  She took us to the "adults only" side and showed us what the facilities in that area looked like.  The next day, we walked through the glass stores stating only "Adults Only" and attempted to settle in lounge chairs only to be told we didn't have the right color bracelet and the "adults only" side was only for patrons in Pyramid 5.  This was not previously explained to us nor is it posted at the entrance.

Pools were overall beautiful and were clean.  Service at the "regular" pools was slow.  Our server was very friendly but obviously had a big area to cover as she only came by once in about 2 hours.

All in all, we were very disappointed in such a highly rated resort.  While there was nothing earth-shattering like food poisoning, there were SO many little things that were not indicative of such a "nice" resort.  We will not be returning.

Pics are of our original room, the view from the Asian restaurant, or food, the room we switched to with a supposed “view, the empty fridge, doorway height discrepancy

reviews.author: Tutti T
reviews.title: Old room with many issues
reviews.text: Our room was very old and dirty. There were issues from the moment we checked in. We were entitled to an upgrade, which we didn’t get because they claimed rooms weren’t available. I looked on their own app and plenty of rooms were available for the duration of our stay. The AC failed. There was a hole in the bathroom. The curtains had mold. The toilet seat was disgusting. Oh, and then the ceiling started to fall apart. Things were not addressed until our last day there. It was too late at this point. The staff was nice though and food selection was OK. They need to clean the moss off the walls by the pool. It was gross.

reviews.author: Viviana V
reviews.title: Excellent vacation
reviews.text: Great vacation at paradissus excellent hotel great service we would definitivela  recommend the paradisus Meliá . We will try next time one in Playa del CARMEN. My only recommendation will be more daily entertainment

reviews.author: s p
reviews.title: Lovely resort and great service
reviews.text:
We opted for Royal Service which was definitely worth it as an all adult group. The butlers can be a bit hit and miss we discovered with the service they offer but no real complaints on that score. The resort is very clean and efficiently run, the staff try very hard to be pleasant and accommodating, we had one niggle which was dealt with quickly and satisfactorily. The pool area for the Royal service was excellent with cabanas your butler can reserve daily for you. The staff round the pool work tirelessly and always with a smile which made such a difference to our overall experience. La Palapa restaurant was fabulous, very attentive staff and delicious food special mention to Daniel, Valerie, Eddie, Cesare and Orlando... all fab.We enjoyed meals at the Asian restaurant and the Market Grill but cant say the same for Vento, the whole experience here was poor. 
The rooms are clean and spacious, perhaps not as luxurious as I was expecting and the air con was very noisy but no real complaints and we had a lovely view of the sea. There is a lot going on at the hotel and you are only a short cab ride into the centre which we did a couple of times and had a mad and fun evening at Coco Bongo. We would recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: leta g
reviews.title: Great 1st experience in Mexico!
reviews.text:
Let's just start by saying it has been a great holiday.

The food was to a great standard, buffet was always topped up and hot with great variety. The a la cartes also delivered restaurant standard service as if it wasn't a part of the hotel. They offered many food options and always asked if there were any allergies within the party before seating us. As a gluten free pescatarian I thought i may have had some difficulties and am usually prepared for the worst, however they were able to accommodate me perfectly.

There is WiFi throughout the hotel including around the pool area and the signal is very strong so you are able to stay well connected.

There was an issue with my room which was dealt with swiftly and upgraded The next day. 

The majority of the staff are very hospitable, very courteous and polite. However there was one incident with a staff member that was very discriminatory toward me and my family and i was extremely upset.

The management namely Angelica had the most excellent customer service skills and any issues we had she was able to resolve calmly and made me feel at ease.

All in all I would definitely recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: caymus2
reviews.title: First time all-inclusive - Wonderful service!
reviews.text:
First of all, I want to preface this review by noting that this was our first stay at an all-inclusive resort.  Also, we booked Royal Service – this hotel has a separate entry for Royal Service at Paradisus Cancun as well as Paradisus Cancun.  I’ll post this in both places.  Finally, it will be long, so I’ve divided into separate areas that might be of interest.

Arrival
We booked a special through Royal Service that included transportation to and from the resort.  As expected, it is chaotic right outside the arrivals area, but the representative seemed to know me and sought me out of the crowd!  He had a sign with our name, but it was very hard to locate, so we were very impressed with the service as well as the trip to the resort.

Checkin
As we had reserved Royal Service, we were escorted to the dedicated pyramid where we were greeted with a glass of sparkling wine.  They fitted us with our armbands, which are very nice.  All was going very smoothly until they told us that our one-bedroom suite would have two double beds and we prefer a king.  We were traveling for our son’s 18th birthday and specifically booked this type of room because it had a sofa bed in a separate room.  The employees at checkin seemed to know absolutely nothing about the room having a sofa bed.  (In fact, there was not only one but two in our room).

After getting our armbands, putting a credit card on file for incidentals, we were given an overview of the property and restaurants by Cristina, who was very welcoming.  The only complaint I have is that part of this “orientation” is a pitch for a time-share presentation.  We have a prior negative experience with a time-share, so we politely declined scheduling a 90-minute presentation.   Cristina did her best to convince us, but she was polite about it.

Butler
We were then introduced to Galindo, who would be our butler for our stay.  He escorted us to our room, where our luggage had already been delivered.  He helped set us up for dinner reservations, although none were available for the first night.  We instead ate at Blue Agave, which was very good.  It would be helpful if the Royal Service concierge/butler could reach out via e-mail prior to arrival to set up the first night’s reservations, as well as reservations for the Bali beds by the pool.

Galindo went out of his way to help us out throughout the trip – arranging special recognitions at the restaurant for our son’s birthday as well as decorations and special items for the room.  He also managed to get us a Bali bed for the next afternoon that was decorated with balloons – such a nice touch.  The entire Royal Service staff seemed to know that it was his birthday!  

Galindo also helped us to get the two days of Bali beds that we were entitled to under our reservations, as well as all subsequent restaurant reservations.  Overall, I would highly recommend Royal Service.  

Room
Our room had two double beds, a sofa bed, a separate room with a sofa bed and a chaise, as well as two full baths.  It was impeccably clean and maintained.  The mini bar was stocked each day and Galindo shared our preferences for beverages.

Pool/beach area
The dedicated Royal Service area of the pool was beautiful and service was excellent.  It was peaceful and relaxing.  The only problem we had during our whole stay (and we spent most of our time there) was a delay in getting towels on our first day.  They had completely run out for about 30 minutes.  

We did venture over to the main pool area and the vibe was completely different.  Those who want a more lively experience would probably enjoy that area best.  It did appear that the resort has the common problem of people “reserving” chairs early each morning only to return hours later.  In fact, we were not able to find two chairs together anywhere (this was around noon).  We stopped by the swim-up bar in the main pool to grab a quick drink.  The poor bartender was alone and was swamped.  After our drink, we were happy to return to the tranquility and service on the Royal Service side.

We didn’t spend much time on the beach, but could see that the service extended there as well.  Royal Service guests have a dedicated area.  The red flags were out for the duration of our stay, and there was seaweed, but neither of those things was in control of the resort.  

Main areas
The Royal Service atrium is where the dedicated lounge is located and was always very comfortable.  However, walking through the other pyramids was hot and humid to the point that you could see it in the air at times.  A few of the restaurants have areas in the main areas that were a bit warm, even in the evenings.  

Dining
Because we did not have reservations, we ate at Blue Agave our first night and enjoyed a variety of their tacos & quesadillas.  All were very good, and the service was excellent.  The temperature was comfortable, and we were seated immediately.  We also stopped by Naos, the buffet restaurant.  We were seated promptly, but returning with our plates, another patron was seated at our table.  She had seated herself and would not move, so we had to be reseated.   It was handled by the staff, but was a bit of an inconvenience.  The service was good and the selections varied, but we didn’t see a lot of reasons to return with all of the other options at the resort.

Bana is an Asian restaurant in the main pyramid, thus it was a little warm and humid there.  The food & service was very good – everyone enjoyed and a decorated table recognized our son’s birthday.

Fuego is a Latin fusion restaurant that we enjoyed.  We had an excellent view from our table, and the temperature was very comfortable.  Great service here as well.

My son loves Brazilian steakhouses, so we made reservations for Market Grill.  Our server ordered a special drink in honor of his birthday.  The food was very good and very plentiful!  Service was quick and attentive.  The only thing we didn’t like was the heat and humidity – the restaurant is open air with a beach view, but there are large glass panes, which limit the sea breezes.  

Reservations for a tasting menu at Tempo were included in our reservations package (it is normally an extra charge).  It is truly a fine dining experience – we loved everything about it.  The chef provided several small tastings in addition to the main plates.  The service was top notch and matched the fine dining experience.  I would definitely recommend for a special occasion.

We ate several breakfasts and lunches at La Palapa, which is exclusive to Royal Service and is located with a beach view.  Outside of Tempo, it was my overall favorite restaurant at the resort.  Always excellent service.  In addition to La Palapa, food and drinks are available throughout the day (including breakfast) in the Royal Service Lounge, which we enjoyed often.

One suggestion that I would make to the resort is to make menus available online or at least in the rooms, so that people can pre-plan.

Checkout
Checkout for us was a little strange.  We are used to not having to actually stop by a desk to check out.  Particularly in our case, we had pre-paid our stay and gave a credit card for the small amount of incidentals.  They actually make you visit the desk and even get a piece of paper to prove to the bellmen that you did so before you can leave.  Small annoyance, but others may be surprised by this as well.

Overall impression
We were very impressed with the service and were gladly surprised with the quality of food.  Being our first all-inclusive, we were a bit apprehensive but were happily surprised.  The resort is beautiful and very well maintained.  Aside from a few minor hiccups, we had a wonderful stay.  The Royal Service staff all went out of their way to make my son’s birthday special.  In my opinion, the Royal Service was definitely worth the extra cost.

reviews.author: qissa96
reviews.title: horrible management!
reviews.text: the resort itself is beautiful, however management is awful and unprofessional daughter was injured, resorts fault she was seen by dr at resort. I asked for incident report was refused but they wanted me to sign release of liability, very selfish and controlling! i called cheap Caribbean and they tried to reach out to them multiple times, however they ignored all emails and correspondence. cheap Caribbean is making them soooo much $$$$ however they disrespect your customers and YOU. spent so much money and have this happen ruined the vacation!!!

reviews.author: Stan S
reviews.title: Big Disappointment!
reviews.text: We started off waiting for an extended period of time after our check-in time because the room was not ready. When we finally arrived to the room some of the pillowcases and sheets were dirty and clearly have not been changed. We informed housekeeping on the floor had them change out the soiled linens. We had a mini fridge in the room. I opened it to get a bottle of water and it was warm. The fridge was plugged in, but not working. We called the front desk to notify and they said someone would be up in a few minutes. The maintenance man did not come until about 3 hours later. I called to make a reservation at a restaurant for the following day. Only one place had availability to make a reservation. When we arrived there the hostess could not find my name on the list. It took some convincing and we were finally seated. The whole hotel has NO air conditioning in the atrium or hallways. The restaurant was in the center of the hotel and everyone was hot and uncomfortable. We were literally sweating and did not even feel comfortable to eat. The next morning I was woken up to a sound of dripping water. I investigated the sound and found water to be dripping from the bathroom ceiling. I called the front desk. I was shocked that they sent someone up and they were unable to fix it and did not move our room. I asked the manager to please relocate us since the floor was very slippery and my girlfriend already fell. I feel this property has potential, but the management is terrible and leaves their customers unsatisfied. I cannot believe the property does not even have air conditioning in the common areas. I would  not return to this hotel again. Very disappointed. When we left we reported and even took pictures of our concerns, and not even an apology was received. As a corporate travel agent who has many clients travel to the area, I will not be recommending your property in the near future. I had hoped very much to have a pleasurable experience and was very let down.

reviews.author: Mikaela A
reviews.title: Simply amazing service!
reviews.text:
My mother and I have now stayed at the Paradisus with Royal Service for our third time in July 2018 with Rode as our Butler. The resort itself is absolutely amazing, but Rode is the one who truly makes sure our time there is perfect from beginning to end. 

After my first trip we became good friends with him and every trip since we have requested him as our butler and we refuse to stay at any other resort because of his (and the entire staff) excellent care. 

I come to Cancun for medical treatment and we have peace of mind knowing that Rode will have everything taken care of. He's very attentive and responds quickly whenever we give him a call and makes sure I have everything I need to have a comfortable stay after my treatments. He truly treats everyone like they're royalty and his love and dedication for his job shows. 

Out of all the resorts in Cancun, we are dedicated to the Paradisus and look no where else to stay during our trips. We are always guaranteed unparalleled service and have comfort knowing that everything will be taken care of for us thanks to Rode and the rest of the amazing staff. I HIGHLY recommend!!  Make sure to get Royal Service with Rode as your butler!

reviews.author: InKleined2Blue
reviews.title: Somewhat Disappointed
reviews.text:
Located in the hotel zone, it is easy to get to the shopping district or to other resorts. Almost all employees were polite, friendly, and helpful. These are the two saving graces.

Now for the room. We were in an ocean view junior suite. The suite had ample room, although much of it was wasted space (bedroom area, kitchen/dining area, two bathrooms). One of the bathrooms, while spacious, had issues: hairdryer didn't work (actually smelled of burnt electrical) and no hot water. This suite needed repairs and updating. The wall had a hole near the base boards, the entry area had deep holes in the tiles, the fan was rusty, the bed lumpy, and the furniture worn. Food was ample (not always stellar) and servers were excellent. We ate at Bana one evening and found the food substandard (except for the salad). The daily buffet is usually the best bet, but it is repetitious. Upon leaving, we noticed enroute to the airport that one of us had left a hat on the bed in the room. We immediately called the resort to secure the hat. Of course, the hat was not located and we were given the runaround about retrieving it. If the hotel manager contacts us with information about returning the hat, I will update this review to be more favorable. Would we return again? Let's see how the hotel manager responds.

reviews.author: tylerpetty2022
reviews.title: The Perfect Honeymoon Destination
reviews.text: FUTURE HUSBANDS PLANNING A HONEYMOON, SEARCH NO FURTHER. THIS IS THE PLACE FOR YOU.I spent 20+ hours painstakingly researching the perfect place to honeymoon for 6n/7d in Cancun and I made the best decision staying with Paradisus. I could not recommend this place more. When you drive past Paradisus, it's the kind of hotel that makes everybody look out the window and wish they were staying there. The lobby is awesome and the whole hotel feels like you're in a movie. Everything is beautiful across the entire hotel. STAFF:First thing I want to mention is the staff. Every single staff member we encountered was so incredibly kind and helpful, it felt like they were trained by Disney or Chick-fil-A. They would bend over backwards to help you and always did it with a smile. ROOM:I was a little worried about exactly which room we would be getting, but we stayed in the Royal service luxury junior suite ocean view room. It was exactly the room pictured on the website. Huge walk in shower with separate tub, super comfortable king bed, in room AC (the room stayed very cool which was great), stocked mini fridge (included in royal service package), private balcony overlooking the ocean and pools, and a staff that cleaned up the room and restocked the fridge constantly. 10/10 room.ROYAL SERVICE:I was a little skeptical about getting the royal service, because I was afraid there was going to be somebody hovering over us the whole time, but I am so glad we got it. Our butler (Rosanna) was only around when we needed her, and was always available when we did. She made dinner reservations for us every night and surprised us with rose petals on the bed a couple times. If you go with the Royal Service (which you definitely should) make sure you set up your WeChat account before you get there. Also, definitely take advantage of the included spa package. It was awesome. FOOD & DRINKThe food was seriously so good and they definitely weren't light handed on the drinks. It was all included with the Royal Service package. We ate every single meal at the resort and we tried as many things as possible. Everything we tried was delicious. There are so many restaurants that we ate dinner at a different place every night and we didn't even try them all!Overall, I couldn't recommend Paradisus more. We loved every second of our honeymoon there and you should FOR SURE go here if you're planning a honeymoon or romantic getaway. You won't be disappointed!

reviews.author: Stefano N
reviews.title: resort staff
reviews.text: I've just come back from this resort where I spent a week. I've been delighted by the support and courtesy of the resort staff. In particular I want to thank Alfredo Arcos, Ruben Alqudic (restaurant Naos) and Sofonias (attending the customers at pool). They made a difference. Great people and great satisfaction, making us feel at home.

reviews.author: lekimlan
reviews.title: Paradisus August 2018
reviews.text:
My husband and I, with our children (8 yr and 10 yr) were at Paradisus August, 2018.  Love the smells of the resort!  It’s like a HUGE garden of fresh floral.  Check in area was nice and room temperature was comfortable.  We arrived around 10AM and were able to check in to use their facility.   

To make travel easy, we packed our swimwear, sunblock, and any other pool essentials in our backpack and bell check our luggage until our room was ready.

Pool chairs were all taken by the time we arrive.  We asked an attendant (pool lady) to see if she can help us find some chairs and were in luck (most attendants are there most day, so they will know which one is available).   

Since the kids enjoyed the pool very much; we did not check into our room until 5PM.

Day 2:  We got a Cabana and it was so worth it ($150)!   It’s an all day rental, with a huge plate of seafood platter (whole lobster, shrimp cocktail, shrimp ceviche, grilled octopus, guacamole) and a bottle of champagne plus any food or drinks you want from Blue Agave, Market Grill, and poolside grill delivered to your cabana.   At the Cabana, you are assigned 1 to 2 personal waiters.  Our waiters were Manual V.  and Victor R.  They made sure we always have enough to eat and drink.   Cabana is a plus if you have children.  Since there was a nice breeze, we were out at pool area from 9AM to 6PM.    

Day 3:  Our kids love the Cabana, so we RSVP it again!  Since the pool lady (I feel so bad I didn’t get her name) knew we were coming, she had 2 extra lawn chairs for us as my husband and I like to have a little sun throughout the day.  Again we had Manuel and Victor and they were GREAT!

Pros:  Resort was very pretty, floral scents, and updated room (we stayed Pyramid 3 main 5th floor, ocean view), Food was good and not so SALTY! BLT, chicken wings, French fries (it’s always fresh) at Seaside Diner, buy the pool.  My daughter loves the nightly shows, which starts at 8:30PM, so book your dinner early so you do not miss the show.  Tacos at Blue Agave were delicious (opens 3PM).  WIFI is was definitely STRONG even at the beaches by the volleyball.

Cons:  Dinner -  Restaurants are always booked, so make sure you book when you arrive.  Gladly we read reviews, so we booked upon checking in.  A lot of seaweeds on the beach, but that’s just mother nature. 

Overall the staffs were extremely nice and very attentive.   We will definitely visit Paradisus again!

reviews.author: Rocio R
reviews.title: ADULTS ONLY ALL INCLUSIVE HOTEL
reviews.text:
We were 3 adults and reserved 2 rooms in the Royal Service .Total of 5 nights in this hotel and had a great time. Hotel was well located, few minutes from the shopping area. We did not rent a car, it was not necessary, just took the public bus outside the hotel. There is also a company across the street from hotel where you can book any beach activity ( snorkeling, jet skies, parasailing, etc) and inside the hotel there is OTIUM another company you can book. They were excellent too.
Our pyramid ( adults only area ) was perfect, sweet incense only in this part of the hotel which it made it more special. I love incense but for some people may be annoying after the third night...just a warning. The staff was amazingly cordial, attentive, helpful. Cristina gave us an introductory presentation of the hotel and their services. Good job Cristina!
We booked 2 deluxe suites ocean view. Rooms were amazing, view excellent. Clean, everything you need for a great stay. Very comfortable beds and pillows. Every night housekeeping left rose petals in our bed, chocolates and clean our room again if it was necessary. A minibar full of drinks included in the package. Bathrooms were so spacious, one suite had a tub. You will love the bathrooms.
We had our own butler (Rossana ) at our disposition all the time. She was excellent, very helpful, attentive, ready whenever we needed her.
Food and drinks at the concierge level was always right, breakfast, lunch or dinner, you have everything you need. You won’t see these kind of service in another All Inclusive Hotel.
Restaurants at the hotel: food was average on Nola,Market Grill, Palapas. Overall food needed more salt . “Enzo” restaurant unfortunately my husband got sick with one of their seafood soup. “Tempo “ restaurant was the best of our dinners, Chef was unique. Food class A superior. We had a great time!!
Pool activities: Bali Beds , please don’t forget to reserve one, they are just amazing!!! Go early in the morning since they are very popular. Waiters will brIng you any drink you want.
Beach: unfortunately the beach was the sad part of our trip, it was full of seaweeds which it made it imposible to swim. Beach had yellow and red flag during all our stay.
Shows: we just watched ELVIS show and nothing impressive. You can’t hardly understand the singer. Dancers were OK. 
SPA: massages were very good.
So overall we had a great stay but the food in the restaurants we tried were just like any other all inclusive hotel... nothing espectacular. Service and attention from the staff was excellent.

reviews.author: Yaquelin
reviews.title: Bad Experience
reviews.text: The hotel didn’t meet my expectations. The bed and pillows very uncomfortable. The check in process extremely slow and lack professionalism. We reported a cockroach in our room and they changed room without offering something else as courtesy. The only thing good at the hotel was excellent service provided by staff at the Naos international buffet from Christian and Florencio , oustanding service, thank you

reviews.author: teachinkidz
reviews.title: Paradise by Name!
reviews.text: Paradisus has the right word in its name...Paradise!!!  We spent March Break in tower 2 of Paradisus Cancun as guest of RCI.  Room was spectacular...clean and views to die for!   Check in was a breeze at the Melia desk, and our luggage arrived quickly to our room.   We enjoyed spending each day in a rented Bali bed by the Melia pool.  Marizza runs the area so well!  She is hard working, enthusiastic and a delight to talk to.  The Melia pool is shallow for the kids, and goes deeper just past the rocks.  It really met our needs.  Pool drink service was good too..we had a bucket of ice dropped off with ice and water each morning, and drinks throughout the day.  Sometimes, due to how busy it was it took a while to get drink orders, but it was easy enough to walk up to one of the pool bars to get an extra front before your order arrives.  We enjoyed taking walks along the beautiful beach, looking at the clear blue water. The ocean was wavy, but my kiddies loved jumping in the waves.   My kiddies loved the kids club and enjoyed the wax hand activity and the ceramics in particular.  There is also a hut by the kids pool that you can paint ceramics at an inexpensive cost.  The guy that works there is awesome and friendly.  He ensures that it looks amazing at the end.  Food was amazing.  We loved Market Grill, Vento, Fuego and Mole as a la carte restaurants.  Service was amazing.   Of special mention was Martin who we had a several of the restaurants.   Christian was great too.  We also enjoyed the night shows.  Elvis and Michael Jackson were the best!    The staff at Paradisus/Club Melia are what separates this resort from others and are one of the main reasons why we choose to return. They are friendly and go beyond their job description to make your stay amazing.   It appears as if they love their jobs.  We loved engaging in conversation with our butler Georgie, as well as many other Club Meliá and Paradisus Staff. All staff liked chatting and finding out more about us and what life was about where we lived.  We also enjoyed learning about Mexican life from them. This was our second consecutive March Break at this resort.  The staff make this resort feel like home, and the staff are truly like family.   Georgie, our butler took care of all of our needs and wishes, making our trip relaxing and extra memorable.  My kids are still talking about Georgie.  By the end of the week, many staff actually remember our names and address us by them.   have already booked March Break 2019 and are counting down the days!

reviews.author: Ghulub
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancún August trip
reviews.text:
We had a great time at the Paradisus Cancun!  Really enjoyed the restaurants especially Market Grill and Blue Agave.
We stayed in Royal Service.  Loved the RS Lounge as well as La Palapa for breakfast and lunch.  
There was a lot of seaweed this time(we’ve been here 3 times) but nature is always dynamic.  Last time the water was clear. We made the best of it as we love the ocean! 
I must give a shout out to our beach server Victor.... he was great!  Knew our names, what we drank, very personable and attentive.  Made for a very nice experience!

reviews.author: Will D
reviews.title: Nice week in Cancun
reviews.text: Booked two double rooms, got one double plus one king with a second room and sofa bed so that worked out great. The Paradisus was fun, some restaurants were very good, others just ok. Desserts were a disappointment, somewhat institutional in taste. Did not have any trouble making reservations, guessing those complaints are from people who wait too long (you can start as early as 7am the day before you want the restaurant).
