Pools were never crowded, swim up bar well run. The beach had a lot of seaweed, and they didn't make an effort to remove it so it smelled. Servers were usually very attentive. Reason for 4 stars and not 5 is we stayed at the Hyatt Ziva last year and I think they just went for a more premium experience, with better food, better beaches, and much better entertainment at night.

reviews.author: korey2016
reviews.title: Exceeded Expectations!!
reviews.text: The staff was excellent...all staff treated us with a friendly demeanor and all were very hard-working!  We especially want to thank DD, Jose, and Sophina by the pool!  Darwin was very knowledgeable at Enso's.  We really liked the Market Grill and Mole for restaurants.  We felt safe there, and had a very enjoyable time.  The hotel presented my daughter with a cake and decorated our room for her 6th birthday 😀.  Food overall was pretty good for all inclusive.  The hotel has nightly entertainment, and great music by the pool.  Drinks were good as well...we liked the blended mango margaritas the best 😀. The weather was great...only rained for like 15 minutes the whole week.  Parts of the hallways we're under construction and seaweed on the beach were only negatives.  Overall, this a great hotel with superb beauty and staff!! We definitely recommend 😀

reviews.author: David Ortiz
reviews.title: Exceeded expectations!!  Highly recommend!
reviews.text:
After careful review we went to Paradisus with our 3 kids and was the best decision we made. The staff is super friendly and helpful, and made sure they took care of us. The food was probably the best we’ve had at any resort hands down, starting from the buffet and finishing with all restaurants in the Hotel. We booked the Family Concierge package and was worth every penny. Since it’s a Melia hotel we thought we were going to get sabotaged into a timeshare meeting, but they didn’t bother us at all after they initially asked if we had any interest.

Hotel is in perfect location (not too close to all the craziness and not too far from being isolated either).  Would def go back!!! 

If you plan on renting a car, just know they charge about $100 / day if you book with the company inside the hotel! Way too expensive. Take a bus ride downtown and you can get way cheaper. 

** We tipped as much as possible (few dollars) to all the waitstaff, room service, and bell hops every time they helped...** goes a long way..

reviews.author: T P
reviews.title: Outstanding staff, excellent hotel
reviews.text:
We are staying at the hotel right now. This is our fifth time with Paradisus. We stayed at Paradisus La Perla in the past. Paradisus Cancun offers outstanding service by very pleasant and helpful staff, beach front location and delicious food options for the foodie. We upgraded to Royal Service this time and it’s totally worth it.

Daniel, our butler, is exceptional! He arranged a surprise for our occasion and goes above and beyond. Melinda at Royal Service check-in is excellent. Jose at the Royal Pool Concierge is awesome. Daphne gave us a great overview of the property. The staff at the Royal Service restaurant, La Palapa, and bar are simply outstanding: Cezar, Oscar, Julio.

Our favorite restaurant is Vento which is tapas. I’d say almost all food at this hotel, including buffets, is great and, even though restaurants require reservations, they are accommodating.

The people who work at Paradisus are always helpful, work very hard and are pleasant to interact with, which sets this hotel above the rest. That’s why we keep coming back. Highly recommended.

GP

reviews.author: b14nta
reviews.title: The Market
reviews.text: This was our second stay at this resort and the service in The Market was brilliant. The manager, Yamin Hernandez could not do enough for us, especially regarding our kids. she organised steamed veg or anything that we needed that was lied out. A big thank you to her for everything.

reviews.author: Judith31555
reviews.title: Family
reviews.text: Love love love this place . We were all so happy with service, food, amenities, kids clubs .. everything . We really appreciated the butler service with having 4 kids with us . Alejandro was the best!

reviews.author: Kris167
reviews.title: Relaxing Vacation
reviews.text:
Our family had wonderful vacation from Jul 31st-Aug 3rd in Paradisus. Stayed at Pyramid 3 on 3rd floor.  

Good : -

Food - Food was good at all the restaurants. For us best were enzo and Mole. Noah and vento was ok. Mole restaurant is very hard to book for dinner. Try to call early around 7am when the booking starts. 
Spa - Went for a back massage and Spa and massage was fantastic.
Stay - Room was really good, but only thing to complain was air conditioner. 

Bad ;-

Check -in - This process will really test your patience. We almost waited around 1 hour, since there were only 3 people at front desk and there were lot of people waiting to check-in. They should work on speeding up this process, never had to wait that long anywhere. 
Elevators - Some of the elevators with carpet were smelling very bad. We had to avoid some of them.
Appearance - Most of them hotel has vegetation inside, though its is maintained very well, there are some areas which show the ageing. 

Overall we had very relaxed vacation. Thanks to wonderful staff at Paradisus who server with smile and are very helpful.

reviews.author: Aline C
reviews.title: Not a happy experience
reviews.text: I am here and constantly irritated at this resort. Ever since we got here it’s being upsetting as only to check in we were waiting in line about 15 minutes. Every single time I come to the reception for anything it takes a long time to even be helped. I try to change dólares to pesos and every time they don’t have it and ask me to come back later, but the other side of the resort has them... when I go to the other side to change money then I need to take my passport or a copy because the two sides apparently don’t communicate. The room gets hot in the middle of the night and the AC can’t keep up. I swear at night and I have complained multiple times and nothing gets done. One time someone came over and re set the thermostat system and then the other times I complained nobody even came or followed up with me. The beds are comfortable and they did upgrade us to a bigger room since it was 3 adults and 1 child, but now every time I am asking for something or not satisfied with something they make sure to mention to me we were upgraded out of the goodness of their heart, as if I should be grateful and quiet. They did try very very hard to pressure us to pay $500 for the upgrade and I told the we had already spent so much money and I just couldn’t. Let me tell you that I spent over 3000 dólares in airfare and hotel for me and my 5 year old son for 6 nights, then we added my brother who met us here from Brazil for $142 a night and also we added my boyfriend for 2 nights for another $142 a night. We get here and everything is either for “Royal” or “family concierge”. Basically we are not paying enough to get the vest service you know. We go to the bar at the pool first night and it was 6pm. The bartender tell us he is only serving “royal” at that time. I was very upset because basically he was telling me I was not paying enough at an all inclusive resort to get a drink at the pool. Now I know also that the bars at the pools close at 5pm which is absurd to me. The beach is full of sargassum a type of nasty algae and just not good at all, but even if it was, they offer a special area for people with family concierge upgrade with lots of comfortable. For the regular folks only some not so comfortable metal chairs and tables and umbrellas. Also not many chairs, umbrellas and tables at the beach or pool. I asked for reservations at the 4 restaurants allowed to us regular folks with no upgrade. I received only 2 reservations. I was upset because my boyfriend was only staying two nights and I really wanted him to try one of the restaurants. I complained but nothing was done except the next day I received one new restaurant confirmation, however we left the room for the pool at 3:30pm not returning until 6pm. The reservation was put under my door for 6pm. Like really? The buffets have some good food and it tastes very good, however there isn’t much variety from day to day  so it’s the same stuff you are eating unless you are blessed to get reservations at the restaurants. A lot of people say on the reviews they experienced some amazing service here. A lot of people are very polite and friendly but a lot of them are also not trained well and don’t know correct information to give. I was told when we got here that they didn’t offer any beach umbrellas or chairs unless we upgraded. I was furious and then the guy asked around and informed me that they do offer that service. The reception has this very very strong soapy smell which gives me a headache every time since I always have to wait for help there. All in all I am just not happy because I spent way too much money to be served like this.

reviews.author: derek r
reviews.title: Okay
reviews.text:
I'll try to be short, simple and to the point.

Check in is not organized. Told to walk to the back to a place you can't find. Had to ask a few different people where to go. Decided to pass on the Family Concierge upgrade. $540. Don't think i would have used it much anyway. It was too hot to ever need a Bali bed. Dinner reservations were easy. 
Right after checking in a lady sits you down to offer you all these crazy discounts on tours if we go to breakfast for a couple hours in the morning. Thankfully i found a couple at the pool bar that day that warned me about it. It's $1400 once a year plus $250 a month. Then you still have to pay extra for air $$$ and All Inclusive which is $100 a day. Why would anybody ever do that? Just say you will show up and don't answer your phone the rest of the week. lol. I spend way less than that with Orbitz or any travel agent anywhere. 

Food was the worst I have ever had in a dozen years in Cancun. Seriously. My kids wouldn't eat anything but pancakes or hot dogs and hamburgers if they were available. Honestly I couldn't even tell what I was eating half the time.
Only ate at the Asian fusion and the sushi fine dining. Sushi was like Safeway. Asian was like frozen food. Gave up after that. Just ate out elsewhere. 
At least offer a taco or burrito for a day. nothing normal. You will understand when you get there.

Our room was amazing. room 3005. They gave me a king bed for 3 of us by mistake. They sent me down an extra single bed. I didn't complain cause the room, view and location was incredible. one of the new upgraded remodeled rooms. even with the extra bed there was still plenty of room. Ac would have this annoying knocking sound. would wake up almost every other hour because of it.

Bartenders were awesome at the swim up bar and the purple bar late in the evenings. I tip extremely well so i got poured nice nice drinks with premium alcohol. Tipping extra is always a good thing.

Hotel in general was beautiful. But no AC though. Always hot and muggy. sweating just going from your room to the restaurants. 

All and all it was okay. Just a little too big for my liking. I like a little smaller place where employees get to know you. Paradisus was okay just not my style. I will never like a time share pushy place. I should have done a little more research.
any questions feel free to ask.

reviews.author: Amy  T
reviews.title: First trip to Cancun and loved it!
reviews.text: My first trip to Cancun from Los Angeles and traveled with a friend- everything was amazing, relaxing, and the best service! From beginning to end the service was 5 stars. We had a lagoon view room with a balcony which was great, the pool overlooking ocean is a perfect hang out spot, loved the Market Grill Brazilian steakhouse restaurant and the Tapas Restaurant as well. The pool grill by the pool was just okay as well as the Enso Asian cuisine. The resort itself is large and beautiful, people are hard working and smile all the time! Such polite workers here. The pictures of the resort beach are misleading- it’s pretty but not clear water, it’s full of seaweed which means no swimming here. It doesn’t matter though since the ocean is across the street and book excursions through Aqua World. Do the Jungle tour for a fun speed boat that takes you out to snorkel in clear water and we saw so many fish!!! We also took jet skis on the water which was so much fun and absolutely loved the the day trip to Isla Mujeres- we snorkeled in the ocean and loved the taco lunch on the island. We loved every part of the visit- thank you!!! Can’t wait to try the Paradisus coming to Costa Rica!

reviews.author: odpbeta
reviews.title: Royal Service is worth staying
reviews.text: The experience of this service is exceptional.  I would save money for my family as it is worth it.  Beach is wonderful, palapa and service is on point, breakfast in the morning at the palapa is wonderful.  Spa service is exceptional as well.

reviews.author: gr8tfulkim
reviews.title: Club Melia Timeshare - Extremly disppointed/Feel scammed
reviews.text: Paradisus is amazing - beautiful and excellent customer service.  Do not sign up for the timeshare.  We were scammed.  They did not tell us that we could only use the points on even years (not odd), and also they told us that we could use the points toward other sister hotels. These sister locations only honor a small portion of your points toward your stay, and also the sister hotels are not in prime locations (far away from sites).  Also be careful, they serve you champagne and move quickly as you are signing all of the paperwork (small print).   We have lost thousands of dollars.  My husband and I are extremely disappointed.

reviews.author: Paul D
reviews.title: My rating: 5 start +
reviews.text:
We came to Paradisus Cancun for a week away from life's hustle and bustle at home. 
What a pleasant surprise to have found this resort. 
We had upgraded to "Royal Service". Ocean view, less than 200' from the beach. WOW!
Money well spend. Service was beyond our expectations. 
Every meal was a culinary experience. Attention to detail showed the professional approach by the food service team. 
Every team member observed an obvious unique to this hotel greeting manner: hand over the heart while acknowledging our presence. This small gesture had a real impact on our overall experience in Paradisus Cancun. Like Arnold said: we will be back!

reviews.author: Courtney S
reviews.title: Amazing experience!
reviews.text: The Royal Service experience exceed all of our expectations. Our butler, Leyner, went above and beyond in ensuring I had the best possible birthday trip! I would absolutely stay at the Royal Service portion of this property again!

reviews.author: Ayalar1
reviews.title: Summer ‘18 Getaway
reviews.text:
6th time in Cancun, but 1st time lodging at this resort. This was the best resort I’ve stayed at in Cancun. My husband and I had an awesome time. The attentiveness we received from all the staff was amazing. They were extremely helpful and caring to your every need. 
Only downside is that they close the pool at 8pm. But I guess they have their reason for this. Also, we had a lot of unattended children in the pool and taking up the swim up bar. It was hard for the people to order drinks. I think the swim up bar should be limited to adults only. 
Overall, we had an amazing time and would definitely come back next time we’re back in Cancun.

reviews.author: samias87
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: TI is a beautiful property but the beach has so much seaweed that you cannot swimming. Buffet was OK...they didn't have a lot of seafood options. We weren't able to try many of the restaurants. Really wished we could have swim some more.

reviews.author: Jeffnpa
reviews.title: Wonderful relaxing resort
reviews.text:
I start this review noting that we only stayed on the royal service side, and that my wife and I are very busy people professionally and with our family so we wanted a resort that allowed us to do nothing. 

Day 1 arrival day! I recommend using USA TRANSFERS they were easy to find and friendly, they got us to the resort w/o any issues and told us about the culture of the area. 

Check in,  we were greeted by the staff who took our luggage and walked us inside where we were met by another staff who took our name and seated us while they went to get the royal service staff. After 5 minutes we were escorted to the royal service area and met with a drink. They explained the hotel and services and that our butler would be meeting with us shortly. We met our butler (Daniel) who explained his role and since our room was not ready he took us to LaPalapa, an exclusive royal service restaurant. The food was wonderful, we had a great lunch and Daniel took us to a Bali bed while our room was being ready. At 1500 hrs he texted us to say the room was ready, he gave us the tour of our wonderful room. The rest of the day was spent using the pool and pool bar for drinks. We had dinner at Vento which is a tapas restaurant. The food was great, the service even better.

Day 2,

We started off with the breakfast area for royal service  guest, fruit, cereals,eggs, pastries, everything was good. We had a Bali bed by the pool so we spend the entire day there. We had Ramon serve us water and drinks all day. We ordered lunch around 1 and had wings, nachos, spring rolls. Everything was so good. The downside to the day was it rained, for 5 mins lol!! 
Dinner was at Bana, it is Asian and we didn't want a lot of food so we ordered crab salads and each of us got sushi rolls. OMG, this sushi was to die for, so fresh and so yummy we thought about ordering more but they brought us dessert and we had 
enough. We would eat at Bana's again and again.

Day3
We had a 10 am spa treatment and arrived at 9 as suggested, the 45 minute hydro treatment was great, steam/shower/sauna/ hydro pool and then off to the couples massage. Very relaxing and needed. After the spa we went to see if our butler had gotten us a Bali bed and of course he did. We enjoyed the pool and bar service all day. Dinner was at Enso, which was yummy. My wife's only issue was the shrimp are prepared w the heads still on. But on there than that the food was tasty and flavorful.

Day 4, 

Another day in paradise, 
We did nothing special today even though it was our anniversary. We went to the pool and got our Bali bed and chilled, they brought our lunch and drinks all day, it rained for approx 5 minutes and that was it. Our butler had the room made up with roses and it was very nice of him. The dinner was at Feguo and our waiter, christen was great, he recommended food choices and we got 3 appetizers shrimp ceviche, grouper and shrimp bisque soup everything was so good. I got the steak and my wife the chicken which we both loved.  As we are nearing the end of the trip so far we rank the restaurants 
1, Bana
2 a Vento
2b fequo 
3 Enso

reviews.author: jasminerodriguez486
reviews.title: Beautiful views , good food
reviews.text:
Pros: Beautiful decor,  good restaurants , large food selection and again the best waiters ever. 
Con : I booked through Melia rewards and their rooms suck ! like compared to the rest of the hotel it felt like a motel 6. We had just come from paradisus Playa del Carmen concierge room which was heaven , unfortunately when I booked this trip they didn't have availability at Cancun concierge. So I went with regular room from melia rewards members. Never again . I would stay at this hotel again definitely , just not through their rewards room even if it meant saving a few $. Oh , and the hosts are a little time share pushy. Like he wouldn't stop calling the room -_-.

But well worth it  just for the views!

reviews.author: Michael M
reviews.title: Excellent resort to stay at in cancun
reviews.text: The service at the hotel was amazing.  Whatever we needed or asked for was delivered.  Our conceirge, Jose was always asking if we needed anything.  Eden and Eder at the pool bar went above and beyond at all times.  The restaurants were all amazing.  Bana was our favorite.  my son loved the steak at Fuego.  The tacos at Blue Agave were amazing.  It was so nice to have an all inclusive and be able to relax.  The location was perfect and we were able to walk across the street to Aqua World for activities.  I did not know what to expect, but this place has made me a believer.  Great experience.

reviews.author: larik95
reviews.title: Saúl Zárate entretener
reviews.text: THE BEST ENTERTAINER EVEEEEER, he's very funny, and friendly, he was always inviting the guests to the activities in the hotel. Loved my days in the hotel, it's amazing ! Really good and great service.

reviews.author: baruch m
reviews.title: Absolutely beautiful
reviews.text: This hotel resort is beyond stunning the service is amazing and the ambiance is just breathtaking there's a zen like vibe throughout the hotel but especially building number 5 the royal service is just amazing

reviews.author: Yaoob J
reviews.title: We Chose Wrong
reviews.text:
Maybe we were unlucky, or maybe we had higher hopes than most. I will give you a summary of our experience first and if you wish to read onto details, please do. I do recommend researching other hotels before booking here. 

Summary of the Good:
Nice pools
Exceptionally Nice Staff
HydroTherapy was cool
Cleanliness

Summary of the Bad:
Fake Alcohol
Bad Food
Unswimmable Ocean Beachside
Fiance was Drugged!

Details:
My fiance and I booked an all inclusive here for 5 days based on previous reviews and had really high hopes here. After check-in, we were greeted by a staff member who will pitch you discounts and deals upon your stay IF you agree to attend a 90 minute breakfast and presentation the following morning. The deals looked appealing so we did that. We met the following morning with the hotel/ Melia representative, had breakfast, and listened to her pitch. Basically, they ask you to invest $30,000 USD and receive 50 years of hotel exclusives all around the world that Melia caters to. We politely declined as we planned to because..... $30,000 are you kidding me?!?! We still received the discounts and freebies. 
The room was nice, although it took a good 5 minutes to walk to the lobby and restaurants everyday. The plus side is that our room was close to the adults only pool. The pools were clean with friendly staff offering you anything you wanted (food, drink, towels, etc). We wanted an all inclusive because we expected to drink a lot. After my first scotch, I noticed something wrong. It wasn't real Johnnie Walker Black Label (which I adore). I tried a Jack Daniels on the rocks... Still not what I expected. After the first two days I stopped drinking completely because I knew the alcohol was tainted with water or something else. On this topic, my fiance can drink me under the table and after only three drinks the entire evening, she had to go to the room and vomit. She was vomiting for a good half hour before she blacked out and I had to carry her to the bed. I was dumping water down her throat all night trying to get her to drink. She couldn't even move and I was to the point of calling an un-trusted doctor until she broke through. The following day was lost. We stayed in the room all day as I took care of her. Making sure she drank a lot of water and pepto throughout the day. She told me she almost felt like dying. Recent reports of people blacking out in Cancun due to the same thing serviced yesterday as I type this, some even dying due to drugged or tainted drinks. Reading this made me sick to my stomach.

There are about 9 or so restaurants in the hotel. We tried about 5 of them throughout our stay. One of them is not included in our package and requires a $200 USD per person fee (no thanks). All of the food we tried was terrible and tasted the same in every restaurant as if there was one kitchen for every restaurant. Sushi had a drop of fish in a mountain of rice and the chicken was rubbery. Our last night we decided to go to Rosa Negra across the street and pay for good food. Thank God we did that!

We wanted to swim in the ocean, however we couldn't. There were vast amounts of seaweed all over. Some resorts we were told clean the seaweed; Paradisus does not. The beach is un swimmable, but the sand is nice to lay out in if you're about 40 yards back from the shoreline filled with seaweed.

I will say throughout our whole stay, the staff was the best part of the trip. They really are hard workers and were so nice to us. I definitely tipped them everyday until I was broke. 
Some bad weather forced us indoors were we tried out the HydroTherapy included in our package. Sauna and steam room felt great for detoxing the terrible food and drinks we had. Giant whirlpool was extremely relaxing as well.

In the end, we were two youngsters wanting ocean, good drinks, and good food. We received none of that here. However, I did give my girl a ring during this trip so this place is somewhat special to us. A place we will travel to never again.

reviews.author: Megan B
reviews.title: One of the Nicest Resorts in Cancun, Great Value
reviews.text: We traveled here on short notice and absolutely loved our time. First of all, Cancun is one of the best beaches I've visited (white sand, waves you can swim in, aqua waters, and pleasant air and water temperatures).  Cancun is more commercial than say someplace more remote in the South Pacific or the Maldives. However, this also provides more activities beyond the beach if you wish to partake, such as golf, spa treatments, nightclubs, Mayan ruins, a host of water excursions, etc. Paradisus is generally thought of as one of the nicest resorts in Cancun, and with good reason. The rooms are well-appointed and always clean, with a huge shower with glass on 2 sides, for watching the sunset while you wash off the beach. (Just trust me, it is awesome.) Paradisus had one of the nicest beach areas of the resorts, with little umbrella huts and even bali beds available for shade options. We stayed over in the adults only Royal Service section, so couples can enjoy more privacy, but there are other sections designed for families with young kids. There was a concierge that would bring drinks and food to you on the beach. We did have trouble obtaining a reservation at any of the 9 reservation-only restaurants at the resort every night for dinner, even with a butler doing this for us. The food was all excellent, and we were indeed treated like royalty everywhere we went. There was plenty to do, but it is also the perfect setting for doing nothing and just relaxing. The all-inclusive booking made this vacation a great value! I would recommend this to anyone - couples, families, and groups. It would take years to list out all of the amenities that this resort has, but I can almost assure you that if you can dream it in Cancun, they can make it happen for you.

reviews.author: Artur
reviews.title: Really nice!
reviews.text:
+
Fast service
Quality and choice at the buffet
Beach and pool areas are super nice
Waitresses on the beach( specially Asunaon, very friendly)

-
If you are in the room in the evening might get quite noisy because of the live music, but didn't bother us very much. I guess depends where your room located. It's a huge hotel.
Needs renovation in the bathrooms
No kettles in the room, some might need one to prepare baby food. But room service could make you a hot water and bring it to you. Just takes time

reviews.author: Joseph M
reviews.title: My 40th birthday
reviews.text:
This trip was my gift from my girlfriend for my 40th which is today as I type this and our 2nd day here on property. My gf's work associate has a time share with club Melia vacation which he pays good money for. He offered it to her to help her with this trip. He told us what to do and where to eat at the places he likes to go. He also told us that if we wanted to, there is a pay per day option for all inclusive.

When we arrived yesterday at check in we were hit with sort of a mental brick wall. According to the bellman and check in desks our bracelets we get for Club Melia are pretty much worthless and get us nothing but property access. Which I'm ok with but that also meant, according to them, NO RESTAURANTS OR BARS would accept us because they dont take money. The only thing we had as options were the McDonalds across the street,(yes you heard me correctly and I took that as an insult) Buffet or two on site restaurants that were basically $100 per person each dine. Or......We can pay the $100 per person, per day for all inclusive with a minimum of 3 days($600.) 

Now we dont have much money. My gf took this vacation to help her with her budget. It's not really even about the money to be honest. It's the fact its pressured upon us to do this just to enjoy ourselves. Not being able to pay a bar for a drink or two or go eat on the resort paying for a meal without having to do it in a packaged bundle is kind of ridiculous. 

Not to mention as I sit here and type this my drain in the bathroom is being snaked because while my gf tried to wash out the tub to draw a bath the drain next to it started overflowing with water all over the bathroom floor. Coupled that with the flying ants that are everywhere in that bathroom this hasn't been the best start to a 40th birthday. 

I came here for a getaway from any issues and stress. So far only Pasqual at the buffet has been the most helpful and the most sincere on this trip. I feel like the staff here at check in were very misleading and are trying to get more money from us. Asking around and talking to other guests we've come to know that there are places we can go eat and drink that accept cash/credit cards. The all inclusive shakedown was a ploy to get more money from us.

The thing they dont realize is that I work in the Hotel Industry. I've been in the Hospitality business for almost 15 years. I know service. I know what to expect from service too. So far in 2 days we were hit with 2 people who gave us false information and our room I feel like was known to have these issues but was given to us because we didnt take the all inclusive package. This section of the 2nd pyramid (there's 5 total I believe) looks worn down.

I'm hoping the next 4 days here go a little smoother with less water on our floor and with actual service without false information. As of now I wouldnt recommend this property unless you have the money to get all inclusive or Royal Service. In my opinion a hotel stay or EXPERIENCE shouldn't depend on the color bracelet you have.

reviews.author: daliamalouf
reviews.title: Outstanding luxury  property with stellar service. Employees are heartfelt and happy.
reviews.text: Love,love this hotel. Everything was absolutely amazing except the seaweed on the beach.  Brown carpet of seaweed. This is not the prestine waters of Cancun. No complaints about hotel just beach condition. I suggest hotel install a live webcam to show beaches to potential guests.

reviews.author: Morgan G
reviews.title: A Jewel of Cancun!
reviews.text:
Wow! I am a travel agent and have visited many all-inclusive resorts and this one is at the top. We stayed at the Royal Service section and it did NOT disappoint. We both agreed the staff here were the friendliest we have ever encountered. We also feel the drinks are the best we’ve had —-garnished beautifully. Our butler/host Daniel was incredible and “no” was not an answer for him—-anything we asked he made happen! We needed a cooler and ice pack for breast milk and he arranged for a friend to pick them up for us at a local Walmart.
The included Bali beds for royal service are a MUST. Most resorts charge extra for this (even Sandals) so we were pleasantly surprised to find them reserved for us when we arrived.
The food was delicious as well, we loved La Palapa (Daniel there has impeccable service too and even brought us pizza to our Bala bed when they normally didn’t provide that on the pool menu).
Our only complaints were the heat inside the resort (very stifling and hard to enjoy your dinner if dining at ones at the center) and that there weren’t welcome drinks and a cool towel upon arrival. We also missed straws in drinks. But those are extremely small annoyances. 
Also, most staff at resorts make you feel obligated to tip even though it is “included”. We never ever felt that here which honestly made us even want to tip more. 

Five star and buen trabajo Paradisus!

reviews.author: Maureen V
reviews.title: Underwhelmed.
reviews.text:
The hotel decor was beautiful in the main area.  However, there were a lot of hazards walking around, i.e., slippery floors, no handrails, dark hallways, etc.  It was very difficult to get dinner reservations.  My 12 year old son really did not like it at all.  Pool appeared clean, however, when we had a mask on you can see all sorts of stuff floating in the pool! Yuck!  
Some people in our party thought the wait service was terrible.  We have been to other Melia's which were much better (Punta Cana, NYC)

reviews.author: Christee21
reviews.title: Same name totally different resort!
reviews.text: I wish I could give this resort 4 stars but I can’t. Reason being, during our stay we had 2 days of rain. Be warned, there is absolutely nothing to do at the resort if the weather is bad but eat. I was on a family vacation with about 15 people, 7 kids total. The kids ages ranged from 10-17. They were confined to their rooms playing games and on their phones because of boredom. I had an ocean view room which was modern and beautiful, I can’t say the same for my sister. Her room was a bit dated, refrigerator did not work and air conditioner did not cool the room. Also many places in the hotel was extremely hot, a few restaurants had air conditioning. Overall the food was decent, a bit repetitive at the buffet and we had to make separate reservations at the restaurants because many of them could not accommodate our Party size. Asian inspired restaurant was delicious. For the most part hotel was clean, staff friendly. Hotel entertainment was lacking. We all expected more because of the wonderful punta Cana location that we stayed at for my sisters wedding this is why we all came back together to help celebrate their fifth year anniversary. We all said we should have went back to the punta Cana location. P.S. no real party life atmosphere, total relaxation. The grounds was totally beautiful and well maintained.

reviews.author: ranakorma
reviews.title: Amazing Hotel
reviews.text: We just returned from our visit to this amzing hotel our room was on the third tower, seventh floor ocean veiw everything was amazing, i want to thank the manager Eduardo ramos and the chefs Eduardo, Alan , and Antonio and Pascual from Naos buffet for making us feel special and Omar from the intertaiment team .everyone went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and comfortable, love u Guys can’t wait to come back.

reviews.author: 1cjdavis
reviews.title: Quick Anniversary Trip
reviews.text: We made a quick 3 night trip to celebrate our Anniversary and to relax before the rat race started back, so we did not get to enjoy all that was offered. Here are a few takes from our short visit. The check in was easy. We had our rooms within a few, but they should offer you a drink upon arrival. We stayed in pyrimad 3 which right next to everything. I would recommend. The rooms are small but nice. Would be tough for more than two in a room. Also, floors can get very slick, but really enjoyed all of the amenities. One complaint: They did not stock our bar when requested. We only had a chance to eat an Bano buffet and Fuego because the others were booked. Food was very good but they need to evaluate the reservation system because we observed many empty tables in the booked restaurants. The pool is very nice but little entertainment. The only music was that of another customer. Overall loved the pool and had no problem getting chairs and drinks were good and never ending. Beach was beautiful but rough so we only went down for a few pics. Pretty laid back place in the evenings. Noticed most were in bed by 11:00. We enjoyed both clubs all three evenings. Overall a great trip. One suggestion: I would avoid the sales pitch  because they are very pushy. Also the service was great even though we noticed very few tipping. Take a few dollars to tip because they greatly appreciate it. We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Michelle W
reviews.title: Relaxing and Great Service!
reviews.text: This is our second time enjoying Paradisus Cancun. We are sad that our butler Eduardo from last time was no longer with the company. He was excellent! However, we got lucky again with Daniel as our butler. He is just as awesome. I highly recommend booking a room on the Royal Service side. Service is impeccable, and feels so warm and kind. The best part is lounging around in the Bali beds poolside, and eating and drinking. This was total gluttony and epic laziness, but it was definitely what we were looking for to disconnect, recharge and relax. I also got to enjoy a relaxing massage with Liliana. You could tell she was really experienced and knew what she was doing. My husband obviously enjoyed his massage with Brenda because he was snoring almost the entire time. Haha. Love this place! Will definitely come back!

reviews.author: ShakR
reviews.title: Loved This Hotel
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun on the Royal Service wing and it was amazing. Hector, our Butler, was fantastic. He made sure our dinner reservations were made in advance, he booked Bali Beds for our entire stay and catered to our every need. The hotel was absolutely beautiful and well maintained. There were tons of food options and it even had a “night club” that you could go to in the evening. All in all, I would recommend this hotel specifically the Royal Service option if you’re looking for a comfortable place to stay.

reviews.author: Andrea B
reviews.title: very nice family vacation
reviews.text: Wanted a relaxing vacation after a very tough few months at work and got exactly what I needed: luxury accomodations, great food, great service. Did not leave the hotel at all. All I did was eat, sleep, read, swim and walk on the beach. 2 minutes walking distance from the hotel is Aquaworld where my teenagers did all the water sports you can think about.My favorite staff member was Cristian Lovera, always made sure we had a great time at the restaurant. Maria and Gloria, out butlers were also very good. This is the place where I will return whenever I need relaxation to be able to recharge my batteries!

reviews.author: Ligia B
reviews.title: Fun girls trip in Cancun
reviews.text: Traveled 5 days with friends. Had been to Paradisus in Riviera Maya and was hoping for same luxe experience. Was not the same and I would go back to Other one. The beach was nice but had seaweed in many areas. Was in Royal Service and private pool and restaurant were great. Butler was out for 2 days and hotel should have assigned new one but didn’t. Restaurants were better than most AI places but sushi one was meh, and better at other Paradisus in general. Very attentive staff. The Tempo restaurant (not included) was phenomenal and worth every penny! NYC high end restaurant worthy. Spa was ok-services great, facility and space is not grand and much better in other hotels.

reviews.author: Florina C
reviews.title: Beautiful resort and great service!
reviews.text:
We visited Paradisus Cancun by Melia between July 29- August 3! Me and my husband and our boys 7 and 11 years old.Great resort and great service at the restaurants and to the pool bar. The best restaurants after our opinion were Mole and Blue Agave which were the most authentic restaurants from all! Alejandro , the server from Blue Agave made sure that my boys will have the tres leches cake at the end of their dinner! Excellent service and the best authentic tacos in town! Julio,the pool barman did a great job making sure everyone was served right away!
I had a massage at the spa and again best service! Leila , my masseuse was so  careful and really paid attention to my requests!
The lower grounds were very nice maintained! We were staying in the central building #3, which probably is the oldest one! Its true that the rooms need a bit more TLC  and the AC need more power, but when my husband asked the front desk to come to change the filter to the AC , probably in the next 10 min it was changed! I think that it was more appreciated than any of the other small things which needed to be replaced! We seen the maintaining teams all the time in the building or outside repairing and fixing stuff and from small talks with the employees they really like the upper management and the way how they are treating them! Great job Paradisus Cancun! We will come back to visit in February 2019 for tacos at Blue Agave!

reviews.author: Rebecca M
reviews.title: Great family vacation
reviews.text: Stayed July 1-8th. Family of four. We had Family Concierge Suite-Ocean View. Upon arriving Sunday we were taken to our room which was on ground level. I told my husband ground level really isn't a ocean view. I was right. We get into the room which was huge but the view was of a pool and the roof of the snack shack. We only had 1 balcony when we were supposed to have 2. I of course complained and was told that we could move rooms Tuesday morning as all the other rooms were booked. Not much we could do so we were ok with that. Hotel grounds/lobby are GORGEOUS. We were assigned 2 butlers, Fernanda and Violeta. They were so gracious and helpful with our requests-needs. We were celebrating my daughters 12th birthday and my husband's 50th and on those days, we would come back to room and they had made sure to decorate the room/leave birthday treats. When we got our new room Tuesday HOLY MOLY-The ocean view was SPECTACULAR! We were in room 3601. One day we reserved a beach cabana and it was really nice. The waiter had the drinks coming. We got the lobster/seafood tray and champagne with the rental. SO DELICIOUS. 2 other days we rented poolside cabanas (which also came with the champagne-seafood platter). Well worth it since EARLY in the morning people drift to the pool to leave their towels to "claim" chairs around the pool.  The butlers handle all cabana rentals and dinner reservations for you. We tried almost all the restaurants and our favorites were Market Grill, Fuego, Naos Buffet-breakfast (the servers were awesome!) and Blue Agave The other restaurants were ok: Bana-food was great but we could never seem to find our server. ENSO-Blah. Vento was ok.  MOLE-ok but we felt rushed. Overall GREAT vacation. We already booked for next year.

reviews.author: Momof2travelerTXNY
reviews.title: Beautiful pyramid, relaxing stay
reviews.text:
Just got back from here and I have to say, we truly enjoyed ourselves.  As with any property, if you really wanted to dissect it, there are pros and cons to everything.  Overall, this was a relaxing and beautiful resort! Kathia at Naos, Felipe the busboy, Jose my Nespresso guru and the omelet lady for breakfast (picture in my review) all get an A+ in my book!

Not 5 stars b/c the quality is lacking just a bit as they cater to A LOT of rooms/people, but still excellent.

Pros:

·        Big hotel with lots of food options.  Dinner restaurants are reservation only (that can get tricky) but if you don’t make reservations, the buffet is always open.  If you can’t find something to eat at the buffet, you are very picky! Breakfast was my favorite part but I always found SOMETHING to eat.
·        Beach is simply amazing! The water was a *bit* choppy while we were there but still could swim and enjoy. The weather was AMAZING this time of year.  Breezy and 82 everyday!
·        Hard workers can be found EVERYWHERE!!! Really! It’s amazing to see what it takes to keep this resort so beautiful.  I ALWAYS saw someone cleaning, watering plants, cleaning the hundreds of vines that fall from the center, sweeping etc…. Hard working people!
·        The resort is literally across the stress from AquaWorld if you want to partake in any water activities. All you do is cross the street.
·        Ocean view room was worth it!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
·        The Noon Maya show by the pool was pretty cool.
·        The seafood platter from Cocos Beach Club was the most amazing thing I have ever seen!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Highlight of our trip!

Cons:
·        Swim up pool is nice but they close early, at 6 pm.  Who closes a pool that early? That’s a first for me!
·        There are stairs.  A lot of them.  All over the resort.  It’s shaped like a pyramid so expect pyramid type stairs.  Not a huge issue for me but it could be for others.
·        While we were there, the Nespresso bar only opened from 11-6.  I drink my coffee in the early morning. Again, they have coffee in your room and at the buffet but I LOVEDDDD my daily coffee from Mr. Jose so I want to whine about this.  The hours are not posted so I just asked him. The day we left, it seemed they were changing them so I guess it’s a weekly/monthly thing.  In any case, I would’ve wanted earlier coffee hours. I miss Jose already =(
·        Same with the Gelato location.  They were only open 12-5 while we were there. I get they have to cut costs in some areas but some days we couldn’t get crepes b/c they were closed.  However, the lady that makes them is SUPER sweet!!!!!!!!! When we did have them, my kids said that was their favorite part! She was very sweet.  She was handling both the Gelato and the Crepes alone. Always with a line but always with a smile!
·        The Asian food was really not good. As in really bad. I hate to even say that but save your reservations for any place other than Bana and Enso. Bana was tempting b/c it’s the restaurant smack in the middle of the hotel but no bueno.  And Enso was by far our worst meal. BUT we just ended up grabbing a bite at Naos (the buffet) so we really can’t complain much b/c like I said, you can always find food!
·        The evening performances leave a lot to be desired. Don’t expect a Broadway show.

reviews.author: perezrichard92
reviews.title: Save yourself and go to the Playa Del Carmen Paradisus
reviews.text: Came here with my girlfriend to celebrate our / year dating anniversary. Now, I know it isn’t a huge deal considering wedding anniversaries take priority, but still, I shelled out good, hard earned money and even upgraded to their “Royal Service”. My checkin was a disaster, having to wait nearly 2-3 hours before being given a room due to various miscommunication issues within their team. Then, they give us a room with a non functioning toilet, our housekeeping the following day did not have our room clean until 3-4PM despite waking us up at 930AM to clean it. Our welcome amenity was a day late, mind you I had to ask again where it was. Overall, the hotel itself was enjoyable due to us just trying to make the most of it, but if you are considering here or Playa del Carmen, I wholeheartedly recommend Playa. They know how to really take care of guests.

reviews.author: Elenin N
reviews.title: Great Vacations
reviews.text: I went with my husband and my 10 years old son,  we had a great time at Paradisus, everyone was so nice a friendly,  always smiling and ready to take care of you,  I just remember some names: Martin,  Edwin,  Pascual, Arturo,  Cristian. Tania y Héctor in The beach area and Luis and Salvador at The swim up bar. Our room was in the 3rd pyramid 6the floor ocean view. The room was clean,  the mini bar was filled every day. The food was delilicous. Even though the beach was filled with Sargasso, we got in and had fun. It was hard to make a reservation in a restaurant. The check in was a nightmare.

reviews.author: waterside40
reviews.title: Grandma
reviews.text: This was my first stay at the Paradisus Cancun. It was a great experience. The Paradisus Cancun provided luxury, relaxation and our family consierge Fernanda, was absolutely wonderful. She dealt with every detail of our stay and treated us like royalty. She is outgoing, friendly and in a low-key professional and warm way pulls you in and makes you feel like family. The entire Paradisus Cancun experience was exceptional. I would definitely return.

reviews.author: 50henryr
reviews.title: Great Family Get away
reviews.text: The Hotel and the Staff were amazing. Traveled with my Family. They had an amazing time! I relaxed and enjoyed the great food. I highly recommend as a family get away. The shows in the evenings were awesome. Staff was very attentive and friendly.

reviews.author: Ryan P
reviews.title: This Place is Awesome
reviews.text:
This is the first time I've stayed at a 5 star all inclusive in Cancun. I'll definitely be returning.

Paradisus is a brand under the reputable hotel line of Melia. All over the resort this is something you are made aware of as the staff and management value and respect this status.

The hotel itself was amazing. Rooms were great with a good size bathroom and a bidet! Our view was good enough for the little time we spent in the room and the beds were very comfy. The overall 5 pyramid structure is also one of the more impressive looking structures along the strip.

The pool area is also great with a very efficient swim up bar and activities throughout the day. If you want a chair by the pool you should bring towels down early when you go for breakfast.

The restaurants at the Paradisus had to have been the best part. The Brazilian Steakhouse is exceptional with so many different choices for meat and the Japanese bar inside the middle pyramid had a pretty cool atmosphere. Try every restaurant included in  your plan though as they all offer something different and delicious. I could write a paragraph about each one, I just don't feel like it.

I said the food was the best part but this is mostly because the staff is actually the best part. Other hotels in this area that I've visited were brutal for complaining about lack of tips on every single transaction. These guys are grateful for whatever they get and this makes  you want to tip when the service is so great. They've been trained to treat customers the same way you would expect from a fancy American/European hotel. They actually care or do a great job of acting like they do. I had multiple bartenders tell me to write a review on TripAdvisor because they understand this helps them!

This place also has the best drinks I've experienced from an All Inclusive. They will make you pretty much whatever and do a good job of it. They also use higher quality booze than a lot of the places on the strip. No guarantees as it's Mexico but this isn't the type of place where you're going to get sick from the unregulated alcohol going around Mexico lately.

Overall, would recommend this place for couples or a group of friends looking to live luxuriously for a week. If you want to drink terrible drinks, eat awful food and party with 20 year olds, this probably isn't the place for you (it's 2 doors down).

reviews.author: Barb C
reviews.title: Very nice resort
reviews.text: The staff is very friendly. Pablo in the Marketplace and Jose at the pool bar were exceptionally attentive and friendly. The room was always clean although there was inconsistency with the refreshing of towels. We had to call a few times.

reviews.author: MCastro024
reviews.title: Vacation 2017
reviews.text: If  you're looking into staying at this hotel, reserve now, you won't regret it! If you have kids, I recommend you get the family concierge rooms, the service you get from your Butler will make your trip great. They do all the thinking for you. This resort has 8 restaurants that you can try. He will make reservations for you to try all of them if time permits, schedule your spa and kids activities. If you do get Family Concierge make sure you request Alexander Garcia, he was our Butler, we received great help and service from all of concierge employees but Alexander was our personal butler and his hospitality and professionalism exceeded our expectations. You will be welcomed at this resort starting from when you check in to the end of your trip. I wish I remembered all the names of the people who treated us kindly and made us feel at home. Here are some names I remember: Nathanael from the restaurant Blue Agave, he was an excellent waiter; Mario from the buffet restaurant across to Blue Agave; Oscar the greeter from reception area; Fernanda who also worked along with Alexander; Rodolfo and Gabriel also from Concierge and What i want to say, is, if you want great hospitality and great service, stay at this hotel.

reviews.author: Myranda N
reviews.title: Loved loved our experiences here at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: The overall ratings are excellent.  Locations, services, ammenities and ambiances.  One thing is if the restaurant Enso could change their menu.  This is suppose to be Asain Fusion but it's awful.  The tastes were not Asians nor Fusions,   we couldn't even tell what kind of foods it was suppose to be.  This in no way reflect the serves of the staffs there though.  Everything was top notch.  We even joined to Melia Club Members just to say a bit of how please we were with the facility.

reviews.author: Melissa R
reviews.title: The very best family vacation.
reviews.text: If you want a vacation that has a little bit to offer everyone in the family...look no further.  Paradisus Cancun provides a balance of luxury and relaxation for adults, while keeping the kids busy and entertained. Last year was our first stay in the family concierge. Fernanda was assigned to take care of our family for the week and she quickly became a part of our family too.  I can't begin to express our gratitude to her for making our stay comfortable.  She is warm and listens with genuine care. Her attention to details and customer service skills are absolutely exceptional.  Having worked in the hotel industry on a managerial level myself I can be a bit difficult to please.  Fernanda is the reason we returned again this year with our parents. Everyone at this property is lovely. Its our home away from home.

reviews.author: Caridad P
reviews.title: Weekend Getaway to Relax, Renew and Recharge
reviews.text: Visited from Friday to Monday morning, a total of two couples. We stayed at the Pyramid #5 as part of the Royal Service, definitely worth the upgrade and service. Everything was luxurious, the service was unlike anything I have ever experienced, even at a Ritz. Our suite was always immaculately clean and loved having a his and hers bathroom. The view was phenominal. Our personal concierge/butler Sergio is the very BEST. He goes above and beyond to make sure everything from reservations for Bali beds,tennis, romantic dinners,  and transportation are taken care of-EVERYTHING. He does it elegantly and transmits calm energy to make sure you are relaxed. He never stops working and somehow magically appears out of now where to give updates and makes sure you are taken care of. The pool attendants are always working hard to make sure you have drinks and snacks. Carlos, Jose, Josue, Moises are wonderful and attentive. The later two assisted in our Romantic Dinner on the beach, another must do. Completely professional and serviceable. Another dinner must do is the TEMPO EXPERIENCE, with our very own knowledgable sommelier Carlos Duarte, who was very patient and informative in helping our selection. The Maitre'd Clemente, actually escorted us when we were lost and was very attentive to our needs. At the end, Rudy provided a wonderful tequila presentation and for the grand finale, the chef Ismael, a native of Toledo Spain visited our table for a chat. Great Mexican/Spaniard Fusion in a gourmet presentation. My only regret, not staying more day. I will definitely be returning soon. LOVED IT!!!!!! Thank you to all of the Paradius Staff!

reviews.author: Francis R
reviews.title: great time with family
reviews.text: great hotel great food excellent service by julio cesal cazaux at nao but a think that the host at nao and market grilled should be more friendlier they are to tide but over all i give a 4 star the view was beautiful had a lagoon view for 3 days and ocean view for 5 day

reviews.author: Anthony A
reviews.title: Great Family Trip
reviews.text: Went for 8 Days - Family of 4 - me and my wife and our 2 boys 10-12 - We all had a blast - Very Safe - We were staying on the Club Melia Pyramid # 5 - A little far walking - But not really that Bad - Bali Beds were great - Service Excellent - No Issues - Had a great Time - Can't wait to go back.....

reviews.author: kdwink25
reviews.title: Great hotel but upgraded service isn't worth it
reviews.text: Restaurants were hard to get into but food was awesome. Family concierge upgrade isn't really worth the money. Ours were off and had different hours and the others that traveled with us never heard from theirs. The ocean view rooms flooded when we had rain and they seemed annoyed when we went and asked for it to be cleaned. They chase you around to do a time share presentation which we had no interest and just wanted to enjoy our time by the pool. If we hadn't upgraded I would have been extremely satisfied just mad I wasted money for a service that didn't happen.

reviews.author: pr_r19
reviews.title: Professional service and great ocean views
reviews.text:
My fiance and I thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Paradisus Cancun. Overall, we were pleasantly surprised by the attention to detail given to keeping the property spotless, and also enjoyed both the buffet (Market Grill) and the restaurants (especially Fuego the Peruvian themed restaurant). 

The Good:
- We upgraded to the oceanside view room and it was well worth it. Your balcony gives you a great view of the beach and pools, but also offers you a lot of privacy.
- The staff were extremely professional. During breakfasts at Market Grill, we always opted to sit in the outdoor area that offered a view of the beach. Julio Cesar Cazaux was our server and he was great. He was personable and professional and always attentive to our preferences.
- Food was high quality and plentiful. Usually when we go to all inclusive resorts the restaurants aren't that great - but this was not the case at Paradisus Cancun. Our restaurant experiences at Mole and Fuego were great.
- The lobby is beautiful. We loved spending time relaxing in the lobby when it was raining outside. We also enjoyed the cafe and ice cream bar that was in the lobby
- The beach and pools are clean. We travelled in August and the resort was full but not overly crowded - we were always able to find chairs on the beach
- The Spa was a real treat. My fiance had a massage which he loved and would recommend to anyone.
- Evening entertainment was fun, especially "circus" and "popstars"
- Our room was spotless and was cleaned multiple times throughout the day.

The Not-as-good:
- Check in was a terrible start to an otherwise great vacation. It took us an hour to check in, and we were not given any direction when we first arrived. Unfortunately all of the staff seemed very confused, and although friendly they were disorganized. Our vacation package also offered credit toward certain amenities and we had to go back and wait in line a second time the next day to receive those. 
- Food overall was great, but we missed the fresh juices and tropical fruits that we usually expect from resorts.
- Bar tenders were professional but not very friendly
- Daytime activities were often poorly planned and did not start on time. We had signed up for dance classes which were then cancelled, a wine class which was 1 hour long and not very good (only had a chance to try 2 wines), a guacamole class which was poorly planned and a ecotour activity which was cancelled as well.

reviews.author: Ting Ting W
reviews.title: Paradisus is not Paradise
reviews.text:
This is my 3rd time to Cancun and I was not impressed with my stay here at the Paradisus. I booked online because of the beautiful pictures that I saw and the good reviews that came up. We booked the trip for 4 days. When we arrived to the hotel, it was beautiful, looked exactly like the pictures, but as we walked around and went into our room, we started to see that the hotel was super run down. There is also no central AC throughout the entire main hotel. We decided to upgrade to an ocean view room, but I do not think that it was worth it. The way the balcony is structured, you don't get a good view from your room. There's a huge planter that covers the view and the concrete siding, blocks the view as well. 

We had the all inclusive package but every time we ordered our drinks there was hardly any alcohol in the drinks at all. As for all the restaurants, you have to make a reservation a day in advance. When you call, they immediately tell you that all the restaurants are full and they only have the buffet and the blue agave open. I did not spend all of this money to not be able to eat at any restaurants. When I started to complain, they all of a sudden had every restaurant available for whatever times I needed it for. Are you kidding me??? Every time we went by the restaurants, they were all empty. 
Make sure to not get tricked by them telling you their restaurants are full! All the restaurants were not good at all compared to the other all inclusive s I have been to, and it was such a difficult process to book. The only restaurant that was edible was buffet. We tried Fuego, Bansa, Enso, the Buffet. 

Honestly the food as drinks were not good at all. There are plenty other resorts that would be way better for the same price. Try the Dreams properties. 

Overall, I wouldn't return to this hotel and do not recommend it. They are super pushy with their time share presentations, but instead should spend their energy on their service, food and quality of their hotel.

reviews.author: 604larryu
reviews.title: A relaxing week at Paradisus
reviews.text: Our week at Paradisus Royal Service was very relaxing  Our Butler, Edwardo, was very conscious and took care of everything we needed to make our stay a great one, down to the champagne and roses on the bed for our anniversary.  Carlos and all the other pool attendants reserved our Bali Beds and made sure we were comfortable lounging at the pool - which we did everyday!  It was heavenly.  We loved the entire place, and felt like La Palapa was a place we could call our own.  Overlooking the Caribbean, we enjoyed breakfast and lunch where Jorge, Eddie, Ricardo, and Joel waited on us.

reviews.author: Joseph M
reviews.title: Couple Retreat in Tropical Oasis
reviews.text:
My wife and I traveled here  August 19-26. We stayed in the royal service section. The resort was beautiful, the food at the restaurants were very good, and the drinks were top shelf. The staff was great, but there are some standouts I have to mention:
Sanky was our butler. She was great and very attentive made the trip great 
Orlando in the royal service section  made us feel at home and taught us about the culture and customs of the Mexican people . We learned a lot about tequila from him. 
Johnny at Mole restaurant was a standout. He was very personable. 

By the pool at and La Palapa  Joel and Mojias went above and beyond the whole trip. 
We definitely will be returning soon 
Thanks for everything Joe and Rosaria

reviews.author: UARK
reviews.title: Totally Enjoyable Stay
reviews.text: The Royal Service option is the way to go.  Our personal concierge Hector was fantastic.  He anticipated your needs and followed up to make sure you are satisfied.  He really went above and beyond with our entire group.  One couple in our group had a different concierge but once Hector found out that he was MIA, Hector just folded them under his wing and took care of them also.  The food is very good and each restaurant makes dining an "experience".  Overall, a great experience and one I will remember.

reviews.author: Ashanti B
reviews.title: No Hotel is Perfect, but this one comes pretty closes...
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun is a beautiful hotel with its oasis style, spa like vibe and beautiful beach. It's almost enough to make one overlook its imperfections.  Foodies beware!! The all inclusive food (even at the places you have to reserve a day before your meal) are not that great. Avoid ENSO you will need a flashlight to read their menu of food that will eventually lead to heartburn. Also, if in the middle seating area between VENTO and Market Grill for breakfast cover your food. Look up, and you'll see the water dripping from the vents onto tables.  The Jr Suite King Room w/private balcony was average. The staff is great, but some are much nicer if you speak Spanish. Don't get me wrong if you're carefree; okay with average drinks by the beach or pool snacks; love aromathearpy, and going on an excursion or two; this is the place to be. So like I said no place is perfect, but this place gets an E for effort.

reviews.author: Momondago
reviews.title: Family Vacation at a beautiful resort
reviews.text:
The resort is about 20 minutes from the airport. We received a friendly greeting and check-in was relatively smooth. The resort is gorgeous! It's essentially 5 connected buildings, which leaves little connection to the outdoors, but the outside is brought in through a huge central skylight, hanging vines and tropical plants. We did have some trouble navigating, so I wish the buildings and levels were better identified, the corridors were brighter, and you could get from building to building on the lowest level without going up and down stairs/elevators.

My family of 4 (including a 10 girl and 14 year old boy), stayed in a lagoon view junior suite. The room was clean and nicely decorated. The terrace had a nice view of the lagoon and great sunsets. I wish it had a table and lounge furniture instead of just two metal chairs. The fridge was stocked with beer, water, soda and snacks. The room wasn't large, and we found the beds to be too firm, but there was a pullout sofa that my daughter slept on comfortably. 

The staff was friendly, helpful and responsive. Room service was quick, but I wouldn't recommend the pizza (pre-made dough). Naos, the buffet had plenty of variety, with an international menu. Vento, the tapas restaurant, had good food, but the menu was in transition, so many choices were unavailable. I enjoyed the butterfish at Bana, the Japanese restaurant, but the sushi is pre-made with different toppings instead of different fillings. We enjoyed the meat at Market Grill, the Brazilian steakhouse, but wish there were a larger selection of sides. Blue Agave (tacos, quesadillas) is a great choice for a quick, tasty lunch/dinner and a break from the buffet. The wait staff at all the restaurants were great. The gelato and dessert stands were great. 

My husband had an allergic reaction and ended up going to the hospital. The clinic staff was kind, but there didn't seem to be a sense of urgency and they didn't have asthma medicine left. Since the clinic doesn't take insurance, it was actually more expensive than the hospital. The resort and clinic staff did check on him afterwards and offered a follow up.

Most restaurants require reservations which you cannot make more than more than 24 hours in advance. If there were any left, I was given 6:00 or 10:00, but the restaurants always seemed to have plenty of open tables when we went. Making reservations or waiting for cancellations is my biggest complaint.

We attended the timeshare presentation, which was long but not high pressured. We received a credit for the spa and discounts for excursions, so the 90 minutes was worth it. We didn't get hassled by salespeople or vendors.

I had an 80 minute deep tissue massage and my 10 yr old daughter had a 25 minute massage and mani/ pedi. We were both pleased and found the pricing to be reasonable. 

The gym was well equipped but tight. Fortunately, it wasn't overcrowded. I was able to exercise in the room adjacent as well which had plenty of space and mats.  

The beach was clean with plenty of chairs and bamboo umbrellas, I just wish they were closer to the water.  There are two pools, which made them less crowded, but the beach cabana closes early, so we couldn't get a beach towel after 6.

There were some pop tribute performers, but the location made it impossible to see them since most people had to stand. My kids are too old for the kids zone, and there wasn't much for teenagers. There's a game room, but it's for Club Melia Members. My son and husband did enjoy the 9 hole golf course. We brought an X-box, which worked out great when there was an all-day storm and not much to do in the resort. 

All-in-all, we enjoyed the resort. I would recommend it for a family with small children.

reviews.author: K W
reviews.title: Excellent poolside and beachside service
reviews.text: We have been going to Paradisus for over 20 years.  Asuncion is a waitress at the pool and beach and has been working there for 25 years!  She is the best server we have ever had - ANYWHERE!!!  If you go to this hotel, do what you can to sit in her section and tell the Warp's said HELLO!!!

reviews.author: Rita A
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: This all-inclusive resort is a good place to stay and if you can go for the Royal Service upgrade, you will not regret it. It has a multiple a la carte restaurants that you need to do a reservation ahead of time, great activities and entertainment.

reviews.author: Fernando D
reviews.title: very nice accommodations
reviews.text: very nice resort. nice restaurants on resort.  Great spa!  Nice pools.  Nice beach with numerous palaces.  Wish there was a place to go dancing in the resort.  Rooms were comfortable.  AC worked well.  Bath amenities were very good.

reviews.author: Marty M
reviews.title: Excellent service at Mole
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun is ideal for a vacation with family. There a good selection of restaurants but our favorite was Mole,  Daniel (manger) and Roberto always made our experimente unique. We stayed 10 days and repeated this restaurant 3 times. Service is always top of mind and the quality of food at Mole was super good. My wife if gluten free and they (Daniel y Roberto) made an effort to make her feel at home. My daughter who is 12 yo loved Mole as well. Daniel spoiled my daughter and flautas were her favorite. Our second choice was Banna, with also very good service and food.

reviews.author: Zincke12
reviews.title: Surprised
reviews.text: I went for my 40th Birthday, it was an amazing experience.   The hotel surprised me with balloons and a cake, on my third night.  The service is excellent and most restaurants inside the hotel were great.  over I enjoyed my stay.

reviews.author: shelby9847
reviews.title: Mom/Daughter trip at the Paradisus! Royal service is WORTH it!!
reviews.text:
I am so sad to be leaving this hotel! My mom and I stayed here four days and three nights. We upgraded to the Royal service - this is a must! You have your own personal butler and everything is taken care of for you. Our butler Carlos was fantastic! He booked all of our reservations for dinner and arranged transportation and luggage pickup when we left. The Royal service area is SO peaceful and zen... and the room overlooking the ocean is BEAUTiFuL!!!!!!! There is an area downstairs in the Royal service area where they have fresh fruit and wonderful breakfast, drinks etc every morning. Then they switch it out to meats, cheeses, and delicious snacks throughout the day for any time you want to just sit down and have a drink and or snack. There is live music every night in this area around 7pm :). 
We never left the resort - and never needed to!!! They take such good care of you here.  I can't stress enough how worth the upgrade to Royal service was. When we went into the main lobby, we stopped for a drink at the middle bar with the red lights - Erick our bartender was fantastic! He kept the shots flowing lol.... my mom and I had such a fun time chatting with him. We had dinner at Blue Agave, Enso, and Fuego. Blue Agave was great, Enso and Fuego were good but not our favorites. My favorite was La Palapa (beach restaurant outside in Royal service outside) the most delicious fish and chips!!!!! Joel was our waiter and he took SUCH good care of us!! He told us he had only been there two months but you would never know it, he brought us out some fresh grilled shrimp over rice before our meal and they were FANTASTIC! My mom ordered prime rib tacos and she couldn't stop raving about it. The view is so fantastic overlooking the ocean ... definitely my favorite place to eat there. We spent most of our days by the ocean and working on our tans :).  The last day, I went parasailing and jet skiing.... SO FUN! There were will places to do that by the beach outside the hotel if you choose to be breve :). I loved this hotel and experience and definitely want to come back. Thanks Paradisus!!!

reviews.author: Victoria Miller
reviews.title: Love the employees
reviews.text: We loved  the staff they work so hard to try to please the guests. Daphne our conceiger was wonderful. The room was ok the food options not so much need some more variety. Perhaps vining a couple of the restaurant in to one and adding some more variety and family friendly menus so that we are not forced to eat at Naos every night.

reviews.author: elliegrassia
reviews.title: EG751
reviews.text: My thoughts of this hotel is equal to having Root Canal !! The whole experience has left such a bad taste in my mouth that I have NO future desire to ever go back to Mexico. The only thing that was decent was the drinks & AC in our rooms. Food was average to other places I've been, the things that really upset me the most was we couldn't go in the Ocean due to the under currents( which I understand ) but also the seed weed was over the top, so if you decided to go into the pool to cool off your body guess what!  IT was like going into a Hot Tub the water never cooled you off so now what's the point of enjoying the sun. The other thing was the restaurants had minimal air conditioning & no restrooms in area, you had to walk a good distance to get there when I brought my concerns to the front desk they gave me a respond that was so upsetting that I told them I would never return again & they responded that's of my choice" WHAT KIND OF A RESPOND IS THAT " it was not acceptable to me . So in ending this review let me just say because something says its 5 STAR doesn't mean anything !!!!!

reviews.author: m_rivera019
reviews.title: Paradise?
reviews.text: The place is beautiful and the all inclusive was so worth it. The only downside was The Red Lounge and a few restaurants did not have working A/C. Made it uncomfortable especially in 80% humid weather.

reviews.author: Bryan K
reviews.title: Used and Abused - Okay if you like big crowds and buffets
reviews.text: Spent five days at the Paradisus Cancun resort. Stayed in a king size room on the 8th floor in building three. Hotel appears like it gets used and abused for Spring Break. General touch points; furniture, bathrooms, and pool seem tired. The restaurant reservation policy is a joke. Forget making a reservation at a reasonable time or more than a day in advance if you're a "general" guest. When we did have reservations for prime-time dining, the restaurant sat half-empty. Lots of time-share folks running around too. One even told a family member during the sales pitch that general guest are treated like a number and that being a member is the only way to get quality service. Wow! Overall way too many people for our taste. As usual, the hotel staff were exemplary, but the hotel reservation policy and condition leave much to be desired.

reviews.author: Maggie M
reviews.title: Wonderful! Highly recommend!
reviews.text: I stayed here with my children and from the minute we stepped onto the property till we left, we loved EVERY minute.  Wonderful food! Top notch service!! You cannot go wrong.  We stayed in a beautiful room in the family concierge building.  The deck was huuuuuuge! Such a wonderful experience for the children and I.  We will be back.

reviews.author: MAO
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text:
We have just concluded our third visit to Paradisus Cancun, and once more not disappointed by the hospitality, beauty and wonder of the place. The minute we walk in we switch off leaving behind stress and worry and enter a world of much needed relaxation and tranquility.  
The all inclusive resort arguably puts all other all inclusives to shame, you are never left wanting or needing any thing you didn't know you needed. The support offered by Rodolfo in family concierge is outstanding and we can’t thank him enough for his help before and during our stay. Also a special thanks to Fernanada and Alex who looked after out every need from the moment we walked into the resort to the moment we left. We will back.

reviews.author: Durantires
reviews.title: Great family Time!!!
reviews.text: Great hotel...Great location...Amazing service...The staff is very friendly...I recommend this hotel and I will come back again. take the jungle tour it's amazing.the food it's good a lot of variety. great shows...good location.

reviews.author: Giuseppina D
reviews.title: Cancun 2017
reviews.text: The resort was stunning. I would like to see more activities at night. The place is very quiet after 9P.M unless you go to the club.The only problem that I had was my sons portable charger was stolen.

reviews.author: Jose R
reviews.title: Victor Cawich service on 1000%
reviews.text: I must say from the moment we walked in we felt like we were at home. It was the best vacation my wife and I have had ever. Everyone was so nice and always helpful we didn't walk past someone that didn't greet us. Our favorite part was at the royale pool and the customer service we got from Victor Cawich he was untouchable. Let's just say that we never had to ask for anything not even food. We will deff be back and look forward of victor taking care of us!!!!

reviews.author: Emily L
reviews.title: Trip with friends
reviews.text:
I will start out by saying that my husband and I have stayed at some 5 star resorts that definitely earned their stars.  We sort of consider ourselves "hotel-snobs".  This resort did not live up to our expectations.  The lobby was grand and beautiful.  The rooms were completely ordinary and plain.  Granted, we stayed in the lagoon-view king bed room, but it felt no different than a Holiday Inn.  This hotel is old, but they try hard to make sure things are fixed up.  Ongoing maintenance all over the resort.  The restaurants were nice, great food.  You had to make reservations the day before and we didn't get to eat at all of them.  Buffet got very crowded in morning hours, but the food was all delicious.  No one on our trip got any food sickness :)  There were lots of kids in the resort, so if you want to get away from them I would not recommend coming here.  We would try a different resort next time. 

Pros: food, lobby and indoor areas decor, overall appearance outside, entertainment, rooms clean

Cons: pool too deep- 5 ft everywhere, stone walkways too hot on feet, beach dropped off and waves strong, rooms ordinary decor, no open bars inside during the day to hang out when it storms, missed out on restaurants because we couldn't get reservations, hard to get chairs around pool
