reviews.author: Gloria G
reviews.title: Great hotel, wonderful staff, amazing stay!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun from the 7th to the 12th of August, 2017, and even though we had a tropical storm the first day we had a wonderful time. 
We arrived a bit earlier than the check-in time but, they checked us in any way, gave us the bracelet to enjoy all the amenities, food and drinks and stored our luggage until our rooms were ready. 
The beach at this hotel is simply gorgeous. There was a bit of kelp in the ocean and the shore because of the storm, but they did a great job cleaning every day. There were also some sea shells on the beach in front of tower #1, so it may be a good idea to bring and wear water shoes there.
The only minor, minor complaint I would have, is that our bathtub drained a bit slower than usual, but I understand it must be difficult to keep the drains free of all the sand we as guess sometimes bring in our bathing suits. We had a bit of trouble booking ahead for some of the restaurants which seemed to be in high demand for dinner; however, we did have other options and the food was very good pretty much everywhere. 
We made sure we had enough one and five dollar bills for tips, but the service was always excellent in the restaurants and everywhere, regardless. 
My mom had a bit of an accident and hit her head near one of the pools and the paramedic and other staff were there within minutes; took care of her and made sure she was ok. Even days later, they kept asking how she was and asking if she needed anything else. I am so sorry I don't remember their names because I would really like them to get the recognition and praise they deserve.
On our way back home, when we got to the airport we realized we had left one of our pieces of luggage in the reception area of the hotel after our check-out. We called the hotel and the staff were very helpful and kind enough to ask one of the taxi drivers to bring it to us as fast as possible. We assumed it was going to cost us a small fortune but it did not. The taxi driver was very professional and reasonable so I was more than happy to give him more than he was asking for. 
All in all, I simply loved our stay in this hotel. I would highly recommend it and I would go back in a heartbeat!

reviews.author: Roni Renee
reviews.title: AMAZING, AMAZING, AMAZING, AMAZING, AMAZING
reviews.text: This resort is absolutely amazing, stunning, breathtaking!!! I have never in my life and I mean NEVER felt so relaxed.  They treated us like royalty from the time we got out of the cab.  The food is delicious, the drinks are great.  Royal Service is an ABSOLUTE MUST!!! You cannot pass this deal up.  I have cruised several times, this was my very first time staying at an all inclusive hotel.  My husband and I went with my BFF and her hubby and we had not one complaint, we adored our butler Rosanna, she was perfecto!!! Everything was great.  I cannot wait to visit AGAIN and AGAIN and AGAIN and AGAIN. We stayed in room 5215 and it was perfecto!!!! By the way the Tequila was even better LOL.

reviews.author: Estiie7
reviews.title: BEST VACATION EVER!
reviews.text:
I usually always find something to complain about as I'm super picky, but this place is HEAVEN!!! Everything was GREAT! Can't complain about the food, except the fact that I gained weight as they definitely know how to make delicious food :) The rooms weren't bad. However, if you want a quite area- ask for building # 4 as you'd hear everything in your room in the evening if you stay in building # 2 or 3. Even on the 8th floor, we heard the music in our room, and we stayed in building # 3.

This hotel is definitely one of the best, if not the best hotel in Cancun!!!

reviews.author: Sojourns By Chetan (चेतन)
reviews.title: Fantastic all inclusive resort with a few learning curves to navigate through.
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun is a fantastic all inclusive resort, with all the expected superlatives that would apply to such a resort. 

Here is what works:
Fantastic food and restaurant choice. I wish they had a proper Indian restaurant, but this won't matter to everyone. 

The kids center where you can drop off your kids/toddlers (I don't know about infants) is really great if you want an adults only meal/drink or even a nap. 

Rooms are great. Lots of space. Great views (if you pay for it) and very good room service. We had a couple of 5 AM tours and an early morning flight out and it was fantastic to get great and timely room service. We placed our order and when we wanted it on the previous night. 

The gorgeous beach with the umbrellas, chairs and bar service is awesome. 

What's not so great:
The coupon books are not very usable. 

The prices for anything (tours/spas) you book in the hotel is overpriced. 

Tipping etiquette is confusing and a cause for annoyance for international travelers. 

The pool is great for adults (one section) or kids (separate section) but not both.

reviews.author: monilee16
reviews.text: Take care of the problems reported by the customer as soon as possible. I reported that the air conditioning to the room was not working and nothing was done about it. Price was too high for the service provided

reviews.author: Kellien G
reviews.title: Great Resort Vacation
reviews.text: My best friend and I decided to spend a feq days in Cancun and we are so happy we chose Paradisus Cancun Royal Service. The hotel itself is clean, smells wonderful all the time. I think they have some essential oils in the air system. The Royal Service side is quiet and very zen. The staff is very polite and helpful. Most of them speak english so its never a problem. Royal service comes with butler services,  our butler was helpful but wouldnt say proactive in trying to assist us. We asked tbat he book our dinner reservation for the duration of our trip and asked for restaurants with seafood choices as I dont eat meat and the first two nights the reserved restaurants offered either no seafood and the other a very limited selection. That was the only thing i could say was negative. On the otber hand we spent most of our time at rhe pool/beach and the staff there is hands down the beat service we've experienced in any resort. I have to point out a few in particular that went above and beyond to make our stay special...Victor, Edier, Ricardo, Omar, Valeria and Hector. They knew what we wanted even before we did!! They offer such great swrvice and they did it with such a happy and kind demeanor, it just made our stay that much more special. Thank you!

reviews.author: Gabrielle S
reviews.title: Amazing Family Vacation!
reviews.text: First time travelling to Cancun and this place was recommended by family members who traveled there the year before. Party of 6 - 3 couples and the hotel was accommodating of our requests to have rooms near one another. The all-inclusive dining was a fun experience and they had many different types of food to offer. Fun activities at night and plenty to do during the day. Well maintained beach area and beautiful rooms.

reviews.author: Daina B
reviews.title: Best resort so far! ❤
reviews.text: Everything has been great! Best resort so far. All staff are pleasant and very helpful. Will definitely be back. The restaurants are great! Roberto and Francisco from Red lounge was very friendly and made our last evening very enjoyable! Our room was always clean. The food great. Service is unforgettable! Our family will definitely be back to this resort. We wish we had more days!

reviews.author: sameguy
reviews.title: DO NOT STAY ANYWHERE ELSE IN CANCUN!
reviews.text: I am a very seasoned world traveler and I have stayed at many premium properties worldwide.  I am also not easily pleased and I truly believe that if I spend money then I should receive value.  To me, cost is an issue in the absence of value and, in this case, the price was extremely fair compared to the outstanding value and service we received.

reviews.author: gocel2
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Great Vacation! August 10th through 17th.
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun Resort, truly a good place to spend a vacation. We have travelled to Cancun a few times and stayed at a different hotel each time.
The Good;
High Speed Internet
The food at the buffet Naos has plenty of variety and great food.
The restaurants are also very good with plenty of choices on the menu.
The pools are good but some may be too deep (5.9’) for some people.
The views are beautiful whether you have an Ocean or Lagoon room.
The vegetation and fish ponds in the hotel are beautiful.
The whole hotel including rooms are clean and well maintained.
Clean towels at the beach or pools are always available and the annoying cards for towels are not used.
No smoking is allowed in all indoor areas including rooms.
Buffet service is great, look for Atilano and Pascual. They are very attentive to your needs.

The Not So Good;
The Ocean on the side of the hotel is rough not suitable for small children. My Son and I enjoyed it but we were knock down by the waves a few times.
The Lobby front desk where check-ins and check-outs is done needs improvement. Unfriendly and inefficient staff.

reviews.author: Fearless249937
reviews.title: 60th birthday for hubby
reviews.text: We have visited Cancun many times, but our first time at Paradisus at Cancun let me day WONDERFUL THE BEST!! EVER. we will NEVER stay anywhere else. The YHI Spa is great Ana & mae was great awesome.  I can't not say enough about resort paradise.

reviews.author: Gina M
reviews.title: Excellent service, beautiful hotel and great food, but some policies leave room for improvement
reviews.text:
Our family of 4 traveled to the Paradisus Cancun in July 2017 and stayed for 5 nights.  I had heard great reviews of the Royal Service, but because one of our sons is 16 years old, we were unable to take advantage of RS (it is for adults only).

Overall, this is a beautiful, clean hotel with good food and excellent service.  We had a lovely vacation.  The resort is family friendly but it's not really a haven for young children.  Our sons are older teens so that wasn't an issue for us.  The environment was calm and relaxed - not a party hotel at all. We found that it struck the perfect balance.  We definitely would categorize this as a luxury hotel, and would have rated have given it a higher overall rating if it were not for some hotel policies which need updating.  These pertain to the pool/beach seating and the dining reservation system.

I'll try to summarize individual areas below. 

Check-In:  Check in was quick and efficient.  We had two rooms next to each other, as we had requested.  After check in, we sat for a few moments with a host who gave us the run-down on making dinner reservations, etc.  He did broach the subject of attending a "breakfast," which is really a time share tour, but was polite when we declined and simply gave us his number in case we wanted to hear more at a later time.

Service: Throughout the hotel, all staff were friendly, helpful, and went above and beyond to improve our stay.  Here is an example.  We checked in at around 4:15 pm, which is in the short window when the buffet restaurant is closed.  Our sons were very hungry after traveling all day, and as we got on the elevator we were wondering out loud about where we might grab a bite.  The baggage porter who was helping with our bags outlined some options for us as he helped us into our rooms and I assured my sons that we would head down to grab some food as soon as we did some unpacking.  About five minutes later, there was a knock on the door.  He had sent someone from room service up with a tray of food - wings, rice and veggies.  We were so touched by that!  The service we encountered here was outstanding.

Atmosphere:  The hotel's common areas and grounds are exceptionally clean and well maintained.  The lobby is gorgeous, with foliage from ceiling to floor.  Our rooms were well-appointed, but they are showing their age.  In one of our rooms, the handle on the outside of the deck door was missing, we had to push on the glass to slide the door open and closed.  In our bathroom, the latch to the door of the water closet was missing, so it did not close all the way.  None of these issues were really a bother to us, but the hotel may want to work on those types of room repairs and maintenance.  Housekeeping in our room was excellent throughout our stay.

Pool:  The pools are very nice and well maintained, but really deep.  I am 5'4" and there was no portion of the pool in which I could stand flat footed with my head above water.  This was odd, as this is a family hotel, and those with small children had to keep them in floats or rafts at all times.  For me, it meant that I had to be standing at the swim up bar or seated outside of the pool to have a drink. If you're short, pack a cheap float in your bag.

Beach:  The beach here is lovely, especially for this area of Cancun.  During our stay, the water was calm enough for swimming on all but one day.  There is some seaweed, but it's not too bad.  There are lifeguards stationed at the beach, but we rarely saw them. There are vendors walking the beach who will approach you to sell items, but they are easily refused and rarely approach you directly.

Pool and Beach seating: This is an area that the resort really MUST improve.  In order to ensure that you have seating at the beach or pool, plan to wake up early and put towels out to hold the chairs.  At that, if you are not in the chairs by 10:00 am or so, staff will remove the towels.  My husband and I would usually go down at about 7:00 am to reserve four seats, and then he and I would get breakfast and return to the seats by 8:30-9:00 am.  Staff might then try to remove towels from our other two seats, and we would have to assure them that those seats were for our sons (who do not wake up that early on vacation).  This entire system is ridiculous because there is PLENTY of space for seating all of the hotel guests.  There are a slew of large bali beds or cabanas both on the beach and around the pool which have a daily rental cost involved.  I have stayed at several luxury all inclusives before, and have never had to pay to secure beach or pool seating.  If we were to have rented two bali beds for each of the five days of our stay, we would have spent somewhere in the neighborhood of $1500!  As we walked through the pool and beach areas each day, we were absolutely overwhelmed by the number of bali beds and cabanas that sat empty (I would estimate 95% of them).  Because they are large structures, they take up SO MUCH room around the pool and on the beach that could be dedicated to open chairs with umbrellas.  I am very fair and I need coverage in the Mexican sun to prevent sunburn - there is simply not enough seating with sun cover available to guests, and there is a simple solution to this problem.  

Restaurant Reservations:  The reservation system is another area in which this hotel needs improvement.  We stayed for five nights, which means five dinners.  We checked in on our first day close to dinner time, and so we were told that there were no available reservations in any of the restaurants.  We ate at the buffet that evening.  We were told that we could call in the morning (as early as possible) to make reservations for the next night.  We called early on the morning after we checked in, and we were informed that there was nothing available for that night, but we could make reservations for the following night.  Essentially, unless we had arrived at the hotel early in the morning on our first day, we would then not be granted a dinner reservation until the THIRD night of our stay.  My husband argued this, and was told that because the hotel was full, they were setting up a special dinner event outside at the pool (barbecue menu) and they could give us a reservation for that.  The barbecue dinner was ok, but not great.  This was all really disappointing, because once we were able to make reservations and eat in the nicer restaurants, we really enjoyed our meals.  We felt like we missed two nights of eating well.  Another guest later told us that they had just walked up to restaurants without reservations and asked if there was an opening, and they were seated.  I wish we had known that- we would have done it.

Restaurants:  Naos is the main buffet restaurant.  It was in line with what I have had at buffets in other all inclusives.  At breakfast, there is a nice make your own omelette station.  There are many food choices.
Blue Agave is a taco restaurant that is open almost all the time.  We ate lunch there several times and it was also good, with a limited menu.  
The buffet "barbecue" dinner that we ate outside at the pool was good but not outstanding.  
On the three nights that we were able to make dinner reservations, we ate at Vento, Market Grill and Bana.  All three were very good, but Vento was our absolute favorite.  It is a mediterranean tapas restaurant and the food was excellent!  We sampled so many things from the menu and loved them all (try the butterfish), and we were sad that we didn't have a chance to eat there twice.  
Market Grill was good, it's a brazilian rodizio restaurant.  Not my personal favorite, but my sons are meat lovers and they both really enjoyed it.  
The food at Bana was also delicious. My family loves sushi, but I have a shellfish allergy.  They were very accommodating of my needs.  A warning about Bana, though - it is uncomfortably warm in that restaurant.  It is located in the lobby area of the hotel, and in the evenings the entire center of the main tower is hot and humid.  We were sweating like crazy during dinner.  It is also very dark in Bana - we could honestly barely see each other or our food.  We think that the ambiance is intended to be romantic - there is live music - but it's all just so uncomfortable that it definitely detracts from the experience, which is a shame because the food is great.
Gelato and donut stands in lobby were delicious and a nice touch.  Sunset Grille at the pool was ok, mostly french fries and pizza type fare.  Room service, which we ordered several times, was also good (and quick).  

Excursions:  There are several desks around the lobby where you can book excursions.  If you stop at the one that is on the same side as Blue Agave, you will be pitched a time share "breakfast" so that you can save money on the excursion.  After this happening to us a few times, my husband and I decided to just do the tour so that we could get the discount.  It lasted 90 minutes and it was fine.  We did not purchase the time share and had no intention to do so, but it saved us about $400 on an excursion.  Once that was out of the way, we were directed to an excursion desk on the other side of the lobby.  The gentleman there was so helpful - calling ahead to book our time, giving us explicit instructions on how to get where we were going, how to pay, etc.  

Costs:  This is an all inclusive hotel, but as I said earlier, there is a cost (about $150 per day when we were there) for bali beds or cabanas.  Also, in the restaurants, there are wine lists or beer lists on each table, and you are referred to them by your servers.  However, there is cost for every wine except the white or red house wine.  In Blue Agave, my husband ordered a beer from the list of four or five bottled beers posted on the bar and a big scene was made, with a manager type person checking on which one he wanted and sending someone to get it in another part of the hotel.  Ten minutes later they had the bottled beer for him and he was presented with a bill for $8.  It wasn't a big deal, but it wasn't communicated well.  Same thing in the restaurants, where I was asked if I wanted a specific wine from the wine list, but I had to ask if there was an additional cost for it - it was offered but the cost was not immediately explained.

reviews.author: Marek K
reviews.title: Amazing place
reviews.text:
Amazing place - comfortable rooms, high speed internet :); not so many sunbeds near pools, but available at the beach
Great staff - always smiling & helpful
Delicious cuisine in each of the restaurants 
Family Concierge - probably the best I've tried in Mexico

reviews.author: nrmbnt
reviews.title: Great Cancun Hotel in the middle of the "7"
reviews.text: Having stayed and a wonderful hotel in Playa del Carmen, and pretty good resort in Puerto Morelos, I wasn't sure how much I would like being on a "Miami Beach" strip of hotels in the middle of Cancun (which is shaped like the number 7).  Well, the Paradisus Cancun was great!  First of all the staff was friendly and accommodating to a person.  Check in to the Royal Service (which I HIGHLY recommend!!!) was a breeze.  The beach/ocean facing room was very nice and the view was beautiful.  Even the inside of the hotel, shaped like a pyramid, is beautiful, with lush greenery and decorations. Food in all the restaurants was very good.  The Royal Service portion of the hotel adds music in the "lobby" at dinner time.  Finger foods and top shelf drinks are always available during "waking" hours, and are included in your stay.  Royal Service also means that all food and top shelf drinks are yours anywhere on the grounds of the hotel.  Beach chairs in a roped off area for R.S. is constantly attended by waiters bringing you food and drink.  R.S. has it's own large pool. The beach was beautiful white sand and had minimal seaweed issues, unlike beaches south of Cancun.  The water...GORGEOUS!  To top it off, Paradisus Cancun is right across the street from a large water sport facility where most people visiting the strip will end up to either rent boats, cruise, scuba, water park, etc, but staying here you simply walk across the street!  I would absolutely go back here.

reviews.author: lisa1000_13
reviews.title: Fantastic service and amenities
reviews.text: We upgraded to Royal service.  The entire staff was kind, attentive,accommodating and exceeded our expectations. Extra special shout out to Joel de Jesus Rojano (pictured with us) Joel really went out of his way for us at La Pallapa which had the most incredible breakfast, lunch, and deserts. Joel truly made our vacation special.

reviews.author: tommyg1111
reviews.title: Birthday Bash 8/10-8/17/2017
reviews.text:
Upon arrival we were led to Royal Service check in: Melina checked us into our Royal stay and we were assigned to Rode as our butler, pronounced "roady"  Rode made all of our dinner reservations for our stay, also reservations at Yhi Spa.  Poolside/beach side bali beds were handled by Carlos, great guy that is truly concerned with your stay and how he can make it better.  Royal Service customers are guaranteed one day pool bali bed and one day beach bali bed.  Carlos exceeded this for us, thanks Carlos.  Drinks were served beachside by Moises, Orlando and Octavian.  These guys work hard i the Can cun heat to keep your glass filled with your choice of beverage.  La Palapa grill overlooks the beautiful Cancun Caribbean sea!  Valeria, Cesar Ramon, Joel, Hector and the staff at La Palapa work hard to make your stay in Paradisus unforgettable!  Vento is tapas and food was good, The Market Grill is good but I suggest at least a 7:30 pm reservation as it is warm.  Special Romanatic dinner for my wife's birthday was handled by Cesar and Ramon.  Filet Mignon and grilled Caribbean lobster was outstanding, so was their service.  Fuego is great! Naos buffet is somewhat crowded for breakfast but if you go Royal you can eat breakfast at La Palapa or eat in Pyramid 5.  First relaxing massage was with Liliana and Sandy and it was fantastic.  The second relaxing massage was Anna and Sandy and equally fantastic.  If you come here to relax that is what you will get.  The butler Rode gave us his cell number and if we needed anything we simply texted him and he took great care of us.  The butler does not follow you around but is there if you want or need anything.  Rode filled the bill.  Camille was very helpful at the Royal Service Pyramid 5 with USD/Peso conversion and general information.  Just for the heck of it we took bus R-1 to Cancun Centro ADO and another bus to Playa Del Carmen for the day!  People were like freaking out as they thought we were taking a chance but we had no problems.  Overall I say it is five (5) star*****!  Looking to come back to Paradisus Cancun Royal Service soon.
TommyG1111

reviews.author: Hermann Schroeder
reviews.title: Swimming pool an Auditorium
reviews.text:
The swimming pool is nice and warm, but is very hot here and this hotel lacks of of umbrellas to protect you from the sun, it is imposible to sit by the sun the whole day. They need at least as minimum about 50 or more of them to protect yourself from the sun. 
The other thing that is so bad of this hotel is that there is no place to see the shows in the evenings, you have to sit on the steps that go to the beach to see the night shows, which are very uncomfortable. I have been in other hotels with a beautiful place to sit and enjoy the show. This hotel was much better 6 years ago when we came for the first time.

reviews.author: rford316
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: The hotel was great overall. From the time we checked in until we left. Food, service, facilities and cleanliness was exceptional. Everyone was so helpful. Lots of English staff to help. I will definitely stay here again on my next visit.

reviews.author: DoctorFlo
reviews.title: AMAZING... ROYAL SERVICE - Where you NEED to be!!!!
reviews.text: I rarely write reviews, but while at the resort, I said I HAVE to write something. This experience was beyond!! I have traveled all over the world, and this was the BEST service I ever received. The grounds are extremely clean, and very well kept - I did notice that some of the furniture looked a little dated, but that was the minority... But more importantly, if you book here, you HAVE to book ROYAL SERVICE. I cant stress that enough. And its not even that much more... I dont have the time or patience to write down all Royal Service has to offer (it really is that much), but I will say this: We left with 6 FULL bottles of absolut vodka, rum, and tequila. These were just gifts left in our room. The premium bar was so good that, we didnt even need to open our bottles, so we took them home. Probably would have taken more if our check in bag had the space. The butler service is amazing. They book everything for you. They get your clothes ironed everyday. Personalize your pillow with whatever scent you want. Make your dinner reservations (which I hear is really hard on the regular side). The private pool area and balibeds... and my favorite - snacks and drinks delivered directly to you on your bed or WHILE IN THE POOL - just amazing. I must admit some bartenders are better than others. They have good products but you may have to direct them a little.... Anyway, the most relaxing, enjoyable time. OH, and I love to party, so I got the best of both worlds. The relaxation during the day, and turn up at night. The Red lounge was packed with people every night, and they actually played good music. The kind I listen to like Hip Hip & R&B.

reviews.author: MONIQUEBxNy
reviews.title: GO Mexico !!!!
reviews.text: Let me begin with I LOVE MEXICO! 1st time @ Paradisus, must say the pictures online are spot on.The hotel itself is beautiful, my only complaints is NO AIR-CONDITIONING !! I get it ,they are preserving the beautiful plant life,that being said  I really enjoyed the Red Lounge and Ave Bar but would have really loved it had they had just a little air!! All the restaurant are delicious (had a fried salmon skin salad @ BANA to die for) all the bars have top shelf  liquor .Must say as far as service it was good,however not GREAT!!! I believe my experience @ the RUI resort have left me spoiled. Yes they will get you whatever you want/need but you must ask and as far as being greeted with an Hola Buenas Dias ..it may not happen .As I said maybe I'm just spoiled from RUI,where you never need to ask for a single thing !!! And the hospitality is superb! Would I come back YES!!! the hotel is about 15-20 min from airport ,good food, good drinks ,night shows,pool shows, beautiful beach.

reviews.author: trinamolnar
reviews.title: This is a great place for the money
reviews.text: We were there in mid July and had a wonderful time.  We scheduled our extra excursions with the hotel and they were so helpful with tips on what to do.  We also took the bus which we had before this trip and they are easy to use and very clean.  Only cost one dollar for one way. The Bana Restaurant was wonderful as always, Ezequlel the Manager stopped by to see if everything was to our liking and we had to say yes because Luis our waiter was right on top of everything.  He recommended we try sake which was perfect with our dinner.  Cannot wait to go back. (P.S. we had no issues with drinks being tainted).

reviews.author: Mario M
reviews.title: Paradises Cancun Family Vacation
reviews.text:
Beautiful Resort with excellent customer service throughout the hotel. Really enjoyed the responsiveness of the hotel staff to my families needs. The food was excellent and with a great variety such as Naos Buffet, Mole Restaurant, Blue Agave, The Market Grill, these are the ones my family dined at during our stay. The coffee bar in the lower lobby was excellent according to my mom who enjoyed it every morning. My children like the ice cream and crepe bar and stopped for snacks each day. The room service was excellent and according to my three children, the chicken wings and club sandwichs were excellent. The Ave Bar in the evening was an excellent place to relax and meet people from everywhere. The service was excellent a huge thank you to Francisco and bartenders! These Gentlemen do a fantastic job. For those 18 years of age plus, stop into the Red Lounge for some music and dancing. Depending on the crowd mix the music will vary each night. Beach service is with drinks for the whole family buckets of water, soda, and cocktails are at your asking. I would recommend renting a bed on the beach, which was great for the kids to lounge in. The entertainment at night was good, but I would recommend getting their a little earlier to get a good seat because people come and it gets crowded and very warm. They do open some windows, so depending on where you are seating or standing you may feel a beautiful breeze.
The rooms in the hotel are very nice and well maintained with good housekeeping service. The beds are comfortable and you can get a good nights sleep. The mini bars are always full with soda, water and beer and basic snacks.
The pools are not to crowded and really low key. The servers around the pool do an excellent job of taking care of you. Get to the pool early to grab a place to sit for the day. It tends to fill up fast most days.

Overall an excellent vacation. Can't wait to return next August with my family. We have been Melia Club Members since 2002. This is my actual first review of the property.

reviews.author: Peggyspk
reviews.title: nice Service but nor for anniversary!
reviews.text:
Just back from there,very good service, If you need something it was there right away.
Clean rooms 
But....
What I was really shocked was I told them before my trip to reserve me a table for my anniversary in a restaurant which they did and sent the confirmation for the occasion by email. Also I told them in the check in desk first day. Guess what! I got nothing! No room decoration, no offers, nothing in the restaurant and ...
I was so disappointed that how could it be possible with the nice organized service they had but didn't care about the important occasion like this. 
Also needed more care about the A/C inside the hotel.
But The rest was good.

reviews.author: Sharon K
reviews.title: Great hotel for families, amazing service
reviews.text: 2nd time in this hotel for the second year in a row. We can't speak highly enough about Gabriel from the Family concierge- his amazing service, attention to details and genuine care just made out trip- and made us come back for the second year. We traveled with 2 small kids and we really looked for a vacation option to fit our needs.The family concierge service is exactly that- they cater all your hotel stay and travel needs with little kids. Great food, we recommend getting reservations a head of time to the fancy dinner options- Fuego, Bana & Vento (Gabriel took care of the dinner reservations as well). The Coco's bar on the beach deck with the Hukkah lounge is also great- Karina, the bartender always welcomed us with a big smile and made sure we get good service. Looking forward to our next vacation.

reviews.author: mparker129
reviews.title: All Inclusive Royal Treatment
reviews.text: Very pleased with the way everyone was so friendly!  Joel took extra special care if us at the Lapala restaurant.  Royal package was well worth the money private beach, pool, lobby, and service was terrific. Dinner dining was fabulous. Didn't explorer much of the main pool due to high volume of people.  Loved the private area that was never crowded.

reviews.author: Jennifer M
reviews.title: Should have stayed 10 days
reviews.text: Just returned from 7 days at the Paradisus Cancun and had an amazing time. The service was incredible from initial check in and thru out the week. Maria and Gloria from family concierge went above and beyond to accommodate my family. Even when my daughter was sick. The Market Grill restaurant is a must when visiting this resort. The only down side is there is no ac in the lobbies and the restaurants tend to be a bit warm. I wished we had stayed 10 days.

reviews.author: Catherine P
reviews.title: Keeps getting better and better
reviews.text:
We have now stayed at the Paradisus six times - and each time we visit, it gets better and better. They are constantly making upgrades that improve our experience - for example, putting new lamps in the rooms with USB charging ports on them. Very convenient. 

The restaurants also keep getting better. We really enjoyed Restaurante Bana. The sushi is fantastic and so are the fish entrees. We decided to eat there twice during our week-long stay. The manager Ezequiel stopped by our table each time to make sure we enjoyed everything and our waiter Catana was lovely and very helpful. 

The buffet at Restarant Naos is also a treat. The breakfast buffet is so good - it has literally anything you could want. I loved the fresh fruit bar and my husband had amazing chilequiles. The waiters are so friendly. We had the same waiters every day and after a day or two, they would anticipate what we wanted and would automatically bring us the jucies and coffees we wanted. Arturo BC, Eduardo and Fermin Antonio would joke with us, try to teach us a little Spanish and joke around with my son. Really really fun. 

I hope to be back again soon!

reviews.author: samantha799
reviews.title: So glad I chose the Paradisus
reviews.text: I booked our 2017 family vacation at the Paradisus Cancún and I am so happy that I did. Our overall experience was phenomenal. Our family concierge butlers Gabriel and Josue helped to make our stay great. They were always there to help answer any questions we had which were plenty. The rooms were good but the best parts were the overall resort atmosphere, the beautiful beach, good food and drinks and the friendly service from the staff. I would definitely recommend the Paradisus Cancún. I did not want to leave.

reviews.author: Mai N
reviews.title: Distisfied customer
reviews.text: Water leak into my room from the balcony. I had to put towels by the doors to stop the flooding. Water leaking from the from above into my bathroom. Two charges made on my credit that I did not authorize for.

reviews.author: allisonbN3118VA
reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text: Very beautiful hotel!! New and updated. Very clean. Very friendly, attentive and helpful staff. Beautiful decor. The food was just average, it could have been a little better, but I find sometimes that's the case with these all inclusive places. The food isn't top notch. They cut corners. Certain restaurants are better than others.  You need to make a reservation a day in advance for most restaurants- which can be a bit annoying.  My one complaint would be that the rooms need a stronger air conditioner. I had trouble sleeping due to being hot. I didnt sleep under the covers once during the trip, I had to sleep on top of them because I was sweaty. Maybe they should consider installing ceiling fans in the rooms or lowering the temperature by a few degrees. Certain areas of the hotel are very warm/humid and they need to crank up the AC or have more fans to circulate the hot humid air. It would be cool if they had a little more nightlife/entertainment. Overall, my boyfriend and I had a great, relaxing experience. I would recommend Paradisus to others.

reviews.author: julia_young891
reviews.title: BRILLIANT BRILLIANT BRILLIANT
reviews.text: We had an amazing time. Roseanna was so sweet and helpful. All the staff were very nice especially the barmen in our area and Octavia at la palapa. We will be back. Fish and chips are a must at la palapa but all the food was amazing

reviews.author: Amanda N
reviews.title: Amazing week and GREAT people!
reviews.text:
My husband and I returned home yesterday morning from a one week stay at Paradisus Cancun.  I would like to share our experience and thoughts for anyone considering visiting. (Forgive the length of my review LOL)

We stayed in Room 2211 (Pyramid 2, floor 2) which afforded us a beautiful ocean and pool view and a ridiculously huge balcony which spanned from our bedroom all the way around to the living room.  It was awesome!

Believe me when I say EVERYBODY we encountered was amazing, but the following people really went above and beyond to make us feel special and so well taken care of and these are some folks I will always remember and consider friends:
Arturo at Naos and Martin at Market Grill both of whom were always so attentive and friendly; Sergio and Laura who took GREAT care of us poolside and kept the buckets of bottled water cold and kept our drinks flowing often without us even having to ask, and Laura surprised us with a yummy plate of nachos; Eben and Samuel at the swim up pool bar who also kept the drinks flowing with a smile; Francisco at the Avenue Bar somehow remembered not only our names but also what we preferred to drink when we returned days later, he is quite the charmer.  Jennifer who was the hostess at Naos every morning was always such a pleasant friendly young lady.   Last but not least Pascual who seemed to be everywhere and always ready with a smile and would actually seek us out to greet us by name and a handshake. He made such an impression and someone both my husband and I seemed to connect with.  He is also quite the charmer.  :-) I do wish there were a way to keep in touch with these amazing people. 

As for the resort, the immediate impression upon entering was quite impressive. The main lobby and the Melia lobby, indoor gardens, koi ponds, fountains give it an amazing tropical and luxurious feel.  Upon check-in we were greeted with cold beverages and Melissa who completed our check-in was very friendly.  The resort itself IS quite large and could be tricky to navigate at first but we learned our way around quickly and I don’t feel we were ever too terribly far from anything.  The grounds were very well kept, and it seemed there was always touch-ups being done outdoors.  Yet they somehow managed to do the work without being obtrusive which we found very impressive.  Often we would see palapas being replaced or repaired long after the pool closed and people had left the pool area. (the only exception to this is on Friday there was a small area of the pool that was closed off as they are working on putting down new cement and replacing the pavers around the pools, but the work they were doing is going very quickly and I think will be a nice improvement over the hotter, bumpier pavers they previously had).

Our room was much larger than I anticipated and the king sized bed was decorated with rose petals as we were celebrating our honeymoon.  We also had a delivery of champagne and chocolate covered strawberries in our room as we arrived.  We had two full bathrooms with large, deep tubs and nice rain-shower shower heads.  Towels were plentiful but we did only get 2 face clothes all week which was a bit odd.  Shampoo, conditioner and soap were always in kept good supply.  Coffee for the coffee maker was plentiful and the fridge was always kept stocked with bottled water, juice, a couple of beers and some snacks (oreos, a fruit bar and a bag of chips).  We did see there is a toaster, full set of plates, glasses, coffee cups, flatware and an ice bucket although we personally did not have use for everything, they are there for your use.

The buffet offered a ridiculous amount of food, we certainly never went hungry! We found the food to be kept well-stocked, almost NEVER seeing anything running out. If it did it was replenished very quickly.

“CONS” which term I use loosely as these are in no way complaints, rather just some constructive criticisms regarding things we noticed:

We felt the restaurants open too late for dinner.  The few reservations our concierge made for us were just WAY too late (8:30 pm, 9:30 pm etc). Given we are from the East coast of the US with the time difference it was REALLY difficult to enjoy a dinner that late.  There was an earlier reservation made for us for dinner and there was some confusion about the time we were given and they did refuse to seat us which was unfortunate.  We never did get the reservation to Mole I requested a couple of times.

Also, as beautiful as the room was it is showing its age and could use some updating. This was most noticeable around the window frames and the sliders.  We were there for Tropical Storm Franklin and our room took on water through the sliding door in the living room AND the bedroom and water was also leaking into the bathroom window. If you take a close look at the window casings you can see they are somewhat shoddy looking and dusty.

The pool was HUGE and beautiful, kept very clean and I did not see any areas in need of repair but it is just too deep to really enjoy it for any period of time in my opinion.  Most places I either had to stand on my tip-toes and stretch my neck to keep my head above water, tread water or hang on the edge of the pool.  (I am 5’ 5”) That aspect was not terribly relaxing. Also, the pool closes very early (7:00 pm) and it would be nice if it were open later.

The pool bar was a great bonus and one of the reasons we chose this resort, but there were way too many kids allowed at the bar which somewhat limited our ability to find a seat and enjoy it.  I do wish this was monitored.  Also the use of personal speakers which were playing VERY loudly at or around the pool we found disruptive.  It seems many large groups of people were congregating around the pool with their music and kind of took over the pool bar.  We couldn’t hear the resort music and some of the music the other guests were playing was pretty vulgar and really loud.  We were hoping someone from the resort would have spoken to those guests. We were not the only people who were bothered by it. 

Overall we had an AMAZING memorable week and I would give anything to be sitting under my palapa right now enjoying the sounds of the waves behind me and Laura and Sergio keeping us hydrated.  It truly was a fantastic vacation and I hope to be able to come back soon to see my new Mexican friends as I miss them all already :-(

reviews.author: vmar13162
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: The service was excellent. Our favorite restaurant was fuego and the chef Elio was great. Bana was also really good. And the waiter Ignacio from Blue Agave gave excellent service as well as Asunción from the beach. Overall great place. Very family friendly.

reviews.author: Jose P
reviews.title: Great Food Attentive Staff.
reviews.text:
We were there from August 4th- 10th. I could not give it 5 stars because our room a/c stopped working twice( The issue was resolved shortly thereafter). And some staff members constantly trying to sell us excursions. Also the hotel is kept warm in the  open center of the hotel, someone said because of the vegetation. i told them that a hotel called Gaylord Palms in Florida had twice the amount of vegetation in the center and was never warm. This Hotel has a lot of steps. Steps to the pool, steps to the beach, Steps out front of the property.
One staff member that stands out is Roberto at the Avenue Bar. He kept us entertained so with a party of eight we made the Avenue Bar our late nite meeting point. Thanks Roberto and thanks for the magic tricks.
Although because of the excursions we did we were not able to eat at all the restaurants. The ones that we ate at were outstanding.

reviews.author: Eileen F
reviews.title: Just Got Back August 2017 & It's Still my favorite Resort
reviews.text:
I go back for it's warm hospitality, clean rooms, delicious food, attention to details and the amazing pools and beach.....VIVA MEXICO!!!

All the restaurants that this resort offers are great. I've stayed in the Club area and the hotel side and have NEVER been disappointed.  Great job in creating a distinguished resort.

reviews.author: Majdi S
reviews.title: DISASTER
reviews.text:
Air conditioning non existent in common restaurants and areas including Avenue Bar.
The ballroom where we attended a wedding reception had no air conditioning  prompting staff to distribute cold wet towels to put around our necks .  Re family pool, although service was very good, however overall pool depth is  5-8 to  6 feet.It reduced our interaction with our grandkids.

reviews.author: abolduc0824
reviews.title: Happy and Not so Happy Traveler
reviews.text:
Service provided by Asuncion our waitress at the pool bar was excellent!  Always had a smile on her face and couldn't do enough for us.
On the other hand; I was very dissatisfied with your policy of leaving pool chairs vacant for 30 minutes and security removing my personal property.  I awoke each morning at 6:00 AM to secure seating by the pool.  One particular morning; we went to breakfast and to your gift shop where we spent money; only to return to find security had removed my personal items.  No chairs available and no assistance from your pool manager.  However, on another day he assisted another family of 12 with getting chairs????  I was not a happy guest.

reviews.author: Shaylan P
reviews.title: GREAT HOTEL AND RESORT
reviews.text:
We came this Summer and stayed with he family concierge package, Gabriel was a great help and would definitely recommend. The lobby is lush and absolutely beautiful. The pool and beach was fantastic, with great service. We have been to Cancun 3 times now, and this hotel was definitely the best.
100% RECCOMMEND

reviews.author: mojorojo0
reviews.title: Patel family review
reviews.text: Very nice resort, rooms are a little dated, but beautiful pool,restaurants and views.  We were very happy with the family concierge, well worth it.  Gabriel did a wonderful job, was very helpful , friendly and accommodated us our entire stay in June 2017.  Even after we left, we contacted Gabriele regarding our professional family photographs, and he looked into it for us, and responded with the information we asked him.  Exceptional....

reviews.author: Art M
reviews.title: A hotel that is designed with intricate detail. You won't want to leave your hotel.
reviews.text:
The hotel is breath taking. You are greeting by lovely staff ready to make your stay exceptional.  The hotel is very clean and very organized. I went here with my girlfriend and as a young couple we fell in love with the hotel. There are so many things to do at the hotel, you honestly won't want to leave. 

The staff was super friendly, and it is a genuine friendliness. When we got to the hotel 
our check in was at 3:00 however our arrival was at 7a.m so we had to kill time for a few hours because there weren't any available rooms. 

To compensate for the wait, Miguel upgraded us from regular to Royal Service " which is like a 500 dollar bonus on Expedia". 

I had a few people help me that really made me appreciate and enjoy my stay. I would like to thank Dafne who works concierge , she did an exceptionally amazing job. She made sure everything was perfect and on point. She would call my room to check if I'm happy with my stay and if I need any services. She was very professional and courteous. 

I would also like to thank Daniel who was my butler for the Royal Service, He helped me orchestrate a great stay full of wonderful surprises.

reviews.author: tuckera2
reviews.title: Wonderful Hotel / Fantastic Staff
reviews.text:
My wife and i are just completing 5 nights at the Paradisus Cancun.
We are club Melia members and were given a very comfortable 1Br. / 2Full Ba. suite.
 Check in was quick and without incident. The hotel is large and beautifully appointed.
The Real assets that set this vacation apart form many others was the staff.
At check in Ms. Betsabe Ornelas and Mr. Luis Herrera were so patient, pleasant and knowledgeable they made us very comfortable set the tone for our entire vacation. Ms. Ornelas called to see if there we any problems with our accommodations and was just as pleasant and helpful at check out as she was at check in.
Our Concierge was Mr. Luis Herrera, he explained everything about the resort to us and made all our diner reservations at the restaurants of our choosing. We were trying  to schedule a time for a presentation but i became ill and rather than pressing us to reschedule he came by our room everyday to see how we were doing or if we needed anything.
My wife and i will definitely return here next year because of the excellent treatment we received from these exceptional members of the Club Melia team.

reviews.author: fiordalizan
reviews.title: Wonderful Cancun Experience
reviews.text: Our family had an amazing experience at the Paradisus and made many unforgettable memories.  The staff was friendly and very efficient.  The pool and beach areas were beautifully maintained.  The lobby of the hotel takes your breath away.

reviews.author: A A
reviews.title: Great place to visit.
reviews.text: I had a great experience. Would like to go back with my family. Not in the summer and good place for wedding. We went for my niece wedding and it was great. The weather was not comfortable and was hot and humid.

reviews.author: Anthony M
reviews.title: Paradisus August stay
reviews.text: Excellent service. Felt pampered. Tempo was unique experience, well worth the extra cost. Did not utilize all services, such as mini bar - didn't know it was there. Some restaurants hard to get into. Electrical outlets in our rooms did not work. One sparked and thought a fire would start.

reviews.author: kimhT1665IZ
reviews.title: Not satisfied
reviews.text: Location is ok. Beach is always rough. Kids can only play in pool not beach too rough. Restaurant has to be reserved 2 days ahead. Spa services prices are tripled from US. Not much family friendly. Entertainment was so boring. No originality at all.

reviews.author: Eric H
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradise
reviews.text: We were just there and had a great time. I highly recommend getting The Royal Service. It's well worth it. Our butler Eduardo was so friendly and efficient and catered to our every need. The staff is all very friendly and eager to please. We've been there before and have had the same great experience. We love to hang out at the pool all day in the bali beds and our server Joel was extremely attentive. We never had an empty glass. He surprised us with special treats and drinks that we loved. We would definitely go again.

reviews.author: EdizSr
reviews.title: Great value for the money; great place with the family
reviews.text:
We just spent 7 days/nights in August. Truly enjoyed our stay. Total of 5 people (3 kids) in 2 rooms. 
Arrived with red eye around 7 am; front desk worked hard to accommodate us.. at 11 AM we had rooms. Great service! Instead of telling us, check-in is after 3 PM.
We tried all restaurants except the Japanese one in the center. Our favorites are Vento and Mole.. Blue Agave was great as well. We had multiple lunches trying different tacos. 
If you are looking for a lot of activity this may not be ideal place.. Iwe were there mainly for a relaxing vacation.. beach, pool, drinks and family time. Mission accomplished. Hotal staff worked hard to make our stay pleasant. Again excellent service.
Overall large resort; multiple pools, beach as expected beautiful but we had a lot of wind and big waves when we were there. If you have really young kids it may not be ideal at the beach. so pool area.
Our younger son enjoyed Kid Zone. He spent a lot of time there. 
After couple of days kids were able to roam around without any issue. 
Highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: lboogie4evr
reviews.title: Had a great time overall..
reviews.text: I can only speak from the Butler/Royal service, since that's where me and my girls stayed.  The wing of the hotel was lovely and being away from all the kids during our vacay was appreciated.  The property itself was pretty big, we often had to ask for directions to different restaurants. The pool was mostly empty and the restaurant solely for Royal Service customers was where we ate the most (La Palapa). The butler herself was seldom around and helped us maybe twice during our entire trip.  She tried to redeem herself towards the end of the trip, which was nice but we mostly had to fend for ourselves or see someone at front desk when we had requests. She was very nice though.  The lobby area in the Royal service wing was always stocked with bottled water and fresh fruit and cheese and pastries.  It was also air conditioned unlike the lobby of the main lobby, which was extremely hot and muggy at all times.  Our rooms were lovely, some had better views than others.  Ours was of a garden and had a few plants on the balcony which were long dried and dead.  The beds were comfy and the bathroom was modern.  In the morning we thought the power had gone out after we had a hard time putting the lights on only to discover that there's a switch to turn all the electricity on in the room. I felt like someone should've mentioned that at check in, that it would happen daily. We tried many of the restaurants but not all.  The buffet, Naos, was mediocre. Enso had a nice ambiance, but the only food we liked were the spring rolls.  Everything else was mediocre at best. The Brazilian restaurant Market Grille, was great, the food was flavorful and they kept it coming.  It had some beautiful outdoor seating, that was nice when the heat was bearable. Blue Agave was a small Mexican restaurant that I liked a lot. La Palapa had an amazing view of the ocean, and had a little of everything on their menu and a bar adjacent to the pool, which made it a favorite of mine.  Mole' was a fancy Latin restaurant where the food was pretty decent, depending on what you got.  The vibe was awesome in this place, they had a live mariachi band playing at times, and even took requests. We had a problem with the maitre'd at Vento, though, because he couldn't find our reservation, even though we made them all a day in advance (which I highly recommend for dinner) and they were very rude about it.  After all the fuss, I disliked the food so much, I wish I hadn't gone in the first place. There was an outdoor BBQ that looked really nice, but we were unaware of it. I would try and make a reservation for that next time, not sure of the name, but it was right outside of Market Grill.  The nightlife was almost non-existent at this resort after dinner everything was pretty quiet, even the pool on the Royal service wing closed early,  there was maybe one 'show' a night, but they were all in the lobby area that was too hot to bear, even at night. We visited the Red Lounge the first night, very small and hot also. The DJ was surprisingly good and since we didn't have plans that night we just accepted the fact that it would be a sweat box and enjoyed the music. Bottom line, I had a good time, and would prob return but would def return to Royal service.  Also, if you walk the beach, all the other hotels are lined up, which I liked. Different vendors and water sports to choose from and shop for the best price.

reviews.author: Marc G
reviews.title: Nice resort with very good service
reviews.text:
We booked the all inclusive package through Apple and my family stayed for 6 days / 5 nights.  It was my wife, my son -20yrs and daughter 16 yrs. We all had a great time. Paradisus is beautiful and the service was very good. Here is a breakdown:

Rooms:  We had two lagoon facing rooms ion the first floor in building 1 which turns out to be where the time share rooms are located. Even on the first floor we had a great view of the sunset. The rooms were sizable with kitchenettes and a jacuzzi tub on the deck. Although the rooms were nice and clean they were a bit dated. My wife also 'blew a fuse' / tripped the circuit breaker several times during our stay with her hair dryer.  I only called one time for them to fix and it was immediate. Once I saw where the breaker was I just hit the switch on my own when it happened again. 

We were offered two "upgrades" when we checked in which we did not take. Ocean view for $80 per room per night  or Royal Service Lagoon View for $120 per room per night. I didn't see the value in this. However, if you are looking for quiet, more low key spaces then Royal Service might be worth it to you. 

Resort: It was certainly beautiful as the center atrium with tropical foliage is a focal point. However, the trade off was the interior restaurants and lounge areas were not very cool. At night, it was almost better to be outside by the pool where there was a breeze. 
Check in and check out were easy and the bell men were always attentive. We got in at 11am so our room wasn't ready but they have changing rooms with shower/bath room.  The pool was great, the pool bar was hopping and it wasn't hard to get a drink. However, over the week I will tell you it was not easy to get chairs by the pool or on the beach if you showed up after 10am. 

The one area where we spent some extra money was paying for a Bali bed at Coco's Beach Club. The first full day we went all in and got the Bali bed with champagne and lobster. Ran about $180 USD for the full day. The next few days we didn't get lobster but rebooked the Bali bed with champagne for about $120. There were always empty Bali beds and we were quoted $100 for the ones by the pool. My guess is you can negotiate these prices if you like to negotiate especially if you come down the day of in the afternoon and just want it for a couple of hours. 

Melia is selling time shares (they will only call it a membership) so be prepared to be lured (they offered 2 free messages in the spa) to have breakfast with a sales rep. They made a couple of attempts but it wasn't the least bit aggressive. Very respectful.  We did not participate in one of those breakfasts.  

Restaurants: The food was pretty good and certainly plentiful. The major downside is you HAVE to make dinner reservations in advance for the reservation based restaurants. We never got a same day reservation. It took multiple tries to get into Market Grill and we never got into Mole. 
For us, the highlight was the Taco and Tequila restaurant.  No reservation needed and the food quality was really good. We ate dinner here twice.  Casual, fun and delicious.  
They also pulled together two reservation only poolside buffets. One Italian and one BBQ.  We were able to get same day reservations. 
Liquor had top shelf available however, an upsell is also available. For example, Kettle One and Belvedere are included but Grey Goose is extra unless your in Royal Service. 
Included wines were not to our liking and there is an opportunity to buy bottles of wine they aren't pouring by the glass. 

Extra Tipping-not required but certainly appreciated and you can only do it in cash (dollar or peso).   The service and attention was really good. The staff really wants you to enjoy yourself and they work hard. We did tip.

reviews.author: RikHD
reviews.title: Almost five stars
reviews.text:
PROS
Lots of restaurant, but missing an italian one.  
Golf is free but only 9 holes 100 yards each, bring 3-4 clubs.
The rooms are nice and comfy.
The service is fantastic.
Bus service to go downtown is safe and cheap, 1$.  Great shopping nearby.
The pools are clean.
Fridge is always full.
Asian restaurant was the best, Enso.
The facility is top notch.

CONS
The pizza is bad
The golf has no distance, no signs, nothing,
The waves are rough in the ocean, always red flag.
My wife got food poisonning at tapas restaurant, Vento.
Doctor advices cost $120.  But the doctor gave free advices to my wife to buy pedialite.
Things are expensive to buy, go across the street.

Royal service is good if you need someone to take care of you, pool area is silent but with no atmosphere.

reviews.author: 9lisa58
reviews.title: Amazing vacation!
reviews.text: My daughter and I celebrated my 60th birthday at the Paradisus Cancun and loved every moment!  We stayed 8/2/2017-8/7/2017.   Upon arrival, check in was very quick.  They did not offer us the Royal Service...not sure why because I probably would have upgraded. But, I have to tell you, the service we received was excellent! They knew it was my birthday and when we entered our room there were balloons, confetti and cake with candles!!  It was such a great surprise and made me feel so great!  The hotel is beautiful and very clean.  Our room was beautiful ocean view.  The A/C worked very well, the beds were very comfortable. The hotel has a lot of foliage, which makes it so beautiful, so it is humid, but that was OK with me because it did not seem hot to me. The pools are wonderful, there is always different entertainment by the pool which was fun!   I felt the food was very, very good!  We ate at the buffet, they had lots of food stations outside which was convenient, and very good!  We also ate at the Japanese restaurant one night too which was good. The maids were excellent and kept our room clean and the mini bar stocked well.  Of course we tipped them  $5 every day we were there. I appreciated how they had our room cleaned early in the day.  They deserve it; they work hard. In fact,  all the employees at this hotel work extremely hard and always have smiles on their faces.  I just can't recommend this hotel enough!! I can't wait to return....

reviews.author: ricardoi898
reviews.title: Great time with family!
reviews.text: This place is phenomenal! People working there are very friendly and polite. Pools are great and very clean beaches! Food at restaurants is very good. Overall experience was amazing! Highly recommend this Hotel for a great family vacation!

reviews.author: Kara1114
reviews.title: It's an Ok Hotel
reviews.text:
I travelled with my mother to the Paradisus Cancun July 21st-27th. This was our first time in Cancun and overall we had a very nice vacation. We stayed in the regular section of the hotel and did not get the royal service package.

Pros:
- The hotel grounds are extremely beautiful and well maintained
- The wait staff in the buffet are super friendly. Omar was our favorite waiter. I have an allergy to sesame and one night during our stay it was "Asian Night" which meant I could not eat most of the food since sesame oil was used in it; our waiter was Pablo that day and he was kind enough to let the manager of the buffet know about my allergy. The manager allowed me to eat from the royal service section where there were more options that did not include sesame.
- The beach is beautiful!! The sand was nice and powdery. There was a lot of seaweed in the water and on the beach for the first few days of our stay but, I know that can't be helped sometimes
- The hotel is pretty clean. Our room was fairly clean as well. 
- Our room had a really nice view

Cons:
- The check in process is so lengthy and disorganized. If you're like my mom and I and like to relax in the room for a few minutes after your flight, I would suggest that you try and arrive to the hotel after 3:00pm so that your room will be ready upon arrival. We arrived to the hotel around 11am and did not get into our room until about 3:15pm. Check in is at 3:00pm and there is no way they will allow you to check in earlier. BRING A PRINTED COPY OF YOUR RESERVATION! When we gave our name to the women at the front they said the they had no reservation under our name. We showed her the copy of our reservation and she brought it to another woman who was able to locate it after a few minutes.

-We stayed in the main building where all of the restaurants were and the Wifi is kind of non-existent on the first floor of this building. I would suggest getting a room on a higher floor for stronger wifi.

- Buffet is extremely basic. We didn't end up eating at any of the restaurants because it was nearly impossible to make a reservation so we ate at the buffet the entire time. The food was either over salted, did not have enough seasoning, or had too much oil in it. There were several occasions when even the rice was in a pool of oil. Don't expect there to be any authentic mexican food because they really dull the food down to try and fit what they think the guests like. Even something as simple as the guacamole didn't taste good. The cloth napkins at the table were almost always dirty and stained every time we sat down. BEWARE OF THE FISH LABELED WHITE TUNA! It is not white tuna, it's escolar and it made my mom sick for the first few days. Escolar is an oil fish which caused my mom to have really bad diarrhea and caused oil to leak from her bottom!! Whatever you do, stay away from anything they label as white tuna because it's not.

- BE CAREFUL WHO YOU BOOK YOUR EXCURSIONS WITH! Upon check in they assign a concierge to you who is supposed to explain more about the hotel and answer any questions you may have. Our concierge was Marta who tried to force us into a timeshare/royal service presentation. It took about 30 minutes of us saying "no, we are not interested" for her to finally stop trying to pressure us to attend. After she was done with the timeshare pitch I asked her where we could go to book excursions. She walked us over to an Expedia excursion booth and told us that we could book here. We booked two excursions, one to Isla Mujeres and one to Chichen Itza. We went to Isla Mujeres two days before Chichen Itza and had a great time with no issues. However, Chichen Itza was a disaster. We were in the lobby by 7:00am just as we were told to be. We waited for 45 MINUTES and OUR TOUR BUS NEVER SHOWED UP. After seeing that we were out there for almost an hour without the bus coming, one of the guys at the front desk in the lobby offered to call the tour company for us. He called and they said that they had no record of our reservation. The man at the front desk who called for us suggested that we go back to the booth where we booked the excursion once the staff arrived and see what happened. Later on that day as we made our way to the expedia booth from our room, we were stopped by a man who worked for Otium, another tour company within the hotel, he had recognized us from standing outside earlier that morning. He explained to us that Marta should not have brought us to the expedia excursion booth and should have brought us to Otium instead; he said depending on what travel agency or website you book your vacation package through, you have to go to the according excursion booth inside the hotel. I have no idea how they expect their guests to know that if no one tells us! Also, it should be up to the concierge to ensure that we are at the right booth!! Fortunately he was very kind and was able to get us on a tour bus to Chichen Itza for the next day with their tour company and we did not have to pay any additional costs. I am not sure if Marta brought us to the wrong excursion booth on purpose because she was annoyed that we weren't interested in the timeshare but, it certainly discouraged us from asking her anything for the remainder of our stay.

-The pool is always crowded until probably 6pm. There were never any chairs available no matter how early we got up. The water in the pool is so warm too. It was easily over 90 degrees everyday we were there and the pool water was anything but refreshing.

- There are cabanas called bali beds that you can rent out for the day by the pool or by the beach. At first the concierge Marta, told us that it was $50-$100 to rent one for the day. After a few days we decided to rent one since we could never find seating at the pool but we we were told they were all $120. We decided against renting one because we wee skeptical since the price keep changing for whatever reason.

Overall it is a nice hotel but, I would not say it was worth the money that we spent. The hotel advertises itself as a 5 star luxury hotel but, I would not agree with that statement. This is probably just an extremely basic all-inclusive, I'm sure there are better options out there if your are looking for luxury.

reviews.author: 585aliciae
reviews.title: Not enough air conditioning!
reviews.text: This resort needs more air conditioning especially at the places where you eat!  Main pool is to deep to walk around and to many young children hanging around the bar.  Location is great!  Service good!  Cooler air in rooms too!

reviews.author: Chris E
reviews.title: One of the best holidays I have ever been on
reviews.text:
From start to finish this was one of the best holidays I have ever been on. We had opted to go All Inclusive in the Royal suite, and it was the best hotel experience i have ever received. The attention to detail in every area of the hotel was sublime.

Every member of staff, from cleaner to management greeted you at any opportunity with a warm welcoming smile or hello. They clearly all took pride in the job they were doing.

The food was also impeccable. We tried most of the restaurants, except the Michelin Star, and the food was simply to die for. 

There was also plenty to do around the hotel, we had our own private beech area which was a nice added touch for the Royal Suite, and though we did not spend too much time in the hotel, we could've quite easily spent the whole holiday there.

I am very much looking to returning in the near future!

reviews.author: James F
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Royal Service
reviews.text: My wife and i stayed at the Paradisus Cancun Aug. 4th-9th in a Royal Service jr. suite ocean view. This is my honest to the bone assessment of our stay. First of all do not stay here without an upgrade to royal service. Why?...There is a major and i mean major difference. When we arrived  we received a gold band which gave us preferential treatment at the resort. We were pampered with a personal butler and our service was over and above all of the black-bands. It sounds ridiculous but its absolutely true. Staff everywhere knew us by name and was extremely caring and hospitable. We could've stayed in the Royal service area the whole time and never regretted a thing. Pyramids 1-4 was hot and muggy, only a few restaurants had air conditioning. However, our suite was ice cold. I requested a fan because i like to sleep with one. Our butler (Rode) accommodated quickly. The pool service was second to none.  Moises and Eddie begged us to ask for anything and they would try to oblige. It was almost embarrassing for us how much they cared about our stay. The Market Grill was by far our favorite restaurant for dinner. We were required to have a reservation wherever we went, which our butler did for us. Since we had Royal service, our transportation was included from Otium. We did not make any spa reservations but we did use the free water ritual treatments offered to Royal Service guests! Room service is also offered to Royal service at no charge. The beach had a little seaweed but was big and chairs were always available! We were afforded a bali bed everyday by the pool and service was excruciatingly good! Make this your next vacation if you want top-notch personal service. Spend the extra for the upgrade or book a different resort. DO NOT BOOK THIS WITHOUT ROYAL SERVICE! I promise you'll be disappointed if you do! Thank you Paradisus and a special thanks to Rode, Maria, Eddie, Moises, Javier, Omar, and Jose!

reviews.author: Christina L
reviews.title: This one takes the cake!!!!
reviews.text:
My husband and I just got back from a week at paradise...I mean at the Paradusis Cancun! We stayed in building 5, which is the adults only  Royal Service. Check in here was efficient and quick. We had a lagoon room but upgraded to an ocean view room and let me tell you it was well worth the upgrade. The room was AMAZING, AC was super cold (I was freezing at night) the bathroom was to die for, and the bed (once we realized we needed to flip it to the pillow topper) was really comfortable. The buffet was just okay for us. There was always something to eat but it was Luke warm at best. The Royal Service restaurant food was great, fresh and always hot. We tried a few of the other ala carte restaurants and they were pretty good. We did enjoy the free spa services that were included in the royal service package. The hydro jets were well worth it as well as the massage that we received from Brenda and Justina. They definitely know how to give a great message. The drinks were normally very strong and that is just how we like them :)  Ricardo was the best RS waiter, he always had a drink for us when we were out. We only swam in the adult pool and while we were there the water level had been lowered about a foot so we did not have any issues with it being too deep when walking around. The beach was good, didn't stay out there much because the water was a little too rough for our liking. We did not enjoy the nightly shows at all. They were very bland and they lip sang to all other artists songs. We did see a lot of mosquitos but I kept bug spray on and neither of us got bitten. 

I have to give a MAJOR shoutout to our butler Eduardo. He was such a kind, attentive, generous man. Paradusis really got it right with him. He was always there when you needed him and let you know he was there even when you didn't need him. We never had a butler before and let me tell you, he set the standards really high for if we ever have one again. We loved this resort so much, we accepted the welcome breakfast that Alexa set up for us and joined the Melia Resort Time Share. We are very excited to be apart of the Melia Club and cant wait to use our free 4 day 3 night trip in October. Thank you so much to the hard working Paradusis team, we will be back!!!

reviews.author: holreview2016
reviews.title: Great holiday
reviews.text: Just sitting in the room waiting to leave unfortunately. This is our last day and tropical storm Franklyn has hit the coast so the rain is here and it's windy but that has not dampened what has been an excellent holiday. The staff at paradisus cancun could not have done anymore to make this a perfect time. The food, facilities and staff could not have been improved in anyway. I have been in the royal service section of the hotel and I would recommend if possible. Thanks to all for a great time

reviews.author: bi0n0
reviews.title: Good, but declined from our visit the prior summer - I still recommend it
reviews.text: This hotel is still a very good value and I would recommend it for all it offers, always clean with hard-working friendly staff.  But the restaurants were not as good as the prior summer, and as repeat customers we did not get any benefit, we had to wait hours beyond normal check-in to get in our room, check-in was extremely slow, and the room locations were bad but were corrected the second day (albeit the hassle of moving to another room). If you are a larger group (7 of us) they will try and serve you what they call " family style meals" instead of showing you the menu.  Always ask to see the menu because family style meals were more like tapas with infrequent visits with random small portions of food without some of the offerings from the menu. It took us until our 3rd dinner to ask for the menu, because it was not offered to us the previous two times.  I'll end this on a positive note, this hotels benefits are a good bang for the buck, clean, friendly, good large pool, great swim up bar, afternoon entertainment at the pool, few young children (more adult), large selection of bars and restaurants and type of food (and all of the bars and restaurants are actually open for service unlike many Cancun hotels), large private balcony, nice rooms, good gym, and other offerings.

reviews.author: DanyBlanco1975
reviews.title: Summer Annual Vacation Spot
reviews.text:

This time I would like to thank Cristian  & Fernando at NAOS for their TOP NOTCH attention, every time we were there. Also the guy at the coffee & donoughts station . I can not wait until next year.

reviews.author: sfppn5
reviews.title: Best place to go
reviews.text:

Alberto,Vincent and Orlando were the best they went out of there way to  make sure we had everything we needed and if they didn't have it they made sure to try and get it and go out of there way for us this really makes a difference when you have great service like this we looked forward to seeing them ever morning and after noon for breakfast and lunch.
