reviews.author: Dcastro72
reviews.title: We Truly Enjoyed the Royal Service & Adults Only vacation!
reviews.text:
We traveled with four of us in Two rooms..... the team did a great job accommodating our wishes to stay near one another. It was our sons anniversary and they decorated the room with flowers & balloons - it was sweet!!

The rooms were beautifully appointed and the views were amazing!

They didn't a great job stocking waters, sodas, beer and any kind of alcohol you'd like... we had several bottles brought to the room and had Cranberry and OJ in there to mix... you can take what you don't drink - which was cool.

Eduardo was our assigned Butler - he went above and beyond to ensure our vacation was stress free!! I've read other reviews about not being able to get dinner reservations... he asked us several questions about our likes and dislikes and made reservations for us the entire week. He even rescheduled once we knew what we liked.

He reserved Bali Beds for us on 4 days, two of which were beachfront - it was fantastic and we had great service from LaPalapa All day. Caesar was a hustler!!

La Palapa was my favorite place to eat - for me personally there's nothing like eating a meal oceanfront and hearing the waves crashing in. Special kudos to Valeria, Octavio & Edier...they kept La Palapa humming each day I was there. (Great Breakfast - chillaquilles & Lunch - fish & chips, Mexican Pizza and save room for dessert)

Some of the food wasn't to our taste but a few notable locations

- Bana - great sushi and service
- Market Grill - dinner is a Brazilian steakhouse with an awesome selections of meats and veggies
- Blue Agave - great Al pastor tacos & great service anytime of the day!!!

Two minor Cons:

Our A/C never quite cooled our room to our liking but They tried twice with slight improvement... the room will be remodeled soon so I'm sure it will be improved... our sons room was freezing 🤧 so we knew what was possible.

Otium desk for shuttles & excursions - we booked a snorkeling trip and my husband woke up feeling sluggish and opted not to go... they said they couldn't give a refund or credit since it was the day of - unless we had a doctors note. Then we go to our excursion and had a great time except our return shuttle was 70 mins late 
.... it was painfully hot and uncomfortable to be waiting around that long.

We all truly enjoyed our weeklong vacation here & really want to Thank the entire Paradisus staff - they were all Amazing & so friendly! We intend on coming back!

reviews.author: Luis C
reviews.title: I was very good vacation,
reviews.text: the hotel is very unique, need maintenance all over the place, the food was excellent, what really made the hotel a unique experience for me was the customer service, everyone was always ready to help, and serve you in a very professional wait in special Alexander our advisor  he is outstanding on his day off Fernanda was covering for him she was also very good. The night at Mole Restaurant also was excellent, last night at FUEGO restaurant not good at all.

reviews.text:

Best regards,

reviews.author: GracieC12
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: We had an amazing family vacation (4 adults, 1 child, 1 toddler) at Paradisus Cancun. The staff was amazing. There are a couple of people that really stood out and went the extra mile to make our vacation extra special. Miguel, Dider and Sergio in the pool area, Jorge in the concierge pool area, Caudencio in the buffet was fantastic with my kids. The pools and the beach are beautiful. We did the mixology class, Zumba, aerobics and the sushi class. There's so much to do!!! And at the same time if you just want to relax and sunbath it's the perfect location. The food was delicious! My favorite was Vento, and my husband's was Mole. Muchsimas gracias Paradisus Cancun!!

reviews.author: Yanetgonzalez
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel: Paradisus Cancun. Yanet Gonzalez
reviews.text: Excellent Hotel. This was our 6 time in Cancun and our second in this hote. We were here last year, and we loved so much that we decided to comeback this summer 2017. It is a little expensive( you can find a all inclusive hotel in the hotel zone for a little less $, as you can find a way more expensive one) but this one  is worth it for everything that offeres. Excellent food, a lot of Restaurant were you can eat every Nigth. Excellent food, at Naos Restaurant "GAUDENCIO" always served us, great attention, he is awsome. At Bana Restaurant "ROBERT" is great, as well as the peruvian Restaurant, Fuego, which is my favorite. The only thing that i didn't like that much was we need to make a reservation before you go to the Restaurant, but it has to be made the Same day and every time we called was full, that bothered me, but if you talk to your consiergue they always help you, "MOISES" was our consiergue and was excellent. Recomendation, if you decide to take any excursión always reserve it through the hotel agency, don't go anywhere else, we had a bad Experience with someone else, but at the end everything was solved, fírst time that happened to us. The hotel is always clean with beautiful flowers. Rooms are clean, they do it twice a day. Plenty of towels for the pool and the beach. Always have activities at the pool. If you have kids, they have amazing kids club, our daughter didn't want to leave the club. Please, always remember to tip at least a little the people who serves you, especially the ones at the beach and the pool, they work very hard under the sun and the heat, it is just a token of appreciattion. I hope this help you a lot to decided to choose the right hotel for you in cancun and enjoy your vacacions as we did. Couples only, families, kids, they have for everyone. Paradisus Cancún se you next year 😊😍 (overall, everyone there is amazing) 👌🏼👍🏻

reviews.author: tempest s
reviews.title: BED BUGs!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: On May 17, 2017 I took my two daughters on their first trip to a carribean island and we stayed at Pardisus Resorts in Cancun, MX.  The first night we stayed, I woke up with 12 bites on my right side. I didn't notice until I got in the shower around 8am on May 18th that I felt my side  itching and burning when the water hit it.  When I got out the shower I was shock to see 12 large bed bug bite. Now you may ask, how did you know it was bed bugs? 1. I'm an RN so I see many bedbug bites on people and two I pulled back the mattress and found them scattering. I immediately packed our belongings and went to front desk. Unfortunately, staff was none caring stating the "rash" came from the algae in the ocean. I NEVER STEP FOOT ON THE BEACH  I told them but they didn't seem to care and put us in another room.  I ask if they could dry clean our clothes because some were on the bed and they said no, not without a fee.  The service was horrible and I still today have the bed bug marks as a reminder of how nasty the hotel was.  PLEASE PLEASE DO NOT STAY AT THIS HOTEL!!!!! Though it looks beautiful, the hotel is not clean and customer service is horrible!!!! I will never stay at any of Grand Melia resorts (the mother company for Paradisus). You have been warned, please doe not stay here.

reviews.author: jerry5072017
reviews.title: Excellent hotel and service
reviews.text:
Family vacation with our 2 kids, age 4 and 1. Loved the hotel, the attention and service to the customer, and the overall attitude by every single employee that we came in contact with. Truly and outstanding experience that exceeded our expectations. Our only issue was with the A/C not cooling enough, but am sure they will be addressing this as they are remodeling their rooms. The whole experience was so good that in retrospect, this is just a minor detail.
We will definitely go back. Even my older one was saying... "Daddy, we should come back here every year", and I think we will....

reviews.author: Bballluke
reviews.title: Couldn't ask for better!!!
reviews.text: This hotel is awesome!  Could not ask for better. Royal Service is a must, and a special thanks to Maria our butler who is now our friend. She made our trip experience the absolute best. Shout out to Jorge and Javier for taking care of us at LaPalapa and royal lounge. Ernesto sent us on great excursions that our family loved!  Everyone was so kind and helpful and the hotel is beautiful. So clean!!!  Thank you Paradisus and we will see you again soon.

reviews.author: Valdir V
reviews.title: Excellent food and pool
reviews.text:
This is an excellent all inclusive hotel for the family. Internal decoration is great with a lot of green. The pool is one of the best I have seen. They had very nice shows every night. All 8 restaurants are very good. Service is also outstanding. A special thanks for the maître on Italian/BBQ night by the pool. He and the team work in these dinners were fantastic.
We also loved the service at the Japanese restaurant (Bana). One tip: Lagoon view is as good as ocean view as you can see the par-3 golf course and the city center. Golf is free at hotel course, Just paying about $30 for rental clubs.

reviews.author: mc20172017
reviews.title: Not sure it was worth the price tag
reviews.text: I think the number one thing my husband and I could not get over was how hot it was everywhere in this hotel.   I understand it's hot outside and they have all this foliage inside but we shouldn't be uncomfortably warm inside the restaurants and in our room.  The food was okay.  Some of it was really good and some of it was just okay.   The rooms were not anything fancy and you can see the wear and tear throughout the hotel.  For dinner, they said reserve the day before in the morning, but when I called they were already booked for most of the restaurants.  If you go, make sure you just reserve all your dinners for the entire time you are there the first day you get there or you won't get in, and will be stuck doing the buffet or tacos again.  The beach was beautiful.   The swimming pools were incredibly hot as well.  The staff were very nice.   We tipped everyone because we could see how hard they worked.  The entertainment was pretty good.  They work their butts off.   I wish there was a better space for them to do the shows because it was crowded and they were smashed into unconventional places to perform.  Overall, we enjoyed ourselves.  This was our honeymoon and they did do flowers and champagne and fruit the first day which was nice.  Will not stay be staying at this hotel on our next trip.

reviews.author: 721akina
reviews.title: AK
reviews.text:
Fantastic and memorable. The rooms, pool area, access to beach, food, drink and attentive nature of staff were of the highest standard. Wanted to stay for the whole summer.
The staff make you feel welcome and looked after the whole time. Once they have an idea what you like they tailor the service to your needs very effectively

reviews.author: wanderlust-TRIP
reviews.title: Great place for a family vacation with room for improvement.
reviews.text:
We came to Paradisus in July for one week, hoping that everything we had read about the resort was accurate. Indeed it was and, this the four star rating. This place is definitely worth returning to, but in order to make it 100% some things need improving.

Check in:  We booked a great deal on Hotwire so we expected not the the best room. We were sent to the basement and to the Club Melia building where it is depressing and dark. We immediately returned to the front desk and felt that with a 5 year old in tow, it wasn't safe to be on the bottom floor. They gave us another room and then my 5 year old daughter opened the closet door only to reveal several pairs of shoes. Shortly after, a man opened the door on the other side. We went back to the front desk and they gave us another basement room and promised to move us in the morning. We were able to do this but the number of moves could have been avoided if they only realized that the Club Melia side is no man's land.  And if everyone else is correct when they say the main tower is loud. Yes, there is fun and sometimes cheesy entertainment every night that ends before 10pm, but there is also a nightclub that rages late and you can hear it. 

Service:  pretty awesome overall. The people here are consistently smiling and extremely helpful. No problem here. 

Pool: 
Not 3 pools but two. The kiddie pool and main pool are connected so that is one pool. The kiddie pool was a jacuzzi by early morning.  We stayed near the pool by the buffet. It was relatively easy to get seats here and the pool wasn't a sausage fest like the bar at the main pool. And of course, the kiddie pool was a jacuzzi. 

There's also a hidden norm about saving chairs. Apparently, you CAN save seats but only if you leave a personal item in the chair and after an indecided amount of time, your belongings will be removed and held safely for you. Chairs at the beach and chairs at the pool. Just check in every 30 minutes. 

Restaurants:  hard to get reservations at some.  Had sushi two nights but really loved it. The gaucho style meat restaurant, we walked out of mid meal. This was a super poorly managed meal and we waited and waited for two whole people serving skewers they personally cut for you. 

Room service: 24 hours and great overall. They take forever to answer the phone anywhere you call. They are working their tails off so I think they need more help there. 

One downside:  We were missing a comb the first day and thought our daughter hid it. The second day, we had a bag of snack we brought home go missing. We thought we lost it. When we got home my wife was missing her workout pants that she never used. (We were enjoying the pool much more). When I emailed the hotel, I received no response. 

Final verdict, we had an amazing time and the staff there are great. The food is above average and had several surprisingly great restaurants. The place needs more staff because the workload on everyone I saw  was bulging during my visit.

reviews.author: ylove02
reviews.title: rude service.
reviews.text: i had my  wedding there and my wedding planner, i don't know if she was new or just didn't care, but there was a huge lack of communication. she always managed to find me when i needed to make a payment but i could never seem to find her. and no im not a bridezilla! when your guest come up to you to tell you she is on her phone and not attending there is a problem. when you are told your all white party   will have  things you paid for and don't it is a problem. when you give her a head count and there are still chairs missing for the wedding ceremony its a problem and when you should be directing  people to where the cocktail hour will be but instead again you are on your phone (pointed out to me by many guest)  its a HUGE problem. my maid of honor even brought some of my fustrations to her attention at  the white party bbq and yet at the wedding you are on your phone the whole time. this hotel isn't cheap i spent a lot of money, my wedding party consisted of 50 people not a small party of 10. i have called and emailed and have yet to hear anything from them. (my wedding was july 1st) ylove02@gmail

reviews.author: finedrew
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text:
Our stay started off poorly, but slowing got better throughout the week.  After a slow check-in process, it took 2 hours for the bellman to bring our bags to the room - which we had to call down and request.  The housekeepers were using the guest elevators, so we ended up having to use the stairs after about 9am through around 5pm each day to get up to the 5th floor.  Not a huge deal since we are both in good shape, not the best service when we saw guests and housekeepers with carts waiting on every floor for the 1 elevator to come.

Other than that, the food is really good at all of the restaurants and the pool was really fun.  At night they had different shows in the Avenue Bar.

reviews.author: Love2travel19892
reviews.title: Perfect, EXCEPT...
reviews.text:
We just arrived home from a week at the Paradisus and need to admit after 20 different trips to Cancun, this was our favorite.  The resort is big but restaurants, bars, entertainment was all in the main area which is beautiful and smells amazing!
The food was great and we especially liked the Market Grill.  If you don't like the food selection or quality at this resort, NO place will make you happy.  They offer everything from a quick hamburger and fries by the pool to lobster tail for lunch at the buffet.   

The room was always clean and the air conditioner worked great.  The beds in our ocean view room (like all the other rooms we saw) was a double which is fairly small for 2 people.  A queen or king bed would have been so much nicer. 
The resort also offers free wifi throughout the facility which worked great in our room  every place we went.
There was always clean towels by the pool and music playing throughout the resort with a live evening show every night at 8:30  We really enjoyed the Michael Jackson show.  
The ONLY part of this resort that is not excellent is the number of kids.  (Please don't get us wrong, we have 4 kids that have been to Cancun many times.)  The main pool area has a great swim up bar where 'adults' can have a few drinks.  Unfortunately there were always kids taking the pool stools and jumping in the water right at the bar and most of our drinks had to be thrown away.  The pool is long and huge and we see no reason why that section of the pool can't be for adults only.   

The resort does have free computer access to check on you flights home but no computer printer in that area to print your boarding pass.  You need e-mail your flight documents to the concierge who can print them for you.  This took us 30 minutes and a small army of employees to figure this out.  A printer in that area would be SOOO much easier.   

This resort is also HUGE on selling you a 'VACATION PACKAGE' and we were asked 5 or 6 times if we'd like to sit through a breakfast orientation.  They were offering a free 3 night stay at a Melia resort and a free pass to Xplore (we negotiated that) so we agreed to sit through their 90 minute presentation.  A hour and a half presentation was 2 hours but we did have breakfast during this time.

HERE'S THE DEAL ON THE  'vacation package'.  You'll get 27,000 points which is enough points for a 7 day stay.  They also have locations through RCI.  The cost is $1,200 upfront on your credit card and $10,800 that you can make monthly payments on.  Total price is $12,000 PLUS there was also a yearly 'maintenance fee' of $1,100.00 (which could go up) and all this did not include the 'all inclusive' part of your stay. 
If you wanted to stay at the same Melia resort in Cancun, Cozumel or Playa Del Carmen, the 'all inclusive' was another $90 per day per person.  
If we bought this vacation package our yearly 7 day vacation cost would be $90 a day for the all inclusive X 2 people is $180 a day X 7 days is $1,260.00 plus the $1,100.00 yearly maintenance fee.  Yearly cost is now $2,360 plus airfare on top of the $12,000 you already gave them.  
The vacation package does make you a member and you do get some perks but this was not for us.  We booked this resort early and our cost was less than that without paying the initial $12,000
 
LOCATION is excellent and just across the street from Aqua World if you want to rent jet skies or go for a jungle tour. 
If you are looking to go to the market for souvenir shopping, there are 2 different places to go.  The first shopping area is down on the main strip near Senior Frog's (new location) and Coco Bongo's.  The second location is in the actual city of Cancun about 5 miles past the 'strip' called the market place.  This is a huge area with 400+ vendors all willing to negotiate prices to get your business.  We heard many of the vendors on the strip buy from this market and resell for a profit.
The # 1 bus takes you up and down the main strip only.  If you want to go to the bigger, cheaper market place, you'll take the # 2 bus.  The market place is the last stop and the driver will let you know.   IMPORTANT ~ The driver will let you off in front of some souvenir shops but that is NOT the market.  You'll walk 4 blocks up, follow the road to the right and cross the street.  You will feel PERFECTLY safe and everyone is happy to give you very easy directions.  When you're done, jump on the # 2 bus back to your resort.

Overall a beautiful, wonderful resort with GREAT staff and customer service and would go back.

reviews.author: Estefania G
reviews.title: Loved This Resort
reviews.text: I went to this resort with my boyfriend, it was an awesome experience... The service was great, especially Christian and Pablo at Naos Restaurant Buffet , they are very kind and helpful .. Loveeee this place .. We can't wait to go back .. We super recommend this resort ! Cancun was amazing , we loved Mexico !!!!

reviews.author: cgarner1225
reviews.title: PERFECT
reviews.text:
Had it not been for the check in, I would have rated this a perfect 5.  This was our annual mother-daughter/girlfriends outing and we could not have selected a better vacation spot.  We stayed on the Royal Service side, which is the adult only section.  There is NO ONE there that does not want you to relax and have a great time.  Our first night we had dinner at La Palapa, clearly the best restaurant on site!  Service, service, service.  From towels, cabanas, and drinks someone was anticipating your every want and need.  Jose, Cauich, Valeria, and Jorge do there job and do it well.
If you get the chance, go!  You will experience the best vacation ever!

reviews.author: 773maegant
reviews.title: Do not Stay here
reviews.text: The customer service was rude. My boyfriend and I were staying here to celebrate my birthday and he had requested specific things to accommodate us (surprising me with a champagne bottle and a cake or flowers was one of them) and they stated they saw the request when we checked in but they failed to do anything with the request. We had to ask about an upgrade ourselves and they said they only had an upgrade available the last night of our stay. We asked to do so and they did not make it happen for us. Some of the customer service agents were rude. I would never stay here again for what I paid.

reviews.author: Frankie
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Good Food, Great Service
reviews.text:
Once you get past the slightly awkward check-in process, you're good to go. We were 2 hours early, they gave us bracelets to get some food and drinks, we side-stepped the lady selling the time shares - she introduces herself as an entertainment director of some sort and tries to get you to go to the spa with a discount if you view a property - time share pitch.

Our opinion of the food:
Food is good, not the best we've had at a resort but good for the money.  Honestly we liked the Market Grill the best - pool side burgers, dogs, wings, fries, etc.  We killed two plates of wings, they were so good.  We tried the Japanese place which was decent - it's the place in the middle of the resort with the canopy bar. Sushi was fresh but they give you 4 bites, so don't be shy about ordering a few extra rolls. Tapas place was good as well - very small portions so order more than you think you need.  We loved the Blue Agave place - their quesadillas were amazing (poblano and cheese) and they have a good pozole as well.  They serve chips/guac/salsa when you sit down - they also have a breakfast buffet if you want to skip the busy main buffet.

Rooms
Spacious and clean. Nice marble floors granite bathroom - and they have a bidet.  Private balcony is always nice.  Everyone keeps saying you have to have the royal service - we didn't get this ($120 extra per day) and we didn't miss it at all.  We can make our own reservations, and top shelf liquor is nice but not necessary when we drink beer primarily :) I was worried we would be treated differently if we didn't upgrade, but that wasn't the case, everything was amazing.  Mini bar did not have liquor, just beer and sodas and a few snacks - royal service might be different though.

Pool
Huge pool, swim up bar, food, servers, towels, etc.  No hot tub though, that was a bit disappointing

Beach
Get there early, the free chairs/huts fill up quick.  Seaweed was a slight problem but not a deal breaker.

Overall this was a nice little trip to Mexico - this was our 4th resort we've stayed at in Cancun and I would rank it #2.

reviews.author: Alexander R
reviews.title: Paradisus Vacation
reviews.text:
We had stayed in here in August for 6 nights. Over the trip was absolutely amazing. The food, drinks, the treatment you recieved from the staff. When entering they took the bags for you and brought them to your room while checking in. After check out a "concierge" takes you and talks to you about setting up an appointment, you realize it is for a time share through Club Melia. After a long day of travel this is the last thing you want to do.
 We had a ocean view room which was amazing! The room was everything we needed it be. Daily housekeeping, Minibar stocked daily, and turn down service which we only used 2 times. They did a good job keep the room clean. We had have 2 issues with the room. After we ordered room service, we forgot to immediatley put the dishes out the door, and a we came to a table full of ants. Then the 2nd issue was the we lost power b/c apparantly the hair dryer my friend brought was too high voltage. 
The resort credits are not what they are thought to be. It is a coupon book for 20 dollars off a Bali bed at the pool or beach, coupons for 10 dollars off 100 dollar purchase at the gift shop, and a small discount at the spa.
We loved all the bars, Salvador at the swim up bar was amazing, we had a good time with  him. After dinner we would go to Coco Beach bar , Avenue, or Red Lounge. They all were our good time, and most the bartenders would remember our drinks. Does that mean we drank too much? hahaha. The food was very good too. The steak at Fuego was amazing.

reviews.author: Leanna V
reviews.title: Really nice place if you want all inclusive
reviews.text:
All inclusive provides the drinks, all the restaurants in the hotel (which doesn't suck), and a nice room with an ocean view. 

When you walk in, the whole place smells like a spa, which is soothing and relaxing. The beach is right behind the resort and they have a pretty large private beach for guests only, in which they have cocktail waiters that come out to where you are sitting.

They also have a huge pool with a pool bar. That was awesome cause I've never been to a bar that in a pool before.

Overall it was a great stay. It was an all paid for trip by my family so I would recommend it if you like all-inclusive type of resorts but I would not go back just because all-inclusive is not my thing and I enjoy exploring the foreign country I am at.

reviews.author: Karlene A
reviews.title: Terrible - from check in to check out!
reviews.text:
Made requests before arriving at the hotel and none of it was registered, at check in the staff seemed clueless. Not a place for teenage kids, my two kids were absolutely bored. The bar service at Avenue bar was horrible, the night time activities were sorely lacking. The menu at the buffet was repetitive, some days the restaurant was dirty. I requested a wheelchair for my son and was never told I had to pay a daily rental for this service. Had to pay additional for the beds both beach and poolside, not a true all-inclusive experience! I stayed 5 nights and enjoyed none of it! 

When we couldn't take the boredom at the resort and decided to rent a car and go out to the cenotes, on arriving back to the boulevard, we were pulled over by the police and asked to pay, "off the records" for speeding. The officers told us the fine is USD300 and if we paid USD150 we did not have to go to the police station. We later found out that the fine for speeding is USD80 bucks.

Cancun is a beautiful place, outside the resort the Mexicans are great people.

reviews.author: 967lidiag
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: I have booked my vacation during 4 years in a row in the Royal Service . I have been very pleased  with the service I had received in all areas. Everyone has made me feel especial. I would like to take the opportunity of thanking the employees who have contributed to make my vacation  happier and unforgettable. Juan ( butler), Roxana (butler) Javier (butler), Valeria, Gustavo, Jose, Eddier, Moises, Pablo, Daniel  and many more. In general all employees at Royal Service deliver an excellent service. and .. our especial thanks to Royal Service manager , el Senor Lazaro.

reviews.author: Kevin D
reviews.title: Royal Service at Paradisus Cancun - Simply Amazing!
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed at Paradisus Cancun for eight nights in August 2016 and our experience was nothing short of phenomenal.  We had an absolutely wonderful time.  We stayed in the Royal Service section, which helped make our stay even better.  The entire hotel is absolutely gorgeous and we love the décor, architecture, and lighting at night.  The private Royal Service lobby area and pool area make Royal Service totally worth it.  They always have food (breakfast buffet, fruit, snacks, bread, cheeses, etc.) and drinks (coffee, soda, water, beer, wine, liquors, etc.) available.  The staff in the Royal Service are all extremely helpful and kind.  Our room was very nice (we don’t spend much time there anyway) and the view of the ocean off of our balcony was gorgeous.  
A few of the highlights and favorite things about our stay at Paradisus Cancun included: 
•	The food at the restaurants is some of the best we have ever eaten.  We especially liked Fuego (highly recommend the duck, chicken and salmon for an entrées and crème brule for dessert, but everything is amazing), Vento (the lamb chops were phenomenal), Mole (lamb tacos and, of course, the chicken mole) and Bana (the sushi, ginger shrimp, and curry chicken were all out of this world).  We liked Market Grill as well, which is full of delicious meat.  The private Royal Service restaurant by the Royal Service Pool, Palapa, had absolutely scrumptious food as well.  The hamburger was not only delicious, but huge!  My wife and I ordered one to share and that was perfect!  I also highly recommend the mini lamb gyros.  
•	We were able to get a bali bed by the pool every day, which made it so easy rest and relax during the day.
•	The beach and ocean are simply gorgeous.  
•	Twice we got massages at Yhi Spa and we left feeling so relaxed!  After a couple of late nights dancing, we needed the second massage that we got on the last day of our stay.
•	We had lots of late night fun dancing and singing at the Red Lounge.  It was never too packed and there was plenty of couches and seats to relax on when we needed to take a break for a song or two.  
•	Toji Bar in Bana was our favorite place to go for pre-dinner drinks (we made our reservations for dinner at 9PM every night).  It was right in the middle of the action and entertainment.  
•	The service by the Royal Service pool was always fast and reliable, whether with drinks or food from the snack menu.
•	We contacted the Royal Service manager, Lazaro ahead of our stay with a number of special requests.  He met each one of them to the letter and we were very impressed with him.  He greeted us every day and made sure everything was going well.  Whenever we had a request, he made sure it was done promptly and correctly.  
•	Our butler, Guillermo, was always courteous and set up a number of special treats for us in our room, including bubble baths, aromatherapy, and some champagne and cake.  He was very attentive and did a fantastic job.
There were a few hiccups so to speak, but nothing that really detracted from our pleasure on the trip too any significant extent.
•	The service the Palapa restaurant was really slow.  We stopped going for breakfast and lunch after the first two days of our trip, because we did not want to waste time sitting and waiting for food.  It routinely took an hour to complete our meal and considering the small portions and time of day, we did not want to waste our time sitting and waiting for food when we could be enjoying the ocean, beach, bali bed, and sun.
•	Twice our room did not get cleaned until about 5 at night, and I had to request that a maid come to clean our room.  
•	Our mini-bar and water bottles were not restocked one day as I requested and I had to ask three times to get it completed as we needed.  Normally, I would not care much and would wait, but to brush our teeth and drink water, we need the water bottles since you cannot use the water out of the faucet. 
•	The DJs at the Red Lounge were pretty much jerks.  We would request songs and they never played them, which was disappointing.  And the songs were all club/dance type songs.  It was not like we were asking for heavy metal or country.  
A big part of the enjoyment of our stay was the courteous, attentive, and personable staff at Paradisus Cancun.  I mentioned Lazaro, the Royal Service Manager and Guillermo our butler above, but I wanted to highlight below the efforts of a number of the staff members, since we became friends with a number of them and their efforts helped make our stay as enjoyable as it was.
•	Eric, our waiter at Bana, provided probably the best service we had at Paradisus Cancun.  We went to Bana twice.  The first night he was our water and we got to know him, since he is very personable.  His attention to detail and level of service was exemplary.  We learned he was training to be a Royal Service butler and have no doubt he will be one of the best.  Our second night, he set up a special table for us with rose petals and even gave us each a gift of traditional Mexican candies.  He is a kind and generous person.  Hopefully, when we return to Paradisus Cancun, we will be able to request his services as a butler.  To say we were highly impressed by Eric is an understatement to say the least.
•	Galdino was another Royal Service butler who helped us out during our stay and always stopped by to chat.  
•	Royal Service/Palapa Waiters – As I said above, they were attentive and always prompt and included Javier, Octavio, Jorge, Rafael, Gustavo, Cesar, and Alejandro.
•	The Royal Service Pool Concierges, Javier, Daniel and Omar, all provided excellent service and always were attentive and kind.  We enjoyed chatting with them and getting to know them as well.  
•	Efrain, our waiter at Market Grill, also really stood out for his excellent service and kind demeanor.  
•	Last, but certainly not least, the bar staff across the board was phenomenal.  We became friends with a number of them and they certainly enhanced our enjoyment on our trip.  This included, Carlos from the Royal Service bar, Balan, Edgar and Reymundo at the Toji Bar, and Jason at Avenue Lounge.

reviews.author: D T
reviews.title: Some overdue R&R
reviews.text: First visit ever to Cancun for me and it was wonderful.  3 nights 4 days perfect weather, no rain. The water was beautiful.  Our butler during our royal visit was Antonio and he made our vacation go very smoothly. He booked Bali beds, dinners and a spa reservation.  Made sure our rooms had everything we needed each night we were there we could not ask for better service.   And my absolute favorite bartender Christian!!!  He fixed whatever kind of drinks or shots we wanted and even when we couldn't think of what to drink all you needed to tell him was what you were wanting for example I like citrus drinks and he kept them coming but also took care to make sure we drank water as well.  He was very attentive and we enjoyed seeing him everyday right up until we had to leave.  "Big poppy we will be back, your drinks were the best" from The Atlanta six. Eduardo was our poolside butler and he did a great job as well.  Everyone at Paradisus were really nice and there are no problems here at all to report!!! We will return to Cancun and Paradisus!

reviews.author: rjsarkis3
reviews.title: Honeymoon in the Royal Service!
reviews.text: For our Honeymoon in August 2016, my husband and I choose the Paradisus Cancun Royal Service Junior Ocean Suite Package.  We could not have made a better decision.  The hotel itself was beautiful, but our secluded adult only side was quiet, relaxing, and luxurious.  We had a wonderful butler, Caesar, who was amazing. We had a restaurant on the beach that was exclusive to the Royal Service Guests, access to a private pool and section of the beach.  Waiters in the Royal Service Portion of our stay were amazing.  Checking in on us at the beach and the pool to refill drinks and bring food, so attentive and curious.  The restaurant, La Palapa was our favorite one at the hotel.  Valeria, Catzin, Diez, and Sindy were amazing servers there.  All of the hotels restaurants were delicious: sushi, Mediterranean, Brazilian, a buffet, and multiple authentic Mexican restaurants.  We had a great experience booking an full day excursion through the hotel to see Mayan Ruins in Chichen-Itza.  The service brought our bags to our rooms and escorted us to a check in desk that had champaign waiting.  The beaches were spectacular and we could not have asked for a more wonderful Suite with a three room-wide balcony for our Honeymoon.  The PERFECT experience!

reviews.author: Amy B
reviews.title: 2nd time back this year
reviews.text:
This is my second time back because I loved it so much, my husband's first time in Mexico and flying. The first time I was there on a business trip with a friend so everything was taken care of. This time I booked using Cheap Caribbean.com. Doing it this way our flight, hotel, transportation and insurance was included in the price. I had also followed up with the hotel about a late check out due to our flight being so late.  I have one complaint and otherwise we had a great stay!!!! When we checked in we were told we could not have the late check out which was fine they were more then accommodating to us on check out day!!! We greatly appreciate it!!!  We had a great stay. Marco in the buffet is the best. Love him. Had him in February and only one day this time but love him he is great!  Love the Michael Jackson show!  My husband also loved his bartender at Cocos beach club bar. 

This is my only issue the day we checked in... We had been up since 4 am. My husband never flew or been out of the country before. He was not thrilled with this trip. We had a very long day. We were very tired and hungry when we got there and had to wait for our room. He was not a happy person. He works non stop at home and we never see each other the minute we check in Judy comes and says she is our concierge and tries to set us up for a meeting for the next day. Once my husband figures out what it was he says no way and starts flipping out. He runs a business and was on vacation to get away and not be bothered. So we missed a meeting with Amstar because of Judy.  I know it is her job and I saw a lot of people doing it this time. Just a suggestion maybe let people settle in give them time etc. You have no idea what a person has just been through to get there. My husband warmed up to the place by the end of the week but it took him until Wednesday till he got work out of his system.   

We had a great time! Again love the resort! Love the shows! Everyone is so friendly so thanks again for another great trip to Mexico!

reviews.author: Tito Tim Travels
reviews.title: Woderful hotel - great service!
reviews.text: I stayed here quite some time ago - but what an unforgettable experience. Yes, it is far from the main road, but that is not a problem for me. I enjoy the walk, if you do not... take a taxi?  :)  When I first got into the lobby I was a bit concerned about the humidity. If you have seen the pics of the luscious plants, well, it is kind of like a greenhouse.  Glass pyramids, lots of sun, lots of water for the plants.  But my concern was unwarranted. The shops, offices, restaurants and bars are properly air conditioned.  The room was great!  I had a odd corner  of the pyramid with a partial ocean view and partial lagoon view.  It was great.  The bathroom was big, and properly equipped. Big tub, amazing shower, separate room for the toilet and bidet. Hard to find such nice fixtures in an American hotel.  The concierge service was so helpful! I usually don't use a concierge but they were so friendly and chatted with me throughout my week. Then they gave the best advice on tours and restaurants.

reviews.author: LeisaW65
reviews.title: Loved the Resort
reviews.text: I loved being on this resort. The staff was very nice. I just had one issue with housekeeping that turned my brown eyes blue. Housekeeping would clean the bathroom take all the face towels and wouldn't replace them with new towels , which made me have to call housekeeping 4 days out of the six days I was at the resort, very frustrating!!!

reviews.author: Tina D
reviews.title: relaxing  atmosphere
reviews.text: I traveled  with  my husband  and  17 year  old  daughter  and  her  2 friends .   Felt very safe.  We stayed in the Club Meliá side and we're impressed  with  the  room, staff, and  amenities.  No problem  with  room .  Safe located in  room.  Staff was friendly  and  helpful.  I felt  like  they  cared about  our experience  and  wanted to  do  all they could  to make  it  enjoyable .  Staff spoke  English  but loved it  if you  knew  Spanish .   We had an early  flight  when  leaving  and it was arranged for  us to  have  breakfast  sent to  our room at 4am!  Would  recommend .

reviews.author: Sunshine D
reviews.title: Best family vacation
reviews.text:
I've been to several Melia brand hotels in a few different countries and I've been to a lot of hotels and resorts in the Cancun area. I was totally was satisfied with my recent trip. I traveled with my 18 month old and mother and they enjoyed their stay. 

I took my son to the Baby Club Room quite often and he enjoyed it. It was clean, inviting and well staffed, Alma and Adriana were kind and attentive. The toys were spotless and current with tons of familiar shows and movies for the babies. They even had a small "potty sized" toilet which my son was so excited to use every day. 

The restaurants were excellent and catered to my Gluten-Free needs, providing me with daily fresh bread, and options. I particularly loved Enso and Bana with thee most attentive waitstaff Darwin and Oscar. Every employee was kind and patient especially with my 18 month old Shawn. 

Thank you for everything Paradisus, we will continue to explore the Melia brand.

reviews.author: Grisel M
reviews.title: DO NOT TRUST AT ALL THIS REVIEWS, YOU BEEN ADVICE.
reviews.text: Let me start by i made the reservatio beliving on the reviews when i book this hotels food in the hotel buffet is horrible,hotel is very tired,so as the rooms ,the hotels is a quarter of a mile from the main road so you have to walk from the main road everyday if you do excursions or go outsite the hotel,after that walk,be ready for 60 steps(my family call it the chichen itza) every single day 60 steps ,there is no golf car for the guess to provide that service,we went with my parents 75 and 71 year old with a mild disability and a 7 year old child that after been out the whole day that child was exhausted,the golf car is only available in the morning to "sell you" a vacation plan .       the pool was horrible, if you check the bar by the pool is falling apart and has mold really discusting .the front of the hotel is nicely painted "the back" hasen't been paint in years .only went to the pool one .the beaches in cancun are "not good"actually it can be dangerous, a lot of waves and very very deep .the specialties restaurants are ok,you have to make reservations at 7:00 am the night before bc it gets pack very quickly. PARADISUS CANCUN  the scents in the lobby give you a head acheT NEVER NEVER AGAIN.

reviews.author: normac131
reviews.title: Awesome!!
reviews.text: Awesome experience!  Pampered the entire time!  Highly recommend staying with Paradisus Cancun!! Entire staff was friendly and prompt.  Never had a bad experience.  Grounds were very well kept.  Rooms and entire resort kept clean at all times.

reviews.author: Jennifer B
reviews.title: Beautiful Property!
reviews.text:
This hotel was absolutely beautiful throughout!  From what I saw of other resorts in the area, Paradisus appeared to be one of the nicest. Every staff member I encountered was very friendly.  Service was prompt in every restaurant and bar.
The room was very nice with a beautiful view. The bed was comfortable and had no issues with any aspect of our room.  
Food in the restaurants was good- Enso was our favorite!  Blue Agave had great tacos and was nice to not need a reservation.  The buffet was great for breakfast- had a nice selection
The Kid's Club was good- although my daughter only went a few times for 1-2 hours max as we had other activities planned.  She is 9, so she was able to play with the other kids and have a good time.  I am not sure I would recommend for young kids  (4-5ish) as it looked a little hectic at times and not much staff to supervise as many kids as can sometimes be in there. But was a good option when my husband and I just wanted to relax with a drink for a while.
The only improvement I can think of is more daytime entertainment or at least more upbeat music outside.  We aren't ones to just sit by the pool on vacation as we have a pool at home.  But the few times we were out there, it was kinda quiet.
Overall, we had a good time and would consider staying here again if staying in the Hotel Zone

reviews.author: Bernarda W
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: The best resort I have ever stayed for sure I will stay there again hopefully next year everyone was so helpful and nice. The room we stayed very clean whatever we need it was always there for everyone is very nice yes we will be back thanks again

reviews.author: Hines395
reviews.title: Cancun Wedding
reviews.text: The only reason we stayed at this hotel was because my cousin was having her wedding here and it was required to stay to attend the wedding. I am so glad we did though. Every detail and feature of the hotel is awesome. As soon as you arrive, there's a service to greet you as you come in and take your luggage up to your room to allow you to check in without having the extra bags. Everyone is on their A game 100% of the time. Very courteous and friendly. The all inclusive part of the hotel is great as well with many restaurants to chose from. The only reason I didn't give it the 5 rating is because of the food, I feel it could've been better. That didn't bother me from having a great experience here though. The pools are great and the view of the beach is amazing as you walk down the steps. They also have a little show everyday at 8 for families. Overall, I would definitely recommend and come back to stay here. I enjoyed my visit to Paradisus.

reviews.author: Fletcher3233
reviews.title: Horrible Experience!!
reviews.text:
Let me first off start with Ive honestly never written any kind of negative survey in any sort including yelp etc. 
My son and I arrive late Sunday night and they did not have my reservation. I explained to the front desk manager I did not bring my confirmation since all the correspondence was through my work email etc and I did not bring my work phone or laptop. However I was able to look up my billing statement through my credit card and calling my credit card company of the charge to the hotel. Didn't matter! The manager stated that it didn't matter because in their system they did not have any reservation under my name.  At one point he basically stated that there was no possible way they made the mistake and sincerely became down ride rude. Because it was Sunday they night they said their reservation offices were closed and they could not verify till the morning. I ended up having to pay $380 for Sunday night on a separate credit card. I talked first thing to the reservations office on Monday and they greatly apologized for the mistake and they would refund the $380 and everything was taken care of. Since I'm running out of space I wish I could continue about the rest of the week and horrible service as well its now been over 2 months and Ive never received the refund of $380 and had to report the issue to the credit card company. There are tons of beautiful hotels and resorts in Cancun and I would kindly plea for you to stay anywhere else!!

reviews.author: MAO
reviews.title: As close to perfection as you can get
reviews.text: Second visit with the family and not disappointed. Wonderful atmosphere and support. The check in this time was better than last time but still room for improvement. The hotel is truly spectacular offering all that you need and wish for. The family concierge service is highly recommended and special thank you goes to Rodolfo who was exceptionally helpful and supportive, also a thank you to Fernanada who predicted our needs before we even thought of them. If you are looking for a truly all inclusive resort with exceptional service, spectacular scenery and excellent food, you'll not be disappointed with Paradisus Cancun. One minor comment on the internet which is definitely better than last year but could be improved further. We will look forward to booking again to come next year.

reviews.author: FiorePebbly
reviews.title: Wonderful Romantic Getaway!
reviews.text:
I've stayed at this hotel before, but never at the adults only area and it was definitely worth the upgrade. 

The adults only area is in its own tower and it includes a personal concierge, ours was Sergio, a "royal service" bar with drinks and little hors d'ouvres, a couple of days of personal cabanas by the all adult pool (awesome), mini bar and room service included (really awesome), and I'm sure other stuff i'm forgetting.

The room was nice and spacious with a very comfortable bed and really great toiletries (so great, I wish I could buy full size shampoo and conditioners of it). The room was a bit dated, but very clean and looked after.

The best part of the trip was that my husband mentioned to our concierge that Sunday was our anniversary and when we came back to the room Sunday afternoon, Sergio and his team had filled the room with rose petals, set up our table with a  bottle of champagne and chocolate covered berries, and filled the bathtub with roses. It was so beautifully done and so incredibly thoughtful!

As far as the food is concerned, everything was good, although the pool service food and the adults only restaurant were by far our favorite.  We were only there for 3 days, but there are enough different types of cuisines that you don't get bored.

The only real hiccup of the trip occurred at check-in. We got to the hotel at around 11am and the room was not ready, which was ok because check-in wasn't until 3, but when we came back at that time, it was still not ready! So they gave us a "courtesy room" where we could change and leave our stuff (they also gave us  a courtesy room when we checked out as our flight was not until late at night and we wanted to spend the day at the beach and then have a place to shower).

Overall we loved our experience at the Melia. We'll definitely be back soon!

One final word of caution: the hotel is beautiful in part because it's full of plants on the inside, which also means that it is incredibly humid INSIDE  the hotel. Even as a Florida girl, the humidity was very overwhelming. So if you're planning on having normal hair days, forget about it.

reviews.author: Rafael A
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: From beginning to end excellent excellent service beautiful rooms excellent food very clean very well kept beautiful inside and outside. good activities great Beach great service at the beach room service food is okay.

reviews.author: Mishleen K
reviews.title: Great and friendly place
reviews.text: I visited paradises Cancun with my family and it was great clean and friendly. Loved it. The staff was attentive and the food was out of this world. I have been to many all inclusive and this was absolutely worth every penny. Must visit again. When we went they did not have a kids stay free offer but it was well worth the extra charge.

reviews.author: Alicia B
reviews.title: Anniversary trip with Royal Service
reviews.text:
We stayed here Aug 11-19th, 2016. We had an excellent time in the Royal Service part of the hotel.  Our butler was Rodè. He did an awesome job. Those guys are seriously under paid for the service they provide. We had Daniel and Omar for pool service guys. Daniel is working to be a butler and I think he would do a great job at it. Hopefully on our next trip, he will be our butler. They were awesome. Very helpful. The most attentive and friendly server was Gustavo Pimentel. He was our waiter by the pool, at La Palapa restaurant and also in our lobby bar. He remembered our names from day one and was always there to help with anything and everything. If they didn't have what we needed, he would go find it. I would definitely recommend the Royal Service to any adult who doesn't want to spend their vacation with little kids, as this area is adults only. 
-The Bakers

reviews.author: omarlaffita
reviews.title: Good stay!
reviews.text:
In short: we traveled there for 8 days, and we end up staying two weeks. That's how good it is. I will recommend more shows at night but they have good shows during the day and at night, well, what they have it's not half bad. The disco is nice and gets packed but the dj is somehow rude when you ask to play some tracks. 
The food is good and you have like a whole bunch of places to eat. I loved the sushi place and the Peruvian, bana and fuego. 
Now, this review wouldn't be completed without talking about the best worker/server/awesome individual named Armando. This guy is a rock star of customer service. He is super cool and he'll move mountains to accommodate you and make you feel like royalty. He works mainly at the pool, although I met him the day I got to the hotel serving by the front desk. My group was huge, like 20 plus and he was always taking care of us. Make sure you go and talk to him on behalf of the huge group of Cubans from Miami that stayed there beginning of July. He's the best.
The rooms are good but they do get hot. I don't know why and some of my friends changed rooms like the last day cause the AC stopped working altogether. Probably too many people. The hotel was packed those days. 
Oh, lobster, a lot of lobster almost every day. What???!!!
I will go there again, yes.

reviews.author: donovansimon87
reviews.title: Seen better days...
reviews.text:
This hotel has seen better days, the air conditioning seems to be an issue in most rooms as it leaks onto the floor, after two days we had a room upgrade following two complaints, this hotel just seems to be too big and it needs all the restaurants on offer to cater for all the guests and it constantly fails.
The food is ok, but my advice is to get up early for breakfast, it's like a cattle market after 9pm and ques to be seated, for food etc can be long...
Be very cautious when booking trips, time share rip offs are common place especially out of the complex offering too good to be true deals on excursions that usually are just that! TGTBT... You'll be enticed with offers of free breakfast that your getting anyway in exchange for a 3-4 hour seminar sold too you as a 90 minute 'chat' .... Be warned!!!
On the plus side the beach is awesome, plenty to do on your doorstep, the pools are large enough not to be cramped and the drink is readily available with brand shots generously poured, food is available all day but again, pretty standard stuff...
The entertainment at night is rickety at best, and nothing for children, although there is a kids club, you have to leave your kids in the care of others which wasn't for us... But each to there own...
Hotel is situated in a good location, with most excursions no more than  twenty minute cab ride away, you can get the local bus for cheaper, but it's hot with no air con...
Senior Frogs is a must in my opinion, the foods good and it's good fun, especially with children...

reviews.author: Benita J
reviews.title: Mexico
reviews.text: Staff was wonderful, especially David, bus driver are not helpful, almost had me some where I didn't want to be. Nice young lady helped me get back to Melia Paradisus hotel, after boat ride on the Marina. I would have been lost without her. Food was great, enjoyed each restaurant. Drinks were good, all inclusive the best. Very hot and humid, enjoyed my tan.

reviews.author: Fadi Z
reviews.title: Vacation with my family
reviews.text:
Excellent hotel it's our 4th time we stay there.
The food is excellent A1, if you like seafood this resort serve a lot of variety of seafood.
Rooms are clean the service is A1.
Ocean view room is a real ocean view.

reviews.author: Ed M
reviews.title: Fantastic all inclusive!!
reviews.text: Pristine property, great service, and terrific food at all restaurants on site. Memorable employee was Andres, the barista at the Nespresso bar. What a great guy! We looked forward to seeing him every day.

reviews.author: maryellenbolden
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, amazin staff, We will return !
reviews.text: We are just returning from our 7 day trip to Melia Paradisus Cancun.  At first we were overwhelmed by the grand size of the property, but once you get your bearings around "Pyramid #3" is the center, everything else became much easier.  The staff was amazing and so welcoming. I didn't meet one server I didn't have fun with.  They offer a variety of pools, so you can either have a quiet setting, or you can "turn it up" with the Entertainment Staff.  (Thanks Ernesto!)  They have so many restaurants to chose from (Need to make daily dinner reservations, or just chose from 2 of the buffet restaurants)  After a night of dancing, go see our man in the Blue Agave for late night fresh burgers (midnight to 4am).  DANG, forgot his name.  You'll know when you meet him, because he RUNS that place after hours, AND will remember how you like your burger.  We are Vacation Club owners at Melia Cabo Real, but while it's under construction, we opted to go to Melia Paradisus Cancun.  We will be back !!!

reviews.author: hotrod11296
reviews.title: From Greeting to leaving
reviews.text:
Stayed from Aug 6th to Aug 15th, upon arriving was greeted by Raul, how this man can remember a couple every year is amazing. Raul makes a person feel like family.Later that evening we were returning from dinner and  the same for Jose, makes one feel good. We had the pleasure of being checked in by Betsabe Ornelas she made it quick and simple. Paradisus is lucky to have such great employees. Upon leaving they made you feel like you are leaving family. Asking when we would be returning.
As far as the room goes, it must have just been remodeled, it was just Great.

reviews.author: 494mayras
reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text: Had royal service, was totally worth it, to have access to the palapa restaurant by the beach for brkfast & lunch where you are served by waiter & not have to fight the crowds in the buffet, the food was delicious there too, & the view breathtaking, also loved 24hr room service included, all mini bar snacks etc included, valet parking included, local cell phn provided (came in very handy), also liked the private check in & out. We were celebrating our anniversary & when we got to our room the bed had 2 hearts made with red rose petals that said "Tu y Yo", very, very nice surprise! The next day we got to our room, our bath tub was all ready for us with warm water, bubbles & again red rose petals. Every day there was petals somewhere & chocolates. Totally romantic, loved the details! Over all Pretty fancy hotel & experience, also I have to mention that the whole hotel & room smelled like perfume, inscense or some kind of freshner. Hotel was very clean & always smelled great! Overall did feel pretty special, service was pretty good & the hotel is beautiful!

reviews.author: LindseyandMike
reviews.title: Gave Paradisus another chance
reviews.text:
A little backstory: If you look through the bad reviews you will find an earlier one from us when they ROYALLY messed up a six-person trip for my parents' 50th wedding anniversary. During that 10-day trip they shipped us to ME for five days. For that screw up, they comped us three rooms for five days to use any time in a year. We never thought we'd use them but we couldn't resist.

This time around we were pleasantly surprised to see Javier at the check-in. He had handled all the overbooking in December. He actually remembered us (I was pretty angry at the time so I'm sure it was memorable). He got us all checked in quickly, upgraded us to Royal Service and even made some dinner reservations for us. They are lucky to have him.

When I made these reservations I told them we'd be celebrating my mom's birthday. When we got to her room there were balloons and cake. (This was the experience I had expected in December.) So redemption was made.

We traveled with two seniors, two teens and two 40-somethings. The resort is very family friendly and yet my husband and I still had some fun nights meeting people from all over the world.

Restaurants are good but not the best I've had in Cancun. Fuego was the best. Vento and La Palapa (only Royal Service at that last one) were great too. Worst were the snack shack by the main pool and honestly, as fancy as Mole is, we weren't fans of the food. The buffet, I think it's Naos, was a hit with everyone but me, but I'm not a buffet person.

They have made some changes. We really liked all the activities by the pool in December, especially when hosted by Rodrigo. But now they are having more shows by the pool, like dancers and such. I guess it depends on what you are interested in, but for us, we liked the interactive games by the pool. More fun for the teens, who aren't included in the kids club activities. 

Last couple of notes: My parents LOVED getting a bali bed over in the Royal Service area; you do have to make reservations for the restaurants but we never had any problems; we HATED the pillows in the rooms, way too soft; and my kids had an air conditioning leak in their room TWICE. Luis was our favorite poolside bartender and when he had a day off EVERYONE noticed LOL. It does seem like the wait staff are a little overwhelmed. Really great people but not enough to go around. Oh, almost forgot, pools are VERY DEEP. Bring a float. The most shallow part of the main pool is right by the bar so there are a thousand splashing kids there. Can't blame them but it was annoying.

I would recommend Paradisus for families. If I was just on a trip with my husband though I would stay at an adults-only hotel like Live Aqua, which we loved. Hope all this info helps someone. Would go back but not in December.

reviews.author: marcpenny
reviews.title: Perfect for a relaxing vacation!!!
reviews.text:
Ill get straight to the point: My wife and I loved Paradisus Cancun Resort and will be returning for future vacations! 

This was our first visit to Cancun, so to say we were nervous was an understatement. Upon arriving at the airport we were greeted by representatives for our travel company "vacation express/nexus". They promptly brought my wife and I a van and whisked us away to our destination (Our friends at Vacation Express and Nexus made an excellent first impression for our first trip into Mexico) 

Upon arriving at Paradisus the front lobby staff gave us a very warm and welcome greeting. Our room wasn't ready yet so they stored our luggage for us, got us checked in, and gave us our "all inclusive" wrist bands. This allowed us to go get some lunch and relax at the bar for an hour before we went up to the room. 
Nayeli at the Concierge desk was instrumental in ensuring that we had everything we needed to make our stay perfect.

There were eight of us total in our group so we rotated paying for a beach side Cabana for the week. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS! If you are beach bums like us then you just want to stay on the beach all day drinking pina coladas and rum drinks lol. The cabanas allow you to do just that! We had plenty of shade throughout the day so if we got a little to hot or to burnt we just sat in the shade and took a nap. So this next statement is very important: If you get a cabana you MUST request these three amazing gentlemen to be your servers. Here comes a name drop: Sofonia, Manuel, and David! These guys are AWESOME! We lacked for nothing while we relaxed in the cabana. And when we would visit the pool for an hour or so they looked after our stuff so we didn't have to worry about it. They kept our drinks full and our made sure we had everything we needed for total relaxation. If I had to name one thing that we enjoyed the most then this was it; Our beachside cabana! 

Just to touch on food really quick. It was good (not great)! Make your reservation EARLY! We had a large group so it wasn't always easy getting the place we wanted if I was a bit behind making the reservation. 

Overall we had a wonderful time and will be returning for our next Cancun adventure! I don't have anything negative to say, because not a bit of our experience was bad. The resort staff made every effort to make our stay as wonderful as they could, and in that they succeeded! THANK YOU PARADISUS! FOR EVERYTHING! Especially our new friends Nayeli, Sofonia, Manuel, and David!

reviews.author: AussieRulz
reviews.title: Awesome week and will be back again
reviews.text: This was only the second all-inclusive resort we have stayed at - the other being Paradisus Punta Cana. We stayed in the Royal Service and did in fact feel like Royalty. We booked 5 rooms in all giving our butler Juan many folks to attend to. Luckily, we are not demanding folks. That said, Juan was fantastic and always asked if there was anything else he could do for us. As there were 9 of us, Juan organized a private tour to Chichen Itza for basically the same price as the bus tours. This meant we weren't sitting on a bus while it picked up and dropped off at numerous hotels early in the morning and late in the evening. We were able to enjoy breakfast, depart at a reasonable time, and we're back with plenty of time to shower and have dinner. Juan also organized beer and snacks for the trip. The Royal Service lounge was one of favorite places. Architecturally, it is designed to be like a Xenote (sink hole) complete with ponds, fountains, koi, and a wonderfully serene and cool atmosphere. The Royal Pool was huge compared to the one in Punta Cana with one section of it over 30 meters if you were interested in swimming some laps. Unfortunately, the pool water was very warm which is probably nice for many of the ladies taking a dip, but not refreshing enough for me. The food in most of the restaurants was fantastic. Being a party of 9, we were fortunate enough to eat family style at most restaurants and this allowed us to sample many dishes. Our most favored restaurants were Enos (new Thai fusion which I think has replaced La Perla), Ventos, Mole and the Taco bar at Blue Agave. While this Paradisus resort is more expensive (40% taxes added on to originally shown prices when booking through Melia website) than the Punta Cana Paradisus resort, the Royal Lounge, Pool and food is better. I still believe Punta Cana is good value for money, but you get a much more luxurious experience at Paradisus Cancun. We will be back.

reviews.author: leba0210
reviews.title: Mrs! González
reviews.text: Close to airport! Nice beach! Very Good pools!! Good food!!!But in general guest attention was very limited!! No warm approach!! Poor coordination between concierge and tour schedule , activities, and expedia representative apears to be not working there!! Lack of information!! We had some incident with pick Up and drop of with amigostours travel guide!! The information was not clear!! Múltiple cultural issues !! We have been taking some actions for The unpleasant events that We  live!!!

reviews.author: jtiran
reviews.title: Bad choice: Search for a better hotel for your trip....!!!
reviews.text: Overall service is limited. Everybody gives you a warming welcome, but are unable to deliver great service. It would seem employees are not so happy to work here, they appear over exhausted, but they still try to help. Rooms are old, beds not too comfy, TV and cable has many issues like bad image, lost signal, etc... and they are unable to fix it. Security boxes inside the rooms extremely old and don´t work properly. Food is average as also drinks, not good relation between what you pay and what you get. The best part is the beach as with any other hotel in Cancun. And don´t even dream in trying to speak to the manager, he or she will never show up or work to make your stay improve. We left several messages to address our problems, we never received any kind of contact back Even though there is great people working here, management is terrible.

reviews.author: 147alfredr
reviews.title: Do not get lodge in Building 1
reviews.text: Building appears to be the oldest building in the complex.  The rooms show the sign of time.  The mattress are only good for the dumpsters.  The AC did not work well and the room only had one small chair for us to sit on.

reviews.author: bada21
reviews.title: Fabulous holiday
reviews.text:
Royal service all the way.  Our butler Suzanna was the absolute best, she couldn't do enough for you.  If you didn't contact her she would come and find you whether you were on the beach or by the pool just to make sure everything was okay and if there was anything she could do for you.  Every day she left little notes for us, organised champagne and wine in our room for our wedding anniversary, we could not have asked for better service.
The majority of staff that we had contact with couldn't do enough for you and I would like to make a special mention to Raphael in the Royal service lounge who was always attentive with the drinks service!
I would like to mention the spa as others have commented on how expensive the treatments were.  Yes they are more expensive compared to the UK but I have to say it is one of the nicest spas that I have used, both in atmosphere and the calibre of the staff, I had one of the best massages ever!

reviews.author: CF M
reviews.title: Beautiful Oceanfront Resort
reviews.text:
The ocean views from our room and by the pool were breathtaking. I thought nothing beats Aruba but this one is up there. We felt like we were on a cruise ship when looking out to the ocean from our Bali bed by the pool. As a club Melia member, we got to use the Bali bed 2 days for free and only $10/day afterward. Other people had to pay $75/ day.
Club Melia really did us a favor this time. We travelled with our 2 sons and they both are taller than 6 ft. I asked for 2 beds in our 1 br suite but they gave us 2 connecting rooms instead since only king beds in all suites. Thank you! Club Melia members go to pyramid 1 and it has its own check in desk. The check in was speedy and clear. First time traveling as a club member, very happy and impressed.
The resort itself needs lots of update. There were many water leaks throughout the buildings. Leaky faucets, non working ceiling fans and AC in the rooms. However, people came quickly to fix whatever problem I reported.
As far as restaurants, we went to Vento, Fuego and Mole and we like Mole the most. The tapas in Vento were first for us. Some dishes were too salty for our taste but the lamb cutlet was best. Fuego had slow service and my husband's flank steak was too tough. Mole had great service, our waiter was Atilano. He was very attentive and made sure everything came accordingly. The beef ribs was very good. We also loved the buffet too. It had different choices everynight. 
The gym was very good, it even provided chlorophyll water. My sons used it everyday.

reviews.author: mrtows
reviews.title: cancun trip
reviews.text: mostly good restaurants were all great pools were fantastic rooms were clean but not new at all    bed was comfie and clean all employees were great and fast with the service they provided all and all a good time

reviews.author: cristee13
reviews.title: Spectacular Resort!
reviews.text: By far the best resort I have ever stayed. Upscale and beautiful to say the least. The food was so delicious. So many options to chose from. The variety of alcohol at this resort was great. My family and I enjoyed this resort very much. It is a huge resort so be ready for a lot of walking. Pool was fun but not a party pool with music but we always had a good time. Not as close to the downtown as I thought. Definitely recommended this resort to all my friends and family. Already had one friend go and she loved it too. Will be staying here again!

reviews.author: laurenjlopez
reviews.title: First Time in Cancun
reviews.text:
I just recently had my family reunion in Cancun, the hotel is large and can definitely hold a party of our size, I did not like how the property had no ac anywhere in the hotel except for the rooms and some of the restaurants. The Humility was horrible ! We arrived around 6am and the hotel wouldn't let us check in or even buy a day room so we can rest from our red eye flight and long travels- even though we specified early check in.

The food was "ok" not really to my taste, I got sick my second night with a little bit of Montezuma revenge... I travel often and NEVER get sick. 

The rooming accommodations if you are in the first tower is not so good, try to get a different tower if you can. Not all drinks are included in the all inclusive package, you have to pay for redbull. 

We were throwing a football in the pool and got asked not too. They have cabanas all around the pool and beachfront, BUT you have to buy them for $100.00 and it comes with a bottle of champagne... they have tours that are offered on the property BUT they make sure to ask where the water sports are at, we didn't and instead of jet ski and boat on the pretty blue water, we were directed to the lagoon. 

I did not like that you cant see the beach from the pool, the pool areas are raised above eyesight. 

The staff is friendly and always cleaning.

reviews.author: calidude79
reviews.title: Fantastic stay
reviews.text: Brilliant interior views. Fantastic service and food. Ideal beach location. I do recommend upgrading to the royal service. The quiet north end of the hotel is worth the sleep. The middle of the hotel can get loud, especially the room on/just off the main atrium. Too much to write about, but we would definitely revisit. The only thing we could think that didn't work was the tub spout. You couldn't take a bath. Otherwise we left after 7 days wishing we had about 2 more. 5 stars for an all inclusive, no doubt. I will say the Expedia service desk in the hotel would not refund a trip that got cancelled due to the weather. They stated on 2 visits they were refunding a day trip, they never did. We are currently taking it up with Expedia. Do not trust the Expedia office in the hotel.

reviews.author: John B
reviews.title: Fantastic Resort
reviews.text:
My family recently stayed at this resort and were very pleased in all respects.  The resort is quite large but interesting to walk through the Pyramids.  The pool was well maintained and having a family we typically stayed closer to the family pool area.  The most impressive item we found about this resort was the food and restaurants.  The main restaurant NAOS was amazing and offered a very wide variety of food every day (lunch and evening).  The breakfast was amazing with again so much on offer. 

The staff were excellent no matter if they were your usual waiter or just somebody new...very polite, courteous and happy.  At breakfast, we were normally waited upon by a waiter called Wilberth.  He is the most genuine person we have met, very polite and pleasant...so please ask for him!  

We did have an issue with our bedroom leaking from the balcony sliding doors as it did rain the first few days we were there.  The initial response from the front desk was poor but finally we managed to resolve and come to an arrangement with the manager.  The hotel is ~27years old so needs some attention.

The beach is clean and is quite often 'combed' in the morning.  The sea is warm and pleasant but can get a little rough at times but good enough to paddle in most of the time.  

A very pleasant break and will certainly be visiting again!

reviews.author: Sabrina K
reviews.title: Comfortable vacation
reviews.text: The Hotel is huge. The Buffet is very big too and it tastes really nice. The quality was superb, especially the quality of the lobsters. The Beach ist very clean and the water is clear, it looks beautiful. The rooms are big enough and the Ocean  View from the balcony is beautiful! I would love to visit paradisus again!

reviews.author: A J
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at Paradisus.  We were treated like royalty and catered to. We had the Royal Service and a wonderful butler, Rode, who was at our beck and call.  He made sure we had Bali Beds reserved each day at the pool and reservations for dinner each night and just about anything else we wanted.  

The hotel and grounds are beautiful!  I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Sergio R
reviews.title: Love the place more and more each time we go
reviews.text:
My wife and I recently stay at Paradisus and, we can't say enough about this place.  It has everything one would want from a resort.  The staff is super nice, and accomdating and are always there with a smile.

The resort opened a small coffee shop that's all inclusive that was a nice surprise. the food there is amazing.  I recommend Sushi restaurant, Market Grill and Blue Agave.  

For lunch we ate at La Palapa and Jorge Cahuica was always super friendly and very attentive.

Honestly we can't say anythign bad about this resort, we have been there 3 years in a row, and actually were married there last year, and plan to go back next year.

I would just recommend to those going don't waste your time w/ the Club Melia tour, we actually went w/ the intentions of signing up but after we did the match and really put a dollar amount to it, its not worth it in the end.  If you are thinking of being a member look up the reviews and read what som people have gone through.

HOpe all this helps

reviews.author: 336p
reviews.title: Mixed bag
reviews.text:
A large 1980s-era hotel on the beach. 
The pool is quite cramped for the number of guests.
Rooms are spacious and clean, with large balconies.
Restaurants vary from the excellent (Naos, Ibana) to the hopeless (Market Grill.)
Service varies from polite but slow (poolside) to the seriously eccentric (restaurant waiters.)
Checking out is a bizarre process that involves going to different desks and paying off different parts of the bill to different offices. Only when this is complete do you receive a 'check out voucher' without which you can't put your luggage in a taxi.  
Someone at Melia should try staying here as a guest.

reviews.author: KathyC
reviews.title: Royal service is the way to go!!
reviews.text:
This is a late review since we traveled August 2015!
