I have to say this was one of the best choices I have ever made while staying in Cancun. The service was top notch, everyone was super friendly and helpful. And their whole resort smells AMAZING! My boyfriend and I scored a great deal to stay on the royal service side (Building 5) which is for adults only. It was seriously the best! We had a butler (Ivan) who made sure everything was ready and done for us. He did an excellent job in taking care of our restaurant reservation and refilling our fridge with m&m's and dos X (my boyfriend's requests from day 1) lol. We loved the self-serve bar in the lobby which offered great selections of liquor, spirits, etc. Most of the times there was someone there to help you fill your glasses.
Food was good but if you want more selections in food (breakfast and lunch), then you will definitely have to go to the other buildings outside the royal service sections. Their pool menu was still pretty decent and definitely take advantage of the desert section they put out in the lobby!!  We tried all the restaurants except for Vento due to time (unfortunately). We really loved Bana (and Roberto was such an awesome waiter!!! Really patient with us and made great suggestions), Fuego was super delicious (one of the best for us). Make sue to take advantage of all the ones you have to make reservations for!! 
We also took advantage of their sushi class, in which head Chef Erika did a great job in teaching us! it was so much fun.

The only thing I can say is that the pool in the royal service side needs some type of shade or swim up bar. Its the adult section of the resort so it would have been nice to have something like that. We tried going on the other side and our drinks were splashed with water by all the kids swimming around. And some music or some type of entertainment would be nice as well. It was too hot sometimes to be in the pool especially since the water got warm as well. Unfortunately the beach had a lot of seaweed so we didn't get in but it was really nice looking from far. Overall, great stay, awesome, clean rooms, and impeccable service! cant wait to be back.

reviews.author: Kerrona B
reviews.title: Our best destination by far
reviews.text: First impressions are very important. From the moment you arive you are treated like royalty. As soon as you walk in the hotel you feel a sense of relaxation and calmness. Very clean and the smell is invigorating. The staff were very friendly and always willing to help with a smile on their face. We choose the Royal service which came with a butler. Let me just say that our butler Francisco went above and beyond his duties in making us feel more comfortable. He took care of everything from getting towels sent to the pool to making dinner reservation and even giving us a cell phone so that we could reach him at any time. The food was amazing and the drinks were even better.

reviews.author: Bellaseror
reviews.title: Paradisus cancun
reviews.text: Beautiful accomadations ! The level rooms are totally worth it with the added services you recieve! The reserved cabanas for 2 days of your stay was amazing. Also they make reservations in all the restaurants for you . They also make anything your heart desires in the restaurant overlooking the most beautiful view on the ocean. The attention you get poolside is incredible - they bring you refills without you having to say a word . You really feel like the only guest there!!!

reviews.author: halk
reviews.title: Paradeusus cancun
reviews.text: We are members of Malia and as always another great resort . The personal are wounderfull and always want to help you. The food is by far the best , and the beach is really the best. Melia can't be beat.

reviews.author: tring2016
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Had a great time.  Butler Rosanna was superb.  Very attentive.  Went the extra mile everyday.  Enso restaurant was the best.  They were actually closed when we arrived and they still managed to give us friendly quality service.   Food is soooo good!!!

reviews.author: Matt R
reviews.title: Great Family Vacation
reviews.text: Family concierge junior suite with my wife and 7 year old some.  Our concierge was Pamela and she treated our son great!  She had gifts for him every other day. Also, a wine a cheese plate was sent up to our room several nights. The  food was awesome. Tempo was amazing and while it is not part of the inclusive package it is well worth it!  The tasting menu made us feel like judges on Iron Chef America!  Only complaint is that the balcony walls are high and if you sit in the prided chairs, it is hard to see the ocean.  All in all a great hotel for families!

reviews.author: sdimm2277
reviews.title: Couple Retreat
reviews.text: I loved the Paradisus, from the moment you walk into the hotel you are welcomed by staff. We stayed in the Royal Service and it was amazing. No children. The food was okay. I only had a few meals that I had enjoyed. The beach was clear, blue water and hardly any seaweed. The pool area was a blast! I highly recommend upgrading to Royal Service. I wish our stay was longer.

reviews.author: Steve R
reviews.title: This is how you do Cancun!
reviews.text:
Had a wonderful family vacation out here. This package came with transportation to and from the airport. The "All-Inclusive" was literally all and everything I could ask for. I have had a few bad experiences but I could say that this place was a really fun and it felt as though this location was a very exclusive locale. 
My family picked this place, I hadn't heard of it. The humidity kept everything moist so the linen and towels had that 'not all the way' dried aroma. Other than that I couldn't complain about too much else. Room service arrived quickly and promptly, my refrigerator was filled up everyday. We communicated with management our needs and they were more than obliged to furnish us with what we asked for from tooth brushes to in room dining supplies. 
The private beach was very calm and serene and the pools were gorgeous. I had a very good time and I think everyone in our family enjoyed themselves from the young to the old. Our Parents renewed their vows and we had an "All-White" ceremony which was absolutely decadent and gave us some good photos as well. 
All and all if you need a place to stay and you haven't booked a spot yet, I give you my endorsement on pulling the trigger for here. We all spoke spanish rather fluently, and everyone (except the young children) had been to Cancun before, so we were content with mostly staying put. The teens and twenty- year olds found their way to the club, but the traffic made the non air conditioned cab rides sort of obnoxious. So if your looking for a more centrally located spot, you might consider this out of the way. If you want a very cozy and chill place to relax, than this place has got your number.

reviews.author: 873rob
reviews.title: Very nice hotel if you want a relaxing holiday
reviews.text:
Lovely clean hotel, staff very friendly.  Entertainment is disappointing and was really let down when they couldn't show uk premiership football.  I have now stayed at 4 all inclusive hotels in Cancun / riviera maya area and they all offered coverage of football.

Obviously lots of couples will see this as a positive but wanted to warn people as a few, like me, really enjoy just taking two hours away with a few cold beers watching a game.

Anyway don't want to put people off as it is a lovely beach and restaurants etc. Are very good.

Enjoy the relaxation.

reviews.author: Jiekai C
reviews.title: Old than the photos
reviews.text: The room and the hotel are older than the photos. The MINI fridge was not re-fill properly not all the drink was filled. The hotel should tell the customers when it was built, and if has been renovated.

reviews.author: Jose N
reviews.title: Birthday Getaway.
reviews.text:
The staff was extremely friendly, helpful and knowledgable- not only about the property, but also the area. A true testimony to their commitment to hospitality. 

Room was always impeccable upon our return and the common areas well kept and maintained. 

The food selection seems fresh and tasty, it's their specialty restaurants where I felt they fell short. 

We dined at Market, the Brazilian/Argentinian grill for my wife's birthday, and the experience was off to a rough start. We had made reservations Thru one of the concierge and explained to him that it was for my wife's birthday, even expressed that the whole trip was to celebrate her birthday. Upon arrival it was informed that no reservation had been made and the (I believe to be manager- she seemed in charge and others were going to her for direction) manager proceeded to explain that often concierge did not actually make the reservations as indicated and confirmed. Long story short, after explaining to her the situation and the fact that it was my wife's birthday, she finally proceed to make arrangement for us in a restaurant that never went on to fill up the entire time we were there. Sixty percent was the most it filled up at its busiest of time during our visit. 
She did later proceed to constantly check up on us, but it was too little too late. The meat here was always well done, but I can excuse that to dietary preferences. Still unfortunate. 

The outdoor Thai restaurant was equally disappointing, if for nothing else not letting us know that they were out of the duck until my wife's dinner hit the table. Which they proceeded to leave there while my meal was prepared and it was cold by the time I got my second choice entree. Tasty, but it would've been nice if both of us had gotten our food at the same time. 

The staff is above par, and I cannot express that enough. Maybe with a little more planning input behalf, this would've been a five experience.

reviews.author: dcgal2015
reviews.title: EXCELLENT FOOD AND SERVICE...ROOMS NEED SOME REMODELING
reviews.text:
I'm a bit delayed in writing this review but I figure better late than never :). Our trip was comprised of two couples (my bf and myself and my friend and her husband). When we first arrived, we were greeted and provided a drink to cool down and relax while we checked in. The staff was very kind and helpful. When we first went to our rooms we were a bit disappointed. The rooms looked old and not much like the pictures we saw online. I would rate the rooms as 3 Stars.  I then requested to be upgraded to Royal Service but was provided info that Royal Service was full and that they would switch our room instead. For those who are picky about rooms, I would DEFINITELY upgrade to Royal Service prior to coming here.  The second room they provided was much better but it still needed a bit of TLC. But that's OK because we were not trying to spend time in the room anyways! We are beach people and wanted to be outside and quite frankly the AMAZING restaurant and staff service made up for the room. 

Restaurants/Food: AMAZING. The quality of the food and service is something out of this world. It's SO CLEAN and the servers are so professional. The wait staff in the U.S.A could learn a thing or two from this team! Everyone was amazing but specifically, some staffers who really made sure we were taken care of and went the extra mile were: 
Andreas at the Nespresso Bar (yes they have one and he makes the best drinks)
Yhoni Gonzalez Torres and Arturo at Restaurant Naos
Miguel Santos at Restaurant Naos (PM)

Thank you guys for making us want to come back again for our vacation next year! 

Spa - My boyfriend and I received a couples massage and it was AMAZING! I loved it and the ladies were awesome. I also wanted my hair braided and I provided zero notice and they were so accomodating and had someone ready to braid my hair in 5 minutes! She did an amazing job and when I came back to the U.S. everyone gave me compliments on my braids. Thank you Senora (sorry I forgot her name but everyone at the spa is amazing)

Gym - SO NICE...but quite frankly I had so much fun during the zumba class I didn't use the gym. Zumba is done by the pool and the best is to have a fresh made fruit smoothie afterwards then jump in the pool! I miss this so much!

Excursion - We went on the day trip via boat and it was so much fun! I highly recommend the excursions. The boat staff went the extra mile to make sure we had a blast and even took photos of everyone and provided pics (for sale of course) after the excursion was over. 

Grounds - So beautiful, you feel like you are walking around in heaven. Everywhere is spotless and shines. The cleanliness was top notch. 

Room Service - Awesome, and speedy! 

Thanks again Paradisus Cancun! I am now a part of the Melia Rewards program and have stayed at the INNside in New York since my trip to the Paradisus and I will only travel to Melia hotels from now on. You guys have spoiled me :) See you next time!

reviews.author: christopherlavin
reviews.title: Service not as it has been in the past
reviews.text:
Been going to the Paradisus for the past 20 years started out as the Gran Malia,
Service this year was no where near what it has been in the past. We had a personal concierge, Carlos, who was not easy to contact and did not return request so I am not really sure what he does. The spa was not clean, and the food by the pool was below average.Ice machines did not work, were locked or empty. Kids pool was not clean  If you go to the Paradisus  the service and staff are not up to the standard you would expect.

reviews.author: Dwight F
reviews.title: Couples trip
reviews.text: This resort was wonderful.  We booked the Royal Service and everything was first class.  Everyone was very attentive to our needs and our butler, Antonio, was the best.  This is our first time there but I can't imagine a better butler.  He went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed.

reviews.author: Rob T
reviews.title: We enjoyed it and would come back
reviews.text: This was our 4th visit to Cancun and we have stayed at all-inclusive hotels each time. The only negative was a very long wait and slow check-in. The property is beautiful and customer service outstanding. We stayed in the VIP section and used the VIP pool. My wife had broken her foot a few days before we flew down there and the property is so large and we had rooms in bldg #5 (VIP section) - Guadalupe at the front desk went out of her way to accommodate us to get our rooms moved the following day to be closer to the common areas and my wife and I are thankful for her great service.  ALL staff we interacted with were awesome - from the concierge at the pool to busboys in the buffet. Housekeeping was very good and the rooms are updated and very comfortable. The service at the VIP pool from Eddie and Ricardo was great. The food was excellent. We would come back.

reviews.author: Liz L
reviews.title: Royal Service was Absolutely AMAZING!
reviews.text:
We booked to Paradisus and decided to upgrade to Royal Service because of the adults only aspect. Little did we know we would be getting the best service of our lives! 

From the moment we checked in and were assigned our personal butler, Antonio, our trip was outstanding. From the welcome glasses of champagne, to our personalized mini bar, we were treated so well. We also received two bottles of tequila delivered to our door as a gift from the hotel. Antonio booked all of our reservations for dinner for us, and made recommendations on where to eat each night (he never let us down!). One day we left our room and came back to rose petals leading from the door to the bed with a rose petal heart on it. He also checked in with us every single day to make sure our experience was going well, and took the time to chat with us by the pool. He made sure we had reservations for Bali beds by the pool every day, which was so relaxing a a definite must in the hot Mexico sun! He is the most genuine and helpful person we've ever encountered in the service industry anywheres. He made our trip unforgettable and so relaxing. We will be going back to his hotel because of him for sure :D

The whole staff in Royal Service went out of their way to make sure we were taken care of. Never once did we hear the word "no" or "we can't do that." They always said "it's our pleasure" and found a way to cater to our needs. Daniel and Omar (the pool concierges) were also outstanding!!! We now consider them friends from afar, as they are incredible at their job, and made a big effort every day to take care of us, and get to know us. These guys are top notch! Not to mention, our pool servers Jorge and Javier. I don't think we ever had an empty drink or an empty stomach:) These guys waited on us hand and foot for hours each day. They got us numerous amount of fun tropical drinks, bottle service with champagne glasses, and served us food right to our Bali bed. They also got us buckets of ice water and mini towels to put on our head for the exceptionally hot days. 

One of our favorite spots to eat was also in Royal service at La Palapa. The most amazing breakfast (we always had omelettes, French toast, and pancakes), for a snack we always had mini Kobe burgers with goat cheese and chips and guac around the pool, and for lunch the Kobe burger on the menu is HUGE and SO good. Our favorite part of the trip was sitting at this restaurant with an awesome ocean breeze, and just taking in the scenery. 

Royal service is worth every penny. Pyramid 5 felt like you were staying in a spa and the pool area was super chill and relaxing with no obnoxious people. We literally stayed on the resort for 9 days just chilling in Royal service with not one compliant. We love the staff and the hotel. We will be telling everyone to go here, and we can't wait to get back. Our trip was so memorable because of the impeccable service. If people write negative reviews about this place....there is something wrong with them, not Paradisus Cancun. People in the U.S. Service industry could learn a lot from the staff at this resort. Thank you again to our Paradisus amigos!!!! Xoxo

reviews.author: 381Rosie
reviews.title: Food is average at best
reviews.text: We were disappointed by the food at several of the restaurants on site. The room is adequate but nothing special. The hotel staff are friendly and helpful. Probably not the place to choose if you prefer quiet and absence of crowds.

reviews.author: KenpoDC
reviews.title: PARADISUS enjoyed it and would certainly go back!
reviews.text:
I wanted to start off by talking about The building five desk: Veronica at the desk in building number 5 was VERY helpful in making reservations, providing information and just overall really making a good attempt at making the stay pleasant. Veronica is a very friendly person, very, very beautiful on the inside and outside.  She is a stellar employee and I'm grateful for all the help she provided. 

The food: 

The restaurant Enso, which is billed as an Asian fusion was a drastic disappointment in quality of food. Everything we ordered was quite disappointing. The service was great, the staff very friendly but the food I give a D+.  The only redeeming thing was this Pineapple/orange/Lychee/Strawberry vanilla punch they had. That was good, the rest for get it, skip this place. 

La palapa, now that place had good food. Well worth it. The food was quite good with a wonderful presentation. With a table overlooking the water, it was an experience worth remembering. Again the staff was very friendly and accommodating. We went here four times it was that good. 

Mole: The food was not great, not bad, just ok. The dish I had was quite sweet, so sweet that it drowned out the shrimp. The sea bass was also overwhelmed by all the activity that was occurring on top of it. The topping was just too strong, the fish was lost in the ocean of favors. Alejandro was extremely helpful, cheerful and completely willing to go above and beyond. He was great. He was so versatile that he was almost like our private concierge for an hour. He kept checking in on is to be sure our experience was a good one. What a great employee. The hostess Ana, was very pleasant, very helpful, friendly and really went the extra mile. Ana was extremely attentive. She and Alejandro made the lack-luster food worth coming. The staff was great, but the food not so much. 

I'm going to give barro an -A. Good solid sushi, you can't go wrong here.  The staff was wonderful. The hostess beautiful on the inside and outside. The bar tender was fantastic. Friendly, creative and funny. He made a drink up for me out of his own mind that was fantastic. I asked him to make me something unusual, weird and fruity and he delivered! 

The market Grille in the restaurant buffet attached to it were OK I would give them a B. They do need some upgrades though in the buffet area. It was pretty good, not great, just good. 

The café seating area in the building number five (5) section was fantastic. The food provided was great the drink selection was optimal the Koi pond was gorgeous the ivy was incredible and artistic and beautiful. I love the selection of cheeses and meats and the breakfast items were fantastic. The selection of desserts in the evening was scrumptious. Good job on this part of the resort! 

At times it was hard to get in to some of the restaurants as thy book up all I gut Carly quickly. 

The Pool area: 

The staff outside in the pool area also were extremely friendly with Omar always going above and beyond with helping us out.  He was friendly and funny. The only downside to the pool area is I think that there should be more lounge chairs. The cabana are at a premium and sometimes difficult to secure leaving only the ability to relax with a lounge chair and I just don't think that they were enough. I also think that more lounge chairs are needed on the beach and that there should be the music playing out there on the beach as well. Why no speakers pointing out to the water? 

The front desk and Bell staff:

Johnathan at the bel-stand, was friendly, accommodating, and very helpful in getting on the shuttle. The front desk and concierge staff were always helpful and friendly. 

The Spa:

We enjoyed the spa and had a lovely time in there. The staff was very friendly and accommodating inside the spa area. Facilities were lovely I would just like to see a little bit more of a selection of health related food items in the spa area where the drinks are.

One thing that bothers me is there there should be more places to make change so we can tip properly.  It was always an adventure to get change. I think some of the amenities close too early. It's very bothersome to see the staff in long pants and shirts when it's so hot. Especially outside. At a minimum, everyone working outside or who goes in and out should be in shorts and short sleeve shirts and the women should be allowed to wear skirts if they want to. It is just horrible seeing the staff in those clothes. One thing I would like to know, is why in the world does hotel management make their poor staff wear long pants and 3/4 length or long sleeve shirts when the temperature is close to unbearable. At times it was a heat index of over 100 degrees outside. The heat and humidity are nothing to shrug a shoulder to as they are intense. It's unfair and makes me feel so badly for them. They walk around with smiles and wonderful attitudes, as friendly and pleasant as anyone could ever want someone to be. It's unbelievable that management thinks it's ok to subject their staff to wearing clothing that is not suited for the weather. 

Overall it was a fantastic experience and I would certainly go back. If I go to the area again, I wouldn't stay anywhere other than the Paradisus.

reviews.author: Anoush B
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: We were very pleased overall. The staff was amazig and very friendly. And you could tell it was coming from their heart. Every one spoke very good English. Food was great too. The hotel smelled really good and was very clean. I wasn't impressed eith the entertainment but it was not bad. Could have been better.

reviews.author: damato2016
reviews.title: excellant vacation
reviews.text: resort was very clean staff very friendly. For breakfast and lunch you eat at Naos restaurant our server was Marco we looked for him every morning. He would bring us coffee, tea and juice as soon as he saw us come in. there were two other servers in the same area as Marco they were also very attentive to all the people in there area (when you eat at Naos you can sit in fuegos sitting area for breakfast and lunch that is were we sat you had a great view of the ocean. We rented the Bali beds twice which we enjoyed having shade when we wanted it.,

reviews.author: rafayelh2016
reviews.title: Best place
reviews.text: It was very nice good place love it we will be back next year wire our kids nice people good customer service friendly love the place  I will go back again same place rooms where very nice and clean best hotel in Cancun

reviews.author: zapzap85
reviews.title: Eating at Bana restaurant.
reviews.text: Pamela was the best hostess. She greets us (me & my fiancee) with a welcome smile and explain the menu and place us at our table very fast. And also our server was amazing. He took our ordered very quick and our food came out very fast. Our server name was Jose. Shootout to this crew.

reviews.author: Nadiya K
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: My husband and I have just returned from our 4 night anniversary vacation in Paradisus. We are happy to have chosen this hotel, because the grounds are beautiful, location and the beach are amazing. We liked our room and a quiet pool, most of all we enjoyed our 2 dinners at Bana and would like to say thank you to waiter Erik, who provided us with perfect service and special attentions. Erik, saludos de Sres. Garcia! We will be back. Thank you all.

reviews.author: andreagD1959RF
reviews.title: Awsome Place to stay
reviews.text:
I love staying at Paradisus.  It was an awesome stay. Staff were great. the restaurants are awesome.
the staff was friendly and happy to help.  They made me my Hemp seed / Ginger Drink .Every Morning. I would definitely stay there again. Royal Service is the best.

reviews.author: TxJoneses
reviews.title: Family Vacation Review- 90% GREAT!
reviews.text:
We booked our stay thru Melia.com, and traveled with my Wife & 2 boys.

We booked an Ocean View Jr Suite with a King Bed. We called the front desk several days in advance to confirm our room, ocean view, king bed, sofa bed and a crib in our room. And, 24 hours prior to our arrival we checked in online thru Melia.com.

Check In:
We arrived at around 12:30 and despite checking in online 24 hours ahead of time, our room was not ready. Additionally, they had us in a room with (2) double beds not the King Bed we had booked and confirmed prior to our arrival. Our room did get corrected but our room was not ready until 3:30pm. And, once in our room there was not a crib. They did get one up for us. I'd rate check in as a 2 star experience.

Room:
Was nice, but, not great. It was very clean but the furnishings are rather dated. We stayed in building 3 (main building) on the 8th floor. We had a kid and a baby with us so the proximity to the restaurants was very nice. If you are traveling without kids, you DEFINITELY want to stay in the Royal Service section. We had family that booked Royal Service and their building was very quite and their room was also quite nicer. Even on the 8th floor, building 3 is loud until around 10pm because of the music and shows on the main level. If you go bed early, want a quite/peaceful vacation....building 3 is probably not for you. Unless, you have kids and the "proximity" factor outweighs the noise factor. Our room was also not cleaned one day and we had a hair dryer break down. That said, we had a great view of the ocean, and I'd rate the room as a 3.5 star. 

Resort:
I've read all the reviews, and have seen people complaining about the common areas not having ac. And, I am aware that many resorts in the tropics do not have ac in the common areas. I didn't think it would be much of an issue. But, after the second day of getting showered and dressed up for dinner I started to get pretty frustrated by the sauna like temperature, humidity and sweat. My shirt and head would be covered in sweat just walking to our dinner reservation, it got a little old. Ac would have been nice. The grounds of the resort are meticulously maintained, the interior common space is meticulously maintained, the pools are nice and the beach is awesome! I'd rate the resort a 4 star.

Restaurants:
For an all-inclusive I don't know how you could ask for more! The restaurants were great! We ate at Naos buffet, which was very good. Vento- which was excellent, Fuego-which was excellent, Market Grill- which was excellent, Mole- which was excellent. Awesome dinning experiences! I'd rate the restaurants/food selections as 4.5 star.

Service:
Outstanding (other than check in) it was outstanding! They have a great team of servers/bartenders/concierge, just about everyone we encountered had a smile and was very happy to help. All it takes I guess is a slightly puzzled look on your face and literally within seconds someone will approach you to ask if they can help with anything. It was amazing! 5 star service!

Drinks:
We had a lot of them :) Great selection, great liquor selection. This isn't the typical "well whiskey" all inclusive they have upper tier liquor available upon request. Beer selection was a little light, all I could find was Dos Equis or Tecate. That said, most bartenders were great and perhaps the best service comes from the beach waiters. 4 star for drinks. 

All in all we had a GREAT trip, fun had by all, service expectations exceeded. 

I'd rate our entire experience as a 4 star experience. There may be a 4.5-5 star all inclusive experience out there but I would still recommend Paradisus to family and friends. 

Thank You For A Great Week Paradisus

reviews.author: carlosandrad
reviews.title: Beatuful Hotel!
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel, very well located & great service! Room service was very good, The food, the service, the room and hotel cleanliness were all amazing, amenities were great, and the staff was very friendly

reviews.author: Jacob Q
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Check in process was horrible. Very slow. Almost like the attendants didn't have any incentive to be timely. They just didn't care. They did offer beer and drinks in the check in area but only if you asked. 
We arrived at 5 PM as a party of 4. Then they tried to give us a room with one King bed. Who does that? I kind of have a feeling they lowered there expectations when they saw us, same skin color and race, and thought we could all spend 8 days in the same king bed together. After 2 more hours of complaining, they finally moved us to a room with 2 full beds. 
Funny thing is, my brother in law who looks white was able to move us to an ocean view room next to his the next day at noon. With no upgrade fees. Go figure. 
Now most if not all the staff were very nice and well groomed. Especially pool side. 
The pool was great with the cabanas. The ocean location was excellent. The restaurant food was great as well as the buffets. Always fresh. Thy were very accommodating with reservations as well. 
I hope my review was fair.

reviews.author: hamsterlover82
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel.
reviews.text: The hotel definitely lives up to its name. The hotel check-in was superb. The sanitation of the room and the maintenance was perfect. The staff... The staff was truly INCREDIBLE. Everyone was polite and at your service when needed. The food was good, it just depends on your personal preference. But luckily the hotel has a variety of restaurants to choose from, whether it's from Japenese food, to American or it's very own Mexican food. The hotel definitely has a photogenic ambiance to it; daytime and nighttime. The only negative or downside to the hotel was the lighting. The lighting is very dim in the hotel.. even in your room. It's hard for people to see where they're going or what they're eating. But overall the hotel was beautiful.

reviews.author: Janet S
reviews.title: Staff were very friendly and helpful
reviews.text:
Our trip to Cancun was a blast. We stayed at Paradisus Cancun at the hotel zone. This resort was situated in the perfect place - right in the middle of hotel zone. One could easily take the public bus transportation to Mercado 28, the aquarium, the high-end malls and several restaurants. The view from our room was spectacular. Most importantly, everyone at the hotel from the check-in desk, room service, restaurants and cleaning staff were all very helpful, courteous and friendly. 

Andres from the Nespresso bar was exceptionally friendly and helpful. He is one person who you could absolutely say that he LOVES his job. He was always smiling no matter how busy he was and even when the espresso machine broke down.

In addition, Gamiel from Fuego provided us excellent service while dining. He went above and beyond in serving us to make sure we had a great experience at this restaurant. When my husband ordered his usual diet coke drink, Gamiel offered some great suggestions which turned out to be awesome! We appreciated his initiative and friendliness in making our dining experience a wonderful one.

reviews.author: Ktwa2
reviews.title: false advertisement horrible customer service
reviews.text:
Our family booked our trip because this was our 15th wedding anniversary and my husband and I were going to renew our vows.  Trip was booked over a year via a travel agent.  We booked an 8day/7night family concierge ocean view room because the hotel offered a Wish Package for weddings and such.  We had a very hard time getting our vow renewal finalized because people wouldn't return our emails and were sending us peoples personal information about a wedding in February to our email.  After trying to work with each dept that we had to after getting a manager involved.  During our stay at the hotel our "butler" Fernanda and the rest of the butler staff were horrible.  We were supposed to get certain things in our room for the family concierge services and we didn't.  Kids size items ex bath soaps, bath robes, kid size pillows, kids welcome bag with sand toys, nightly milk and cookies, parents pillow menu.  
Well needless to say the kids size bath soaps are baby soap baby lotion and baby shampoo not for a 10yr old.  Kids welcome bag we had to ask for since our daughters were excited and looking for it when we walked in the room.  They got a Barbie tooth brush and tooth paste and a toddler size tee shirt.  (Our youngest child is 10)
Milk and cookies yeah that happened 2 nights only.  Pillows for kids never saw them at all kids bathrobe had 1st day and house keeping took it and never got it back.  parents pillow menu when we asked about it no one knew what it was.  Dinner reservations were a joke as well.  Had to beg for a restaurant for 6 even though we should get a confirmed reservation according to the concierge info.  They put us in a restaurant that both my dad and husband had allergies to the food and gave us a hard time to get reservations at a different location.  
Wedding coordinator was supposed to meet with us and confirm all the details for the renewal.  Melina sent an email to me confirming to meet us at 3:00pm to go over details for our renewal.  Well she NEVER showed up no one knew where she was nor could they find her. After 2 attempts we meet with someone else whom had not a clue about our renewal and offered little input as to what we would be doing.  Spoke with the manager of Concierge because of us not being able to get the coordinator and the fact that we still didn't have confirmation on restaurant changes. She was rude and said I will confirm them.  Next day our Butler told us she couldn't get the dinner locations we requested there was no availability. (even though the manger the day prior said she will get them).  Her answer was No Ma'am there are no tables available at Market Grill for your family tonight.  I later got a call from the manager scolding me like I was 2yrs old telling me I told you I confirmed the table you have a reservation. I tried to explain what Fernanda had told us and her response was I don't care I told you this yesterday and you shouldn't have asked the butler about it.  When I told her that Fernanda came to me about it she said I don't care.  After having an issue after issue at the hotel we asked to speak with the hotel manager.  The concierge manager came to us (same lady that we had been speaking to) we were trying to explain what was going on.  When we were speaking our 10yr old had started to say something and the manager stops her and said Im speaking to your mother not you as she grabbed her arm and squeezed it.  At that point I told her she was out of line and don't ever speak to my child in that manner and DONT ever place a finger on her.  I went and spoke with the Hotel Manager at that point. He apologized for everything and told me he would get to the bottom of the issue and help us make our stay (which was just one day) nice.  He would do something special for our family especially our kids.  He agreed with us that the kids amenities are geared towards babies and toddlers that his 11yr old son makes the same comments about the baby style things he gets when he stays there.  He asked that I forward him some of the emails and he would be in touch with me.  I forwarded him an email that evening after our vow renewal because once again things weren't done.  As part of the wish package you get special things one was a bottle of wine the night of the ceremony.  When we went to open the bottle we couldn't cause the cork was one that needed an opener nothing was provided called down to room service and the concierge office and we were told someone would be right up no one came.  Our license and our sand we did during the ceremony was to come to our room that night.  Nope had to fight with them the next day as we are packing to leave.  We got the items with in 15 mins before we were to leave the room.  After all this we were to get our refund to our card for the vow renewal it is a deposit and refund with in 2 weeks home 3 weeks and refund is still not received.  The special stuff the manager said he would do for the kids resulted in absolutely NOTHING.  I would not at all recommend this hotel for the family concierge services.  It is a scam and falsely advertised to us.  The details I have written here are just some of the problems.  Will add this note BE CAUTIONS WHEN WALKING INTO THE POOL  THE TILE IS VERY SLIPPERY AND I ALONG WITH MULTIPLE GUEST FELL GETTING INTO THE POOL.

reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: Was with my family. 15 year old twins. There needs to be more activities at the resort. Very little for their age to do. Pamela the Family Conceirge was wonderful. Lobby was beautiful. Food was very good. Staff was very helpful.

reviews.author: Enjoying-These-Trips
reviews.title: Outstanding personal service
reviews.text: While other travellers have described the property and amenities very well I'd like to also stress the excellent personal attention my wife and I received while dealing with Paradisus' Royal Service. Special commendations are deserved for Lazaro Asencio, the Royal Service Manager, and especially our butler, Sergio. (My apologies, Sergio, I can't recall your last name). Lazaro, Sergio as well as the other Royal Staff made out trip memorable. Sergio was always around and handled our special requests with outstanding efficiency. Sergio - thank you - and that little figurine you gave us as a present upon departure has a special place on our counter, reminding us of a beautiful time!

reviews.author: Nick L
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort & Great Staff
reviews.text:
Well first i will have to say a friend and I had the Royal Service package. For us when we booked it was slightly more but definitely worth the price difference. 

Thanks to our butler Rode, (highly recommended to request him) we were upgraded from a lagoon view to a beach view at no extra cost. They provided us with early check in at about 1 pm. We did email them 1 week prior to confirm as well as a request a room on a high floor, and we were accommodated. They also provided a cell phone to contact our butler and he always answered.

Most of our stay was in the royal service section (we have access to the whole resort) which is a seperate building that is still connected to the rest of the resort. It consists of a 2 private pools and  a restaurant / bar with a beach view. The service was impeccable. poolside drink service was easy to get. The pools were clean and they provided towels, sunscreen etc. They even had beach drink service. 

The buffet is one of the best I've seen they can accommodate almost any diet I would say . They even had gluten free bread. Seafood galore, Vegetables, Salads, Deserts, meats breads fresh juices all cooked to perfection. 

I'd definitely stay there again

reviews.author: nanaca44
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: From our check in to check out all the staff was helpful. The room was super clean with balcony facing the ocean. The view was great. The room was kept clean, the service by the pool always at hand and the food at the restaurants delicious. I definitely will stay here again.

reviews.author: nyer140
reviews.title: A Great Family Vacation in Paradise!
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful, the staff very friendly and helpful. They think of everything in order to make your stay superb! A gorgeous beach with plenty of  lounge chairs under the tiki umbrellas available. We also loved the bali beds! We stayed in the Royal Service part of the resort and had our own butler Eduardo. He was so polite and helpful, especially with giving us advice on excursions and he made all our dinner reservations.

reviews.author: JaggerO1
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text:
Sorry for the late report!
To start off with, we're no world travelers or fancy food gurus. We're just a regular family and wanted to give our review on Cancun especially the resort Paradisus. We had an absolute wonderful time and would recommend Paradisus to anyone!
  For starters I'll give you our take on each restaurant as we ate at all of them except Tempo and Bana.                        
  First was Naos which is their buffet. They had a large selection of food, from sushi, seafood, steaks and deserts. For me the food was good, the only complaint was the food wasn't too warm at times. But breakfast was good and we did eat here a lot.  Now I have to give a BIG shout out to one of our fav waiters, Miguel Santo, he was excellent. Never have I had a waiter at a buffet run to get Tequila shots for us.  Lol. Find him and sit in his section, you won't be disappointed!
  Next Blue Agave, it is just as advertised, Tequila and Tacos. Only ate here once but the Tequila was good and Tacos tasty.
  Next up was Fuego, we ate here out last night and it didn't disappoint. I had the best Shrimp Ceviche I've ever had, plus we had different pasta and meat dishes which I didn't remember their names. Too bad we ate here last as we loved every dish we had.
  Then on to Mole which touted Mexican food, we're from the US, in fact, South Texas and know about TexMex food but this was something else with different favors and textures. The quesadillas, Tortilla  soup and one diner had a Chicken with pineapples and all were excellent. Plus more tequila!
   Now to La Perla, I believe this is the restaurant in the Royal service section right next to the pool, beautiful open air and gorgeous view of the beach. We had several quick bites here. The Akashi beef minis were great! Also had breakfast with a view here.
  Getting close, now to our shinning star, Vento. We had no clue what Tapas were but we found out, the small pasta and pizza dishes were delicious. As a group we loved every one we ordered. Just wish we stayed longer and at there more often. Here also, I have to commend Grecia, Ruben and Alejandro. They did an excellent job waiting on our every need.
  But with everything, there was some disappointment and it can from the Market Grill. First of all, it's a gorgeous open air restaurant. In our opinion, the best laid out eatery with a view. It's like a Brazilian steakhouse but the comparison stops there. All of the meat served tasted the same and even though thinly sliced most were tough. The shrimp were mush and inedible.
Also, the serviced lacked with us having to ask for certain types of steak. Hopefully it was just a night off for the stall.  But we will try again when we return. 
  There were a few that we didn't have time to eat at but when we come back, we'll have reviews of them.
  Quickly, our take on the Bars/Drinks, another excellent job. Bartenders and waiters were all friendly and don't let someone tell you the drinks are watered down or that they won't serve top shelf. Far from the truth!
  On to the Pools and Beach area, we had the Royal service and would definately recommend it. The private bar, mini buffet and atrium were stunning. It was well worth the service. The most crowded I saw the beach was maybe 4-5 people and 10 in the pool. The Cabanas and pool service in this area are top notch. Now the swim up bar pool was more crowded/noisy but not overly. 
  Also, Aqua World is on site and handled some of our excursions. The one thing we didn't do was zip line but that's for next year.
  Lastly, we'd like the thank all of the staff. They took great care of us and catered to our every need. Most staff members we met welcomed us with "Buenos Diaz" or Buenos Noches". Some even held their hand over their heart while welcoming you. But our warmest thank you goes to our personal butler Juan, we can't thank him enough. He did a great job of taking care of our needs. He made sure all of our restaurant reservations were made and just made us feel welcome. One day I told him I didn't have a koozie, he offered to get me one from town when he came back to work! We will ask for him next year.
 I'm sure he wasn't the only one as all of their butlers do a great job.
Hope you enjoyed "our" take on Paradisus. Till next year!

reviews.author: Chantalle B
reviews.title: Poor Front Desk Service
reviews.text:
We (kind of) stayed at Paradisus in an ocean view junior suite.  I wanted to give Paradisus a good review, but two encounters with the front desk left me with an overall bad impression of our stay. 

First, I will say that the staff in the restaurants, the nespresso bar, and pool side were always amazing and treated us wonderfully. We ate at Bana, Fuego, and Market Grill for our reserved dinners. Fuego was our favorite meal and was made all the better with service from Daniel and Gabrielle. Fuego is the seafood restaurant and all of our dishes we tried were amazing. Our second favorite was Market Grill, which is the Brazilian/Argentinian restaurant. Unfortunately, I don’t remember our main server, but all of the staff was really nice. There is no menu for Market Grill. They bring dishes around and ask you whether you would like some. In our opinion, the later dishes were tastier than the earlier ones, so try not to fill up on the earlier ones. Also, if you are a vegetarian, it would be difficult to eat here. The main dishes are different kinds of meat with some side dishes such as salad, rice & beans, and some vegetables. Lastly, is Bana. Bana is the sushi restaurant. Bana was good as well. It was a standard sushi restaurant, but was made better by our server, Claudio. 

On our first full day, we rented a cabana by the pool because we were too late to get chairs with an umbrella. When we signed for the cabana we were told that we were receiving a promotional price for celebrating a special occasion at the resort, which we were excited about. However, this later became a problem with the front desk (see below). Our day renting the cabana was really fun. The poolside server, David, was a hard worker and kept checking on us. 

Andres at the Nespresso Bar was an absolute joy. You could tell that he loved his job. He treated everyone with kindness and was genuinely happy. 

As for the front desk, unfortunately we had two bad encounters. The first was when tropical storm Earl blew in. The storm cracked our balcony sliding glass door completely across the bottom, slightly in the middle, and across the top. After maintenance checked it out, they thought it was best that we switch rooms. After waiting two hours for the whole ordeal and several calls to the front desk, someone was sent to give us our new room. The new room happened to be the room next door to us, but was two full size beds when our previous room was a king bed. They offered to put the beds together, but we didn’t want to fall in between the beds in the middle of the night and it was not what we paid for. We had to go to the front desk and they gave us an alternate room. However, the alternate room was not an ocean view, which is what we paid for. We went back to the front desk and the attendant refused to give us any accommodations (money back or services to make us for the loss) even though the majority of our stay would be in a room that faced their other pyramid building, not the ocean. 

The second encounter with the front desk was at check out. We had an early flight and checked out a little before 6:00 a.m. During checkout we had to pay for the cabana that we rented. The attendant ran my significant other’s card and it didn’t work. We thought that our bank put our cards on hold thinking it was fraud. Therefore, our only option was cash.  We had enough cash to pay for the cabana, but we did not have exact change. The attendant informed us that he did not have any change and could not give us any money back. Not only that, but they were charging us the full amount for the cabana, not the promotional price that was offered to us. When I informed that attendant about the promotional price, he said that he could not do anything about it because they didn’t give me a receipt! This is absurd because the front desk knows there is a promotional price – they were the ones that informed us about it! Therefore, we were stuck overpaying for a cabana because we didn’t receive the price we were guaranteed and the attendant didn’t have change for us to pay for the cabana!

Overall, based on the service I received from the front desk, I would not come back to Paradisus in any of their locations. Furthermore, I will be posting my review on any website that allows me to so I can warn other travellers about this ridiculousness. I’m not a person to complain about these things, but I did pay a substantial amount of money to go on vacation, not to be taken advantage of.

reviews.author: T Corey
reviews.title: Ah Summer 16 Ah Summer 16
reviews.text:
Overall the resort is great. The lobby areas are like you are outside with the heat. Not extremely the most comfortable. The rooms are nice although we did have a few tiny bugs crawling around tables. No big deal after all, we are in Cancun. The staff are great including but, not limited to Yhoni Gonzalez-Torres, who welcomed us with a friendly smile and of course a shot of tequila. He made us laugh and shared some local visits we should check out. He was great and remembered us every time he saw us near the main lobby. 

Also, Jesus at the middle bar (next to Bana sushi spot) was fantastic. Him and his coworker were on top of everything. Made his "special" drink which was delicious. 

Overall, we had a great time! Thank you guys!

reviews.author: 996zoec
reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.text: the food is amaizing and the food and beverage staff is excellet, they really go the extra mile to make you feel special. But be aware if you go durring the summer it will be really warm in all of the hotel main areas and restaurants.  the AC does not cool good on the rooms.

reviews.author: Frank F
reviews.title: What a place
reviews.text: I just finished my stay at royal service and I have nothing to complain about the staff was amazing especially our Butler rode he was amazing he got us a better room made sure we had everything he made our stay 1000 time better if u go here I would opt for the royal service and ask for rode as your Butler he will make your stay so amazing he treat with such a warm heart and he treat like family more then guest so many food choice pool is amazing

reviews.author: 162kerbys
reviews.title: Amazing experience. Our Butler was no where to be found.
reviews.text: We have stayed at several Paradisus Resorts and we are always extremely satisfied. Our Butler, Gerado, was no where to be found the entire stay. We met him at check in then never saw him again. Since we had stayed at Royal Service before we knew what to do and expect.

reviews.author: KatieWilks19
reviews.title: We will definitely be going back!
reviews.text: My boyfriend, our two best friends, and I came here in May right after graduation. We are 21 and 22 and we weren't looking for a crazy party resort. We wanted something very nice, relaxing, but fun for all of us to spend time together. Paradisus exceeded our expectations by far. The entire resort was immaculate, the staff was unbelievably courteous and helpful the entire week and the resort and the beach were just beautiful. The food was amazing and there were so many options. It was extremely easy to go from our cabana bed by the pool to take a dip or sit by the ocean which was only a short walk away. There was always someone helping us and checking up on us wherever we were. Needless to say we didn't want to leave. We purchased the royal service package which was well worth it. Juan helped us all week and he was amazing, so a special thank you to him. I would recommend this resort and the Royal service package to anyone and we are already planning on coming back!

reviews.author: 779joanne
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: Beautiful  hotel, big enough to have peace and quiet and to enjoy some activities when they decided to do some. Food not the best but not the worst. Having a Butler was a plus, very nice perk. He was very helpfull! These people work very hard and even though gratuitit's were included we still felt the need to tip some outstanding people we met, and they were grateful!

reviews.author: fitians
reviews.title: Dream Vacation
reviews.text: To start, we went to this hotel for the first time, not knowing much about it. But upon arrival, we were warmly welcomed and treated with the best care. The check in was quick and easy, and although we thought it was because we just arrived, the truth was that the welcome got better and better. No matter what kind of staff member we passed (whether a housekeeper, maintenance workers, or even cooks) we were always greeted kindly. And it didn't stop there. We'd like to give a special thanks to the pool concierge Armando Palomino for his great service, because he not only served us, but with his warm smile and friendliness, he talked to us and made us laugh and we got to know him as a friend. Sofonia and David, Armando's coworkers, also served us with the utmost of kindness. Other pool concierges that we enjoyed having were Abraham Campa and Alexander Garcia. And of course, we couldn't forget the chef with the amazing food in both the buffet and at the specialty restaurants, Chef Juan. Also, our kind hotel concierge Denise was a huge help in allowing us to get to know the hotel and helping us to be "more at home". This hotel is a family of great people who we enjoy being with and people that never cease to make us smile.

reviews.author: Global108799
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful resort and great staff. Spa was fantastic and restaurants were good as well. Special thank you to Edgar for the fantastic tour! The activities were good but sometimes too short. The more popular ones should definitely be extended. Looking forward to coming here again!

reviews.author: ironfist2015
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun isn't just a hotel, it is a family of some tremendous people!
reviews.text:
We were able to become "family" at this hotel for a week this July, right before returning to school.  Every dream we had was fulfilled and the people of Paradisus Cancun were able to even do some things for us that we had not thought possible!  
Before arriving, Maria de los Reyes, Family Concierge Manager, emailed us a preference form to fill out so they could get to know us.  When we arrived, we quickly checked in through Family Concierge.  When walking in to the hotel and into our room, it is just breathtaking!  That evening, we met our family concierge for the week, Gabriel.  He was phenomenal and even helped us with a few details we had not thought about for our trip!   
We ate at a different restaurant each evening, but I have to say Mole was our absolute favorite!  The manager, Daniel, is so delightful, thoughtful, and truly cares about your experience!  It was so good, we had to go back two different evenings.  The mariachi playing periodically throughout the night was a great treat and both nights, our waiters, Leonardo and Angel, were just spectacular!  Wonderful personalities, very attentive, the food was incredible!!!  We also had lunch one day at Blue Agave, Daniel is the manager at that restaurant too and Angel was working again.  Again, absolutely yummy food!!!
Finally, the majority of our time was spent at the beach or at the pool.  We had a Bali bed each day that our family could use as a launching point for the kids.  Armando and Manuel were our pool concierge the majority of our time there.  They were top notch!  Not only did they help us, but we got to know them, about what they like to do in their free time, and just what kind people they were.  Paradisus Cancun has a beautiful stretch of beach as well as life guards, so you feel extremely safe and relaxed!  
Finally, one of the neatest part of our trips, was being able to meet Elizabeth, the hotel's biologist, and getting to talk to her about Melia's Baby Sea Turtle Program.  That is something I never in a million years would have expected, but was able to fulfill my dream of seeing a baby sea turtle!  It made me even more proud of Melia and the way they not only care for their employee's, but that they care for animals/sea life as well.  
Our trip to Paradisus Cancun is something our family will not soon forget and would love to repeat in the future!  This hotel is absolutely stunning, but the people working at this hotel are what make it such a paradise.  Keep up the amazing work!!

reviews.author: Carol A
reviews.title: Miss it already!
reviews.text: I can't wait to come back.... Immaculate and the staff wait on you hand and foot and enjoy doing it!! The view of the Caribbean Sea are amazing! The sea is very rough but lifeguards are very attentive! Definitely pay attention to the color of the flags!!

reviews.author: mohammedmJ8032JL
reviews.title: Amazing experience at Paradisus
reviews.text: Very nice hotel. We had an amazing trip. The hotel is located right by the water. Definitely recommend this hotel. We were greeted by very friendly employees, and once we chexked in they called to check we needed anything else. The food choices at the restaurants were amazing, and especially at Naoas!

reviews.author: vickio853
reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text: Beautiful property , clean hotel, clean pools, friendly and very helpful staff, great food and alcohol variety. I would suggest making drink menus with a variety of cocktails for guests to try something new

reviews.author: Farnoosh M
reviews.title: Beautiful, long check in lines
reviews.text:
Resort is beautiful! Great access to the beach. Long check in lines. Rooms are nice most with a beautiful view. Not all the guests are all inclusive so you may not take any food or snack out of the restaurants. Friendly staff. They try to sell you time share, so if you don't want it don't fall for 3 free nights (those free nights will not be all inclusive). 

Water was pretty wavy but fun for us. Beach was sandy and not many rocks.

reviews.author: fmnouri
reviews.title: Enjoyed our stay! Check in had a long line most of the time.
reviews.text:
The resort is very nice inside, gives you a feel of being in a rain forest. Most rooms either have ocean view or lagoon view. Access to beach is very convenient. We stayed the last weekend of July and the waves were very strong.

They could definitely IMPROVE the CHECK IN PROCESS. Most hotels/resorts greet and check you in their open lobby. Here, they send you to a crowded check in room. There was a big line every time we passed by the check in area. 

They take a mix of all inclusive guests and non-all inclusive (time share, etc.) guests. This made the feel of going to restaurants a bit different than all other all inclusive resorts we have been to. One time we wanted to take a couple of muffins out of their breakfast restaurant for our daughter to go take professional pictures, we were stopped by their security telling us we can not take any food outside the restaurant. We have never experienced anything like this in any all inclusive resort and we have been to many.

reviews.author: Pam A
reviews.title: Mostly good but needs improvement
reviews.text:
The Paradisus started off in the wrong foot, but redeemed itself with all it had to offer. 
THE GOOD: The staff. They work tirelessly to keep the hotel clean and everyone served. The rooms-spacious and comfortable, cleaned two to three times a day and my room had turn down service with chocolates placed on my pillows. Room service and requests were fast and efficient. Kudos to the housekeeping department here. They deserve an award!!! The fourth tower is nice and quiet. The bathrooms had huge bath sheets (think restoration hardware) and plenty of terry mugler toiletries. The shower had an ample deep tub with an over head rain shower and a side hand held one, good water pressure too. The toilet had both a urinal and a commode and a privacy door. The grounds-are beautifully kept and service at the restaurants is excellent. 
The food-Good in the market argentinian meats, the sushi (try the black tea ice cream) and fuego (try the salmon ceviche). 

THE BAD: check in is a long and tedious chore that leaves a bad aftertaste for the rest of your stay. My room wasn't ready and I was told to come back two hours later at 3. I went back at 3:10 and waited for 20 minutes in line and no one could give me a key to my rooms. Sandy in the front desk rudely sent me back to the check in desk and didn't apologize for making me run back and forth asking for my room key. Why can't they have one desk for everything? I booked two rooms but only got one and was told the other room was dirty so someone would go to my room and give me the key. No one ever went. I finally had to go and complain at the check in desk and they gave me two clean rooms immediately. Check out was annoying too. I was charged $85 pesos for a local 3 minute call to my shuttle company. 
The food- the buffet at naos was only good at breakfast. The rest was hit and miss. 
The pools- huge and clean. Towel service doesn't require a card or have strict return policies which is great. 
The bars- I only went to the Michael Jackson show and the huge crowds constricted their performance. They don't have enough sitting for everyone and the dance floor/stage is small. 
The pool- all chairs were taken even in early morning. I was told by the waiter to just rent a Bali bed but when i tried to I was sent to the ugly ones on the back and was told the ocean view ones were reserved for club members. Then they sent me down to the beach and was told the same thing and to come back tomorrow because club members have priority. So, if you're not a melia club member get used to placing ur towel on the grass as I did. 
The service was not as good as other cancun hotels I've stayed in. There was just way to many patrons and the staff couldn't keep up. I always tipped well but wasn't too impressed. I rarely was offered anything at the pool and never got offered anything at the beach. 
TIPS:  carry a multi port charger for all your devices. There's hardly any outlets in the room. 
Protect your cell phone with a water proof case. 
Check in after 4 p.m. and avoid the annoying lines. Be patient. Their check in process is unlike any other hotel. Horrible system. They send you to one desk for checking in and to another desk on the opposite side of the lobby for your key...if it's ready. 
TIP your waiter. Take some tip dollars. Even though tips are included I noticed some people were treated better than others. 
Take comfortable non slip shoes. The floors get slippery with water. I had croc sandals that worked wonders. 
Use the kids club. The children love it. 
DO NOT USE their phone! Or be aware you'll incur charges upon check out and further delay the check out process. 
Be aware that they make carbon copies of your credit card as in the old days. They also make copies of your passport. 

Hope this review helps anyone visiting this hotel. Enjoy and have fun!

reviews.author: j0ag0m
reviews.title: Great All-inclusive!!
reviews.text:
Wonderful experience for a family vacation.  Very responsive and friendly staff.  Clean rooms.  Wonderful food and activities.  
People really go out of their way to make you feel welcome
Will definitely come back one day (soon!).

reviews.author: Kathy B
reviews.title: Won't come back
reviews.text:
Started out just ok.  Check in ok for family plan. Made it sound like a fab upgrade with 550$ in hotel credit.  It was a coupn book. It was one fiasco aft another. I had no electric the first night during the night.  The safe was broken.  No hot water. They did fix electric and safe (which they told me I didn't know how to use it).  Safe was broken. The best is the hot water. They basically told me I was crazy. There was hot water. Ok. I took another shower, cold again, etc etc.  kept making  excuses.  Finally sent someone again and there was a broken valve.  My room was dirty, never supplied with proper amenities. 
I didn't expect to be waited on hand foot but we did have a family butler.  The room never had enough towels, etc., had to keep calling.  Just an FYI:  they give day passes to locals.  Not a good situation.  Tabititha was fabulous from the pool and food manager.  Family concierge mgr did try her best.  
Probably will not go back.

reviews.author: chip80
reviews.title: Beautiful Vacation
reviews.text:
We visited Paradisus Cancun in mid July. We found the service to be outstanding. No we did not opt for Royal Service  and still thought the service was great! Some standout employees were Gibran at the lobby bar who entertained us while he made our drinks. Always added a little flare and style. Christian in the Noas restaurant was our server for breakfast. Although it was a buffet he went above and beyond to provide exceptional service. 

The Beach

The beach was beautiful. Water was crystal clear with breaking waves and endless shades of blue. The thatched huts were great for shade and the tables around them very convenient. Drink service was very good. Loved  the ice buckets with bottled water.
The huts are taken quite early. iIf you are not there by 8am chances are they will not be available.

The Pool

The pool was large and sprawling. The pool bar had awesome drinks. The beer was surprisingly very cold! Again excellent service. The bar tenders really hustled and always had a smile on there face. The only negative thing I would say about the pool is it is really deep. (5' 9") no shallow end at all.Others in our party complained that the water was too warm and not refreshing but this did not bother me.I liked it warm.

Rooms

The rooms were clean and spacious.The beds were comfortable. AC worked well.We were on the ground floor near the spa and it was very quiet. We did not hear a thing! The bathroom was spacious. Water was hot with good pressure. The ledge to the tub was exorbitantly high. I know that sounds strange but it was mid thigh (I am 5"2") I kept thinking my parents would not be able to bathe!

Restaurants

The food quality was good. We enjoyed all of our meals. Some of the sit down restaurants served your meals family style. This was a great way to try a lot of different things on the menu.  I made our reservations around 8am  the morning before and I never had a problem getting a table.

Bars

Bartenders worked hard. Some bars were very crowded but it never took long to get a drink. If there is a particular brand of alcohol you like just ask. If it is available they will give it to you otherwise you will get the house brand.

The evening entertainment was weak. The venue too small and too hot. We usually skipped this.

Overall it was a fantastic trip!  I would highly recommend this resort and would love to return.

reviews.author: Mary
reviews.title: Amazing & beyond our expectations!
reviews.text:
Been wanting to experience an all-inclusive for the first time, and Paradisus Cancun happened to be our chosen resort. NO REGRETS. Went here on July 11-15, and unfwe wished we could have stayed longer! 

The staff at the resort are EXTREMELY welcoming and accommodating. No matter what corner you turn, there will always be someone there to assist you. Super friendly and helped in any way they could. 

The rooms were super spacious! My best friend and I shared a Junior suite lagoon view. And although we did not have ocean view, the room itself was amazing! We had a living room space with couches and a mini fridge that was constantly being refilled. Two washrooms with a shower in each, two balconies, a closet full of essentials and of course, our beds (in a separate room) that were super comfy, and always made done by the amazing staff- Thank you!! We also had AC that was either monitored from the living room or our bedroom. Wifi was also great in the rooms, not so much in the lobby though.

The beach is clean and well maintained. The only down part was that we went on a week where the waves were horrible, however that is aside from Paradisus' fault. There are many beach chairs and huts to lay under. There are always always always staff on the beach giving refreshments. The pools were great as well! However we wished that the pool bar was kept for adults only. We felt uncomfortable drinking in front of young children. 

As for food, they did not disappoint! We attempted to try all the restaurants, but our days fell short so we only had the chance to try out a few - Bana,  La Palapa, Blue Agave, Naos, Market Grill. They were all so amazing and the variety they served was outstanding! As for the drinks, they served a great selection! Don Julio definitely was our drink during our stay. They also made amazing cocktails and made great recommendations when it came to drinks. 

Special mentions to Jose and Jorge from La Palapa who made our dinner extra special. They not only ensured a well delivered meal, but they also entertained us well making our dinner extra special. Their hospitality, kindness and charisma is greatly appreciated! 

Overall, this resort was amazing! I had very little expectations as it was our first all-inclusive. However this resort definitely gave us high standards and we will 100% be coming back. Pictures really don't do this resort justice! Must see this resort in person!! 

Thank you very much to the staff of Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: terrib910
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: The Royal Service option is a must !  Our butler, Antonio, was exceptional.  Always pleasant, always accommodating and always professional...genuinely great guy.  Our second stay at this resort because of the staff in the Royal Service area.  The pool staff and waiters were fantastic.  Paradisus Cancun Royal Service is never a disappointment and we will be back for a third stay!

reviews.author: Raj B
reviews.title: A Royal Class All Inclusive Experience!
reviews.text:
A royal experience! We stayed at the Royal Service (upgraded) where we had a private check-in and was assigned a very hospitable butler, Gerado. He attended to our every needs and was at our disposal. With the cell phone we were given, he answered every call and every accommodation. The Royal service section was bit of a hike from the central action, however after the 3rd day we discovered the shortcuts. The resort grounds are well kept, and the staff are so welcoming! Room service was faster than Chinese-food delivery! 

Our favorite restaurant was La Palapa! It was so beautiful, overlooking the turquoise waters and outdoors. Special thank you to RICARDO, OCTAVIO, & EDDIE from La Palapa and the Royal Service pool! They were remarkable! Our cabana service every day was so ROYAL! All the restaurants on the property were fantastic, but this one was just our favorite. 

Paradisus has really made a statement defining luxury at this resort. We previously stayed at Sandals Beaches before and must say, Paradisus far surpasses our expectations! Perhaps Sandals should take notes! Won't change our minds, we will continue to vacation at Paradisus resorts!

We did the tour to Chichen Itza Maya Temples, Jungle Tour with Speed Boats, and took the bus downtown for souvenirs, nightlife and Coco Bongo! All booked from the convenience of the hotel representatives always onsite. Totally safe, and only $1 USD per passenger. Don't take taxi's, they can be unsafe at times going downtown and around.

Overall, it was a 5-star experience!

reviews.author: Rakesh P
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, Great Employees
reviews.text: This resort is stunning- however the rooms need work/update and the food is served cold even in the buffet style, certain things were delicious but our food was not enjoyable cold. Our family owns restaurants and know that if food is served room temperature during buffet it allows food longevity- however it's not enjoyable. Perhaps a new method for feeding the masses and maintaining food quality would be best.

reviews.author: ms_knelson
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We stayed 4 nights in the Royal Service. The atmosphere was peaceful and serene. The service was excellent and all staff was very welcoming and friendly and ready to meet our every need. Would stay again!

reviews.author: Stephane G
reviews.title: No AC on July lobby.. it so hot..
reviews.text: I stay with some friends over 3 nights. Place is amazing when you arrive you don't notes there is not AC inside just on in close areas like the main waiting check in, and then some restaurants not all have Ac running so if you are the persons that needs AC all times don't Stay here they have fans stands around for air flow on the sushi restaurant is amazing because the plants hanging in the middle.. Ac on rooms can't be ajust is set. Also we have a problem with a guy that works there, he ask me what room I was staying the First night we arrive and he have other rooms numbers  on a notebook he asked what we like and what we didn't, I just wake up in the middle of the night and saw him standing there.. I wake up the next morning and check the door the door wasn't locked we forgot to looked, I asked my friends is they saw someone here last night, next night we make sure was lock, when I leave i make sure they knew about it at the front desk... so lock you door also if you stay here.. specially if you come with  young kids. I won't stay here again. Sorry.. also they have a bar where you have to buy a shisha or buy a bottle to sit there.. so we were thinking we can enjoy the place we already paid all inclusive. :(. Good things beds are very clean and comfortable, sushi resturant with reservation excellent food and service and music at night. That's what most enjoyable thing about the place. The pool is ok but not the best. The beach is clean but you can sit outside with out paying.. so ...

reviews.author: murphguard
reviews.title: Nice all inclusive
reviews.text:
Went on a boys trip with my cousin to Cancun.
The resort was beautiful and clean. The beach was larger than the properties near Paradisus. The sand was clean, white and powdery.
There were multiple pools that were kept clean.
This resort is great for families and couples. This was boys trip and there were not that many single young women at the resort. However, the nightlife strip was a bus ride away which made up for the lack of single people. 

The entertainment at the pool was slow for three days and then picked up the last days of our trip. We spent most of our time at the main pool bar (Rodger was a great bartender). Our favorite poolside waitress was Asuncion, she was fantastic.

After a checking inn incident we were upgraded to a ocean front view room. I will never book a room without ocean view again. The view was breathtaking. The room was not very cool and the ac seemed to have mildew around the edge- but it was no big deal since we only slept in the room. The room had a mini fridge with beer, water, soda, juices and three snacks. 

Blue Agave was our favorite spot to eat, Carlos was our favorite waiter here. The food all around the resort was average nothing special. 

We made friends and hung out with them at the pool bar and Coco's beach bar the whole trip. The entertainment in the Red Lounge and at the Main Pool can be improved by being more modern and lively. 

Overall, this is a beautiful and large resort. We would definitely come back.

reviews.author: ngcho627
reviews.title: Royal Service at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
3 nights 4 days at Paradisus Cancun, we had a ocean front 1 king suite and upgraded to Royal Service.  Royal service was amazing.  

Personal butler - makes all reservations (dinner, bali beds, spa, car service)
We received 4 complimentary bottles of liquor or wine during our stay (2 bottles of tequila, 1 bottle of rum and 1 bottle of red wine)
La Pallapa was amazing - right on the beach with great service, drinks and food 
*ask for the green habanero hot sauce*
Exclusive pool - quiet and relaxing not crowded
But we also had access to the other pools - music, swim up bar but tons of kids
Beach - waiters came by took drink and food orders - we ordered buckets of beers filled with ice and they will come by with more ice to keep your beers cold
Royal Service lounge - full bar and serves breakfast/lunch and dinner - small bites
check in/check out - super easy and fast. greeted us with glasses of champagne while we checked in

Restaurants:
Bana - don't eat the salmon - tastes and smells funny
butter fish, calamari, edamame were very good
very dark, they give you a mini flash light to see the menu, try to get seat near the bar in the middle. great service
Enzo - thai/asian food. it's decent, the welcome cocktail was good, nice view of the ocean with breeze, the pork wraps, thai chicken wings and fried rice was good. great service
Blue Agave - tequila and taco bar - margaritas on point, the quesadillas and tacos are good, chorizo wasn't that great
Marketplace - brazilian steakhouse - the lobster was good, not many choice for red meat, sausage and chicken thighs were good as well. great service
Naos - food was okay, the egg station takes forever, good variety
Pool - the wings are amazing, as well as the chicken and green rice
La Pallapa - great kobe burger, the grilled shrimp with thai sauce and quesadillas all amazing
