Bar - drinks were all good and strong. my favorite was the kali kali (not sure of how to spell it) but its this blue drink with frozen lemonade on top
they dont have coronas at all - only have tecate and dos equis

I read so many horror stories about the rooms not having ac and certain things not working.  But we didn't have any issues.  Our room was in pyramid 5 since we upgraded to Royal Service.  Pyramid 4 smells funny and is very humid.  Most of the hotel in general in common space is hot and humid.  I don't think they have AC and in Pyramid 5 I think they turn the AC off at night.
The mini bar is always stocked to the rim and we always had clean towels and our bed was nice and comfy.  We told them it was our anniversary so we had rose petals in shapes of hearts all over our bed.

Nothing really bad to say about Paradisus, overall it was a very relaxing mini vacation. The beach is beautiful (minus all the seaweed) and it was nice and sunny with a few rain showers at night but besides that it was wonderful.  Surprisingly there were no mosquitos.  Already planning another trip to Paradisus next year.

reviews.author: gilbop
reviews.title: Not What We Had Hoped
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed at the Paradisus from July 4 – 11.  Unfortunately, the weather was quite hot and very humid, which limited our beach activities, leaving us to the hotel and its amenities.  I had hoped to return to write a glowing review of what initially appeared, by other Trip Advisor reviews, to be a perfect oasis.  It was far from it, unfortunately.
We had upgraded to the Royal Service, which entitled us to a “personal butler”, who was to attend to our needs and make all of our dinner reservations.  This was a HUGE failure.  Our butler, Cesar, never once got our reservations correct, never saw to it that our room was prepared correctly, and was Missing in Action for most of the vacation.  Hardly worth the $$$ upgrade.  On our first day, I left a tip for Housekeeping on the bed.  When we returned to our room at 3:30 p.m., the room had still not been made up and the money was gone.  I reported immediately to the Royal Service front desk, who contacted Security.  Security came and spoke to us and said they would return in five minutes to ask us additional questions.  After waiting for a half hour, we returned to the room and, after 6 more days, were never contacted.  
The hotel itself is very large and difficult to navigate, but the views were quite spectacular and it was very clean.  The rooms were large and the bed was quite comfortable. The highlights of the trip were the wait staff who went above and beyond to make our stay enjoyable.  Special praise to Marco in the Naos Restaurant, who greeted us warmly by name every morning and saw to all of our needs; to Daniel, the manager in the Mole Restaurant, who took over our dinner reservation issues from our “butler”, fixing a variety of errors, treating us warmly and respectfully, and providing the best food of any of the restaurants.  Manuel from the Swim-Up Bar made the best Cadillac Margaritas!
(There is no logic whatsoever for having the Swim-Up Bar in the Family Pool and not in the Adult Pool.  Little children took up the majority of bar stools.  The adults were drinking, cavorting, and swearing around the children and the kids were splashing all over everyone trying to relax and enjoy an adult beverage.)
We have been to Cancun at least 8 times, staying at a variety of hotels.  We are least likely to return to this one.

reviews.author: ellinks2016
reviews.title: wonderul place, wonderful time
reviews.text:
Just got back and the only thing wrong was that it was only 3 days!  would have stayed another week, easily.  great service, we were in the preferred area so an extra pool, breakfast and snack area, and gorgeous room.  High praise all around.
Ellen Linkletter

reviews.author: Kevin V
reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.text: We went with family.  The beaches and pools were outstanding and the food was plentiful.  All-inclusive lacks the night shows and variety of entertainment that a cruise offers but it was an enjoyable experience nonetheless.  Very affordable too!

reviews.author: PadrePio22
reviews.title: A Very Good, All-Inclusive Option Near Everything
reviews.text:
I had a recent 4 day stay at Paradisus Cancun through a timeshare exchange and overall had a very good experience. A number of pros, a few cons overall and would stay again.

Check in - I was skeptical from the start after they couldn't find my name at check in and stated I should've received an email from a concierge assigned to my party, which I never received. I was directed however to a part of the hotel that I am assuming may be reserved for people on exchanges opposed to standard guests. Check in was easy. We were early and the room wasn't ready, however they did direct us to a "hospitality room" where we were able to change and begin to enjoy the resort. The place is HUGE and if I had one criticism its that they spend very little time at check in explaining everything about the resort (general location of amenities, how to get beach towels, recommendations on making reservations, options to eat, etc.). I had most of these things down pat by Day 3, but by then my stay was almost over. 

Room - Spacious, similar to a small apartment. Very clean. Some very minor repairs either needed or the ones that were made not necessarily that of the highest quality. In their defense, like I said the place is HUGE and I can only imagine its a herculean undertaking the maintain this place. Mini bar in the room that's included in your all-inclusive is a nice touch as well as the jet tub our on the patio area. FYI - Tried to call out to the airline and was told there's a charge to activate the phone for outside calls. Big bummer.

Beach - Kept very clean with only a random trace of garbage. TIP: No matter how much you love the sun, find yourself an available tiki umbrella and make yourself home. The sun is HOT, and you'll need it. There are waiters/waitresses who work the beach all day. Show some love and tip them. Keep asking for a bucket of ice, bottled water, and beers to save yourself to have to keep asking for more. They'll be happy to replenish your ice even if not finished.  

Pool - Usually more packed than the beach, and noisier to boot. If you're looking for quiet, stick to the beach. 

Food - Overall the quality was good. Optioned the buffet more than anything as its quick, easy, and most of the food tasty. Blue Agave is an often less packed option for a nice change. Outside grill is perfect for burgers, wings, hot dogs to bring poolsod or down to the beach. TIP: Be prepared to make dinner reservations ahead, otherwise you may miss out. They fill up quick. Did get to eat at Market Grill, very good rodizio style restaurant.

Location - Perfect location if you ask me. 20 minutes to the airport, 20 minute taxi ride or $1 bus ride to Party City or Playa Tortuga to take the ferry to Isla Mujeres. 

Staff - Welcoming and entertaining, most wanting to do whatever to make sure you're pleased. They genuinely seem happy to interact with guests and love to tell you about their culture, teach you Spanish, make recommendations about things to do and see. I purposely came with a small stack of ones and fives to tip when appropriate. 

Other amenities - Didn't try the spa, but there seemed to be a sizeable number of menu options. The gym is small, but a nice variety of equipment. Concierge service did seem to do whatever they could to help and keep you satisfied. They do try to sell you on becoming a Club Melia member, but is a soft sales pitch from staff and you are never obligated to attend any type of presentation unless you're interested.

Overall, this place was a good value. Would take a lot to bring it to a "5", but definitely a "4" and would happy to recommend or go there again.

reviews.author: Ignacio Orellana
reviews.title: NAOS
reviews.text: I have to say that I had an amazing week in Paradisus Cancún, everything is perfect... but one of the highest parts of the resort was NAOS, just amazing food, great personal, what a nice place & one of the waiters was incredible!! His name was Moises Narvaez, he always been there for us, everything we need he got it, even when I couldn't find a pizza he went for it haha, he makes us laugh so hard in the buffet, I just feel that we went very special for him as much as he went for us, he's an amazing person, actually we feel like we miss him haha, I hope to see him again next year! it would be amazing! thanks for everything!

reviews.author: Kevin P
reviews.title: July 22-30, 2016
reviews.text:
Our second time staying at this property.  Clean and good service. I think the value is average.
August is a tough month to be in Cancun. High humidity and with an open air resort, hard to get away from the humidity.
We went in March and it was much better.

reviews.author: Annie E
reviews.title: Amazing vacation
reviews.text:
This was a spectacular stay. The resort is pristine- so clean. The staff was wonderful, everyone was so kind. Very safe environment. Family resort- not many crazy, partiers even during spring break. Room service was quick and on top of things. The room was clean, always, and very spacious. you get a BANG for your buck.

The beach was huge and clean. not noisy. fresh towels and bar service provided. I relaxed there every day. crystal clear blue water; no seaweed

The food was generally good. The Asian cuisine restaurant in the center of the resort is great. the buffet is great. The Brazilian/Argentinian steak how was great. "Mole" was great. 
However, Vento was not impressive, actually the food was pretty bad :/ Additionally, their beach side bar food was not great. But that's the only negative thing I can say about my whole stay.

reviews.author: S9937ESandrewf
reviews.title: Royal Service Is The Way To Go!
reviews.text: Thank you to the entire staff at the Royal Service side of the hotel.  2nd time staying at the hotel and it was even better than the previous year.  Every individual went out of their way to make sure that we were happy and always asked if there was anything else they could do for us.

reviews.author: Alma R
reviews.title: great time spent here until out last day
reviews.text:
This resort is beautiful, well maintained and has staff that provide great service. Venancio at la palapa was an amazing server, Ivan our butler really took care of use and at the royal service pool Ramon and Victor made sure we had everything we needed. As other reviews I have read online before going on our trip sometimes we were made to feel as though our kindness was being taken advantage of. We left generous tips and the first couple of days we felt as though the other guests that did not speak Spanish or were really foreign were getting better service.  I guess its a hit or miss. Our last day I forgot a valuable electronic and called the resort to maybe have them send it to me because I was already at the airport. They informed me that the electronic was no where to be found... Things can be replaced but I did not expect this from a resort like paradisus. Had I had a doubt that I misplaced the item in another place I wouldnt leave a negative review but I can say I have no doubt. 
All in all its a nice place, get the royal service but now you know DONT FORGET ANYTHING THERE

reviews.author: Robert B
reviews.title: Greatest Place to Relax
reviews.text: If you want a place to escape with that special someone, this is it.  Make your Reservation as Premium Junior Suite, Ocean View.   There is a Family Section also, that is also great.   You can see all inclusive with the hotel.  We went through Travel Agent, she found it.  All Inclusive is Everything including Liquor and Alcohol and Gratuity.  Only Two Restaurants are extra costs.  As a Premium Guest you get a Wrest Band that allows you access to the Entire Resort, but only bands get you into the Premium Pyramid.  You get a Personal Butler (Ours was Gerardo, 1-10 (10 being GREAT), he was a 12.  Asked my wife and I what was occasion for our trip (10 yr Anniv) and made our Dinner Reservations for every night we were there in addition to arranging our return transportation to the airport and Our Bali Bed at Pool Side (all included).  For a small cost ($40.00 usd), you get a cell phone that is set to call your Butler anytime (within reason).  As a Premium Guest, you have access to a Private Pool with Bali Beds pool side and Waiters to bring you drinks and food including in the pool.  A Wait Staff pulls double duty in some parts of the resort, but two (Josue and Ricardo) at the La Palada Restaurant were great, never without a drink and very attentive during meal time and pool side.  This is a Place that my wife and I will attend regularly and will definitely request Gerardo for our Butler and Josue and Ricardo for our pool and restaurant waiters in the Premium Pyramid.........Entire Resort on a 1-10 is by far a 12+......We've never been treated more like royalty than at the Paradisus, Cancun, Mexico.

reviews.author: Asia T
reviews.title: Family Fun in Cancun
reviews.text:
I see why they are highly rated, in terms of service.  They do try very hard.  We booked our room with the Family Concierge, private check-in was cool.  The staff was very VERY sweet to us! If I were to have any "complaints" so to speak, it would have to do with the room and activities. The double room we originally booked didn't fit both me and hubby on the bed at the same time, also we had to special request a pull out and overall the room was just too small for a family of four (kids 7 and 15).  We spent and extra $350 upgrading to a one bedroom suite.  We were moved to a room on the first level, it smelled weird, I'm guessing from the proximity to the ocean?? We asked for it to be cleaned and it was, but it still smelled weird, we toughed it out, wasn't going to move again.  And despite it being ocean view, since we were on the ground level, with the privacy bushes, we lost our ocean view a bit.  I just didn't have the energy to move again.   Also, I was surprised at how little there was to do in the evenings.  Every other beach stay I've ever traveled had tons of beach activities/parties/fun in the evenings and at night.  All of the activities seem to be done on the inside of the resort, but not much to do at night other than eat.  And butler service (lol) we saw a guy one time when we got there. Not sure why they even advertise that or pillow service. Although I did receive a LOT of pillows, they were just all the same.   Food was great, no complaints there.

Pool/Beach - Pools were awesome, the kids side was pretty crowded but if  you have kids that can swim it's big enough never enter the kids side.  Also, there just are NOT enough chairs around the pools and on the beach or towels for the guests.  You do have to kinda stalk your seats early in the day, I wouldn't not go so far as to say 7 am, but definitely by 10-11 am.  Beach looked fantastic, but mother nature stinks, there was so much seaweed you couldn't really get past it to get into the ocean water.  HOwever, I do have GREAT pictures.  

Overall, really nice people, really great staff but I'm sure next time I'd return.

reviews.author: Purin313
reviews.title: Great resort, Great Staff, Excellent Service
reviews.text:
We just came back from a 6 days 5 nights stay at Paradisus.  We initially only paid for the Lagoon view room but decided to upgrade it to the Ocean View room with Royal Service.  We stayed at pyramid 5 (adults only) which overlook the beach and the ocean.  

Room:  We got the ocean view luxury suite.  Unlike some newer hotels, our room was big.  Even we laid our 2 luggages on floor, we still have plenty of room to walk around.  One thing to note is this hotel is not a new hotel.  But they have gone through renovations so overall it's quite clean and modern inside out.  

Restaurants:  Excellent.  All the specialty restaurants are great.  Even at Naos (buffet) you get a ton of choices.  They especially have great seafood choices (we really enjoyed the grilled calamari and scallops).  

I would like to spend some time to elaborate on the Royal Service.  

At the beginning we were quite hesitant about spending the extra money upgrading to the Royal Service.  But once we have it we really think it totally worth the money.  First you get an assigned butler (ours is Antonio, or Tony).  When we arrived we were told the room was not yet available, so Antonio brought us to La Palapa which was the little open kitchen restaurant by the beach (exclusive for Royal Service) and recommended that we had lunch there first so by the time we were done the room would be ready.  Since we were totally newbees at this resort, he had even made reservations for dinner on that night as well (as all specialty restaurants require reservations a day in advance).  With Royal Service we also get 2 days of guaranteed bali beds (the rest of the days are on first come, first serve basis), all free of charge (whereas for non Royal Service you have to pay $80/day I believe to reserve the bali bed).  In my experience, as long as you make the reservation at the pool concierge a day in advance, they should have it available for you the next day.  Antonio is always around pyramid 5 and whenever we bumped into each other he always asked if we had any questions or needed any assistance.  He even left us a bottle of champagne and red wine with a thank you note in our room as well.  I don't know if you can request a specific butler, but if you can Antonio is definitely my choice!

reviews.author: Dania M
reviews.title: Awesome vacation
reviews.text: I visited this hotel 12 years ago and I loved it then , now I love it even more . 5 diamonds ! Beautiful and modified to perfection , top all inclusive . Service, appearance , excellent. Awesome bars and nite life , food is amazing . Something for everyone totally recommend it . Not to far from down town Cancun if you want to party all nite !

reviews.author: KatieMBflo
reviews.title: Great resort lacking almost nothing!
reviews.text:
I loved Paradisus!  My family of 4 went last week, through using points with RCI so we got some good benefits, such as $30 poolside cabanas (no need to be up at 7am to lay claim to a lounger), discounts on side trips, and more. We were greeted at check in with gummy bears and gumdrops for the kids while we picked a room.  Thanks to Trip Advisor reviews, we knew to ask for a room away from the nightly entertainment so we'd have quiet.  We got a hot tub on our porch but it was 90 and humid and we never used it. We had a mini fridge and kitchenette and the fridge was the only part we used, and they did stock it with beer and pop part way into our stay.  Bathroom has door to toilet to separate from shower/sink area, which is nice. We got a 1 bedroom 'suite', but because the room was separated by opaque glass doors, having the light on, or low noise, in the 'living' area wasn't all that feasible. The fold out couch was a definite negative b/c of the different padding amounts at the top vs. the bottom half--after 2 nights without us complaining the housekeeping put a second memory foam mattress on top of the couch one, and that was much, much better--but I had no idea to ask for such a thing. Everything else about the room was great--4 seat table was nice for the couple times we got room service, which was very prompt, particularly our 6:30 am order so we could meet a bus at 7:15 for a trip.
The hotel itself is well kept, marble floors throughout, the restaurant/lobby area is truly beautiful, and the pool and outside areas are also very well kept.  The kids zone was awesome too--imagine free 'daycare' for your vacation?!  My 6 year olds enjoyed it but due to the language barriers with other kids, at times they didn't love it. Still, they have a schedule of fun things like jewelry making, cookie class, pizza making, playdough, etc.  The people working there (Thanks Marisol!) were awesome too.  They open around 9 or 10 am and are open until 8:45pm.  We were able to schedule couples massages because of this.  They even have a baby club for very young toddlers/babies.
The pool is quite deep--5 feet throughout other than at the swimup bar.  This makes relaxing with kids there more difficult, and there are no lifeguards on duty at the pools.  The staff at the swim up bar are AWESOME!  They whip up kids orders and fruity drinks without blinking an eye despite how much work those are!!  And they never forget your order as they multi task to get it all done.  They mix perfectly too--not too strong and not too weak.  There is shade there so you can really relax.  There is a shallow kids area at the far end of the pool that is around 2 feet deep actually. The water is bath water warm in the pool, but even still with the humidity it's good enough. The ocean is so blue, so amazing. There are cabanas out on the beach as well. It's a deep sandy beach area, but there were a couple days with seaweed right at the shore in the water, and a couple days with more or less none.  It was just gorgeous though.
As for food, we used the buffet for every breakfast but one in the room, and it was always excellent. Eggs/omelets to order, cheeses, cereal, yogurt, mueslix, hard boiled eggs, deli meats, bacon, sausage, and a variety of fresh fruits (at times some weren't sorted well enough like cherries would be rotten in parts, but the cut up fruit was always perfect), as well as more like traditional dinner options with meats and fish.  There was a custom smoothie bar too, variety of juices.  For lunches, plenty of variety and for dinner as well.  For dinner there are themes on different nights. Friday was an amazing seafood night--fresh huge shrimp (not fully shelled, etc. though), snow crab claws, crab legs, scallops and more. Brie, goat cheese, other Mexican cheeses, fresh nuts, prosciutto, lox, even tofu/vegetarian area/options, carved meats, etc.  One night we went to the churiscara type option and that was pretty well done-lamb, turkey, beef, and pork options.  We ate at the outside American style bistro at the pool a few times for lunch too--burgers, wings, dogs, fries, chips, etc. Always guacamole too! It as a good deal of cilantro and lemon or lime juice to it but it's real and fresh and abundant.  
We did not do much with nightlife but the Michael Jackson show was fun briefly to see.  Pharmacy across the street from hotel was convenient when kids got random fevers each. We went on side trips 2 days, one to Tulum/xel-ha and the other to xcaret.  Xel ha was our favorite. Tulum was so hot, muggy, and buggy it was actually unbearable, particularly with only natural bug spray those bugs laugh at.  We abandoned our tour and headed back to the start where I was never so happy to see ice cream and starbucks in my life.  Embarrassed to admit it but that's just the truth!  Xel-ha snorkeling was amazing. Xcaret ok but not too great.  Xel ha had a zip line for the kids over the water that they loved. We did the sting ray encounter there--they are free to come and go and return daily for the food. I liked that. Buffet was eh, ok to get by on. At Xcaret it was more like a zoo and the underground river was truly awesome. Not buggy at all there, tons of shade to keep cool. Buffet was ok, better by a little than Xel ha.  They both have dolphin encounters, which after the Cove and all the publicity it garnered, shocked me at the complete lack of anyone saying a single 'negative' thing about those encounters.  I am sure they are huge money makers but it's definitely sad to me.
We also did the parasailing in front of Paradisus.  We enjoyed it, very professional, nice time!  
All in all I would love to go back and would love to return to this specific resort any time.  I know there is a ton I did not get to see and do and yet I loved it.

reviews.author: aglez23
reviews.title: Awful outdated and hot room
reviews.text:
I recently visited the paradisus cancun with my husband, from the 22-26 of August. We were assigned room 1501.. DO NOT let them give you this room.. Very hot, we even had to request them to change at least the filter. This room looks like it was remodeled at least 15-20 years ago, nothing like the pictures we had seen here or in Expedia. Outdated stained furniture, the TV had a huge water stain, the minibar's door was scratching the floor every time we tried to open it, Etc.. The list can go on and on. The view was nice, and it had a jet tube in the balcony. Bathroom ok. 

As per the overall hotel service I would say five star, high quality drinks... Food ok.

Very upset about the room though.. Should not advertise the rooms you will not provide #paradisuscancun

reviews.author: MAO
reviews.title: Sensational
reviews.text:
Positives: The resort lies across a long stretch of sandy beach with no stones or pebbles and you can comfortably walk bare footed along typical turquoise Caribbean Sea. There are a number of large pools to suit families with children and an adult only section. The all inclusive resort is truly wonderful with food and drinks available throughout the day and at all areas. The staff were very helpful and polite. 
Negatives: The check in process was poor, for a resort of this size you would need more than 3 check in desks, and after a long haul flight you would really wish for an improved reception. The swimming pools are great but despite their size it’s not always easy to get a deck chair with a parasol unless you wake up very early.  Some room amenities were not working and required us calling to fix. Wifi was free which is great but unfortunately frustratingly slow to be of real use other than perhaps accessing your emails.
Overall and despite the negative points which I hope would be addressed soon, we had a wonderful time staying at this resort and we would not hesitate to come back again.

reviews.author: Cindy S
reviews.title: Exceptional Service
reviews.text: Spent 2 weeks in August at Club Melia in Paradisus Cancun and could not have been more pleased.  The property is gorgeous; the pools are amazing and the Kids Club and children's pool area was hopping with many activities.  The food in all the restaurants was far above average. With everything near perfect, the standout feature here is the staff - everywhere on the property! Friendly, helpful, experienced, knowledgeable and just a pleasure to be around.  They gave our niece and her husband an awesome honeymoon experience every day of the week!  While we never had bad service, our standouts were: Kauil and Ignacio in Naos who served us breakfast and lunch most days; Bladimir, our Butler in Club Melia - attentive, creative, a pleasure; Jose, our pool concierge; Leoburdo, Katia & Jose in Vento; Angel in Mole; Caesar & Victor who served us for our dinner on the beach - perfect!  One of our party had an emergency one night during dinner and the Manager of Blue Agave, Lifeguard - Gabriel, Security Mgr-Supervisor  Yoarit  and Mgr Guest Service - Anna Lopez handled everything and us professionally and kindly and stayed with us until the Doctor arrived and sent us to the E.R.  What a comfort they were! And last, but by no means least - our fabulous pool and beach servers - Victor, Ingrid, Letticia, Enrique, Luiz, Ascunsion and Sofo - You made our vacation pampering complete!  And we love Juan and Raul on the front door who are so helpful with our bags, cabs, and directions!  We have been guests here for 12 years and will continue to do so and bring our friends and family.

reviews.author: salinas j
reviews.title: Awesome vacation
reviews.text:
We visited cancun from NY and we stayed at paradisus cancun, gorgeous hotel the rooms we're very nice and clean ,very nice atmosphere delicious food and all of the people that work there are very nice and helpful.
The only downside is that our check in took forever, and the beach has a lot of seaweed. Oh and I almost forgot they gonna try to sale you a timeshare that's really annoying the guy that spoke to us was Arthur he's really nice but after his presentation a girl named Carolina l believe... she's from Colombia... she  took over and she was very annoying and rude trying to get involved into our personal life. Other than that everything was very nice.

reviews.author: Jade P
reviews.title: AMAZING TIME
reviews.text: Three weeks ago I spent four days at this truly AMAZING HOTEL. We booked a hotel and air fare deal which gave us the "ROYAL SERVICE" package. ADVICE: If you plan on attending this hotel with other adults the Royal Service package will be worth your wild! When you arrive, they will seat you in the royal service waiting area. You will have a designated butler; they will help you reserve dinners, and accommodate you in anyway they can. Our Butler, Juan, was truly helpful and so wonderful. The restaurants are amazing. Our room was always restocked daily with beverages of our choice. Thank you Paradisus Cancun Staff for making our stay wonderful. I hope to be back soon!

reviews.author: Luis N
reviews.title: Paradisus just Average
reviews.text:
Be prepared to wake up at 7am to get a beach or pool chair otherwise you will be left to stand around. Hotel music be played outside your room at 7am.Pools are not children friendly. The staff was very friendly and the food was average.
Hotel just average

reviews.author: JuliePrimiani
reviews.title: Amazing Service and Wonderful Atmosphere!
reviews.text: The Paradisus Hotel is amazing! They have very helpful and friendly staff! The staff goes above and beyond their duties always trying to make us laugh and smile! We were a huge group of 11 family members but there was never any problem EVER trying to get a table at any of the restaurants! In the morning we would go to Nanos (the breakfast buffet) and they would seat us almost immediately! There are 2 amazing waiters in that restaurant named Yhoni Gonzalez and Javier Cua Caab who are very attentive and always make us laugh! One morning my dad was really sick and wanted some watermelon but the   buffet was about to close to set up for lunch. But Yhoni and Javier still took us in and gave us watermelon, toast and juice for my dad (: they are amazing servers and they have an amazing memory for names and our drink orders! :P Also, the hotel has amazing amenities! They have a spa, a bunch of restaurants and stores where we purchased stamps and postcards to send to our love ones back home! My family and I especially loved the water aerobics that were held everyday at noon! We really got the best workout with our instructor Maurisio! He was very funny and helped us burn calories so we could enjoy more tequila! :D Overall this hotel provided my family with a wonderful experience and we would definitely come back again! The food and service were beyond extraordinary and we were very happy! :D

reviews.author: B7500SUclaudiad
reviews.title: Our family vacation
reviews.text: This is a very nice place to stay with the family the kids are entertain with various activities and the service is great we had a great experience hope to go back and enjoy for a second time and make sure the kids are there on a Friday so they can experience and see the turtles go to the sea we did not got to see that part.

reviews.author: elchiqui66
reviews.title: Unplanned Vacations at Paradisus CanCun august 20 end august 27 2015
reviews.text: My Husband and I. It was the first time we rented at Paradisus CanCun and was an unforgettable experience. From the girl who clean my room that week , passing to the boys at the Pool Bar. Emmanuel, Juanito , Jose, Emilio, Arjenis, Jeison, and the ones at coco's Bar, Sammy in the area of towels and tours, Then Orlando at the Market Grill every morning he has ready the Expresso for my husband. thanks to all of them our Unplanned Vacation was special

reviews.author: Suzann47
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: We were here August 9 to August 14. This is the most beautiful resort I have been to in Cancun. We had the Royal service which I would recommend that any adults staying here without children should have. We had our own section with pool, bar, restaurant & private beach area. Also, there was always food & a bar inside our own private area & also entertainment. I can't say enough about the staff. They would go out of the way to make sure you got what you wanted. I didn't see any steak at Vento & was going to go to the buffet since I didn't have another dinner reservation so the man in charge called another restaurant that had the steak & made sure we could eat there. We had a Butler, Gauldino (probably spelled wrong) who was so nice & he made our dinner reservations for us. If you have the Royal service you also get to reserve a Bali Bed around the pool or on the beach. I reserved one on the beach 2 days & it was awesome. I could lay there out of the sun & just lay back & watch the ocean, read & take a nap. Staff would bring your drinks to you (they even brought popsicles if you wanted one). Daniel was great in helping you with towels or anything else around the pool area you needed. The bartenders & waiters at the restaurant & bar in the Royal service area are awesome. There were Josue, Omar, Victor, Jorge, Edier, 2 Eddie's, Rafael, Alex, Martin, Sofania & if I forgot someone's name I'm sorry because every single person working at the restaurant & bar are awesome. The drinks were awesome, not watered down at all.  Also, Veuaucio at the bar inside the Royal service area is totally awesome & really makes you feel special. Another great thing about the Royal service is that you don't have to worry about getting a lounge chair on the beach. Normally, we would have to rush out early in the morning at other resorts & save a lounge chair. Some evenings they have Carlos Molnar playing the violin in the restaurant area. The restaurant in the Royal service adult only area is outside with beautiful view of the ocean. Carlos was an excellent violin & orquesta virtual. I could sit on the comfortable sofa or chair watching the ocean waves, cocktail in hand & listening to beautiful music. Ok, now I have to say my complaint. The Avenue Bar is absolutely beautiful & the bartenders Francisco, Ernesto & Carlos are so nice & fun to be around, just loved them. Also, their boss, Simon, was awesome. I talked to him about the nightly entertainment. The shows they had were so good but they need to have a theater for the shows. There is no room to watch them unless you are there extremely early & sit on the 'beds' they have there. There are also kids sitting on the floor & on the hassocks they have. You have to try & see the show standing & if you are not in front watching between other people. I love to see entertainment at night but was really disappointed that I couldn't watch the shows. Thanks to Simon I was able to watch one show. It's not the shows but the fact they do not have a big enough area for the shows or the audience. The shows are awesome if you can watch them. Also, I don't think they should allow children to sit at the bar in the back. Their is also a nightclub with a DJ. Now for the restaurants. My favorite was the Market Grill. They bring out so much great food. I also liked the Mexican restaurant Mole. The restaurant in the Royal Service area La Palapa was very good. The restaurant Vento had a very fancy menu but I could not find anything I wanted to try (octopus, lamb, etc,). It did not have any steak or shrimp. Our room was very clean & beautiful. We had a beautiful ocean view. Besides the entertainment issue I would definitely recommend this place. People have complained about the seaweed & their was seaweed but the beach is so wide you can still walk along the beach. The seaweed was bad anyplace you would go & some people said it was even worse at other places. On our last day the seaweed was gone. You will love this place & its beauty & the service you receive by all the staff!!!

reviews.author: Charlotte H
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: My friend and I went to Cancun as part of her trip to see me in the USA and absolutely loved this hotel. We were treated exceptionally and the food, drinks and service were all fabulous. Big shout out to Omar who was one of the loveliest and funniest members of staff who entertained and looked after us as at the Royal service pool. Also to Orlando who made our breakfasts brilliant. Would hundred percent go again.

reviews.author: Sandra A
reviews.title: Great service beautiful hotel!!
reviews.text: Been many times in Cancun but first time we stayed at this hotel, I am very pleased by the attentiveness of the staff there, everything was very clean and people go out of their way to make you happy, we pay for the Royal service and is TOTALLY worth it!! only once we went into the regular pool since it was full on people and kids, we tried to get a drink at the swim up bar and had to leave without it since we couldn't talk to the bar attender, so we returned to our pool were it was exclusive for those who had the royal service,  our servers, ALBERTH, JOSE ENRIQUEZ, CHIM TUYUB, CESAR LANDA AND VISTOR PEREZ,  the cabana boys ALEX AND OMAR were exceptional!! friendly and always were on top of things, we had our lunch at the Palapa restaurant and CESAR LANDA had my habanero salsas ready for me without asking, the food there was very good however the 'MARKET GRILL" was not, the meat there was tough and chewy, also LETICIA PATLAN was awesome explaining all the benefits and hotel services,  one of the things I want to mentioned is that if you go to this places PLEASE DONT FORGET TO TIP THEM!! they really deserve and earn every dollar you give them.

reviews.author: Kdalfred
reviews.title: Great time at the Paradisus
reviews.text:
I just returned home from Cancun this week. I went in celebration of a friends 50th birthday and there were six of us ladies who stayed at this resort for 5 days.

I found the resort to be clean and orderly the restaurants to be plentiful and the service to be outstanding. My friends and I opted to upgrade to Royal service as we were not going to be doing many excursions.

Personally, I feel Royal Service is a must do if you are on an adults only trip. Having a private pool and private beach which were kid free was fantastic (no offense to those with kids).

Special thanks to our Butler Antonio for making our stay so memorable!! The service he provided was top notch!!

Would definitely stay again!!

reviews.author: Xheladin S
reviews.title: Happy vacation at paradisus cancun July 4 - end 18 July 2015
reviews.text: The best resort in cancun whe had best services  waiter sofania & Oscar vangelis very profesional staff very happy workers paradisus cancun they deserve more !! The management you need restorant in main pool covered it's very hot too have food there that's my small idea

reviews.author: sualpas
reviews.title: My only complaint about our whole stay would be that it was too short!!!!!!
reviews.text: By far one of the best resorts I've been to. They really try to make your stay special! We stayed at a room with an ocean view and we couldn't have been happier with the size and the cleanliness of the room. You would walk out to two huge balconies where you could watch the sunset! The mini bar was always stocked with not only drinks but also snacks. On our first day, we met one of the servers, Gaudencio and he made sure all our needs were taken care of! Later on, if there was something we wanted to eat and we didn't see it on the table, Gaudencio would have the kitchen staff make it for us! All our dinner experiences were also very pleasant, one at the "Vento" and the other one at the "Market Grill". The pool area and the washrooms were always clean and the grounds were well taken care of. All in all, I would definitely recommend this resort without any doubt in my mind!

reviews.author: Jonathan C
reviews.title: Good but far from excellent
reviews.text:
My expectations were high for this resort after staying at Paradisus La Esmeralda but it fell a bit short in my opinion. I'm not saying it was bad, it's actually a good resort but small details are the difference between good and excellent. I stayed 7 nights with my wife and kids (4 and 2) at a junior suite with lagoon view. First thing to notice is that even though the resort looks nice in and out, it is a 20+ years old construction that has been completely renovated to offer the Paradisus experience. There's nothing bad with this, but you can notice here and there some hints of the old hotel, specially in the room which was a noticeable downgrade from the junior suite at La Esmeralda (older furniture, no furniture in balcony, less amenities like iPod dock, scale, bathrobes and slippers, big tub plus big shower). The other big downside was the service which wasn't all bad but far from the excellent service we had at La Esmeralda with some remarkable exceptions: Pablo from Naos and Luis at the pool and other few staff members that really seemed to care and tried their best to make you feel comfortable. The dinning was also inconsistent with our previous experience, although there are basically the same restaurants in both resorts, we found in general a higher quality and an overall better experience at La Esmeralda. No illy coffee bar...what a major disappointment.

Despite my disappointment in the mentioned areas, we still had a great vacation and enjoyed our stay and of course there are positive things too like the stunningly beautiful beach, the warm pool, the amazing sunrises on the beach and beautiful sunsets on the lagoon. Overall it's a nice and beautiful resort but I don't think I would visit it again.

Some tips for travelers:

1. WiFi is not very good, signal is lost constantly. If you are planning on bringing your laptop, bring an Ethernet cable, wired connection in the room is fast enough and consistent.

2. If you travel on peak season prepare to wake up early (by 6 am) to book a hut by the pool/beach, otherwise you won't find a place to sit after 9 am. I really hated this because the hotel has a sign by the pool saying this is prohibited, but they don't seem to care and we sadly learned from day one that this is the way things work there.

3. Tip the staff. Bring plenty of 20s and 50s (Mexican pesos) these bills are made of some kind of plastic which make them waterproof, so you can carry them even in the pool with no worries

Comments for the administration:

When we checked in we commented about our son's birthday during our stay and the lady at the front desk told us she would take note of that to send a present to our room. It didn't happen. Not that I care about the present, but again details are important and a simple call or happy birthday note would have worked. The only message we received is:  "we don't care".

reviews.author: Joshua H
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel - awful food.
reviews.text: I have stayed at Melia hotels for 12 years now. This was my only negative experience. The food at the hotel, specifically the La Perla restaurant, gave me food poisoning. The Melia chain of hotels has always had good food. For some reason, this hotel could not get it right. The only restaurants that were 'safe' to eat and not get sick were Bana and Blue Agave. .

reviews.author: marieannetteh2015
reviews.title: paradisus is the bomb
reviews.text: too many kids in the bar area of the pool,  adults having adult conversations and drinking I don't think kids should be part of that.  separate kids pool area would be nice and the pool was too hot, the weather was very hot and you want to cool off in the pool and can't

reviews.author: Amanda C
reviews.title: Best vacation ever!
reviews.text: First visit to an all inclusive and we want to go back all ready.  The staff were courteous and helpful, the hotel clean and amazing to look at, inside and out., we had fun just walking around.  Royal Service was above our expectations! Our butler was so helpful, asked everyday what he could do FOR us.  Loved the Bali beds!  Service was great, we never had to wait like others said.  Our room was wonderful, although on the bottom floor ocean view, I would ask for a room higher up next time...we had coffee on our deck each morning and workers passed by all each morning, although politely ignoring us I might add.  But it was not ready for us when we got there, and we were given a complimentary room to freshen up in and change from our traveling clothes.   (yes we were early for checkin).  The mini bar was nicely stocked, and although we could not get a bottle of bourbon for my husband, we could get a cup of it from the royal Lounge to bring back to our room .  I did ask for some other beverages that weren't in the mini bar and they appeared that day, and replaced as needed.  All in all a wonderful stay, a heavenly vacation, and looking forward to our next one.

reviews.author: Gemmelee Y
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever
reviews.text: Love love our vacation in Paradissus Cancun; Staffs are great; Especially Mr. Luis Herrera Hernandez; His the best; My 4 year old daughter loves him too! :) Best service, location, services. I would truly recommend this place to all of our friends.

reviews.author: Lisa B
reviews.title: Paradisus is paradise in cancun
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I just came back from our 5 night stay at paradisus and loved every minute of it . We were upgraded to the royal service which made our stay that much more enjoyable.

The royal service pool is the adults only pool which was very relaxing although they do not have a swim up bar, but I heard they will be building one there next month.  At the royal service pool you can reserve a bali bed at no additional charge. The beds are very comfortable and provide nice shade from the cancun sun.

As far as waiters go in the royal pool, Victor was by far the best one.  When he brought us our first drink of the day we tipped him and he treated us like royalty the rest of the day. Moises was also good but Victor was much more attentive. 

In the pool bar the bartenders Emmanuel and manager Simon were awesome. They kept the drinks coming and were very pleasant. We also saw Emmanuel working one night in the Avenue bar. My boyfriend likes his long island ice teas with muddled fruit and when they ran out of oranges Emanuel went searching for them and came back with several and a huge smile on his face.

The pool bar was very nice however kids are allowed in there and were even sitting at the bar stools in the pool. They also were playing right next to the pool bar and constantly splashing pool watee in our drinks. I understand they are kids being kids but I think the hotel should reserve the pool bar for adults only.

At the Avenue bar at night see ernesto. Best bartender in there although Francisco Pancho was very good too. Ernesto was always smiling and happy to be there.  

We will definitely come back to see our favorites at the resort: Victor the waiter in the royal service, Emmanuel in the pool bar and ernesto at the Avenue bar.

Our butler Juan was very accommodating as well. He set up all our dinner reservations and a late check out with a changing room. 

Market grill, the brasilian steakhouse was the best dinner restaurant we tried. The food was so good and the waiters will keep bringing out more food. 

La palapa, the royal service was nice too but had a very limited menu.  The restaurant is high end so the portions are small.  My bf left there still hungry so we went to the buffet, Nao which was always very delicious.  Nice ommlettes made to order for breakfast in Nao.

Blue agave is good too. It's basically a taco bar but the quality of the meat was very good.

Go to Mole, the Mexican restaurant for authentic mexican food.

La perla restaurant was okay but not one of our favorites.

We will definitely come back to this resort and recommend it to my parents who are already looking into booking their stay.

Beware for the club melia presentation.  They are persistent and try their very best to get you to purchase into club melia, their 50 year time share plan.

reviews.author: I8054YHalexa
reviews.title: Nice resort but needs attention to details.
reviews.text:
it was our first visit to this resort. It was highly rated on travel websites. So we had high expectations.
And this is indeed a nice looking resort inside and out. We loved it from the first minute and we still like our vacation there.
There were few areas for improvement. Bed were very uncomfortable with sagging mattresses and stone-hard and smelly pillows. Water wasn't draining properly in the bath tub and hand sink. TV remote was broken and some lights didn't work either.
Food was good overall, although in vary from restaurant to restaurant. From highly rated Fuego restaurant ( I will give it 4 stars), to La Perla ( 1 star will be too much for this one). Buffet restaurant Naos provided tasty food all day long.

reviews.author: Joey W
reviews.title: Service hit and miss.
reviews.text:
We stayed here August 1-10 in the Royal section.  A little about us.  We are a gay couple and this is our second year in Cancun and our 5th overall in the area.  Previous 3 visits were near Akumal.  I only mention our sexual orientation because som elf ten ask about the gay friendliness of the area and resorts and this resort is the first where being gay may have affected service.
Check In & Room
Check in is a bit unorganized if you booked Royal.  We arrived at the main reception and were to wait. After no further explanation and 10 minutes later we spoke to reception and someone finally escorted us to the Royal pyramid for check in.  Uneventful but this has been the first resort we have been to where they held appx $200 US for incidentals.
Our room was on the 6th floor oceanview.  Good size, nicely appointed.  Huge balcony with 2 chairs.  There were also 3 small bottles of liquor.  Should have been 4 but we were told they were out of rum.  A Nespresso machine and well stocked fridge with beers, soda and juices as well as M&Ms.  Bathroom was also well stocked.  Probably best of any hotel or resort I've ever stayed is as the had razors and shaving lotion.
Airconditioning worked very well.
Common Areas
This is a beautiful and unique resort.  Well kept and generally clean. (There was a can of beer that we passed by 3 days in a row on our way to the gym).
The gym is somewhat hidden and not labeled well.  It's across from the spa and the entry looks like you are entering another part of the spa.  Small but well equipped with several treadmills, bikes, weight machines and small stack of free weights.  Good a/c.
While on the topic of a/c, it is severely lacking in the common areas and just bearable in many restaurants. Somewhat understandable due the the pyramid design tho.  
There is also a gift shop but at $39 for a small wooden box and $15 for a pack of cigarettes I would skip it.  (Go across the street to the OXXO if you need anything)
Restaurants
Buffet, ate breakfast there all but one morning.  Omelette station is. Good and there is a smoothie bar as well.  Precooked food is pretty much cold.  Bacon is thin, overcooked and greasy. Not very appetizing.  Lots of meat leftovers.  Same holds true for the few lunches and dinners we ate there.  A lot of fish, some actually good.
Service is hit and miss.  Some staff seem more concerned about socializing.  The good staff are over the top great.
Ate at Bana twice.  Pretty good.  Good service.  There was a singer there both nights.  She was pretty amazing.  Ate once at Mole.  Very small portions. Had the best fish ever there.  Believe it was grilled red snapper with a red sauce.  We had reservations at Fuego but after looking at the menu, skipped it.  Wish we had also skipped Blue Agave.  It's basically a taco joint.  Touted as authentic Mexican complete with stale tasting chips from a bag.  The tacos themselves were edible although not even close to the tacos I get at home from the taco truck.  The quesadillas were actually nauseating.  Not sure about the filling.  It was described as beef stew!  Disgusting.  The Brazillian restaurant was our favorite.  Great meat and sides and the most attentive staff of any of the restaurants we visited. 
Other meals we ate poolside.  Some great wings over on the non Royal section.  Even better wings at Royal section which at first we did not realize as it is not on the menu. Just ask.
Pool and beach
This is where Paradisus really left us with a bad taste.  During our orientation we were told there is a pool concierge who will greet you upon arrival at the pool.  They will find you a lounger and give you your towels.  There are usually 3 people in the towel hut but they do not greet you and barely reciprocate a hello when you ask for a towel.  You can have your butler reserve a Bali Bed at least two times during your stay.  If you do not get a bed you are stuck with 4 loungers in front of the towel hut with no shade.  TIP, if you don't have a reserved Bali Bed ask to be put on the waiting list with the towel hut guys.  If someone does not claim their bed by 11am they will put you in one. We were always able to get one when we did this.  Also there are plenty of loungers and palapas at the beach.
Service. We were at the pool the afternoon of our first day and pretty much the entire time our second day.  While in the pool and sitting poolside, we were never once approached and asked if we wanted something to drink.  However we did observe other couples who were offered buckets of water bottles and drinks. Initially I think we just wrote it off as poor service and the fact we had arrived that afternoon and weren't there very long.  When we continued to be ignored all of day two we began to wonder if it was because we were two males travelling together.  We've never been treated differently in our previous travels to the area or any other area including back home so it was rather strange.  I can't say with 100% certainty this was the reason and have never before felt like this.  We are not demanding and extremely thankful for any service.  We also are very liberal tippers so to this day don't know what it was those two day except maybe...
The second day we spent the morning on a lounger at the beach and again noticed a server asking others what they wanted and ignored us.  
Day 3 we had a Bali bed and everything turned around.  We finally had an amazing server who would even bring another drink to the bed if we were in the pool without us asking.  The remainder of our stay service was hit and miss but we were no longer completely ignored.  On the bright side, the bartender benefited from all of this since most of our tips went to him.  Great service at the bar and he always had our shots and drink choices ready as we walked up.  Kudos as well to one of the bar managers who became a bit angry as my partner was struggling to carry two drinks and two bottle of water down to the beach.  He actually got one of the servers standing around the bar to take the drinks and bring them down along with a bucket of ice and additional waters.
One other negative is the pool water temperature.  It is borderline hot.  I believe I've read that the pool is heated in the winter but it seems the heater is running during summer as well.  The temp was ok in the morning but too warm in the afternoon.  The pool is rather deep so hard to believe it would warm up that much.  There is a small shallow pool hidden to the side and it was much cooler despite only being about two feet deep.  We walked over to the family pools a couple times and it was kinda a madhouse.  I could not imagine staying in that section unless it was during off season.

Overall this is not a bad resort.  It is clean, well maintained and for the most part staff are friendly and accommodating. We were on vacation and enjoyed ourselves. However the situation we experienced our first two days at the pool and one other time after that, soured our impression.  For the right price this would be a great property for many but regardless of price we would not return.

reviews.author: Brenda R
reviews.title: Royal Service at the Paradisus
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I just spent close to a week at the Paradisus in Cancun and it was A-One wonderful.  We were in the Royal Service upgrade and even though we were shifted around a little when we got there, no problem.  The room was very nice, though it was on the bottom floor and I would opt for higher to see the ocean next time.  Our butler Cesar was very helpful, a waiter named Juan Arlos in Mole Restaurant above and being courteous, but actually, all who worked there were exemplarary.  Thoughout the hotel were beautiful flowers, vines...tropical splendor well cared for..delicious food, nice workout room,woderful pool area,etc.  I definitely would recommend this hotel

reviews.author: Elaine R
reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.text: We used the family concierge and couldn't be happier. The staff though very busy took exceptional care of us. We were assigned Hervick as our "majordomo" and he made sure we were well taken care of. The buffet rest was exceptional. For the other rest we had to make reservations and Mole and Vento were among the favorites! The beach and pool were nice, but crowded in the early afternoons. The outside bathrooms needed some attention.  The pool activities were fun! The room was well stocked and impeccable. On the downside, we used the Spa water experience and some of the jets were malfunctioning. Overall I would love to go back.

reviews.author: WorldTraveler552015
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
We were so excited to go to cancun and experience the all inclusive luxury resort as the hotel advertised.  The reviews were stellar and the pictures were beautiful so I booked the hotel for 7 days for the family.  I am sharing my view of the hotel so others won't make the same mistake I did and be mesmerized by all the wonderful reviews.   

Staff: 
They are friendly and hardworking for the most part.  If you tip them, they will remember you and provide you with better quality service.    

Entertainment: 
Very limited and disorganized activities during the day other than drinking at the swim up bar...    The non-motorized sport equipment is on the other side of the road from the hotel in the bay area.  No one was there because the only thing they offered was cheapest looking kayaks.  The nightly half hour show they provide at the Avenue bar is decent but because it's not on a stage, only 10 to 15 people can see the complete show.  Most of us peer through small openings in between people where you saw little bits of the show.   

Pool: 
Their main pool is very large with a swim up bar.  I was excited to plunge into it with my kids. I could not touch the bottom; I am 5'2; I am used to deep pools but there is usually an area where I can touch the bottom comfortably so I can  be anchor to the kids when they need to rest.  Well, this pool had same depth through out the entire pool except the baby area where the water was lower than your waste.  So was I suppose to swim or tread water the entire 4-5 hours we are in the pool?   They had no floating tubes or beds so I had to hold on to the sides when I wasn't swimming.  We did ended up buying a tube at their store which made it better but still not ideal.  If you are 5'10, your face will clear.   I smelled urine everywhere I went in the pool; not sure if they test the pool water regularly...  

Food:
They had many options between multiple restaurants, buffet, and snack bar by the pool.  We tried three restaurants; our favorite was the Mole Mexican, Taco snack (Agave), and the snack bar by the pool.  Buffet was similar to seafood buffet you would get in the states so it met my expectation.  I would stay away from Bana for sushi, worst sushi I have ever tasted.  Drinks are water down but similar to what you would get from any all inclusive resorts.  

Facility:
They just went through major renovation to be eco friendly.  I completely am all for that.  However, when you are vacationing, you don't want to be sweating sitting in a nice restaurant with best clothes on.  It would have been better if they had most of their restaurants outside, at least you get nice ocean breeze.   Night time, hotel is completely dim; at Bana, I couldn't see what I was eating...   I felt like I was in a cheap motel whenever I was in the hall to get to our room because it was so dim.    In our room, the air conditioner noise was constant (not what I was expecting from a luxury hotel).  

Cancun beaches are beautiful but not ideal to swim; large waves and seaweed issue.

For $300 - $500 per day, this hotel completely fails to meet my expectation.  Despite this, my family had a good time which had nothing to do with the hotel.   Xel-ha is a must.

reviews.author: CJYang
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation in the paradise!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun in mid-August for 7 nights, we have been on cruises before, but this was our first all-inclusive on land, and first trip to Mexico.  We traveled as a family of 4 (2 adults, 2 kids, age 10 and 6), and we booked the Family Concierge ocean view junior suite.   

Upon arrival, we were greeted at the door and offered chilled face cloth, and escorted directly into the Family Concierge area for check-in.  Kids were able to start eating, drinking and playing Xbox videos games and pool table in the Family Concierge area while I registered, very nice.  Met our personal concierge Ramon there, we were given a cell phone to call him directly whenever we need him, and also the Family Concierge backpacks, sand buckets/toys and hats/t-shirts, which made the kids very excited.  We were assigned an ocean view room with double beds on the ground floor of Tower 2 close to the Kids Zone; would've loved to be on a higher floor for a better view, but I guess none were available at the time and someone has to stay on the on ground floor :-)  But it turned out to be fine, because the ocean view is still nice, we didn't have to wait for elevators, we were practically next to the Kids Zone which we utilized quite a few times, and we didn't really hear any noise that bothered us.  The room was clean and very spacious (there was plenty of space to put our inflatable bed and tubes for pool), beds were comfortable (although double sized beds were a bit tight for 2 people).  There were 2 loungers on the balcony, but since you can't see over the concrete planters once you sit down, we didn't use them at all.  Our room was kept clean and mini fridge & bottled water restocked by the maid every day, AC was cold enough on its lowest setting.  The resort atrium is beautiful with green plants and coy pond, it felt so refreshing whenever we were walking around in the resort. 

Our personal concierge Ramon was wonderful, he took care of our dinner reservations, booked our spa visits & Bali beds, gave us good information on the resort and also the nearby malls (and directions to get there), and helped us whenever we had question or issue. 

We ended up renting the Bali beds for 2 days (the days we were going to spend full day at the poolside).  These beds are quite nice and comfortable, facing pool and also ocean, and it kept us cool in hot sun; the Bali beds were $50/day but we gladly paid extra for these so that we didn't have to get up early to reserve a chair, as there aren't that many around poolside, especially ones in shade. 

$1500 resort credits sounded good, but it's really only a coupon book.  We used 2 $15 coupons for the Bali bed, 2 $50 off for spa massages, and $10 off for kids spa, for a total of $140. 

We did a full-day excursion to Xel-ha (booked on Internet prior to arrival), and Sky Rider parasailing (purchased onsite through Aqua World), both were really fun and would recommend them. 

We ate all our breakfasts at Naos buffet, we all enjoyed having custom made omelets.  We ate few lunches at Naos and few at the poolside grill.  For dinners, we were able to try all restaurants once – Vento, Bana, Feugo, Blue Agave, Market Grill, La Perla, and Mole.  All meals were tasty, but we especially enjoyed Market Grill (Brazilian steak) and Blue Agave (Mexican).  We received outstanding service from all restaurants and bars (only encountered one unsatisfactory service from our waiter in Vento). 

I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of nightly entertainment, dancing performances by really good professional dancers.  But I will also echo other reviewers in saying that I wish the resort can find a better and more comfortable & spacious venue for the performers and the audience.  The dancers were really energetic & talented but there just wasn't much room to move around and the Avenue Bar couldn't fit many people.  I would also suggest adding more to show variety, as all 7 shows were either dancing or singing.   It would be nice to see a magic show or acrobats.  Avenue Bar hosted Casino nights every few days, and it was fun and enjoyable (kids could also play).
 
Kids club – they offer some fun staff-led activities at certain times, like ceramic painting, cookie making, tie dye bandana, play-doh, etc, but otherwise kids were left to play amongst themselves or play video games.  My 6-YO had lots of fun but my 10-YO said she was bored at times. 

Two things that I have read a lot and had me worried prior to arriving in Paradisus were (1) seaweed and (2) timeshare.  Seaweed – yes, they are still around, some days better than other, but definitely not as bad as some pictures that I have seen on Internet.  My kids didn't like playing on the beach or the sea because of it, so we ended up spending most of our time in the pool area.  It was a negative, but it's mother nature (though we were thankful that it was sunny every day while we were there), and it affects all other hotels north and south of Paradisus.  Timeshare - we actually didn't encounter any, maybe because we missed that phone call the first morning we were there (still sleeping), no one bothered us about it, so it was a non-issue. 

Comparing this Cancun all-inclusive to cruising, the room is way more spacious than staying in a small cabin on cruise ships, and you don't have to pay extra for beverages; and of course you get the big swimming pools and the beach.  On the other hand, the cruise ships have better variety of entertainment and show venues, and the kids activities are better as well.  But all in all, we had a great time, we give high marks and our recommendation to Paradisus Cancun, we will not hesitate to stay here again whenever we return to Cancun!

reviews.author: Patrice A
reviews.title: Don't go if you do not pay extra for Royal Service!
reviews.text:
Me and mi fiancé wanted to try Cancun for the first time and we picked this place based on the beautiful photos. We were not disappointed by the resort itself. The resort was grandiose, and very meticulous. We upgraded our room and we had a jacuzzi on our balcony. 
Our vacation started great until we got kicked off the bali beds which are in every picture on their website, and they cost $100 a day to rent….By the way, very few people ever rented them, majority of the time they were empty, which was a disappointment because I just wanted to use them for maybe 20 minutes in a day. 
And it got worse when we found out that the adult only pool were for "the royal service" so we had to spend our whole time in the main pool with little kids splashing water in our drinks and screaming. Also, half the beach was for the "royal service" which no one was ever sitting in. On the half of the beach we were allowed to sit in, there were never any empty chairs, and people would go before breakfast and leave a towel there to save their seat.
If i knew that the resort was going to be segregated I wouldn't have gone here. We paid for all inclusive, but the "royal service" "club melia" "family concierge" "non- all inclusive"
were all treated better and served first before us. The waiters on the beach and around the pool would serve the non-all inclusive people first because they though they would tip since that wasn't included in their package. SInce the tips were included in our all inclusive package they would serve us last thinking we weren't going to tip.

Our disappointment continued when we went to get lunch right after we got there. We asked to sit outside and we kept waiting for a waiter to come over but no one ever did. There were two waiters walking around ignoring us. This kept happening every time we would go to Naos which was the resorts buffet, Finally on our last couple of days there we finally got to meet two waiters named Luis and Leonardo. We ended up siting in his section the rest of the time, and he treated us very nicely. I would defiantly recommend sitting inside at this buffet if not you will get ignored. The waiters at the restaurants that required a reservation were all great and we would tip them $5 each. 
The pool bar was again slow service, it took forever to get a drink. The problem with this resort is that they seemed understaffed. Most of the time only 2 bartenders were at the pool bar and at one point the other went on break and there was only 1 pool bartender serving 40+ people. 
My last few days there I met a waiter named Erik who was at a side bar. I was happy to get out of the pool and walk to the bar under the palapa restaurant just to have him make my drinks. Having him as a bartender honestly made my miserable vacation so much better.
Don't use the iron they provide!!!!! It burnt directly through my brand new dress!!!!!!
I will surely not return to this resort despite the beautiful property and the delicious gourmet food.

reviews.author: nes56
reviews.title: Worth every cent - and reasonably priced; clean property, fun activities, yummy wide selection of food
reviews.text:
Paradisus exceeded my expectations & I've traveled a decent amount. BIG shout out to Rode - our Royal Service Butler; you are a rock star and made an OK vacation turn into an excellent one. TYVM to Victor - our waiter in building 5/Royal Service - I've never seen anyone work so hard and still keep such a friendly and happy attitude especially in 90+ degree heat. Finally Hugo made aqua aerobics terrific fun !
Paradisus isn't perfect, but they go above and beyond in their quest to achieve perfection. Yes there were some hiccups - nothing major in my opinion. We upgraded to Royal Service (a must if you're travelling without children and want an adults only experience - drinking to your heart's content...) Rode, our butler took care of all of our logistical needs - reserving Bali beds, restaurant reservations, baggage pick ups. THANK YOU. The gym is great, the pools are great - clean and warm (some wanted it cooler but it was fine for me), the food is simply incredible in terms of the selections and quality. The service is fantastic - everyone is very humble and willing to make things as good as they can. 
If you do have kids there's plenty for them to do and free shows nightly in the Avenue Bar. I plan to return as soon as feasible for me. You will definitely get your $$'s worth so indulge in the upgrades as they add another dimension to your vacation. I felt like a pampered princess.
Also they do "clean" the beach but the hotel can't control the ocean so there's seaweed (not a ton) on the beach and in the water - just float past it and you're ok.
My only criticisms are the lack of a ramp to the beach for the handicapped and my family with lagoon views (they didn't tip till the end of the vaca) experienced a shortage of towels - I had a ton but left $2 US every day and came back to a pristine fully stocked suite :-)

reviews.author: Amira L
reviews.title: Truly Royal Service
reviews.text: Paradisus is the most beautiful place I have ever seen or stayed in. We stayed for 6 days and the service was amazing. All employees greeted us with kindness. Our beds turned down nightly with a piece of chocolate left near the pillow. The only true complaints I have is the pools close at 7pm. I thought for sure in the royal area we would have candlelight swims with soft music. That disappointed me a lot especially when u go on excursions and get back late. The fire alarm is over the bed and flashes lights that is very distracting as well. The resort is absolutely gorgeous. I wish I had known we got an hour a day at the spa. We did go on Friday our last day so my next trip I know. I will definitely be back next year.

reviews.author: Jules
reviews.title: 2 night in July 2015
reviews.text:
We moved to this hotel for the last two days of our 2 week holiday as our Hotel was overbooked and they were looking for volunteers to move to Cancun. We decided to go as the beach in Cancun is lovely and not covered in seaweed as our beach in Playa del Carmen was where we were staying. This is only reason we moved. A big mistake 
The hotel is huge, the staff are grumpy apart from the Concierge who was very helpful
Our room was small and the bathroom tiny. 
The swimming pool water was hot so not refreshing at all. The ground was boiling hot so you needed to make sure you always wore your flip flops or you could burn your feet
There were not enough beds round the pool for everyone and both days we were there they had run out of towels
We were not impressed at all by this resort and definately would never go back

reviews.author: bodyfruit
reviews.title: Fifth year in a row coming here and we can't wait for next year already!
reviews.text: I can't believe we have been coming here 5 years and I have never written a review. We absolutely love this place! We always feel so spoiled. We have a timeshare in Cozumel but trade it for a week stay in a 2 bedroom/3 full bath and partial kitchen with living room and 3 balconies with an ocean view unit at the Paradisus because we like it so much better. The grounds are beautiful, the beach is pristine with the water in colors that will leave you speechless. Housekeeping takes wonderful care of us with nightly turn-down service and constant replenishing of toiletries. All the staff is so gracious and polite. Even the in-room coffee is good which I never drink in-room coffee. My husband and I went as far as seeing if we could get some to bring home with us! It is such a convenient location within the hotel zone and Aquaworld is right across the street for booking tours. Last night we participated in releasing Green Sea Turtles that hatch on the property every year. It is my son's favorite activity and quite a magical opportunity! He was in tears this morning when we were leaving. He wants to move in to the Paradisus. It is a happy place for us all. Thank you Paradisus for providing us with 5 wonderful years full of happiness and wonderful memories! See you same time next year.

reviews.author: Enrique O
reviews.title: Problems, Problems, and more problems!
reviews.text: I paid a lot of money to stay here and I expected to be pampered. Let me say, that I wasn't. Our room air conditioner leaked and only after several days of complaining were we moved to another room, a smaller room I will say. When I returned to complain and ask for an upgrade to a room with an ocean view  due to my repeat inconvenience, the manager told me that he'd give me a "discount" on that room. I couldn't believe he still wanted money. Anyhow, the hotel is 30+ years old and it shows. Restaurants are always booked, so if you don't make a reservation very early you'll find yourself eating a burger or at the buffet again and again. Again, for the amount of money I paid I should not have run into these problems. Finding a chair at the pool was close to impossible! Each chair had a towel on it so we had to walk around and around until someone left. Beach towels were also hard to find, each time we went for one they said they were out. All in all, the hotel is old and the amenities are lacking. For the $5,000 USD I paid, I should NOT have encountered so many problems. I will not be returning under any circumstance.

reviews.author: Jason11778
reviews.title: Very nice time
reviews.text: Good place.  Good food.  Kids zone was very nice.  Need more chairs pool side.  Clean place good atmosphere.  Pool water was too warm for us but hey it is what it is.  Room was very nice comfy and clean.  Bar service was a little slow to help you but it was busy.

reviews.author: PKosta
reviews.title: Paradise in Cancun
reviews.text:
We went to Cancun in January and we choose this melia hotel...
If you have kids go for the family concierge option, it's worth the money!
We like very much the suites with everything that we needed!
The food in the restaurants is good but could be better... 
This hotel It's a valid and good option in Cancun !

reviews.author: Luzstella6561
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: We just came back from a family vacation at this place. We were 4 adults and 5 children between ages of 10 and 15. I read some of the reviews before I left so I didn't know what to expect. Let me tell you, this was one of our best vacations. They offer various activities during the day by the pool and also for the grown ups. We participated of a cooking class with Chef Erika and Hugo, the activities person as well as a mixology class to learn how to prepare drinks. The best of all is service! They make you feel like royal people. Everybody there are courteous and eager to help in anyway. So if you are planning a trip there, you won't be disappointed!!

reviews.author: Janelle D
reviews.title: A Bucket List Destination
reviews.text: It was an absolutely amazing experience! The hotel staff is at your service from the literal moment that you walk through the front door. The location is absolutely gorgeous! -There are green plants growing everywhere you look, along with these cute little sand designs at every available corner. The beach was very nice and clean. If you wake up early (like I do) and head out to the balcony, you'll see them cleaning the bits of seaweed and trash off the sand so that it's at it's most beautiful by the time you get there. They have various forms of night life entertainment for you to experience, and every restaurant we sampled was absolutely delicious! If you want my recommendation, Vento is the only spot my family and I visited twice (besides the breakfast spot, Naos). On a completely different note, there are bus stops right in front of the hotel which bring you directly to the regular mall (with stores such as forever21, nike, and coach) or to downtown, where you'll find vendors selling practically anything you could possibly want. With all things considered, it was an absolutely amazing trip. I would recommend Paradisus Cancun to anyone who wants a fun, yet relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: Trevor O
reviews.title: Good and Bad
reviews.text: Happy to help others and share some information about my recent family vacation to the Paradisus Cancun Aug. 13th through 19, 2015.  My kids are 13 and 12 and they are active kids.  We were very disappointment with the amount of seaweed on the beach.  It appears this is a Cancun thing and not isolated to this resort, however everyone is telling me this problem has been going on for some time.  The water temp was excellent, but you really need to swim out about 40 yards to avoid the seaweed.   There is not a lot of activities for the kids.  The resort is safe and we were comfortable letting our kids explore.  Our kids played soccer a lot on the beach with other children.  We rented a beach bed at Cocos Beach Club - Sam our waiter was excellent and very attentive.
