I highly recommend renting the beach bed - they make the whole experience better - they will work with you on price.  The food - the best meals we had were on the beach bed at Cocos - shrimp and chicken skewers were very good.  We ate at all the restaurants and none of them gave us the WOW factor - however we are not foodies.  All require a reservation, except Blue Agave which was nice if you just wanted quick food with a waiter.  Breakfast was good at the large buffet at Naos.  The hotel itself was very clean and the staff were friendly.  Except for the pool swim up bar - those guys had no personality and never engaged in conversation.  I was very disappointed with our package and the coupons you receive.  They are basically worthless - spend $100 in the gift shop to save $20, etc.  Rooms - There are 5 towers.  the main tower is #3 and I would reommend staying in #2 or #4.  We upgraded to a two bedroom suite and were first placed in tower #1 - just to far of a walk.  we moved halfway to tower #4 and we liked the room and the location - much easier to run up from the beach to your room if you forgot something.  Overall I would give this resort a 4 out of 5 stars.  I enjoy vacationing in the Caribbean more then Mexico.

reviews.author: Vanessa d
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel but needs improvements in diff. areas
reviews.text:
The hotel is beautiful with green plants eveyrwhere.  Great location, beautiful beach and pool area. However, there are a few major issues:
1. Location of the shows is terrible. When we go on vacation, we really enjoy the evening shows. Our kids enjoy the shows and entertainment. The Paradissus hotel has great show but it does not have an appropriate location for shows.  The hotel should consider building an appropriate location with a stage or moving one of the restaurants.
2. Pool - not enough chairs/shade. When we go on vacation, we don't want to worry about finding a place to sit around the pool. Many guests would leave towels for 2+ hours. The staff should monitor the chairs/guests around the pool.  
3. Service around the pool - the guests that rented a bali bed would have great service. We know because we rented for 2 days due the fact we could not find chairs. The bali bed is $50 a day.  Service around the pool needs to improve
4. Restaurants - the market grill and the Asian restaurants are the best restaturants at the Paradissus. All others, needs major improvement on quality of food.  
5. Reservations for restaurants - resevation was required the day before. It was very difficult to get reservations. However, when you walk to the restaurants, there was always many empty tables.

reviews.author: lmchiaca
reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text:
We were in Paradisus Cancun in March 2015. The resort and view was beautiful. The servers and food are very good. Especially Javier and Jorge, their service were top notch. 
Our room bed had badbug and  my husband got bttten all over his arm and leg. We requested changing bed but was ignored. They didn't do anything about it. 
We will not go back to this resort again

reviews.author: Jamie C
reviews.title: Amazing all-inclusive hotel! Royal service is the best for couples!
reviews.text:
We absolutely loved our stay at this hotel! I am one of those people who search relentlessly thru reviews before selecting a final destination. Let me tell you, we could not be happier with our selection. If there was anything we needed or even slightly dissatisfied with they were there to make it better. To say anything negative about this place would simply be nitpicking. 

Upon check-in, we gladly accepted the offer to upgrade to the adults-only/royal service pyramid #5. To us, this was worth every penny spent! It is a quiet, kid-free zone that offers exceptional service with luxurious amenities. From the moment we stepped inside we were treated as royalty rather than just another hotel guest. Royal service is true to its name! 

Yes, it is true that this is an older hotel but the real beauty lies within. The coy ponds, water fountains, wooden walkways and the greenery inside is truly captivating. It's like walking into a rainforest! What could be more relaxing than that?! At night, its even more spectacular with the candles and purple up-lighting.

In the big pyramid, pyramid #3, there are stores for souvenir, clothing, jewelry, and household shopping. There is even a doctors office if medical attention is needed. Orbitz and Expedia are there to assist with booking any tours or excursions you may be interested in. Also, there is an ATM machine in case you need additional funds during your stay (currency is pesos). This hotel accommodates your every need so that you don't ever have to leave!

Next up is the food! If you like to eat then this is the place for you. We tried every single restaurant and were completely satisfied with each one. If you want more food or something different, simply order it! There is no reason why you should ever be hungry. Besides the restaurants, royal service has a buffet that you have access to throughout the day. Lets not forget about the room service 24-hours a day and your mini-fridge with drinks & snacks. If you don't want to leave the comfort of your bali bed by the pool, no problem. They will bring the food to you! Let's not forget about the drinks! Order whatever you may like, they will make it for you. If you drink fast, they will bring you two. If you prefer a particular beer, they will stock your mini-fridge with it. They are there to cater to you!

Next, I want to talk about the pool and beach. The pool at the royal service pyramid is the best! It is very quiet, clean and relaxing. The breeze and soft music drown out any noise from the other side of the hotel. Every once in a while we would walk to the other side and realize very quickly that royal service is the way to go for couples. Don't get me wrong, the other side is just as nice but it is a lot more active with kids and louder music. If a kid would happen to cross over to the royal service side an employee would politely escort them back to the other side. One of the many perks of staying on the royal service side is that the turtle conservation site is located just a few short steps on the beach. The conservation process is amazing to watch and if you're lucky you might be able to hold a baby turtle. The beach is clean and the hotel staff try their best to keep the area seaweed free. The water is clear and inviting with its beautiful aqua and turquoise hues of the Caribbean. 

Lets talk about the service! Wow, wow, and wow! These people are happy to serve you and do their jobs! The service is what makes this place top notch. They were always very helpful, polite, honest and trustworthy. We sincerely appreciate everything the staff did for us while staying at this hotel.

Now, its time to acknowledge a few special employees. We would like to say a big THANK YOU to Pedro, our butler, for everything you did for us. The reservations you made, birthday cake, balloons, champagne, rose petals, hot bath and simply your guidance is greatly appreciate! We would like to say thank you to Letty with the concierge service for taking great care of us and being so polite. A special thank you to Rafael for taking such great care of us by the pool and at our bali bed. Much thanks to Erick, Jose and to all the other servers at each restaurant who made sure we were never without food or drinks. Finally, we would like to say thank you to Roberto and Delio with Grayline for providing us with a wonderful tour experience to Chichen Itza.

There are a few pros that I would like to give attention to:
* The turn down service every night was a nice touch to end the day. It was basically like getting your room cleaned twice a day.
* The bathroom amenities include: toothbrush with toothpaste, comb, razor, nail file, sewing kit, q-tips, make-up remover pads, loofah, shower cap, and plenty of soap, shampoo & conditioner.
* The bath towels are the size of beach towels
* Daily newspaper with sudoku puzzles were fun
* The nightly shows were entertaining and enjoyable 
* A violinist or mariachi band provides entertainment during dinner

GUEST RECOMMENDATIONS:
* The royal service provides sunscreen but if you require a high SPF then bring some from home.
* Although tips are included in your all-inclusive per night rate, it's definitely worth it to provide a small tip to those serving you. ;)
* Prearrange your transportation to and from the airport prior to your visit. If you book thru a travel agency or travel website, print out a voucher for proof of purchase. This will save you money!
* When arriving at the airport for your vacation, do NOT let them try to sell you tours and package. Paradisus Cancun offers the same tours with trusted tour guides.

HOTEL RECOMMENDATIONS:
* Provide a transportation bus to and from the airport for hotel guest
* Less house music and more club hits for the Red Lounge club. Every night it would start off slow but the place would get packed when he would play Pitbull and other hitmakers.

We can not think of a better way to celebrate our 1 year wedding anniversary! Thank you Paradisus Cancun for a wonderful vacation!!

reviews.author: 540cathyk
reviews.title: Made our first visit to Cancun amazing!
reviews.text:
My review is almost a year belated, so some bits are fuzzy in my mind, but I really wanted to write a review.

My boyfriend and I had an extremely stressful year and were looking to go somewhere where we could just relax, and the Royal Service at Paradisus Cancun served to be the perfect setting for us.

SERVICE: The service was so great. Literally everyone we came across was so nice and willing to help. Coming from New York, this was highly refreshing and appreciated. At one point we missed our early morning bus for an excursion, but when we approached the man at the excursion booth for help (we didn't even buy our tickets from them), he kindly and willingly took us outside, got a hold of the tour company, asked the bus to wait for us, got us a taxi, and thanks to him, we didn't miss our excursion.

FOOD: The food was decent for the most part. We went to Naos for breakfast almost every day for our 8-night stay. Oddly, never got sick of it. We went to Bana a few times as well, pretty good sushi. Mole was yummy as well. The only place I would not recommend would be Market Grill. The service was horrible and the meat was so overcooked.

ROYAL SERVICE: If you're going to go to Paradisus Cancun without children, I highly recommend the Royal Service. Not only is it adult-only, so it's so peaceful in that part of the hotel, but there are extra benefits to reap, such as butler service, a separate pool in a very quiet area, a designated portion of the beach with food/drinks served right on the sand.

ROOM: We had an ocean view room, which was totally worth the upgrade. The room wasn't huge, but the way they designed the interior makes the room look fresh. I would love waking up in the morning and opening the balcony doors. AHH so refreshing. I wish I could go back right now. The room was spotless and so cozy. The bathroom was very spacious as well.

EXTRA: Directly across the street from the hotel was a pharmacy, a convenient store, and a McDonalds! Yummm churros.

I highly recommend Paradisus Cancun and would gladly go again.

reviews.author: Jay  C
reviews.title: Wonderful experience!
reviews.text: The service and employees were great and wonderful.  The everyday buffet has plenty of choices, but to  keep it from getting old, do not forget to make reservations for rest of the restaurants.  The reservation could be made one day early or same day before 4:00 pm. The "Vento" was a little good surprise for us.  The portions are small, so you could try a lot of them. The "Vento" staffs were excellent and very helpful.  Ask "Jose"  for advise for selecting dishes.

reviews.author: Ray L
reviews.title: Value Added and stupendously fine
reviews.text:
Oh, Where do you begin??? At the airport, where you are carelully guided to the best transporation to your diestination (with a little bit of time sharing tenacity).
You are greeted by a wonderful 5 star staff, that know there craft.
You are ushered to a special check in area, where all your questions are answered courtiously...
If you are fortunate to be in the Royal Service addition, then your stay will be even that more comforting and enjoyable.
The Royal service has its own little world, its own huge pool, and all the cnapies that you can eat, almost 24/7 and of course the drink contnuously flow, and we are talking premium brands.
THe rooms are very large and very quiet, almost all of them overlooking the ocean or the pool. You have a nice Balcony to sit on and enjoy the drinks in your room.
Towels are lush and plentiful, soaps are wondrful as are the other amentiies that you will find in your room which are refreshed twice a day.
The food on the 2nd floor is fabulous finger oods, that are meant to satisfy the best catered wedding in Manhattan and layed out in a most appealing manner.
Since this is an all inclusive property, the choices of restaurants and the various buffet items are too countless to count. Believe me when I say you will find the best of foods and the most plentiful of choices, especially with smaller family members.
We enjoyed five differenet eating venues and they were all fine.
This would be more of a book rather than a review, so I will let you read all of the other excellent reviews and put them together to have a pictorial of a wonderful and exciting vacation resort.

reviews.author: Melanie C
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text: We stayed here for 2 weeks in August. The place is amazing with direct access to the beach and opposite aqua land on the lagoon. Right outside is s bus stop with regular buses into cancun centre for approx $1. The room we had overlooked the lagoon and although nice, could have been bigger with more storage space for clothes. As a family of four we felt a little disappointed but by no means did it spoil our holiday. The restaurants in the hotel cater for all tastes and appetites. From buffet self service to a Michelin style restaurant. The staff were wonderful and couldn't do enough for you. You will not go hungry in this hotel. The pools were nice but I do think one of the major let downs is the fact they are all deep with none less than 5ft 4 except the infants pool. For non confident swimmers, this was a disappointment. The pool side staff are excellent and keep you hydrated! The dj at cocos bar throughout the day is fantastic and plays chilled house music you can listen to on the beach. We never struggled for a sun bed on the beach but we were up early to reserve one by the pool. You can pay a small fee to reserve a cabana which are very comfortable. The sea was covered in seaweed but we expected this and were told it is natures way of cleaning the ocean! It prevented us from really going in the sea but again didn't spoil our holiday. The mini bar is stocked daily and includes beer, water and soft drinks. You also get a packet of crisps and Oreos daily. There are plenty of daily activities from yoga to fun pool side stuff. Night time entertainment was difficult to view as it was situated in a small area of a bar which didn't make great viewing. For this reason we opted out. Our room was in the main pyramid and we could hear the noise from the entertainment at nights. If you are a light sleeper I would avoid pyramid number 3! I would come back to this hotel and would recommend it.

reviews.author: jclax2015
reviews.title: Excellent Stay Room 3801
reviews.text:
We stayed here Aug 1 - 14 2015. We did not pay extra for Royal Service, even though it was our 30th Wedding Anniversary. We did upgrade to a Ocean View, and boy was that worth it! For those who say you can't see the view when sitting down.... honestly! The hotel would have to have glass fronted balconies for you to do this, and you can clearly see it has not. I have added some pics taken while I was sitting down on the balcony. See if you think it is worth the upgrade. The noise of the sea crashing on the beach was fantastic. 
As I said, we did not upgrade to Royal Service. Coming from the UK it was an extra £1000 for 2 weeks. Not worth it. We had a fantastic room, with 2 baconies, reclining chairs and a table, and a huge extended bathroom. The air con was fantastic. Our room was decorated for us free of charge for our 30th Wedding Anniversary. 
We did not need a butler as all you need to do is pick up the phone next to your bed each morning, and book the restaurant of your choice for the following day. They speak perfect English. We also used room service, they bring you whatever you need. No different to a butler.  We booked Bali beds - which were only $35 as we had a voucher book giving $15 off each bed. So we paid £22 a day for each Bali bed. Some were round the main pool, some facing the ocean. In total we paid just over £100 for Bali beds. So is Royal Service financially worth it?? Even if we had paid for 10 Bali beds it would only have been £220. 
Our room was top floor pyramid 3. Yes there is noise from the music below, but during the day it is soothing 'zen' music, and during the live shows you are usually either watching the shows or having dinner. We loved being right in the centre of the action. Our room was right next to the lift. No noise at all from that. 
The Wi-fi in our room was as fast as our 150mb broadband at home. no complaints. 
Club Melia - NOT ONCE were we pestered to attend presentations or hard sell. In fact their desk was opposite our lift and nothing was ever said. When we arrived Matha showed us to our room. She asked if we would like to have breakfast with her tomorrow. 
We told her our Virgin Rep was due at 9am and she just said 'ok'. That was as close as we got to a 'hard sell'. 
The pool water is warm, but the outside temp was 91 degrees, and the sun warms up the water. If you want cold water, have a shower!
Everyone has their own views on restaurants. We loved Blue Agave, and Fuego, but hated Vento. Market Grill was 50/50. One night the service was slow, the meat rare and very fatty, no potatoes etc just salad. The other night was fantastic. This was the only place I feel the staff need a mention. Karla the hostess arranged a wonderful cake for our anniversary, and the waiters in our section, Jose, Rody, Alan and Guillerno were brilliant. During the 2 weeks no other member of staff really stood out. Someone on TA said there was no where to get coffee. In the Family Conciege room (which everyone can use) are all the coffee machines. You also book Bali beds here. 
All the alcohol is brand name and not watered down. We saw waiters open the seal on the bottles and pour... they do not water it down. However there is so much ice in the drinks, when this melts it does water down the alcohol. So either drink it quick, or remove the ice!
The buses stop right outside the hotel, we never waited for a bus, they arrive every minute or so. just pay 10.50 peso's per person where ever you want to go. Easy. The main shopping centre La Isla is only a 5 min bus ride. It is partially outside, but lots of shade. Luxury Avenue shopping mall is totally enclosed, and closer. 
We booked with Virgin, and did not go on any excursions with them. Firstly it was too hot in August, and also they are very expensive compared to other operators. 
When we visited in August 95% of hotel guests were Spanish speakers. (Mostly Mexican) Very few Americans/Canadians and even less British. 
We are in our 50s and noticed all the children were under 10 years of age. The very few teenagers there looked totally bored in the evenings. Although this resort caters for children, it does not cater for teenagers. 
Very romantic at night with reduced lighting and the use of candles.

reviews.author: Langeloyalo
reviews.title: Best employees!!! Not just because they are nice to us...
reviews.text: The architecture of this resort is the best in the area. The employees are excellent like Luis who help us with everything, Carlos our mini bar service, and especially the room service people who cleans twice a day with new towels. One day we left the safe open with all our valuables like money, iphone, ipod, passport, and wallet and they took the liberty to lock the safe for our own good with the note by saying just call them to open it. Thank God for this good people that nothing is missing. I definitely recommend this resort to everyone!

reviews.author: Ryan H
reviews.title: Amazing vacation!
reviews.text:
My girlfriend and I just spent 5 days in the royal service. From the moment we arrived, things went incredibly smoothly. 
Staff: First and foremost the staff were very friendly and welcoming. We had the royal service, which turned out to be great. Our nightly dinner reservations and daily Bali bed reservations were always made for us. Everyone was very outgoing, definitely exceeded my expectations.
Location: great location with quick access to excursions. Only took about 20 min to get to the resort from the airport. Remember to book an airport transport.
Amenities: we ended up going on a snorkeling adventure, parasailing, and a underwater scooter tour. We saw a stingray, sea turtles and a barracuda....very cool. The underwater scooters were awesome.
Beach: The beach was beautiful, super blue water with white sand. My only complaint was there was quite a bit of seaweed (not the resort's fault).
Pool: we had a private reserved Bali bed at each day at the exclusive pool since we were royal service. I would definitely recommend it.
Overall, the trip went as ideally as I could imagine. Will definitely be back!

reviews.author: jamesmatthewp
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun - 5 day stay
reviews.text: I really enjoyed our stay at this all-inclusive Hotel. There were so many nice things they did for you there! I would come back again & highly recommend it.There is a section for families & a section for adults which is really nice!

reviews.author: TexasCeCe08
reviews.title: Paradisus Review from Fairly Seasoned Mexico Traveler
reviews.text:
Our trip to the Paradisus Cancun was very nice.  I will start this review by saying it may be long, so take it for what you can use…

I consider myself a fairly seasoned traveler to the area, as I have stayed in Playa Del Carmen and Akumal areas for over 9 years now and speak some Spanish – enough to have conversations to get what is needed.  This was my first time in Cancun or at a Paradisus resort. I usually do a considerable amount of research prior and did with this trip as well.  This year, we booked through playadelcarmen.com with Lisa Wright as our travel agent – I will always use this agency from now on.  I have booked with the larger internet travel agencies before and done well, but Lisa resides in the area, she speaks the language, understands the needs of her clients and she has personally been on site to most of the hotels and was able to offer me a great amount of advice that I was not able to get from the other sites.  Un-matched service in my opinion – even down to not having to share the transfers to and from the hotels which is a nice time saver for sure.  She checked on us before, during and after our stay and was able to communicate with the hotel on our behalf for requests, which were happily given to us upon arrival.  

I won’t cover the check in process and minor things that come along with traveling – as all the other reviews hit most of that – I will just lend a few suggestions and compliments.  Paradisus is a nice hotel – yes, a bit dated, but only on the outside - its been there for a while. Yes, it could use a little paint on the exterior and some new planters on the outside but outside of that the interior is extremely nice. Beds and rooms are great – look like most of the hotels in the area with marble and wood.  The AC works and if it doesn’t or you have a need, a phone call usually does the trick.  We needed towels and extra pillows during our stay and within moments of the call, they were at our door – our luggage was delivered to our room in minutes of us walking in – and if we needed anything, it was done swiftly and friendly.  

The staff here is what makes this place great – EVERYONE, was incredible.  I have never seen people so happy to be at work and enjoying what they do – and I can’t imagine having to deal with tourists all day every day as the demands can be very high.  We choose to tip on vacation but the staff never expected it – which made it all the more reason we did extend the courtesy.   

There seemed to be a lot of questions about the family concierge package – to buy or not to buy.  We opted not to buy.  Please know this was our choice and if you don’t want to deal with a thing – buy the package. We opted to not and did well – we just rose early, called every morning for dinner reservations that you make for the day of and day after and were able to get every time we wanted.  We weren’t set on a specific restaurant each night, so we took what was available and were flexible – we ate at all the restaurants other than Mole, as Mexican food is easy to get in Texas.  They were all fabulous and the buffet as all have said – so many options…we were a little disappointed in the sushi at Bana, as the rice to sushi ratio was not right, but their other offerings were nice.  

Let’s talk seaweed – if you haven’t experienced Mexico’s beaches you won’t have an issue – if you have, yes, they aren’t pristine and perfect anymore – it is the cycle of nature.  However, I can’t imagine having cancelled our trip to avoid this – I try to have an open mind and go with the flow – and was concerned the kids were going to freak – they could have cared less…we were there for 8 days and some days you had to wade through a few feet of the floating garden to get to the good water and other days, we were able to walk right in with the clear water free of almost all of it with just a few floaters.  The tide changes daily as does the shore, so keep in mind – if you arrive and it’s a bad day – the next day may not be – it changed hour to hour during the day too – some mornings were free and then afternoons were bad and vice versa –think of it as a cheaper version of a seaweed wrap in the spa : ) - just be cautious as you enter – the day we left, we rescued a hatchling on the shore from the pending grips of a seagull for breakfast – apparently the evening before, there was a release and this little guy didn’t make it through the seaweed – we almost stepped on him. Once we saw he was there- gently moved the seaweed from him without handling him and we went to get the biologist on staff and she came immediately and scooped him up – and got him moving again.   We also found a turtle just about to nest and had to get staff to run down to the beach because people were taking photos and getting really close to her – they were able to get her away from all the commotion and she was able to nest and the eggs are now in a protected area – please educate a bit before you go on this issue – these turtles are protected and the seaweed is really causing issues with them so know what to do if you encounter one. 

We opted to rent a bali bed for 3 days - $150 total and worth every dime. Once you check in, you have to go into the family concierge lounge and they will book the beds for you – we had #105 – right by the pool and steps to the beach with La Perla in front – HUGE shout out to Roger – amazing employee – he never let us go without a drink or ice or anything – whatever we asked for he accommodated and even made a grasshopper out of the leaves for us which was incredible –– which the 6 year old used to scare her sister with later, so that was pretty funny.  They bring popsicles and refill your ice buckets constantly. Nice touch. The bali beds on the beach on one side are for the FC and Melia packages - the ones in front of Coco's Beach club are for adults only - if you are into loud, rave like music being blasted all day long - this is your spot.  If not - go for one at the pool. :) I am sure if I were younger or wilder, this would have been the place for me. But alas - I prefer a little more quiet. 

Yes, some of the bars pour a little light – just ask for more – its NEVER an issue – they are happy to get you what you want. 

If you want a pool chair, yes you have to get up and out there – all were gone by 9 usually.  There are not that many because of the way the pool was designed and the bali beds take a lot of space that pool chairs could be swapped out for, but beds have shade and bring in revenue – it is what it is – rent a bed if you can , then you don’t have to play the towel game.  The pool is deep, I am 5’4” and I could barely stand on point – that isn’t good – the pool really needs a place people can stand in and not have to hold onto the sides other than the steps where people would gather. And yep, the water is hot.  They don’t seem to have jets to keep it cool.  And 5 of the 8 days they were always out of towels – this is a problem.  One day I can understand – but 5? A resort of this stature really should consider investing in an overstock of towels.  The last day we had to wait for our bali bed to be dressed until almost 11 because of the towel problem and that isn’t ok when you are paying for a full day of use.  

The 6 year old used the kids club and loved it. We couldn’t get her out of it – bring socks as they request the kids wear them inside. They can even eat dinner there if you need a moment alone. 
Staff was great. Note – finding it can be confusing, but there is an easy access from the pool – go past La perla – up to the entrance to the hotel where it says Club Melia – go in the doors, make a right – and the end of the hall make a left – follow it around till you see the club on the right.  You enter from the hotel Pyramid 3 too, but this is easy if you are at the pool.

We were on Floor 3 of Pyramid 3 and we heard noise one night from the entertainment – its over by 9 or 930 and it was so minimal we had to go outside to even identify where it came from. Ocean view will give you gorgeous sunrises and a view – lagoon side with offer amazing sunsets and a view of the hotel zone and Cancun night lights.

Outside of the towel issue the only real complaint we had is that the interior of the hotel is extremely dark at night – that is fine for ambience, but the issue is that there are a lot of marble stairs that are all the same color and blend together so much that our teenager fell because she couldn’t see the last step. We never told anyone she fell because she seemed to just have a small bruise, but as a healthy adult, we were having trouble seeing the steps out of the lounges and often wondered if someone had a little too much to drink or was older how they might navigate some of this without the potential to miss steps.  Maybe it was just us – but a little more lighting on stairways in the center would solve the problem.

My two cents tips:
1)	Bring a flashlight
2)	Ask for the coconut ice cream and add Kahlua – it is ridiculously good
3)	Invest in non-slip shoes
4)	When leaving the airport – until you see clouds and sky – do not stop, do not pass go – they do not know you – or where you are staying and no – your transportation is not there – it is outside
5)	Pass on Market 28 – it’s a flea market and a BAD experience all around – sketchy area really – its safe but it is a maze and you get lost extremely easy and it is pushy – if you need to shop hit the other flea market closer to Isla Shopping Center or Plaza Caracoal.  We spent $90 round trip ($70 to rent a car and we didn’t want to deal with parking) and went into Playa Del Carmen for the day and it is SO much less stress, easier and nicer shopping – depending on what you want – always had a positive experience here.
6)	Bring a small umbrella for shopping trips
7)	Parasailing – we used the people on the beach in tents - $60 per person
8)	Ask the concierges here – they are honest and won’t steer you wrong – big shout out to Luis and Jaime – both awesome
9)	Take more sunscreen than you think you need.  Bottles start at $25 and go up there – not kidding. 
10)	Take a raft and ask the store at the hotel to inflate – we forgot ours and got one for $16, which is high but great for getting the kids over the seaweed and passed it along to a family on our way out
11)	Check the exchange rates daily – decent value right now for the exchange
12)	Ask for the liquor you want – they have top shelf here, just ask

Feel free to email with questions…happy travels

reviews.author: hannahthompson1989
reviews.title: Amazing in every way!
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun is the most beautiful hotel I have ever stayed in. The staff are outstanding and cannot do enough for you and the hotel is kept immaculate at all hours of the day! We didn't opt for royal service and we were not disappointed. The food in all of the restaurants is excellent, particualrly Vento (for tapas) and Bana (for sushi). The buffet is also beautiful. The drinks are premium in all of the bars and the staff will prepare any drink that you like! The selection is brilliant. We opted to spend most of our days around the busier pool with the swim up bar. The atmosphere is so nice and staff and guests alike were so friendly.The entertainments team at this pool (Uziel, Freddy, Angel, Arturo, Hugo) were amazing and they work so hard to keep adults and children happy and entertained throughout the day and night. They really do a brilliant job. Sergio Mesero served us our drinks at this pool and provided excellent, friendly service throughout our trip! Again, he works so so hard and constantly has a smile on his face! Everything about the holiday was perfect and is ideal for couples, families, friends etc. I will most definitely be returning!

reviews.author: Christopher S
reviews.title: Ever had a place you can't wait to go back to? :)
reviews.text:
Love love love Paradisus!

Where do I start?

The location is amazing! The hotel is impressive driving up, in the lobby, throughout the whole property!

Do Royal Service! It is worth it!

Pricey - but well worth it! :)

The food was great in each of the restaurants.

The service was awesome as well!

Can't wait to go back!!!!

reviews.author: Scott K
reviews.title: Royal Service is the way to go!
reviews.text: We were very pleased with our decision to get the Royal Service package! It definitely met and exceeded our expectations right from the start. Our butler, Pedro, was very attentive and took care of booking our restaurant and Bali-bed reservations. All of the staff at Paradisus were friendly, approachable, courteous and accommodating. Food options cover pretty much every palate. Blue Agave has awesome tacos! Very authentic tasting. We had a great time at the main lobby bar where the nightly entertainment/shows took place. Christian, the bartender, made us feel really welcome, made us laugh and made us excellent cocktails! The lounge right near that main lobby bar had great music to dance to and for an on-site lounge was a fun place to party late night. Simply put, everything at the resort was great. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: GrottoGast620
reviews.title: A MUST GO
reviews.text: AMAZING AMAZING AMAZING from start to finish. You WILL NOT be disappointed. We chose Royal Service. Pedro (our butler), Daniel (pool employee), Yeuri (waiter at Bana), Jorge (waiter by the pool) were AWESOME! Make sure to ask for them because your stay will be just as fantastic as ours was. This is going to sound terrible and I'm sad to even say it but Fuego, the restaurant, in OUR opinion, was a waste of time. Bana and Vento were our absolute favorites! Couldn't have asked for anything better!

reviews.author: keekrico
reviews.title: Gorgeous property
reviews.text: We had the royalty service and it was beautiful. Shout out to our butler Sergio! You are the best! The property is large but not too large. Restaurants are very good and the drinks are also tasty. The pool bar was a blast and the staff out there is great. My only complaint besides how small the bathrooms are is how hot the pools are.  Way, way too hot.  No relief.  I'm not sure how or if that can be fixed but it seriously needs to be at least 15 degrees cooler than what it is.

reviews.author: familytraveler11
reviews.title: Outstanding in nearly every way. A perfect vacation
reviews.text:
This was our third and best Paridisus.  When searching a vacation for our family, we poured over Trip Advisor, Oyster, Expedia, you name it because we wanted this vacation to be spectacular.  After hours of exhausting research, we chose Paradisus Cancun and seems our system paid off.   Someone at a very high level there "gets it" and does things right.  This will be long, but is also the type of review I was looking for when making our decision.  Hope it helps you
ARRIVAL/CHECK IN
   The transfers by Otium (arranged for free when booking) went very smoothly for all travelers in our group of 6, some who arrived/departed different days and different flights.  Our plane was 90 minutes late, but other than that, so far so good..
  I was a little disappointed  not to receive a refreshing welcome drink upon arrival.  Though, when we were clearly searching for this, someone actually took a drink order for us and brought us what we wanted.  The check in lobby was cool and fragrant, though not annoyingly so, but just right.
   Ironically, our first encounter at Paradisus was not a good one.   We had requested (long in advance) two rooms near each other (same floor/same building), each room for three people.  One room was perfect, and the type of suites we are used to at Paradisus.  The second was a regular king room.  No "suite" part, no place for the third person.  We went down to the lobby and were offered two doubles, offered different buildings, different floors, none of which is what we wanted for our 7 days.  Not giving up, a room was to open the next night, king suite, same floor and same building as the other room.  We would have to switch rooms after one night.  It wasn't the end of the world, and for us, the preferable option and they threw in an ocean view.   What could have really started the vacation off on the wrong foot, ended up proving to be foreshadow of the superior level of service we would find throughout the trip.  Never relenting, the staff at check in, led by Alberto, persevered until we were happy.
   On Day 2, we were told to check back frequently, as soon as the other guests left, they would rush the cleaning of the new room, so we could move as early as possible.  There was no default "come back at 3", they actually worked with us to accommodate our preference.  Sure enough, we were in the new room before 12, and they helped us move. 
ROOMS
  The girls had a lagoon view and we had been given ocean view - all on the 4th floor, in building 4.  I don't think you can go wrong in any buildings, but we liked 4 as it was the other side of the small kids area, and still close to the main building 3.  Everything was convenient, yet quiet.  The bed was comfortable as were the pillows.  No complaints, and slept well.  Shower has the option of overhead 'rain' or handheld. No Jacuzzi as in some other Paradisus.  We didn't miss it. Bathroom a good size and separate private toilet area with bidet.  The A/C worked great, and was not intrusively noisy.  I am a light sleeper, and found it to be a lulling white noise.  We had a nice balcony, as did the kids, and both rooms had nice views. No complaints about Lagoon view rooms.  For the first time of any stay, the mini bar was actually fully restocked every day.  Room cleaned twice a day and very well.  Could it use an update, sure. However, we found enough outlets, and it was so well cleaned and appointed, we were very comfortable.  The TV does not get loud, for the one hour I watched before falling asleep.  My guess is so maybe others won't hear it, as I have heard neighboring rooms tv's in other places.  I was happy for it. Bathrobes and slippers were there to use and plenty of amenities.  Very content with every aspect of the rooms.

As others have said, the wifi is hit and miss.  But we didn't come to Cancun to be plugged in, so for our needs (occasionaly check of email or facebook ,I guess), it was sufficient.but texting and games and Pandora did not work ...

RESTAURANTS/POOL/ENTERAINMENT
You have to reserve restaurants a day in advance, so the first night, we hit the buffet.  It was hit and miss.  Some things were very tasty, and others not so much. However, there was enough variety and enough 'hits' to keep us all happy .  Again. the service was gracious and efficient.  We plotted our restaurants for the next 6 days - La Perla, Bana ,Fuego, (one night out - Senor Frogs), Vento and Mole. We had no issues getting the reservation we wanted for the six of us, though I recommend calling before noon (once called at 2:30 and had to take 6:30 instead of our usual 7pm).
   We are early risers, so we had no issues getting chairs by the pool.  It is pretty much were I became anchored for the week.  Kids (26,25,21 and 17, but still 'kids' to us) volleyed between pool, beach, and grill.   Once again, outstanding service,.  I never felt so inclined to tip -not because it seemed that was the only way to get good service, but because it was NOT the only way to get good service. Sergio and Luis were our poolside servers, who checked on us frequently, and always made sure we had a bucket of ice cold water.  So, yes, I chose to reward that, and I felt like it was my choice, not obligation, which made it more enjoyable. 
   The pool water was not very cold, but refreshing when it got too hot.  The staff d an excellent job of cleaning up - there were NO BUGS.  No bees by the garbage bins. We bought bug spray - didn't use it (except the kids kept the balcony door open one night which was not too bright).  We did not reserve the cabanas for $50 though many did.  With 6 of us, one would not be enough anyway, and the umbrellas by the chairs gave us enough shade.  Had we not been early risers, I doubt we would have gotten 6 chairs next to each other.  I think you can always get a chair, and I saw staff pulling them out of somewhere and placing them on the grass, or other places, so you can just ask if you need help.

  Every one of us enjoyed La Perla immensely.  My husband is a vegan, and I had the feeling Luis, our server, would have traveled the strip to make sure my husband received the broccoli he hoped for.and was so happy to have.   We felt like royalty and the food was really delicious, though one daughter didn't love her flank steak.. Thing is, it is very easy and possible to get something else if you are not happy.  I have to say ALL the restaurants were a stark contrast to ALL the ones at Paradisus  Playa Del Carmen, where the service was almost non-existent, the wait for food unreal , (I never even received a meal once), and the quality so/so.  We even said this time, we better go when we are not that hungry yet because last trip it took over an hour to get served.  Not so here!
  We capped off the night at Avenue bar where Carlos, Francisco and Ernesto will be your best friends for your trip. Arriba, Abajo... and you can find out the rest when you get there.. The drinks are not watered down, you can get Belvedere and Bombay Sapphire and you will have fun, if that's what you came there to do.  When Avenue closed, we went to club that is open to 2 and danced.  
    Each morning we got up very early, first to work out in the gym.  There seemed to be enough equipment since it wasn't too crowded ,but definitely some in disrepair.  Yet, it was sufficient to get an elliptical workout  and feel a little less guilty about what lied ahead.  My  husband went to swim in the pool before it 'opened' officially, and had no issues.  He likes to lap swim when not crowded, so a 7am swim worked great.  At 10am, I discovered Zumba and the Experience Entertainment team, Hugo, Uzzie, Angel and Freddie..  Ive never done Zumba.  Is is always this fun?  I never missed a 10am Zumba the rest of the trip.   At 12:00, we also did the water aerobics. Again, great fun, and a decent workout believe it or not.  did i overdo the exercise?  I don't think so, as i ate and drank to my hearts content and didn't put on any weight!
We also really enjoyed all the activities around the pool ,and our family won the song challenge.   Having grown up kids, this was our first vacation all together in 12 years, and it was amazing.  They also loved the paintball competition and gave a good run.
    The grill was  hit and miss.  In Punta Cana, the burgers were inedible.  In Playa del Carmen, they were delicious.  Here they were in the middle. So we skipped the burgers (though my husband appreciated the veggie burgers), and we went with the delicious chicken wrap and decent pizza..  
  We really enjoyed Bana with Daniel and Jose.  We are big sushi lovers and were impressed with the service and food.   After not really loving Vento so much, we came back here later in the night to see if they could serve us.  Angela, the hostess, was not too happy about it and said 'no' (one of the rare rebuffs in service), but the manager said come back in 30 minutes and accommodated us.  He didn't have to, but he did ,and it made us all really happy.  
  We went one night into town to Senor Frogs.  It is an easy bus ride with the stop across from the hotel.  The concierge was very helpful in telling us how to do it, and making reservations for us.  We had a blast.
  At Fuego the food was again delicious and everyone was very happy with their filet steaks  There is an opportunity to pay for different cuts, but we chose the filet on the menu and did not regret it.  As with the other restaurants, the chefs were very accommodating to my husbands vegan diet and concocted something special for him.
   Vento is tapas, and we found them to be hit and miss and our server, who was clearly trying ,seemed a bit inexperienced.   We had been so spoiled by the outstanding service thus far, it was a little bit of a let down, and while not terrible, jsut paled in comparison to the bar that had been set.  We ended up in the buffet, and Bana afterwards.
  Mole was once again great service with Angel.  He had the chef come to speak to my husband about how the refried beans are prepared (no lard!) and it was so nice on both their parts to do that.  Once again one daughter tried the flank steak (Fuego gave us hope) and once again, this was a miss.  Angel was concerned and offered to get her anything else.   She filled up on so many yummy appetizers that she really didn't need another dish - plus there is always desert  - yum.

YHI SPA
We booked massages using a coupon we got when booking online.  The spa is in terrible disrepair.   One shower didn't work, we couldn't remove our keys from the lockers, not all the jets in the giant jacuzzi pool worked.  Of the four girls getting massages, three said they were outstanding, or best they've had.  I was the fourth, with the disappointing massage.  She never asked how the pressure was, and after telling her my real sore areas, she never focused on either .  What was the point of asking?  I could have asked to go deeper, but I kept thinking she would work up to it from the light swedish strokes.  Didn't happen.  The other girls said their therapists asked and exchanged information to give them what they had hoped for,   The use of the spa facilities came with the massages.  If I had paid for those separately, I would have been disappointed.  The steam rooms was pretty good, but the sauna not hot, probably because of the broken door.

BEACH:
I was always at the pool, usually swimming to and from the swim up bar, which was busy and lively, but you didn't have to wait too long to be served.  The kids and husband would also go to beach, and they really liked it.  No problem getting chairs.  Water a little choppy and yes, there is seaweed,  I checked out zillions of hotels in Cancun on the strip where we wanted to go, so it was not unique to this hotel,  Just is. 

At night, we did sometimes go into a cabana on the beach or by the pool and hang out and play a game (Heads up) on our phones, and it was really nice and fun.   I went to the Red Lounge a couple nights for the late night dancing, though usually I was pretty worn out by then,  I am pretty sure the kids were there more often.

There were nightly shows at Avenue - they got crowded. Some better than others. It was a nice change of pace, though we didn't go to all of them.

DEPARTURE
We had complicated reservations because some kids arrived/left on different days. The staff was very much aware, and made sure there were not issues with the kids room continuity, and getting 'check out' tickets for those that were leaving.  There were no issues or surprises with the bill and OTIUM was there on time to take us back to the quick ride to the airport.

I have given many reviews on Trip Advisor and this was my first five.  Was it perfect in every way ?  No.  But it was SO GOOD in SO MANY ways, and just what were were looking for,  Every staff, regardless of position were so friendly and helpful and pleasant.  There have always been the grumpy, the chips on the shoulder, the desperate for tips.  I did not see that here.I saw bartenders notice little kids who don't tip as much as adults. I appreciated that. The hospitality all around was genuine and impressive  We've never been to the same place twice, but I definitely definitely go back to this one if given the chance.

reviews.author: Pshad562
reviews.title: Very Pleased
reviews.text: Very Nice Hotel, Service Excellent, Daily and Nightly Entertainment, Club was Great, Waiter Service on the Beach and At the Pool.  The only draw back is during our stay the beach had  many seaweeds. The Japanese restaurant was excellent  The pool at the swim up bar needs to be shallower, too deep. Other that that My Experience was Excellent

reviews.author: Candace M
reviews.title: BEST RESORT EVER
reviews.text: Best resort ever!! Trust me your not going wrong if you choose here... With family or with friends.. Make sur you try La Palapa... EDDIE is one of the best servers .. Very polite and aims to please.. LOVE LOVE LOVE! And also my butler Rode who pulled our vacation together to make it special

reviews.author: Shalane B
reviews.title: Best vacation ever
reviews.text: From start to finish my experience was amazing. We opted to do the the royal service package when booking and it was worth every penny. great service from our personal butler Ivan he was amazing, food was great ,nice and clean resort beautiful view this trip was nothing short of amazing i loved every minute...

reviews.author: AMCDva
reviews.title: Quick Get Away (5 days/4 nights)
reviews.text: We stayed in a Royal Service Ocean View One Bedroom Suite. Check-in was swift and efficient!  Desk personnel were extremely friendly and inviting. Up to the room:  Very nicely laid out, clean and bright - very comfortable atmosphere. We booked ocean view to see the ocean, well if you were sitting on the balcony you can't see the ocean, you see cement balcony wall (unless your chair is right on the edge of the balcony).  We found the balcony furniture lacking. Balcony off the bedroom has 2 chairs and 1 side table. Balcony off the living room has 2 lounge chairs and 1 side table (this balcony is huge and can handle dining set and lounge chairs).  Thought of enjoying morning coffee overlooking the ocean and the hotel grounds were completely dashed.  The service, restaurants and food were just amazing.  Huge kudos to Ceasar our personal Butler - HE MADE THINGS HAPPEN from making dinner reservations, giving directions, cabana reservations, transportation, shopping, etc.  HE DID IT ALL! You must reserve a Bali Bed for the pool. The pool service was exceptional, Eddie kept us supplied in water, drinks and food; he seemed to know just when to appear.  (The temperature of the pool was way too warm, did they have a water heater on??)  Sadly the surf was covered in seaweed and certainly something the hotel(s) can't do much about - they do rake the beach and the ocean was perfect once you got past the seaweed.  Our favorite restaurant was Vento (reservations are a must) - friendly enjoyable attention-to-detail service by Emanuel, Katia and Jose.  If we go back to Cancun, we can't think of a reason not to stay here again.  (We didn't give it a Excellent rating based on our world wide travels experiences.)

reviews.author: bmejia63
reviews.title: great vacation spot
reviews.text: excellent service all around. the hotel staff was excellent. rooms were always clean & had that at-home feel.  mini bar was always stocked & staff even double checked at night if we needed to be restocked.  the food was great. excellent variety.  breakfast, lunch & dinner always had great choices.  if you want to eat at the restaurants, i strongly recommend to make reservations.  the pool bar staff are awesome. Sergio, Miguel, Luis, Giovani and the staff were excellent.  they always made sure we had enough water & drinks. they always were attentive to our requests. when we needed more lounge chairs , we were taken care of. the only thing that was missing was some music in the pool area, but if you take a portable speaker, you'll be ok.  one other thing, the beach was full of seaweed. the hotel staff did their best to clear as much off the beach as possible, but there's not much you can do against Mother Nature.  public transportation is readily available if you want to go to downtown Cancun for shopping or bar hopping.  overall, it was an excellent experience.  i would definitely recommend the Paradisus Cancun resort to others.

reviews.author: Jason W
reviews.title: Wonderful Vacation
reviews.text: my rooms were exactly as advertised beautiful beach views from the bedroom. The staff was excellent. Gabrielle our butler was very attentive and scheduled all of our dinners and activities for the children. The Pool was where we spend the majority of our time. David that manages the pool and the Bali Beds was very personable as well as attentive. i will be surprised if he is not promoted in the near future. All of the bar tenders at the pool were top notch. Salvador,Edgar, Eduardo, and Miguel took excellent care of my family and I. The food was amazing and exceeded expectations. My only complaint is the a/c was not cold enough but that said it was a great vacation and I would return.

reviews.author: R404EMangelac
reviews.title: Okay
reviews.text:
Pricey.  Property is nice.  Beach had ton of seaweed   Pool depth was too deep. Hard to move about.   Took too long for staff to deal with spills in pool.  Decent experience in general.  
      .......
Zzz
Xxxxxxxxxxd

reviews.author: N2817DNstephenk
reviews.title: quick, family trip before school starts
reviews.text: Overall, this resort was good. The Service was usually fast and friendly.  Food was pretty good.   Bana was exceptional in every way.  Their food and service was, by far the best we experienced during our stay.  Vento was at the opposite end of the spectrum.  This is not the best place we've stayed, but basically a great hotel.  We had a limited amount of time to get away with our large family before school resumed for the year and this was a quick, easy vacation.  It was pretty much what we expected.  Clean, friendly and service overall was excellent.  Dinner reservations were sometimes difficult to get at the times we wanted.  They have many restaurants to choose from, but they are all quite small and accommodate limited reservations each evening.  Even with that being said, it wasn't a huge problem for us.

reviews.author: drnudy
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: Hotel rooms are not great quality, look old. All inclusive restaurants are booked and can't accommodate large groups. Our group booked 3 months in advance and we couldn't get hotel rooms in the same building. We requested double beds, none available, were given king size single bed room. Took forever to check in to hotel, over an hour.

reviews.author: 490sebastien
reviews.title: Restaurant bana
reviews.text: I just make a reservation at the restaurant Bana it was so good and the service by Yair perez so nice and all the time with the smile he is friendly and the food was so amazing. The ambiance with the person who sing just beside the waterfall it's just magic

reviews.author: Tina T
reviews.title: Anniversary trip
reviews.text: 5 Star for Butlers, and waiters, view, service.  3 star for the buildings.  The room was great, but the middle of buildings were horrible.  We traveled in the middle of July for a trip to paradise adults only. We paid for the Royal Service when we made the reservation because we wanted to have an enjoyable time with out kids to relax.  We arrived around 2 and was immediately taken over to the Royal Service side.  Check in was not bad.  Our room had a sea view and was awesome!  It overlooked the pool area and able to see the sea and all it's beauty.  We were assigned a Butler Giroldo(sp) who was awesome.  He got us reservations at all the restaurants, booked the Bali Beds, and made sure all was going okay.  We tipped him good the first day.  Then once again before we left.  Our first nights dinner was at LA PALAPA RESTAURANT by the pool on the Royal Service side.  We had a table right next to the glass railing overlooking the beach.  A wedding had taken place and the reception was going on on the beach with music and dancing.  We could not have made plans any better than that!.  Saturday morning our toilet overflowed and it took more than 3 hours to get it fixed.  Our waiters at the pool Caesar(sp) and one other gentleman were fantastic!  We tipped them good so they were always making sure we were good.  We were lucky (or not) to have had a Bali Bed everyday.  Normally you only have it reserved 2 days.  If you wait until 11:00 who ever did not claim their beds will loose them so that was how we got lucky on two days.  Monday morning we were going to stay in and watch the British Open, but the Cable Box broke.  So another 3 hours to get that fixed.  Needless to say, they were very happy to just get us a reservation for a Bali Bed on Tuesday for all we had to deal with.  It is so close to a top notch place but just does not reach it!  The atriums (all the rooms are on the sides leaving an atrium in the middle) in every building does not have air conditioning or fans.  This makes the breakfast area in the Royal Service building too hot to eat in.  The building which housed the restaurant Vento did not have air conditioning where you ate.  They did have an area that seats people with fans overhead.  We had to be moved to one of those.  The food was top notch in the restaurants!  Beautifully arranged and flavorful.  We only ate breakfast in the Buffet area once.  After the first day of sweating to death in the Royal Service food area we opted to get room service the next day.  Be prepared for an hour or more to get room service delivered.  It was delicious, just took a long time.  We got lost one night trying to get back to our building and was soaking wet when we finally got back to the room.  Too hot in the corridors!  We only travelled from building to building outside after that.  Cooler outside than in.  To make it to a 5 star they only need to put in air conditioning or fans to have air circulation.    My husband has no desire to return because of the air condition problem.  Oh the room air only goes down to 68, but it never gets that cold since when the cleaning people come and the turn down service comes they leave the door open and all the cool air leaves the room while they work  They did put rose pedals on the bed in the shape of a heart and gave us a bottle of Champagne the first night.  The night of the cable box issue, they drew a hot bath and put rose pedals in the bath.  All in all I enjoyed my stay.  Hey it's Cancun, but, I paid a whole lot to stay here and would have liked to have  been comfortable the entire time.  If air conditioning is not a problem for you, then this is a 5 star place!  Also there was a wedding every night we were there.

reviews.author: 310jackie
reviews.title: Excellent All-Inclusive in Cancun
reviews.text: Paradisus far exceeded our expectations.  The rooms were nice, clean and modern.  The staff was friendly, helpful and were available around every corner.  The food in every restaurant and the buffet was delicious - a wide variety and they did not skimp on the details.  Once you sit down at a restaurant, they immediately offer you a welcome drink and keep the drinks coming for as long as you want.  You have to plan each day ahead by making restaurant reservations 24 hrs in advance but it was worth it.  The kids really enjoyed the pool (although the water got way too warm, especially in the afternoon) and the free kids club.  We did 4 excursions and the on-site advisor was very helpful.  We would highly recommend this hotel!

reviews.author: Nori B
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
Juan Carlos helped my husband arrange an amazing birthday getaway at paradisus. When we arrived we were met in royal service with champagne and a fast check-in. Our butler, Rode, walked us to our beautiful ocean view room. He decorated the room with an arrangment of roses, ballons, streamers, fresh fruit, and a slice of cake!!! He also made all of our dining arrangments and bali bed rentals. Infact, he gave us a variety of beds with different views during our stay and he also arranged an extra day at the beds for us.

The pool is very nice it's 4ft to around 5ft and it typically clears out before it closes around dusk so we had it all to ourselves several days for around and hour. The staff at the pool are awsome they keep the drinks and food flowing. The cool ocean water was refreshing due to all of the heat and we enjoyed Jet skiing on the surf.  

On my Birthday, Juan Carlos personally arranged the purchase of my Birthday cake which was BEAUTIFUL! I was so shocked when they brought it out at the end of dinner.

The Expedia staff arranged for us to visit Xcaret, chichen itza, and the coco bongo. I recommend all of these activities.

The restaurants are great, my favorite was Bana. Room service is also very good and a great option for breakfast. I have to mention our butler from last year Hector. He helped to make sure our car service was on time for pick-up. And anytime he saw us he would ask if he could assist  us in anyway even though he was not our assigned butler. I recommend this hotel and we will be back!!!

reviews.author: asmirj
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Amazing great place ,can't wait to come back I liked the food and the people and workers were nice and funny there staff is amazing.i loved the bathroom and the room overall was great I love the plants.

reviews.author: Tigran D
reviews.title: Kids Zone
reviews.text: Excellent service, very carying and attentive staff.  My twin boys had great time at Kids Zone. Everyday the staff had different creative activities that were educational and entertaining. My boys loved Franas, Sheila, Luciana, Deya, Jacquie, Marisol and Sarahi. These young ladies created very cheering, comforting and cozy atmosphere. We will definitely come back to Paradisus Cancun Resort.

reviews.author: felicia d
reviews.title: Awesome vacation
reviews.text:
This was our 1st time in Cancun and Paradisus made the entire vacation a wonderful one. The staff at the resort were absolutely amazing with impeccable customer services. Thumbs up to Marco and Victor at the Naos restaurant, our glasses and plates were never empty thanks to those 2. There were so many restaurants to eat from and once we knew some required reservations, we did just that and tasted some great cuisines.
Only thumbs down was the very terrible WIFI and seaweed on the beach which you cannot blame on the resort.
We will stay at the hotel again and will definitely recommend it.

reviews.author: crecio1
reviews.title: Best hotel on earth
reviews.text: Everyone at Paradisus ROCKS!!! I had my wedding here August 1st. It was magnificent. Extraordinary service. Outstanding staff. I will recommend Paradisus to my friends and family always. You guys are AWESOME!!!

reviews.author: kayaellis
reviews.title: 5 nights in the caribe
reviews.text:
despite seeing a lot of mixed reviews of this hotel i decided to book anyway and considered the fact that most people that have a good to great experience will never actually bother to review but if you have a terrible experience then you can't wait to tell the world how bad it was lol. 

the first thing i should mention is that i think i got a pretty good deal, i signed up to the melia rewards program (free on website) this also gave me some points for my first booking which i was able to use to reduce the total amount paid for the booking. 

we stayed for 5 nights in a ocean view room (definitely recommend as the view was incredible) and the total cost was $1,458  AUD so a little under $300 a night, considering i saw rooms being advertised on booking.com and expedia for $600 aud per night just before our stay i would say we got a great deal so this also factors into my overall review as we loved the hotel but there was some issues that for $300 a night didn't bother me in the slightest but for $500 or $600 a night my whole perception would of changed.

we arrived at 6am after taking a redeye from LAX and although they advised checkin was not until 3pm we were given our all inclusive wristbands and told to go and enjoy the facilities which i found to be nice. our room was ready by 2pm and we were on the 8th floor of the main pyramid with ocean view (paid about a extra $40 aud per night for it but for me it was most defiantly worth it.

rooms are decent size with king bed, we had 2 large balconies 1 with furniture, the furnishings are quite old and could use being updated but not bothersome, bed was comfortable with good quality linens, AC doesn't get as cold as i would like but it was sufficient for sleeping.

although the buffets are okay the book in only restaurants are what you want! they are amazing!!! we went to fuego twice and bana & la perl once, the trick is so call up each morning around 7 or 8am and book for that night and the night after this always ensured us the choices we wanted. 

not sure what there policy is for the bookings but the special restaurants were always empty so my assumption was they keep tables open for the royal service guests. pretty frustrating if you didn't get your booking done early enough then just see a empty restaurant and there supposedly fully booked. 

Fuego was our pick although bana (asian fusion) was also really enjoyable, there are few more but we didn't try.

Service all over the hotel was impeccable and the staff should really be commended.

the pool is huge but we didn't spend anytime there and decided on the beach each day for a few reasons the first being there were never any chairs avail as the good old go down and lay towels and other items on them and hold for the day trick as was being used in force by the guests unfortunately, this never deters me as i just throw there towels away but we still choose the beach as the pool scene was so douchy, lots of loudmouth americans drinking and kids everywhere, the beach is beautiful and there were less kids and no annoying american tourists! all over just a much better vibe plus waiters bring your drinks to you at beach anyway so its a win win.

overall the facilities are good, beautiful location and helpful staff but the property is ageing and could do with some refurbishments but as i said earlier for what we paid i would rate 5 stars

reviews.author: tomtrang
reviews.title: thank you note for the staff at Paradisus Cancun.
reviews.text:
I traveled a lot, and never have written a review. When I read reviews on this website, there are often extreme rating from 2 stars to 5 stars on the same resort. So it is very confusing and I tend not to take them seriously.  BUT I agree review is very helpful for first time visit.
    The most important thing that make my experience good or bad when I visit the resort is the staff.  They make all the difference. Because some of the staff are very nice and work extremely hard to service us, I fell obligated to write a review to thanks them.  Of course, there are other staff not so friendly and rude, and we just tried to avoid them, can't let them ruin my vacation.  Staff with a smile makes all the different!
     At Paradisus, we have party of 24 and I am in charge of arranging everything. I would like to thanks these staff for the excellent service.

Front desk. Hola Alma, always smiling :>
Noan buffet:  Hola Gaudencio, David, Carlos, Antonio, plus the lunch and dinner hostess (sorry I forgot your name :<). food is excellent and always have fresh fruit
Coco's Bar: Hola Jesus, thanks for Mojito every hours 
Market Grill: Cody and all his dinner staff. We had a birthday party. Must try the smash potato!
Lastly the dinner reservation: They make my job easy and fit all 24 most nights for dinner.
There are still many staff that makes our stay enjoyable, especially the one behind the scene. Constantly cleaning up the place and stock the supply.
  
And don't let any bad staff ruin your vacation. Just tell them they should be nice or stay away from you until you leave the resort :>

Lastly, about the beach. We have lots of children and 1 senior. In general, the beach in Cancun strip is not accessible with a wheel chair. You need to take stairs to reach the beach.  Also the wave is too strong for little kids.  If you like calm ocean and wheel chair accessible, I recommend resort in Riviera Maya (block by Cozumel), or the north side of Cancun like Mujeres. 

Mucho Gracias

Trang family

reviews.author: Nancy M
reviews.title: Paradise!!!
reviews.text: Everything was awesome except maid service. They came after 430 everyday when we were trying to get ready for dinner. The staff was amazingly kind and accommodating. Pool bar and wait staff was truly exceptional! We felt pampered and like VIPs. The staff goes above and beyond to make sure you want for nothing. It is truly paradise!

reviews.author: Loretta D
reviews.title: Luis Herrera
reviews.text: Luis Herrera is a very kid friendly, kind, funny and a wonderful care taker!!!  We had an amazing time while at this resort.  Luis made us feel safe and comfortable.  Our rooms were fabulous!!!  Luis made sure we received the best price for our excursions.  He was very helpful with our airport transportation . It was great meeting Luis!! He is an asset to Melia resorts   Thank you for everything!!!!!

reviews.author: jkbarryatl
reviews.title: Amazing Staff, Not a 5 star resort
reviews.text:
First let me start with the good, and I should say great because the staff at the Paradisus is absolutely incredible top to bottom. Whether its the bartenders, room cleaners, butlers .. .Everyone goes above and beyond. We had Royal Service and our Butler Galdino did a GREAT job in making sure we had everything we needed. 

Now that the good is out of the way lets talk about the bad. 

AIR CONDITIONING.... I'd say it was bad but i'm pretty sure it didn't exist. I understand that much of the resort is outside and its impossible to cool but I can't think of one place in the resort that is well air conditioned. The lobby, The indoor restaurants, even our room. Our sister had to change rooms it was so bad but when she switched the new one was good. We had 4 rooms at the resort and 3 of them were nice and cold. Ours was cool at best. We could have moved but we were so moved in we didn't want to have to re-pack. 

The food was average at best. La Perla, the steak and pasta restaurant was definitely the best. Mole and the Asian place were close seconds. Everything else was poor. The food at the buffet for lunch and dinner was really poor. 

Note to management. Don't put a tennis court next to a sewage pipe. Yes, I'm serious. Every 10 minutes you get a treat that you DONT want. Also, Upgrade your WIFI, its really bad in most of the hotel. 

As a whole I can't recommend the Paradisus unless they make a lot of changes.

reviews.author: Maria P
reviews.title: Huge disappointment
reviews.text: Stayed here in April for my brothers wedding I was so excited to go back and tagging along finally was my parents who never wanted to go to Mexico but I told them it's the best ever! I was sorely disappointed with this resort food was horrible everyday bad, drinks bad-go figure they usually rock! And if you don't tip lots they don't leave you enough towels etc. there is no place to gather as s family in the evening, this is truly my first complaint, but again I cannot say enough about the staff they are amazing and work hard.

reviews.author: shinal_patel
reviews.title: Awesome experience!
reviews.text:
This was my first time in Cancun - I went for a bachelorette and it was well worth it. Everyone was extremely friendly and welcoming. Each person went above and beyond to make our experience one to remember. I would highly recommend this resort to anyone. Also, I would recommend getting Royal Service, it does cost a little extra, but it is worth the extra cost. The extra cost goes a long way and makes life a lot easier. Two of us did not originally get Royal Service, but the manager gave us a reasonable deal.
As for the staff, Daniel, Rode, and Victor were awesome and made the experience even better!  These three made sure all of the girls had what we needed.  We could not have asked for three better people to assist us while staying in Cancun/Paradisus. When we needed something they were right there ready to get us whatever we needed. They took care of all our needs from drinks to dinner reservations. Those three guys took great care of us and we could not ask for better hosts! 
 Honestly, I have no complaints from the stay at Paradisus.  We all felt extremely safe, which was big concern for all of us since we were all girls.

reviews.author: samira s
reviews.title: Terrible experience , very disappointed !
reviews.text: Nothing good I can say about this hotel . Hotel is very dark , rooms are terrible and nothing works(plugs, AC, shower ,...) and the biggest problem was the noise .. Our room was too noisy at night so non of us could get a sleep and that ruined our all next day with kids being so tired ... Even after we changed our room it was the same . NO RELAXATION ... I'm very disappointed .... Service is terrible . I told all my friends about this worst experience at Paradisus and don't want any of my loved ones go through what we went . It was supposed to be a relax and fun vacation .

reviews.author: Helenore G
reviews.title: Amazing place, amazing staff
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed at the Paradisus for our 25 wedding anniversary. This is a beautiful resort with lovely grounds and restaurants. My only complaint is that the beach was full of seaweed and not much was done to clear it for guests.
We ate at 3 of the restaurants on site as well as the buffet and have absolutely not complaints about any one of them. The food was amazing and the staff great. Our favorite restaurant was Bana, the Japanese restaurant,we ate there twice, the food was amazing. Our waiter Miguel was so great our first night that we asked to be seated at his table on our second visit, he was amazing worked very hard and went out of his way to bring us a special desert for our anniversary. He went above and beyond just fantastic. 
The drinks were plentiful and in no way watered down like some resorts, even top shelf liquor was included a nice touch. 
We booked this hotel on a time share promotion, so we had to sit through a 90 minute presentation.... I was prepared for the worst and a hard sell, but surprised that it was not bad at all. I made it clear that it was not for us and that was it , the agent shook our hands and said thank you very much, and we were on our way. 
Overall a beautiful resort great food great Drinks and great staff. I would not hesitate to stay here again and inwould recommend it to anyone.

reviews.author: Nick F
reviews.title: Wonderful getaway!
reviews.text: This place is wonderful. We had royal service and it was well worth it. Our butler was Hervik and he was amazing. He had no hesitation with any requests and was extremely kind. Hervik is a wonderful representation of the company and the royal service experience. While he was not around, Gustavo made our stay beyond memorable. He was extremely knowledgeable and very friendly whether it was outside by the bar or inside of the royal service lounge. His response time for things was very quick and would gladly come visit again, even if I only encountered these two gentlemen. Overall, it was a great stay and look forward to staying again as my yearly getaway.

reviews.author: Grainneoflynn
reviews.title: Always amazing
reviews.text: This is my third time to this particular resort, I am a club melia member and have gone to some of their other resorts, my daughter and I keep coming back here because we just love it. The people are so friendly, special mention to Marco, Pablo and Victor in the Naos buffet. Arturo and Angel who made my daughters vacation one to remember every time. Our butler Pablo who took care of everything from reservations to a birthday surprise for my 14 year old. We are still here and are staying 15 days, ocean view room was breathtaking and the ocean breeze at night coupled with the sound of the waves, removed any stress I may have been feeling. The food is incredible and I own a very popular French restaurant in Manhattan and am picky, no complaints. When my boyfriend comes we have been offered a couples massage as a gift. I love this place. I'm sure I'm forgetting people to thank but thank you anyway Grainne from Manhattan

reviews.author: Ladi J
reviews.title: Luv this place
reviews.text:
My husband and I luv this place.  The service is beautiful. The 1st time we stayed was Nov 2011 for our honeymoon.  Our room had a jacuzzi on the balcony and it was Amazing. We took our wedding photos there and the scenery was great!
  The second time we stayed we were in the red level adult only area. Although I loved the personal check in and breakfast options I would have luv to have the jacuzzi room. 
The staff remembered my husband and I and again the serve was amazing!!!!!

reviews.author: Shelley W
reviews.title: Average Hotel/Service
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying that My husband and I have been to Cancun/Playa Del Carmen about 7 times over the past 10 years. We have always stayed in AI resorts....I rate Paradisus average....this resort is NOT a 5 star resort I am sorry to say. 
We booked a OV suite as we were traveling with our 17 month old. The room was a nice size and enabled us to keep our daughter in a separate sleeping area which was great. The OV while beautiful is limited to standing because of the design of the balcony you cannot sit down and see the ocean. If I was to ever stay here again I would NOT waste my money on OV because of this. When I booked OV I want to be able to sit on my balcony and enjoy the view.
We also booked Family Concierge. While Ramon was very helpful and nice....I would not waste my money on this either. Unless you plan on calling your butler constantly and asking for stuff...you really don’t need this.
