The backpack and bucket with sand toys was nice but honestly not worth very much...certainly not the cost of the upgrade. The cookies and milk at night was a joke...first two nights we didn’t even get it and its milk that you already have in your fridge and one pathetic looking cookie that didn't taste like much. I called several times (3-4) to get my husband a different pillow and as per the benefits of family con. you get a "pillow menu" which we were never given or offered....anyway we never did receive a new pillow after asking 3-4 times for a new one. 
Since we had to travel around with a stroller...the elevator situation was annoying...long wait times due to the staff using the elevator. Probably because its an older hotel and they don’t have service elevators but just a note...if you will be using a stroller...this can be frustrating at times.
We didn’t have a problem with getting a Palapa at the pool every day because my husband was down there at 5:30-6 am putting out our things....but the pool/beach is very busy so get up early and reserve your spot or you will not have one.
Food was average...not bad but nothing spectacular either...the specialty restaurants were OK...my favorites were Mole (Luis our waiter there twice was GREAT) and Market Grill for Brazilian Steak experience. all others were just average for us.
Lunch pretty much option was buffet...or Taco place (which was pretty good too). First day we were there Market Grill had a menu and it was very good but after that they never had a menu there again and only served hamburgers and pizza?
Seaweed is bad for sure and kind of ruined the beach but hey its mother nature. Resorts were all seemed to do a good job at keeping it under control. 
Pool temp was pretty warm for my taste not very refreshing. Service at pool area was ok...not fastest but not terrible either.
We like our coffee…as I am sure most people do...aside from coffee being out at Naos in the morning before bfast....it is VERY difficult to get coffee at lunch/dinner time...you will get it...it just takes a while and it seems hard to get cream instead of milk as well. Mainly what I mean is you can’t get a coffee on the run...unless you are sitting down in the restaurant you can’t get a coffee? All of the other places we have stayed had coffee house type place where you could always get a coffee no matter time of day.

Overall this was a nice trip...just average not 5 star in our opinion. Was a decent quality for price paid. Staff was friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Tytti85
reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This was my first time in all inclusive hotel. The hotel itself is beautiful and kept clean. Because the center of the main pyramid is very open it doesn't feel like normal hotel at all. Food in the restaurants was good and I'm sure everyone will find something suitable for their taste. Fridge in the room was filled everyday with drinking water and sodas etc, which was really nice (included in the hotel price). Best thing about this hotel is the amazingly beautiful beach! I saw the beach in different spots along the hotel zone, and it is not that pretty everywhere. I could have stayed forever in the beach looking at the beautiful ocean. When we wanted to go further from the hotel (but inside the hotel zone) we used the buses which are running very often and one bus stop is right in front of the hotel. It is very easy to use and really handy (one way costs 1USD). I have only two negative things to comment about this hotel: 1) we had a balcony facing the lagoon and it would have been nice to sit there, but we didn't have any chairs or sunbeds in the balcony, which was bit disappointing and 2) there are not enough sunbeds in the pool area or in the beach for all hotel guests, so you need to go really early (before 8am) to reserve a chair for you (I know, there are signs that it is not allowed to reserve any chairs and items will be removed from chairs if nobody shows up in 30 minutes, but after two days we also started to reserve the chairs since everyone else was doing it also and we never saw that anyone's items would have been removed). Otherwise the hotel was perfect for our vacation. And I still have to mention this once more: the beach in front of the hotel is just amazing!

reviews.author: Sylvia R
reviews.title: Disappointed in  Paradisus
reviews.text: Travelled with grown daughter on July 5-12  .Upon registering was given Pyramid 3 which I said I didn NOT  want because of noise.Clerk at reception said that we had a quiet room on floor 6.It was very  noisy with music-- .so next morning my daughter went to reception & we were given a room in Pyramid 2 facing parking lot.We kept that room as it was quiet & easy to get to pool.     Waiters in Naos were excellent -as was food  So we ate all our meals in Naos--Orlando ,excellent waiter .We   could not   swim in ocean--red flags up every day & beach was covered in seaweed.  No one cleaned away the weeds as they did in the hotel next door.. Therefore pools were crowded & there were many children there.Pool water was very warm.

reviews.author: 95Moore
reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: upgraded to royal service, well worth the extra money. However, wasted quite a bit of time listening to "how the hotel can provide discounts" if we sit through a 90 minutes sales pitch...not worth it.  Our butler, Rodrigo was great. Our waiter on the beach, Gustavo was excellent as well. Food was good. Pool could have been cooler. Spa service was wonderful.

reviews.author: Gerardo A
reviews.title: Summer vacation
reviews.text: Service was very good at the best time staff waiters everybody was generous made me feel want to go back and visit food was great quite a few restaurants to pick from and the resort the bars were located all in a good areas and they offer good packages to go see and do many activities would recommend to everybody

reviews.author: travelbug696
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: Rooms dated and in terrible disrepair. Mold on ceiling over shower with bulging ceiling plaster which burst and the faulty pipe sprayed water all over the bathroom and its electrical outlets and electric mirror lights! Hairdryer didn't work and had to be replaced. Towels in our room were very random. We are a family of 4 and some days were given 1 hand towel and 2 bath towels. Some days 2 wash clothes, no hand towels? Our "lagoon view" was a ground floor view of a car park. Our 4 yr old was not permitted to play in the Kid Zone with his 5 yr old brother Amanda we were told he could play in the Baby Room which was not suitable for a child over the age of 2. Having stayed at the wonderful Paradisus La Esmerelda in Playa Del Carmen, the Cancun Paradisus was a big disappointment.

reviews.author: LuxWorldTraveler
reviews.title: A place to stay and have fun not luxurious
reviews.text:
This is an hotel about 30-40 years old which I am sure was very luxurious then but not any more. The maintenance is not well done and the place plus rooms is very tired and old. All inclusive Hotel food buffet with a lot of variety of dishes
Really good attentive service from all the employees, Most of the employees are of the older generation. The drink service is top notch as they serve premium drinks also. 

Here is the not so good.....went for a weekend and could not rent a cabana claiming they are all booked already. It seems you must book a cabana months in advance before you are even planning in going to Cancun which is pretty ridiculous.  After making a big fuss they finally where able to scrap one. There are not enough cabanas and lounge chairs at the pool. The food is not of high quality dining. The place is old and needs a major renovation from the lobby to the pool and back. Wifi very slow and remember their are 800 rooms. If they were to invest in renovating the whole place it can be something good but you will feel like in the 80s as of now.

reviews.author: 7toddwilson7@gmail.com
reviews.title: Excellent Vacation Experience...AGAIN
reviews.text: My family of 5 has stayed at the Paradisus Cancun 6 times over the past decade.  Each visit gets better and better.  Marco and Alejandro at Naos Restaurant provided incredible service daily, and always had well wishes and a smile when we started our day at breakfast.  We upgraded our Melia Club membership for a 2nd time as well.  Glendy was a great Vacation Concierge, taking care of us so well.  The facility was clean, rooms spacious and clean, and the overall service excellent.  The drink service on the beach was great too.

reviews.author: Frank S
reviews.title: Fantastic Adventure
reviews.text:
Family of 4, two 12 year old twins. Stayed in family suite with butler, ocean view. 

We stayed for 8 days and I could write a book on how wonderful this hotel / resort is....but I think I am only going to focus on what others have tried to discuss that were negatives, and give you some insights into each. Again....This hotel was fantastic...and if we go back to Cancun, we would not hesitate to go back to the Paradisus and bring friends.  The Key word here is IF....and you need to wait until the end of this review to get more clarify on my IF statement.

- Check in : Our experience was fantastic. Again, with family concierge, it was a breeze. Sure I had to wait about 10 minutes for my turn. But in the mean time I drank 2 very needed cold beers and relaxed while my kids checked out the pool table and Xbox !!!! All went smooth. 

I think its important that I share with you something that I found VERY odd....considering all the reviews I read on TA.....and in fact I think this might get someone in trouble...I hope not....NOT ONCE......NOT ONE TIME was I ever asked to participate in ONE SINGLE meeting / event / presentation / review / discussion regarding a time share, excursions, spa, etc.....I have NO IDEA why....Trust me we are VERY normal (not trashy)..bordering classy..dare I say....looking family....And NOT ONCE did someone even remotely hit us up ? In fact.....about day 6...for about 5 minutes...started to wonder....why not ??? Am I not special !!!! LOL !!!! ...Let me be clear...I NEVER SAID ANYTHING to anyone about ANYTHING on the subject. 

OK....moving on:

Room: Our room was fantastic !!!! In fact, during the night the AC worked TOO WELL !!!!

Food: OMG....Im not saying they are 5 star restaurants....but we ate at everyone of them..(some 3 times) and they were really....really good !!!. Let me state that we are NOT big eaters...picky....like good service....but food is not our #1 priority. But with that....by far the Japanese restaurant is the best....but you have to keep in mind....my whole family loves Japanese food..... 

The Buffet : Again...I am really confused about who found this to be a problem !!! There are SOO many options and 90% are presented, served and or prepared perfectly. Not 100%..but my goodness...there have to be over 50 different main courses to choose from for breakfast, lunch and dinner !!!! So they don't get 3 of them perfect.....47 were. 

Shows: Fantastic. Is find a "perfect spot" to watch a bit difficult....yes....but my goodness....there are plenty of spots to watch..if its important that you are on first row...show up 15 minutes early. 

Wifi : Was super fast in room. Very fast in hotel. Slow to non existent outside. (of course) 

Noise from center area: Our room was in main pyramid. Noise is from 8pm-9:30pm...What in the heck are you doing in your room ???Go watch the show, eat dinner walk on the beach...to the family room.....if your in at 8pm every night ...even then the noise is not THAT BAD....turn on a TV....I dont get this complaint.  

Service: Beach : Amazing. Give the guys a buck or two and they will treat you like royalty. I guess if you ignore them, or stiff them.....they might only come by to see you 20 or 30 times during the day...versus ever 5 minutes !!!!!

Service: Hotel: Generally very good. Only one time did I have a bad experience. But out of 300.....I would say one is pretty acceptable. And even that one got better on another day. 

Family Room: I am amazed that more families don't hang in there at night. (versus watching TV in room I guess??). But part of me is very glad, as it is small...but considering most nights it was us and one or two other families....it was fantastic...by the way..full open bar, food, pool table, xbox to play FIFA.....wow....

Butler: I just cant thank Ramon enough for all he did. I don't want to list all the things he did for my family above and beyond normal....as I don't want others to overwhelm him with the same requests !!!! LOL.....But thank you Ramon.....you were a great help. 

Dinner Reservations: Yes...this is a bit complex...but I think we figured it out...they have some how regulate the amount of food prep....if 50% guests go to the same restaurant on the same night.....they will run out of food in that restaurant and have to throw away food in others....so yes......but with a Bulter...all is easily discussed and if you find something you really like...they will really try to get you into that place more often. 

Drinks : Watered down ? Maybe..its hard to tell......the ice melts so fast that it could be that...but I never worried about it....I would just order a double, or drink more than one...

Pool chairs...oh ya...this is a big one on TA.......OK....here is the deal.....

Free version:
Pool chairs around pool that have shade : Will be gone by 7am
Pool chairs around pool without shade: Are available until about 10am
Chairs on beach with share...first row.......9am
Chairs on beach second row.....11am
Chairs on beach third row.....4pm...if ever

Bottom line if you need shade...well....go earlier......but I never understood why people are going to a SUNNY beach resort and complaining about the shade around the POOL !!! People....Its a BEACH RESORT IN CANCUN !!!!  Its hot !!!!

OK....MY ONLY complaint. And I really feel strongly about this...and I very much wish it was not a problem......

Lets talk about the BEACH and the famous SEAWEED. 

First...for 6 out of 8 days....Seaweed was heavy.....2 days it seemed much lighter. 

Now, I fully understand that the seaweed is an act of God....and not the hotel mgmt. However, what is under the hotels control is the service of CLEANING (which is basically burying) the seaweed. Over the 8 days we were there, there was a tractor that did a fantastic job cleaning the beach the FIRST DAY and the LAST DAY we were there. In between was 6 days of NOTHING. NO WORK, NO Tractor, NOTHING. Its clear to me that about 10+ hotels (or more) are all SHARING ONE tractor service. And it take this ONE TRACTOR GUY 6-8 days to get down the beach. Then he turns around and comes back again...hitting YOUR HOTELS beach...once over 6-7 days. This is ridiculous and should be an embarrassment to not only the mgmt. of the hotels, but to the Cancun tourist bureau. What would ANOTHER tractor cost ? $5000 a week perhaps ? As compared to $10's millions in operating costs...this would seem to be a reasonable expense. The beaches need to be cleared at least every other day for goodness sake. And please do not lecture me on turtles...the tractor clearly is not considering the turtles on the days they are cleaning (also the turtles are protected by a protected fence). I just think its lack of caring by mgmt. on this subject. 

So as you can tell....I am being honest about this review. 

4.5 Star hotel, people, service
4.0 star on food
1.0 star on beach maintenance. 

Lastly, we are beach people (why we always found a chair with shade)....and until this issue is resolved with mother nature....we will not be back....as we cannot count on hotel or city mgmt. to take care of the issue. 

This is the IF statement:

IF you NOT beach fanatics......then this is the resort you must go to in Cancun. 

IF you are.....I suggest waiting until mother nature is finished with this issue...Then book your room at Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Angel G
reviews.title: Amazing Place
reviews.text:
We stayed here for 5 days and each day was better than the day before. Because they overbooked our room they upgraded us at NO EXTRA CHARGE to Royal Service. We were given full access to all amenities, including adult only location and pool, butler service and concierge. The hotel is great, very clean and well maintained. On site entertainment every night, excellent restaurants and great food. 
The service is spectacular, EVERYONE wears a smile and is genuinely happy to serve you. Our butler Pedro was exceptional and always checking up on us, and I can't forget Manuel our server at Bana restaurant, he truly was the best of all.  This is our second visit to a Paradisus Resort (also Punta Cana, DR) and we plan to visit others. If you plan to vist bring plenty of sun block and leave the rest to the Paradisus staff, they will make your stay a memorable event.

reviews.author: Athope
reviews.title: Best vacation ever
reviews.text:
Not too many hotels have this great service.  Nightly show was great. Food was great, bartenders were great.  This was money well spent.  
Pros 
Location, service, shows, nightlife

Cons 
not the whole hotel interior is air conditioned
Wifi sucks
Some rooms are a far walk from pool and beach

reviews.author: Kelsey P
reviews.title: AMAZING!
reviews.text: We went here for our 2 year anniversary and everything was great!! We had an amazing time apart from the seaweed problem plus I also wish the pool water was colder since it was always really warm . We stayed at The Royal Service which was very fancy and always smelled great. Marcos was the best waiter at Naos as well! The buffet was amazing so many different types of food for breakfast,lunch and dinner. Everyone was friendly and always greeted us. The packages for the aqua world was also very fun,it was a bit expensive but well worth it. I do recommend this hotel to  everyone!

reviews.author: Tyler S
reviews.title: My wife and I had the time of our lives!
reviews.text: Hotel is beautiful, clean, classy, and fun!  The heart of this place is no doubt the staff.  The people are constantly working and couldn't seem to be happier to be doing it.  They certainly appreciate the tips as their salaries are meager; but NEVER did we feel that they lingered or begged for a tip, which says a lot about the overall staff's character.  They consistently say "Hola or Buenos dias" and always with a smile and/or with a hand over their hearts.  There is a lot of seaweed but come on get over it, once you get out like 10 feet you're past the seaweed and we certainly enjoyed the beautiful, warm water; and never had we seen such BLUE water! Our only complaint would be the temperature of the pool, likely high 80's my guess is.  We thoroughly enjoyed the food, especially the buffet for breakfast and lunch, and we would like to extend our heartfelt thanks to Gaudencio at Naos, he was perfect! As was Mole and Market Grill for what we believed were our best dinners.  We took advantage of the gym and yoga throughout our week.  Our room was comfortable and well equipped.  One of our lights didn't work and maintenance was up in a matter of 1/2 hour at most to fix it.  We would suggest definitely calling early the day before to make dinner reservations as the restaurants fill up quickly. Also, the concierge, although EXREMELY helpful upon our arrival to the hotel, was very persistent in asking us to attend the Club Melia membership presentation.  At first we thought we might go just to get a coupon to use at the spa, but then we decided against it and we felt that their attitude changed towards us as soon as we declined and that we had to almost avoid them in order to not feel uncomfortable.  My advice would be to just decline from the beginning.  As far as the Royal service, we opted not to upgrade, we met some friends during our trip who did upgrade to the Royal service and although they said it was wonderful, we had many of the same experiences and definitely did not feel that we would have received better service in any area, we had top service throughout our stay.Overall, an amazing, fun, relaxing, beautiful vacation.  We cannot wait to go back!

reviews.author: Traveleverywherenow
reviews.title: Having a great stay so far so good
reviews.text:
Having a great stay so far, all concerns that we had beforehand were unfounded.

Planning is everything look at reviews and act on the sensible ones , try to book in advance for evening meals or ASAP as it is a busy resort for fine dinning restaurants ,

Staff have been friendly and responsive to all our needs.

Place is spotless and has enough capacity so far in terms of beds and even the sumptuous Bali beds can be obtained without to much trouble.

Food in Italian was great but the service was better.

Sushi restaurant was ace , the teppanyaki was also fine. We turned up late after visiting Chichen Itza 

Quality Drinks  & food are free flowing and abundant.  Staff Always change your order to suit around eg no mayo etc.

Used the

Service around the pool is endless , great place for people with younger children , say up to 16 years + 

Older teams well catered for with kayaking , beach football and volley ball

Beautiful resort.

Been out a couple of times to have a change of scene but it feels good getting back here.

reviews.author: ExpertLuxuryTraveler
reviews.title: Disapointing!
reviews.text:
Poor!  Dirty room, very old, bad food quality, VERY BAD SERVICE, very rude staff. 
Not friendly with strollers or wheel chairs. 
Not a five star hotel like they say. Not worth to pay, there are much more better hotels in Cancun for the price. 
Have to fight to get something even that its all inclusive. 
Good quality of alcohol.

reviews.author: virginia085
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel. Great service. Wonderful vacation.
reviews.text: We stayed for 4 nights in mid August and had a great experience. I would highly recommend booking into the Royal Service for your stay. The hotel is truly beautiful and commands a long stretch of prime beachfront. We watched dozens of hotel workers combing the beach of seaweed to make the view and swimming that much more enjoyable (not every hotel neighbor did this).  Our room was well appointed, the air conditioning was more than adequate, and and oceanfront view spectacular. The service is truly exceptional and elevates this hotel to a cut above. Valeria at the beach side La Palapa restaurant, where Royal Service Guests have breakfast and lunch, particularly deserves recognition for making every meal special with her friendliness, and attention to detail. Edier couldn't have been more attentive at providing great drinks and snacks poolside. And I also want to give kudos to Rigoberto and Rody at Mole restaurant and Martin at Fuego. We enjoy fine dining, by the way, and were not disappointed by the restaurants at this hotel. Honestly, the only negative was our experience with the butler service. As this is a feature highly touted by the hotel, I would recommend that they provide a butler who is on duty during your stay. When we arrived Erich was already off for the day, but stayed around long enough to make our dinner reservations for the week (not the times we wanted so we visited the concierge desk to alter them). We had tipped him generously upon meeting him, but we were  very surprised to see that he hadn't particularly arranged for our Bali beds and we were pretty much on our own to make these arrangements. He had a day off the third day we were there but by then we were used to  going to the concierge desk and making our own arrangements. These were minor blips. Loved our experience and would highly recommend Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Robin B
reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.text: Just returned from Paradisus, took a trip with family and friends.( all girls) the resort is beautiful,the beach was incredible. The rooms are nice ,but we could never get the A/C to a comfortable temp in any of our rooms( we were in building 3) it was very frustrating. Cancun is obviously hot in Aug and we had no where except the water to get any relief from the heat , as the common areas of the resort are ALWAYS very hot and humid. We liked the 24 hour buffet, we visited the other eateries a couple times . It is just too difficult to make a reservation and the times aren't convenient, too early or too late ( interfere with the show times ) Speaking of the show's....  The shows were OK, but the space they have them in is way to small, never anywhere to sit, and when standing you can't see well. Customer service is top notch around the pool area😊 maid service was good , except they never gave us wash cloths, and one day we ask for extra coffee and she told us to order room service ( WRONG answer). I feel improvements could be made to help make things more convenient and pleasant for the vacationer. I wouldn't say I would not return or recommend, but I would say I have stayed at other places in Cancun that I enjoyed more .

reviews.author: GFR2011
reviews.title: Go for the "Royal Service". You can't go wrong.
reviews.text:
I have just been at the Paradisus Cancún for five nights, staying at the building #5, which is the one reserved for "Royal Service" guests. Though the hotel has been around for quite a while, it still is in great condition. Both room and bathroom were large and were generously equipped. The 10sqm terrace offered direct sea view and plenty of privacy. The room features an efficient AC, free mini-bar which was daily refilled, flatscreen TV, free safe, ironing equipment, Nespresso coffe machine, king-size bed, bathrobe, slippers and towels intended for the pool/beach as well as for the Spa.

I especially enjoyed the food. Outstanding quality and variety. I wouldn't mind to stay there for a couple of weeks more. But best of all, the service. All employees are extremely friendly and costumer focused. They made me feel home away from home.

Absolutely recommendable. As mentioned in the title, you can't go wrong choosing this resort.

reviews.author: Kristina E
reviews.title: Best wedding ever! And vacation
reviews.text: I have been to this resort twice now. This time I had my wedding there. I had Lourdes as my romance coordinator. She did an awesome job! Everything was perfect and we had no problems at all on our wedding day. We even brought extra items like a cake topper and she took care of putting it on the cake for us. For being in Mexico, this resort actually has food that tastes good. I have been to Mexico to all inclusive resorts seven times now and I am always starving by the time we leave because the food is so much different than what I am used to. But at Paradisus I even enjoyed the food. I will be back for a third time for sure!

reviews.author: Can K
reviews.title: Superb Beach, Superb Hotel
reviews.text:
My family stayed at Paradisus for 8 days the last week in August and had a superb time. We choose Melia based on our experience at Punta Cana's Reserve Paradisus and this one was very comparable to our Punta Cana Experience. We stayed at a 1 bedroom Family Concierge with a 1.5, 5 and 7 year old children. In summary, a fabulous experience with superb service. I read in some reviews that the hotel needed upgrades, but in my opinion it is in superb shape. If you are from the U.S., it is comparable to Intecontinental hotels.

Pros: Super clean and high end everything. Service was awesome with everyone being extremely friendly. No different than any place you go, tips are recommended for good service. 

Negatives: The only negative is that in high season you have to wake up early and reserve lounges at the pool or on the beach if you want shade, or you can rent a cabana for $50. This really is minor as all resorts have similar issues.

Food: Each restaurant we went to was excellent. I am in food service and you can tell that the staff is very well trained. The food quality was certainly above average. All you can eat buffet offers great rotating selections. 

Bar: High end liquor and easy access to drinks all day long. Friendly and accessible bar staff.

Kid's club: Not as good as Punta Cana because it was indoors, but the staff was great and they have more than enough activities. You can also arrange a baby sitter for younger than 5 year olds for $15 per hour - it is worth it as they are well trained and caring.

Hotel areas: Very clean and shiny marble floors wherever you go - outstanding.

reviews.author: Tathyana P
reviews.title: Great restaurants!
reviews.text:
I was in Paradisus for a 6 day vacation with mi fiancée and we both LOVED the whole scenarion in this hotel. The room itself was OK, nothing special... but the central space, filled with plants and a restaurants were amazing. 
Best of:
1) Restaurants within the hotel - call reservations as soon as you get there to book one of the fine restaurants for dinner - Bana (best ambient), Fuego (best food), Mole (real mexican cousine) and Vento (tapas). Do this every morning when you get up
2) Beach in front of the hotel - white sand, clear water... it's worthwhile to take a snorkel gear to spot cute fish groups
3)Snorkel in Puerto Morelos - 75USD for a half day tour in a national park with amazing reef and colorful fishes, turtle, etc. Go for PuertoTours and ask for Rudi - he is the best! only takes small groups of up to 10 - explains everything you need to know about snorkel gear and the location. 

Not so great:
1) Garrafon in Isla Mujeres: maybe we were poorly informed, but the snorkeling was really disappointing - the food was awful. The location itself is beautiful, though. We liked the hang out spots as the infinity pool facing the ocean.
2) Dolphin Discovery - we payed over 150USD each to "swim" with dolphins and take home the pictures. Each adult performed 5 different tricks with a dolphin, two of them were really amazing - we felt like a sea world trainer! what threw us off was that it was really expensive for so little time. It's one of those things where you really feel like cattle... I hate that kind of tourism but I just had to fulfill a long time dream :-)

5 1/2 days were great to relax and get to know a little bit of Cancun, but we will definitely come back (probably to the same hotel) with more time to discover more attractions!

reviews.author: K N
reviews.title: Greatest beach resort in Cancun
reviews.text: I have visited Cancun more than a dozen times, and stayed a tat least 10 different hotels. This was my second stay at Paradisus Cancun, and I decided to make it my permanent choice for future visits. In addition to the obvious aspects such as the great beach front location and magnificent building, the restaurant offerings are amazing, and the staff highly professional and very friendly. I particularly recommend Royal Service for travelers seeking a more private experience and exclusive service.

reviews.author: Silvia J
reviews.title: Overall Good
reviews.text:
My husband and my two boys booked a week here.  Although my husband and I were skeptical, we were less concerned since it was a vacation more related for our 5 and 7 year old boys.  Despite this we found that most of the critics and comments throughout this site were dead on. We have been to Cancun before and our general feel of most of the people there is that they are constantly trying to sell you something or want something from you.  That said the Melia club sell was very heavy duty but most of the people were very nice and very pleasant.  The rooms were clean although the beds did show the actual 20 + years of the hotel.  these were old style and not very comfortable.  The food was overall very good and had a lot of variety, the sushi restaurant was particularly good. Although we did not think of getting Pool cabanas because we were spending most days just in the pool with the boys, we decided to do it for the last two days and we feel it was worth every penny.  The comfort and shade outside of the pool was great but mostly we had Sofonia and Enrique Alcudia bringing us food and service and for us they made the whole experience better than we could have imagined.  They were service oriented, if we were in the pool they would come and seek us out to make sure we were never hungry or thirsty.  For us throughout the pool service they were far and away the show stealers.  We even asked for our cabanas to be there the next day just so we could be in their designated area.
Another wonderful surprise that we found were the evening shows in the Avenue lounge.  The variety was great and the performers were really good.  
Perhaps our only real complaints throughout was the constant calls to our room and selling pitches throughout and the very lacking and boring kids zone area.  
As long as others go with the same frame of mind as we did, we would recommend going as a it is a overall a good stay.

reviews.author: GMANNJ
reviews.title: First vacation in a long time and this place is worth it!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun from August 7th to 14th. The review below is by me and the most honest review you will find.

Ok let me start off by saying the Cancun is a great choice for Summer and August. Its hot and humid but more of a reason to get you in a pool or the beach. The airport to the resort was 15 minutes. We actually received transfers from the resort itself. 

Room and Check in:
When we arrived, we were sent to the family concierge lounge. It was awesome. The entrance was nice and the room had things for the kids and snacks to eat. We received our info and our $1500 credits. With the family concierge package, we get our cellphone where we can call our butler whenever we needed him. More on that later. We paid for a room with an ocean view family concierge room. We received our info and the first room was room 3001. Now that room is right next to the stairs closest to the lobby. There would be too much noise at night time and not the ideal place for 2 young kids to stay. So I asked them to move me. That part baffles me. I know the logic is to have the family concierge rooms close to where everything is so parents don’t have to travel a lot but right where the noise is shouldn’t be the ideal location. So I asked them to move me to Tower 1. When we arrived to the room, it was awesome. Not the biggest room but we didn’t care. It was enough for us to have the crib(that they provided) and the big bed for us to share. The view was awesome. I mean seeing the ocean and overlooking the kid pool was perfect. We even had a whirlpool on the outside balcony. It was perfect. The fridge was stocked with drinks for adults and kids. Bathroom was clean and the tv was nice(we didn’t even turn it on). 

Grounds:
It was nice and clean. The area was clean and had no issues. The pools were deep in the adult area. 6 feet but great for swimming. The pool for the kids was great. Nice enough for them to play and keep them occupied. The bali beds were great (you can only get bali beds on one side as the bali beds facing the ocean are only for club Melia members). I recommend getting them every day. I mean you go big or go home. They weren’t bad either. The water was warm and that’s just a no brainer because its hot as hell out there. The beach was awesome to. Clean sand and the water was clear.  The seats are saved in the morning with a towel and an item. And I stress the item because people tried to save seats with just a towel and that’s just a big no according to their policy. DON’T DO THAT. They will take your towel and the seat won’t be saved anymore.  

Food:
Now this is a toss up. I mean I wasn’t expecting 5 star Gordon Ramsey food but food that will be different than what I would get at home and food that will keep me fueled the week. They delivered. I mean the restaurants were good. Not great but good. The breakfast buffet is the way to go for the morning. Get everything you can and from waffles to eggs to croissants. Btw, the croissants are freaking amazing. Get them!!! For lunch its either the restaurant in between the pools or the buffet or the hot dogs and hamburgers with chips and guac. I mean don’t expect hot dogs to be from gray papayas or hamburgers from Bobby Vanns. Its their version of meat and bread. But again, it did the job when we were hungry. The restaurants at night were good. There is the buffet that offers decent food at night and again hits the spot with all the things you need. As for the particular restaurants, I recommend Vento and their shrimp risotto. Bana for their delicious sushi. Mole had some good lamb chops. There is also a BBQ outside by the pool and that was the best. I mean they don’t mention it on the website but ask for it. It was like a BBQ in the summer.  Meat, chicken, Pork chops, potato and etc. It was the best. For my anniversary, I also had requested a dinner by the ocean. That was top notch and provided a great view and moment I will never forget. 

The staff:
As I said before, we received a butler as part of the family concierge package. His name is Hervik and he is the best of the best. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND HERVIK. He provided my family the best vacation we had in a long time. I mean when you go away with two young kids, you don’t want to worry about much because you are preoccupied already with them. You want everything done and taken care of. He did that. With a quick call, he will help you make reservations or come wherever you are at the resort. He provided the bali beds when you wanted it and even saved seats for me when I couldn’t. He is the best at what he does and again I highly recommend Hervik. The guy deserves a raise. If you want your experience to be the best, get Hervik to take care of you the whole week. As for the rest of the staff, they were nice and helpful. Always said good morning or evening. They help you with a smile and do their best to accommodate you with anything you need. They will even get you bacon or sausages in the buffet breakfast if you ask for it. So don’t think they don’t have it. They do. Jamie from the breakfast buffet was great. Got us anything we wanted as special request. At the dinner by the ocean, our server was great. Got us extra soup and any drink we wanted. He made the dinner that much better. 

My only complaints:
Now listen, while I  said the staff was great, there was another staff that were a bit annoying. The ladies with the white outfits in the desks in different places are nice to you but they also want to lure you in for a Club Melia pitch. I mean they will hound you every morning for our “Welcome package”. Be careful because there is no welcome package unless you already met with your concierge. They are nice and will help you get around the place but they want to lure you into a conversation with a Club Melia rep.  Now onto the Club Melia promotion, I wasn’t interested from the beginning. Its basically a time share but they aren’t calling it that. We had a guy named Paco give us the pitch. They was extremely nice and a class act. He knew the stuff and knew the talk. Now this is where I become alittle picky on this issue.  We had a private breakfast at one of the restaurants in the morning. This restaurant was closed off just for club melia breakfast meetings. Going in there, it was nice but to see that the premium breakfast items like bacon and sausages and other items were just for these meetings kind of rubbed me the wrong way. I didn’t pay 2 dollars for my premium experience. I paid a ton of money to at least get those items for breakfast without me having to ask the waiter to get it for me.  So again, me being nit picky but it did rub me the wrong way. Paco was great and a stand up guy. The club Melia pitch was just bad and too expensive for my liking. The whole thing was like buying a car. Once Paco couldn’t give me the price, he got a manager to come out and try to seal a deal with a “great” price. It wasn’t a great price and how people get these things is beyond me. The manager was a bit rude and not what I expected. They will then sell you another deal of a great stay at another resort for a price. Again, I declined. Felt bad for Paco but his manager wasn’t the nicest person. 

Summary:
Would I go again? Heck yeah… it was one of the best times I had. From the resort to the food to the butler to the weather, this was an awesome time. I will definitely go again and I recommend this place to anyone with kids under 5. Just stay away from the Club Melia pitch unless you want it that bad.

reviews.author: DCW
reviews.title: Very Satisfied With Our Stay
reviews.text:
I have nothing but wonderful things to say about resort. The entire resort remained clean, smelled delightful, and the staff was very nice to everybody! They all do a great job with the upkeep of this resort. During our check-in I requested our room to be located in pyramid 3 and beach front view. Most of the restaurants are located in pyramid 3, along with the kid zone, boutiques, lobby, etc. 
Once we were checked in, a staff member came over and spoke to us about the resort and what it offers. Not sure if this happens on certain days or this gets offered to everybody but please be aware that some way, somehow, they will try to offer you the timeshare. She did this by tricking us into going to a “FREE” royal service breakfast, and it would only take 90min of our time. So we went ahead and made our free breakfast reservation. They called our room numerous times to remind us about breakfast and slipped a reminder note underneath our door. After that point, we realized it was a timeshare scam so we didn’t go to breakfast the next morning after all. 
The room was fresh and clean. As long as your doors remain closed, the ac keeps running. It automatically shuts off once the entrance door or sliding doors remain open. We never had any issues with the AC or the room being too hot. Our room always stayed cool. We never had issues taking baths or showers as well. I mention it because the last resort we stayed at in Playa Del Carmen was very frustrating. They had horrible water foundation. Very little water would come out and when it did I would constantly have to turn the knobs because either the water was very cold or very hot. 
I also want to add that the resort (or at least in pyramid 3) was not as hot as stated on some feedback. Just my personal opinion.
We were not big fans of the cuisine buffet (no reservation needed), as they did not have a big selection and served a lot of the same dishes daily. Blue Agrave is another restaurant that does not require reservation. They served posole soup, shrimp soup, and a verity of tacos. We actually enjoyed that restaurant better than the cuisine buffet. The snack bar near the pool was delicious!! They served nachos, hot dogs, burgers, and their guacamole is the BEST! 
They have a huge family pool with a swim up bar. My son had a great time and met a lot of new friends to play with. There’s a section where the pool is nose deep (I’m 5.4ft) and the round section was not as deep. There’s people out there at 6:30am in the morning reserving chairs with straw umbrellas by placing their towels, floaties, shoes, or books, then go back up to their room or have breakfast or whatever they have to do. Well I noticed this going on and I honestly do not think it’s fair! We are out there at 8am ready to lay out and relax and there is no chairs with the straw umbrella available.  Yet, the pool is almost completely empty… How is that possible??? There was a set of lounge chairs with the straw umbrella that had a deflated floatie (meaning that was reserved already). So I moved the deflated floatie out of the way and sat there instead. Minute & hours passed and nobody claimed their deflated floatie or “their” spot. That is my only rant but this had nothing to do with the resort. It’s the people that do this kind of stuff. 
Overall, we enjoyed our stay and would recommend it to anybody. We loved it!!!

reviews.author: Leonora C
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Best time and experience .service was perfect. Everyone was so friendly.also almost everyone knower how to speak English that was amazing because we don't speak Spanish the room was not to big not too little the bed was comfortable

reviews.author: Stacey R
reviews.title: Nice stay in royal service but a few things....
reviews.text:
Beautiful beach, loved the royal service pool/restaurant staff, Javier, Eddy, Valerie, Karina and Francisco!  Butler service, ok....helpful day one to get first few restaurant reservations but found for Bali bed reservations (these are great) was more effective to speak directly with pool concierge just as it was for spa info. Saw our butler In the morning the first three days, shift changed to afternoons, barely saw him when it did. 

Rooms are nice, clean and up to date, no tv in sitting area so have to watch from bed (can't turn it) .  
Room cleaning....so far of five days four have been after 4 or 5pm......we are out by 730am.....not observant as other hotels can be to notice we are out early and might appreciate our rom being done earlier in the day.....actually had to call one day for service.

Restaurants, nice selection, loved the royal service pool restaurant for breakfast and lunch ..great service and food. 

Spa is nice, bar and lounge sound great, music played is great, very relaxing, nice staff and overall very good vacation. 

Wouldn't book through air canada reservations...rep is never here.

reviews.author: Antonio y Naty
reviews.title: Unique experience that must enjoyed more than once!
reviews.text:
My fiancé and myself booked this place cause the great reputation Paradisus has around the world and we decided to go with the Royal Service. Upon our arrival we were greeted by Mauricio that explained in the outmost detail what our next couple of days would be like, he was great by the way always on top of everything. The Royal Service is located in a different building from the regular hotel rooms, making this area more exclusive for adults. When we checked in our butler took all out reservations for the upcoming days in the restaurants and did not forget one single detail, we were celebrating our anniversary so ERICK our butler made sure we had something in our room he has outstanding. We did spend some of our days outside the hotel, but Erick was always attentive and made sure we had what we needed. We do have to give a special thanks to Aide which helped us with a minor inconvenience we had, the air conditioner in the first room they gave us was not working well and Aide was on top of that; 10 minutes later we had a different room and that was great! Thanks Aide! We had dinner at all the restaurants and everyone had great knowledge on the plates in the restaurant, but some restaurants like Fuego, Vento and Mole the portions are small; delicious but smalls so order as much as you like. Naos has the all day buffet and it was very good, the amount of different meals they had during the day was outstanding. The last day the Hotel was great we stayed at the pool all day we were greeted by Pedro the pool concierge that was awesome, we arrived late for our reserved cabana but he was able to get us something near the pool and had tons of information about the food at the restaurant we wanted to order lunch and even helped with our drinks. Later that night we had dinner at Mole which is the Mexican restaurant and it was GREAT! Plus Sonia the hostess made our dinner even better, she explained every little detail of the restaurant and the food. Sonia went by our table also asking if we needed anything, she was amazing made our dinner even better than it was. The guacamole at Mole was just the best I have ever had you could tell it was just made it was fresh as if they made it for you on the spot. 
If you want to enjoy Cancun at its finest you must stay at this property and of course the Royal Service, the luxury and the attention you get from all the staff at the hotel during your stay is outstanding. This area is for adults only and is nice, relaxing and free of noise "if you get what I mean" Don't get me wrong I have nothing against children but sometimes you just want to relax by the pool and have your drinks nice and quite. I have to admit that without Mauricio, Erick, Sonia, Octavio (Royal Service bartender) and Pedro (Pool concierge) our stay would not have been memorable. I have to recommend this hotel and the Royal Service, hands down great service and attention to detail. Once is never enough that's what I say...

reviews.author: Jack R
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradise
reviews.text: This place is by far the best place I have ever stayed at. I am a very picky person when it comes to hotels/resorts because I judge every little thing I can possibly find wrong, and I have to say there was nothing to complain about.  The rooms were very clean, hotel was super clean, always smelled amazing.  The staff is the friendliest I have ever experienced.  The food was AMAZING!!!!  I have stayed in great resorts in other places in Mexico and the US and this is the BEST so far.

reviews.author: Aude146
reviews.title: Amazing experience!
reviews.text: I just came back from Paradisus Cancun and my trip was amazing. The restaurants were beyond what I expected. As for the service whether at the beach, pool, restaurant, buffet or Lobey, it was excellent. The food at the buffet was also excellent. I loved the balcony and the rooms. The person at the concierge counter was always helpful. The shows during the evening were great. I had a lot of fun and I recommend this to everyone. Thank you

reviews.author: Thomas K
reviews.title: Absolute Paradise
reviews.text: 7 of us went to Cancun to celebrate a birthday and a graduation, and had a great time.  We stayed in the Royal Service adults only section.  We were pampered by the hotel butlers and other staff for 5 days.  The food was very good, and the hotel was clean and well kept.  A special thanks to Sergio, Cesar, and Francisco for taking such good care of all of us.

reviews.author: John H
reviews.title: would not return
reviews.text: Went to Paradisus Cancun for a wedding.  We had 30 people staying and the first thing they asked went we checked in was if we wanted to upgrade for $200 we said no and then they gave us the same upgrade for free.  Then they give you a coupon book so you can spend all your money at the resort. They screwed up the rehearsal dinner and then tried to charge us more money for the dinner then the wedding was going to cost.  Only after contacting every major person in the corporation was that resolved.

reviews.author: Kevin D
reviews.title: Loved Paradisus Cancun Royal Service
reviews.text:
My wife and I just completed a week long stay at Paradisus in Cancun in August 2014.  In a word, the experience was spectacular.  We went with the Royal Service and we highly recommend this for anyone planning to stay at the resort and not traveling with children.  We have stayed at other all-inclusive resorts, but never in the adult only atmosphere of the Royal Service.  It is beyond compare.  The level of service, relaxation, and amenities are phenomenal! Right when you check in they serve you a welcoming glass of champagne.  It was certainly a nice tough. The private pool area with the bali beds is the ultimate in relaxation and the private Royal Service restaurant by the pool, Palapas, offers great food and is just so convenient.  Palapas is open for lunch and breakfast, both of which have a great selection of delicious food.  The Royal Service lobby also has a mini-breakfast buffet set up, all day snacks/fruit, and desserts and appetizers in the evening.  They also have a bar set up where you can make your own drink any time during the day.  This is just the tip of the iceberg!

The food at the restaurants we at ate was amazing.  I literally ate some of the best food I have ever tasted in my life at Paradisus.  Our favorite restaurant was Fuego.  The portions are small, but you can order all you want.  I highly recommend the crab cake soup, beef, duck, and grouper.  The passion fruit dessert (I don't remember exactly what it was called) was the best.  The service is also great.  We ate there twice during our stay and after having him the first night, we had to request Martin to be our waiter the second night.  He is top notch and so kind.  Bana is great if you love sushi, which my wife and I do.  Vento offers delicious food too, but again portions are very small.  Our waiter let us know this right away and we were ordered three appetizers and three entrees apiece.  I again would recommend the sea bass, the duck, and the salmon mousse appetizer.  Also, the pumpkin custard was absolutely delicious for dessert.  The other restaurant we went to was Mole.  Again, the food was delicious.  I would recommend the lamb tacos and mole chicken.  The service at Mole was probably the best of all the restaurants we went to.  We want to give a special thanks to Rigo, Rody, and Sonia who were our servers and did a fantastic job.

Our personal butler was Hector and he did a spectacular job.  He got us everything we wanted and 3 of the nights on our stay set us up something special in our room for us to enjoy.  He would come and see as at our bali bed in the pool and always was concerned if we needed anything.  He got us reservations right away whenever we wanted them and whenever we made changes, he easily accommodated us.  He definitely gave us 5-star service and we would highly recommend him.  

Now, the butler works a normal shift and has days off, but there is always someone there to help if you need it.  The people at the Royal Service front desk are always there to help (Julie was very helpful our whole stay) and the other butlers helped us out as well (a special thanks to Galadino, who was always very helpful when Hector was off).  

The Royal Service at the pool is what really set apart the experience for us.  The Palapas restaurant (and private breakfast buffet) simply made things so convenient and allowed us to maintain the exclusive nature of the Royal Service without having to go into the hotel to get food.  For breakfast, we highly recommend the french toast, eggs benedict, and the prosciutto and Camembert omelet.  For lunch, the guacamole is amazing, and the chicken wrap, sirloin burger, and pesto shrimp flat bread were simply delicious.   The service is also 5-star as well.  Our favorite waiter was Efrain.  He got us anything and everything we wanted and always had a smile on his face.  He was also very personable and we had several nice long conversations with him.  The other waiters were all amazing too though, and saying Efrain was the best takes nothing away from them.  Javier, Rogelio and Octavio all served as as well at some point and did a great job.  Javier even went so far as to get my wife and I some ice cream from the Market Grill and delivered it to our room.  Also, Rogelio the bartender had a great sense of humor and made the best drinks at the hotel!  The guys who ran the pool and set up the bali beds, Omar and Pedro also were extremely courteous and did a great job as well.  Omar always asked me every day, "What's cooking?"  Great staff all around.

The rooms are beautiful and ours was huge, and the maid always did a great job cleaning it.  They restocked the mini-bar daily and all we had to do was let Hector know what we wanted and it was there. They had snacks too in the mini-bar and we had some M&Ms and Oreos.  

One other comment on the food is that the fruit there was absolutely delicious and typically so much better than in the US.  The papaya, cantaloupe, plums, mango and peaches were out of this world.  I never had eaten so much fruit over a week before in my life, and I eat lots of fruit typically!  Also in the Royal Service area they would have blackberries, raspberries, and blueberries, none of which I saw in the general buffet.

Speaking of the buffet, we only ate there once for breakfast and once for lunch.  The food was really good both times.  The waffles are some of the best I have ever eaten.  What was a little strange was that they would have things like chicken, fish, nachos, etc. for breakfast foods, which I found odd.  Also, if you are used to the environment of the Royal Service, the buffet can be a challenge.  When we were there it was quite crowded and the lines for things like omelets were really long.  Also, there were lots of kids running around and babies crying (I still don't understand why people bring their babies to a resort).  As a matter of fact, on our last full day we went to the buffet for breakfast because we were right in the front of the hotel taking pictures and figured we were right there...well, we left almost right away.  It was a mob scene, the line for omelets was 8 people long, food was running out, and the only seating we could get was outside.  I put down the plate I was holding, and we returned to the Royal Service area for their mini-buffet and enjoyed our breakfast in peace.  

A couple of things I think the hotel needs to work on (1) They need to do a better job segregating the Royal Service beach and pool area.  Several times we say other guests come into the area that were not in the Royal Service and bring their children.  Also, they come from the beach and use the Royal Service bathrooms and beach showers.  I had to tell the pool concierge and he had to ask people to leave once.  Now, I am not trying to come off as snobby, but we paid for the adult only environment and when I am laying in my bali bed, I don't want to hear kids crying in the beach shower.  So Paradisus definitely needs to work on improving keeping up the exclusive nature of the Royal Service at the beach and pool area (2) the Avenue Lounge where they do the shows is simply too small and not a good venue for performances (3) they need to offer more activities in the evening, like different themed dance nights.  They also should look into developing a real night club for the shows and such dancing. (4) They need to put better irons and blow dryers in the rooms.  I burned a shirt of mine, and I NEVER damage anything ironing.  In general the iron sucked and the steam function was not working.  Also, be aware that the voltage in the electrical circuits is different and you need an adapter.  My wife always brings her own hair dryer and straightener for her hair and the breakers blew, even with the adapter.  And the hair dryer in the bathroom was small and not too good. (5)  We really wanted to try La Perla, the seafood buffet, but it was closed our whole stay.  We were told it was because the hotel was not very full.  It would have been nice if they opened it at least once in a while, even if they hotel is not too full (6) The Royal Service pool needs a swim up bar.

We highly recommend Paradisus Cancun and definitely highly recommend the Royal Service.  We definitely would go again in the future! The hotel is gorgeous and the staff is so kind and helpful.  Even our complaints are relatively minor.  I hope you found this review helpful.

reviews.author: Chipster2013
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text:
Booked via Cheapcaribbean.com - no problems encountered! Transfers via Amstar was also a breeze! 
Had to wait 2 hours for a room. Theyre not usually ready until 2pm-ish which could be a hassle. Being kind of forced into the Club Melia presentation right after check in was a hassle too since youre tired from the flight (esp when flying with a toddler!). We set up an appointment for another time, but cancelled it.
Hotel itself was nice, but previous reviews were right about the hot temperature inside the buildings. With my toddler in tow, it was kind of miserable at times esp during dinner. Room a/c was always set on 65 degrees but it never really felt that cool. Wifi not good. Food was average for breakfast and lunch at Naos. Dinner was better. Vento was my favorite. Bana, Market Grill, and Blue Agave were fine too. Didn't get to try the others. Snacks by pool is great! I could not get enough of their guac/cheese/nachos. Also good for toddlers as they offered pizza. Ordered cerviche everyday but extra charge ($15). 
Pools were nice, we mostly stayed by the kiddie pools. The other pools were so deep! Beach was soooo nice! Best feature! Ive read so many bad reviews about problems with getting decent beach chairs so I just booked a Bali bed for our entire stay! It was awesome coz it served as a bed so my toddler can nap comfortably. Miguel and Laura from the pool bar were great! 
Overall it was good. Would probably try another place if and when we go back. 
But nothing beats quality time with your family, wherever you are =)

reviews.author: waterlilly9
reviews.title: gurantee a good service
reviews.text: The lavender aroma at the entrance made me relaxed already, The front desk staff is courteous and accommodating while i was checking out my taxi was waiting,  the staff expedited my check out and i really appreciated it.Drinks are accessibleeverywhere because they have several restaurants and lounges There are three things that need improvement.First is the buffet food at Naos, at night there should be variety or a theme night so even you did not make a reservation at least it's different and fun. Second the elevator had an unpleasant smell, the carpet might be wet and it did not get dry completely. Third their pillows are no t pluffy my head sinks to the bed. Overall the service was great,they also have nice little shops inside the hotel.

reviews.author: Nicole K
reviews.title: Glorious experience
reviews.text: This was our second stay at Paradisus.  We actually started this trip at another hotel, after one night in the other all inclusive we transferred over to Paradisus.  There was no comparason for the same money.  From the moment we arrived, it was pure luxery.  Words cannot express how wonderful this place it.

reviews.author: Paula C
reviews.title: Awesome family vacation
reviews.text: We traveled in July 2014 and we had an awesome time.  From the moment thAt we arrived until we left, we were pampered!  We splurged on the family concierge!  Our butler Alvaro was the best!  We didn't even have to wash or sterilize baby bottles.  To me, that was such a pleasant surprise. We would definitely stay at the paradisus again!  Familia Correia

reviews.author: Sandra D
reviews.title: Cancun Ag 2014
reviews.text: It was a really nice experience overall. I definitely would choose the same hotel.  It was clean, staff are very nice, beach is fabulous, it is close in urban bus to nightlife, and if you don't want to go out of the hotel, they have shows and very good ambience.

reviews.author: Michael G
reviews.title: Cancun Paradise
reviews.text:
The hotel ambiance is amazing.  The lighting, scents, and overall hotel appearance are wonderful.  
The restaurants were fabulous!  Bano was our favorite.  The food variety was the best.  We did the all inclusive and were very happy

reviews.author: Peridot0831
reviews.title: Wouldn't return but it wasn't a horrible stay
reviews.text:
I looked at several reviews before booking at this hotel. 
I would honestly say it isn't a horrible hotel. It smells so nice.
Whenever you request a service the reception will double check if you recieved your service (i.e. Room service, extra towels, etc)
Bana was definetly my favorite restaurant. I would request the server by the name Franchesco or something beginning with an F. He truly made our experience at Bana. Vento wasn't that bad. If you're a vegetarian you can manage, but it's okay options. Fuego was okay the presentation was nice. Blueagave was another one of my favorite places to eat. There's a place to eat near the pool and that was nice. La perla doesnt have any options for vegatarians and its a very limited menu. But they cook their food quite well.
Naos has amazing soups and it's better if you go there early. 
The food was pretty good.
Some of the waiters were unfriendly and sometimes forgot to give us our food/drinks.
The rooms. Well the wifi isn't the best in them. We stayed in a Royal deluxe lagoon suite and it was quite small... and the beds feel smaller than queen beds, it was quite an uncomfortable arrangement. The one night we requested an extra bed to sleep on, I got attacked by vicious bugs and insects so they had to spray the room down. The house keeping service is quite great. The cleaning lady helps quite a lot. The room is too hot.  The view of the sunset from the lagoon suite is just beautiful. The beach is also really nice and you have to really look for chairs to sit on. You should leave some stuff so no one can take them. The cabanas are so expensive we didn't get to really enjoy them. Also, the hotel is just very hot, and it makes you feel really lightheaded. The best place is the welcome lounge- it has a lot of AC. I wish there were more activities to do to with families. Overall it's an okay experience, nothing too bad, nothing extraodrinary. I travel quite a lot and this is quite an expensive hotel, if you find it for a decent price, i would check it out. If not, it's quite expensive and isn't worth THAT much.

reviews.author: cianakiara
reviews.title: Overall, I Had A Good Time!
reviews.text:
The hotel is huge with a pretty nice layout.  When I first check in we were literally "whisked away" to the Royal Service check-in in Pyramid 5.  The check in process was cool.  There we were assigned our butler, Gauldino and a cell phone to keep us in touch with him.  The room clean,  bathroom size descent and balcony pretty good size that overlooked the ocean.

Our butler made sure we were good on all accounts.  He made all of our dinner reservations and even reserved our bali bed for 7 days out of our 8 day stay (you are only guaranteed 3).  Gualdino even delivered a chill bottle of champagne on night 1, a bottle of tequilla on night two and sent us home with a bottle of Milagros tequilla...all free of charge.

The spa service was good...but the next day for some reason or another my neck and back was stiff...think it was too much pressure...lol...I think everyone should at least experience the spa treatments if at all possible.

The food at Nao's which is the main dining room was OK...it wasn't a large selection at all and they were not consistent.  Bacon & saugages is something you have to ask for, it was not part of the buffet, I dont know why.  The other restuarants were ok too...all though I didn't experience all of them.  Since I had the Royal Service package we had breakfast & lunch on the RS side and trust me when I tell you, you can see and feel the difference in service.

The pools, 3 in total are nice and clean, one is specifically for the Royal Service guests.  The beach was awesome but its a longggggg walk from the ocean back to the your lounge chair...LOL. 

Only real complaints for me is the fact that yes, they do not have enough lounge chairs and shaded areas...and yes, after awhile of unclaimed lounge chairs with personal belongings on it, people did start to move those items and take over the chairs, which i felt wasn't cool at all.  My only other grievance is that during my stay, the company CINTAS was there for their annual President's Club "conference" and we heard that there was a total of 400 people in this group.  Their stay at the hotel really did slow down service, especially at the pool bar and with the room service for food orders.   The common areas, such as the atrium and lobby areas were really hot and muggy...there was no real air conitioning in the common areas which became annoying after awhile because it was pretty hot outside and when you came in, all you wanted to do was cool off...granted it was the middle of August.  Other than those things the hotel & staff to me were pretty cool and quite accommodating.

If I had the chance, I would more than likely visit the Paradisus and do the Royal Service package again...to me it was worth it.

PS...those daggone on Buffalo Wings were hmmm hmmm good...make sure you get some!

reviews.author: erlbfdeppWorld
reviews.title: The best place ever
reviews.text:
I stayed in Paradisius for 2 weeks, from july 22nd to august 5th.
It was perfect, perfect place, perfect beach, perfect food and above everything perfect people.
I had the chance to stay at the Royal Service and everything was perfect, excellent service, calm space, wonderful beach.A huge thank to Carlos, very kind and helpful at every moment, to people from "la palapa" who made every breakfast and lunch a very pleasant moment : thanks to Valeria, Roger, Rogelio,Michael, thanks to Balan y Andres for the best cocktails ever. Thanks to Leyner, our perfect Mayordome who was everyday so helpful and nice. Thanks to Omar who taked good care of us every day.
our  room was really beautiful, spaceful, with many attentions (perfumed pillows, chocolates...) everyday that contributes making this stay being amazing. 
We had the chance to try every restaurant and a special mention to "la Perla", "el vento", toji, and the Naos buffet was also really good. 
We'll certainly come back, one more time, to enjoy every little part of this "Paradise".

reviews.author: Juan F
reviews.title: Hotel activities
reviews.text: I wanted to say that the activities in the hotel were cool and fun.  Special thanks to Freddy for making the Beach Soccer and Volley-ball fun and entertaining. His staff and group were very outgoing and went out of their way to make it a friendly and fun time. Definitely going back. Keep it up guys. Well done.

reviews.author: bsaitow
reviews.title: Great View
reviews.text: I traveled to Cancun for a Convention and the hotel is amazing. First, I got a Junior Suite oceanfront. Waking up with that amazing view from your balcony is priceless. The food is delicious and the hotel offers many options. I called for room services several times and everytime the employees were totally polite and we happy to serve you. You could feel that! If you have the chance to stay at Paradisus... You won regret!

reviews.author: Vanessa De Carlo
reviews.title: Too many mistakes
reviews.text: The hotel was incredible and the staff was awesome. The food was remarkable, but many issues happened during our stay. We booked and paid in advance our stay at Royal service (which is an exclusive area of the hotel), and then, one week before going to Mexico we received an email with a free upgrade to a room for the Family Concierge (not exclusive). As we arrived, there were no more rooms for us on the royal service and we had to stay one night at the family concierge, where the seiling above the bath tub was a "hole", the sink was leaking and other minor stuff. Thankfully, the staff managed to transfer us to Royal service on the next day. I also booked a romance package in advance, paying almost 500 USD for couple´s massage, romantic dinner at the beach, flowers at the room and romantic breakfast. We were kind of lost because it was a surprise to my husband and no one picked us up at the room. Then, when we came back to the room, I found out that the flowers were disposed at my parents room!!!. Even though, everything else was great and we had a wonderful time.

reviews.author: Michael A
reviews.title: Cancun Royalty
reviews.text:
My partner and I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun from August 11, 2014 to August 16, 2014.  I first heard about The Paradisus Resort from a colleague who visited the one in Dominican Republic, Punta Cana. He said that his experience was beyond exceptional, he and his family where treated like royalty. We read reviews on Trip advisor and Bookit.com, most where good but there were some very bad ones as well.  After we booked the trip we remembered about the Royal Service. We tried to apply for this upgrade by phone, however where told that there are no rooms available for the week we are visiting.

When we arrived at the hotel, we were graciously greeted by Miroslava, a Melia Vacation Club representative she escorted us to the check in desk where Guadalupe, who made every effort to communicate to us in English and I must say she did a good job. We asked about the Royal Service, she was able to offer us what was available. 

Miroslava introduced us to the host Muracio who took his time explaining the services we signed up for as he escorted us to bldg. #5.  Once we got over to Bldg. #5 Galdino & Hector where Introduced as our personal butler.  Hector work the morning shift and Galdino did the evening. They both provided outstanding service throughout our stay.  They were able to book all of our restaurant reservations and accommodate any special request and we did have a few. 
We were also assigned a pool concierge David, who was very attentive to our needs which gave a very personable experience. He worked with a team of guys Omar, Pedro and Alexander who all offered excellent customer service. 

The waiters where outstanding as well, the ones that come to mind particularly are Edier, Efrian & Rodger. They all seem to have a unique ability to anticipate your needs along with helpful suggestion about the menu or drink selections, which worked well for me because I never know what I want. 

The entertainment was mediocre at best however, the dancers did work hard. I would like to suggest that they provide all guests with an Entertainment schedule. We had no idea what was going on any given day or night. It was only by chance that we happened upon the Dance of the Flamingos (In the Royal Service Area) & a ritualistic dance in the general stay pool area which I enjoyed both.  

Overall the room was nice but average but the service was outstanding. We would return to this resort or try another Paradisus in another area. We would definitely recommend to family and friends the Royal Service.

reviews.author: Tigresatiffany
reviews.title: August 14 - 17, 2014 visit
reviews.text: Immaculately clean. Service is excellent, friendly and helpful. The gym is good and you will need it considering how good the food is. Food options run from the best wings at the pool side bar to a frisée salad for those who don’t really care to put on an ounce. The healthy options are always there. We enjoyed the very punctual room service each morning – poached eggs, fruit, and the best coffee. Our room in the family concierge area was very large with a large patio overlooking the ocean. The bed gets an A+ for comfort and the room was wonderful as the heat was so well regulated that systems were not turning on and off all night – making for an excellent sleep. Drinks by the pool have that drinks-by-the-pool feel, but there is a well-kept secret. You may have the best margarita of your life in Blue Agave at night. Blue Agave is the Mexican restaurant that does not require reservations. It was by far the best and most interesting food I had there. The menu is not extensive, it is simple, traditional, Mexican  and delicious. Each “taco” (not fried, but a small white corn tortilla with toppings) is small and allows you to taste a variety. Everything we had was great, with the Poblano quesadilla and the chorizo taco getting many rave reviews. The restaurant comes across as an upscale, relaxed spot. Other restaurants were good. The buffet at Naos  contains a huge variety – beautifully presented and delicious.  Beach service was provided by “Victor” who must be on a mission to be remembered by being just what you need. He appears out of no-where, replenishes your icy bucket of drinks while you sleep and quietly ensures you are in heaven. The pools get a bit warm in summer – most likely due to the roasting temperatures at this time. The ocean is refreshing and swimmable. The spa was a treat, excellent massage and mani/pedi. Although, Mani/pedi area needs a refresh –  the massage area was dreamy. Many tourists have commented on one of the only negatives that can be found. They are pumping an incense in at the front entrance that is overwhelming. It will knock you over and may put a tickle in your throat. Far too strong, completely artificial and makes you think something is going to be wrong with this otherwise beautiful experience. They need to shut that down immediately.

reviews.author: SunyEllie
reviews.title: Great Place to stay if traveling with a big group
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Adults Only section of the resort. 

This hotel has a great location, close to restaurants shoppes and nightlife.You can even take the bus for like a dollar right across the street from the resort. It's also right on the beach and the beach it's beautiful. White sand and bright blue water.
 
Pros.
The Adult only section was nice and quiet. The food was very good the butler brought anything we wanted to our room and made reservations at the restaurants so we had priority.
Breakfast was delicious and they offer a great variety of dishes and also fresh squeeze juice.
The night club or bar offer sensational entertainment . They had very well choreographed dancers and singers. People of all ages attend it and enjoy it.

Rooms were spacious and offer a balcony with launch chairs. They also had Nespresso machines
If you dint feel like going down to eat you could have your breakfast deliver to your room which I though it was a plus.
If we wanted to be on the other side of the resort were they played music etc, that was available as well so I felt that we had the best of both worlds.

Cons:
The place is a little old but very well kept.
Dinner portions were small.

Being in an all inclusive resort is a lot of fun specially if you are traveling with a group. No one has to worry about the bill and people are more relaxed.

reviews.author: Sean715
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Victor Chale from the pool bar is AWSEOME! He was very helpful and would bring us different mixed drinks just so we could try them all. Victor Chale is great hardworking man. One day hope to return and visit this beautiful place.

reviews.author: GailYonkers
reviews.title: "No Complaints"
reviews.text: My most recent stay was this July 2014. I have stayed at the Paradisus Cancun 3 times prior and must say enjoyed each and every stay.  I am a member of the melia vacation club with my home club being the melia tropical. I have heard some people complain that vacation club members get first dibs on dinner reservations so I really have never had an issue, but like everyone else I too have to make my reservations the day before. I have stayed at many all inclusives and this resort has a nice variety of foods. For the most part the servers are very attentive, happy, and aim to please, and a few dollars goes a long way and they are so appreciative. The buffet is different everyday and the food always looks fresh. Many people don't know that where the indoor buffet is, when you sit outside you can actually order lunch from a menu which is nice. I have no complaints about any of the restaurants. Drinks here are also good, pretty much anything is included. At some resorts you have to pay extra for Jack Daniels, Stoly vodka but that shelf of liquor here is all inclusive. The pool and grounds are well maintained. The beach water is gorgeous but depending on the breeze sometimes can be a little rough. If you need anything services for your room as like a problem with the ac or tv they send someone in minutes. The wifi is good in the rooms and in most locations of the hotel with the exception of the pool area...that is hit or miss. You will have no regrets staying at the Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Nelly P
reviews.title: Excellent everything! Wow!
reviews.text: I stayed at paradisus last summer (June) and wow! I still remember this as if it was just yesterday! I fell in love with this resort!
