The service, cleanliness, food, bartenders and reception is impeccable! Just by entering the resort it feels so relaxing as if you entered a spa. Right away we got checked in without a wait in line or anything, they explained to us every detail and walked us to our room. Room was so clean! The view was amazing! The only sucky part about it was that the hot tub wasn't really working and the toilet either, we had to call to get the toilet fixed. Every morning we would wake up and go have breakfast, lots of variety to eat. When we went back to the room it was impeccable, even complimentary chocolates were placed on the bed after being nicely done. The mini refrigerator was always stocked with sodas/water and beer. If we had a question and we would ask anyone of the staff they always had a smile and were happy to help. Room service 24/7. The beach was beautiful, best beach I've ever been to, water so clear and the best part of it is that there is no one that bothers you about time share or any of that annoying crap they do in all resorts. The beach is right in front of the hotel. The pools very clean and warm water, pool boys very attentive if you needed anything to drink. They had grills next to the pools making burgers/pizza or other food which is awesome because after the pool you feel very hungry (well atleast I do). Restaurants with very good service and views to the beach. Oh my god I am def recommending this place to friends and family members. Definitely would lovvveeeee to come back!

reviews.author: lolita2007Iasi
reviews.title: A piece of mexican cheerfulness
reviews.text:
This has been my first time in mexico and i hope not for the last.stayed in this beautiful hotel from 29 july till -9 august 2014.paradisus hotel
It s not about the luxury within or about the variety of restaurants, it s about the politness and about the serviability of people,it s about how people treat you there.because yes almost all
The staff from this hotel really try their best.special thanks to nice waiters from  the grill retaurant area and to the japanese bar restaurant.not very sure if it s called monji.but anyway special thanks to chirstian and angelo who really tryed to put up a big smile on everybody s face and make you delicious cocktails.best bartenders!looking forward to see more of mexico do the shark whale snorkeling tour in cancun.the moment you have touched a dolphin,all the problems in this world dissapear for some time

reviews.author: Nancy1308
reviews.title: Amazing Stay
reviews.text:
We had an excellent stay at Paradisus Cancun, the service was excellent and everyone was so lovely and friendly. Especially the staff at Naos Resturant and in particular the manager Tony. 
Everything we needed was provided, we felt extremely comfortable during our stay. The hotel is exactly as shown in the photos, and we loved every minute of it.

reviews.author: Nikea G
reviews.title: Great hotel, but their customer service needs work
reviews.text: My family and i just returned from Cancun and we stayed here at the Paradisus. The hotel it's self is lovely,the drinks were good. When we first checked in our room we noticed the mini bar was dirty as well as a half filled bottle of water was left behind. When we went into the bathroom the tub was not cleaned and we had a broken iron. When we called the front desk they took about 2 hours to come and fix the problems. Besides those problems we had an awesome time.

reviews.author: lalab123
reviews.title: We can't recommend it....
reviews.text: We recently stayed here and I really don't know where to start....first, the hotel does have a nice appearance and most (not all) of the staff are nice and polite. The main problem here is how how the lobby and other common areas are too hot!!! We couldn't sit at any of the bars for long because we were drenched in sweat.  The room ac worked ok but never got very cold.  Our room did not face the pool and ocean, which was disappointing. The food is ok, but not good. I hate being critical, but there are just other places where we have stayed that are much better. In fact, the first part of our week we stayed at the Hyatt Zilara and it was wonderful!! We have also stayed at Live Aqua and it is also amazing!! I would pick other places over the Paradisus.

reviews.author: sportschick1211
reviews.title: Stayed here twice
reviews.text: This is our favorite place to visit in Cancun. We take advantage of the Royal Service, and we could not be happier with the service, selection of restaurants and liquor and the pool/beach is one of the best on Cancun. Can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Joanne G
reviews.title: A Wonderful time at the Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
I was so busy settling back to "real life", that this is my 1st opportunity to review our recent trip to the Paradisus (Aug 4-11).  The hotel is beautiful, it reminded us of a Vegas style hotel located on a BEAUTIFUL beach.  I know that some people mentioned the incense smell in the hotel, we liked it, it gave a spa smell everywhere.  The food was really good for an all inclusive, and the buffet always gave plenty of options (Fuego and Bana were our favorites!!!)...make your reservations EARLY.  They allow you to do that day and the next day, but are closed by 9 am, I believe). When we weren't playing on the BEAUTIFUL beach (did I tell you how nice it was?? lol), we were enjoying delicious drinks and conversation with our pool bartenders Enrique, Erickk, Samuel, Rafael, and Ernesto!  Enrique and Errick kept us happy and laughing.  We even got to see Enrique's photos he took of what he did on his day off! Ha! Ernesto took time talking to me and my husband, telling me about his English classes and how much he enjoyed them (it shows, he speaks very well).
This was very family friendly.  A little more so than we had expected.  It didn't bother us, but it you are looking for a more adult oriented experience, book an adults only (my suggestion).  However, we also did go to Cancun, in August, which we have not done before, so I guess that could be part of it. A lot of little kids taking seats at the pool bar, drinking juice and milk, so that I could have probably done without, but really, it wasn't that big of a deal, and we really enjoyed this hotel. And no salt and pepper on the tables in ANY restaurant.  Odd.
As for the room, we didn't do Royal service, we did a Oceanview Jr Suite, which had an unobstructed view of the gorgeous beach (Rm 3301).  The room was lovely and clean and we had no complaints.  We met several people by the pool that did do Royal Service and they told us that unless you really plan on using your butler's services, they didn't feel like it was worth it.  The RS adult pool is isolated with no music or bar, and the rooms are very far from the restaurants, lobby, etc. But we were very happy with what we had!
Last thing I think it worth mentioning is that the hotel does NOT have an adequate amount of beach/lounge chairs for as large as it is.  If you are not going down and getting your chair for the day by 7 am, you will not have a place for your things or to lay down.  We didn't mind, as me and the hubs are early birds (even in our real lives! lol), but for those who enjoy sleeping in on vacation, take heed. 
All in all, I am sad I am not presently sitting at the pool bar, drinking a Conga (have Enrique or Errick make one for you!), and enjoying another week at the Paradisus Cancun, but sometimes life is cruel! Beautiful, fun time.

reviews.author: Das889 S
reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: This vacation resort was average at best. It has a pretty face but is lacking underneath. The royal service is the only way to go. The food is not good. Make sure you sign up for restaurants when you arrive. The open house rest and bad. Also sign up for the Bali beds ASAP on arrival too or you will not get one. They are the cabanas around the pool.  The whole tropical tiki hut feel is awesome though.

reviews.author: Luv2travel0802
reviews.title: Fantastic service and stay
reviews.text: My husband and I enjoyed our honeymoon trip in this resort. It was a phenomenal visit thanks to the friendly staff. Great food and beach. Beach water had semi strong waves the majority of time but CRYSTAL CLEAR water and clean. Poolside and beachside umbrellas must be taken early in the morning if not then you're out of luck. Pool water was a bit too warm for us to go into. We preferred lounging by the beach and grabbing lunch by the snack bar. Buffet food had a great delicious variety all the time. All attentive service at the buffet and la perla. In particular VICTOR CHALE from the pool bar was EXTREMELY attentive, hardworking, and eager to serve us anything all day by the beach to make us feel comfortable. He also gave us tourist advice on the best places to visit while in Cancun. Great man and worker!!! Servers Orlando and Jaime were also good to us. Daylia from front desk was also very nice during our.checkin. THANK YOU PARADISUS FOR MAKING OUR STAY TRULY UNFORGETTABLE!!

reviews.author: Raben N
reviews.title: fantastic entertainment staff
reviews.text: such a great hotel! The entertainment staff were great and always making sure we were having a good time. Angel, Edwardo (Lolito), Rodrigo, Carla, and Stefani were fantastic! great food and beaches too!

reviews.author: Brian P
reviews.title: Paradisus is PERFECT!
reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about this hotel.  The atmosphere was relaxed.  The food was fantastic.  The hotel room and the pool area was very clean and inviting.  They kept the beach very inviting.  The best thing was the staff.  They were all very friendly, and accommodating.  We had a wonderful time, and hopefully will be returning soon!  We'll recommend this hotel to everyone.

reviews.author: aaabbbb1111
reviews.title: First AI experience
reviews.text:
Where to begin… ok, background info, we’ve never done All inclusive before, but travelled to Mexico a few times staying at smaller hotels, in PDC and Isla Mujeres. Sorry but we were always ‘afraid of the AI crowd stereotype’ (drunk, loud, unpleasant)  We booked Paradisus following reviews here that mentioned it was more relaxing than elsewhere, almost boring with few activities and guests that are not on party mode 24/7.   When we arrive at Cancun airport and went to the waiting area for transportation we saw crowds going to Bahia and the likes already drinking and smoking like chimneys next to children… We were already disappointed of going AI.

But then we found we were the only ones from the tour operator group going to Paradisus.. relief...  Getting to the Hotel from the airport took a matter of 15 minutes. As soon as we arrived we were treated like royalty, from the personal taking care of the luggages to the concierge greeting us with drinks for us and our kids before even checking in.  We were a bit early so we were given a small tour and explanations of how the place works, the different restaurants, etc,, by the concierge.  She offered us the timeshare breakfast presentation on the next morning which we declined, it was the end of it.  Then we got to have a first lunch before getting our room.  We had booked lagoon view junior suite (no Royal nor family concierge program).  The room was clean, just spacious enough and with a nice view of the lagoon.  If money is no object then surely ocean view must be great, but lagoon view is probably better than most hotels ‘no view room’ and probably better than many hotels claiming waterfront view.

Our mini fridge was re-stocked everyday, or should I say ‘over-stocked’ everyday, the guy taking care of the mini-bar quickly got a grip of what our kids liked and our kids had a blast everyday coming back from the beach to find bags of M&Ms, Oreo’s, Hershey chocolate milk, etc…  

WIFI, no complaints, I was able to stream MLS Live soccer without difficulty.

The breakfast buffet was nice, I was happy no to see an overwhelming choice of foods, since I prefer quality over quantity.  We were served every morning by either Alessandro or Oscar and both were very nice to deal with, they usually served us Mimosas and plates of bacon & sausages to go with the buffet food.

The lunch buffet was good but we mostly just ate few snacks like chicken wings or pizza by the beach since we were never that hungry.

Cannot talk about diner buffet since we ate every night either at Blue Agave or in a a la carte restaurant, because yes, there is no limited number of a la carte restaurant usage.  Reservation was never a problem, very easy.  Vento tapas were really good, but a bit on the salty side.  Presentation was excellent.  Market grill was ok, service was too quick!, we ate too much too fast.  La Perla was good, but service was lacking compared to the other places.  However the family favorite was Blue Agave, so simple yet so delicious tacos and soups,  Wonderful service there too.  Our glasses were refiled with wine very quickly, we never saw the bottom of a wine glass!

I won’t talk about the pools, I have one at home, I don’t need to go to one at the hotel, specially with all the people there… there was like a film or sheen of oil on the water, probably from the suntan lotions.  It must be like that at all the hotels.  Anyway, who wants a pool when there is a beach like that available!!  The colours, the waves,, just magnificent, and since this hotel is pretty wide, they have a good amount of beach front, however they could easily add another row of palapas.  The beach side service was equally nice.  The activities there were twice a day, beach soccer and volley in which we participated.  My young boy always found some other kids to play soccer with and always had fun.  One morning the lifeguard was digging for turtle eggs and found two hatchlings and showed them to us.

A few notes on the not so good stuff, yes we HAD to play the towel game for reserving some shade.  the last day when we arrived at our ‘reserved’ chairs we found that our kids toys were gone, we found them in a garbage bin,  We put aside the things the other people had put and still used the place… in the afternoon two extremely rude girls passed by and picked their stuff up and left (we found out they had also reserved a spot near the pools).  Ok so there were those types of people there too, well at least two specimen.  I also got stomach ache after the Market grill dinner, I’m 50/50 if it was the food or having too much of it.  Luckily it didn’t last long. 

Overall, a great stay that will make us have a hard time finding anything equivalent if or when we go AI again.

reviews.author: Richard H
reviews.title: Great for kids, not couples
reviews.text:
Great place for the family with small children, not for couples, great food, great accomadations, nice beach, nice pool.
Only issue was that you needed to rent the poolside cabanas inorder to reserve them, kind of petty.

reviews.author: ADEYEMI S
reviews.title: Amazing and refreshing
reviews.text:
This is one of the best vacation, i have taken. The hotel is 4-5 star with great 
amenities and services. The foods varieties is unbelievable, great taste and varieties. You have more than enough to choose from. Varieties of fruits and fresh. The restaurants are first class with wonderful services. The staffs were very polite and ready and willing to assist promptly. I will definitely repeat my visit and highly recommend the hotel. You will definitely get the value for your money and more.

reviews.author: Boarding_gate123
reviews.title: Hotel true to its name (as long as you go with Royal Service!) but also some snakes in paradise
reviews.text:
Stayed here for seven nights with my husband in a Royal Service Junior Suite with a lagoon view. We had originally wanted a sea view room but they were fully booked. Upon check-in, we inquired about this again and were first shown a bigger suite with a sea view on the ground floor and then the deluxe suite on either the 5th or 6th floor with a lagoon view. We chose the lagoon view because my husband loves sunsets and because the sea view from the room on the ground floor was pretty limited, to say the least.

Royal service is a must, my rating and experience of this hotel would be considerably lower without it. The Royal Service gives you a nicer, calmer and child-free pool, great beach-side service and the lounge where you can serve yourself a huge glass of perfectly nice sparkling wine (note; not champagne, as some have claimed!), among other things, whenever you want. In short, it pretty much raises the standard of the hotel and your hotel experience with one star. 

Positives:

-          The All Inclusive plan was extensive and included more or less everything within reason (ie. also, for example, espresso, sparkling wine, sake and an array of different wines which I have seen excluded at other AI-hotels we’ve stayed at previously)

-          Fantastic beach service; menus and food are brought to the beach so you can actually spend the entire day on your sun lounger and have food and drinks brought to you. We booked beach cabanas on two days (you get two days in royal service) and they were absolutely gorgeous. However, we had no problems whatsoever getting sun loungers under a palapa on the other four days (and we’re not early risers and do not participate in the towel game).

-          Gorgeous beach. The red flag was up every single day but that didn’t stop people from wading in and swimming.

-          I was initially worried about the room since some previous comments on TA have noted that it’s in need of modernizing. Yes, it’s not the flashiest room with the newest designer lighting, twin sinks or rainforest shower but it’s clean and sufficiently modern. I did not feel that it was old. Room had excellent soundproofing (or, at least our did) and the minibar (with M&Ms!) was replenished daily.

-          We travel extensively around the world with my husband and without exception always get stomach problems at some point even though we stay away from all the usual suspects. Here, I decided to risk it and even went for ice in drinks and some veggies. Amazingly, we had no problems whatsoever.

Problems:

-          We realized immediately upon checking into our room that our toilet was not flushing. We called the front desk who promised to take care of it. When we came back from dinner it was still not flushing. I called the front desk again. They told me someone had been up and fixed it. This was an outright lie since we’d used the toilet before realizing the problem so we could tell no one had flushed it. I called again, this time more sternly. At this point we were getting pretty frustrated because we’d been travelling for the past 20 hours, had arrived at the hotel in the early evening, had had a quick meal and just wanted to go to bed. I understand that hotel rooms need maintenance once in a while and that things break down. I can easily compromise with certain things but a flushing toilet isn’t one of them. We waited for another 45 minutes until maintenance showed up, they worked for 20 minutes and the problem was resolved. My bedside table lamp was also broken but although we told the front desk about this four times on four different occasions during the week, nothing ever happened. It didn’t feel like a huge thing so in the end we just let it be.

-          Inconsistency when communicating with staff. In addition to the incident described above, we experienced similar problems on a number of other occasions. 1. We were planning on dining at Bana one evening. I don’t eat sushi so I asked three different members of staff beforehand if the restaurant also served other food. They all said yes. When we got there and were handed the menus it was blatantly obvious that it was all sushi. I had all the other items on the menu, ie. a small noodle soup and some fried starters. The waiter made things worse by insisting that I “should try a little bit, it’s very nice”. I’m not five. 2. On our first morning, when we had planned to have a long lie-in, we were rudely awakened by the phone ringing at 8.43. It was the Melia concierge, trying to give us the time-share pitch. The next morning, the phone again rang before nine, waking us up again, but there was no one in the other end (wrong number?). We learned our lesson and disconnected our room phones for the night after that. 3. One morning I called to reserve two spots for the tequila tasting. I was told it was already full although bookings had just opened three minutes earlier. When I asked about this, the lady in the other end went silent and then hung up the phone!! We simply decided to turn up for the tasting. There were the two of us and two other people! Pretty bizarre.

-          Wine in the AI package was served by glass, not per bottle, which was pretty annoying. We constantly had to get a waiter to top up our glasses since we're hard-core wine-drinkers.

-          The hotel blasts out really loud and annoying techno music constantly on one side of the beach. If you’re on the Royal side you will hear it depending on the wind. We considered renting a beach cabana  one day on this ‘music side’ since the cabanas looked pretty but were put off by the music. I think the hotel advertises these as party cabanas, but unfortunately the party atmosphere spills over to everyone else as well who might be looking for a more tranquil and romantic experience.

-          There is a similar problem with music clashing in the lobby during the evening. Just outside Bana, they have a piano or violin player in the evenings. Unfortunately, you are simultaneously bombarded with music from at least the lobby and the evening show.

-          Desserts at all restaurants were pretty bad. There was no ice cream, which was a pity.

Other things to take note of for fellow travelers:

-          Restaurant service varied from fantastic to utterly and totally lousy, we experienced the whole range.

-          There is no restaurant for dinner on the beach (except if you pay extra for the private dining option) and almost all are more or less inside for dinner (except for Market Grill and the Royal Service restaurant and buffet for lunch). Many are huddled together in the main lobby and although they’ve done a good job of separating between them it feels like such a waste to not have, for example, a barefoot seafood restaurant right on the beach.

-          Butler service is odd. We had a good butler, who did all of our dinner reservations etc., but if you’ve stayed at other hotels (5 star) with real, proper butler service you will notice a big difference. It felt like they’d come up with a fun-sounding and attention-grabbing term but then not really implemented it in practice and thought about what a butler is supposed to do.

-          This was not American spring break time but the hotel still seemed to attract a certain amount of adults (both younger and older) who appeared to consider it acceptable to behave as though it was their private party arena. They were walking around the hotel without shoes (or perhaps just beach flip flops for dinner as ‘dress up’), jumping headfirst into the pool and yelling (“making new acquaintances”) from one bali bed to the next. The swim-up bar was unfortunately totally run over by them and they were doing body shots in the pool (yes, really). Extremely uncomfortable for everyone else.

-          There is no complimentary beach bag in the room that one can borrow.

- We had perfect weather, it did not rain a single time during our week-long stay in July. This isn't really a comment about the hotel, but just as info for others thinking about whether Cancun is okay in July.

All in all, this is a solid 4 star hotel in a gorgeous location on a beautiful beach with friendly and, for the most part, pretty good service (especially the beach service!), perfectly acceptable food (as long as you’re not expecting Michelin standards) and drinks and a perfect place to unwind and just lie back, enjoy the view and the strawberry margaritas.

Most of the negative comments above (except for the toilet issue) did not really detract significantly from a great vacation. Just set your expectations right: it’s all-inclusive and if you’re paying around 200 euros/night you can’t expect five-star luxury, amenities, food or service.

Would definitely recommend, but only if you get the Royal Service, and would go back in an instant!

reviews.author: Vetusya
reviews.title: Stay away!
reviews.text: Worst experience ever. No air conditioning anywhere besides lobby. Poor service, horrible food . Cant really mention a single thing that was ok. None of the stuff speaks or understands english. I've traveled a lot but never had such a bad experience. Did not enjoy at all! Stay away from this old, unprofessional, unfriendly and WARM hotel! It's not worth it!!!

reviews.author: Rashmitsuri
reviews.title: Fabulous Stay
reviews.text: I visited Paradius Resot and spa hotel for my birthday and they made it so special. We were lucky to get an upgrade to royal suite with ocean view, it was just amazing. The hotel staff were very friendly and made our stay very comfortable. Food options were very good, specially Vento. Victor our server made the experience very special. Also the royal suite pool area service was excellent. Over all excellent stay.

reviews.author: Christopher N
reviews.title: Vacation 2014
reviews.text: Resort was absolutely gorgeous. Customer service could have been MUCH better. We checked in and ended up having to wait 4 hours for our rooms to be ready. The staff didn't really make any attempts to accommodate us while we waited. When asking for help, staff kept bouncing us back and forth. The restaurants were all really good. BlueAgave was my favorite. The buffet was also great. Ask for the mango blended margarita.

reviews.author: Jacqueline E
reviews.title: Honeymoon Vacation
reviews.text:
We stayed here for our honeymoon:) AMAZING experience for me and my husband in the ROYAL SERVICE!! Everyone is really nice and treat you like a king/queen in this beautiful palace! Special thanks to all the services in the royal pool! Thank you sooo much Omar, Pedro, Octavio… and ALL these guys that make these services very special! 
Please tip even if your all-inclusive.. they deserve it for all their hard work :)

reviews.author: Dimpal P
reviews.title: My Time Fool
reviews.text: Hotel and everything is good but don't get fool with My Time, I didn't got any special service for having My Time even after complaining 7-10 times. Rest service and all is good. with My Time you have coupon which I got on 6th day that to after knowing from other friends and they were supposed to give me same same time when we check in

reviews.author: icmir
reviews.title: Wonderful Carribean sea, interesting architecture of the hotel, staff needs more training
reviews.text:
We stayed in the resort 10 days together with 8 friends , so, the  reservations for "a la carte restaurants"  were difficult to get, even one day in advance . Anyway, exepting Tempo, which is very expensive, the rest of them are average;   NAOS international restaurant is ok, but in rush hours, the lack of organizing things is obvious. Food choice is good, however few of the members of the staff are almost rude.
Accomodation is fine; the music at poolbars is too loud on beach side rooms and lasts too many hours  a day. It seems like a  "teenagers "hotel. Cleaning of the rooms was superficial, under the beds there was a thick layer of dust. The technical team was efficient and they helped us almost every day with a problem: stuck doors, leaking pipes,  air conditioned, bad key cards. This hotel is older than you'd expect for its stars.
The beach is exceptional, however the beach boys  make a  business from "reserving" places at 6 AM, 4 hours  in advance  for some special guests; think they could use a better control from their superiors, it's only them that do not respect the" 30 minutes rule"

Beautiful tours: dolphins, sharks,aqua parks, good public transportation; very poor WiFi in the rooms

reviews.author: Irina P
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: Beautiful property with gorgeous white sand beach! Resort should make it a little bit more clear for families about kids activities. The hotel has a kids club but all activities were for kids 1-6 years old. Had some troubles booking dinner reservations as you have to book only 24 hours in advance and dinners were booked up pretty early - 8 am on some days was too late. However, the buffet food was absolutely delicious and staff took care of everything we needed. Great pools also!!

reviews.author: Brad D
reviews.title: Excellent Resort
reviews.text: We had Royal Service...Sergio was our Butler....Great vacation....Pool swim up bar was fun and then you could go mellow  out at the Royal Adult Pool...All restaurants were excellent !!!  the bartenders treat you like a king !! Please tip even if you are all inclusive !!!

reviews.author: Robynquinn
reviews.title: Many pros, cons and tips to talk about.
reviews.text: Traveled with 15 people so the size of the resort was nice, wasn't too big and there was only one pool bar so we always could find each other. I'll list out my pro cons and tips to make it easier but overall and average place I would not return. One big thumbs up to the customer service and workers, all were great!Pros: gym and classes, great. some food was really good, but most was ave. but the theme of lunch everyday changed and was nice. Room service food was delish! staff was super helpful and kind, kids zone was awesome for my 6 and 9 year old, they did something new and special (like cooking) everyday. Hotel shows every night were great. Cons: everywhere in the hotel and restaurants were boiling hot - your "resort credits" are a joke, you had to carry around a coupon book, yes a coupon book to get anything. Wine upgrades were so over priced it was terrible. Bring cash because there were lots of extras and tipping was expected! If you want shade my the pool rent a cabana for $50 a day, ouch! TIPS: bring lots of cash and bring a float for the pool, the pool is just a touch too deep and everyone there has to by a float unless you are over 5'4, stick one in your suitcase and save $30! Book a photo shoot, its free and the pictures come out amazing (ps buy the disk so you own them). Talk your price down for everything, at the hotel, stores, rentling stuff, for anything you purchase it was harder to make a deal at the downtown markets than at the hotel.

reviews.author: Myla N
reviews.title: An Awesome Vacation
reviews.text: It was our first time to visit Mexico and the color of the beach is what caught my attention the day we arrived. I thought it was just in pictures but the color of the ocean was real...turquoise. I have been to Bahamas and Grand Cayman but this by far is the best beach I have been to...the color, the waves and the water. The staff are all great! They were all friendly and very attentive to the needs of the guests. We did not go for Royal Service yet we were treated like royalty. It was a truly wonderful experience to have been to this resort...we will definitely come back.

reviews.author: Olivia848
reviews.title: Great but a view minor things to complain about
reviews.text:
We were really happy and amazed by the set up of the hotel. There are lounge areas everywhere and the hotel is really nice and modern. The beach is beautiful and the room size and layout is nice as well.

What we didn't like: 
1.The lounge chairs at the pool and at the beach are ALL reserved after 7am in the morning. We didn't know if the problem was if there were not enough chairs or if people reserved at the pool and at the beach. The was a sign with rules, which explained that the towels would be taken away after 30 minutes not occupying the chairs but the personnel of the hotel actually didn't do anything about it

2. The food was average. I expected a little more and I think I am not very choosy.

3.Our room was right above the grill (pool without pool bar), which was used after 7pm and the smell in our room was absolutely terrible.

reviews.author: worldtravelerNJ30
reviews.title: Poor service and housekeeping
reviews.text:
Dinner reservations can only be made two nights at a time and you have to do them by 7am otherwise you are eating at the buffet 3 times a day. Not enough variety at buffet.

Housekeeping does NOT speak any English. Had to communicate with Service Express, Housekeeping Managers, Housekeeping Supervisors EVERY SINGLE DAY to explain what i needed cleaned and how. Maid would claim no one spoke to her about anything. Dirty sheets used 4 days in a row.

Had to move from Pyramid 1 to 3 after first night because toilets didn't work and it was too too far to Pyramid 3 with kids. Check in young lady said it was the best tower and she clearly lied because she had no other rooms to offer us. We were promised an upgrade to oceanview when we arrived and they didn't give us that either. Highly disappointed

reviews.author: t33ny415
reviews.title: Family trip summer 2014
reviews.text:
Our first family vacation to Cancun.  It was pretty awesome here, the staff are nice but always a few that gives you the dirty looks. 
We stayed 9 nights on the lagoon side.  Get to see the sunset every night which I think it's better than the sunrise.  We had a patio with jacuzzi which we used once.  Not really something we needed but it was there.
Majority of the restaurant require reservations, we woke at 7 to mAke them and go back to sleep. Fuego, Bana, La Perla are really good ones to reserve.  Blue Agave is really good, order one of everything.  Don't bother with the Market Grill, service was the worst and food is scarce since they don't come around much with food. 
We get up early to save a hut that are first come first served.  Most are gone by 10am. So do it early if u want shade. 
We bought boogie boards across the streets since we stayed so many days.  Better than renting them, kids have some thing to do in the water.

reviews.author: Michelle L
reviews.title: Paradisus August 2014
reviews.text: This hotel lacked amenities for children. The food was horrible except at Market grill. Unless you get up at 6 am you will not get a spot at the beach or pool area. Very disappointed in this hotel....

reviews.author: Cesar C
reviews.title: Travel with a one yr old
reviews.text:
The best thing about this resort is that it has cribs and booster seats, it also has a huge room in the basement cater to babies and kids. They have squishy floors and toys..and even babysitting services. 
Also the staff is super friendly and you get what you need right away. 
The food was ok, nothing amazing...but they did have lots of seafood, fish and ceviches and mussles. The drinks are pretty dam good..not watered down. Rooms are a bit outdated..but the minibars are great...always stocked with water, beer, pop and m&ms. 
I only had one issue which was at the Perla..is the retaurant outside...you cannot eat there if you are wet and you cannot take food out from there to the beach or pool area. I was turned away with my one year old son...I found it to be rude...and it would have been prevented if I knew this in advance. 
Overall, it was a nice resort..very family oriented...lots of people with kids..but a bit pricey for an august vacation.

reviews.author: BigRick E
reviews.title: Paradisus is Excellent
reviews.text:
First off, we traveled as a family of 22. We all arrived and checked in. There was a few issues with a couple of rooms b/c of the a/c. We were moved and problem taken care of!  The resort smells wonderful. I personally didn't get the concierge service. One person did for his room. We utilized his concierge to accommodate our reservations. It was hard as a large group to sit together but Paradisus did their best. Our favorite was Bana for dinner (sushi). Alejandro went out of his way to take care of us. I failed to mention half of our group is kids ages 6mo-9yrs.. SO you can imagine the mess they can make. Alejandro and team did a great job making sure the kids had their fare share of sushi and food off the kid menu! It was awesome. Adults at one big table and kids at another! Thank you so much Alejandro for the special shots. We have video of him doing great work! We went to other restaurants and they were decent. Fuego's scallops were delicious! We spent most of our trip eating at Nao's which is the buffet restaurant. We usually ate breakfast and lunch here. They always had great options! I liked to thank Javier Zamara who worked both shifts. For our entire stay he somehow knew what time we were coming for breakfast and lunch and had tables on standby for us. It was awesome!! Of course we took care of him each day with a gratuity. I wanted to recognize his super serving skills especially when we kept asking for bacon!! FYI you won't see the best crispy bacon on the buffet. You have to ask for it!! Always ask for something you don't see!! I did and somehow Javier Z was able to make it happen!! This kept our kids happy!!

The pools were fun! They had a kiddy area pool that was about 2.5 ft deep. This was by tower 1 I believe. It was a big pool and our kids were extremely happy b/c they were able to free instead of being stuck in a 5ft wide kid pool. 

For rooms: We had a standard room in the main tower. All towers are connected. At night you could here the music playing from the bar downstairs.. It was a little loud but it's Cancun and you are there to have fun!! The room suited our needs. We even had a pac-n-play with double beds. The couch also folded out to a bed.  I can also tell you that there are rooms bigger than others. Those on corners of the towers are HUGE! There are also rooms with ceiling fans installed. I guess you just have to ask and be specific when you book!

All in all we traveled together and had a great time! 

Thanks to all the servers who took care of ALL of us with a smile!!

reviews.author: Kiana A
reviews.title: Second time to Paradisus
reviews.text: This was a good experience, I loved this hotel the first time so we decided to come back with more people. Everything about the hotel is beautiful and comfortable. I wish that the main buffet dinning area had more selections during breakfast lunch and dinner it was kind of the same thing every day. But overall it was good the otherresurants were great and everything was good. It's not too far from the airport and the place is wonderful the pool is huge and the beach is beautiful even though you can see sea weed from a distance (not a fan of seaweed) but I loved the warmth of the beach it was perfect.

reviews.author: Meghan C
reviews.title: Cancun trip Ruined
reviews.text: The hotel itself was beautiful. That is my only compliment. We waited for 3 hours for our luggage to arrive to our room after check in. It was lost in the hotel because the bellmen brought it to the incorrect room. Glasses and camera were both stolen by employees. All inclusive but need a 24hr reservation before hand was not compensating to us. We would recommend Fiesta Americana Condensa again instead of this hotel. We regret venturing to try a new hotel.

reviews.author: Ece K
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: Royal service was excellent, particularly the pool/cabana area staff. All the hotel employees are wonderful with the best attitude. We only stayed 3 nights and tried Fuego, Bana and Mole, all were very good. I recommend bringing  a lot of singles etc. to tip the staff, because they really go out of their way to help you.

reviews.author: Beth B
reviews.title: paradise
reviews.text: My family and I just returned from The Paradisus , it was a present for my daughters 18th birthday.  I don't even know how to tell you how wonderful it was !!  Lets start with the hotel, is BEAUTUFUL and IMMACULATE. The pictures do not lie , the hotel looks just like them. The rooms are very clean , we had an ocean front room and the view was simply breathtaking. We also opted for the Royal Service and that's how we were treated , like royalty. Our Butler Juan made our trip a wonderful experience, from putting balloons in my daughters room and a cake to scented pillows at night time, he catered to our every whim.  We never knew what to expect when we entered our room at night he always had a wonderful surprise waiting for us. Thank you Juan!! The employees are incredible I really wish I could remember all their names to thank them personally.  The pools are unbelievable! the pool guys are also incredible I am telling you they are right there for you the whole time we were never without a drink or a snack. The real diamond in the rough is Natalia from Royal Service concierge, without her none of this would have been possible.  Natalia is so efficient it is scary. I love you Natalia !!! The restaurants are an experience in themselves, my favorite was Vento, Fuego was also wonderful and the market grill they were all great honestly and the hostesses Jessica, Marcela all of them are just great. Now, don't be expecting American food not gonna happen, but then you are not here to eat American food right? I have no idea how anyone could not enjoy their experience at the Paradisus. I felt like I was with my family that is a special feeling , I did not meet one person I did not like. I will return to the Paradisus for many more years to come as long as they have this quality of service and I know they will because with the employees they have there is NO way it can be anything but EXCELLENT !!!!!  The Richino Family

reviews.author: Joey N
reviews.title: Vacation @ Paradisus Cancun Mexico
reviews.text: I like this resort very much. All the staff are friendly and helpful except for the towel cottage. They were inconsistent with their policies. Sometimes they will ask for cards before giving the towels and sometimes they will just give them away without the card. The water in the beach is great. The food is also excellent. You will never go hungry. Overall, this resort is great....highly recommended.!

reviews.author: Tom M
reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.text:
Where do I start….We have been to about 10 all-inclusive caribbean resorts and this was the BEST! The food was FANTASTIC! (Most all-inclusives are cattle buffets and tired food). I'm guessing this was because we paid the $80 per night, (per room), upgrade for, "The Royal Service." Trust me, if you're without kids, pay the money. They give you a cell phone and you get a personal butler who arranges ALL of your dinner reservations, (this would have been worth the extra money alone, as my guess is that we would have had a hard time getting a reservation without the Royal Service…). You also get 2 days of the, "Bali Beds," which are private cabanas with personal wait service that are insanely comfortable to lounge in. You also have a private tower with no kids, your own private buffet with high end cheeses, meats, beverages and hors douvres, along with a private breakfast in a secluded and tranquil eating area. The last thing about the Royal Service we loved was the spa! We got to use the tranquility pool, which has about 10 different massage stations, a rock fountain to walk while being sprayed on your legs, along with a sauna and steam room. The locker rooms had towel service and felt like a high end country club.
The staff was awesome….Francisco, Gerardo, Javier, Octavio and I'm leaving out the name of our waiter on the romantic dinner who was awesome. Julie, Chely and Miranda? (Orange shirt) were great at the Concierge desk, along with Pedro, Omar, David and Alexander at the pool.
The Sushi place, Bana, was to die for, but all the food was wonderful. Great place, clean, good a/c and the beach and water are beautiful!

reviews.author: JimRachelle
reviews.title: A Great Break from Winter
reviews.text:
The food and atmosphere at Paradisus Cancun is excellent. To live -30celcius and in less than 5 house sitting pool and beach side is amazing. The food is fantastic with the opportunity for al a carte each night. The sushi place in the middle of the hotel in amongst the water and trees was a special evening. Pool side was great and the burgers and nachos by the beach excellent. Paid a bit extra for private beach dinner and it was worth the money. Atmosphere and service is excellent. Stayed in a lagoon view room and it was just okay. Have a drink in one of the lounges inside and sip our your Margarita lounging on a bed with a magnificent view of the ocean.

It is easy to catch a bus and head down to the mall on the bus if shopping is your thing. Only downside is that the chairs on the beach are at a premium and it does not have the same kind of entertainment you may have had in the Dominican at a RIU for example. However endless sand beach and beautiful water and the food and drink service on the beach is excellent. Would stay here again anytime as it has a great location and fantastic food.

reviews.author: Frank R
reviews.title: Great Getaway
reviews.text:
This property is absolutely gorgeous, not to mention the crystal clear water of the Caribbean sea. The service was amazing, the staff at the resort is very attentive, Juan our Butler really went out of his way to please; he made all of our reservations for the restaurants to have dinner (You'll need to make reservations for some of the restaurants), and made recommendation on what tours we would enjoy which he also booked for us. We decided to do the Jungle Tour at AquaWorld right across the street from Paradisus. You'll drive a Speed Boat through the lagoon into the Caribbean sea until you arrive at a coral reef where you'll get to Snorkel for approximately 30mins, the tour is about 1:30 to 2 hours. I'll definitely recommend doing it. But what really impress me about Juan's service, is that one of the nights after we came back to the room from the club, Red Lounge, he placed roses' petals, candles and a bottle of champagne in the room which was quite romantic. Thank you, Juan! 

My experience is based on the Royal Service stay, definitively worth it! Upgrade. Originally we had a lagoon view room and were upgraded to an Ocean view without even asking which was great. When you stay at their 5th pyramid which is the Royal Service, you'll enjoy a private pool and an exclusive restaurant, La Palapa, loved having breakfast and lunch there right by the Ocean. Oh! and yes, Juan also reserve our Bali beds by the pool, once gain thank you! 

The ROOM - The room was very elegant and modern, we had a balcony facing the ocean which was great to relax and enjoy a few drinks. The room has fridge stocked daily with beer, bottled water, and candy. it also has a safe to keep value items.

The SERVICE - JUAN! I mean GREAT!

Restaurants - Try NAOS, Blue Agave, and Vento (Reservation needed) this was my favorite. 

Entertainment -  Every night they have activities in the main Pyramid where very talented artist perform. Also try Red Lounge the DJ was okay at first but definitely got everyone on their feet after an 1hr.

The NEGATIVE -  The main pyramid was a little too warm during my stay compare to the 5th pyramid (Royal Service) which had a great nice and cool temperature. (very pleasant after spending the day outside) MANAGEMENT please do not yell to your employees in front of the guest. Arguments are the last thing I want to heard on a vacation. BUT YOU WERE COMPLETE RIGHT WITH YOUR ARGUMENT but do it behind doors. Other than that this property beautiful and will consider it on my next trip to Cancun!

reviews.author: Rajesh G
reviews.title: Decent hotel
reviews.text: Nice beach. Limited restaurant choices due to need for "reservations" which were mostly booked out much in advance. Naos restaurant was the best choice for world food, available any time of the day. Overall good food wherever we could eat. Best part is restaurant wait staff - excellent service.

reviews.author: I_heart_flipflops
reviews.title: Pleasantly Surprised
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus at the end of May 2014, so I am a little tardy getting this review out.  We have stayed at many AI, but never with the kids (ages 7 and 9).  Our first choice was a Beaches brand resort, but didn't want to fork over the $$$$ (or arm, leg, or kidney) for it.  Cancun has never been our first choice because we prefer Eastern Caribbean but I realize now, it could have been because we never stayed at the Paradisus.  We booked it primarily because we got a great deal on the Family Concierge. 

Check in:  
Upon arrival, we were taken to the Family Concierge Center.  The kids had a blast playing pool, being able to get on the video games while my husband and I took care of business.  The candy jars were also a big hit with the kids.  The wrist bands are not the tacky plastic variety, but thick string with a wooden piece displaying the Paradisus logo.  (My daughter STILL has hers on.)  Andrea and Reyes checked us in, made a dinner reservation for the first night, and explained all procedures.  We were assigned a butler, Hervik, and given a cell phone so that we may contact him, or anyone at Family Concierge.  On the occasions that we visited the center, we were always greeted by name, and a warm smile,  We also had many interactions with Alvaro.  He was WONDERFUL!  Outgoing, pleasant, and would go above and beyond for us.  

Room:

Our room was ENORMOUS!  Very pleased with the mini frig options and that there were two full bathrooms.  It also had two balconies, and the master bedroom balcony wrapped around for more room.  Everything was restocked daily when we returned from the pool/beach.  Milk and cookies were always left for the kids.  They each received backpacks with amenities and pool toys.  Nice touch.  View of the ocean was PHENOMENAL.  Housekeeping was very prompt and we were always stocked with all items we needed.  

Beach:  Gorgeous water.  It does tend to get a little rough making it hard to really enjoy.  There is a strong undertow and we saw a few people in need of rescue.

Pool:

Pool area was great.  The only shallow area is in the kid section.  When you're 5'3", 5.5' of water is very difficult to navigate with a kid on your back or a drink in your hand.  Anuncion, Hector, and Enrique took care of us many days at the pool.  We did tip.  They work hard and always are smiling.  We also rented Bali beds.  It would have been nice to have this option included with Family Concierge.  We did use our coupons to bring the price down from $50 to $35.  Bed #106 offers the best view of water and pool.  

Food:

Very good at most restaurants.  Bana has a great steak.  Oscar, waiter, at the Market Grill was exceptional.  Overall, food was decent.  Better than expected for an AI.  

Kids Zone:

Lots of activities, and kept them entertained.  The girls who work there (Isabel is the only one I can remember off hand) do a fantastic job and are very kind.  

Every staff person we encountered was pleasant and courteous.  We would recommend this hotel and will definitely return.

reviews.author: favoritesun
reviews.title: Wonderful, relaxing vacation
reviews.text: My family and I went to this resort with friends in July.  We all enjoyed the place very much.  The resort was beautiful.  Food and service was great.  Our favorite dinner restaurants were La Perla and The Market Grille. We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: yarianni
reviews.title: BEST VACATIONS!
reviews.text:
The hotel is beautiful, the food is top quality, the attention is the best of all !!!!
We were staying with ocean view in the pyramid 4 The best view !! had the privilege of being cared for in a family concierge by Mr. Hervick  the best Butler a family can have! super helpful and good with children helped us in everything we need in the hotel, restaurant reservations and in the transfer back to the airport, return to Hotel to be seen by him again
When you go to the pool bar, I recommend asking for Simon!! Christian and Enrique are very helpful and the drinks are excellent prepared !! these bartenders are very good guys ...
Finally but not least, Mr. Jesus!! in the restaurant NAO, best service waiter that you can receive in life!!!, excellent service !!! he recommend you the best drinks, and food.
We felt very comfortable in this hotel, everyone was really nice and friendly
I wanted to emphasize the attention of these beautiful people to make us feel better than home !! 
the only thing the hotel needs to improve is the air conditioning, it's hot in closed areas such as the lobby and restaurants.

reviews.author: Rosebud808
reviews.title: Overall, A Nice Vacation But would Not Go Back
reviews.text:
My family and I stayed at this resort from July 24 until July 31, 2014. This was our third visit to an all-inclusive resort in Mexico but our first at Paradisus. I decided to take my family  to this place after reading the good reviews that it received from previous guests. I realize, however, that these reviews were based on individual preferences and expectations. Having said that, I would try to be as fair as I can in expressing my opinions about this particular resort.

The first thing I noticed was the staff's fixation on knowing whether my husband was with me or not (I was accompanied by my 12-year-old son, niece, sister, and brother-in-law). Throughout our stay, there were three staff members who inquired on the whereabouts of my husband, which I found to be bothersome since I felt that it was none of their business (my husband passed away three years ago). I believe that they planned on offering us a membership to their resort but assumed that my husband was the head of the family who would make the final decision on the matter. In terms of customer service, it was either a hit or miss at this resort. Professional courtesy and hospitality were not consistent among the staff members. Although many of them were accommodating, some were rude including the restaurant managers and waiters. When we showed up at a restaurant on our last night, one of the head staff members bluntly told us that we could not be seated before we can even inform him that we actually made a reservation. At another restaurant, we requested a table for 7 since two of our friends were planning on joining us. However, they could not make it. In the middle of our dining, the manager approached us and said that we shouldn't have asked for a table for 7 since there were only 5 of us. All he had to do was politely ask if they could take the two chairs away for the other guests rather than reprimanding us. 

The selections of food at the restaurants were quite varied and the dishes were delicious, including the ones for room service. However, a dinner reservation must be made to most of the restaurants early in the morning for the following day. Most of the waiters were pleasant but the one at the Vento restaurant was the most unfriendly and cold. My friend had to ask this waiter if he had a problem serving us. It was only then that his demeanor changed to a better one. At the end of our dinner, we tipped him which made him a lot warmer and nicer (what money can do). Tipping, of course, was optional but it is customary for us to give a tip, especially since most of the staff at these places are truly hard-working. 

The view at the resort was beautiful. There were two huge pools and the one without the built in bar was not crowded at all. The beach had its white, gorgeous sand but beware when you see the Bali beds. My son and I took one of those not knowing that they were reserved for the VIP guests (a distinction can be made between the VIP guests and ordinary customers through the color of the bracelets that people are made to wear upon their arrival to the hotel). We were approached by a staff who told us that we had to pay $50.00 for using the Bali bed. I gave him our room number so that it could be charged to my account. He said that I couldn't do that. He was showing me a form although he could not articulate what it was all about. He said, "I don't speak English." My son and I packed up our stuff like two people evicted from their house. The resort should employ people in that line of work who can clearly converse with the guests since confusion and frustration can arise from poor communication. 

As I mentioned earlier, this review is based on my experience as a guest of this resort. The satisfaction and enjoyment that a guest derives from a resort is really contingent upon his/her preferences and priorities. When choosing a resort, out of the many, my family and I expect great food and excellent customer service that is consistent throughout. Although the food items and drinks were above average, the quality of customer service did not meet our expectations. Unfortunately, not even the good food and the breathtaking view could make up for the unpleasant aspects of our stay at this resort.

reviews.author: David K
reviews.title: Poor Service
reviews.text:
I gave two stars out of three because for me service out weighs the facility and beach.

STAFF/SERVICE:  This was the rudest staff I've ever experienced on a resort.  Food Service people were very polite and friendly.  However, anyone working behind the desks were much more rude than what I'm used to.  I work in New York City and live in New Jersey so I'm used to rude people and even I was taken by surprised.  Lot of them don't even look at you in the eye when you speak to them.  I've had one staff (Delia) that worked in room registration that rolled her eyes during conversation.  I was also had someone say "it's you again...." when approaching the front desk.  My luggage was lost during the flight and no one helped.  It was left me to keep going to concierge to ask for help.  Even the concierge never went out of their way to help.  I had to explicitly ask them to call the airport for them to assist with the situation.

FACILITY:  Not a bad hotel.  Large hotel so you won't feel trapped.  Rooms are not bad, but stay away from top floor as it gets hotter as your go up floors.  There were no chairs were prepared in my balcony so I had to ask for it.  All other rooms had a chair in the balcony.  The fridge in the room didn't work.  I didn't bother asking them to fix it.  

BEACH:  Beach is not bad as well and plenty of pool space.  Sand is pretty fine and gets finer as you go into the water.  Beach wasn't over crowded, but recommend going out early enough in the morning to claim a chair.  Most people woke up and put their towel on the beach chair before grabbing their breakfast.

FOOD:  I thought the food was good.  Had to wait at least 20 minutes every time I made dinner reservations but was worth it.  Make dinner reservations in the morning as most get booked by night.  

ACTIVITIES:  There is aquawater company right across the street and onsite to entice you with various activities (at cost) so you will have plenty of extra activities to do.  We went on snorkeling package at Isla Mujeres.  Snorkeling itself wasn't impressive and was short, but the trip itself was great as the package includes time on the island.  We rented a golf cart for $30 and rode around the island which was fun.  

Overall, the resort is not bad if you don't mind the rudeness.  If you are like me and service is important to you, avoid this place.

reviews.author: Maria M
reviews.title: Great vacation, hotel, and staff!!!
reviews.text: We had an excellent stay at this resort.  We have visited other melia and Paradisus properties and really enjoyed it here. Great restaurants and great service! We would like to especially recognize Francisco Terrazas.  He was excellent. He was very courteous, personable, and prompt! He really took care of us and made us feel like we were the only people here.  Julie in royal service was also very helpful!   We highly recommend coming here.   Kareem and Maria McCleskey

reviews.author: Myra H
reviews.title: Great time and Experience at Paradisus
reviews.text: We recently returned from our honeymoon at Paradisus in Cancun and we were both thrilled and pleased with our overall experience. We felt pampered and really enjoyed every aspect of our trip and resort.

reviews.author: NRod6
reviews.title: Paradise!!!!
reviews.text:
Paradisus Hotel:  beautiful and very very clean.  Composed of 5 pyramid shaped buildings.  It is very large hotel but everything is walking distance.  The main pyramid is the 3rd one which is right  in the middle.  Most restaurants and bars are located here. Very we'll designed and decorated.  It is even more beautiful at night.  The purple lighting makes it look even more elegant.  The design tries to bring the outside in with all the hanging vines.  Loved the uniqueness of it.

Check in:  smooth and quick.  We needed three rooms and all were in same pyramid and same hallway.  Watch out for the person who escorts you to room.  They are time share reps.  They will try to get you to go to presentation, which you can chose to or not attend.  They are also stationed right by the buffet restaurant Naos.  I did not like they were always there trying to get us to go to the presentation.  One of them even told us that if we didn't attend she would have to pay for us missing the presentation.  Really?  

Check-out:  under five minutes!!!!!

Room: cleaned twice a day.  Very we'll stocked.  Fridge always full plus they leave snacks such as m & m's and chips for the kids.  Room was spacious enough for a family of 4.  Our room had a king size bed and a fold out couch. The balcony was very small and the view is a bit obstructed because of the way it is built.  None the less the ocean view is beautiful.  We he a jacuzzi on the balcony.  Our kids used it a few times.  The drain wasn't good.  Balcony was always wet.  

Room service:  Excellent.  About an hour wait.  There is a variety of food to pick from.  Food on menu is different than that in buffet.  Very tasty food.  Room service was included with the all-inclusive package.

Kids club: check the schedule for daily activities.  My daughter loved going to kids club.  They have a giant inflable slide that she really enjoyed.  For the most part, they had two to three employees watching the kids.  They never had more than 20 kids at a time.  

Restaurants: 
Naos Buffet: some times too crowded.  Servers are good and attentive but always have many tables to wait on.  They have a variety of items to select from. Anything from salads to steak and of course desserts.  Breakfast is also great.  Fresh squeezed juices and a smoothie bar.  They have two people at grill making eggs and omelets.  Line can get long mid morning.  

Blue Agave: tacos n tequila.  Great.  Different types of tacos on corn tortilla.  We ordered family platter which consisted of three tacos of each different meat they offered plus 4 quesadillas. More than enough for 4 people.  

Vento:  Mediterranean.  Delicious.  Do not pass up the opportunity to dine here.  The chef's special entree was great.  Consisted of steak, fish, shrimp.
Beach grill:  Hot wings, burgers, hot dogs, nachos and all the guacamole u can eat.  

La Perla:  pass on this if u like not great.  Service was very slow and there is no air conditioning.

La Parrila:  we had a wonderful ocean and pool side dinner under the moonlight.  Buffet consists of grilled rib eye, New York strip and chicken.  Absolutely great food and very good drinks.

Market Grill:  brazilian style churrasqueria.  Servers come around with scewers of meats.  Very good. Loved the grilled asparagus and mushrooms.

Beach:  gorgeous white sand. Very clean!  Plenty of beach chairs.  Shaded beach chairs get taken up early in the morning.   Water is turquoise and beautiful. It is a little rough. The 7 days we were there the red flag was up.  They do have lifeguards on duty.  I would not let a child under 8 who is not a great swimmer swim without an adult by their side at all times.  Waves were rough.  
We never woke up early to reserve beach chairs but we always found some.  

Bali beds on the beach and by the pool are available for rental.  $30 for the whole day if u use the coupon in coupon book they give u at check in. Totally worth renting for a few days.  We rented one by the pool overlooking the beach so we could go back and forth from beach to pool. 

Pool:  very large and clean.  Runs from pyramid to pyramid so anywhere u find an exit door will lead u to pool.  There is a kid area in pool area in front of pyramid one.  This has a round shallow pool for the little ones and the the shallow end of the large pool with the cool beach chairs built into the pool.  Rent a Bali bed.  There are some that are by the pool and overlook the ocean.  Worth it.

Towels: no need for cards to get towels.  Drawback is people leave towels on chairs and u don't know if they are occupied or not since towels don't need to be turned in.

Shows:  there is nightly entertainment.  Unfortunately we didn't catch many shows to due to the lack of seating.  Shows take place at the Avenue bar.  No matter how early you get there u will end up in the back because there are no seats.  The bar has these cool couch-bed looking seats.  People are rude and will stand in front of couch-beds and block your view.  From what little we were able to catch, shows looked well choreographed and entertaining.

Bars: there are bars in each restaurant, one by beach, and a swim up bar.  I really liked that they serve beer from a can as opposed to draft.  They only carry Mexican beer.  No worries that such a large resort has such few bars, there are always waiters walking around taking drink orders.  You will never need to go to the bar because the waiters are always available.  They will even bring you food from the grill if asked.

Red Lounge Club: never went in because we came with young children but it looked pretty fun.  Some nights it looked really busy others not very much.  

Souvenir Shopping:  stay away from the flea market!!!!  Horrible place.  Every shop person haggles you and the prices are outrageous!!!  If you want a nice place to shop for souvenirs head to Flaming Plaza next to Outback Steakhouse.  There is a really nice shop in the across from Margaritaville Store that has great prices and promotions.  We got a free beach bag with every $70 we purchased.  The have every thing from shirts to tequila.

Worst thing about hotel was the incense.  Very nauseating.  As soon as you walk in the smell hits you.  It's is very strong and aggravating.  I understand the hotel is trying to create a zen feeling but the smell is way too much.

Best thing about this hotel was the service.  We felt welcomed and were waited on hand and foot.  Our cups were never empty (tip: bring a large cup with a lid for your drinks so you don't have to get refilled often).  Bring lots of tip money.  You are going to need it and it is very well deserved.

reviews.author: riteshp923
reviews.title: Food sucks here.
reviews.text: I am at hotel right now and I don't recommend any one this hotel. Food sucks here.  At day bar is only out side. Nothing inside. I have stayed at rui palace and it was great. Hotel is nice and clean but rest sucks. Pool is nice. You to wait in line to have breakfast.

reviews.author: Rachel D
reviews.title: Best vacation
reviews.text:
Had a great time!! Went there with my husband for my birthday and wow, it was amazing!
The hotel is beautiful,the pools are so nice! 
We went jungle river at the aqua water across from the hotel and that was so much fun I recommend it !
The only thing was annoying we had to wait an extra hour to check to our room but beside that was lot of fun 
My favorite resturant is bana and vento
Basically had a great time and definitely will come back:)

reviews.author: nathan w
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: This was an excellent resort.  My wife and I had an excellent time.  The food was great and the service was exceptional.  The par three golf course was not great but enjoyable and well kept.  I would recommend and ocean side room because the view was great.  The evening entertainment was fun.  We went with another couple and neither of us have children.  Even though many of the people there did have children it was not a problem or distraction.  There was plenty of space and  a full no children section that was very quite and relaxing.  We made our arrangements through Berwick Travel and our coordinator was Kelly Pinto.  She was extremely helpful and informative.  Berwick travel made making our arrangements for our trip extremely easy and stress free.  Because of my experience with Kelly Pinto and Berwick Travel I intend to use them for travel in the future.

reviews.author: Shawna H
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: I am a cruiser so this is my first all inclusive resort. We traveled as a couple without children however this was a family friendly resort. Everything was great, no complaints about the food and drink.  The only small issue I had was the amount of children and toddlers in the bar at midnight and the small televisions. We were there during the NBA playoffs so that was an important part of my husband's relaxation and it was hard to enjoy the game with some drinks because kids were everywhere. Not a big deal we know we can jump on the bus for $1 and head into town to Hooters etc. The staff is excellent and Royal Service is the way to go!  Excellent price wise...because we were always on a boat didn't need an ocean view...Lagoon View was perfect! We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Darrell F
reviews.title: Paradisus is Awesome!
reviews.text:
The service here was awesome. Lot's of food options and all great. The pool area and beach were well kept and the entertainment was great. Stayed 6 nights. Visited a few other hotels in the area just for giggles to compare and Paradisus has them hands down. Christian, the bar tender, was great as was all the staff........US hotels can take a page out of the level of service provided by this place. I kept looking for something neutral to comment on but I can't. Right across the street is Aqua World which has everything including renting Waverunners. I'd go there again in a heartbeat. It had a Mexican flavor to it that was great as opposed to let's say the Hard Rock, which is the same everywhere. 

Darrell

reviews.author: SooperJ2S
reviews.title: Ratings always subjective...
reviews.text:
This may be a long review so if you are seriously considering this particular resort, read on...if just browsing, may be too long to be of any interest...

We've just returned from a 7 day stay at Paradisus Cancun in the Family Concierge Room, main pyramid (3), ocean view...The view was AMAZZZING!!  The room however, is centered to the main pool so if there is music and/or people partying in the pool, you can hear it but it did not bother us.  Resort was built in the 70's so although quite beautiful architecturally, rooms are beautiful superficially if you do not look too closely.  With that being said, upon arrival, the resort was HOT.  It takes a day for your body to acclimate but even then, it is hot and humid.  The interior of the resort (to include most of the restaurants), it is NOT air conditioned. Upon arrival, yes, you do notice a strong smell of air freshener that blows out in random places.  As some other reviewers, the smell can be a bit much but you can get use to it...some even like the smell...again, this is subjective.  Our room had air conditioning problems from the first night and it took three staff members to try and correct it...We did not go to the sleep the first night until close to midnight.  Eventually, we were instructed to keep the air conditioning on "on" and not "auto" so that it ran ALL the time and was quite noisy...again, it is something we eventually got use to. Family Concierge included a "butler" for the family.  Our butler was Grace whom we adored.  She always smiled, made all our dinner reservations and got in touch almost every night with random treats -Mexican candy, fish food for the koi, toy for end of visit for the kids. We were given a phone to use during our visit to keep in touch with her.  We actually only needed that once to change a reservation.  Family Concierge also included cookies and milk each night and turn down service.  We received the turn down service twice...even though we reported the lack of this particular service...again, not something that was too bothersome.  One of the annoying things about our housekeeping however, was the lack of towels and inconsistency with the towels.  Almost every day, we had to ask for more washcloths...for four people, we would be left ONE washcloth.  Every day, we received 3 bath towels for four people, never 4, bath rug was left for us twice.  Again, you may receive an excellent housekeeper and never have this issue but even with our butler contacting them, it was a constant issue the entire time we were there.

Food:  Again, this is subjective and I will compare it to cruise food.  The resort is feeding guests that fill 800 rooms.  The buffet is pretty much the same each and every day with very little change.  There are omelet stations in the morning but the lines for eggs was enough for me not to place an order.  I enjoyed the fresh fruit, yogurts and nachos...yes, nachos for breakfast.  Lunch had several types of ceviches (scallop, fish, sometimes octopus, and shrimp), pastas, a meat of some sort or two, a soup, etc.  Dinner buffet was not as good as lunch, in my opinion. The other restaurants that we experienced for dinner were again, nothing overly fabulous but we enjoyed the BBQ outside by the pool overlooking the beach.  The service was also exceptional here with Mario.  Service was also great at the Market Grill for the rodisio-style "meat" dinner...Other then those two restaurants, you can keep the service we received from every one else.  Seriously.  They try hard with the atmosphere but service is mediocre at best.  

Drinks:  When served by servers poolside, you can't taste the alcohol, however, when you order at the pool bars, they are MUCH better.

Pool:  UGH...where do I begin?? This was a very annoying area for us the entire week.  Resort guests save their pool chairs at 6 and 7 AM...they come down, place towels down with maybe a plastic toy or a shirt and go back to bed.  Meanwhile, you can eat breakfast, get to the pool by 9 am, and there is not a seat in sight...no where.  Our first day at the pool was so frustrating.  We got to the pool at almost 10 and there were maybe a dozen people there but not a seat left.  We eventually decided to rent bali beds for the remaining days at $50 (minus $15 each day in coupons we received for staying 7 days) to save ourselves the frustrations of finding a seat.  This is a major sore spot for me because hotel guests are so ignorant but then there appears to be nothing the staff can do.  Apparently, there is "rule" that guests can not save chairs for more than 30 minutes but staff are not allowed to touch personal belongings.  So...no one does anything and everyone continues to be ignorant.  Fabulous.  Makes for frustrations as I watched two families arguing in Spanish over who moved who's things...You almost feel forced to purchase the Bali beds just for your families comfort and security of having a seat for the day.

Entertainment:  VERY small area for the nightly entertainment...We could hear the music, see a bit of something or another but unless you get there early, you will NOT be able to see what's happening.

TIPPING!!!  This is a HUGE topic!!!  When you purchase this all-inclusive package, you are told that the service providers all receive a portion of what you've paid to the resort already.  HOWEVER, you may be told that you do not need to tip and that it is included in your stay but EVERYONE expects to recieve tips...CONSTANTLY.  I wish more reviewers who rave on and on about how fabulous their service was would be honest about how they tipped and when.  In the U.S., we may tip after we've received our service so that we may tip accordingly but in Mexico, let me inform you that if you want a specific type of service, you need to tip BEFORE you receive the service and then continue to do so throughout your stay.  I contacted several reviewers regarding the tipping custom and was told how they tipped...it was hardly ever enough.  

We traveled at the end of July...This is when the Mexican kids are on their short summer break...NOT a good time.  We only met two other American families with kids and they also felt the same as us...second class citizens.  Because we could not speak Spanish, we did not feel as welcome as the Spanish speaking. Perhaps if we had traveled at a different time, our experience could have been better.

Overall, I will say that this is one of the most beautiful beaches I have ever seen.  My family and I had a fabulous time because we made it that way, even with the frustrations we encountered along the way.  Service is not impressive, food is for the masses and property needs some updating.  Our airport transporter told us that the Paradisus was once THE place to stay but has been steadily declining due to age and other amazing resorts going up around Cancun.  We will not be returning.  We will seek other places.  For kids older than 8, i think this resort lacks any type of program for them.  We've only stayed at an all-inclusive one other time and that was a Sandals resort in Jamaica for our honeymoon.  We are not all-inclusive veterans so perhaps our expectations were too high....a smile goes such a long way...we saw so little of this there that when we returned to the States, it made us really appreciate our fellow Americans!

reviews.author: BobcatMD
reviews.title: The good and the bad
reviews.text:
We stayed here 15 year ago and again Aug. 2014. This used to be called the Melia Cancun. The layout and decor have not changed. They would still like to have you listen to their time share and club options but they aren't as aggressive as in the past.  The rooms are spacious and clean, however you can only up the A/C to a certain level (we could not get our room cold enough for our tastes).The all-inclusive gets you all of your meals unless you wish to dine at their elite "Tempo", there is a significant fee for this. When the resort is near full, it is tough to get into the better restaurants- book 2 days in advance.

Drinks are included unless you want top shelf or elegant wines. The house wines are actually quite good. The bartenders and waiters are great- wonderful service. Mole is a romantic restaurant (nuevo Mexican fusion), kudos to staff Leonardo, Rody and Sonia.

A note on golf.They have a 9 hole par 3 course included in all inclusive. You must rent their old steel shaft clubs (no hybrids). The course is poorly mapped and there are no fairways, just 1 to 2 inch Florida grass and the slowest greens you have ever seen. The course looks great from your room but skip it. 

The Gulf water beaches are fantastic and so are the pools. Tons of water fun. The resort is kid friendly. You can wind down and relax at this resort.

reviews.author: Mamie M
reviews.title: A perfect escape!
reviews.text: We selected this property based on positive reviews we had read. Selecting a resort can be a gamble when reviews of all other resorts are similar. Paradisus Cancun is a winner. The Royal Service was beyond our expectations. We hardly availed ourselves of any of the man benefits of Concierge Services. We also greatly appreciated the adult only aspect of the Royal Service section. Our personal concierge was Cesar and he was very attentive. When we checked in I mentioned that I would be looking for some vanilla extract to bring home for a friend.
