Aidee, another concierge told me that she would be happy to get some for me during our stay.  True to her work, and to my surprise, she left a message in our room, before we left, that she had my purchases at their desk. I would recommend this resort to everyone and I hope to return.

reviews.author: Garima K
reviews.title: Excellent location and Hotel
reviews.text: Our vacation in all-inclusive Paradisus Cancun was the best and least expensive vacation we have taken in a while. The rooms were fantastic, the resort was very big and amazing. The beaches and pools were unbelievable. the weather was a bit hot, but doable. I'm vegetarian do food options were limited to pastas and pizzas but other people in our group really enjoyed the food. Overall this was the best vacation we have done in years. I would book Paradisus resort in any other location in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: Cornelia S
reviews.title: Truly a paradise
reviews.text: Coming from Germany my husband and I spend end of June a wonderful week in this great resort. The beach facing room (junior suite is the standard room) was very clean and spacious, the beds very comfortable, the minibar free of charge always filled up.The staff everywhere in the hotel is excellent, extremely friendly and caring for every need. The beach is very clean, the caribbean sea of thousands of shades from turqoise, the warm water crystal-clear. Watch just before the currents and waves, especially children. Life guards at the beach are very attentive. For us the pool was too busy, the water in it too hot to refresh, so staying in the breeze on the beach was perfect. In our one week stay we ate every night in a different à-la-carte restaurant and it was every time a pleasure. The variety of the food and the service was excellent, especially in "Fuego" we felt like we were in a gourmet restaurant. We could not believe that really everything on this high standard is all inclusive. You can enjoy your holiday without any thoughts to make. We can recommend this true paradise with full conviction.

reviews.author: Desiree' C
reviews.title: The Paradisus in Cancun was Paradise
reviews.text: We just came home over the weekend from our 5 day stay in the Royal Service pyramid at the Paradisus.  I miss it soooo much already!! It was such an amazing hotel!  It had a spa-like smell all over and our room was super clean and nice size.  The balcony overlooked the pool and ocean, which is something that is indescribable to see every morning.  I can't speak highly enough about the staff at this hotel; not just in the Royal Service section, but all over.  EVERYONE wanted to serve/help you with whatever you wanted/needed.  Pedro made sure we got a Bali bed every day even on the beach!  Hector was our butler and he was constantly checking on us to see if we needed anything.  He made all of our reservations for both dinner and our bali beds.  Angel and his pool entertainment crew made the day a lot of fun with Zumba, water aerobics, and fun games.  I was simply amazed at how friendly all of the staff were..nobody walked by you without smiling and saying hello or hola.  I loved the little buffet of food and drink the Royal Service had out each day; a very nice touch.  One day at our pool there was a saxophone player...what a great touch relaxing poolside!!  It was very easy to get back and forth from the Royal Service pool and the main pool, which is where the swim up bar is.  That would be my only complaint: the swim up bar was mobbed with kids every day; they shouldn't be allowed at the bar and/or sit on the bar stools.  The Royal Service pool needs a swim up bar even though the wait staff was always checking on you to see if you needed a drink or something to eat, it would still be a nice adults only touch.  I was comfortable throughout the hotel during our stay; however, my boyfriend was extremely hot and very uncomfortable.  We really enjoyed Bana, the sushi restaurant; great food and great service!  The Market Grill was also pretty cool because they just kept coming around with all different types of meat (Fogo de Chao style)...I also loved our bathroom :)  I can't wait to go back to this resort!!  They have 3 other locations...might have to check them out too!

reviews.author: Robert S
reviews.title: Asuncion & Jaime
reviews.text: Aside from some issues with our family concierge, we had a great time.   Nice rooms, good food and entertainment.  Highlights of our trip was the beach.  Kids had a great time and the service from Asuncion from the pool bar was amazing.  She did a tremendous job and met our every need.  Jaime, our waiter at the breakfast buffet was great too.  These two did a terrific job,

reviews.author: ElviaJ
reviews.title: Didnt want to leave.....
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful vacation at this all inclusive resort. You will feel like your in the amazon or staying at a local attraction without leaving. Fifteen minute ride from airport. Vines, beautiful flowers it smelled great throughout the resort. Design by a well known Spanish architect.
The suite was facing the ocean and the pool side. My room was quiet. Large patio doors muffle 
the pool activities. During the morning zumba class is available or you can dance on your bacony as I did. My room was was clean & the beds were comfortable. Fully stock refrigerator on hand with water, local beers and snacks. The food was excellent and abundant. All you can eat breakfast, lunch and dinner.  Reservation are needed for many of the restaurants on site which is also available at no fee. Book ahead many of the restaurant were fantastic. Many Bali beds for a fee and lounger on the beach with tikki umbrellas to shade you. Swim up pool bars and kiddy pools are available. Beach and pool waitress are available to to take your drink order if needed. Bring a book to rest and enjoy the views. Caring staff to assist your every need.  Life guards were on their job saving guest that wondering off into the deep. Small bar lounge available to dance those calories away. Evening entertainment is available off the lobby. Visit coco bongo for entertainment which is off site only a short cab drive away. Rental car service can be arrange to see the local attraction. Many water activities are available for a fee. 
Many snow birds were visiting from all over the east coast getting away from the terrible winter months we had. Not many kids were present when I was there. 
Great value for your money. This place had it all. I really rest and enjoyed myself. I tipped everyone when I left from the table servers to the cleaning staff. Great management, from top to  bottom including the life guards. I will be back!!

reviews.author: Cindy J
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here for our 20th wedding anniversary.   The staff is wonderful.  The hotel was very clean, however the shower/water pressure is a little lacking.  We had Royal Service and I LOVED it.  It felt very quiet, the pool was adults only and never crowded - although I wish it were a little cooler, the water was very warm.  The pool and cabana area is beautiful.  The staff is attentive and friendly.  The beach is clean, white and colors of the ocean were stunning.  We ate at several of the restaurants and the food was delicious, breakfast was great.  Loved the wonderful smells that wafted through the corridors.  ONLY a couple of complaints -- when you first arrive your butler wants to know where to make reservations -- not knowing anything about the hotel, wish they would have not pressured us on what we wanted to do and let us have a minute to read the information they provided so that we could make a more informed decision.  Plus, we didn't want to be scheduled and wanted to take things as they came.  The room was a little warm, even with the air conditioning, but my husband acquired a fan and that made a HUGE difference. Also, for those who worry about money -like me- all inclusive really does mean all inclusive, so don't worry about your meals costing you and the end of your trip -- they really are included, so relax.  Take some advice.....bring tip money -- everyone expects a tip and the pool and restaurant staff honestly work very, very hard, so tip them!!  :)  Overall, we loved this hotel and would highly recommend it.  Also, if you didn't reserve a cabana at the Royal Service pool, if you go after 12:00 in the afternoon, you can still get one - because they always have people not show up for their reservation.  Don't get one by the bar, get one along the edge of the pool area - you get a great breeze and view of the ocean.

reviews.author: Wcurtis
reviews.title: Fun Caribbean Get-Away
reviews.text:
I live in Denver where I can fly direct to Cancun in 4 hours.  Pretty hard to resist taking off for a visit to the clear waters of the Caribbean.  Cancun has so much to offer and there are always great deals.  After seeing all the reviews and comparing prices, we decided on the Paradisus.  It is a beautiful resort in a central location.  In order to help people understand the resort, here a list of some Pros and Cons.

Pros
Food and Beverages:  I was pretty impressed considering it is an all-inclusive.  The food was very high quality and the service of the waitstaff in the restaurants and on the beach was great.  There are a variety of places to eat or grab a drink.  We ate at Fuego, Venta, Mole and the Market Grill.  We didn't really love the Market Grill (Brazilian Style), but the others were very good.  We suggest getting Margaritas at the Blue Agave!  Also, Coco's on the beach is nice in the evening and at night.

Spa:  Try the deep tissue massage from Moses!  The facilities are quite nice (not great) and the staff was very polite and attentive.  The massage was great!

Rooms:  We had an ocean-front room in the main pyramid and were pleased with the maid service and the ocean view (see pictures).  Unfortunately, they had no kings only 2 doubles.   There is no way we were both going to fit in one of those little beds, so we slept separately.  Not really a big deal to me, but that may make some couples very angry.

Beach:  Exactly what you expect in Cancun.  Beautiful soft white sand and clear blue water.  Some waves, but calm enough for kids.  Nice beach palapas for shade.  Great beverage service on the beach as well.

Cons:  
Busy:  I am not sure what it is like at other times of the year, but during the last week of July, this place was BUSY.  If you do not like being aroud a lot of people, this may not be the place for you.  Forget about getting any seating in the shade unless you get up at 7:00am or earlier to reserve a spot (fortunately my boyfriend is an early riser).  The restaurants can be busy and there are tons of kids here, so beware if you don't like that atmosphere (unless you pay extra for the adults-only section).

Restaurant Reservations:  As with most all-inclusive resorts, you have to make dinner reservations the day prior.  Often they will say the restaurants are full, but when you look in they are more that half empty.  When you inquire (and people always do), they say that this is because people make reservations and don't show up.  I don't doubt that is true, but if people don't show up, shouldn't you give the table to a different guest...like every other restaurant on the planet?  This was very frustrating and makes no sense whatsoever.  There was a night when we couldn't get into any of the restaurants (even though we tried the day before as instructed) and had to eat at the buffet.  Not really a big deal, but they were very busy with a line to get in.  For the most part service was good, but I do want to report one sad incident.  At the next table were four ladies in their 60's finishing their dinner when the manager (at the Buffet) comes over and tells them to please hurry up and leave as there are many people waiting for the tables.  Are you kidding?  That was incredibly rude and uncalled for!

Entertainment Area:  So I suppose that this is both a pro and a con, but the entertainment here was amazing!  In my experience these resort shows were never even worth watching, but these people were GOOD!  They had amazing dancers, singers, jugglers, and gymnasts.  Honestly I couldn't believe how good they were...comparable to vegas etc.  Only problem is there was nowhere to sit and watch them.  The shows were in the upstairs bar where about 40 people could sit.  Everyone else had to stand on tiptoes trying to see or get behind them and watch from the back.  I appreciate that they hire good people, but if you can't watch, what is the point?

Anyway, we had a great time and would definitely recommend the resort.  We walked away having felt that it was a great and relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: Luv2share
reviews.title: Good value for the money
reviews.text:
Service:  Loved the staff.  Most were very helpful and always showed up with a smile.  

Food:  A couple of good restaurants (Fuego, Vento, Market Grill) but mostly average.  Portions are quite small and we're "little people".  La Perla was awful - poor food, very warm/muggy as it's outdoors, slow and inattentive wait staff.  We did enjoy the casual tacos only restaurant for late night snacks/second dinner (Blue Agave).  Breakfast was just OK.  Lots of options but most were average at best.  No sausage or bacon though - you'll need to ask for this.  Pool side bar/palapa wasn't bad for mid-day snack.  Wings were awesome.

Small rooms.  If you have a family of four, don't even try it unless your kiddos are under 5.  Fortunately we booked two rooms for a couple of teens and adults.  Lots of bugs in one of our rooms which gave us terrible rashes/bites.  Nothing could be done to get rid of them.  

Pools:  Main pool was nice though you'll need to get up by 6:15 to "reserve" a chair if you want something with shade.  Most mornings all were taken by 6:15 - 6:30.  Oh well - on the bright side I did get to see the sun rise every morning.  The rest of the "sun only" chairs are gone by 8:00.  Pool bar was excellent.  Make sure to ask specifically for your specific tequila/vodka/etc or you'll get a very short pour of the house brands.  Their not too bad though either for the fruity drinks.

Nightly entertainment:  be there by 8:00 or you'll end up standing to watch.  Surprisingly decent shows.  Had one cheesy night (Michael Jackson) but honestly the dance troups were quite good.  Though the venue is tiny, I'd actually have to say their entertainment was on par with some of the nicer hotels we've stayed at.

Overall a good value for the money but FAR from 5 star that most have rated. We travel a lot and typically stay in 4-star hotels if we're able.  Several brands are much better we thought and similarly priced.  Definitely not an Aqua/Westin/upper end Iberostar type resort though that usually commands 4-5 stars.  We'd rate this a 3.5 if half stars were available, mostly due to the efforts of the staff.  For the money we'd stay here again except we rarely stay anywhere twice.  Life's too short!

reviews.author: ttfringe84
reviews.title: Paradise at the Paradisus
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at the Paradisus. Juan at the poolside made certain that we were accommodated with our cabana & lounge chairs. Sammy was very helpful in picking out certain activities for our children. We chose to scuba dive & Jay Jay was our instructor at poolside. He had such a gentle manner with the kids & was very informative. This was very important to have someone explain what to do for the kids. Enrique Diaz, bartender at the Coco Bar provided excellent service with always a smile on his face. We enjoyed our stay at the Paradisus & are planning to come again next year with lots more family members. We are looking forward to seeing everyone again.     Big Al & Therese, New Jersey

reviews.author: Philip_Rogers
reviews.title: Outstanding hotel with exceptional service
reviews.text:
Outstanding hotel with exceptional service. We stayed in Royal Service for 10 days from 19-29 July having booked a very good deal with Melia Rewards points.

The positives:
ALL staff were exceptionally kind, polite and helpful from the Royal Service Manager to the cleaning and waiting staff.  A special thanks to our "butler" Hector who did his best to sort out things we wanted like dinner reservations and an early room service breakfast one morning before an early start day trip.

Very good range of food with something for everyone.  Fuego and Mole restaurants were the best.

Included refreshments in the lounge were excellent particularly after walking in the heat outside.

Right on the beach!  Clear water and sand but waves too strong most days for any serious swimming. 

Room A/C worked well if a little noisy.

Range of shops for toiletries, souvenirs etc.

Very cheap bus service in and out of Cancun city.  Aquaworld is across the road for watersports.

The negatives, if any:
Some restaurants were very hot with little in the way of A/C.

reviews.author: Patti M
reviews.title: Summer 2014 Vacation at the Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We had a suite with the "family concierge" service which was outstanding!  Ramon was our personal concierge.  Besides being very responsive and friendly he went up and beyond our expectations.  Efrain was great also.  Highly recommend this resort.  Beautiful pools with poolside cabanas to get out of the sun.  Beautiful beach.  We thought the the prices were very reasonable for an all inclusive.  We enjoyed the food, there were several restaurants to choose, but our favorite was Blue Agave the taco restaurant.

reviews.author: merlyn j
reviews.title: Great family resort
reviews.text: We were at Paradisus Cancun with our daughters (ages 7 and 11 months). The staff was very friendly. At Naos, the buffet place, Tomas, Orlando, and David were great. They were very polite and attentive. At Market Grill, Misael, Jaime and Jessica were also were friendly and hospitable. Nau at LA Perla was also very nice. The sushi at Bana is not the best but they try. At Bana, they have a live band that plays which adds a nice touch to the dinner.It was my daughter's 7th bday and the band came over and sang to her. This was very much appreciated. The waiter we had was so nice. I regret not writing his name down as well.  The resort overall is very clean and smells nice too. You get the feel of walking into a spa when you walk in with the light music and the fragrant smell. They do have kids zone where they have activities for the kids. Wi fi is not the best. The spa is a little pricey also. Overall I would recommend this to other couples and those traveling with kids.

reviews.author: laura55505
reviews.title: Not a royal service
reviews.text: If you are expecting a royal service like the one in paradisus la perla, this is not the same service,we only see our concierge 2 times, when we called him sometimes he didn't answer, his name was Erick, we asked for Balinese bed on the pool area and he did it for the day that we returned, the bell boy showed up 1 hour before we asked to pick up our luggage and then he never came back.the food in the royal service's restaurant it is excellent, the same in Vento, Market grill, and Bana. I think we will never go back here, excellence playa mujeres or  la perla are much better.

reviews.author: pranieri
reviews.title: Food was not impressive
reviews.text: I spent a week at the paradisus and I will say for the first time ever on vacation I was glad it was over! After reading the reviews I had high expectations so I did expect a five star experience.  First off the good points. Hotel, beach and service at the pool bar and beach was amazing! However the food in the restaurant was very poor quality.  The buffet was good but u can get sick of the same food every day! I can honestly say I will never go back because one of the important things to me is the food.  The entertainment was none existent...they had it only three nights out of the seven so it can be very boring after dinner with kids.  Kids club was so so and there were no events going on during the day.  Oh ya when we got there I was told it was going to be 28 dollars each room to have the rooms beside each other. Really? We paid for two rooms now they want $56 dollars a night to be beside each other.  The management should be embarassed! Again I would recommend somewhere else if u like food and have kids!  I got a T-bone steak one night and was looking forward to it till it got there! It was the worst steak ever so I took a bit and ended up at buffet.  I never take time to send reviews but I don't want people to spend top dollar and be disappointed like my family was!

reviews.author: John F
reviews.title: Very good hospitality
reviews.text: Beautiful property and well maintained along a gorgeous shoreline. The interior of all five buildings were spotless and there are several facilities within. The food is fantastic and the waitstaff is absolutely professional and pleasant all the time. We stayed in the Royal Services area and everyone was fantastic. Special thanks to David and Consuelo who made pool side a pleasure everyday.

reviews.author: Rosy S
reviews.title: Majestic hotel*Impressive service! We'll come back!
reviews.text: This property is situated along the hotel boulevard in Cancun and sits on the shores of a gorgeous emerald green beach. The lobby is impressive and immaculate with marble floors and a welcome staff that greets and assist it's guests at all times. A sunken area in the center, with wooden floors is surrounded by hanging vines that drape from the balconies and a steep, huge, glass ceiling. This adds to a nature-inspired decor that hosts a pond of tropical fishes, a Sushi restaurant and a central fountain that gives added elegance. The rooms are large, comfortable and very clean; many of these rooms have a sitting area and a balcony towards the pool/beach. The restaurants and food are delicious! THIS PLACE IS AWESOME! Come visit Cancun at Paradisus Melia! You'll love it!

reviews.author: charlieaguitas
reviews.title: Very good place
reviews.text: Well guys, here again with a new review. This time is for the Paradisus Cancun, México. As you can see in other reviews, the hotel has very impressive facilities. The construction itself its wonderful, surrounded by beautiful gardens, nice pool area and the extremely beautiful ocean of Cancun. I was traveling with my family again and we took the Ocean View Family Concierge Room. I need to tell that the people in charge is all the time trying to make your vacation experience as favorable as possible, with good attention and service, but when we arrived we got a room on the first floor. My ocean view was a kind of terrace that was below the level of the room and blocked by the garden, so the only chance to see the ocean was step on a chair and lift your head as much as you can. Another disagree was, I was traveling with my kids and since the beginning asked for a double bed room, instead I got a King Size bed with a convertible sofa. My kids spent two nights in the very uncomfortable sofa. I got the promise from the concierge guys to change my room as soon as there was one available, two nights after we moved to a very nice room with a Jacuzzi in the terrace (that was awesome). In general the hotel is a very good place to stay, foods is grate (you can’t miss the tacos) and try to get your reservations for the restaurants upon your arrival, otherwise you will not get any chance for dinner in the very good special restaurants. The ratio cost-benefit for this place is worthy.

reviews.author: piccolove
reviews.title: AMAZING PLACE
reviews.text: I've been here several times including when it was Gran Melia Resort. I have a wonderful experience every time! Zero complaints Every thing is 5 stars from the food to the service. Beautiful rooms, beautiful amenities, and beautiful beaches! LOVE THIS PLACE!

reviews.author: Connie M
reviews.title: Another great time!
reviews.text: This was our second trip to this resort. We were there 3 years ago when it was Gran Melia and enjoyed ourselves so much that we decided to return.  This time other family members joined us.  Upon check in we did have some problems and a problem with one of the rooms losing power a couple of times, but when Fred, the director of operations, learned of this everything changed.  We (3 couples) were all moved to Royal Service and our wonderful vacation began.Fred personally check on us a few times, made reservation in one of the restaurants for us and even arranged our transportation back to the airport in one of the hotel vans.   The resort is simply beautiful and the staff at the pool area and restaurant (David and Sergio) could not have been nicer. We never had to look for them if we needed anything, they almost anticipated our every wish.  The only issue we did have was with the restaurants in the resort.  We like to do all inclusive so we can just order and not have to worry about extra fees.  Many of the restaurants had extra fees for certain meals. We did receive coupons upon check in for discounts but they did not cover the entire charge.  The last time we were there it was truly ALL INCLUSIVE I hope they return to their original policies.  All in all we had a wonderful time and do plan to return again.

reviews.author: gspumoni
reviews.title: Making Great Vacations one family at a time
reviews.text:
This family vacation was 2 years in the making and when the time finally came to go we were all so excited. The first 2 days were rainy and we were a little bummed, but at least were were away from home and there is alot of things within the hotel for the kids to do so they were happy.  My father unbenounced to us had a fever prior to leaving and on the 2nd day began shaking and wasn't able to speak so we rushed him to the E.R.(which is an amazing story in itself) and that is where se spent the next 4 days. Fred had Heard of our situation and came to our room to introduce himself and  discuss what was going on and surprisingly take care or us in a way we never expected.  When my father came out of the hospital Fred took care of everything..he made us dinner reservations, he sent people over to us to make sure we were ok..he came to visit my father a few times a day.  We as a group were all taken back  at the hospitality and quickly went back to vacation mode.  We decided to stay a few extra days and  Fred took care of everything from dealing with the Hotel end to setting up our new flights with the airline. Thank you so much Fred for your Hospitality you went above and beyond anything I have ever experienced!
 NOw for the expeience..This was a special one thanks to Fred and a well oiled staff !
   We were a party of 14 and it only took the staff seeing us once to have our table ready again for breakfast or dinner as soon as they saw us.   They catered to our every need esp. because we went with small children who never liked what was on the menu and the wait staff or the dining room manager were always helpful to make them happy..Happy kids = great vacation..  The Food was amazing..every day the menu changed on the buffet and everything  was always  tasty..We ate at all the resturants and one was better than the next so for us there was never a reason to leave the resort. 
 We were also able to see the giant sea turtles lay their eggs which was absolutely a once in a lifetime experience..the turtles were huge!
Thanks again to the Staff both FOHand BOH for making our vaction a memorable one..We'll be back for sure.

reviews.author: 990efrats
reviews.title: A true paradise in every way
reviews.text:
We LOVED this hotel! I created a Trip Advisor account just to review it. Here's why I loved it:

- Location: Sits on a gorgeous stretch of beach, with the other side of the building facing a lagoon. It's away from the "crazy" part of Cancun, and probably for that reason there were many families staying there and not many drunk college students, which is how I like it. (There was still a bit of night life inside the hotel for those who want it - a bar and a nightclub - and it's a short bus or taxi ride to the central part of Cancun if you want more action.)

- Facilities: The hotel is beautiful! I loved the atmosphere: very modern and hip, mellow and soothing. Every detail has been thought through with great taste, from the gorgeous pools that overlook the ocean, to the modern lounge areas and decor, even down to the soothing smell that follows you throughout the building; it smells like a spa everywhere you go.

- Food: The hotel has several restaurants that each serve different types of food. We ate at each restaurant at least once, and they were all delicious! I love that you can stay there a week and eat at a different restaurant every day. This one restaurant, Tempo, was the BEST food my husband and I have ever eaten - no joke! And we live in San Francisco where we have access to many excellent restaurants. The food at Tempo was so incredible, I cried at one point. Note that Tempo is the only restaurant not included in the all-inclusive deal, so you have to pay extra, but it's sooo worth it! Look for coupons when you arrive at the hotel, which make the restaurant more affordable.

- Staff: The staff at Paradisus was so friendly. We were really impressed with everyone and they really made our vacation so enjoyable and relaxing. If you go to Paradisus - or really, any hotel - please make sure to treat the staff well, and don't forget to tip them. I watched them all work so hard day after day just to make our vacation enjoyable. They deserve the best. 

I want to give a special thanks to the staff, especially: Valeria (she was so warm and friendly, I got teary-eyed saying goodbye to her) and Nacho at Naos; Julio, Joel, Carol and Fernanda at Mole; Margarita, Rodu and Hugo-Natanael at Market Grill; Jose, Hector and Susy at Fuego; Raul and Samuel at Tempo (and of course the brilliant chef whose food I will never forget!); all the cleaning staff that did a great job keeping our room and the entire hotel spotless (even the windows which I saw getting washed several times so they always reflect the clearest view of the ocean); and all the staff that worked tirelessly on the beach, lugging around piles of beach chairs and towels, and serving drinks. Thank you Paradisus! We will be back again for sure.

reviews.author: Maria L
reviews.title: Almost a great Experience!!!
reviews.text: My Family and I went to this hotel to celebrate my moms 50th birthday. We were 20 in our group. I must say this was an amazing and beautiful hotel. but when it came time to go to the restaurants i felt the staff was a bit rude specially the waiters. All the girls were wonderful but the men were very rude. when you ask for something they will slam the stuff on the table. they will get upset if you wouldnt tip them. but how can i tip if the service iam getting is not great. The room we were staying in smell musty even after they will clean it .Also the day of my moms birthday we ask for a table for 20 in the Ibana Restaurant and they sat us in two different table far from each other. They didnt give us menus they just started serving the food without explaining how it works. when we ask the waiter he got upset. They sure need some training in customer service. I must say Asuncion at the Pool bar was excellent.. she was very nice and friendly. Fred the Operations Manager was also very attentive to his wespedes like he would say. The dates i spend there were 8/12-8/17/2013. Dont know if i will return to the Paradisus.

reviews.author: dolcerosa
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text:
I just came back from a 7 day stay at the paradisus with my entire family.
 It was my first time at a resort and they set the standards. Everything was super clean. The staff was very friendly and accommodating. 
Unfortunately when we were there my father became very sick...Diana the Doctor on site was absolutely amazing...and had the best bedside manner. She was comforting and sweet so we felt at ease. She asked about my father every time I saw her with genuine concern. Big thanks to Diana!!!
I would absolutely recommend everyone to stay there. However if you are traveling with elders this may not be the best place for them to stay. For no other reason but for the vastness of the hotel. You have to do a lot of walking to get to the restaurants and the beach. We were in 1 st pyramid and it was a pain. So you had to make sure you have all the things you needed for the day. BC the last thing you wanted was to take time to walk back and forth to rhe room.

We at at the different restaurants everyday BC we all inclusive. But honestly the buffet was my favorite. Breakfast and lunch was different and Deelish with the different meats and fish. It was Awesome. 
All in all I had an amazing time there. The staff was great..food was awesome. The hotel was gorgeous and clean.  

And a special thank you to Fred rhw general manager for all you did for my parents. You went out of your way and I appreciate it.
And a special thanks to the awesome wait staff that waited on us in the buffet every day. They were on point!!!  
Thank you Paradisus!!! Great experience!!

reviews.author: Jarrad H
reviews.title: Fantastic Food Superb Service!
reviews.text: Had dinner at the Market Grill last night. Food was excellent and the service was superb! Special thanks to Jose and Guillermo who kept us well fed with great Brazilian style meats and plenty of good wine and tequila! Also thanks to Margarita and Rody! We will surely be back during our stay at Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: joy m
reviews.title: The complete package!
reviews.text:
This was not our first trip to the Paradisus Cancun and it will surely not be our last!  The property is just beautiful..very relaxing with beautiful gardens inside and out.  The beach is just perfect..white soft sand and rolling waves.  The rooms are lovely with nice comfy beds and great linens. AC works great, and rooms are well appointed.

What really stands out to us is the quality of the staff/service.  Our experience at the vacation club check in was perfect, as usual.  The whole process took less than 10 minutes.  It is always a pleasure to see Ivette, and the outstanding team, who truly goes the extra mile in customer service.

The restaraunts are just great.  The quality of the food and service is top notch. We had the pleasure of meeting a wonderful new staff member..a getleman named Max, who is very warm, friendly, and someone who goes the extra mile to make sure you are completely satisified with every restaraunt experience.  The team in Bana, led by Mario is superb. And..the best sushi I have had!  The Market Grill, led by Rody and his great staff also stands out as first rate!  Jeremiah, Victor and all of the staff are warm, friendly and always deliver great service. The staff and service at Vento, Fuego and Mole are all on par, perfect every time.  Our waiters for breakfast buffet and lunch were the best..Jessy was a lot of fun and spot on with everything!  I wish that I could list each and every member of the staff that delivers great service, but the list would be too long.. And of couse, the signature restaraunt, Tempo, is in a league of its own. Although it is the only restaraunt which is not included, it is well worth a visit. Probably one of the best meals we have ever experienced..including the best of the best in NYC. The staff there is just spectacular, and again, its worth a visit.

The wine manager, Carols Duarte, has been there for years and is just outstanding.  He gave us a reccomendation on a great bottle of french wine that I wish I could find here at home (I want to know where he shops!).  His selections are always outstanding and his knowledge of wines from around the world is just remarkable. For those of you who enjoy great wine..look for him..!  

We look forward to our next visit to Cancun, and it will always be to The Paradisus.  I hope that this review is helpful to anyone considering this great hotel!

reviews.author: jonathan c
reviews.title: Great ambience, stunning resort, lousy housekeeping
reviews.text:
Overall, we found our experience to be memorable. Upon arriving, Guadalupe at the front desk kindly gave us an upgraded room (from lagoon view to highest floor, ocean view room) after I half-jokingly requested the details I just stated. When you enter the center of the resort, you're exposed to an 8-story high open area with pools of water with cod fish, vines draping down all over the place, and so much more to give you an exotic, jungle-like experience perfectly matched with elegance. I've been to 4 other resorts in Cancun before this, and NONE of them, Moon Palace included, offered more stunning interior views. 

The restaurant food is very good, but you have to make a reservation each morning for that night's restaurant choice, so you're stuck with sticking with your dinner plans, or if you bail, you've still got the buffet spot, though it's not that stellar.

The pool length is large and beautiful. The ocean views are incredible.

The biggest complaint I have is room-related: it's small (bathroom is tiny), the walls are thin (we kept hearing the kids next door) and the housekeeping was lousy. The first day I got there, the floor wasn't swept and the shower was dirty. Two of the other days they didn't come clean until after 4 PM.

reviews.author: Melaniethetraveler
reviews.title: I Found it so relaxing
reviews.text:
I went to the hotel a year ago and It was such a great experience to be able to travel to Mexico and stay in that hotel. The service is awesome. I really recommend coming here! 
First of all the beach is like a gigantic pool For real!
The hotel sometimes has a music band, great food, the service from people is impeccable. 
Over all it was an spot on choice. My kids had a lot of fun :)

reviews.author: ShajiS1965
reviews.title: Beautiful with some kinks
reviews.text:
First of all I will definitely go back.  
We went with a large group with kids (4 Families).  We leveraged the Family Concierge Service.  I will rate based on each service.

Family Concierge:  Overall, a pleasant experience but it could have been better.  Many times there were mix ups on the $1000 Voucher we received where we used $300 for room upgrades. During checkout they didn't have it in the system.  Just a little hassle but Natalia the manager was amazing in helping clarify.   Our private so called butler Paty had odd hours and was hardly available when I needed her.  When I called in the morning, she started at 3pm.  I ended up usually the concierge service front desk and they were helpful especially with organizing dinner reservations.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND making dinner reservations ahead of time and Cabanas.  Our kids loved all the free goodies they gave (Cookies, M&M's, usage of the family concierge room with the pool table).  Overall, Paty was helpful when available.  I would definitely recommend the Family Concierge Service.

Restaurants:  Most of the experience was very good.  Bana, the staff seemed very slow but food was good.  Vento was great tapas.  Fuego, the fish was just OK.  Naos had a decent buffet selections but they should have more availability for kids (i.e. Chicken Nuggets and Pizza).  They had pizza on a few days.  Market Grill was excellent and the service from our host Rody was tremendous.  Blue Agave also was excellent but only has Taco's and Quesadillas but the simplicity and quality of the food was very good.  Wish we had a chance to eat at Mole and Tempo but with kids it was difficult as these are adults only.  Overall, a 4 star for all their restaurants.

Bars:  Avenue Bar is excellent and elegant.  Red Lounge is very cool to hang out late at night and dance a little.  

Service:  Now this is where I believe Paradisus excels over the other place.  Except for Bana experience, the service at the Pool, Bar, Restaurants and everywhere else was exceptional.  Very satisfied here.

Red Lounge Dance Club:  Nice concept and we had a blast but the music was the same every night but we were happy that the adults could hang out late and drink while kids were sleeping.

Pool and Pool Bar:  Just excellent.  Only thing is that the main pool is 5 feet and for little kids they can't have a good time. There is a kiddle pool down the end but overall the pool was excellent.  

Beach:  Very good and the waves were tremendous to play in.  Probably the most fun our family had on all beach vacations.  Also, to see sea turtles at night laying eggs and seeing the resort show us the hatchlings were a great experience.

Hotel  Design and Layout:  Just a beautifully designed hotel.  The designer had a great vision when designing.  The central veranda with the greenery and coy ponds and the walkways were just beautiful.  I loved just hanging out there with a cup of coffee early in the morning.  So peaceful.  The rooms also were nice and the view to the ocean was excellent.  DEFINITLEY UPGRADE TO OCEANVIEW.  You will be disappointed with the Lagoon View.  

Vouchers:  We booked directly with Melia and you receive these $1000 hotel credit vouchers. You can only use 1 voucher per service and cannot combine.  For example, the $100 wine vouchers are 5 $20 vouchers.  Each voucher can only be used for one bottle so you have pay for $40 for a $60 bottle of wine.   $300 for room upgrade which we used to upgrade to oceanview. $300 (6 $50 food and credit) which we used for premium alcohol like Blue Label and Don Julio Real but the process was painful.  The $150 Spa Vouchers (3 $50 vouchers) are useless.  Each voucher can only be used once and cannot be combined.  Each massage cost $150 so you have to spend $100 out of pocket.  Regardless we used the hotel upgrade and food and beverage credit.  Good idea but need to be more open on usage.  Can't complain as I drank Blue Label.  :-)

Overall, this resort is excellent and I would recommend it to everyone.  I will definitely go back.

reviews.author: nicolelinsey
reviews.title: Don't upgrade to Royal Service and waste your money!
reviews.text:
Let me start this by saying I have never written a review online before. I feel inclined to share our experience so hopefully other people won't make the same mistake we did. The resort is nice, my husband and I were actually surprised when we walked in that it was nicer than the pictures we saw on tripadvisor. We immediately upgraded to the Royal Service (adults only side) based on what we read here. BIG mistake and huge waste of money. You get a butler but we didn't see him again one time after he brought us to our room the first night. Every time we called him for something we were transferred to someone else. All of the restaurants are in the main tower so you are constantly walking back and forth, which is fine but we were told several things are accessible on the adults only side in the main area but the self serve breakfast for example is horrible. If you are an early riser like we are and you can't drink coffee without cream, good luck getting coffee before 8am. 
It rained almost the entire time we were there, which of course isn't the resorts fault but they should have made up it with the service. Instead there wasn't a bartender to be found. The only helpful person was the cabana/towel boy, Sergio. We loved him! Very nice guy and very helpful but he isn't a waiter or a bartender so there is only so much he can do. We found ourselves on the other side of the resort at the swim up bar where we would have been anyways if we didn't upgrade. So many other complaints that I cant even list them all here. One of the days that it was raining we were coming back in from outside and my husband slipped on the stairs outside. Why you would have wooden stairs painted with a high gloss paint is beyond me. The first drop of rain and they are a huge accident waiting to happen! Trust me, we found out first hand. The manager took us to the nurses station but made him walk there.. WHY?! He is now missing 2 days of work and going to the doctor today... I just hope nothing is broken. I complained to the royal service manager about everything and he reimbursed us some of our upgrade but not enough. I regret that we spent the money to upgrade, period. All in all a huge disappointment for our 4 day getaway. 
** Side note** Don't go to Coco Bongo. Another $150 wasted. The drinks are terrible and if a fire broke out in that place everyone would die! They pack you in like sardines.

reviews.author: jrdavisjr
reviews.title: Average, could be much better, will not return.
reviews.text:
We just returned from our 6-day stay at the Paradisus Cancun yesterday.  Actually happy to be home after this resort stay.  We are not sure how this hotel scored a #20 in Cancun.

PROS: Good 'reservation only' restaurants with excellent food (Vento was the best), good selection of alcohol and beer, decent gym (about the size of a medium cruise ship), friendly bar/wait staff, linens in room were clean and fresh, nice beach (however water is always rough with large waves, not good for most any type of water activity), free WIFI.

CONS: Check-in was an hour long process, room had a dirty toilet with broken door, the buffet had strange tasting, poor quality food (cold items were never cold, and hot items never hot), building was a in severe disrepair - we had a day and a half of rain and it leaked in several areas (window, doors, ceilings) including rooms, no air condition in main hotel (the place was a hot and humid green house in the main pyramid), elevator fire occurred one afternoon during our stay (always unsettling).

Overall we were not impressed with this resort, we would not recommend this place to friends and family, and would not return. You get what you pay for.

reviews.author: julia125
reviews.title: paradisus is a paradise
reviews.text: beautiful hotel.amazing ocean view. food isexcellente. we like the buffet very much, lots of variety, especially Fuego restaurant the food is really good and the service is amazing.the rooms are very clean and comfortable.I WISH I was there everyday we will definitely come back!

reviews.author: osufan01
reviews.title: Great location, service, value, stay...
reviews.text:
I will preface my review with the fact that this is my 6th trip to Cancun area in six years, all at different resorts.
I booked a room in the adults only royal service building, Upon arrival we were greeted at the door promptly and taken to the royal service building 5 to check-in. The check-in process was quick and effecient, they gave us welcoming drinks and our butler showed us to our room. The room was nice, updated, and had a beautiful ocean front veiw. There was only one chair on the balcony which I thought was odd, I asked the butler for an additional chair, he said he would get it but never got it the entire trip. The royal service pool is very calm and relaxing, almost too relaxing. The pool chairs and beds are situated that there is little interaction with other guest...this is good for awhile but if you want any kinda mojo, you have to find your way to the main pool. The bartender, waitress, and towel service employees are great, they wait on you hand and foot and are always friendly and go out of their way to take care off you. The food at the resort is pretty good quality for an all inclusive. The buffet is about your only opition for  breakfast, the buffet is laid out in about 7 different stations, this makes for alot of guest going in every direction, many kids just running around, noisey, I ate there two mornings then opted for room service for breakfast, room service was wonderful.
Book your reservations for dinner 2 days in advance to be sure you get the restaurant and time you want. My favorite was Ventos, it was great, try the sea bass you wont be dissapointed.
The beach area in my opinion is the best along the strip! 
If you want great service, great value, and an overall good experience choose this resort, you'll be glad you did!

reviews.author: Lyka74
reviews.title: OK, but could be better.
reviews.text:
We stayed here 1 wk this August under RCI and as an experienced traveller here's my take:
PROS: Beautiful location, great stretch of white sandy beach, near everything (located at Hotel zone), great Reception area, waiters are nice /ok, KIDS club till 8pm ( great for  families/ couples) without a fee, OK night show, reasonable All Inclusive meal plan.
CONS: Upon check in we ask to change room because bath tub is filthy ( even maintainance man cant take off bath stain/dirt), we got a room change nxt day but here and there some stuff in our new room breaks ( old building needs renovation) ,  when it rains the hallways floor are filled with towels to absorb roof water leaks ( not expected for a highly rated resort), breakfast and lunch All Inclusive is just one restaurant ( buffet) w/c mostly 60% same each day, only dinner varies amongs the 4-5 rest. but u need to reserve ahead cos always full but whenever we eat there, half are not filled.
Miscommunication among staff, they offer you a family concierge which u dont even able to use nor help you at all , @ times makes it more confusing.Night shows is OK ( hit or miss) but is in this just small part of a lounge where people are packed up and you cant even get a good view. The restaurant food are OK but can be better, for the amount they charge ( more than in US) you would expect better.Pool  cabanas are like dinner reservations, always full but never really occupied, there must be a new policy to cancel reservations and let people USE it if no one shows up. SPA charges a lot ( more than in the U.S.) but mediocre service and spa facility needs cleaning and renovation ( looks good online the jacuzzi but not so really) . All tips are included and automatic in your services ( rest., spa etc) . My kid got stomach ache after eating the room service food that took 2+ hrs to come so we used the hotel MD ( private and charges more than $100 USD for consultation and + $100 USD more for Rx).
OVERALL OK especially for kids & families esp. if you want to spend $$ every turn you make , every package you get ,  but its not the luxury , high rated hotel  that it looks like it boast of.
After u spend 3+ days you kinda want to get moving out lol .

reviews.author: McDougall082013
reviews.title: pleasant for the most part
reviews.text: My husband and I made the trip to celebrate our anniversary and my birthday. Upon arrival the service and hospitality of the staff was outstanding and tell you about the amenities and point out were the main service areas are and how and were to get assistance if needed. The staff is always smiling, greeting you and always asking if there is anything that they can do for you. We had a hiccup on our first day though; we have been traveling since 4 am and went straight to the beach right after settling in our room and after spending an hour at the beach and we decided to check the pool area. Coincidently the hotel staff was setting up a "parrillada" aka BBQ right by one of the pools and we decided to go check it out. We were wearing our bathing suits but my husband had a shirt on and I was wear a long sorong that completely covered my bikini. Before joining the parrillada  we  asked a couple of the staff greeting guests by the pool if it was ok to join them and they said "of course, this is a party for all of our guests". We then sat at a table, ordered some drinks and even our waiter offered to take our picture, then we decided to get some food which they had set up in a buffet style. While getting food, a man from the staff dressed in black and with a walkie talkie approached my husband and I and told us that we could not be in the "parrillada" because part of our clothes were wet and we had to go change clothes. It was very embarrasing and the man was not even polite or apologetic about the fact that he was making us leave the party with full plates on hand; his way of handling the situation was very unproffesional and rude and my husband and I did not enjoy the remaining of the day because of that bad experience. I called guest services to file a complaint and they directed me to a complaint department and was told that they were going to look into the issue and follow up with us, but they never did. My husband and I decided that we were not going to let that bad experience ruin the rest of our trip and unstead focused our energy in enjoying the beautiful beach and great outstanding service that we received  from other hotel staff,  specially Rudy that helped us settle in the hotel and was very attentive of our needs every time he would see us in the lobby or hallways. Israel at the swimup bar was amazing, not only did he know how to make all different types of drinks, but he was very polite, fun, friendly and most important, patient with all the high maintenance people at the pool, some of which would order several complex drinks at the time and not bother to leave a tip/gratuity. Mr. Luis at one of the bars by the pool went above and beyond when he surprised me with a plate full of sweet treats that had written "happy birth day" while my husband and I were relaxing at one of the cabanas. Unrelated, the food at all the restaurants in the hotel is very good and has a lot of options! Our favorite was Mole, a mexican restaurant with a contemporary twist. My only complain is that I wish they had an " all seafood" restaurant, or at least more seafood options at their existing restaurants. The lobby is decorated beautifully and the hotel has a contemporary feel throughout.  In addition, we had the opportunity to witness sea turtles nest at night right on the hotel's beach and it was nice to see that the hotel has staff making sure that guests would not disturb or harm the turtles even at 3 am!!  overall our stay was very pleasant, exept for that hiccup on our first day, but I would highly consider going back to Paradisus Cancun again.   (our stay was from August 8-14, room 5511)

reviews.author: bpol57122
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text:
My family of five stayed in the hotel for one week in July. Overall we had a great time. There were a few issues:
Although we had the Family Concierge plan which includes a cell phone to contact the Concierge we were told all the phones were taken when we arrived. We were also told we would not have access to a cabana, even though we were told originally we would have one. On our very last day and just before checking out we discovered a large number of small bugs on one of the walls.
Our phone was out for a few days and when we plugged our computer into one of the wall outlets the outlet almost came out of the wall.

On the first day there at check in we found out about the phone and cabana issue and were not very pleased so we asked to speak to the manager. He came over and after a lengthy talk with us he was able to procure a phone and the cabana.

Were were introduced to the concierge and from there on things got better. The concierge service is worth every cent you pay. The young ladies are polite, courteous, and ast to help you. Every one we worked with was exceptional. I would have have single out Patty, who was there during the day. She is exceptional.

The food was very good, especially the sushi restaurant which we ate at twice and the hotel staff is friendly and aims to please. I am hopeful the bugs were not there the whole time we were in the room, that was concerning and think the room could use some electrical repairs and painting was would definately visit again.

reviews.author: rapte
reviews.title: TERRIBLE SERVICE!!!
reviews.text: It's a very good hotel (great instalations). The bad part is the staff. Constantly all over us trying to sell us every single thing ( time sharing properties...). I had to talk to the General Manager begging him to tell the staff to stop. It was so annoying. they were like flies over us. It was too much.

reviews.author: Jessica T
reviews.title: It is just PERFECT
reviews.text: Its perfect for everybody. I rated cleanliness 5 because nothing is wrong with it. And its only 15 minutes away from the airport. Rooms are very comfortable. I went there with my family and my friend's familf and we werent dissapointed at all. Food is great. There are many restaurats including mexican italian buffe etc. Everything was included. Sometimes the weather was a bit rainy, but it was still a great day because the activity wasnt missing inside. The wonderful sea cant be described!!! It was the most beautiful sea ever!!! Its color and the white sand... I recommend this hotel to everybody.

reviews.author: Betty M
reviews.title: HEAVEN!
reviews.text: Last May I visited Paradusis for a week's stay and it was absolutely wonderful. We had the 'all inclusive' package and we could go anywhere, anytime and do whatever suited us- from the swim up bar, to parasailing, to lazing by the pool in a cabana to chillin on the beach under the straw umbrellas with a book and being served lunch, anytime snacks or frozen libations! The food was fantastic at  ALL of the 9 restaurants we had to choose from and we met wonderful people from all over. Our oceanfront room was spacious and beautiful so that we were able to enjoy coffee and breakfast looking over the beautiful white sand and turquoise water! Their staff was so friendly and helpful also and the Spa there- fabulous. Did I enjoy myself? Would I go back?? Not before tomorrow!!!!

reviews.author: OseaNo
reviews.title: The Most Relaxing Experience
reviews.text:
I came back from Paradisus Cancun.  I stayed with my wife and 19 yr son in a 1 Bedroom Suite at the Club Melia Pyramid 1.  
It was the most relaxing experience.  The Hotel's new restaurants are just AMAZING.
Staff and Personnel are SUPPERB!  Nancy, Claudia, Betsabe, Lolita, Ivette, are just part of my family now.
Enrique, Jessica, Alejandro, and Julio from the swim-up bar are amazing and treat you like royalty.

Laura, Yoli, and Susi are the most attentive waitresses.  Love you girls.

The sea it's amazing.  Water is crystal.  You can see the bottom of the sea.

I recommended to everybody.

Gracias a Todos por su cariño.

reviews.author: Kim D
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun is Paradise
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I just returned from a 6 day / 5 night vacation at the Paradisus Cancun. The resort and the Royal Service was everything we wanted and more... a true paradise! The hotel and the grounds were beautiful and clean. Our Ocean View Suite was spectacular. The food was excellent...from the buffet to the room service to the Royal Service spreads to the a la carte restaurants, the menus and the wait staff were top-notch! Some of our favorite a la carte spots were Blue Agave, Mole, Market Grill and Vento. Everything was a dream, but above everything that made this resort as spectacular as it was, was the caring and kind staff. They were the best of the best! I have to praise two staff members that we already miss. First, I cannot praise our butler Juan enough....he was simply wonderful. He catered to us and exceeded all of our expectations. His thoughtful considerations and kindness helped to make our trip over the top! The resort is lucky to have him on staff! A second person that went above and beyond was the Royal Service Pool Concierge Sergio. He made sure that we had a prime spot wherever we wanted at the pool and on the beach daily and provided service with a smile. Thank you Paradisus Cancun for our vacation in paradise...we will be back!

reviews.author: Spencer E
reviews.title: Great hotel for the money
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful with great pools and beaches. The rooms are very nice and bathrooms are big. We reserve 1bedroom suite but upgraded to a room with 2 bedrooms and bathrooms. The food is just decent but has a lot of variety, you can easily get tired of the food- but remember it's all included and you can always go out and eat. I was there with a 12 and 8 year old for 5 days and we found something on the menu/buffet to eat. For an all inclusive hotel, with even free drinks in your room, you can't beat it. Cancun is expensive, we went to Outback and paid $100 for dinner. Paradisus do the best they can to accomodate you. You can lay at pool all day and eat (they serve hamburger, hotdog, nachos, chips) and drink for free (take plenty of $1 and $5 to tip). It's not a five star hotel but it is very clean and worth the money. Will stay there again.

reviews.author: TellingWHOLEtruth
reviews.title: Ants, dusty, misleading filth Paradisus
reviews.text: Charge me $56 USD for 4 -1min calls. Hotel is dated, needs renovating. Waited 1.5 hrs in our luggage. We finally got it ourselves from the front door. We called them 3 times and they claim they didn't know where it was. We changed rooms 5 times in 3 nights  literally.Rooms were unclean, extremely dusty, 1980s curtains. Ironing board cover had  massive hole and stains in it. The tub didn't drain. ANTS! Tub fixtures a loose from the wall-looked like cheap patch up of fancy fixtures in all 5 rooms. Looks like mole. Got 7 mosquito bites from inside the atrium. More ants.The royal service is a joke! You will not get the preferential treatment reservations or the turn down service. If ur from US, u will hate the food with passion and disgust even at the themed restaurants. Ibana has very basic sushi-rice rolls which was the best restaurant. The extremely small buffet consisted of gross salads like scrambled eggs in red sauce. Everthg had a sauce on it. No cheddar cheese or simple fajitas. Hardly any mexican food u can recognize and I'm from Texas. We had to get gaucamole from the pool area only. Nearly same foods repeated daily. WthYou will have go out to eat on the strip. WTH.This resort ruined our trip!!!!!

reviews.author: jtomusic
reviews.title: It doesn't get much better than this
reviews.text:
We have traveled to most countries of Western Europe as well as many island resorts.  This is the 1st review I have written and for a variety of reasons.  1st, we really, really like this place and have come here 5 times, and 2nd, I can’t believe the reasons some people come up with for complaints. Alright, it is a huge place with 5 zones (towers they are called) and if you get placed in T1 or T5 you may want to plan for the day when you leave in the morning.  We were placed in T1 on our 1st visit and since then, we ask for and receive the assignment to T3 (center).  Now, my wife and I are in our late 60s and appreciate being near to the restaurants, pools etc, but younger people probably might appreciate the privacy that comes with being on the “fringe”. There is easily enough staff to handle the amount of people/rooms and you will not meet a more caring group of people than the Mexicans on the hotel staff.  In any hotel, things can go wrong.  The measure of the service is how quickly and successfully the problem is resolved.  We treated our adult children and their wives/children/girlfriends.  7 people and 3rooms in all.  Our problems consisted of: not enough bedding, TV volume control, water out for 10 minutes, and a few other trivial things.  In each circumstance, the problem was fixed “in a matter of minutes!”
The pools and ocean are just steps away and are in fantastic shape.  They could use a few more cabanas for the amount of people, but no matter what time you get to the pool, you can always find a chair (and shade if you look for it). The food is absolutely great!  I think I counted 10 restaurants and we went to about 6 of them.  Many of them you have to make reservations for so take the time, be flexible and do it. About the only thing I had an issue with was the techno music at the pool. I wanted to read and could not.  That said, there is an “adults only” pool that is much quieter if I wanted to take the 50 extra steps.  This is also a kid friendly place and they were extremely well behaved. The 1st 4 times we stayed here it was the Gran Melia.  This time it was the Paradisus Cancun.  Our worries were of no concern as the hotel is over the top.

reviews.author: Silvanamalita
reviews.title: Great!
reviews.text: Everything about this hotel is amazing,from the rooms,food,costumer service experience.The staff was great.Very welcoming,profesional and helpfuly.The condition of the rooms is also high quality.We had an ocean view suite and it worth every dime we spend.Our buttler Herkiv Lopez was there for us in case if we need something and Karla as well.The restaurant "Fuego" has great food and very nice service.Martin was our waiter and he was very friendly and helpful.Also "Vento" restaurant has mediteranean food and was delicious,Mariowas our waiter.We had a great time,great experience and for sure we will be back.

reviews.author: jenny8117
reviews.title: Better than our honeymoon....
reviews.text:
First of all, I want to say that I have been to Cancun or Riviera Maya (along with Punta Cana) about 20 times.  So I had a lot to compare to and some hard shoes to fill!  Especially because my husband and I were used to such great service on our honeymoon.  This was better, if thats possible.  This is the only hotel which I would like to book again immediately instead of trying something new.  This may be a long review but hopefully it will help!  We also did NOT pay for Royal Service, and would never pay for it after staying our trip...

Ill start with the very slight cons first (Because you know every place has a few).  No, there is usually no welcome drink when you first get there.  I did my research ahead of time and knew this, so didnt expect one.  I did notice that some people got the welcome drinks, but it looked to me as though they were stepping out of a private transfer or a limo.  The hotel must slightly cater to them.  
Also, never try to use your free coupon or resort credits unless you expect to pay about the normal price for a service.  The massage credit is $40, but you have to spend about $55 to USE the credit.  About the same price as a massage at home.  Again, we knew this so didnt even pull the credits out unless we expected to have to pay.  You cant use credits for a room upgrade.
Restaurant reservations are tough to get, so make your reservation the monring BEFORE you want to eat somewhere. Not the same day because they have been booked lately.  Again, we made all of our reservations one day out and got to eat everywhere we wanted.  The first day, we begged Fuego to let us in.  They said to come back in 30 minutes and we got in.  I just wouldnt want to to this every day.

Ok, now that the cons are out of the way Ill tell you more.  When we first got there, someone fgreeted us and showed us where everything was, helped us check inand gave us a rundown of the resort.  Usually at hotels they make you come down the next morning for a welcome breakfast, and than goodness we didnt have to do that.  She did ask if we wantd to do a time share breakfast and we said no.  Were not asked about it again after that.  The wristbands are a lot better than others I am used to!  No plastic, just a nice cloth band with the paradisus symbol.

You know what the lobby and grounds look like from the pictures, but they are about 6 times better than that in person.  Everything looks like just a step above the usual 5 or even 6 star hotels we have been to. Our room was beautiful and on the 8th floor.  No problem at all with room size or view, it was perfect.  Ill add pictures of everything.  The bathroom even had its own balcony with a view.  We had the cleaner come in from 11-12 each day and then also had a nighly turndown service with chocolates!  That was not expected.  The last night, they gave us truffles.  Everything was always stocked perfectly.

The gym was great!  Air conditioned, water always ready for you and enough machines that you didnt feel rushed or missed something you needed.  We used the gym every day and it was great!  They even had 4 pound arm weights which I cannot find in the US.

The beach is the best beach in the strip in my opinion. The waves were just enough to have fun in, but not enough to knock you over most days.  There were 2 out of 6 days that were rougher, but Im a scaredy and still could get out and play in the waves.  Most of the days, you could walk out pretty far and just lay on a raft!  THAT was totally unexpected for me because usually when Im in Cancun I cant get in the water.  We walked down to a bunch of other hotels and their beach was either roped off or there was a lot more seaweed.

Beach service was excellent!  The waiter came to our palapa about every 10 minutes and was always offering drinks.  We just took our towels down there about 8 am and found a spot.  Although there were empty ones, you might want to go at that time to ensure you get the shade and great beach service.  We never use the pool but they seemed to have some fun games going on as well as areas that you could take food anywhere on the beach or pool area.  Nachos, hotdogs, pizza and hamburgers.  We tried all of it!

The restaurants were great!  Vento was our favorite, then probably Bana and Blue Agave, the buffet was ALWAYS amazing, and mole was probably our least favorite.  but again, it always depends what you order.  Its hard to rate restaurants because everyone likes different things.  But we thought Vento was clearly the best.

The night entertainment was in the Avenue Bar each night and was great!  You might want to get there around 8 (eat before or after) and watch the show from the bar or the beds and couches they have.  It fills up quick once the show starts.  All bars (even pool bars) serve Captain Morgan, Jack Daniels, absolute, etc.  Also Grey Goose!  Very good quality and they dont water the drinks down.  They take their time to make sure you have a great drin before they serve.  I wish the Avenue bar were a little more crowded during the day and evening, but it seems that people would rather be on the beach or at the clubs in Cancun.  The shows were very good though and lasted about 45 minutes!  We would have liked a little more nighttime fun, because the Red Lounge is empty as well.  But we made our own fun at the bar!

If there is anything I missed, please dont hesitate to send a message!  This place was amazing in every way!  I will write reviews in excursions later, we did a few. Just book now!!!

reviews.author: Kristin K
reviews.title: Our 2nd wonderful trip at this resort!
reviews.text:
We stayed here 3 years ago when it was the Gran Melia. It was not all inclusive then, but we got the "red service" which is the equivalent of "royal service" now.

Definitely a better selection of restaurants now, more on dining options below. Royal Service is 
the way to go, very quiet, breakfast, coffee, snacks and drinks throughout the day. Dedicated pool and Palopa hut area too. To be honest, Royal Service was even more valuable when the resort wasn't all inclusive since you could have breakfast and snack during the day without having to worry about dinner.

We were very excited to try the new dining options, here's what we found:
1st night: buffet, Naos. We're not buffet people, but it was really good. Every option you could think of, salad, fish, meat, veggies etc. Cactus was the surprise and very good. Calamari grilled to order was excellent.
2nd night: Mole y Tacos - very good ceviche and cochinita pibil. Steak was good but not  outstanding.
3rd night: La Perla - Mexican buffet and show. Wasnt what we expected, we were told it was a seafood restaurant. Food was really good though, Tacos made to order and the Mexican show was a bonus. We generally don't like that type of thing, and it was a little predictable but we actually really enjoyed it, great way to get in the Mexican spirit. 
4th night: Fuego - we had great expectations about this, and were disappointed. Menu sounded great, but my boyfriend had the pork tenderloin and it was pretty tough, I had the sea bass and it was ok. We can't say anything terrible about Fuego, but I guess we expected more.
5th night: Vento - Outstanding. Brilliant. Phenomenal! By our last night we were a little discouraged by the dining options so didn't think this place would be that good. Oh boy were we surprised! Roasted pepper with tuna was sublime. Scallops with melon soup was superb. Spinach and goat cheese salad delicious. Octopus awesome. Duck breast fantastic. Truffled sea bass divine. Probably would have eaten he every night in retrospect!

Staff were unbelievably pleasant and friendly the whole time. Consuela by the pool, Lourdes at checkin, Octavio in the royal service area and our butler Juan Jose made the trip. They were all genuinely happy to have us stay there and be their guests, not that type of fake pleasantry you see all too often from service staff who are just trying to get a good tip.

reviews.author: Josette M
reviews.title: SIMPLY WONDERFUL!!!
reviews.text: The hotel is breathtaking. Lobby is beautiful and smells Amazing. The food is top notch. Service is excellent from the minute you walk through the door. Everything is WONDERFUL about this place. The spa is amazing. The wait staff is great, Orland in Naos/Vento, Miguel, the Mole staff is wonderful. Lolita was a great help also.

reviews.author: TDY2013
reviews.title: Beautiful resort on the beach
reviews.text: Excellent service, accomodations, and food. The staff was extremely friendly, courteous, and professional. We are already planning a trip back  a few months. A special thanks to David Sergio, our pool concierge. He did a great job anticipating our every need.

reviews.author: MariaIztchelAlcala
reviews.title: An Unique Experience
reviews.text: This hotel is what perhaps defines a genuine vacation in one  of the most beautiful places in the world, Cancun. Not only is it all-inclusive hotel, but it is also a hotel that through it's workers/crew delivers a sensation that makes whoever is staying the most important person in the world. Besides from this, the rooms in my case were phenomenal due to their location and it's first world feel. For example, me and my family only had to walk several steps and were already at either the beach or the pool. Then, after having fun for a couple of hours at the beach and pool, we would enjoy a cold drink through the room's refrigerator. I know and have stayed in five star hotels such as Riu and can assure you won't regret that the money you saved and spent on this hotel.

reviews.author: Rovena B
reviews.title: Exellent.. I'll definitely go back..
reviews.text:
First of all thank u to all the staff of this resort and a special thanks to family concierge staff for making my vacation a dream come true..
Thank u Karla u'r an Angel ,are families had a blast and u were great ...(our concierge )
We stayed at this resort for 10 days ,we were two families and we had kids .We arrived there early ,the check in was at 3.00 but the staff at family  concierge were so nice and they offered us drinks and showed us around and actually we had lunch and kids had fun at the kids zone before our rooms were ready.
The rooms are very clean ,the bathrooms as well ,they clean them twice a day .The staff is so good and always with a smile at their faces.Everyone always ready to help .There were waiters by the pool ,waiters by the beach always asking if we needed anything .We had wi-fi all the time ,and they gave us phones as well just in case if we needed anything while we were outside the room .
Overall we all had a great time at this resort ,my suggestions to people who read my review and they plan to go to this resort is to call them two days prior they arrival and to make sure they make reservations for the restaurants that they want and for the cabana  by the pool for the days that they are staying ,and make sure that they are getting the rooms that they want,with the view that they want,this  way they will be happy and have nothing to complain .For us was not such a big deal because Naos   always had good food and you don't need reservation for that,you have to wait on line sometimes but everyone has plenty of time  when they are in vacation.They made fresh omelets and fresh juices the way u liked it every morning and for people that can't wait 5 min they have other choices ready for them.The credit coupons that they give I didn't really find it helpful ,because u still have to pay like 90% of the price ( like the spa or the wine ) because u have to pay taxes and services as well..
My suggestion for the administration of the resort , please leave an empty envelope  by the rooms because we never saw the ladies that cleaned our rooms ,and they deserve to be appreciated for they work ,and the pool bar should not close so early, because people stay at the pool until 7 and sometimes even later.
I will definitely recommend this resort ,for everyone.If they have kids they have great pools ,great beach and very clean  ,they have activities ,the kids zone it's huge and the kids have so much fun in   it.They offer babysitter service for the kids if the parents want to go somewhere .For adults they can go out ,the city it's like 20 min away and the night life it's great .     
Thank u paradisus  Cancun ,and thanks to all your staff  and to family concierge keep up the good work ..
Well be back..

reviews.author: aloha0000
reviews.title: beautiful resort with a few kinks
reviews.text:
We’ve been in Cancun may times before and have stayed at all the royal resorts, the palace resorts, le blanc and others  and this is our first time with Paradisus in cancun, the one in punta cana is much better . The resort has many beautiful aspects and i understand that there can be hiccups at any resort. what sets this resort apart from other "luxury" resorts, is the unfortunately slow response and the attitude towards the customer when handling them.   I have traveled extensively around the world, and have stayed at 2 of melia’s properties, 1 in punta cana and now here in cancun.  They have great food and good service once u established grounds, meaning tipping well.  Would our group come back, I don’t know.  Would I recommend this place, I would if they have smaller groups of under 10.
We are a group of multi-families (39 of us) that travels together every summer to different places in the carribbean, and this time we stayed 8 days at Paradisus Cancun during jul27-aug3. We picked this resort because they did a great job when we were in punta cana last year.  This hotel is beautifully decorated, the pools are great and beach is white sand and pristine clear.  My husband and I have stayed at many different resorts thruout the last 20 years at different resorts in cancun and this one is great if there were only the 2 of us but for a big group, I am not sure if our group would ever come back.  Food choices are excellent at some and the buffet is decent, better at melia in punta cana . There're no time share salemen as people stated here. The rooms are not as nice as the pictures shown on website. The wi-fi internet works great throughout the hotel and but not so good in the room. Here are a few things I want you to know before booking with Paradisus Cancun:
Our big group arrived at the resort, and no one was there to greet us with a drink or even a welcome smile.  We clearly requested that our 11 rooms be close to one another as we all have small children, we also emailed the resort 2 times after booking to ensure that everything was in place and they promised that we would do their best to have our 11 rooms as close to each other as possible. Well when we got to the hotel to our surprise our rooms were in two different buildings and on 4 different floors in 1 building.
