The receptionist told us that she guaranteed for us to have all the rooms on 2 floors in the same building the next day when other guests have checked out. After 2 hrs at the reception’s desk, 1 of the 10 rooms were ready at 3pm, and some of us can finally walk the 16 kids down to the buffet so they can have lunch. I had to stick around to finish checking the rest of the rooms in.  I was told that there weren't any rooms available until at least 4pm so come back then. My room was finally available around 5:30 and I walked in to a room filled with cigarette smoke,  at that point I became really upset. Called to tell them and came back an hour later and smell was gone.  The very next day we noticed food on the wall in the patio that was left there from who knows when, and air condition was leaking and lights in the toilet were burned out.  Called and they came up to fix after about 2 hrs of waiting.  
On the 2nd day I came down to get some of the rooms moved from another building as they have promised and one of the room was not available until after 3pm.  I asked about the $1000 resort credit but it was not in the system that we even had this credit for our rooms and was asked to show them my reseversation with that confirmation, they quoted that my travel agent probably told me that so I will book with them.  I told them I booked directly with MELIA.COM and it was on the site.  I came back and showed them my confirmation but of course the people that could confirm this credit are now gone for the day so I have to wait til tomorrow when they come in so receptionist can verify.  While I was here, I asked them to check and see if our rates are going to be the same as what I reserved them for and guess what, the rates were all higher that what I had booked them thru MELIA.COM for (at least $1000 US more).  I was elated at this time, and asked them to check into it because there was no way I am paying $11,000 more for our 11 rooms.  
On the 3rd day, I came down and talked to the manager alberto chan, he said that the credit was good to go for all of our rooms, however we all had to be there to sign for our credits and I was assured that when they come to sign it should only take a minute to get their credit booklet,  of course some of the rooms got the credit and others did not.  At this point I lost it, this is the 3rd day of my vacation that I had to come back and take care of their screw ups…and they had the nerve to tell me that even though the credit is not in the system, out of the goodness of his heart, he is giving it to us…  we asked to use our room upgrades using our $300 credit and was told that we were supposed to do that within 24 hrs of checking in, mind u we finally got the credits 3 days after with much aggravation. And of course, all the ocean view were not available, only the rooms in the royal service bldg. is but u can’t be in there because kids aren’t allowed.  And there were no family concierge rooms were available either so the credits were useless.  At this time, I lost it, totally lost it.    A couple of people went to the spa for massages and use their credits and was told that if they use their credit the massage is at a standard rate of $141 for 50 mins, their cost out of pocket would be $91, but they are running a special right now at $71, total cost, without using their credit.  What a SCAM~!!!!!!!!  So disappointed. 
As for reservation to restaurants for a big group, more than 4 people, is impossible.  The largest number of people in reservation is 12 people at either 6:15pm or 10pm, now who eats at 6:15pm????  But when u sit down at any of those restaurant with your group of 12, like we did at the Market grill one night and noticed that most of the tables were empty.  We asked for another table of 4 added to our, we were told that the restaurant is totally booked and after much begging, we got 4 more added and we were told everyone has to be there in 10 mins otherwise we will not be served.  Food was good but salty, so salty that we had to go to the buffet and get veggies to wash it down with.  Our group tip very well, for that dinner, party of 16, we tipped a total of $60, this is the average when we sit down and eat at any restaurants.  After the manager and the staff realized that we are the group to go after, they told the rest of the resort staff about us so now everyone wants us to eat at their restaurants.  The very next day 2 restaurants were fighting to serve the fish, that fished on our deep sea fishing trip,.  We tipped the chef $40 to cook and $30 to the manager, and $70 to the staff.  At this point we can get reservation to any restaurants of our likings at anytime.  Bana was excellent, we dined there 2 nights.  
The resort manager, fred, called and apoligied for the screw ups that we experienced and tried to make up to us by offering to sit all of us at the restaurant of our choice at 10pm on our last day so we can at least have 1 meal together without all the hassles.  The chef, Alberto worked with us on the menu, and the manager, inacio gave us 4 waiters just for our party and we get to pick where to sit in the restaurant too.  Thank u guys for a great meal.  
Fred the manager asked me if there’s anything he can do to make up for all the screw ups and he did follow thru on one of the offers with the restaurant  but I am still waiting for him to follow thru on the other offer of 5 bathrobes for the girls all under 12 yrs old, that they would totally love to have, but haven’t seen anything yet so maybe I shouldn’t hold my breath hah. Lol…….
This is the first resort that I've ever had to set foot in the reception area more than once or twice or three times after checking in to a resort.  The waiters and the housekeeping staff were wonderful as was the food at this resort. I just regret all of the arguing that we had to do the first 3 days there, who wants to spend 3 days in a row(total of about 8 hrs) arguing about the problems with rooms and credits. I also thought they would have more cultural events but this didn't happen. The entertainment pretty much ended at 9:30 every night.  The red lounge sucks, the music sucks. The drinks all over inconsistent as well, the servers at the Avenue Bar were wonderful to us since we are big tippers and so was the swim up bar! We never send any of our kids to get drinks or food without tip money, the wait staff loved waiting on our kids.  Beach was beautiful and clean, the pools were good for adults, not kid friendly, the kiddy pool is truely is for the "kiddies", the one right off of the Market Grill could use some music and a swim up bar, it would get so boring there. there were lack of games around the pool for both adults and kids.

I am a firm believer in judging a place on how they handle "challenges". i just returned from another visit to cancun and now see how a luxury resort should handle problems. promptly and without hesitation. the customer is always right attitude. i felt at every turn at Paradisus that i was a "complainer" when in actuality, i should have gotten the rooms and the services that we paid for and not running around the first three days trying correct their screw ups.
the overall feel at the resort was not quite what i am used to in Mexico or anywhere in the carribbean. at times i felt that workers avoided contact as if they did not want you to ask for anything. of course there were many nice people, but i just noticed an overwhelming amount of people who looked too busy to help.
1)  The staff is nice overall but you HAVE to ask for everything.
2) Services along the pool and beach are very slow. The resort is too BIG for some but not for us. It takes long time for them to go over each section of the pool.
3) Forget about booking cabanas, they’re all reserved way in advance. 
4) The restaurants are IMPOSSIBLE to book for a big group the time you’d like so be flexible and get ready. The buffet and a la carte ones do not provide much variety of sea foods. But lots of meats for meat lover.
5) Nightly entertainment is just one hour and not much interaction like other resorts, we’re quiet disappointed. 
6) It is so bloody hot in the lobby area and Avenue bar because there’s no AC. They have many fish ponds thus there are lot of MOSQUITOS. We got bitten quiet a bit. I didn’t realize mosquitoes are in the rooms until my daughter got bitten so many times.
7) TEMPO is very expensive. Even with the vouchers
8) Overall the foods are great. (Except not lots of sea food choices). We love Vento, and Bana. They’re hard to book so book in advance.
9) Across the street is AquaWorld for water activities. You can kayak for free.
10) The kid pool is very nice but too shallow it can be long walk. The other pools are deep and not kid friendly, it’s 6 feet deep, and it drops to 5 ½ to 6 feet as u enter to pool, so if u r 6 and under forget about walking in the pool with a drink, and they don’t have infinity pools.

reviews.author: IdealistRealist
reviews.title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
reviews.text:
This is my seventh time in Cancun and I have always selected this hotel (previously the Gran Melia) due to their attention to detail.  I have used their Royal Service each and every time (worth it).

Melia Hotels International still owns this hotel which recently changed names from the previous Gran Melia to the Paradisus.  The big difference is that now they are all-inclusive.

Unfortunately, I did not have the usual excellent experience during my stay from July 14th to July 19th.  Let me explain:

THE GOOD
The new butler service at the Royal Service Tower was quite good.  My assigned butler, Hector, was attentive and professional.  The best change was the all inclusive package.  The food from Vento, Fuego and Mole were delicious!  This was not always the case when it was the Gran Melia.  As usual, the Royal Service desk personnel were courteous and highly professional.

THE BAD
As I mentioned before, I have been a guest at this hotel several times, always choosing the Royal Service Tower.  I previously requested via email (never received a reply) and made a follow up phone call to Reservations get a room either in the 4th or 5th floor.  During the phone call, I was assured by the reservations representative, Victor,  that all was OK.  Upon arrival, I found out I was assigned to the basement level.  Personnel was unable to accommodate me and did not offer a complimentary upgrade.   Mind you, I am a loyal client and paid top money for the Royal Service.  Oh well, the room was OK but, did not have the views that I was accustomed to.

THE UGLY
In the past (when it was the Gran Melia), it was customary for Royal Service clients to request late check out (up to 4:00 p.m.).  This time I was told that I had to pay (an additional $90) to do so.  Interesting, in various traveling websites, the Paradisus offers late check out up to 4:00 p.m. as part of the Royal Service package.  I was still charged the additional $90.00.  I later contacted via email the hotel's General Manager Conrad [--](conrad[--]@melia.com) and the Royal Service Manager Lazaro [--] (lazaro[--]@melia.com) on July 21st requesting they look into this matter.  As of today (8/3/13) neither has responded. I intend to contact Corporate offices in Spain.

In sum, I am very disappointed with the new Management of this Hotel.  The previous General Manager, Rolf [--], would respond to my emails in a timely manner. This hotel has been a home away from home and I was hoping to come back soon.  I am not sure anymore.

reviews.author: MrLomas
reviews.title: Not a bad spot on the strip... Nice interior courtyards.
reviews.text: The six story high ceiling to floor hanging green vines in the courtyard of each compound are what help save this resort from Cancun-strip mediocrity. They make for a somewhat surreal and exciting atmosphere. The staff are wonderfully accommodating, with the only let down (for me) being a slightly dated room and non functioning spa. Still, location is perfect and the greenery that adorns each compound makes for a superb in-resort experience. Not half bad if Cancun is your thing... it isn't mine though.

reviews.author: Ashley K
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort- AMAZING SERVICE!!
reviews.text:
My husband and I recently went to Paradisus in Cancun for 10 days for our honeymoon...we had an incredible time!  The place was absolutely beautiful!  When we first got there we were greeted, by name, and welcomed into the resort personally.  We offered a drink and check in was smooth and quick!  Our room was very clean and the ocean view was perfect!  I recommend getting an ocean view room if you stay there because the lagoon view is not as good.  The food was excellent.  There are many restaurants to choose from.  Our favorites were Bana and Market Grill.  Our waiters at all of the restaurants were extremely polite, helpful, and friendly!  They felt more like friends to us as our vacation went on!  Two great gentlemen that worked there were Eric (Bana restaurant) and Enrique (pool bartender).  Both Eric and Enrique were super friendly, helpful, and made our experience that much better.  We enjoyed talking with them all throughout our vacation.  They were excellent!!

We can't say anything bad about this resort...we loved the food, room, view, service, amenities, etc!!  The beach was beauitful and the pool was a lot of fun to hang out in during the day. The hotel was constantly being cleaned!  I don't think there was ever a time where I didnt see someone cleaning something or fixing something up to make it look nicer.

Recommendations:

There are shows every night at Avenue Bar.  I recommend getting there around 745-8 (show starts at 830) so that you get a good seat for the show.  If not, you will have to stand and you won't get a good view.  

Make reservations for restaurants in the morning especially if you are a party of more than 2.  We were 2 people, so we really didn't have a problem, but I heard it was hard to get reservations for larger parties sometimes.

The shaded areas at the pool fill up fast.  You might want to go to the pool early to get a lounge chair in the shade.  THere is always shade available on the beach though.  That didn't seem to fill up as fast.

Stay at this resort! And ask for Eric (Bana Bar) and Enrique(pool bartender)!!!
